This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.

# File Summary

## Purpose
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

## File Format
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A header with the file path (## File: path/to/file)
  b. The full contents of the file in a code block

## Usage Guidelines
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

## Notes
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/*.meta, **/*.unity, **/*.prefab, **/*.asset
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

## File: Core/Audio/Runtime/AudioAgent.cs
````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Audio;

namespace FRFrame
{
    internal sealed class AudioAgent
    {
        private readonly AudioManager _manager;
        private readonly AudioCategory _category;
        private readonly Transform _transform;
        private readonly AudioSource _source;
        private ResourceHandle<AudioClip> _resourceHandle;
        private AudioPlayOptions _options;
        private bool _hasResourceHandle;
        private bool _hasFollowTarget;
        private bool _stopReported;
        private float _baseVolume = 1f;
        private float _fadeTimer;
        private float _fadeDuration;
        private float _fadeStartVolume;
        private float _fadeTargetVolume;
        private Vector3 _lastFollowPosition;

        public int Id { get; private set; }
        public AudioAgentState State { get; private set; } = AudioAgentState.Idle;
        public ResourceKey Key { get; private set; }
        public float Elapsed { get; private set; }
        public int Priority => _options != null ? _options.Priority : 0;
        public bool IsIdle => State == AudioAgentState.Idle;
        public bool IsPlayingLike => State == AudioAgentState.Playing || State == AudioAgentState.FadingIn || State == AudioAgentState.FadingOut || State == AudioAgentState.Paused;
        public bool PersistentAcrossScene => _options != null && _options.PersistentAcrossScene;

        public AudioAgent(AudioManager manager, AudioCategory category, Transform parent, int index, AudioGroupConfig config, AudioMixerGroup mixerGroup)
        {
            _manager = manager;
            _category = category;
            GameObject go = new GameObject($"AudioAgent_{category.Type}_{index}");
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            _transform = go.transform;
            _source = go.AddComponent<AudioSource>();
            _source.playOnAwake = false;
            _source.outputAudioMixerGroup = mixerGroup;
            ApplyGroupConfig(config);
        }

        public void ApplyGroupConfig(AudioGroupConfig config)
        {
            _source.rolloffMode = config.RolloffMode;
            _source.minDistance = config.MinDistance;
            _source.maxDistance = config.MaxDistance;
        }

        public void PlayLoaded(int id, ResourceKey key, ResourceHandle<AudioClip> resourceHandle, AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            ClearCurrent(false, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
            _hasResourceHandle = true;
            _resourceHandle = resourceHandle;
            PlayInternal(id, key, resourceHandle.Asset, options);
        }

        public void PlayClip(int id, AudioClip clip, AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            ClearCurrent(false, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
            _hasResourceHandle = false;
            _resourceHandle = null;
            PlayInternal(id, default, clip, options);
        }

        public void MarkLoading(int id, ResourceKey key, AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            ClearCurrent(false, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
            Id = id;
            Key = key;
            _options = options;
            Elapsed = 0f;
            _stopReported = false;
            State = AudioAgentState.Loading;
        }

        public void Stop(float fadeOut, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            if (State == AudioAgentState.Idle)
                return;

            if (State == AudioAgentState.Loading)
            {
                ClearCurrent(true, reason);
                return;
            }

            if (fadeOut > 0f && _source.isPlaying)
            {
                BeginFade(_source.volume, 0f, fadeOut, AudioAgentState.FadingOut);
                State = AudioAgentState.FadingOut;
                return;
            }

            ClearCurrent(true, reason);
        }

        public void Pause()
        {
            if (!IsPlayingLike || State == AudioAgentState.Paused)
                return;
            _source.Pause();
            State = AudioAgentState.Paused;
        }

        public void Resume()
        {
            if (State != AudioAgentState.Paused)
                return;
            _source.UnPause();
            State = AudioAgentState.Playing;
        }

        public void SetVolume(float volume)
        {
            _baseVolume = Mathf.Clamp01(volume);
            if (State != AudioAgentState.FadingIn && State != AudioAgentState.FadingOut)
                _source.volume = _baseVolume;
        }

        public void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            if (State == AudioAgentState.Idle || State == AudioAgentState.Loading)
                return;

            Elapsed += unscaledDeltaTime;
            UpdateFollowTarget();
            UpdateFade(unscaledDeltaTime);

            if ((State == AudioAgentState.Playing || State == AudioAgentState.FadingIn) && !_source.loop && !_source.isPlaying)
                ClearCurrent(true, AudioStopReason.Finished);
        }

        public AudioAgentSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            return new AudioAgentSnapshot
            {
                Id = Id,
                State = State,
                Location = Key.Location,
                PackageName = Key.PackageName,
                ClipName = _source.clip != null ? _source.clip.name : null,
                Loop = _source.loop,
                Priority = Priority,
                Volume = _baseVolume,
                Elapsed = Elapsed
            };
        }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            ClearCurrent(false, AudioStopReason.ManagerDestroyed);
            if (_transform != null)
                Object.Destroy(_transform.gameObject);
        }

        private void PlayInternal(int id, ResourceKey key, AudioClip clip, AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            Id = id;
            Key = key;
            _options = options ?? new AudioPlayOptions();
            _baseVolume = Mathf.Clamp01(_options.Volume);
            Elapsed = 0f;
            _stopReported = false;

            _source.clip = clip;
            _source.loop = _options.Loop;
            _source.pitch = _options.Pitch;
            _source.panStereo = _options.PanStereo;
            _source.spatialBlend = _options.SpatialBlend;
            _source.minDistance = _options.MinDistance;
            _source.maxDistance = _options.MaxDistance;
            _source.volume = _options.FadeIn > 0f ? 0f : _baseVolume;

            if (_options.FollowTarget != null)
            {
                _hasFollowTarget = true;
                _lastFollowPosition = _options.FollowTarget.position;
                _transform.position = _lastFollowPosition;
            }
            else if (_options.Position.HasValue)
            {
                _transform.position = _options.Position.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                _transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
            }

            if (clip == null)
            {
                ClearCurrent(true, AudioStopReason.LoadFailed);
                return;
            }

            _source.Play();
            if (_options.FadeIn > 0f)
                BeginFade(0f, _baseVolume, _options.FadeIn, AudioAgentState.FadingIn);
            else
                State = AudioAgentState.Playing;
        }

        private void UpdateFollowTarget()
        {
            if (_options == null || _options.FollowTarget == null)
            {
                if (_options != null && _hasFollowTarget && _options.Loop && State != AudioAgentState.FadingOut)
                    Stop(_options.FadeOut, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
                return;
            }

            _lastFollowPosition = _options.FollowTarget.position;
            _transform.position = _lastFollowPosition;
        }

        private void BeginFade(float startVolume, float targetVolume, float duration, AudioAgentState state)
        {
            _fadeStartVolume = startVolume;
            _fadeTargetVolume = targetVolume;
            _fadeDuration = Mathf.Max(0.0001f, duration);
            _fadeTimer = 0f;
            State = state;
        }

        private void UpdateFade(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (State != AudioAgentState.FadingIn && State != AudioAgentState.FadingOut)
                return;

            _fadeTimer += deltaTime;
            float t = Mathf.Clamp01(_fadeTimer / _fadeDuration);
            _source.volume = Mathf.Lerp(_fadeStartVolume, _fadeTargetVolume, t);

            if (t < 1f)
                return;

            if (State == AudioAgentState.FadingOut)
                ClearCurrent(true, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
            else
                State = AudioAgentState.Playing;
        }

        private void ClearCurrent(bool reportStop, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            int oldId = Id;
            bool shouldReport = reportStop && !_stopReported && oldId > 0;
            _stopReported = true;

            if (_source != null)
            {
                _source.Stop();
                _source.clip = null;
            }

            // The playback handle is owned by the agent. Release it on every stop;
            // otherwise ReleaseOnStop=false silently loses the only release path.
            if (_hasResourceHandle)
                _resourceHandle?.Release();

            _hasResourceHandle = false;
            _resourceHandle = null;
            _options = null;
            Key = default;
            Id = 0;
            Elapsed = 0f;
            _fadeTimer = 0f;
            _lastFollowPosition = default;
            _hasFollowTarget = false;
            State = AudioAgentState.Idle;

            if (shouldReport)
                _manager.NotifyAgentStopped(oldId, reason);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Audio;

namespace FRFrame
{
    internal sealed class AudioCategory
    {
        private readonly AudioManager _manager;
        private readonly List<AudioAgent> _agents = new List<AudioAgent>();
        private readonly string _volumeParameter;
        private readonly AudioMixer _mixer;
        private bool _paused;
        private bool _mute;
        private float _volume = 1f;

        public AudioType Type { get; }
        public string Name { get; }
        public bool AllowSteal { get; }
        public bool AvoidStealSamePriority { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<AudioAgent> Agents => _agents;
        public bool Paused => _paused;

        public bool Mute
        {
            get => _mute;
            set
            {
                _mute = value;
                ApplyMixerVolume();
            }
        }

        public float Volume
        {
            get => _volume;
            set
            {
                _volume = Mathf.Clamp01(value);
                ApplyMixerVolume();
            }
        }

        public AudioCategory(AudioManager manager, AudioGroupConfig config, Transform parent, AudioMixer mixer)
        {
            _manager = manager;
            _mixer = mixer;
            Type = config.Type;
            Name = string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.MixerGroupName) ? config.Type.ToString() : config.MixerGroupName;
            _volumeParameter = string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.VolumeParameter) ? $"{config.Type}Volume" : config.VolumeParameter;
            _volume = Mathf.Clamp01(config.Volume);
            _mute = config.Mute;
            AllowSteal = config.AllowSteal;
            AvoidStealSamePriority = config.AvoidStealSamePriority;

            Transform categoryRoot = new GameObject(Name).transform;
            categoryRoot.SetParent(parent, false);
            AudioMixerGroup mixerGroup = FindMixerGroup(mixer, Name);
            int count = Mathf.Max(1, config.AgentCount);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                _agents.Add(new AudioAgent(manager, this, categoryRoot, i, config, mixerGroup));

            ApplyMixerVolume();
        }

        public AudioAgent SelectAgent(AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_agents[i].IsIdle)
                    return _agents[i];
            }

            if (!AllowSteal)
                return null;

            AudioAgent selected = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
            {
                AudioAgent agent = _agents[i];
                if (agent.Priority < options.Priority)
                {
                    if (selected == null || agent.Priority < selected.Priority || agent.Elapsed > selected.Elapsed)
                        selected = agent;
                }
                else if (!AvoidStealSamePriority && agent.Priority == options.Priority)
                {
                    if (selected == null || agent.Elapsed > selected.Elapsed)
                        selected = agent;
                }
            }

            return selected;
        }

        public void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
                _agents[i].Update(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
        }

        public void StopAll(float fadeOut, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
                _agents[i].Stop(fadeOut, reason);
        }

        public void StopNonPersistent()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!_agents[i].PersistentAcrossScene)
                    _agents[i].Stop(0f, AudioStopReason.SceneChanged);
            }
        }

        public void PauseAll()
        {
            _paused = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
                _agents[i].Pause();
        }

        public void ResumeAll()
        {
            _paused = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
                _agents[i].Resume();
        }

        public AudioAgent FindAgent(int id)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_agents[i].Id == id)
                    return _agents[i];
            }

            return null;
        }

        public AudioCategorySnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            var snapshot = new AudioCategorySnapshot
            {
                Type = Type,
                Name = Name,
                Volume = Volume,
                Mute = Mute,
                Paused = Paused,
                AgentCount = _agents.Count
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
            {
                AudioAgentSnapshot agent = _agents[i].CreateSnapshot();
                snapshot.Agents.Add(agent);
                switch (agent.State)
                {
                    case AudioAgentState.Idle:
                        snapshot.IdleCount++;
                        break;
                    case AudioAgentState.Loading:
                        snapshot.LoadingCount++;
                        break;
                    default:
                        snapshot.PlayingCount++;
                        break;
                }
            }

            return snapshot;
        }

        public void Destroy()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _agents.Count; i++)
                _agents[i].Destroy();
            _agents.Clear();
        }

        private void ApplyMixerVolume()
        {
            if (_mixer == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_volumeParameter))
                return;
            _mixer.SetFloat(_volumeParameter, AudioManager.LinearToDb(_mute ? 0f : _volume));
        }

        private static AudioMixerGroup FindMixerGroup(AudioMixer mixer, string name)
        {
            if (mixer == null)
                return null;

            AudioMixerGroup[] groups = mixer.FindMatchingGroups(name);
            if (groups != null && groups.Length > 0)
                return groups[0];

            groups = mixer.FindMatchingGroups("Master");
            return groups != null && groups.Length > 0 ? groups[0] : null;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class AudioEvents
    {
        public event Action<AudioHandle> PlayStarted;
        public event Action<AudioHandle, AudioStopReason> PlayStopped;
        public event Action<ResourceKey, string> LoadFailed;
        public event Action<AudioType, float> VolumeChanged;
        public event Action<AudioType, bool> MuteChanged;

        internal void RaisePlayStarted(AudioHandle handle)
        {
            PlayStarted?.Invoke(handle);
        }

        internal void RaisePlayStopped(AudioHandle handle, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            PlayStopped?.Invoke(handle, reason);
        }

        internal void RaiseLoadFailed(ResourceKey key, string error)
        {
            LoadFailed?.Invoke(key, error);
        }

        internal void RaiseVolumeChanged(AudioType type, float volume)
        {
            VolumeChanged?.Invoke(type, volume);
        }

        internal void RaiseMuteChanged(AudioType type, bool mute)
        {
            MuteChanged?.Invoke(type, mute);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public readonly struct AudioHandle : IEquatable<AudioHandle>
    {
        private readonly AudioManager _manager;

        public int Id { get; }
        public bool IsValid => _manager != null && Id > 0 && _manager.IsHandleValid(this);

        internal AudioHandle(AudioManager manager, int id)
        {
            _manager = manager;
            Id = id;
        }

        public void Stop(float fadeOut = 0f)
        {
            _manager?.Stop(this, fadeOut);
        }

        public void Pause()
        {
            _manager?.Pause(this);
        }

        public void Resume()
        {
            _manager?.Resume(this);
        }

        public void SetVolume(float volume)
        {
            _manager?.SetHandleVolume(this, volume);
        }

        public bool Equals(AudioHandle other)
        {
            return Id == other.Id;
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is AudioHandle other && Equals(other);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return Id;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Audio/Runtime/AudioManager.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Audio;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class AudioManager : IManagerBase
    {
        private const string DefaultConfigPath = "FRFrameAudioConfig";
        private readonly Dictionary<AudioType, AudioCategory> _categories = new Dictionary<AudioType, AudioCategory>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, AudioAgent> _agentsById = new Dictionary<int, AudioAgent>();
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, ResourceHandle<AudioClip>> _preloadedClips = new Dictionary<ResourceKey, ResourceHandle<AudioClip>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, UniTask<ResourceHandle<AudioClip>>> _preloadTasks = new Dictionary<ResourceKey, UniTask<ResourceHandle<AudioClip>>>();
        private readonly HashSet<int> _loadingIds = new HashSet<int>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, AudioScope> _scopes = new Dictionary<string, AudioScope>();
        private int _serialSeed;
        private int _musicRequestVersion;
        private Transform _audioRoot;
        private AudioMixer _mixer;
        private float _masterVolume = 1f;
        private bool _masterMute;
        private int _stealCount;
        private int _playFailureCount;
        private bool _destroyed;
        private bool _initialized;

        public override int Priority => 15;
        public AudioEvents Events { get; } = new AudioEvents();
        public AudioMixer Mixer => _mixer;

        public float MasterVolume
        {
            get => _masterVolume;
            set
            {
                _masterVolume = Mathf.Clamp01(value);
                ApplyMasterVolume();
            }
        }

        public bool MasterMute
        {
            get => _masterMute;
            set
            {
                _masterMute = value;
                ApplyMasterVolume();
            }
        }

        public override async UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            if (_initialized || _destroyed)
                return;

            await FRFM.WaitReady<ResourceManager>();
            if (_destroyed)
                return;

            InitializeDirectPlayback();
        }

        /// <summary>Initializes the existing categories/agents for already loaded AudioClips without
        /// awaiting the asset loader. Permanent Gameplay Labs and direct-reference presentation backends
        /// use this path; location-based asynchronous playback still requires ResourceManager readiness.</summary>
        public void InitializeDirectPlayback(AudioModuleConfig config = null)
        {
            if (_initialized || _destroyed) return;
            BuildAudioRoot();
            config = config != null ? config : Resources.Load<AudioModuleConfig>(DefaultConfigPath);
            bool ownsConfig = config == null;
            if (config == null)
                config = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<AudioModuleConfig>();

            _mixer = config.Mixer;
            _masterVolume = config.MasterVolume;
            _masterMute = config.MasterMute;
            BuildCategories(config);
            ApplyMasterVolume();
            SceneManager.activeSceneChanged += OnActiveSceneChanged;
            _initialized = true;
            if (ownsConfig) { if (Application.isPlaying) UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(config); else UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(config); }
            FRLog.Info("AudioManager initialized.");
        }

        public override void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            foreach (AudioCategory category in _categories.Values)
                category.Update(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
        }

        public override void Destroy()
        {
            if (_destroyed)
                return;

            _destroyed = true;
            _initialized = false;
            SceneManager.activeSceneChanged -= OnActiveSceneChanged;
            _musicRequestVersion++;

            foreach (AudioScope scope in new List<AudioScope>(_scopes.Values))
                scope.Dispose();
            _scopes.Clear();

            StopAll(null, 0f, AudioStopReason.ManagerDestroyed);
            ReleaseAllPreloaded();

            foreach (AudioCategory category in _categories.Values)
                category.Destroy();
            _categories.Clear();
            _agentsById.Clear();
            _loadingIds.Clear();
            _preloadTasks.Clear();

            if (_audioRoot != null)
            {
                Object.Destroy(_audioRoot.gameObject);
                _audioRoot = null;
            }

            FRLog.Info("AudioManager destroyed.");
        }

        public AudioScope CreateScope(string name, string packageName = null)
        {
            if (_destroyed)
                return null;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            {
                FRLog.Error("CreateAudioScope failed, name is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            if (_scopes.TryGetValue(name, out AudioScope scope) && !scope.IsDisposed)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(scope.PackageName, packageName, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    FRLog.Warning($"CreateAudioScope got existing scope with different package. name:{name}, current:{scope.PackageName}, requested:{packageName}");
                return scope;
            }

            scope = new AudioScope(this, name, packageName);
            _scopes[name] = scope;
            return scope;
        }

        internal void RemoveScope(AudioScope scope)
        {
            if (scope != null && _scopes.TryGetValue(scope.Name, out AudioScope current) && current == scope)
                _scopes.Remove(scope.Name);
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayMusicAsync(string location, float fadeOut = 0.3f, float fadeIn = 0.3f, string packageName = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested || _destroyed)
                return default;

            StopAll(AudioType.Music, fadeOut);
            int requestVersion = ++_musicRequestVersion;
            AudioHandle handle = await PlayAsync(location, new AudioPlayOptions
            {
                Type = AudioType.Music,
                PackageName = packageName,
                Loop = true,
                FadeIn = fadeIn,
                FadeOut = fadeOut,
                Priority = int.MaxValue
            }, cancellationToken);

            if (requestVersion != _musicRequestVersion)
            {
                handle.Stop();
                return default;
            }

            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayAmbienceAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            options = PrepareOptions(options, AudioType.Ambience);
            return await PlayAsync(location, options, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlaySoundAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            options = PrepareOptions(options, AudioType.Sound);
            return await PlayAsync(location, options, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayUISoundAsync(string location, float volume = 1f, string packageName = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return await PlayAsync(location, new AudioPlayOptions
            {
                Type = AudioType.UISound,
                Volume = volume,
                PackageName = packageName
            }, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayVoiceAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            options = PrepareOptions(options, AudioType.Voice);
            return await PlayAsync(location, options, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            options ??= new AudioPlayOptions();
            return await PlayAsync(new ResourceKey(options.PackageName, location), options, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayAsync(ResourceKey key, AudioPlayOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            options ??= new AudioPlayOptions();
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested || _destroyed)
                return default;

            key = FRFM.Resource.NormalizeKey(new ResourceKey(string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.PackageName) ? key.PackageName : options.PackageName, key.Location));
            if (!_categories.TryGetValue(options.Type, out AudioCategory category))
            {
                _playFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Error($"Play audio failed, category not found : {options.Type}");
                return default;
            }

            AudioAgent agent = category.SelectAgent(options);
            if (agent == null)
            {
                _playFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Warning($"Play audio failed, no available agent : {key}");
                return default;
            }

            if (!agent.IsIdle)
            {
                _stealCount++;
                agent.Stop(options.FadeOut > 0f ? options.FadeOut : 0.15f, AudioStopReason.Stolen);
            }

            int id = NextId();
            AudioHandle handle = new AudioHandle(this, id);
            _agentsById[id] = agent;
            _loadingIds.Add(id);
            agent.MarkLoading(id, key, options.Clone());

            ResourceHandle<AudioClip> resourceHandle;
            try
            {
                ResourceLoadOptions loadOptions = new ResourceLoadOptions
                {
                    CancellationToken = cancellationToken
                };
                if (_preloadedClips.TryGetValue(key, out ResourceHandle<AudioClip> preloaded) && preloaded.IsValid)
                {
                    AudioClip cachedClip = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<AudioClip>(key, loadOptions);
                    resourceHandle = new ResourceHandle<AudioClip>(FRFM.Resource, key, cachedClip);
                }
                else
                {
                    resourceHandle = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetHandleAsync<AudioClip>(key, loadOptions);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                _loadingIds.Remove(id);
                if (_agentsById.TryGetValue(id, out AudioAgent failedAgent) && failedAgent == agent)
                    agent.Stop(0f, AudioStopReason.LoadFailed);
                FRLog.Error($"Play audio load exception : {key}, {exception.Message}");
                Events.RaiseLoadFailed(key, exception.Message);
                return default;
            }

            _loadingIds.Remove(id);
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested || _destroyed)
            {
                resourceHandle?.Release();
                if (_agentsById.TryGetValue(id, out AudioAgent canceledAgent) && canceledAgent == agent)
                    agent.Stop(0f, AudioStopReason.ScopeDisposed);
                return default;
            }

            if (!_agentsById.TryGetValue(id, out AudioAgent currentAgent) || currentAgent != agent || agent.Id != id)
            {
                resourceHandle?.Release();
                return default;
            }

            if (resourceHandle == null || !resourceHandle.IsValid)
            {
                _agentsById.Remove(id);
                agent.Stop(0f, AudioStopReason.LoadFailed);
                Events.RaiseLoadFailed(key, "load failed");
                return default;
            }

            agent.PlayLoaded(id, key, resourceHandle, options.Clone());
            Events.RaisePlayStarted(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public AudioHandle Play(AudioClip clip, AudioPlayOptions options = null)
        {
            if (_destroyed || clip == null)
                return default;

            options ??= new AudioPlayOptions();
            if (!_categories.TryGetValue(options.Type, out AudioCategory category))
            {
                _playFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Error($"Play audio clip failed, category not found : {options.Type}");
                return default;
            }

            AudioAgent agent = category.SelectAgent(options);
            if (agent == null)
            {
                _playFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Warning($"Play audio clip failed, no available agent : {clip.name}");
                return default;
            }

            if (!agent.IsIdle)
            {
                _stealCount++;
                agent.Stop(options.FadeOut > 0f ? options.FadeOut : 0.15f, AudioStopReason.Stolen);
            }

            int id = NextId();
            var handle = new AudioHandle(this, id);
            _agentsById[id] = agent;
            agent.PlayClip(id, clip, options.Clone());
            Events.RaisePlayStarted(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public bool Stop(AudioHandle handle, float fadeOut = 0f)
        {
            if (!_agentsById.TryGetValue(handle.Id, out AudioAgent agent))
                return false;
            agent.Stop(fadeOut, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
            return true;
        }

        public void StopAll(AudioType? type = null, float fadeOut = 0f)
        {
            if (!type.HasValue || type.Value == AudioType.Music)
                _musicRequestVersion++;
            StopAll(type, fadeOut, AudioStopReason.Stopped);
        }

        public void Pause(AudioHandle handle)
        {
            if (_agentsById.TryGetValue(handle.Id, out AudioAgent agent))
                agent.Pause();
        }

        public void Resume(AudioHandle handle)
        {
            if (_agentsById.TryGetValue(handle.Id, out AudioAgent agent))
                agent.Resume();
        }

        public void PauseAll(AudioType? type = null)
        {
            foreach (var pair in _categories)
            {
                if (!type.HasValue || pair.Key == type.Value)
                    pair.Value.PauseAll();
            }
        }

        public void ResumeAll(AudioType? type = null)
        {
            foreach (var pair in _categories)
            {
                if (!type.HasValue || pair.Key == type.Value)
                    pair.Value.ResumeAll();
            }
        }

        public bool IsHandleValid(AudioHandle handle)
        {
            return _agentsById.ContainsKey(handle.Id);
        }

        public void SetHandleVolume(AudioHandle handle, float volume)
        {
            if (_agentsById.TryGetValue(handle.Id, out AudioAgent agent))
                agent.SetVolume(volume);
        }

        public float GetVolume(AudioType type)
        {
            return _categories.TryGetValue(type, out AudioCategory category) ? category.Volume : 0f;
        }

        public void SetVolume(AudioType type, float volume)
        {
            if (!_categories.TryGetValue(type, out AudioCategory category))
                return;
            category.Volume = volume;
            Events.RaiseVolumeChanged(type, category.Volume);
        }

        public bool GetMute(AudioType type)
        {
            return _categories.TryGetValue(type, out AudioCategory category) && category.Mute;
        }

        public void SetMute(AudioType type, bool mute)
        {
            if (!_categories.TryGetValue(type, out AudioCategory category))
                return;
            category.Mute = mute;
            Events.RaiseMuteChanged(type, mute);
        }

        public async UniTask PreloadAsync(string location, AudioType type, string packageName = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            await PreloadAsync(new ResourceKey(packageName, location), type, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask PreloadAsync(ResourceKey key, AudioType type, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            key = FRFM.Resource.NormalizeKey(key);
            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested || _destroyed)
                return;

            if (_preloadedClips.TryGetValue(key, out ResourceHandle<AudioClip> existing) && existing.IsValid)
                return;

            if (!_preloadTasks.TryGetValue(key, out UniTask<ResourceHandle<AudioClip>> preloadTask))
            {
                preloadTask = LoadAndStorePreloadAsync(key);
                _preloadTasks[key] = preloadTask;
            }

            try
            {
                await preloadTask.AttachExternalCancellation(cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                // The shared preload continues for other callers; this caller is done.
            }
        }

        public void ReleasePreloaded(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            ReleasePreloaded(new ResourceKey(packageName, location));
        }

        public void ReleasePreloaded(ResourceKey key)
        {
            key = FRFM.Resource.NormalizeKey(key);
            if (!_preloadedClips.TryGetValue(key, out ResourceHandle<AudioClip> handle))
                return;
            handle.Release();
            _preloadedClips.Remove(key);
        }

        public void ReleaseAllPreloaded()
        {
            foreach (ResourceHandle<AudioClip> handle in _preloadedClips.Values)
                handle.Release();
            _preloadedClips.Clear();
        }

        public AudioDiagnosticsSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            var snapshot = new AudioDiagnosticsSnapshot
            {
                LoadingCount = _loadingIds.Count,
                PreloadedClipCount = _preloadedClips.Count,
                StealCount = _stealCount,
                PlayFailureCount = _playFailureCount
            };

            foreach (AudioCategory category in _categories.Values)
            {
                AudioCategorySnapshot categorySnapshot = category.CreateSnapshot();
                snapshot.Categories.Add(categorySnapshot);
                snapshot.PlayingCount += categorySnapshot.PlayingCount;
            }

            return snapshot;
        }

        internal void NotifyAgentStopped(int id, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            _agentsById.Remove(id);
            _loadingIds.Remove(id);
            Events.RaisePlayStopped(new AudioHandle(this, id), reason);
        }

        internal static float LinearToDb(float volume)
        {
            return volume <= 0.0001f ? -80f : Mathf.Log10(volume) * 20f;
        }

        private void BuildAudioRoot()
        {
            _audioRoot = FRFrameRoot.Get().GetOrCreateCompoent("Audio");
        }

        private async UniTask<ResourceHandle<AudioClip>> LoadAndStorePreloadAsync(ResourceKey key)
        {
            try
            {
                ResourceHandle<AudioClip> handle = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetHandleAsync<AudioClip>(key);
                if (_destroyed || handle == null || !handle.IsValid)
                {
                    handle?.Release();
                    return handle;
                }

                if (_preloadedClips.TryGetValue(key, out ResourceHandle<AudioClip> existing))
                {
                    handle.Release();
                    return existing;
                }

                _preloadedClips[key] = handle;
                return handle;
            }
            finally
            {
                _preloadTasks.Remove(key);
            }
        }

        private void OnActiveSceneChanged(Scene oldScene, Scene newScene)
        {
            foreach (AudioCategory category in _categories.Values)
                category.StopNonPersistent();
        }

        private void BuildCategories(AudioModuleConfig config)
        {
            _categories.Clear();
            List<AudioGroupConfig> groups = config.Groups != null && config.Groups.Count > 0
                ? config.Groups
                : ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<AudioModuleConfig>().Groups;

            for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
            {
                AudioGroupConfig group = groups[i];
                _categories[group.Type] = new AudioCategory(this, group, _audioRoot, _mixer);
            }
        }

        private void ApplyMasterVolume()
        {
            if (_mixer != null)
                _mixer.SetFloat("MasterVolume", LinearToDb(_masterMute ? 0f : _masterVolume));
            else
                AudioListener.volume = _masterMute ? 0f : _masterVolume;
        }

        private AudioPlayOptions PrepareOptions(AudioPlayOptions options, AudioType type)
        {
            options ??= new AudioPlayOptions();
            options.Type = type;
            return options;
        }

        private void StopAll(AudioType? type, float fadeOut, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            foreach (var pair in _categories)
            {
                if (!type.HasValue || pair.Key == type.Value)
                    pair.Value.StopAll(fadeOut, reason);
            }
        }

        private int NextId()
        {
            _serialSeed++;
            if (_serialSeed <= 0)
                _serialSeed = 1;
            return _serialSeed;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Audio/Runtime/AudioScope.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class AudioScope : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly AudioManager _audioManager;
        private readonly HashSet<AudioHandle> _handles = new HashSet<AudioHandle>();
        private readonly HashSet<ResourceKey> _preloadedKeys = new HashSet<ResourceKey>();
        private readonly CancellationTokenSource _lifetimeCts = new CancellationTokenSource();

        public string Name { get; }
        public string PackageName { get; }
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

        internal AudioScope(AudioManager audioManager, string name, string packageName)
        {
            _audioManager = audioManager;
            Name = name;
            PackageName = packageName;
            _audioManager.Events.PlayStopped += OnAudioStopped;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayMusicAsync(string location, float fadeOut = 0.3f, float fadeIn = 0.3f)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlayMusicAsync(location, fadeOut, fadeIn, PackageName, LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayAmbienceAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options = null)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlayAmbienceAsync(location, WithPackage(options), LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlaySoundAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options = null)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlaySoundAsync(location, WithPackage(options), LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayUISoundAsync(string location, float volume = 1f)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlayUISoundAsync(location, volume, PackageName, LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayVoiceAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options = null)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlayVoiceAsync(location, WithPackage(options), LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayAsync(string location, AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlayAsync(location, WithPackage(options), LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask<AudioHandle> PlayAsync(ResourceKey key, AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = await _audioManager.PlayAsync(key, WithPackage(options), LifetimeToken);
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public AudioHandle Play(AudioClip clip, AudioPlayOptions options = null)
        {
            AudioHandle handle = _audioManager.Play(clip, WithPackage(options));
            Track(handle);
            return handle;
        }

        public async UniTask PreloadAsync(string location, AudioType type)
        {
            ResourceKey key = FRFM.Resource.NormalizeKey(new ResourceKey(PackageName, location));
            await _audioManager.PreloadAsync(key, type, LifetimeToken);
            if (!IsDisposed && !_lifetimeCts.IsCancellationRequested)
                _preloadedKeys.Add(key);
        }

        public async UniTask PreloadAsync(ResourceKey key, AudioType type)
        {
            key = FRFM.Resource.NormalizeKey(key);
            await _audioManager.PreloadAsync(key, type, LifetimeToken);
            if (!IsDisposed && !_lifetimeCts.IsCancellationRequested)
                _preloadedKeys.Add(key);
        }

        public void StopAll(float fadeOut = 0f)
        {
            foreach (AudioHandle handle in new List<AudioHandle>(_handles))
                handle.Stop(fadeOut);
            _handles.Clear();
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
                return;

            IsDisposed = true;
            _lifetimeCts.Cancel();
            _audioManager.Events.PlayStopped -= OnAudioStopped;
            foreach (AudioHandle handle in new List<AudioHandle>(_handles))
                handle.Stop();
            _handles.Clear();

            foreach (ResourceKey key in _preloadedKeys)
                _audioManager.ReleasePreloaded(key);
            _preloadedKeys.Clear();
            _audioManager.RemoveScope(this);
            _lifetimeCts.Dispose();
        }

        private AudioPlayOptions WithPackage(AudioPlayOptions options)
        {
            options ??= new AudioPlayOptions();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.PackageName))
                options.PackageName = PackageName;
            return options;
        }

        private CancellationToken LifetimeToken => IsDisposed
            ? new CancellationToken(true)
            : _lifetimeCts.Token;

        private void Track(AudioHandle handle)
        {
            if (handle.Id <= 0)
                return;

            if (IsDisposed || _lifetimeCts.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                handle.Stop();
                return;
            }

            _handles.Add(handle);
        }

        private void OnAudioStopped(AudioHandle handle, AudioStopReason reason)
        {
            _handles.Remove(handle);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Audio/AudioModule_Design.md
````markdown
# Audio 模块详细设计

## 设计目标

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Audio` 是 FRFrame 的统一音频模块，负责游戏运行期的音乐、环境音、普通音效、UI 音效和语音播放。

模块目标不是简单封装 Unity `AudioSource`，而是提供完整的音频生命周期、资源生命周期、分组混音、通道调度、多 package 语义和诊断能力。

总体目标：

- 通过 `FRFM.Audio` 统一访问音频能力。
- 支持 `Music`、`Ambience`、`Sound`、`UISound`、`Voice` 五类音频。
- 支持 AudioMixer 分类音量、静音、总音量控制。
- 支持异步加载 AudioClip，并在播放结束、停止、抢占、销毁时释放资源引用。
- 支持 `AudioScope`，为“一个子游戏一个 package”的项目提供默认 package 和生命周期边界。
- 支持 2D / 3D 音效、固定世界坐标和 Transform 跟随播放。
- 支持有限通道池、优先级抢占、淡入淡出、暂停恢复。
- 支持运行时诊断快照，方便排查音频播放和资源释放问题。

## 参考框架结论

### TEngine

TEngine 的音频模块采用“模块 - 分类 - 代理”结构：

- `AudioModule` 负责模块生命周期、AudioMixer、资源加载和全局控制。
- `AudioCategory` 按音频类型划分，每类维护多个 `AudioAgent`。
- `AudioAgent` 封装单个 `AudioSource`、播放状态、资源句柄和淡出逻辑。
- `AudioGroupConfig` 配置分类音量、通道数和 3D 衰减参数。

FRFrame 借鉴其分类、Mixer、Agent 池和状态驱动设计，但改为适配 `IManagerBase`、`ResourceKey` 和 `ResourceHandle<AudioClip>`。

### XHFramework

XHFramework 的音频系统强调播放 id、播放参数和优先级抢占。

FRFrame 借鉴其：

- 每次播放生成唯一 id。
- 播放返回 `AudioHandle`。
- 使用 `AudioPlayOptions` 承载播放参数。
- 通道不足时按 priority 选择可抢占 Agent。
- 加载中的声音可以被停止，加载完成后不再播放。

### JKFrame

JKFrame 的音频 API 简单，BGM 和 OneShot 易用。

FRFrame 借鉴其业务便捷性：

- `PlayMusicAsync`
- `PlaySoundAsync`
- `PlayUISoundAsync`
- BGM 默认支持淡出旧音乐、淡入新音乐。

## 架构总览

模块采用四层结构：

```text
AudioManager
  ├── AudioScope
  ├── AudioCategory
  │     └── AudioAgent
  └── AudioDiagnosticsSnapshot
```

职责划分：

- `AudioManager`：模块入口，负责初始化、播放 API、音量控制、预加载、诊断和销毁。
- `AudioScope`：绑定默认 package 和生命周期，适合子游戏、战斗、关卡、剧情等业务边界。
- `AudioCategory`：音频分类，管理一组 AudioAgent，处理分类音量、静音、暂停和抢占。
- `AudioAgent`：单个 AudioSource 播放代理，处理播放、淡入淡出、Transform 跟随、资源释放。
- `AudioHandle`：播放句柄，业务通过它停止、暂停、恢复、调节单个声音。
- `AudioPlayOptions`：播放参数集合。

## 目录结构

```text
Assets/FRFrame/Core/Audio
├── Runtime
│   ├── AudioAgent.cs
│   ├── AudioAgentState.cs
│   ├── AudioCategory.cs
│   ├── AudioDiagnosticsSnapshot.cs
│   ├── AudioEvents.cs
│   ├── AudioGroupConfig.cs
│   ├── AudioHandle.cs
│   ├── AudioManager.cs
│   ├── AudioModuleConfig.cs
│   ├── AudioPlayOptions.cs
│   ├── AudioScope.cs
│   ├── AudioStopReason.cs
│   └── AudioType.cs
├── Editor
├── AudioModule_Design.md
└── AudioModule_Guide.md
```

## 模块生命周期

### 初始化

`AudioManager` 继承 `IManagerBase`：

```csharp
public sealed class AudioManager : IManagerBase
{
    public override int Priority => 15;
}
```

优先级为 15，原因：

- `ResourceManager.Priority = 10`，Audio 依赖 Resource 加载 AudioClip，因此必须晚于 Resource。
- `UIManager.Priority = 20`，UI 初始化或打开后可能立即播放 UI 音效，因此 Audio 应早于 UI。

初始化流程：

```text
FRFM.RegisterAllManagers()
    ↓
注册 ResourceManager、AudioManager、UIManager
    ↓
ResourceManager 初始化完成
    ↓
AudioManager.InitializeAsync()
    ↓
等待 ResourceManager ready
    ↓
创建 FRFrameObject/Audio 根节点
    ↓
加载 Resources/FRFrameAudioConfig
    ↓
创建各 AudioCategory 和预分配 AudioAgent
    ↓
应用 MasterVolume 和分类音量
```

如果 `Resources/FRFrameAudioConfig` 不存在，会创建运行时默认配置，保证模块可用。

### 更新

`AudioManager.Update` 每帧驱动全部 `AudioCategory.Update`，再由 Category 驱动 Agent 状态：

- 淡入淡出计时。
- 非循环音播放结束检测。
- Transform 跟随位置同步。
- 播放结束后的资源释放。

### 销毁

销毁流程：

```text
Dispose 所有 AudioScope
    ↓
StopAll
    ↓
ReleaseAllPreloaded
    ↓
Destroy 所有 AudioCategory / AudioAgent
    ↓
清理句柄、加载中 id、诊断数据
    ↓
销毁 Audio 根节点
```

## 多 package 设计

项目整体是“一个子游戏一个 package”，因此 Audio 模块不推荐业务每次播放都手写 `packageName`。

底层标准仍然是 `ResourceKey(PackageName, Location)`，但业务层推荐使用 `AudioScope`：

```csharp
using var audioScope = FRFM.Audio.CreateScope("Battle", "BattlePackage");
await audioScope.PlayMusicAsync("Audio/Bgm/BattleTheme");
await audioScope.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit");
```

此时底层等价于：

```csharp
new ResourceKey("BattlePackage", "Audio/Sfx/Hit")
```

跨包资源仍显式使用 `ResourceKey`：

```csharp
await audioScope.PlayAsync(
    new ResourceKey("SharedPackage", "Audio/Common/Confirm"),
    new AudioPlayOptions { Type = AudioType.UISound });
```

API 分层：

```csharp
FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync(ResourceKey key, options);   // 最明确，底层标准入口
FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync(location, options);          // 默认包或少量公共资源
scope.PlaySoundAsync(location, options);               // 子游戏内推荐入口
```

不采用全局 `CurrentPackage`，避免多系统并发播放时串包。

## 核心类型

### AudioType

```csharp
public enum AudioType
{
    Music,
    Ambience,
    Sound,
    UISound,
    Voice
}
```

语义：

- `Music`：背景音乐，默认循环，切换时淡入淡出。
- `Ambience`：场景环境音，可多条并存。
- `Sound`：战斗、交互、世界音效。
- `UISound`：按钮、弹窗、提示等 UI 音效。
- `Voice`：角色语音、剧情对白。

### AudioPlayOptions

`AudioPlayOptions` 用于承载播放参数：

- `Type`：音频类型。
- `PackageName`：可选 package；在 `AudioScope` 内可省略。
- `Loop`：是否循环。
- `Volume`：单个声音音量。
- `FadeIn` / `FadeOut`：淡入淡出时间。
- `Priority`：抢占优先级。
- `Pitch` / `PanStereo` / `SpatialBlend`：AudioSource 参数。
- `MinDistance` / `MaxDistance`：3D 音效距离参数。
- `Position`：固定世界坐标播放。
- `FollowTarget`：跟随 Transform 播放。
- `ReleaseOnStop`：停止时是否释放模块加载的资源引用。
- `PersistentAcrossScene`：预留跨场景策略字段。

### AudioHandle

播放返回 `AudioHandle`：

```csharp
AudioHandle handle = await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit");
handle.Pause();
handle.Resume();
handle.SetVolume(0.5f);
handle.Stop(0.2f);
```

`AudioHandle` 只保存 id 和 manager 引用，实际控制由 `AudioManager` 查找当前 Agent。

### AudioScope

`AudioScope` 是 Audio 模块的业务生命周期边界：

- 保存默认 package。
- 跟踪该 scope 播放出去的 AudioHandle。
- 跟踪该 scope 预加载的 AudioClip。
- Dispose 时停止所有未结束音频并释放预加载资源。

适用场景：

- 子游戏。
- 战斗局。
- 关卡。
- 剧情流程。
- 临时活动玩法。

### AudioCategory

每个 `AudioType` 对应一个 Category：

- 持有固定数量 `AudioAgent`。
- 保存分类音量和静音。
- 使用 AudioMixer 参数落地音量。
- 负责 Agent 选择和抢占策略。

### AudioAgent

每个 `AudioAgent` 对应一个 Unity `AudioSource`：

- 绑定 AudioClip。
- 保存当前 ResourceHandle。
- 处理淡入淡出。
- 处理自然播放结束。
- 处理 Transform 跟随。
- 停止或结束时释放 ResourceHandle。

## 通道与抢占策略

播放时选择 Agent 的顺序：

1. 优先使用 Idle Agent。
2. 没有 Idle 且 `AllowSteal=false`，播放失败。
3. 有可抢占 Agent 时，优先抢占 priority 更低的声音。
4. 同 priority 时，如果 `AvoidStealSamePriority=false`，抢占播放时间更长的声音。
5. 被抢占声音使用 `options.FadeOut`，没有配置时默认 0.15 秒。

`Music` 特殊处理：

- `PlayMusicAsync` 会先 StopAll Music。
- 旧音乐按 fadeOut 淡出，新音乐按 fadeIn 淡入。
- 默认 loop 和最高优先级。

## 资源生命周期

路径播放使用 Resource 模块：

```csharp
ResourceHandle<AudioClip> handle = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetHandleAsync<AudioClip>(key);
```

Agent 保存该 handle，并在以下时机释放：

- 自然播放结束。
- `handle.Stop()`。
- 分类或全局 `StopAll`。
- 被抢占。
- Scope Dispose。
- AudioManager Destroy。

直接传入 `AudioClip` 时，Audio 模块不释放该 clip：

```csharp
FRFM.Audio.Play(clip, options);
```

## 预加载设计

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PreloadAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit", AudioType.Sound, "BattlePackage");
FRFM.Audio.ReleasePreloaded("Audio/Sfx/Hit", "BattlePackage");
FRFM.Audio.ReleaseAllPreloaded();
```

Scope 内推荐：

```csharp
await audioScope.PreloadAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit", AudioType.Sound);
```

规则：

- 预加载持有一份 ResourceHandle。
- 播放命中预加载资源时仍会为本次播放申请自己的引用，保证播放结束释放不会影响预加载缓存。
- Scope Dispose 会释放该 Scope 预加载的资源。

## 音量与 AudioMixer

默认 Mixer 分组建议：

```text
Master
├── Music
├── Ambience
├── Sound
├── UISound
└── Voice
```

默认暴露参数：

```text
MasterVolume
MusicVolume
AmbienceVolume
SoundVolume
UISoundVolume
VoiceVolume
```

线性音量转 dB：

```csharp
volume <= 0.0001f ? -80f : Mathf.Log10(volume) * 20f
```

如果没有配置 Mixer，则 `MasterVolume` 会退化到 `AudioListener.volume`，分类音量只保存在模块状态中。

## 3D 音效

固定坐标：

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Explosion", new AudioPlayOptions
{
    Position = transform.position,
    SpatialBlend = 1f
});
```

跟随目标：

```csharp
AudioHandle handle = await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/FireLoop", new AudioPlayOptions
{
    Loop = true,
    FollowTarget = fireTransform,
    SpatialBlend = 1f
});
```

`UISound` 默认应保持 2D，`Sound` 和 `Ambience` 可按业务设置 3D。

## 诊断设计

`FRFM.Audio.CreateSnapshot()` 返回：

- 当前播放数。
- 加载中数量。
- 预加载数量。
- 抢占次数。
- 播放失败次数。
- 每个分类的音量、静音、暂停、Agent 数。
- 每个 Agent 的 id、状态、location、package、clip、loop、priority、elapsed。

后续可基于该快照实现 Editor 诊断窗口。

## 事件

`AudioEvents` 提供：

- `PlayStarted`
- `PlayStopped`
- `LoadFailed`
- `VolumeChanged`
- `MuteChanged`

初版使用 C# event，业务需要跨系统广播时再桥接 `FRFM.Event`。

## 对外 API 汇总

```csharp
FRFM.Audio.CreateScope(name, packageName);
FRFM.Audio.PlayMusicAsync(location, fadeOut, fadeIn, packageName);
FRFM.Audio.PlayAmbienceAsync(location, options);
FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync(location, options);
FRFM.Audio.PlayUISoundAsync(location, volume, packageName);
FRFM.Audio.PlayVoiceAsync(location, options);
FRFM.Audio.PlayAsync(ResourceKey key, options);
FRFM.Audio.Play(AudioClip clip, options);
FRFM.Audio.Stop(handle, fadeOut);
FRFM.Audio.StopAll(type, fadeOut);
FRFM.Audio.Pause(handle);
FRFM.Audio.Resume(handle);
FRFM.Audio.PauseAll(type);
FRFM.Audio.ResumeAll(type);
FRFM.Audio.SetVolume(type, volume);
FRFM.Audio.SetMute(type, mute);
FRFM.Audio.PreloadAsync(key, type);
FRFM.Audio.ReleasePreloaded(key);
FRFM.Audio.CreateSnapshot();
```

## 使用建议

- 子游戏内优先创建 `AudioScope`，不要每次手写 packageName。
- 跨包资源用 `ResourceKey` 显式表达。
- 长循环音保存 `AudioHandle`，退出时 Stop 或交给 Scope Dispose。
- UI 点击音可以直接 `PlayUISoundAsync`。
- 直接传 `AudioClip` 时，调用方自己负责 clip 来源和生命周期。
- 音量保存到本地配置由业务层负责，Audio 模块只提供 Capture/Apply 的扩展空间。
````

## File: Core/Audio/AudioModule_Guide.md
````markdown
# Audio 模块使用指南

## 模块入口

Audio 模块通过 `FRFM.Audio` 使用：

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PlayUISoundAsync("Audio/UI/Click");
```

模块初始化顺序为：

```text
ResourceManager -> AudioManager -> UIManager
```

因此 Audio 可以安全使用 Resource 模块加载 AudioClip，UI 初始化后也可以直接播放 UI 音效。

## 推荐用法：AudioScope

当前工程偏向“一个子游戏一个 package”，因此子游戏、战斗、关卡、剧情等业务内推荐先创建 `AudioScope`：

```csharp
public sealed class BattleAudioController : System.IDisposable
{
    private readonly AudioScope _audioScope = FRFM.Audio.CreateScope("Battle", "BattlePackage");
    private AudioHandle _fireLoop;

    public async UniTask EnterAsync(Transform fireTransform)
    {
        await _audioScope.PlayMusicAsync("Audio/Bgm/BattleTheme", fadeOut: 0.5f, fadeIn: 0.5f);

        _fireLoop = await _audioScope.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/FireLoop", new AudioPlayOptions
        {
            Loop = true,
            FollowTarget = fireTransform,
            SpatialBlend = 1f,
            Volume = 0.8f
        });
    }

    public async UniTask PlayHitAsync(Vector3 position)
    {
        await _audioScope.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit", new AudioPlayOptions
        {
            Position = position,
            SpatialBlend = 1f,
            Priority = 10
        });
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _audioScope.Dispose();
    }
}
```

`AudioScope` 的 `packageName` 会作为 string location API 的默认 package。Scope Dispose 时会停止该 Scope 播放的声音，并释放该 Scope 预加载的 AudioClip。

## 跨 package 播放

Scope 内大多数资源可以只写 location。跨包资源使用 `ResourceKey`：

```csharp
await audioScope.PlayAsync(
    new ResourceKey("SharedPackage", "Audio/Common/Confirm"),
    new AudioPlayOptions { Type = AudioType.UISound });
```

不要依赖全局 CurrentPackage 之类的状态，避免多个子系统并发播放时串包。

## 直接使用 FRFM.Audio

适合默认包或公共资源：

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PlayMusicAsync("Audio/Bgm/Main", fadeOut: 0.5f, fadeIn: 0.5f);
await FRFM.Audio.PlayUISoundAsync("Audio/UI/Click");
await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Explosion", new AudioPlayOptions
{
    PackageName = "BattlePackage",
    Position = transform.position,
    SpatialBlend = 1f
});
```

如果是非默认包资源，优先使用 `ResourceKey` 或 `AudioScope`。

## 常用播放接口

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PlayMusicAsync(location, fadeOut, fadeIn, packageName);
await FRFM.Audio.PlayAmbienceAsync(location, options);
await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync(location, options);
await FRFM.Audio.PlayUISoundAsync(location, volume, packageName);
await FRFM.Audio.PlayVoiceAsync(location, options);
await FRFM.Audio.PlayAsync(new ResourceKey(packageName, location), options);
```

直接播放已有 AudioClip：

```csharp
AudioHandle handle = FRFM.Audio.Play(audioClip, new AudioPlayOptions
{
    Type = AudioType.Sound,
    Volume = 0.8f
});
```

直接传入 `AudioClip` 时，Audio 模块不会释放该 clip。

## AudioHandle 控制

```csharp
AudioHandle handle = await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Loop", new AudioPlayOptions
{
    Loop = true
});

handle.SetVolume(0.5f);
handle.Pause();
handle.Resume();
handle.Stop(0.2f);
```

## 3D 音效

固定位置：

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/Explosion", new AudioPlayOptions
{
    Position = transform.position,
    SpatialBlend = 1f,
    MinDistance = 2f,
    MaxDistance = 50f
});
```

跟随目标：

```csharp
AudioHandle handle = await FRFM.Audio.PlaySoundAsync("Audio/Sfx/EngineLoop", new AudioPlayOptions
{
    Loop = true,
    FollowTarget = vehicleTransform,
    SpatialBlend = 1f
});
```

跟随目标销毁后，循环音会自动停止。

## 音量与静音

```csharp
FRFM.Audio.MasterVolume = 0.8f;
FRFM.Audio.MasterMute = false;

FRFM.Audio.SetVolume(AudioType.Music, 0.5f);
FRFM.Audio.SetMute(AudioType.UISound, false);

float musicVolume = FRFM.Audio.GetVolume(AudioType.Music);
bool uiMuted = FRFM.Audio.GetMute(AudioType.UISound);
```

如果配置了 AudioMixer，模块会写入：

```text
MasterVolume
MusicVolume
AmbienceVolume
SoundVolume
UISoundVolume
VoiceVolume
```

如果没有 Mixer，MasterVolume 会退化到 `AudioListener.volume`。

## 预加载

全局预加载：

```csharp
await FRFM.Audio.PreloadAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit", AudioType.Sound, "BattlePackage");
FRFM.Audio.ReleasePreloaded("Audio/Sfx/Hit", "BattlePackage");
```

Scope 预加载：

```csharp
await audioScope.PreloadAsync("Audio/Sfx/Hit", AudioType.Sound);
```

Scope Dispose 会释放该 Scope 预加载的资源。

## 暂停与停止

```csharp
FRFM.Audio.PauseAll(AudioType.Sound);
FRFM.Audio.ResumeAll(AudioType.Sound);
FRFM.Audio.StopAll(AudioType.Sound, fadeOut: 0.1f);
FRFM.Audio.StopAll();
```

游戏暂停时推荐暂停 `Sound`、`Ambience`、`Voice`，是否暂停 `Music` 由业务决定。

## 诊断

运行时可获取快照：

```csharp
AudioDiagnosticsSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.Audio.CreateSnapshot();
```

Editor 菜单：

```text
FRFrame/Diagnostics/Audio Diagnostics
```

可查看：

- 播放中数量。
- 加载中数量。
- 预加载数量。
- 抢占次数。
- 播放失败次数。
- 每个分类的 Agent 状态和正在播放的资源。

## 配置

可选创建 `Resources/FRFrameAudioConfig.asset`，类型为 `AudioModuleConfig`。

默认分类建议：

| 分类 | Agent 数 | 用途 |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Music | 2 | BGM 淡入淡出 |
| Ambience | 4 | 环境循环音 |
| Sound | 16 | 战斗和世界音效 |
| UISound | 8 | UI 反馈音 |
| Voice | 4 | 语音对白 |

如果不提供配置，模块会使用运行时默认配置。

## 注意事项

- 非默认包资源优先用 `AudioScope` 或 `ResourceKey`。
- 直接传 `AudioClip` 时，Audio 模块不负责释放 clip。
- 长循环音应保存 `AudioHandle`，或放进 `AudioScope` 生命周期内。
- 不要用 `AudioSource.PlayClipAtPoint` 绕过模块，否则无法统一音量、诊断和资源释放。
- 如果听不到声音，先检查 package、location、AudioMixer 暴露参数、分类静音和 MasterMute。
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using FRFrame;

[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Events/Void Game Event")]
public sealed class VoidGameEventAsset : GameEventAsset
{
}

[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Events/Int Game Event")]
public sealed class IntGameEventAsset : GameEventAsset<int>
{
}

public class AssetBridgeExample : MonoBehaviour
{
    [SerializeField] private VoidGameEventAsset playerDeadAsset;
    [SerializeField] private IntGameEventAsset goldChangedAsset;

    private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

    private void OnEnable()
    {
        FRFM.Event.Bridge.Bind(playerDeadAsset, () => new PlayerDeadEvent(1)).AddTo(_scope);
        FRFM.Event.Bridge.Bind<int, GoldChangedEvent>(goldChangedAsset, value => new GoldChangedEvent(value)).AddTo(_scope);

        FRFM.Event.Subscribe<PlayerDeadEvent>(OnPlayerDead, owner: this).AddTo(_scope);
        FRFM.Event.Subscribe<GoldChangedEvent>(OnGoldChanged, owner: this).AddTo(_scope);
    }

    private void OnDisable()
    {
        _scope.Clear();
    }

    private void OnDestroy()
    {
        _scope.Dispose();
    }

    private void OnPlayerDead(PlayerDeadEvent evt)
    {
        FRLog.InfoT("Event", $"Bridge dead {evt.PlayerId}");
    }

    private void OnGoldChanged(GoldChangedEvent evt)
    {
        FRLog.InfoT("Event", $"Bridge gold {evt.NewValue}");
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using FRFrame;

public struct PlayerDeadEvent
{
    public int PlayerId;

    public PlayerDeadEvent(int playerId)
    {
        PlayerId = playerId;
    }
}

public struct GoldChangedEvent
{
    public int NewValue;

    public GoldChangedEvent(int newValue)
    {
        NewValue = newValue;
    }
}

public class EventBusExample : MonoBehaviour
{
    private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

    private void OnEnable()
    {
        FRFM.Event.Subscribe<PlayerDeadEvent>(OnPlayerDead, owner: this).AddTo(_scope);
        FRFM.Event.Subscribe<GoldChangedEvent>(OnGoldChanged, owner: this, priority: 10).AddTo(_scope);
    }

    private void Start()
    {
        FRFM.Event.Publish(new PlayerDeadEvent(7));
        FRFM.Event.Post(new GoldChangedEvent(100));
    }

    private void OnDisable()
    {
        _scope.Clear();
    }

    private void OnDestroy()
    {
        _scope.Dispose();
    }

    private void OnPlayerDead(PlayerDeadEvent evt)
    {
        FRLog.InfoT("Event", $"Player dead: {evt.PlayerId}");
    }

    private void OnGoldChanged(GoldChangedEvent evt)
    {
        FRLog.InfoT("Event", $"Gold changed: {evt.NewValue}");
    }
}
````
