## File: Core/Event/AssetEventBridge.cs
````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 资产事件桥接器。
    ///
    /// 第一版职责：
    /// - 单向桥接：AssetEvent -> EventBus
    /// - 显式绑定
    /// - Bind 返回 IDisposable，支持精确解绑
    /// - Bridge 自身也维护一个作用域，支持 Clear / Dispose 全量解绑
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class AssetEventBridge : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly EventBus _bus;
        private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();
        private bool _disposed;

        public AssetEventBridge(EventBus bus)
        {
            _bus = bus ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(bus));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 将一个无参资产事件桥接为总线事件。
        /// 资产 Raise 时，立即 Publish(converter())。
        /// </summary>
        public IDisposable Bind<TEvent>(
            GameEventAsset asset,
            Func<TEvent> converter,
            object owner = null)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(AssetEventBridge));

            if (asset == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));

            if (converter == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(converter));

            IDisposable binding = asset.Register(() =>
            {
                _bus.Publish(converter());
            }, owner);

            _scope.Add(binding);
            return binding;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 将一个单参数资产事件桥接为总线事件。
        /// 资产 Raise(arg) 时，立即 Publish(converter(arg))。
        /// </summary>
        public IDisposable Bind<TArg, TEvent>(
            GameEventAsset<TArg> asset,
            Func<TArg, TEvent> converter,
            object owner = null)
        {
            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(AssetEventBridge));

            if (asset == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));

            if (converter == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(converter));

            IDisposable binding = asset.Register(arg =>
            {
                _bus.Publish(converter(arg));
            }, owner);

            _scope.Add(binding);
            return binding;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清除当前 Bridge 创建的全部桥接绑定。
        /// Bridge 本身仍可继续使用。
        /// </summary>
        public void Clear()
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;

            _scope.Clear();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清除当前 Bridge 创建的全部桥接绑定，并使 Bridge 进入终态。
        /// </summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;

            _disposed = true;
            _scope.Dispose();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Event/EventBus.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class EventBus
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, IListenerList> _listenerLists = new Dictionary<Type, IListenerList>();
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, IAsyncListenerList> _asyncListenerLists = new Dictionary<Type, IAsyncListenerList>();
        private readonly Dictionary<object, List<IEventSubscriptionInternal>> _subscriptionsByOwner = new Dictionary<object, List<IEventSubscriptionInternal>>();
        private readonly Queue<IQueuedEvent> _postQueue = new Queue<IQueuedEvent>();

        private long _nextSubscriptionId = 1;
        private long _nextSequence = 1;

        public EventBusOptions Options { get; } = new EventBusOptions();

        public IDisposable Subscribe<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));

            ListenerList<TEvent> list = GetOrCreateListenerList<TEvent>();
            var subscription = new EventSubscription<TEvent>(this, list, handler, owner, priority, false, _nextSubscriptionId++, _nextSequence++);
            list.Add(subscription);
            RegisterOwnerSubscription(owner, subscription);
            return subscription;
        }

        public IDisposable SubscribeOnce<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));

            ListenerList<TEvent> list = GetOrCreateListenerList<TEvent>();
            var subscription = new EventSubscription<TEvent>(this, list, handler, owner, priority, true, _nextSubscriptionId++, _nextSequence++);
            list.Add(subscription);
            RegisterOwnerSubscription(owner, subscription);
            return subscription;
        }

        public IDisposable SubscribeAsync<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));

            AsyncListenerList<TEvent> list = GetOrCreateAsyncListenerList<TEvent>();
            var subscription = new AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>(this, list, handler, owner, priority, false, _nextSubscriptionId++, _nextSequence++);
            list.Add(subscription);
            RegisterOwnerSubscription(owner, subscription);
            return subscription;
        }

        public IDisposable SubscribeAsyncOnce<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));

            AsyncListenerList<TEvent> list = GetOrCreateAsyncListenerList<TEvent>();
            var subscription = new AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>(this, list, handler, owner, priority, true, _nextSubscriptionId++, _nextSequence++);
            list.Add(subscription);
            RegisterOwnerSubscription(owner, subscription);
            return subscription;
        }

        public int Unsubscribe<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(handler));

            if (!_listenerLists.TryGetValue(typeof(TEvent), out IListenerList baseList))
                return 0;

            return ((ListenerList<TEvent>)baseList).RemoveByHandler(handler);
        }

        public int UnsubscribeAll(object owner)
        {
            if (owner == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(owner));

            if (!_subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(owner, out List<IEventSubscriptionInternal> subscriptions))
                return 0;

            var snapshot = new List<IEventSubscriptionInternal>(subscriptions);
            int removed = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Count; i++)
            {
                IEventSubscriptionInternal sub = snapshot[i];
                if (sub == null || sub.IsDisposed)
                    continue;

                sub.Dispose();
                removed++;
            }

            return removed;
        }

        public void Publish<TEvent>(TEvent evt)
        {
            if (_listenerLists.TryGetValue(typeof(TEvent), out IListenerList baseList))
                ((ListenerList<TEvent>)baseList).Publish(evt);
        }

        public UniTask PublishAsync<TEvent>(TEvent evt, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (_asyncListenerLists.TryGetValue(typeof(TEvent), out IAsyncListenerList baseList))
                return ((AsyncListenerList<TEvent>)baseList).PublishAsync(evt, cancellationToken);

            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        public void Post<TEvent>(TEvent evt)
        {
            int max = Options.MaxPostQueueCount;
            if (max > 0 && _postQueue.Count >= max)
            {
                switch (Options.OverflowPolicy)
                {
                    case EventPostOverflowPolicy.Throw:
                        throw new InvalidOperationException($"Event post queue overflow. Max:{max}, Event:{typeof(TEvent).FullName}");
                    case EventPostOverflowPolicy.DropOldest:
                        _postQueue.Dequeue();
                        break;
                    case EventPostOverflowPolicy.WarningAndDropNewest:
                        FRLog.WarningT("Event", $"Event post queue overflow. Drop newest. Max:{max}, Event:{typeof(TEvent).FullName}");
                        return;
                    default:
                        return;
                }
            }

            _postQueue.Enqueue(new QueuedEvent<TEvent>(evt));
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            int count = _postQueue.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                IQueuedEvent queuedEvent = _postQueue.Dequeue();
                queuedEvent.Dispatch(this);
            }
        }

        public int Flush(int maxCount)
        {
            if (maxCount <= 0)
                return 0;

            int count = Math.Min(maxCount, _postQueue.Count);
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                IQueuedEvent queuedEvent = _postQueue.Dequeue();
                queuedEvent.Dispatch(this);
            }

            return count;
        }

        public int ClearPostQueue()
        {
            int count = _postQueue.Count;
            _postQueue.Clear();
            return count;
        }

        public int ClearPostQueue<TEvent>()
        {
            return ClearPostQueue(typeof(TEvent));
        }

        public int ClearPostQueue(Type eventType)
        {
            if (eventType == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(eventType));

            int removed = 0;
            int count = _postQueue.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                IQueuedEvent queuedEvent = _postQueue.Dequeue();
                if (queuedEvent.EventType == eventType)
                    removed++;
                else
                    _postQueue.Enqueue(queuedEvent);
            }

            return removed;
        }

        public void Clear<TEvent>()
        {
            if (_listenerLists.TryGetValue(typeof(TEvent), out IListenerList baseList))
                baseList.Clear();
        }

        public void ClearAll()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _listenerLists)
                pair.Value.Clear();

            foreach (var pair in _asyncListenerLists)
                pair.Value.Clear();

            _listenerLists.Clear();
            _asyncListenerLists.Clear();
            _subscriptionsByOwner.Clear();
            _postQueue.Clear();
        }

        public int GetListenerCount<TEvent>()
        {
            return GetListenerCount(typeof(TEvent));
        }

        public int GetListenerCount(Type eventType)
        {
            int count = 0;
            if (_listenerLists.TryGetValue(eventType, out IListenerList list))
                count += list.ListenerCount;
            if (_asyncListenerLists.TryGetValue(eventType, out IAsyncListenerList asyncList))
                count += asyncList.ListenerCount;
            return count;
        }

        public int GetTotalListenerCount()
        {
            int count = 0;
            foreach (var pair in _listenerLists)
                count += pair.Value.ListenerCount;
            foreach (var pair in _asyncListenerLists)
                count += pair.Value.ListenerCount;
            return count;
        }

        public int GetEventTypeCount()
        {
            var types = new HashSet<Type>(_listenerLists.Keys);
            foreach (var pair in _asyncListenerLists)
                types.Add(pair.Key);
            return types.Count;
        }

        public int GetOwnerCount()
        {
            return _subscriptionsByOwner.Count;
        }

        public int GetOwnerSubscriptionCount(object owner)
        {
            if (owner == null)
                return 0;

            return _subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(owner, out List<IEventSubscriptionInternal> subscriptions) ? subscriptions.Count : 0;
        }

        public int GetPostQueueCount()
        {
            return _postQueue.Count;
        }

        public bool HasListener<TEvent>()
        {
            return GetListenerCount<TEvent>() > 0;
        }

        public EventBusSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            var listeners = new List<EventListenerSnapshot>();
            foreach (var pair in _listenerLists)
                listeners.Add(pair.Value.CreateSnapshot());
            foreach (var pair in _asyncListenerLists)
                listeners.Add(pair.Value.CreateSnapshot());

            var owners = new List<EventOwnerSnapshot>();
            foreach (var pair in _subscriptionsByOwner)
            {
                owners.Add(new EventOwnerSnapshot
                {
                    OwnerName = pair.Key?.ToString() ?? string.Empty,
                    OwnerType = pair.Key?.GetType(),
                    SubscriptionCount = pair.Value.Count
                });
            }

            return new EventBusSnapshot
            {
                TotalListenerCount = GetTotalListenerCount(),
                EventTypeCount = GetEventTypeCount(),
                OwnerCount = GetOwnerCount(),
                PostQueueCount = _postQueue.Count,
                Listeners = listeners,
                Owners = owners
            };
        }

        private ListenerList<TEvent> GetOrCreateListenerList<TEvent>()
        {
            Type eventType = typeof(TEvent);
            if (_listenerLists.TryGetValue(eventType, out IListenerList existing))
                return (ListenerList<TEvent>)existing;

            var list = new ListenerList<TEvent>(this);
            _listenerLists.Add(eventType, list);
            return list;
        }

        private AsyncListenerList<TEvent> GetOrCreateAsyncListenerList<TEvent>()
        {
            Type eventType = typeof(TEvent);
            if (_asyncListenerLists.TryGetValue(eventType, out IAsyncListenerList existing))
                return (AsyncListenerList<TEvent>)existing;

            var list = new AsyncListenerList<TEvent>(this);
            _asyncListenerLists.Add(eventType, list);
            return list;
        }

        private void RegisterOwnerSubscription(object owner, IEventSubscriptionInternal subscription)
        {
            if (owner == null || subscription == null)
                return;

            if (!_subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(owner, out List<IEventSubscriptionInternal> list))
            {
                list = new List<IEventSubscriptionInternal>();
                _subscriptionsByOwner.Add(owner, list);
            }

            list.Add(subscription);
        }

        private void OnSubscriptionRemoved(IEventSubscriptionInternal subscription)
        {
            if (subscription == null || subscription.Owner == null)
                return;

            if (_subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(subscription.Owner, out List<IEventSubscriptionInternal> list))
            {
                list.Remove(subscription);
                if (list.Count == 0)
                    _subscriptionsByOwner.Remove(subscription.Owner);
            }
        }

        private void HandleDispatchException(List<EventDispatchException> exceptions, Type eventType, object owner, Exception exception)
        {
            switch (Options.ExceptionPolicy)
            {
                case EventExceptionPolicy.LogAndContinue:
                    FRLog.Exception("Event", exception, $"Event listener failed. Event:{eventType.FullName}, Owner:{owner}");
                    break;
                case EventExceptionPolicy.CollectAndThrow:
                    exceptions.Add(new EventDispatchException { EventType = eventType, Owner = owner, Exception = exception });
                    break;
                default:
                    throw exception;
            }
        }

        private interface IListenerList
        {
            Type EventType { get; }
            int ListenerCount { get; }
            int OnceCount { get; }
            int MaxPriority { get; }
            int MinPriority { get; }
            void Clear();
            EventListenerSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
        }

        private interface IAsyncListenerList : IListenerList
        {
        }

        private interface IEventSubscriptionInternal : IDisposable
        {
            object Owner { get; }
            bool IsDisposed { get; }
        }

        private interface IQueuedEvent
        {
            Type EventType { get; }
            void Dispatch(EventBus bus);
        }

        private readonly struct QueuedEvent<TEvent> : IQueuedEvent
        {
            private readonly TEvent _event;
            public Type EventType => typeof(TEvent);

            public QueuedEvent(TEvent evt)
            {
                _event = evt;
            }

            public void Dispatch(EventBus bus)
            {
                bus.Publish(_event);
            }
        }

        private sealed class ListenerList<TEvent> : IListenerList
        {
            private readonly EventBus _bus;
            private readonly List<EventSubscription<TEvent>> _listeners = new List<EventSubscription<TEvent>>();
            private readonly List<EventSubscription<TEvent>> _pendingAdd = new List<EventSubscription<TEvent>>();
            private readonly List<EventSubscription<TEvent>> _pendingRemove = new List<EventSubscription<TEvent>>();
            private int _dispatchDepth;
            private bool _needsSort;

            public Type EventType => typeof(TEvent);
            public int ListenerCount => _listeners.Count + _pendingAdd.Count;
            public int OnceCount => CountOnce(_listeners) + CountOnce(_pendingAdd);
            public int MaxPriority => GetPriority(true);
            public int MinPriority => GetPriority(false);

            public ListenerList(EventBus bus)
            {
                _bus = bus;
            }

            public void Add(EventSubscription<TEvent> subscription)
            {
                if (_dispatchDepth > 0)
                    _pendingAdd.Add(subscription);
                else
                    _listeners.Add(subscription);

                _needsSort = true;
            }

            public void Remove(EventSubscription<TEvent> subscription)
            {
                if (subscription == null)
                    return;

                if (_dispatchDepth > 0)
                {
                    if (!_pendingRemove.Contains(subscription))
                        _pendingRemove.Add(subscription);
                }
                else
                {
                    bool removed = _listeners.Remove(subscription) | _pendingAdd.Remove(subscription);
                    if (removed)
                        _bus.OnSubscriptionRemoved(subscription);
                }
            }

            public int RemoveByHandler(Action<TEvent> handler)
            {
                int removed = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count; i++)
                {
                    var sub = _listeners[i];
                    if (!sub.IsDisposed && sub.Handler == handler)
                    {
                        sub.Dispose();
                        removed++;
                    }
                }

                for (int i = 0; i < _pendingAdd.Count; i++)
                {
                    var sub = _pendingAdd[i];
                    if (!sub.IsDisposed && sub.Handler == handler)
                    {
                        sub.Dispose();
                        removed++;
                    }
                }

                return removed;
            }

            public void Publish(TEvent evt)
            {
                if (_needsSort)
                    SortNow();

                List<EventDispatchException> exceptions = _bus.Options.ExceptionPolicy == EventExceptionPolicy.CollectAndThrow ? new List<EventDispatchException>() : null;
                _dispatchDepth++;
                try
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count; i++)
                    {
                        EventSubscription<TEvent> sub = _listeners[i];
                        if (sub.IsDisposed)
                            continue;

                        try
                        {
                            sub.Handler.Invoke(evt);
                        }
                        catch (Exception e)
                        {
                            _bus.HandleDispatchException(exceptions, typeof(TEvent), sub.Owner, e);
                        }

                        if (sub.IsOnce && !sub.IsDisposed)
                            sub.Dispose();
                    }
                }
                finally
                {
                    _dispatchDepth--;
                    if (_dispatchDepth == 0)
                        ApplyPendingChanges();
                }

                if (exceptions != null && exceptions.Count > 0)
                    throw new EventDispatchAggregateException(exceptions);
            }

            public void Clear()
            {
                var snapshotMain = new List<EventSubscription<TEvent>>(_listeners);
                var snapshotPending = new List<EventSubscription<TEvent>>(_pendingAdd);
                for (int i = 0; i < snapshotMain.Count; i++)
                    if (!snapshotMain[i].IsDisposed) snapshotMain[i].Dispose();
                for (int i = 0; i < snapshotPending.Count; i++)
                    if (!snapshotPending[i].IsDisposed) snapshotPending[i].Dispose();

                if (_dispatchDepth == 0)
                {
                    _listeners.Clear();
                    _pendingAdd.Clear();
                    _pendingRemove.Clear();
                    _needsSort = false;
                }
            }

            public EventListenerSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
            {
                return new EventListenerSnapshot { EventType = typeof(TEvent), ListenerCount = ListenerCount, OnceListenerCount = OnceCount, MaxPriority = MaxPriority, MinPriority = MinPriority };
            }

            private void ApplyPendingChanges()
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _pendingRemove.Count; i++)
                {
                    EventSubscription<TEvent> sub = _pendingRemove[i];
                    bool removed = _listeners.Remove(sub) | _pendingAdd.Remove(sub);
                    if (removed)
                        _bus.OnSubscriptionRemoved(sub);
                }
                _pendingRemove.Clear();

                for (int i = 0; i < _pendingAdd.Count; i++)
                {
                    EventSubscription<TEvent> sub = _pendingAdd[i];
                    if (!sub.IsDisposed)
                        _listeners.Add(sub);
                    else
                        _bus.OnSubscriptionRemoved(sub);
                }
                _pendingAdd.Clear();

                if (_needsSort)
                    SortNow();
            }

            private void SortNow()
            {
                _listeners.Sort(SubscriptionComparison);
                _needsSort = false;
            }

            private int GetPriority(bool max)
            {
                bool has = false;
                int result = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (_listeners[i].IsDisposed)
                        continue;
                    if (!has || (max ? _listeners[i].Priority > result : _listeners[i].Priority < result))
                        result = _listeners[i].Priority;
                    has = true;
                }
                return has ? result : 0;
            }

            private static int CountOnce(List<EventSubscription<TEvent>> list)
            {
                int count = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
                    if (!list[i].IsDisposed && list[i].IsOnce) count++;
                return count;
            }

            private static int SubscriptionComparison(EventSubscription<TEvent> a, EventSubscription<TEvent> b)
            {
                int priorityCompare = b.Priority.CompareTo(a.Priority);
                return priorityCompare != 0 ? priorityCompare : a.Sequence.CompareTo(b.Sequence);
            }
        }

        private sealed class AsyncListenerList<TEvent> : IAsyncListenerList
        {
            private readonly EventBus _bus;
            private readonly List<AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>> _listeners = new List<AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>>();
            private bool _needsSort;

            public Type EventType => typeof(TEvent);
            public int ListenerCount => _listeners.Count;
            public int OnceCount => CountOnce(_listeners);
            public int MaxPriority => GetPriority(true);
            public int MinPriority => GetPriority(false);

            public AsyncListenerList(EventBus bus)
            {
                _bus = bus;
            }

            public void Add(AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent> subscription)
            {
                _listeners.Add(subscription);
                _needsSort = true;
            }

            public void Remove(AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent> subscription)
            {
                if (subscription != null && _listeners.Remove(subscription))
                    _bus.OnSubscriptionRemoved(subscription);
            }

            public async UniTask PublishAsync(TEvent evt, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
            {
                if (_needsSort)
                    SortNow();

                var snapshot = new List<AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>>(_listeners);
                List<EventDispatchException> exceptions = _bus.Options.ExceptionPolicy == EventExceptionPolicy.CollectAndThrow ? new List<EventDispatchException>() : null;
                for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Count; i++)
                {
                    cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
                    AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent> sub = snapshot[i];
                    if (sub.IsDisposed)
                        continue;

                    try
                    {
                        await sub.Handler.Invoke(evt);
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        _bus.HandleDispatchException(exceptions, typeof(TEvent), sub.Owner, e);
                    }

                    if (sub.IsOnce && !sub.IsDisposed)
                        sub.Dispose();
                }

                if (exceptions != null && exceptions.Count > 0)
                    throw new EventDispatchAggregateException(exceptions);
            }

            public void Clear()
            {
                var snapshot = new List<AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>>(_listeners);
                for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Count; i++)
                    if (!snapshot[i].IsDisposed) snapshot[i].Dispose();
                _listeners.Clear();
                _needsSort = false;
            }

            public EventListenerSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
            {
                return new EventListenerSnapshot { EventType = typeof(TEvent), ListenerCount = ListenerCount, OnceListenerCount = OnceCount, MaxPriority = MaxPriority, MinPriority = MinPriority };
            }

            private void SortNow()
            {
                _listeners.Sort(SubscriptionComparison);
                _needsSort = false;
            }

            private int GetPriority(bool max)
            {
                bool has = false;
                int result = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (_listeners[i].IsDisposed)
                        continue;
                    if (!has || (max ? _listeners[i].Priority > result : _listeners[i].Priority < result))
                        result = _listeners[i].Priority;
                    has = true;
                }
                return has ? result : 0;
            }

            private static int CountOnce(List<AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent>> list)
            {
                int count = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
                    if (!list[i].IsDisposed && list[i].IsOnce) count++;
                return count;
            }

            private static int SubscriptionComparison(AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent> a, AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent> b)
            {
                int priorityCompare = b.Priority.CompareTo(a.Priority);
                return priorityCompare != 0 ? priorityCompare : a.Sequence.CompareTo(b.Sequence);
            }
        }

        private sealed class EventSubscription<TEvent> : IEventSubscriptionInternal
        {
            public readonly ListenerList<TEvent> List;
            public readonly Action<TEvent> Handler;
            public object Owner { get; }
            public int Priority { get; }
            public bool IsOnce { get; }
            public long Sequence { get; }
            public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

            public EventSubscription(EventBus bus, ListenerList<TEvent> list, Action<TEvent> handler, object owner, int priority, bool isOnce, long id, long sequence)
            {
                List = list;
                Handler = handler;
                Owner = owner;
                Priority = priority;
                IsOnce = isOnce;
                Sequence = sequence;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (IsDisposed)
                    return;
                IsDisposed = true;
                List.Remove(this);
            }
        }

        private sealed class AsyncEventSubscription<TEvent> : IEventSubscriptionInternal
        {
            public readonly AsyncListenerList<TEvent> List;
            public readonly Func<TEvent, UniTask> Handler;
            public object Owner { get; }
            public int Priority { get; }
            public bool IsOnce { get; }
            public long Sequence { get; }
            public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

            public AsyncEventSubscription(EventBus bus, AsyncListenerList<TEvent> list, Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner, int priority, bool isOnce, long id, long sequence)
            {
                List = list;
                Handler = handler;
                Owner = owner;
                Priority = priority;
                IsOnce = isOnce;
                Sequence = sequence;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (IsDisposed)
                    return;
                IsDisposed = true;
                List.Remove(this);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using System;
using System.Threading;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class EventManager : IManagerBase
    {
        public override int Priority => 0;

        public EventBus Bus { get; private set; }
        public AssetEventBridge Bridge { get; private set; }

        public override UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            Bus = new EventBus();
            Bridge = new AssetEventBridge(Bus);
            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        public IDisposable Subscribe<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            return Bus.Subscribe(handler, owner, priority);
        }

        public IDisposable SubscribeOnce<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            return Bus.SubscribeOnce(handler, owner, priority);
        }

        public IDisposable SubscribeAsync<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            return Bus.SubscribeAsync(handler, owner, priority);
        }

        public IDisposable SubscribeAsyncOnce<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            return Bus.SubscribeAsyncOnce(handler, owner, priority);
        }

        public int Unsubscribe<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler)
        {
            return Bus.Unsubscribe(handler);
        }

        public int UnsubscribeAll(object owner)
        {
            return Bus.UnsubscribeAll(owner);
        }

        public void Publish<TEvent>(TEvent evt)
        {
            Bus.Publish(evt);
        }

        public UniTask PublishAsync<TEvent>(TEvent evt, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return Bus.PublishAsync(evt, cancellationToken);
        }

        public void Post<TEvent>(TEvent evt)
        {
            Bus.Post(evt);
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            Bus.Flush();
        }

        public int Flush(int maxCount)
        {
            return Bus.Flush(maxCount);
        }

        public int ClearPostQueue()
        {
            return Bus.ClearPostQueue();
        }

        public int ClearPostQueue<TEvent>()
        {
            return Bus.ClearPostQueue<TEvent>();
        }

        public int ClearPostQueue(Type eventType)
        {
            return Bus.ClearPostQueue(eventType);
        }

        public int GetListenerCount<TEvent>()
        {
            return Bus.GetListenerCount<TEvent>();
        }

        public int GetPostQueueCount()
        {
            return Bus.GetPostQueueCount();
        }

        public EventBusSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            return Bus.CreateSnapshot();
        }

        public override void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            int max = Bus.Options.MaxFlushCountPerFrame;
            if (max > 0)
                Bus.Flush(max);
            else
                Bus.Flush();
        }

        public void ClearAll()
        {
            Bridge.Clear();
            Bus.ClearAll();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Event/EventModule_Analysis.md
````markdown
# Event 模块新功能详细设计

## 设计边界

`EventManager` 由 FRFrame 框架初始化流程统一创建和初始化，业务层不直接 `new EventManager()`。因此本设计不把运行时未初始化保护作为核心需求，只优化 `Test` 示例代码，避免示例误导业务绕过框架生命周期。

Event 模块继续保持当前核心模型：同步、强类型、可预测的事件总线。新增能力应围绕诊断、生命周期防漏、延迟队列治理、异步事件独立通道和 ScriptableObject 事件调试展开，不改变现有 `Publish` / `Subscribe` 语义。

## 当前基础

当前 Event 模块已具备：

- `EventBus` 强类型事件总线。
- `Publish` 同步分发。
- `Post` / `Flush` 延迟分发。
- `SubscribeOnce` 一次性订阅。
- 订阅优先级。
- owner 批量解绑。
- 分发期间安全增删监听。
- `EventSubscriptionScope` 订阅作用域。
- `GameEventAsset` / `GameEventAsset<T>` ScriptableObject 事件通道。
- `AssetEventBridge` 资产事件到代码事件桥接。
- `EventManager` 接入框架生命周期并每帧 Flush。

## 功能一：优化示例代码

### 目标

确保 `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/Test` 下示例体现真实框架使用方式，避免示例直接 `new EventManager()` 导致未初始化误用。

### 调整范围

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/Test/EventBusExample.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/Test/AssetBridgeExample.cs`

### 设计方案

示例统一改为以下两种之一：

1. 通过 `FRFM.Event` 演示事件订阅和发布。
2. 如果需要演示独立 `EventBus`，则明确示例对象是 `EventBus`，不使用 `EventManager`。

推荐示例：

```csharp
public sealed class EventBusExample : MonoBehaviour
{
    private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

    private void OnEnable()
    {
        FRFM.Event.Subscribe<PlayerLevelUpEvent>(OnPlayerLevelUp, owner: this)
            .AddTo(_scope);
    }

    private void OnDisable()
    {
        _scope.Dispose();
    }

    private void OnPlayerLevelUp(PlayerLevelUpEvent evt)
    {
        FRLog.Info("Event", $"Player level up : {evt.Level}");
    }
}
```

### 验收标准

- 示例代码不再直接 `new EventManager()`。
- 示例能体现订阅释放方式。
- 示例中桥接逻辑通过 `FRFM.Event.Bridge` 表达。

## 功能二：事件诊断与统计 API

### 目标

让框架和业务能在运行期观察事件系统状态，定位订阅泄漏、延迟队列堆积、owner 未解绑等问题。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventBusSnapshot.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventListenerSnapshot.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventOwnerSnapshot.cs`

```csharp
public sealed class EventBusSnapshot
{
    public int TotalListenerCount;
    public int EventTypeCount;
    public int OwnerCount;
    public int PostQueueCount;
    public IReadOnlyList<EventListenerSnapshot> Listeners;
    public IReadOnlyList<EventOwnerSnapshot> Owners;
}

public sealed class EventListenerSnapshot
{
    public Type EventType;
    public int ListenerCount;
    public int OnceListenerCount;
    public int MaxPriority;
    public int MinPriority;
}

public sealed class EventOwnerSnapshot
{
    public string OwnerName;
    public Type OwnerType;
    public int SubscriptionCount;
}
```

### EventBus 新增 API

```csharp
public int GetListenerCount<TEvent>();
public int GetListenerCount(Type eventType);
public int GetTotalListenerCount();
public int GetEventTypeCount();
public int GetOwnerCount();
public int GetOwnerSubscriptionCount(object owner);
public int GetPostQueueCount();
public bool HasListener<TEvent>();
public EventBusSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
```

### 内部设计

当前 `EventBus` 已有：

- `_listenerLists`
- `_subscriptionsByOwner`
- `_postQueue`

诊断 API 可基于这三个结构生成快照。需要给 `IListenerList` 补充只读统计能力：

```csharp
int Count { get; }
int OnceCount { get; }
int MaxPriority { get; }
int MinPriority { get; }
```

### EventManager 转发 API

```csharp
public int GetListenerCount<TEvent>();
public int GetPostQueueCount();
public EventBusSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
```

### 验收标准

- 可查询单事件类型监听数量。
- 可查询延迟队列长度。
- 可查询 owner 订阅数量。
- 快照不暴露可修改内部集合。

## 功能三：延迟队列治理

### 目标

避免 `Post` 队列无限增长，支持清理指定类型延迟事件，并允许控制单帧 Flush 开销。

### 新增配置

建议新增：

```csharp
public sealed class EventBusOptions
{
    public int MaxPostQueueCount = 0;
    public int MaxFlushCountPerFrame = 0;
    public EventPostOverflowPolicy OverflowPolicy = EventPostOverflowPolicy.WarningAndDropNewest;
}

public enum EventPostOverflowPolicy
{
    WarningAndDropNewest,
    DropNewest,
    DropOldest,
    Throw
}
```

### EventBus 新增 API

```csharp
public EventBusOptions Options { get; }
public int ClearPostQueue();
public int ClearPostQueue<TEvent>();
public int ClearPostQueue(Type eventType);
public int Flush(int maxCount);
```

### 行为规则

- `MaxPostQueueCount <= 0` 表示不限制。
- `Post` 时如果队列超限，根据策略处理。
- `Flush()` 维持当前语义：只处理本轮开始时已有事件。
- `Flush(maxCount)` 最多处理指定数量。
- `EventManager.Update()` 可使用 `Options.MaxFlushCountPerFrame` 控制每帧分发上限。

### 清理指定类型事件

当前 `_postQueue` 是 `Queue<IQueuedEvent>`。要支持指定类型清理，`IQueuedEvent` 需暴露：

```csharp
Type EventType { get; }
```

清理时重建队列，保留其它类型事件。

### 验收标准

- 队列超限时行为符合配置。
- 可清理某类型延迟事件。
- 可限制单次 Flush 数量。
- 默认配置保持现有行为。

## 功能四：监听器异常策略

### 目标

让事件系统可在开发期严格暴露异常，也可在运行期避免一个监听器异常中断后续监听器。

### 新增类型

```csharp
public enum EventExceptionPolicy
{
    Throw,
    LogAndContinue,
    CollectAndThrow
}

public sealed class EventDispatchException
{
    public Type EventType;
    public object Owner;
    public Exception Exception;
}

public sealed class EventDispatchAggregateException : Exception
{
    public IReadOnlyList<EventDispatchException> Exceptions { get; }
}
```

### EventBusOptions 扩展

```csharp
public EventExceptionPolicy ExceptionPolicy = EventExceptionPolicy.Throw;
```

### 行为规则

- `Throw`：保持当前行为。
- `LogAndContinue`：使用 `FRLog.Exception` 记录，继续执行后续监听器。
- `CollectAndThrow`：执行全部监听器后抛出聚合异常。

### 验收标准

- 默认策略保持当前行为。
- `LogAndContinue` 下单个监听器异常不会中断其它监听器。
- 异常日志包含事件类型、owner、handler 信息。

## 功能五：MonoBehaviour 生命周期绑定语法糖

### 目标

为大量短生命周期 MonoBehaviour 订阅场景提供自动解绑能力，降低 UI、HUD、场景对象、临时 View 忘记释放订阅的风险。

该功能只作为语法糖和防漏解绑工具，不改变 EventBus 核心。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventSubscriptionScopeComponent.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventMonoBehaviourExtensions.cs`

```csharp
public sealed class EventSubscriptionScopeComponent : MonoBehaviour
{
    private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

    public void Add(IDisposable subscription);
    private void OnDestroy();
}
```

扩展 API：

```csharp
public static IDisposable AddTo(this IDisposable subscription, MonoBehaviour owner);
```

### 使用示例

```csharp
public sealed class InventoryView : MonoBehaviour
{
    private void OnEnable()
    {
        FRFM.Event.Subscribe<ItemChangedEvent>(OnItemChanged)
            .AddTo(this);
    }
}
```

### 注意事项

如果订阅发生在 `OnEnable`，而自动解绑发生在 `OnDestroy`，对象 Disable 后仍会收到事件。若需要 Disable 即解绑，仍应使用显式 `EventSubscriptionScope` 并在 `OnDisable` Dispose。

### 验收标准

- MonoBehaviour 销毁时自动 Dispose 所有 AddTo 的订阅。
- 多次 AddTo 复用同一个组件。
- 不影响现有 `EventSubscriptionScope` 用法。

## 功能六：独立异步事件通道

### 目标

支持发布方需要等待监听器完成的流程，但不改变现有同步 `Publish` 语义。

典型场景：

- 登录成功后等待多个系统异步准备完成再进入大厅。
- 场景切换前等待存档、网络同步、资源释放完成。
- 新手引导事件等待弹窗和剧情播放完成再继续流程。

### 新增 API

```csharp
public IDisposable SubscribeAsync<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
public UniTask PublishAsync<TEvent>(TEvent evt, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
```

可选 once：

```csharp
public IDisposable SubscribeAsyncOnce<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
```

### 执行顺序

建议第一版采用顺序 await：

1. 按 priority 降序。
2. 同 priority 按订阅顺序。
3. 一个 handler 完成后再执行下一个。

原因：顺序执行更可预测，也更符合现有事件优先级语义。

后续可扩展并行策略：

```csharp
public enum EventAsyncDispatchMode
{
    Sequential,
    Parallel
}
```

### 异常策略

异步事件复用 `EventExceptionPolicy`：

- `Throw`：遇到异常立即抛出。
- `LogAndContinue`：记录异常并继续。
- `CollectAndThrow`：全部执行后汇总抛出。

### 生命周期规则

- 异步监听器也支持 owner 批量解绑。
- 分发开始时生成订阅快照。
- 分发过程中 Dispose 的监听器不影响当前快照是否继续执行，第一版可保持和同步事件一致。

### 验收标准

- 同步 `Publish` 行为不变。
- `PublishAsync` 能等待所有异步监听器完成。
- 异步监听器支持 priority、once、owner。
- 异常策略与同步事件一致。

## 功能七：ScriptableObject 事件增强

### 目标

提升 `GameEventAsset` 和 `GameEventAsset<T>` 的调试能力和延迟分发能力。

### 新增 API

无参事件：

```csharp
public void Post();
public void Flush();
public int GetListenerCount();
public GameEventAssetSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
```

单参数事件：

```csharp
public void Post(T value);
public void Flush();
public int GetListenerCount();
public GameEventAssetSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
```

### 新增快照

```csharp
public sealed class GameEventAssetSnapshot
{
    public string Name;
    public int ListenerCount;
    public int PostQueueCount;
    public int RaiseCount;
    public float LastRaiseTime;
}
```

### Editor 调试

可新增 Editor Inspector：

- 显示 listener count。
- 显示 raise count。
- 显示 last raise time。
- 提供无参事件手动 Raise 按钮。

### 验收标准

- ScriptableObject 事件支持延迟分发。
- 可查看监听数量和最近触发信息。
- 无参事件可在 Inspector 手动触发。

## 功能八：Event Editor 诊断窗口

### 目标

提供运行时事件系统可视化，辅助排查订阅泄漏和事件队列堆积。

### 建议路径

`Assets/FRFrame/Editor/Diagnostics/FRFrameEventDiagnosticsWindow.cs`

菜单：`FRFrame/Diagnostics/Event Diagnostics`

### 展示内容

- 总监听数量。
- 事件类型数量。
- owner 数量。
- Post 队列长度。
- 各事件类型 listener count。
- 各 owner subscription count。
- 可筛选事件类型和 owner。

### 操作能力

- Refresh。
- Clear Post Queue。
- Clear 指定事件类型订阅。
- ClearAll 需要二次确认或只在运行时调试阶段提供。

### 验收标准

- Play Mode 下能显示 `FRFM.Event` 快照。
- 不在每帧产生大量 GC。
- 清理操作不会误删工程资产。

## 功能九：事件录制与回放

### 目标

辅助复杂玩法流程调试，记录关键事件流并支持回放。

该功能属于高级调试能力，优先级低于诊断 API 和生命周期绑定。

### 新增类型

```csharp
public sealed class EventRecord
{
    public Type EventType;
    public string EventTypeName;
    public string Json;
    public float Time;
    public int Frame;
}

public sealed class EventRecorder
{
    public bool IsRecording { get; }
    public void Start();
    public IReadOnlyList<EventRecord> Stop();
    public void Clear();
}
```

### 设计限制

- 只记录可序列化事件。
- 默认不启用。
- 高频事件需要过滤。
- 回放只适合调试，不保证完全复现所有副作用。

## 阶段规划

### 第一阶段：稳定性与诊断基础

1. 优化 `Test` 示例代码。
2. 增加 listener count、queue count、owner count。
3. 增加 EventBus snapshot。
4. 增加指定类型 Post 队列清理。

### 第二阶段：生命周期与队列治理

1. 增加 `EventBusOptions`。
2. 增加 Post 队列容量和 Flush 上限。
3. 增加 `AddTo(MonoBehaviour)`。
4. 增加 ScriptableObject 事件 listener count 和调试信息。

### 第三阶段：高级能力

1. 增加异常策略配置。
2. 增加 `SubscribeAsync` / `PublishAsync` 独立异步通道。
3. 增加 Event Editor 诊断窗口。
4. 增加事件录制与回放。

## 推荐实现顺序

优先实现不会改变现有行为的功能：诊断 API、示例优化、MonoBehaviour AddTo。随后处理延迟队列治理。异步事件和异常策略涉及语义设计，应单独实现和测试。

## 测试建议

- Subscribe / Publish 基础分发。
- SubscribeOnce 只触发一次。
- priority 顺序正确。
- owner UnsubscribeAll 正确。
- 分发期间新增/删除安全。
- Post / Flush 只处理本轮开始时队列。
- ClearPostQueue<T> 只清指定类型。
- AddTo(MonoBehaviour) 在 OnDestroy 自动释放。
- PublishAsync 按顺序等待监听器。
- 异常策略在同步和异步下表现一致。
````

## File: Core/Event/EventModule_Guide.md
````markdown
# Event 模块详细说明

## 模块定位

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event` 是 FRFrame 的事件系统模块，提供同步强类型事件总线、延迟事件队列、异步事件通道、订阅生命周期管理、ScriptableObject 事件资产、资产事件桥接和运行时诊断能力。

Event 模块的核心模型是：同步、强类型、可预测。默认 `Publish` / `Subscribe` 语义保持同步立即分发；需要等待异步监听器时使用独立的 `PublishAsync` / `SubscribeAsync`，不要把同步事件和异步流程混在一起。

常见适用场景：

- UI、玩法、资源、战斗等系统间解耦通信。
- UI View / HUD / 场景对象的短生命周期订阅。
- 需要跨帧延迟派发的事件。
- 需要等待多个系统异步准备完成的流程。
- 使用 ScriptableObject 事件资产进行可视化触发和桥接。
- 运行时诊断订阅泄漏、owner 未解绑、Post 队列堆积。

## 核心类型

### EventManager

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventManager.cs`

事件系统运行时宿主，由框架初始化流程统一创建，通常通过 `FRFM.Event` 访问。

常用 API：

```csharp
IDisposable Subscribe<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
IDisposable SubscribeOnce<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
IDisposable SubscribeAsync<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
IDisposable SubscribeAsyncOnce<TEvent>(Func<TEvent, UniTask> handler, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
int Unsubscribe<TEvent>(Action<TEvent> handler);
int UnsubscribeAll(object owner);
void Publish<TEvent>(TEvent evt);
UniTask PublishAsync<TEvent>(TEvent evt, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);
void Post<TEvent>(TEvent evt);
void Flush();
int Flush(int maxCount);
int ClearPostQueue();
int ClearPostQueue<TEvent>();
int ClearPostQueue(Type eventType);
int GetListenerCount<TEvent>();
int GetPostQueueCount();
EventBusSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
void ClearAll();
```

`EventManager.Update()` 会按 `Bus.Options.MaxFlushCountPerFrame` 自动 Flush 延迟队列。

### EventBus

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Event/EventBus.cs`

强类型事件总线核心实现。一般业务使用 `FRFM.Event`，只有需要独立事件通道时才直接创建 `EventBus`。

特性：

- 强类型事件订阅和分发。
- once 订阅。
- owner 批量解绑。
- priority 优先级。
- 分发期间安全增删监听。
- Post / Flush 延迟分发。
- 独立异步监听器通道。
- 监听器异常策略。
- 运行时统计和快照。

## 基础同步事件

### 定义事件

推荐使用 struct 或小型 class 表达事件参数：

```csharp
public readonly struct PlayerLevelUpEvent
{
    public readonly int PlayerId;
    public readonly int Level;

    public PlayerLevelUpEvent(int playerId, int level)
    {
        PlayerId = playerId;
        Level = level;
    }
}
```

### 订阅与发布

```csharp
private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

private void OnEnable()
{
    FRFM.Event.Subscribe<PlayerLevelUpEvent>(OnPlayerLevelUp, owner: this)
        .AddTo(_scope);
}

private void OnDisable()
{
    _scope.Clear();
}

private void OnPlayerLevelUp(PlayerLevelUpEvent evt)
{
    FRLog.Info("Event", $"Player {evt.PlayerId} level up to {evt.Level}");
}

private void LevelUp()
{
    FRFM.Event.Publish(new PlayerLevelUpEvent(1001, 5));
}
```

### 一次性订阅

```csharp
FRFM.Event.SubscribeOnce<TutorialFinishedEvent>(OnTutorialFinished, owner: this)
    .AddTo(_scope);
```

首次触发后自动 Dispose。

### 优先级

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Subscribe<DamageEvent>(ApplyShield, priority: 100);
FRFM.Event.Subscribe<DamageEvent>(ApplyHpDamage, priority: 0);
```

priority 越大越先执行；同 priority 按订阅顺序执行。

## 订阅生命周期

### EventSubscriptionScope

适合 OnEnable / OnDisable 生命周期：

```csharp
private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

private void OnEnable()
{
    FRFM.Event.Subscribe<ItemChangedEvent>(OnItemChanged).AddTo(_scope);
}

private void OnDisable()
{
    _scope.Clear();
}

private void OnDestroy()
{
    _scope.Dispose();
}
```

`Clear()` 会释放已收集订阅，但 scope 可继续复用。`Dispose()` 后 scope 进入终态，不允许继续 Add。

### AddTo(MonoBehaviour)

语法糖和防漏工具：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Subscribe<ItemChangedEvent>(OnItemChanged)
    .AddTo(this);
```

该扩展会自动给当前 GameObject 添加 `EventSubscriptionScopeComponent`，并在 `OnDestroy` 时统一 Dispose。

注意：如果订阅发生在 `OnEnable`，但只用 `.AddTo(this)`，对象 Disable 后仍会收到事件，直到 Destroy。需要 Disable 即解绑时，应使用显式 `EventSubscriptionScope` 并在 `OnDisable` 调用 `Clear()`。

### owner 批量解绑

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Subscribe<BattleEndEvent>(OnBattleEnd, owner: this);
FRFM.Event.UnsubscribeAll(this);
```

适合系统、服务或长期对象按 owner 管理订阅。

## 延迟事件 Post / Flush

`Post` 会把事件加入队列，等待 `Flush` 时分发：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Post(new GoldChangedEvent(100));
```

默认 `EventManager.Update()` 每帧 Flush。手动控制：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Flush();
FRFM.Event.Flush(maxCount: 20);
```

行为规则：

- `Flush()` 只处理本轮开始时已有事件。
- Flush 期间新增的 Post 留到下一次 Flush。
- `Flush(int maxCount)` 最多处理指定数量。
- 可通过 `ClearPostQueue<TEvent>()` 清理指定类型延迟事件。

## 队列治理配置

`EventBusOptions`：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Bus.Options.MaxPostQueueCount = 1000;
FRFM.Event.Bus.Options.MaxFlushCountPerFrame = 100;
FRFM.Event.Bus.Options.OverflowPolicy = EventPostOverflowPolicy.WarningAndDropNewest;
```

溢出策略：

```csharp
public enum EventPostOverflowPolicy
{
    WarningAndDropNewest,
    DropNewest,
    DropOldest,
    Throw
}
```

默认不限制队列数量。高频事件或线上环境建议设置队列上限和单帧 Flush 上限。

## 异步事件通道

异步事件独立于同步 `Publish`：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.SubscribeAsync<LoginSuccessEvent>(PrepareInventoryAsync, owner: this, priority: 100)
    .AddTo(_scope);

await FRFM.Event.PublishAsync(new LoginSuccessEvent(userId), cancellationToken);
```

执行规则：

- 按 priority 降序执行。
- 同 priority 按订阅顺序执行。
- 当前实现按顺序 await，一个监听器完成后再执行下一个。
- `SubscribeAsyncOnce` 首次执行后自动移除。
- 异步监听器同样支持 owner 批量解绑。

适合场景：

- 登录成功后等待背包、任务、邮件等系统准备完成。
- 切场景前等待存档、网络同步、资源释放完成。
- 新手引导等待弹窗、剧情播放完成后继续。

不需要等待结果的普通通知继续使用同步 `Publish`。

## 监听器异常策略

配置：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Bus.Options.ExceptionPolicy = EventExceptionPolicy.LogAndContinue;
```

策略：

```csharp
public enum EventExceptionPolicy
{
    Throw,
    LogAndContinue,
    CollectAndThrow
}
```

- `Throw`：默认行为，监听器异常直接向上传播。
- `LogAndContinue`：用 `FRLog.Exception("Event", ...)` 记录并继续后续监听器。
- `CollectAndThrow`：执行完所有监听器后抛出 `EventDispatchAggregateException`。

开发期建议使用默认 `Throw` 及时暴露问题；运行期关键通道可按需要使用 `LogAndContinue`。

## ScriptableObject 事件资产

### 无参 GameEventAsset

```csharp
[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Events/Void Game Event")]
public sealed class VoidGameEventAsset : GameEventAsset
{
}
```

API：

```csharp
IDisposable Register(Action listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
IDisposable RegisterOnce(Action listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
int Unregister(Action listener);
int UnregisterAll(object owner);
void Raise();
void Post();
void Flush();
int GetListenerCount();
GameEventAssetSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
void ClearAll();
```

### 单参数 GameEventAsset<T>

```csharp
[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "Events/Int Game Event")]
public sealed class IntGameEventAsset : GameEventAsset<int>
{
}
```

API：

```csharp
IDisposable Register(Action<T> listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
IDisposable RegisterOnce(Action<T> listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0);
int Unregister(Action<T> listener);
int UnregisterAll(object owner);
void Raise(T value);
void Post(T value);
void Flush();
int GetListenerCount();
GameEventAssetSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
void ClearAll();
```

快照字段：事件资产名、监听数量、Post 队列数量、Raise 次数、最近 Raise 时间。

## AssetEventBridge

资产事件桥接到代码事件总线：

```csharp
FRFM.Event.Bridge.Bind(playerDeadAsset, () => new PlayerDeadEvent(1)).AddTo(_scope);
FRFM.Event.Bridge.Bind<int, GoldChangedEvent>(goldChangedAsset, value => new GoldChangedEvent(value)).AddTo(_scope);
```

推荐在需要策划或场景资产触发代码事件时使用。桥接后业务系统仍订阅强类型代码事件。

## 事件录制

`EventRecorder` 用于调试关键事件流：

```csharp
var recorder = new EventRecorder();
recorder.Start();
recorder.Record(new BattleStartEvent());
IReadOnlyList<EventRecord> records = recorder.Stop();
```

记录字段：事件类型、类型名、Json、时间、帧号。该功能用于调试，不保证完整复现所有副作用。

## 诊断 API

### EventBusSnapshot

```csharp
EventBusSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.Event.CreateSnapshot();
```

包含：

- 总监听数量。
- 事件类型数量。
- owner 数量。
- Post 队列长度。
- 各事件类型 listener count、once count、优先级范围。
- 各 owner subscription count。

### 常用统计查询

```csharp
int count = FRFM.Event.GetListenerCount<PlayerLevelUpEvent>();
int queueCount = FRFM.Event.GetPostQueueCount();
int ownerCount = FRFM.Event.Bus.GetOwnerCount();
bool hasListener = FRFM.Event.Bus.HasListener<PlayerLevelUpEvent>();
```

### Editor 窗口

菜单：`FRFrame/Diagnostics/Event Diagnostics`

可查看监听数量、事件类型、owner、Post 队列和各类快照，并可清理 Post 队列。

## 推荐工作流

### 普通业务通知

1. 定义强类型事件。
2. 发布方调用 `FRFM.Event.Publish(evt)`。
3. 订阅方在 OnEnable Subscribe，在 OnDisable Clear。
4. 使用 `owner` 或 scope 管理生命周期。

### UI / 场景对象订阅

- Disable 后不应接收事件：使用 `EventSubscriptionScope` + `OnDisable.Clear()`。
- 只需 Destroy 自动释放：使用 `.AddTo(this)`。

### 需要跨帧或削峰

- 使用 `Post`，配置 `MaxFlushCountPerFrame`。
- 高频事件设置 `MaxPostQueueCount` 和溢出策略。

### 需要等待监听器

- 使用 `SubscribeAsync` / `PublishAsync`。
- 保持异步事件语义清晰，不要让同步事件承担等待流程。

### ScriptableObject 事件

- 资产事件用于 Inspector 连接和调试触发。
- 复杂业务仍桥接到强类型代码事件，避免业务散落在资产监听中。

## 使用规范

- 业务不要直接 `new EventManager()`，使用 `FRFM.Event`。
- 事件类型应表达清晰含义，避免用 `object` 或字符串事件名。
- 高频事件参数可结合 Pool 模块复用，但发布后不要再修改被监听器使用的数据。
- 订阅必须有释放策略：scope、owner 或 AddTo(MonoBehaviour)。
- 同步 `Publish` 默认可抛异常，监听器内异常会影响发布方。
- 异步事件只用于发布方确实需要等待的流程。
- Post 队列不是无限缓存，高频使用时必须考虑上限和清理。
- ScriptableObject 事件适合桥接和调试，不替代核心代码事件模型。
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class EventRecorder
    {
        private readonly List<EventRecord> _records = new List<EventRecord>();

        public bool IsRecording { get; private set; }

        public void Start()
        {
            IsRecording = true;
            _records.Clear();
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<EventRecord> Stop()
        {
            IsRecording = false;
            return _records;
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            _records.Clear();
        }

        public void Record<TEvent>(TEvent evt)
        {
            if (!IsRecording)
                return;

            string json = string.Empty;
            try
            {
                json = JsonUtility.ToJson(evt);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                FRLog.WarningT("Event", $"Event record serialize failed. Event:{typeof(TEvent).FullName}, Error:{e.Message}");
            }

            _records.Add(new EventRecord
            {
                EventType = typeof(TEvent),
                EventTypeName = typeof(TEvent).FullName,
                Json = json,
                Time = Time.realtimeSinceStartup,
                Frame = Time.frameCount
            });
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 订阅扩展工具。
    /// </summary>
    public static class EventSubscriptionExtensions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 将一个 IDisposable 订阅句柄加入指定作用域，并返回原对象，便于链式调用。
        /// </summary>
        public static TDisposable AddTo<TDisposable>(
            this TDisposable disposable,
            EventSubscriptionScope scope)
            where TDisposable : IDisposable
        {
            if (disposable == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(disposable));

            if (scope == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(scope));

            scope.Add(disposable);
            return disposable;
        }

        public static TDisposable AddTo<TDisposable>(
            this TDisposable disposable,
            MonoBehaviour owner)
            where TDisposable : IDisposable
        {
            if (disposable == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(disposable));

            if (owner == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(owner));

            EventSubscriptionScopeComponent component = owner.GetComponent<EventSubscriptionScopeComponent>();
            if (component == null)
                component = owner.gameObject.AddComponent<EventSubscriptionScopeComponent>();

            component.Add(disposable);
            return disposable;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Event/EventSubscriptionScope.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 订阅作用域。
    /// 用于统一收集多个 IDisposable 订阅句柄，并在适当时机统一释放。
    ///
    /// 典型用法：
    /// var scope = new EventSubscriptionScope();
    /// bus.Subscribe<FooEvent>(OnFoo).AddTo(scope);
    /// ...
    /// scope.Dispose();
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class EventSubscriptionScope : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly List<IDisposable> _subscriptions = new List<IDisposable>();
        private bool _disposed;

        /// <summary>
        /// 将一个订阅句柄加入当前作用域。
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="subscription">订阅句柄，不能为 null。</param>
        /// <exception cref="ArgumentNullException"></exception>
        /// <exception cref="ObjectDisposedException"></exception>
        public void Add(IDisposable subscription)
        {
            if (subscription == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(subscription));

            if (_disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(EventSubscriptionScope));

            _subscriptions.Add(subscription);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 释放当前作用域中已收集的所有订阅。
        /// scope 本身仍可继续使用。
        /// </summary>
        public void Clear()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _subscriptions.Count; i++)
            {
                _subscriptions[i]?.Dispose();
            }

            _subscriptions.Clear();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 释放当前作用域中已收集的所有订阅，并使该 scope 进入终态。
        /// Dispose 后不允许继续 Add。
        /// </summary>
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;

            _disposed = true;
            Clear();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Event/GameEventAsset.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public abstract class GameEventAsset : ScriptableObject
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<object, List<Subscription>> _subscriptionsByOwner = new Dictionary<object, List<Subscription>>();
        private readonly List<Subscription> _listeners = new List<Subscription>();
        private readonly List<Subscription> _pendingAdd = new List<Subscription>();
        private readonly List<Subscription> _pendingRemove = new List<Subscription>();
        private readonly Queue<Action> _postQueue = new Queue<Action>();

        private int _dispatchDepth;
        private bool _needsSort;
        private long _nextId = 1;
        private long _nextSequence = 1;

        public int RaiseCount { get; private set; }
        public float LastRaiseTime { get; private set; } = -1f;

        public IDisposable Register(Action listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            if (listener == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(listener));

            var sub = new Subscription(this, listener, owner, priority, false, _nextId++, _nextSequence++);
            Add(sub);
            RegisterOwnerSubscription(owner, sub);
            return sub;
        }

        public IDisposable RegisterOnce(Action listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            if (listener == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(listener));

            var sub = new Subscription(this, listener, owner, priority, true, _nextId++, _nextSequence++);
            Add(sub);
            RegisterOwnerSubscription(owner, sub);
            return sub;
        }

        public int Unregister(Action listener)
        {
            if (listener == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(listener));

            int removed = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count; i++)
            {
                var sub = _listeners[i];
                if (!sub.IsDisposed && sub.Listener == listener)
                {
                    sub.Dispose();
                    removed++;
                }
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < _pendingAdd.Count; i++)
            {
                var sub = _pendingAdd[i];
                if (!sub.IsDisposed && sub.Listener == listener)
                {
                    sub.Dispose();
                    removed++;
                }
            }

            return removed;
        }

        public int UnregisterAll(object owner)
        {
            if (owner == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(owner));

            if (!_subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(owner, out List<Subscription> subscriptions))
                return 0;

            var snapshot = new List<Subscription>(subscriptions);
            int removed = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Count; i++)
            {
                var sub = snapshot[i];
                if (sub == null || sub.IsDisposed)
                    continue;
                sub.Dispose();
                removed++;
            }

            return removed;
        }

        public void Raise()
        {
            RaiseCount++;
            LastRaiseTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartup;
            if (_needsSort)
                SortNow();

            _dispatchDepth++;
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count; i++)
                {
                    var sub = _listeners[i];
                    if (sub.IsDisposed)
                        continue;

                    sub.Listener.Invoke();
                    if (sub.IsOnce && !sub.IsDisposed)
                        sub.Dispose();
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _dispatchDepth--;
                if (_dispatchDepth == 0)
                    ApplyPendingChanges();
            }
        }

        public void Post()
        {
            _postQueue.Enqueue(Raise);
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            int count = _postQueue.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                _postQueue.Dequeue().Invoke();
        }

        public int GetListenerCount()
        {
            return _listeners.Count + _pendingAdd.Count;
        }

        public GameEventAssetSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            return new GameEventAssetSnapshot
            {
                Name = name,
                ListenerCount = GetListenerCount(),
                PostQueueCount = _postQueue.Count,
                RaiseCount = RaiseCount,
                LastRaiseTime = LastRaiseTime
            };
        }

        public void ClearAll()
        {
            var snapshotMain = new List<Subscription>(_listeners);
            var snapshotPending = new List<Subscription>(_pendingAdd);
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshotMain.Count; i++)
                if (!snapshotMain[i].IsDisposed) snapshotMain[i].Dispose();
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshotPending.Count; i++)
                if (!snapshotPending[i].IsDisposed) snapshotPending[i].Dispose();

            if (_dispatchDepth == 0)
            {
                _listeners.Clear();
                _pendingAdd.Clear();
                _pendingRemove.Clear();
                _needsSort = false;
                _subscriptionsByOwner.Clear();
                _postQueue.Clear();
            }
        }

        private void Add(Subscription sub)
        {
            if (_dispatchDepth > 0)
                _pendingAdd.Add(sub);
            else
                _listeners.Add(sub);
            _needsSort = true;
        }

        private void Remove(Subscription sub)
        {
            if (_dispatchDepth > 0)
            {
                if (!_pendingRemove.Contains(sub))
                    _pendingRemove.Add(sub);
            }
            else
            {
                bool removed = _listeners.Remove(sub) | _pendingAdd.Remove(sub);
                if (removed)
                    OnSubscriptionRemoved(sub);
            }
        }

        private void ApplyPendingChanges()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _pendingRemove.Count; i++)
            {
                Subscription sub = _pendingRemove[i];
                bool removed = _listeners.Remove(sub) | _pendingAdd.Remove(sub);
                if (removed)
                    OnSubscriptionRemoved(sub);
            }
            _pendingRemove.Clear();

            for (int i = 0; i < _pendingAdd.Count; i++)
            {
                Subscription sub = _pendingAdd[i];
                if (!sub.IsDisposed)
                    _listeners.Add(sub);
                else
                    OnSubscriptionRemoved(sub);
            }
            _pendingAdd.Clear();

            if (_needsSort)
                SortNow();
        }

        private void SortNow()
        {
            _listeners.Sort(CompareSubscription);
            _needsSort = false;
        }

        private static int CompareSubscription(Subscription a, Subscription b)
        {
            int priorityCompare = b.Priority.CompareTo(a.Priority);
            return priorityCompare != 0 ? priorityCompare : a.Sequence.CompareTo(b.Sequence);
        }

        private void RegisterOwnerSubscription(object owner, Subscription sub)
        {
            if (owner == null)
                return;

            if (!_subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(owner, out List<Subscription> list))
            {
                list = new List<Subscription>();
                _subscriptionsByOwner.Add(owner, list);
            }

            list.Add(sub);
        }

        private void OnSubscriptionRemoved(Subscription sub)
        {
            if (sub == null || sub.Owner == null)
                return;

            if (_subscriptionsByOwner.TryGetValue(sub.Owner, out List<Subscription> list))
            {
                list.Remove(sub);
                if (list.Count == 0)
                    _subscriptionsByOwner.Remove(sub.Owner);
            }
        }

        private sealed class Subscription : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly GameEventAsset _asset;
            public Action Listener { get; }
            public object Owner { get; }
            public int Priority { get; }
            public bool IsOnce { get; }
            public long Sequence { get; }
            public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

            public Subscription(GameEventAsset asset, Action listener, object owner, int priority, bool isOnce, long id, long sequence)
            {
                _asset = asset;
                Listener = listener;
                Owner = owner;
                Priority = priority;
                IsOnce = isOnce;
                Sequence = sequence;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (IsDisposed)
                    return;
                IsDisposed = true;
                _asset.Remove(this);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public abstract class GameEventAsset<T> : ScriptableObject
    {
        private readonly EventBus _bus = new EventBus();
        private int _raiseCount;
        private float _lastRaiseTime = -1f;

        public IDisposable Register(Action<T> listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            return _bus.Subscribe(listener, owner, priority);
        }

        public IDisposable RegisterOnce(Action<T> listener, object owner = null, int priority = 0)
        {
            return _bus.SubscribeOnce(listener, owner, priority);
        }

        public int Unregister(Action<T> listener)
        {
            return _bus.Unsubscribe(listener);
        }

        public int UnregisterAll(object owner)
        {
            return _bus.UnsubscribeAll(owner);
        }

        public void Raise(T value)
        {
            _raiseCount++;
            _lastRaiseTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartup;
            _bus.Publish(value);
        }

        public void Post(T value)
        {
            _bus.Post(value);
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            _bus.Flush();
        }

        public int GetListenerCount()
        {
            return _bus.GetListenerCount<T>();
        }

        public GameEventAssetSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            return new GameEventAssetSnapshot
            {
                Name = name,
                ListenerCount = GetListenerCount(),
                PostQueueCount = _bus.GetPostQueueCount(),
                RaiseCount = _raiseCount,
                LastRaiseTime = _lastRaiseTime
            };
        }

        public void ClearAll()
        {
            _bus.ClearAll();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Fsm/AsyncFsmState.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public abstract class AsyncFsmState : FsmState
    {
        private CancellationTokenSource _cancellationTokenSource;

        protected CancellationToken CancellationToken => _cancellationTokenSource?.Token ?? CancellationToken.None;

        public override void OnEnter()
        {
            _cancellationTokenSource?.Dispose();
            _cancellationTokenSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
            RunEnterAsync(_cancellationTokenSource.Token).Forget();
        }

        public override void OnExit()
        {
            if (_cancellationTokenSource == null)
                return;

            _cancellationTokenSource.Cancel();
            _cancellationTokenSource.Dispose();
            _cancellationTokenSource = null;
        }

        protected virtual UniTask OnEnterAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        private async UniTaskVoid RunEnterAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                await OnEnterAsync(cancellationToken);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                FRLog.Exception("FSM", e, $"Async state failed. State:{GetType().FullName}");
                if (fsmController is FsmTaskController taskController)
                    taskController.Fail(e.Message, e);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public partial class FsmController
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, object> _blackboard = new Dictionary<string, object>(8);

        public void SetData(string key, object data)
        {
            _blackboard[key] = data;
        }

        public object GetData(string key)
        {
            if (!_blackboard.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
            {
                var msg = $"黑板中不存在 Key : {key}";
                LogError($"[FSM] {Name} GetData Error => {msg}");
                throw new Exception(msg);
            }

            return value;
        }

        public T GetData<T>(string key)
        {
            return (T)GetData(key);
        }

        public void SetData<Tag>(object value)
        {
            SetData(typeof(Tag).FullName, value);
        }

        public T GetData<T, Tag>()
        {
            return GetData<T>(typeof(Tag).FullName);
        }

        public void SetData<T>(T value)
        {
            SetData(typeof(T).FullName, value);
        }

        public T GetData<T>()
        {
            return GetData<T>(typeof(T).FullName);
        }

        public bool TryGetData(string key, out object value)
        {
            return _blackboard.TryGetValue(key, out value);
        }

        public bool TryGetData(Type type, out object value)
        {
            if (type == null)
            {
                value = null;
                return false;
            }

            return TryGetData(type.FullName, out value);
        }

        public bool TryGetData<T>(string key, out T value)
        {
            if (_blackboard.TryGetValue(key, out var obj))
            {
                if (obj is T t)
                {
                    value = t;
                    return true;
                }

                LogWarning($"Blackboard type mismatch. Fsm:{Name}, Key:{key}, Expected:{typeof(T).FullName}, Actual:{obj?.GetType().FullName ?? "null"}");
            }

            value = default;
            return false;
        }

        public bool TryGetData<T>(out T value)
        {
            return TryGetData(typeof(T).FullName, out value);
        }

        public bool TryGetData<TValue, TTag>(out TValue value)
        {
            return TryGetData(typeof(TTag).FullName, out value);
        }

        public T GetDataOrDefault<T>(string key, T defaultValue = default)
        {
            return TryGetData(key, out T value) ? value : defaultValue;
        }

        public T GetDataOrDefault<T>(T defaultValue = default)
        {
            return TryGetData(out T value) ? value : defaultValue;
        }

        public bool ContainsData(string key)
        {
            return _blackboard.ContainsKey(key);
        }

        public void RemoveData(string key)
        {
            _blackboard.Remove(key);
        }

        public void ClearBlackboard()
        {
            _blackboard.Clear();
        }

        protected void GetBlackboardKeys(List<string> results)
        {
            results.Clear();
            foreach (var pair in _blackboard)
                results.Add(pair.Key);
        }
    }
}
````
