````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public abstract partial class FsmController : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, FsmState> _states = new Dictionary<Type, FsmState>(8);
        private readonly List<string> _stateNames = new List<string>(8);
        private readonly HashSet<FsmTransitionKey> _transitionRules = new HashSet<FsmTransitionKey>();
        private readonly List<FsmStateChangeRecord> _stateHistory = new List<FsmStateChangeRecord>(32);
        private readonly List<string> _blackboardKeysCache = new List<string>(8);

        private float _runTime;

        public string Name => GetType().Name;
        public string CurrentStateName => CurState?.GetType().Name ?? string.Empty;
        public FsmState CurState { get; private set; }
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }
        public bool IsPaused { get; private set; }
        public object Owner { get; internal set; }
        public float RunTime => _runTime;
        public int StateCount => _states.Count;
        public IReadOnlyList<string> StateNames => _stateNames;
        public IReadOnlyList<FsmStateChangeRecord> StateHistory => _stateHistory;
        public bool EnableLog { get; internal set; }
        public FsmTransitionPolicy TransitionPolicy { get; set; } = FsmTransitionPolicy.Free;
        public int MaxStateHistoryCount { get; set; } = 32;

        public event Action<FsmController> OnInitialized;
        public event Action<FsmController, FsmState, FsmState> OnStateChanged;
        public event Action<FsmController> OnDisposed;

        public void Initialize()
        {
            OnInitialize();
            OnInitialized?.Invoke(this);
            LogInfo($"[FSM] Initialize => {Name}");
        }

        protected virtual void OnInitialize()
        {
        }

        public virtual void Update(float elapseSeconds, float realElapseSeconds)
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return;

            _runTime += elapseSeconds;
            if (IsPaused) return;

            CurState?.OnUpdate(elapseSeconds, realElapseSeconds);
        }

        public void Pause()
        {
            if (IsDisposed || IsPaused)
                return;

            IsPaused = true;
            CurState?.OnPause();
            LogInfo($"[FSM] Pause => {Name}");
        }

        public void Resume()
        {
            if (IsDisposed || !IsPaused)
                return;

            IsPaused = false;
            CurState?.OnResume();
            LogInfo($"[FSM] Resume => {Name}");
        }

        protected T AddState<T>() where T : FsmState, new()
        {
            var type = typeof(T);
            if (_states.TryGetValue(type, out var existed))
                return (T)existed;

            var state = new T();
            state.OnInit(this);
            _states.Add(type, state);
            _stateNames.Add(type.Name);
            LogInfo($"[FSM] {Name} AddState => {type.Name}");
            return state;
        }

        protected FsmState AddState(FsmState state)
        {
            if (state == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(state));

            var type = state.GetType();
            if (_states.TryGetValue(type, out var existed))
                return existed;

            state.OnInit(this);
            _states.Add(type, state);
            _stateNames.Add(type.Name);
            LogInfo($"[FSM] {Name} AddState => {type.Name}");
            return state;
        }

        public T GetState<T>() where T : FsmState
        {
            _states.TryGetValue(typeof(T), out var state);
            return state as T;
        }

        public bool TryGetState(Type stateType, out FsmState state)
        {
            if (stateType == null)
            {
                state = null;
                return false;
            }

            return _states.TryGetValue(stateType, out state);
        }

        public bool TryGetState(string stateName, out FsmState state)
        {
            state = null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stateName))
                return false;

            FsmState simpleMatch = null;
            foreach (var pair in _states)
            {
                Type type = pair.Key;
                if (type.FullName == stateName || pair.Value.StateName == stateName)
                {
                    state = pair.Value;
                    return true;
                }

                if (type.Name == stateName)
                {
                    if (simpleMatch != null)
                    {
                        LogError($"[FSM] {Name} TryGetState Error => State name conflict: {stateName}");
                        state = null;
                        return false;
                    }

                    simpleMatch = pair.Value;
                }
            }

            state = simpleMatch;
            return state != null;
        }

        public bool HasState<T>() where T : FsmState
        {
            return _states.ContainsKey(typeof(T));
        }

        public virtual bool ChangeState<T>() where T : FsmState
        {
            return ChangeState(typeof(T));
        }

        public virtual bool ChangeState(Type stateType)
        {
            if (!TryGetState(stateType, out FsmState next))
            {
                var msg = $"状态未注册: {stateType?.Name ?? "null"}";
                LogError($"[FSM] {Name} ChangeState Error => {msg}");
                throw new Exception(msg);
            }

            return ChangeStateInternal(next);
        }

        public virtual bool ChangeState(string stateName)
        {
            if (!TryGetState(stateName, out FsmState next))
            {
                LogError($"[FSM] {Name} ChangeState Error => 状态未注册: {stateName}");
                return false;
            }

            return ChangeStateInternal(next);
        }

        protected void AddTransition<TFrom, TTo>() where TFrom : FsmState where TTo : FsmState
        {
            AddTransition(typeof(TFrom), typeof(TTo));
        }

        protected void AddTransition(Type from, Type to)
        {
            if (from == null || to == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(from == null ? nameof(from) : nameof(to));

            _transitionRules.Add(new FsmTransitionKey(from, to));
        }

        protected virtual bool CanChangeState(Type from, Type to)
        {
            if (_transitionRules.Count == 0 || from == null)
                return true;

            return _transitionRules.Contains(new FsmTransitionKey(from, to));
        }

        public void ClearStateHistory()
        {
            _stateHistory.Clear();
        }

        public virtual FsmDebugInfo GetDebugInfo()
        {
            GetBlackboardKeys(_blackboardKeysCache);
            return new FsmDebugInfo
            {
                Name = Name,
                FsmName = Name,
                TypeName = GetType().FullName,
                OwnerName = Owner?.ToString() ?? string.Empty,
                OwnerTypeName = Owner?.GetType().FullName ?? string.Empty,
                CurrentStateName = CurrentStateName,
                CurrentStateTypeName = CurState?.GetType().FullName ?? string.Empty,
                IsDisposed = IsDisposed,
                IsPaused = IsPaused,
                RunTime = RunTime,
                StateCount = StateCount,
                StateNames = new List<string>(_stateNames),
                BlackboardKeys = new List<string>(_blackboardKeysCache),
                StateHistory = new List<FsmStateChangeRecord>(_stateHistory),
                IsTask = this is FsmTaskController,
                IsTaskFsm = this is FsmTaskController,
                TaskState = this is FsmTaskController taskFsm ? taskFsm.TaskState : TaskState.None
            };
        }

        protected void LogDebug(string message)
        {
            if (EnableLog) FRLog.DebugT("FSM", message);
        }

        protected void LogInfo(string message)
        {
            if (EnableLog) FRLog.InfoT("FSM", message);
        }

        protected void LogWarning(string message)
        {
            if (EnableLog) FRLog.WarningT("FSM", message);
        }

        protected void LogError(string message)
        {
            if (EnableLog) FRLog.ErrorT("FSM", message);
        }

        protected void Log(string message)
        {
            LogInfo(message);
        }

        public virtual void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return;
            IsDisposed = true;

            LogInfo($"[FSM] Dispose => {Name}");
            CurState?.OnExit();
            CurState = null;
            _states.Clear();
            _transitionRules.Clear();
            _stateHistory.Clear();
            _blackboard.Clear();
            _stateNames.Clear();
            Owner = null;
            OnDisposed?.Invoke(this);
            OnInitialized = null;
            OnStateChanged = null;
            OnDisposed = null;
        }

        private bool ChangeStateInternal(FsmState next)
        {
            if (ReferenceEquals(CurState, next))
                return false;

            Type fromType = CurState?.GetType();
            Type toType = next.GetType();
            bool canChange = CanChangeState(fromType, toType);
            if (!canChange)
            {
                string message = $"[FSM] {Name} Invalid transition => {fromType?.Name ?? "None"} -> {toType.Name}";
                if (TransitionPolicy == FsmTransitionPolicy.Strict)
                {
                    LogError(message);
                    return false;
                }

                if (TransitionPolicy == FsmTransitionPolicy.WarningOnly)
                    LogWarning(message);
            }

            var prev = CurState;
            prev?.OnExit();
            CurState = next;
            CurState.OnEnter();
            RecordStateChange(prev, CurState);
            LogInfo($"[FSM] {Name} ChangeState => {prev?.GetType().Name ?? "None"} -> {CurState.GetType().Name}");
            OnStateChanged?.Invoke(this, prev, CurState);
            return true;
        }

        private void RecordStateChange(FsmState from, FsmState to)
        {
            if (MaxStateHistoryCount <= 0)
                return;

            _stateHistory.Add(new FsmStateChangeRecord
            {
                FromState = from?.GetType().Name ?? string.Empty,
                ToState = to?.GetType().Name ?? string.Empty,
                Time = Time.realtimeSinceStartup,
                Frame = Time.frameCount
            });

            while (_stateHistory.Count > MaxStateHistoryCount)
                _stateHistory.RemoveAt(0);
        }

        private readonly struct FsmTransitionKey : IEquatable<FsmTransitionKey>
        {
            private readonly Type _from;
            private readonly Type _to;

            public FsmTransitionKey(Type from, Type to)
            {
                _from = from;
                _to = to;
            }

            public bool Equals(FsmTransitionKey other)
            {
                return _from == other._from && _to == other._to;
            }

            public override bool Equals(object obj)
            {
                return obj is FsmTransitionKey other && Equals(other);
            }

            public override int GetHashCode()
            {
                unchecked
                {
                    return ((_from != null ? _from.GetHashCode() : 0) * 397) ^ (_to != null ? _to.GetHashCode() : 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public class FsmManager : IManagerBase
    {
        public override int Priority => 2;

        private sealed class FsmRuntime
        {
            public FsmController Fsm;
            public FsmCreateOption Option;
        }

        private readonly List<FsmRuntime> _runtimes = new List<FsmRuntime>(16);
        private readonly FsmManagerStatistics _statistics = new FsmManagerStatistics();

        public int Count => _runtimes.Count;

        public override UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        public T CreateFsm<T>(FsmCreateOption option = null) where T : FsmController, new()
        {
            T fsm = new T();
            SetupFsm(fsm, option);
            return fsm;
        }

        public FsmController CreateFsm(Type type, FsmCreateOption option = null)
        {
            if (type == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(type));
            if (!typeof(FsmController).IsAssignableFrom(type))
                throw new Exception($"{type.FullName} 不是 FsmController 类型");

            FsmController fsm = (FsmController)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
            SetupFsm(fsm, option);
            return fsm;
        }

        public bool RemoveFsm(FsmController fsm)
        {
            if (fsm == null) return false;

            for (int i = _runtimes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(_runtimes[i].Fsm, fsm))
                {
                    if (fsm.EnableLog)
                        FRLog.InfoT("FSM", $"[FSMManager] RemoveFsm => {fsm.Name}");

                    _runtimes[i].Fsm.Dispose();
                    _runtimes.RemoveAt(i);
                    _statistics.TotalDisposed++;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        public int RemoveByOwner(object owner)
        {
            if (owner == null) return 0;

            int count = 0;
            for (int i = _runtimes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(_runtimes[i].Fsm.Owner, owner))
                {
                    var fsm = _runtimes[i].Fsm;
                    if (fsm.EnableLog)
                        FRLog.InfoT("FSM", $"[FSMManager] RemoveByOwner => {fsm.Name}");

                    fsm.Dispose();
                    _runtimes.RemoveAt(i);
                    _statistics.TotalDisposed++;
                    count++;
                }
            }

            return count;
        }

        public int RemoveByType<T>() where T : FsmController
        {
            int count = 0;
            for (int i = _runtimes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (_runtimes[i].Fsm is T)
                {
                    var fsm = _runtimes[i].Fsm;
                    if (fsm.EnableLog)
                        FRLog.InfoT("FSM", $"[FSMManager] RemoveByType => {fsm.Name}");

                    fsm.Dispose();
                    _runtimes.RemoveAt(i);
                    _statistics.TotalDisposed++;
                    count++;
                }
            }

            return count;
        }

        public T GetFirstFsm<T>() where T : FsmController
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _runtimes.Count; i++)
                if (_runtimes[i].Fsm is T t) return t;
            return null;
        }

        public List<T> GetFsms<T>() where T : FsmController
        {
            var result = new List<T>();
            GetFsms(result);
            return result;
        }

        public void GetFsms<T>(List<T> results) where T : FsmController
        {
            if (results == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(results));
            results.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < _runtimes.Count; i++)
                if (_runtimes[i].Fsm is T t) results.Add(t);
        }

        public int FillFsms<T>(IList<T> results) where T : FsmController
        {
            if (results == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(results));
            results.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < _runtimes.Count; i++)
                if (_runtimes[i].Fsm is T t) results.Add(t);
            return results.Count;
        }

        public List<FsmDebugInfo> GetAllDebugInfo()
        {
            var result = new List<FsmDebugInfo>(_runtimes.Count);
            GetAllDebugInfo(result);
            return result;
        }

        public void GetAllDebugInfo(List<FsmDebugInfo> results)
        {
            if (results == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(results));
            results.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < _runtimes.Count; i++)
            {
                var fsm = _runtimes[i].Fsm;
                if (fsm != null)
                    results.Add(fsm.GetDebugInfo());
            }
        }

        public FsmManagerStatistics GetStatistics()
        {
            int taskCount = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < _runtimes.Count; i++)
                if (_runtimes[i].Fsm is FsmTaskController) taskCount++;

            return new FsmManagerStatistics
            {
                ActiveCount = _runtimes.Count,
                TotalCreated = _statistics.TotalCreated,
                TotalDisposed = _statistics.TotalDisposed,
                TotalAutoRemoved = _statistics.TotalAutoRemoved,
                TaskFsmCount = taskCount
            };
        }

        public override void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            for (int i = _runtimes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                var runtime = _runtimes[i];
                var fsm = runtime.Fsm;

                if (fsm == null || fsm.IsDisposed)
                {
                    _runtimes.RemoveAt(i);
                    continue;
                }

                fsm.Update(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);

                if (runtime.Option.AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone && fsm is FsmTaskController taskFsm && taskFsm.IsDone)
                {
                    if (fsm.EnableLog)
                        FRLog.InfoT("FSM", $"[FSMManager] AutoRemove TaskFsm => {fsm.Name}, TaskState: {taskFsm.TaskState}");

                    taskFsm.Dispose();
                    _runtimes.RemoveAt(i);
                    _statistics.TotalAutoRemoved++;
                    _statistics.TotalDisposed++;
                }
            }
        }

        public override void Dispose()
        {
            for (int i = _runtimes.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (_runtimes[i].Fsm != null && !_runtimes[i].Fsm.IsDisposed)
                    _statistics.TotalDisposed++;
                _runtimes[i].Fsm?.Dispose();
            }

            _runtimes.Clear();
        }

        private void SetupFsm(FsmController fsm, FsmCreateOption option)
        {
            option ??= new FsmCreateOption();
            fsm.Owner = option.Owner;
            fsm.EnableLog = option.EnableLog;
            fsm.Initialize();
            _runtimes.Add(new FsmRuntime { Fsm = fsm, Option = option });
            _statistics.TotalCreated++;

            if (fsm.EnableLog)
                FRLog.InfoT("FSM", $"[FSMManager] CreateFsm => {fsm.Name}, Owner: {fsm.Owner?.GetType().Name ?? "None"}");
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Fsm/FsmModule_Analysis.md
````markdown
# Fsm 模块新功能详细设计

## 设计边界

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Fsm` 保持轻量、代码驱动、类型安全的有限状态机定位。常规业务状态切换继续以 `ChangeState<T>()` 为主，新增 `ChangeState(Type)` 和可选 `ChangeState(string)` 用于编辑器调试、配置化流程、存档恢复和工具链场景。

Fsm 模块后续增强重点：接入 `FRLog`、提升黑板安全性、完善任务型 FSM 结果语义、提供无 GC 查询、诊断可视化、暂停恢复和状态切换治理能力。

## 当前基础

当前 Fsm 模块已具备：

- `FsmManager` 统一创建、更新、移除 FSM。
- `FsmController` 管理状态集合和当前状态。
- `FsmState` 提供 `OnInit` / `OnEnter` / `OnUpdate` / `OnExit` 生命周期。
- 黑板支持 string key、泛型 tag key、类型 key。
- `FsmTaskController` 支持 `UniTask` 等待和任务完成状态。
- `FsmCreateOption` 支持 Owner、EnableLog、AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone。
- `FsmDebugInfo` 提供基础调试快照。
- Resource 模块 YooAsset 初始化/下载流程已实际使用 FSM。

## 功能一：FSM 日志接入 FRLog

### 目标

统一框架日志输出，修正 warning/error 等级不准确的问题，让 FSM 日志受 Log 模块统一配置、文件输出和编译宏控制。

### 调整范围

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Fsm/FsmController.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Fsm/FsmManager.cs`
- 其它直接使用 `Debug.Log` 的 Fsm 文件。

### 设计方案

新增或调整内部日志方法：

```csharp
protected void LogDebug(string message)
{
    if (EnableLog) FRLog.Debug("FSM", message);
}

protected void LogInfo(string message)
{
    if (EnableLog) FRLog.Info("FSM", message);
}

protected void LogWarning(string message)
{
    if (EnableLog) FRLog.Warning("FSM", message);
}

protected void LogError(string message)
{
    if (EnableLog) FRLog.Error("FSM", message);
}
```

`FsmManager` 创建、移除、自动清理任务 FSM 的日志也改为 `FRLog`。

### 行为规则

- `EnableLog` 继续控制单个 FSM 是否输出流程日志。
- warning/error 必须使用对应 `FRLog.Warning` / `FRLog.Error`。
- 不改变 FSM 状态机行为。

### 验收标准

- Fsm 模块不再直接使用 `Debug.Log` 输出框架日志。
- warning/error 在 Unity Console 中等级正确。
- 文件日志开启时可记录 FSM 日志。

## 功能二：黑板安全读取增强

### 目标

降低黑板 key 不存在、类型错误时的定位成本，同时保留严格读取 API。

### 新增 API

```csharp
public bool TryGetData(string key, out object value);
public bool TryGetData(Type type, out object value);
public T GetDataOrDefault<T>(string key, T defaultValue = default);
public T GetDataOrDefault<T>(T defaultValue = default);
public bool TryGetData<T>(out T value);
public bool TryGetData<TValue, TTag>(out TValue value);
```

### 类型错误日志

当 `TryGetData<T>` 发现 key 存在但类型不匹配时，输出：

- FSM 名称。
- key。
- 期望类型。
- 实际类型。

```csharp
FRLog.Warning("FSM", $"Blackboard type mismatch. Fsm:{Name}, Key:{key}, Expected:{typeof(T).FullName}, Actual:{value.GetType().FullName}");
```

### 行为规则

- `GetData<T>` 保持严格语义，可继续抛异常。
- `TryGetData` 不抛异常，返回 false。
- `GetDataOrDefault` 不抛异常，失败返回默认值。

### 验收标准

- 缺 key 时可通过 Try API 安全处理。
- 类型错误时有明确 warning。
- 现有使用 `GetData<T>` 的代码不受影响。

## 功能三：非泛型状态切换

### 目标

支持编辑器调试、配置化流程、存档恢复和工具链通过 `Type` 或状态名驱动状态切换。

### 新增 API

```csharp
public bool ChangeState(Type stateType);
public bool ChangeState(string stateName);
public bool TryGetState(Type stateType, out FsmState state);
public bool TryGetState(string stateName, out FsmState state);
```

### 泛型 API 保留

```csharp
public void ChangeState<T>() where T : FsmState;
```

泛型仍是业务主入口。

### Type 切换适用场景

- Editor 调试窗口选择状态并强制跳转。
- 自动化测试通过反射切换状态。
- 可视化状态图工具驱动运行时跳转。

### string 切换适用场景

- 配置表中保存状态名。
- 存档或调试快照记录当前状态名。
- 外部脚本或控制台命令输入状态名。

### 状态名规则

建议状态名默认使用 `state.GetType().FullName`，同时保留简短 `Name` 用于显示。

查找优先级：

1. FullName 精确匹配。
2. Name 精确匹配。
3. 简名匹配，若冲突则失败并输出 error。

### 验收标准

- `ChangeState(Type)` 可切换到已注册状态。
- `ChangeState(string)` 可按 FullName 或 Name 切换。
- 状态不存在时返回 false 或输出明确错误。
- `ChangeState<T>()` 行为不变。

## 功能四：状态切换合法性约束

### 目标

为复杂 FSM 提供可选 transition 约束，避免误跳状态。

### 新增类型

```csharp
public sealed class FsmTransitionRule
{
    public Type From;
    public Type To;
}

public enum FsmTransitionPolicy
{
    Free,
    WarningOnly,
    Strict
}
```

### FsmController 新增 API

```csharp
public FsmTransitionPolicy TransitionPolicy { get; set; } = FsmTransitionPolicy.Free;
protected void AddTransition<TFrom, TTo>() where TFrom : FsmState where TTo : FsmState;
protected void AddTransition(Type from, Type to);
protected virtual bool CanChangeState(Type from, Type to);
```

### 行为规则

- `Free`：保持现有任意切换。
- `WarningOnly`：非法切换输出 warning，但仍允许切换。
- `Strict`：非法切换输出 error 并拒绝。
- 未配置 transition 时，默认不限制。

### 验收标准

- 默认行为完全兼容现有代码。
- 配置 transition 后能检测非法跳转。
- 子类可重写 `CanChangeState` 实现动态条件。

## 功能五：暂停与恢复

### 目标

支持业务临时暂停状态机更新，例如暂停游戏、切后台、弹窗阻塞流程、剧情等待。

### 新增 API

```csharp
public bool IsPaused { get; private set; }
public void Pause();
public void Resume();
```

### FsmState 新增生命周期

```csharp
protected virtual void OnPause();
protected virtual void OnResume();
```

### 行为规则

- 暂停后 `FsmController.Update` 继续累积或不累积 `RunTime` 需要明确。
- 建议 `RunTime` 表示 FSM 存活时间，继续累积。
- 暂停时不调用当前状态 `OnUpdate`。
- 重复 Pause/Resume 不重复触发生命周期。

### 验收标准

- Pause 后状态 OnUpdate 不再执行。
- Resume 后恢复 OnUpdate。
- 当前状态能收到 OnPause/OnResume。

## 功能六：任务型 FSM 结果语义增强

### 目标

让 `FsmTaskController` 能清晰表达完成、取消、失败原因，便于业务等待流程后判断结果。

### 新增类型

```csharp
public sealed class FsmTaskResult
{
    public TaskState State;
    public bool IsSuccess => State == TaskState.Completed;
    public bool IsCanceled => State == TaskState.Canceled;
    public bool IsFailed => State == TaskState.Failed;
    public string CompleteStateName;
    public string Error;
    public Exception Exception;
    public string CancelReason;
    public FsmTaskController Controller;
}
```

### FsmTaskController 新增 API

```csharp
public string Error { get; private set; }
public Exception Exception { get; private set; }
public string CancelReason { get; private set; }
public UniTask<FsmTaskResult> WaitResultAsync();
public void Cancel(string reason = null);
public void Fail(string error = null, Exception exception = null);
```

### 兼容性

保留现有：

```csharp
UniTask<FsmTaskController> WaitAsync();
void Cancel();
void Fail();
```

旧 API 委托到新 API。

### 行为规则

- `Complete()` 设置 `TaskState.Completed`。
- `Cancel(reason)` 设置 `TaskState.Canceled` 和原因。
- `Fail(error, exception)` 设置 `TaskState.Failed`。
- `Dispose()` 如果任务未完成，可设置 canceled 或保持现有取消语义，但需文档化。

### 验收标准

- 等待者可区分成功、失败、取消。
- 失败时保留错误信息和异常。
- 旧 API 不破坏现有调用。

## 功能七：任务完成状态注册校验

### 目标

`BeginTask(Type completeStateType)` 时提前发现完成状态未注册的问题。

### 新增行为

```csharp
public bool ValidateCompleteStateOnBegin { get; set; } = true;
```

`BeginTask` 中检查：

- `completeStateType` 是否继承 `FsmState`。
- 该状态是否已注册。

失败时：

- 输出 `FRLog.Error`。
- 可直接 `Fail()`。

### 验收标准

- 完成状态未注册时能提前报错。
- 可通过配置关闭校验，兼容特殊动态注册场景。

## 功能八：无 GC 查询 API

### 目标

避免编辑器窗口或运行时频繁查询 FSM 时产生 List 分配。

### FsmManager 新增 API

```csharp
public void GetFsms<T>(List<T> results) where T : FsmController;
public void GetAllDebugInfo(List<FsmDebugInfo> results);
public int FillFsms<T>(IList<T> results) where T : FsmController;
```

### 行为规则

- 方法不主动 Clear 传入列表，还是主动 Clear 需统一约定。
- 建议主动 Clear，减少调用方误用。
- 返回填充数量。

### 兼容性

保留现有：

```csharp
List<T> GetFsms<T>();
List<FsmDebugInfo> GetAllDebugInfo();
```

### 验收标准

- 新 API 可复用外部 List。
- 旧 API 行为不变。

## 功能九：FsmDebugInfo 增强

### 目标

为 Editor 诊断和运行时排查提供更完整快照。

### 字段扩展

```csharp
public sealed class FsmDebugInfo
{
    public string Name;
    public string TypeName;
    public string OwnerName;
    public string OwnerTypeName;
    public string CurrentStateName;
    public string CurrentStateTypeName;
    public float RunTime;
    public int StateCount;
    public bool IsDisposed;
    public bool IsPaused;
    public bool IsTask;
    public TaskState TaskState;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> StateNames;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> BlackboardKeys;
}
```

### 注意事项

黑板只输出 key，不输出 value，避免泄露复杂对象或产生过多 GC。

### 验收标准

- 能区分普通 FSM 和任务 FSM。
- 能看到 Owner、当前状态、暂停状态和黑板 key。

## 功能十：状态切换历史记录

### 目标

辅助排查复杂流程跳转错误。

### 新增类型

```csharp
public sealed class FsmStateChangeRecord
{
    public string FromState;
    public string ToState;
    public float Time;
    public int Frame;
}
```

### FsmController 新增字段/API

```csharp
public int MaxStateHistoryCount { get; set; } = 32;
public IReadOnlyList<FsmStateChangeRecord> StateHistory { get; }
public void ClearStateHistory();
```

### 行为规则

- 每次成功切换状态记录一条。
- 超出最大数量移除最旧记录。
- `MaxStateHistoryCount <= 0` 表示不记录。

### 验收标准

- 可查看最近状态跳转链路。
- 不无限增长。

## 功能十一：FSM 运行统计

### 目标

从框架层观察 FSM 创建、销毁和异常情况。

### 新增类型

```csharp
public sealed class FsmManagerStatistics
{
    public int ActiveCount;
    public int TotalCreated;
    public int TotalDisposed;
    public int TotalAutoRemoved;
    public int TaskFsmCount;
}
```

### FsmManager 新增 API

```csharp
public FsmManagerStatistics GetStatistics();
```

### 验收标准

- 创建、移除、自动移除任务 FSM 时更新统计。
- 可用于 Editor 诊断窗口展示。

## 功能十二：FSM Editor 诊断窗口

### 目标

可视化查看当前运行中的 FSM，辅助调试资源流程、战斗流程、UI 流程。

### 建议路径

`Assets/FRFrame/Editor/Diagnostics/FRFrameFsmDiagnosticsWindow.cs`

菜单：`FRFrame/Diagnostics/FSM Diagnostics`

### 展示内容

- FSM 总数。
- 按类型过滤。
- 按 Owner 过滤。
- 当前状态。
- 运行时间。
- StateCount。
- IsPaused。
- TaskState。
- Blackboard keys。
- State history。

### 操作能力

- Refresh。
- Pause / Resume 指定 FSM。
- Remove 指定 FSM。
- 强制 ChangeState(Type) 到指定状态。

### 安全要求

- 强制切状态、Remove 操作只在 Play Mode 下可用。
- 危险操作需要确认。
- 不修改工程资产。

## 功能十三：配置化流程支持

### 目标

为后续剧情、新手引导、关卡脚本、工具生成流程预留配置驱动能力。

### 基础能力

依赖前述：

- `ChangeState(Type)`。
- `ChangeState(string)`。
- Transition 约束。
- State debug info。

### 可选新增类型

```csharp
public sealed class FsmGraphConfig
{
    public string InitialState;
    public List<FsmGraphTransition> Transitions;
}

public sealed class FsmGraphTransition
{
    public string From;
    public string To;
}
```

第一版不建议直接实现完整图编辑器，只提供状态名切换和 transition 规则即可。

## 功能十四：异步状态生命周期辅助

### 目标

降低状态内启动 UniTask 后，状态退出或 FSM 销毁时回调继续执行造成的风险。

### 新增基类

```csharp
public abstract class AsyncFsmState : FsmState
{
    protected CancellationToken CancellationToken { get; }
    protected override void OnExit();
    protected virtual UniTask OnEnterAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
}
```

### 行为规则

- 状态进入时创建 CTS。
- 状态退出时取消 CTS。
- 异步逻辑必须观察 token。
- 异常通过 `FRLog.Exception` 记录，并可选择让 FSM Fail。

### 验收标准

- 状态退出后异步回调不再继续操作旧状态。
- 异常有日志。

## 阶段规划

### 第一阶段：稳定性与易用性

1. FSM 日志接入 `FRLog`。
2. 黑板安全读取 API。
3. `ChangeState(Type)`。
4. `ChangeState(string)`。
5. 任务型 FSM 失败/取消原因记录。
6. 任务完成状态注册校验。

### 第二阶段：诊断与性能

1. 无 GC 查询 API。
2. `FsmDebugInfo` 增强。
3. 状态切换历史记录。
4. FSM 运行统计。
5. FSM Editor 诊断窗口。

### 第三阶段：流程治理能力

1. 状态切换合法性约束。
2. 暂停/恢复能力。
3. `FsmTaskResult`。
4. 配置化流程基础支持。
5. `AsyncFsmState`。

## 推荐实现顺序

优先实现不改变行为的稳定性功能：日志接入、黑板 Try API、ChangeState(Type)。随后补齐任务结果语义和诊断快照。Transition、Pause/Resume、AsyncFsmState 涉及流程语义，应在后续阶段单独测试。

## 测试建议

- 创建 FSM 后初始状态正确。
- `ChangeState<T>` 行为保持不变。
- `ChangeState(Type)` 和 `ChangeState(string)` 能切换已注册状态。
- 非法状态切换按策略处理。
- 黑板 Try API 缺 key 和类型错误返回 false。
- Pause 后 OnUpdate 不执行。
- Task FSM 成功/失败/取消结果正确。
- AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone 仍生效。
- 无 GC 查询 API 填充结果正确。
- State history 不超过上限。
````

## File: Core/Fsm/FsmModule_Guide.md
````markdown
# Fsm 模块详细说明

## 模块定位

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Fsm` 是 FRFrame 的有限状态机模块，用于承载框架流程、业务流程、可等待任务流程和工具调试流程。模块保持代码驱动、类型安全、轻量运行时的定位：业务常规切状态优先使用 `ChangeState<T>()`，运行时诊断、配置化流程、存档恢复和编辑器工具可以使用 `ChangeState(Type)` 或 `ChangeState(string)`。

常见适用场景：

- 资源初始化、版本检查、资源下载等框架流程。
- 战斗角色 AI、怪物行为、技能阶段。
- UI 引导流程、新手教程、剧情步骤。
- 可 await 的任务流程，例如加载、下载、准备战斗。
- Editor 诊断窗口中查看、暂停、恢复和调试状态机。

## 核心类型

### FsmManager

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Fsm/FsmManager.cs`

统一管理 FSM 的创建、更新、查询、移除和统计，通常通过 `FRFM.Fsm` 访问。

常用 API：

```csharp
T CreateFsm<T>(FsmCreateOption option = null) where T : FsmController, new();
FsmController CreateFsm(Type type, FsmCreateOption option = null);
bool RemoveFsm(FsmController fsm);
int RemoveByOwner(object owner);
int RemoveByType<T>() where T : FsmController;
T GetFirstFsm<T>() where T : FsmController;
List<T> GetFsms<T>() where T : FsmController;
void GetFsms<T>(List<T> results) where T : FsmController;
int FillFsms<T>(IList<T> results) where T : FsmController;
List<FsmDebugInfo> GetAllDebugInfo();
void GetAllDebugInfo(List<FsmDebugInfo> results);
FsmManagerStatistics GetStatistics();
```

`GetFsms<T>(List<T>)`、`FillFsms<T>`、`GetAllDebugInfo(List<FsmDebugInfo>)` 会复用调用方传入列表，适合诊断窗口或高频查询。

### FsmCreateOption

创建 FSM 时的配置：

```csharp
var fsm = FRFM.Fsm.CreateFsm<BattleFsm>(new FsmCreateOption
{
    Owner = this,
    EnableLog = true,
    AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone = true
});
```

字段含义：

- `Owner`：FSM 归属对象，可用于 `RemoveByOwner` 批量移除。
- `EnableLog`：是否输出 FSM 流程日志，日志走 `FRLog`，tag 为 `FSM`。
- `AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone`：任务型 FSM 完成、失败或取消后由 `FsmManager` 自动移除。

### FsmController

状态机控制器基类，负责状态注册、切换、黑板、暂停恢复、流转约束和调试快照。

重要属性：

```csharp
string Name;
string CurrentStateName;
FsmState CurState;
bool IsDisposed;
bool IsPaused;
object Owner;
float RunTime;
int StateCount;
IReadOnlyList<string> StateNames;
IReadOnlyList<FsmStateChangeRecord> StateHistory;
FsmTransitionPolicy TransitionPolicy;
int MaxStateHistoryCount;
```

常用 API：

```csharp
void Initialize();
void Update(float elapseSeconds, float realElapseSeconds);
void Pause();
void Resume();
T GetState<T>() where T : FsmState;
bool TryGetState(Type stateType, out FsmState state);
bool TryGetState(string stateName, out FsmState state);
bool ChangeState<T>() where T : FsmState;
bool ChangeState(Type stateType);
bool ChangeState(string stateName);
FsmDebugInfo GetDebugInfo();
void Dispose();
```

状态注册在子类 `OnInitialize` 中完成：

```csharp
public sealed class BattleFsm : FsmController
{
    protected override void OnInitialize()
    {
        AddState<BattlePrepareState>();
        AddState<BattleRunState>();
        AddState<BattleEndState>();

        ChangeState<BattlePrepareState>();
    }
}
```

## 状态基类 FsmState

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Fsm/FsmState.cs`

状态生命周期：

```csharp
public virtual void OnInit(FsmController fsmController);
public virtual void OnEnter();
public virtual void OnExit();
public virtual void OnUpdate(float elapseSeconds, float realElapseSeconds);
public virtual void OnPause();
public virtual void OnResume();
```

状态内部常用保护方法：

```csharp
ChangeState<T>();
ChangeState(Type stateType);
ChangeState(string stateName);
SetData(string key, object data);
GetData<T>(string key);
TryGetData<T>(string key, out T value);
TryGetData<T>(out T value);
GetDataOrDefault<T>(string key, T defaultValue = default);
RemoveData(string key);
```

示例：

```csharp
public sealed class BattlePrepareState : FsmState
{
    public override void OnEnter()
    {
        SetData("StartTime", UnityEngine.Time.time);
    }

    public override void OnUpdate(float elapseSeconds, float realElapseSeconds)
    {
        if (TryGetData("Ready", out bool ready) && ready)
            ChangeState<BattleRunState>();
    }
}
```

## 黑板数据

黑板支持三种 key 模式：

### 字符串 key

```csharp
fsm.SetData("speed", 5f);
float speed = fsm.GetData<float>("speed");
```

### Tag 类型 key

```csharp
public struct SpeedTag {}

fsm.SetData<SpeedTag>(5f);
float speed = fsm.GetData<float, SpeedTag>();
```

### 值类型自身作为 key

```csharp
fsm.SetData(100);
int hp = fsm.GetData<int>();
```

安全读取 API：

```csharp
bool TryGetData(string key, out object value);
bool TryGetData(Type type, out object value);
bool TryGetData<T>(string key, out T value);
bool TryGetData<T>(out T value);
bool TryGetData<TValue, TTag>(out TValue value);
T GetDataOrDefault<T>(string key, T defaultValue = default);
T GetDataOrDefault<T>(T defaultValue = default);
```

`GetData<T>` 保持严格语义，缺 key 或类型错误时可能抛异常。业务流程中可恢复的读取优先使用 `TryGetData` 或 `GetDataOrDefault`。

## 状态切换

### 泛型切换

业务代码优先使用：

```csharp
ChangeState<BattleRunState>();
```

未注册状态会抛异常，便于开发期尽早暴露错误。

### Type 切换

适合编辑器、自动化测试、反射工具：

```csharp
fsm.ChangeState(typeof(BattleRunState));
```

### string 切换

适合配置、存档、控制台命令：

```csharp
fsm.ChangeState("FRFrame.BattleRunState");
fsm.ChangeState("BattleRunState");
```

查找逻辑支持 FullName、StateName、类型简名。简名冲突时返回失败并输出错误日志。

## 状态切换约束

`FsmTransitionPolicy`：

```csharp
public enum FsmTransitionPolicy
{
    Free,
    WarningOnly,
    Strict
}
```

默认 `Free`，不限制跳转。配置 transition 后可限制复杂流程误跳：

```csharp
public sealed class GuideFsm : FsmController
{
    protected override void OnInitialize()
    {
        AddState<GuideStartState>();
        AddState<GuideStepState>();
        AddState<GuideEndState>();

        TransitionPolicy = FsmTransitionPolicy.Strict;
        AddTransition<GuideStartState, GuideStepState>();
        AddTransition<GuideStepState, GuideEndState>();

        ChangeState<GuideStartState>();
    }
}
```

规则：

- `Free`：任意切换。
- `WarningOnly`：非法切换输出 warning，但仍允许。
- `Strict`：非法切换输出 error 并拒绝。
- 未配置任何 transition 时不限制。

## 暂停与恢复

```csharp
fsm.Pause();
fsm.Resume();
```

行为：

- `RunTime` 继续累积，表示 FSM 存活时间。
- 暂停期间不调用当前状态 `OnUpdate`。
- 当前状态会收到 `OnPause` / `OnResume`。
- 重复 Pause/Resume 不重复触发生命周期。

适合暂停游戏、弹窗阻塞、切后台、剧情等待。

## 任务型 FSM

`FsmTaskController` 用于可等待流程，支持完成、取消、失败结果。

常用 API：

```csharp
void BeginTask(Type completeStateType, CancellationToken token = default);
void BeginTask<TCompleteState>(CancellationToken token = default) where TCompleteState : FsmState;
UniTask<FsmTaskController> WaitAsync();
UniTask<FsmTaskResult> WaitResultAsync();
void Complete();
void Cancel(string reason = null);
void Fail(string error = null, Exception exception = null);
void ResetTaskState();
```

结果字段：

```csharp
TaskState State;
bool IsSuccess;
bool IsCanceled;
bool IsFailed;
string CompleteStateName;
string Error;
Exception Exception;
string CancelReason;
FsmTaskController Controller;
```

示例：

```csharp
var fsm = FRFM.Fsm.CreateFsm<ResourceDownloadFsm>(new FsmCreateOption
{
    Owner = this,
    EnableLog = true,
    AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone = true
});

fsm.BeginTask<DownloadCompleteState>();
FsmTaskResult result = await fsm.WaitResultAsync();

if (result.IsSuccess)
    FRLog.Info("Download", "Download complete");
else if (result.IsCanceled)
    FRLog.Warning("Download", result.CancelReason);
else
    FRLog.Error("Download", result.Error);
```

`ValidateCompleteStateOnBegin` 默认为 true，`BeginTask` 时会校验完成状态是否已注册。特殊动态注册场景可关闭。

## AsyncFsmState

`AsyncFsmState` 用于状态进入后启动异步逻辑，并在退出状态时自动取消。

```csharp
public sealed class LoadConfigState : AsyncFsmState
{
    protected override async UniTask OnEnterAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await LoadConfigAsync(cancellationToken);
        ChangeState<NextState>();
    }
}
```

规则：

- 进入状态时创建 CTS。
- 退出状态时取消并释放 CTS。
- 异步异常会通过 `FRLog.Exception("FSM", ...)` 输出。
- 如果所属 FSM 是 `FsmTaskController`，异常会调用 `Fail`。

异步逻辑应观察 `cancellationToken`，避免状态退出后继续操作旧状态。

## 调试与诊断

### FsmDebugInfo

```csharp
public class FsmDebugInfo
{
    public string Name;
    public string TypeName;
    public string OwnerName;
    public string OwnerTypeName;
    public string CurrentStateName;
    public string CurrentStateTypeName;
    public float RunTime;
    public int StateCount;
    public bool IsDisposed;
    public bool IsPaused;
    public bool IsTask;
    public TaskState TaskState;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> StateNames;
    public IReadOnlyList<string> BlackboardKeys;
    public IReadOnlyList<FsmStateChangeRecord> StateHistory;
}
```

黑板快照只输出 key，不输出 value。

### 状态切换历史

```csharp
fsm.MaxStateHistoryCount = 32;
IReadOnlyList<FsmStateChangeRecord> history = fsm.StateHistory;
fsm.ClearStateHistory();
```

`MaxStateHistoryCount <= 0` 表示不记录。

### 管理器统计

```csharp
FsmManagerStatistics statistics = FRFM.Fsm.GetStatistics();
```

包含：活跃数量、总创建数、总销毁数、自动移除数、任务 FSM 数。

### Editor 窗口

菜单：`FRFrame/Diagnostics/FSM Diagnostics`

可查看 FSM 列表、Owner、当前状态、RunTime、暂停状态、任务状态、黑板 key 和状态历史。

## 日志规范

Fsm 模块内部统一使用 `FRLog`，tag 为 `FSM`。

```csharp
FRLog.Info("FSM", "...");
FRLog.Warning("FSM", "...");
FRLog.Error("FSM", "...");
```

单个 FSM 的流程日志由 `FsmCreateOption.EnableLog` 控制。

## 推荐工作流

1. 为业务流程创建一个 `FsmController` 或 `FsmTaskController` 子类。
2. 在 `OnInitialize` 注册所有状态，并切入初始状态。
3. 在状态类中只处理本状态职责，通过 `ChangeState<T>()` 跳转。
4. 用黑板传递少量运行时上下文，复杂数据优先封装为明确类型。
5. 可等待流程使用 `FsmTaskController.WaitResultAsync()`。
6. 需要防误跳时配置 transition，并选择 `WarningOnly` 或 `Strict`。
7. 异步状态优先继承 `AsyncFsmState`，并观察 token。
8. 调试时使用 `GetDebugInfo()`、`GetStatistics()` 或 Editor 诊断窗口。

## 使用规范

- 常规业务切状态优先使用 `ChangeState<T>()`。
- `ChangeState(Type/string)` 主要用于工具、配置、存档和测试。
- 状态不要持有长期外部资源；若持有，应在 `OnExit` 释放。
- `OnUpdate` 中避免高频分配。
- 黑板严格读取用于必需数据，非必需数据使用 Try API。
- 任务 FSM 应明确成功、取消、失败语义，不要用同一个 Fail 表达取消。
- 开启 `AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone` 前确认外部不会继续持有并使用该 FSM。
- 不要直接调用 Unity `Debug.Log` 输出 FSM 框架日志，统一使用 `FRLog`。
````

## File: Core/Fsm/FsmTaskController.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public class FsmTaskController : FsmController
    {
        private CancellationToken _token;
        private Type _completeStateType;
        private UniTaskCompletionSource<FsmTaskController> _tcs;
        private UniTaskCompletionSource<FsmTaskResult> _resultTcs;

        public TaskState TaskState { get; private set; } = TaskState.None;
        public bool IsDone => TaskState == TaskState.Completed || TaskState == TaskState.Failed || TaskState == TaskState.Canceled;
        public bool IsCancel => TaskState == TaskState.Canceled || (_token.CanBeCanceled && _token.IsCancellationRequested);
        public string CompleteStateName => _completeStateType?.Name ?? string.Empty;
        public string Error { get; private set; }
        public Exception Exception { get; private set; }
        public string CancelReason { get; private set; }
        public bool ValidateCompleteStateOnBegin { get; set; } = true;

        public void BeginTask(Type completeStateType, CancellationToken token = default)
        {
            if (completeStateType != null && !typeof(FsmState).IsAssignableFrom(completeStateType))
            {
                Fail($"Complete state type is not FsmState: {completeStateType.FullName}");
                return;
            }

            TaskState = TaskState.Running;
            _completeStateType = completeStateType;
            _token = token;
            _tcs = new UniTaskCompletionSource<FsmTaskController>();
            _resultTcs = new UniTaskCompletionSource<FsmTaskResult>();
            Error = null;
            Exception = null;
            CancelReason = null;

            if (ValidateCompleteStateOnBegin && _completeStateType != null && !TryGetState(_completeStateType, out _))
            {
                Fail($"Complete state not registered: {_completeStateType.FullName}");
                return;
            }

            if (_completeStateType != null)
                LogInfo($"[FSM-TASK] {Name} BeginTask => CompleteState: {_completeStateType.Name}");
        }

        public void BeginTask<TCompleteState>(CancellationToken token = default) where TCompleteState : FsmState
        {
            BeginTask(typeof(TCompleteState), token);
        }

        public UniTask<FsmTaskController> WaitAsync()
        {
            if (IsDone)
                return UniTask.FromResult(this);

            _tcs ??= new UniTaskCompletionSource<FsmTaskController>();
            return _tcs.Task;
        }

        public UniTask<FsmTaskResult> WaitResultAsync()
        {
            if (IsDone)
                return UniTask.FromResult(CreateResult());

            _resultTcs ??= new UniTaskCompletionSource<FsmTaskResult>();
            return _resultTcs.Task;
        }

        public override bool ChangeState(Type stateType)
        {
            bool changed = base.ChangeState(stateType);
            if (changed && _completeStateType != null && stateType == _completeStateType)
                Complete();
            return changed;
        }

        public override bool ChangeState(string stateName)
        {
            if (!TryGetState(stateName, out FsmState state))
                return base.ChangeState(stateName);

            bool changed = base.ChangeState(state.GetType());
            if (changed && _completeStateType != null && state.GetType() == _completeStateType)
                Complete();
            return changed;
        }

        public void Complete()
        {
            if (IsDone)
                return;

            if (_token.CanBeCanceled && _token.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                Cancel("CancellationToken canceled");
                return;
            }

            TaskState = TaskState.Completed;
            LogInfo($"[FSM-TASK] {Name} Complete => Success");
            CompleteSources();
        }

        public void Cancel()
        {
            Cancel(null);
        }

        public void Cancel(string reason = null)
        {
            if (IsDone)
                return;

            TaskState = TaskState.Canceled;
            CancelReason = reason;
            LogWarning($"[FSM-TASK] {Name} Cancel => {reason ?? string.Empty}");
            CompleteSources();
        }

        public void Fail()
        {
            Fail(null, null);
        }

        public void Fail(string error = null, Exception exception = null)
        {
            if (IsDone)
                return;

            TaskState = TaskState.Failed;
            Error = error;
            Exception = exception;
            if (exception != null)
                LogError($"[FSM-TASK] {Name} Fail => {error} {exception.Message}");
            else
                LogError($"[FSM-TASK] {Name} Fail => {error ?? string.Empty}");
            CompleteSources();
        }

        public void ResetTaskState()
        {
            TaskState = TaskState.None;
            _completeStateType = null;
            _token = default;
            _tcs = null;
            _resultTcs = null;
            Error = null;
            Exception = null;
            CancelReason = null;
            LogInfo($"[FSM-TASK] {Name} ResetTaskState");
        }

        public override FsmDebugInfo GetDebugInfo()
        {
            var info = base.GetDebugInfo();
            info.TaskState = TaskState;
            return info;
        }

        public override void Dispose()
        {
            if (!IsDone && TaskState == TaskState.Running)
                Cancel("FSM disposed");

            _tcs = null;
            _resultTcs = null;
            TaskState = TaskState.None;
            _completeStateType = null;
            _token = default;
            base.Dispose();
        }

        private void CompleteSources()
        {
            _tcs?.TrySetResult(this);
            _resultTcs?.TrySetResult(CreateResult());
        }

        private FsmTaskResult CreateResult()
        {
            return new FsmTaskResult
            {
                State = TaskState,
                CompleteStateName = CompleteStateName,
                Error = Error,
                Exception = Exception,
                CancelReason = CancelReason,
                Controller = this
            };
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Log/AsyncFileFRLogHandler.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class AsyncFileFRLogHandler : IFRLogHandler, IFRLogFileHandler
    {
        private readonly FRLogConfig _config;
        private readonly FileFRLogHandler _writer;
        private readonly Queue<FRLogEntry> _queue = new Queue<FRLogEntry>();
        private readonly object _lock = new object();
        private readonly AutoResetEvent _signal = new AutoResetEvent(false);
        private readonly Thread _thread;
        private bool _running = true;
        private int _droppedCount;

        public string CurrentLogFilePath => _writer.CurrentLogFilePath;

        public int QueueCount
        {
            get
            {
                lock (_lock)
                    return _queue.Count;
            }
        }

        public int DroppedCount => _droppedCount + _writer.DroppedCount;

        public AsyncFileFRLogHandler(FRLogConfig config)
        {
            _config = config;
            _writer = new FileFRLogHandler(config);
            _thread = new Thread(WriteLoop)
            {
                IsBackground = true,
                Name = "FRLogFileWriter"
            };
            _thread.Start();
        }

        public void Handle(in FRLogEntry entry)
        {
            bool writeSync = false;
            lock (_lock)
            {
                int capacity = _config.AsyncFileQueueCapacity;
                if (capacity > 0 && _queue.Count >= capacity)
                {
                    switch (_config.AsyncQueueOverflowPolicy)
                    {
                        case FRLogAsyncQueueOverflowPolicy.DropOldest:
                            _queue.Dequeue();
                            _droppedCount++;
                            break;
                        case FRLogAsyncQueueOverflowPolicy.Block:
                            while (_running && _queue.Count >= capacity)
                                Monitor.Wait(_lock, 10);
                            break;
                        case FRLogAsyncQueueOverflowPolicy.WriteSync:
                            writeSync = true;
                            break;
                        default:
                            _droppedCount++;
                            return;
                    }
                }

                if (!writeSync)
                    _queue.Enqueue(entry);
            }

            if (writeSync)
            {
                _writer.Handle(entry);
                return;
            }

            _signal.Set();
            if (_config.FlushImmediatelyOnError && entry.Level >= FRLogLevel.Error)
                Flush();
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            while (true)
            {
                FRLogEntry[] batch = DequeueBatch(int.MaxValue);
                if (batch.Length == 0)
                    break;

                WriteBatch(batch);
            }

            _writer.Flush();
        }

        public void Shutdown()
        {
            _running = false;
            _signal.Set();
            _thread.Join(2000);
            Flush();
            _writer.Shutdown();
            _signal.Dispose();
        }

        private void WriteLoop()
        {
            while (_running)
            {
                _signal.WaitOne(Math.Max(1, _config.AsyncFileFlushIntervalMs));
                FRLogEntry[] batch = DequeueBatch(Math.Max(1, _config.AsyncFileBatchSize));
                if (batch.Length > 0)
                {
                    WriteBatch(batch);
                    _writer.Flush();
                }
            }
        }

        private FRLogEntry[] DequeueBatch(int maxCount)
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                int count = Math.Min(maxCount, _queue.Count);
                if (count <= 0)
                    return Array.Empty<FRLogEntry>();

                FRLogEntry[] batch = new FRLogEntry[count];
                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                {
                    batch[i] = _queue.Dequeue();
                }

                Monitor.PulseAll(_lock);
                return batch;
            }
        }

        private void WriteBatch(FRLogEntry[] batch)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < batch.Length; i++)
            {
                _writer.Handle(batch[i]);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class CrashReportFRLogHandler : IFRLogHandler
    {
        private readonly ICrashReportAdapter _adapter;
        private readonly FRLogLevel _minimumLevel;

        public CrashReportFRLogHandler(ICrashReportAdapter adapter, FRLogLevel minimumLevel = FRLogLevel.Error)
        {
            _adapter = adapter ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(adapter));
            _minimumLevel = minimumLevel;
        }

        public void Handle(in FRLogEntry entry)
        {
            if (entry.Level < _minimumLevel)
                return;

            try
            {
                if (entry.Fields != null)
                {
                    foreach (var pair in entry.Fields)
                        _adapter.SetCustomKey(pair.Key, pair.Value);
                }

                _adapter.Log(FRLogger.Format(entry));
                if (entry.Exception != null)
                    _adapter.RecordException(entry.Exception, entry.Message);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning($"[FRFrame][Log] Crash report handler failed: {e.Message}");
            }
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
        }

        public void Shutdown()
        {
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Log/FileFRLogHandler.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class FileFRLogHandler : IFRLogHandler, IFRLogFileHandler
    {
        private readonly FRLogConfig _config;
        private readonly object _lock = new object();
        private StreamWriter _writer;
        private string _currentPath;
        private int _fileIndex;
        private readonly string _sessionDirectory;

        public string CurrentLogFilePath => _currentPath;
        public int QueueCount => 0;
        public int DroppedCount => 0;

        public FileFRLogHandler(FRLogConfig config)
        {
            _config = config;
            _sessionDirectory = GetLogDirectory(config);
            OpenWriter();
        }

        public void Handle(in FRLogEntry entry)
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                WriteEntry(entry);
                if (_config.FlushImmediatelyOnError && entry.Level >= FRLogLevel.Error)
                    _writer.Flush();
            }
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                _writer?.Flush();
            }
        }

        public void Shutdown()
        {
            lock (_lock)
            {
                _writer?.Flush();
                _writer?.Dispose();
                _writer = null;
            }
        }

        internal void WriteEntry(in FRLogEntry entry)
        {
            RotateIfNeeded();
            _writer.WriteLine(FRLogger.Format(entry));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.StackTrace))
            {
                _writer.WriteLine("StackTrace:");
                _writer.WriteLine(entry.StackTrace);
            }
        }

        private void OpenWriter()
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_sessionDirectory);
            string suffix = _fileIndex == 0 ? string.Empty : $"_{_fileIndex:000}";
            DateTime now = _config.UseUtcTime ? DateTime.UtcNow : DateTime.Now;
            string utc = _config.UseUtcTime ? "_UTC" : string.Empty;
            _currentPath = Path.Combine(_sessionDirectory, $"{_config.FileNamePrefix}_{now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_fff}{utc}{suffix}.log");
            _writer = new StreamWriter(_currentPath, true, Encoding.UTF8) { AutoFlush = false };
            TrimOldFiles();
        }

        private void RotateIfNeeded()
        {
            if (_writer == null)
            {
                OpenWriter();
                return;
            }

            if (_config.MaxLogFileSize <= 0)
                return;

            FileInfo fileInfo = new FileInfo(_currentPath);
            if (fileInfo.Exists && fileInfo.Length >= _config.MaxLogFileSize)
            {
                _writer.Flush();
                _writer.Dispose();
                _fileIndex++;
                OpenWriter();
            }
        }

        private void TrimOldFiles()
        {
            if (!_config.EnableLogRetention)
                return;

            DirectoryInfo root = new DirectoryInfo(_config.FileLogDirectory);
            if (!root.Exists)
                return;

            FileInfo[] files = root.GetFiles($"{_config.FileNamePrefix}_*.log", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .OrderByDescending(file => file.LastWriteTimeUtc)
                .ToArray();

            int maxFileCount = _config.MaxRetainedFileCount > 0 ? _config.MaxRetainedFileCount : _config.MaxLogFileCount;
            for (int i = maxFileCount; maxFileCount > 0 && i < files.Length; i++)
            {
                DeleteFile(files[i]);
            }

            if (_config.MaxRetainedDays > 0)
            {
                DateTime limit = DateTime.UtcNow.AddDays(-_config.MaxRetainedDays);
                for (int i = 0; i < files.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (files[i].Exists && files[i].LastWriteTimeUtc < limit)
                        DeleteFile(files[i]);
                }
            }

            if (_config.GroupLogBySession && _config.MaxRetainedSessionCount > 0)
            {
                DirectoryInfo[] sessions = root.GetDirectories("Session_*")
                    .OrderByDescending(dir => dir.LastWriteTimeUtc)
                    .ToArray();

                for (int i = _config.MaxRetainedSessionCount; i < sessions.Length; i++)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        sessions[i].Delete(true);
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning($"[FRFrame][Log] Delete old log session failed: {sessions[i].FullName}, {e.Message}");
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        private static void DeleteFile(FileInfo file)
        {
            try
            {
                file.Delete();
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning($"[FRFrame][Log] Delete old log failed: {file.FullName}, {e.Message}");
            }
        }

        internal static string GetLogDirectory(FRLogConfig config)
        {
            if (!config.GroupLogBySession)
                return config.FileLogDirectory;

            DateTime now = config.UseUtcTime ? DateTime.UtcNow : DateTime.Now;
            string utc = config.UseUtcTime ? "_UTC" : string.Empty;
            return Path.Combine(config.FileLogDirectory, $"Session_{now:yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_fff}{utc}");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.IO;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class FRLogConfig
    {
        public bool EnableUnityLog = true;
        public bool EnableFileLog = false;
        public FRLogLevel MinimumLevel = FRLogLevel.Debug;
        public bool ShowTimestamp = true;
        public bool ShowFrameCount = true;
        public bool ShowThreadId = false;
        public bool CaptureStackTrace = true;
        public FRLogLevel StackTraceMinLevel = FRLogLevel.Warning;
        public string FileLogDirectory = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, "FRFrameOut", "Logs");
        public long MaxLogFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024;
        public int MaxLogFileCount = 10;
        public bool EnableLogRetention = true;
        public int MaxRetainedFileCount = 10;
        public int MaxRetainedDays = 0;
        public bool GroupLogBySession = false;
        public int MaxRetainedSessionCount = 0;
        public bool FlushImmediatelyOnError = true;
        public string FileNamePrefix = "FRLog";
        public bool UseUtcTime = false;
        public FRLogFileWriteMode FileWriteMode = FRLogFileWriteMode.Sync;
        public int AsyncFileQueueCapacity = 4096;
        public int AsyncFileBatchSize = 64;
        public int AsyncFileFlushIntervalMs = 1000;
        public FRLogAsyncQueueOverflowPolicy AsyncQueueOverflowPolicy = FRLogAsyncQueueOverflowPolicy.DropNewest;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class FRLogContext
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _globalFields = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        private readonly AsyncLocal<Stack<KeyValuePair<string, string>>> _scopeFields = new AsyncLocal<Stack<KeyValuePair<string, string>>>();

        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> GlobalFields => _globalFields;

        public void SetGlobal(string key, string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
                throw new ArgumentException("Log context key is null or empty", nameof(key));

            if (value == null)
                _globalFields.Remove(key);
            else
                _globalFields[key] = value;
        }

        public bool RemoveGlobal(string key)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) && _globalFields.Remove(key);
        }

        public void ClearGlobal()
        {
            _globalFields.Clear();
        }

        public IDisposable BeginScope(string key, string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
                throw new ArgumentException("Log context key is null or empty", nameof(key));

            Stack<KeyValuePair<string, string>> stack = _scopeFields.Value;
            if (stack == null)
            {
                stack = new Stack<KeyValuePair<string, string>>();
                _scopeFields.Value = stack;
            }

            var field = new KeyValuePair<string, string>(key, value);
            stack.Push(field);
            return new FRLogScope(this, field);
        }

        internal Dictionary<string, string> CreateFieldsSnapshot()
        {
            Dictionary<string, string> fields = null;
            if (_globalFields.Count > 0)
                fields = new Dictionary<string, string>(_globalFields);

            Stack<KeyValuePair<string, string>> stack = _scopeFields.Value;
            if (stack == null || stack.Count == 0)
                return fields;

            fields ??= new Dictionary<string, string>();
            KeyValuePair<string, string>[] scopes = stack.ToArray();
            for (int i = scopes.Length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                fields[scopes[i].Key] = scopes[i].Value;
            }

            return fields;
        }

        private void EndScope(KeyValuePair<string, string> field)
        {
            Stack<KeyValuePair<string, string>> stack = _scopeFields.Value;
            if (stack == null || stack.Count == 0)
                return;

            if (EqualityComparer<KeyValuePair<string, string>>.Default.Equals(stack.Peek(), field))
            {
                stack.Pop();
                return;
            }

            KeyValuePair<string, string>[] values = stack.ToArray();
            stack.Clear();
            bool removed = false;
            for (int i = values.Length - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (!removed && EqualityComparer<KeyValuePair<string, string>>.Default.Equals(values[i], field))
                {
                    removed = true;
                    continue;
                }

                stack.Push(values[i]);
            }
        }

        private sealed class FRLogScope : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly FRLogContext _context;
            private readonly KeyValuePair<string, string> _field;
            private bool _disposed;

            public FRLogScope(FRLogContext context, KeyValuePair<string, string> field)
            {
                _context = context;
                _field = field;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_disposed)
                    return;

                _disposed = true;
                _context.EndScope(_field);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Log/FRLogger.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public static class FRLogger
    {
        private static readonly object LockObject = new object();
        private static readonly List<IFRLogHandler> Handlers = new List<IFRLogHandler>();
        private static readonly FRLogContext LogContext = new FRLogContext();
        private static FRLogConfig _config;
        private static bool _initialized;
        private static int _debugCount;
        private static int _infoCount;
        private static int _warningCount;
        private static int _errorCount;
        private static int _fatalCount;
        private static int _exceptionCount;

        public static FRLogContext Context => LogContext;

        public static void Initialize(FRLogConfig config = null)
        {
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                ShutdownInternal();
                _config = config ?? CreateDefaultConfig();
                AddConfiguredHandlers();
                _initialized = true;
                Log(FRLogLevel.Info, "Log", $"Log initialized. Directory:{_config.FileLogDirectory}, Retention:{_config.EnableLogRetention}, MaxFiles:{GetMaxRetainedFileCount()}, MaxDays:{_config.MaxRetainedDays}");
            }
        }

        public static void AddHandler(IFRLogHandler handler)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                return;

            EnsureInitialized();
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                if (!Handlers.Contains(handler))
                    Handlers.Add(handler);
            }
        }

        public static void RemoveHandler(IFRLogHandler handler)
        {
            if (handler == null)
                return;

            lock (LockObject)
            {
                if (Handlers.Remove(handler))
                    handler.Shutdown();
            }
        }

        public static void ClearHandlers()
        {
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                ShutdownInternal();
                _initialized = true;
            }
        }

        public static bool IsLevelEnabled(FRLogLevel level)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            return level >= _config.MinimumLevel;
        }

        public static void SetMinimumLevel(FRLogLevel level)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            _config.MinimumLevel = level;
        }

        public static void SetUnityOutputEnabled(bool enabled)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                _config.EnableUnityLog = enabled;
                RemoveHandlers<UnityFRLogHandler>();
                if (enabled)
                    Handlers.Add(new UnityFRLogHandler());
            }
        }

        public static void SetFileOutputEnabled(bool enabled)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                _config.EnableFileLog = enabled;
                RemoveFileHandlers();
                if (enabled)
                    Handlers.Add(CreateFileHandler(_config));
            }
        }

        public static void SetStackTraceLevel(FRLogLevel level)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            _config.StackTraceMinLevel = level;
            _config.CaptureStackTrace = true;
        }

        public static FRLogRuntimeConfigSnapshot GetRuntimeConfigSnapshot()
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                return new FRLogRuntimeConfigSnapshot
                {
                    MinimumLevel = _config.MinimumLevel,
                    UnityOutputEnabled = _config.EnableUnityLog,
                    FileOutputEnabled = _config.EnableFileLog,
                    CaptureStackTrace = _config.CaptureStackTrace,
                    StackTraceLevel = _config.StackTraceMinLevel,
                    HandlerCount = Handlers.Count,
                    FileDirectory = _config.FileLogDirectory
                };
            }
        }

        public static FRLogStatistics CreateStatisticsSnapshot()
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                var statistics = new FRLogStatistics
                {
                    DebugCount = _debugCount,
                    InfoCount = _infoCount,
                    WarningCount = _warningCount,
                    ErrorCount = _errorCount,
                    FatalCount = _fatalCount,
                    ExceptionCount = _exceptionCount,
                    HandlerCount = Handlers.Count
                };

                for (int i = 0; i < Handlers.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (Handlers[i] is IFRLogFileHandler fileHandler)
                    {
                        statistics.FileQueueCount += fileHandler.QueueCount;
                        statistics.DroppedCount += fileHandler.DroppedCount;
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(statistics.CurrentLogFilePath))
                            statistics.CurrentLogFilePath = fileHandler.CurrentLogFilePath;
                    }
                }

                return statistics;
            }
        }

        public static void ResetStatistics()
        {
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                _debugCount = 0;
                _infoCount = 0;
                _warningCount = 0;
                _errorCount = 0;
                _fatalCount = 0;
                _exceptionCount = 0;
            }
        }

        public static void Log(FRLogLevel level, string message, Object context = null)
        {
            Log(level, null, message, context);
        }

        public static void Log(FRLogLevel level, string tag, string message, Object context = null)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            if (level < _config.MinimumLevel)
                return;

            FRLogEntry entry = new FRLogEntry(
                level,
                GetTime(),
                Time.frameCount,
                Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId,
                tag,
                message,
                ShouldCaptureStackTrace(level) ? FRLogStackTraceUtility.Capture(4) : string.Empty,
                context,
                LogContext.CreateFieldsSnapshot());

            IncrementLevelCount(level);
            Write(entry);
            if (_config.FlushImmediatelyOnError && level >= FRLogLevel.Error)
                Flush();
        }

        public static void Exception(Exception exception, string message = null, Object context = null)
        {
            Exception(null, exception, message, context);
        }

        public static void Exception(string tag, Exception exception, string message = null, Object context = null)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            if (FRLogLevel.Error < _config.MinimumLevel)
                return;

            string exceptionMessage = exception == null ? string.Empty : $"{exception.GetType().Name}: {exception.Message}";
            string finalMessage = string.IsNullOrEmpty(message) ? exceptionMessage : $"{message} {exceptionMessage}";
            FRLogEntry entry = new FRLogEntry(FRLogLevel.Error, GetTime(), Time.frameCount, Thread.CurrentThread.ManagedThreadId, tag, finalMessage, exception?.ToString() ?? string.Empty, context, LogContext.CreateFieldsSnapshot(), exception);
            _errorCount++;
            _exceptionCount++;
            Write(entry);
            if (_config.FlushImmediatelyOnError)
                Flush();
        }

        public static void Flush()
        {
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < Handlers.Count; i++)
                    Handlers[i].Flush();
            }
        }

        public static void Shutdown()
        {
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                ShutdownInternal();
            }
        }

        public static string Format(in FRLogEntry entry)
        {
            FRLogConfig config = _config ?? CreateDefaultConfig();
            var builder = new StringBuilder(128);
            builder.Append("[FRFrame]");
            if (config.ShowTimestamp)
                builder.Append('[').Append(entry.Time.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff")).Append(']');

            builder.Append('[').Append(entry.Level).Append(']');
            if (config.ShowFrameCount)
                builder.Append("[F:").Append(entry.FrameCount).Append(']');

            if (config.ShowThreadId)
                builder.Append("[T:").Append(entry.ThreadId).Append(']');

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.Tag))
                builder.Append('[').Append(entry.Tag).Append(']');

            if (entry.Fields != null && entry.Fields.Count > 0)
            {
                builder.Append('[');
                bool first = true;
                foreach (var pair in entry.Fields)
                {
                    if (!first)
                        builder.Append(',');
                    builder.Append(pair.Key).Append('=').Append(pair.Value);
                    first = false;
                }
                builder.Append(']');
            }

            builder.Append(' ').Append(entry.Message);
            return builder.ToString();
        }

        public static FRLogConfig CreateDefaultConfig()
        {
            return new FRLogConfig
            {
                MinimumLevel = GetDefaultMinimumLevel(),
                EnableUnityLog = true,
#if FR_ENABLE_FILE_LOG
                EnableFileLog = true
#else
                EnableFileLog = false
#endif
            };
        }

        private static void EnsureInitialized()
        {
            if (_initialized)
                return;

            Initialize(CreateDefaultConfig());
        }

        private static void Write(in FRLogEntry entry)
        {
            lock (LockObject)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < Handlers.Count; i++)
                    Handlers[i].Handle(entry);
            }
        }

        private static void ShutdownInternal()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < Handlers.Count; i++)
                Handlers[i].Shutdown();

            Handlers.Clear();
            _initialized = false;
        }

        private static DateTime GetTime()
        {
            return _config != null && _config.UseUtcTime ? DateTime.UtcNow : DateTime.Now;
        }

        private static bool ShouldCaptureStackTrace(FRLogLevel level)
        {
            return _config != null && _config.CaptureStackTrace && level >= _config.StackTraceMinLevel;
        }

        private static void AddConfiguredHandlers()
        {
            if (_config.EnableUnityLog)
                Handlers.Add(new UnityFRLogHandler());

            if (_config.EnableFileLog)
                Handlers.Add(CreateFileHandler(_config));
        }

        private static IFRLogHandler CreateFileHandler(FRLogConfig config)
        {
            return config.FileWriteMode == FRLogFileWriteMode.Async ? new AsyncFileFRLogHandler(config) : new FileFRLogHandler(config);
        }

        private static void RemoveFileHandlers()
        {
            for (int i = Handlers.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (Handlers[i] is IFRLogFileHandler)
                {
                    Handlers[i].Shutdown();
                    Handlers.RemoveAt(i);
                }
            }
        }

        private static void RemoveHandlers<T>() where T : IFRLogHandler
        {
            for (int i = Handlers.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (Handlers[i] is T)
                {
                    Handlers[i].Shutdown();
                    Handlers.RemoveAt(i);
                }
            }
        }

        private static int GetMaxRetainedFileCount()
        {
            return _config.MaxRetainedFileCount > 0 ? _config.MaxRetainedFileCount : _config.MaxLogFileCount;
        }

        private static void IncrementLevelCount(FRLogLevel level)
        {
            switch (level)
            {
                case FRLogLevel.Debug:
                    _debugCount++;
                    break;
                case FRLogLevel.Info:
                    _infoCount++;
                    break;
                case FRLogLevel.Warning:
                    _warningCount++;
                    break;
                case FRLogLevel.Error:
                    _errorCount++;
                    break;
                case FRLogLevel.Fatal:
                    _fatalCount++;
                    break;
            }
        }

        private static FRLogLevel GetDefaultMinimumLevel()
        {
#if FR_ENABLE_DEBUG_LOG || FR_ENABLE_DEBUG_AND_ABOVE_LOG
            return FRLogLevel.Debug;
#elif FR_ENABLE_INFO_LOG || FR_ENABLE_INFO_AND_ABOVE_LOG
            return FRLogLevel.Info;
#elif FR_ENABLE_WARNING_LOG || FR_ENABLE_WARNING_AND_ABOVE_LOG
            return FRLogLevel.Warning;
#elif FR_ENABLE_ERROR_LOG || FR_ENABLE_ERROR_AND_ABOVE_LOG
            return FRLogLevel.Error;
#elif FR_ENABLE_FATAL_LOG || FR_ENABLE_FATAL_AND_ABOVE_LOG
            return FRLogLevel.Fatal;
#else
            return UnityEngine.Debug.isDebugBuild ? FRLogLevel.Debug : FRLogLevel.Warning;
#endif
        }
    }
}
````
