````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class ResourceEvents
    {
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> AssetLoaded;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> AssetLoadFailed;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> AssetReleased;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> SceneLoaded;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> SceneUnloaded;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> InstanceRecycled;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> PoolObjectCreated;
        public event Action<ResourceEventArgs> PoolObjectReleased;

        public event Action<AssetLoadEventArgs> AssetLoadedV2;
        public event Action<AssetLoadEventArgs> AssetLoadFailedV2;
        public event Action<AssetReleaseEventArgs> AssetReleasedV2;
        public event Action<SceneLoadEventArgs> SceneLoadedV2;
        public event Action<SceneLoadEventArgs> SceneUnloadedV2;
        public event Action<ResourcePoolEventArgs> InstanceRecycledV2;
        public event Action<ResourcePoolEventArgs> PoolObjectCreatedV2;
        public event Action<ResourcePoolEventArgs> PoolObjectReleasedV2;
        public event Action<PackageDownloadProgress> PackageDownloadProgress;
        public event Action<PackageDownloadResult> PackageDownloadFinished;

        internal void RaiseAssetLoaded(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            AssetLoaded?.Invoke(args);
            AssetLoadedV2?.Invoke(new AssetLoadEventArgs { Key = args.Key, Location = args.Location, PackageName = args.PackageName, Error = args.Error, AssetObject = args.AssetObject });
        }

        internal void RaiseAssetLoadFailed(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            AssetLoadFailed?.Invoke(args);
            AssetLoadFailedV2?.Invoke(new AssetLoadEventArgs { Key = args.Key, Location = args.Location, PackageName = args.PackageName, Error = args.Error, AssetObject = args.AssetObject });
        }

        internal void RaiseAssetReleased(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            AssetReleased?.Invoke(args);
            AssetReleasedV2?.Invoke(new AssetReleaseEventArgs { Key = args.Key, Location = args.Location, PackageName = args.PackageName });
        }

        internal void RaiseSceneLoaded(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            SceneLoaded?.Invoke(args);
            SceneLoadedV2?.Invoke(new SceneLoadEventArgs { Key = args.Key, Location = args.Location, PackageName = args.PackageName, Error = args.Error });
        }

        internal void RaiseSceneUnloaded(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            SceneUnloaded?.Invoke(args);
            SceneUnloadedV2?.Invoke(new SceneLoadEventArgs { Key = args.Key, Location = args.Location, PackageName = args.PackageName, Error = args.Error });
        }

        internal void RaiseInstanceRecycled(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            InstanceRecycled?.Invoke(args);
            InstanceRecycledV2?.Invoke(ToPoolEventArgs(args));
        }

        internal void RaisePoolObjectCreated(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            PoolObjectCreated?.Invoke(args);
            PoolObjectCreatedV2?.Invoke(ToPoolEventArgs(args));
        }

        internal void RaisePoolObjectReleased(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            PoolObjectReleased?.Invoke(args);
            PoolObjectReleasedV2?.Invoke(ToPoolEventArgs(args));
        }

        internal void RaisePackageDownloadProgress(PackageDownloadProgress progress) => PackageDownloadProgress?.Invoke(progress);
        internal void RaisePackageDownloadFinished(PackageDownloadResult result) => PackageDownloadFinished?.Invoke(result);

        private static ResourcePoolEventArgs ToPoolEventArgs(ResourceEventArgs args)
        {
            return new ResourcePoolEventArgs { Key = args.Key, Location = args.Location, PackageName = args.PackageName, Instance = args.Instance };
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceDiagnostics.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class ResourceDiagnostics
    {
        private readonly ResourceManager _resourceManager;

        public ResourceDiagnostics(ResourceManager resourceManager)
        {
            _resourceManager = resourceManager;
        }

        public ResourceStatistics GetStatistics()
        {
            return _resourceManager.GetStatistics();
        }

        public ResourceDiagnosticSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            var snapshot = new ResourceDiagnosticSnapshot
            {
                Statistics = GetStatistics(),
                Assets = new List<AssetEntrySnapshot>(_resourceManager.GetAssetSnapshots()),
                Scenes = new List<SceneEntrySnapshot>(_resourceManager.GetSceneSnapshots()),
                Packages = new List<PackageResourceSnapshot>(_resourceManager.GetPackageResourceSnapshots())
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Assets.Count; i++)
            {
                var asset = snapshot.Assets[i];
                if (asset.State == ResourceEntryState.Loaded && !asset.HandleValid)
                    snapshot.Warnings.Add($"Asset loaded but handle invalid : {asset.Key}");
                if (asset.State == ResourceEntryState.Failed)
                    snapshot.Warnings.Add($"Asset failed entry still cached : {asset.Key}");
                if (_resourceManager.GetPackageState(asset.PackageName) != PackageRuntimeState.Initialized)
                    snapshot.Warnings.Add($"Asset package not initialized : {asset.Key}");
            }

            var buckets = FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.GetBucketSnapshots();
            if (buckets != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
                {
                    var bucket = buckets[i];
                    if (_resourceManager.GetAssetEntry(bucket.Key) == null)
                        snapshot.Warnings.Add($"GameObjectPool bucket has no asset entry : {bucket.Key}");
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(bucket.Warning))
                        snapshot.Warnings.Add($"GameObjectPool bucket warning : {bucket.Key}, {bucket.Warning}");
                }
            }

            return snapshot;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<AssetEntrySnapshot> GetAssetSnapshots(string packageName = null)
        {
            return _resourceManager.GetAssetSnapshots(packageName);
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<SceneEntrySnapshot> GetSceneSnapshots(string packageName = null)
        {
            return _resourceManager.GetSceneSnapshots(packageName);
        }

        public string DumpSummary()
        {
            var stats = GetStatistics();
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendLine("==== Resource Diagnostics ====");
            sb.AppendLine(stats.ToString());
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        public string DumpDetail()
        {
            var snapshot = CreateSnapshot();
            var sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendLine(DumpSummary());
            sb.AppendLine("---- Packages ----");
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Packages.Count; i++)
            {
                var package = snapshot.Packages[i];
                sb.AppendLine($"{package.PackageName} Assets:{package.AssetCount} Scenes:{package.SceneCount} Loading:{package.LoadingAssetCount}");
            }
            sb.AppendLine("---- Assets ----");
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Assets.Count; i++)
            {
                var asset = snapshot.Assets[i];
                sb.AppendLine($"{asset.Key} Ref:{asset.RefCount} State:{asset.State} Residency:{asset.Residency} Handle:{asset.HandleValid}");
            }
            sb.AppendLine("---- Warnings ----");
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Warnings.Count; i++)
                sb.AppendLine(snapshot.Warnings[i]);
            return sb.ToString();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceHandle.cs
````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using YooAsset;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class ResourceHandle<T> : IDisposable where T : Object
    {
        private readonly ResourceManager _resourceManager;

        public ResourceKey Key { get; }
        public T Asset { get; }
        public ResourceHandleState State { get; private set; }
        public bool IsValid => State == ResourceHandleState.Valid && Asset != null;

        internal ResourceHandle(ResourceManager resourceManager, ResourceKey key, T asset)
        {
            _resourceManager = resourceManager;
            Key = key;
            Asset = asset;
            State = asset != null ? ResourceHandleState.Valid : ResourceHandleState.None;
        }

        public void Release()
        {
            if (State == ResourceHandleState.Released)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"ResourceHandle duplicate release ignored : {Key}");
                return;
            }

            if (State != ResourceHandleState.Valid)
                return;

            _resourceManager?.ReleaseAssetReference(Key);
            State = ResourceHandleState.Released;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            Release();
        }
    }

    public sealed class ResourceRawFileHandle : IDisposable
    {
        public ResourceKey Key { get; }
        public string FilePath { get; }
        public ResourceHandleState State { get; private set; }
        public bool IsValid => State == ResourceHandleState.Valid && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(FilePath);

        internal ResourceRawFileHandle(ResourceKey key, string filePath)
        {
            Key = key;
            FilePath = filePath;
            State = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath)
                ? ResourceHandleState.Valid
                : ResourceHandleState.None;
        }

        public void Release()
        {
            if (State == ResourceHandleState.Released)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"ResourceRawFileHandle duplicate release ignored : {Key}");
                return;
            }

            if (State != ResourceHandleState.Valid)
                return;

            State = ResourceHandleState.Released;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            Release();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 资源唯一标识。
    /// 由 PackageName + Location 共同决定。
    /// 不再使用简单字符串拼接，避免多包冲突和可读性问题。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct ResourceKey : IEquatable<ResourceKey>
    {
        public readonly string PackageName;
        public readonly string Location;

        public ResourceKey(string packageName, string location)
        {
            PackageName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName) ? string.Empty : packageName;
            Location = string.IsNullOrEmpty(location) ? string.Empty : location;
        }

        public bool Equals(ResourceKey other)
        {
            return PackageName == other.PackageName && Location == other.Location;
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is ResourceKey other && Equals(other);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                return ((PackageName != null ? PackageName.GetHashCode() : 0) * 397) ^
                    (Location != null ? Location.GetHashCode() : 0);
            }
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return $"[{PackageName}]::{Location}";
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceScope.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class ResourceScope : System.IDisposable
    {
        private readonly ResourceManager _resourceManager;
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, int> _references = new Dictionary<ResourceKey, int>();
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, ResourceRawFileHandle> _rawFiles = new Dictionary<ResourceKey, ResourceRawFileHandle>();

        public string Name { get; }
        public string PackageName { get; }
        public ResourceScopeState State { get; private set; } = ResourceScopeState.Active;
        public IReadOnlyList<ResourceKey> Keys => new List<ResourceKey>(_references.Keys);

        internal ResourceScope(ResourceManager resourceManager, string name, string packageName = null)
        {
            _resourceManager = resourceManager;
            Name = name;
            PackageName = packageName;
        }

        public async UniTask<T> LoadAssetAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            return await LoadAssetAsync<T>(CreateKey(location), options);
        }

        public async UniTask<T> LoadAssetAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            if (!EnsureActive())
                return null;

            key = _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(key);
            T asset = await _resourceManager.LoadAssetAsync<T>(key, options);
            if (asset != null)
                Retain(key);
            return asset;
        }

        public async UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            return await LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(CreateKey(location), options);
        }

        public async UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            if (!EnsureActive())
                return null;

            key = _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(key);
            var handle = await _resourceManager.LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(key, options);
            if (handle != null && handle.IsValid)
                Retain(key);
            return handle;
        }

        public UniTask<string> LoadRawFilePathAsync(string location)
        {
            return LoadRawFilePathAsync(CreateKey(location));
        }

        public async UniTask<string> LoadRawFilePathAsync(ResourceKey key)
        {
            if (!EnsureActive())
                return null;

            key = _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(key);
            if (_rawFiles.TryGetValue(key, out ResourceRawFileHandle cached) && cached.IsValid)
                return cached.FilePath;

            ResourceRawFileHandle loaded = await _resourceManager.LoadRawFileHandleAsync(key);
            if (loaded == null || !loaded.IsValid)
                return null;

            if (State != ResourceScopeState.Active)
            {
                loaded.Release();
                return null;
            }

            // 并发请求只保留一个由 scope 持有的原生文件句柄。
            if (_rawFiles.TryGetValue(key, out cached) && cached.IsValid)
            {
                loaded.Release();
                return cached.FilePath;
            }

            _rawFiles[key] = loaded;
            return loaded.FilePath;
        }

        public async UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(string location, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            return await InstantiateAsync(CreateKey(location), parent, options);
        }

        public async UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(ResourceKey key, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            if (!EnsureActive())
                return null;

            key = _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(key);
            GameObject instance = await _resourceManager.InstantiateAsync(key, parent, options);
            if (instance != null)
                Retain(key);
            return instance;
        }

        public void Release(ResourceKey key)
        {
            key = _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(key);
            if (!_references.TryGetValue(key, out int count))
                return;

            _resourceManager.ReleaseAssetReference(key);
            count--;
            if (count <= 0)
                _references.Remove(key);
            else
                _references[key] = count;
        }

        public void ReleaseRawFile(string location)
        {
            ReleaseRawFile(CreateKey(location));
        }

        public void ReleaseRawFile(ResourceKey key)
        {
            key = _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(key);
            if (!_rawFiles.TryGetValue(key, out ResourceRawFileHandle handle))
                return;

            handle.Release();
            _rawFiles.Remove(key);
        }

        public void ReleaseAll()
        {
            if (State == ResourceScopeState.Released)
                return;

            State = ResourceScopeState.Releasing;
            foreach (var pair in new Dictionary<ResourceKey, int>(_references))
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < pair.Value; i++)
                    _resourceManager.ReleaseAssetReference(pair.Key);
            }
            _references.Clear();
            foreach (ResourceRawFileHandle handle in _rawFiles.Values)
                handle.Release();
            _rawFiles.Clear();
            State = ResourceScopeState.Released;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            ReleaseAll();
        }

        private void Retain(ResourceKey key)
        {
            _references.TryGetValue(key, out int count);
            _references[key] = count + 1;
        }

        private ResourceKey CreateKey(string location)
        {
            return _resourceManager.NormalizeKey(new ResourceKey(PackageName, location));
        }

        private bool EnsureActive()
        {
            if (State == ResourceScopeState.Active)
                return true;
            FRLog.Error($"ResourceScope is released : {Name}");
            return false;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using YooAsset;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 创建下载器状态。
    /// </summary>
    public class PackageDownloaderCreateState : FsmState
    {
        public override void OnEnter()
        {
            base.OnEnter();
            CreateDownloader();
        }

        private void CreateDownloader()
        {
            PackageConfig packageConfig = GetData("packageConfig") as PackageConfig;
            if (packageConfig == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("PackageDownloaderCreateState failed, packageConfig is null.");
                FailPrepare();
                return;
            }

            ResourceDownloaderOperation downloader = FRFM.Resource.YooExtension.CreateDownloader(
                packageConfig.name,
                YooAssetConfigs.DownloadingMaxNum,
                YooAssetConfigs.FailedTryAgain);

            if (downloader == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"Create downloader failed : {packageConfig.name}");
                FailPrepare();
                return;
            }

            if (downloader.TotalDownloadCount == 0)
            {
                FRLog.Info($"No files need download : {packageConfig.name}");

                UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepareDoneSignal = GetData("prepareDone") as Cysharp.Threading.Tasks.UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>;
                prepareDoneSignal?.TrySetResult(true);
                return;
            }

            SetData("downloader", downloader);

            // 如果存在下载 FSM，则交给下载 FSM
            AssetsDownLoadFsmController downloadController = FRFM.Fsm.CreateFsm<AssetsDownLoadFsmController>(
                new FsmCreateOption
                {
                    Owner = this,
                    AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone = true,
                    EnableLog = true,
                });

            // 透传数据
            downloadController.SetData("packageConfig", packageConfig);
            downloadController.SetData("downloader", downloader);
            downloadController.SetData("prepareDone", GetData("prepareDone"));
            downloadController.Start();
        }

        private void FailPrepare()
        {
            UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepareDone = GetData("prepareDone") as UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>;
            prepareDone?.TrySetResult(false);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/YooAsset/Operations/PackageDownloadState.cs
````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using YooAsset;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 下载状态。
    /// </summary>
    public class PackageDownloadState : FsmState
    {
        public override void OnEnter()
        {
            base.OnEnter();
            BeginDownloadAsync().Forget();
        }

        private async UniTask BeginDownloadAsync()
        {
            PackageConfig packageConfig = GetData("packageConfig") as PackageConfig;
            ResourceDownloaderOperation downloader = GetData("downloader") as ResourceDownloaderOperation;

            if (packageConfig == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("PackageDownloadState failed, packageConfig is null.");
                FailPrepare();
                return;
            }

            if (downloader == null)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"PackageDownloadState ignored, downloader is null : {packageConfig.name}");

                UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> nullDownloaderDone = GetData("prepareDone") as UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>;
                nullDownloaderDone?.TrySetResult(true);
                return;
            }

            downloader.DownloadError += data =>
            {
                FRLog.Error($"{data.FileName} download failed : {data.ErrorInfo}");
            };

            downloader.DownloadProgressChanged += data =>
            {
                // 你后续可以在这里接 UI 进度
                // FRLog.Info($"Download progress:{data.Progress}");
            };

            downloader.DownloadCompleted += data =>
            {
                FRLog.Info($"Downloader finished : {data.PackageName}, succeed : {data.Succeeded}");
            };

            downloader.DownloadFileStarted += data =>
            {
                FRLog.Info($"Begin download file : {data.FileName}, size : {data.FileSize}");
            };

            downloader.StartDownload();
            await downloader.ToUniTask();

            if (downloader.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"Package download failed : {packageConfig.name}");
                FailPrepare();
                return;
            }

            await FRFM.Resource.YooExtension.ClearUnusedCacheFilesAsync(packageConfig.name);
            FRLog.Info($"Package download completed : {packageConfig.name}");

            UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepareDoneSignal = GetData("prepareDone") as UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>;
            prepareDoneSignal?.TrySetResult(true);
        }

        private void FailPrepare()
        {
            UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepareDone = GetData("prepareDone") as UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>;
            prepareDone?.TrySetResult(false);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using YooAsset;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 包初始化状态。
    /// 负责根据 PackageConfig.playMode 创建 InitializePackageOptions 并初始化 package。
    /// </summary>
    public class PackageInitState : FsmState
    {
        public override void OnEnter()
        {
            base.OnEnter();
            InitializePackageAsync().Forget();
        }

        private async UniTask InitializePackageAsync()
        {
            PackageConfig packageConfig = GetData("packageConfig") as PackageConfig;
            if (packageConfig == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("PackageInitState failed, packageConfig is null.");
                FailPrepare();
                return;
            }

            YooAssetExtension yoo = FRFM.Resource.YooExtension;
            InitializePackageOptions initParams = yoo.CreateInitializeParameters(packageConfig);
            if (initParams == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"PackageInitState failed, init params create failed : {packageConfig.name}");
                FailPrepare();
                return;
            }

            bool ok = await yoo.InitializePackageAsync(
                packageConfig.name,
                initParams,
                packageConfig.isDefaultPackage);

            if (!ok)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"PackageInitState failed : {packageConfig.name}");
                //TODO：事件通知屏幕变化
                return;
            }

            ChangeState<PackageVersionUpdateState>();
        }

        private void FailPrepare()
        {
            UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepareDone = GetData("prepareDone") as UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>;
            prepareDone?.TrySetResult(false);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/YooAsset/YooAssetConfigs.cs
````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// YooAsset 配置访问器。
    /// </summary>
    public static class YooAssetConfigs
    {
        private static YooAssetPackagesConfig _packagesConfig;
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 异步加载 json 配置
        /// </summary>
        public static async UniTask InitializeFromJsonAsync()
        {
            _packagesConfig = await YooAssetPackagesJsonLoader.LoadAsync();
            if (_packagesConfig == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("YooAsset Packages Config json 加载失败。");
            }
        }
        
        private static void PrepareYooPackagesConfig()
        {
            if (_packagesConfig != null)
                return;

            _packagesConfig = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<YooAssetPackagesConfig>();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 配置对象。
        /// </summary>
        public static YooAssetPackagesConfig Config
        {
            get
            {
                PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
                return _packagesConfig;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 主服务器地址。
        /// </summary>
        public static string ResUrl
        {
            get
            {
                PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
                return _packagesConfig != null ? _packagesConfig.hostServerURL : string.Empty;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 备用服务器地址。
        /// </summary>
        public static string FallbackResUrl
        {
            get
            {
                PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
                return _packagesConfig != null ? _packagesConfig.fallbackHostServerURL : string.Empty;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 包配置列表。
        /// </summary>
        public static List<PackageConfig> PackageConfigs
        {
            get
            {
                PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
                return _packagesConfig != null ? _packagesConfig.packages : null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 最大下载并发数。
        /// </summary>
        public static int DownloadingMaxNum
        {
            get
            {
                PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
                return _packagesConfig != null ? _packagesConfig.downloadingMaxNum : 10;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 下载失败重试次数。
        /// </summary>
        public static int FailedTryAgain
        {
            get
            {
                PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
                return _packagesConfig != null ? _packagesConfig.failedTryAgain : 3;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 默认包配置。
        /// 优先找 isDefaultPackage=true，否则取第一个。
        /// </summary>
        public static PackageConfig DefaultPackageConfig
        {
            get
            {
                var list = PackageConfigs;
                if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
                    return null;

                for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (list[i] != null && list[i].isDefaultPackage)
                        return list[i];
                }

                return list[0];
            }
        }

        public static PackageConfig GetPackageConfig(string name)
        {
            var list = PackageConfigs;
            if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
                return null;

            foreach (PackageConfig config in list)
            {
                if (config.name == name)
                    return config;
            }

            return null;
        }

        public static async UniTask ReloadFromJsonAsync()
        {
            await InitializeFromJsonAsync();
        }

        public static void SaveCurrentJson()
        {
            PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
            if (_packagesConfig == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            YooAssetPackagesJsonLoader.Save(_packagesConfig);
        }

        public static void UpsertPackageConfig(PackageConfig packageConfig)
        {
            if (packageConfig == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageConfig.name))
            {
                return;
            }

            PrepareYooPackagesConfig();
            if (_packagesConfig == null)
            {
                _packagesConfig = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<YooAssetPackagesConfig>();
            }

            if (_packagesConfig.packages == null)
            {
                _packagesConfig.packages = new List<PackageConfig>();
            }

            int index = _packagesConfig.packages.FindIndex(config => config != null && config.name == packageConfig.name);
            if (index >= 0)
            {
                _packagesConfig.packages[index] = packageConfig;
            }
            else
            {
                _packagesConfig.packages.Add(packageConfig);
            }

            YooAssetPackagesJsonLoader.Save(_packagesConfig);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 获取当前平台名。
        /// </summary>
        public static string GetPlatformName()
        {
#if UNITY_ANDROID
            return "Android";
#elif UNITY_IOS
            return "iOS";
#elif UNITY_WEBGL
            return "WebGL";
#elif UNITY_STANDALONE_WIN
            return "Windows";
#elif UNITY_STANDALONE_OSX
            return "MacOS";
#elif UNITY_STANDALONE_LINUX
            return "Linux";
#else
            return "Default";
#endif
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/YooAsset/YooAssetExtension.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
using YooAsset;
using SceneHandle = YooAsset.SceneHandle;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// YooAsset 扩展层。
    /// 这次以你旧版逻辑为主：
    /// 1. 初始化 YooAssets
    /// 2. 管理 DefaultPackage
    /// 3. 提供包获取与资源加载统一入口
    /// 4. 为 AssetsProcess / Operations 提供辅助方法
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class YooAssetExtension
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 默认包。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourcePackage DefaultPackage { get; private set; }

        private readonly Dictionary<string, ResourcePackage> _packages = new Dictionary<string, ResourcePackage>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _initializedPackages = new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, PackageRuntimeInfo> _packageInfos = new Dictionary<string, PackageRuntimeInfo>();

        public async UniTask CreateGamePackageDefault(PackageConfig packageConfig)
        {
            UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepaerDone = new UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>();
            AssetsPrepareFsmController fsm = FRFM.Fsm.CreateFsm<AssetsPrepareFsmController>(
                new FsmCreateOption()
                {
                    Owner = this,
                    AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone = true,
                    EnableLog = true,
                });

            fsm.SetData("packageConfig", packageConfig);
            fsm.SetData("prepareDone", prepaerDone);
            fsm.Start();

            bool ok = await prepaerDone.Task;
            if (!ok)
            {
                FRLog.Info("CreateGamePackageDefault " + packageConfig.name + " Failed");
            }

            FRLog.Info("CreateGamePackageDefault " + packageConfig.name + " Finish");
        }
        
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 初始化 YooAssets 框架。
        /// </summary>
        public void InitializeFramework()
        {
            YooAssets.Initialize();
            FRLog.Info("YooAssets.Initialize completed.");
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 获取或创建包。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourcePackage GetOrCreatePackage(string packageName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
            {
                FRLog.Error("GetOrCreatePackage failed, packageName is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            if (_packages.TryGetValue(packageName, out var package))
                return package;

            if (!YooAssets.TryGetPackage(packageName, out package))
                package = YooAssets.CreatePackage(packageName);

            _packages[packageName] = package;
            GetOrCreatePackageInfo(packageName).State = PackageRuntimeState.Created;
            return package;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 获取包。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourcePackage GetPackage(string packageName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
                return DefaultPackage;

            if (_packages.TryGetValue(packageName, out ResourcePackage package))
                return package;

            if (YooAssets.TryGetPackage(packageName, out package))
            {
                _packages[packageName] = package;
                GetOrCreatePackageInfo(packageName).State = _initializedPackages.Contains(packageName) ? PackageRuntimeState.Initialized : PackageRuntimeState.Created;
            }

            return package;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 设置默认包。
        /// </summary>
        public void SetDefaultPackage(ResourcePackage package)
        {
            if (package == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("SetDefaultPackage failed, package is null.");
                return;
            }

            DefaultPackage = package;
            foreach (var pair in _packageInfos)
                pair.Value.IsDefaultPackage = false;
            GetOrCreatePackageInfo(package.PackageName).IsDefaultPackage = true;
            FRLog.Info($"Default package set : {package.PackageName}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 根据资源包配置创建初始化参数。
        /// 这部分严格沿用你旧版思路，只做结构整理。
        /// </summary>
        public InitializePackageOptions CreateInitializeParameters(PackageConfig packageConfig)
        {
            if (packageConfig == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("YooEx, CreateInitializeParameters failed, packageConfig is null.");
                return null;
            }

            EPlayMode playMode = packageConfig.playMode;

            // Older persisted configs may contain EditorSimulateMode. YooAsset 3.x keeps
            // the editor API in player builds as a throwing stub, so never invoke it on device.
            if (!Application.isEditor && playMode == EPlayMode.EditorSimulateMode)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"Package {packageConfig.name} uses EditorSimulateMode on player; falling back to OfflinePlayMode.");
                playMode = EPlayMode.OfflinePlayMode;
            }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
            if (Application.isEditor &&
                (playMode == EPlayMode.HostPlayMode || playMode == EPlayMode.OfflinePlayMode || playMode == EPlayMode.WebPlayMode))
            {
                playMode = EPlayMode.EditorSimulateMode;
            }
#endif

            switch (playMode)
            {
                case EPlayMode.EditorSimulateMode:
                {
                    PackageBuildResult buildResult = EditorSimulateBuildInvoker.Build(packageConfig.name, (int)EBundleType.VirtualAssetBundle);
                    string packageRoot = buildResult.PackageRootDirectory;
                    EditorSimulateModeOptions editorParams = new EditorSimulateModeOptions
                    {
                        EditorFileSystemParameters = FileSystemParameters.CreateDefaultEditorFileSystemParameters(packageRoot)
                    };
                    return editorParams;
                }

                case EPlayMode.OfflinePlayMode:
                {
                    string packagesRoot = packageConfig.isDefaultPackage ? null :
                        PathExtension.GetPackagesExtensionPath(packageConfig.name);
                    FRLog.Info($"YooAssetExtension package {packageConfig.name} use package root path {packagesRoot}");
                    
                    FileSystemParameters buildinFileSystemParams = FileSystemParameters.CreateDefaultBuiltinFileSystemParameters(packagesRoot);
                    
                    OfflinePlayModeOptions offlineParams = new OfflinePlayModeOptions
                    {
                        BuiltinFileSystemParameters = buildinFileSystemParams,
                    };
                    return offlineParams;
                }

                case EPlayMode.HostPlayMode:
                {
                    string defaultHostServer = GetHostServerURL();
                    string fallbackHostServer = GetFallbackHostServerURL();
                    IRemoteService remoteServices = new RemoteServices(defaultHostServer, fallbackHostServer);
                    HostPlayModeOptions hostParams = new HostPlayModeOptions
                    {
                        BuiltinFileSystemParameters = FileSystemParameters.CreateDefaultBuiltinFileSystemParameters(),
                        CacheFileSystemParameters = FileSystemParameters.CreateDefaultSandboxFileSystemParameters(remoteServices)
                    };
                    return hostParams;
                }

                case EPlayMode.WebPlayMode:
                {
#if UNITY_WEBGL && WEIXINMINIGAME && !UNITY_EDITOR
                    string defaultHostServer = GetHostServerURL();
                    string fallbackHostServer = GetFallbackHostServerURL();
                    string packageRoot = $"{WeChatWASM.WX.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/__GAME_FILE_CACHE";
                    IRemoteService remoteServices = new RemoteServices(defaultHostServer, fallbackHostServer);
                    WebPlayModeOptions webParams = new WebPlayModeOptions();
                    webParams.WebNetworkFileSystemParameters = WechatFileSystemCreater.CreateFileSystemParameters(packageRoot, remoteServices);
                    return webParams;
#else
                    WebPlayModeOptions webParams = new WebPlayModeOptions
                    {
                        WebServerFileSystemParameters = FileSystemParameters.CreateDefaultWebServerFileSystemParameters(),
                    };
                    return webParams;
#endif
                }

                default:
                    FRLog.Error($"Unsupported play mode : {playMode}");
                    return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 初始化包。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<bool> InitializePackageAsync(string packageName, InitializePackageOptions parameters, bool setAsDefault)
        {
            ResourcePackage package = GetOrCreatePackage(packageName);
            if (package == null || parameters == null)
                return false;

            var info = GetOrCreatePackageInfo(packageName);
            if (_initializedPackages.Contains(packageName))
            {
                if (setAsDefault)
                {
                    SetDefaultPackage(package);
                }

                info.State = PackageRuntimeState.Initialized;
                FRLog.Info($"Package already initialized : {packageName}");
                return true;
            }

            info.State = PackageRuntimeState.Initializing;
            info.LastError = null;
            InitializePackageOperation operation = package.InitializePackageAsync(parameters);
            await operation.ToUniTask();

            if (operation.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                info.State = PackageRuntimeState.Failed;
                info.LastError = operation.Error;
                FRLog.Error($"Package initialize failed : {packageName}, error : {operation.Error}");
                return false;
            }

            if (setAsDefault)
                SetDefaultPackage(package);

            _initializedPackages.Add(packageName);
            info.State = PackageRuntimeState.Initialized;
            FRLog.Info($"Package initialize success : {packageName}");
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 请求包版本。
        /// 注意：这里按你旧版接口改为 RequestPackageVersionAsync。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<string> RequestPackageVersionAsync(string packageName)
        {
            ResourcePackage package = GetPackage(packageName);
            if (package == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"RequestPackageVersionAsync failed, package not found : {packageName}");
                return null;
            }

            RequestPackageVersionOperation operation = package.RequestPackageVersionAsync();
            await operation.ToUniTask();

            if (operation.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"RequestPackageVersionAsync failed : {packageName}, error : {operation.Error}");
                return null;
            }

            FRLog.Info($"Request package version success : {packageName}, version : {operation.PackageVersion}");
            GetOrCreatePackageInfo(package.PackageName).Version = operation.PackageVersion;
            return operation.PackageVersion;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 更新包清单。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<bool> UpdatePackageManifestAsync(string packageName, string packageVersion)
        {
            ResourcePackage package = GetPackage(packageName);
            if (package == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UpdatePackageManifestAsync failed, package not found : {packageName}");
                return false;
            }

            LoadPackageManifestOperation operation = package.LoadPackageManifestAsync(new LoadPackageManifestOptions(packageVersion, 60));
            await operation.ToUniTask();

            if (operation.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UpdatePackageManifestAsync failed : {packageName}, error : {operation.Error}");
                return false;
            }

            FRLog.Info($"UpdatePackageManifest success : {packageName}, version : {packageVersion}");
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 创建下载器。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourceDownloaderOperation CreateDownloader(string packageName, int downloadingMaxNum, int failedTryAgain)
        {
            ResourcePackage package = GetPackage(packageName);
            if (package == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"CreateDownloader failed, package not found : {packageName}");
                return null;
            }

            return package.CreateResourceDownloader(new ResourceDownloaderOptions(downloadingMaxNum, failedTryAgain));
        }

        {

        {

        /// <summary>

        /// </summary>
        public SceneHandle LoadSceneAsync(string location, LoadSceneMode loadMode, bool activateOnLoad, string packageName = null)
        {

        /// <summary>
        /// 清理未使用缓存文件。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask ClearUnusedCacheFilesAsync(string packageName)
        {
            var package = GetPackage(packageName);
            if (package == null)
                return;

            var operation = package.ClearCacheAsync(new ClearCacheOptions(ClearCacheMethods.ClearUnusedBundleFiles));
            await operation.ToUniTask();

        public bool IsPackageCreated(string packageName)
        {
            return _packages.ContainsKey(packageName) || YooAssets.TryGetPackage(packageName, out _);
        }

        public bool IsPackageInitialized(string packageName)
        {
            return _initializedPackages.Contains(packageName);
        }

        public bool IsDefaultPackage(string packageName)
        {
            return DefaultPackage != null && DefaultPackage.PackageName == packageName;
        }

        public PackageRuntimeState GetPackageState(string packageName)
        {
            return _packageInfos.TryGetValue(packageName, out var info) ? info.State : PackageRuntimeState.None;
        }

        public PackageRuntimeInfo GetPackageInfo(string packageName)
        {
            return _packageInfos.TryGetValue(packageName, out var info) ? info : null;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<PackageRuntimeInfo> GetAllPackageInfos()
        {
            return new List<PackageRuntimeInfo>(_packageInfos.Values);
        }

        private PackageRuntimeInfo GetOrCreatePackageInfo(string packageName)
        {
            if (!_packageInfos.TryGetValue(packageName, out var info))
            {
                info = new PackageRuntimeInfo { PackageName = packageName, State = PackageRuntimeState.None };
                _packageInfos.Add(packageName, info);
            }

            return info;
        }

        {
            return YooAssetConfigs.ResUrl;
        }

        private string GetFallbackHostServerURL()
        {
            return YooAssetConfigs.FallbackResUrl;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 远端地址查询服务。
        /// </summary>
        private class RemoteServices : IRemoteService
        {
            private readonly string _defaultHostServer;
            private readonly string _fallbackHostServer;

            public RemoteServices(string defaultHostServer, string fallbackHostServer)
            {
                _defaultHostServer = defaultHostServer;
                _fallbackHostServer = fallbackHostServer;
            }

            public IReadOnlyList<string> GetRemoteUrls(string fileName)
            {
                return new[]
                {
                    $"{_defaultHostServer}/{fileName}",
                    $"{_fallbackHostServer}/{fileName}"
                };
            }
        }
````

````csharp
using System.IO;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public static class YooAssetPackagesJsonLoader
    {
        public static string PersistentPath => Path.Combine(BootstrapConfigLoader.PersistentRoot, BootstrapFileNames.YooAssetPackagesFile);

        public static async UniTask<YooAssetPackagesConfig> LoadAsync()
        {
            string json = await BootstrapConfigLoader.LoadTextAsync(BootstrapFileNames.YooAssetPackagesFile);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))
            {
                FRLog.Error($"Load YooAssetPackagesConfig json failed : {PersistentPath}");
                return null;
            }

            YooAssetPackagesConfig config = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<YooAssetPackagesConfig>();
            JsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite(json, config);

            return config;
        }

        public static void Save(YooAssetPackagesConfig config)
        {
            if (config == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            BootstrapConfigLoader.SaveText(BootstrapFileNames.YooAssetPackagesFile, JsonUtility.ToJson(config, true));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;

using Object = UnityEngine.Object;
using SceneHandle = YooAsset.SceneHandle;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 资源管理器。
    /// 负责：
    /// 1. Package 初始化与准备流程
    /// 2. 普通资源加载与缓存
    /// 3. 场景加载与记录
    /// 4. GameObject 实例复用与回收
    /// 5. 资源清理与诊断
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class ResourceManager : IManagerBase
    {
        public override int Priority => 10;

        /// <summary>
        /// 资源事件。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourceEvents Events { get; } = new ResourceEvents();

        /// <summary>
        /// YooAsset 适配层。
        /// </summary>
        public YooAssetExtension YooExtension { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// 资源诊断。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourceDiagnostics Diagnostics { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// 是否已初始化完成。
        /// </summary>
        private bool _isReady;
        public bool IsReady => _isReady;
        public bool IsProcessLoading => _loadingAssets.Count > 0;

        /// <summary>
        /// 普通资源缓存表。
        /// </summary>
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, AssetEntry> _assetEntries = new Dictionary<ResourceKey, AssetEntry>();

        /// <summary>
        /// 场景资源缓存表。
        /// </summary>
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, SceneEntry> _sceneEntries = new Dictionary<ResourceKey, SceneEntry>();

        /// <summary>
        /// 正在加载中的资源 key 集合。
        /// </summary>
        private readonly HashSet<ResourceKey> _loadingAssets = new HashSet<ResourceKey>();

        /// <summary>
        /// 同 key 并发加载合并表。
        /// </summary>
        private readonly Dictionary<ResourceKey, UniTaskCompletionSource<Object>> _assetLoadingTasks =
            new Dictionary<ResourceKey, UniTaskCompletionSource<Object>>();

        private readonly Dictionary<string, ResourceScope> _scopes = new Dictionary<string, ResourceScope>();
        private ResourceCleanupOptions _autoCleanupOptions;
        private float _lastUnloadUnusedAssetsTime = -999f;
        public bool EnableSyncLoadWarning { get; set; } = true;
        public bool AllowSyncLoadMissCache { get; set; } = true;

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前主场景 key。
        /// </summary>
        private ResourceKey? _currentMainSceneKey;

        #region Initialize / Destroy

        public override async UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            YooExtension = new YooAssetExtension();
            YooExtension.InitializeFramework();

            Diagnostics = new ResourceDiagnostics(this);

            // 读取默认包配置
            await YooAssetConfigs.InitializeFromJsonAsync();
            PackageConfig defaultPackageConfig = YooAssetConfigs.DefaultPackageConfig;
            if (defaultPackageConfig == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("ResourceManager initialize failed, default package config is null.");
                return;
            }

            // 依赖 FsmManager。请确保 FsmManager 的 Priority 小于 ResourceManager。
            if (FRFM.Fsm == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("ResourceManager initialize failed, FsmManager is null.");
                return;
            }

            UniTaskCompletionSource<bool> prepareDone = new UniTaskCompletionSource<bool>();

            AssetsPrepareFsmController fsm = FRFM.Fsm.CreateFsm<AssetsPrepareFsmController>(
                new FsmCreateOption
                {
                    Owner = this,
                    AutoRemoveWhenTaskDone = true,
                    EnableLog = true,
                });

            fsm.SetData("packageConfig", defaultPackageConfig);
            fsm.SetData("prepareDone", prepareDone);
            fsm.Start();

            bool ok = await prepareDone.Task;
            if (!ok)
            {
                FRLog.Error("ResourceManager initialize failed, assets prepare FSM failed.");
                return;
            }

            _isReady = true;
            FRLog.Info("ResourceManager initialized and package prepared.");
        }

        public override void Destroy()
        {
            ClearAllAssets();
            ClearAllScenes();
            ReleaseAllScopes();
            _isReady = false;
            FRLog.Info("ResourceManager destroyed.");
        }

        #endregion

        #region Package

        public bool IsPackageInitialized(string packageName)
        {
            return YooExtension != null && YooExtension.IsPackageInitialized(packageName);
        }

        public bool IsPackageCreated(string packageName)
        {
            return YooExtension != null && YooExtension.IsPackageCreated(packageName);
        }

        public bool IsDefaultPackage(string packageName)
        {
            return YooExtension != null && YooExtension.IsDefaultPackage(packageName);
        }

        public PackageRuntimeState GetPackageState(string packageName)
        {
            return YooExtension != null ? YooExtension.GetPackageState(packageName) : PackageRuntimeState.None;
        }

        public PackageRuntimeInfo GetPackageInfo(string packageName)
        {
            return YooExtension?.GetPackageInfo(packageName);
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<PackageRuntimeInfo> GetAllPackageInfos()
        {
            return YooExtension != null ? YooExtension.GetAllPackageInfos() : new List<PackageRuntimeInfo>();
        }

        public bool CheckLocationValid(ResourceKey key)
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            if (YooExtension == null || !YooExtension.IsPackageInitialized(key.PackageName))
                return false;
            ResourcePackage package = YooExtension.GetPackage(key.PackageName);
            return package != null && package.GetAssetInfo(key.Location).IsValid;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 初始化指定资源包。
        /// 一般由 FSM 状态内部调用。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<bool> InitializePackageAsync(string packageName, InitializePackageOptions initializeParameters, bool setAsDefault = false)
        {
            if (YooExtension == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("InitializePackageAsync failed, YooExtension is null.");
                return false;
            }

            return await YooExtension.InitializePackageAsync(packageName, initializeParameters, setAsDefault);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 请求包版本。
        /// 注意：当前按你旧工程实际接口使用 RequestPackageVersionAsync。
        /// </summary>
        public UniTask<string> RequestPackageVersionAsync(string packageName)
        {
            return YooExtension.RequestPackageVersionAsync(packageName);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 更新包清单。
        /// </summary>
        public UniTask<bool> UpdatePackageManifestAsync(string packageName, string packageVersion)
        {
            return YooExtension.UpdatePackageManifestAsync(packageName, packageVersion);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 创建下载器。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourceDownloaderOperation CreateDownloader(string packageName, int downloadingMaxNum = 10, int failedTryAgain = 3)
        {
            return YooExtension.CreateDownloader(packageName, downloadingMaxNum, failedTryAgain);
        }

        public async UniTask<PackageDownloadResult> DownloadPackageAsync(string packageName, PackageDownloadOptions options = null)
        {
            options ??= new PackageDownloadOptions();
            var result = new PackageDownloadResult { PackageName = packageName };
            if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                result.Error = "canceled";
                Events.RaisePackageDownloadFinished(result);
                return result;
            }

            ResourceDownloaderOperation downloader = CreateDownloader(packageName, options.DownloadingMaxNum, options.FailedTryAgain);
            if (downloader == null)
            {
                result.Error = "downloader is null";
                Events.RaisePackageDownloadFinished(result);
                return result;
            }

            if (downloader.TotalDownloadCount == 0)
            {
                result.Succeed = true;
                Events.RaisePackageDownloadFinished(result);
                return result;
            }

            downloader.DownloadProgressChanged += data =>
            {
                var progress = new PackageDownloadProgress
                {
                    PackageName = packageName,
                    TotalDownloadCount = data.TotalDownloadCount,
                    CurrentDownloadCount = data.CurrentDownloadCount,
                    TotalDownloadBytes = data.TotalDownloadBytes,
                    CurrentDownloadBytes = data.CurrentDownloadBytes,
                    Progress = data.Progress
                };
                options.ProgressCallback?.Invoke(progress);
                Events.RaisePackageDownloadProgress(progress);
            };
            downloader.DownloadError += data => result.Error = data.ErrorInfo;
            downloader.DownloadCompleted += data => result.Succeed = data.Succeeded;
            downloader.StartDownload();
            await downloader.ToUniTask();

            if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                result.Succeed = false;
                result.Error = "canceled";
            }
            else if (downloader.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                result.Succeed = false;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(result.Error))
                    result.Error = downloader.Error;
            }
            else
            {
                result.Succeed = true;
                await YooExtension.ClearUnusedCacheFilesAsync(packageName);
            }

            Events.RaisePackageDownloadFinished(result);
            return result;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Asset Load

        public async UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            T asset = await LoadAssetAsync<T>(key, options);
            return new ResourceHandle<T>(this, key, asset);
        }

        public async UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            options ??= ResourceLoadOptions.Default;
            ResourceKey key = MakeKey(location, options.PackageName);
            T asset = await LoadAssetAsync<T>(location, options);
            return new ResourceHandle<T>(this, key, asset);
        }

        public async UniTask<ResourceRawFileHandle> LoadRawFileHandleAsync(ResourceKey key)
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.Location))
            {
                FRLog.Error("LoadRawFileHandleAsync failed, location is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            EnsureBundleFileOperation operation = YooExtension.EnsureBundleFileAsync(key.Location, key.PackageName);
            if (operation == null)
                return null;

            await operation.ToUniTask();
            if (operation.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"LoadRawFileHandleAsync failed : {key}, error : {operation.Error}");
                return null;
            }

            string filePath = operation.Detail.BundleFilePath;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(filePath))
            {
                FRLog.Error($"LoadRawFileHandleAsync got empty file path : {key}");
                return null;
            }

            return new ResourceRawFileHandle(key, filePath);
        }

        public UniTask<ResourceRawFileHandle> LoadRawFileHandleAsync(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            return LoadRawFileHandleAsync(MakeKey(location, packageName));
        }

        public ResourceHandle<T> LoadAssetHandle<T>(ResourceKey key) where T : Object
        {

        public ResourceHandle<T> LoadAssetHandle<T>(string location, string packageName = null) where T : Object
        {

            T asset = LoadAsset<T>(location, packageName);

        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 异步加载强类型资源。
        /// </summary>

        {

            return obj as T;
        }

        public async UniTask<T> LoadAssetAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {

            return obj as T;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 异步加载无类型资源。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<Object> LoadAssetAsync(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
````
