````csharp
        }

        public async UniTask<Object> LoadAssetAsync(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            return await LoadAssetInternalAsync(location, null, options);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 同步加载资源。
        /// 兼容你旧版 ResourceManager 的使用习惯。
        /// </summary>
        public T LoadAsset<T>(ResourceKey key) where T : Object
        {
            return LoadAsset<T>(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public T LoadAsset<T>(string location, string packageName = null) where T : Object
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);

            if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var cachedEntry) &&
                cachedEntry.IsLoaded &&
                cachedEntry.Handle.IsValid)
            {
                cachedEntry.RefCount++;
                cachedEntry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
                return cachedEntry.Handle.AssetObject as T;
            }

            var package = YooExtension.GetPackage(key.PackageName);
            if (package == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"LoadAsset sync failed, package not found : {key.PackageName}");
                return null;
            }

            if (EnableSyncLoadWarning && AllowSyncLoadMissCache)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"LoadAsset sync miss cache : {key}");
            }

            if (!AllowSyncLoadMissCache)
                return null;

            AssetHandle handle = package.LoadAssetSync<T>(location);
            if (handle.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"LoadAsset sync failed : {location}, error : {handle.Error}");
                return null;
            }

            var entry = new AssetEntry
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName,
                RefCount = 1,
                LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime,
                Residency = ResourceResidency.Normal,
                State = ResourceEntryState.Loaded,
                Handle = handle,
                AllowGameObjectPool = true
            };

            _assetEntries[key] = entry;

            Events.RaiseAssetLoaded(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName,
                AssetObject = handle.AssetObject
            });

            return handle.AssetObject as T;
        }

        private async UniTask<Object> LoadAssetInternalAsync(string location, System.Type assetType, ResourceLoadOptions options)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(location))
            {
                FRLog.Error("LoadAssetInternalAsync failed, location is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            options ??= ResourceLoadOptions.Default;
            if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                return null;

            ResourceKey key = MakeKey(location, options.PackageName);

            // 已缓存并已加载完成
            if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var cachedEntry) &&
                cachedEntry.IsLoaded &&
                cachedEntry.Handle.IsValid)
            {
                TouchAssetEntry(cachedEntry, options);
                return cachedEntry.Handle.AssetObject;
            }

            // 同 Key 并发加载合并
            if (_assetLoadingTasks.TryGetValue(key, out var existingTcs))
            {
                Object loadedObj = await existingTcs.Task;
                if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    return null;

                if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var existingEntry))
                {
                    TouchAssetEntry(existingEntry, options);
                }

                return loadedObj;
            }

            UniTaskCompletionSource<Object> tcs = new UniTaskCompletionSource<Object>();
            _assetLoadingTasks[key] = tcs;

            AssetEntry entry;
            if (!_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out entry))
            {
                entry = new AssetEntry
                {
                    Key = key,
                    Location = location,
                    PackageName = key.PackageName,
                    Residency = options.Residency,
                    AllowGameObjectPool = options.AllowGameObjectPool,
                    RefCount = 0,
                    State = ResourceEntryState.None
                };

                if (options.AllowCache)
                    _assetEntries[key] = entry;
            }

            entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Loading;
            entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
            _loadingAssets.Add(key);

            try
            {
                AssetHandle handle = assetType == null
                    ? YooExtension.LoadAssetAsync(location, key.PackageName)
                    : YooExtension.LoadAssetAsync(location, assetType, key.PackageName);

                entry.Handle = handle;
                await handle.ToUniTask();

                _loadingAssets.Remove(key);

                if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    if (options.ReleaseOnCanceled && handle.IsValid)
                        handle.Release();
                    entry.State = ResourceEntryState.None;
                    _assetEntries.Remove(key);
                    tcs.TrySetResult(null);
                    _assetLoadingTasks.Remove(key);
                    return null;
                }

                if (handle.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
                {
                    entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Failed;

                    Events.RaiseAssetLoadFailed(new ResourceEventArgs
                    {
                        Key = key,
                        Location = location,
                        PackageName = key.PackageName,
                        Error = handle.Error
                    });

                    tcs.TrySetResult(null);
                    _assetLoadingTasks.Remove(key);

                    FRLog.Error($"LoadAsset failed : {key}, error : {handle.Error}");
                    return null;
                }

                entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Loaded;
                TouchAssetEntry(entry, options);

                Object obj = handle.AssetObject;
                tcs.TrySetResult(obj);
                _assetLoadingTasks.Remove(key);

                Events.RaiseAssetLoaded(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = key,
                    Location = location,
                    PackageName = key.PackageName,
                    AssetObject = obj
                });

                return obj;
            }
            catch (System.Exception e)
            {
                _loadingAssets.Remove(key);
                _assetLoadingTasks.Remove(key);
                entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Failed;
                tcs.TrySetException(e);

                Events.RaiseAssetLoadFailed(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = key,
                    Location = location,
                    PackageName = key.PackageName,
                    Error = e.Message
                });

                FRLog.Error($"LoadAsset exception : {key}, {e}");
                return null;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 预加载资源。
        /// 默认不增加引用计数。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<T> PreloadAssetAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            options ??= new ResourceLoadOptions
            {
                TrackReference = false,
                AllowCache = true,
                Residency = ResourceResidency.Normal
            };

            return await LoadAssetAsync<T>(key, options);
        }

        public async UniTask<T> PreloadAssetAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object
        {
            options ??= new ResourceLoadOptions
            {
                TrackReference = false,
                AllowCache = true,
                Residency = ResourceResidency.Normal
            };

            return await LoadAssetAsync<T>(location, options);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 尝试获取已缓存资源。
        /// </summary>
        public bool TryGetAsset<T>(ResourceKey key, out T asset) where T : Object
        {
            return TryGetAsset(key.Location, out asset, key.PackageName);
        }

        public bool TryGetAsset<T>(string location, out T asset, string packageName = null) where T : Object
        {
            asset = null;
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);

            if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry) &&
                entry.IsLoaded &&
                entry.Handle.IsValid)
            {
                asset = entry.Handle.AssetObject as T;
                return asset != null;
            }

            return false;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Scope

        public ResourceScope CreateScope(string name, string packageName = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            {
                FRLog.Error("CreateScope failed, name is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            if (_scopes.TryGetValue(name, out var scope) && scope.State == ResourceScopeState.Active)
            {
                if (!string.Equals(scope.PackageName, packageName, System.StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    FRLog.Warning($"CreateScope got existing scope with different package. name:{name}, current:{scope.PackageName}, requested:{packageName}");
                return scope;
            }

            scope = new ResourceScope(this, name, packageName);
            _scopes[name] = scope;
            return scope;
        }

        public bool TryGetScope(string name, out ResourceScope scope)
        {
            return _scopes.TryGetValue(name, out scope) && scope.State == ResourceScopeState.Active;
        }

        public bool ReleaseScope(string name)
        {
            if (!_scopes.TryGetValue(name, out var scope))
                return false;

            scope.ReleaseAll();
            _scopes.Remove(name);
            return true;
        }

        public void ReleaseAllScopes()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _scopes)
                pair.Value.ReleaseAll();
            _scopes.Clear();
        }

        #endregion

        #region Instantiate / Recycle

        /// <summary>
        /// 异步实例化 prefab。
        /// 优先尝试从对象池中获取。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(ResourceKey key, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            return await InstantiateAsync(key.Location, parent, WithPackage(options, key));
        }

        public async UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(string location, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            options ??= ResourceLoadOptions.Default;
            options.AllowGameObjectPool = true;

            var key = MakeKey(location, options.PackageName);

            // 先从池取
            var pooled = FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.TryGet(key);
            if (pooled != null)
            {
                if (parent != null)
                    pooled.transform.SetParent(parent, false);

                var tracker = pooled.GetComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>();
                if (tracker == null)
                    tracker = pooled.AddComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>();

                tracker.ResourceKey = key;
                tracker.Location = location;

                if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var pooledEntry))
                {
                    pooledEntry.RefCount++;
                    pooledEntry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
                }

                return pooled;
            }

            // 池里没有，先加载 prefab
            GameObject prefab = await LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>(location, options);
            if (prefab == null)
                return null;

            if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                ReleaseAssetReference(key);
                return null;
            }

            GameObject instance = Object.Instantiate(prefab, parent);
            instance.name = prefab.name;

            AssetInstanceTracker instanceTracker = instance.GetComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>();
            if (instanceTracker == null)
                instanceTracker = instance.AddComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>();

            instanceTracker.ResourceKey = key;
            instanceTracker.Location = location;

            Events.RaisePoolObjectCreated(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName,
                Instance = instance
            });

            return instance;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 预热 GameObject 池。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask WarmupGameObjectAsync(ResourceKey key, int count, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            await WarmupGameObjectAsync(key.Location, count, WithPackage(options, key));
        }

        public async UniTask WarmupGameObjectAsync(string location, int count, ResourceLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            if (count <= 0)
                return;

            options ??= ResourceLoadOptions.Default;
            options.AllowGameObjectPool = true;

            var instances = new List<GameObject>(count);

            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
            {
                if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    break;

                var instance = await InstantiateAsync(location, null, options);
                if (instance != null)
                    instances.Add(instance);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < instances.Count; i++)
            {
                RecycleInstance(instances[i]);
            }

            FRLog.Info($"WarmupGameObjectAsync finished : {location}, count : {count}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 回收实例到池。
        /// </summary>
        public bool RecycleInstance(GameObject instance)
        {
            if (instance == null)
                return false;

            var tracker = instance.GetComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>();
            if (tracker == null)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"RecycleInstance failed, tracker not found : {instance.name}");
                Object.Destroy(instance);
                return false;
            }

            var key = tracker.ResourceKey;
            if (!_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"RecycleInstance failed, entry not found : {key}");
                Object.Destroy(instance);
                return false;
            }

            entry.RefCount = Mathf.Max(0, entry.RefCount - 1);
            entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;

            FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Release(key, tracker.Location, instance);

            Events.RaiseInstanceRecycled(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = tracker.Location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName,
                Instance = instance
            });

            Events.RaisePoolObjectReleased(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = tracker.Location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName,
                Instance = instance
            });

            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 兼容旧版接口命名。
        /// </summary>
        public void Recycle(GameObject instanceObject, bool forceDestroy = false)
        {
            if (instanceObject == null)
                return;

            if (forceDestroy)
            {
                DestroyInstance(instanceObject);
                return;
            }

            RecycleInstance(instanceObject);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 销毁实例，不回池。
        /// </summary>
        public bool DestroyInstance(GameObject instance)
        {
            if (instance == null)
                return false;

            var tracker = instance.GetComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>();
            if (tracker != null && _assetEntries.TryGetValue(tracker.ResourceKey, out var entry))
            {
                entry.RefCount = Mathf.Max(0, entry.RefCount - 1);
                entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
            }

            Object.Destroy(instance);
            return true;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Scene

        /// <summary>
        /// 异步加载场景。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<SceneHandle> LoadSceneAsync(ResourceKey key, SceneLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            key = MakeKey(key);
            return await LoadSceneAsync(key.Location, WithPackage(options, key));
        }

        public async UniTask<SceneHandle> LoadSceneAsync(string location, SceneLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            options ??= new SceneLoadOptions();
            if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                return default;

            ResourceKey key = MakeKey(location, options.PackageName);

            if (_sceneEntries.TryGetValue(key, out SceneEntry existing) &&
                existing.IsLoaded &&
                existing.Handle.IsValid)
            {
                existing.RefCount++;
                existing.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
                return existing.Handle;
            }

            SceneEntry entry = new SceneEntry
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName,
                Residency = options.Residency,
                RefCount = 1,
                State = ResourceEntryState.Loading,
                IsMainScene = options.IsMainScene
            };

            _sceneEntries[key] = entry;

            SceneHandle handle = YooExtension.LoadSceneAsync(location, options.LoadSceneMode, options.ActivateOnLoad, key.PackageName);
            entry.Handle = handle;
            
            await handle.ToUniTask();

            if (options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Failed;
                FRLog.Warning($"LoadSceneAsync canceled : {key}");
                return default;
            }

            if (handle.Status != EOperationStatus.Succeeded)
            {
                entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Failed;

                Events.RaiseAssetLoadFailed(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = key,
                    Location = location,
                    PackageName = key.PackageName,
                    Error = handle.Error
                });

                FRLog.Error($"LoadSceneAsync failed : {key}, error : {handle.Error}");
                return default;
            }

            entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Loaded;
            entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;

            // Single 模式视为主场景切换
            if (options.LoadSceneMode == LoadSceneMode.Single)
            {
                _currentMainSceneKey = key;

                if (options.CleanupSceneScopedAssetsAfterLoad)
                    CleanupSceneScopedAssets();

                if (options.CleanupNormalAssetsAfterLoad)
                    CleanupUnusedNormalAssets();
            }

            Events.RaiseSceneLoaded(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName
            });

            FRLog.Info($"Scene loaded : {key}");
            return handle;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 卸载场景。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask<bool> UnloadSceneAsync(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return await UnloadSceneAsync(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public async UniTask<bool> UnloadSceneAsync(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);

            if (!_sceneEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"UnloadSceneAsync ignored, scene entry not found : {key}");
                return false;
            }

            if (!entry.Handle.IsValid)
            {
                _sceneEntries.Remove(key);
                return false;
            }

            entry.State = ResourceEntryState.Unloading;

            var operation = entry.Handle.UnloadSceneAsync();
            await operation.ToUniTask();

            entry.RefCount = 0;
            entry.State = ResourceEntryState.None;

            if (_currentMainSceneKey.HasValue && _currentMainSceneKey.Value.Equals(key))
            {
                _currentMainSceneKey = null;
            }

            _sceneEntries.Remove(key);

            Events.RaiseSceneUnloaded(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName
            });

            FRLog.Info($"Scene unloaded : {key}");
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 判断场景是否已加载。
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsSceneLoaded(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return IsSceneLoaded(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public bool IsSceneLoaded(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            return _sceneEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry) &&
                   entry.IsLoaded &&
                   entry.Handle.IsValid;
        }

        #region Release / Cleanup

        /// <summary>
        /// 手动减少资源引用。
        /// 常用于非实例资源。
        /// </summary>
        public bool ReleaseAssetReference(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return ReleaseAssetReference(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public bool ReleaseAssetReference(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            if (!_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
                return false;

            entry.RefCount = Mathf.Max(0, entry.RefCount - 1);
            entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 兼容旧版命名。
        /// </summary>
        public void ReleaseReference(ResourceKey key)
        {
            ReleaseReference(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public void ReleaseReference(string location)
        {
            ReleaseReference(location, null);
        }

        public void ReleaseReference(string location, string packageName)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
            {
                entry.RefCount = Mathf.Max(0, entry.RefCount - 1);
                entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;

                if (entry.RefCount <= 0 && entry.Residency != ResourceResidency.Resident)
                {
                    UnloadAsset(location, key.PackageName);
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 卸载指定资源。
        /// </summary>
        public bool UnloadAsset(ResourceKey key, bool clearGameObjectPool = true)
        {
            return UnloadAsset(key.Location, key.PackageName, clearGameObjectPool);
        }

        public bool UnloadAsset(string location, string packageName = null, bool clearGameObjectPool = true)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            if (!_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
                return false;

            if (entry.State == ResourceEntryState.Loading || _loadingAssets.Contains(key))
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"UnloadAsset ignored, asset is loading : {key}");
                return false;
            }

            if (entry.IsResident)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"UnloadAsset ignored, asset is resident : {key}");
                return false;
            }

            if (entry.RefCount > 0)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"UnloadAsset ignored, asset is still referenced : {key}, refCount : {entry.RefCount}");
                return false;
            }

            if (clearGameObjectPool)
            {
                FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(key);
            }

            if (entry.Handle.IsValid)
            {
                entry.Handle.Release();
            }

            _assetEntries.Remove(key);

            Events.RaiseAssetReleased(new ResourceEventArgs
            {
                Key = key,
                Location = location,
                PackageName = key.PackageName
            });

            FRLog.Info($"Asset unloaded : {key}");
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 兼容旧版命名。
        /// </summary>
        public void UnLoadAsset(ResourceKey key)
        {
            UnloadAsset(key);
        }

        public void UnLoadAsset(string location)
        {
            UnloadAsset(location);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 添加常驻资源。
        /// 如果资源已加载则直接修改条目驻留语义；
        /// 如果未加载，则在下次加载时应通过 options 指定 Resident 更稳妥。
        /// </summary>
        public void AddResidentAsset(ResourceKey key)
        {
            AddResidentAsset(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public void AddResidentAsset(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            if (_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
            {
                entry.Residency = ResourceResidency.Resident;
                FRLog.Info($"Asset set to resident : {key}");
            }
            else
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"AddResidentAsset ignored, asset not loaded yet : {key}");
            }
        }

        public void CleanupPackageAssets(string packageName, bool includeResident = false)
        {
            var pendingRemove = new List<ResourceKey>();

            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                var entry = pair.Value;
                if (entry.PackageName != packageName)
                    continue;

                if (entry.State == ResourceEntryState.Loading || _loadingAssets.Contains(entry.Key))
                    continue;

                if (!includeResident && entry.IsResident)
                    continue;

                if (entry.RefCount > 0)
                    continue;

                FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(entry.Key);

                if (entry.Handle.IsValid)
                {
                    entry.Handle.Release();
                }

                pendingRemove.Add(entry.Key);

                Events.RaiseAssetReleased(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = entry.Key,
                    Location = entry.Location,
                    PackageName = entry.PackageName
                });
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < pendingRemove.Count; i++)
            {
                _assetEntries.Remove(pendingRemove[i]);
            }

            Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets();
            FRLog.Info($"CleanupPackageAssets finished : {packageName}, removed count : {pendingRemove.Count}");
        }

        public void ClearPackageGameObjectPool(string packageName)
        {
            FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.ClearPackage(packageName);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清空指定资源键对应的实例池桶。
        /// </summary>
        public int ClearGameObjectPool(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(MakeKey(key)) ?? 0;
        }

        public ResourceCleanupResult CleanupAssets(ResourceCleanupOptions options)
        {
            options ??= new ResourceCleanupOptions();
            var result = new ResourceCleanupResult();
            var pendingRemove = new List<ResourceKey>();
            float now = Time.unscaledTime;

            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                var entry = pair.Value;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(options.PackageName) && entry.PackageName != options.PackageName)
                    continue;
                if (entry.State == ResourceEntryState.Loading || _loadingAssets.Contains(entry.Key))
                    continue;
                if (options.Residency.HasValue && entry.Residency != options.Residency.Value)
                    continue;
                if (!options.IncludeResident && entry.IsResident)
                    continue;
                if (entry.RefCount > 0)
                    continue;
                if (options.MinUnusedSeconds > 0f && now - entry.LastUseTime < options.MinUnusedSeconds)
                    continue;

                pendingRemove.Add(entry.Key);
            }

            pendingRemove.Sort((a, b) => _assetEntries[a].LastUseTime.CompareTo(_assetEntries[b].LastUseTime));
            int removeCount = options.MaxRemoveCount > 0
                ? Mathf.Min(options.MaxRemoveCount, pendingRemove.Count)
                : pendingRemove.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < removeCount; i++)
            {
                if (!_assetEntries.TryGetValue(pendingRemove[i], out var entry))
                    continue;
                result.ClearedPoolBucketCount += FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.ContainsBucket(entry.Key) == true ? 1 : 0;
                FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(entry.Key);
                if (entry.Handle.IsValid)
                    entry.Handle.Release();
                _assetEntries.Remove(entry.Key);
                result.RemovedAssetCount++;
                Events.RaiseAssetReleased(new ResourceEventArgs { Key = entry.Key, Location = entry.Location, PackageName = entry.PackageName });
            }

            if (options.UnloadUnusedAssets && now - _lastUnloadUnusedAssetsTime >= options.UnloadUnusedAssetsMinInterval)
            {
                Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets();
                _lastUnloadUnusedAssetsTime = now;
                result.CalledUnloadUnusedAssets = true;
            }

            return result;
        }

        public ResourceCleanupResult CleanupLeastRecentlyUsed(int maxRemoveCount, string packageName = null)
        {
            return CleanupAssets(new ResourceCleanupOptions { PackageName = packageName, MaxRemoveCount = maxRemoveCount });
        }

        public ResourceCleanupResult CleanupUnusedOlderThan(float seconds, string packageName = null)
        {
            return CleanupAssets(new ResourceCleanupOptions { PackageName = packageName, MinUnusedSeconds = seconds });
        }

        public void SetAutoCleanupOptions(ResourceCleanupOptions options)
        {
            _autoCleanupOptions = options;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清理未被引用的普通资源。
        /// 不清理 Resident。
        /// </summary>
        public void CleanupUnusedNormalAssets()
        {
            var pendingRemove = new List<ResourceKey>();

            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                var entry = pair.Value;

                if (entry.State != ResourceEntryState.Loaded)
                    continue;

                if (entry.Residency != ResourceResidency.Normal &&
                    entry.Residency != ResourceResidency.Transient)
                    continue;

                if (entry.RefCount > 0)
                    continue;

                FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(entry.Key);

                if (entry.Handle.IsValid)
                {
                    entry.Handle.Release();
                }

                pendingRemove.Add(entry.Key);

                Events.RaiseAssetReleased(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = entry.Key,
                    Location = entry.Location,
                    PackageName = entry.PackageName
                });
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < pendingRemove.Count; i++)
            {
                _assetEntries.Remove(pendingRemove[i]);
            }

            Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets();
            FRLog.Info($"CleanupUnusedNormalAssets finished, removed count : {pendingRemove.Count}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清理场景作用域资源。
        /// 主场景切换时调用。
        /// </summary>
        public void CleanupSceneScopedAssets()
        {
            var pendingRemove = new List<ResourceKey>();

            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                var entry = pair.Value;

                if (entry.State != ResourceEntryState.Loaded)
                    continue;

                if (entry.Residency != ResourceResidency.SceneScoped)
                    continue;

                if (entry.RefCount > 0)
                    continue;

                FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(entry.Key);

                if (entry.Handle.IsValid)
                {
                    entry.Handle.Release();
                }

                pendingRemove.Add(entry.Key);

                Events.RaiseAssetReleased(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = entry.Key,
                    Location = entry.Location,
                    PackageName = entry.PackageName
                });
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < pendingRemove.Count; i++)
            {
                _assetEntries.Remove(pendingRemove[i]);
            }

            FRLog.Info($"CleanupSceneScopedAssets finished, removed count : {pendingRemove.Count}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 异步等待不在加载中，然后执行清理。
        /// 兼容旧版 cleanUpAsync。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask CleanUpAsync()
        {
            await UniTask.WaitUntil(() => _loadingAssets.Count <= 0);
            CleanUp();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 兼容旧版命名。
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask cleanUpAsync()
        {
            await CleanUpAsync();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清理全部非常驻普通资源。
        /// 兼容旧版 CleanUp 行为。
        /// </summary>
        public void CleanUp()
        {
            CleanupUnusedNormalAssets();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清理全部非 Resident 资源。
        /// </summary>
        public void ClearAllAssets()
        {
            var keys = new List<ResourceKey>(_assetEntries.Keys);

            for (int i = 0; i < keys.Count; i++)
            {
                var key = keys[i];
                if (!_assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry))
                    continue;

                if (entry.IsResident)
                    continue;

                FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.Clear(key);

                if (entry.Handle.IsValid)
                {
                    entry.Handle.Release();
                }

                Events.RaiseAssetReleased(new ResourceEventArgs
                {
                    Key = key,
                    Location = entry.Location,
                    PackageName = entry.PackageName
                });

                _assetEntries.Remove(key);
            }

            Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清理全部场景记录。
        /// </summary>
        public void ClearAllScenes()
        {
            _sceneEntries.Clear();
            _currentMainSceneKey = null;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Diagnostics

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前资源统计。
        /// </summary>
        public ResourceStatistics GetStatistics()
        {
            return new ResourceStatistics
            {
                LoadedAssetCount = _assetEntries.Count,
                LoadedSceneCount = _sceneEntries.Count,
                LoadingAssetCount = _loadingAssets.Count,
                ReferencePoolCachedCount = FRFM.Pool?.ReferencePool?.GetTotalCachedCount() ?? 0,
                ObjectPoolCount = FRFM.Pool?.ObjectPool?.GetPoolCount() ?? 0,
                GameObjectPoolBucketCount = FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.GetBucketCount() ?? 0,
                GameObjectPoolInactiveCount = FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool?.GetTotalInactiveCount() ?? 0
            };
        }

        public AssetEntry GetAssetEntry(ResourceKey key)
        {
            _assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry);
            return entry;
        }

        public AssetEntry GetAssetEntry(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            _assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry);
            return entry;
        }

        public SceneEntry GetSceneEntry(ResourceKey key)
        {
            _sceneEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry);
            return entry;
        }

        public SceneEntry GetSceneEntry(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            _sceneEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry);
            return entry;
        }

        public int GetLoadedAssetCount(string packageName)
        {
            int count = 0;
            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                if (pair.Key.PackageName == packageName)
                    count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        public int GetLoadedSceneCount(string packageName)
        {
            int count = 0;
            foreach (var pair in _sceneEntries)
            {
                if (pair.Key.PackageName == packageName)
                    count++;
            }

            return count;
        }

        public bool IsAssetLoaded(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return IsAssetLoaded(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        public bool IsAssetLoaded(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            var key = MakeKey(location, packageName);
            return _assetEntries.TryGetValue(key, out var entry) &&
                   entry.IsLoaded &&
                   entry.Handle.IsValid;
        }

        internal IReadOnlyList<AssetEntrySnapshot> GetAssetSnapshots(string packageName = null)
        {
            var snapshots = new List<AssetEntrySnapshot>();
            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                var entry = pair.Value;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName) && entry.PackageName != packageName)
                    continue;
                snapshots.Add(new AssetEntrySnapshot
                {
                    Key = entry.Key,
                    PackageName = entry.PackageName,
                    Location = entry.Location,
                    RefCount = entry.RefCount,
                    Residency = entry.Residency,
                    State = entry.State,
                    LastUseTime = entry.LastUseTime,
                    HandleValid = entry.Handle.IsValid,
                    IsResident = entry.IsResident
                });
            }
            return snapshots;
        }

        internal IReadOnlyList<SceneEntrySnapshot> GetSceneSnapshots(string packageName = null)
        {
            var snapshots = new List<SceneEntrySnapshot>();
            foreach (var pair in _sceneEntries)
            {
                var entry = pair.Value;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName) && entry.PackageName != packageName)
                    continue;
                snapshots.Add(new SceneEntrySnapshot
                {
                    Key = entry.Key,
                    PackageName = entry.PackageName,
                    Location = entry.Location,
                    RefCount = entry.RefCount,
                    Residency = entry.Residency,
                    State = entry.State,
                    LastUseTime = entry.LastUseTime,
                    HandleValid = entry.Handle.IsValid,
                    IsMainScene = entry.IsMainScene
                });
            }
            return snapshots;
        }

        internal IReadOnlyList<PackageResourceSnapshot> GetPackageResourceSnapshots()
        {
            var map = new Dictionary<string, PackageResourceSnapshot>();
            foreach (var pair in _assetEntries)
            {
                if (!map.TryGetValue(pair.Key.PackageName, out var snapshot))
                {
                    snapshot = new PackageResourceSnapshot { PackageName = pair.Key.PackageName };
                    map.Add(pair.Key.PackageName, snapshot);
                }
                snapshot.AssetCount++;
            }
            foreach (var pair in _sceneEntries)
            {
                if (!map.TryGetValue(pair.Key.PackageName, out var snapshot))
                {
                    snapshot = new PackageResourceSnapshot { PackageName = pair.Key.PackageName };
                    map.Add(pair.Key.PackageName, snapshot);
                }
                snapshot.SceneCount++;
            }
            foreach (var key in _loadingAssets)
            {
                if (!map.TryGetValue(key.PackageName, out var snapshot))
                {
                    snapshot = new PackageResourceSnapshot { PackageName = key.PackageName };
                    map.Add(key.PackageName, snapshot);
                }
                snapshot.LoadingAssetCount++;
            }
            return new List<PackageResourceSnapshot>(map.Values);
        }

        internal ResourceKey NormalizeKey(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return MakeKey(key);
        }

        #endregion

        #region Helpers

        private ResourceKey MakeKey(ResourceKey key)
        {
            return MakeKey(key.Location, key.PackageName);
        }

        private ResourceKey MakeKey(string location, string packageName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
            {
                var defaultPackage = YooExtension != null && YooExtension.DefaultPackage != null
                    ? YooExtension.DefaultPackage.PackageName
                    : string.Empty;

                packageName = defaultPackage;

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
                {
                    FRLog.Warning($"MakeKey got empty package name. location : {location}");
                }
            }

            return new ResourceKey(packageName, location);
        }

        private ResourceLoadOptions WithPackage(ResourceLoadOptions options, ResourceKey key)
        {
            options ??= ResourceLoadOptions.Default;
            options.PackageName = key.PackageName;
            return options;
        }

        private SceneLoadOptions WithPackage(SceneLoadOptions options, ResourceKey key)
        {
            options ??= new SceneLoadOptions();
            options.PackageName = key.PackageName;
            return options;
        }

        private void TouchAssetEntry(AssetEntry entry, ResourceLoadOptions options)
        {
            entry.LastUseTime = Time.unscaledTime;
            entry.Residency = options.Residency;
            entry.AllowGameObjectPool = options.AllowGameObjectPool;

            if (options.TrackReference)
            {
                entry.RefCount++;
            }
        }

        #endregion
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Resource/ResourceModule_Analysis.md
````markdown
# Resource 模块新功能详细设计

## 设计边界

`ResourceManager` 仍保持当前职责边界：框架初始化阶段只初始化 `DefaultPackage`，其它游戏 package 由对应业务初始化流程自行调用单包初始化、版本更新、清单更新和下载接口。

本设计不改变默认初始化策略，重点补强运行期资源生命周期、多 package API、诊断、清理策略和下载流程封装。

## 当前基础

当前 Resource 模块已经具备以下基础能力：

- 基于 YooAsset 的默认包初始化流程。
- 单 package 初始化、版本请求、清单更新、下载器创建入口。
- `ResourceKey(PackageName, Location)` 作为资源唯一标识。
- 同步加载、异步加载、预加载、实例化、场景加载。
- 资源缓存、引用计数、驻留类型、同 key 并发加载合并。
- 与 `GameObjectPool` 联动的 prefab 实例回收。
- 资源事件、基础统计、基础诊断。

后续新增功能应尽量围绕这些已有结构扩展，不重写 YooAsset 适配层，不让 Pool 模块直接接管资源句柄生命周期。

## 功能一：资源句柄 ResourceHandle

### 目标

解决“加载返回资源对象后，调用方忘记释放或释放责任不清晰”的问题。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceHandle.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceHandleState.cs`

```csharp
public enum ResourceHandleState
{
    None,
    Valid,
    Released
}

public readonly struct ResourceHandle<T> : IDisposable where T : UnityEngine.Object
{
    public ResourceKey Key { get; }
    public T Asset { get; }
    public bool IsValid { get; }
    public ResourceHandleState State { get; }
    public void Release();
    public void Dispose();
}
```

`ResourceHandle<T>` 不直接持有 YooAsset 的 `AssetHandle`，而是持有 `ResourceKey` 和资源对象，通过 `ResourceManager.ReleaseAssetReference(Key)` 释放引用。这样可以保持 YooAsset handle 仍由 `AssetEntry` 统一管理。

### ResourceManager 新增 API

```csharp
public async UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object;
public async UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object;
public ResourceHandle<T> LoadAssetHandle<T>(ResourceKey key) where T : Object;
public ResourceHandle<T> LoadAssetHandle<T>(string location, string packageName = null) where T : Object;
```

### 生命周期规则

- 加载成功后，引用计数与现有 `LoadAssetAsync` 一致增加。
- `Release` 只减少引用计数，不强制卸载资源。
- 多次 `Release` 应只生效一次，重复释放输出 warning。
- 如果资源加载失败，返回 invalid handle。
- `Dispose` 等价于 `Release`。

### 与旧 API 的关系

旧的 `LoadAssetAsync<T>` 保留，用于简单场景。新业务推荐使用 `LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>`，特别是 UI、战斗、剧情、关卡等生命周期明确的系统。

## 功能二：资源作用域 ResourceScope

### 目标

为 UI、战斗、关卡、剧情等业务提供统一资源释放边界，减少手动释放遗漏。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceScope.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceScopeState.cs`

```csharp
public enum ResourceScopeState
{
    Active,
    Releasing,
    Released
}

public sealed class ResourceScope : IDisposable
{
    public string Name { get; }
    public ResourceScopeState State { get; }
    public IReadOnlyList<ResourceKey> Keys { get; }
    public UniTask<T> LoadAssetAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object;
    public UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null) where T : Object;
    public UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(ResourceKey key, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
    public void Release(ResourceKey key);
    public void ReleaseAll();
    public void Dispose();
}
```

### ResourceManager 新增 API

```csharp
public ResourceScope CreateScope(string name);
public bool TryGetScope(string name, out ResourceScope scope);
public bool ReleaseScope(string name);
public void ReleaseAllScopes();
```

### 行为规则

- `ResourceScope` 内部记录加载成功并增加引用的 `ResourceKey`。
- 同一 scope 多次加载同一 key，需要记录引用次数，而不是只记录 key。
- `ReleaseAll` 按记录次数调用 `ReleaseAssetReference`。
- scope 释放后不允许继续加载，调用时输出 error 并返回 null。
- scope 可绑定业务对象生命周期，例如 UIForm 关闭时释放。

### 与 Residency 的关系

`ResourceScope` 是引用释放边界，`ResourceResidency` 是资源清理策略。二者不互斥。

- scope 释放会减少引用计数。
- 是否立即卸载仍由资源驻留类型和清理策略决定。
- `Resident` 资源即使 scope 释放也不会被普通清理卸载。

## 功能三：取消加载 CancellationToken

### 目标

支持 UI 快速关闭、场景切换、业务中断时取消等待加载结果，避免加载完成后产生无用引用或实例。

### Options 扩展

在 `ResourceLoadOptions` 增加：

```csharp
public CancellationToken CancellationToken;
public bool ReleaseOnCanceled = true;
```

在 `SceneLoadOptions` 增加：

```csharp
public CancellationToken CancellationToken;
```

### 加载流程设计

`LoadAssetInternalAsync` 中关键节点检查取消：

1. 发起加载前检查，已取消则直接返回 null。
2. YooAsset handle 完成后检查，若已取消且 `ReleaseOnCanceled` 为 true，则不增加引用并释放 handle。
3. 并发加载合并时，每个调用方独立响应自己的 token，但底层共享加载任务不因为单个调用方取消而取消。

### 实例化取消规则

- prefab 加载前已取消：返回 null。
- prefab 加载后实例化前取消：释放本次引用，返回 null。
- 实例化后通常不再响应取消，由调用方回收或销毁。

### 场景取消规则

YooAsset 场景加载底层不一定支持真正取消，因此这里只取消等待和后续处理。若 handle 已完成但 token 取消，按失败路径返回 default，并记录 warning。

## 功能四：Package 状态查询

### 目标

让业务初始化流程可以可靠判断某个 package 的创建、初始化、失败状态，避免重复初始化和错误调用。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/YooAsset/PackageRuntimeState.cs`

```csharp
public enum PackageRuntimeState
{
    None,
    Created,
    Initializing,
    Initialized,
    Failed
}

public sealed class PackageRuntimeInfo
{
    public string PackageName;
    public bool IsDefaultPackage;
    public PackageRuntimeState State;
    public string Version;
    public string LastError;
}
```

### YooAssetExtension 扩展

维护：

```csharp
private readonly Dictionary<string, PackageRuntimeInfo> _packageInfos;
```

新增：

```csharp
public bool IsPackageCreated(string packageName);
public bool IsPackageInitialized(string packageName);
public bool IsDefaultPackage(string packageName);
public PackageRuntimeState GetPackageState(string packageName);
public PackageRuntimeInfo GetPackageInfo(string packageName);
public IReadOnlyList<PackageRuntimeInfo> GetAllPackageInfos();
```

### 状态流转

- `GetOrCreatePackage` 成功：`None -> Created`。
- `InitializePackageAsync` 开始：`Created -> Initializing`。
- 初始化成功：`Initializing -> Initialized`。
- 初始化失败：`Initializing -> Failed`，记录 `LastError`。
- `SetDefaultPackage` 更新 `IsDefaultPackage`。

## 功能五：Package 下载任务与进度事件

### 目标

在不强制业务使用统一下载 UI 的前提下，提供标准下载任务封装和进度事件。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/YooAsset/PackageDownloadOptions.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/YooAsset/PackageDownloadProgress.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/YooAsset/PackageDownloadResult.cs`

```csharp
public sealed class PackageDownloadOptions
{
    public int DownloadingMaxNum = 10;
    public int FailedTryAgain = 3;
    public CancellationToken CancellationToken;
    public Action<PackageDownloadProgress> ProgressCallback;
}

public sealed class PackageDownloadProgress
{
    public string PackageName;
    public int TotalDownloadCount;
    public int CurrentDownloadCount;
    public long TotalDownloadBytes;
    public long CurrentDownloadBytes;
    public float Progress;
}

public sealed class PackageDownloadResult
{
    public string PackageName;
    public bool Succeed;
    public string Error;
}
```

### ResourceManager 新增 API

```csharp
public UniTask<PackageDownloadResult> DownloadPackageAsync(string packageName, PackageDownloadOptions options = null);
```

### ResourceEvents 扩展

```csharp
public event Action<PackageDownloadProgress> PackageDownloadProgress;
public event Action<PackageDownloadResult> PackageDownloadFinished;
```

### 行为规则

- 内部仍通过 `CreateDownloader` 获取 YooAsset downloader。
- 没有下载内容时直接返回成功。
- 进度事件和 options 回调都触发。
- 下载失败返回失败结果，不抛异常。
- token 取消时返回失败结果，错误信息为 canceled。

## 功能六：诊断快照增强

### 目标

让编辑器调试面板和运行期日志能定位资源泄漏、引用异常、package 状态异常。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceDiagnosticSnapshot.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/AssetEntrySnapshot.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/SceneEntrySnapshot.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/PackageResourceSnapshot.cs`

```csharp
public sealed class ResourceDiagnosticSnapshot
{
    public ResourceStatistics Statistics;
    public List<PackageResourceSnapshot> Packages;
    public List<AssetEntrySnapshot> Assets;
    public List<SceneEntrySnapshot> Scenes;
    public List<string> Warnings;
}
```

`AssetEntrySnapshot` 字段建议包含：

- `ResourceKey Key`
- `string PackageName`
- `string Location`
- `int RefCount`
- `ResourceResidency Residency`
- `ResourceEntryState State`
- `float LastUseTime`
- `bool HandleValid`
- `bool IsResident`

### ResourceDiagnostics 新增 API

```csharp
public ResourceDiagnosticSnapshot CreateSnapshot();
public string DumpDetail();
public IReadOnlyList<AssetEntrySnapshot> GetAssetSnapshots(string packageName = null);
public IReadOnlyList<SceneEntrySnapshot> GetSceneSnapshots(string packageName = null);
```

### 异常检测规则

- entry 状态为 Loaded 但 handle 无效。
- entry 状态为 Failed 但仍留在缓存中。
- refCount 长时间大于 0 且 LastUseTime 很久未更新。
- package 未初始化但存在资源 entry。
- GameObjectPool 中存在资源 entry 不存在的桶。

## 功能七：资源清理策略增强

### 目标

从“手动清理函数”升级为“可配置清理策略”，减少内存峰值和频繁 `Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets` 带来的卡顿。

### 新增类型

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceCleanupOptions.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceCleanupResult.cs`

```csharp
public sealed class ResourceCleanupOptions
{
    public string PackageName;
    public ResourceResidency? Residency;
    public float MinUnusedSeconds = 0f;
    public int MaxRemoveCount = 0;
    public bool IncludeResident = false;
    public bool UnloadUnusedAssets = true;
    public float UnloadUnusedAssetsMinInterval = 5f;
}

public sealed class ResourceCleanupResult
{
    public int RemovedAssetCount;
    public int ClearedPoolBucketCount;
    public bool CalledUnloadUnusedAssets;
}
```

### ResourceManager 新增 API

```csharp
public ResourceCleanupResult CleanupAssets(ResourceCleanupOptions options);
public ResourceCleanupResult CleanupLeastRecentlyUsed(int maxRemoveCount, string packageName = null);
public ResourceCleanupResult CleanupUnusedOlderThan(float seconds, string packageName = null);
public void SetAutoCleanupOptions(ResourceCleanupOptions options);
```

### 清理规则

- 只清理 `RefCount <= 0` 的资源。
- 默认不清理 `Resident`。
- 清理资源前先清理对应 `GameObjectPool` 桶。
- LRU 清理按 `LastUseTime` 从旧到新排序。
- `Resources.UnloadUnusedAssets` 需要节流，避免连续多次调用。

## 功能八：事件参数标准化

### 目标

让事件字段更清晰，降低监听者误用字段的概率。

### 新增事件参数

建议新增文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Events/AssetLoadEventArgs.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Events/AssetReleaseEventArgs.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Events/SceneLoadEventArgs.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Events/PackageDownloadEventArgs.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Events/ResourcePoolEventArgs.cs`

### 兼容策略

第一阶段保留现有 `ResourceEventArgs` 和事件，同时新增强类型事件。

```csharp
public event Action<AssetLoadEventArgs> AssetLoadedV2;
public event Action<AssetLoadEventArgs> AssetLoadFailedV2;
public event Action<AssetReleaseEventArgs> AssetReleasedV2;
public event Action<SceneLoadEventArgs> SceneLoadedV2;
public event Action<SceneLoadEventArgs> SceneUnloadedV2;
```

第二阶段业务迁移后，再考虑标记旧事件为 `[Obsolete]`。

## 功能九：同步加载使用收敛

### 目标

保留同步加载兼容能力，同时降低运行期卡顿风险。

### ResourceLoadOptions 扩展

```csharp
public bool WarnIfSyncLoadMissCache = true;
```

### ResourceManager 新增设置

```csharp
public bool EnableSyncLoadWarning { get; set; } = true;
public bool AllowSyncLoadMissCache { get; set; } = true;
```

### 行为规则

- `LoadAsset<T>` 命中缓存时不输出 warning。
- 未命中缓存且需要真正同步 YooAsset 加载时输出 warning。
- 若 `AllowSyncLoadMissCache == false`，未命中缓存直接返回 null。
- 文档推荐运行期优先使用 `PreloadAssetAsync` + `TryGetAsset`。

## 实施顺序建议

### 阶段一

1. 实现 `ResourceHandle<T>`。
2. 实现 `ResourceScope`。
3. 增强诊断快照。
4. 增加 package 状态查询。

### 阶段二

1. 加入取消加载支持。
2. 实现下载任务和进度事件。
3. 实现统一清理策略。

### 阶段三

1. 标准化事件参数。
2. 收敛同步加载策略。
3. 基于诊断快照制作编辑器调试窗口。

## 验收标准

- 默认 Resource 初始化仍只初始化 `DefaultPackage`。
- 业务 package 仍可独立初始化、下载和卸载资源。
- 所有新增 API 都支持 `ResourceKey`。
- `ResourceHandle<T>` 重复释放不会破坏引用计数。
- `ResourceScope.ReleaseAll` 后作用域内资源引用计数正确归零或减少。
- 取消加载不会产生额外引用泄漏。
- 诊断快照能列出每个 package 的资源、场景、引用计数和异常项。
- 清理策略不会卸载仍被引用或默认保护的常驻资源。

## 总结

Resource 模块后续的核心方向是把“能加载资源”升级为“能可靠表达资源生命周期”。最关键的设计是 `ResourceHandle<T>`、`ResourceScope`、取消加载、package 状态查询和诊断快照。它们不会改变当前默认包初始化边界，但能显著降低业务层资源泄漏、重复加载和多 package 使用错误的概率。
````

## File: Core/Resource/ResourceModule_Guide.md
````markdown
# Resource 模块详细说明

## 模块定位

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource` 是 FRFrame 对 YooAsset 的资源管理封装层，负责默认包初始化、业务包辅助接口、资源加载、引用计数、Prefab 实例化、场景加载、资源作用域、下载进度、诊断与清理。

模块设计边界：框架初始化阶段只初始化 `DefaultPackage`。其它游戏 package 由对应业务初始化流程自行初始化、更新清单、下载资源。本模块提供多 package API 和必要状态查询，但不批量接管所有业务包初始化。

## 核心入口

### ResourceManager

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/ResourceManager.cs`

常用入口通常通过 `FRFM.Resource` 访问。

核心职责：

- 初始化 YooAsset 与默认包。
- 管理 YooAsset package 状态和下载流程。
- 以 `ResourceKey` 管理多 package 资源唯一标识。
- 管理资源缓存、引用计数、驻留策略和清理。
- 管理 Prefab 实例化与 `GameObjectPool` 联动。
- 管理场景加载、卸载和主场景切换清理。
- 提供资源诊断、统计和事件。

### YooAssetExtension

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/YooAsset/YooAssetExtension.cs`

职责：

- 包装 YooAsset 初始化。
- 获取或创建 `ResourcePackage`。
- 设置 `DefaultPackage`。
- 创建初始化参数。
- 初始化单个 package。
- 请求版本、更新清单、创建下载器。
- 维护 `PackageRuntimeInfo` 状态。

业务初始化其它 package 时优先使用 `ResourceManager` 对外 API，只有框架内部或特殊流程才直接访问 `YooAssetExtension`。

## 资源标识 ResourceKey

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceKey.cs`

`ResourceKey` 由 `PackageName` 和 `Location` 组成，用于避免多 package 下相同 location 冲突。

```csharp
var key = new ResourceKey("BattlePackage", "Assets/Game/Battle/Prefabs/Hero.prefab");
```

规则：

- 推荐业务代码在多 package 场景下显式传入 `ResourceKey`。
- 如果 `PackageName` 为空，ResourceManager 会尝试解析为默认包名。
- 非默认 package 的资源不要只传 location，否则会被当作默认包资源处理。

## 初始化与 Package 流程

### 框架初始化

`ResourceManager.InitializeAsync()` 会：

1. 创建 `YooAssetExtension`。
2. 调用 `YooAssets.Initialize()`。
3. 加载 YooAsset package 配置。
4. 获取默认 package 配置。
5. 通过资源准备 FSM 初始化默认包。
6. 初始化成功后设置 `IsReady = true`。

### 业务 package 初始化建议流程

```csharp
PackageConfig config = YooAssetConfigs.GetPackageConfig("BattlePackage");
InitializeParameters parameters = FRFM.Resource.YooExtension.CreateInitializeParameters(config);
bool initialized = await FRFM.Resource.InitializePackageAsync(config.name, parameters, setAsDefault: false);

if (!initialized)
    return;

string version = await FRFM.Resource.RequestPackageVersionAsync(config.name);
bool manifestOk = await FRFM.Resource.UpdatePackageManifestAsync(config.name, version);
```

如果业务需要下载资源：

```csharp
var result = await FRFM.Resource.DownloadPackageAsync("BattlePackage", new PackageDownloadOptions
{
    DownloadingMaxNum = 10,
    FailedTryAgain = 3,
    ProgressCallback = progress =>
    {
        float value = progress.Progress;
    }
});

if (!result.Succeed)
{
    FRLog.Error(result.Error);
}
```

### Package 状态 API

```csharp
bool created = FRFM.Resource.IsPackageCreated(packageName);
bool initialized = FRFM.Resource.IsPackageInitialized(packageName);
bool isDefault = FRFM.Resource.IsDefaultPackage(packageName);
PackageRuntimeState state = FRFM.Resource.GetPackageState(packageName);
PackageRuntimeInfo info = FRFM.Resource.GetPackageInfo(packageName);
IReadOnlyList<PackageRuntimeInfo> infos = FRFM.Resource.GetAllPackageInfos();
```

`PackageRuntimeState`：

- `None`
- `Created`
- `Initializing`
- `Initialized`
- `Failed`

## 资源加载 API

### 异步加载

```csharp
var key = new ResourceKey("UIPackage", "Assets/Game/UI/Main.prefab");
GameObject prefab = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>(key);
```

使用 options：

```csharp
var asset = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<Texture2D>("Assets/Game/Icon.png", new ResourceLoadOptions
{
    PackageName = "UIPackage",
    Residency = ResourceResidency.Normal,
    TrackReference = true,
    AllowCache = true,
    CancellationToken = cancellationToken
});
```

### 同步加载

```csharp
Texture2D icon = FRFM.Resource.LoadAsset<Texture2D>(new ResourceKey("UIPackage", "Assets/Game/Icon.png"));
```

同步加载策略：

- 优先从已缓存资源中返回。
- 缓存 miss 时可直接调用 YooAsset 同步加载。
- `EnableSyncLoadWarning` 控制是否对同步 miss 输出 warning。
- `AllowSyncLoadMissCache` 为 false 时，同步 miss 会返回 null。

建议：运行期主流程优先使用异步加载；同步加载适合确定已预加载的资源或编辑器/调试场景。

### 预加载与 TryGet

```csharp
await FRFM.Resource.PreloadAssetAsync<GameObject>(key);

if (FRFM.Resource.TryGetAsset<GameObject>(key, out var prefab))
{
    // 使用已加载资源
}
```

### ResourceLoadOptions

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceLoadOptions.cs`

字段：

- `PackageName`：资源包名。
- `Residency`：驻留策略。
- `TrackReference`：是否增加引用计数。
- `AllowCache`：是否写入资源缓存。
- `AllowGameObjectPool`：Prefab 实例化是否允许对象池。
- `CancellationToken`：取消等待加载结果。
- `ReleaseOnCanceled`：取消后是否释放本次加载引用。
- `WarnIfSyncLoadMissCache`：同步加载缓存 miss 时是否警告。

## 资源驻留策略

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceResidency.cs`

常见策略：

- `Normal`：普通资源，可在引用归零后被清理。
- `Transient`：临时资源，适合短生命周期加载。
- `SceneScoped`：场景级资源，适合场景切换时清理。
- `Resident`：常驻资源，不被普通清理移除。

设置方式：

```csharp
await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<AudioClip>(key, new ResourceLoadOptions
{
    Residency = ResourceResidency.Resident
});
```

也可以显式标记常驻：

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.AddResidentAsset(key);
```

## ResourceHandle

文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceHandle.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceHandleState.cs`

用途：让调用方明确拥有一次资源引用，并通过 `Dispose` / `Release` 释放。

```csharp
using ResourceHandle<Texture2D> handle = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetHandleAsync<Texture2D>(key);
if (handle.IsValid)
{
    Texture2D texture = handle.Asset;
}
```

手动释放：

```csharp
ResourceHandle<GameObject> handle = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetHandleAsync<GameObject>(key);
// 使用资源
handle.Release();
```

规则：

- 加载成功后引用计数增加。
- `Release()` 会调用 `ReleaseAssetReference(Key)`。
- 重复释放只输出 warning，不会重复减少引用计数。
- `Dispose()` 等价于 `Release()`。

## ResourceScope

文件：

- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceScope.cs`
- `Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Runtime/ResourceScopeState.cs`

用途：为 UI、关卡、战斗、剧情等业务建立资源生命周期边界。Scope 可以绑定默认 package，适合每个业务 package 像独立游戏一样管理自身资源的场景。

```csharp
ResourceScope scope = FRFM.Resource.CreateScope("UI.MainMenu", "UIPackage");

GameObject prefab = await scope.LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>("Assets/Game/UI/MainMenu.prefab");
GameObject instance = await scope.InstantiateAsync("Assets/Game/UI/MainMenu.prefab");
string videoPath = await scope.LoadRawFilePathAsync("Assets/Game/Video/intro.mp4");

scope.ReleaseAll();
```

跨 package 资源仍然显式使用 `ResourceKey`：

```csharp
GameObject shared = await scope.LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>(
    new ResourceKey("SharedPackage", "Assets/Game/Common/Shared.prefab"));
```

推荐用法：

```csharp
public sealed class BattleLoader : System.IDisposable
{
    private readonly ResourceScope _scope = FRFM.Resource.CreateScope("Battle", "BattlePackage");

    public async UniTask LoadAsync(Transform parent)
    {
        await _scope.LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>("Assets/Game/Battle/Hero.prefab");
        await _scope.InstantiateAsync("Assets/Game/Battle/Bullet.prefab", parent);
    }

    public void Dispose()
    {
        _scope.Dispose();
    }
}
```

API：

```csharp
ResourceScope CreateScope(string name, string packageName = null);
UniTask<T> LoadAssetAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
UniTask<T> LoadAssetAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(string location, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
UniTask<ResourceHandle<T>> LoadAssetHandleAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
UniTask<string> LoadRawFilePathAsync(string location);
UniTask<string> LoadRawFilePathAsync(ResourceKey key);
void ReleaseRawFile(string location);
void ReleaseRawFile(ResourceKey key);
UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(string location, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
UniTask<GameObject> InstantiateAsync(ResourceKey key, Transform parent = null, ResourceLoadOptions options = null);
```

规则：

- `CreateScope(name, packageName)` 的 `packageName` 是 scope 内 string location API 的默认包名。
- 未绑定 package 的 scope 仍按 ResourceManager 默认包解析 string location。
- 同一 scope 多次加载同一 key 会记录次数。
- 原生文件句柄由 scope 缓存，`ReleaseRawFile` 或 `ReleaseAll` 时释放。
- `Release(key)` 释放一次引用。
- `ReleaseAll()` 按记录次数释放所有引用。
- scope 释放后继续加载会输出 error 并返回 null。
- scope 默认 package 只是默认值，不限制该 scope 只能加载这个包；跨包资源使用 `ResourceKey` 明确表达。

## Prefab 实例化与回收

### 实例化

```csharp
GameObject instance = await FRFM.Resource.InstantiateAsync(
    new ResourceKey("BattlePackage", "Assets/Game/Battle/Hero.prefab"),
    parent);
```

流程：

1. 先尝试从 `FRFM.Pool.GameObjectPool` 按 `ResourceKey` 获取 inactive 实例。
2. 如果池中没有，则加载 prefab。
3. `Object.Instantiate` 创建实例。
4. 添加或更新 `AssetInstanceTracker`。
5. 触发资源池相关事件。

### 预热

```csharp
await FRFM.Resource.WarmupGameObjectAsync(key, 10, new ResourceLoadOptions
{
    PackageName = "BattlePackage"
});
```

### 回收

```csharp
bool recycled = FRFM.Resource.RecycleInstance(instance);
```

回收流程：

- 通过 `AssetInstanceTracker` 找到来源 `ResourceKey`。
- 减少资源引用计数。
- 放入 `GameObjectPool`。
- 如果缺少 tracker，则销毁实例并输出 warning。

### 销毁实例

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.DestroyInstance(instance);
```

适合不希望入池复用的实例。

## 场景加载

### SceneLoadOptions

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Scene/SceneLoadOptions.cs`

字段：

- `PackageName`
- `LoadSceneMode`
- `ActivateOnLoad`
- `IsMainScene`
- `Residency`
- `CleanupNormalAssetsAfterLoad`
- `CleanupSceneScopedAssetsAfterLoad`
- `CancellationToken`

### 加载场景

```csharp
SceneHandle handle = await FRFM.Resource.LoadSceneAsync(
    new ResourceKey("ScenePackage", "Assets/Game/Scenes/Battle.unity"),
    new SceneLoadOptions
    {
        LoadSceneMode = LoadSceneMode.Single,
        IsMainScene = true,
        CleanupNormalAssetsAfterLoad = true,
        CleanupSceneScopedAssetsAfterLoad = true
    });
```

主场景加载成功后，会记录当前主场景 key，并按 options 触发普通资源和场景级资源清理。

### 卸载场景

```csharp
await FRFM.Resource.UnloadSceneAsync(new ResourceKey("ScenePackage", "Assets/Game/Scenes/Battle.unity"));
```

### 查询场景

```csharp
bool loaded = FRFM.Resource.IsSceneLoaded(key);
int count = FRFM.Resource.GetLoadedSceneCount("ScenePackage");
```

## 清理策略

### 引用释放

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.ReleaseAssetReference(key);
```

兼容旧 API：

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.ReleaseReference(key);
```

### 卸载资源

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.UnloadAsset(key, force: false);
```

兼容旧 API：

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.UnLoadAsset(key);
```

### 按 package 清理

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.CleanupPackageAssets("BattlePackage", includeResident: false);
FRFM.Resource.ClearPackageGameObjectPool("BattlePackage");
```

### 策略清理

```csharp
ResourceCleanupResult result = FRFM.Resource.CleanupAssets(new ResourceCleanupOptions
{
    PackageName = "BattlePackage",
    Residency = ResourceResidency.Normal,
    MinUnusedSeconds = 30f,
    MaxRemoveCount = 20,
    IncludeResident = false,
    UnloadUnusedAssets = true,
    UnloadUnusedAssetsMinInterval = 5f
});
```

快捷方式：

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.CleanupLeastRecentlyUsed(20, "BattlePackage");
FRFM.Resource.CleanupUnusedOlderThan(30f, "BattlePackage");
```

### 常用清理 API

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.CleanupUnusedNormalAssets();
FRFM.Resource.CleanupSceneScopedAssets();
await FRFM.Resource.CleanUpAsync();
FRFM.Resource.CleanUp();
FRFM.Resource.ClearAllAssets();
FRFM.Resource.ClearAllScenes();
```

## 诊断与统计

### ResourceStatistics

```csharp
ResourceStatistics stats = FRFM.Resource.GetStatistics();
```

### ResourceDiagnostics

```csharp
ResourceDiagnosticSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.Resource.Diagnostics.CreateSnapshot();
string summary = FRFM.Resource.Diagnostics.DumpSummary();
string detail = FRFM.Resource.Diagnostics.DumpDetail();
```

诊断信息包括：

- 资源统计。
- Asset 快照。
- Scene 快照。
- Package 资源快照。
- warning 列表。

典型 warning：

- 已加载资源 handle 无效。
- 失败资源仍在缓存中。
- 资源所属 package 未初始化。
- GameObjectPool bucket 找不到对应资源 entry。

### Editor 诊断窗口

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Editor/Diagnostics/FRFrameRuntimeDiagnosticsWindow.cs`

菜单：`FRFrame/Diagnostics/Runtime Diagnostics`

可查看：

- Resource
- Packages
- GameObject Pools
- Object Pools
- Reference Pools
- Warnings

## 事件系统

文件：`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Resource/Events/ResourceEvents.cs`

旧事件：

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.Events.AssetLoaded += OnAssetLoaded;
FRFM.Resource.Events.AssetLoadFailed += OnAssetLoadFailed;
FRFM.Resource.Events.AssetReleased += OnAssetReleased;
FRFM.Resource.Events.SceneLoaded += OnSceneLoaded;
FRFM.Resource.Events.SceneUnloaded += OnSceneUnloaded;
```

V2 强类型事件：

```csharp
FRFM.Resource.Events.AssetLoadedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.AssetLoadFailedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.AssetReleasedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.SceneLoadedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.SceneUnloadedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.InstanceRecycledV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.PoolObjectCreatedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.PoolObjectReleasedV2 += args => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.PackageDownloadProgress += progress => { };
FRFM.Resource.Events.PackageDownloadFinished += result => { };
```

新业务优先订阅 V2 事件。

## 推荐工作流

### UI 界面资源

1. 创建 UI scope。
2. 使用 `ResourceKey` 加载 prefab、图集、音效。
3. 界面关闭时释放 scope。
4. 对频繁打开的 UI prefab 可使用 `WarmupGameObjectAsync`。

```csharp
ResourceScope scope = FRFM.Resource.CreateScope("UI.Inventory");
GameObject view = await scope.InstantiateAsync(new ResourceKey("UIPackage", "Assets/Game/UI/Inventory.prefab"));

// UI 关闭
scope.ReleaseAll();
FRFM.Resource.RecycleInstance(view);
```

### 战斗 package

1. 业务初始化阶段初始化 `BattlePackage`。
2. 下载缺失资源。
3. 战斗开始创建 `Battle` scope。
4. 加载角色、技能、特效、音效。
5. 战斗结束释放 scope，清理 `SceneScoped` 或 package 资源。

```csharp
ResourceScope battleScope = FRFM.Resource.CreateScope("Battle");
await battleScope.LoadAssetAsync<GameObject>(new ResourceKey("BattlePackage", "Assets/Game/Battle/Hero.prefab"));

battleScope.ReleaseAll();
FRFM.Resource.CleanupUnusedOlderThan(0f, "BattlePackage");
```

### 场景切换

1. 用 `LoadSceneAsync` 加载新主场景。
2. 设置 `CleanupNormalAssetsAfterLoad` 和 `CleanupSceneScopedAssetsAfterLoad`。
3. 对上一场景 package 执行 package 级清理。

## 使用规范

- 多 package 资源优先使用 `ResourceKey`。
- 默认包资源可以传 location，但长期建议也使用 `ResourceKey` 保持一致。
- 资源所有权明确的业务优先使用 `ResourceHandle<T>` 或 `ResourceScope`。
- 不要绕过 ResourceManager 直接持有 YooAsset handle，除非在 YooAsset 适配层内部。
- Prefab 实例回收优先使用 `RecycleInstance`，不要直接丢进 `GameObjectPool`。
- 常驻资源使用 `Resident`，不要依赖“永不释放引用”实现常驻。
- 同步加载应限于已预加载资源或调试场景。
- Package 初始化由业务模块负责，不要把所有 package 加入框架初始化流程。
- 清理 package 资源时同步考虑 GameObjectPool bucket。
- 订阅事件时优先使用 V2 强类型事件。

## 常见问题

### 资源加载到了错误 package

检查是否只传了 location。非默认包资源必须设置 `PackageName` 或使用 `ResourceKey`。

### 引用计数没有下降

检查是否忘记调用 `ResourceHandle.Release()`、`ResourceScope.ReleaseAll()` 或 `ReleaseAssetReference()`。

### Prefab 回收后资源仍未卸载

GameObjectPool 只管理实例复用。资源卸载仍由 ResourceManager 引用计数和清理策略决定。需要调用清理 API。

### 下载进度没有回调

确认 `DownloadPackageAsync` 创建的 downloader 不是 null，且 package manifest 已正确更新。

### 诊断窗口看到 GameObjectPool bucket 无 asset entry

通常表示池中还有实例缓存，但资源 entry 已被清理。可清理对应 package 的 GameObjectPool。
````

## File: Core/Runtime/BootstrapConfigLoader.cs
````csharp
using System.IO;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public static class BootstrapConfigLoader
    {
        public static string PersistentRoot => PathExtension.GetMainPackageBootstrapRootPath();
        public static string LegacyPersistentRoot => Path.Combine(PathExtension.GetPersistentDataPath(), BootstrapFileNames.DirectoryName);
        public static string PersistentManifestPath => Path.Combine(PersistentRoot, BootstrapFileNames.ManifestFile);

        public static async UniTask<string> LoadTextAsync(string fileName)
        {
            string persistentPath = Path.Combine(PersistentRoot, fileName);
            if (File.Exists(persistentPath))
            {
                return await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => File.ReadAllText(persistentPath));
            }

            string legacyBootstrapPath = Path.Combine(LegacyPersistentRoot, fileName);
            if (File.Exists(legacyBootstrapPath))
            {
                return await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => File.ReadAllText(legacyBootstrapPath));
            }

            string streamingPath = Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, BootstrapFileNames.DirectoryName, fileName);
            return await ReadStreamingAssetsTextAsync(streamingPath, true);
        }

        public static void SaveText(string fileName, string json)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(PersistentRoot);
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(PersistentRoot, fileName), json);
        }

        public static async UniTask<UIBootstrapConfig> LoadUIBootstrapAsync()
        {
            string json = await LoadTextAsync(BootstrapFileNames.UIBootstrapFile);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(json))
            {
                return null;
            }

            return JsonUtility.FromJson<UIBootstrapConfig>(json);
        }

        private static async UniTask<string> ReadStreamingAssetsTextAsync(string path, bool logMissing)
        {
#if UNITY_ANDROID && !UNITY_EDITOR
            using UnityWebRequest request = UnityWebRequest.Get(path);
            await request.SendWebRequest().ToUniTask();

            if (request.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                if (logMissing)
                {
                    FRLog.Error($"Read StreamingAssets failed : {path}, error : {request.error}");
                }
                return null;
            }

            return request.downloadHandler.text;
#elif UNITY_WEBGL && !UNITY_EDITOR
            using UnityWebRequest request = UnityWebRequest.Get(path);
            await request.SendWebRequest().ToUniTask();

            if (request.result != UnityWebRequest.Result.Success)
            {
                if (logMissing)
                {
                    FRLog.Error($"Read StreamingAssets failed : {path}, error : {request.error}");
                }
                return null;
            }

            return request.downloadHandler.text;
#else
            if (!File.Exists(path))
            {
                if (logMissing)
                {
                    FRLog.Error($"StreamingAssets file not found : {path}");
                }
                return null;
            }

            return await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => File.ReadAllText(path));
#endif
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Text;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class NewtonsoftJsonSaveSerializer : ISaveSerializer
    {
        private readonly JsonSerializerSettings _settings = new JsonSerializerSettings
        {
            Formatting = Formatting.Indented,
            TypeNameHandling = TypeNameHandling.None,
            ObjectCreationHandling = ObjectCreationHandling.Replace
        };

        public string FileExtension => ".json";

        public byte[] Serialize<T>(T value)
        {
            string json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(value, _settings);
            return Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json);
        }

        public T Deserialize<T>(byte[] bytes)
        {
            string json = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<T>(json, _settings);
        }

        public object Deserialize(byte[] bytes, Type type)
        {
            string json = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(bytes);
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(json, type, _settings);
        }
    }
}
````
