````csharp
using System;
using System.IO;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    internal sealed class SaveFileStorage
    {
        private const string RootFolderName = "FRFrameSave";
        private const string SlotMetaName = "SlotMeta";
        private readonly string _rootPath;
        private readonly ISaveSerializer _serializer;

        public SaveFileStorage(ISaveSerializer serializer)
        {
            _serializer = serializer;
            _rootPath = Path.Combine(Application.persistentDataPath, RootFolderName);
        }

        public string RootPath => _rootPath;

        public string GetPath(SaveKey key)
        {
            string fileName = Sanitize(key.DataName) + _serializer.FileExtension;
            switch (key.Domain)
            {
                case SaveDomain.GlobalSettings:
                    return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "GlobalSettings", fileName);
                case SaveDomain.User:
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.UserId))
                        return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Users", "Default", fileName);
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.PackageName))
                        return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Users", Sanitize(key.UserId), fileName);
                    return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Users", Sanitize(key.UserId), "Packages", Sanitize(key.PackageName), fileName);
                case SaveDomain.Slot:
                    return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Slots", Sanitize(key.UserId), Sanitize(key.PackageName), Sanitize(key.SlotId), fileName);
                case SaveDomain.Cache:
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.PackageName))
                        return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Cache", fileName);
                    return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Cache", Sanitize(key.PackageName), fileName);
                default:
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
            }
        }

        public string GetSlotDirectory(string packageName, string userId, string slotId)
        {
            return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Slots", Sanitize(userId), Sanitize(packageName), Sanitize(slotId));
        }

        public string GetSlotRootDirectory(string packageName, string userId)
        {
            return Path.Combine(_rootPath, "Slots", Sanitize(userId), Sanitize(packageName));
        }

        public SaveKey CreateSlotMetaKey(string packageName, string userId, string slotId)
        {
            return new SaveKey(SaveDomain.Slot, SlotMetaName, packageName, userId, slotId);
        }

        public UniTask WriteAsync(SaveKey key, byte[] bytes, bool backup)
        {
            return UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => Write(key, bytes, backup));
        }

        public void Write(SaveKey key, byte[] bytes, bool backup)
        {
            string path = GetPath(key);
            string directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(path);
            if (!Directory.Exists(directory))
                Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);

            string tempPath = path + ".tmp";
            string backupPath = path + ".bak";
            File.WriteAllBytes(tempPath, bytes);
            if (backup && File.Exists(path))
                File.Copy(path, backupPath, true);
            if (File.Exists(path))
                File.Delete(path);
            File.Move(tempPath, path);
            if (File.Exists(tempPath))
                File.Delete(tempPath);
        }

        public async UniTask<(bool success, byte[] bytes, bool fromBackup, string error)> ReadAsync(SaveKey key, bool allowBackup)
        {
            string path = GetPath(key);
            string backupPath = path + ".bak";
            try
            {
                if (!File.Exists(path))
                    return (false, null, false, "File not found");
                byte[] bytes = await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => File.ReadAllBytes(path));
                return (true, bytes, false, null);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                if (!allowBackup || !File.Exists(backupPath))
                    return (false, null, false, e.ToString());

                try
                {
                    byte[] bytes = await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => File.ReadAllBytes(backupPath));
                    return (true, bytes, true, null);
                }
                catch (Exception backupException)
                {
                    return (false, null, false, backupException.ToString());
                }
            }
        }

        public UniTask<bool> ExistsAsync(SaveKey key)
        {
            return UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => File.Exists(GetPath(key)));
        }

        public UniTask<bool> DeleteAsync(SaveKey key)
        {
            return UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() =>
            {
                string path = GetPath(key);
                string backupPath = path + ".bak";
                bool deleted = false;
                if (File.Exists(path))
                {
                    File.Delete(path);
                    deleted = true;
                }
                if (File.Exists(backupPath))
                    File.Delete(backupPath);
                return deleted;
            });
        }

        public UniTask DeleteDirectoryAsync(string path)
        {
            return UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() =>
            {
                if (Directory.Exists(path))
                    Directory.Delete(path, true);
            });
        }

        public UniTask CopyDirectoryAsync(string source, string target)
        {
            return UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() =>
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(source))
                    return;
                if (Directory.Exists(target))
                    Directory.Delete(target, true);
                CopyDirectory(source, target);
            });
        }

        private static void CopyDirectory(string source, string target)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(target);
            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(source))
                File.Copy(file, Path.Combine(target, Path.GetFileName(file)), true);
            foreach (string directory in Directory.GetDirectories(source))
                CopyDirectory(directory, Path.Combine(target, Path.GetFileName(directory)));
        }

        public static string Sanitize(string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
                return "Default";
            foreach (char invalid in Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
                value = value.Replace(invalid, '_');
            return value;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Save/Runtime/SaveKey.cs
````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public readonly struct SaveKey : IEquatable<SaveKey>
    {
        public readonly SaveDomain Domain;
        public readonly string PackageName;
        public readonly string UserId;
        public readonly string SlotId;
        public readonly string DataName;

        public SaveKey(SaveDomain domain, string dataName, string packageName = null, string userId = null, string slotId = null)
        {
            Domain = domain;
            PackageName = Normalize(packageName);
            UserId = Normalize(userId);
            SlotId = Normalize(slotId);
            DataName = Normalize(dataName);
        }

        public bool Equals(SaveKey other)
        {
            return Domain == other.Domain && PackageName == other.PackageName && UserId == other.UserId && SlotId == other.SlotId && DataName == other.DataName;
        }

        public override bool Equals(object obj)
        {
            return obj is SaveKey other && Equals(other);
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                int hashCode = (int)Domain;
                hashCode = (hashCode * 397) ^ PackageName.GetHashCode();
                hashCode = (hashCode * 397) ^ UserId.GetHashCode();
                hashCode = (hashCode * 397) ^ SlotId.GetHashCode();
                hashCode = (hashCode * 397) ^ DataName.GetHashCode();
                return hashCode;
            }
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return $"{Domain}/{PackageName}/{UserId}/{SlotId}/{DataName}";
        }

        public static bool operator ==(SaveKey left, SaveKey right)
        {
            return left.Equals(right);
        }

        public static bool operator !=(SaveKey left, SaveKey right)
        {
            return !left.Equals(right);
        }

        private static string Normalize(string value)
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? string.Empty : value;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Save/Runtime/SaveManager.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class SaveManager : IManagerBase
    {
        private sealed class SaveCacheEntry
        {
            public object Value;
            public Type ValueType;
            public bool Dirty;
        }

        private readonly Dictionary<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry> _cache = new Dictionary<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, SaveScope> _scopes = new Dictionary<string, SaveScope>();
        private ISaveSerializer _serializer;
        private SaveFileStorage _storage;
        private int _saveFailureCount;
        private int _loadFailureCount;
        private int _backupRestoreCount;

        public override int Priority => 30;
        public SaveEvents Events { get; } = new SaveEvents();
        public string RootPath => _storage?.RootPath;

        public override UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            _serializer = new NewtonsoftJsonSaveSerializer();
            _storage = new SaveFileStorage(_serializer);
            FRLog.Info("SaveManager initialized.");
            return UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        public override void Destroy()
        {
            foreach (SaveScope scope in new List<SaveScope>(_scopes.Values))
                scope.Dispose();
            _scopes.Clear();
            Flush();
            _cache.Clear();
            FRLog.Info("SaveManager destroyed.");
        }

        public SaveScope CreateScope(string name, SaveScopeOptions options = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
            {
                FRLog.Error("Create SaveScope failed, name is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            options ??= new SaveScopeOptions();
            if (_scopes.TryGetValue(name, out SaveScope existing))
            {
                if (existing.PackageName != (options.PackageName ?? string.Empty) || existing.UserId != (options.UserId ?? string.Empty) || existing.SlotId != (options.SlotId ?? string.Empty))
                    FRLog.Warning($"Create SaveScope got existing scope with different context. name:{name}");
                return existing;
            }

            SaveScope scope = new SaveScope(this, name, options);
            _scopes.Add(name, scope);
            return scope;
        }

        public async UniTask SaveAsync<T>(SaveKey key, T data, SaveWriteOptions options = null)
        {
            options ??= new SaveWriteOptions();
            if (!ValidateKey(key))
                return;

            Events.RaiseSaveStarted(key);
            try
            {
                byte[] bytes = _serializer.Serialize(data);
                await _storage.WriteAsync(key, bytes, options.Backup);
                if (!options.SkipCache)
                    SetCache(key, data, typeof(T), false);
                Events.RaiseSaveCompleted(key);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _saveFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Error($"SaveAsync failed : {key}, {e}");
                Events.RaiseSaveFailed(key, e.ToString());
            }
        }

        public async UniTask<SaveLoadResult<T>> LoadAsync<T>(SaveKey key, SaveLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            options ??= new SaveLoadOptions();
            if (!ValidateKey(key))
                return new SaveLoadResult<T>(false, default, error: "Invalid key");

            if (!options.IgnoreCache && _cache.TryGetValue(key, out SaveCacheEntry entry) && entry.Value is T cached)
                return new SaveLoadResult<T>(true, cached, true);

            Events.RaiseLoadStarted(key);
            try
            {
                var result = await _storage.ReadAsync(key, options.AllowBackup);
                if (!result.success)
                {
                    _loadFailureCount++;
                    Events.RaiseLoadFailed(key, result.error);
                    return new SaveLoadResult<T>(false, default, error: result.error);
                }

                T data = _serializer.Deserialize<T>(result.bytes);
                SetCache(key, data, typeof(T), false);
                if (result.fromBackup)
                    _backupRestoreCount++;
                Events.RaiseLoadCompleted(key);
                return new SaveLoadResult<T>(true, data, false, result.fromBackup);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _loadFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Error($"LoadAsync failed : {key}, {e}");
                Events.RaiseLoadFailed(key, e.ToString());
                return new SaveLoadResult<T>(false, default, error: e.ToString());
            }
        }

        public async UniTask<T> LoadOrDefaultAsync<T>(SaveKey key, T defaultValue = default, SaveLoadOptions options = null)
        {
            SaveLoadResult<T> result = await LoadAsync<T>(key, options);
            return result.Success ? result.Data : defaultValue;
        }

        public UniTask<bool> ExistsAsync(SaveKey key)
        {
            return _storage.ExistsAsync(key);
        }

        public async UniTask<bool> DeleteAsync(SaveKey key)
        {
            bool deleted = await _storage.DeleteAsync(key);
            if (_cache.Remove(key))
                Events.RaiseDirtyChanged(key, false);
            return deleted;
        }

        public UniTask SaveSettingAsync<T>(string name, T data)
        {
            return SaveAsync(new SaveKey(SaveDomain.GlobalSettings, name), data);
        }

        public UniTask<T> LoadSettingAsync<T>(string name, T defaultValue = default)
        {
            return LoadOrDefaultAsync(new SaveKey(SaveDomain.GlobalSettings, name), defaultValue);
        }

        public UniTask SaveUserAsync<T>(string userId, string name, T data, string packageName = null)
        {
            return SaveAsync(new SaveKey(SaveDomain.User, name, packageName, userId), data);
        }

        public UniTask<T> LoadUserAsync<T>(string userId, string name, T defaultValue = default, string packageName = null)
        {
            return LoadOrDefaultAsync(new SaveKey(SaveDomain.User, name, packageName, userId), defaultValue);
        }

        public void SetDirty<T>(SaveKey key, T data)
        {
            if (!ValidateKey(key))
                return;
            SetCache(key, data, typeof(T), true);
            Events.RaiseDirtyChanged(key, true);
        }

        public async UniTask FlushAsync()
        {
            List<KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry>> dirtyEntries = CollectDirtyEntries();
            for (int i = 0; i < dirtyEntries.Count; i++)
            {
                SaveKey key = dirtyEntries[i].Key;
                SaveCacheEntry entry = dirtyEntries[i].Value;
                bool success = await SaveObjectAsync(key, entry.Value, entry.ValueType);
                if (success)
                {
                    entry.Dirty = false;
                    Events.RaiseDirtyChanged(key, false);
                }
            }
        }

        public void Flush()
        {
            List<KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry>> dirtyEntries = CollectDirtyEntries();
            for (int i = 0; i < dirtyEntries.Count; i++)
            {
                SaveKey key = dirtyEntries[i].Key;
                SaveCacheEntry entry = dirtyEntries[i].Value;
                bool success = SaveObject(key, entry.Value, entry.ValueType);
                if (success)
                {
                    entry.Dirty = false;
                    Events.RaiseDirtyChanged(key, false);
                }
            }
        }

        public async UniTask<SaveSlotInfo> CreateSlotAsync(string packageName, string userId, string displayName = null)
        {
            string slotId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
            DateTime now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            SaveSlotInfo slot = new SaveSlotInfo
            {
                SlotId = slotId,
                DisplayName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayName) ? slotId : displayName,
                PackageName = packageName ?? string.Empty,
                UserId = userId ?? string.Empty,
                AppVersion = Application.version,
                DataVersion = 1,
                CreateTime = now,
                UpdateTime = now
            };

            await SaveSlotMetaAsync(slot);
            Events.RaiseSlotCreated(slot);
            return slot;
        }

        public async UniTask<IReadOnlyList<SaveSlotInfo>> GetSlotsAsync(string packageName, string userId)
        {
            List<SaveSlotInfo> result = new List<SaveSlotInfo>();
            string root = _storage.GetSlotRootDirectory(packageName, userId);
            if (!Directory.Exists(root))
                return result;

            string[] directories = await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => Directory.GetDirectories(root));
            for (int i = 0; i < directories.Length; i++)
            {
                string slotId = Path.GetFileName(directories[i]);
                SaveKey key = _storage.CreateSlotMetaKey(packageName, userId, slotId);
                SaveLoadResult<SaveSlotInfo> loaded = await LoadAsync<SaveSlotInfo>(key);
                if (loaded.Success && loaded.Data != null)
                    result.Add(loaded.Data);
            }

            result.Sort((left, right) => right.UpdateTime.CompareTo(left.UpdateTime));
            return result;
        }

        public async UniTask<bool> DeleteSlotAsync(string packageName, string userId, string slotId)
        {
            SaveKey metaKey = _storage.CreateSlotMetaKey(packageName, userId, slotId);
            SaveSlotInfo slot = await LoadOrDefaultAsync<SaveSlotInfo>(metaKey);
            string directory = _storage.GetSlotDirectory(packageName, userId, slotId);
            await _storage.DeleteDirectoryAsync(directory);
            RemoveCacheForSlot(packageName, userId, slotId);
            if (slot != null)
                Events.RaiseSlotDeleted(slot);
            return slot != null;
        }

        public async UniTask<bool> CopySlotAsync(string packageName, string userId, string sourceSlotId, string targetSlotId)
        {
            string source = _storage.GetSlotDirectory(packageName, userId, sourceSlotId);
            if (!Directory.Exists(source))
                return false;

            string target = _storage.GetSlotDirectory(packageName, userId, targetSlotId);
            await _storage.CopyDirectoryAsync(source, target);

            SaveKey targetMetaKey = _storage.CreateSlotMetaKey(packageName, userId, targetSlotId);
            SaveSlotInfo meta = await LoadOrDefaultAsync<SaveSlotInfo>(targetMetaKey, null, new SaveLoadOptions { IgnoreCache = true });
            if (meta != null)
            {
                meta.SlotId = targetSlotId;
                meta.UpdateTime = DateTime.UtcNow;
                await SaveSlotMetaAsync(meta);
            }
            return true;
        }

        public SaveDiagnosticsSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            SaveDiagnosticsSnapshot snapshot = new SaveDiagnosticsSnapshot
            {
                RootPath = RootPath,
                CacheCount = _cache.Count,
                SaveFailureCount = _saveFailureCount,
                LoadFailureCount = _loadFailureCount,
                BackupRestoreCount = _backupRestoreCount
            };

            foreach (KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry> pair in _cache)
            {
                if (!pair.Value.Dirty)
                    continue;
                snapshot.DirtyCount++;
                snapshot.DirtyItems.Add(new SaveDirtySnapshot
                {
                    Key = pair.Key,
                    TypeName = pair.Value.ValueType?.FullName ?? string.Empty
                });
            }
            return snapshot;
        }

        internal void RemoveScope(SaveScope scope)
        {
            if (scope != null && _scopes.TryGetValue(scope.Name, out SaveScope existing) && existing == scope)
                _scopes.Remove(scope.Name);
        }

        private async UniTask<bool> SaveObjectAsync(SaveKey key, object value, Type type)
        {
            Events.RaiseSaveStarted(key);
            try
            {
                byte[] bytes = SerializeObject(value, type);
                await _storage.WriteAsync(key, bytes, true);
                Events.RaiseSaveCompleted(key);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _saveFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Error($"SaveObjectAsync failed : {key}, {e}");
                Events.RaiseSaveFailed(key, e.ToString());
                return false;
            }
        }

        private bool SaveObject(SaveKey key, object value, Type type)
        {
            Events.RaiseSaveStarted(key);
            try
            {
                byte[] bytes = SerializeObject(value, type);
                _storage.Write(key, bytes, true);
                Events.RaiseSaveCompleted(key);
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                _saveFailureCount++;
                FRLog.Error($"SaveObject failed : {key}, {e}");
                Events.RaiseSaveFailed(key, e.ToString());
                return false;
            }
        }

        private byte[] SerializeObject(object value, Type type)
        {
            return _serializer.Serialize(value);
        }

        private List<KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry>> CollectDirtyEntries()
        {
            List<KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry>> dirtyEntries = new List<KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry>>();
            foreach (KeyValuePair<SaveKey, SaveCacheEntry> pair in _cache)
            {
                if (pair.Value.Dirty)
                    dirtyEntries.Add(pair);
            }
            return dirtyEntries;
        }

        private UniTask SaveSlotMetaAsync(SaveSlotInfo slot)
        {
            SaveKey key = _storage.CreateSlotMetaKey(slot.PackageName, slot.UserId, slot.SlotId);
            return SaveAsync(key, slot);
        }

        private void SetCache(SaveKey key, object value, Type valueType, bool dirty)
        {
            _cache[key] = new SaveCacheEntry
            {
                Value = value,
                ValueType = valueType,
                Dirty = dirty
            };
        }

        private void RemoveCacheForSlot(string packageName, string userId, string slotId)
        {
            List<SaveKey> removeKeys = new List<SaveKey>();
            foreach (SaveKey key in _cache.Keys)
            {
                if (key.Domain == SaveDomain.Slot && key.PackageName == (packageName ?? string.Empty) && key.UserId == (userId ?? string.Empty) && key.SlotId == (slotId ?? string.Empty))
                    removeKeys.Add(key);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < removeKeys.Count; i++)
                _cache.Remove(removeKeys[i]);
        }

        private bool ValidateKey(SaveKey key)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.DataName))
            {
                FRLog.Error("Save key data name is null or empty.");
                return false;
            }

            if (key.Domain == SaveDomain.Slot && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.PackageName) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.UserId) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.SlotId)))
            {
                FRLog.Error($"Slot save key needs packageName, userId and slotId : {key}");
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Save/Runtime/SaveScope.cs
````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class SaveScope : System.IDisposable
    {
        private readonly SaveManager _manager;
        private readonly SaveDomain _defaultDomain;

        internal SaveScope(SaveManager manager, string name, SaveScopeOptions options)
        {
            _manager = manager;
            Name = name;
            PackageName = options.PackageName ?? string.Empty;
            UserId = options.UserId ?? string.Empty;
            SlotId = options.SlotId ?? string.Empty;
            _defaultDomain = options.DefaultDomain;
        }

        public string Name { get; }
        public string PackageName { get; }
        public string UserId { get; }
        public string SlotId { get; }
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

        public UniTask SaveAsync<T>(string dataName, T data, SaveDomain? domain = null)
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"SaveScope is disposed : {Name}");
                return UniTask.CompletedTask;
            }
            return _manager.SaveAsync(CreateKey(dataName, domain), data);
        }

        public UniTask<T> LoadAsync<T>(string dataName, T defaultValue = default, SaveDomain? domain = null)
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"SaveScope is disposed : {Name}");
                return UniTask.FromResult(defaultValue);
            }
            return _manager.LoadOrDefaultAsync(CreateKey(dataName, domain), defaultValue);
        }

        public void SetDirty<T>(string dataName, T data, SaveDomain? domain = null)
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"SaveScope is disposed : {Name}");
                return;
            }
            _manager.SetDirty(CreateKey(dataName, domain), data);
        }

        public UniTask FlushAsync()
        {
            return _manager.FlushAsync();
        }

        public UniTask<bool> DeleteAsync(string dataName, SaveDomain? domain = null)
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"SaveScope is disposed : {Name}");
                return UniTask.FromResult(false);
            }
            return _manager.DeleteAsync(CreateKey(dataName, domain));
        }

        public SaveKey CreateKey(string dataName, SaveDomain? domain = null)
        {
            SaveDomain targetDomain = domain ?? _defaultDomain;
            return new SaveKey(targetDomain, dataName, PackageName, UserId, SlotId);
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed)
                return;
            IsDisposed = true;
            _manager.RemoveScope(this);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Save/SaveModule_Design.md
````markdown
# Save 模块初步设计

## 设计目标

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/Save` 作为 FRFrame 的统一存档模块，目标是管理游戏运行期需要持久化到本地的数据，包括设置、游戏进度、玩家数据、子游戏数据、临时缓存和存档槽信息。

你理解的方向是对的：一个完善的 Unity 存档模块通常不只保存“游戏进度”，也会保存：

- 全局设置：音量、画质、语言、帧率、按键配置、隐私授权等。
- 用户数据：账号维度的本地缓存、最近登录角色、引导状态、设备偏好。
- 存档槽：单机或局内进度，例如关卡进度、背包、角色属性、任务状态、地图探索。
- 子游戏数据：当前工程是多 package / 多子游戏结构，每个子游戏可以有自己的存档命名空间。
- 运行缓存：可删除、可重建的本地缓存，例如最近一次下载状态、调试开关。

但这些数据不应该全部混在一个文件或一个 API 里。Save 模块需要明确“存储域”和“生命周期”。

## 参考框架调研结论

### JKFrame SaveSystem

JKFrame 有相对完整的存档系统，主要能力：

- 有 `SaveItem` 概念，表示一个存档槽。
- 支持创建、删除、获取所有存档槽。
- 区分 `saveData` 和 `setting` 两类目录。
- 存档槽内可按文件名保存多个对象。
- 支持缓存已加载对象。
- 支持 Json 或 Binary 序列化。
- 存档系统数据中记录当前 id、存档列表和最后保存时间。

可借鉴点：

- 存档槽 `SaveSlot` / `SaveItem` 设计。
- 全局设置与游戏存档分目录。
- 一个存档槽内按数据块保存多个对象，而不是所有数据塞进一个大文件。
- 保存元数据，例如创建时间、更新时间、显示名、版本。
- 缓存已加载数据，减少频繁 IO。

需要调整点：

- JKFrame 是静态系统，FRFrame 应做成 `SaveManager : IManagerBase`。
- JKFrame 同步 IO 较多，FRFrame 应优先提供 `UniTask` 异步 API。
- BinaryFormatter 风格不适合作为默认方案，FRFrame 应默认 JSON，可选二进制。
- 需要考虑多 package / 子游戏命名空间。

### XHFramework SettingManager

XHFramework 的 `SettingManager` 偏向 PlayerPrefs 设置管理：

- 支持 bool / int / float / string。
- 支持 object 序列化到 string。
- 关闭时 `PlayerPrefs.Save()`。

可借鉴点：

- 轻量设置适合走 Key-Value。
- 全局设置和大型存档文件应分开。

问题：

- 它更像 Setting 模块，不是完整 Save 模块。
- `GetObject<T>` 实现里疑似直接反序列化 settingName，而不是从 PlayerPrefs 读出的字符串，这类设计不能照搬。

### TEngine / I2 PersistentStorage

TEngine 主要提供 PlayerPrefs 增强和文件工具，I2 Localization 的 PersistentStorage 提供 PlayerPrefs 和文件存取抽象。

可借鉴点：

- PlayerPrefs 可用于小型设置。
- 大数据应存文件。
- 文件路径应统一落在 `Application.persistentDataPath`。
- PlayerPrefs 字符串过大时可能遇到平台限制，不适合大型存档。

## 设计边界

Save 模块负责：

- 本地持久化路径管理。
- 全局设置读写。
- 用户级数据读写。
- 存档槽创建、删除、复制、查询。
- 存档槽内数据块读写。
- 序列化、反序列化、版本、迁移入口。
- 缓存、脏标记、自动保存、备份和诊断。

Save 模块不负责：

- 云存档同步。
- 账号登录和用户身份认证。
- 游戏配置表读取，配置表仍属于 Luban / Config 体系。
- 资源加载，资源仍由 Resource 模块负责。
- 业务数据结构定义，例如背包、任务、角色属性由业务模块提供。

后续可以扩展云存档适配层，但 Core 模块首版应先把本地存档做好。

## 核心概念

### SaveDomain

存储域决定数据的生命周期和路径。

```csharp
public enum SaveDomain
{
    GlobalSettings,
    User,
    Slot,
    Cache
}
```

语义：

- `GlobalSettings`：不依赖用户和存档槽，例如音量、语言、画质。
- `User`：依赖当前用户，但不依赖具体存档槽，例如账号本地偏好、已读公告、本地引导记录。
- `Slot`：具体存档槽数据，例如进度、背包、任务、关卡。
- `Cache`：可删除、可重建，不保证长期稳定。

### SaveScope

类似 ResourceScope / AudioScope，用于绑定一组默认上下文。

你的项目是多子游戏结构，因此 Save 模块也建议提供 Scope：

```csharp
using var saveScope = FRFM.Save.CreateScope("Battle", new SaveScopeOptions
{
    PackageName = "BattlePackage",
    UserId = "user_001",
    SlotId = "slot_001"
});

await saveScope.SaveAsync("PlayerProgress", progressData);
PlayerProgress data = await saveScope.LoadAsync<PlayerProgress>("PlayerProgress");
```

Scope 负责默认：

- 子游戏 / package 名。
- 用户 id。
- 存档槽 id。
- 存储域。
- 缓存和脏标记。

这样业务不需要每次都传 userId、slotId、packageName。

### SaveKey

底层唯一标识建议结构化，而不是简单字符串拼接。

```csharp
public readonly struct SaveKey
{
    public SaveDomain Domain { get; }
    public string PackageName { get; }
    public string UserId { get; }
    public string SlotId { get; }
    public string DataName { get; }
}
```

示例：

```text
GlobalSettings / AudioSettings
User / user_001 / GuideState
Slot / BattlePackage / user_001 / slot_001 / PlayerProgress
Cache / BattlePackage / DownloadState
```

### SaveSlot

存档槽元数据。

```csharp
public sealed class SaveSlotInfo
{
    public string SlotId;
    public string DisplayName;
    public string PackageName;
    public string UserId;
    public string AppVersion;
    public int DataVersion;
    public DateTime CreateTime;
    public DateTime UpdateTime;
    public string PreviewImagePath;
    public Dictionary<string, string> Tags;
}
```

用途：

- 存档列表显示。
- 排序。
- 判断版本兼容。
- 复制、删除、备份。
- 存档封面图或简略状态展示。

## 推荐目录结构

建议所有数据都在：

```text
Application.persistentDataPath/FRFrameSave
```

内部结构：

```text
FRFrameSave
├── GlobalSettings
│   ├── AudioSettings.json
│   ├── GraphicsSettings.json
│   └── InputSettings.json
├── Users
│   └── user_001
│       ├── UserProfile.json
│       ├── GuideState.json
│       └── Packages
│           └── BattlePackage
│               └── UserBattleState.json
├── Slots
│   └── user_001
│       └── BattlePackage
│           ├── slot_001
│           │   ├── SlotMeta.json
│           │   ├── PlayerProgress.json
│           │   ├── Inventory.json
│           │   ├── QuestState.json
│           │   └── WorldState.json
│           └── slot_002
└── Cache
    └── BattlePackage
        └── DownloadState.json
```

这种结构适合多 package / 子游戏：每个子游戏的数据天然隔离，但公共设置和用户数据仍可共享。

## 序列化策略

首版推荐默认 JSON。

原因：

- 可读，便于开发期排查。
- 适合框架调试和版本迁移。
- 对游戏进度、设置、玩家数据都足够通用。

建议抽象接口：

```csharp
public interface ISaveSerializer
{
    string FileExtension { get; }
    byte[] Serialize<T>(T value);
    T Deserialize<T>(byte[] bytes);
}
```

默认实现：

- `JsonSaveSerializer`：默认。
- 后续可扩展 `BinarySaveSerializer`。
- 后续可扩展 `EncryptedSaveSerializer` 或包装层。

注意：Unity `JsonUtility` 对 Dictionary、多态、复杂结构支持弱。若工程已有 Newtonsoft.Json，建议默认用 Newtonsoft.Json；如果不想引入依赖，首版可以提供接口并先使用 JsonUtility，但要在文档里说明限制。

## 写入策略

### 原子写入

存档文件不能直接覆盖写入，避免写到一半崩溃导致主存档损坏。

推荐流程：

```text
Serialize data
    ↓
写入 xxx.tmp
    ↓
如果 xxx 存在，复制为 xxx.bak
    ↓
用 tmp 替换正式文件
    ↓
删除 tmp
```

读取时：

```text
优先读取正式文件
    ↓
失败则读取 .bak
    ↓
仍失败则返回默认值或失败结果
```

### 脏标记与自动保存

对于频繁变化的数据，不建议每次变化都立刻写磁盘。

设计：

```csharp
saveScope.SetDirty("PlayerProgress", progressData);
await saveScope.FlushAsync();
```

自动保存策略：

- 间隔 N 秒自动 Flush。
- 应用切后台时 Flush。
- 游戏退出或模块 Destroy 时 Flush。
- 关键节点手动 Flush，例如通关、获得重要道具、充值结果落地。

## API 设计草案

### SaveManager

```csharp
public sealed class SaveManager : IManagerBase
{
    public override int Priority => 30;

    public SaveScope CreateScope(string name, SaveScopeOptions options = null);

    public UniTask SaveAsync<T>(SaveKey key, T data, SaveWriteOptions options = null);
    public UniTask<SaveLoadResult<T>> LoadAsync<T>(SaveKey key, SaveLoadOptions options = null);
    public UniTask<bool> ExistsAsync(SaveKey key);
    public UniTask<bool> DeleteAsync(SaveKey key);

    public UniTask SaveSettingAsync<T>(string name, T data);
    public UniTask<T> LoadSettingAsync<T>(string name, T defaultValue = default);

    public UniTask<SaveSlotInfo> CreateSlotAsync(string packageName, string userId, string displayName = null);
    public UniTask<IReadOnlyList<SaveSlotInfo>> GetSlotsAsync(string packageName, string userId);
    public UniTask<bool> DeleteSlotAsync(string packageName, string userId, string slotId);
    public UniTask<bool> CopySlotAsync(string packageName, string userId, string sourceSlotId, string targetSlotId);
}
```

Priority 建议为 30：

- 不强依赖 Resource。
- 但通常希望 Log、Event、Pool、Fsm、Resource、Audio、UI 都可以先初始化。
- UI 设置界面可能使用 Save，实际可在 UI 初始化后调用。

如果后续 UI 初始化时需要读取设置，也可以把 Save 提前到 12 或 15。首版文档建议讨论后再定。

### SaveScope

```csharp
public sealed class SaveScope : IDisposable
{
    public string Name { get; }
    public string PackageName { get; }
    public string UserId { get; }
    public string SlotId { get; }

    public UniTask SaveAsync<T>(string dataName, T data, SaveDomain domain = SaveDomain.Slot);
    public UniTask<T> LoadAsync<T>(string dataName, T defaultValue = default, SaveDomain domain = SaveDomain.Slot);
    public void SetDirty<T>(string dataName, T data, SaveDomain domain = SaveDomain.Slot);
    public UniTask FlushAsync();
    public UniTask<bool> DeleteAsync(string dataName, SaveDomain domain = SaveDomain.Slot);
    public void Dispose();
}
```

### 设置快捷 API

轻量设置可以提供便捷 API：

```csharp
FRFM.Save.SetInt("FrameRate", 60);
FRFM.Save.GetInt("FrameRate", 60);
FRFM.Save.SetFloat("MusicVolume", 0.8f);
FRFM.Save.GetFloat("MusicVolume", 1f);
FRFM.Save.SetBool("Vibration", true);
FRFM.Save.GetBool("Vibration", true);
FRFM.Save.SavePrefs();
```

但建议内部仍统一走 Save 模块命名空间，避免直接散落 PlayerPrefs key。

## 典型使用场景

### 保存全局设置

```csharp
await FRFM.Save.SaveSettingAsync("AudioSettings", new AudioSettingsData
{
    MasterVolume = 0.8f,
    MusicVolume = 0.6f,
    UISoundVolume = 1f
});
```

### 加载全局设置

```csharp
AudioSettingsData settings = await FRFM.Save.LoadSettingAsync(
    "AudioSettings",
    AudioSettingsData.Default);
```

### 创建子游戏存档槽

```csharp
SaveSlotInfo slot = await FRFM.Save.CreateSlotAsync("BattlePackage", userId, "第一章");
```

### 使用 Scope 保存游戏进度

```csharp
using var scope = FRFM.Save.CreateScope("Battle", new SaveScopeOptions
{
    PackageName = "BattlePackage",
    UserId = userId,
    SlotId = slot.SlotId
});

await scope.SaveAsync("PlayerProgress", progress);
await scope.SaveAsync("Inventory", inventory);
```

### 读取进度

```csharp
PlayerProgress progress = await scope.LoadAsync("PlayerProgress", PlayerProgress.CreateDefault());
```

### 脏标记批量保存

```csharp
scope.SetDirty("PlayerProgress", progress);
scope.SetDirty("QuestState", questState);
await scope.FlushAsync();
```

## 数据版本与迁移

存档模块需要考虑版本升级。

建议每个数据块可选实现：

```csharp
public interface ISaveVersionedData
{
    int Version { get; }
}
```

模块级迁移接口：

```csharp
public interface ISaveMigration
{
    string DataName { get; }
    int FromVersion { get; }
    int ToVersion { get; }
    object Migrate(object oldData);
}
```

首版可以只保留迁移入口，不急着实现复杂迁移链。至少 `SaveSlotInfo` 要记录整体 `DataVersion` 和 `AppVersion`。

## 安全与防篡改

存档是否需要加密取决于项目类型。

建议分层：

1. 首版默认 JSON 明文，便于开发。
2. 提供可插拔 `ISaveProcessor`：压缩、加密、校验。
3. 需要防篡改时加入 hash / HMAC。
4. 不把密钥硬编码成“安全保证”，客户端本地密钥只能提高篡改成本，不能绝对防破解。

可选接口：

```csharp
public interface ISaveProcessor
{
    byte[] BeforeWrite(SaveKey key, byte[] bytes);
    byte[] AfterRead(SaveKey key, byte[] bytes);
}
```

## 缓存策略

建议 `SaveManager` 内部维护缓存：

```text
SaveKey -> object
SaveKey -> dirty state
SaveKey -> last load/write time
```

规则：

- `LoadAsync` 命中缓存直接返回。
- `SaveAsync` 写磁盘成功后更新缓存。
- `SetDirty` 只更新缓存和 dirty 标记。
- `FlushAsync` 批量写 dirty 数据。
- 删除数据时同步移除缓存。

## 事件与诊断

### 事件

建议提供：

- `SaveStarted`
- `SaveCompleted`
- `SaveFailed`
- `LoadStarted`
- `LoadCompleted`
- `LoadFailed`
- `SlotCreated`
- `SlotDeleted`
- `DirtyChanged`

首版可先用 C# event，后续需要跨模块广播再接 `FRFM.Event`。

### 诊断快照

`SaveDiagnosticsSnapshot` 建议包含：

- 根目录路径。
- 当前用户 id。
- 存档槽数量。
- 缓存数量。
- dirty 数量。
- 最近保存 / 加载记录。
- 写入失败次数。
- 备份恢复次数。
- 各 domain 占用空间。

Editor 窗口后续可提供：

- 打开存档目录。
- 查看存档槽列表。
- 查看 dirty 数据。
- 手动 Flush。
- 删除 Cache。
- 导出指定 Slot。

## 与其它模块关系

### Audio

Audio 设置可保存到 `GlobalSettings/AudioSettings`，例如音量、静音状态。

### UI

设置界面可以读写 Save 模块。UI 打开时不应直接读写 PlayerPrefs。

### Resource

Save 模块不保存资源对象，只保存资源引用信息，例如 itemId、resourceLocation、packageName。资源实际加载仍由 Resource 模块处理。

### Event

存档完成、加载失败、槽位变化可通过事件通知 UI 或业务系统。

### Log

所有读写失败、备份恢复、迁移失败应通过 `FRLog` 输出。

## 初步结论

FRFrame Save 模块建议采用：

```text
SaveManager + SaveScope + SaveKey + SaveSlotInfo + Serializer + Atomic File Storage
```

总体设计建议：

- 全局设置、用户数据、存档槽数据、缓存数据分 domain。
- 多子游戏数据通过 `PackageName` 隔离。
- 业务优先使用 `SaveScope`，像 AudioScope 一样减少重复传参。
- 存档槽内按数据块保存，而不是所有业务数据塞进一个大文件。
- 默认 JSON + 原子写入 + bak 备份。
- 提供缓存和 dirty/Flush，避免频繁 IO。
- 首版先做本地存档，不急着做云同步。

这套结构可以覆盖设置、游戏进度、玩家数据，也能适配你当前“一个子游戏一个 package”的整体设计。
````

## File: Core/Save/SaveModule_Guide.md
````markdown
# Save 模块使用指南

## 模块入口

Save 模块通过 `FRFM.Save` 使用：

```csharp
await FRFM.Save.SaveSettingAsync("AudioSettings", audioSettings);
AudioSettingsData settings = await FRFM.Save.LoadSettingAsync("AudioSettings", AudioSettingsData.Default);
```

模块默认把数据写入：

```text
Application.persistentDataPath/FRFrameSave
```

默认序列化器为 Newtonsoft.Json，文件格式为可读 JSON。

## 推荐用法：SaveScope

当前工程偏向“一个子游戏一个 package”，业务内推荐创建 `SaveScope`，避免每次传 `packageName`、`userId`、`slotId`：

```csharp
SaveSlotInfo slot = await FRFM.Save.CreateSlotAsync("BattlePackage", userId, "第一章");

using SaveScope saveScope = FRFM.Save.CreateScope("Battle", new SaveScopeOptions
{
    PackageName = "BattlePackage",
    UserId = userId,
    SlotId = slot.SlotId
});

await saveScope.SaveAsync("PlayerProgress", progress);
PlayerProgress loaded = await saveScope.LoadAsync("PlayerProgress", PlayerProgress.CreateDefault());
```

Scope 默认写入 `SaveDomain.Slot`，适合关卡进度、背包、任务、地图探索等存档槽数据。

## 全局设置

全局设置不绑定用户和存档槽：

```csharp
await FRFM.Save.SaveSettingAsync("GraphicsSettings", graphicsSettings);
GraphicsSettingsData data = await FRFM.Save.LoadSettingAsync("GraphicsSettings", GraphicsSettingsData.Default);
```

适合音量、语言、画质、帧率、输入配置等。

## 用户数据

用户数据绑定用户，但不绑定具体存档槽：

```csharp
await FRFM.Save.SaveUserAsync(userId, "GuideState", guideState);
GuideState state = await FRFM.Save.LoadUserAsync(userId, "GuideState", GuideState.Default);
```

如果用户数据只属于某个子游戏，可以传 package：

```csharp
await FRFM.Save.SaveUserAsync(userId, "UserBattleState", state, "BattlePackage");
```

## 脏标记和批量保存

频繁变化的数据不要每帧写磁盘，先标记 dirty，再在关键节点 Flush：

```csharp
saveScope.SetDirty("PlayerProgress", progress);
saveScope.SetDirty("QuestState", questState);
await saveScope.FlushAsync();
```

`FlushAsync` 会把所有 dirty 数据批量写入磁盘，并清理 dirty 状态。

## 存档槽

创建、查询、删除、复制存档槽：

```csharp
SaveSlotInfo slot = await FRFM.Save.CreateSlotAsync("BattlePackage", userId, "第一章");
IReadOnlyList<SaveSlotInfo> slots = await FRFM.Save.GetSlotsAsync("BattlePackage", userId);
await FRFM.Save.CopySlotAsync("BattlePackage", userId, slot.SlotId, "backup_slot");
await FRFM.Save.DeleteSlotAsync("BattlePackage", userId, slot.SlotId);
```

每个槽位会保存 `SlotMeta.json`，包含显示名、用户、package、创建时间、更新时间、版本和标签。

## 存储域

`SaveDomain` 决定路径和生命周期：

```csharp
public enum SaveDomain
{
    GlobalSettings,
    User,
    Slot,
    Cache
}
```

Scope 中可临时指定 domain：

```csharp
await saveScope.SaveAsync("DownloadState", downloadState, SaveDomain.Cache);
```

## 直接使用 SaveKey

框架底层 API 使用结构化 `SaveKey`：

```csharp
SaveKey key = new SaveKey(
    SaveDomain.Slot,
    "Inventory",
    packageName: "BattlePackage",
    userId: userId,
    slotId: slotId);

await FRFM.Save.SaveAsync(key, inventory);
SaveLoadResult<InventoryData> result = await FRFM.Save.LoadAsync<InventoryData>(key);
```

`SaveLoadResult<T>` 会返回是否成功、是否来自缓存、是否来自 `.bak` 备份以及错误信息。

## 原子写入和备份

Save 模块写入流程为：

```text
serialize -> 写入 .tmp -> 备份旧文件为 .bak -> 替换正式文件
```

读取正式文件失败时允许回退 `.bak`。默认 `SaveLoadOptions.AllowBackup = true`。

## 诊断

运行时可获取诊断快照：

```csharp
SaveDiagnosticsSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.Save.CreateSnapshot();
Debug.Log(snapshot.RootPath);
Debug.Log(snapshot.DirtyCount);
```

Editor 菜单提供诊断窗口：

```text
FRFrame/Diagnostics/Save Diagnostics
```

窗口可查看根目录、缓存数量、dirty 数量、失败次数，并支持手动 Flush。
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// 示例：角色配置表。
/// 
/// Excel 字段名需要和这里的 public 字段名一致。
/// </summary>
[Serializable]
public class CharacterConfig : IConfigRow
{
    public int id;
    public string name;
    public string rarity;
    public int hp;
    public int atk;
    public string avatarAddress;

    public int GetId()
    {
        return id;
    }

    public void Validate(ConfigValidateContext context)
    {
        if (id <= 0)
        {
            context.Error("角色 id 必须大于 0");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(name))
        {
            context.Error(string.Format("角色 {0} 的 name 为空", id));
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rarity))
        {
            context.Error(string.Format("角色 {0} 的 rarity 为空", id));
        }

        if (hp <= 0)
        {
            context.Error(string.Format("角色 {0} 的 hp 必须大于 0", id));
        }

        if (atk < 0)
        {
            context.Error(string.Format("角色 {0} 的 atk 不能小于 0", id));
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(avatarAddress))
        {
            context.Warning(string.Format("角色 {0} 的 avatarAddress 为空", id));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

/// <summary>
/// 所有配置行建议实现这个接口。
/// 
/// 好处：
/// 1. 可以统一获取 id
/// 2. 可以统一做基础校验
/// 3. 每张表可以写自己的 Validate 逻辑
/// </summary>
public interface IConfigRow
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 返回配置 id。
    /// 一般每张配置表都应该有唯一 id。
    /// </summary>
    int GetId();

    /// <summary>
    /// 自定义校验逻辑。
    /// 例如：名字不能为空、数值不能小于 0、资源地址不能为空等。
    /// </summary>
    void Validate(ConfigValidateContext context);
}

/// <summary>
/// 配置校验上下文。
/// 用于收集错误和警告。
/// </summary>
public class ConfigValidateContext
{
    public string TableName { get; private set; }

    private readonly List<string> _errors = new List<string>();
    private readonly List<string> _warnings = new List<string>();

    public bool HasError
    {
        get { return _errors.Count > 0; }
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<string> Errors
    {
        get { return _errors; }
    }

    public IReadOnlyList<string> Warnings
    {
        get { return _warnings; }
    }

    public ConfigValidateContext(string tableName)
    {
        TableName = tableName;
    }

    public void Error(string message)
    {
        string fullMessage = string.Format("[{0}] {1}", TableName, message);
        _errors.Add(fullMessage);
        Debug.LogError(fullMessage);
    }

    public void Warning(string message)
    {
        string fullMessage = string.Format("[{0}] {1}", TableName, message);
        _warnings.Add(fullMessage);
        Debug.LogWarning(fullMessage);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public static class ObjectExtension
    {
        private static readonly List<Transform> s_CachedTransform = new List<Transform>();

        public static T GetOrAddComponent<T>(this Component obj) where T : Component
        {
            return obj.gameObject.GetOrAddComponent<T>();
        }
        
        public static T GetOrAddComponent<T>(this GameObject gameObject) where T : Component
        {
            T obj = gameObject.GetComponent<T>();
            if (obj == null)
            {
                obj = gameObject.AddComponent<T>();
            }
            return obj;
        }

        public static Component GetOrAddComponent(this Component obj, Type componentType)
        {
            return obj.gameObject.GetOrAddComponent(componentType);
        }
        
        public static Component GetOrAddComponent(this GameObject gameObject, Type componentType)
        {
            if (gameObject == null) return null;
            Component component = gameObject.GetComponent(componentType);
            if (component == null)
            {
                component = gameObject.AddComponent(componentType);
            }
            return component;
        }

        public static void SetLayerRecursively(this GameObject gameObject, int layer)
        {
            gameObject.GetComponentsInChildren(true, s_CachedTransform);
            for (int i = 0; i < s_CachedTransform.Count; i++)
            {
                s_CachedTransform[i].gameObject.layer = layer;
            }
            s_CachedTransform.Clear();
        }
        
        public static void SetParentAndReset(this Transform transform, Transform parent)
        {
            transform.SetParent(parent,false);
            transform.localPosition = Vector3.zero;
            transform.localRotation = Quaternion.identity;
            transform.localScale = Vector3.one;
        }
        
        public static void AddOrUpdate<TKey, TValue>(this IDictionary<TKey, TValue> dict, TKey key, TValue value)
        {
            if (dict.ContainsKey(key))
                dict[key] = value;
            else
                dict.Add(key, value);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public abstract class Singleton<T> where T : Singleton<T>, new()
    {
        private static T instance;
        private static readonly object lockObj = new object();

        public static T Instance
        {
            get
            {
                if (instance == null)
                {
                    lock (lockObj)
                    {
                        if (instance == null)
                        {
                            instance = new T();
                            instance.OnInitialize();
                        }
                    }
                }
                return instance;
            }
        }

        protected virtual void OnInitialize()
        {
            
        }

        public virtual void Initialize()
        {
            
        }
    }

    public abstract class SingletonMono<T> : MonoBehaviour where T : SingletonMono<T>
    {
        public static T Instance;

        public virtual void Awake()
        {
            if (Instance == null)
            {
                Instance = this as T;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/Tool/ZipExtractor.cs
````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Threading;
using Unity.SharpZipLib.Zip;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public readonly struct ZipExtractProgress
    {
        public readonly int Current;
        public readonly int Total;
        public readonly float Percent;
        public readonly string FileName;

        public ZipExtractProgress(int current, int total, float percent, string fileName)
        {
            Current = current;
            Total = total;
            Percent = Mathf.Clamp01(percent);
            FileName = fileName;
        }
    }

    public static class ZipExtractor
    {
        private const int BufferSize = 81920;

        public static async UniTask<bool> ExtractAsync(
            string zipPath,
            string extractPath,
            IProgress<ZipExtractProgress> onProgress = null,
            string password = null,
            bool overwrite = true,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(zipPath) || !File.Exists(zipPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError($"Zip文件不存在: {zipPath}");
                return false;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(extractPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError("解压路径不能为空");
                return false;
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(extractPath);
            int totalFileCount = await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(() => GetTotalFileCount(zipPath, password), cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
            if (totalFileCount <= 0)
            {
                onProgress?.Report(new ZipExtractProgress(0, 0, 1f, string.Empty));
                return true;
            }

            return await UniTask.RunOnThreadPool(
                () => Extract(zipPath, extractPath, totalFileCount, onProgress, password, overwrite, cancellationToken),
                cancellationToken: cancellationToken);
        }

        private static bool Extract(
            string zipPath,
            string extractPath,
            int totalFileCount,
            IProgress<ZipExtractProgress> onProgress,
            string password,
            bool overwrite,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            int processedCount = 0;
            string extractRoot = Path.GetFullPath(extractPath);
            using ZipFile zipFile = new ZipFile(zipPath);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
            {
                zipFile.Password = password;
            }

            foreach (ZipEntry entry in zipFile)
            {
                if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    return false;
                }

                if (entry.IsDirectory)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string entryName = entry.Name.Replace('\\', '/');
                string outputPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(extractRoot, entryName));
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(entryName) || Path.IsPathRooted(entryName) || !outputPath.StartsWith(extractRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"Zip条目路径非法: {entry.Name}");
                    return false;
                }

                string directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(outputPath);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory))
                {
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);
                }

                if (!File.Exists(outputPath) || overwrite)
                {
                    ExtractEntry(zipFile, entry, outputPath);
                }

                processedCount++;
                onProgress?.Report(new ZipExtractProgress(processedCount, totalFileCount, (float)processedCount / totalFileCount, entryName));
            }

            return true;
        }

        private static int GetTotalFileCount(string zipPath, string password)
        {
            int count = 0;
            using ZipFile zipFile = new ZipFile(zipPath);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
            {
                zipFile.Password = password;
            }

            foreach (ZipEntry entry in zipFile)
            {
                if (!entry.IsDirectory)
                {
                    count++;
                }
            }

            return count;
        }

        private static void ExtractEntry(ZipFile zipFile, ZipEntry entry, string outputPath)
        {
            using (Stream zipStream = zipFile.GetInputStream(entry))
            {
                using (FileStream fileStream = File.Create(outputPath))
                {
                    byte[] buffer = new byte[BufferSize];
                    int bytesRead;
                    while ((bytesRead = zipStream.Read(buffer, 0, buffer.Length)) > 0)
                    {
                        fileStream.Write(buffer, 0, bytesRead);
                    }
                }
            }

            File.SetLastWriteTime(outputPath, entry.DateTime);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/UI/Editor/Binding/UIBindBatchRenameWindow.cs
````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    /// <summary>
    /// UI 绑定批量重命名弹窗。
    ///
    /// 设计说明：
    /// 1. 只负责根据选中的绑定生成"新名字方案"并预览，真正写回由回调交给调用方，
    ///    这样 Undo、SetDirty、列表刷新都由管理窗口统一处理；
    /// 2. 支持加前缀 / 加后缀 / 查找替换 / 正则替换 / 按节点名+类型规则重建；
    /// 3. 应用前会对整批目标名做去重，避免批量操作制造出新的重复字段名。
    ///
    /// 关于"批量是否有意义"：
    /// 如果字段名彼此没有共同规律，前缀/替换类操作确实帮助有限，
    /// 这时更推荐使用"按规则重建"生成语义化默认名，再逐个微调；
    /// 逐个微调请使用管理窗口表格里的行内编辑。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class UIBindBatchRenameWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 一条待重命名的目标。
        /// </summary>
        public sealed class RenameTarget
        {
            public UIBindInfo info;
            public string originalName;
        }

        private readonly List<RenameTarget> _targets = new List<RenameTarget>();
        private Action<List<RenameTarget>> _applyCallback;

        private UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode _mode = UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode.AddPrefix;
        private string _argA = string.Empty;
        private string _argB = string.Empty;

        private Vector2 _scroll;

        // 预览结果：与 _targets 一一对应。
        private readonly List<string> _preview = new List<string>();
        private bool _hasConflictWithOutside;

        /// <summary>
        /// 打开批量重命名弹窗。
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="targets">被选中的绑定及其原名。</param>
        /// <param name="allFieldNamesExcludingTargets">除选中项外，其余绑定已经占用的字段名，用于跨批次判重。</param>
        /// <param name="applyCallback">用户点击应用后回调，参数为写入了新名字的目标列表。</param>
        public static void Open(
            List<RenameTarget> targets,
            HashSet<string> allFieldNamesExcludingTargets,
            Action<List<RenameTarget>> applyCallback)
        {
            if (targets == null || targets.Count == 0)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("提示", "请先在列表中选择要批量重命名的绑定。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            UIBindBatchRenameWindow window = CreateInstance<UIBindBatchRenameWindow>();
            window.titleContent = new GUIContent("批量重命名");
            window.minSize = new Vector2(520f, 420f);

            window._targets.Clear();
            window._targets.AddRange(targets);
            window._outsideNames = allFieldNamesExcludingTargets ?? new HashSet<string>();
            window._applyCallback = applyCallback;

            window.RecomputePreview();
            window.ShowUtility();
        }

        private HashSet<string> _outsideNames = new HashSet<string>();

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"选中 {_targets.Count} 条绑定", EditorStyles.boldLabel);

            DrawModeArea();

            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            DrawPreviewArea();

            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            DrawButtons();
        }

        private void DrawModeArea()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginVertical("box");

            EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();

            _mode = (UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("操作方式", _mode);

            switch (_mode)
            {
                case UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode.AddPrefix:
                    _argA = EditorGUILayout.TextField("前缀", _argA);
                    break;

                case UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode.AddSuffix:
                    _argA = EditorGUILayout.TextField("后缀", _argA);
                    break;

                case UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode.Replace:
                    _argA = EditorGUILayout.TextField("查找", _argA);
                    _argB = EditorGUILayout.TextField("替换为", _argB);
                    break;

                case UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode.RegexReplace:
                    _argA = EditorGUILayout.TextField("正则", _argA);
                    _argB = EditorGUILayout.TextField("替换为", _argB);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_argA) && !UIBindEditorUtility.IsValidRegex(_argA))
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("正则表达式无法编译，将保持原名。", MessageType.Warning);
                    }
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("替换串支持 $1 $2 分组引用。", EditorStyles.miniLabel);
                    break;

                case UIBindEditorUtility.BatchRenameMode.RebuildByRule:
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(
                        "按每个节点的名字 + 组件类型规则重新生成字段名（如 LoginBtn 节点 → _btnLogin）。\n" +
                        "适合字段名彼此没有共同规律、想要一个语义化默认名再逐个微调的场景。",
                        MessageType.Info);
                    break;
            }

            if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())
            {
                RecomputePreview();
            }

            EditorGUILayout.EndVertical();
        }

        private void DrawPreviewArea()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("预览", EditorStyles.boldLabel);

            if (_hasConflictWithOutside)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("部分新名字与未选中的绑定重名，应用时会自动追加序号消歧。", MessageType.Warning);
            }

            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll, "box");

            for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Count; i++)
            {
                string oldName = _targets[i].originalName;
                string newName = i < _preview.Count ? _preview[i] : oldName;

                EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(oldName, GUILayout.MinWidth(160f));
                GUILayout.Label("→", GUILayout.Width(20f));

                Color old = GUI.contentColor;
                if (newName != oldName)
                    GUI.contentColor = new Color(0.55f, 0.9f, 0.55f);

                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(newName, GUILayout.MinWidth(160f));
                GUI.contentColor = old;

                EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            }

            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }

        private void DrawButtons()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

            if (GUILayout.Button("应用", GUILayout.Height(28)))
            {
                Apply();
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button("取消", GUILayout.Height(28)))
            {
                Close();
            }

            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 重新计算预览。这里已经把整批目标名的相互去重也算进去，
        /// 让预览结果和真正应用后的结果保持一致。
        /// </summary>
        private void RecomputePreview()
        {
            _preview.Clear();
            _hasConflictWithOutside = false;

            // used 先放入未选中项已占用的名字，保证批量结果不会撞到它们。
            HashSet<string> used = new HashSet<string>(_outsideNames);

            for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Count; i++)
            {
                RenameTarget target = _targets[i];
                string original = target.originalName;

                string raw = UIBindEditorUtility.EvaluateBatchRename(
                    original, _mode, _argA, _argB, target.info, used);

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(raw))
                    raw = original;

                // 与已有名字去重。
                string unique = UIBindEditorUtility.MakeUniqueAgainst(raw, used);
                if (unique != raw && _outsideNames.Contains(raw))
                    _hasConflictWithOutside = true;

                used.Add(unique);
                _preview.Add(unique);
            }
        }

        private void Apply()
        {
            RecomputePreview();

            for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Count; i++)
            {
                _targets[i].info.fieldName = _preview[i];
            }

            _applyCallback?.Invoke(_targets);
            Close();
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    [CustomEditor(typeof(UIBindData))]
    public sealed class UIBindDataEditor : UnityEditor.Editor
    {
        private UIBindData _bindData;
        private UIBindScriptHolder _scriptHolder;

        #region Inspector 显示设置

        /// <summary>
        /// Bind Infos 的分组方式。
        /// </summary>
        private enum BindGroupMode
        {
            None = 0,
            PathArea = 1,
            Type = 2,
            WidgetOrNormal = 3
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Bind Infos 的显示过滤方式。
        /// </summary>
        private enum BindDisplayFilter
        {
            All = 0,
            ErrorOnly = 1
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前 Inspector 搜索关键字。
        /// </summary>
        private string _searchText = string.Empty;

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前分组模式。
        /// 默认按路径区域分组，比较符合 UI 预制体层级习惯。
        /// </summary>
        private BindGroupMode _groupMode = BindGroupMode.PathArea;

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前过滤模式。
        /// </summary>
        private BindDisplayFilter _displayFilter = BindDisplayFilter.All;

        /// <summary>
        /// 分组折叠状态缓存。
        /// 
        /// key 包含 UIBindData InstanceID + 分组模式 + 分组名，
        /// 避免不同预制体之间折叠状态互相影响。
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, bool> GroupFoldoutStates = new Dictionary<string, bool>();

        /// <summary>
        /// 单条 BindInfo 折叠状态缓存。
        /// 
        /// key 包含 UIBindData InstanceID + BindInfo 稳定 key。
        /// </summary>
        private static readonly Dictionary<string, bool> ItemFoldoutStates = new Dictionary<string, bool>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Inspector 中用于绘制的一条绑定视图数据。
        /// 
        /// 注意：
        /// 这里不直接承担数据编辑，只用于分组、过滤、显示状态。
        /// 真正编辑仍然通过 SerializedProperty 完成。
        /// </summary>
        private sealed class BindInfoView
        {
            public int index;
            public string groupName;
            public UIBindInfo info;
            public bool hasError;
            public string errorText;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Ping Bind Info 定位功能

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前需要在 Inspector 中定位的 UIBindData 实例 ID。
        /// </summary>
        private static int _pendingPingBindDataInstanceId;

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前需要定位的 BindInfo 在列表里的索引。
        /// 索引用于优先快速匹配，key 用于兜底。
        /// </summary>
        private static int _pendingPingBindInfoIndex = -1;

        /// <summary>
        /// 当前需要定位的 BindInfo 稳定标识。
        /// </summary>
        private static string _pendingPingBindInfoKey;

        /// <summary>
        /// 从 Hierarchy 的绑定菜单跳转到 UIBindData Inspector 中对应的 BindInfo。
        /// </summary>
        public static void PingBindInfo(UIBindData bindData, UIBindInfo info)
        {
            if (bindData == null || info == null)
                return;

            int bindDataInstanceId = bindData.GetInstanceID();

            _pendingPingBindDataInstanceId = bindDataInstanceId;
            _pendingPingBindInfoIndex = FindBindInfoIndex(bindData, info);
            _pendingPingBindInfoKey = MakeBindInfoKey(info);

            /*
             * 必须延迟一帧切换 Selection。
             * 
             * GenericMenu 回调发生在当前 GUI 事件中，
             * 如果当帧直接切 Selection，有概率打断 Inspector 的 GUILayout 状态，
             * 导致 Bind Infos 不显示或 Inspector 空白。
             */
            EditorApplication.delayCall += () =>
            {
                UIBindData targetBindData = EditorUtility.InstanceIDToObject(bindDataInstanceId) as UIBindData;
                if (targetBindData == null)
                    return;

                Selection.activeGameObject = targetBindData.gameObject;
                EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(targetBindData.gameObject);

                RepaintEditorViews();
            };
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 查找 BindInfo 在 UIBindData.BindInfos 中的索引。
        /// </summary>
        private static int FindBindInfoIndex(UIBindData bindData, UIBindInfo info)
        {
            if (bindData == null || info == null)
                return -1;

            IReadOnlyList<UIBindInfo> infos = bindData.BindInfos;
            if (infos == null)
                return -1;

            for (int i = 0; i < infos.Count; i++)
            {
                if (ReferenceEquals(infos[i], info))
                    return i;
            }

            string key = MakeBindInfoKey(info);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
                return -1;

            for (int i = 0; i < infos.Count; i++)
            {
                if (MakeBindInfoKey(infos[i]) == key)
                    return i;
            }

            return -1;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 生成 BindInfo 稳定标识。
        /// 
        /// 不长期保存 UIBindInfo 引用，是为了避免 Inspector 刷新、序列化重建后引用不稳定。
        /// </summary>
        private static string MakeBindInfoKey(UIBindInfo info)
        {
            if (info == null)
                return string.Empty;

            int targetId = info.target != null ? info.target.GetInstanceID() : 0;

            return string.Format(
                "{0}|{1}|{2}|{3}|{4}|{5}",
                targetId,
                info.fieldName ?? string.Empty,
                info.typeName ?? string.Empty,
                info.path ?? string.Empty,
                info.isWidget,
                info.widgetTypeName ?? string.Empty
            );
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 判断指定 index 的 BindInfo 是否是当前 Ping Info 定位目标。
        /// </summary>
        private bool IsPingTarget(int index)
        {
            if (_bindData == null)
                return false;

            if (_pendingPingBindDataInstanceId == 0)
                return false;

            if (_bindData.GetInstanceID() != _pendingPingBindDataInstanceId)
                return false;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_pendingPingBindInfoKey))
                return false;

            IReadOnlyList<UIBindInfo> infos = _bindData.BindInfos;
            if (infos == null || index < 0 || index >= infos.Count)
                return false;

            UIBindInfo info = infos[index];
            if (info == null)
                return false;

            string currentKey = MakeBindInfoKey(info);

            if (_pendingPingBindInfoIndex == index && currentKey == _pendingPingBindInfoKey)
                return true;

            return currentKey == _pendingPingBindInfoKey;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清除当前 Ping Info 定位状态。
        /// </summary>
        private static void ClearPingBindInfo()
        {
            _pendingPingBindDataInstanceId = 0;
            _pendingPingBindInfoIndex = -1;
            _pendingPingBindInfoKey = null;

            RepaintEditorViews();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 如果删除的 BindInfo 正好是当前定位目标，则清理定位状态。
        /// </summary>
        private static void ClearPingBindInfoIfMatch(UIBindData bindData, UIBindInfo info)
        {
            if (bindData == null || info == null)
                return;

            if (_pendingPingBindDataInstanceId == 0)
                return;

            if (bindData.GetInstanceID() != _pendingPingBindDataInstanceId)
                return;

            string key = MakeBindInfoKey(info);
            if (key == _pendingPingBindInfoKey)
            {
                ClearPingBindInfo();
            }
        }

        #endregion

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            _bindData = target as UIBindData;
            if (_bindData != null)
            {
                _scriptHolder = _bindData.GetComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>();
            }
        }

        public override void OnInspectorGUI()
        {
            serializedObject.Update();

            if (_bindData == null)
            {
                serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                return;
            }

            DrawScriptSelectArea();
            EditorGUILayout.Space();

            DrawOperationButtons();
            EditorGUILayout.Space();

            DrawBindList();

            serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
        }

        #region 顶部脚本选择区域

        private void DrawScriptSelectArea()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Target Script", EditorStyles.boldLabel);

            if (_scriptHolder == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("当前节点缺少 UIBindScriptHolder。", MessageType.Info);

                if (GUILayout.Button("添加 Script Holder"))
                {
                    _scriptHolder = _bindData.gameObject.GetComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>();
                    if (_scriptHolder == null)
                    {
                        _scriptHolder = Undo.AddComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>(_bindData.gameObject);
                    }
                }

                return;
            }

            EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
            MonoScript newScript = (MonoScript)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Target Script", _scriptHolder.targetScript, typeof(MonoScript), false);
            if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())
            {
                Undo.RecordObject(_scriptHolder, "Set UI Target Script");
                _scriptHolder.targetScript = newScript;
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(_scriptHolder);
                SyncTargetScriptToRuntimeData();
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button("同步脚本信息到运行时数据"))
            {
                SyncTargetScriptToRuntimeData();
            }
        }

        private void SyncTargetScriptToRuntimeData()
        {
            if (_bindData == null || _scriptHolder == null || _scriptHolder.targetScript == null)
                return;

            Type type = _scriptHolder.targetScript.GetClass();
            if (type == null)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "所选脚本没有有效类型。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            MonoScriptReference scriptRef = new MonoScriptReference
            {
                className = type.Name,
                namespaceName = type.Namespace,
                assemblyName = type.Assembly.GetName().Name
            };

            Undo.RecordObject(_bindData, "Sync UI Target Script");
            _bindData.SetTargetScript(scriptRef);
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(_bindData);
        }

        #endregion

        #region 操作按钮

        private void DrawOperationButtons()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("操作", EditorStyles.boldLabel);

            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            
            if (GUILayout.Button("生成绑定代码", GUILayout.Height(30)))
            {
                if (ValidateBindInfos(true))
                {
                    UICodeGenerator.Generate(_bindData, _scriptHolder != null ? _scriptHolder.targetScript : null);
                }
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button("刷新/清理", GUILayout.Height(30)))
            {
                RefreshBindInfos();
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button("校验", GUILayout.Height(30)))
            {
                ValidateBindInfos(true);
            }

            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();

            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

            EditorGUILayout.PrefixLabel(new GUIContent(
                "排序规则",
                "路径：按节点名称路径排序；Hierarchy：按节点在层级面板中的先后顺序排序。同一节点上的多个绑定继续按组件类型和字段名排序。"));
            UIBindSortMode sortMode = (UIBindSortMode)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup(
                _bindData.SortMode,
                GUILayout.MinWidth(100),
                GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true));
            if (sortMode != _bindData.SortMode)
            {
                Undo.RecordObject(_bindData, "Change UI Bind Sort Mode");
                _bindData.SetSortMode(sortMode);
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(_bindData);
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button(
                    new GUIContent("应用排序", "按当前排序规则重排绑定列表；生成绑定代码时也会自动应用同一规则。"),
                    GUILayout.Width(90),
                    GUILayout.Height(26)))
            {
                SortBindInfos();
            }

            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();

            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

            if (GUILayout.Button("打开管理窗口", GUILayout.Height(26)))
            {
                UIBindManagerWindow.Open(_bindData);
            }
            
            if (GUILayout.Button("清除定位", GUILayout.Height(26)))
            {
                ClearPingBindInfo();
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button("清空绑定", GUILayout.Height(26)))
            {
                if (EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("确认", "确定清空全部绑定？", "确定", "取消"))
                {
                    Undo.RecordObject(_bindData, "Clear UI Bind Infos");
                    _bindData.SetBindInfos(new List<UIBindInfo>());
                    EditorUtility.SetDirty(_bindData);
                    ClearPingBindInfo();
                }
````
