using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Callbacks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    /// <summary>
    /// UIForm、UIWidget、UIItem 初始化菜单工具。
    ///
    /// 用途：
    /// 对一个新的 UI 预制体或 UI 根节点，一键完成：
    /// 1. 根据菜单类型创建同名 UIForm、UIWidget 或 UIItem 脚本；
    /// 2. 脚本继承对应的 UI 运行时基类；
    /// 3. 脚本声明为 partial，供 UI Bind 生成同名绑定分部类；
    /// 4. 根节点添加 UIBindData；
    /// 5. 根节点添加 UIBindScriptHolder；
    /// 6. 自动关联刚创建的脚本；
    /// 7. 脚本编译完成后同步真实命名空间与程序集信息。
    ///
    /// 支持：
    /// - Hierarchy 中的普通场景对象；
    /// - Prefab Stage 中打开的预制体对象；
    /// - Project 面板中的 Prefab Asset。
    ///
    /// 类型约定：
    /// - UIForm 用作由 UIManager 管理的完整窗口；
    /// - UIWidget 用作窗口内部具备独立生命周期的复合区域；
    /// - UIItem 用作列表、网格或对象池中的可复用条目。
    /// </summary>
    public static class UIFormSetupMenu
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 初始化工具支持的运行时 UI 根类型。
        /// 该类型同时决定菜单语义、默认脚本名和生成脚本的基类。
        /// </summary>
        private enum UIType
        {
            Form,
            Widget,
            Item
        }

        private const string MenuRoot = "UI Bind";

        /*
         * 这里默认认为 UIForm、UIWidget、UIItem 都在 FRFrame 命名空间下。
         *
         * 如果这些运行时基类不在 FRFrame 命名空间：
         * 1. 可以把 GeneratedScriptUsingNamespace 改成空字符串；
         * 2. 或者改成实际存放这些基类的运行时命名空间。
         */
        private const string GeneratedScriptUsingNamespace = "FRFrame";

        /*
         * 这里默认生成的 UI 脚本不包 namespace。
         *
         * 如果你希望所有自动生成的 UIForm、UIWidget、UIItem 脚本都进入固定 namespace，
         * 例如 Game.UI，可以改成：
         *
         * private const string GeneratedScriptNamespace = "Game.UI";
         */
        private const string GeneratedScriptNamespace = "";

        /*
         * 新脚本默认程序集名。
         *
         * 如果脚本放在普通 Assets 目录且没有 asmdef，通常是 Assembly-CSharp。
         * 如果脚本放在 asmdef 下，后续脚本编译完成后，本工具会尝试通过 MonoScript.GetClass()
         * 再同步一次真实程序集名。
         */
        private const string DefaultAssemblyName = "Assembly-CSharp";

        /*
         * pending 信息跨脚本编译和域重载暂存。
         * GlobalObjectId 用于重新定位 UIBindData，ScriptPath 用于取得编译后的 MonoScript 类型。
         */
        private const string PendingGlobalObjectIdKey = "FRFrame.UIFormSetup.Pending.GlobalObjectId";
        private const string PendingScriptPathKey = "FRFrame.UIFormSetup.Pending.ScriptPath";

        #region Hierarchy 菜单

        /// <summary>
        /// 为 Hierarchy 选中的根节点创建 UIForm 脚本并初始化绑定。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("GameObject/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIForm 脚本并初始化绑定", false, 10)]
        private static void CreateForHierarchyObject(MenuCommand command)
        {
            CreateForHierarchyObject(command, UIType.Form);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 为 Hierarchy 选中的根节点创建 UIWidget 脚本并初始化绑定。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("GameObject/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIWidget 脚本并初始化绑定", false, 11)]
        private static void CreateWidgetForHierarchyObject(MenuCommand command)
        {
            CreateForHierarchyObject(command, UIType.Widget);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 为 Hierarchy 选中的根节点创建 UIItem 脚本并初始化绑定。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("GameObject/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIItem 脚本并初始化绑定", false, 12)]
        private static void CreateItemForHierarchyObject(MenuCommand command)
        {
            CreateForHierarchyObject(command, UIType.Item);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 解析右键菜单上下文或当前 Selection，并进入场景对象初始化主流程。
        /// MenuCommand.context 优先，可确保 Hierarchy 右键对象与当前激活对象不一致时仍操作正确目标。
        /// </summary>
        private static void CreateForHierarchyObject(MenuCommand command, UIType uiType)
        {
            GameObject target = command.context as GameObject;
            if (target == null)
                target = Selection.activeGameObject;

            if (target == null)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("提示", "请先选择一个 UI 根节点。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            CreateScriptAndSetupSceneObject(target, uiType);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 仅在 Hierarchy 中存在激活对象时启用三类初始化菜单。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("GameObject/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIForm 脚本并初始化绑定", true)]
        [MenuItem("GameObject/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIWidget 脚本并初始化绑定", true)]
        [MenuItem("GameObject/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIItem 脚本并初始化绑定", true)]
        private static bool ValidateCreateForHierarchyObject()
        {
            return Selection.activeGameObject != null;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Project Prefab 菜单

        /// <summary>
        /// 为 Project 面板选中的 Prefab Asset 创建 UIForm 脚本并初始化绑定。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("Assets/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIForm 脚本并初始化绑定", false, 10)]
        private static void CreateForPrefabAsset()
        {
            CreateForPrefabAsset(UIType.Form);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 为 Project 面板选中的 Prefab Asset 创建 UIWidget 脚本并初始化绑定。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("Assets/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIWidget 脚本并初始化绑定", false, 11)]
        private static void CreateWidgetForPrefabAsset()
        {
            CreateForPrefabAsset(UIType.Widget);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 为 Project 面板选中的 Prefab Asset 创建 UIItem 脚本并初始化绑定。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("Assets/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIItem 脚本并初始化绑定", false, 12)]
        private static void CreateItemForPrefabAsset()
        {
            CreateForPrefabAsset(UIType.Item);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 校验 Project 面板选择并进入 Prefab Asset 初始化主流程。
        /// 这里只接受真正的 Prefab Asset，不处理普通 GameObject 或其他资源类型。
        /// </summary>
        private static void CreateForPrefabAsset(UIType uiType)
        {
            GameObject prefabAsset = Selection.activeObject as GameObject;
            if (prefabAsset == null)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("提示", "请在 Project 面板中选择一个 Prefab。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            string prefabPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(prefabAsset);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefabPath) || PrefabUtility.GetPrefabAssetType(prefabAsset) == PrefabAssetType.NotAPrefab)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("提示", "当前选择的对象不是 Prefab Asset。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            CreateScriptAndSetupPrefabAsset(prefabPath, uiType);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 仅在 Project 面板选中 Prefab Asset 时启用三类初始化菜单。
        /// </summary>
        [MenuItem("Assets/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIForm 脚本并初始化绑定", true)]
        [MenuItem("Assets/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIWidget 脚本并初始化绑定", true)]
        [MenuItem("Assets/" + MenuRoot + "/创建 UIItem 脚本并初始化绑定", true)]
        private static bool ValidateCreateForPrefabAsset()
        {
            GameObject prefabAsset = Selection.activeObject as GameObject;
            if (prefabAsset == null)
                return false;

            return PrefabUtility.GetPrefabAssetType(prefabAsset) != PrefabAssetType.NotAPrefab;
        }

        #endregion

        #region 主流程：场景对象 / Prefab Stage 对象

        /// <summary>
        /// 对 Hierarchy 中的对象执行对应 UI 类型的脚本创建和组件初始化。
        /// 包括普通场景对象，以及 Prefab Stage 中打开的预制体对象。
        ///
        /// 场景对象通过 Undo API 添加和修改组件，使整次初始化可以撤销；
        /// Prefab 实例上的组件变更还会记录为实例覆盖。
        /// </summary>
        private static void CreateScriptAndSetupSceneObject(GameObject root, UIType uiType)
        {
            if (root == null)
                return;

            string defaultClassName = MakeSafeClassName(root.name, uiType);
            string scriptPath = AskScriptSavePath(defaultClassName, uiType);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(scriptPath))
                return;

            string className = MakeSafeClassName(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(scriptPath), uiType);

            if (!CreateScriptFile(scriptPath, className, uiType))
                return;

            MonoScript monoScript = LoadMonoScript(scriptPath);

            string undoTypeName = GetTypeName(uiType);
            Undo.RegisterFullObjectHierarchyUndo(root, $"Setup {undoTypeName} Binding");

            UIBindData bindData = GetOrAddComponent<UIBindData>(root);
            UIBindScriptHolder scriptHolder = GetOrAddComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>(root);

            if (scriptHolder != null)
            {
                Undo.RecordObject(scriptHolder, $"Set {undoTypeName} Script");
                scriptHolder.targetScript = monoScript;
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(scriptHolder);
            }

            if (bindData != null)
            {
                Undo.RecordObject(bindData, $"Set {undoTypeName} Script Reference");
                SetRuntimeScriptReference(bindData, monoScript, className, GeneratedScriptNamespace, DefaultAssemblyName);
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(bindData);
            }

            EditorUtility.SetDirty(root);

            /*
             * 如果当前对象属于 Prefab 实例或 Prefab Stage，尽量保存修改。
             */
            TryRecordPrefabInstanceModification(bindData);
            TryRecordPrefabInstanceModification(scriptHolder);

            RegisterPendingRuntimeScriptSync(bindData, scriptPath);

            Selection.activeGameObject = root;
            EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(root);

            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();

            Debug.Log($"[UIBind] {GetTypeName(uiType)} 初始化完成: {root.name}, Script: {scriptPath}");
        }

        #endregion

        #region 主流程：Project Prefab Asset

        /// <summary>
        /// 对 Project 面板中的 Prefab Asset 执行对应 UI 类型的初始化。
        ///
        /// 注意：
        /// Prefab Asset 不能像场景对象一样直接通过 Undo.AddComponent 修改，
        /// 需要先用 LoadPrefabContents 打开隔离内容，完成组件配置后再保存并卸载。
        /// </summary>
        private static void CreateScriptAndSetupPrefabAsset(string prefabPath, UIType uiType)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefabPath))
                return;

            GameObject prefabAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(prefabPath);
            if (prefabAsset == null)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "无法加载 Prefab Asset。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            string defaultClassName = MakeSafeClassName(prefabAsset.name, uiType);
            string scriptPath = AskScriptSavePath(defaultClassName, uiType);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(scriptPath))
                return;

            string className = MakeSafeClassName(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(scriptPath), uiType);

            if (!CreateScriptFile(scriptPath, className, uiType))
                return;

            MonoScript monoScript = LoadMonoScript(scriptPath);

            GameObject prefabRoot = null;

            try
            {
                prefabRoot = PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents(prefabPath);
                if (prefabRoot == null)
                {
                    EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "无法加载 Prefab 内容。", "确定");
                    return;
                }

                UIBindData bindData = prefabRoot.GetComponent<UIBindData>();
                if (bindData == null)
                    bindData = prefabRoot.AddComponent<UIBindData>();

                UIBindScriptHolder scriptHolder = prefabRoot.GetComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>();
                if (scriptHolder == null)
                    scriptHolder = prefabRoot.AddComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>();

                if (scriptHolder != null)
                {
                    scriptHolder.targetScript = monoScript;
                    EditorUtility.SetDirty(scriptHolder);
                }

                if (bindData != null)
                {
                    SetRuntimeScriptReference(bindData, monoScript, className, GeneratedScriptNamespace, DefaultAssemblyName);
                    EditorUtility.SetDirty(bindData);
                }

                PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(prefabRoot, prefabPath);

                /*
                 * 保存后重新拿 Prefab Asset 上的 UIBindData，用于注册编译后的二次同步。
                 */
                GameObject savedPrefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(prefabPath);
                UIBindData savedBindData = savedPrefab != null ? savedPrefab.GetComponent<UIBindData>() : null;
                RegisterPendingRuntimeScriptSync(savedBindData, scriptPath);

                Selection.activeObject = savedPrefab;
                EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(savedPrefab);

                AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
                AssetDatabase.Refresh();

                Debug.Log($"[UIBind] Prefab {GetTypeName(uiType)} 初始化完成: {prefabPath}, Script: {scriptPath}");
            }
            finally
            {
                if (prefabRoot != null)
                    PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(prefabRoot);
            }
        }

        #endregion

        #region 创建脚本

        /// <summary>
        /// 弹出脚本保存面板，让用户选择对应 UI 类型的脚本保存目录。
        /// 保存文件名将再次经过类名清理，因此用户可以在面板中修改默认名称。
        /// </summary>
        private static string AskScriptSavePath(string defaultClassName, UIType uiType)
        {
            string typeName = GetTypeName(uiType);
            string path = EditorUtility.SaveFilePanelInProject(
                $"创建 {typeName} 脚本",
                defaultClassName + ".cs",
                "cs",
                $"请选择 {typeName} 脚本保存位置。"
            );

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                return string.Empty;

            if (!path.StartsWith("Assets/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "脚本必须保存到 Assets 目录下。", "确定");
                return string.Empty;
            }

            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                bool overwrite = EditorUtility.DisplayDialog(
                    "文件已存在",
                    $"脚本已存在：\n{path}\n\n是否覆盖？",
                    "覆盖",
                    "取消"
                );

                if (!overwrite)
                    return string.Empty;
            }

            return path;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 创建 UIForm、UIWidget 或 UIItem 脚本文件并立即导入 AssetDatabase。
        /// 文件采用无 BOM UTF-8，保持生成代码编码稳定。
        /// </summary>
        private static bool CreateScriptFile(string assetPath, string className, UIType uiType)
        {
            try
            {
                string fullPath = AssetPathToFullPath(assetPath);
                string directory = Path.GetDirectoryName(fullPath);

                if (!Directory.Exists(directory))
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(directory);

                string content = GenerateScriptContent(className, uiType);
                File.WriteAllText(fullPath, content, new UTF8Encoding(false));

                AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(assetPath);
                AssetDatabase.Refresh();

                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogException(e);
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "创建脚本失败，请查看 Console。", "确定");
                return false;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 生成对应 UI 类型的最小业务脚本内容。
        /// 仅声明 partial 类和正确基类，绑定字段由后续 UI Bind 代码生成器负责。
        /// </summary>
        private static string GenerateScriptContent(string className, UIType uiType)
        {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

            sb.AppendLine("using UnityEngine;");

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GeneratedScriptUsingNamespace))
                sb.AppendLine("using " + GeneratedScriptUsingNamespace + ";");

            sb.AppendLine();

            string typeName = GetTypeName(uiType);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(GeneratedScriptNamespace))
            {
                sb.AppendLine("namespace " + GeneratedScriptNamespace);
                sb.AppendLine("{");
                sb.AppendLine("    public partial class " + className + " : " + typeName);
                sb.AppendLine("    {");
                sb.AppendLine("    }");
                sb.AppendLine("}");
            }
            else
            {
                sb.AppendLine("public partial class " + className + " : " + typeName);
                sb.AppendLine("{");
                sb.AppendLine("}");
            }

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 返回生成脚本使用的运行时基类名称。
        /// 该名称也用于菜单提示、日志、默认类名和 Undo 操作名称。
        /// </summary>
        private static string GetTypeName(UIType uiType)
        {
            switch (uiType)
            {
                case UIType.Widget:
                    return "UIWidget";
                case UIType.Item:
                    return "UIItem";
                default:
                    return "UIForm";
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 加载刚创建并导入的 MonoScript。
        /// 首次加载时脚本可能尚未完成编译，因此允许 GetClass() 暂时返回 null，
        /// 后续由 pending sync 在域重载后补全真实类型信息。
        /// </summary>
        private static MonoScript LoadMonoScript(string scriptPath)
        {
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(scriptPath);
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();

            MonoScript monoScript = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonoScript>(scriptPath);
            if (monoScript == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("[UIBind] MonoScript 暂时加载失败，可能需要等待 Unity 编译完成: " + scriptPath);
            }

            return monoScript;
        }

        #endregion

        #region 组件初始化

        /// <summary>
        /// 获取或添加组件。
        /// 场景对象用 Undo.AddComponent，方便撤销。
        /// Prefab Asset LoadPrefabContents 出来的对象不走这里。
        /// </summary>
        private static T GetOrAddComponent<T>(GameObject gameObject) where T : Component
        {
            if (gameObject == null)
                return null;

            T component = gameObject.GetComponent<T>();
            if (component != null)
                return component;

            return Undo.AddComponent<T>(gameObject);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 设置 UIBindData 中运行时脚本引用信息。
        ///
        /// 优先使用 MonoScript.GetClass() 的真实类型信息。
        /// 如果刚创建脚本后 Unity 还没编译完成，则使用预估信息先写入。
        /// 编译完成后会通过 pending sync 再尝试同步一次真实信息。
        /// </summary>
        private static void SetRuntimeScriptReference(
            UIBindData bindData,
            MonoScript monoScript,
            string fallbackClassName,
            string fallbackNamespace,
            string fallbackAssemblyName)
        {
            if (bindData == null)
                return;

            string className = fallbackClassName;
            string namespaceName = fallbackNamespace;
            string assemblyName = fallbackAssemblyName;

            if (monoScript != null)
            {
                Type type = monoScript.GetClass();
                if (type != null)
                {
                    className = type.Name;
                    namespaceName = type.Namespace;
                    assemblyName = type.Assembly.GetName().Name;
                }
            }

            MonoScriptReference scriptReference = new MonoScriptReference
            {
                className = className,
                namespaceName = namespaceName,
                assemblyName = assemblyName
            };

            bindData.SetTargetScript(scriptReference);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 记录 Prefab 实例上的组件属性修改，使绑定信息能够作为实例覆盖被 Unity 保存。
        /// 对普通场景对象或 Prefab Stage 对象调用不会改变初始化语义。
        /// </summary>
        private static void TryRecordPrefabInstanceModification(UnityEngine.Object obj)
        {
            if (obj == null)
                return;

            PrefabUtility.RecordPrefabInstancePropertyModifications(obj);
        }

        #endregion

        #region 编译后再次同步脚本真实程序集信息

        /// <summary>
        /// 注册一个待同步任务。
        ///
        /// 原因：
        /// 新脚本创建后，Unity 通常会触发编译。
        /// 在编译完成前，MonoScript.GetClass() 可能返回 null。
        /// 所以这里先把目标 UIBindData 和脚本路径记到 SessionState。
        /// 编译完成 / 域重载后，再尝试用真实 Type 信息同步一次。
        /// </summary>
        private static void RegisterPendingRuntimeScriptSync(UIBindData bindData, string scriptPath)
        {
            if (bindData == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(scriptPath))
                return;

            string globalObjectId = GlobalObjectId.GetGlobalObjectIdSlow(bindData).ToString();

            SessionState.SetString(PendingGlobalObjectIdKey, globalObjectId);
            SessionState.SetString(PendingScriptPathKey, scriptPath);
        }

        [DidReloadScripts]
        private static void OnScriptsReloaded()
        {
            EditorApplication.delayCall += TryConsumePendingRuntimeScriptSync;
        }

        [InitializeOnLoadMethod]
        private static void OnEditorLoaded()
        {
            EditorApplication.delayCall += TryConsumePendingRuntimeScriptSync;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 脚本编译完成后，尝试重新读取 MonoScript.GetClass()，
        /// 并把真实 namespace / assemblyName 写入 UIBindData。
        /// </summary>
        private static void TryConsumePendingRuntimeScriptSync()
        {
            string globalObjectIdString = SessionState.GetString(PendingGlobalObjectIdKey, string.Empty);
            string scriptPath = SessionState.GetString(PendingScriptPathKey, string.Empty);

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(globalObjectIdString) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(scriptPath))
                return;

            MonoScript monoScript = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonoScript>(scriptPath);
            if (monoScript == null)
                return;

            Type type = monoScript.GetClass();

            /*
             * 如果脚本还没编译好，保留 pending，下次再试。
             */
            if (type == null)
                return;

            if (!GlobalObjectId.TryParse(globalObjectIdString, out GlobalObjectId globalObjectId))
            {
                ClearPendingRuntimeScriptSync();
                return;
            }

            UnityEngine.Object targetObject = GlobalObjectId.GlobalObjectIdentifierToObjectSlow(globalObjectId);
            UIBindData bindData = targetObject as UIBindData;

            if (bindData == null)
            {
                ClearPendingRuntimeScriptSync();
                return;
            }

            Undo.RecordObject(bindData, "Sync UI Script Reference After Compile");

            MonoScriptReference scriptReference = new MonoScriptReference
            {
                className = type.Name,
                namespaceName = type.Namespace,
                assemblyName = type.Assembly.GetName().Name
            };

            bindData.SetTargetScript(scriptReference);
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(bindData);

            UIBindScriptHolder scriptHolder = bindData.GetComponent<UIBindScriptHolder>();
            if (scriptHolder != null && scriptHolder.targetScript != monoScript)
            {
                Undo.RecordObject(scriptHolder, "Sync UI MonoScript After Compile");
                scriptHolder.targetScript = monoScript;
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(scriptHolder);
            }

            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            ClearPendingRuntimeScriptSync();

            Debug.Log($"[UIBind] 已在脚本编译后同步 UI 脚本信息: {type.FullName}, Assembly: {type.Assembly.GetName().Name}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 清除已经完成或无法继续处理的编译后同步任务。
        /// </summary>
        private static void ClearPendingRuntimeScriptSync()
        {
            SessionState.EraseString(PendingGlobalObjectIdKey);
            SessionState.EraseString(PendingScriptPathKey);
        }

        #endregion

        #region 路径和类名辅助

        /// <summary>
        /// 把 Assets 相对路径转换为当前 Unity 工程中的绝对文件系统路径。
        /// </summary>
        private static string AssetPathToFullPath(string assetPath)
        {
            string projectPath = Directory.GetParent(Application.dataPath).FullName;
            return Path.Combine(projectPath, assetPath);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 把 GameObject 或文件名转换成合法 C# 类名。
        /// 空名称按目标 UI 类型回退为 NewUIForm、NewUIWidget 或 NewUIItem。
        /// </summary>
        private static string MakeSafeClassName(string rawName, UIType uiType)
        {
            string fallbackName = "New" + GetTypeName(uiType);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rawName))
                return fallbackName;

            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();

            for (int i = 0; i < rawName.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = rawName[i];

                if (char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) || c == '_')
                    sb.Append(c);
                else
                    sb.Append('_');
            }

            string className = sb.ToString();

            while (className.Contains("__"))
                className = className.Replace("__", "_");

            className = className.Trim('_');

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(className))
                className = fallbackName;

            if (char.IsDigit(className[0]))
                className = "UI" + className;

            if (IsCSharpKeyword(className))
                className = className + "UI";

            return className;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 判断清理后的类名是否仍与 C# 保留关键字冲突。
        /// </summary>
        private static bool IsCSharpKeyword(string value)
        {
            return CSharpKeywords.Contains(value);
        }

        private static readonly HashSet<string> CSharpKeywords = new HashSet<string>
        {
            "abstract",
            "as",
            "base",
            "bool",
            "break",
            "byte",
            "case",
            "catch",
            "char",
            "checked",
            "class",
            "const",
            "continue",
            "decimal",
            "default",
            "delegate",
            "do",
            "double",
            "else",
            "enum",
            "event",
            "explicit",
            "extern",
            "false",
            "finally",
            "fixed",
            "float",
            "for",
            "foreach",
            "goto",
            "if",
            "implicit",
            "in",
            "int",
            "interface",
            "internal",
            "is",
            "lock",
            "long",
            "namespace",
            "new",
            "null",
            "object",
            "operator",
            "out",
            "override",
            "params",
            "private",
            "protected",
            "public",
            "readonly",
            "ref",
            "return",
            "sbyte",
            "sealed",
            "short",
            "sizeof",
            "stackalloc",
            "static",
            "string",
            "struct",
            "switch",
            "this",
            "throw",
            "true",
            "try",
            "typeof",
            "uint",
            "ulong",
            "unchecked",
            "unsafe",
            "ushort",
            "using",
            "virtual",
            "void",
            "volatile",
            "while"
        };

        #endregion
    }
}
#endif

#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    /// <summary>
    /// UI 绑定代码生成器。
    /// 
    /// 生成内容：
    /// 1. 字段声明
    /// 2. BindInit 字段绑定
    /// 3. BindEvent 自动事件绑定
    /// 4. UnbindEvent 自动事件解绑
    /// 5. 常见 UGUI / TMP 控件事件包装方法
    /// 6. partial 业务回调方法声明
    /// 7. 常用 UI 辅助方法
    /// 8. 脚本 / 组件 enabled 控制方法
    /// 9. 绑定空值校验
    /// 
    /// 注意：
    /// 生成文件为 XXX.Bind.cs，请勿在生成文件里写业务逻辑。
    /// 业务逻辑请写在用户自己的 partial 类文件中。
    /// </summary>
    public static class UICodeGenerator
    {
        private sealed class GeneratedEventInfo
        {
            public string FieldName;
            public string EventName;
            public string AddLine;
            public string RemoveLine;
            public string WrapperName;
            public string PartialName;
            public string ParameterSignature;
            public string ParameterCall;
        }

        public static void Generate(UIBindData bindData, MonoScript explicitScript = null)
        {
            if (bindData == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("UICodeGenerator.Generate failed, bindData is null.");
                return;
            }

            if (!ValidateBindData(bindData))
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "绑定数据校验失败，请查看 Console。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            MonoScript script = explicitScript != null ? explicitScript : FindTargetMonoScript(bindData);
            if (script == null)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "未找到目标脚本，请先在 UIBindData 上指定 Target Script。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            Type targetType = script.GetClass();
            Debug.Log($"[UICodeGenerator] Target Script = {script.name}, Type = {targetType?.FullName}, Path = {AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(script)}");
            if (targetType == null)
            {
                EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("错误", "目标脚本无法解析出类型。", "确定");
                return;
            }

            string scriptPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(script);
            string dir = Path.GetDirectoryName(scriptPath);
            string fileName = targetType.Name + ".Bind.cs";
            string outputPath = Path.Combine(dir ?? string.Empty, fileName);

            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos = CreateBindInfos(bindData);
            UIBindEditorUtility.SortBindInfos(bindInfos, bindData);
            if (!HasSameOrder(bindData.BindInfos, bindInfos))
            {
                Undo.RecordObject(bindData, "Sort UI Bind Infos For Code Generation");
                bindData.SetBindInfos(bindInfos);
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(bindData);
            }

            string code = BuildCode(bindInfos, targetType);
            File.WriteAllText(outputPath, code, new UTF8Encoding(false));
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();

            Debug.Log($"UI Bind code generated : {outputPath}");
        }

        private static string BuildCode(List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos, Type targetType)
        {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(16384);
            HashSet<string> usingSet = CollectUsingNamespaces(bindInfos, targetType);
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> eventInfos = CollectGeneratedEvents(bindInfos);

            AppendHeader(sb);
            AppendUsings(sb, usingSet);
            AppendNamespaceBegin(sb, targetType);

            string indent = string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetType.Namespace) ? "" : "    ";

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}public partial class {targetType.Name}");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}{{");

            AppendFields(sb, bindInfos, eventInfos, indent);
            AppendBindInit(sb, bindInfos, targetType, indent);
            AppendBindEvent(sb, eventInfos, indent);
            AppendUnbindEvent(sb, eventInfos, indent);
            AppendValidateGeneratedBinds(sb, bindInfos, targetType, indent);
            AppendEventWrappersAndPartials(sb, eventInfos, indent);
            AppendWidgetBindPartials(sb, bindInfos, indent);
            AppendHelperMethods(sb, bindInfos, indent);

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}}}");

            AppendNamespaceEnd(sb, targetType);

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private static void AppendHeader(StringBuilder sb)
        {
            sb.AppendLine("// ==========================================================");
            sb.AppendLine("// <auto-generated>");
            sb.AppendLine("// 此文件由 FRFrame UI 绑定工具自动生成，请勿手动修改。");
            sb.AppendLine("// 业务逻辑请写在另一个 partial 类文件中。");
            sb.AppendLine("// </auto-generated>");
            sb.AppendLine("// ==========================================================");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendUsings(StringBuilder sb, HashSet<string> usingSet)
        {
            List<string> list = new List<string>(usingSet);
            list.Sort(StringComparer.Ordinal);

            for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(list[i]))
                    sb.AppendLine($"using {list[i]};");
            }

            if (list.Count > 0)
                sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendNamespaceBegin(StringBuilder sb, Type targetType)
        {
            string ns = targetType.Namespace;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ns))
            {
                sb.AppendLine($"namespace {ns}");
                sb.AppendLine("{");
            }
        }

        private static void AppendNamespaceEnd(StringBuilder sb, Type targetType)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(targetType.Namespace))
            {
                sb.AppendLine("}");
            }
        }

        private static void AppendFields(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos,
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> eventInfos,
            string indent)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成字段");

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                string fieldType = GetFieldTypeDisplayName(info);
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    protected {fieldType} {info.fieldName};");
            }

            if (eventInfos.Count > 0)
            {
                sb.AppendLine();
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    /// <summary>");
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    /// 自动生成事件是否已经绑定。");
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    /// 用于防止重复 AddListener。");
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    /// </summary>");
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    private bool _generatedEventsBound;");
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendBindInit(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos,
            Type targetType,
            string indent)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成绑定初始化");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    protected override void BindInit()");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    {{");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        if (_bindData == null) return;");
            sb.AppendLine();

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                string fieldType = GetFieldTypeDisplayName(info);

                if (info.isWidget)
                {
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {info.fieldName} = CreateWidget<{fieldType}>(_bindData.GetGameObjectByIndex({i}));");
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        OnBind{ToPascalCase(info.fieldName)}({info.fieldName});");
                }
                else if (fieldType == "GameObject")
                {
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {info.fieldName} = _bindData.GetGameObjectByIndex({i});");
                }
                else
                {
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {info.fieldName} = _bindData.GetComponentByIndex<{fieldType}>({i});");
                }
            }

            sb.AppendLine();
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        ValidateGeneratedBinds();");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    }}");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendBindEvent(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> eventInfos,
            string indent)
        {
            if (eventInfos.Count == 0)
                return;

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成事件绑定");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    protected override void BindEvent()");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    {{");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        if (_generatedEventsBound) return;");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        _generatedEventsBound = true;");
            sb.AppendLine();

            string currentField = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < eventInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                GeneratedEventInfo e = eventInfos[i];

                if (currentField != e.FieldName)
                {
                    if (currentField != null)
                        sb.AppendLine();

                    currentField = e.FieldName;
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        if ({e.FieldName} != null)");
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {{");
                }

                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}            {e.AddLine}");

                bool nextSameField = i + 1 < eventInfos.Count && eventInfos[i + 1].FieldName == currentField;
                if (!nextSameField)
                {
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        }}");
                }
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    }}");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendUnbindEvent(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> eventInfos,
            string indent)
        {
            if (eventInfos.Count == 0)
                return;

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成事件解绑");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    protected override void UnbindEvent()");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    {{");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        if (!_generatedEventsBound) return;");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        _generatedEventsBound = false;");
            sb.AppendLine();

            string currentField = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < eventInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                GeneratedEventInfo e = eventInfos[i];

                if (currentField != e.FieldName)
                {
                    if (currentField != null)
                        sb.AppendLine();

                    currentField = e.FieldName;
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        if ({e.FieldName} != null)");
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {{");
                }

                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}            {e.RemoveLine}");

                bool nextSameField = i + 1 < eventInfos.Count && eventInfos[i + 1].FieldName == currentField;
                if (!nextSameField)
                {
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        }}");
                }
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    }}");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendValidateGeneratedBinds(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos,
            Type targetType,
            string indent)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成绑定校验");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    private void ValidateGeneratedBinds()");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    {{");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}#if UNITY_EDITOR");

            // 用 (引用是否为空, 字段名) 数组循环校验，避免绑定数量多时生成大量重复的 if 行。
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        var __checks = new (bool isNull, string name)[]");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {{");

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}            ({info.fieldName} == null, \"{info.fieldName}\"),");
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        }};");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        for (int __i = 0; __i < __checks.Length; __i++)");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {{");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}            if (__checks[__i].isNull)");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}                Debug.LogError($\"[{targetType.Name}] UI bind failed : {{__checks[__i].name}}\", this);");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        }}");

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}#endif");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    }}");
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendEventWrappersAndPartials(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> eventInfos,
            string indent)
        {
            if (eventInfos.Count == 0)
                return;

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成事件包装方法");

            for (int i = 0; i < eventInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                GeneratedEventInfo e = eventInfos[i];

                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    private void {e.WrapperName}({e.ParameterSignature})");
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    {{");

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(e.ParameterCall))
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {e.PartialName}();");
                else
                    sb.AppendLine($"{indent}        {e.PartialName}({e.ParameterCall});");

                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    }}");
                sb.AppendLine();
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成业务回调 partial 方法声明");

            HashSet<string> methodKeys = new HashSet<string>();
            for (int i = 0; i < eventInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                GeneratedEventInfo e = eventInfos[i];
                string key = e.PartialName + "|" + e.ParameterSignature;
                if (!methodKeys.Add(key))
                    continue;

                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    partial void {e.PartialName}({e.ParameterSignature});");
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendWidgetBindPartials(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos,
            string indent)
        {
            bool hasWidget = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                if (bindInfos[i].isWidget)
                {
                    hasWidget = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!hasWidget)
                return;

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成 Widget 绑定回调 partial 方法声明");

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                if (!info.isWidget)
                    continue;

                string fieldType = GetFieldTypeDisplayName(info);
                sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    partial void OnBind{ToPascalCase(info.fieldName)}({fieldType} widget);");
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendHelperMethods(
            StringBuilder sb,
            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos,
            string indent)
        {
            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #region 自动生成常用 UI 辅助方法");

            HashSet<string> generatedMethods = new HashSet<string>();

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                if (info == null)
                    continue;

                Type t = ResolveBindInfoType(info);
                string fieldName = info.fieldName;
                string pascal = ToPascalCase(fieldName);

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
                    continue;

                // GameObject 显隐
                if (IsGameObjectType(t) || IsComponentType(t) || info.isWidget)
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Visible", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Visible(bool visible)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {GetGameObjectExpression(fieldName, t, info)}.SetActive(visible);
    }}");
                }

                if (IsEnableableComponentType(t))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Enabled", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Enabled(bool enabled)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.enabled = enabled;
    }}");
                }

                // Text / TMP_Text
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.Text") ||
                    IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "TMPro.TMP_Text"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Text", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Text(string value)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.text = value ?? string.Empty;
    }}");
                }

                // InputField / TMP_InputField
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.InputField") ||
                    IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "TMPro.TMP_InputField"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Text", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Text(string value)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.text = value ?? string.Empty;
    }}");

                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Get{pascal}Text", $@"
    protected string Get{pascal}Text()
    {{
        return {fieldName} != null ? {fieldName}.text : string.Empty;
    }}");
                }

                // Image
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.Image"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Sprite", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Sprite(Sprite sprite)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.sprite = sprite;
    }}");

                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Color", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Color(Color color)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.color = color;
    }}");
                }

                // RawImage
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.RawImage"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Texture", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Texture(Texture texture)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.texture = texture;
    }}");

                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Color", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Color(Color color)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.color = color;
    }}");
                }

                // Toggle
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.Toggle"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}IsOn", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}IsOn(bool isOn, bool notify = true)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} == null) return;

        if (notify)
            {fieldName}.isOn = isOn;
        else
            {fieldName}.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(isOn);
    }}");
                }

                // Slider / Scrollbar
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.Slider") ||
                    IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.Scrollbar"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Value", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Value(float value, bool notify = true)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} == null) return;

        if (notify)
            {fieldName}.value = value;
        else
            {fieldName}.SetValueWithoutNotify(value);
    }}");
                }

                // Dropdown / TMP_Dropdown
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.UI.Dropdown") ||
                    IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "TMPro.TMP_Dropdown"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Value", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Value(int value, bool notify = true)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} == null) return;

        if (notify)
            {fieldName}.value = value;
        else
            {fieldName}.SetValueWithoutNotify(value);
    }}");
                }

                // CanvasGroup
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.CanvasGroup"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}CanvasVisible", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}CanvasVisible(bool visible)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} == null) return;

        {fieldName}.alpha = visible ? 1f : 0f;
        {fieldName}.interactable = visible;
        {fieldName}.blocksRaycasts = visible;
    }}");

                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}Interactable", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}Interactable(bool interactable)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} == null) return;

        {fieldName}.interactable = interactable;
        {fieldName}.blocksRaycasts = interactable;
    }}");
                }

                // RectTransform
                if (IsTypeOrSubclass(t, "UnityEngine.RectTransform"))
                {
                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}AnchoredPosition", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}AnchoredPosition(Vector2 anchoredPosition)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.anchoredPosition = anchoredPosition;
    }}");

                    AppendUniqueMethod(generatedMethods, sb, indent, $"Set{pascal}SizeDelta", $@"
    protected void Set{pascal}SizeDelta(Vector2 sizeDelta)
    {{
        if ({fieldName} != null)
            {fieldName}.sizeDelta = sizeDelta;
    }}");
                }
            }

            sb.AppendLine($"{indent}    #endregion");
            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static void AppendUniqueMethod(
            HashSet<string> generatedMethods,
            StringBuilder sb,
            string indent,
            string methodName,
            string rawMethodCode)
        {
            if (!generatedMethods.Add(methodName))
                return;

            string[] lines = rawMethodCode.Trim('\r', '\n').Split(new[] { "\r\n", "\n" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
            for (int i = 0; i < lines.Length; i++)
            {
                sb.AppendLine(indent + lines[i]);
            }

            sb.AppendLine();
        }

        private static string GetGameObjectExpression(string fieldName, Type t, UIBindInfo info)
        {
            if (IsGameObjectType(t))
                return fieldName;

            return $"{fieldName}.gameObject";
        }

        private static List<GeneratedEventInfo> CollectGeneratedEvents(List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos)
        {
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> result = new List<GeneratedEventInfo>();

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                if (info == null || info.isWidget)
                    continue;

                Type t = ResolveBindInfoType(info);
                if (t == null)
                    continue;

                AppendEventsForType(result, t, info.fieldName);
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static void AppendEventsForType(List<GeneratedEventInfo> list, Type type, string fieldName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
                return;

            string pascal = ToPascalCase(fieldName);

            if (IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.Button"))
            {
                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "Click",
                    $"{fieldName}.onClick.AddListener(OnClick{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onClick.RemoveListener(OnClick{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnClick{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnClick{pascal}",
                    "",
                    "");
                return;
            }

            if (IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.Toggle"))
            {
                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "ValueChanged",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.AddListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}",
                    "bool value",
                    "value");
                return;
            }

            if (IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.Slider") ||
                IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.Scrollbar"))
            {
                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "ValueChanged",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.AddListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}",
                    "float value",
                    "value");
                return;
            }

            if (IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.Dropdown") ||
                IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "TMPro.TMP_Dropdown"))
            {
                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "ValueChanged",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.AddListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}",
                    "int value",
                    "value");
                return;
            }

            if (IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.InputField") ||
                IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "TMPro.TMP_InputField"))
            {
                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "ValueChanged",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.AddListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}",
                    "string value",
                    "value");

                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "EndEdit",
                    $"{fieldName}.onEndEdit.AddListener(OnEndEdit{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onEndEdit.RemoveListener(OnEndEdit{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnEndEdit{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnEndEdit{pascal}",
                    "string value",
                    "value");
                return;
            }

            if (IsTypeOrSubclass(type, "UnityEngine.UI.ScrollRect"))
            {
                AddEvent(list, fieldName, "ValueChanged",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.AddListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"{fieldName}.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated);",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}Generated",
                    $"OnValueChanged{pascal}",
                    "Vector2 value",
                    "value");
            }
        }

        private static void AddEvent(
            List<GeneratedEventInfo> list,
            string fieldName,
            string eventName,
            string addLine,
            string removeLine,
            string wrapperName,
            string partialName,
            string parameterSignature,
            string parameterCall)
        {
            list.Add(new GeneratedEventInfo
            {
                FieldName = fieldName,
                EventName = eventName,
                AddLine = addLine,
                RemoveLine = removeLine,
                WrapperName = wrapperName,
                PartialName = partialName,
                ParameterSignature = parameterSignature,
                ParameterCall = parameterCall
            });
        }

        private static List<UIBindInfo> CreateBindInfos(UIBindData bindData)
        {
            List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos = new List<UIBindInfo>();
            for (int i = 0; i < bindData.BindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                if (bindData.BindInfos[i] != null)
                    bindInfos.Add(bindData.BindInfos[i]);
            }

            return bindInfos;
        }

        private static bool HasSameOrder(IReadOnlyList<UIBindInfo> current, List<UIBindInfo> sorted)
        {
            if (current == null || current.Count != sorted.Count)
                return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < current.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!ReferenceEquals(current[i], sorted[i]))
                    return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        private static HashSet<string> CollectUsingNamespaces(List<UIBindInfo> bindInfos, Type targetType)
        {
            HashSet<string> set = new HashSet<string>();

            set.Add("UnityEngine");

            for (int i = 0; i < bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindInfos[i];
                if (info == null)
                    continue;

                Type t = ResolveBindInfoType(info);
                if (t != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(t.Namespace))
                {
                    set.Add(t.Namespace);
                }
            }

            if (targetType.Namespace == "FRFrame")
            {
                set.Remove("FRFrame");
            }

            return set;
        }

        private static Type ResolveBindInfoType(UIBindInfo info)
        {
            if (info == null)
                return null;

            if (info.isWidget)
            {
                return UIBindEditorUtility.FindType(info.widgetTypeName);
            }

            return UIBindEditorUtility.FindType(info.typeName);
        }

        private static string GetFieldTypeDisplayName(UIBindInfo info)
        {
            Type t = ResolveBindInfoType(info);
            if (t != null)
            {
                return GetFriendlyTypeName(t);
            }

            if (info.isWidget && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.widgetTypeName))
            {
                int dot = info.widgetTypeName.LastIndexOf('.');
                return dot >= 0 ? info.widgetTypeName.Substring(dot + 1) : info.widgetTypeName;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.typeName))
                return "GameObject";

            int lastDot = info.typeName.LastIndexOf('.');
            return lastDot >= 0 ? info.typeName.Substring(lastDot + 1) : info.typeName;
        }

        private static string GetFriendlyTypeName(Type type)
        {
            if (type == null)
                return "object";

            if (!type.IsGenericType)
                return type.Name;

            string typeName = type.Name;
            int backtickIndex = typeName.IndexOf('`');
            if (backtickIndex >= 0)
                typeName = typeName.Substring(0, backtickIndex);

            Type[] args = type.GetGenericArguments();
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.Append(typeName);
            sb.Append("<");
            for (int i = 0; i < args.Length; i++)
            {
                if (i > 0)
                    sb.Append(", ");

                sb.Append(GetFriendlyTypeName(args[i]));
            }
            sb.Append(">");
            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private static MonoScript FindTargetMonoScript(UIBindData bindData)
        {
            if (bindData.TargetScript != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bindData.TargetScript.FullTypeName))
            {
                Type t = UIBindEditorUtility.FindType(bindData.TargetScript.FullTypeName);
                if (t != null)
                {
                    string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets($"t:MonoScript {t.Name}");
                    for (int i = 0; i < guids.Length; i++)
                    {
                        string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guids[i]);
                        MonoScript ms = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<MonoScript>(path);
                        if (ms != null && ms.GetClass() == t)
                            return ms;
                    }
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static bool ValidateBindData(UIBindData bindData)
        {
            bool valid = true;
            HashSet<string> fieldNames = new HashSet<string>();
            HashSet<string> bindingKeys = new HashSet<string>();

            for (int i = 0; i < bindData.BindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                UIBindInfo info = bindData.BindInfos[i];
                if (info == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] BindInfo null, index: {i}");
                    valid = false;
                    continue;
                }

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(info.fieldName))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] FieldName empty, index: {i}");
                    valid = false;
                }
                else if (!fieldNames.Add(info.fieldName))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Duplicate fieldName: {info.fieldName}, index: {i}");
                    valid = false;
                }

                if (info.target == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Target null, field: {info.fieldName}, index: {i}");
                    valid = false;
                }

                if (info.isWidget)
                {
                    Type widgetType = UIBindEditorUtility.FindType(info.widgetTypeName);
                    if (widgetType == null)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Widget type not found: {info.widgetTypeName}, field: {info.fieldName}");
                        valid = false;
                    }
                    else if (!UIBindEditorUtility.IsWidgetType(widgetType))
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Type is not UIWidget: {info.widgetTypeName}, field: {info.fieldName}");
                        valid = false;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    Type type = UIBindEditorUtility.FindType(info.typeName);
                    if (type == null)
                    {
                        Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Bind type not found: {info.typeName}, field: {info.fieldName}");
                        valid = false;
                    }
                    else if (type != typeof(GameObject) && info.target != null)
                    {
                        Component component = UIBindEditorUtility.ResolveComponent(info.target, type);
                        if (component == null)
                        {
                            Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Component missing: {type.Name}, target: {info.target.name}, field: {info.fieldName}");
                            valid = false;
                        }
                    }
                }

                string key = info.target != null
                    ? info.target.GetInstanceID() + "|" + (info.isWidget ? info.widgetTypeName : info.typeName)
                    : string.Empty;

                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) && !bindingKeys.Add(key))
                {
                    Debug.LogError($"[UICodeGenerator] Duplicate binding: {key}, field: {info.fieldName}");
                    valid = false;
                }
            }

            return valid;
        }

        private static bool IsGameObjectType(Type t)
        {
            return t == typeof(GameObject);
        }

        private static bool IsComponentType(Type t)
        {
            return t != null && typeof(Component).IsAssignableFrom(t);
        }

        private static bool IsEnableableComponentType(Type t)
        {
            return t != null && typeof(Behaviour).IsAssignableFrom(t);
        }

        private static bool IsTypeOrSubclass(Type type, string fullName)
        {
            if (type == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullName))
                return false;

            Type current = type;
            while (current != null)
            {
                if (current.FullName == fullName)
                    return true;

                current = current.BaseType;
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string ToPascalCase(string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
                return string.Empty;

            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(value.Length);
            bool upperNext = true;

            for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = value[i];

                if (c == '_' || c == '-' || c == ' ')
                {
                    upperNext = true;
                    continue;
                }

                if (sb.Length == 0)
                {
                    sb.Append(char.ToUpperInvariant(c));
                    upperNext = false;
                    continue;
                }

                if (upperNext)
                {
                    sb.Append(char.ToUpperInvariant(c));
                    upperNext = false;
                }
                else
                {
                    sb.Append(c);
                }
            }

            return sb.ToString();
        }
    }
}
#endif

using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed class BannerLabWidget : RuntimeLabWidget
    {
        private UIInfiniteCarousel _carousel;
        private GameObject _template;
        private Text _status;
        private readonly List<BannerData> _all = new List<BannerData>();
        private bool _paused;
        private float _interval = 2f;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            Root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform bar = Toolbar(Root, 68);
            Button(bar, "Previous", () => _carousel.Previous());
            Button(bar, "Next", () => _carousel.Next());
            Button(bar, "MoveTo 3", () => _carousel.MoveToIndex(2));
            Button(bar, "暂停/继续", TogglePause);
            Button(bar, "间隔 +/-", ChangeInterval);
            Button(bar, "切换 1/2/5 项", ChangeCount);
            _status = Label(bar, "", 12, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter);
            RectTransform viewport = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "BannerViewport",
                Root,
                new Color(.03f, .04f, .07f, 1)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                viewport,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(90, 45),
                new Vector2(-90, -100)
            );
            viewport.gameObject.AddComponent<RectMask2D>();
            RectTransform content = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel("Content", viewport, Color.clear);
            ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(content.gameObject);
            _template = Template("BannerCardPrefab", new Color(.18f, .28f, .48f));
            Text templateText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText(
                "Label",
                _template.transform,
                "",
                20,
                TextAnchor.MiddleCenter,
                Color.white
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(templateText.gameObject);
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
                _all.Add(new BannerData { Title = "限时活动 " + (i + 1), Reward = (i + 1) * 500 });
            _carousel = viewport.gameObject.AddComponent<UIInfiniteCarousel>();
            _carousel.Configure(viewport, content, _template, 5);
            AddUIEvent(
                _carousel.onIndexChanged,
                i =>
                {
                    Status();
                    Emit("Banner CurrentIndex=" + i);
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _carousel.onSettled,
                i =>
                {
                    Status();
                    Emit("Banner settled=" + i);
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _carousel.onItemClicked,
                c =>
                {
                    if (c.IsCenter)
                    {
                        BannerData d = (BannerData)c.Data;
                        Emit($"点击中心活动：{d.Title}，奖励 {d.Reward}");
                    }
                    else
                        Emit("旁卡点击：可拖动或 Previous/Next 切到中心");
                }
            );
            SetCount(5);
            _carousel.SetAutoPlay(true, _interval);
            Status();
        }

        protected override void OnShow(object userData)
        {
            if (_paused)
                _carousel.PauseAutoPlay();
            else
                _carousel.ResumeAutoPlay();
        }

        protected override void OnHide()
        {
            _carousel?.PauseAutoPlay();
        }

        protected override void OnDispose()
        {
            if (_template != null)
                Object.Destroy(_template);
        }

        private void Bind(UIInfiniteCarouselItemContext c)
        {
            BannerData d = (BannerData)c.Data;
            Text t = c.Slot.GetComponentInChildren<Text>();
            t.text =
                $"{d.Title}\n累计登录奖励 {d.Reward}\n{(c.IsCenter ? "点击查看详情" : "旁卡")}";
            Image image = c.Slot.GetComponent<Image>();
            image.color = c.IsCenter ? new Color(.20f, .55f, .90f) : new Color(.12f, .18f, .28f);
            c.RectTransform.localScale = c.IsCenter ? Vector3.one : Vector3.one * .82f;
        }

        private void TogglePause()
        {
            _paused = !_paused;
            if (_paused)
                _carousel.PauseAutoPlay();
            else
                _carousel.ResumeAutoPlay();
            Emit("自动轮播暂停=" + _paused);
            Status();
        }

        private void ChangeInterval()
        {
            _interval = _interval >= 3f ? 1f : _interval + 1f;
            _carousel.SetAutoPlay(true, _interval);
            if (_paused)
                _carousel.PauseAutoPlay();
            Emit("轮播间隔=" + _interval + "s");
            Status();
        }

        private void ChangeCount()
        {
            int next =
                _carousel.Count == 5 ? 1
                : _carousel.Count == 1 ? 2
                : 5;
            SetCount(next);
            Emit("动态 Banner 数量=" + next);
        }

        private void SetCount(int count)
        {
            _carousel.SetData(_all.GetRange(0, count), Bind);
            Status();
        }

        private void Status()
        {
            if (_status != null && _carousel != null)
                _status.text =
                    $"count={_carousel.Count} CurrentIndex={_carousel.CurrentIndex}\nIsSettling={_carousel.IsSettling} interval={_interval:F0}s paused={_paused}";
        }
    }

    public sealed class BannerData
    {
        public string Title;
        public int Reward;
    }
}

        private static Texture2D Gradient()
        {
            Texture2D t = new Texture2D(96, 48);
            for (int y = 0; y < t.height; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < t.width; x++)
                t.SetPixel(
                    x,
                    y,
                    Color.Lerp(new Color(.1f, .55f, 1), new Color(1, .45f, .1f), x / 95f)
                );
            t.Apply();
            return t;
        }

            Text hidden = Label(_uguiRoot, "UGUI Text 隐藏组（includeInactive=true）", 15);
            hidden.gameObject.SetActive(false);
            RectTransform tmpRoot = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "TMPControl",
                Root,
                new Color(.13f, .08f, .14f, 1)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                tmpRoot,
                new Vector2(.64f, .08f),
                new Vector2(1, 1),
                new Vector2(6, 10),
                new Vector2(-12, -86)
            );
            TMP_Text tmp = ExampleUIFactory.CreateTmpText(
                "TMP",
                tmpRoot,
                "TMP 对照组\nTMP_Text 使用 TMP FontAsset，明确不属于 UIFontTextureRefresh 扫描/刷新范围。",
                16,
                TextAlignmentOptions.Center,
                Color.white
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(tmp.gameObject);
            _fontA = ExampleUIFactory.DefaultFont;
            _fontB = Resources.GetBuiltinResource<Font>("LegacyRuntime.ttf");
            if (_fontB == null)
                _fontB = _fontA;
            _refresh = gameObject.AddComponent<UIFontTextureRefresh>();
            _refresh.targetRoot = _uguiRoot;
            _refresh.includeInactive = true;
            _refresh.RebuildTargets();
            Status("A/B 均为非空内置字体引用（可指向同一 Font 实例）");
        }

        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (_refresh != null)
                Status(null);
        }

        private void CreateBatch()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++)
            {
                Text text = Label(_uguiRoot, $"动态 Text #{++_batch}", 12);
                RectTransform r = text.rectTransform;
                r.anchorMin = r.anchorMax = new Vector2(.05f, .1f);
                r.sizeDelta = new Vector2(160, 18);
                r.anchoredPosition = new Vector2((_batch % 3) * 170, (_batch / 3) * 20);
                text.font = i % 2 == 0 ? _fontA : _fontB;
            }
            _refresh.RebuildTargets();
            Status("创建 6 个 UGUI Text 后 RebuildTargets");
        }

        private void Status(string note)
        {
            if (_status == null || _refresh == null)
                return;
            _status.text =
                $"PendingFontCount={_refresh.PendingFontCount} Scanned={_refresh.LastScannedCount}\nRefreshed={_refresh.LastRefreshedCount} · TMP 不属于组件";
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(note))
                Emit(note);
        }
    }
}
