````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed class GuildChatLabWidget : RuntimeLabWidget
    {
        private readonly ChatSource _source = new ChatSource();
        private readonly List<GameObject> _templates = new List<GameObject>();
        private UIDynamicVirtualList _list;
        private Text _stats;
        private long _serial = 100;
        private bool _follow = true;
        private int _created,
            _visible,
            _recycled;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            Root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform bar = Toolbar(Root, 68);
            Button(bar, "追加", () => Append(1));
            Button(bar, "批量追加", () => Append(6));
            Button(bar, "头插历史", Prepend);
            Button(bar, "展开可见", ExpandVisible);
            Button(bar, "回到底部", () => _list.ScrollToBottom());
            Button(
                bar,
                "自动跟随",
                () =>
                {
                    _follow = !_follow;
                    Emit("自动跟随=" + _follow);
                }
            );
            _stats = Label(bar, "", 11, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter);
            ScrollRect scroll = Scroll(
                Root,
                out RectTransform viewport,
                out RectTransform content,
                true
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                scroll.GetComponent<RectTransform>(),
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(10, 10),
                new Vector2(-10, -84)
            );
            GameObject self = Template("SelfMessagePrefab", new Color(.12f, .30f, .42f));
            GameObject other = Template("OtherMessagePrefab", new Color(.18f, .20f, .28f));
            GameObject system = Template("SystemMessagePrefab", new Color(.32f, .24f, .10f));
            _templates.AddRange(new[] { self, other, system });
            _list = scroll.gameObject.AddComponent<UIDynamicVirtualList>();
            _list.Configure(scroll, viewport, content, self, 5, 5, 5, 2, 30);
            _list.Initialize(OwnerForm, typeof(SelfChatItem));
            _list.ConfigureTemplates(
                new[]
                {
                    new UIVirtualListTemplate("self", self, typeof(SelfChatItem)),
                    new UIVirtualListTemplate("other", other, typeof(OtherChatItem)),
                    new UIVirtualListTemplate("system", system, typeof(SystemChatItem)),
                }
            );
            _list.AnchorMode = UIVirtualListAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
            _list.SizeAnchorMode = UIDynamicSizeAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
            _list.SetSizeProvider((i, d) => ((ChatData)d).Height);
            AddUIEvent(
                _list.onItemCreated,
                _ =>
                {
                    _created++;
                    Stats();
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _list.onItemVisible,
                (_, __) =>
                {
                    _visible++;
                    Stats();
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _list.onItemRecycled,
                (_, __) =>
                {
                    _recycled++;
                    Stats();
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(_list.onVisibleRangeChanged, (_, __) => Stats());
            for (int i = 0; i < 45; i++)
                _source.Items.Add(
                    Make(
                        i % 9 == 0 ? "system"
                            : i % 2 == 0 ? "self"
                            : "other",
                        "消息 " + (i + 1) + "：公会远征准备中"
                    )
                );
            _list.SetDataSource(_source);
            _list.ScrollToBottom(false);
            Stats();
        }

        protected override void OnDispose()
        {
            foreach (GameObject go in _templates)
                if (go != null)
                    UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(go);
        }

        protected override void OnShow(object userData)
        {
            Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases();
            _list?.ForceRefresh();
        }

        private ChatData Make(string type, string text) =>
            new ChatData
            {
                Key = ++_serial,
                Type = type,
                Text = text,
                Height = type == "system" ? 42 : 58,
            };

        private void Append(int count)
        {
            bool wasEnd = _list.IsAtEnd();
            int start = _source.Count;
            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                _source.Items.Add(
                    Make(
                        i % 5 == 4 ? "system"
                            : i % 2 == 0 ? "self"
                            : "other",
                        "新消息 #" + _serial
                    )
                );
            _list.AnchorMode = UIVirtualListAnchorMode.FollowEndIfAtEnd;
            _list.InsertRange(start, count);
            _list.AnchorMode = UIVirtualListAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
            if (_follow && wasEnd)
                _list.ScrollToBottom();
            Emit($"增量追加 {count} 条；追加前 IsAtEnd={wasEnd}，follow={_follow}");
            Stats();
        }

        private void Prepend()
        {
            var history = new List<ChatData>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
                history.Add(Make(i == 0 ? "system" : "other", "历史消息 -" + (8 - i)));
            _source.Items.InsertRange(0, history);
            _list.AnchorMode = UIVirtualListAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
            _list.InsertRange(0, history.Count);
            Emit("头插 8 条历史，PreserveFirstVisibleKey 保持阅读锚点");
            Stats();
        }

        private void ExpandVisible()
        {
            _list.GetVisibleRange(out int start, out int end);
            if (start < 0)
                return;
            _list.BeginSizeUpdate();
            for (int i = start; i <= end; i++)
            {
                ChatData d = _source.Items[i];
                d.Expanded = !d.Expanded;
                d.Height = d.Expanded ? 104 : (d.Type == "system" ? 42 : 58);
                _list.RefreshItem(i);
                _list.NotifyItemSizeChanged(i, d.Height);
            }
            _list.EndSizeUpdate();
            Emit($"批量尺寸 API：展开可见 [{start},{end}]，锚点模式={_list.SizeAnchorMode}");
            Stats();
        }

        private void Stats()
        {
            if (_stats == null || _list == null)
                return;
            long? key = _list.GetFirstVisibleKey();
            _stats.text =
                $"created={_created} visible={_visible} recycled={_recycled}\nfirstKey={key?.ToString() ?? "-"} IsAtEnd={_list.IsAtEnd()} anchor={_list.AnchorMode}/{_list.SizeAnchorMode}";
        }
    }

    public sealed class ChatData
    {
        public long Key;
        public string Type;
        public string Text;
        public float Height;
        public bool Expanded;
    }

    public sealed class ChatSource : IUIVirtualListDataSource
    {
        public readonly List<ChatData> Items = new List<ChatData>();
        public int Count => Items.Count;

        public long GetKey(int i) => Items[i].Key;

        public object GetData(int i) => Items[i];

        public string GetTemplateId(int i) => Items[i].Type;
    }

    public abstract class ChatLabItem : UIItem<ChatData>
    {
        private Text _text;
        private int _visible,
            _recycled;
        protected abstract string Side { get; }

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            _text = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText(
                "Message",
                transform,
                "",
                13,
                TextAnchor.MiddleLeft,
                Color.white
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                _text.rectTransform,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(12, 4),
                new Vector2(-12, -4)
            );
        }

        protected override void OnSetData(int i, ChatData d)
        {
            Draw(d);
        }

        protected override void OnItemVisible(int i, ChatData d)
        {
            _visible++;
            Draw(d);
        }

        protected override void OnItemRecycled(int i, ChatData d)
        {
            _recycled++;
        }

        private void Draw(ChatData d)
        {
            if (d != null && _text != null)
                _text.text =
                    $"[{Side}] Key={d.Key} · {d.Text}{(d.Expanded ? "\n已展开：战术坐标与成员状态详情" : "")}\n复用 visible={_visible} recycled={_recycled}";
        }
    }

    public sealed class SelfChatItem : ChatLabItem
    {
        protected override string Side => "self";
    }

    public sealed class OtherChatItem : ChatLabItem
    {
        protected override string Side => "other";
    }

    public sealed class SystemChatItem : ChatLabItem
    {
        protected override string Side => "system";
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed class InventoryLabWidget : RuntimeLabWidget
    {
        private readonly InventorySource _source = new InventorySource();
        private readonly List<GameObject> _templates = new List<GameObject>();
        private UIVirtualList _list;
        private ScrollRect _scroll;
        private RectTransform _viewport;
        private RectTransform _content;
        private GameObject _materialTemplate;
        private Text _stats;
        private long _selected;
        private int _created,
            _visible,
            _recycled;
        private long _serial = 5000;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            Root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform bar = Toolbar(Root, 68f);
            Button(bar, "随机获得", AddLoot);
            Button(bar, "删除选中", DeleteSelected);
            Button(bar, "品质排序", () => Sort(true));
            Button(bar, "数量排序", () => Sort(false));
            Button(bar, "移到最前", MoveFirst);
            Button(bar, "过滤低品质", Filter);
            Button(bar, "ScrollToKey", ScrollSelected);
            _stats = Label(bar, "", 11, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter);
            _scroll = Scroll(
                Root,
                out _viewport,
                out _content,
                true
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                _scroll.GetComponent<RectTransform>(),
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(10, 10),
                new Vector2(-10, -84)
            );
            _materialTemplate = Template("MaterialPrefab", new Color(.12f, .30f, .35f));
            GameObject equipment = Template("EquipmentPrefab", new Color(.28f, .17f, .38f));
            _templates.AddRange(new[] { _materialTemplate, equipment });
            _content.anchorMax = new Vector2(0f, 1f);
            Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases();
            _list = _scroll.gameObject.AddComponent<UIVirtualList>();
            ConfigureGrid();
            _list.Initialize(OwnerForm, typeof(InventoryMaterialItem));
            _list.ConfigureTemplates(
                new[]
                {
                    new UIVirtualListTemplate(
                        "material",
                        _materialTemplate,
                        typeof(InventoryMaterialItem),
                        20
                    ),
                    new UIVirtualListTemplate(
                        "equipment",
                        equipment,
                        typeof(InventoryEquipmentItem),
                        20
                    ),
                    new UIVirtualListTemplate(
                        "header",
                        _materialTemplate,
                        typeof(InventoryHeaderItem),
                        4
                    ),
                }
            );
            _list.AnchorMode = UIVirtualListAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
            AddUIEvent(
                _list.onItemCreated,
                _ =>
                {
                    _created++;
                    UpdateStats();
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _list.onItemVisible,
                (_, item) =>
                {
                    _visible++;
                    BindSelect(item);
                    UpdateStats();
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _list.onItemRecycled,
                (_, __) =>
                {
                    _recycled++;
                    UpdateStats();
                }
            );
            _source.Reset();
            _list.SetDataSource(_source);
            UpdateStats();
        }

        protected override void OnDispose()
        {
            foreach (GameObject go in _templates)
                if (go != null)
                    UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(go);
        }

        protected override void OnShow(object userData)
        {
            Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases();
            ConfigureGrid();
            _list?.ForceRefresh();
        }

        private void ConfigureGrid()
        {
            if (_list == null || _scroll == null || _viewport == null || _content == null || _materialTemplate == null)
                return;

            const int columns = 5;
            const float horizontalSpacing = 8f;
            const float horizontalPadding = 10f;
            float availableWidth = Mathf.Max(1f, _viewport.rect.width - horizontalPadding - horizontalSpacing * (columns - 1));
            float itemWidth = availableWidth / columns;
            _list.Configure(
                _scroll,
                _viewport,
                _content,
                _materialTemplate,
                UIVirtualListLayoutMode.GridVertical,
                new Vector2(itemWidth, 78f),
                new Vector2(horizontalSpacing, 8f),
                new UIVirtualListPadding
                {
                    top = 5,
                    bottom = 5,
                    left = 5,
                    right = 5,
                },
                columns,
                2,
                30
            );
        }

        private void BindSelect(UIItem item)
        {
            InventoryLabItem baseItem = item as InventoryLabItem;
            if (baseItem != null)
                baseItem.Select = key =>
                {
                    _selected = key;
                    _list.ForceRefresh();
                    Emit("选中背包 key=" + key);
                    UpdateStats();
                };
            item.SetSelected(item.Key == _selected);
        }

        private void AddLoot()
        {
            int index = Mathf.Min(1, _source.Count);
            var data = new InventoryData
            {
                Key = ++_serial,
                Name = "战利品" + _serial,
                Count = UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, 30),
                Quality = UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, 6),
                Template = UnityEngine.Random.value > .45f ? "equipment" : "material",
            };
            _source.Items.Insert(index, data);
            _list.InsertRange(index, 1);
            _selected = data.Key;
            Emit("增量 InsertRange 获得 " + data.Name);
            UpdateStats();
        }

        private void DeleteSelected()
        {
            int i = _source.Items.FindIndex(x => x.Key == _selected);
            if (i < 0)
                return;
            _source.Items.RemoveAt(i);
            _list.RemoveRange(i, 1);
            Emit("增量 RemoveRange 删除 key=" + _selected);
            _selected = 0;
            UpdateStats();
        }

        private void Sort(bool quality)
        {
            _source.Items.Sort(
                (a, b) =>
                    a.Template == "header" ? -1
                    : b.Template == "header" ? 1
                    : quality ? b.Quality.CompareTo(a.Quality)
                    : b.Count.CompareTo(a.Count)
            );
            _list.ReplaceRange(0, _source.Count);
            Emit("ReplaceRange：按" + (quality ? "品质" : "数量") + "排序，并保持首可见 key");
        }

        private void MoveFirst()
        {
            int i = _source.Items.FindIndex(x => x.Key == _selected);
            if (i <= 1)
                return;
            InventoryData d = _source.Items[i];
            _source.Items.RemoveAt(i);
            _source.Items.Insert(1, d);
            _list.Move(i, 1);
            Emit("Move：选中项移到最前");
        }

        private void Filter()
        {
            bool filtered = _source.Items.Exists(x => x.Quality < 3);
            if (filtered)
                _source.Items.RemoveAll(x => x.Template != "header" && x.Quality < 3);
            else
                _source.Reset();
            _list.ReplaceRange(0, _source.Count);
            Emit(filtered ? "过滤品质<3" : "恢复全部背包数据");
            UpdateStats();
        }

        private void ScrollSelected()
        {
            bool ok = _list.ScrollToKey(_selected, UIVirtualListAlignment.Center);
            Emit("ScrollToKey(" + _selected + ")=" + ok);
        }

        private void UpdateStats()
        {
            if (_stats != null)
                _stats.text =
                    $"data={_source.Count} created={_created} visible={_visible} recycled={_recycled}\nselected key={_selected} · PreserveFirstVisibleKey";
        }
    }

    public sealed class InventoryData
    {
        public long Key;
        public string Name;
        public int Count;
        public int Quality;
        public string Template;
    }

    public sealed class InventorySource : IUIVirtualListDataSource
    {
        public readonly List<InventoryData> Items = new List<InventoryData>();
        public int Count => Items.Count;

        public long GetKey(int i) => Items[i].Key;

        public object GetData(int i) => Items[i];

        public string GetTemplateId(int i) => Items[i].Template;

        public void Reset()
        {
            Items.Clear();
            Items.Add(
                new InventoryData
                {
                    Key = 100,
                    Name = "材料与装备",
                    Template = "header",
                }
            );
            for (int i = 0; i < 80; i++)
                Items.Add(
                    new InventoryData
                    {
                        Key = 1000 + i,
                        Name = (i % 4 == 0 ? "装备" : "素材") + " #" + (i + 1),
                        Count = i % 17 + 1,
                        Quality = i % 5 + 1,
                        Template = i % 4 == 0 ? "equipment" : "material",
                    }
                );
        }
    }

    public abstract class InventoryLabItem : UIItem<InventoryData>
    {
        protected Text Text;
        protected int Visible,
            Recycled;
        public Action<long> Select;
        protected abstract string Kind { get; }

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            Text = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText(
                "Data",
                transform,
                "",
                13,
                TextAnchor.MiddleLeft,
                Color.white
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                Text.rectTransform,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(12, 4),
                new Vector2(-8, -4)
            );
            AddPointerClick(
                gameObject,
                (g, e) => Select?.Invoke(Key),
                UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose
            );
        }

        protected override void OnSetData(int i, InventoryData d)
        {
            Draw(d);
        }

        protected override void OnItemVisible(int i, InventoryData d)
        {
            Visible++;
            Draw(d);
        }

        protected override void OnItemRecycled(int i, InventoryData d)
        {
            Recycled++;
        }

        protected override void OnSelectedChanged(bool s)
        {
            transform.localScale = s ? Vector3.one * 1.03f : Vector3.one;
        }

        private void Draw(InventoryData d)
        {
            if (d != null && Text != null)
                Text.text =
                    $"[{Kind}] Key={d.Key} · Q{d.Quality} · {d.Name} x{d.Count}\n复用 visible={Visible} recycled={Recycled}";
        }
    }

    public sealed class InventoryMaterialItem : InventoryLabItem
    {
        protected override string Kind => "material";
    }

    public sealed class InventoryEquipmentItem : InventoryLabItem
    {
        protected override string Kind => "equipment";
    }

    public sealed class InventoryHeaderItem : InventoryLabItem
    {
        protected override string Kind => "header";
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public abstract class RuntimeLabWidget : UIWidget
    {
        protected Action<string> Log;
        protected RectTransform Root;
        protected readonly Color PanelColor = new Color(0.10f, 0.12f, 0.18f, 1f);

        protected override void OnOpen(object userData)
        {
            Log = userData as Action<string>;
        }

        protected void Emit(string text)
        {
            Log?.Invoke(text);
        }

        protected void AddUIEvent<T0, T1>(UnityEvent<T0, T1> unityEvent, UnityAction<T0, T1> action)
        {
            if (unityEvent == null || action == null)
                return;

            unityEvent.AddListener(action);
            AddEventSubscription(
                new UnityEventSubscription(() => unityEvent.RemoveListener(action)),
                UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose
            );
        }

        protected Text Label(
            Transform parent,
            string text,
            int size = 13,
            TextAnchor anchor = TextAnchor.MiddleLeft
        )
        {
            return ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("Label", parent, text, size, anchor, Color.white);
        }

        protected Button Button(Transform parent, string text, Action action)
        {
            Button b = ExampleUIFactory.CreateButton(text.Replace(" ", ""), parent, text);
            b.GetComponentInChildren<Text>().fontSize = 13;
            AddButtonClick(b, () => action(), UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);
            return b;
        }

        protected RectTransform Toolbar(Transform parent, float height = 34f)
        {
            RectTransform bar = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "Toolbar",
                parent,
                new Color(0.07f, 0.09f, 0.14f, 1f)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                bar,
                new Vector2(0f, 1f),
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(8f, -height - 8f),
                new Vector2(-8f, -8f)
            );
            HorizontalLayoutGroup layout = bar.gameObject.AddComponent<HorizontalLayoutGroup>();
            layout.padding = new RectOffset(4, 4, 3, 3);
            layout.spacing = 4f;
            layout.childForceExpandWidth = true;
            layout.childForceExpandHeight = true;
            return bar;
        }

        protected ScrollRect Scroll(
            Transform parent,
            out RectTransform viewport,
            out RectTransform content,
            bool vertical = true
        )
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(
                "Scroll",
                typeof(RectTransform),
                typeof(Image),
                typeof(ScrollRect)
            );
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.035f, 0.045f, 0.07f, 1f);
            viewport = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel("Viewport", go.transform, Color.clear);
            ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(viewport.gameObject);
            viewport.gameObject.AddComponent<RectMask2D>();
            content = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel("Content", viewport, Color.clear);
            content.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 1f);
            content.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
            content.pivot = new Vector2(0f, 1f);
            content.offsetMin = content.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
            ScrollRect scroll = go.GetComponent<ScrollRect>();
            scroll.viewport = viewport;
            scroll.content = content;
            scroll.vertical = vertical;
            scroll.horizontal = !vertical;
            scroll.movementType = ScrollRect.MovementType.Clamped;
            return scroll;
        }

        protected GameObject Template(string name, Color color)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(
                name,
                typeof(RectTransform),
                typeof(CanvasRenderer),
                typeof(Image)
            );
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = color;
            go.SetActive(false);
            return go;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed class SnapPageLabWidget : RuntimeLabWidget
    {
        private UISnapScrollPage _snap;
        private RectTransform _content;
        private Text _status;
        private Coroutine _reflowCoroutine;
        private int _serial = 5;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            Root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform bar = Toolbar(Root, 68f);
            Button(bar, "Previous", () => _snap.Previous());
            Button(bar, "Next", () => _snap.Next());
            Button(
                bar,
                "快速 Next x3",
                () =>
                {
                    _snap.Next();
                    _snap.Next();
                    _snap.Next();
                }
            );
            Button(bar, "Start/Center/End", Alignment);
            Button(bar, "Clamp/Wrap", IndexMode);
            Button(bar, "+ 页面", AddPage);
            Button(bar, "- 页面", RemovePage);
            Button(bar, "改变页宽", ChangeWidth);
            _status = Label(bar, "", 11, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter);

            ScrollRect scroll = Scroll(Root, out _, out _content, false);
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                scroll.GetComponent<RectTransform>(),
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(30f, 35f),
                new Vector2(-30f, -95f)
            );
            scroll.horizontal = true;
            scroll.vertical = false;

            _content.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
            _content.anchorMax = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
            _content.pivot = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
            _content.sizeDelta = new Vector2(0f, 190f);
            HorizontalLayoutGroup layout =
                _content.gameObject.AddComponent<HorizontalLayoutGroup>();
            layout.spacing = 14f;
            layout.padding = new RectOffset(12, 12, 8, 8);
            layout.childForceExpandWidth = false;
            layout.childForceExpandHeight = true;
            _content.gameObject.AddComponent<ContentSizeFitter>().horizontalFit = ContentSizeFitter
                .FitMode
                .PreferredSize;

            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
                AddPage(130f + i * 45f);

            _snap = scroll.gameObject.AddComponent<UISnapScrollPage>();
            _snap.scrollRect = scroll;
            _snap.content = _content;
            _snap.alignment = UIPageAlignment.Center;
            _snap.indexMode = UIPageIndexMode.Clamp;
            _snap.enableCenterScale = true;
            AddUIEvent(
                _snap.onPageChanged,
                i =>
                {
                    Status();
                    Emit("SelectedPage=" + i);
                }
            );
            AddUIEvent(
                _snap.onPageSettled,
                i =>
                {
                    Status();
                    Emit("SettledPage=" + i);
                }
            );
            Reflow();
        }

        protected override void OnShow(object userData)
        {
            ScheduleReflow();
        }

        protected override void OnHide()
        {
            CancelReflow();
        }

        private void AddPage(float width)
        {
            int id = ++_serial;
            RectTransform card = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "QuestPage" + id,
                _content,
                new Color(0.12f + id % 3 * 0.06f, 0.24f, 0.38f, 1f)
            );
            LayoutElement element = card.gameObject.AddComponent<LayoutElement>();
            element.preferredWidth = width;
            element.minWidth = width;
            Text text = Label(
                card,
                $"任务章节 {id}\n实际宽度 {width:F0}\n由 HorizontalLayoutGroup 定位",
                15,
                TextAnchor.MiddleCenter
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(text.gameObject);
        }

        private void Alignment()
        {
            _snap.alignment =
                _snap.alignment == UIPageAlignment.Start ? UIPageAlignment.Center
                : _snap.alignment == UIPageAlignment.Center ? UIPageAlignment.End
                : UIPageAlignment.Start;
            Reflow();
            Emit("页面对齐=" + _snap.alignment);
        }

        private void IndexMode()
        {
            _snap.indexMode =
                _snap.indexMode == UIPageIndexMode.Clamp
                    ? UIPageIndexMode.Wrap
                    : UIPageIndexMode.Clamp;
            Emit("页索引模式=" + _snap.indexMode);
            Status();
        }

        private void AddPage()
        {
            AddPage(115f + _content.childCount * 25f);
            ScheduleReflow();
            Emit("增加页面");
        }

        private void RemovePage()
        {
            if (_content.childCount <= 2)
            {
                Emit("至少保留两个页面");
                return;
            }

            Object.Destroy(_content.GetChild(_content.childCount - 1).gameObject);
            ScheduleReflow();
            Emit("删除末尾页面");
        }

        private void ChangeWidth()
        {
            if (_content.childCount == 0)
                return;

            int index = Mathf.Clamp(_snap.SelectedPage, 0, _content.childCount - 1);
            LayoutElement element = _content.GetChild(index).GetComponent<LayoutElement>();
            element.preferredWidth =
                element.preferredWidth >= 260f ? 120f : element.preferredWidth + 55f;
            element.minWidth = element.preferredWidth;
            Reflow();
            Emit($"页面 {index} 宽度改为 {element.preferredWidth} 并 RefreshPages");
        }

        private void ScheduleReflow()
        {
            CancelReflow();
            _reflowCoroutine = StartCoroutine(ReflowNextFrame());
        }

        private void CancelReflow()
        {
            if (_reflowCoroutine == null)
                return;

            StopCoroutine(_reflowCoroutine);
            _reflowCoroutine = null;
        }

        private IEnumerator ReflowNextFrame()
        {
            yield return null;
            _reflowCoroutine = null;
            Reflow();
        }

        private void Reflow()
        {
            _snap?.RefreshPages();
            Status();
        }

        private void Status()
        {
            if (_status == null || _snap == null)
                return;

            _status.text =
                $"pages={_snap.PageCount} Selected={_snap.SelectedPage} Settled={_snap.SettledPage}\nIsSettling={_snap.IsSettling} align={_snap.alignment} mode={_snap.indexMode}";
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed class TacticalMapLabWidget : RuntimeLabWidget
    {
        private UIMeshImage _mesh;
        private Text _status;
        private Texture2D _texture;
        private int _shape;
        private readonly string[] _shapes = { "圆形", "扇形", "环形", "矩形" };

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            Root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform bar = Toolbar(Root);
            Button(bar, "命中 Rect/Triangles", ToggleRaycast);
            Button(bar, "适配 Stretch/Fit/Fill", CycleFit);
            Button(bar, "几何 圆/扇/环/矩形", CycleShape);
            _status = Label(bar, "等待点击地图", 12, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter);

            RectTransform map = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "HarborMap",
                Root,
                new Color(0.025f, 0.06f, 0.10f, 1f)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                map,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(30f, 24f),
                new Vector2(-30f, -52f)
            );
            _mesh = new GameObject(
                "SkillRange",
                typeof(RectTransform),
                typeof(CanvasRenderer),
                typeof(UIMeshImage)
            ).GetComponent<UIMeshImage>();
            _mesh.transform.SetParent(map, false);
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                _mesh.rectTransform,
                new Vector2(.15f, .1f),
                new Vector2(.85f, .9f),
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.zero
            );
            _mesh.color = new Color(1f, 1f, 1f, .86f);
            _mesh.RaycastMode = UIMeshRaycastMode.Triangles;
            _mesh.FitMode = UIMeshFitMode.Stretch;
            _texture = GradientTexture();
            _mesh.SetTexture(_texture);
            SetShape(0);
            AddPointerClick(_mesh.gameObject, OnMapClick, UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);
            Text hint = Label(
                map,
                "运行时渐变技能区：透明外部不应被 Triangles 命中",
                13,
                TextAnchor.LowerCenter
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                hint.rectTransform,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(4f, 4f),
                new Vector2(-4f, -4f)
            );
        }

        protected override void OnDispose()
        {
            if (_texture != null)
                Object.Destroy(_texture);
        }

        private void ToggleRaycast()
        {
            _mesh.RaycastMode =
                _mesh.RaycastMode == UIMeshRaycastMode.Rect
                    ? UIMeshRaycastMode.Triangles
                    : UIMeshRaycastMode.Rect;
            Emit("地图命中模式=" + _mesh.RaycastMode);
        }

        private void CycleFit()
        {
            _mesh.FitMode =
                _mesh.FitMode == UIMeshFitMode.Stretch ? UIMeshFitMode.Fit
                : _mesh.FitMode == UIMeshFitMode.Fit ? UIMeshFitMode.Fill
                : UIMeshFitMode.Stretch;
            Emit("技能区适配=" + _mesh.FitMode);
        }

        private void CycleShape()
        {
            SetShape((_shape + 1) % _shapes.Length);
            Emit("技能几何=" + _shapes[_shape]);
        }

        private void OnMapClick(GameObject go, PointerEventData evt)
        {
            RectTransformUtility.ScreenPointToLocalPointInRectangle(
                _mesh.rectTransform,
                evt.position,
                evt.pressEventCamera,
                out Vector2 local
            );
            bool hit = _mesh.Raycast(evt.position, evt.pressEventCamera);
            _status.text = $"local=({local.x:F1},{local.y:F1}) hit={hit}";
            Emit($"地图点击 local=({local.x:F1},{local.y:F1})，{_mesh.RaycastMode} hit={hit}");
        }

        private void SetShape(int shape)
        {
            _shape = shape;
            var v = new List<Vector3>();
            var uv = new List<Vector2>();
            var t = new List<int>();
            if (shape == 3)
            {
                v.AddRange(
                    new[]
                    {
                        new Vector3(-1, -.55f),
                        new Vector3(-1, .55f),
                        new Vector3(1, .55f),
                        new Vector3(1, -.55f),
                    }
                );
                uv.AddRange(new[] { Vector2.zero, Vector2.up, Vector2.one, Vector2.right });
                t.AddRange(new[] { 0, 1, 2, 2, 3, 0 });
            }
            else
            {
                int segments = 32;
                float start = shape == 1 ? -55f : 0f;
                float span = shape == 1 ? 110f : 360f;
                float inner = shape == 2 ? .52f : 0f;
                if (inner <= 0f)
                {
                    v.Add(Vector3.zero);
                    uv.Add(Vector2.one * .5f);
                    for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++)
                    {
                        float a = (start + span * i / segments) * Mathf.Deg2Rad;
                        Vector2 p = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(a), Mathf.Sin(a));
                        v.Add(p);
                        uv.Add(p * .5f + Vector2.one * .5f);
                        if (i > 0)
                            t.AddRange(new[] { 0, i, i + 1 });
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i <= segments; i++)
                    {
                        float a = span * i / segments * Mathf.Deg2Rad;
                        Vector2 p = new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(a), Mathf.Sin(a));
                        v.Add(p);
                        v.Add(p * inner);
                        uv.Add(p * .5f + Vector2.one * .5f);
                        uv.Add(p * inner * .5f + Vector2.one * .5f);
                        if (i > 0)
                        {
                            int n = i * 2;
                            t.AddRange(new[] { n - 2, n, n - 1, n, n + 1, n - 1 });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            _mesh.SetGeometry(v, uv, t);
        }

        private static Texture2D GradientTexture()
        {
            Texture2D tex = new Texture2D(96, 64, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
            tex.name = "RuntimeSkillGradient";
            for (int y = 0; y < tex.height; y++)
            for (int x = 0; x < tex.width; x++)
                tex.SetPixel(
                    x,
                    y,
                    Color.Lerp(
                        new Color(.1f, .9f, 1f, .75f),
                        new Color(1f, .2f, .12f, .9f),
                        x / (float)(tex.width - 1)
                    )
                );
            tex.Apply();
            return tex;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed partial class CurrencyWidget : UIWidget
    {
        public sealed class CurrencyData
        {
            public int Gold;
            public int Diamond;
        }

        private Text _goldText;
        private Text _diamondText;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            RectTransform root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            Image image = gameObject.GetComponent<Image>();
            if (image == null)
                image = gameObject.AddComponent<Image>();
            image.color = new Color(0.12f, 0.15f, 0.22f, 1f);

            _diamondText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("DiamondText", root, "Diamond: 0", 16, TextAnchor.MiddleLeft, new Color(0.55f, 0.9f, 1f));
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_diamondText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 1f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(12f, -66f), new Vector2(-12f, -38f));
        }

        protected override void OnRefresh(object userData)

    public sealed class ShopPageWidget : UIWidget
    {
        private readonly List<RoleItem> _items = new List<RoleItem>();
        private RectTransform _listRoot;
        private Text _titleText;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            RectTransform root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            Image image = gameObject.GetComponent<Image>();
            if (image == null)
                image = gameObject.AddComponent<Image>();
            image.color = new Color(0.08f, 0.09f, 0.13f, 1f);

            _titleText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("Title", root, "非虚拟列表 · UIWidget + UIItem 示例", 22, TextAnchor.MiddleLeft, Color.white);
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_titleText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 1f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(20f, -42f), new Vector2(-20f, -8f));

            Text hintText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("Hint", root, "这里手动创建 3 个 UIItem 卡片，用于展示子控件生命周期，不是 UIVirtualList", 14, TextAnchor.MiddleLeft, new Color(0.64f, 0.70f, 0.82f));
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(hintText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 1f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(20f, -68f), new Vector2(-20f, -44f));

            _listRoot = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel("List", root, new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0f));
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_listRoot, new Vector2(0f, 0f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(20f, 20f), new Vector2(-20f, -82f));
        }

        protected override void OnOpen(object userData)
        {
            Refresh(userData);
        }

        protected override void OnShow(object userData)
        {
            Refresh(userData);
        }

        protected override void OnRefresh(object userData)
        {
            if (!(userData is ShopTabParam param))
                return;

            _titleText.text = $"{GetTabName(param.Tab)}列表 · 非虚拟 UIItem 卡片";
            EnsureItemCount(param.Items != null ? param.Items.Count : 0);

            for (int i = 0; i < _items.Count; i++)
            {
                bool active = param.Items != null && i < param.Items.Count;
                _items[i].gameObject.SetActive(active);
                if (active)
                    _items[i].SetItemData(i, param.Items[i]);
            }
        }

        private void EnsureItemCount(int count)
        {
            while (_items.Count < count)
            {
                GameObject itemGo = new GameObject($"Item_{_items.Count}", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
                itemGo.transform.SetParent(_listRoot, false);
                RectTransform rect = itemGo.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
                rect.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 1f);
                rect.anchorMax = new Vector2(1f, 1f);
                rect.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                rect.sizeDelta = new Vector2(0f, 84f);
                rect.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0f, -_items.Count * 96f);
                Image itemImage = itemGo.GetComponent<Image>();
                itemImage.color = new Color(0.14f, 0.17f, 0.25f, 1f);
                Outline outline = itemGo.AddComponent<Outline>();
                outline.effectColor = new Color(0.36f, 0.48f, 0.70f, 0.85f);
                outline.effectDistance = new Vector2(1f, -1f);

                RoleItem item = CreateChildWidget<RoleItem>(itemGo);
                _items.Add(item);
            }
        }

        private string GetTabName(ShopTab tab)
        {
            switch (tab)
            {
                case ShopTab.Weapon:
                    return "武器";
                case ShopTab.Fashion:
                    return "时装";
                default:
                    return "道具";
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed partial class RoleItem : UIItem<ShopItemData>
    {
        private Text _nameText;
        private Text _descText;
        private Text _priceText;
        private Text _stateText;
        private Button _buyButton;
        private int _purchaseCount;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            RectTransform root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);

            _nameText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("Name", root, string.Empty, 18, TextAnchor.MiddleLeft, Color.white);
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_nameText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 1f), new Vector2(0.58f, 1f), new Vector2(18f, -34f), new Vector2(0f, -6f));

            _descText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("Desc", root, string.Empty, 14, TextAnchor.MiddleLeft, new Color(0.75f, 0.78f, 0.85f));
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_descText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 0f), new Vector2(0.66f, 1f), new Vector2(18f, 10f), new Vector2(0f, -38f));

            _priceText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("Price", root, string.Empty, 17, TextAnchor.MiddleRight, new Color(1f, 0.86f, 0.3f));
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_priceText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0.58f, 0.35f), new Vector2(0.78f, 1f), new Vector2(0f, 0f), new Vector2(-10f, 0f));

            _stateText = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText("State", root, "未购买", 13, TextAnchor.MiddleRight, new Color(0.62f, 0.78f, 1f));
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_stateText.rectTransform, new Vector2(0.58f, 0f), new Vector2(0.78f, 0.45f), new Vector2(0f, 4f), new Vector2(-10f, 0f));

            _buyButton = ExampleUIFactory.CreateButton("BuyButton", root, "购买");
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(_buyButton.GetComponent<RectTransform>(), new Vector2(1f, 0.5f), new Vector2(1f, 0.5f), new Vector2(-120f, -22f), new Vector2(-18f, 22f));
            AddButtonClick(_buyButton, OnClickBuy, UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);
            AddPointerEnter(gameObject, (go, eventData) => _descText.color = Color.white, UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);
            AddPointerExit(gameObject, (go, eventData) => _descText.color = new Color(0.75f, 0.78f, 0.85f), UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);

            UILongPressTrigger longPress = _buyButton.gameObject.AddComponent<UILongPressTrigger>();
            longPress.longPressThreshold = 0.6f;
            longPress.repeatLongPress = true;
            longPress.repeatInterval = 0.35f;
            longPress.onLongPressed.AddListener(() => FRFM.UI.Toast.Show(TypedData != null ? $"长按购买 {TypedData.Name}" : "长按购买商品"));
            longPress.onLongPressRepeated.AddListener(() => FRFM.UI.Toast.Show(TypedData != null ? $"连续购买 {TypedData.Name}" : "连续购买商品"));
        }

        protected override void OnSetData(int index, ShopItemData data)
        {
            if (data == null)
                return;

            _purchaseCount = 0;
            _nameText.text = $"{index + 1}. {data.Name}";
            _descText.text = data.Desc;
            _priceText.text = data.SoldOut ? "已售罄" : $"{data.Price}G";
            _stateText.text = data.SoldOut ? "不可购买" : "未购买";
            _stateText.color = data.SoldOut ? new Color(0.9f, 0.45f, 0.45f) : new Color(0.62f, 0.78f, 1f);
            _buyButton.interactable = !data.SoldOut;
            Text buttonText = _buyButton.GetComponentInChildren<Text>(true);
            if (buttonText != null)
                buttonText.text = data.SoldOut ? "售罄" : "购买";
            SetSelected(false);
        }

        protected override void OnSelectedChanged(bool selected)
        {
            Image image = GetComponent<Image>();
            if (image != null)
                image.color = selected ? new Color(0.22f, 0.34f, 0.52f, 1f) : new Color(0.14f, 0.17f, 0.25f, 1f);
        }

        private void OnClickBuy()
        {
            _purchaseCount++;
            SetSelected(true);
            _stateText.text = $"已购买 x{_purchaseCount}";
            _stateText.color = new Color(0.55f, 1f, 0.65f);
            _buyButton.GetComponentInChildren<Text>(true).text = "再买";
            FRFM.UI.Toast.Show(TypedData != null ? $"购买 {TypedData.Name}" : "购买商品");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    public sealed class RuntimeExtensionsExampleWidget : UIWidget
    {
        private readonly List<UIWidget> _scenes = new List<UIWidget>();
        private readonly List<string> _logEntries = new List<string>(12);
        private readonly string[] _names =
        {
            "战术地图",
            "背包整理",
            "公会聊天",
            "活动 Banner",
            "任务分页",
            "字体诊断",
            "常用交互",
        };
        private RectTransform _workspace;
        private Text _eventLog;
        private int _current = -1;

        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            RectTransform root = ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            (GetComponent<Image>() ?? gameObject.AddComponent<Image>()).color = new Color(
                0.055f,
                0.065f,
                0.095f,
                1f
            );
            Text title = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText(
                "Title",
                root,
                "UI Runtime 业务实验室",
                20,
                TextAnchor.MiddleLeft,
                Color.white
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                title.rectTransform,
                new Vector2(0f, 1f),
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(14f, -31f),
                new Vector2(-14f, -4f)
            );

            RectTransform tabs = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "SceneTabs",
                root,
                new Color(0.08f, 0.10f, 0.15f, 1f)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                tabs,
                new Vector2(0f, 1f),
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(10f, -70f),
                new Vector2(-10f, -34f)
            );
            HorizontalLayoutGroup layout = tabs.gameObject.AddComponent<HorizontalLayoutGroup>();
            layout.padding = new RectOffset(4, 4, 3, 3);
            layout.spacing = 4f;
            layout.childForceExpandWidth = true;
            layout.childForceExpandHeight = true;
            for (int i = 0; i < _names.Length; i++)
            {
                int index = i;
                Button button = ExampleUIFactory.CreateButton("Tab" + i, tabs, _names[i]);
                button.GetComponentInChildren<Text>().fontSize = 13;
                AddButtonClick(button, () => SwitchScene(index), UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);

            _workspace = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "Workspace",
                root,
                new Color(0.075f, 0.085f, 0.12f, 1f)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                _workspace,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(10f, 74f),
                new Vector2(-10f, -74f)
            );
            RectTransform logPanel = ExampleUIFactory.CreatePanel(
                "EventLog",
                root,
                new Color(0.035f, 0.045f, 0.07f, 1f)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                logPanel,
                Vector2.zero,
                new Vector2(1f, 0f),
                new Vector2(10f, 8f),
                new Vector2(-10f, 68f)
            );
            _eventLog = ExampleUIFactory.CreateText(
                "Text",
                logPanel,
                "事件日志：选择场景开始业务验收",
                12,
                TextAnchor.UpperLeft,
                new Color(0.65f, 0.82f, 1f)
            );
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(
                _eventLog.rectTransform,
                Vector2.zero,
                Vector2.one,
                new Vector2(8f, 4f),
                new Vector2(-8f, -4f)
            );

            CreateScene<TacticalMapLabWidget>("TacticalMap");
            CreateScene<InventoryLabWidget>("Inventory");
            CreateScene<GuildChatLabWidget>("GuildChat");
            CreateScene<BannerLabWidget>("Banner");
            CreateScene<SnapPageLabWidget>("SnapPage");
            CreateScene<FontRefreshLabWidget>("FontRefresh");
            CreateScene<CommonInteractionLabWidget>("CommonInteraction");
            SwitchScene(0);
        }

        protected override void OnShow(object userData)
        {
            if (_current >= 0 && _current < _scenes.Count)
                _scenes[_current].SetVisible(true);
        }

        protected override void OnHide()
        {
            if (_current >= 0 && _current < _scenes.Count && _scenes[_current].IsVisible)
                _scenes[_current].SetVisible(false);
        }

        private void CreateScene<T>(string name)
            where T : UIWidget
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
            go.transform.SetParent(_workspace, false);
            ExampleUIFactory.Stretch(go);
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = Color.clear;
            T scene = CreateChildWidget<T>(go, (System.Action<string>)Log);
            scene.SetVisible(false);
            _scenes.Add(scene);
        }

        private void SwitchScene(int index)
        {
            if (index < 0 || index >= _scenes.Count)
                return;

            if (index == _current)
            {
                if (!_scenes[index].IsVisible)
                    _scenes[index].SetVisible(true);
                return;
            }

            if (_current >= 0 && _scenes[_current].IsVisible)
                _scenes[_current].SetVisible(false);

            _current = index;
            _scenes[index].SetVisible(true);
            Log("切换场景：" + _names[index]);
        }

        private void Log(string message)
        {
            if (_eventLog == null)
                return;

            _logEntries.Insert(0, $"[{Time.unscaledTime:F1}] {message}");
            if (_logEntries.Count > 12)
                _logEntries.RemoveRange(12, _logEntries.Count - 12);
            _eventLog.text = string.Join("\n", _logEntries);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace Game.UI
{
    internal static class ExampleUIFactory
    {
        private static TMP_FontAsset _tmpFont;

        public static Font DefaultFont => Resources.GetBuiltinResource<Font>("LegacyRuntime.ttf");
        public static TMP_FontAsset DefaultTmpFont => _tmpFont != null ? _tmpFont : _tmpFont = UIBuiltinFontProvider.Font;

        public static RectTransform Stretch(GameObject go)
        {
            RectTransform rect = go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
            if (rect == null)
                rect = go.AddComponent<RectTransform>();

            rect.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
            rect.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
            rect.localScale = Vector3.one;
            return rect;
        }

        public static RectTransform CreatePanel(string name, Transform parent, Color color)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            Stretch(go);
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = color;
            return go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
        }

        public static Text CreateText(string name, Transform parent, string text, int size, TextAnchor anchor, Color color)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Text));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            Text label = go.GetComponent<Text>();
            label.font = DefaultFont;
            label.text = text;
            label.fontSize = size;
            label.alignment = anchor;
            label.color = color;
            label.raycastTarget = false;
            return label;
        }

        public static TMP_Text CreateTmpText(string name, Transform parent, string text, int size, TextAlignmentOptions alignment, Color color)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            TMP_Text label = go.GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
            if (DefaultTmpFont != null)
                label.font = DefaultTmpFont;
            label.text = text;
            label.fontSize = size;
            label.alignment = alignment;
            label.color = color;
            label.raycastTarget = false;
            return label;
        }

        public static Button CreateButton(string name, Transform parent, string text)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image), typeof(Button));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.18f, 0.28f, 0.45f, 0.95f);

            Text label = CreateText("Label", go.transform, text, 18, TextAnchor.MiddleCenter, Color.white);
            Stretch(label.gameObject);
            return go.GetComponent<Button>();
        }

        public static void SetRect(RectTransform rect, Vector2 anchorMin, Vector2 anchorMax, Vector2 offsetMin, Vector2 offsetMax)
        {
            rect.anchorMin = anchorMin;
            rect.anchorMax = anchorMax;
            rect.offsetMin = offsetMin;
            rect.offsetMax = offsetMax;
        }
````

````csharp
            _richText.RegisterLinkHandler("shop", context => FRFM.UI.Toast.Show($"打开商店入口：{context.Payload}"));

        private void CreateTabButton(string name, string text, ShopTab tab, float top)
        {
            Button button = ExampleUIFactory.CreateButton(name, _tabRoot, text);
            ExampleUIFactory.SetRect(button.GetComponent<RectTransform>(), new Vector2(0f, 1f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(16f, top - 44f), new Vector2(-16f, top));
            AddButtonClick(button, () => SwitchTab(tab), UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);
        }

        private void SwitchTab(ShopTab tab)
        {
            _showingExtensions = false;
            if (_extensionsWidget != null)
                HideWidget(_extensionsWidget);
            if (_currentPage != null)
                HideWidget(_currentPage);

            if (!_pages.TryGetValue(tab, out ShopPageWidget page) || page == null)
            {
                GameObject pageGo = new GameObject(BuildTabRootName(tab), typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
                pageGo.transform.SetParent(_listRoot, false);
                page = CreateWidget<ShopPageWidget>(pageGo, BuildTabParam(tab));
                _pages[tab] = page;
            }
            else
            {
                ShowWidget(page, BuildTabParam(tab));
            }

            _currentPage = page;
            _currentPage.Refresh(BuildTabParam(tab));
        }

        private void ShowExtensionsExample()
        {
            if (_currentPage != null)
                HideWidget(_currentPage);

            if (_extensionsWidget == null)
            {
                GameObject widgetGo = new GameObject("RuntimeExtensionsExample", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
                widgetGo.transform.SetParent(_listRoot, false);
                _extensionsWidget = CreateWidget<RuntimeExtensionsExampleWidget>(widgetGo);
            }
            else
            {
                ShowWidget(_extensionsWidget);
            }

            _showingExtensions = true;
        }

        private ShopTabParam BuildTabParam(ShopTab tab)
        {
            return new ShopTabParam
            {
                Tab = tab,
                Items = BuildItems(tab)
            };
        }

        private string BuildTabRootName(ShopTab tab)
        {
            return $"{tab}Page";
        }

        private CurrencyWidget.CurrencyData BuildCurrencyData()
        {
            return new CurrencyWidget.CurrencyData
            {
                Gold = _param != null ? _param.Gold : 0,
                Diamond = _param != null ? _param.Diamond : 0
            };
        }

        private void ToggleRichTextStyle()
        {
            _alternateRichTextStyle = !_alternateRichTextStyle;
            _richText.config.defaultLinkColor = _alternateRichTextStyle ? new Color(1f, 0.58f, 0.30f, 1f) : new Color(0.45f, 0.75f, 1f, 1f);
            _richText.config.underlineLinks = !_alternateRichTextStyle;
            _richText.Refresh();
            UpdateRichTextStatus();
        }

        private void UpdateRichTextStatus()
        {
            if (_richTextStatus == null || _richText == null)
                return;
            int warningCount = _richText.LastParseResult != null ? _richText.LastParseResult.Warnings.Count : 0;
            _richTextStatus.text = $"warning={warningCount} · cache={_richText.CacheCount}";
        }

        private string BuildRichTextExample(ShopExampleFormOpenParam openParam)
        {
            string playerName = openParam != null ? openParam.PlayerName : "Guest";
            int gold = openParam != null ? openParam.Gold : 0;
            return $"[player:10001]{playerName} 与 [player:10002]同名[player:10003]嵌套玩家[/player][/player][/player] 获得金币 x{gold}\n" +
                   "[gradient:quality5][item:2001]gradient 包裹可点击霜火长弓[/item][/gradient] · [shop:daily]商店入口[/shop] · 未知标签会转义：<script>";
        }

        private IReadOnlyList<ShopItemData> BuildItems(ShopTab tab)
        {
            switch (tab)
            {
                case ShopTab.Weapon:
                    return new[]
                    {
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "训练木剑", Desc = "适合新手的基础武器", Price = 300 },
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "霜火长弓", Desc = "带有减速效果", Price = 1800 },
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "星陨法杖", Desc = "提升技能伤害", Price = 2600, SoldOut = true }
                    };
                case ShopTab.Fashion:
                    return new[]
                    {
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "学院制服", Desc = "常驻时装", Price = 900 },
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "夏日泳装", Desc = "限定外观", Price = 2200 },
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "执事礼服", Desc = "提升魅力值", Price = 1600 }
                    };
                default:
                    return new[]
                    {
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "小型体力药", Desc = "恢复 30 点体力", Price = 120 },
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "扫荡券", Desc = "快速完成已通关副本", Price = 80 },
                        new ShopItemData { Name = "强化石", Desc = "装备强化材料", Price = 240 }
                    };
            }
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 运行时可序列化脚本引用信息。
    /// 编辑器中写入脚本类名与命名空间。
    /// </summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class MonoScriptReference
    {
        public string className;
        public string namespaceName;
        public string assemblyName;

        public string FullTypeName
        {
            get
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(namespaceName))
                    return className;
                return namespaceName + "." + className;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/UI/Runtime/Binding/UIBindData.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// UI 绑定列表的持久化排序规则。
    /// 代码生成器按相同规则重排数据，确保生成索引与运行时列表一致。
    /// </summary>
    public enum UIBindSortMode
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 按节点名称路径、组件类型优先级、字段名依次排序。
        /// </summary>
        Path = 0,

        /// <summary>
        /// 按 Hierarchy 深度优先顺序、组件类型优先级、字段名依次排序。
        /// </summary>
        Hierarchy = 1
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// UI绑定数据容器。
    /// 挂在UI prefab 根节点上，运行时按索引或字段名获取。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class UIBindData : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private MonoScriptReference _targetScript;
        [SerializeField] private UIBindSortMode _sortMode;
        [SerializeField] private List<UIBindInfo> _bindInfos = new List<UIBindInfo>();

        public MonoScriptReference TargetScript => _targetScript;
        public UIBindSortMode SortMode => _sortMode;
        public IReadOnlyList<UIBindInfo> BindInfos => _bindInfos;

        public void SetTargetScript(MonoScriptReference scriptRef)
        {
            _targetScript = scriptRef;
        }

        public void SetSortMode(UIBindSortMode sortMode)
        {
            _sortMode = sortMode;
        }

        public void SetBindInfos(List<UIBindInfo> infos)
        {
            _bindInfos = infos ?? new List<UIBindInfo>();
        }

        public int Count => _bindInfos != null ? _bindInfos.Count : 0;

        public T GetComponentByIndex<T>(int index) where T : Component
        {
            if (_bindInfos == null || index < 0 || index >= _bindInfos.Count)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UIBindData.GetComponentByIndex failed, index out of range : {index}");
                return null;
            }

            var info = _bindInfos[index];
            if (info == null)
                return null;

            if (info.component == null && info.target != null)
            {
                if (typeof(T) == typeof(Transform))
                    return info.target.transform as T;

                if (typeof(T) == typeof(RectTransform))
                    return info.target.transform as T;

                return info.target.GetComponent<T>();
            }

            return info.component as T;
        }

        public GameObject GetGameObjectByIndex(int index)
        {
            if (_bindInfos == null || index < 0 || index >= _bindInfos.Count)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UIBindData.GetGameObjectByIndex failed, index out of range : {index}");
                return null;
            }

            return _bindInfos[index]?.target;
        }

        public bool TryGetBindInfo(string fieldName, out UIBindInfo info)
        {
            info = null;
            if (_bindInfos == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
                return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < _bindInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                var item = _bindInfos[i];
                if (item != null && item.fieldName == fieldName)
                {
                    info = item;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    internal static class UIBuiltinFontProvider
    {
        private const string DefaultFontLocation = "Assets/GameRes/Common/Font/font_main_zht SDF.asset";
        private static TMP_FontAsset _font;
        private static UniTask<TMP_FontAsset> _loadingTask;
        private static bool _hasLoadingTask;

        public static TMP_FontAsset Font => _font;

        public static UniTask<TMP_FontAsset> PreloadDefaultFontAsync()
        {
            if (_font != null)
                return UniTask.FromResult(_font);

            if (_hasLoadingTask)
                return _loadingTask;

            _hasLoadingTask = true;
            _loadingTask = LoadDefaultFontAsync();
            return _loadingTask;
        }

        private static async UniTask<TMP_FontAsset> LoadDefaultFontAsync()
        {
            if (FRFM.Resource == null)
                return null;

            _font = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<TMP_FontAsset>(DefaultFontLocation, new ResourceLoadOptions
            {
                PackageName = "DefaultPackage",
                Residency = ResourceResidency.Resident,
                AllowCache = true,
                TrackReference = true
            });
            return _font;
        }

        public static void Apply(TMP_Text text)
        {
            if (text != null && _font != null)
                text.font = _font;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    internal static class UIBuiltinViewFactory
    {
        /// <summary>创建全屏拉伸 RectTransform，用于纯代码窗口根节点。</summary>
        public static RectTransform Stretch(GameObject go)
        {
            RectTransform rect = go.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
            if (rect == null)
                rect = go.AddComponent<RectTransform>();

            rect.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
            rect.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
            rect.localScale = Vector3.one;
            return rect;
        }

        public static RectTransform CreatePanel(string name, Transform parent, Color color)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            RectTransform rect = Stretch(go);
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = color;
            return rect;
        }

        public static TextMeshProUGUI CreateText(string name, Transform parent, string text, float size, TextAlignmentOptions alignment, Color color)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(TextMeshProUGUI));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            TextMeshProUGUI label = go.GetComponent<TextMeshProUGUI>();
            UIBuiltinFontProvider.Apply(label);
            label.text = text;
            label.fontSize = size;
            label.alignment = alignment;
            label.color = color;
            label.raycastTarget = false;
            return label;
        }

        public static Button CreateButton(string name, Transform parent, string text)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Image), typeof(Button));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            go.GetComponent<Image>().color = new Color(0.20f, 0.35f, 0.60f, 1f);
            TextMeshProUGUI label = CreateText("Label", go.transform, text, 24f, TextAlignmentOptions.Center, Color.white);
            Stretch(label.gameObject);
            return go.GetComponent<Button>();
        }

        public static void SetRect(RectTransform rect, Vector2 anchorMin, Vector2 anchorMax, Vector2 offsetMin, Vector2 offsetMax)
        {
            rect.anchorMin = anchorMin;
            rect.anchorMax = anchorMax;
            rect.offsetMin = offsetMin;
            rect.offsetMax = offsetMax;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 内置通用弹窗。
    /// </summary>
    public partial class UIDialogForm : UIForm
    {
        private UIDialogParams _param;

        protected override void OnInit(object userData)
        {
            if (_txtTitle != null)
                return;

            RectTransform root = UIBuiltinViewFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform panel = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreatePanel("Panel", root, new Color(0.08f, 0.09f, 0.12f, 0.98f));
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(panel, new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f), new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f), new Vector2(-360f, -210f), new Vector2(360f, 210f));

            _txtTitle = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreateText("Title", panel, string.Empty, 30f, TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.Center, Color.white);
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(_txtTitle.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 1f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(32f, -76f), new Vector2(-32f, -20f));

            _txtContent = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreateText("Content", panel, string.Empty, 23f, TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.Center, new Color(0.86f, 0.88f, 0.92f, 1f));
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(_txtContent.rectTransform, Vector2.zero, Vector2.one, new Vector2(44f, 104f), new Vector2(-44f, -92f));

            _btnConfirm = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreateButton("ConfirmButton", panel, "确定");
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(_btnConfirm.GetComponent<RectTransform>(), new Vector2(0.5f, 0f), new Vector2(0.5f, 0f), new Vector2(24f, 30f), new Vector2(224f, 86f));
            _txtConfirm = _btnConfirm.GetComponentInChildren<TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI>(true);

            _btnCancel = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreateButton("CancelButton", panel, "取消");
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(_btnCancel.GetComponent<RectTransform>(), new Vector2(0.5f, 0f), new Vector2(0.5f, 0f), new Vector2(-224f, 30f), new Vector2(-24f, 86f));
            _txtCancel = _btnCancel.GetComponentInChildren<TMPro.TextMeshProUGUI>(true);
            _goCancel = _btnCancel.gameObject;
        }

        protected override void OnOpen(object userData)
        {
            _param = userData as UIDialogParams;
            if (_param == null)
                _param = new UIDialogParams();

            _param.Form = this;

            if (_txtTitle != null) _txtTitle.text = _param.Title ?? string.Empty;
            if (_txtContent != null) _txtContent.text = _param.DisplayContent ?? string.Empty;
            if (_txtConfirm != null) _txtConfirm.text = _param.ConfirmText ?? "确定";
            if (_txtCancel != null) _txtCancel.text = _param.CancelText ?? "取消";
            if (_goCancel != null) _goCancel.SetActive(_param.ShowCancel);

            if (_btnConfirm != null)
            {
                _btnConfirm.onClick.RemoveAllListeners();
                _btnConfirm.onClick.AddListener(OnClickConfirm);
            }

            if (_btnCancel != null)
            {
                _btnCancel.onClick.RemoveAllListeners();
                _btnCancel.onClick.AddListener(OnClickCancel);
            }
        }

        private void OnClickConfirm()
        {
            _param?.OnConfirm?.Invoke();
            _param?.ResultSource?.TrySetResult(UIDialogResult.Confirm);
            Close();
        }

        private void OnClickCancel()
        {
            _param?.OnCancel?.Invoke();
            _param?.ResultSource?.TrySetResult(UIDialogResult.Cancel);
            Close();
        }

        protected override void OnClose(object userData)
        {
            _param?.ResultSource?.TrySetResult(UIDialogResult.Close);
            if (_param != null && _param.Form == this)
                _param.Form = null;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
            RectTransform root = UIBuiltinViewFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            Image bg = gameObject.GetComponent<Image>();
            if (bg == null)
                bg = gameObject.AddComponent<Image>();
            bg.color = new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0.55f);
            bg.raycastTarget = true;

            RectTransform panel = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreatePanel("Panel", root, new Color(0.08f, 0.09f, 0.12f, 0.96f));
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(panel, new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f), new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f), new Vector2(-260f, -86f), new Vector2(260f, 86f));

            _txtMessage = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreateText("Message", panel, "Loading...", 26f, TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.Center, Color.white);
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(_txtMessage.rectTransform, new Vector2(0f, 0.5f), new Vector2(1f, 1f), new Vector2(24f, -18f), new Vector2(-24f, -10f));

            GameObject sliderGo = new GameObject("Progress", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Slider));
            sliderGo.transform.SetParent(panel, false);
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(sliderGo.GetComponent<RectTransform>(), new Vector2(0f, 0f), new Vector2(1f, 0f), new Vector2(42f, 24f), new Vector2(-42f, 48f));
            Slider slider = sliderGo.GetComponent<Slider>();
            slider.minValue = 0f;
            slider.maxValue = 1f;
            sliderGo.SetActive(false);
        }

        protected override void OnOpen(object userData)
        {
            if (userData is UILoadingRequest req)
            {
                SetMessage(req.Message);
                SetProgress(req.Progress, req.ShowProgress);
            }
        }

        public void SetMessage(string message)
        {
            if (_txtMessage != null)
                _txtMessage.text = string.IsNullOrEmpty(message) ? "Loading..." : message;
        }

        public void SetProgress(float progress, bool showProgress)
        {
            Slider slider = GetComponentInChildren<Slider>(true);
            if (slider == null)
                return;

            slider.gameObject.SetActive(showProgress);
            slider.value = Mathf.Clamp01(progress);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 内置Toast窗口。
    /// 对应配置 formId = UIToastForm
    /// </summary>
    public partial class UIToastForm : UIForm
    {
        protected override void OnInit(object userData)
        {
            if (_txtMessage != null)
                return;

            RectTransform root = UIBuiltinViewFactory.Stretch(gameObject);
            RectTransform panel = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreatePanel("Panel", root, new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0.78f));
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(panel, new Vector2(0.5f, 0f), new Vector2(0.5f, 0f), new Vector2(-360f, 72f), new Vector2(360f, 144f));

            _txtMessage = UIBuiltinViewFactory.CreateText("Message", panel, string.Empty, 24f, TMPro.TextAlignmentOptions.Center, Color.white);
            UIBuiltinViewFactory.SetRect(_txtMessage.rectTransform, Vector2.zero, Vector2.one, new Vector2(24f, 8f), new Vector2(-24f, -8f));
        }

        protected override void OnOpen(object userData)
        {
            if (userData is UIToastRequest req)
            {
                if (_txtMessage != null)
                    _txtMessage.text = req.Message;
                ApplyPosition(req.Position);
            }
        }

        private void ApplyPosition(UIToastPosition position)
        {
            RectTransform rect = transform as RectTransform;
            if (rect == null)
                return;

            switch (position)
            {
                case UIToastPosition.Top:
                    rect.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                    rect.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                    rect.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                    rect.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0f, -120f);
                    break;
                case UIToastPosition.Center:
                    rect.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f);
                    rect.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f);
                    rect.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f);
                    rect.anchoredPosition = Vector2.zero;
                    break;
                default:
                    rect.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
                    rect.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
                    rect.pivot = new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
                    rect.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(0f, 120f);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}
````
