## File: Core/UI/Runtime/Config/UIConfigRegistry.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// UI配置注册表。
    /// 支持ScriptableObject配置组加载，也支持代码动态注册。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class UIConfigRegistry
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, UIFormConfig> _configsById = new Dictionary<string, UIFormConfig>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, List<string>> _groupToFormIds = new Dictionary<string, List<string>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _groupDefaultPackages = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _loadedGroups = new HashSet<string>();

        public bool IsGroupLoaded(string groupName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupName))
                return false;
            return _loadedGroups.Contains(groupName);
        }

        public void Register(UIFormConfig config)
        {
            if (config == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("UIConfigRegistry.Register failed, config is null.");
                return;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.formId))
            {
                FRLog.Error("UIConfigRegistry.Register failed, formId is null or empty.");
                return;
            }

            _configsById[config.formId] = config;

            string groupName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.configGroup) ? "Default" : config.configGroup;
            if (!_groupToFormIds.TryGetValue(groupName, out var list))
            {
                list = new List<string>();
                _groupToFormIds.Add(groupName, list);
            }

            if (!list.Contains(config.formId))
            {
                list.Add(config.formId);
            }

            FRLog.Info($"UIConfig loaded : {config.formId}, group : {groupName}");
        }

        public void RegisterGroup(UIConfigGroup group)
        {
            if (group == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error("UIConfigRegistry.RegisterGroup failed, group is null.");
                return;
            }

            string groupName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.groupName) ? "Default" : group.groupName;
            _loadedGroups.Add(groupName);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.defaultPackageName))
                _groupDefaultPackages[groupName] = group.defaultPackageName;

            if (group.forms == null)
                return;

            for (int i = 0; i < group.forms.Count; i++)
            {
                UIFormConfig config = group.forms[i];
                if (config == null)
                    continue;

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.configGroup))
                {
                    config.configGroup = groupName;
                }

                Register(config);
            }

            FRLog.Info($"UIConfig group loaded : {groupName}, count : {group.forms.Count}");
        }

        public bool TryGet(string formId, out UIFormConfig config)
        {
            return _configsById.TryGetValue(formId, out config);
        }

        public UIFormConfig Get(string formId)
        {
            _configsById.TryGetValue(formId, out var config);
            return config;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<string> GetGroupFormIds(string groupName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupName))
                return null;

            if (_groupToFormIds.TryGetValue(groupName, out var list))
                return list;

            return null;
        }

        public string GetDefaultPackageName(string groupName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupName))
                return null;

            return _groupDefaultPackages.TryGetValue(groupName, out string packageName) ? packageName : null;
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            _configsById.Clear();
            _groupToFormIds.Clear();
            _groupDefaultPackages.Clear();
            _loadedGroups.Clear();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public static class UIDefaultAnimationPlayer
    {
        public static UniTask PlayOpenAsync(UIForm form, UIFormConfig config, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (form == null || config == null || config.openAnimation == UIAnimationPreset.None)
                return UniTask.CompletedTask;

            return PlayAsync(form, config.openAnimation, config.openAnimationDuration, config.openAnimationEase, true, cancellationToken);
        }

        public static UniTask PlayCloseAsync(UIForm form, UIFormConfig config, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            if (form == null || config == null || config.closeAnimation == UIAnimationPreset.None)
                return UniTask.CompletedTask;

            return PlayAsync(form, config.closeAnimation, config.closeAnimationDuration, config.closeAnimationEase, false, cancellationToken);
        }

        private static async UniTask PlayAsync(UIForm form, UIAnimationPreset preset, float duration, UIAnimationEase ease, bool opening, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            RectTransform rect = form.transform as RectTransform;
            if (rect == null)
                return;

            CanvasGroup canvasGroup = form.GetComponent<CanvasGroup>();
            if (canvasGroup == null)
                canvasGroup = form.gameObject.AddComponent<CanvasGroup>();

            duration = Mathf.Max(0.01f, duration);
            Vector3 originalScale = rect.localScale;
            Vector2 originalPosition = rect.anchoredPosition;
            Vector2 slideOffset = GetSlideOffset(rect, preset);

            Prepare(rect, canvasGroup, preset, opening, originalScale, originalPosition, slideOffset);

            switch (preset)
            {
                case UIAnimationPreset.Fade:
                    await UITween.Fade(canvasGroup, opening ? 1f : 0f, duration, ease).ToUniTask(cancellationToken);
                    break;
                case UIAnimationPreset.Scale:
                    UITweenHandle scaleFade = UITween.Fade(canvasGroup, opening ? 1f : 0f, duration, ease);
                    UITweenHandle scaleOnly = UITween.Scale(rect, opening ? originalScale : originalScale * 0.85f, duration, ease);
                    await scaleOnly.ToUniTask(cancellationToken);
                    scaleFade.Kill(true);
                    break;
                case UIAnimationPreset.FadeScale:
                    UITweenHandle fade = UITween.Fade(canvasGroup, opening ? 1f : 0f, duration, ease);
                    UITweenHandle scale = UITween.Scale(rect, opening ? originalScale : originalScale * 0.85f, duration, ease);
                    await scale.ToUniTask(cancellationToken);
                    fade.Kill(true);
                    break;
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromLeft:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromRight:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromTop:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromBottom:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToLeft:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToRight:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToTop:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToBottom:
                    Vector2 target = opening ? originalPosition : originalPosition + slideOffset;
                    UITweenHandle slideFade = UITween.Fade(canvasGroup, opening ? 1f : 0f, duration, ease);
                    UITweenHandle slideMove = UITween.Move(rect, target, duration, ease);
                    await slideMove.ToUniTask(cancellationToken);
                    slideFade.Kill(true);
                    break;
            }

            if (form != null && rect != null && canvasGroup != null && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                canvasGroup.alpha = opening ? 1f : 0f;
                rect.localScale = originalScale;
                rect.anchoredPosition = originalPosition;
            }
        }

        private static void Prepare(RectTransform rect, CanvasGroup canvasGroup, UIAnimationPreset preset, bool opening, Vector3 originalScale, Vector2 originalPosition, Vector2 slideOffset)
        {
            if (!opening)
                return;

            switch (preset)
            {
                case UIAnimationPreset.Fade:
                    canvasGroup.alpha = 0f;
                    break;
                case UIAnimationPreset.Scale:
                    canvasGroup.alpha = 0f;
                    rect.localScale = originalScale * 0.85f;
                    break;
                case UIAnimationPreset.FadeScale:
                    canvasGroup.alpha = 0f;
                    rect.localScale = originalScale * 0.85f;
                    break;
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromLeft:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromRight:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromTop:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromBottom:
                    canvasGroup.alpha = 0f;
                    rect.anchoredPosition = originalPosition + slideOffset;
                    break;
            }
        }

        private static Vector2 GetSlideOffset(RectTransform rect, UIAnimationPreset preset)
        {
            RectTransform parent = rect.parent as RectTransform;
            Rect sourceRect = parent != null ? parent.rect : rect.rect;
            float width = Mathf.Max(sourceRect.width, rect.rect.width, 1f);
            float height = Mathf.Max(sourceRect.height, rect.rect.height, 1f);
            switch (preset)
            {
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromLeft:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToLeft:
                    return new Vector2(-width, 0f);
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromRight:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToRight:
                    return new Vector2(width, 0f);
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromTop:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToTop:
                    return new Vector2(0f, height);
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideFromBottom:
                case UIAnimationPreset.SlideToBottom:
                    return new Vector2(0f, -height);
                default:
                    return Vector2.zero;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIEventScopeSet : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _disposeScope = new EventSubscriptionScope();
        private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _openScope = new EventSubscriptionScope();
        private readonly EventSubscriptionScope _visibleScope = new EventSubscriptionScope();

        public IDisposable Add(IDisposable subscription, UIEventListenMode mode)
        {
            if (subscription == null)
                return null;

            switch (mode)
            {
                case UIEventListenMode.WhileOpen:
                    subscription.AddTo(_openScope);
                    break;
                case UIEventListenMode.WhileVisible:
                    subscription.AddTo(_visibleScope);
                    break;
                default:
                    subscription.AddTo(_disposeScope);
                    break;
            }

            return subscription;
        }

        public void ClearOpen()
        {
            _openScope.Clear();
            _visibleScope.Clear();
        }

        public void ClearVisible()
        {
            _visibleScope.Clear();
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            _visibleScope.Dispose();
            _openScope.Dispose();
            _disposeScope.Dispose();
        }
    }

    public sealed class UnityEventSubscription : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly Action _removeAction;
        private bool _disposed;

        public UnityEventSubscription(Action removeAction)
        {
            _removeAction = removeAction;
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed)
                return;

            _disposed = true;
            _removeAction?.Invoke();
        }
    }

    public static class UIEventUtility
    {
        public static IDisposable AddButtonClick(Button button, UnityAction action)
        {
            if (button == null || action == null)
                return null;

            button.onClick.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => button.onClick.RemoveListener(action));
        }

        public static IDisposable AddToggleChanged(Toggle toggle, UnityAction<bool> action)
        {
            if (toggle == null || action == null)
                return null;

            toggle.onValueChanged.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => toggle.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(action));
        }

        public static IDisposable AddSliderChanged(Slider slider, UnityAction<float> action)
        {
            if (slider == null || action == null)
                return null;

            slider.onValueChanged.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => slider.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(action));
        }

        public static IDisposable AddInputChanged(InputField input, UnityAction<string> action)
        {
            if (input == null || action == null)
                return null;

            input.onValueChanged.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => input.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(action));
        }

        public static IDisposable AddInputChanged(TMP_InputField input, UnityAction<string> action)
        {
            if (input == null || action == null)
                return null;

            input.onValueChanged.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => input.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(action));
        }

        public static IDisposable AddUIEvent(UnityEvent unityEvent, UnityAction action)
        {
            if (unityEvent == null || action == null)
                return null;

            unityEvent.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => unityEvent.RemoveListener(action));
        }

        public static IDisposable AddUIEvent<T>(UnityEvent<T> unityEvent, UnityAction<T> action)
        {
            if (unityEvent == null || action == null)
                return null;

            unityEvent.AddListener(action);
            return new UnityEventSubscription(() => unityEvent.RemoveListener(action));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [DisallowMultipleComponent]
    public abstract class UIForm : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public int SerialId { get; internal set; }
        public string FormId { get; internal set; }
        public UIFormConfig Config { get; internal set; }
        public UIGroup Group { get; internal set; }
        public UIFormState State { get; internal set; }

        public bool IsInitialized { get; private set; }
        public bool IsPaused { get; private set; }
        public bool IsCovered { get; private set; }
        public bool IsVisible { get; private set; }
        public bool IsClosing => State == UIFormState.Closing;
        public int SortingOrder => _canvas != null ? _canvas.sortingOrder : 0;
        public bool UseMask => _useMaskOverride ?? (Config != null && Config.useMask);
        public bool CloseOnMaskClick => _closeOnMaskClickOverride ?? (Config != null && Config.closeOnMaskClick);
        public UIMaskMode MaskMode => _maskModeOverride ?? (Config != null ? Config.maskMode : UIMaskMode.None);
        public Color MaskColor => _maskColorOverride ?? (Config != null ? Config.maskColor : Color.clear);

        protected Canvas _canvas;
        protected GraphicRaycaster _raycaster;
        protected CanvasGroup _canvasGroup;
        protected RectTransform _rectTransform;
        protected UIBindData _bindData;

        private readonly List<UIWidget> _widgets = new List<UIWidget>();
        private readonly UIEventScopeSet _eventScopes = new UIEventScopeSet();
        private bool? _useMaskOverride;
        private bool? _closeOnMaskClickOverride;
        private UIMaskMode? _maskModeOverride;
        private Color? _maskColorOverride;

        internal void InternalSetLoading()
        {
            State = UIFormState.Loading;
        }

        internal void ApplyOpenOptions(UIOpenOptions options)
        {
            _useMaskOverride = options.UseMaskOverride;
            _closeOnMaskClickOverride = options.CloseOnMaskClickOverride;
            _maskModeOverride = options.MaskModeOverride;
            _maskColorOverride = options.MaskColorOverride;
        }

        internal void InternalInitialize(UIFormOpenContext context)
        {
            FormId = context.FormId;
            Config = context.Config;

            _rectTransform = transform as RectTransform;
            _canvas = gameObject.GetComponent<Canvas>();
            if (_canvas == null)
                _canvas = gameObject.AddComponent<Canvas>();

            _canvas.overrideSorting = true;

            _raycaster = gameObject.GetComponent<GraphicRaycaster>();
            if (_raycaster == null)
                _raycaster = gameObject.AddComponent<GraphicRaycaster>();

            _canvasGroup = gameObject.GetComponent<CanvasGroup>();
            if (_canvasGroup == null)
                _canvasGroup = gameObject.AddComponent<CanvasGroup>();

            _bindData = gameObject.GetComponent<UIBindData>();

            if (!IsInitialized)
            {
                BindInit();
                BindEvent();
                OnInit(context.UserData);
                IsInitialized = true;
                State = UIFormState.Initialized;
            }
        }

        internal void InternalOpen(object userData)
        {
            gameObject.SetActive(true);
            SetVisible(true);
            IsPaused = false;
            IsCovered = false;
            State = UIFormState.Opened;
            OnOpen(userData);
        }

        internal void InternalClose(object userData)
        {
            _eventScopes.ClearOpen();
            OnClose(userData);
            State = UIFormState.Closed;
        }

        internal void InternalBeginClose()
        {
            State = UIFormState.Closing;
        }

        internal void InternalPreload()
        {
            gameObject.SetActive(false);
            SetVisible(false);
            State = UIFormState.Preloaded;
        }

        internal void InternalPause()
        {
            if (IsPaused) return;
            IsPaused = true;
            _eventScopes.ClearVisible();
            OnPause();
        }

        internal void InternalResume()
        {
            if (!IsPaused) return;
            IsPaused = false;
            OnResume();
        }

        internal void InternalCover()
        {
            if (IsCovered) return;
            IsCovered = true;
            _eventScopes.ClearVisible();

            switch (Config.coverVisualMode)
            {
                case UICoverVisualMode.KeepVisible:
                    _canvasGroup.interactable = false;
                    _canvasGroup.blocksRaycasts = false;
                    break;
                case UICoverVisualMode.HideByCanvasGroup:
                    _canvasGroup.alpha = 0f;
                    _canvasGroup.interactable = false;
                    _canvasGroup.blocksRaycasts = false;
                    break;
                case UICoverVisualMode.SetInactive:
                    gameObject.SetActive(false);
                    break;
            }

            OnCover();
        }

        internal void InternalReveal()
        {
            if (!IsCovered) return;
            IsCovered = false;

            switch (Config.coverVisualMode)
            {
                case UICoverVisualMode.KeepVisible:
                    _canvasGroup.interactable = true;
                    _canvasGroup.blocksRaycasts = true;
                    break;
                case UICoverVisualMode.HideByCanvasGroup:
                    _canvasGroup.alpha = 1f;
                    _canvasGroup.interactable = true;
                    _canvasGroup.blocksRaycasts = true;
                    break;
                case UICoverVisualMode.SetInactive:
                    gameObject.SetActive(true);
                    break;
            }

            OnReveal();
        }

        internal void InternalSetDepth(int sortingOrder)
        {
            if (_canvas != null)
                _canvas.sortingOrder = sortingOrder;

            OnDepthChanged(sortingOrder);
        }

        internal void InternalHide()
        {
            _eventScopes.ClearVisible();
            for (int i = 0; i < _widgets.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_widgets[i] != null && _widgets[i].IsVisible)
                    _widgets[i].InternalHide();
            }

            SetVisible(false);
            State = UIFormState.Hidden;
            OnHide();
            if (Config != null && Config.disableGameObjectWhenHidden)
                gameObject.SetActive(false);
        }

        internal void InternalShow(object userData)
        {
            gameObject.SetActive(true);
            SetVisible(true);
            State = UIFormState.Opened;
            OnShow(userData);
        }

        internal void InternalDispose()
        {
            if (State == UIFormState.Disposed)
                return;

            ReleaseAllWidgets();
            _eventScopes.Dispose();
            _useMaskOverride = null;
            _closeOnMaskClickOverride = null;
            _maskModeOverride = null;
            _maskColorOverride = null;
            UnbindEvent();
            OnDispose();
            State = UIFormState.Disposed;
        }

        internal void InternalUpdate(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            if (State != UIFormState.Opened || IsPaused)
                return;

            OnUpdate(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
        }

        internal UniTask InternalPlayOpenAnimationAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return PlayOpenAnimationAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        internal UniTask InternalPlayCloseAnimationAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return PlayCloseAnimationAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        public void Close(object userData = null)
        {
            FRFM.UI?.Close(this, userData);
        }

        public UniTask CloseAsync(object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return FRFM.UI == null ? UniTask.CompletedTask : FRFM.UI.CloseAsync(this, userData, cancellationToken);
        }

        public void Hide()
        {
            FRFM.UI?.Hide(this);
        }

        public void Show(object userData = null)
        {
            FRFM.UI?.Show(this, userData);
        }

        protected T CreateWidget<T>(GameObject root, object userData = null) where T : UIWidget
        {
            if (root == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UIForm.CreateWidget failed, root is null. widget type : {typeof(T).Name}");
                return null;
            }

            T widget = root.GetComponent<T>();
            if (widget == null)
                widget = root.AddComponent<T>();

            root.SetLayerRecursively(gameObject.layer);
            widget.InternalInitialize(this);
            widget.InternalOpen(userData);
            root.SetLayerRecursively(gameObject.layer);
            RegisterWidget(widget);
            return widget;
        }

        protected async UniTask<T> LoadWidgetAsync<T>(ResourceKey key, Transform parent, object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where T : UIWidget
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key.Location) || cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                return null;

            GameObject instance = await FRFM.Resource.InstantiateAsync(key, parent);
            if (instance == null)
                return null;

            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                FRFM.Resource.Recycle(instance);
                return null;
            }

            return CreateWidget<T>(instance, userData);
        }

        protected UIWidgetSwitcher CreateWidgetSwitcher(Transform parent)
        {
            return new UIWidgetSwitcher(this, parent);
        }

        protected void ShowWidget(UIWidget widget, object userData = null)
        {
            widget?.InternalShow(userData);
        }

        protected void HideWidget(UIWidget widget)
        {
            widget?.InternalHide();
        }

        protected void ReleaseWidget(UIWidget widget)
        {
            if (widget == null)
                return;

            _widgets.Remove(widget);
            widget.InternalDispose();
            ReleaseWidgetGameObject(widget.gameObject);
        }

        protected void ReleaseAllWidgets()
        {
            for (int i = _widgets.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                UIWidget widget = _widgets[i];
                if (widget == null)
                    continue;

                widget.InternalDispose();
                ReleaseWidgetGameObject(widget.gameObject);
            }

            _widgets.Clear();
        }

        internal void RegisterWidget(UIWidget widget)
        {
            if (widget != null && !_widgets.Contains(widget))
                _widgets.Add(widget);
        }

        private void ReleaseWidgetGameObject(GameObject widgetGameObject)
        {
            if (widgetGameObject == null)
                return;

            if (widgetGameObject.GetComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>() != null)
                FRFM.Resource.Recycle(widgetGameObject);
            else
                Destroy(widgetGameObject);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddButtonClick(Button button, UnityAction action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddButtonClick(button, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddToggleChanged(Toggle toggle, UnityAction<bool> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddToggleChanged(toggle, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddSliderChanged(Slider slider, UnityAction<float> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddSliderChanged(slider, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddInputChanged(InputField input, UnityAction<string> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddInputChanged(input, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddInputChanged(TMP_InputField input, UnityAction<string> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddInputChanged(input, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddUIEvent(UnityEvent unityEvent, UnityAction action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddUIEvent(unityEvent, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddUIEvent<T>(UnityEvent<T> unityEvent, UnityAction<T> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddUIEvent(unityEvent, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerClick(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIPointerEventListener.Get(target)?.AddClick(action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerDown(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIPointerEventListener.Get(target)?.AddDown(action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerUp(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIPointerEventListener.Get(target)?.AddUp(action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerBeginDrag(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIPointerEventListener.Get(target)?.AddBeginDrag(action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerDrag(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIPointerEventListener.Get(target)?.AddDrag(action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerEndDrag(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIPointerEventListener.Get(target)?.AddEndDrag(action), mode);
        }

            return UIDefaultAnimationPlayer.PlayCloseAsync(this, Config, cancellationToken);
        }

        protected virtual void BindEvent() { }
        protected virtual void UnbindEvent() { }
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 单个UI层组。
    /// 负责排序、遮挡、暂停。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class UIGroup
    {
        public UIGroupLayer Layer { get; }
        public string Name { get; }
        public Transform Root { get; }
        public int SortingOrderBase { get; }

        private readonly List<UIForm> _forms = new List<UIForm>();

        public UIGroup(UIGroupLayer layer, string name, Transform root, int sortingOrderBase)
        {
            Layer = layer;
            Name = name;
            Root = root;
            SortingOrderBase = sortingOrderBase;
        }

        public IReadOnlyList<UIForm> Forms => _forms;

        public void Add(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            if (!_forms.Contains(form))
            {
                _forms.Add(form);
            }

            RefreshDepth();
            RefreshCoverState();
        }

        public void Remove(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            _forms.Remove(form);
            RefreshDepth();
            RefreshCoverState();
        }

        public void BringToFront(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            if (_forms.Remove(form))
            {
                _forms.Add(form);
                RefreshDepth();
                RefreshCoverState();
            }
        }

        public int GetTopSortingOrder()
        {
            return SortingOrderBase + (_forms.Count * 100);
        }

        public UIForm GetTopForm()
        {
            for (int i = _forms.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                UIForm form = _forms[i];
                if (form != null && form.State == UIFormState.Opened)
                    return form;
            }

            return null;
        }

        public bool Contains(UIForm form)
        {
            return form != null && _forms.Contains(form);
        }

        public int GetDepth(UIForm form)
        {
            return form == null ? -1 : _forms.IndexOf(form);
        }

        public void RefreshDepth()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _forms.Count; i++)
            {
                int sortingOrder = SortingOrderBase + i * 100;
                _forms[i].InternalSetDepth(sortingOrder);
            }
        }

        public void RefreshCoverState()
        {
            ApplyCoverState(false);
        }

        public bool ApplyCoverState(bool coveredByHigherGroup)
        {
            bool covered = coveredByHigherGroup;
            bool hasOpenedFullScreen = false;

            for (int i = _forms.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                UIForm form = _forms[i];
                if (form == null || form.State != UIFormState.Opened)
                    continue;

                if (!covered)
                {
                    form.InternalReveal();
                    form.InternalResume();

                    if (BlocksUnderlying(form))
                    {
                        covered = true;
                        hasOpenedFullScreen = true;
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    form.InternalCover();
                    if (form.Config != null && form.Config.pauseCovered)
                        form.InternalPause();
                }
            }

            return coveredByHigherGroup || hasOpenedFullScreen;
        }

        public UIForm GetTopBackCloseForm()
        {
            for (int i = _forms.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                UIForm form = _forms[i];
                if (form == null || form.State != UIFormState.Opened)
                    continue;

                if (form.Config != null && form.Config.allowBackClose)
                    return form;
            }

            return null;
        }

        public UIForm GetTopMaskForm()
        {
            for (int i = _forms.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                UIForm form = _forms[i];
                if (form == null || form.State != UIFormState.Opened || !form.IsVisible)
                    continue;

                if (form.Config != null && form.UseMask && form.MaskMode != UIMaskMode.None)
                    return form;
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static bool BlocksUnderlying(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form?.Config == null)
                return false;

            switch (form.Config.blockingMode)
            {
                case UIBlockingMode.None:
                    return false;
                case UIBlockingMode.Always:
                    return true;
                default:
                    return form.Config.fullScreen;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame
{
    public abstract class UIItem : UIWidget
    {
        public int Index { get; private set; } = -1;
        public long Key { get; private set; }
        public string TemplateId { get; private set; }
        public object Data { get; private set; }
        public bool IsSelected { get; private set; }

        public void RefreshItem(int index, object data)
        {
            SetItemData(index, data);
        }

        public void SetItemData(int index, object data)
        {
            Index = index;
            Data = data;
            OnSetData(index, data);
            OnRefreshItem(index, data);
        }

        public void SetSelected(bool selected)
        {
            if (IsSelected == selected)
                return;

            IsSelected = selected;
            OnSelectedChanged(selected);
        }

        internal void InternalItemVisible(int index, object data)
        {
            InternalItemVisible(index, index, null, data);
        }

        internal void InternalItemVisible(int index, long key, string templateId, object data)
        {
            Key = key;
            TemplateId = templateId;
            SetItemData(index, data);
            OnItemVisible(index, data);
        }

        internal void InternalSetIndex(int index)
        {
            Index = index;
        }

        internal void InternalItemRecycled()
        {
            int oldIndex = Index;
            object oldData = Data;
            OnItemRecycled(oldIndex, oldData);
            SetSelected(false);
            Index = -1;
            Data = null;
            ClearTypedData();
            Key = 0L;
            TemplateId = null;
        }

        protected virtual void OnSetData(int index, object data) { }
        protected virtual void OnSelectedChanged(bool selected) { }
        protected virtual void OnRefreshItem(int index, object data) { }
        protected virtual void OnItemVisible(int index, object data) { }
        protected virtual void OnItemRecycled(int index, object data) { }
        protected virtual void ClearTypedData() { }
    }

    public abstract class UIItem<TData> : UIItem
    {
        public TData TypedData { get; private set; }

        protected sealed override void OnSetData(int index, object data)
        {
            if (data is TData typedData)
            {
                TypedData = typedData;
                OnSetData(index, typedData);
            }
            else
            {
                TypedData = default;
                OnSetData(index, default);
            }
        }

        protected sealed override void OnItemVisible(int index, object data)
        {
            OnItemVisible(index, TypedData);
        }

        protected sealed override void OnItemRecycled(int index, object data)
        {
            OnItemRecycled(index, TypedData);
        }

        protected sealed override void ClearTypedData()
        {
            TypedData = default;
        }

        protected abstract void OnSetData(int index, TData data);
        protected virtual void OnItemVisible(int index, TData data) { }
        protected virtual void OnItemRecycled(int index, TData data) { }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/UI/Runtime/Core/UIManager.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem;
using UnityEngine.SceneManagement;
#if FRFRAME_URP_AVAILABLE
using UnityEngine.Rendering.Universal;
#endif
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIManager : IManagerBase
    {
        public override int Priority => 20;

        private sealed class UILoadingOperation
        {
            public string FormId;
            public int SerialId;
            public UniTaskCompletionSource<UIForm> Source;
            public CancellationTokenSource CancellationSource;
            public bool CancelRequested;
        }

        private readonly Dictionary<UIGroupLayer, UIGroup> _groups = new Dictionary<UIGroupLayer, UIGroup>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, UIForm> _formsBySerialId = new Dictionary<int, UIForm>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, List<UIForm>> _formsById = new Dictionary<string, List<UIForm>>();
        private readonly HashSet<int> _loadingSerialIds = new HashSet<int>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, UILoadingOperation> _loadingFormsById = new Dictionary<string, UILoadingOperation>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, UILoadingOperation> _loadingFormsBySerialId = new Dictionary<int, UILoadingOperation>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, UIPreloadInfo> _preloadInfos = new Dictionary<string, UIPreloadInfo>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _configGroupPackageFallbackWarnings = new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly List<UIForm> _updateForms = new List<UIForm>();

        private int _serialSeed;
        private GameObject _uiRootGo;
        private Canvas _rootCanvas;
        private Camera _uiCamera;
        private UIConfigRegistry _configRegistry;
        private UIMaskService _maskService;
        private CancellationTokenSource _sceneCancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();

        private UIToastService _toastService;
        private UIDialogService _dialogService;
        private UILoadingService _loadingService;
        private UINavigator _navigation;

        public UIConfigRegistry ConfigRegistry => _configRegistry;
        public UIToastService Toast => _toastService;
        public UIDialogService Dialog => _dialogService;
        public UILoadingService Loading => _loadingService;
        public UINavigator Navigation => _navigation;

        public override async UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            _configRegistry = new UIConfigRegistry();
            await FRFM.WaitReady<ResourceManager>();
            BuildUIRoot();
            BuildGroups();
            _maskService = new UIMaskService();
            _maskService.Initialize(this, _groups);
            await LoadInitializeConfigGroupsAsync();
            await UIBuiltinFontProvider.PreloadDefaultFontAsync();
            RegisterBuiltinCodeFormConfigs();
            BuildBuiltinServices();
            SceneManager.sceneLoaded += OnSceneLoaded;
            AttachUICameraToSceneMainCamera(SceneManager.GetActiveScene());
            FRLog.Info("UIManager initialized.");
        }

        public override void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            _updateForms.Clear();
            foreach (var form in _formsBySerialId.Values)
            {
                if (form != null)
                    _updateForms.Add(form);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < _updateForms.Count; i++)
            {
                UIForm form = _updateForms[i];
                if (form != null && _formsBySerialId.ContainsKey(form.SerialId))
                    form.InternalUpdate(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
            }

            if (Keyboard.current?.escapeKey.wasPressedThisFrame == true)
                Back();

            _toastService?.Update(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
            _loadingService?.Update(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
        }

        public override void Destroy()
        {
            SceneManager.sceneLoaded -= OnSceneLoaded;
            CancelAllLoading();
            var forms = new List<UIForm>(_formsBySerialId.Values);
            for (int i = 0; i < forms.Count; i++)
            {
                if (forms[i] != null)
                    DisposeForm(forms[i], null);
            }

            _formsBySerialId.Clear();
            _formsById.Clear();
            _loadingSerialIds.Clear();
            _loadingFormsById.Clear();
            _loadingFormsBySerialId.Clear();
            _preloadInfos.Clear();
            _updateForms.Clear();
            _maskService?.Dispose();
            _maskService = null;
            _groups.Clear();
            _configRegistry?.Clear();
            _sceneCancellationSource?.Dispose();

            if (_uiRootGo != null)
            {
                Object.Destroy(_uiRootGo);
                _uiRootGo = null;
            }

            FRLog.Info("UIManager destroyed.");
        }

        private void BuildUIRoot()
        {
            Transform root = FRFrameRoot.Get().GetOrCreateCompoent("UIRoot");
            _uiRootGo = root.gameObject;

            _rootCanvas = _uiRootGo.GetComponent<Canvas>();
            if (_rootCanvas == null)
                _rootCanvas = _uiRootGo.AddComponent<Canvas>();

            _rootCanvas.renderMode = RenderMode.ScreenSpaceCamera;
            _rootCanvas.worldCamera = GetOrCreateUICamera();
            _rootCanvas.planeDistance = 10f;
            _rootCanvas.overrideSorting = false;

            int uiLayer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("UI");
            if (uiLayer >= 0)
                _uiRootGo.SetLayerRecursively(uiLayer);

            if (_uiRootGo.GetComponent<UnityEngine.UI.CanvasScaler>() == null)
            {
                var scaler = _uiRootGo.AddComponent<UnityEngine.UI.CanvasScaler>();
                scaler.uiScaleMode = UnityEngine.UI.CanvasScaler.ScaleMode.ScaleWithScreenSize;
                scaler.referenceResolution = new Vector2(1920, 1080);
                scaler.screenMatchMode = UnityEngine.UI.CanvasScaler.ScreenMatchMode.MatchWidthOrHeight;
                scaler.matchWidthOrHeight = 0.5f;
            }

            if (_uiRootGo.GetComponent<UnityEngine.UI.GraphicRaycaster>() == null)
                _uiRootGo.AddComponent<UnityEngine.UI.GraphicRaycaster>();

            if (EventSystem.current == null)
            {
                GameObject eventSystem = new GameObject("EventSystem", typeof(EventSystem), typeof(StandaloneInputModule));
                Object.DontDestroyOnLoad(eventSystem);
            }
        }

        private Camera GetOrCreateUICamera()
        {
            if (_uiCamera != null)
                return _uiCamera;

            Transform cameraTransform = FRFrameRoot.Get().transform.Find("UICamera");
            if (cameraTransform == null)
            {
                GameObject cameraGo = new GameObject("UICamera", typeof(Camera));
                cameraGo.transform.SetParent(FRFrameRoot.Get().transform, false);
                cameraTransform = cameraGo.transform;
            }

            _uiCamera = cameraTransform.GetComponent<Camera>();
            if (_uiCamera == null)
                _uiCamera = cameraTransform.gameObject.AddComponent<Camera>();

            _uiCamera.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.Depth;
            _uiCamera.backgroundColor = Color.clear;
            _uiCamera.orthographic = true;
            _uiCamera.orthographicSize = 5f;
            _uiCamera.nearClipPlane = -50f;
            _uiCamera.farClipPlane = 50f;
            int uiLayer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("UI");
            if (uiLayer >= 0)
            {
                _uiCamera.cullingMask = 1 << uiLayer;
                _uiCamera.gameObject.layer = uiLayer;
            }
            else
            {
                _uiCamera.cullingMask = -1;
            }

            _uiCamera.allowHDR = true;
            _uiCamera.allowMSAA = true;

#if FRFRAME_URP_AVAILABLE
            UniversalAdditionalCameraData uiCameraData = _uiCamera.GetUniversalAdditionalCameraData();
            uiCameraData.renderType = CameraRenderType.Overlay;
            uiCameraData.renderPostProcessing = false;
#endif
            return _uiCamera;
        }

        private void OnSceneLoaded(Scene scene, LoadSceneMode mode)
        {
            AttachUICameraToSceneMainCamera(scene);
        }

        private void AttachUICameraToSceneMainCamera(Scene scene)
        {
#if FRFRAME_URP_AVAILABLE
            if (_uiCamera == null)
                return;

            Camera mainCamera = FindBaseCameraInScene(scene);
            if (mainCamera == null || mainCamera == _uiCamera)
                return;

            UniversalAdditionalCameraData mainCameraData = mainCamera.GetUniversalAdditionalCameraData();
            if (mainCameraData.renderType != CameraRenderType.Base)
                return;

            List<Camera> stack = mainCameraData.cameraStack;
            if (stack == null)
                return;

            stack.RemoveAll(c => c == null);
            if (!stack.Contains(_uiCamera))
                stack.Add(_uiCamera);
#endif
        }

#if FRFRAME_URP_AVAILABLE
        private Camera FindBaseCameraInScene(Scene scene)
        {
            if (!scene.IsValid() || !scene.isLoaded)
                return null;

            GameObject[] roots = scene.GetRootGameObjects();
            Camera tagged = null;
            Camera fallback = null;
            for (int i = 0; i < roots.Length; i++)
            {
                Camera[] cameras = roots[i].GetComponentsInChildren<Camera>(true);
                for (int j = 0; j < cameras.Length; j++)
                {
                    Camera camera = cameras[j];
                    if (camera == null || camera == _uiCamera)
                        continue;

                    UniversalAdditionalCameraData data = camera.GetUniversalAdditionalCameraData();
                    if (data.renderType != CameraRenderType.Base)
                        continue;

                    if (camera.CompareTag("MainCamera"))
                    {
                        tagged = camera;
                        break;
                    }

                    if (fallback == null)
                        fallback = camera;
                }

                if (tagged != null)
                    break;
            }

            return tagged != null ? tagged : fallback;
        }
#endif

        private void BuildGroups()
        {
            // Canvas Sorting Order 的有效范围是 Int16，层级基准必须控制在 32767 以内。
            CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer.Background, "Background", 0);
            CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer.Normal, "Normal", 5000);
            CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer.Popup, "Popup", 10000);
            CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer.Top, "Top", 15000);
            CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer.Overlay, "Overlay", 20000);
            CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer.System, "System", 25000);
        }

        private void CreateGroup(UIGroupLayer layer, string name, int sortingOrderBase)
        {
            Transform parent = _uiRootGo.transform.Find(name);
            if (parent == null)
            {
                GameObject go = new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform));
                go.transform.SetParent(_uiRootGo.transform, false);
                var rect = go.transform as RectTransform;
                rect.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
                rect.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
                rect.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
                rect.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
                parent = go.transform;
            }

            int uiLayer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("UI");
            if (uiLayer >= 0)
                parent.gameObject.SetLayerRecursively(uiLayer);

            _groups[layer] = new UIGroup(layer, name, parent, sortingOrderBase);
        }

        private async UniTask LoadInitializeConfigGroupsAsync()
        {
            UIBootstrapConfig uiBootstrap = await BootstrapConfigLoader.LoadUIBootstrapAsync();
            string defaultConfigLocation = uiBootstrap == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(uiBootstrap.defaultUIConfigLocation)
                ? "Assets/GameRes/Common/Config/UI/UIConfigGroup_Default.asset"
                : uiBootstrap.defaultUIConfigLocation;
            string packageName = uiBootstrap == null ? null : uiBootstrap.defaultPackageName;

            UIConfigGroup groups = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<UIConfigGroup>(defaultConfigLocation, new ResourceLoadOptions
            {
                PackageName = packageName,
                Residency = ResourceResidency.Resident
            });

            if (groups == null)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"UIManager UIConfigGroup not found : {defaultConfigLocation}, package : {packageName}");
                return;
            }

            if (groups.loadOnInitialize)
                _configRegistry.RegisterGroup(groups);
        }

        public void LoadConfigGroup(UIConfigGroup group)
        {
            if (group != null && !_configRegistry.IsGroupLoaded(group.groupName))
                _configRegistry.RegisterGroup(group);
        }

        public async UniTask LoadConfigGroupAssetAsync(string location, string packageName = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(location))
                return;

            UIConfigGroup group = await FRFM.Resource.LoadAssetAsync<UIConfigGroup>(location, new ResourceLoadOptions
            {
                PackageName = packageName,
                Residency = ResourceResidency.Resident
            });

            if (group == null)
            {
                FRLog.Warning($"UIManager.LoadConfigGroupAssetAsync not found asset : {location}, package : {packageName}");
                return;
            }

            if (!_configRegistry.IsGroupLoaded(group.groupName))
                _configRegistry.RegisterGroup(group);
        }

        private void BuildBuiltinServices()
        {
            UIBuiltinConfig config = UIBuiltinConfig.Default;
            _toastService = new UIToastService(this, config);
            _dialogService = new UIDialogService(this, config);
            _loadingService = new UILoadingService(this, config);
            _navigation = new UINavigator(this);
        }

        private void RegisterBuiltinCodeFormConfigs()
        {
            RegisterCodeFormConfig<UIToastForm>(UIGroupLayer.Top, false, UIFormCloseMode.Destroy, false, UICoverVisualMode.KeepVisible, UIAnimationPreset.Fade, UIAnimationPreset.Fade);
            RegisterCodeFormConfig<UIDialogForm>(UIGroupLayer.Popup, true, UIFormCloseMode.Destroy, true, UICoverVisualMode.KeepVisible, UIAnimationPreset.FadeScale, UIAnimationPreset.Fade);
            RegisterCodeFormConfig<UILoadingForm>(UIGroupLayer.System, false, UIFormCloseMode.Cache, true, UICoverVisualMode.KeepVisible, UIAnimationPreset.Fade, UIAnimationPreset.Fade);
        }

        public void RegisterCodeFormConfig<T>(UIGroupLayer layer = UIGroupLayer.Normal, bool useMask = false, UIFormCloseMode closeMode = UIFormCloseMode.Cache, bool resident = false, UICoverVisualMode coverVisualMode = UICoverVisualMode.HideByCanvasGroup, UIAnimationPreset openAnimation = UIAnimationPreset.None, UIAnimationPreset closeAnimation = UIAnimationPreset.None, bool overrideExisting = false) where T : UIForm
        {
            Type type = typeof(T);
            if (!overrideExisting && _configRegistry.TryGet(type.Name, out _))
                return;

            RegisterConfig(new UIFormConfig
            {
                formId = type.Name,
                logicType = type.FullName,
                assetPath = string.Empty,
                configGroup = "Code",
                layer = layer,
                allowMultiInstance = false,
                closeMode = closeMode,
                resident = resident,
                coverVisualMode = coverVisualMode,
                useMask = useMask,
                maskMode = useMask ? UIMaskMode.Dim : UIMaskMode.None,
                closeOnMaskClick = false,
                openAnimation = openAnimation,
                closeAnimation = closeAnimation
            });
        }

        public void RegisterConfig(UIFormConfig config)
        {
            _configRegistry.Register(config);
        }

        public bool IsLoading(string formId)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId) && _loadingFormsById.ContainsKey(formId);
        }

        public bool IsLoading<T>() where T : UIForm => IsLoading(typeof(T).Name);
        public bool IsAnyLoading() => _loadingSerialIds.Count > 0;

        public UniTask<UIForm> OpenAsync(string formId, object userData = null)
        {
            return OpenAsync(formId, UIOpenOptions.FromUserData(userData));
        }

        public UniTask<UIForm> OpenAsync(string formId, object userData, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return OpenAsync(formId, UIOpenOptions.FromUserData(userData, cancellationToken));
        }

        public async UniTask<UIForm> OpenAsync(string formId, UIOpenOptions options)
        {
            options = UIOpenOptions.Normalize(options);

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId))
            {
                FRLog.Error("UIManager.OpenAsync failed, formId is null or empty.");
                return null;
            }

            if (!_configRegistry.TryGet(formId, out UIFormConfig config))
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UIManager.OpenAsync failed, form config not found : {formId}");
                return null;
            }

            CancellationTokenSource linkedSource = CreateLinkedCancellation(options.CancellationToken, options.Timeout);
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = linkedSource.Token;

            try
            {
                if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    return null;

                if (!config.allowMultiInstance)
                {
                    UIForm existing = Get(formId);
                    if (existing != null)
                    {
                        await OpenExistingFormAsync(existing, options, cancellationToken);
                        return existing;
                    }

                    if (_loadingFormsById.TryGetValue(formId, out UILoadingOperation loadingOperation))
                    {
                        UIForm loadingForm = await loadingOperation.Source.Task;
                        if (loadingForm != null && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                            await OpenExistingFormAsync(loadingForm, options, cancellationToken);
                        return cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested ? null : loadingForm;
                    }
                }

                int serialId = ++_serialSeed;
                UILoadingOperation operation = CreateLoadingOperation(formId, serialId, config, linkedSource);

                try
                {
                    GameObject instance = string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.assetPath)
                        ? CreateCodeFormRoot(formId, GetGroupRoot(config.layer))
                        : await FRFM.Resource.InstantiateAsync(config.assetPath, GetGroupRoot(config.layer), new ResourceLoadOptions
                        {
                            PackageName = ResolvePackageName(config),
                        });

                    if (instance == null || operation.CancelRequested || cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    {
                        if (instance != null)
                            RecycleOrDestroyFormInstance(instance, config);
                        operation.Source?.TrySetResult(null);
                        return null;
                    }

                    UIForm form = CreateFormInstance(instance, config, formId, serialId, options.UserData);
                    if (form == null)
                    {
                        FRFM.Resource.Recycle(instance);
                        operation.Source?.TrySetResult(null);
                        return null;
                    }

                    RegisterForm(form, config);
                    form.ApplyOpenOptions(options);
                    ApplyOpenParam(form, options.UserData, options.StrongParamType);
                    await _maskService.PrepareBlurAsync(form);
                    form.InternalOpen(options.UserData);
                    RefreshAllVisualStates();

                    if (options.PlayAnimation)
                        await form.InternalPlayOpenAnimationAsync(cancellationToken).SuppressCancellationThrow();

                    operation.Source?.TrySetResult(form);
                    return form;
                }
                finally
                {
                    RemoveLoadingOperation(operation, config);
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                linkedSource?.Dispose();
            }
        }

        public UniTask<T> OpenAsync<T>(object userData = null) where T : UIForm
        {
            return OpenAsync<T>(userData, default);
        }

        public async UniTask<T> OpenAsync<T>(object userData, CancellationToken cancellationToken) where T : UIForm
        {
            UIForm form = await OpenAsync(typeof(T).Name, userData, cancellationToken);
            return form as T;
        }

        public async UniTask<UIOpenResult<T>> TryOpenAsync<T>(object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where T : UIForm
        {
            if (!_configRegistry.TryGet(typeof(T).Name, out _))
                return UIOpenResult<T>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.ConfigNotFound, typeof(T).Name);

            T form = await OpenAsync<T>(userData, cancellationToken);
            if (form != null)
                return UIOpenResult<T>.Success(form);

            return cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested
                ? UIOpenResult<T>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.Canceled, typeof(T).Name)
                : UIOpenResult<T>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.LoadFailed, typeof(T).Name);
        }

        public async UniTask<UIOpenResult<UIForm>> TryOpenAsync(string formId, UIOpenOptions options)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId))
                return UIOpenResult<UIForm>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.InvalidFormId);

            if (!_configRegistry.TryGet(formId, out _))
                return UIOpenResult<UIForm>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.ConfigNotFound, formId);

            UIForm form = await OpenAsync(formId, options);
            if (form != null)
                return UIOpenResult<UIForm>.Success(form);

            return options.CancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested
                ? UIOpenResult<UIForm>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.Canceled, formId)
                : UIOpenResult<UIForm>.Failure(UIOpenFailureReason.LoadFailed, formId);
        }

        public void Close(string formId, object userData = null)
        {
            if (CancelLoading(formId))
                return;

            UIForm form = Get(formId);
            if (form != null)
                Close(form, userData);
        }

        public void Close<T>(object userData = null) where T : UIForm => Close(typeof(T).Name, userData);

        public void Close(UIForm form, object userData = null)
        {
            CloseAsync(form, userData).Forget();
        }

        public UniTask CloseAsync(string formId, object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            UIForm form = Get(formId);
            return form == null ? UniTask.CompletedTask : CloseAsync(form, userData, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask CloseAsync(UIForm form, object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (form == null || form.State == UIFormState.Disposed || form.State == UIFormState.Closing)
                return;

            form.InternalBeginClose();
            await form.InternalPlayCloseAnimationAsync(cancellationToken).SuppressCancellationThrow();
            form.InternalClose(userData);

            if (form.Config != null && (form.Config.resident || form.Config.closeMode == UIFormCloseMode.Cache))
            {
                form.InternalHide();
                RefreshAllVisualStates();
                return;
            }

            DisposeForm(form, userData);
        }

        public void Hide(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            form.InternalHide();
            RefreshAllVisualStates();
        }

        public void Hide(string formId)
        {
            Hide(Get(formId));
        }

        public void Hide<T>() where T : UIForm
        {
            Hide(typeof(T).Name);
        }

        public void Show(UIForm form, object userData = null)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            if (form.Config != null && form.Config.bringToFrontOnOpen)
                form.Group?.BringToFront(form);

            form.InternalShow(userData);
            RefreshAllVisualStates();
        }

        public void Show(string formId, object userData = null)

        }
````
