````csharp
        }

        public async UniTask PreloadAsync(string formId, UIPreloadMode mode = UIPreloadMode.AssetOnly, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId) || !_configRegistry.TryGet(formId, out UIFormConfig config))
                return;

            UIPreloadInfo info = GetOrCreatePreloadInfo(formId, config, mode);
            info.Mode = mode;

            if ((mode == UIPreloadMode.AssetOnly || mode == UIPreloadMode.AssetAndInstance) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.assetPath))
            {
                await FRFM.Resource.PreloadAssetAsync<GameObject>(config.assetPath, new ResourceLoadOptions
                {
                    PackageName = ResolvePackageName(config),
                    TrackReference = false,
                    AllowCache = true
                });

                if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    return;

                info.AssetPreloaded = true;
                info.LastPreloadTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartup;
            }

            if (mode == UIPreloadMode.AssetOnly)
                return;

            if (Get(formId) != null)
            {
                info.InstanceWarmed = true;
                info.LastPreloadTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartup;
                return;
            }

            GameObject instance = string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.assetPath)
                ? CreateCodeFormRoot(formId, GetGroupRoot(config.layer))
                : await FRFM.Resource.InstantiateAsync(config.assetPath, GetGroupRoot(config.layer), new ResourceLoadOptions
                {
                    PackageName = ResolvePackageName(config),
                });

            if (instance == null || cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                if (instance != null)
                    RecycleOrDestroyFormInstance(instance, config);
                return;
            }

            instance.SetActive(false);
            int serialId = ++_serialSeed;
            UIForm form = CreateFormInstance(instance, config, formId, serialId, null);
            if (form == null)
            {
                RecycleOrDestroyFormInstance(instance, config);
                return;
            }

            RegisterForm(form, config);
            form.ApplyOpenOptions(UIOpenOptions.Default);
            if (form is IUIPreloadHandler preloadHandler)
                await preloadHandler.OnPreloadAsync(cancellationToken).SuppressCancellationThrow();
            form.InternalPreload();
            info.InstanceWarmed = true;
            info.LastPreloadTime = Time.realtimeSinceStartup;
            RefreshAllVisualStates();
        }

        public UniTask PreloadAsync<T>(UIPreloadMode mode = UIPreloadMode.AssetOnly, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where T : UIForm
        {
            return PreloadAsync(typeof(T).Name, mode, cancellationToken);
        }

        public void ReleasePreload(string formId)
        {
            UIForm form = Get(formId);
            if (form != null && form.State == UIFormState.Preloaded)
                DisposeForm(form, null);
        }

        public void ReleaseAllPreloads()
        {
            List<UIForm> preloadedForms = new List<UIForm>();
            foreach (UIForm form in _formsBySerialId.Values)
            {
                if (form != null && form.State == UIFormState.Preloaded)
                    preloadedForms.Add(form);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < preloadedForms.Count; i++)
                DisposeForm(preloadedForms[i], null);
        }

        public bool IsPreloaded(string formId)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId) && _preloadInfos.TryGetValue(formId, out UIPreloadInfo info) && (info.AssetPreloaded || info.InstanceWarmed))
                return true;

            UIForm form = Get(formId);
            return form != null && form.State == UIFormState.Preloaded;
        }

        public bool Back()
        {
            if (CloseTopBackForm())
                return true;

            return _navigation != null && _navigation.Back();
        }

        public bool CloseTopBackForm(object userData = null)
        {
            for (int layer = (int)UIGroupLayer.System; layer >= (int)UIGroupLayer.Background; layer--)
            {
                if (!_groups.TryGetValue((UIGroupLayer)layer, out UIGroup group))
                    continue;

                UIForm form = group.GetTopBackCloseForm();
                if (form == null)
                    continue;

                if (form.InternalTryHandleBack())
                    return true;

                Close(form, userData);
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        public bool CancelLoading(string formId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId) || !_loadingFormsById.TryGetValue(formId, out UILoadingOperation operation))
                return false;

            operation.CancelRequested = true;
            operation.CancellationSource?.Cancel();
            operation.Source?.TrySetResult(null);
            return true;
        }

        public bool CancelLoading(int serialId)
        {
            if (!_loadingFormsBySerialId.TryGetValue(serialId, out UILoadingOperation operation))
                return false;

            operation.CancelRequested = true;
            operation.CancellationSource?.Cancel();
            operation.Source?.TrySetResult(null);
            return true;
        }

        public void CancelSceneLoading()
        {
            _sceneCancellationSource.Cancel();
            CancelAllLoading();
        }

        public void ResetSceneCancellation()
        {
            _sceneCancellationSource.Dispose();
            _sceneCancellationSource = new CancellationTokenSource();
        }

        public UIForm Get(string formId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId))
                return null;

            return _formsById.TryGetValue(formId, out var list) && list.Count > 0 ? list[0] : null;
        }

        public T Get<T>() where T : UIForm => Get(typeof(T).Name) as T;

        public List<UIForm> GetAll(string formId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId))
                return null;

            return _formsById.TryGetValue(formId, out var list) ? list : null;
        }

        public List<T> GetAll<T>() where T : UIForm
        {
            string formId = typeof(T).Name;
            List<T> result = new List<T>();
            if (_formsById.TryGetValue(formId, out var list))
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
                {
                    if (list[i] is T t)
                        result.Add(t);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        public bool IsOpen(string formId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId) || !_formsById.TryGetValue(formId, out var list))
                return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
            {
                UIForm form = list[i];
                if (form != null && form.State == UIFormState.Opened && form.IsVisible)
                    return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        public bool IsOpen<T>() where T : UIForm => IsOpen(typeof(T).Name);

        public UIManagerSnapshot CreateSnapshot()
        {
            UIManagerSnapshot snapshot = new UIManagerSnapshot
            {
                NavigationCount = _navigation != null ? _navigation.Count : 0,
                Toast = _toastService?.CreateSnapshot(),
                Dialog = _dialogService?.CreateSnapshot(),
                Loading = _loadingService?.CreateSnapshot(),
                Masks = _maskService != null ? _maskService.CreateSnapshots() : new List<UIMaskSnapshot>()
            };

            foreach (var pair in _groups)
            {
                snapshot.Groups.Add(new UIGroupSnapshot
                {
                    Layer = pair.Key,
                    Name = pair.Value.Name,
                    FormCount = pair.Value.Forms.Count,
                    SortingOrderBase = pair.Value.SortingOrderBase
                });
            }

            foreach (UIForm form in _formsBySerialId.Values)
            {
                if (form == null)
                    continue;

                if (form.State == UIFormState.Opened)
                    snapshot.OpenedCount++;
                else if (form.State == UIFormState.Hidden)
                    snapshot.HiddenCount++;
                else if (form.State == UIFormState.Preloaded)
                    snapshot.PreloadedCount++;
                else if (form.State == UIFormState.Loading)
                    snapshot.LoadingCount++;

                snapshot.Forms.Add(new UIFormSnapshot
                {
                    SerialId = form.SerialId,
                    FormId = form.FormId,
                    LogicType = form.Config != null ? form.Config.logicType : null,
                    AssetPath = form.Config != null ? form.Config.assetPath : null,
                    ConfigGroup = form.Config != null ? form.Config.configGroup : null,
                    PackageName = form.Config != null ? ResolvePackageName(form.Config) : null,
                    Layer = form.Config != null ? form.Config.layer : UIGroupLayer.Normal,
                    State = form.State,
                    SortingOrder = form.SortingOrder,
                    Depth = form.Group != null ? form.Group.GetDepth(form) : -1,
                    IsTopOfFormId = GetTop(form.FormId) == form,
                    IsVisible = form.IsVisible,
                    IsPaused = form.IsPaused,
                    IsCovered = form.IsCovered,
                    UseMask = form.UseMask,
                    MaskMode = form.MaskMode,
                    CloseOnMaskClick = form.CloseOnMaskClick
                });
            }

            foreach (UILoadingOperation operation in _loadingFormsBySerialId.Values)
            {
                snapshot.LoadingForms.Add(new UILoadingFormSnapshot
                {
                    FormId = operation.FormId,
                    SerialId = operation.SerialId,
                    CancelRequested = operation.CancelRequested,
                    HasFormInstance = _formsBySerialId.ContainsKey(operation.SerialId)
                });
            }
            snapshot.LoadingCount += _loadingFormsBySerialId.Count;

            foreach (UIPreloadInfo info in _preloadInfos.Values)
            {
                snapshot.Preloads.Add(new UIPreloadSnapshot
                {
                    FormId = info.FormId,
                    Mode = info.Mode,
                    AssetPreloaded = info.AssetPreloaded,
                    InstanceWarmed = info.InstanceWarmed,
                    PackageName = info.PackageName,
                    AssetPath = info.AssetPath,
                    LastPreloadTime = info.LastPreloadTime
                });
            }

            return snapshot;
        }

        public UIForm GetTop(string formId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(formId) || !_formsById.TryGetValue(formId, out var list))
                return null;

            UIForm top = null;
            int topOrder = int.MinValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
            {
                UIForm form = list[i];
                if (form == null || form.State == UIFormState.Disposed)
                    continue;

                int order = form.SortingOrder;
                if (top == null || order >= topOrder)
                {
                    top = form;
                    topOrder = order;
                }
            }

            return top;
        }

        public T GetTop<T>() where T : UIForm => GetTop(typeof(T).Name) as T;

        public bool TryGetBySerialId(int serialId, out UIForm form)
        {
            return _formsBySerialId.TryGetValue(serialId, out form);
        }

        public void CloseTop(string formId, object userData = null)
        {
            UIForm form = GetTop(formId);
            if (form != null)
                Close(form, userData);
        }

        public void CloseTop<T>(object userData = null) where T : UIForm => CloseTop(typeof(T).Name, userData);

        public void CloseAll(string formId, object userData = null)
        {
            if (CancelLoading(formId))
                return;

            List<UIForm> forms = GetAll(formId);
            if (forms == null)
                return;

            List<UIForm> snapshot = new List<UIForm>(forms);
            for (int i = snapshot.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                Close(snapshot[i], userData);
        }

        public void CloseAll<T>(object userData = null) where T : UIForm => CloseAll(typeof(T).Name, userData);

        public void Close(int serialId, object userData = null)
        {
            if (CancelLoading(serialId))
                return;

            if (_formsBySerialId.TryGetValue(serialId, out UIForm form))
                Close(form, userData);
        }

        public UniTask CloseAsync(int serialId, object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            return _formsBySerialId.TryGetValue(serialId, out UIForm form) ? CloseAsync(form, userData, cancellationToken) : UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        internal void RemoveFromNavigation(UIForm form)
        {
            _navigation?.Remove(form);
        }

        private async UniTask OpenExistingFormAsync(UIForm form, UIOpenOptions options, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            ApplyOpenParam(form, options.UserData, options.StrongParamType);
            form.ApplyOpenOptions(options);
            if (form.Config != null && (options.BringToFront ?? form.Config.bringToFrontOnOpen))
                form.Group?.BringToFront(form);

            bool willOpen = form.State == UIFormState.Preloaded ||
                            form.State == UIFormState.Hidden ||
                            !form.gameObject.activeSelf ||
                            form.State != UIFormState.Opened;
            if (willOpen)
                await _maskService.PrepareBlurAsync(form);

            if (form.State == UIFormState.Preloaded)
                form.InternalOpen(options.UserData);
            else if (form.State == UIFormState.Hidden || !form.gameObject.activeSelf)
                form.InternalShow(options.UserData);
            else if (form.State != UIFormState.Opened)
                form.InternalOpen(options.UserData);

            RefreshAllVisualStates();
            if (options.PlayAnimation)
                await form.InternalPlayOpenAnimationAsync(cancellationToken).SuppressCancellationThrow();
        }

        private GameObject CreateCodeFormRoot(string formId, Transform parent)
        {
            GameObject instance = new GameObject(formId, typeof(RectTransform));
            instance.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            RectTransform rect = instance.transform as RectTransform;
            rect.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
            rect.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
            rect.localScale = Vector3.one;
            int uiLayer = LayerMask.NameToLayer("UI");
            if (uiLayer >= 0)
                instance.SetLayerRecursively(uiLayer);
            return instance;
        }

        private UIForm CreateFormInstance(GameObject instance, UIFormConfig config, string formId, int serialId, object userData)
        {
            if (!(instance.transform is RectTransform))
                FRLog.Warning($"UIManager.OpenAsync warning, ui root is not RectTransform : {formId}, asset : {config.assetPath}");

            Type logicType = ResolveLogicType(config.logicType);
            if (logicType == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UIManager.OpenAsync failed, logic type not found : {config.logicType}");
                return null;
            }

            UIForm form = instance.GetComponent(logicType) as UIForm;
            if (form == null)
                form = instance.AddComponent(logicType) as UIForm;

            if (form == null)
            {
                FRLog.Error($"UIManager.OpenAsync failed, form component create failed : {config.logicType}");
                return null;
            }

            UIGroup group = _groups[config.layer];
            form.SerialId = serialId;
            form.Group = group;
            form.InternalSetLoading();
            form.InternalInitialize(new UIFormOpenContext { FormId = formId, Config = config, UserData = userData });
            instance.transform.SetParent(group.Root, false);
            instance.SetLayerRecursively(group.Root.gameObject.layer);
            return form;
        }

        private void RegisterForm(UIForm form, UIFormConfig config)
        {
            if (!_formsById.TryGetValue(form.FormId, out var list))
            {
                list = new List<UIForm>();
                _formsById.Add(form.FormId, list);
            }
            list.Add(form);
            _formsBySerialId.Add(form.SerialId, form);
            UIGroup group = _groups[config.layer];
            group.Add(form);
            if (config.bringToFrontOnOpen)
                group.BringToFront(form);
        }

        private void DisposeForm(UIForm form, object userData)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            RemoveFromNavigation(form);
            form.Group?.Remove(form);
            _formsBySerialId.Remove(form.SerialId);
            if (_formsById.TryGetValue(form.FormId, out var list))
            {
                list.Remove(form);
                if (list.Count == 0)
                    _formsById.Remove(form.FormId);
            }

            form.InternalDispose();
            if (form.gameObject != null)
                RecycleOrDestroyFormInstance(form.gameObject, form.Config);

            RefreshAllVisualStates();
        }

        private void RecycleOrDestroyFormInstance(GameObject instance, UIFormConfig config)
        {
            if (instance == null)
                return;

            // Destroy-mode forms must not be returned to the resource pool. A pooled
            // UIForm has already been disposed (including event unbinding), while
            // UIForm.IsInitialized remains true, so reusing it skips BindEvent and
            // produces a dead UI on the next open.
            if (config == null ||
                string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.assetPath) ||
                config.closeMode == UIFormCloseMode.Destroy)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(config?.assetPath))
                    Object.Destroy(instance);
                else
                    FRFM.Resource.DestroyInstance(instance);
            }
            else
            {
                FRFM.Resource.Recycle(instance);
            }
        }

        private UILoadingOperation CreateLoadingOperation(string formId, int serialId, UIFormConfig config, CancellationTokenSource cancellationSource)
        {
            UILoadingOperation operation = new UILoadingOperation
            {
                FormId = formId,
                SerialId = serialId,
                CancellationSource = cancellationSource,
                Source = config.allowMultiInstance ? null : new UniTaskCompletionSource<UIForm>()
            };
            _loadingSerialIds.Add(serialId);
            _loadingFormsBySerialId.Add(serialId, operation);
            if (!config.allowMultiInstance)
                _loadingFormsById.Add(formId, operation);
            return operation;
        }

        private void RemoveLoadingOperation(UILoadingOperation operation, UIFormConfig config)
        {
            if (operation == null)
                return;

            _loadingSerialIds.Remove(operation.SerialId);
            _loadingFormsBySerialId.Remove(operation.SerialId);
            if (!config.allowMultiInstance)
                _loadingFormsById.Remove(operation.FormId);
        }

        private CancellationTokenSource CreateLinkedCancellation(CancellationToken cancellationToken, float timeout)
        {
            CancellationTokenSource linked = CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(cancellationToken, _sceneCancellationSource.Token);
            if (timeout > 0f)
                linked.CancelAfterSlim(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(timeout));
            return linked;
        }

        private void ApplyOpenParam(UIForm form, object userData, Type strongParamType)
        {
            if (form == null || userData == null)
                return;

            Type userDataType = userData.GetType();
            Type[] interfaces = form.GetType().GetInterfaces();
            for (int i = 0; i < interfaces.Length; i++)
            {
                Type interfaceType = interfaces[i];
                if (!interfaceType.IsGenericType || interfaceType.GetGenericTypeDefinition() != typeof(IUIOpenParamReceiver<>))
                    continue;

                Type paramType = interfaceType.GetGenericArguments()[0];
                if (!paramType.IsAssignableFrom(userDataType))
                    continue;

                interfaceType.GetMethod(nameof(IUIOpenParamReceiver<object>.SetOpenParam))?.Invoke(form, new[] { userData });
                return;
            }

            if (strongParamType != null)
                FRLog.Warning($"UIManager.OpenAsync warning, form {form.GetType().Name} does not implement IUIOpenParamReceiver<{strongParamType.Name}>.");
        }

        private void CancelAllLoading()
        {
            var operations = new List<UILoadingOperation>(_loadingFormsBySerialId.Values);
            for (int i = 0; i < operations.Count; i++)
            {
                operations[i].CancelRequested = true;
                operations[i].CancellationSource?.Cancel();
                operations[i].Source?.TrySetResult(null);
            }
        }

        private void RefreshAllVisualStates()
        {
            RefreshAllCoverStates();
            _maskService?.Refresh(_groups);
        }

        private void RefreshAllCoverStates()
        {
            bool covered = false;
            for (int layer = (int)UIGroupLayer.System; layer >= (int)UIGroupLayer.Background; layer--)
            {
                if (_groups.TryGetValue((UIGroupLayer)layer, out UIGroup group))
                    covered = group.ApplyCoverState(covered);
            }
        }

        private Transform GetGroupRoot(UIGroupLayer layer) => _groups[layer].Root;

        private UIPreloadInfo GetOrCreatePreloadInfo(string formId, UIFormConfig config, UIPreloadMode mode)
        {
            if (!_preloadInfos.TryGetValue(formId, out UIPreloadInfo info))
            {
                info = new UIPreloadInfo
                {
                    FormId = formId
                };
                _preloadInfos.Add(formId, info);
            }

            info.Mode = mode;
            info.PackageName = ResolvePackageName(config);
            info.AssetPath = config != null ? config.assetPath : null;
            return info;
        }

        internal string ResolvePackageName(UIFormConfig config)
        {
            if (config == null)
                return null;

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.packageName))
                return config.packageName;

            string packageName = _configRegistry?.GetDefaultPackageName(config.configGroup);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
                return packageName;

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.configGroup) && _configGroupPackageFallbackWarnings.Add(config.configGroup))
                FRLog.Warning($"UI config uses configGroup as package fallback: {config.configGroup}. Please set packageName/defaultPackageName explicitly.");

            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.configGroup) ? null : config.configGroup;
        }

        private Type ResolveLogicType(string fullTypeName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullTypeName))
                return null;

            Type type = Type.GetType(fullTypeName);
            if (type != null)
                return type;

            var assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();
            for (int i = 0; i < assemblies.Length; i++)
            {
                type = assemblies[i].GetType(fullTypeName);
                if (type != null)
                    return type;
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIMaskService
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<UIGroupLayer, MaskView> _masks = new Dictionary<UIGroupLayer, MaskView>();
        private UIManager _uiManager;

        public void Initialize(UIManager uiManager, IReadOnlyDictionary<UIGroupLayer, UIGroup> groups)
        {
            _uiManager = uiManager;
            for (int layer = (int)UIGroupLayer.Background; layer <= (int)UIGroupLayer.System; layer++)
            {
                UIGroupLayer groupLayer = (UIGroupLayer)layer;
                Transform parent = groups != null && groups.TryGetValue(groupLayer, out UIGroup group) ? group.Root : null;
                if (parent == null)
                    continue;

                GameObject go = CreateStretchNode($"{groupLayer}Mask", parent, typeof(Canvas), typeof(GraphicRaycaster), typeof(Image), typeof(Button));

                Canvas canvas = go.GetComponent<Canvas>();
                canvas.overrideSorting = true;

                Image image = go.GetComponent<Image>();
                image.color = Color.clear;
                image.raycastTarget = true;

                GameObject backdropGo = CreateStretchNode("Backdrop", go.transform, typeof(CanvasRenderer), typeof(RawImage));
                RawImage backdrop = backdropGo.GetComponent<RawImage>();
                backdrop.raycastTarget = false;
                backdrop.color = Color.white;

                GameObject tintGo = CreateStretchNode("Tint", go.transform, typeof(CanvasRenderer), typeof(RawImage));
                RawImage tint = tintGo.GetComponent<RawImage>();
                tint.texture = Texture2D.whiteTexture;
                tint.raycastTarget = false;

                Button button = go.GetComponent<Button>();
                MaskView view = new MaskView(go, canvas, image, backdrop, tint, button);
                _masks[groupLayer] = view;
                go.SetActive(false);
            }
        }

        public UniTask PrepareBlurAsync(UIForm target)
        {
            if (target?.Group == null || !target.UseMask || target.MaskMode != UIMaskMode.Blur)
                return UniTask.CompletedTask;

            return _masks.TryGetValue(target.Group.Layer, out MaskView view)
                ? view.PrepareBlurAsync(target)
                : UniTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        public void Refresh(IReadOnlyDictionary<UIGroupLayer, UIGroup> groups)
        {
            foreach (var pair in _masks)
            {
                if (!groups.TryGetValue(pair.Key, out UIGroup group))
                {
                    pair.Value.Hide();
                    continue;
                }

                UIForm target = group.GetTopMaskForm();
                if (target == null)
                {
                    pair.Value.Hide();
                    continue;
                }

                pair.Value.Show(target, _uiManager);
            }
        }

        public void HideAll()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _masks)
                pair.Value.Hide();
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _masks)
                pair.Value.Dispose();
            _masks.Clear();
        }

        public List<UIMaskSnapshot> CreateSnapshots()
        {
            List<UIMaskSnapshot> snapshots = new List<UIMaskSnapshot>();
            foreach (var pair in _masks)
                snapshots.Add(pair.Value.CreateSnapshot(pair.Key));
            return snapshots;
        }

        private static GameObject CreateStretchNode(string name, Transform parent, params System.Type[] components)
        {
            GameObject go = new GameObject(name, components);
            go.layer = parent.gameObject.layer;
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            RectTransform rect = go.transform as RectTransform;
            rect.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
            rect.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
            rect.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
            return go;
        }

        private sealed class MaskView
        {
            private const int BlurDownsample = 2;
            private const int BlurIterations = 2;
            private static readonly int ParameterId = Shader.PropertyToID("_Parameter");
            private static readonly int DirectionId = Shader.PropertyToID("_Direction");
            private static Shader _blurShader;
            private static bool _blurShaderLoaded;

            private readonly GameObject _go;
            private readonly Canvas _canvas;
            private readonly Image _image;
            private readonly RawImage _backdrop;
            private readonly RawImage _tint;
            private readonly Button _button;
            private UIForm _target;
            private UIManager _uiManager;
            private Material _blurMaterial;
            private RenderTexture _blurTexture;

            public MaskView(GameObject go, Canvas canvas, Image image, RawImage backdrop, RawImage tint, Button button)
            {
                _go = go;
                _canvas = canvas;
                _image = image;
                _backdrop = backdrop;
                _tint = tint;
                _button = button;
                _button.onClick.AddListener(OnClick);
            }

            public async UniTask PrepareBlurAsync(UIForm target)
            {
                _target = target;
                // The capture must exclude this mask. Show() can be reached later in
                // the same open flow, so keep the mask hidden until the frame-end grab.
                _go.SetActive(false);
                await UniTask.WaitForEndOfFrame();
                CaptureBlur();
            }

            public void Show(UIForm target, UIManager uiManager)
            {
                _target = target;
                _uiManager = uiManager;

                _canvas.sortingOrder = Mathf.Max(0, target.SortingOrder - 1);
                _tint.color = GetColor(target);
                _go.SetActive(true);

                bool useBlur = target.MaskMode == UIMaskMode.Blur;
                if (!useBlur)
                {
                    _backdrop.gameObject.SetActive(false);
                    ReleaseBlurTexture();
                    return;
                }

                // PrepareBlurAsync performs the frame-end capture before this object is
                // shown. Avoid a synchronous fallback here: it would capture the mask.
                _backdrop.gameObject.SetActive(_blurTexture != null);
            }

            public void Hide()
            {
                _target = null;
                _go.SetActive(false);
                ReleaseBlurTexture();
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                ReleaseBlurTexture();
                if (_blurMaterial != null)
                {
                    Object.Destroy(_blurMaterial);
                    _blurMaterial = null;
                }
            }

            public UIMaskSnapshot CreateSnapshot(UIGroupLayer layer)
            {
                return new UIMaskSnapshot
                {
                    Layer = layer,
                    Active = _go != null && _go.activeSelf,
                    SortingOrder = _canvas != null ? _canvas.sortingOrder : 0,
                    TargetFormId = _target != null ? _target.FormId : null,
                    TargetSerialId = _target != null ? _target.SerialId : 0,
                    MaskMode = _target != null ? _target.MaskMode : UIMaskMode.None,
                    Color = _tint != null ? _tint.color : Color.clear,
                    CloseOnMaskClick = _target != null && _target.CloseOnMaskClick
                };
            }

            private void CaptureBlur()
            {
                ReleaseBlurTexture();
                Shader shader = GetBlurShader();
                if (shader == null)
                    return;

                if (_blurMaterial == null)
                    _blurMaterial = new Material(shader) { hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave };

                int width = Mathf.Max(1, Screen.width / BlurDownsample);
                int height = Mathf.Max(1, Screen.height / BlurDownsample);
                Texture2D screenshot = null;
                RenderTexture ping = null;
                RenderTexture pong = null;
                RenderTexture result = null;
                bool previousSrgbWrite = GL.sRGBWrite;
                try
                {
                    screenshot = ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshotAsTexture();
                    if (screenshot == null)
                        return;

                    ping = RenderTexture.GetTemporary(width, height, 0, RenderTextureFormat.Default, RenderTextureReadWrite.Linear);
                    pong = RenderTexture.GetTemporary(width, height, 0, RenderTextureFormat.Default, RenderTextureReadWrite.Linear);
                    screenshot.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
                    screenshot.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
                    ping.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
                    ping.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
                    pong.wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp;
                    pong.filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear;
                    GL.sRGBWrite = false;
                    _blurMaterial.SetVector(ParameterId, Vector4.one);
                    _blurMaterial.SetVector(DirectionId, Vector2.zero);
                    Graphics.Blit(screenshot, ping, _blurMaterial, 0);
                    for (int i = 0; i < BlurIterations; i++)
                    {
                        _blurMaterial.SetVector(ParameterId, new Vector4(1f + i, 0f, 0f, 0f));
                        _blurMaterial.SetVector(DirectionId, Vector2.right);
                        Graphics.Blit(ping, pong, _blurMaterial);
                        _blurMaterial.SetVector(DirectionId, Vector2.up);
                        Graphics.Blit(pong, ping, _blurMaterial);
                    }

                    result = new RenderTexture(width, height, 0, RenderTextureFormat.Default, RenderTextureReadWrite.sRGB)
                    {
                        name = "UI Backdrop Blur",
                        filterMode = FilterMode.Bilinear,
                        wrapMode = TextureWrapMode.Clamp
                    };
                    if (!result.Create())
                        return;

                    // The source already contains display-encoded screenshot values.
                    // Store those values unchanged in the sRGB-tagged UI texture.
                    GL.sRGBWrite = false;
                    Graphics.Blit(ping, result);
                    _blurTexture = result;
                    result = null;
                    _backdrop.texture = _blurTexture;
                }
                finally
                {
                    GL.sRGBWrite = previousSrgbWrite;
                    if (screenshot != null)
                        Object.Destroy(screenshot);
                    if (ping != null)
                        RenderTexture.ReleaseTemporary(ping);
                    if (pong != null)
                        RenderTexture.ReleaseTemporary(pong);
                    if (result != null)
                    {
                        result.Release();
                        Object.Destroy(result);
                    }
                }
            }

            private static Shader GetBlurShader()
            {
                if (_blurShaderLoaded)
                    return _blurShader;

                _blurShaderLoaded = true;
                _blurShader = Resources.Load<Shader>("UIBackdropBlur");
                if (_blurShader == null)
                    FRLog.Warning("UI blur mask shader was not found.");
                return _blurShader;
            }

            private void ReleaseBlurTexture()
            {
                _backdrop.texture = null;
                if (_blurTexture == null)
                    return;

                _blurTexture.Release();
                Object.Destroy(_blurTexture);
                _blurTexture = null;
            }

            private void OnClick()
            {
                if (_target == null || _target.Config == null)
                    return;

                if (_target.CloseOnMaskClick)
                    _uiManager?.Close(_target);
            }

            private static Color GetColor(UIForm form)
            {
                if (form == null)
                    return Color.clear;

                switch (form.MaskMode)
                {
                    case UIMaskMode.Dim:
                        return new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0.6f);
                    case UIMaskMode.CustomColor:
                        return form.MaskColor;
                    case UIMaskMode.Blur:
                        Color blurColor = form.MaskColor;
                        if (QualitySettings.activeColorSpace == ColorSpace.Linear && blurColor.a > 0f)
                            blurColor.a = 1f - Mathf.Pow(1f - blurColor.a, 2.6f);
                        return blurColor;
                    default:
                        return Color.clear;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
    {
        public readonly bool Succeeded;
        public readonly TForm Form;
        public readonly UINavigationFailureReason FailureReason;

            Message = null;

        {
            Succeeded = false;
            Form = null;
            FailureReason = failureReason;
            Message = message;
        }
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UINavigator
    {
        private readonly UIManager _uiManager;
        private readonly List<UINavEntry> _stack = new List<UINavEntry>();

        public UINavigator(UIManager uiManager)
        {
            _uiManager = uiManager;
        }

        public int Count => _stack.Count;
        public IReadOnlyList<UINavEntry> Stack => _stack;

        public async UniTask<TForm> PushAsync<TForm>(object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            return await PushAsync<TForm>(userData, UINavClosePolicy.HidePrevious, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<TForm> PushAsync<TForm, TParam>(TParam param, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            return await PushAsync<TForm>(param, UINavClosePolicy.HidePrevious, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<TForm> PushAsync<TForm>(object userData, UINavClosePolicy closePolicy, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            UINavigationResult<TForm> result = await TryPushAsync<TForm>(userData, closePolicy, cancellationToken);
            return result.Form;
        }

        public async UniTask<UINavigationResult<TForm>> TryPushAsync<TForm>(object userData = null, UINavClosePolicy closePolicy = UINavClosePolicy.HidePrevious, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            UINavEntry previous = _stack.Count > 0 ? _stack[_stack.Count - 1] : null;
            bool previousHidden = false;

            if (previous?.Form != null && closePolicy == UINavClosePolicy.HidePrevious)
            {
                previous.Form.Hide();
                previousHidden = true;
            }

            TForm form = await _uiManager.OpenAsync<TForm>(userData, cancellationToken);
            if (form == null)
            {
                if (previousHidden && previous?.Form != null)
                    previous.Form.Show(previous.UserData);

                return cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested
                    ? UINavigationResult<TForm>.Failure(UINavigationFailureReason.Canceled, typeof(TForm).Name)
                    : UINavigationResult<TForm>.Failure(UINavigationFailureReason.OpenFailed, typeof(TForm).Name);
            }

            if (previous?.Form != null && closePolicy == UINavClosePolicy.ClosePrevious)
                previous.Form.Close();

            WarnIfNotNormalLayer(form);
            _stack.Add(new UINavEntry
            {
                FormId = form.FormId,
                Form = form,
                UserData = userData,
                Layer = form.Config != null ? form.Config.layer : UIGroupLayer.Normal,
                ClosePolicy = closePolicy
            });
            return UINavigationResult<TForm>.Success(form);
        }

        public async UniTask<TForm> ReplaceAsync<TForm>(object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            UINavigationResult<TForm> result = await TryReplaceAsync<TForm>(userData, cancellationToken);
            return result.Form;
        }

        public async UniTask<TForm> ReplaceAsync<TForm, TParam>(TParam param, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            return await ReplaceAsync<TForm>(param, cancellationToken);
        }

        public async UniTask<UINavigationResult<TForm>> TryReplaceAsync<TForm>(object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TForm : UIForm
        {
            UINavEntry top = _stack.Count > 0 ? _stack[_stack.Count - 1] : null;
            UINavigationResult<TForm> result = await TryPushAsync<TForm>(userData, UINavClosePolicy.KeepPrevious, cancellationToken);
            if (!result.Succeeded)
                return result;

            if (top != null)
            {
                _stack.Remove(top);
                top.Form?.Close();
            }

            return result;
        }

        public bool Back(object userData = null)
        {
            if (_stack.Count <= 1)
                return false;

            UINavEntry top = _stack[_stack.Count - 1];
            _stack.RemoveAt(_stack.Count - 1);
            if (top.Form != null)
                top.Form.Close(userData);

            UINavEntry previous = _stack[_stack.Count - 1];
            if (previous.Form != null)
                previous.Form.Show(previous.UserData);

            return true;
        }

        public void BackToRoot(object userData = null)
        {
            while (_stack.Count > 1)
                Back(userData);
        }

        public void Clear(bool closeForms = false)
        {
            if (closeForms)
            {
                for (int i = _stack.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                    _stack[i].Form?.Close();
            }

            _stack.Clear();
        }

        private void WarnIfNotNormalLayer(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form?.Config != null && form.Config.layer != UIGroupLayer.Normal)
                FRLog.Warning($"UINavigator warning, pushed form should use Normal layer. form : {form.FormId}, layer : {form.Config.layer}");
        }

        internal void Remove(UIForm form)
        {
            if (form == null)
                return;

            for (int i = _stack.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (_stack[i].Form == form)
                    _stack.RemoveAt(i);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIOpenHandle<TForm> where TForm : UIForm
    {
        private readonly Action _cancelAction;

        public UIOpenHandle(UniTask<TForm> task, Action cancelAction)
        {
            Task = task;
            _cancelAction = cancelAction;
        }

        public UniTask<TForm> Task { get; }
        public bool IsDone => Task.Status != UniTaskStatus.Pending;
        public bool IsCanceled { get; private set; }

        public void Cancel()
        {
            if (IsCanceled)
                return;

            IsCanceled = true;
            _cancelAction?.Invoke();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public struct UIOpenOptions
    {
        public object UserData;
        public CancellationToken CancellationToken;
        public float Timeout;
        public bool? BringToFront;
        public bool PlayAnimation;
        public bool HasPlayAnimationValue;
        public bool SuppressCancelLog;
        public Type StrongParamType;
        public bool? CloseOnMaskClickOverride;
        public bool? UseMaskOverride;
        public UIMaskMode? MaskModeOverride;
        public Color? MaskColorOverride;

        public static UIOpenOptions Default => new UIOpenOptions
        {
            PlayAnimation = true,
            HasPlayAnimationValue = true,
            SuppressCancelLog = true
        };

        public static UIOpenOptions Normalize(UIOpenOptions options)
        {
            if (!options.HasPlayAnimationValue)
                options.PlayAnimation = true;

            options.HasPlayAnimationValue = true;
            return options;
        }

        public static UIOpenOptions FromUserData(object userData, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            UIOpenOptions options = Default;
            options.UserData = userData;
            options.CancellationToken = cancellationToken;
            return options;
        }
    }

    public interface IUIOpenParamReceiver<in TParam>
    {
        void SetOpenParam(TParam param);
    }

    public interface IUIPreloadHandler
    {
        Cysharp.Threading.Tasks.UniTask OnPreloadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>Instance-owned notification tree. A node is visible when its own flag or any
    /// child is visible. Reparenting refreshes both ancestors and rejects cycles. It owns no timer,
    /// global singleton or gameplay state; presenters supply actual business eligibility.</summary>
    public sealed class UIRedDotTree
    {
        private sealed class Node
        {
            public bool Own,Visible;
            public Node Parent;
            public readonly List<Node> Children=new List<Node>();
            public Action<bool> Changed;
        }
        private readonly Dictionary<string,Node> _nodes=new Dictionary<string,Node>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private Node Get(string key)
        {
            if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(key))throw new ArgumentException("Notification key required.",nameof(key));
            if(!_nodes.TryGetValue(key,out var node)){node=new Node();_nodes.Add(key,node);}return node;
        }
        public bool IsVisible(string key)=>Get(key).Visible;
        public void Set(string key,bool visible){var node=Get(key);if(node.Own==visible)return;node.Own=visible;Refresh(node);}
        public void SetParent(string key,string parentKey)
        {
            var node=Get(key);var parent=parentKey==null?null:Get(parentKey);
            for(var ancestor=parent;ancestor!=null;ancestor=ancestor.Parent)
                if(ReferenceEquals(ancestor,node))throw new ArgumentException("Notification hierarchy cannot contain a cycle.");
            if(ReferenceEquals(node.Parent,parent))return;
            var old=node.Parent;old?.Children.Remove(node);node.Parent=parent;parent?.Children.Add(node);
            Refresh(old);Refresh(parent);
        }
        /// <summary>Immediate current-state callback. Dispose removes only this binding;
        /// observers cannot interrupt tree state propagation.</summary>
        public IDisposable Subscribe(string key,Action<bool> callback)
        {
            if(callback==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(callback));
            var node=Get(key);node.Changed+=callback;Notify(callback,node.Visible);return new Binding(node,callback);
        }
        private static void Refresh(Node node)
        {
            var changed=new List<Node>();
            for(var current=node;current!=null;current=current.Parent){
                bool visible=current.Own||current.Children.Exists(child=>child.Visible);
                if(current.Visible==visible)break;current.Visible=visible;changed.Add(current);
            }
            foreach(var current in changed)if(current.Changed!=null)
                foreach(Action<bool> callback in current.Changed.GetInvocationList())Notify(callback,current.Visible);
        }
        private static void Notify(Action<bool> callback,bool value)
        {try{callback(value);}catch(Exception error){Debug.LogException(error);}}
        private sealed class Binding:IDisposable
        {
            private Node _node;private Action<bool> _callback;
            public Binding(Node node,Action<bool> callback){_node=node;_callback=callback;}
            public void Dispose(){if(_node==null)return;_node.Changed-=_callback;_node=null;_callback=null;}
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
    public abstract class UIWidget : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public UIForm OwnerForm { get; private set; }
        public UIWidget ParentWidget { get; private set; }
        public UIForm RootForm { get; private set; }
        public UIWidgetState State { get; private set; }
        public bool IsInitialized { get; private set; }
        public bool IsVisible { get; private set; }

        protected UIBindData _bindData;
        protected RectTransform _rectTransform;

        private readonly List<UIWidget> _children = new List<UIWidget>();
        private readonly UIEventScopeSet _eventScopes = new UIEventScopeSet();

        internal void InternalInitialize(UIForm ownerForm, UIWidget parentWidget = null)
        {
            OwnerForm = ownerForm;
            ParentWidget = parentWidget;
            RootForm = ownerForm != null ? ownerForm : parentWidget?.RootForm;
            _rectTransform = transform as RectTransform;
            _bindData = GetComponent<UIBindData>();

            if (!IsInitialized)
            {
                BindInit();
                BindEvent();
                OnInit();
                IsInitialized = true;
                State = UIWidgetState.Initialized;
            }
        }

        internal void InternalOpen(object userData = null)
        {
            gameObject.SetActive(true);
            IsVisible = true;
            State = UIWidgetState.Opened;
            OnOpen(userData);
        }

        internal void InternalShow(object userData = null)
        {
            gameObject.SetActive(true);
            IsVisible = true;
            State = UIWidgetState.Opened;
            OnShow(userData);
        }

        internal void InternalHide()
        {
            _eventScopes.ClearVisible();
            for (int i = 0; i < _children.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_children[i] != null && _children[i].IsVisible)
                    _children[i].InternalHide();
            }

            gameObject.SetActive(false);
            IsVisible = false;
            State = UIWidgetState.Hidden;
            OnHide();
        }

        internal void InternalRefresh(object userData = null)
        {
            OnRefresh(userData);
        }

        internal void InternalDispose()
        {
            if (State == UIWidgetState.Disposed)
                return;

            ReleaseAllChildWidgets();
            _eventScopes.Dispose();
            UnbindEvent();
            OnDispose();
            State = UIWidgetState.Disposed;
        }

        public void Refresh(object userData = null)
        {
            InternalRefresh(userData);
        }

        /// <summary>Opens a world-space or standalone widget through the same initialization and
        /// visibility lifecycle as form-owned widgets. The caller owns placement/pooling; this does
        /// not register a UIForm, create a timer or replace UIManager for ordinary application UI.</summary>
        public void OpenStandalone(object userData = null)
        {
            if (OwnerForm != null || ParentWidget != null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("A form-owned widget cannot be opened as standalone.");
            if (State == UIWidgetState.Disposed)
                throw new ObjectDisposedException(GetType().Name);
            InternalInitialize(null);
            InternalOpen(userData);
        }

        public void SetVisible(bool visible)
        {
            if (visible)
                InternalShow();
            else
                InternalHide();
        }

        protected T CreateChildWidget<T>(GameObject root, object userData = null) where T : UIWidget
        {
            if (root == null)
                return null;

            T widget = root.GetComponent<T>();
            if (widget == null)
                widget = root.AddComponent<T>();

            root.SetLayerRecursively(gameObject.layer);
            widget.InternalInitialize(OwnerForm, this);
            widget.InternalOpen(userData);
            root.SetLayerRecursively(gameObject.layer);
            RegisterChildWidget(widget);
            OwnerForm?.RegisterWidget(widget);
            return widget;
        }

        protected async UniTask<T> LoadChildWidgetAsync<T>(string assetPath, Transform parent, object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where T : UIWidget
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath) || cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                return null;

            GameObject instance = await FRFM.Resource.InstantiateAsync(assetPath, parent);
            if (instance == null)
                return null;

            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                FRFM.Resource.Recycle(instance);
                return null;
            }

            return CreateChildWidget<T>(instance, userData);
        }

        protected UIWidgetSwitcher CreateWidgetSwitcher(Transform parent)
        {
            return new UIWidgetSwitcher(OwnerForm, parent, this);
        }

        private void RegisterChildWidget(UIWidget widget)
        {
            if (widget != null && !_children.Contains(widget))
                _children.Add(widget);
        }

        private void ReleaseAllChildWidgets()
        {
            for (int i = _children.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                UIWidget child = _children[i];
                if (child == null)
                    continue;

                child.InternalDispose();
                ReleaseWidgetGameObject(child.gameObject);
            }

            _children.Clear();
        }

        internal void ReleaseWidgetGameObject(GameObject widgetGameObject)
        {
            if (widgetGameObject == null)
                return;

            if (widgetGameObject.GetComponent<AssetInstanceTracker>() != null)
                FRFM.Resource.Recycle(widgetGameObject);
            else
                Destroy(widgetGameObject);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddButtonClick(Button button, UnityAction action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {
            return AddEventSubscription(UIEventUtility.AddButtonClick(button, action), mode);
        }

        protected IDisposable AddToggleChanged(Toggle toggle, UnityAction<bool> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
        {

        }

        protected IDisposable AddPointerBeginDrag(GameObject target, Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> action, UIEventListenMode mode = UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose)
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIWidgetSwitcher
    {
        private readonly UIForm _ownerForm;
        private readonly UIWidget _ownerWidget;
        private readonly Transform _parent;
        private readonly Dictionary<string, UIWidget> _widgets = new Dictionary<string, UIWidget>();

        public UIWidgetSwitcher(UIForm ownerForm, Transform parent, UIWidget ownerWidget = null)
        {
            _ownerForm = ownerForm;
            _ownerWidget = ownerWidget;
            _parent = parent;
        }

        public UIWidget Current { get; private set; }

        public async UniTask<TWidget> ShowAsync<TWidget>(string key, string assetPath, object userData = null, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default) where TWidget : UIWidget
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
                key = typeof(TWidget).Name;

            if (_widgets.TryGetValue(key, out UIWidget existing))
            {
                Show(key, userData);
                return existing as TWidget;
            }

            if (_ownerForm == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath) || cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                return null;

            GameObject instance = await FRFM.Resource.InstantiateAsync(assetPath, _parent);
            if (instance == null)
                return null;

            if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                FRFM.Resource.Recycle(instance);
                return null;
            }

            TWidget widget = instance.GetComponent<TWidget>();
            if (widget == null)
                widget = instance.AddComponent<TWidget>();

            int layer = _ownerWidget != null ? _ownerWidget.gameObject.layer : _ownerForm.gameObject.layer;
            instance.SetLayerRecursively(layer);
            widget.InternalInitialize(_ownerForm, _ownerWidget);
            widget.InternalOpen(userData);
            instance.SetLayerRecursively(layer);
            _ownerForm.RegisterWidget(widget);
            _widgets[key] = widget;

            if (Current != null && Current != widget)
                Current.InternalHide();

            Current = widget;
            return widget;
        }

        public bool Show(string key, object userData = null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || !_widgets.TryGetValue(key, out UIWidget widget))
                return false;

            if (Current != null && Current != widget)
                Current.InternalHide();

            Current = widget;
            widget.InternalShow(userData);
            return true;
        }

        public void HideCurrent()
        {
            Current?.InternalHide();
            Current = null;
        }

        public void Release(string key)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || !_widgets.TryGetValue(key, out UIWidget widget))
                return;

            if (Current == widget)
                Current = null;

            _widgets.Remove(key);
            widget.InternalDispose();
            if (widget.gameObject != null)
                widget.ReleaseWidgetGameObject(widget.gameObject);
        }

        public void ReleaseAll()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _widgets)
            {
                UIWidget widget = pair.Value;
                if (widget == null)
                    continue;

                widget.InternalDispose();
                if (widget.gameObject != null)
                    widget.ReleaseWidgetGameObject(widget.gameObject);
            }

            _widgets.Clear();
            Current = null;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIRichTextStringEvent : UnityEvent<string>
    {
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIRichTextLinkEvent : UnityEvent<UIRichTextClickContext>
    {
    }

    /// <summary>TMP 富文本主组件，提供项目友好标签解析、链接点击和动态模板参数。</summary>
    [RequireComponent(typeof(TMP_Text))]
    public sealed class UIRichText : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public TMP_Text targetText;
        public UIRichTextConfig config = new UIRichTextConfig();
        public bool parseOnEnable = true;
        public bool enableClick = true;
        public bool enableLongPress = true;
        public bool enableHover;
        public float longPressThreshold = 0.6f;
        public bool cacheParsedText = true;
        [Min(0)] public int maxCachedEntries = 128;
        public string sourceText;
        public UIRichTextLinkEvent onLinkClicked = new UIRichTextLinkEvent();
        public UIRichTextLinkEvent onLinkLongPressed = new UIRichTextLinkEvent();
        public UIRichTextLinkEvent onLinkHovered = new UIRichTextLinkEvent();
        public UIRichTextStringEvent onParseCompleted = new UIRichTextStringEvent();

        private readonly Dictionary<string, Action<UIRichTextClickContext>> _linkHandlers = new Dictionary<string, Action<UIRichTextClickContext>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, UIRichTextParseResult> _parseCache = new Dictionary<string, UIRichTextParseResult>();
        private UIRichTextParser _parser;
        private IUIRichTextSpriteResolver _spriteResolver;
        private UIRichTextClickHandler _clickHandler;
        private UIRichTextParseResult _lastParseResult;
        private UIRichTextConfig _cachedConfig;
        private int _cachedConfigHash;
        private int _spriteResolverGeneration;
        private int _cachedSpriteResolverGeneration = -1;

        public bool EnableClick => enableClick;
        public bool EnableLongPress => enableLongPress;
        public bool EnableHover => enableHover;
        public float LongPressThreshold => longPressThreshold;
        public UIRichTextParseResult LastParseResult => _lastParseResult;
        public int CacheCount => _parseCache.Count;

        private void Awake()
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            if (parseOnEnable && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceText))
                Refresh();
        }

        private void OnValidate()
        {
            if (targetText == null)
                targetText = GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
            longPressThreshold = Mathf.Max(0.05f, longPressThreshold);
            maxCachedEntries = Mathf.Max(0, maxCachedEntries);
        }

        public void SetText(string source)
        {
            sourceText = source ?? string.Empty;
            Refresh();
        }

        public void SetText(string source, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object> args)
        {
            SetText(UIRichTextUtility.FormatTemplate(source, args));
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            EnsureInitialized();
            if (targetText == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("UIRichText 需要挂载 TMP_Text 组件。", this);
                enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            _lastParseResult = Parse(sourceText ?? string.Empty);
            targetText.text = _lastParseResult.ParsedText;
            targetText.ForceMeshUpdate();
            onParseCompleted.Invoke(_lastParseResult.ParsedText);
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            sourceText = string.Empty;
            _lastParseResult = null;
            if (targetText != null)
                targetText.text = string.Empty;
        }

        public void RegisterLinkHandler(string scheme, Action<UIRichTextClickContext> handler)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(scheme) || handler == null)
                return;

            _linkHandlers[scheme] = handler;
        }

        public void UnregisterLinkHandler(string scheme)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scheme))
                _linkHandlers.Remove(scheme);
        }

        public void SetSpriteResolver(IUIRichTextSpriteResolver resolver)
        {
            _spriteResolver = resolver;
            _spriteResolverGeneration++;
            if (_parser != null)
                _parser.SetSpriteResolver(GetActiveSpriteResolver());
            InvalidateCache();
        }

        public void SetConfig(UIRichTextConfig value, bool refresh = true)
        {
            config = value;
            InvalidateCache(refresh);
        }

        public void InvalidateCache(bool refresh = false)
        {
            _parseCache.Clear();
            _cachedConfig = null;
            _cachedSpriteResolverGeneration = -1;
            if (_parser != null)
                _parser.SetSpriteResolver(GetActiveSpriteResolver());
            if (refresh && isActiveAndEnabled)
                Refresh();
        }

        public void DispatchLinkEvent(UIRichTextClickContext context)
        {
            if (context == null)
                return;

            switch (context.PointerEvent)
            {
                case UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent.LongPress:
                    onLinkLongPressed.Invoke(context);
                    break;
                case UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent.Hover:
                    onLinkHovered.Invoke(context);
                    break;
                default:
                    onLinkClicked.Invoke(context);
                    if (_linkHandlers.TryGetValue(context.Scheme, out Action<UIRichTextClickContext> handler))
                        handler.Invoke(context);
                    break;
            }
        }

        private UIRichTextParseResult Parse(string source)
        {
            EnsureCacheState();
            string cacheKey = source;
            if (cacheParsedText && _parseCache.TryGetValue(cacheKey, out UIRichTextParseResult cached))
                return cached;

            UIRichTextParseResult result = _parser.Parse(source, config);
            if (cacheParsedText && maxCachedEntries > 0)
            {
                if (_parseCache.Count >= maxCachedEntries)
                    _parseCache.Clear();
                _parseCache[cacheKey] = result;
            }
            return result;
        }

        private void EnsureCacheState()
        {
            int configHash = config != null ? config.ComputeContentHash() : 0;
            if (ReferenceEquals(_cachedConfig, config) && _cachedConfigHash == configHash &&
                _cachedSpriteResolverGeneration == _spriteResolverGeneration)
                return;

            _parseCache.Clear();
            _cachedConfig = config;
            _cachedConfigHash = configHash;
            _cachedSpriteResolverGeneration = _spriteResolverGeneration;
            if (_parser != null)
                _parser.SetSpriteResolver(GetActiveSpriteResolver());
        }

        private IUIRichTextSpriteResolver GetActiveSpriteResolver()
        {
            return _spriteResolver ?? new UIRichTextConfigSpriteResolver(config);
        }

        private void EnsureInitialized()
        {
            if (targetText == null)
                targetText = GetComponent<TMP_Text>();
            if (_parser == null)
                _parser = new UIRichTextParser(GetActiveSpriteResolver());

            if (_clickHandler == null)
            {
                _clickHandler = GetComponent<UIRichTextClickHandler>();
                if (_clickHandler == null)
                    _clickHandler = gameObject.AddComponent<UIRichTextClickHandler>();
            }

            _clickHandler.owner = this;
            _clickHandler.targetText = targetText;
            if (targetText != null)
                targetText.raycastTarget = enableClick || enableLongPress || enableHover;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent
    {
        Click,
        LongPress,
        Hover
    }

    public sealed class UIRichTextClickContext
    {
        public UIRichText Source { get; }
        public string LinkId { get; }
        public string Scheme { get; }
        public string Payload { get; }
        public string Text { get; }
        public int LinkIndex { get; }
        public Vector2 ScreenPosition { get; }
        public UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent PointerEvent { get; }

        public UIRichTextClickContext(UIRichText source, string linkId, string text, int linkIndex, Vector2 screenPosition, UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent pointerEvent)
        {
            Source = source;
            LinkId = linkId ?? string.Empty;
            Text = text ?? string.Empty;
            LinkIndex = linkIndex;
            ScreenPosition = screenPosition;
            PointerEvent = pointerEvent;

            int splitIndex = LinkId.IndexOf(':');
            if (splitIndex >= 0)
            {
                Scheme = LinkId.Substring(0, splitIndex);
                Payload = LinkId.Substring(splitIndex + 1);
            }
            else
            {
                Scheme = LinkId;
                Payload = string.Empty;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>TMP 链接命中处理器，负责把点击和长按转发给 UIRichText。</summary>
    public sealed class UIRichTextClickHandler : MonoBehaviour, IPointerClickHandler, IPointerDownHandler, IPointerUpHandler, IPointerExitHandler, IPointerMoveHandler
    {
        public UIRichText owner;
        public TMP_Text targetText;

        private bool _pressed;
        private bool _suppressClick;
        private int _pressedLinkIndex = -1;
        private float _pressStartTime;
        private Vector2 _pressPosition;

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!_pressed || _suppressClick || owner == null || !owner.EnableLongPress)
                return;

            if (Time.unscaledTime - _pressStartTime < owner.LongPressThreshold)
                return;

            _suppressClick = true;
            Dispatch(_pressedLinkIndex, _pressPosition, UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent.LongPress);
        }

        public void OnPointerDown(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            _pressed = true;
            _suppressClick = false;
            _pressStartTime = Time.unscaledTime;
            _pressPosition = eventData.position;
            _pressedLinkIndex = FindLinkIndex(eventData.position);
        }

        public void OnPointerUp(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            _pressed = false;
        }

        public void OnPointerClick(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (_suppressClick || owner == null || !owner.EnableClick)
                return;

            Dispatch(FindLinkIndex(eventData.position), eventData.position, UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent.Click);
        }

        public void OnPointerExit(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            _pressed = false;
        }

        public void OnPointerMove(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (owner == null || !owner.EnableHover)
                return;

            Dispatch(FindLinkIndex(eventData.position), eventData.position, UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent.Hover);
        }

        private int FindLinkIndex(Vector2 screenPosition)
        {
            if (targetText == null)
                return -1;

            return TMP_TextUtilities.FindIntersectingLink(targetText, screenPosition, UIRichTextUtility.ResolveEventCamera(targetText));
        }

        private void Dispatch(int linkIndex, Vector2 screenPosition, UIRichTextLinkPointerEvent pointerEvent)
        {
            if (owner == null || targetText == null || linkIndex < 0 || linkIndex >= targetText.textInfo.linkCount)
                return;

            TMP_LinkInfo linkInfo = targetText.textInfo.linkInfo[linkIndex];
            owner.DispatchLinkEvent(new UIRichTextClickContext(owner, linkInfo.GetLinkID(), linkInfo.GetLinkText(), linkIndex, screenPosition, pointerEvent));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIRichTextSpriteAlias
    {
        public string key;
        public TMP_SpriteAsset spriteAsset;
        public string spriteName;
        public int spriteIndex = -1;
        public float scale = 1f;
        public float yOffset;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIRichTextColorAlias
    {
        public string key;
        public Color color = Color.white;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIRichTextGradientAlias
    {
        public string key;
        public string materialPreset;
        public string fallbackColor = "#FFD37A";
    }

    /// <summary>富文本标签、颜色、图标和链接行为的集中配置。</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIRichTextConfig
    {
        public TMP_SpriteAsset defaultSpriteAsset;
        public List<UIRichTextSpriteAlias> spriteAliases = new List<UIRichTextSpriteAlias>();
        public List<UIRichTextColorAlias> colorAliases = new List<UIRichTextColorAlias>();
        public List<UIRichTextGradientAlias> gradientAliases = new List<UIRichTextGradientAlias>();
        public bool escapeUnknownTags = true;
        public bool underlineLinks = true;
        public Color defaultLinkColor = new Color(0.45f, 0.75f, 1f, 1f);
        public string missingSpriteText = "□";

        public int ComputeContentHash()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                int hash = 17;
                AddHash(ref hash, defaultSpriteAsset);
                AddHash(ref hash, spriteAliases != null ? spriteAliases.Count : -1);
                if (spriteAliases != null)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < spriteAliases.Count; i++)
                    {
                        UIRichTextSpriteAlias alias = spriteAliases[i];
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias != null);
                        if (alias == null)
                            continue;
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.key);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.spriteAsset);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.spriteName);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.spriteIndex);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.scale);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.yOffset);
                    }
                }

                AddHash(ref hash, colorAliases != null ? colorAliases.Count : -1);
                if (colorAliases != null)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < colorAliases.Count; i++)
                    {
                        UIRichTextColorAlias alias = colorAliases[i];
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias != null);
                        if (alias == null)
                            continue;
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.key);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.color);
                    }
                }

                AddHash(ref hash, gradientAliases != null ? gradientAliases.Count : -1);
                if (gradientAliases != null)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < gradientAliases.Count; i++)
                    {
                        UIRichTextGradientAlias alias = gradientAliases[i];
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias != null);
                        if (alias == null)
                            continue;
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.key);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.materialPreset);
                        AddHash(ref hash, alias.fallbackColor);
                    }
                }

                AddHash(ref hash, escapeUnknownTags);
                AddHash(ref hash, underlineLinks);
                AddHash(ref hash, defaultLinkColor);
                AddHash(ref hash, missingSpriteText);
                return hash;
            }
        }

        public bool TryGetSpriteAlias(string key, out UIRichTextSpriteAlias alias)
        {
            alias = null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || spriteAliases == null)
                return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < spriteAliases.Count; i++)
            {
                UIRichTextSpriteAlias item = spriteAliases[i];
                if (item != null && String.Equals(item.key, key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    alias = item;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        public bool TryGetColor(string key, out Color color)
        {
            color = Color.white;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || colorAliases == null)
                return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < colorAliases.Count; i++)
            {
                UIRichTextColorAlias item = colorAliases[i];
                if (item != null && String.Equals(item.key, key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    color = item.color;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return ColorUtility.TryParseHtmlString(key, out color);
        }

        public bool TryGetGradient(string key, out UIRichTextGradientAlias alias)
        {
            alias = null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) || gradientAliases == null)
                return false;

            for (int i = 0; i < gradientAliases.Count; i++)
            {
                UIRichTextGradientAlias item = gradientAliases[i];
                if (item != null && String.Equals(item.key, key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    alias = item;
                    return true;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AddHash(ref int hash, UnityEngine.Object value)
        {
            AddHash(ref hash, value != null ? value.GetInstanceID() : 0);
        }

        private static void AddHash(ref int hash, string value)
        {
            if (value == null)
            {
                AddHash(ref hash, -1);
                return;
            }

            AddHash(ref hash, value.Length);
            for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
                AddHash(ref hash, value[i]);
        }

        private static void AddHash(ref int hash, bool value)
        {
            AddHash(ref hash, value ? 1 : 0);
        }

        private static void AddHash(ref int hash, int value)
        {
            hash = hash * 31 + value;
        }

        private static void AddHash(ref int hash, float value)
        {
            AddHash(ref hash, value.GetHashCode());
        }

        private static void AddHash(ref int hash, Color value)
        {
            AddHash(ref hash, value.r);
            AddHash(ref hash, value.g);
            AddHash(ref hash, value.b);
            AddHash(ref hash, value.a);
        }
    }
}
````
