````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>把项目友好标签转换成 TMP 可直接渲染的富文本。</summary>
    public sealed class UIRichTextParser
    {
        private static readonly HashSet<string> InlineTmpTags = new HashSet<string> { "b", "i", "u", "s" };
        private IUIRichTextSpriteResolver _spriteResolver;

        public UIRichTextParser(IUIRichTextSpriteResolver spriteResolver = null)
        {
            _spriteResolver = spriteResolver;
        }

        public void SetSpriteResolver(IUIRichTextSpriteResolver spriteResolver)
        {
            _spriteResolver = spriteResolver;
        }

        public UIRichTextParseResult Parse(string source, UIRichTextConfig config)
        {
            List<UIRichTextLinkInfo> links = new List<UIRichTextLinkInfo>();
            List<UIRichTextSpriteInfo> sprites = new List<UIRichTextSpriteInfo>();
            List<string> warnings = new List<string>();
            string parsed = ParseRange(source ?? string.Empty, 0, (source ?? string.Empty).Length, config, links, sprites, warnings);
            return new UIRichTextParseResult(source, parsed, links, sprites, warnings);
        }

        private string ParseRange(string source, int start, int end, UIRichTextConfig config, List<UIRichTextLinkInfo> links, List<UIRichTextSpriteInfo> sprites, List<string> warnings)
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(end - start);
            int index = start;
            while (index < end)
            {
                if (source[index] == '[' && TryReadTag(source, index, end, out UIRichTextTag tag))
                {
                    if (tag.IsClosing)
                    {
                        AppendEscaped(builder, source, index, tag.EndIndex);
                        index = tag.EndIndex;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (TryAppendSelfClosingTag(builder, tag, config, sprites, warnings))
                    {
                        index = tag.EndIndex;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (TryFindClosingTag(source, tag.EndIndex, end, tag.Name, out int contentEnd, out int closeEnd))
                    {
                        string content = ParseRange(source, tag.EndIndex, contentEnd, config, links, sprites, warnings);
                        AppendWrappedTag(builder, tag, content, config, links, warnings);
                        index = closeEnd;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (config == null || config.escapeUnknownTags)
                        AppendEscaped(builder, source, index, tag.EndIndex);
                    else
                        builder.Append(source, index, tag.EndIndex - index);
                    index = tag.EndIndex;
                    continue;
                }

                AppendEscaped(builder, source[index]);
                index++;
            }

            return builder.ToString();
        }

        private bool TryAppendSelfClosingTag(StringBuilder builder, UIRichTextTag tag, UIRichTextConfig config, List<UIRichTextSpriteInfo> sprites, List<string> warnings)
        {
            if (tag.Name != "icon" && tag.Name != "emoji")
                return false;

            string key = tag.Argument;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
                key = tag.Name;

            IUIRichTextSpriteResolver resolver = _spriteResolver ?? new UIRichTextConfigSpriteResolver(config);
            if (resolver.TryResolve(key, out UIRichTextSpriteRef spriteRef))
            {
                builder.Append(UIRichTextUtility.BuildSpriteTag(spriteRef, key));
                sprites.Add(new UIRichTextSpriteInfo { Key = key, SpriteName = spriteRef.SpriteName, SpriteIndex = spriteRef.SpriteIndex });
                return true;
            }

            if (config != null && config.defaultSpriteAsset != null)
            {
                builder.Append("<sprite name=\"").Append(key).Append("\">");
                sprites.Add(new UIRichTextSpriteInfo { Key = key, SpriteName = key, SpriteIndex = -1 });
                return true;
            }

            warnings.Add($"未找到富文本图标：{key}");
            builder.Append(UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText(config != null ? config.missingSpriteText : "□"));
            return true;
        }

        private void AppendWrappedTag(StringBuilder builder, UIRichTextTag tag, string content, UIRichTextConfig config, List<UIRichTextLinkInfo> links, List<string> warnings)
        {
            switch (tag.Name)
            {
                case "item":
                case "player":
                    AppendLink(builder, tag.Name, tag.Argument, content, config, links);
                    break;
                case "link":
                    AppendGenericLink(builder, tag.Argument, content, config, links);
                    break;
                case "color":
                    AppendColor(builder, tag.Argument, content, config);
                    break;
                case "gradient":
                    AppendGradient(builder, tag.Argument, content, config, warnings);
                    break;
                default:
                    if (InlineTmpTags.Contains(tag.Name))
                        builder.Append('<').Append(tag.Name).Append('>').Append(content).Append("</").Append(tag.Name).Append('>');
                    else
                        AppendUnknown(builder, tag, content, config);
                    break;
            }
        }

        private void AppendLink(StringBuilder builder, string scheme, string payload, string content, UIRichTextConfig config, List<UIRichTextLinkInfo> links)
        {
            string safePayload = UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText(payload);
            string linkId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(safePayload) ? scheme : scheme + ":" + safePayload;
            links.Add(new UIRichTextLinkInfo { Scheme = scheme, Payload = payload, Text = content });

            builder.Append("<link=\"").Append(linkId).Append("\">");
            if (config == null || config.underlineLinks)
                builder.Append("<u>");
            builder.Append("<color=").Append(UIRichTextUtility.ToHtmlColor(config != null ? config.defaultLinkColor : Color.cyan)).Append('>').Append(content).Append("</color>");
            if (config == null || config.underlineLinks)
                builder.Append("</u>");
            builder.Append("</link>");
        }

        private void AppendGenericLink(StringBuilder builder, string linkId, string content, UIRichTextConfig config, List<UIRichTextLinkInfo> links)
        {
            string safeLinkId = UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText(linkId);
            int splitIndex = linkId != null ? linkId.IndexOf(':') : -1;
            links.Add(new UIRichTextLinkInfo
            {
                Scheme = splitIndex >= 0 ? linkId.Substring(0, splitIndex) : linkId,
                Payload = splitIndex >= 0 ? linkId.Substring(splitIndex + 1) : string.Empty,
                Text = content
            });

            builder.Append("<link=\"").Append(safeLinkId).Append("\">");
            if (config == null || config.underlineLinks)
                builder.Append("<u>");
            builder.Append("<color=").Append(UIRichTextUtility.ToHtmlColor(config != null ? config.defaultLinkColor : Color.cyan)).Append('>').Append(content).Append("</color>");
            if (config == null || config.underlineLinks)
                builder.Append("</u>");
            builder.Append("</link>");
        }

        private void AppendColor(StringBuilder builder, string colorKey, string content, UIRichTextConfig config)
        {
            Color color;
            string colorText = config != null && config.TryGetColor(colorKey, out color) ? UIRichTextUtility.ToHtmlColor(color) : UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText(colorKey);
            builder.Append("<color=").Append(colorText).Append('>').Append(content).Append("</color>");
        }

        private void AppendGradient(StringBuilder builder, string key, string content, UIRichTextConfig config, List<string> warnings)
        {
            if (config != null && config.TryGetGradient(key, out UIRichTextGradientAlias alias) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias.materialPreset))
            {
                builder.Append("<gradient=\"").Append(UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText(alias.materialPreset)).Append("\">").Append(content).Append("</gradient>");
                return;
            }

            string color = "#FFD37A";
            if (config != null && config.TryGetGradient(key, out alias) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(alias.fallbackColor))
                color = alias.fallbackColor;
            else
                warnings.Add($"未找到富文本渐变：{key}");
            if (ContainsTmpTag(content))
            {
                if (!ColorUtility.TryParseHtmlString(color, out Color fallbackColor))
                    fallbackColor = new Color(1f, 0.82f, 0.38f, 1f);
                builder.Append("<color=").Append(UIRichTextUtility.ToHtmlColor(fallbackColor)).Append('>')
                    .Append(content).Append("</color>");
                warnings.Add($"富文本渐变包含 TMP 标签，已使用起始色回退：{key}");
                return;
            }

            AppendFallbackGradient(builder, content, color);
        }

        private static bool ContainsTmpTag(string content)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(content))
                return false;

            int open = content.IndexOf('<');
            return open >= 0 && content.IndexOf('>', open + 1) >= 0;
        }

        private void AppendFallbackGradient(StringBuilder builder, string content, string startColor)
        {
            if (!ColorUtility.TryParseHtmlString(startColor, out Color from))
                from = new Color(1f, 0.82f, 0.38f, 1f);

            Color to = new Color(1f, 0.25f, 0.18f, 1f);
            int length = string.IsNullOrEmpty(content) ? 0 : content.Length;
            for (int i = 0; i < length; i++)
            {
                float t = length <= 1 ? 0f : i / (float)(length - 1);
                builder.Append("<color=").Append(UIRichTextUtility.ToHtmlColor(Color.Lerp(from, to, t))).Append('>');
                AppendEscaped(builder, content[i]);
                builder.Append("</color>");
            }
        }

        private void AppendUnknown(StringBuilder builder, UIRichTextTag tag, string content, UIRichTextConfig config)
        {
            if (config == null || config.escapeUnknownTags)
            {
                builder.Append(UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText(tag.RawText)).Append(content).Append(UIRichTextUtility.EscapeTmpText("[/" + tag.Name + "]"));
                return;
            }

            builder.Append(tag.RawText).Append(content).Append("[/").Append(tag.Name).Append(']');
        }

        private static bool TryReadTag(string source, int start, int end, out UIRichTextTag tag)
        {
            tag = default;
            int close = source.IndexOf(']', start + 1);
            if (close < 0 || close >= end)
                return false;

            string raw = source.Substring(start, close - start + 1);
            string body = source.Substring(start + 1, close - start - 1).Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(body))
                return false;

            bool closing = body[0] == '/';
            if (closing)
                body = body.Substring(1).Trim();

            int split = body.IndexOf(':');
            string name = split >= 0 ? body.Substring(0, split) : body;
            string argument = split >= 0 ? body.Substring(split + 1) : string.Empty;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
                return false;

            tag = new UIRichTextTag(name.ToLowerInvariant(), argument, closing, raw, close + 1);
            return true;
        }

        private static bool TryFindClosingTag(string source, int start, int end, string tagName, out int contentEnd, out int closeEnd)
        {
            contentEnd = -1;
            closeEnd = -1;
            if (tagName == "icon" || tagName == "emoji")
                return false;

            int depth = 1;
            int index = start;
            while (index < end)
            {
                int tagStart = source.IndexOf('[', index);
                if (tagStart < 0 || tagStart >= end)
                    return false;
                if (!TryReadTag(source, tagStart, end, out UIRichTextTag tag))
                {
                    index = tagStart + 1;
                    continue;
                }

                index = tag.EndIndex;
                if (!string.Equals(tag.Name, tagName, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    continue;
                if (tag.IsClosing)
                {
                    depth--;
                    if (depth == 0)
                    {
                        contentEnd = tagStart;
                        closeEnd = tag.EndIndex;
                        return true;
                    }
                }
                else if (tag.Name != "icon" && tag.Name != "emoji")
                {
                    depth++;
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static void AppendEscaped(StringBuilder builder, string source, int start, int end)
        {
            for (int i = start; i < end; i++)
                AppendEscaped(builder, source[i]);
        }

        private static void AppendEscaped(StringBuilder builder, char c)
        {
            switch (c)
            {
                case '<':
                    builder.Append("&lt;");
                    break;
                case '>':
                    builder.Append("&gt;");
                    break;
                case '&':
                    builder.Append("&amp;");
                    break;
                case '"':
                    builder.Append("&quot;");
                    break;
                default:
                    builder.Append(c);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using TMPro;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public struct UIRichTextSpriteRef
    {
        public TMP_SpriteAsset SpriteAsset;
        public string SpriteName;
        public int SpriteIndex;
        public float Scale;
        public float YOffset;
    }

    /// <summary>业务可接入的图标解析接口，用于把 icon key 映射到 TMP Sprite。</summary>
    public interface IUIRichTextSpriteResolver
    {
        bool TryResolve(string key, out UIRichTextSpriteRef spriteRef);
    }

    public sealed class UIRichTextConfigSpriteResolver : IUIRichTextSpriteResolver
    {
        private readonly UIRichTextConfig _config;

        public UIRichTextConfigSpriteResolver(UIRichTextConfig config)
        {
            _config = config;
        }

        public bool TryResolve(string key, out UIRichTextSpriteRef spriteRef)
        {
            spriteRef = default;
            if (_config == null || !_config.TryGetSpriteAlias(key, out UIRichTextSpriteAlias alias))
                return false;

            spriteRef = new UIRichTextSpriteRef
            {
                SpriteAsset = alias.spriteAsset != null ? alias.spriteAsset : _config.defaultSpriteAsset,
                SpriteName = alias.spriteName,
                SpriteIndex = alias.spriteIndex,
                Scale = alias.scale <= 0f ? 1f : alias.scale,
                YOffset = alias.yOffset
            };
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public static class UIRichTextUtility
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<char, string> EscapeMap = new Dictionary<char, string>
        {
            { '<', "&lt;" },
            { '>', "&gt;" },
            { '&', "&amp;" },
            { '"', "&quot;" }
        };

        /// <summary>转义外部输入，避免玩家名或聊天内容注入 TMP 标签。</summary>
        public static string EscapeTmpText(string text)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
                return string.Empty;

            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder(text.Length);
            for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
            {
                char c = text[i];
                builder.Append(EscapeMap.TryGetValue(c, out string escaped) ? escaped : c.ToString());
            }

            return builder.ToString();
        }

        public static string ToHtmlColor(Color color)
        {
            return "#" + ColorUtility.ToHtmlStringRGBA(color);
        }

        public static string BuildSpriteTag(UIRichTextSpriteRef spriteRef, string fallbackName)
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder("<sprite");
            if (spriteRef.SpriteAsset != null)
                builder.Append("=\"").Append(spriteRef.SpriteAsset.name).Append("\"");
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(spriteRef.SpriteName))
                builder.Append(" name=\"").Append(spriteRef.SpriteName).Append("\"");
            else if (spriteRef.SpriteIndex >= 0)
                builder.Append(" index=").Append(spriteRef.SpriteIndex);
            else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fallbackName))
                builder.Append(" name=\"").Append(fallbackName).Append("\"");

            if (!Mathf.Approximately(spriteRef.Scale, 0f) && !Mathf.Approximately(spriteRef.Scale, 1f))
                builder.Append(" scale=").Append(spriteRef.Scale.ToString("0.###", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            if (!Mathf.Approximately(spriteRef.YOffset, 0f))
                builder.Append(" voffset=").Append(spriteRef.YOffset.ToString("0.###", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));

            builder.Append(">");
            return builder.ToString();
        }

        public static string FormatTemplate(string source, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object> args)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(source) || args == null)
                return source ?? string.Empty;

            string result = source;
            foreach (KeyValuePair<string, object> pair in args)
                result = result.Replace("{" + pair.Key + "}", EscapeTmpText(Convert.ToString(pair.Value)));
            return result;
        }

        public static Camera ResolveEventCamera(TMP_Text text)
        {
            if (text == null || text.canvas == null || text.canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay)
                return null;
            return text.canvas.worldCamera != null ? text.canvas.worldCamera : Camera.main;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIAnimationNamedEvent : UnityEvent<string>
    {
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIAnimationStringEvent : UnityEvent<string>
    {
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIAnimationIntEvent : UnityEvent<int>
    {
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIAnimationFloatEvent : UnityEvent<float>
    {
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIAnimationObjectEvent : UnityEvent<UnityEngine.Object>
    {
    }

    public sealed class UIAnimationEventBridge : MonoBehaviour
    {
        private sealed class DisposableAction : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly Action _disposeAction;
            private bool _disposed;

            public DisposableAction(Action disposeAction)
            {
                _disposeAction = disposeAction;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_disposed)
                    return;

                _disposed = true;
                _disposeAction?.Invoke();
            }
        }

        public UnityEvent onTriggered = new UnityEvent();
        public UIAnimationNamedEvent onNamedTriggered = new UIAnimationNamedEvent();
        public UIAnimationStringEvent onStringTriggered = new UIAnimationStringEvent();
        public UIAnimationIntEvent onIntTriggered = new UIAnimationIntEvent();
        public UIAnimationFloatEvent onFloatTriggered = new UIAnimationFloatEvent();
        public UIAnimationObjectEvent onObjectTriggered = new UIAnimationObjectEvent();

        private readonly UIEventScopeSet _listeners = new UIEventScopeSet();

        public void Trigger()
        {
            onTriggered.Invoke();
        }

        public void TriggerName(string eventName)
        {
            onNamedTriggered.Invoke(eventName);
        }

        public void TriggerString(string value)
        {
            onStringTriggered.Invoke(value);
        }

        public void TriggerInt(int value)
        {
            onIntTriggered.Invoke(value);
        }

        public void TriggerFloat(float value)
        {
            onFloatTriggered.Invoke(value);
        }

        public void TriggerObject(UnityEngine.Object value)
        {
            onObjectTriggered.Invoke(value);
        }

        public IDisposable AddListener(string eventName, Action callback)
        {
            if (callback == null)
                return null;

            UnityAction<string> listener = value =>
            {
                if (value == eventName)
                    callback.Invoke();
            };
            onNamedTriggered.AddListener(listener);
            IDisposable subscription = new DisposableAction(() => onNamedTriggered.RemoveListener(listener));
            return _listeners.Add(subscription, UIEventListenMode.UntilDispose);
        }

        public IDisposable AddOnce(string eventName, Action callback)
        {
            IDisposable subscription = null;
            subscription = AddListener(eventName, () =>
            {
                subscription?.Dispose();
                callback?.Invoke();
            });
            return subscription;
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _listeners.Dispose();
            onTriggered.RemoveAllListeners();
            onNamedTriggered.RemoveAllListeners();
            onStringTriggered.RemoveAllListeners();
            onIntTriggered.RemoveAllListeners();
            onFloatTriggered.RemoveAllListeners();
            onObjectTriggered.RemoveAllListeners();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum UIAspectFitMode
    {
        Contain = 0,
        Cover = 1,
        FitWidth = 2,
        FitHeight = 3,
        Fill = 4
    }

    public enum UIAspectAlignment
    {
        TopLeft = 0,
        TopCenter = 1,
        TopRight = 2,
        MiddleLeft = 3,
        MiddleCenter = 4,
        MiddleRight = 5,
        BottomLeft = 6,
        BottomCenter = 7,
        BottomRight = 8
    }

    public enum UIAspectFitStrategy
    {
        ResizeTarget = 0,
        ScaleHierarchy = 1
    }

    [ExecuteAlways]
    public sealed class UIAspectFitter : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private RectTransform _container;
        [SerializeField] private RectTransform _target;
        [SerializeField] private UIAspectFitMode _fitMode = UIAspectFitMode.Contain;
        [SerializeField] private UIAspectFitStrategy _strategy = UIAspectFitStrategy.ScaleHierarchy;
        [SerializeField] private UIAspectAlignment _alignment = UIAspectAlignment.MiddleCenter;
        [SerializeField] private Vector2 _referenceSize;
        [SerializeField] private bool _useGraphicSource = true;
        [SerializeField] private bool _useTargetSizeAsReference = true;
        [SerializeField] private bool _snapToAlignment = true;
        [SerializeField, HideInInspector] private Vector2 _initialTargetSize;
        [SerializeField, HideInInspector] private Vector3 _initialTargetScale;

        private RectTransform _rectTransform;
        private Vector2 _lastContainerSize;

        private void Awake()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Refresh();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Refresh();
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Vector2 size = _container != null ? _container.rect.size : Vector2.zero;
            if (_lastContainerSize != size)
                Refresh();
        }

        private void OnRectTransformDimensionsChange()
        {
            Refresh();
        }

        private void OnValidate()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Refresh();
        }

        public void SetReferenceSize(Vector2 size)
        {
            _referenceSize = size;
            Refresh();
        }

        public void SetAlignment(UIAspectAlignment alignment)
        {
            _alignment = alignment;
            Refresh();
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            if (_container == null || _target == null)
                return;

            _lastContainerSize = _container.rect.size;
            Vector2 reference = GetReferenceSize();
            if (_lastContainerSize.x <= 0f || _lastContainerSize.y <= 0f || reference.x <= 0f || reference.y <= 0f)
                return;

            if (_strategy == UIAspectFitStrategy.ScaleHierarchy)
                ScaleHierarchy(reference);
            else
                ResizeTarget(reference);
        }

        private void ScaleHierarchy(Vector2 reference)
        {
            float widthScale = _lastContainerSize.x / reference.x;
            float heightScale = _lastContainerSize.y / reference.y;
            float scale;

            switch (_fitMode)
            {
                case UIAspectFitMode.Cover:
                    scale = Mathf.Max(widthScale, heightScale);
                    break;
                case UIAspectFitMode.FitWidth:
                    scale = widthScale;
                    break;
                case UIAspectFitMode.FitHeight:
                    scale = heightScale;
                    break;
                case UIAspectFitMode.Fill:
                    _target.localScale = new Vector3(
                        _initialTargetScale.x * widthScale,
                        _initialTargetScale.y * heightScale,
                        _initialTargetScale.z);
                    ApplyAlignment();
                    return;
                default:
                    scale = Mathf.Min(widthScale, heightScale);
                    break;
            }

            _target.localScale = new Vector3(
                _initialTargetScale.x * scale,
                _initialTargetScale.y * scale,
                _initialTargetScale.z);
            ApplyAlignment();
        }

        private void ResizeTarget(Vector2 reference)
        {
            if (_fitMode == UIAspectFitMode.Fill)
            {
                _target.anchorMin = Vector2.zero;
                _target.anchorMax = Vector2.one;
                _target.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
                _target.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
                return;
            }

            float containerAspect = _lastContainerSize.x / _lastContainerSize.y;
            float referenceAspect = reference.x / reference.y;
            Vector2 size = _lastContainerSize;

            switch (_fitMode)
            {
                case UIAspectFitMode.Cover:
                    if (referenceAspect > containerAspect)
                        size.x = _lastContainerSize.y * referenceAspect;
                    else
                        size.y = _lastContainerSize.x / referenceAspect;
                    break;
                case UIAspectFitMode.FitWidth:
                    size.y = _lastContainerSize.x / referenceAspect;
                    break;
                case UIAspectFitMode.FitHeight:
                    size.x = _lastContainerSize.y * referenceAspect;
                    break;
                default:
                    if (referenceAspect > containerAspect)
                        size.y = _lastContainerSize.x / referenceAspect;
                    else
                        size.x = _lastContainerSize.y * referenceAspect;
                    break;
            }

            ApplyAlignment();
            _target.SetSizeWithCurrentAnchors(RectTransform.Axis.Horizontal, size.x);
            _target.SetSizeWithCurrentAnchors(RectTransform.Axis.Vertical, size.y);
        }

        private void ApplyAlignment()
        {
            if (!_snapToAlignment)
                return;

            Vector2 alignment = GetAlignment();
            _target.anchorMin = alignment;
            _target.anchorMax = alignment;
            _target.pivot = alignment;
            _target.anchoredPosition = Vector2.zero;
        }

        private Vector2 GetAlignment()
        {
            switch (_alignment)
            {
                case UIAspectAlignment.TopLeft:
                    return new Vector2(0f, 1f);
                case UIAspectAlignment.TopCenter:
                    return new Vector2(0.5f, 1f);
                case UIAspectAlignment.TopRight:
                    return Vector2.one;
                case UIAspectAlignment.MiddleLeft:
                    return new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
                case UIAspectAlignment.MiddleRight:
                    return new Vector2(1f, 0.5f);
                case UIAspectAlignment.BottomLeft:
                    return Vector2.zero;
                case UIAspectAlignment.BottomCenter:
                    return new Vector2(0.5f, 0f);
                case UIAspectAlignment.BottomRight:
                    return new Vector2(1f, 0f);
                default:
                    return new Vector2(0.5f, 0.5f);
            }
        }

        private Vector2 GetReferenceSize()
        {
            if (_useGraphicSource && _target != null)
            {
                Image image = _target.GetComponent<Image>();
                if (image != null && image.sprite != null)
                    return image.sprite.rect.size;

                RawImage rawImage = _target.GetComponent<RawImage>();
                if (rawImage != null && rawImage.texture != null)
                    return new Vector2(rawImage.texture.width, rawImage.texture.height);
            }

            if (_referenceSize.x > 0f && _referenceSize.y > 0f)
                return _referenceSize;

            return _useTargetSizeAsReference ? _initialTargetSize : Vector2.zero;
        }

        private void CacheComponents()
        {
            if (_rectTransform == null)
                _rectTransform = transform as RectTransform;
            if (_target == null)
                _target = _rectTransform;
            if (_container == null && _target != null)
                _container = _target.parent as RectTransform;
            if (_target != null && (_initialTargetSize.x <= 0f || _initialTargetSize.y <= 0f))
            {
                _initialTargetSize = _target.rect.size;
                _initialTargetScale = _target.localScale;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using DG.Tweening;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIDOTweenDriver : IUITweenDriver
    {
        public UITweenHandle Move(RectTransform target, Vector2 to, float duration, UIAnimationEase ease, bool ignoreTimeScale = true)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return new UITweenHandle(null);

            Tween tween = target.DOAnchorPos(to, Mathf.Max(0f, duration)).SetEase(ConvertEase(ease)).SetUpdate(ignoreTimeScale).SetLink(target.gameObject, LinkBehaviour.KillOnDestroy);
            return new UITweenHandle(tween);
        }

        public UITweenHandle Scale(Transform target, Vector3 to, float duration, UIAnimationEase ease, bool ignoreTimeScale = true)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return new UITweenHandle(null);

            Tween tween = target.DOScale(to, Mathf.Max(0f, duration)).SetEase(ConvertEase(ease)).SetUpdate(ignoreTimeScale).SetLink(target.gameObject, LinkBehaviour.KillOnDestroy);
            return new UITweenHandle(tween);
        }

        public UITweenHandle Fade(CanvasGroup target, float to, float duration, UIAnimationEase ease, bool ignoreTimeScale = true)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return new UITweenHandle(null);

            Tween tween = target.DOFade(to, Mathf.Max(0f, duration)).SetEase(ConvertEase(ease)).SetUpdate(ignoreTimeScale).SetLink(target.gameObject, LinkBehaviour.KillOnDestroy);
            return new UITweenHandle(tween);
        }

        public UITweenHandle Value(float from, float to, float duration, Action<float> onUpdate, UIAnimationEase ease, bool ignoreTimeScale = true)
        {
            Tween tween = DOTween.To(() => from, value => onUpdate?.Invoke(value), to, Mathf.Max(0f, duration)).SetEase(ConvertEase(ease)).SetUpdate(ignoreTimeScale);
            return new UITweenHandle(tween);
        }

        private static Ease ConvertEase(UIAnimationEase ease)
        {
            switch (ease)
            {
                case UIAnimationEase.InQuad:
                    return Ease.InQuad;
                case UIAnimationEase.OutQuad:
                    return Ease.OutQuad;
                case UIAnimationEase.OutBack:
                    return Ease.OutBack;
                case UIAnimationEase.InBack:
                    return Ease.InBack;
                default:
                    return Ease.Linear;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIDynamicVirtualList : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private ScrollRect _scrollRect;
        [SerializeField] private RectTransform _viewport;
        [SerializeField] private RectTransform _content;
        [SerializeField] private GameObject _itemPrefab;
        [SerializeField] private float _spacing = 8f;
        [SerializeField] private float _paddingTop;
        [SerializeField] private float _paddingBottom;
        [SerializeField] private int _extraCount = 2;
        [SerializeField] private int _maxCacheCount = 64;
        [SerializeField] private UIVirtualListAnchorMode _anchorMode = UIVirtualListAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
        [SerializeField] private UIDynamicSizeAnchorMode _sizeAnchorMode = UIDynamicSizeAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey;
        [SerializeField] private float _minimumItemSize = 1f;

        public UIVirtualListRangeChangedEvent onVisibleRangeChanged = new UIVirtualListRangeChangedEvent();
        public UIVirtualListItemEvent onItemVisible = new UIVirtualListItemEvent();
        public UIVirtualListItemEvent onItemRecycled = new UIVirtualListItemEvent();
        public UnityEngine.Events.UnityEvent<UIItem> onItemCreated = new UnityEngine.Events.UnityEvent<UIItem>();

        private const string DefaultTemplateId = "default";
        private readonly List<object> _dataList = new List<object>();
        private readonly List<float> _itemSizes = new List<float>();
        private readonly Dictionary<int, UIItem> _visibleItems = new Dictionary<int, UIItem>();
        private readonly Dictionary<long, int> _keyToIndex = new Dictionary<long, int>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, UIVirtualListTemplate> _templates = new Dictionary<string, UIVirtualListTemplate>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, Stack<UIItem>> _pools = new Dictionary<string, Stack<UIItem>>();
        private readonly List<int> _removeIndices = new List<int>();
        private readonly List<KeyValuePair<int, UIItem>> _remappedItems = new List<KeyValuePair<int, UIItem>>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _missingTemplateErrors = new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly FenwickTree _sizes = new FenwickTree();

        private UIForm _ownerForm;
        private Type _itemLogicType;
        private IUIVirtualListDataSource _dataSource;
        private Func<int, object, float> _sizeProvider;
        private IUIDynamicItemMeasurer _measurer;
        private int _currentStartIndex = -1;
        private int _currentEndIndex = -1;
        private int _sizeUpdateDepth;
        private bool _sizesDirty;
        private SizeAnchor _sizeUpdateAnchor;
        private UITweenHandle _scrollTween;
        private ScrollRect _boundScrollRect;
        private bool _destroyed;

        public UIVirtualListAnchorMode AnchorMode { get => _anchorMode; set => _anchorMode = value; }
        public UIDynamicSizeAnchorMode SizeAnchorMode { get => _sizeAnchorMode; set => _sizeAnchorMode = value; }
        private int Count => _dataSource != null ? Mathf.Max(0, _dataSource.Count) : _dataList.Count;

        public void Initialize(UIForm ownerForm, Type itemLogicType)
        {
            UnbindScrollRect();
            if (_itemLogicType != itemLogicType) { RecycleAllVisible(); DestroyCache(); }
            _ownerForm = ownerForm; _itemLogicType = itemLogicType; RebuildDefaultTemplate(); CacheComponents();
            if (isActiveAndEnabled) { BindScrollRect(); ForceRefresh(); }
        }

        public void Configure(ScrollRect scrollRect, RectTransform viewport, RectTransform content, GameObject itemPrefab, float spacing = 8f, float paddingTop = 0f, float paddingBottom = 0f, int extraCount = 2, int maxCacheCount = 64)
        {
            UnbindScrollRect(); RecycleAllVisible();
            if (_itemPrefab != itemPrefab) DestroyCache();
            _scrollRect = scrollRect; _viewport = viewport; _content = content; _itemPrefab = itemPrefab;
            _spacing = Mathf.Max(0f, spacing); _paddingTop = Mathf.Max(0f, paddingTop); _paddingBottom = Mathf.Max(0f, paddingBottom);
            _extraCount = Mathf.Max(0, extraCount); _maxCacheCount = Mathf.Max(0, maxCacheCount);
            RebuildDefaultTemplate(); TrimCaches(); RebuildSizeCache();
            if (isActiveAndEnabled) { BindScrollRect(); UpdateVisibleItems(true); }
        }

        public void ConfigureTemplates(IEnumerable<UIVirtualListTemplate> templates)
        {
            RecycleAllVisible(); DestroyCache(); _templates.Clear(); _missingTemplateErrors.Clear();
            if (templates != null)
            {
                foreach (UIVirtualListTemplate template in templates)
                {
                    if (template == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(template.templateId) || template.prefab == null || template.itemLogicType == null || !typeof(UIItem).IsAssignableFrom(template.itemLogicType))
                    { FRLog.Error("UIDynamicVirtualList ignored an invalid template."); continue; }
                    if (_templates.ContainsKey(template.templateId)) { FRLog.Error($"UIDynamicVirtualList duplicate template id: {template.templateId}"); continue; }
                    template.maxCacheCount = Mathf.Max(0, template.maxCacheCount); _templates.Add(template.templateId, template); _pools[template.templateId] = new Stack<UIItem>();
                }
            }
            if (_templates.Count == 0) RebuildDefaultTemplate();
            ForceRefresh();
        }

        public void SetDataSource(IUIVirtualListDataSource dataSource)
        {
            ListAnchor anchor = CaptureListAnchor(_anchorMode); _dataSource = dataSource; RebuildKeys(); RebuildSizeCache(false); RestoreListAnchor(anchor, _anchorMode); ForceRefresh();
        }

        public void SetSizeProvider(Func<int, object, float> sizeProvider) { _sizeProvider = sizeProvider; RebuildSizeCache(); }
        public void SetItemMeasurer(IUIDynamicItemMeasurer measurer) { _measurer = measurer; }

        public void SetDataList<T>(IList<T> dataList)
        {
            ListAnchor anchor = CaptureListAnchor(_anchorMode); _dataSource = null; _dataList.Clear();
            if (dataList != null) for (int i = 0; i < dataList.Count; i++) _dataList.Add(dataList[i]);
            RebuildKeys(); RebuildSizeCache(false); RestoreListAnchor(anchor, _anchorMode); ForceRefresh();
        }

        public void InsertRange(int index, int count)
        {
            if (count <= 0) return;
            index = Mathf.Clamp(index, 0, Count);
            NotifyStructureChanged(i => i >= index ? i + count : i);
        }
        public void RemoveRange(int index, int count)
        {
            if (count <= 0) return;
            index = Mathf.Max(0, index); int end = index + count;
            NotifyStructureChanged(i => i < index ? i : (i >= end ? i - count : -1));
        }
        public void ReplaceRange(int index, int count)
        {
            if (count <= 0) return;
            index = Mathf.Max(0, index); int end = index + count;
            NotifyStructureChanged(i => i >= index && i < end ? -1 : i);
        }
        public void Move(int fromIndex, int toIndex, int count = 1)
        {
            if (count <= 0 || fromIndex < 0 || toIndex < 0 || fromIndex == toIndex) return;
            NotifyStructureChanged(i => RemapMovedIndex(i, fromIndex, toIndex, count));
        }
        private void NotifyStructureChanged(Func<int, int> remap)
        {
            ListAnchor anchor = CaptureListAnchor(_anchorMode);
            RemapVisibleItems(remap);
            RebuildKeys();
            RebuildSizeCache(false);
            RestoreListAnchor(anchor, _anchorMode);
            UpdateVisibleItems(true);
        }
        private void RemapVisibleItems(Func<int, int> remap)
        {
            _remappedItems.Clear();
            foreach (var pair in _visibleItems)
            {
                int newIndex = remap(pair.Key);
                if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= Count) { RecycleItem(pair.Key, pair.Value); continue; }
                pair.Value.InternalSetIndex(newIndex);
                _remappedItems.Add(new KeyValuePair<int, UIItem>(newIndex, pair.Value));
            }
            _visibleItems.Clear();
            for (int i = 0; i < _remappedItems.Count; i++)
            {
                KeyValuePair<int, UIItem> pair = _remappedItems[i];
                if (_visibleItems.ContainsKey(pair.Key)) RecycleItem(pair.Key, pair.Value);
                else _visibleItems.Add(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            }
        }
        private static int RemapMovedIndex(int index, int fromIndex, int toIndex, int count)
        {
            int fromEnd = fromIndex + count;
            if (index >= fromIndex && index < fromEnd) return toIndex + index - fromIndex;
            if (fromIndex < toIndex && index >= fromEnd && index < toIndex + count) return index - count;
            if (toIndex < fromIndex && index >= toIndex && index < fromIndex) return index + count;
            return index;
        }

        public void Prewarm(int count)
        {
            UIVirtualListTemplate template = GetTemplate(DefaultTemplateId); if (template == null) return;
            Stack<UIItem> pool = GetPool(template.templateId); int target = Mathf.Min(Mathf.Max(0, count), template.maxCacheCount);
            while (pool.Count < target) { UIItem item = CreateItem(template); if (item == null) return; item.gameObject.SetActive(false); pool.Push(item); }
        }

        public void RefreshItem(int index) { if (_visibleItems.TryGetValue(index, out UIItem item) && index >= 0 && index < Count) item.RefreshItem(index, GetData(index)); }

        public void BeginSizeUpdate()
        {
            if (_sizeUpdateDepth++ == 0) { _sizeUpdateAnchor = CaptureSizeAnchor(_sizeAnchorMode); _sizesDirty = false; }
        }

        public void NotifyItemSizeChanged(int index) { if (index >= 0 && index < Count) NotifyItemSizeChanged(index, GetItemSize(index)); }
        public void NotifyItemSizeChanged(int index, float size)
        {
            if (index < 0 || index >= Count) return;
            bool ownBatch = _sizeUpdateDepth == 0; if (ownBatch) BeginSizeUpdate();
            SetItemSize(index, ValidateSize(size, index));
            if (ownBatch) EndSizeUpdate();
        }

        public void NotifyItemSizesChanged(int startIndex, int count)
        {
            BeginSizeUpdate(); int end = Mathf.Min(Count, Mathf.Max(0, startIndex) + Mathf.Max(0, count));
            for (int i = Mathf.Max(0, startIndex); i < end; i++) SetItemSize(i, GetItemSize(i));
            EndSizeUpdate();
        }

        public void NotifyItemSizesChanged() => InvalidateAllSizes();
        public void InvalidateSize(int index) => NotifyItemSizeChanged(index);
        public void InvalidateAllSizes() { BeginSizeUpdate(); for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++) SetItemSize(i, GetItemSize(i)); EndSizeUpdate(); }

        public void EndSizeUpdate()
        {
            if (_sizeUpdateDepth == 0) return;
            if (--_sizeUpdateDepth != 0) return;
            if (_sizesDirty) { RefreshContentSize(); RestoreSizeAnchor(_sizeUpdateAnchor, _sizeAnchorMode); ForceRefresh(); }
        }

        public int MeasureVisibleItems()
        {
            if (_measurer == null || _viewport == null) return 0;
            BeginSizeUpdate(); int measured = 0;
            foreach (var pair in _visibleItems)
            {
                float value = _measurer.MeasureItem(pair.Value, pair.Key, GetData(pair.Key), _viewport.rect.width);
                SetItemSize(pair.Key, ValidateSize(value, pair.Key)); measured++;
            }
            EndSizeUpdate(); return measured;
        }

        public void RebuildSizeCache() => RebuildSizeCache(true);
        private void RebuildSizeCache(bool refresh)
        {
            _itemSizes.Clear(); for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++) _itemSizes.Add(GetItemSize(i));
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIFontTextureRefresh : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Transform targetRoot;
        public bool includeInactive = true;

        private readonly HashSet<Font> _pendingFonts = new HashSet<Font>();
        private readonly HashSet<Font> _processingFonts = new HashSet<Font>();
        private readonly HashSet<Font> _notifyingFonts = new HashSet<Font>();
        private Text[] _targets = new Text[0];

        public int PendingFontCount => _pendingFonts.Count;
        public int LastScannedCount { get; private set; }
        public int LastRefreshedCount { get; private set; }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            Font.textureRebuilt += OnFontTextureRebuilt;
            RebuildTargets();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            Font.textureRebuilt -= OnFontTextureRebuilt;
            _pendingFonts.Clear();
            _processingFonts.Clear();
            _notifyingFonts.Clear();
        }

        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (_pendingFonts.Count == 0)
                return;

            _processingFonts.Clear();
            _processingFonts.UnionWith(_pendingFonts);
            _pendingFonts.Clear();

            LastScannedCount = _targets.Length;
            LastRefreshedCount = 0;
            _notifyingFonts.UnionWith(_processingFonts);
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Length; i++)
                {
                    Text text = _targets[i];
                    if (text == null || !_processingFonts.Contains(text.font))
                        continue;

                    text.FontTextureChanged();
                    LastRefreshedCount++;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _notifyingFonts.Clear();
                _processingFonts.Clear();
            }
        }

        public void RequestRefresh(Font font)
        {
            if (font != null)
                _pendingFonts.Add(font);
        }

        public int Refresh(Font font)
        {
            LastScannedCount = _targets.Length;
            LastRefreshedCount = RefreshTargets(font);
            return LastRefreshedCount;
        }

        public int RefreshAll()
        {
            LastScannedCount = _targets.Length;
            LastRefreshedCount = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Length; i++)
            {
                Text text = _targets[i];
                if (text != null && text.font != null)
                    _notifyingFonts.Add(text.font);
            }

            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Length; i++)
                {
                    Text text = _targets[i];
                    if (text == null)
                        continue;

                    text.FontTextureChanged();
                    LastRefreshedCount++;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _notifyingFonts.Clear();
            }
            return LastRefreshedCount;
        }

        public void RebuildTargets()
        {
            Transform root = targetRoot != null ? targetRoot : transform;
            _targets = root.GetComponentsInChildren<Text>(includeInactive);
        }

        private int RefreshTargets(Font font)
        {
            if (font == null)
                return 0;

            int refreshedCount = 0;
            _notifyingFonts.Add(font);
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Length; i++)
                {
                    Text text = _targets[i];
                    if (text == null || text.font != font)
                        continue;

                    text.FontTextureChanged();
                    refreshedCount++;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _notifyingFonts.Remove(font);
            }
            return refreshedCount;
        }

        private void OnFontTextureRebuilt(Font font)
        {
            if (!_notifyingFonts.Contains(font))
                RequestRefresh(font);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
        }

        internal void HandleSlotClick(UIInfiniteCarouselSlotClick click)
        {
            if (click == null || _dragging || Count == 0 || click.SlotIndex < 0 || click.SlotIndex >= _slots.Count)
                return;

            onItemClicked.Invoke(_slots[click.SlotIndex].Context);
        }

        private void MoveBy(int delta, bool animated)
        {
            if (Count <= 1 || delta == 0)
            {
                if (Count == 1 && !animated)
                    onSettled.Invoke(0);
                return;
            }

            CancelTween();
            float target = _offset - delta * _step;
            if (!animated || settleDuration <= 0f)
            {
                _offset = target;
                NormalizeOffset(true);
                _offset = 0f;
                LayoutSlots();
                onSettled.Invoke(_currentIndex);
                ResetAutoPlayTimer();
                return;
            }
            StartOffsetTween(target);
        }

        private void StartOffsetTween(float target)
        {
            CancelTween();
            if (Mathf.Approximately(_offset, target) && Mathf.Approximately(target, 0f))
            {
                onSettled.Invoke(CurrentIndex);
                ResetAutoPlayTimer();
                return;
            }

            int version = ++_tweenVersion;
            float distance = target - _offset;
            float previous = 0f;
            IsSettling = true;
            _tween = UITween.Value(0f, distance, settleDuration, value =>
            {
                if (version != _tweenVersion)
                    return;
                _offset += value - previous;
                previous = value;
                NormalizeOffset(true);
                LayoutSlots();
            }, UIAnimationEase.OutQuad);
        }

        private void CompleteSettlement(int version)
        {
            if (!IsSettling || version != _tweenVersion)
                return;
            IsSettling = false;
            _tween = null;
            NormalizeOffset(true);
            _offset = 0f;
            LayoutSlots();
            onSettled.Invoke(CurrentIndex);
            ResetAutoPlayTimer();
        }

        private void CancelTween()
        {
            ++_tweenVersion;
            IsSettling = false;
            _tween?.Kill();
            _tween = null;
        }

        private void NormalizeOffset(bool notify)
        {
            if (Count <= 1 || _step <= 0f)
                return;

            while (_offset <= -_step)
            {
                _offset += _step;
                _currentIndex = Wrap(_currentIndex + 1, Count);
                RotateFirstToLast();
                BindSlots();
                if (notify)
                    onIndexChanged.Invoke(_currentIndex);
            }
            while (_offset >= _step)
            {
                _offset -= _step;
                _currentIndex = Wrap(_currentIndex - 1, Count);
                RotateLastToFirst();
                BindSlots();
                if (notify)
                    onIndexChanged.Invoke(_currentIndex);
            }
        }

        private void RotateFirstToLast()
        {
            if (_slots.Count == 0)
                return;
            SlotState first = _slots[0];
            _slots.RemoveAt(0);
            _slots.Add(first);
            AssignPositions();
        }

        private void RotateLastToFirst()
        {
            if (_slots.Count == 0)
                return;
            int lastIndex = _slots.Count - 1;
            SlotState last = _slots[lastIndex];
            _slots.RemoveAt(lastIndex);
            _slots.Insert(0, last);
            AssignPositions();
        }

        private void EnsureSlots()
        {
            int desired = Mathf.Max(3, slotCount);
            if ((desired & 1) == 0)
                desired++;
            if (_slots.Count != desired)
                RebuildSlots();
        }

        private void RebuildSlots()
        {
            CancelTween();
            for (int i = 0; i < _slots.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_slots[i].GameObject != null)
                    Destroy(_slots[i].GameObject);
            }
            _slots.Clear();

            if (content == null || itemPrefab == null)
                return;

            int desired = Mathf.Max(3, slotCount);
            if ((desired & 1) == 0)
                desired++;
            slotCount = desired;
            for (int i = 0; i < desired; i++)
            {
                GameObject instance = Instantiate(itemPrefab, content, false);
                instance.name = itemPrefab.name + "_Slot" + i;
                RectTransform rect = instance.GetComponent<RectTransform>();
                if (rect == null)
                    rect = instance.AddComponent<RectTransform>();
                UIInfiniteCarouselSlotClick click = instance.GetComponent<UIInfiniteCarouselSlotClick>();
                if (click == null)
                    click = instance.AddComponent<UIInfiniteCarouselSlotClick>();
                click.Owner = this;
                click.SlotIndex = i;
                var context = new UIInfiniteCarouselItemContext
                {
                    Slot = instance,
                    RectTransform = rect,
                    SlotIndex = i
                };
                _slots.Add(new SlotState
                {
                    GameObject = instance,
                    Rect = rect,
                    Context = context,
                    Click = click
                });
                ConfigureSlotRect(rect, i);
            }
            AssignPositions();
        }

        private void AssignPositions()
        {
            int half = _slots.Count / 2;
            for (int i = 0; i < _slots.Count; i++)
            {
                SlotState slot = _slots[i];
                slot.Position = i - half;
                slot.Context.SlotIndex = i;
                slot.Click.SlotIndex = i;
                slot.Rect.SetSiblingIndex(i);
            }
        }

        private void BindSlots()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _slots.Count; i++)
            {
                SlotState slot = _slots[i];
                bool active = Count > 0;
                slot.GameObject.SetActive(active);
                if (!active)
                    continue;
                slot.DataIndex = Wrap(_currentIndex + slot.Position, Count);
                UIInfiniteCarouselItemContext context = slot.Context;
                context.Data = _data[slot.DataIndex];
                context.DataIndex = slot.DataIndex;
                context.IsCenter = slot.Position == 0;
                _bind?.Invoke(context);
            }
        }

        private void ConfigureSlotRect(RectTransform rect, int siblingIndex)
        {
            rect.anchorMin = new Vector2(0.5f, rect.anchorMin.y);
            rect.anchorMax = new Vector2(0.5f, rect.anchorMax.y);
            rect.SetSizeWithCurrentAnchors(RectTransform.Axis.Horizontal, _step);
            rect.SetSiblingIndex(siblingIndex);
        }

        private void LayoutSlots()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _slots.Count; i++)
            {
                RectTransform rect = _slots[i].Rect;
                Vector2 position = rect.anchoredPosition;
                position.x = _slots[i].Position * _step + _offset;
                rect.anchoredPosition = position;
            }
        }

        private void ResetAutoPlayTimer()
        {
            _autoPlayElapsed = 0f;
        }

        private static int Wrap(int value, int count)
        {
            return (value % count + count) % count;
        }
    }

    public sealed class UIInfiniteCarouselSlotClick : MonoBehaviour, IPointerClickHandler
    {
        internal UIInfiniteCarousel Owner { get; set; }
        internal int SlotIndex { get; set; }

        public void OnPointerClick(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            Owner?.HandleSlotClick(this);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UILongPressProgressEvent : UnityEvent<float>
    {
    }

    public sealed class UILongPressTrigger : MonoBehaviour, IPointerDownHandler, IPointerUpHandler, IPointerExitHandler, IDragHandler
    {
        public float longPressThreshold = 0.8f;
        public float moveTolerance = 12f;
        public bool useUnscaledTime = true;
        public bool cancelOnExit = true;
        public bool cancelOnMove = true;
        public bool triggerClickAfterLongPress;
        public bool repeatLongPress;
        public float repeatInterval = 0.2f;

        public UnityEvent onPressed = new UnityEvent();
        public UnityEvent onReleased = new UnityEvent();
        public UnityEvent onClicked = new UnityEvent();
        public UnityEvent onLongPressed = new UnityEvent();
        public UnityEvent onLongPressRepeated = new UnityEvent();
        public UnityEvent onCanceled = new UnityEvent();
        public UILongPressProgressEvent onProgressChanged = new UILongPressProgressEvent();

        private bool _isPressed;
        private bool _isLongPressed;
        private float _pressTime;
        private float _nextRepeatTime;
        private Vector2 _pressPosition;

        public bool IsPressed => _isPressed;
        public bool IsLongPressed => _isLongPressed;
        public float Progress { get; private set; }

        public void OnPointerDown(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (_isPressed)
                Cancel();

            _isPressed = true;
            _isLongPressed = false;
            Progress = 0f;
            _pressTime = Now;
            _nextRepeatTime = _pressTime + Mathf.Max(0.01f, longPressThreshold);
            _pressPosition = eventData.position;
            onPressed.Invoke();
            onProgressChanged.Invoke(0f);
        }

        public void OnPointerUp(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (!_isPressed)
                return;

            bool shouldClick = !_isLongPressed || triggerClickAfterLongPress;
            bool moved = Vector2.Distance(_pressPosition, eventData.position) > moveTolerance;
            onReleased.Invoke();
            if (shouldClick && !moved)
                onClicked.Invoke();

            ResetState();
        }

        public void OnPointerExit(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (!_isPressed || !cancelOnExit)
                return;

            Cancel();
        }

        public void OnDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (_isPressed && cancelOnMove && Vector2.Distance(_pressPosition, eventData.position) > moveTolerance)
                Cancel();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (_isPressed)
                Cancel();
            else
                ResetState();
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!_isPressed)
                return;

            float elapsed = Now - _pressTime;
            float threshold = Mathf.Max(0.01f, longPressThreshold);
            Progress = Mathf.Clamp01(elapsed / threshold);
            onProgressChanged.Invoke(Progress);

            if (!_isLongPressed && elapsed >= threshold)
            {
                _isLongPressed = true;
                _nextRepeatTime = Now + Mathf.Max(0.01f, repeatInterval);
                onLongPressed.Invoke();
            }

            if (_isLongPressed && repeatLongPress && Now >= _nextRepeatTime)
            {
                _nextRepeatTime = Now + Mathf.Max(0.01f, repeatInterval);
                onLongPressRepeated.Invoke();
            }
        }

        public void Cancel()
        {
            if (!_isPressed)
                return;

            ResetState();
            onCanceled.Invoke();
        }

        public void ResetState()
        {
            _isPressed = false;
            _isLongPressed = false;
            Progress = 0f;
            _pressPosition = Vector2.zero;
            onProgressChanged.Invoke(0f);
        }

        private float Now => useUnscaledTime ? Time.unscaledTime : Time.time;
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum UIMeshRaycastMode
    {
        None,
        Rect,
        Triangles
    }

    public enum UIMeshFitMode
    {
        None,
        Stretch,
        Fit,
        Fill
    }

    public sealed class UIMeshImage : MaskableGraphic
    {
        [SerializeField] private Texture _texture;
        [SerializeField] private Mesh _mesh;
        [SerializeField] private UIMeshRaycastMode _raycastMode = UIMeshRaycastMode.Rect;
        [SerializeField] private UIMeshFitMode _fitMode = UIMeshFitMode.Stretch;

        private readonly List<Vector3> _vertices = new List<Vector3>();
        private readonly List<Vector2> _uvs = new List<Vector2>();
        private readonly List<int> _triangles = new List<int>();
        private readonly List<int> _submeshTriangles = new List<int>();
        private readonly List<Vector2> _mappedVertices = new List<Vector2>();
        private readonly List<Vector2> _mappedUvs = new List<Vector2>();
        private readonly List<int> _validTriangles = new List<int>();
        private bool _geometryDirty = true;
        private Rect _cachedRect;

        public override Texture mainTexture => _texture != null ? _texture : s_WhiteTexture;

        public Mesh Mesh
        {
            get => _mesh;
            set
            {
                if (_mesh == value)
                    return;

                _mesh = value;
                InvalidateGeometry();
            }
        }

        public UIMeshRaycastMode RaycastMode
        {
            get => _raycastMode;
            set
            {
                if (_raycastMode == value)
                    return;

                _raycastMode = value;
                SetVerticesDirty();
            }
        }

        public UIMeshFitMode FitMode
        {
            get => _fitMode;
            set
            {
                if (_fitMode == value)
                    return;

                _fitMode = value;
                InvalidateGeometry();
            }
        }

        public void SetTexture(Texture texture)
        {
            if (_texture == texture)
                return;

            _texture = texture;
            SetMaterialDirty();
        }

        public void SetMesh(Mesh mesh)
        {
            Mesh = mesh;
        }

        public void RefreshMesh()
        {
            InvalidateGeometry();
        }

        public void SetVertices(IList<Vector3> vertices, IList<Vector2> uvs, IList<int> triangles)
        {
            SetGeometry(vertices, uvs, triangles);
        }

        public void SetGeometry(IList<Vector3> vertices, IList<Vector2> uvs, IList<int> triangles)
        {
            _mesh = null;
            _vertices.Clear();
            _uvs.Clear();
            _triangles.Clear();
            if (vertices != null)
                _vertices.AddRange(vertices);
            if (uvs != null)
                _uvs.AddRange(uvs);
            if (triangles != null)
                _triangles.AddRange(triangles);
            InvalidateGeometry();
        }

        public void ClearMesh()
        {
            _mesh = null;
            _vertices.Clear();
            _uvs.Clear();
            _triangles.Clear();
            InvalidateGeometry();
        }

        public override bool Raycast(Vector2 sp, Camera eventCamera)
        {
            if (_raycastMode == UIMeshRaycastMode.None)
                return false;
            if (_raycastMode == UIMeshRaycastMode.Rect)
                return base.Raycast(sp, eventCamera);
            if (!base.Raycast(sp, eventCamera))
                return false;
            if (!RectTransformUtility.ScreenPointToLocalPointInRectangle(rectTransform, sp, eventCamera, out Vector2 local))
                return false;

            EnsureGeometry();
            for (int i = 0; i < _validTriangles.Count; i += 3)
            {
                Vector2 a = _mappedVertices[_validTriangles[i]];
                Vector2 b = _mappedVertices[_validTriangles[i + 1]];
                Vector2 c = _mappedVertices[_validTriangles[i + 2]];
                if (ContainsPoint(local, a, b, c))
                    return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        protected override void OnPopulateMesh(VertexHelper vh)
        {
            vh.Clear();
            EnsureGeometry();
            if (_mappedVertices.Count == 0 || _validTriangles.Count == 0)
            {
                AddDefaultQuad(vh);
                return;
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < _mappedVertices.Count; i++)
            {
                UIVertex vertex = UIVertex.simpleVert;
                vertex.position = _mappedVertices[i];
                vertex.color = color;
                vertex.uv0 = _mappedUvs[i];
                vh.AddVert(vertex);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < _validTriangles.Count; i += 3)
                vh.AddTriangle(_validTriangles[i], _validTriangles[i + 1], _validTriangles[i + 2]);
        }

        protected override void OnRectTransformDimensionsChange()
        {
            base.OnRectTransformDimensionsChange();
            InvalidateGeometry();
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        protected override void OnValidate()
        {
            base.OnValidate();
            InvalidateGeometry();
            SetMaterialDirty();
        }
#endif

        private void InvalidateGeometry()
        {
            _geometryDirty = true;
            SetVerticesDirty();
        }

        private void EnsureGeometry()
        {
            Rect rect = GetPixelAdjustedRect();
            if (!_geometryDirty && rect == _cachedRect)
                return;

            _geometryDirty = false;
            _cachedRect = rect;
            _mappedVertices.Clear();
            _mappedUvs.Clear();
            _validTriangles.Clear();

            if (_mesh != null)
            {
                _vertices.Clear();
                _uvs.Clear();
                _triangles.Clear();
                _mesh.GetVertices(_vertices);
                _mesh.GetUVs(0, _uvs);
                for (int submesh = 0; submesh < _mesh.subMeshCount; submesh++)
                {
                    _submeshTriangles.Clear();
                    _mesh.GetTriangles(_submeshTriangles, submesh);
                    _triangles.AddRange(_submeshTriangles);
                }
            }

            if (_vertices.Count == 0 || _triangles.Count < 3)
                return;

            Bounds bounds = new Bounds(_vertices[0], Vector3.zero);
            for (int i = 1; i < _vertices.Count; i++)
                bounds.Encapsulate(_vertices[i]);

            for (int i = 0; i < _vertices.Count; i++)
            {
                _mappedVertices.Add(MapVertex(_vertices[i], bounds, rect));
                _mappedUvs.Add(i < _uvs.Count ? _uvs[i] : Vector2.zero);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i + 2 < _triangles.Count; i += 3)
            {
                int a = _triangles[i];
                int b = _triangles[i + 1];
                int c = _triangles[i + 2];
                if (a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 || a >= _mappedVertices.Count || b >= _mappedVertices.Count || c >= _mappedVertices.Count)
                    continue;
                if (Mathf.Abs(Cross(_mappedVertices[b] - _mappedVertices[a], _mappedVertices[c] - _mappedVertices[a])) <= Mathf.Epsilon)
                    continue;
                _validTriangles.Add(a);
                _validTriangles.Add(b);
                _validTriangles.Add(c);
            }
        }

        private Vector2 MapVertex(Vector3 vertex, Bounds bounds, Rect rect)
        {
            if (_fitMode == UIMeshFitMode.None)
                return new Vector2(vertex.x, vertex.y);

            float width = bounds.size.x;
            float height = bounds.size.y;
            float normalizedX = width > Mathf.Epsilon ? (vertex.x - bounds.min.x) / width - 0.5f : 0f;
            float normalizedY = height > Mathf.Epsilon ? (vertex.y - bounds.min.y) / height - 0.5f : 0f;
            float scaleX = rect.width;
            float scaleY = rect.height;

            if (_fitMode != UIMeshFitMode.Stretch)
            {
                float sourceWidth = width > Mathf.Epsilon ? width : 1f;
                float sourceHeight = height > Mathf.Epsilon ? height : 1f;
                float scale = _fitMode == UIMeshFitMode.Fit
                    ? Mathf.Min(rect.width / sourceWidth, rect.height / sourceHeight)
                    : Mathf.Max(rect.width / sourceWidth, rect.height / sourceHeight);
                scaleX = width * scale;
                scaleY = height * scale;
            }

            return new Vector2(rect.center.x + normalizedX * scaleX, rect.center.y + normalizedY * scaleY);
        }

        private static bool ContainsPoint(Vector2 point, Vector2 a, Vector2 b, Vector2 c)
        {
            float ab = Cross(b - a, point - a);
            float bc = Cross(c - b, point - b);
            float ca = Cross(a - c, point - c);
            return ab >= 0f && bc >= 0f && ca >= 0f || ab <= 0f && bc <= 0f && ca <= 0f;
        }

        private static float Cross(Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
        {
            return a.x * b.y - a.y * b.x;
        }

        private void AddDefaultQuad(VertexHelper vh)
        {
            Rect rect = GetPixelAdjustedRect();
            UIVertex vertex = UIVertex.simpleVert;
            vertex.color = color;
            vertex.position = new Vector3(rect.xMin, rect.yMin);
            vertex.uv0 = new Vector2(0f, 0f);
            vh.AddVert(vertex);
            vertex.position = new Vector3(rect.xMin, rect.yMax);
            vertex.uv0 = new Vector2(0f, 1f);
            vh.AddVert(vertex);
            vertex.position = new Vector3(rect.xMax, rect.yMax);
            vertex.uv0 = new Vector2(1f, 1f);
            vh.AddVert(vertex);
            vertex.position = new Vector3(rect.xMax, rect.yMin);
            vertex.uv0 = new Vector2(1f, 0f);
            vh.AddVert(vertex);
            vh.AddTriangle(0, 1, 2);
            vh.AddTriangle(2, 3, 0);
        }
    }
}
````
