````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.InputSystem.EnhancedTouch;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIPinchZoomScaleEvent : UnityEvent<float>
    {
    }

    public sealed class UIPinchZoom : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public RectTransform target;
        public RectTransform viewport;
        public float minScale = 0.5f;
        public float maxScale = 3f;
        public float zoomSpeed = 1f;
        public float panSpeed = 1f;
        public bool clampToViewport = true;
        public bool disableParentScrollRectWhilePinching = true;
        public float reboundDuration = 0.2f;
        public UnityEvent onZoomStarted = new UnityEvent();
        public UIPinchZoomScaleEvent onZoomChanged = new UIPinchZoomScaleEvent();
        public UnityEvent onZoomEnded = new UnityEvent();

        private ScrollRect _parentScrollRect;
        private bool _pinching;
        private bool _enhancedTouchEnabled;
        private bool _parentScrollWasEnabled;
        private bool _parentScrollTemporarilyDisabled;
        private int _firstTouchId = -1;
        private int _secondTouchId = -1;
        private float _lastDistance;
        private Vector2 _lastCenter;
        private Vector3 _initialScale;
        private UITweenHandle _scaleReboundTween;
        private UITweenHandle _moveReboundTween;

        public bool IsPinching => _pinching;
        public float CurrentScale => GetCurrentScale();

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (target == null)
                target = transform as RectTransform;
            if (viewport == null)
                viewport = transform.parent as RectTransform;
            _initialScale = target != null ? target.localScale : Vector3.one;
            _parentScrollRect = GetComponentInParent<ScrollRect>();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            EnhancedTouchSupport.Enable();
            _enhancedTouchEnabled = true;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            CancelPinch();
            KillRebounds();
            if (_enhancedTouchEnabled)
            {
                EnhancedTouchSupport.Disable();
                _enhancedTouchEnabled = false;
            }
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            CancelPinch();
            KillRebounds();
            if (_enhancedTouchEnabled)
            {
                EnhancedTouchSupport.Disable();
                _enhancedTouchEnabled = false;
            }
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (target == null)
                return;

            var touches = UnityEngine.InputSystem.EnhancedTouch.Touch.activeTouches;
            if (!_pinching)
            {
                if (touches.Count < 2)
                    return;

                var first = touches[0];
                var second = touches[1];
                if (!IsInsideViewport(first.screenPosition) || !IsInsideViewport(second.screenPosition))
                    return;

                BeginPinch(first.touchId, second.touchId, first.screenPosition, second.screenPosition);
                return;
            }

            bool foundFirst = false;
            bool foundSecond = false;
            Vector2 p0 = Vector2.zero;
            Vector2 p1 = Vector2.zero;
            for (int i = 0; i < touches.Count; i++)
            {
                var touch = touches[i];
                if (touch.touchId == _firstTouchId)
                {
                    foundFirst = true;
                    p0 = touch.screenPosition;
                }
                else if (touch.touchId == _secondTouchId)
                {
                    foundSecond = true;
                    p1 = touch.screenPosition;
                }
            }

            if (!foundFirst || !foundSecond)
            {
                EndPinch(true);
                return;
            }

            float distance = Vector2.Distance(p0, p1);
            Vector2 center = (p0 + p1) * 0.5f;
            float delta = distance - _lastDistance;
            float scale = Mathf.Clamp(CurrentScale + delta * 0.005f * zoomSpeed, minScale, maxScale);
            target.localScale = _initialScale * scale;

            Vector2 centerDelta = (center - _lastCenter) * panSpeed;
            target.anchoredPosition += centerDelta;
            if (clampToViewport)
                ClampToViewport(false);

            _lastDistance = distance;
            _lastCenter = center;
            onZoomChanged.Invoke(scale);
        }

        public void ResetZoom(bool animated = true)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return;

            KillRebounds();
            if (animated && reboundDuration > 0f)
            {
                _scaleReboundTween = UITween.Scale(target, _initialScale, reboundDuration, UIAnimationEase.OutQuad);
                _moveReboundTween = UITween.Move(target, Vector2.zero, reboundDuration, UIAnimationEase.OutQuad);
            }
            else
            {
                target.localScale = _initialScale;
                target.anchoredPosition = Vector2.zero;
            }
        }

        public void CancelPinch()
        {
            EndPinch(false);
        }

        private void BeginPinch(int firstTouchId, int secondTouchId, Vector2 firstPosition, Vector2 secondPosition)
        {
            _pinching = true;
            _firstTouchId = firstTouchId;
            _secondTouchId = secondTouchId;
            _lastDistance = Vector2.Distance(firstPosition, secondPosition);
            _lastCenter = (firstPosition + secondPosition) * 0.5f;
            KillRebounds();
            DisableParentScroll();
            onZoomStarted.Invoke();
        }

        private void EndPinch(bool rebound)
        {
            if (!_pinching)
                return;

            _pinching = false;
            _firstTouchId = -1;
            _secondTouchId = -1;
            RestoreParentScroll();
            if (rebound && clampToViewport)
                ClampToViewport(true);
            onZoomEnded.Invoke();
        }

        private bool IsInsideViewport(Vector2 screenPosition)
        {
            return viewport != null && RectTransformUtility.RectangleContainsScreenPoint(viewport, screenPosition);
        }

        private float GetCurrentScale()
        {
            if (target == null)
                return 1f;
            if (!Mathf.Approximately(_initialScale.x, 0f))
                return target.localScale.x / _initialScale.x;
            return 1f;
        }

        private void ClampToViewport(bool animated)
        {
            if (viewport == null || target == null)
                return;

            Vector2 viewportSize = viewport.rect.size;
            Vector2 targetSize = Vector2.Scale(target.rect.size, new Vector2(Mathf.Abs(target.localScale.x), Mathf.Abs(target.localScale.y)));
            Vector2 maxOffset = Vector2.Max(Vector2.zero, (targetSize - viewportSize) * 0.5f);
            Vector2 clamped = target.anchoredPosition;
            clamped.x = Mathf.Clamp(clamped.x, -maxOffset.x, maxOffset.x);
            clamped.y = Mathf.Clamp(clamped.y, -maxOffset.y, maxOffset.y);

            _moveReboundTween?.Kill();
            _moveReboundTween = null;
            if (animated && reboundDuration > 0f)
                _moveReboundTween = UITween.Move(target, clamped, reboundDuration, UIAnimationEase.OutQuad);
            else
                target.anchoredPosition = clamped;
        }

        private void KillRebounds()
        {
            _scaleReboundTween?.Kill();
            _moveReboundTween?.Kill();
            _scaleReboundTween = null;
            _moveReboundTween = null;
        }

        private void DisableParentScroll()
        {
            if (!disableParentScrollRectWhilePinching || _parentScrollRect == null)
                return;

            _parentScrollWasEnabled = _parentScrollRect.enabled;
            _parentScrollRect.enabled = false;
            _parentScrollTemporarilyDisabled = true;
        }

        private void RestoreParentScroll()
        {
            if (!_parentScrollTemporarilyDisabled)
                return;

            if (_parentScrollRect != null)
                _parentScrollRect.enabled = _parentScrollWasEnabled;
            _parentScrollTemporarilyDisabled = false;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIPointerEventListener : MonoBehaviour, IPointerClickHandler, IPointerDownHandler, IPointerUpHandler, IPointerEnterHandler, IPointerExitHandler, IBeginDragHandler, IDragHandler, IEndDragHandler, IDropHandler, IScrollHandler, ISelectHandler, IDeselectHandler, IMoveHandler
    {
        private sealed class DisposableAction : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly Action _disposeAction;
            private bool _disposed;

            public DisposableAction(Action disposeAction)
            {
                _disposeAction = disposeAction;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_disposed)
                    return;

                _disposed = true;
                _disposeAction?.Invoke();
            }
        }

        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> PointerClick;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> PointerDown;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> PointerUp;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> PointerEnter;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> PointerExit;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> BeginDrag;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> Drag;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> EndDrag;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> Drop;
        private event Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> Scroll;
        private event Action<GameObject, BaseEventData> Select;
        private event Action<GameObject, BaseEventData> Deselect;
        private event Action<GameObject, AxisEventData> Move;

        public static UIPointerEventListener Get(GameObject go)
        {
            if (go == null)
                return null;

            UIPointerEventListener listener = go.GetComponent<UIPointerEventListener>();
            if (listener == null)
                listener = go.AddComponent<UIPointerEventListener>();
            return listener;
        }

        public IDisposable AddClick(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            PointerClick += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => PointerClick -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddDown(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            PointerDown += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => PointerDown -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddUp(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            PointerUp += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => PointerUp -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddEnter(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            PointerEnter += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => PointerEnter -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddExit(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            PointerExit += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => PointerExit -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddBeginDrag(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            BeginDrag += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => BeginDrag -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddDrag(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            Drag += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => Drag -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddEndDrag(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            EndDrag += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => EndDrag -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddDrop(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            Drop += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => Drop -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddScroll(Action<GameObject, PointerEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            Scroll += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => Scroll -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddSelect(Action<GameObject, BaseEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            Select += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => Select -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddDeselect(Action<GameObject, BaseEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            Deselect += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => Deselect -= callback);
        }

        public IDisposable AddMove(Action<GameObject, AxisEventData> callback)
        {
            if (callback == null) return null;
            Move += callback;
            return new DisposableAction(() => Move -= callback);
        }

        public void OnPointerClick(PointerEventData eventData) => PointerClick?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnPointerDown(PointerEventData eventData) => PointerDown?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnPointerUp(PointerEventData eventData) => PointerUp?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnPointerEnter(PointerEventData eventData) => PointerEnter?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnPointerExit(PointerEventData eventData) => PointerExit?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);

        public void OnBeginDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (HasDragHandlers)
                BeginDrag?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
            else
                ForwardDrag(eventData, ExecuteEvents.beginDragHandler);
        }

        public void OnDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (HasDragHandlers)
                Drag?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
            else
                ForwardDrag(eventData, ExecuteEvents.dragHandler);
        }

        public void OnEndDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (HasDragHandlers)
                EndDrag?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
            else
                ForwardDrag(eventData, ExecuteEvents.endDragHandler);
        }

        public void OnDrop(PointerEventData eventData) => Drop?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnScroll(PointerEventData eventData) => Scroll?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnSelect(BaseEventData eventData) => Select?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnDeselect(BaseEventData eventData) => Deselect?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);
        public void OnMove(AxisEventData eventData) => Move?.Invoke(gameObject, eventData);

        private bool HasDragHandlers => BeginDrag != null || Drag != null || EndDrag != null;

        private void ForwardDrag<THandler>(PointerEventData eventData, ExecuteEvents.EventFunction<THandler> callback)
            where THandler : IEventSystemHandler
        {
            Transform parent = transform.parent;
            while (parent != null)
            {
                if (ExecuteEvents.CanHandleEvent<THandler>(parent.gameObject))
                {
                    ExecuteEvents.Execute(parent.gameObject, eventData, callback);
                    return;
                }
                parent = parent.parent;
            }
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            PointerClick = null;
            PointerDown = null;
            PointerUp = null;
            PointerEnter = null;
            PointerExit = null;
            BeginDrag = null;
            Drag = null;
            EndDrag = null;
            Drop = null;
            Scroll = null;
            Select = null;
            Deselect = null;
            Move = null;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum UIRawImageFitMode
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 保持图片比例，完整显示图片，容器可能留白。
        /// </summary>
        Contain = 0,

        /// <summary>
        /// 保持图片比例，完全覆盖容器，图片可能被裁剪。
        /// </summary>
        Cover = 1,

        /// <summary>
        /// 强制填满容器，可能拉伸变形。
        /// </summary>
        Fill = 2,

        /// <summary>
        /// 使用纹理的原始尺寸。
        /// </summary>
        NativeSize = 3
    }

    [ExecuteAlways]
    [RequireComponent(typeof(RawImage))]
    public sealed class UIRawImageFitter : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("Fit Settings")]
        [SerializeField]
        private UIRawImageFitMode _fitMode = UIRawImageFitMode.Cover;

        [Tooltip("Cover 模式下通过修改 uvRect 裁剪图片，而不是放大 RawImage。")]
        [SerializeField]
        private bool _useUvRect = true;

        [Header("Container")]
        [Tooltip("自动使用当前对象所在的根 Canvas 作为适配区域。启用后会忽略 Fit Container。")]
        [SerializeField]
        private bool _useRootCanvas = true;

        [Tooltip("需要适配的目标区域。Use Root Canvas 启用时会忽略此字段。")]
        [SerializeField]
        private RectTransform _fitContainer;

        [Header("Transform Options")]
        [Tooltip("自动将 RawImage 的中心对齐到目标容器中心。")]
        [SerializeField]
        private bool _alignToContainer = true;

        [Tooltip("刷新时将 RawImage 的 Local Scale 重置为 1。推荐启用。")]
        [SerializeField]
        private bool _resetLocalScale = true;

        [Header("Debug")]
        [Tooltip("强制每帧刷新。一般不需要启用，排查层级或布局问题时可以开启。")]
        [SerializeField]
        private bool _refreshEveryFrame = false;

        private RawImage _rawImage;
        private RectTransform _rectTransform;

        private readonly Vector3[] _containerWorldCorners = new Vector3[4];

        // 上一次状态，用于运行时检测变化。
        private Texture _lastTexture;
        private Vector2 _lastTextureSize;
        private Vector2 _lastContainerSize;
        private Vector3 _lastContainerWorldCenter;

        private UIRawImageFitMode _lastFitMode;
        private bool _lastUseUvRect;
        private bool _lastUseRootCanvas;
        private bool _lastAlignToContainer;
        private bool _lastResetLocalScale;

        private RectTransform _lastConfiguredContainer;
        private RectTransform _lastResolvedContainer;
        private Transform _lastTargetParent;

        private bool _refreshing;

        public UIRawImageFitMode FitMode
        {
            get => _fitMode;
            set
            {
                if (_fitMode == value)
                    return;

                _fitMode = value;
                Refresh();
            }
        }

        public bool UseUvRect
        {
            get => _useUvRect;
            set
            {
                if (_useUvRect == value)
                    return;

                _useUvRect = value;
                Refresh();
            }
        }

        public bool UseRootCanvas
        {
            get => _useRootCanvas;
            set
            {
                if (_useRootCanvas == value)
                    return;

                _useRootCanvas = value;
                Refresh();
            }
        }

        public RectTransform FitContainer
        {
            get => _fitContainer;
            set
            {
                if (_fitContainer == value)
                    return;

                _fitContainer = value;
                Refresh();
            }
        }

        public bool AlignToContainer
        {
            get => _alignToContainer;
            set
            {
                if (_alignToContainer == value)
                    return;

                _alignToContainer = value;
                Refresh();
            }
        }

        public bool ResetLocalScale
        {
            get => _resetLocalScale;
            set
            {
                if (_resetLocalScale == value)
                    return;

                _resetLocalScale = value;
                Refresh();
            }
        }

        public RawImage RawImage
        {
            get
            {
                CacheComponents();
                return _rawImage;
            }
        }

        private void Reset()
        {
            CacheComponents();

            _fitMode = UIRawImageFitMode.Cover;
            _useUvRect = true;
            _useRootCanvas = true;
            _alignToContainer = true;
            _resetLocalScale = true;

            Refresh();
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Refresh();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Refresh();
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            Refresh();
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            CacheComponents();

            if (_rawImage == null || _rectTransform == null)
                return;

            if (_refreshEveryFrame || HasStateChanged())
                Refresh();
        }

        private void OnValidate()
        {
            CacheComponents();

            // Inspector 中修改 FitMode、UseUvRect 等字段时立即刷新。
            if (isActiveAndEnabled)
                Refresh();
        }

        private void OnTransformParentChanged()
        {
            Refresh();
        }

        private void OnRectTransformDimensionsChange()
        {
            if (!_refreshing)
                Refresh();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 设置 RawImage 的纹理并刷新。
        /// </summary>
        public void SetTexture(Texture texture, bool refresh = true)
        {
            CacheComponents();

            if (_rawImage == null)
                return;

            _rawImage.texture = texture;

            if (refresh)
                Refresh();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 强制重新计算 RawImage 的位置、尺寸和 UV。
        /// </summary>
        public void Refresh()
        {
            if (_refreshing)
                return;

            CacheComponents();

            if (_rawImage == null || _rectTransform == null)
                return;

            _refreshing = true;

            try
            {
                if (_resetLocalScale)
                    _rectTransform.localScale = Vector3.one;

                Texture texture = _rawImage.texture;
                RectTransform container = ResolveFitContainer();

                if (!TryGetContainerMetrics(
                        container,
                        out Vector2 containerSize,
                        out Vector3 containerWorldCenter))
                {
                    SaveCurrentState(
                        texture,
                        container,
                        Vector2.zero,
                        Vector3.zero);

                    return;
                }

                SaveCurrentState(
                    texture,
                    container,
                    containerSize,
                    containerWorldCenter);

                if (texture == null)
                {
                    ResetUvRect();

                    if (_alignToContainer)
                        AlignToWorldCenter(containerWorldCenter);

                    return;
                }

                float textureWidth = texture.width;
                float textureHeight = texture.height;

                if (textureWidth <= 0f || textureHeight <= 0f)
                    return;

                if (containerSize.x <= 0f || containerSize.y <= 0f)
                    return;

                Vector2 textureSize = new Vector2(
                    textureWidth,
                    textureHeight);

                switch (_fitMode)
                {
                    case UIRawImageFitMode.NativeSize:
                    {
                        ResetUvRect();
                        SetSizeAndAlign(
                            textureSize,
                            containerWorldCenter);

                        break;
                    }

                    case UIRawImageFitMode.Fill:
                    {
                        ResetUvRect();
                        SetSizeAndAlign(
                            containerSize,
                            containerWorldCenter);

                        break;
                    }

                    case UIRawImageFitMode.Contain:
                    {
                        ResetUvRect();

                        float scale = Mathf.Min(
                            containerSize.x / textureSize.x,
                            containerSize.y / textureSize.y);

                        Vector2 finalSize = textureSize * scale;

                        SetSizeAndAlign(
                            finalSize,
                            containerWorldCenter);

                        break;
                    }

                    case UIRawImageFitMode.Cover:
                    {
                        ApplyCover(
                            textureSize,
                            containerSize,
                            containerWorldCenter);

                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                _refreshing = false;
            }
        }

        private void ApplyCover(
            Vector2 textureSize,
            Vector2 containerSize,
            Vector3 containerWorldCenter)
        {
            if (_useUvRect)
            {
                // RawImage 本身与容器大小一致，
                // 通过 UV 裁掉纹理多余部分。
                SetSizeAndAlign(
                    containerSize,
                    containerWorldCenter);

                float containerAspect =
                    containerSize.x / containerSize.y;

                float textureAspect =
                    textureSize.x / textureSize.y;

                if (textureAspect > containerAspect)
                {
                    // 图片比容器更宽，裁剪图片左右两侧。
                    float uvWidth =
                        containerAspect / textureAspect;

                    float uvX =
                        (1f - uvWidth) * 0.5f;

                    _rawImage.uvRect = new Rect(
                        uvX,
                        0f,
                        uvWidth,
                        1f);
                }
                else
                {
                    // 图片比容器更高，裁剪图片上下两侧。
                    float uvHeight =
                        textureAspect / containerAspect;

                    float uvY =
                        (1f - uvHeight) * 0.5f;

                    _rawImage.uvRect = new Rect(
                        0f,
                        uvY,
                        1f,
                        uvHeight);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                // 不裁剪 UV，直接将 RawImage 等比例放大，
                // 直到完全覆盖容器。
                ResetUvRect();

                float scale = Mathf.Max(
                    containerSize.x / textureSize.x,
                    containerSize.y / textureSize.y);

                Vector2 finalSize = textureSize * scale;

                SetSizeAndAlign(
                    finalSize,
                    containerWorldCenter);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 获取实际使用的目标容器。
        /// </summary>
        private RectTransform ResolveFitContainer()
        {
            if (_useRootCanvas)
            {
                Canvas canvas = GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();

                if (canvas != null)
                {
                    Canvas rootCanvas = canvas.rootCanvas;

                    if (rootCanvas != null)
                        return rootCanvas.transform as RectTransform;

                    return canvas.transform as RectTransform;
                }
            }

            if (_fitContainer != null)
                return _fitContainer;

            if (_rectTransform != null)
            {
                RectTransform parent =
                    _rectTransform.parent as RectTransform;

                if (parent != null)
                    return parent;
            }

            return _rectTransform;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 将目标容器的世界空间范围转换到 RawImage 父节点的局部空间。
        ///
        /// 这样即使 FitContainer 和 RawImage 不在同一个父节点下，
        /// 中间存在缩放或多级 RectTransform，也能得到正确尺寸。
        /// </summary>
        private bool TryGetContainerMetrics(
            RectTransform container,
            out Vector2 sizeInTargetParent,
            out Vector3 worldCenter)
        {
            sizeInTargetParent = Vector2.zero;
            worldCenter = Vector3.zero;

            if (container == null || _rectTransform == null)
                return false;

            RectTransform targetParent =
                _rectTransform.parent as RectTransform;

            worldCenter = container.TransformPoint(
                container.rect.center);

            // 正常 UI 层级下，RawImage 应该有 RectTransform 父节点。
            if (targetParent == null)
            {
                sizeInTargetParent = container.rect.size;
                return sizeInTargetParent.x > 0f &&
                       sizeInTargetParent.y > 0f;
            }

            container.GetWorldCorners(_containerWorldCorners);

            Vector3 min = new Vector3(
                float.PositiveInfinity,
                float.PositiveInfinity,
                0f);

            Vector3 max = new Vector3(
                float.NegativeInfinity,
                float.NegativeInfinity,
                0f);

            for (int i = 0; i < _containerWorldCorners.Length; i++)
            {
                Vector3 localPoint =
                    targetParent.InverseTransformPoint(
                        _containerWorldCorners[i]);

                min.x = Mathf.Min(min.x, localPoint.x);
                min.y = Mathf.Min(min.y, localPoint.y);

                max.x = Mathf.Max(max.x, localPoint.x);
                max.y = Mathf.Max(max.y, localPoint.y);
            }

            sizeInTargetParent = new Vector2(
                max.x - min.x,
                max.y - min.y);

            return sizeInTargetParent.x > 0f &&
                   sizeInTargetParent.y > 0f;
        }

        private void SetSizeAndAlign(
            Vector2 size,
            Vector3 containerWorldCenter)
        {
            SetSize(size);

            if (_alignToContainer)
                AlignToWorldCenter(containerWorldCenter);
        }

        private void SetSize(Vector2 size)
        {
            if (_rectTransform == null)
                return;

            _rectTransform.SetSizeWithCurrentAnchors(
                RectTransform.Axis.Horizontal,
                size.x);

            _rectTransform.SetSizeWithCurrentAnchors(
                RectTransform.Axis.Vertical,
                size.y);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 对齐的是 RawImage 的几何中心，而不仅仅是 Pivot。
        /// 因此即使 Pivot 不是 0.5，也可以正确居中。
        /// </summary>
        private void AlignToWorldCenter(Vector3 targetWorldCenter)
        {
            if (_rectTransform == null)
                return;

            Vector3 currentWorldCenter =
                _rectTransform.TransformPoint(
                    _rectTransform.rect.center);

            Vector3 offset =
                targetWorldCenter - currentWorldCenter;

            _rectTransform.position += offset;
        }

        private void ResetUvRect()
        {
            if (_rawImage != null)
                _rawImage.uvRect = new Rect(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f);
        }

        private bool HasStateChanged()
        {
            if (_rawImage == null || _rectTransform == null)
                return true;

            Texture texture = _rawImage.texture;

            Vector2 textureSize = texture != null
                ? new Vector2(texture.width, texture.height)
                : Vector2.zero;

            RectTransform resolvedContainer =
                ResolveFitContainer();

            TryGetContainerMetrics(
                resolvedContainer,
                out Vector2 containerSize,
                out Vector3 containerWorldCenter);

            if (_lastTexture != texture)
                return true;

            // RenderTexture 可能还是同一个对象，但内部尺寸发生了变化。
            if (!Approximately(_lastTextureSize, textureSize))
                return true;

            if (!Approximately(_lastContainerSize, containerSize))
                return true;

            if (!Approximately(
                    _lastContainerWorldCenter,
                    containerWorldCenter))
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (_lastFitMode != _fitMode)
                return true;

            if (_lastUseUvRect != _useUvRect)
                return true;

            if (_lastUseRootCanvas != _useRootCanvas)
                return true;

            if (_lastAlignToContainer != _alignToContainer)
                return true;

            if (_lastResetLocalScale != _resetLocalScale)
                return true;

            if (_lastConfiguredContainer != _fitContainer)
                return true;

            if (_lastResolvedContainer != resolvedContainer)
                return true;

            if (_lastTargetParent != _rectTransform.parent)
                return true;

            return false;
        }

        private void SaveCurrentState(
            Texture texture,
            RectTransform resolvedContainer,
            Vector2 containerSize,
            Vector3 containerWorldCenter)
        {
            _lastTexture = texture;

            _lastTextureSize = texture != null
                ? new Vector2(texture.width, texture.height)
                : Vector2.zero;

            _lastContainerSize = containerSize;
            _lastContainerWorldCenter = containerWorldCenter;

            _lastFitMode = _fitMode;
            _lastUseUvRect = _useUvRect;
            _lastUseRootCanvas = _useRootCanvas;
            _lastAlignToContainer = _alignToContainer;
            _lastResetLocalScale = _resetLocalScale;

            _lastConfiguredContainer = _fitContainer;
            _lastResolvedContainer = resolvedContainer;
            _lastTargetParent = _rectTransform.parent;
        }

        private void CacheComponents()
        {
            if (_rawImage == null)
                _rawImage = GetComponent<RawImage>();

            if (_rectTransform == null)
                _rectTransform = transform as RectTransform;
        }

        private static bool Approximately(Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
        {
            return Mathf.Approximately(a.x, b.x) &&
                   Mathf.Approximately(a.y, b.y);
        }

        private static bool Approximately(Vector3 a, Vector3 b)
        {
            const float tolerance = 0.001f;

            return (a - b).sqrMagnitude <=
                   tolerance * tolerance;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>Event-driven binding of an existing Graphic to a notification tree.
    /// Closing/disabling releases its subscription; reopening reads current state, with no polling.</summary>
    public sealed class UIRedDotBinder:MonoBehaviour
    {
        [SerializeField] private string key;
        [SerializeField] private Graphic indicator;
        private UIRedDotTree _tree;
        private IDisposable _binding;
        public void Bind(UIRedDotTree tree,string nodeKey,Graphic graphic)
        {
            if(tree==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tree));
            if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(nodeKey))throw new ArgumentException("Notification key required.",nameof(nodeKey));
            if(graphic==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(graphic));
            _binding?.Dispose();_binding=null;_tree=tree;key=nodeKey;indicator=graphic;
            if(isActiveAndEnabled)Subscribe();
        }
        private void Subscribe(){_binding?.Dispose();_binding=_tree.Subscribe(key,visible=>{if(indicator!=null)indicator.enabled=visible;});}
        private void OnEnable(){if(_tree!=null&&indicator!=null)Subscribe();}
        private void OnDisable(){_binding?.Dispose();_binding=null;}
        private void OnDestroy(){_binding?.Dispose();_binding=null;_tree=null;}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.Serialization;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum SafeAreaAspectPreset
    {
        None,
        Custom,
        Aspect16x9,
        Aspect21x9,
        Aspect4x3,
        Screen
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UISafeAreaChangedEvent : UnityEvent<Rect>
    {
    }

    [RequireComponent(typeof(RectTransform))]
    public sealed class UISafeAreaAdapter : MonoBehaviour
    {
        [Header("安全区域适配方向")]
        public bool fitLeft = true;
        public bool fitRight = true;
        public bool fitTop = true;
        public bool fitBottom = true;

        [Header("应用设置")]
        public bool onlyApplyOnMobile;
        public bool applyOnEnable = true;
        public bool listenScreenChange = true;

        [Tooltip("安全区域之外额外添加的像素边距")]
        public RectOffset extraPadding = new RectOffset();

        [Header("宽高比设置")]
        [Tooltip("将当前 RectTransform 限制在安全区内的设计比例。None 仅应用安全区。")]
        public SafeAreaAspectPreset aspectPreset = SafeAreaAspectPreset.None;

        [Tooltip("宽高比，例如 16:9 填写 1.7777778")]
        [Min(0.0001f)]
        [FormerlySerializedAs("keepRatioValue")]
        public float customAspect = 16f / 9f;

        [Tooltip("固定比例模式下仍覆盖整个父 Canvas 的元素，例如背景图。")]
        [FormerlySerializedAs("equalRatioImgs")]
        public RectTransform[] fullScreenElements;

        [Header("事件")]
        public UISafeAreaChangedEvent onSafeAreaChanged =
            new UISafeAreaChangedEvent();

        private RectTransform _rectTransform;
        private Rect _lastSafeArea;
        private Rect _lastAvailableArea;
        private Vector2Int _lastScreenSize;
        private bool _hasApplied;
        private DrivenRectTransformTracker _drivenTracker;

        private void Awake()
        {
            CacheRectTransform();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            CacheRectTransform();

            if (applyOnEnable)
                Apply();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            _drivenTracker.Clear();
            _hasApplied = false;
            _lastAvailableArea = default;
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (!listenScreenChange)
                return;

            if (!ShouldApply())
                return;

            Rect safeArea = GetSafeArea();
            CacheRectTransform();
            RectTransform parent = _rectTransform != null
                ? _rectTransform.parent as RectTransform
                : null;
            Rect availableArea = GetAvailableLocalArea(parent);
            Vector2Int screenSize =
                new Vector2Int(Screen.width, Screen.height);

            if (!_hasApplied ||
                !Approximately(_lastSafeArea, safeArea) ||
                !Approximately(_lastAvailableArea, availableArea) ||
                _lastScreenSize != screenSize)
            {
                Apply();
            }
        }

        private void OnValidate()
        {
            if (Application.isPlaying && isActiveAndEnabled)
                Apply();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 手动应用安全区域和宽高比。
        /// </summary>
        public void Apply()
        {
            if (!ShouldApply())
                return;

            CacheRectTransform();

            if (_rectTransform == null)
                return;

            Rect safeArea = GetSafeArea();
            Rect paddedArea = ApplyExtraPadding(safeArea);

            RectTransform parent = _rectTransform.parent as RectTransform;
            Rect availableArea = GetAvailableLocalArea(parent);
            Rect paddedLocalArea = ScreenRectToLocalRect(parent, paddedArea);
            Rect targetArea = Intersect(paddedLocalArea, availableArea);
            if (targetArea.width <= 0f || targetArea.height <= 0f)
                targetArea = availableArea;

            float targetAspect = GetConfiguredAspect();
            if (targetAspect > 0f && UsesOwnAspectRatio())
                targetArea = FitInside(targetArea, targetAspect);

            // A fixed design ratio must remain intact; the ratio rectangle is
            // already computed inside the safe area. Fit flags remain the
            // legacy behavior for adapters that do not constrain their own
            // aspect ratio (for example blur panels).
            if (!UsesOwnAspectRatio())
                ApplyFitFlags(ref targetArea, availableArea);
            ApplyLocalArea(_rectTransform, targetArea);
            ApplyFullScreenElements(parent, availableArea);

            // 让当前 RectTransform 精确贴合锚点区域。
            _rectTransform.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
            _rectTransform.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;

            bool changed =
                !_hasApplied ||
                !Approximately(_lastSafeArea, safeArea) ||
                _lastScreenSize.x != Screen.width ||
                _lastScreenSize.y != Screen.height;

            _lastSafeArea = safeArea;
            _lastAvailableArea = availableArea;
            _lastScreenSize =
                new Vector2Int(Screen.width, Screen.height);
            _hasApplied = true;

            if (changed)
                onSafeAreaChanged?.Invoke(safeArea);
        }

        private bool UsesOwnAspectRatio()
        {
            return aspectPreset != SafeAreaAspectPreset.None && GetConfiguredAspect() > 0f;
        }

        private float GetConfiguredAspect()
        {
            switch (aspectPreset)
            {
                case SafeAreaAspectPreset.Aspect16x9:
                    return 16f / 9f;
                case SafeAreaAspectPreset.Aspect21x9:
                    return 21f / 9f;
                case SafeAreaAspectPreset.Aspect4x3:
                    return 4f / 3f;
                case SafeAreaAspectPreset.Screen:
                    Rect screenArea = GetAvailableScreenArea();
                    return screenArea.height > 0f ? screenArea.width / screenArea.height : 0f;
                case SafeAreaAspectPreset.Custom:
                    return customAspect;
                default:
                    return 0f;
            }
        }

        private Rect GetAvailableScreenArea()
        {
            RectTransform parent = _rectTransform.parent as RectTransform;
            if (parent == null)
                return new Rect(0f, 0f, Mathf.Max(1f, Screen.width), Mathf.Max(1f, Screen.height));

            Canvas canvas = parent.GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();
            Camera camera = GetEventCamera(canvas);
            Vector3[] corners = new Vector3[4];
            parent.GetWorldCorners(corners);
            Vector2 min = RectTransformUtility.WorldToScreenPoint(camera, corners[0]);
            Vector2 max = RectTransformUtility.WorldToScreenPoint(camera, corners[2]);
            return Rect.MinMaxRect(min.x, min.y, max.x, max.y);
        }

        private static Rect GetAvailableLocalArea(RectTransform parent)
        {
            if (parent != null)
                return parent.rect;

            return new Rect(0f, 0f, Mathf.Max(1f, Screen.width), Mathf.Max(1f, Screen.height));
        }

        private static Rect ScreenRectToLocalRect(RectTransform target, Rect screenArea)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return screenArea;

            Canvas canvas = target.GetComponentInParent<Canvas>();
            Camera camera = GetEventCamera(canvas);
            Vector2 localMin;
            Vector2 localMax;
            RectTransformUtility.ScreenPointToLocalPointInRectangle(
                target, new Vector2(screenArea.xMin, screenArea.yMin), camera, out localMin);
            RectTransformUtility.ScreenPointToLocalPointInRectangle(
                target, new Vector2(screenArea.xMax, screenArea.yMax), camera, out localMax);
            return Rect.MinMaxRect(localMin.x, localMin.y, localMax.x, localMax.y);
        }

        private void ApplyLocalArea(RectTransform target, Rect localArea)
        {
            if (target == null)
                return;

            RectTransform parent = target.parent as RectTransform;
            if (parent == null)
                return;

            _drivenTracker.Add(this, target,
                DrivenTransformProperties.AnchorMin |
                DrivenTransformProperties.AnchorMax |
                DrivenTransformProperties.AnchoredPosition |
                DrivenTransformProperties.SizeDelta);

            Rect parentRect = parent.rect;
            if (parentRect.width <= 0f || parentRect.height <= 0f)
                return;

            target.anchorMin = new Vector2(
                NormalizeUnclamped(localArea.xMin, parentRect.xMin, parentRect.xMax),
                NormalizeUnclamped(localArea.yMin, parentRect.yMin, parentRect.yMax));
            target.anchorMax = new Vector2(
                NormalizeUnclamped(localArea.xMax, parentRect.xMin, parentRect.xMax),
                NormalizeUnclamped(localArea.yMax, parentRect.yMin, parentRect.yMax));
            target.offsetMin = Vector2.zero;
            target.offsetMax = Vector2.zero;
        }

        private void ApplyFullScreenElements(RectTransform areaSpace, Rect availableArea)
        {
            if (aspectPreset == SafeAreaAspectPreset.None ||
                fullScreenElements == null || fullScreenElements.Length == 0)
                return;

            foreach (RectTransform item in fullScreenElements)
            {
                if (item != null && item != _rectTransform)
                {
                    RectTransform itemParent = item.parent as RectTransform;
                    Rect itemParentArea = TransformRect(areaSpace, itemParent, availableArea);
                    ApplyLocalArea(item, itemParentArea);
                }
            }
        }

        private static Rect TransformRect(RectTransform source, RectTransform target, Rect area)
        {
            if (source == null || target == null || source == target)
                return area;

            Vector3 bottomLeft = target.InverseTransformPoint(
                source.TransformPoint(new Vector3(area.xMin, area.yMin)));
            Vector3 topRight = target.InverseTransformPoint(
                source.TransformPoint(new Vector3(area.xMax, area.yMax)));
            return Rect.MinMaxRect(bottomLeft.x, bottomLeft.y, topRight.x, topRight.y);
        }

        private static float NormalizeUnclamped(float value, float min, float max)
        {
            float range = max - min;
            return Mathf.Abs(range) > Mathf.Epsilon ? (value - min) / range : 0f;
        }

        private void ApplyFitFlags(ref Rect targetArea, Rect availableArea)
        {
            if (!fitLeft) targetArea.xMin = availableArea.xMin;
            if (!fitRight) targetArea.xMax = availableArea.xMax;
            if (!fitBottom) targetArea.yMin = availableArea.yMin;
            if (!fitTop) targetArea.yMax = availableArea.yMax;
        }

        private static Rect FitInside(Rect area, float aspect)
        {
            if (aspect <= 0f || area.width <= 0f || area.height <= 0f)
                return area;

            float currentAspect = area.width / area.height;
            if (currentAspect > aspect)
            {
                float width = area.height * aspect;
                return new Rect(area.center.x - width * 0.5f, area.yMin, width, area.height);
            }

            float height = area.width / aspect;
            return new Rect(area.xMin, area.center.y - height * 0.5f, area.width, height);
        }

        private static Rect Intersect(Rect first, Rect second)
        {
            float xMin = Mathf.Max(first.xMin, second.xMin);
            float yMin = Mathf.Max(first.yMin, second.yMin);
            float xMax = Mathf.Min(first.xMax, second.xMax);
            float yMax = Mathf.Min(first.yMax, second.yMax);
            return Rect.MinMaxRect(xMin, yMin, Mathf.Max(xMin, xMax), Mathf.Max(yMin, yMax));
        }

        private static Camera GetEventCamera(Canvas canvas)
        {
            if (canvas == null || canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay)
                return null;
            return canvas.worldCamera != null ? canvas.worldCamera : Camera.main;
        }

        private void CacheRectTransform()
        {
            if (_rectTransform == null)
                _rectTransform = transform as RectTransform;
        }

        private Rect GetSafeArea()
        {
            return Screen.safeArea;
        }

        private bool ShouldApply()
        {
            if (!Application.isPlaying)
                return false;

            if (onlyApplyOnMobile &&
                !Application.isMobilePlatform)
            {
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }

        private Rect ApplyExtraPadding(Rect safeArea)
        {
            if (extraPadding == null)
                return safeArea;

            Rect result = safeArea;

            result.xMin += extraPadding.left;
            result.xMax -= extraPadding.right;
            result.yMin += extraPadding.bottom;
            result.yMax -= extraPadding.top;

            if (result.width < 0f)
                result.width = 0f;

            if (result.height < 0f)
                result.height = 0f;

            return result;
        }

        private static bool Approximately(Rect a, Rect b)
        {
            return Mathf.Approximately(a.x, b.x) &&
                   Mathf.Approximately(a.y, b.y) &&
                   Mathf.Approximately(a.width, b.width) &&
                   Mathf.Approximately(a.height, b.height);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/UI/Runtime/Extensions/UIScrollText.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Threading;
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum UIScrollTextMode
    {
        HorizontalLoop = 0,
        VerticalLoop = 1,
        PingPong = 2,
        Once = 3
    }

    public sealed class UIScrollText : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public RectTransform viewport;
        public RectTransform textRoot;
        public Text uguiText;
        public TMP_Text tmpText;
        public UIScrollTextMode mode = UIScrollTextMode.HorizontalLoop;
        public float speed = 60f;
        public float startDelay = 0.5f;
        public float endDelay = 0.5f;
        public float spacing = 40f;
        public bool playOnEnable = true;
        public bool useUnscaledTime = true;

        private UITweenHandle _tween;
        private CancellationTokenSource _playCancellation;
        private Vector2 _origin;

        public bool IsOverflow { get; private set; }
        public bool IsPlaying { get; private set; }

        private void Awake()
        {
            CacheComponents();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            Refresh();
            if (playOnEnable)
                Play();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            Stop(true);
        }

        public void SetText(string text, bool play = true)
        {
            Stop(true);
            CacheComponents();
            if (tmpText != null)
                tmpText.text = text;
            else if (uguiText != null)
                uguiText.text = text;
            Refresh();
            if (play)
                Play();
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            if (viewport == null || textRoot == null)
                return;

            LayoutRebuilder.ForceRebuildLayoutImmediate(textRoot);
            _origin = textRoot.anchoredPosition;
            Vector2 viewSize = viewport.rect.size;
            Vector2 preferred = GetPreferredSize();
            IsOverflow = mode == UIScrollTextMode.VerticalLoop ? preferred.y > viewSize.y : preferred.x > viewSize.x;
        }

        public void Play()
        {
            Stop(false);
            if (!IsOverflow || viewport == null || textRoot == null || !isActiveAndEnabled)
                return;

            IsPlaying = true;
            textRoot.anchoredPosition = _origin;
            _playCancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
            PlayLoopAsync(_playCancellation).Forget();
        }

        public void Stop(bool resetPosition = true)
        {
            IsPlaying = false;
            _playCancellation?.Cancel();
            _playCancellation?.Dispose();
            _playCancellation = null;
            _tween?.Kill();
            _tween = null;
            if (resetPosition && textRoot != null)
                textRoot.anchoredPosition = _origin;
        }

        private async UniTask PlayLoopAsync(CancellationTokenSource cancellation)
        {
            CancellationToken token = cancellation.Token;
            try
            {
                if (!await DelayAsync(startDelay, token))
                    return;

                bool towardEnd = true;
                while (!token.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    Vector2 target = towardEnd ? BuildEndPosition() : _origin;
                    float distance = Vector2.Distance(textRoot.anchoredPosition, target);
                    float duration = distance / Mathf.Max(1f, speed);
                    if (duration > 0f)
                    {
                        _tween = UITween.Move(textRoot, target, duration, UIAnimationEase.Linear, useUnscaledTime);
                        UITweenHandle tween = _tween;
                        await tween.ToUniTask(token);
                        if (token.IsCancellationRequested || !tween.IsCompleted)
                            return;
                        if (_tween == tween)
                            _tween = null;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        textRoot.anchoredPosition = target;
                    }

                    if (!await DelayAsync(endDelay, token))
                        return;

                    if (mode == UIScrollTextMode.Once)
                        break;

                    if (mode == UIScrollTextMode.PingPong)
                    {
                        towardEnd = !towardEnd;
                        continue;
                    }

                    textRoot.anchoredPosition = _origin;
                    if (!await DelayAsync(startDelay, token))
                        return;
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                if (cancellation == _playCancellation)
                {
                    IsPlaying = false;
                    _playCancellation.Dispose();
                    _playCancellation = null;
                    _tween = null;
                }
            }
        }

        private async UniTask<bool> DelayAsync(float seconds, CancellationToken token)
        {
            if (seconds <= 0f)
                return !token.IsCancellationRequested;

            bool canceled = await UniTask.Delay(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds), ignoreTimeScale: useUnscaledTime, cancellationToken: token).SuppressCancellationThrow();
            return !canceled;
        }

        private Vector2 BuildEndPosition()
        {
            Vector2 viewSize = viewport.rect.size;
            Vector2 preferred = GetPreferredSize();
            Vector2 to = _origin;
            if (mode == UIScrollTextMode.VerticalLoop)
                to.y += preferred.y - viewSize.y + spacing;
            else
                to.x -= preferred.x - viewSize.x + spacing;
            return to;
        }

        private Vector2 GetPreferredSize()
        {
            if (tmpText != null)
                return tmpText.GetPreferredValues(tmpText.text);
            if (uguiText != null)
                return new Vector2(uguiText.preferredWidth, uguiText.preferredHeight);
            return textRoot != null ? textRoot.rect.size : Vector2.zero;
        }

        private void CacheComponents()
        {
            if (viewport == null)
                viewport = transform as RectTransform;
            if (textRoot == null && transform.childCount > 0)
                textRoot = transform.GetChild(0) as RectTransform;
            if (tmpText == null)
                tmpText = GetComponentInChildren<TMP_Text>(true);
            if (uguiText == null)
                uguiText = GetComponentInChildren<Text>(true);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public enum UISnapScrollDirection
    {
        Horizontal = 0,
        Vertical = 1
    }

    public enum UISnapScrollMode
    {
        Nearest = 0,
        NextOnThreshold = 1,
        Velocity = 2
    }

    public enum UIPageIndexMode
    {
        Clamp = 0,
        Wrap = 1
    }

    public enum UIPageAlignment
    {
        Start = 0,
        Center = 1,
        End = 2
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UISnapScrollPageEvent : UnityEvent<int>
    {
    }

    public sealed class UISnapScrollPage : MonoBehaviour, IBeginDragHandler, IDragHandler, IEndDragHandler
    {
        public ScrollRect scrollRect;
        public RectTransform content;
        public UISnapScrollDirection direction = UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal;
        public UISnapScrollMode snapMode = UISnapScrollMode.Nearest;
        public UIPageIndexMode indexMode = UIPageIndexMode.Clamp;
        public UIPageAlignment alignment = UIPageAlignment.Center;
        public float snapDuration = 0.25f;
        public float swipeThreshold = 0.2f;
        public float velocityThreshold = 300f;
        public bool enableCenterScale;
        public float centerScale = 1.1f;
        public float sideScale = 0.9f;
        public UISnapScrollPageEvent onPageChanged = new UISnapScrollPageEvent();
        public UISnapScrollPageEvent onPageSettled = new UISnapScrollPageEvent();
        public UnityEvent onDragStarted = new UnityEvent();
        public UnityEvent onDragEnded = new UnityEvent();

        private readonly List<RectTransform> _pages = new List<RectTransform>();
        private readonly List<float> _targets = new List<float>();
        private int _selectedPage;
        private int _settledPage;
        private Vector2 _dragStartPosition;
        private UITweenHandle _moveTween;
        private int _moveVersion;

        public int SelectedPage => _selectedPage;
        public int SettledPage => _settledPage;
        public int CurrentPage => SelectedPage;
        public int TargetPage => _selectedPage;
        public int PageCount => _pages.Count;
        public bool IsSettling { get; private set; }

        [Obsolete("Use indexMode instead.")]
        public bool enableLoop
        {
            get => indexMode == UIPageIndexMode.Wrap;
            set => indexMode = value ? UIPageIndexMode.Wrap : UIPageIndexMode.Clamp;
        }

        private RectTransform Viewport
        {
            get
            {
                if (scrollRect != null && scrollRect.viewport != null)
                    return scrollRect.viewport;
                return transform as RectTransform;
            }
        }

        private void Awake()
        {
            CacheComponents();
            RefreshPages(false);
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            StopMovement();
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            StopMovement();
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (IsSettling && (_moveTween == null || !_moveTween.IsActive))
            {
                if (_moveTween != null && _moveTween.IsCompleted)
                    CompleteSettlement(_moveVersion);
                else
                    CancelSettlement();
            }

            if (enableCenterScale)
                UpdateCenterScale();
        }

        public void RefreshPages()
        {
            RefreshPages(true);
        }

        public void RefreshPages(bool preserveSelection = true)
        {
            RectTransform selectedTransform = preserveSelection && _selectedPage >= 0 && _selectedPage < _pages.Count
                ? _pages[_selectedPage]
                : null;
            StopMovement();
            CacheComponents();
            _pages.Clear();
            _targets.Clear();

            if (content == null || Viewport == null)
            {
                _selectedPage = 0;
                _settledPage = 0;
                return;
            }

            Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases();
            LayoutRebuilder.ForceRebuildLayoutImmediate(content);
            Canvas.ForceUpdateCanvases();

            for (int i = 0; i < content.childCount; i++)
            {
                RectTransform page = content.GetChild(i) as RectTransform;
                if (page != null && page.gameObject.activeSelf)
                    _pages.Add(page);
            }

            if (_pages.Count == 0)
            {
                _selectedPage = 0;
                _settledPage = 0;
                return;
            }

            int selected = preserveSelection ? _pages.IndexOf(selectedTransform) : 0;
            if (selected < 0)
                selected = preserveSelection ? Mathf.Clamp(_selectedPage, 0, _pages.Count - 1) : 0;

            CalculateTargets();
            _selectedPage = selected;
            _settledPage = selected;
            content.anchoredPosition = GetPageContentPosition(selected);
            if (scrollRect != null)
                scrollRect.StopMovement();
        }

        public void MoveToPage(int index, bool animated = true)
        {
            if (content == null || PageCount == 0)
                return;

            index = ResolveIndex(index);
            StopMovement();
            _selectedPage = index;
            Vector2 target = GetPageContentPosition(index);
            onPageChanged.Invoke(index);

            if (!animated || snapDuration <= 0f || (target - content.anchoredPosition).sqrMagnitude < 0.0001f)
            {
                content.anchoredPosition = target;
                _settledPage = index;
                onPageSettled.Invoke(index);
                return;
            }

            int version = ++_moveVersion;
            _moveTween = UITween.Move(content, target, snapDuration, UIAnimationEase.OutQuad);
            IsSettling = true;
            _moveVersion = version;
        }

        public void StopMovement()
        {
            CancelSettlement();
            if (scrollRect != null)
                scrollRect.StopMovement();
        }

        public void Next(bool animated = true)
        {
            MoveToPage(SelectedPage + 1, animated);
        }

        public void Previous(bool animated = true)
        {
            MoveToPage(SelectedPage - 1, animated);
        }

        public void OnBeginDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            StopMovement();
            _dragStartPosition = content != null ? content.anchoredPosition : Vector2.zero;
            onDragStarted.Invoke();
        }

        public void OnDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
        }

        public void OnEndDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            onDragEnded.Invoke();
            if (content != null && PageCount > 0)
                MoveToPage(FindTargetPage(), true);
        }

        private void CompleteSettlement(int version)
        {
            if (!IsSettling || version != _moveVersion)
                return;

            IsSettling = false;
            _moveTween = null;
            if (content != null && _selectedPage < _targets.Count)
                content.anchoredPosition = GetPageContentPosition(_selectedPage);
            _settledPage = _selectedPage;
            onPageSettled.Invoke(_settledPage);
        }

        private void CancelSettlement()
        {
            ++_moveVersion;
            IsSettling = false;
            _moveTween?.Kill();
            _moveTween = null;
        }

        private void CacheComponents()
        {
            if (scrollRect == null)
                scrollRect = GetComponent<ScrollRect>();
            if (scrollRect != null && content == null)
                content = scrollRect.content;
        }

        private void CalculateTargets()
        {
            RectTransform viewport = Viewport;
            Bounds contentBounds = RectTransformUtility.CalculateRelativeRectTransformBounds(viewport, content);
            Rect viewportRect = viewport.rect;
            float current = Axis(content.anchoredPosition);
            float minShift;
            float maxShift;

            if (direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal)
            {
                minShift = viewportRect.xMax - contentBounds.max.x;
                maxShift = viewportRect.xMin - contentBounds.min.x;
            }
            else
            {
                minShift = viewportRect.yMax - contentBounds.max.y;
                maxShift = viewportRect.yMin - contentBounds.min.y;
            }

            bool contentFits = minShift > maxShift;
            float fitShift = direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal
                ? viewportRect.center.x - contentBounds.center.x
                : viewportRect.center.y - contentBounds.center.y;

            for (int i = 0; i < _pages.Count; i++)
            {
                Bounds pageBounds = RectTransformUtility.CalculateRelativeRectTransformBounds(viewport, _pages[i]);
                float pagePoint = GetAlignedPoint(pageBounds);
                float viewportPoint = GetAlignedPoint(viewportRect);
                float shift = viewportPoint - pagePoint;
                if (contentFits)
                    shift = fitShift;
                else
                    shift = Mathf.Clamp(shift, minShift, maxShift);
                _targets.Add(current + shift);
            }
        }

        private int FindTargetPage()
        {
            float position = Axis(content.anchoredPosition);
            int nearest = FindNearest(position);
            if (snapMode == UISnapScrollMode.Nearest)
                return nearest;

            float dragDelta = position - Axis(_dragStartPosition);
            int directionalPage = FindAdjacentPage(_selectedPage, dragDelta);
            if (snapMode == UISnapScrollMode.NextOnThreshold)
            {
                float distance = Mathf.Abs(_targets[directionalPage] - _targets[_selectedPage]);
                if (directionalPage != _selectedPage && Mathf.Abs(dragDelta) >= distance * Mathf.Clamp01(swipeThreshold))
                    return directionalPage;
                return _selectedPage;
            }

            float velocity = 0f;
            if (scrollRect != null)
                velocity = direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal ? scrollRect.velocity.x : scrollRect.velocity.y;
            if (Mathf.Abs(velocity) >= velocityThreshold)
                return FindAdjacentPage(nearest, velocity);
            return nearest;
        }

        private int FindNearest(float position)
        {
            int nearest = 0;
            float bestDistance = float.MaxValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Count; i++)
            {
                float distance = Mathf.Abs(position - _targets[i]);
                if (distance < bestDistance)
                {
                    nearest = i;
                    bestDistance = distance;
                }
            }
            return nearest;
        }

        private int FindAdjacentPage(int from, float movement)
        {
            if (Mathf.Approximately(movement, 0f))
                return from;

            float currentTarget = _targets[from];
            int result = from;
            float bestDistance = float.MaxValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < _targets.Count; i++)
            {
                float delta = _targets[i] - currentTarget;
                if (delta * movement <= 0f)
                    continue;
                float distance = Mathf.Abs(delta);
                if (distance < bestDistance)
                {
                    result = i;
                    bestDistance = distance;
                }
            }

            if (result == from && indexMode == UIPageIndexMode.Wrap)
                result = movement > 0f ? PageCount - 1 : 0;
            return result;
        }

        private int ResolveIndex(int index)
        {
            if (indexMode == UIPageIndexMode.Wrap)
                return (index % PageCount + PageCount) % PageCount;
            return Mathf.Clamp(index, 0, PageCount - 1);
        }

        private Vector2 GetPageContentPosition(int index)
        {
            Vector2 position = content.anchoredPosition;
            if (direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal)
                position.x = _targets[index];
            else
                position.y = _targets[index];
            return position;
        }

        private float Axis(Vector2 value)
        {
            return direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal ? value.x : value.y;
        }

        private float GetAlignedPoint(Bounds bounds)
        {
            if (direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal)
                return alignment == UIPageAlignment.Start ? bounds.min.x : alignment == UIPageAlignment.End ? bounds.max.x : bounds.center.x;
            return alignment == UIPageAlignment.Start ? bounds.max.y : alignment == UIPageAlignment.End ? bounds.min.y : bounds.center.y;
        }

        private float GetAlignedPoint(Rect rect)
        {
            if (direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal)
                return alignment == UIPageAlignment.Start ? rect.xMin : alignment == UIPageAlignment.End ? rect.xMax : rect.center.x;
            return alignment == UIPageAlignment.Start ? rect.yMax : alignment == UIPageAlignment.End ? rect.yMin : rect.center.y;
        }

        private void UpdateCenterScale()
        {
            RectTransform viewport = Viewport;
            if (viewport == null || PageCount == 0)
                return;

            float viewportCenter = direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal ? viewport.rect.center.x : viewport.rect.center.y;
            float range = Mathf.Max(1f, direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal ? viewport.rect.width : viewport.rect.height);
            for (int i = 0; i < _pages.Count; i++)
            {
                Bounds bounds = RectTransformUtility.CalculateRelativeRectTransformBounds(viewport, _pages[i]);
                float center = direction == UISnapScrollDirection.Horizontal ? bounds.center.x : bounds.center.y;
                float distance = Mathf.Abs(center - viewportCenter) / range;
                float scale = Mathf.Lerp(centerScale, sideScale, Mathf.Clamp01(distance));
                _pages[i].localScale = Vector3.one * scale;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;

using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIToggleIndexChangedEvent : UnityEvent<int, bool>
    {
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class UIToggleGroupIndexChangedEvent : UnityEvent<int>
    {
    }

    public sealed class UIToggleBinder : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public Toggle toggle;
        public int index;
        public GameObject[] activeWhenOn;
        public GameObject[] activeWhenOff;
        public UIToggleIndexChangedEvent onValueChanged = new UIToggleIndexChangedEvent();

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (toggle == null)
                toggle = GetComponent<Toggle>();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            if (toggle == null)
                toggle = GetComponent<Toggle>();
            if (toggle != null)
                toggle.onValueChanged.AddListener(OnToggleChanged);
            Refresh();
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            if (toggle != null)
                toggle.onValueChanged.RemoveListener(OnToggleChanged);
        }

        public void SetIsOn(bool isOn, bool notify = true)
        {
            if (toggle == null)
                return;

            if (notify)
                toggle.isOn = isOn;
            else
                toggle.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(isOn);
            Refresh();
        }

        public void Refresh()
        {
            bool isOn = toggle != null && toggle.isOn;
            SetActive(activeWhenOn, isOn);
            SetActive(activeWhenOff, !isOn);
        }

        private void OnToggleChanged(bool isOn)
        {
            Refresh();
            onValueChanged.Invoke(index, isOn);
        }

        private static void SetActive(GameObject[] targets, bool active)
        {
            if (targets == null)
                return;

            for (int i = 0; i < targets.Length; i++)
            {
                if (targets[i] != null)
                    targets[i].SetActive(active);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Events;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public sealed class UIToggleGroupBinder : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public ToggleGroup toggleGroup;
        public bool autoCollectChildren = true;
        public bool allowSwitchOff;
        public int defaultIndex;
        public List<Toggle> toggles = new List<Toggle>();
        public UIToggleGroupIndexChangedEvent onSelectedIndexChanged = new UIToggleGroupIndexChangedEvent();
        public UnityEvent<Toggle> onSelectedToggleChanged = new UnityEvent<Toggle>();

        private readonly List<Toggle> _boundToggles = new List<Toggle>();
        private readonly List<UnityAction<bool>> _listeners = new List<UnityAction<bool>>();
        private int _selectedIndex = -1;

        public int SelectedIndex => _selectedIndex;
        public Toggle SelectedToggle => _selectedIndex >= 0 && _selectedIndex < toggles.Count ? toggles[_selectedIndex] : null;

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (toggleGroup == null)
                toggleGroup = GetComponent<ToggleGroup>();
            RefreshToggles();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            RefreshToggles();
            BindEvents();
            if (SelectedToggle == null && defaultIndex >= 0 && defaultIndex < toggles.Count)
                Select(defaultIndex, false);
            RefreshSelected(true);
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            UnbindEvents();
        }

        public void RefreshToggles()
        {
            Toggle selectedToggle = SelectedToggle;
            bool wasBound = _listeners.Count > 0;
            UnbindEvents();

            if (autoCollectChildren)
            {
                toggles.Clear();
                GetComponentsInChildren(true, toggles);
            }

            for (int i = toggles.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (toggles[i] == null)
                    toggles.RemoveAt(i);
            }

            if (toggleGroup == null)
                toggleGroup = GetComponent<ToggleGroup>();

            for (int i = 0; i < toggles.Count; i++)
            {
                toggles[i].group = toggleGroup;
                UIToggleBinder binder = toggles[i].GetComponent<UIToggleBinder>();
                if (binder != null)
                    binder.index = i;
            }

            if (toggleGroup != null)
                toggleGroup.allowSwitchOff = allowSwitchOff;

            int selectedIndex = selectedToggle != null ? toggles.IndexOf(selectedToggle) : -1;
            if (selectedIndex < 0)
                selectedIndex = FindSelectedIndex();
            if (selectedIndex < 0 && defaultIndex >= 0 && defaultIndex < toggles.Count)
                selectedIndex = defaultIndex;

            if (selectedIndex >= 0)
                Select(selectedIndex, false);
            else
                _selectedIndex = -1;

            if (wasBound || isActiveAndEnabled)
                BindEvents();
        }

        public void Select(int index, bool notify = true)
        {
            if (index < 0 || index >= toggles.Count)
                return;

            for (int i = 0; i < toggles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (notify)
                    toggles[i].isOn = i == index;
                else
                    toggles[i].SetIsOnWithoutNotify(i == index);
            }

            RefreshSelected(!notify);
        }

        private void BindEvents()
        {
            UnbindEvents();
            for (int i = 0; i < toggles.Count; i++)
            {
                Toggle toggle = toggles[i];
                UnityAction<bool> listener = _ => RefreshSelected(false);
                _boundToggles.Add(toggle);
                _listeners.Add(listener);
                toggle.onValueChanged.AddListener(listener);
            }
        }

        private void UnbindEvents()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _listeners.Count && i < _boundToggles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_boundToggles[i] != null)
                    _boundToggles[i].onValueChanged.RemoveListener(_listeners[i]);
            }
            _boundToggles.Clear();
            _listeners.Clear();
        }

        private int FindSelectedIndex()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < toggles.Count; i++)
            {
                if (toggles[i] != null && toggles[i].isOn)
                    return i;
            }
            return -1;
        }

        private void RefreshSelected(bool forceNotify)
        {
            int selected = FindSelectedIndex();

            if (!forceNotify && selected == _selectedIndex)
                return;

            _selectedIndex = selected;
            onSelectedIndexChanged.Invoke(_selectedIndex);
            onSelectedToggleChanged.Invoke(SelectedToggle);
        }
    }
}
````
