## File: Core/UI/UIModule_Guide.md
````markdown
# UI 模块详细说明

## 模块定位

`Assets/FRFrame/Core/UI` 是 FRFrame 的 UI 管理模块，负责 UI 根节点、分层、窗口配置、资源加载、窗口生命周期、遮罩、导航、内置 Toast/Dialog/Loading 服务、绑定代码生成和运行时诊断。

常用入口通过 `FRFM.UI` 访问：

```csharp
UIForm form = await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync("InventoryForm");
InventoryForm inventory = await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync<InventoryForm>();
FRFM.UI.Close("InventoryForm");
FRFM.UI.Toast.Show("获得道具");
UIDialogResult result = await FRFM.UI.Dialog.ShowAsync(new UIDialogParams { Title = "提示", Content = "确定退出？" });
```

## 初始化流程

`UIManager.InitializeAsync()` 会：

1. 等待 `ResourceManager` ready。
2. 创建 `UIRoot`、根 Canvas、UI Camera 和 EventSystem。
3. 创建固定 UI 分层：Background、Normal、Popup、Top、Overlay、System。
4. 在每个 group root 下创建独立 mask 节点。
5. 加载启动 UIConfigGroup。
6. 注册内置代码 UI：`UIToastForm`、`UIDialogForm`、`UILoadingForm`。
7. 创建 Toast、Dialog、Loading、Navigation 服务。

## UI 配置

### UIConfigGroup

`UIConfigGroup` 是一组 UI 配置：

```csharp
public string groupName = "Default";
public bool loadOnInitialize = true;
public string defaultPackageName;
public List<UIFormConfig> forms;
```

`defaultPackageName` 表示该组 UI 资源默认所在 YooAsset package。

### UIFormConfig

关键字段：

```csharp
public string formId;
public string logicType;
public string assetPath;
public string configGroup;
public string packageName;
public UIGroupLayer layer;
public bool allowMultiInstance;
public bool fullScreen;
public UIBlockingMode blockingMode;
public bool disableGameObjectWhenHidden;
public UIFormCloseMode closeMode;
public UICoverVisualMode coverVisualMode;
public bool useMask;
public bool closeOnMaskClick;
public UIMaskMode maskMode;
```

### package 解析规则

UI 资源加载 package 解析优先级：

1. `UIFormConfig.packageName`
2. `UIConfigGroup.defaultPackageName`
3. `UIFormConfig.configGroup` 兼容旧数据
4. `null`，交给 Resource 默认包

推荐新配置显式填写 `packageName` 或 `defaultPackageName`，不要继续依赖 `configGroup` 作为 package。

```csharp
var group = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<UIConfigGroup>();
group.groupName = "BattleUI";
group.defaultPackageName = "BattlePackage";

group.forms.Add(new UIFormConfig
{
    formId = "BattleHudForm",
    logicType = "Game.UI.BattleHudForm",
    assetPath = "Assets/Game/UI/Battle/BattleHud.prefab",
    configGroup = "BattleUI",
    packageName = "",
    layer = UIGroupLayer.Normal
});
```

## 打开、关闭和结果 API

### 基础打开

```csharp
InventoryForm form = await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync<InventoryForm>(new InventoryOpenParam
{
    BagId = 1001
});
```

强类型参数可配合：

```csharp
public sealed class InventoryForm : UIForm, IUIOpenParamReceiver<InventoryOpenParam>
{
    private InventoryOpenParam _param;

    public void SetOpenParam(InventoryOpenParam param)
    {
        _param = param;
    }
}
```

### TryOpenAsync

结果型 API 适合不希望自己解析 null 原因的业务：

```csharp
UIOpenResult<InventoryForm> result = await FRFM.UI.TryOpenAsync<InventoryForm>();
if (!result.Succeeded)
{
    FRLog.Warning($"打开背包失败: {result.FailureReason}, {result.Message}");
    return;
}

InventoryForm form = result.Form;
```

### UIOpenOptions

`UIOpenOptions` 支持取消、超时、动画、置顶和 mask 覆盖：

```csharp
var options = UIOpenOptions.FromUserData(param, cancellationToken);
options.Timeout = 5f;
options.BringToFront = true;
options.CloseOnMaskClickOverride = true;
options.MaskModeOverride = UIMaskMode.Dim;
options.MaskColorOverride = new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0.7f);

UIForm form = await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync("DialogForm", options);
```

这些覆盖只作用于本次打开的实例，不会修改共享配置。

### 关闭

```csharp
FRFM.UI.Close("InventoryForm");
await FRFM.UI.CloseAsync("InventoryForm");
FRFM.UI.Close(form.SerialId);
await FRFM.UI.CloseAsync(form.SerialId);
```

`resident=true` 或 `closeMode=Cache` 的窗口关闭时会隐藏并保留实例；其它窗口会释放实例。

## 多实例窗口

当 `allowMultiInstance=true` 时，同一个 `formId` 可以打开多个实例。

```csharp
UIForm first = await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync("RewardPopup", rewardA);
UIForm second = await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync("RewardPopup", rewardB);

UIForm top = FRFM.UI.GetTop("RewardPopup");
FRFM.UI.CloseTop("RewardPopup");
FRFM.UI.CloseAll("RewardPopup");

if (FRFM.UI.TryGetBySerialId(second.SerialId, out UIForm found))
    found.Close();
```

`GetTop` 按排序层级返回最上方实例，比 `Get` 更适合多实例窗口。

## 预加载

`UIPreloadMode` 有三种语义：

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.PreloadAsync("InventoryForm", UIPreloadMode.AssetOnly);
await FRFM.UI.PreloadAsync("InventoryForm", UIPreloadMode.InstanceWarmup);
await FRFM.UI.PreloadAsync("InventoryForm", UIPreloadMode.AssetAndInstance);
```

- `AssetOnly`：只预加载 prefab 资源，不创建 UI 实例。
- `InstanceWarmup`：创建实例并进入 `Preloaded` 状态。
- `AssetAndInstance`：先预加载资源，再预热实例。

查询和释放：

```csharp
bool ready = FRFM.UI.IsPreloaded("InventoryForm");
FRFM.UI.ReleasePreload("InventoryForm");
FRFM.UI.ReleaseAllPreloads();
```

如果窗口实现 `IUIPreloadHandler`，实例预热时会调用：

```csharp
public sealed class InventoryForm : UIForm, IUIPreloadHandler
{
    public async UniTask OnPreloadAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await LoadStaticIconsAsync(cancellationToken);
    }
}
```

## 生命周期状态

`UIFormState`：

- `Loading`：实例已创建，初始化尚未完成。
- `Initialized`：完成绑定和 OnInit。
- `Preloaded`：实例预热完成，尚未打开。
- `Opened`：可见并参与 Update。
- `Hidden`：隐藏但保留实例。
- `Closing`：正在关闭动画。
- `Closed`：已执行 OnClose。
- `Disposed`：已释放。

常用重写点：

```csharp
protected override void OnInit(object userData) { }
protected override void OnOpen(object userData) { }
protected override void OnShow(object userData) { }
protected override void OnHide() { }
protected override void OnClose(object userData) { }
protected override void OnDispose() { }
protected override void OnUpdate(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime) { }
```

`disableGameObjectWhenHidden=true` 时，`InternalHide` 会在 `OnHide` 后 `SetActive(false)`，再次 `Show` 会恢复激活。

## 遮挡、暂停和隐藏

`UIBlockingMode` 控制一个窗口是否遮挡底层 UI：

```csharp
public enum UIBlockingMode
{
    None,
    FullScreenOnly,
    Always
}
```

- `None`：不遮挡底层。
- `FullScreenOnly`：仅 `fullScreen=true` 时遮挡底层。
- `Always`：无论是否全屏都遮挡底层，适合强模态弹窗。

被遮挡窗口的可见策略由 `coverVisualMode` 决定：

- `KeepVisible`：保持显示。
- `HideByCanvasGroup`：透明并关闭射线。
- `SetInactive`：禁用 GameObject。

如果 `pauseCovered=true`，被遮挡窗口会触发 `OnPause`，恢复时触发 `OnResume`。

## Mask

配置级 mask：

```csharp
new UIFormConfig
{
    useMask = true,
    closeOnMaskClick = true,
    maskMode = UIMaskMode.Dim,
    maskColor = new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0.6f)
};
```

实例级覆盖：

```csharp
var options = UIOpenOptions.FromUserData(data);
options.UseMaskOverride = true;
options.CloseOnMaskClickOverride = false;
options.MaskModeOverride = UIMaskMode.CustomColor;
options.MaskColorOverride = new Color(0f, 0f, 0f, 0.85f);
await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync("PopupForm", options);
```

Mask 节点挂在对应 UIGroup root 下，排序在目标窗口下方一层，诊断中可看到每层 mask 的目标窗口和 sorting order。

`UIMaskMode.Blur` 会在窗口显示前捕获并冻结完整背景，使用 1/2 分辨率执行双向 GPU 模糊；`maskColor` 是模糊画面上的叠加颜色。屏幕尺寸变化时会重新捕获。

## 导航

`UINavigator` 适合 Normal 层页面栈：

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.Navigation.PushAsync<HomeForm>();
await FRFM.UI.Navigation.PushAsync<ShopForm>(shopParam, UINavClosePolicy.HidePrevious);
FRFM.UI.Navigation.Back();
FRFM.UI.Navigation.BackToRoot();
```

`UINavClosePolicy`：

- `HidePrevious`：新页面打开前隐藏前一页；若打开失败会恢复前一页。
- `ClosePrevious`：新页面打开成功后关闭前一页，避免失败时丢页面。
- `KeepPrevious`：保留前一页。

结果型导航：

```csharp
UINavigationResult<ShopForm> result = await FRFM.UI.Navigation.TryPushAsync<ShopForm>(shopParam);
if (!result.Succeeded)
{
    FRLog.Warning($"导航失败: {result.FailureReason}");
    return;
}
```

## Toast 服务

```csharp
FRFM.UI.Toast.Show("保存成功");
FRFM.UI.Toast.Show(new UIToastRequest
{
    Message = "获得金币 x100",
    Duration = 1.5f,
    Position = UIToastPosition.Top,
    Priority = 10,
    MergeSameMessage = true
});
```

队列规则：

- `Priority` 高的先显示。
- `MergeSameMessage=true` 时，相同 `Message + Position` 的排队请求会合并。
- `Position` 支持 Top、Center、Bottom。

## Dialog 服务

```csharp
UIDialogResult result = await FRFM.UI.Dialog.ShowAsync(new UIDialogParams
{
    Title = "删除道具",
    Content = "确定删除该道具？",
    ConfirmText = "删除",
    CancelText = "取消",
    ShowCancel = true,
    CloseOnMaskClick = false,
    Timeout = 10f
});

if (result == UIDialogResult.Confirm)
    DeleteItem();
```

队列弹窗：

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.Dialog.EnqueueAsync(new UIDialogParams { Title = "提示1", Content = "第一条" });
await FRFM.UI.Dialog.EnqueueAsync(new UIDialogParams { Title = "提示2", Content = "第二条" });
```

`CloseOnMaskClick` 会通过 `UIOpenOptions.CloseOnMaskClickOverride` 作用到当前 Dialog 实例。

## Loading 服务

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.Loading.ShowAsync(new UILoadingRequest
{
    Message = "正在下载资源...",
    ShowProgress = true,
    Progress = 0f,
    Timeout = 30f
});

FRFM.UI.Loading.SetProgress(0.5f);
FRFM.UI.Loading.SetMessage("解压资源...");
FRFM.UI.Loading.Hide();
```

作用域写法：

```csharp
using (FRFM.UI.Loading.ShowScope("请求服务器..."))
{
    await RequestServerAsync();
}
```

`ForceHide()` 会清空引用计数并关闭 Loading。

## 绑定代码生成

UI 绑定工具读取 `UIBindData.BindInfos` 生成 `*.Bind.cs`，生成前会按 `fieldName + path` 排序，减少层级调整或 Inspector 序列化顺序造成的无意义 diff。

生成文件包含：

- 字段声明。
- `BindInit` 绑定。
- `BindEvent` / `UnbindEvent`。
- 事件 wrapper 和 partial 回调。
- 绑定空值校验。

业务逻辑写在同名 partial 文件中，不要修改 `*.Bind.cs`。

## UI Config Editor

菜单：`FRFrame/UI/UI Config Editor`

能力：

- 创建和编辑 `UIConfigGroup`。
- 编辑 formId、logicType、assetPath、configGroup、packageName、layer、mask、animation、closeMode 等配置。
- 校验重复 formId、logicType 是否存在、prefab 是否存在、mask 语义、blocking 语义等问题。
- 搜索未配置 UI 类型并批量加入配置。

## 运行时诊断

代码获取快照：

```csharp
UIManagerSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.UI.CreateSnapshot();
foreach (UIFormSnapshot form in snapshot.Forms)
{
    FRLog.Info($"{form.FormId}#{form.SerialId} {form.State} {form.Layer} {form.PackageName}");
}
```

Editor 窗口：`FRFrame/Diagnostics/UI Diagnostics`

可查看：

- Opened/Hidden/Preloaded/Loading 数量。
- Toast/Dialog/Loading 服务状态。
- Group form 数量和排序基准。
- 每个 UIForm 的 serialId、state、package、mask、sortingOrder。
- 每层 Mask 的 active、目标窗口和排序。
- 预加载记录和 loading operation。

## Runtime Extensions

运行时扩展位于 `Runtime/Extensions`。在 `ShopExampleForm` 打开“扩展示例”，进入 **UI Runtime 业务实验室** 可切换七个可操作场景；它们是业务验收入口，不只是组件陈列：

| 场景 | 可操作内容 | 主要验收点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| TacticalMap | 切换 Rect/Triangles 命中、Stretch/Fit/Fill、圆/扇/环/矩形几何并点击地图 | `UIMeshImage` 的运行时 Geometry、真实三角形命中与 bounds-to-rect 适配 |
| Inventory | 获得/删除、排序、移动、过滤、`ScrollToKey` | 固定列表多模板池、稳定 Key、增量通知、首可见 Key 锚点和选择状态 |
| GuildChat | 单条/批量追加、头插历史、展开可见项、回到底部、自动跟随 | 动态列表多模板、批量尺寸更新、Fenwick 索引、聊天头插与末端跟随 |
| Banner | Previous/Next/MoveTo、暂停、改间隔、切换 1/2/5 条、拖拽和点击 | `UIInfiniteCarousel` 有限槽位轮换、真正视觉无缝、自动播放和拖拽 settle |
| SnapPage | 前后翻页、快速重入、对齐、Clamp/Wrap、增删页面、改变页宽 | 普通分页按真实页面布局定位，以及 selected/settled 时序 |
| FontRefresh | 请求字体 A、同帧 A+B、RefreshAll、动态创建 Text 后重建目标 | UGUI 字体通知合并、目标缓存、统计和显式 `RebuildTargets()`；TMP 为对照组 |
| CommonInteraction | 动态 Toggle、长按购买、跑马灯、RawImage 模式、双指缩放 | 常见交互的取消、重入、布局与生命周期组合 |

FRFrame Core 不提供统一 Outline 扩展。TMP 文本优先使用 TMP SDF Material Outline，静态图标优先使用美术预制描边 Sprite，大图或特殊效果由业务模块提供目标平台验证过的 Shader；Core 不统一 Shader 属性、描边宽度或材质实例生命周期。

### Mesh Image

`UIMeshImage` 是 `Texture + Mesh/Geometry` 的 `MaskableGraphic`，不是 `Image` 的 Sprite/Type/Fill 替代品。

```csharp
meshImage.SetTexture(texture);
meshImage.SetMesh(mesh);
// 或运行时数据
meshImage.SetGeometry(vertices, uvs, triangles);
meshImage.FitMode = UIMeshFitMode.Fit;
meshImage.RaycastMode = UIMeshRaycastMode.Triangles;
```

- `UIMeshFitMode.None` 保留调用方局部坐标；`Stretch` 将 bounds 分轴铺满 rect；`Fit` 等比完整放入并允许留边；`Fill` 等比铺满并允许超出，通常配合 Mask。
- `UIMeshRaycastMode.None` 不命中；`Rect` 使用标准 Graphic 矩形命中；`Triangles` 先经过 `Graphic` 的 `raycastTarget`、CanvasGroup/Mask 等过滤，再按与渲染相同的映射测试有效三角形。反向 winding 可命中，退化或越界三角形会忽略。
- Mesh、Geometry、FitMode 或 Rect 尺寸变化会使映射缓存失效；Texture 变化只标记材质。同一 Mesh 实例被原地修改后调用 `RefreshMesh()`。`ClearMesh()` 清空自定义几何，此时渲染回退到默认 Quad。
- 它不提供 Sprite、`SetNativeSize`、pixelsPerUnit 或 Image fill；需要这些语义时继续使用 `Image`。

### 普通分页与真正无缝轮播

`UISnapScrollPage` 是标准 `ScrollRect` 的轻量分页器。`RefreshPages(preserveSelection)` 会在布局重建后读取 Content 的直接激活子节点，按每页实际 bounds 计算 Start/Center/End 目标，因此支持 LayoutGroup spacing、padding 和变宽页面。运行时增删页面或改变尺寸后由业务显式调用 `RefreshPages()`，组件不会每帧扫描层级。

```csharp
snap.indexMode = UIPageIndexMode.Clamp;
snap.alignment = UIPageAlignment.Center;
snap.RefreshPages();
snap.MoveToPage(index, animated: true);
```

- `SelectedPage` 在目标确定并触发 `onPageChanged` 时更新；`SettledPage` 仅在立即定位或 Tween 正常完成并触发 `onPageSettled` 时更新。
- `StopMovement()`、新移动、开始拖拽、Disable 或 Destroy 会取消旧 Tween，旧目标不会迟到触发 settled。
- `UIPageIndexMode.Clamp` 截断索引；`Wrap` 只把越界索引取模到另一端。Wrap 不复制页面、不轮换槽位，**不是视觉无缝循环**。旧 `enableLoop` 仅为 obsolete 兼容入口，新代码使用 `indexMode`。

`UIInfiniteCarousel` 用于真正无缝的横向 Banner。它创建奇数个有限槽位，拖动或移动跨过一个 viewport 宽度时轮换首尾槽位并重新绑定数据，Content 不会走到数据边界。

```csharp
carousel.Configure(viewport, content, itemPrefab, newSlotCount: 5);
carousel.SetData(data, context => BindBanner(context));
carousel.SetAutoPlay(true, 3f);
carousel.Next();
carousel.MoveToIndex(index);
```

- `UIInfiniteCarouselItemContext` 提供 `Slot`、`RectTransform`、`Data`、`DataIndex`、`SlotIndex`、`IsCenter`；绑定回调应完整覆盖复用槽位的文本、颜色、缩放等视觉状态。
- `onIndexChanged` 在跨槽位并更新中心数据时触发；`onSettled` 在立即移动或动画正常到位后触发。拖拽期间可连续轮换槽位，松手按 `dragThreshold` 前进/后退或回弹。
- `SetAutoPlay` 使用 unscaled time；拖拽和 settle 期间不推进，`PauseAutoPlay`/`ResumeAutoPlay` 显式控制。Disable 会取消 Tween 与拖拽，但不会改写自动播放配置；页面隐藏时应暂停，显示时恢复。
- 当前仅支持横向、每槽一个 viewport 宽度；不提供纵向、变宽槽位或外部 ScrollRect 惯性。`SetData` 会复制数据引用列表，数据变化后应再次调用它。

### 固定尺寸虚拟列表

`UIVirtualList` 支持纵向、横向及两种固定网格，并支持稳定 Key、多模板独立池、增量通知和锚点恢复。动态业务应实现：

```csharp
public interface IUIVirtualListDataSource
{
    int Count { get; }
    long GetKey(int index);
    object GetData(int index);
    string GetTemplateId(int index);
}
```

用 `ConfigureTemplates(IEnumerable<UIVirtualListTemplate>)` 声明 `templateId/prefab/itemLogicType/maxCacheCount`；每个模板独立缓存，`itemLogicType` 必须派生 `UIItem`。Key 必须在当前数据源中唯一且跨排序、插入和删除保持稳定；重复 Key 会记录错误并只保留首次索引。`SetDataList<T>` 生成 index Key，只适合全量、静态身份数据。

外部数据源采用“**先改数据，再通知列表**”的约定：

```csharp
source.Items.Insert(index, data);
list.InsertRange(index, 1);
source.Items.RemoveAt(index);
list.RemoveRange(index, 1);
// ReplaceRange / Move 同理：先完成 source 修改
```

这些通知重建 Key 映射、内容尺寸和可见项，而不是替业务修改数据。`AnchorMode` 可选 `None`、`PreserveScrollOffset`、`PreserveFirstVisibleKey`、`FollowEndIfAtEnd`。背包排序/头部插入推荐稳定 Key + `PreserveFirstVisibleKey`；聊天末端追加可短暂使用 `FollowEndIfAtEnd`。`ScrollToKey`、`TryGetVisibleItem` 和 `UIVirtualListAlignment` 用于按业务身份定位。

### 动态尺寸虚拟列表

`UIDynamicVirtualList` 是纵向单列动态尺寸列表，共享稳定 Key、多模板池和增量通知语义。通过 `SetSizeProvider((index, data) => size)` 提供估算/已知高度；可选 `IUIDynamicItemMeasurer` 只测量可见 Item。

单项更新使用 `NotifyItemSizeChanged`；多项变化必须批处理，避免每项都刷新布局：

```csharp
list.BeginSizeUpdate();
for (int i = start; i <= end; i++)
    list.NotifyItemSizeChanged(i, newSizes[i]);
list.EndSizeUpdate();
```

内部 Fenwick Tree 使单项尺寸更新、前缀和及按 offset 查索引为对数复杂度；插入/删除通知会批量重建尺寸索引。`UIDynamicSizeAnchorMode.PreserveFirstVisibleKey` 适合展开消息或字体变化，`PreserveEnd` 仅在更新前位于末端时保持末端。聊天加载历史应先头插外部数据，再用 `PreserveFirstVisibleKey + InsertRange` 保持阅读位置；追加前用 `IsAtEnd()` 判断是否跟随，并可调用 `ScrollToBottom()`。

当前动态列表只做纵向单列，不是瀑布流。字体、本地化或 viewport 宽度令大量高度失效时调用 `InvalidateAllSizes()`；不要每帧重建尺寸缓存。

### UIItem 生命周期与资源边界

两种列表的顺序一致：

1. 创建：实例化模板，附加/取得对应 `UIItem`，执行 `InternalInitialize`，再触发 `onItemCreated`。
2. 可见：激活 GameObject，写入 `Index/Key/TemplateId/Data/TypedData`，依次调用 `OnSetData`、`OnRefreshItem`、`OnItemVisible`，最后触发列表 `onItemVisible`。
3. 已可见刷新：`RefreshItem` 更新 Index/Data 并调用 set/refresh，不重复调用 visible。
4. 回收：先触发列表 `onItemRecycled`，再调用 Item 的 `OnItemRecycled`；此时旧 Index/Key/Data 仍可读取。随后清除选择、数据、Key、TemplateId，禁用并进入对应模板池，超出缓存上限则 dispose 并销毁。
5. `Clear()` 会停止 Tween、清数据、回收可见项并销毁全部缓存；Disable 会解绑 ScrollRect、停止 Tween 并回收可见项，Enable 后重绑刷新。

异步图片和资源生命周期由 `UIItem` 管理，不由列表代管。Item 应在 visible/set data 时启动请求，在 recycled/dispose 时取消请求并释放句柄；迟到结果必须核对当前 `Key` 或取消令牌，防止复用串图。

### 字体刷新与透明热区

`UIFontTextureRefresh` 只服务动态字体的 UGUI `Text`，不处理 TMP。Font 事件先进入 pending `HashSet`，在 `LateUpdate` 合并同帧重复/多字体通知，再扫描缓存目标并只刷新匹配字体。`RequestRefresh(Font)` 走合并路径；`Refresh(Font)` 与 `RefreshAll()` 是同步强制入口；`LastScannedCount`、`LastRefreshedCount` 用于观察结果。

目标 Text 在 Enable 时缓存。运行时新增/删除 Text、改变 `targetRoot` 或 `includeInactive` 后必须显式调用 `RebuildTargets()`；组件刻意不监听任意动态层级并每帧重扫。TMP 使用自身 FontAsset/atlas 更新机制。

`UINoDrawingGraphic` 的 Mesh 始终为空，用作透明热区或只参与布局/事件的 Graphic。它不在 Awake 强制射线设置，完整尊重 `Graphic.raycastTarget`：设为 `false` 即不参与 GraphicRaycaster。它不宣称绝对零重建或比所有透明 Image 更高性能。

### 其它交互与显示扩展

- `UIScrollText` 支持 `HorizontalLoop`、`VerticalLoop`、`PingPong`、`Once`。`Play()`、`Stop(resetPosition)`、`SetText(text, play)` 均会正确取消旧播放；未溢出时不播放。
- `UILongPressTrigger` 区分 release/click/cancel；移出、禁用、`Cancel()` 或超过移动容差走取消路径，不再触发 release/click。
- `UIPinchZoom` 仅在两触点都命中 viewport 时开始；结束或 `CancelPinch()` 恢复父 ScrollRect 原状态，`ResetZoom(animated)` 才复位。不支持旋转或三指。
- `UIRawImageFitter` 推荐 `Container + RawImage`：Contain 完整显示并留边，Cover 铺满并裁切，Fill 拉伸。
- `UIToggleGroupBinder` 在运行时增删 Toggle 后调用 `RefreshToggles()`。
- `UIRichText` 的解析缓存由 `cacheParsedText/maxCachedEntries` 控制；配置原地改变后 `InvalidateCache(refresh)`，替换配置用 `SetConfig(config, refresh)`。标签必须严格嵌套，不支持交叉闭合。

### 初始化与刷新原则

- 在组件启用前完成必需引用和配置。列表通常按 `Configure`、`Initialize`、`ConfigureTemplates`、size provider、`SetDataSource` 的顺序设置；布局尚未稳定时等待 Canvas/layout rebuild 后再刷新。
- 不要每帧调用 `ForceRefresh`、`RefreshPages`、`RefreshToggles`、`RebuildTargets`、`InvalidateCache` 或重建尺寸缓存；批量改变后统一通知。
- 按可见量设置 `extraCount`、`Prewarm` 和每模板 cache 上限。当前实现没有提供设备性能结论，具体预算应由业务在目标场景和目标设备验证。

## 推荐实践

### 普通页面

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.Navigation.PushAsync<LobbyForm>(null, UINavClosePolicy.HidePrevious);
```

配置建议：

- `layer = Normal`
- `fullScreen = true`
- `blockingMode = FullScreenOnly`
- `closeMode = Cache`
- `coverVisualMode = HideByCanvasGroup`

### 弹窗

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync<RewardPopup>(rewardData);
```

配置建议：

- `layer = Popup`
- `fullScreen = false`
- `blockingMode = Always`
- `useMask = true`
- `maskMode = Dim`
- `closeOnMaskClick = true`
- `closeMode = Destroy`

### 常驻 HUD

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync<BattleHudForm>();
```

配置建议：

- `layer = Normal`
- `resident = true`
- `closeMode = Cache`
- `blockingMode = None`
- `coverVisualMode = KeepVisible`

### 多 package UI

```csharp
await FRFM.UI.LoadConfigGroupAssetAsync(
    "Assets/Game/Battle/Config/UIConfigGroup_Battle.asset",
    "BattlePackage");

await FRFM.UI.OpenAsync("BattleHudForm");
```

`UIConfigGroup_Battle.defaultPackageName = "BattlePackage"` 后，组内 form 可不再逐个填写 `packageName`。
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame
{
    public class FRFrameRoot : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public static readonly string RootName = "FRFrameObject";
        private static FRFrameRoot _instance;
        private bool _frameworkShutdownStarted;
        private bool _frameworkStarted;

        public static bool IsCreated => _instance != null;
        public static bool IsShuttingDown => _instance != null && _instance._frameworkShutdownStarted;
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 提供一个公共接口，获取不到就创建一个， TODO:使用Mono单例替代
        /// </summary>
        public static FRFrameRoot Get()
        {
            if (_instance == null)
            {
                _instance = FindAnyObjectByType<FRFrameRoot>();
            }
            
            if (_instance == null)
            {
                GameObject prefabObj = Resources.Load<GameObject>("Prefabs/" + RootName);
                bool loadedFromPrefab = false;
                
                if (prefabObj != null)
                {
                    GameObject instanceObj = Instantiate(prefabObj);
                    _instance = instanceObj.GetComponent<FRFrameRoot>();

                    if (_instance != null)
                    {
                        loadedFromPrefab = true;
                        Debug.Log("FRFrameRoot Resources Load And Instantiate.");
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        Debug.Log("FRFrameRoot Resources Load Failed, may script lose.");
                        Object.Destroy(instanceObj);
                    }
                }
                
                if (!loadedFromPrefab)
                {
                    GameObject go = new GameObject(RootName);
                    _instance = go.AddComponent<FRFrameRoot>();
                    Debug.Log("FrameRoot Create GameObject.");
                }
                
                _instance.name = RootName;
                
                // 注册所有的模块
                FRFM.RegisterAllManagers();
            }
            
            return _instance;
        }
        
        private void Awake()
        {
            if (_instance != null && _instance != this)
            {
                Destroy(gameObject);
                return;
            }

            _instance = this;
            GameObject.DontDestroyOnLoad(this);
        }

        private async void Start()
        {
            _frameworkStarted = true;
            // 启动框架的初始化
            await FRFM.InitializeAsync();

            Debug.Log("FRFrameRoot Start Finish.");
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            FRFM.Update(Time.deltaTime, Time.unscaledDeltaTime);
        }

        private void OnApplicationPause(bool pauseStatus)
        {
            if (pauseStatus)
            {
                FRLogger.Flush();
            }
        }

        private void OnApplicationFocus(bool hasFocus)
        {
            if (!hasFocus)
            {
                FRLogger.Flush();
            }
        }

        private void OnApplicationQuit()
        {
            ShutdownFramework();
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            if (_instance != this)
                return;

            ShutdownFramework();
            _instance = null;
        }

        private void ShutdownFramework()
        {
            if (_frameworkShutdownStarted)
                return;

            _frameworkShutdownStarted = true;
            if (Application.isPlaying || _frameworkStarted)
                FRFM.Shutdown();
        }


        public Transform GetOrCreateCompoent(string childName)
        {
            Transform child = transform.Find(childName);
            if (child == null)
            {
                Debug.Log("FRFrameRoot not find child " + childName);
                child = new GameObject(childName).transform;
                child.SetParent(transform, false);
            }

            return child;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Core/GamePackageVersion.cs
````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame
{
    [Serializable]
    public struct GamePackageVersion
    {
        public int major;
        public int full;
        public int patch;

        public GamePackageVersion(int major, int full, int patch)
        {
            this.major = Math.Max(0, major);
            this.full = Math.Max(0, full);
            this.patch = Math.Max(0, patch);
        }

        public static GamePackageVersion Default => new GamePackageVersion(1, 0, 0);

        public static GamePackageVersion Parse(string value)
        {
            if (!TryParse(value, out GamePackageVersion version))
            {
                throw new FormatException($"Invalid game package version: {value}");
            }

            return version;
        }

        public static bool TryParse(string value, out GamePackageVersion version)
        {
            version = Default;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
            {
                return false;
            }

            string[] parts = value.Split('.');
            if (parts.Length != 3)
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (!int.TryParse(parts[0], out int major) || !int.TryParse(parts[1], out int full) || !int.TryParse(parts[2], out int patch))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (major < 0 || full < 0 || patch < 0)
            {
                return false;
            }

            version = new GamePackageVersion(major, full, patch);
            return true;
        }

        public bool IsSameMajor(GamePackageVersion other)
        {
            return major == other.major;
        }

        public GamePackageVersion NextFull()
        {
            return new GamePackageVersion(major, full + 1, 0);
        }

        public GamePackageVersion NextPatch()
        {
            return new GamePackageVersion(major, full, patch + 1);
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return $"{major}.{full}.{patch}";
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using Cysharp.Threading.Tasks;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 所有框架模块的入口
    /// </summary>
    public static class FRFM
    {
        public static FRLogManager Log => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<FRLogManager>();
        public static EventManager Event => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<EventManager>();
        public static PoolManager Pool => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<PoolManager>();
        public static FsmManager Fsm => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<FsmManager>();
        public static ResourceManager Resource => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<ResourceManager>();
        public static AudioManager Audio => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<AudioManager>();
        public static SaveManager Save => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<SaveManager>();
        public static UIManager UI => ManagerCenter.Instance.GetModule<UIManager>();


        /// <summary>
        /// 注册所有模块
        /// </summary>
        public static void RegisterAllManagers()
        {
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new FRLogManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new EventManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new PoolManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new FsmManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new ResourceManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new AudioManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new SaveManager());
            ManagerCenter.Instance.Register(new UIManager());
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 异步初始化
        /// </summary>
        public static async UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            await ManagerCenter.Instance.InitializeAsync();
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 等待某个模块初始化完成
        /// </summary>
        public static async UniTask WaitReady<T>() where T : IManagerBase
        {
            await ManagerCenter.Instance.WaitReady<T>();
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 更新框架。
        /// 建议由一个 MonoBehaviour 驱动。
        /// </summary>
        public static void Update(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            ManagerCenter.Instance.UpdateAll(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 销毁框架。
        /// </summary>
        public static void Shutdown()
        {
            ManagerCenter.Instance.DestroyAll();
        }
    }

    internal class ManagerCenter : Singleton<ManagerCenter>
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// 存储所有注册的模块实例，Type -> IManagerBase
        /// </summary>
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, IManagerBase> _registeredManagers = new Dictionary<Type, IManagerBase>();
        private List<IManagerBase> _orderedManagers = new List<IManagerBase>();
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 存储每个模块的就绪信号源，当模块初始化完成后，触发此信号，唤醒所有等待该模块的代码
        /// </summary>
        private readonly Dictionary<Type, UniTaskCompletionSource> _managerReadySignals = new Dictionary<Type, UniTaskCompletionSource>();

        /// <summary>
        /// 是否初始化完成
        /// </summary>
        private bool _initialized = false;
        private bool _initializing;
        private int _generation;
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 注册模块
        /// </summary>
        public void Register<T>(T manager) where T : IManagerBase
        {
            Type type = typeof(T);
            if (_registeredManagers.ContainsKey(type))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"模块 {type.Name} 已被注册，忽略重复注册。");
                return;
            }

            _registeredManagers[type] = manager;
            // 为每个模块创建一个“未完成”的信号源
            _managerReadySignals[type] = new UniTaskCompletionSource();
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 启动框架：按优先级排序并依次初始化所有模块
        /// </summary>
        public async UniTask InitializeAsync()
        {
            if (_initialized) return;
            if (_initializing) throw new InvalidOperationException("Framework initialization is already running.");
            _initializing = true;
            int generation = ++_generation;
            Debug.Log("=== 框架开始初始化 ===");

            // 【核心逻辑】根据 Priority 对模块进行升序排序
            // 确保 ResourceManager (Priority 10) 在 UIManager (Priority 20) 之前运行
            List<IManagerBase> sortedManagers = _registeredManagers.Values.OrderBy(m => m.Priority).ToList();
            _orderedManagers = new List<IManagerBase>();
            try
            {
                foreach (IManagerBase manager in sortedManagers)
                {
                    if (generation != _generation) return;
                    var ready = _managerReadySignals[manager.GetType()];
                    _orderedManagers.Add(manager); // Shutdown cleans attempted modules, including partial initialization.
                    try
                    {
                        Debug.Log($"正在初始化: {manager.GetType().Name} (优先级: {manager.Priority})");
                        await manager.InitializeAsync();
                        if (generation != _generation) return;
                    
                        // 初始化成功后，触发信号，唤醒所有 await WaitReady<T> 的协程
                        ready.TrySetResult();
                        Debug.Log($"[OK] {manager.GetType().Name} 初始化完成");
                    }
                    catch (Exception e)
                    {
                        if (generation != _generation) return;
                        ready.TrySetException(e);
                        Debug.LogError($"[CRITICAL] 模块 {manager.GetType().Name} 初始化失败: {e}");
                        // Dependent modules receive this failure from WaitReady; independent modules may continue.
                    }
                }
    
                _initialized = true;
                Debug.Log("=== 框架初始化阶段结束；模块可用状态以 WaitReady 为准 ===");
            }
            finally { if (generation == _generation) _initializing = false; }
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 异步等待指定模块就绪
        /// 用法: await FRFM.WaitReady&lt;ResourceManager&gt;();
        /// 初始化失败传播原异常；Shutdown取消尚未就绪的等待，不把失败当成就绪。
        /// </summary>
        public UniTask WaitReady<T>() where T : IManagerBase
        {
            Type type = typeof(T);
            if (!_managerReadySignals.ContainsKey(type))
            {
                return UniTask.FromException(new InvalidOperationException($"未注册的模块: {type.Name}"));
            }

            // 如果模块已经初始化完成，Task.IsCompleted 为 true，await 会立即返回，无性能损耗
            // 如果未完成，代码会挂起，直到 InitializeAsync 触发 TrySetResult
            return _managerReadySignals[type].Task;
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 获取模块实例 (同步)
        /// 注意：请确保在调用前模块已初始化，或者配合 WaitReady 使用
        /// </summary>
        public T GetModule<T>() where T : IManagerBase
        {
            Type type = typeof(T);
            if (_registeredManagers.TryGetValue(type, out IManagerBase module))
            {
                return (T)module;
            }
            Debug.LogError($"模块 {type.Name} 未找到");
            return default;
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 更新全部管理器。
        /// </summary>
        public void UpdateAll(float deltaTime, float unscaledDeltaTime)
        {
            if (!_initialized) return;
            for (int i = 0; i < _orderedManagers.Count; i++)
            {
                var manager = _orderedManagers[i];
                if (_managerReadySignals.TryGetValue(manager.GetType(), out var ready) && ready.Task.Status == UniTaskStatus.Succeeded)
                    manager.Update(deltaTime, unscaledDeltaTime);
            }
        }
        
        /// <summary>
        /// 销毁全部管理器。
        /// 取消就绪等待并隔离旧初始化轮次；不能代替模块自身取消其异步资源加载。
        /// </summary>
        public void DestroyAll()
        {
            ++_generation;
            _initialized = _initializing = false;
            foreach (var ready in _managerReadySignals.Values) ready.TrySetCanceled();
            for (int i = _orderedManagers.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                try { _orderedManagers[i].Destroy(); }
                catch (Exception error) { Debug.LogError($"模块 {_orderedManagers[i].GetType().Name} 销毁失败: {error}"); }
            }
            _registeredManagers.Clear();
            _orderedManagers.Clear();
            _managerReadySignals.Clear();
        }
    }
    
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class AudioDiagnosticsWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private Vector2 _scroll;

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Diagnostics/Audio Diagnostics")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            GetWindow<AudioDiagnosticsWindow>("Audio Diagnostics");
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            if (!Application.isPlaying || FRFM.Audio == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Audio Diagnostics is available in Play Mode.", MessageType.Info);
                return;
            }

            AudioDiagnosticsSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.Audio.CreateSnapshot();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Summary", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Playing", snapshot.PlayingCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Loading", snapshot.LoadingCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Preloaded", snapshot.PreloadedClipCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Steal Count", snapshot.StealCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Play Failure Count", snapshot.PlayFailureCount.ToString());

            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if (GUILayout.Button("Stop All"))
                FRFM.Audio.StopAll();
            if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh"))
                Repaint();
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();

            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.Categories.Count; i++)
            {
                AudioCategorySnapshot category = snapshot.Categories[i];
                EditorGUILayout.Space(8f);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"{category.Type} ({category.Name})", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Volume", category.Volume.ToString("0.00"));
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Mute", category.Mute.ToString());
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Paused", category.Paused.ToString());
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Agents", $"{category.AgentCount}  Idle:{category.IdleCount} Loading:{category.LoadingCount} Playing:{category.PlayingCount}");

                EditorGUI.indentLevel++;
                for (int j = 0; j < category.Agents.Count; j++)
                {
                    AudioAgentSnapshot agent = category.Agents[j];
                    if (agent.State == AudioAgentState.Idle)
                        continue;
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"#{agent.Id} {agent.State}", $"{agent.PackageName} :: {agent.Location}  {agent.Elapsed:0.00}s");
                }
                EditorGUI.indentLevel--;
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public static class BootstrapConfigExporter
    {
        private const string HotFixDirectory = "Assets/StreamingAssets/HotFix";
        private const string LegacyGameCatalogSeedFile = "game_catalog_seed.json";

        public static string StreamingBootstrapRoot => Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, BootstrapFileNames.DirectoryName);

        public static void Export(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(StreamingBootstrapRoot);
            WriteYooAssetPackages(context);
            WriteUIBootstrap(context);
            DeleteLegacyGameCatalogSeed();
            WriteHotfixManifest();
            WriteBootstrapManifest(context);
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            context.Logger.Info($"[Bootstrap] 已导出启动配置：{StreamingBootstrapRoot}");
        }

        private static void WriteYooAssetPackages(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            YooAssetPackagesConfig config = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<YooAssetPackagesConfig>();
            config.packages.Clear();
            config.packages.Add(new PackageConfig
            {
                name = string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.BuildProfile.defaultYooAssetPackageName) ? "DefaultPackage" : context.BuildProfile.defaultYooAssetPackageName,
                playMode = YooAsset.EPlayMode.OfflinePlayMode,
                isDefaultPackage = true
            });

            List<GameBuildProfile> profiles = context.BuildProfile.selectedGameProfiles;
            if (profiles != null)
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < profiles.Count; i++)
                {
                    GameBuildProfile profile = profiles[i];
                    string packageName = profile == null ? string.Empty : GetPackageName(profile);
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName) || packageName == config.packages[0].name)
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    config.packages.Add(new PackageConfig
                    {
                        name = packageName,
                        playMode = YooAsset.EPlayMode.OfflinePlayMode,
                        isDefaultPackage = false
                    });
                }
            }

            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(StreamingBootstrapRoot, BootstrapFileNames.YooAssetPackagesFile), JsonUtility.ToJson(config, true));
        }

        private static void WriteUIBootstrap(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            UIBootstrapConfig config = new UIBootstrapConfig();
            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(StreamingBootstrapRoot, BootstrapFileNames.UIBootstrapFile), JsonUtility.ToJson(config, true));
        }

        private static void DeleteLegacyGameCatalogSeed()
        {
            string path = Path.Combine(StreamingBootstrapRoot, LegacyGameCatalogSeedFile);
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.Delete(path);
            }
        }

        private static void WriteHotfixManifest()
        {
            HotfixBootstrapManifest manifest = new HotfixBootstrapManifest
            {
                version = ReadTextIfExists(Path.Combine(HotFixDirectory, "version.txt")),
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                aotFiles = CreateRecords(Path.Combine(HotFixDirectory, "AOTMeta"), "AOTMeta"),
                hotUpdateFiles = CreateRecords(Path.Combine(HotFixDirectory, "HotDll"), "HotDll")
            };

            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(StreamingBootstrapRoot, BootstrapFileNames.HotfixManifestFile), JsonUtility.ToJson(manifest, true));
        }

        private static void WriteBootstrapManifest(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            BootstrapManifest manifest = new BootstrapManifest
            {
                version = context.BuildProfile.packageVersion,
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
            };

            File.WriteAllText(Path.Combine(StreamingBootstrapRoot, BootstrapFileNames.ManifestFile), JsonUtility.ToJson(manifest, true));
        }

        private static List<HotfixFileRecord> CreateRecords(string root, string relativeRoot)
        {
            List<HotfixFileRecord> records = new List<HotfixFileRecord>();
            if (!Directory.Exists(root))
            {
                return records;
            }

            string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories);
            Array.Sort(files, StringComparer.Ordinal);
            for (int i = 0; i < files.Length; i++)
            {
                string path = files[i];
                records.Add(new HotfixFileRecord
                {
                    path = Path.Combine(relativeRoot, ToRelativePath(root, path)).Replace('\\', '/'),
                    size = new FileInfo(path).Length,
                    hash = ComputeHash(path)
                });
            }

            return records;
        }

        private static string GetPackageName(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.yooAssetPackageName) ? profile.packageName : profile.yooAssetPackageName;
        }

        private static string ReadTextIfExists(string path)
        {
            return File.Exists(path) ? File.ReadAllText(path).Trim() : string.Empty;
        }

        private static string ComputeHash(string path)
        {
            using (FileStream stream = File.OpenRead(path))
            using (SHA256 sha = SHA256.Create())
            {
                return BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(stream)).Replace("-", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();
            }
        }

        private static string ToRelativePath(string root, string path)
        {
            Uri rootUri = new Uri(AppendDirectorySeparatorChar(Path.GetFullPath(root)));
            Uri fileUri = new Uri(Path.GetFullPath(path));
            return Uri.UnescapeDataString(rootUri.MakeRelativeUri(fileUri).ToString()).Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar);
        }

        private static string AppendDirectorySeparatorChar(string path)
        {
            return path.EndsWith(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar.ToString()) ? path : path + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using YooAsset;
using YooAsset.Editor;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class DefaultYooAssetPackageBuildStep : IFRFrameBuildStep
    {
        public string Name => "Build Default YooAsset Package";
        public bool Enabled { get; }

        public DefaultYooAssetPackageBuildStep(bool enabled = true)
        {
            Enabled = enabled;
        }

        public FRFrameBuildStepResult Execute(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = context.BuildProfile;
            if (profile == null)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed("Build profile is null.");
            }

            string packageVersion = string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.defaultYooAssetPackageVersion)
                ? profile.packageVersion
                : profile.defaultYooAssetPackageVersion;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageVersion))
            {
                packageVersion = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd-HHmmss");
            }

            string outputRoot = ResolveBuildOutputRoot(profile.defaultYooAssetBuildOutputRoot);
            string buildinRoot = ResolveBuildinFileRoot(profile.defaultYooAssetBuildinFileRoot);
            string versionOutputPath = Path.Combine(outputRoot, YooAssetConfigs.GetPlatformName(), profile.defaultYooAssetPackageName, packageVersion);
            if (Directory.Exists(versionOutputPath))
            {
                if (!profile.defaultYooAssetOverwriteOutput)
                {
                    return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed($"YooAsset package output already exists: {versionOutputPath}");
                }

                context.Logger.Warning($"[YooAsset] Delete existing default package version output: {versionOutputPath}");
                Directory.Delete(versionOutputPath, true);
            }

            IBuildPipeline pipeline;
            BuildParameters buildParameters;
            switch (profile.defaultYooAssetBuildPipeline)
            {
                case EBuildPipeline.LegacyBuildPipeline:
                    LegacyBuildParameters legacyParameters = new LegacyBuildParameters();
                    pipeline = new LegacyBuildPipeline();
                    buildParameters = legacyParameters;
                    legacyParameters.CompressOption = profile.defaultYooAssetCompressOption;
                    legacyParameters.StripUnityVersion = profile.defaultYooAssetStripUnityVersion;
                    legacyParameters.DisableWriteTypeTree = profile.defaultYooAssetDisableWriteTypeTree;
                    break;
                case EBuildPipeline.ScriptableBuildPipeline:
                    ScriptableBuildParameters scriptableParameters = new ScriptableBuildParameters();
                    pipeline = new FRFrameScriptableBuildPipeline();
                    buildParameters = scriptableParameters;
                    scriptableParameters.CompressOption = profile.defaultYooAssetCompressOption;
                    scriptableParameters.StripUnityVersion = profile.defaultYooAssetStripUnityVersion;
                    scriptableParameters.DisableWriteTypeTree = profile.defaultYooAssetDisableWriteTypeTree;
                    scriptableParameters.BuiltinShadersBundleName = profile.defaultYooAssetBuiltinShadersBundleName;
                    scriptableParameters.MonoScriptsBundleName = profile.defaultYooAssetMonoScriptsBundleName;
                    break;
                default:
                    return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed($"Unsupported YooAsset build pipeline: {profile.defaultYooAssetBuildPipeline}");
            }

            buildParameters.BuildOutputRoot = outputRoot;
            buildParameters.BundledFileRoot = buildinRoot;
            buildParameters.BuildPipeline = profile.defaultYooAssetBuildPipeline.ToString();
            buildParameters.BuildBundleType = (int)EBundleType.AssetBundle;
            buildParameters.BuildTarget = context.BuildTarget;
            buildParameters.PackageName = profile.defaultYooAssetPackageName;
            buildParameters.PackageVersion = packageVersion;
            buildParameters.PackageNote = profile.defaultYooAssetPackageNote;
            buildParameters.ClearBuildCacheFiles = profile.defaultYooAssetClearBuildCacheFiles;
            buildParameters.UseAssetDependencyDB = profile.defaultYooAssetUseAssetDependencyDB;
            buildParameters.EnableSharePackRule = profile.defaultYooAssetEnableSharePackRule;
            buildParameters.SingleReferencedPackAlone = profile.defaultYooAssetSingleReferencedPackAlone;
            buildParameters.VerifyBuildingResult = profile.defaultYooAssetVerifyBuildingResult;
            buildParameters.FileNameStyle = profile.defaultYooAssetFileNameStyle;
            buildParameters.BundledCopyOption = profile.defaultYooAssetBuildinFileCopyOption;
            buildParameters.BundledCopyParams = profile.defaultYooAssetBuildinFileCopyParams;
            buildParameters.BundleEncryptor = new EncryptionNone();
            buildParameters.ManifestEncryptor = new ManifestEncryptorNone();
            buildParameters.ManifestDecryptor = new ManifestDecryptorNone();

            context.Logger.Info($"[YooAsset] Build default package: {profile.defaultYooAssetPackageName}, version: {packageVersion}, target: {context.BuildTarget}");
            BuildResult result = pipeline.Run(buildParameters, true);
            if (!result.Success)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed($"YooAsset build failed: {profile.defaultYooAssetPackageName}, task: {result.FailedTask}, error: {result.ErrorInfo}\n{result.ErrorStack}");
            }

            context.Logger.Info($"[YooAsset] Default package build output: {result.OutputPackageDirectory}");
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Passed();
        }

        private static string ResolveBuildOutputRoot(string outputRoot)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(outputRoot))
            {
                return BundleBuilderHelper.GetDefaultBuildOutputRoot();
            }

            return Path.IsPathRooted(outputRoot)
                ? Path.GetFullPath(outputRoot).Replace('\\', '/')
                : Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", outputRoot)).Replace('\\', '/');
        }

        private static string ResolveBuildinFileRoot(string buildinFileRoot)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(buildinFileRoot))
            {
                return BundleBuilderHelper.GetStreamingAssetsRoot();
            }

            return Path.IsPathRooted(buildinFileRoot)
                ? Path.GetFullPath(buildinFileRoot).Replace('\\', '/')
                : Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", buildinFileRoot)).Replace('\\', '/');
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

## File: Editor/BuildTools/FRFrameBatchBuild.cs
````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Build;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Rendering;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public static class FRFrameBatchBuild
    {
        private const string DefaultBuildProfilePath = "Assets/Settings/FRFrameBuildProfile.asset";

        public static void BuildGameFullPackage()
        {
            if (!Application.isBatchMode)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("FRFrameBatchBuild.BuildGameFullPackage must run in Unity batch mode.");
            }

            int exitCode = 0;
            try
            {
                ExecuteGameFullPackage();
            }
            catch (Exception exception)
            {
                exitCode = 1;
                Debug.LogException(exception);
            }
            finally
            {
                AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            }

            EditorApplication.Exit(exitCode);
        }

        private static void ExecuteGameFullPackage()
        {
            string buildProfilePath = NormalizeAssetPath(GetArgumentValue("-frBuildProfile") ?? DefaultBuildProfilePath);
            FRFrameBuildProfile buildProfile = LoadAsset<FRFrameBuildProfile>(buildProfilePath, "FRFrame build profile");
            GameBuildProfile gameProfile = ResolveGameProfile(buildProfile);
            FRFrameBuildLogger logger = new FRFrameBuildLogger();
            string outputRoot = string.IsNullOrEmpty(buildProfile.outputRoot) ? "BuildOutput" : buildProfile.outputRoot;

            logger.Info($"[BatchBuild] Project: {Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, ".."))}");
            logger.Info($"[BatchBuild] Build profile: {buildProfilePath}");
            logger.Info($"[BatchBuild] Game profile: {AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(gameProfile)}");
            logger.Info($"[BatchBuild] BatchMode={Application.isBatchMode}, GraphicsDevice={SystemInfo.graphicsDeviceType}, ActiveTarget={EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget}");
            if (SystemInfo.graphicsDeviceType != GraphicsDeviceType.Null)
            {
                logger.Warning("[BatchBuild] Graphics device is active. Add -nographics to isolate texture GPU upload memory.");
            }

            FRFrameBuildContext context = new FRFrameBuildContext(
                buildProfile,
                gameProfile,
                buildProfile.buildTarget,
                outputRoot,
                logger);
            FRFrameBuildPipeline pipeline = new FRFrameBuildPipeline()
                .Add(new FRFramePrepareBuildSettingsStep())
                .Add(new GameFullPackageBuildStep());

            FRFrameBuildStepResult result = pipeline.Execute(context);
            if (!result.Success)
            {
                throw new BuildFailedException(result.Error);
            }

            logger.Info($"[BatchBuild] Game full package completed in {result.ElapsedSeconds:F2}s.");
        }

        private static GameBuildProfile ResolveGameProfile(FRFrameBuildProfile buildProfile)
        {
            string gameProfilePath = GetArgumentValue("-frGameProfile");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gameProfilePath))
            {
                return LoadAsset<GameBuildProfile>(NormalizeAssetPath(gameProfilePath), "game build profile");
            }

            GameBuildProfile[] profiles = buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles?
                .Where(profile => profile != null)
                .ToArray() ?? Array.Empty<GameBuildProfile>();
            string gameId = GetArgumentValue("-frGameId");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gameId))
            {
                GameBuildProfile matchedProfile = profiles.FirstOrDefault(profile =>
                    string.Equals(profile.gameId, gameId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
                if (matchedProfile == null)
                {
                    throw new BuildFailedException($"Game profile not found in selectedGameProfiles: {gameId}");
                }

                return matchedProfile;
            }

            if (profiles.Length != 1)
            {
                throw new BuildFailedException(
                    $"Build profile contains {profiles.Length} selected game profiles. " +
                    "Pass -frGameProfile <asset path> or -frGameId <game id>.");
            }

            return profiles[0];
        }

        private static T LoadAsset<T>(string assetPath, string label) where T : UnityEngine.Object
        {
            T asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<T>(assetPath);
            if (asset == null)
            {
                throw new BuildFailedException($"Unable to load {label}: {assetPath}");
            }

            return asset;
        }

        private static string NormalizeAssetPath(string path)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string normalizedPath = path.Trim().Replace('\\', '/');
            if (!Path.IsPathRooted(normalizedPath))
            {
                return normalizedPath;
            }

            string projectRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..")).Replace('\\', '/').TrimEnd('/');
            string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(normalizedPath).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (!fullPath.StartsWith(projectRoot + "/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                throw new BuildFailedException($"Asset path is outside the project: {path}");
            }

            return fullPath.Substring(projectRoot.Length + 1);
        }

        private static string GetArgumentValue(string argumentName)
        {
            string[] arguments = Environment.GetCommandLineArgs();
            for (int i = 0; i < arguments.Length; i++)
            {
                string argument = arguments[i];
                if (argument.StartsWith(argumentName + "=", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    return argument.Substring(argumentName.Length + 1).Trim('"');
                }

                if (string.Equals(argument, argumentName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && i + 1 < arguments.Length)
                {
                    return arguments[i + 1].Trim('"');
                }
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public enum FRFrameBuildLogLevel
    {
        Info,
        Warning,
        Error
    }

    public readonly struct FRFrameBuildLogEntry
    {
        public readonly DateTime Time;
        public readonly FRFrameBuildLogLevel Level;
        public readonly string Message;

        public FRFrameBuildLogEntry(FRFrameBuildLogLevel level, string message)
        {
            Time = DateTime.Now;
            Level = level;
            Message = message ?? string.Empty;
        }
    }

    public sealed class FRFrameBuildLogger
    {
        private readonly List<FRFrameBuildLogEntry> _entries = new List<FRFrameBuildLogEntry>();

        public IReadOnlyList<FRFrameBuildLogEntry> Entries => _entries;

        public void Info(string message)
        {
            Add(FRFrameBuildLogLevel.Info, message);
        }

        public void Warning(string message)
        {
            Add(FRFrameBuildLogLevel.Warning, message);
        }

        public void Error(string message)
        {
            Add(FRFrameBuildLogLevel.Error, message);
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            _entries.Clear();
        }

        public string ToText()
        {
            StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
            foreach (FRFrameBuildLogEntry entry in _entries)
            {
                builder.Append('[').Append(entry.Time.ToString("HH:mm:ss")).Append("] ");
                builder.Append('[').Append(entry.Level).Append("] ");
                builder.AppendLine(entry.Message);
            }

            return builder.ToString();
        }

        private void Add(FRFrameBuildLogLevel level, string message)
        {
            FRFrameBuildLogEntry entry = new FRFrameBuildLogEntry(level, message);
            _entries.Add(entry);

            switch (level)
            {
                case FRFrameBuildLogLevel.Warning:
                    Debug.LogWarning(message);
                    break;
                case FRFrameBuildLogLevel.Error:
                    Debug.LogError(message);
                    break;
                default:
                    Debug.Log(message);
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFrameBuildPipeline
    {
        private readonly List<IFRFrameBuildStep> _steps = new List<IFRFrameBuildStep>();

        public IReadOnlyList<IFRFrameBuildStep> Steps => _steps;

        public FRFrameBuildPipeline Add(IFRFrameBuildStep step)
        {
            if (step != null)
            {
                _steps.Add(step);
            }

            return this;
        }

        public FRFrameBuildStepResult Execute(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed("Build context is null.");
            }

            Stopwatch totalWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            foreach (IFRFrameBuildStep step in _steps)
            {
                if (step == null || !step.Enabled)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Stopwatch stepWatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
                context.Logger.Info($"[Build] Start step: {step.Name}");

                FRFrameBuildStepResult result;
                try
                {
                    result = step.Execute(context);
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    stepWatch.Stop();
                    result = FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed(e.ToString(), stepWatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
                }

                stepWatch.Stop();
                if (!result.Success)
                {
                    context.Logger.Error($"[Build] Step failed: {step.Name}\n{result.Error}");
                    return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed(result.Error, totalWatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
                }

                context.Logger.Info($"[Build] Step done: {step.Name}, {stepWatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds:F2}s");
            }

            totalWatch.Stop();
            return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Passed(totalWatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds);
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFrameBuildWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private enum FRFrameBuildPage
        {
            MainPackage,
            GamePackage,
            PublishPackage
        }

        private const string MenuPath = "FRFrame/构建/构建窗口";
        private const string DefaultProfileDirectory = "Assets/Settings/FRFrameBuild";

        private readonly FRFrameBuildLogger _logger = new FRFrameBuildLogger();
        private Vector2 _scroll;
        private FRFrameBuildProfile _buildProfile;
        private FRFrameBuildPage _activePage;
        private FRFrameGamePackageBuildWindow _gamePackagePanel;

        private bool _showOverview = true;
        private bool _showBuildSettings = true;
        private bool _showHybridCLR = true;
        private bool _showDefaultYooAsset = true;
        private bool _showBootstrap = true;
        private bool _showMainPackageBuild = true;
        private bool _showPlayerBuild = true;
        private bool _showBuildRecords = true;
        private bool _showPublishPackage = true;
        private bool _showPublishRecords = true;
        private bool _showLogs = true;

        [MenuItem(MenuPath)]
        public static void Open()
        {
            FRFrameBuildWindow window = GetWindow<FRFrameBuildWindow>("FRFrame 构建");
            window.minSize = new Vector2(980f, 700f);
            window.Show();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            AutoSelectFirstBuildProfile();
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            DrawHeader();
            DrawPageTabs();
            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            try
            {
                if (_activePage == FRFrameBuildPage.MainPackage)
                {
                    DrawOverviewGroup();
                    DrawBuildSettingsGroup();
                    DrawHybridCLRGroup();
                    DrawDefaultYooAssetGroup();
                    DrawBootstrapGroup();
                    DrawMainPackageBuildGroup();
                    DrawPlayerBuildGroup();
                    DrawBuildRecordsGroup();
                    DrawLogsGroup();
                }
                else if (_activePage == FRFrameBuildPage.GamePackage)
                {
                    GetGamePackagePanel().DrawEmbeddedGUI();
                }
                else
                {
                    DrawPublishPackageGroup();
                    DrawPublishRecordsGroup();
                    DrawLogsGroup();
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
            }
        }

        private void DrawHeader()
        {
            Rect rect = GUILayoutUtility.GetRect(0f, 58f, GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true));
            DrawColorBlock(rect, new Color(0.13f, 0.20f, 0.27f), new Color(0.20f, 0.36f, 0.42f));
            GUILayout.Space(-52f);
            using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope())
            {
                EditorGUILayout.Space(7f);
                GUIStyle titleStyle = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.boldLabel)
                {
                    fontSize = 18,
                    normal = { textColor = Color.white }
                };
                GUIStyle subTitleStyle = new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.miniLabel)
                {
                    normal = { textColor = new Color(0.82f, 0.92f, 0.95f) }
                };
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("FRFrame 构建中心", titleStyle);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("在同一个窗口内切换主包构建、游戏包构建与发布聚合包，各自保留独立流程、参数、输出记录和日志。", subTitleStyle);
            }
            EditorGUILayout.Space(10f);
        }

        private void DrawPageTabs()
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                DrawPageTab(FRFrameBuildPage.MainPackage, "主包构建", new Color(0.18f, 0.42f, 0.58f));
                DrawPageTab(FRFrameBuildPage.GamePackage, "游戏包构建", new Color(0.45f, 0.30f, 0.62f));
                DrawPageTab(FRFrameBuildPage.PublishPackage, "发布聚合包", new Color(0.62f, 0.42f, 0.18f));
            }

            EditorGUILayout.Space(8f);
        }

        private void DrawPageTab(FRFrameBuildPage page, string label, Color color)
        {
            bool active = _activePage == page;
            Color oldBackgroundColor = GUI.backgroundColor;
            GUI.backgroundColor = active ? color : new Color(color.r * 0.65f, color.g * 0.65f, color.b * 0.65f);
            if (GUILayout.Button(label, GUILayout.Height(active ? 34f : 30f)))
            {
                _activePage = page;
                _scroll = Vector2.zero;
                Repaint();
            }
            GUI.backgroundColor = oldBackgroundColor;
        }

        private void DrawOverviewGroup()
        {
            _showOverview = EditorGUILayout.BeginFoldoutHeaderGroup(_showOverview, "主包构建状态");
            if (_showOverview)
            {
                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("当前 Unity 平台", EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget.ToString());
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("构建配置", _buildProfile == null ? "未选择" : _buildProfile.name);
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("目标平台", _buildProfile == null ? "未选择" : _buildProfile.buildTarget.ToString());
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("构建模式", _buildProfile == null ? "未选择" : GetBuildModeLabel(_buildProfile.buildMode));
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("输出根目录", _buildProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_buildProfile.outputRoot) ? "BuildOutput" : _buildProfile.outputRoot);
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("DefaultPackage", _buildProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_buildProfile.defaultYooAssetPackageName) ? "未填写" : _buildProfile.defaultYooAssetPackageName);

        private void DrawPublishGameZipList()
        {
            _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths ??= new List<string>();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"游戏包 zip：{_buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths.Count} 个", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            for (int i = 0; i < _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths.Count; i++)
            {
                using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                {
                    _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths[i] = EditorGUILayout.TextField($"游戏包 {i + 1}", _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths[i]);
                    if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                    {
                        string selected = EditorUtility.OpenFilePanel("选择游戏包 zip", Application.dataPath, "zip");
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selected))
                        {
                            _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths[i] = selected;
                        }
                    }

                    if (GUILayout.Button("移除", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                    {
                        _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths.RemoveAt(i);
                        EditorUtility.SetDirty(_buildProfile);
                        return;
                    }
                }
            }

            if (GUILayout.Button("添加游戏包 zip", GUILayout.Height(26f)))
            {
                _buildProfile.publishGamePackageZipPaths.Add(string.Empty);
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(_buildProfile);
            }
        }

        private void DrawPublishRecordsGroup()
        {
            _showPublishRecords = EditorGUILayout.BeginFoldoutHeaderGroup(_showPublishRecords, "发布聚合包输出记录");
            if (_showPublishRecords)
            {
                string root = GetPublishRecordsRoot();
                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("记录根目录", root);
                    if (GUILayout.Button("打开根目录", GUILayout.Width(120f)) && Directory.Exists(root))
                    {
                        EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(root);
                    }
                }

                if (!Directory.Exists(root))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("未找到发布聚合包输出目录。", MessageType.Info);
                }
                else
                {
                    string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(root, "*.zip", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                        .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTime)
                        .Take(60)
                        .ToArray();
                    foreach (string file in files)
                    {
                        using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                        {
                            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(ToProjectRelativePath(file), GUILayout.MinWidth(0f));
                            if (GUILayout.Button("打开", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                            {
                                EditorUtility.OpenWithDefaultApp(file);
                            }

                            if (GUILayout.Button("定位", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                            {
                                EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(file);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndFoldoutHeaderGroup();
        }

        private void DrawBuildRecordsGroup()
        {
            _showBuildRecords = EditorGUILayout.BeginFoldoutHeaderGroup(_showBuildRecords, "主包输出记录");
            if (_showBuildRecords)
            {
                string root = GetRecordsRoot();
                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("记录根目录", root);
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        if (GUILayout.Button("刷新", GUILayout.Width(120f)))
                        {
                            Repaint();
                        }

                        if (GUILayout.Button("打开根目录", GUILayout.Width(120f)) && Directory.Exists(root))
                        {
                            EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(root);
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!Directory.Exists(root))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("未找到主包输出目录。", MessageType.Info);
                    EditorGUILayout.EndFoldoutHeaderGroup();
                    return;
                }

                string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                    .Where(path => Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".apk", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        || Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".exe", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        || Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".zip", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        || Path.GetFileName(path).Equals("build_history.json", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTime)
                    .Take(60)
                    .ToArray();

                foreach (string file in files)
                {
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField(ToProjectRelativePath(file), GUILayout.MinWidth(0f));
                        if (GUILayout.Button("打开", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                        {
                            EditorUtility.OpenWithDefaultApp(file);
                        }

                        if (GUILayout.Button("定位", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                        {
                            EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(file);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndFoldoutHeaderGroup();
        }
````
