````csharp
        private void ScheduleBuildAction(System.Action action)
        {
            EditorApplication.delayCall += () =>
            {
                try
                {
                    action();
                }
                catch (System.Exception e)
                {
                    Debug.LogException(e);
                    _logger.Error(e.ToString());
                }

                Repaint();
            };
        }

        private void RunStep(IFRFrameBuildStep step)
        {
            FRFrameBuildContext context = CreateContext();
            FRFrameBuildPipeline pipeline = new FRFrameBuildPipeline().Add(step);
            FRFrameBuildStepResult result = pipeline.Execute(context);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                _logger.Info($"[主包构建] 流程完成，{result.ElapsedSeconds:F2}s");
            }
        }

        private void RunPlayerBuildPipeline()
        {
            FRFrameBuildContext context = CreateContext();
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = context.BuildProfile;
            FRFrameBuildPipeline pipeline = new FRFrameBuildPipeline();
            pipeline.Add(new FRFramePrepareBuildSettingsStep());
            pipeline.Add(new FRFrameLogBuildStep());
            AddDefaultYooAssetBuildStepIfNeeded(pipeline, profile);
            pipeline.Add(new FRFrameActionBuildStep("刷新构建输入资源", _ => AssetDatabase.Refresh()));
            pipeline.Add(new FRFramePlayerBuildStep());

            FRFrameBuildStepResult result = pipeline.Execute(context);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                _logger.Info($"[主包构建] Player 构建完成，{result.ElapsedSeconds:F2}s");
            }
        }

        private void RunFullPipeline()
        {
            FRFrameBuildContext context = CreateContext();
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = context.BuildProfile;
            FRFrameBuildPipeline pipeline = new FRFrameBuildPipeline();
            pipeline.Add(new FRFramePrepareBuildSettingsStep());
            pipeline.Add(new FRFrameLogBuildStep());

            if (profile.enableHybridCLR)
            {
                if (profile.buildHotUpdateDll)
                {
                    pipeline.Add(new FRFrameActionBuildStep("生成并复制主包 HybridCLR 到 StreamingAssets 和 GameRes", stepContext => HybridCLRBuildHelper.ExecuteGenerateAndCopyMainHotFixToStreamingAssetsAndGameRes(stepContext.BuildTarget, GetGameHotUpdateAssemblies(stepContext.BuildProfile))));
                }
                else
                {
                    pipeline.Add(new FRFrameActionBuildStep("复制主包 HybridCLR 到 StreamingAssets 和 GameRes", stepContext => HybridCLRBuildHelper.ExecuteCopyMainHotFixToStreamingAssetsAndGameRes(stepContext.BuildTarget, GetGameHotUpdateAssemblies(stepContext.BuildProfile))));
                }
            }

            if (profile.exportBootstrap)
            {
                pipeline.Add(new BootstrapConfigExportBuildStep());
            }

            pipeline.Add(new MainFullPackageBuildStep());

            if (profile.buildPlayer)
            {
                AddDefaultYooAssetBuildStepIfNeeded(pipeline, profile);
                pipeline.Add(new FRFrameActionBuildStep("刷新构建输入资源", _ => AssetDatabase.Refresh()));
                pipeline.Add(new FRFramePlayerBuildStep());
            }

            FRFrameBuildStepResult result = pipeline.Execute(context);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                _logger.Info($"[主包构建] 完整流水线完成，{result.ElapsedSeconds:F2}s");
            }
        }

        private static void AddDefaultYooAssetBuildStepIfNeeded(FRFrameBuildPipeline pipeline, FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (profile.buildDefaultYooAsset)
            {
                pipeline.Add(new DefaultYooAssetPackageBuildStep());
            }
        }

        private static IEnumerable<string> GetGameHotUpdateAssemblies(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (profile?.selectedGameProfiles == null)
            {
                yield break;
            }

            foreach (GameBuildProfile gameProfile in profile.selectedGameProfiles)
            {
                if (gameProfile == null || !gameProfile.includeHotUpdateAssembly)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string assemblyName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.hotUpdateAssemblyName) ? gameProfile.gameId : gameProfile.hotUpdateAssemblyName;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(assemblyName))
                {
                    yield return assemblyName;
                }
            }
        }

        private string DrawFolderField(string label, string value)
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                value = EditorGUILayout.TextField(label, value);
                if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                {
                    string selected = EditorUtility.OpenFolderPanel($"选择{label}", string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? Application.dataPath : value, string.Empty);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selected))
                    {
                        value = selected;
                    }
                }
            }

            return value;
        }

        private string DrawMainVersionFields(string label, string value)
        {
            GamePackageVersion version;
            if (!GamePackageVersion.TryParse(value, out version))
            {
                version = GamePackageVersion.Default;
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox($"{label}格式无效，已按 1.0.0 显示，请保存后继续构建。", MessageType.Warning);
            }

            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(label, version.ToString());
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("大版本", GUILayout.Width(48f));
                version.major = Mathf.Max(0, EditorGUILayout.IntField(version.major, GUILayout.MinWidth(48f)));
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("整包", GUILayout.Width(36f));
                version.full = Mathf.Max(0, EditorGUILayout.IntField(version.full, GUILayout.MinWidth(48f)));
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("补丁", GUILayout.Width(36f));
                version.patch = Mathf.Max(0, EditorGUILayout.IntField(version.patch, GUILayout.MinWidth(48f)));
            }

            return version.ToString();
        }

        private string DrawFileField(string label, string value, string extension)
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                value = EditorGUILayout.TextField(label, value);
                if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                {
                    string selected = EditorUtility.OpenFilePanel($"选择{label}", string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? Application.dataPath : Path.GetDirectoryName(value), extension);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selected))
                    {
                        value = selected;
                    }
                }
            }

            return value;
        }

        private string GetRecordsRoot()
        {
            string outputRoot = _buildProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_buildProfile.outputRoot) ? "BuildOutput" : _buildProfile.outputRoot;
            return Path.GetFullPath(outputRoot);
        }

        private string GetPublishRecordsRoot()
        {
            if (_buildProfile == null)
            {
                return Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine("BuildOutput", "PublishPackage"));
            }

            string outputRoot = string.IsNullOrEmpty(_buildProfile.publishOutputRoot) ? GetRecordsRoot() : _buildProfile.publishOutputRoot;
            return Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(outputRoot, "PublishPackage"));
        }

        private FRFrameGamePackageBuildWindow GetGamePackagePanel()
        {
            return _gamePackagePanel ??= new FRFrameGamePackageBuildWindow(Repaint);
        }

        private static void DrawColorBlock(Rect rect, Color leftColor, Color rightColor)
        {
            if (Event.current.type != EventType.Repaint)
            {
                return;
            }

            EditorGUI.DrawRect(rect, leftColor);
            Rect accent = new Rect(rect.x + rect.width * 0.68f, rect.y, rect.width * 0.32f, rect.height);
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(accent, rightColor);
        }

        private static string GetBuildModeLabel(FRFrameBuildMode buildMode)
        {
            switch (buildMode)
            {
                case FRFrameBuildMode.FollowEditorBuildSettings:
                    return $"跟随 Unity Build Settings ({(EditorUserBuildSettings.development ? "Development" : "Release")})";
                case FRFrameBuildMode.DevelopmentBuild:
                    return "强制 Development Build";
                case FRFrameBuildMode.ReleaseBuild:
                    return "强制 Release Build";
                case FRFrameBuildMode.OfflineFullApk:
                    return "离线完整包";
                case FRFrameBuildMode.MinimalApk:
                    return "最小母包";
                case FRFrameBuildMode.HotFixOnly:
                    return "仅热更";
                case FRFrameBuildMode.BootstrapOnly:
                    return "仅启动配置";
                default:
                    return buildMode.ToString();
            }
        }

        private static string ToProjectRelativePath(string path)
        {
            string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(path).Replace('\\', '/');
            string projectRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..")).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (fullPath.StartsWith(projectRoot))
            {
                return fullPath.Substring(projectRoot.Length).TrimStart('/');
            }

            return fullPath;
        }

        private FRFrameBuildContext CreateContext()
        {
            if (_buildProfile == null)
            {
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException("请先选择或新建主包构建配置资产。");
            }

            return new FRFrameBuildContext(_buildProfile, null, _buildProfile.buildTarget, string.IsNullOrEmpty(_buildProfile.outputRoot) ? "BuildOutput" : _buildProfile.outputRoot, _logger);
        }

        private void AutoSelectFirstBuildProfile()
        {
            if (_buildProfile != null)
            {
                return;
            }

            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:FRFrameBuildProfile");
            if (guids.Length == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guids[0]);
            _buildProfile = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<FRFrameBuildProfile>(path);
        }

        private void CreateBuildProfileAsset()
        {
            string path = EditorUtility.SaveFilePanelInProject("新建主包构建配置", "FRFrameBuildProfile", "asset", "选择主包构建配置资产保存位置", DefaultProfileDirectory);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                return;
            }

            EnsureAssetDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = CreateInstance<FRFrameBuildProfile>();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(profile, path);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            _buildProfile = profile;
            Selection.activeObject = profile;
        }

        private static void SaveAsset(Object asset)
        {
            if (asset == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
        }

        private static void EnsureAssetDirectory(string directory)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory) || AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(directory))
            {
                return;
            }

            string[] parts = directory.Split('/');
            string current = parts[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < parts.Length; i++)
            {
                string next = current + "/" + parts[i];
                if (!AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(next))
                {
                    AssetDatabase.CreateFolder(current, parts[i]);
                }

                current = next;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("当前版本", gameProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.packageVersion) ? "未填写" : gameProfile.packageVersion);
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("YooAsset 包", gameProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetSelectedYooAssetPackageName()) ? "未填写" : GetSelectedYooAssetPackageName());
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("整包用于新增游戏或完整重装，会自动递增第二段版本号并重置补丁号；补丁包会优先使用手动选择的旧 file_manifest.json，未选择时自动关联当前游戏已构建的最新版本清单。", MessageType.Info);

                    if (GUILayout.Button("构建当前游戏整包", GUILayout.Height(30f)))
                    {
                        ScheduleBuildAction(() => RunStep(new GameFullPackageBuildStep()));
                    }

                    EditorGUILayout.Space(6f);
                    string autoManifestPath = GetLatestBuiltFileManifestPath(gameProfile);
                    if (ShouldUseAutoManifestPath(autoManifestPath))
                    {
                        _oldFileManifestPath = autoManifestPath;
                    }

                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        _oldFileManifestPath = EditorGUILayout.TextField("旧文件清单", _oldFileManifestPath, GUILayout.MaxWidth(GetSafeContentWidth() - 90f));
                        if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                        {
                            string selected = EditorUtility.OpenFilePanel("选择旧 file_manifest.json", string.Empty, "json");
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selected))
                            {
                                _oldFileManifestPath = selected;
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField(string.IsNullOrEmpty(autoManifestPath) ? "自动清单：未找到已构建版本" : $"自动清单：{ToProjectRelativePath(autoManifestPath)}", EditorStyles.miniLabel, GUILayout.MaxWidth(GetSafeContentWidth() - 90f));
                        if (GUILayout.Button("使用最新", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                        {
                            _oldFileManifestPath = autoManifestPath;
                        }
                    }

                    if (GUILayout.Button("构建当前游戏补丁包", GUILayout.Height(30f)))
                    {
                        ScheduleBuildAction(() => RunStep(new GamePatchPackageBuildStep(ResolveOldFileManifestPath())));
                    }
                }
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndFoldoutHeaderGroup();
        }

        private void DrawBuildRecordsGroup()
        {
            _showBuildRecords = EditorGUILayout.BeginFoldoutHeaderGroup(_showBuildRecords, "游戏包输出记录");
            if (_showBuildRecords)
            {
                GameBuildProfile gameProfile = ActiveGameProfile;
                string root = GetGameOutputDirectory(gameProfile);
                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("记录根目录", root);
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        if (GUILayout.Button("刷新", GUILayout.Width(120f)))
                        {
                            RequestRepaint();
                        }

                        if (GUILayout.Button("打开根目录", GUILayout.Width(120f)) && Directory.Exists(root))
                        {
                            EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(root);
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (!Directory.Exists(root))
                {
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("未找到游戏包输出记录。", MessageType.Info);
                }
                else
                {
                    string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                        .Where(path => Path.GetFileName(path) == GamePackageBuildUtility.GameManifestFileName
                            || Path.GetFileName(path) == GamePackageBuildUtility.FileManifestFileName
                            || Path.GetFileName(path) == GamePackageBuildUtility.PatchManifestFileName
                            || Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".zip", System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                        .OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTime)
                        .Take(80)
                        .ToArray();

                    foreach (string file in files)
                    {
                        using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                        {
                            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(ToProjectRelativePath(file), GUILayout.Width(GetSafeContentWidth() - 150f));
                            if (GUILayout.Button("打开", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                            {
                                EditorUtility.OpenWithDefaultApp(file);
                            }

                            if (GUILayout.Button("定位", GUILayout.Width(70f)))
                            {
                                EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(file);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndFoldoutHeaderGroup();
        }

        {
            _showLogs = EditorGUILayout.BeginFoldoutHeaderGroup(_showLogs, "游戏包构建日志");

        private void ScheduleBuildAction(System.Action action)
        {
            EditorApplication.delayCall += () =>
            {
                try
                {
                    action();
                }
                catch (System.Exception e)
                {
                    Debug.LogException(e);
                    _logger.Error(e.ToString());
                }

                RequestRepaint();
            };
        }

        private void RequestRepaint()
        {
            _requestRepaint?.Invoke();
        }

        private void RunStep(IFRFrameBuildStep step)
        {
            FRFrameBuildContext context = CreateContext();
            FRFrameBuildPipeline pipeline = new FRFrameBuildPipeline()
                .Add(new FRFramePrepareBuildSettingsStep())
                .Add(step);
            FRFrameBuildStepResult result = pipeline.Execute(context);
            if (result.Success)
            {
                _logger.Info($"[游戏包构建] 流程完成，{result.ElapsedSeconds:F2}s");
            }
        }

        private string DrawAssetLocationField(string label, string value, Object asset)
        {
            string assetPath = asset == null ? string.Empty : AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath))
            {
                value = assetPath;
            }

            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                value = EditorGUILayout.TextField(label, value, GUILayout.MaxWidth(GetSafeContentWidth() - 90f));
                GUI.enabled = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath);
                if (GUILayout.Button("使用资产", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                {
                    value = assetPath;
                }
                GUI.enabled = true;
            }

            return value;
        }

        private string DrawFolderField(string label, string value)
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                value = EditorGUILayout.TextField(label, value, GUILayout.MaxWidth(GetSafeContentWidth() - 90f));
                if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(80f)))
                {
                    string selected = EditorUtility.OpenFolderPanel($"选择{label}", string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? Application.dataPath : value, string.Empty);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selected))
                    {
                        value = selected;
                    }
                }
            }

            return value;
        }

        private string DrawGameVersionFields(string label, string value)
        {
            GamePackageVersion version;
            if (!GamePackageVersion.TryParse(value, out version))
            {
                version = GamePackageVersion.Default;
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox($"{label}格式无效，已按 1.0.0 显示，请保存后继续构建。", MessageType.Warning);
            }

            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(label, version.ToString());
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("大版本", GUILayout.Width(48f));
                version.major = Mathf.Max(0, EditorGUILayout.IntField(version.major, GUILayout.MinWidth(48f)));
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("整包", GUILayout.Width(36f));
                version.full = Mathf.Max(0, EditorGUILayout.IntField(version.full, GUILayout.MinWidth(48f)));
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("补丁", GUILayout.Width(36f));
                version.patch = Mathf.Max(0, EditorGUILayout.IntField(version.patch, GUILayout.MinWidth(48f)));
            }

            return version.ToString();
        }

        private string GetRecordsRoot()
        {
            return Path.GetFullPath(GetOutputRoot());
        }

        private string GetGameOutputDirectory(GameBuildProfile gameProfile)
        {
            string outputRoot = gameProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.outputRoot) ? GetOutputRoot() : gameProfile.outputRoot;
            string gameDirectoryName = gameProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.gameId) ? GetSelectedYooAssetPackageName() : gameProfile.gameId;
            return Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(outputRoot, gameDirectoryName));
        }

        private string ResolveOldFileManifestPath()
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_oldFileManifestPath) && File.Exists(_oldFileManifestPath))
            {
                return _oldFileManifestPath;
            }

            string latestManifestPath = GetLatestBuiltFileManifestPath(ActiveGameProfile);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(latestManifestPath))
            {
                _oldFileManifestPath = latestManifestPath;
            }

            return _oldFileManifestPath;
        }

        private string GetLatestBuiltFileManifestPath(GameBuildProfile gameProfile)
        {
            if (gameProfile == null)
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string stageRoot = Path.Combine(GetGameOutputDirectory(gameProfile), "Stage");
            if (!Directory.Exists(stageRoot))
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            if (!GamePackageVersion.TryParse(gameProfile.packageVersion, out GamePackageVersion currentVersion))
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string currentManifestPath = Path.Combine(stageRoot, currentVersion.ToString(), GamePackageBuildUtility.FileManifestFileName);
            if (File.Exists(currentManifestPath))
            {
                return currentManifestPath;
            }

            return Directory.GetFiles(stageRoot, GamePackageBuildUtility.FileManifestFileName, SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path => IsValidOldManifest(path, currentVersion))
                .OrderByDescending(path => GetManifestVersion(path).full)
                .ThenByDescending(path => GetManifestVersion(path).patch)
                .ThenByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTime)
                .FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
        }

        private static bool IsValidOldManifest(string path, GamePackageVersion currentVersion)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                return false;
            }

            GamePackageVersion manifestVersion = GetManifestVersion(path);
            return manifestVersion.IsSameMajor(currentVersion);
        }

        private bool ShouldUseAutoManifestPath(string autoManifestPath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(autoManifestPath))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_oldFileManifestPath) || !File.Exists(_oldFileManifestPath))
            {
                return true;
            }

            string stageRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(GetGameOutputDirectory(ActiveGameProfile), "Stage"));
            string oldManifestPath = Path.GetFullPath(_oldFileManifestPath);
            return oldManifestPath.StartsWith(stageRoot, System.StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) && GetManifestVersion(oldManifestPath).ToString() != ActiveGameProfile.packageVersion;
        }

        private static GamePackageVersion GetManifestVersion(string path)
        {
            string versionDirectory = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)).Name;
            return GamePackageVersion.TryParse(versionDirectory, out GamePackageVersion version) ? version : GamePackageVersion.Default;
        }

        private float GetSafeContentWidth()
        {
            return Mathf.Max(260f, EditorGUIUtility.currentViewWidth - 48f);
        }

        private string GetOutputRoot()
        {
            return _buildProfile == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(_buildProfile.outputRoot) ? "BuildOutput" : _buildProfile.outputRoot;
        }

        private string GetSelectedYooAssetPackageName()
        {
            GameBuildProfile gameProfile = ActiveGameProfile;
            if (gameProfile == null)
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.yooAssetPackageName) ? gameProfile.packageName : gameProfile.yooAssetPackageName;
        }

        private static string ToProjectRelativePath(string path)
        {
            string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(path).Replace('\\', '/');
            string projectRoot = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..")).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (fullPath.StartsWith(projectRoot))
            {
                return fullPath.Substring(projectRoot.Length).TrimStart('/');
            }

            return fullPath;
        }

        private FRFrameBuildContext CreateContext()
        {
            if (_buildProfile == null)
            {
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException("请先选择或新建构建配置资产。");
            }

            return new FRFrameBuildContext(_buildProfile, ActiveGameProfile, _buildProfile.buildTarget, GetOutputRoot(), _logger);
        }

        private void AutoSelectFirstBuildProfile()
        {
            if (_buildProfile != null)
            {
                return;
            }

            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:FRFrameBuildProfile");
            if (guids.Length == 0)
            {
                return;
            }

            string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guids[0]);
            _buildProfile = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<FRFrameBuildProfile>(path);
            ClampActiveGameIndex();
        }

        private void CreateBuildProfileAsset()
        {
            string path = EditorUtility.SaveFilePanelInProject("新建构建配置", "FRFrameBuildProfile", "asset", "选择构建配置资产保存位置", DefaultProfileDirectory);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                return;
            }

            EnsureAssetDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<FRFrameBuildProfile>();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(profile, path);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            _buildProfile = profile;
            _activeGameIndex = -1;
            Selection.activeObject = profile;
        }

        private void CreateGameProfileAsset()
        {
            if (_buildProfile == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            string path = EditorUtility.SaveFilePanelInProject("新建游戏配置", "GameBuildProfile", "asset", "选择游戏配置资产保存位置", DefaultProfileDirectory);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                return;
            }

            EnsureAssetDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
            GameBuildProfile profile = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameBuildProfile>();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(profile, path);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AddGameProfile(profile);
            Selection.activeObject = profile;
        }

        private void AddGameProfile(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (_buildProfile == null || profile == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            EnsureGameProfileList();
            if (!_buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles.Contains(profile))
            {
                _buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles.Add(profile);
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(_buildProfile);
            }

            _activeGameIndex = _buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles.IndexOf(profile);
        }

        private void EnsureGameProfileList()
        {
            if (_buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles == null)
            {
                _buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles = new System.Collections.Generic.List<GameBuildProfile>();
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(_buildProfile);
            }

            ClampActiveGameIndex();
        }

        private void ClampActiveGameIndex()
        {
            if (_buildProfile == null || _buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles == null || _buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles.Count == 0)
            {
                _activeGameIndex = -1;
                return;
            }

            if (_activeGameIndex < 0 || _activeGameIndex >= _buildProfile.selectedGameProfiles.Count)
            {
                _activeGameIndex = 0;
            }
        }

        private static void SaveAsset(Object asset)
        {
            if (asset == null)
            {
                return;
            }

            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
        }

        private static void EnsureAssetDirectory(string directory)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(directory) || AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(directory))
            {
                return;
            }

            string[] parts = directory.Split('/');
            string current = parts[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < parts.Length; i++)
            {
                string next = current + "/" + parts[i];
                if (!AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(next))
                {
                    AssetDatabase.CreateFolder(current, parts[i]);
                }

                current = next;
            }
        }

        private static void DrawColorBlock(Rect rect, Color leftColor, Color rightColor)
        {
            if (Event.current.type != EventType.Repaint)
            {
                return;
            }

            EditorGUI.DrawRect(rect, leftColor);
            Rect accent = new Rect(rect.x + rect.width * 0.70f, rect.y, rect.width * 0.30f, rect.height);
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(accent, rightColor);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Build;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFrameLogBuildStep : IFRFrameBuildStep
    {
        public string Name => "Sync Log Define Symbols";
        public bool Enabled { get; }

        public FRFrameLogBuildStep(bool enabled = true)
        {
            Enabled = enabled;
        }

        public FRFrameBuildStepResult Execute(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = context.BuildProfile;
            if (profile == null)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed("Build profile is null.");
            }

            NamedBuildTarget namedBuildTarget = NamedBuildTarget.FromBuildTargetGroup(profile.buildTargetGroup);
            HashSet<string> defines = FRLogScriptingDefineSymbols.ReadDefines(namedBuildTarget);
            if (profile.logDefineMode == FRBuildLogDefineMode.Custom)
            {
                defines.Remove(FRLogDefineSymbols.File);
                if (ShouldEnableFileLog(profile))
                {
                    defines.Add(FRLogDefineSymbols.File);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                FRLogScriptingDefineSymbols.RemoveLogDefines(defines);
                foreach (string define in GetLogDefines(profile))
                {
                    defines.Add(define);
                }
            }

            string result = string.Join(";", defines.OrderBy(value => value));
            PlayerSettings.SetScriptingDefineSymbols(namedBuildTarget, result);
            context.Logger.Info($"[LogBuild] Define mode: {profile.logDefineMode}, defines: {result}");
            context.Logger.Info($"[LogBuild] Development level: {profile.developmentMinimumLogLevel}, release level: {profile.releaseMinimumLogLevel}, file dev/release: {profile.enableFileLogInDevelopment}/{profile.enableFileLogInRelease}");
            return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Passed();
        }

        private static IEnumerable<string> GetLogDefines(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            FRBuildLogDefineMode mode = profile.logDefineMode == FRBuildLogDefineMode.FollowBuildMode ? GetBuildModeDefineMode(profile) : profile.logDefineMode;
            switch (mode)
            {
                case FRBuildLogDefineMode.All:
                    yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.EnableLog;
                    break;
                case FRBuildLogDefineMode.InfoAndAbove:
                    yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.InfoAndAbove;
                    break;
                case FRBuildLogDefineMode.WarningAndAbove:
                    yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.WarningAndAbove;
                    break;
                case FRBuildLogDefineMode.ErrorAndAbove:
                    yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.ErrorAndAbove;
                    break;
                case FRBuildLogDefineMode.Custom:
                    foreach (string define in GetCustomLevelDefines(profile))
                    {
                        yield return define;
                    }
                    break;
            }

            if (ShouldEnableFileLog(profile))
            {
                yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.File;
            }
        }

        private static FRBuildLogDefineMode GetBuildModeDefineMode(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (profile.buildMode == FRFrameBuildMode.DevelopmentBuild)
            {
                return FRBuildLogDefineMode.InfoAndAbove;
            }

            if (profile.buildMode == FRFrameBuildMode.ReleaseBuild)
            {
                return FRBuildLogDefineMode.WarningAndAbove;
            }

            return EditorUserBuildSettings.development ? FRBuildLogDefineMode.InfoAndAbove : FRBuildLogDefineMode.WarningAndAbove;
        }

        private static IEnumerable<string> GetCustomLevelDefines(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            FRLogLevel minimumLevel = EditorUserBuildSettings.development ? profile.developmentMinimumLogLevel : profile.releaseMinimumLogLevel;
            if (minimumLevel <= FRLogLevel.Debug)
            {
                yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.DebugAndAbove;
            }
            else if (minimumLevel <= FRLogLevel.Info)
            {
                yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.InfoAndAbove;
            }
            else if (minimumLevel <= FRLogLevel.Warning)
            {
                yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.WarningAndAbove;
            }
            else if (minimumLevel <= FRLogLevel.Error)
            {
                yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.ErrorAndAbove;
            }
            else
            {
                yield return FRLogDefineSymbols.FatalAndAbove;
            }
        }

        private static bool ShouldEnableFileLog(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return EditorUserBuildSettings.development ? profile.enableFileLogInDevelopment : profile.enableFileLogInRelease;
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Build.Reporting;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFramePlayerBuildStep : IFRFrameBuildStep
    {
        public string Name => "Build Player";
        public bool Enabled { get; }

        public FRFramePlayerBuildStep(bool enabled = true)
        {
            Enabled = enabled;
        }

        public FRFrameBuildStepResult Execute(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            string[] scenes = EditorBuildSettings.scenes
                .Where(scene => scene.enabled)
                .Select(scene => scene.path)
                .ToArray();
            if (scenes.Length == 0)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed("No enabled EditorBuildSettings scenes.");
            }

            string locationPathName = GetPlayerOutputPath(context);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(locationPathName));

            BuildPlayerOptions options = new BuildPlayerOptions
            {
                scenes = scenes,
                locationPathName = locationPathName,
                target = context.BuildTarget,
                targetGroup = context.BuildProfile.buildTargetGroup,
                options = GetBuildOptions(context.BuildProfile)
            };

            context.Logger.Info($"[PlayerBuild] Output: {locationPathName}");
            context.Logger.Info($"[PlayerBuild] Options: {options.options}");
            BuildReport report = BuildPipeline.BuildPlayer(options);
            BuildSummary summary = report.summary;
            WriteBuildReport(context, report, locationPathName);
            context.Logger.Info($"[PlayerBuild] Result: {summary.result}, size: {summary.totalSize}, time: {summary.totalTime}");

            return summary.result == BuildResult.Succeeded
                ? FRFrameBuildStepResult.Passed(summary.totalTime.TotalSeconds)
                : FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed(summary.result.ToString(), summary.totalTime.TotalSeconds);
        }

        private static BuildOptions GetBuildOptions(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (profile == null || profile.buildMode == FRFrameBuildMode.FollowEditorBuildSettings)
            {
                return EditorUserBuildSettings.development ? BuildOptions.Development : BuildOptions.None;
            }

            if (profile.buildMode == FRFrameBuildMode.DevelopmentBuild)
            {
                return BuildOptions.Development;
            }

            return BuildOptions.None;
        }

        private static string GetPlayerOutputPath(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            string productName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.BuildProfile.playerOutputName) ? PlayerSettings.productName : context.BuildProfile.playerOutputName;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(productName))
            {
                productName = "UnityPlayer";
            }

            string directory = Path.Combine(context.OutputRoot, "Player", context.BuildTarget.ToString());
            switch (context.BuildTarget)
            {
                case BuildTarget.Android:
                    return Path.Combine(directory, productName + ".apk");
                case BuildTarget.StandaloneWindows:
                case BuildTarget.StandaloneWindows64:
                    return Path.Combine(directory, productName + ".exe");
                default:
                    return Path.Combine(directory, productName);
            }
        }

        private static void WriteBuildReport(FRFrameBuildContext context, BuildReport report, string locationPathName)
        {
            BuildSummary summary = report.summary;
            string reportPath = Path.Combine(context.OutputRoot, "BuildRecords", "Player", DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMdd_HHmmss") + "_build_report.json");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(reportPath));
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = context.BuildProfile;
            string json = JsonUtility.ToJson(new PlayerBuildReportRecord
            {
                target = context.BuildTarget.ToString(),
                outputPath = locationPathName,
                result = summary.result.ToString(),
                totalSize = summary.totalSize,
                totalTime = summary.totalTime.ToString(),
                buildStartedAt = summary.buildStartedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                buildEndedAt = summary.buildEndedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                logDefineMode = profile.logDefineMode.ToString(),
                developmentMinimumLogLevel = profile.developmentMinimumLogLevel.ToString(),
                releaseMinimumLogLevel = profile.releaseMinimumLogLevel.ToString(),
                enableFileLogInDevelopment = profile.enableFileLogInDevelopment,
                enableFileLogInRelease = profile.enableFileLogInRelease
            }, true);
            File.WriteAllText(reportPath, json);
            context.Logger.Info($"[PlayerBuild] Report: {reportPath}");
        }

        [Serializable]
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Build;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFramePrepareBuildSettingsStep : IFRFrameBuildStep
    {
        public string Name => "Prepare Build Settings";
        public bool Enabled { get; }

        public FRFramePrepareBuildSettingsStep(bool enabled = true)
        {
            Enabled = enabled;
        }

        public FRFrameBuildStepResult Execute(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = context.BuildProfile;
            if (profile == null)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed("Build profile is null.");
            }

            BuildTargetGroup targetGroup = BuildPipeline.GetBuildTargetGroup(profile.buildTarget);
            if (targetGroup == BuildTargetGroup.Unknown)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed($"Cannot resolve build target group for {profile.buildTarget}.");
            }

            if (profile.buildTargetGroup != targetGroup)
            {
                context.Logger.Warning($"[PrepareBuild] Profile target group {profile.buildTargetGroup} does not match {profile.buildTarget}; using {targetGroup}.");
            }

            if (profile.switchBuildTarget && EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget != profile.buildTarget)
            {
                context.Logger.Info($"[PrepareBuild] Switch target: {EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget} -> {profile.buildTarget}");
                if (!EditorUserBuildSettings.SwitchActiveBuildTarget(targetGroup, profile.buildTarget))
                {
                    return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed($"Switch build target failed: {profile.buildTarget}");
                }
            }
            else if (EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget != profile.buildTarget)
            {
                return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Failed($"Active build target is {EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget}, but profile target is {profile.buildTarget}. Enable auto switch target or switch platform manually.");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(profile.scriptingDefineSymbols))
            {
                PlayerSettings.SetScriptingDefineSymbols(NamedBuildTarget.FromBuildTargetGroup(targetGroup), profile.scriptingDefineSymbols);
                context.Logger.Info($"[PrepareBuild] Scripting defines: {profile.scriptingDefineSymbols}");
            }

            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            return FRFrameBuildStepResult.Passed();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using YooAsset.Editor;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    /// <summary>
    /// YooAsset ScriptableBuildPipeline with support for video files that must remain raw.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class FRFrameScriptableBuildPipeline : IBuildPipeline
    {
        public BuildResult Run(BuildParameters buildParameters, bool enableLog)
        {
            if (!(buildParameters is ScriptableBuildParameters))
                throw new ArgumentException($"Invalid build parameter type: '{buildParameters.GetType().Name}'.", nameof(buildParameters));

            var pipeline = new List<IBuildTask>
            {
                new TaskPrepare_SBP(),
                new TaskGetBuildMap_SBP(),
                new TaskBuilding_SBP(),
                new TaskVerifyBuildResult_SBP(),
                // Keep SBP validation intact, then restore raw bytes before encryption and manifest hashing.
                new TaskRestoreRawVideoFiles(),
                new TaskEncryption_SBP(),
                new TaskUpdateBundleInfo_SBP(),
                new TaskCreateManifest_SBP(),
                new TaskCreateReport_SBP(),
                new TaskCreatePackage_SBP(),
                new TaskCopyBundledFiles_SBP(),
                new TaskCreateCatalog_SBP()
            };

            return new BundleBuilder().Run(buildParameters, pipeline, enableLog);
        }

        private sealed class TaskRestoreRawVideoFiles : IBuildTask
        {
            void IBuildTask.Run(BuildContext context)
            {
                BuildMapContext buildMap = context.GetContextObject<BuildMapContext>();
                BuildParametersContext parameters = context.GetContextObject<BuildParametersContext>();
                string pipelineOutputDirectory = parameters.GetPipelineOutputDirectory();

                foreach (BuildBundleInfo bundleInfo in buildMap.Collection)
                {
                    if (bundleInfo.AllPackAssets.Count != 1)
                        continue;

                    string assetPath = bundleInfo.AllPackAssets[0].AssetInfo.AssetPath;
                    string sourceExtension = Path.GetExtension(assetPath);
                    if (!string.Equals(sourceExtension, ".mp4", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                        !string.Equals(Path.GetExtension(bundleInfo.BundleName), sourceExtension, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    string destinationPath = Path.Combine(pipelineOutputDirectory, bundleInfo.BundleName);
                    EditorFileUtility.CopyFile(assetPath, destinationPath, true);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Editor/BuildTools/GamePackageBuildUtility.cs
````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using HybridCLR;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Unity.SharpZipLib.Utils;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public static class GamePackageBuildUtility
    {
        public const string GameManifestFileName = "game_manifest.json";
        public const string FileManifestFileName = "file_manifest.json";
        public const string PatchManifestFileName = "patch_manifest.json";
        private const string YooAssetPipelineOutputDirectoryName = "OutputCache";

        public static string BuildFullPackage(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            GameBuildProfile profile = RequireGameProfile(context);
            GenerateHybridCLRIfNeeded(context, profile);
            string profileAssetPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(profile);
            string previousVersion = profile.packageVersion;
            profile.packageVersion = GamePackageVersion.Parse(profile.packageVersion).NextFull().ToString();

            return ExecuteWithVersionRollback(profile, previousVersion, context.Logger, () =>
            {
                string stageRoot = GetStageRoot(context, profile, profile.packageVersion);
                RecreateDirectory(stageRoot);

                string yooAssetSource = BuildAndGetYooAssetPackageDirectory(context, profile);
                CopyYooAssetPackage(yooAssetSource, Path.Combine(stageRoot, "YooAsset"), context.Logger);
                CopyRuntimeFiles(profile, Path.Combine(stageRoot, "RuntimeFiles"), context.Logger);
                CopyGameHotUpdateAssembly(context, profile, Path.Combine(stageRoot, "HotDll"));

                GamePackageBuildManifest manifest = CreateGameManifest(profile);
                manifest.files = CreateFileManifest(stageRoot);
                WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, GameManifestFileName), manifest);
                WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, FileManifestFileName), new GamePackageFileManifest { files = manifest.files });

                string outputDirectory = GetGameOutputDirectory(context, profile);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDirectory);
                if (profile.clearHistoryFullPackages)
                {
                    DeleteHistoryFullPackageFiles(outputDirectory, profile, context.Logger);
                }

                string zipPath = Path.Combine(outputDirectory, ResolveFullPackageName(profile));
                DeleteFileIfExists(zipPath);
                ZipUtility.CompressFolderToZip(zipPath, string.Empty, stageRoot);
                WriteFullPackageRecord(context, profile, stageRoot, zipPath, manifest.files.Count);
                CleanupGeneratedYooAssetOutput(profile, yooAssetSource, context.Logger);
                context.Logger.Info($"[GameFullPackage] Output: {zipPath}");
                PersistPackageVersion(profileAssetPath, profile.packageVersion);
                AssetDatabase.Refresh();
                return zipPath;
            });
        }

        public static string BuildPatchPackage(FRFrameBuildContext context, string oldFileManifestPath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldFileManifestPath) || !File.Exists(oldFileManifestPath))
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("Old file_manifest.json not found.", oldFileManifestPath);
            }

            GameBuildProfile profile = RequireGameProfile(context);
            GenerateHybridCLRIfNeeded(context, profile);
            string profileAssetPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(profile);
            string fromVersion = GetVersionFromManifestPath(oldFileManifestPath);
            GamePackageVersion oldVersion = GamePackageVersion.Parse(fromVersion);
            GamePackageVersion nextVersion = GamePackageVersion.Parse(profile.packageVersion).NextPatch();
            if (!oldVersion.IsSameMajor(nextVersion))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏大版本已变化，不能构建补丁包：旧版本 {fromVersion}，当前版本 {nextVersion}。请构建当前游戏整包。");
            }

            string previousVersion = profile.packageVersion;
            profile.packageVersion = nextVersion.ToString();

            return ExecuteWithVersionRollback(profile, previousVersion, context.Logger, () =>
            {
                string fullStageRoot = GetStageRoot(context, profile, profile.packageVersion);
                RecreateDirectory(fullStageRoot);
                string yooAssetSource = BuildAndGetYooAssetPackageDirectory(context, profile);
                CopyYooAssetPackage(yooAssetSource, Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, "YooAsset"), context.Logger);
                CopyRuntimeFiles(profile, Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, "RuntimeFiles"), context.Logger);
                CopyGameHotUpdateAssembly(context, profile, Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, "HotDll"));

                GamePackageBuildManifest manifest = CreateGameManifest(profile);
                manifest.files = CreateFileManifest(fullStageRoot);
                WriteJson(Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, GameManifestFileName), manifest);
                WriteJson(Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, FileManifestFileName), new GamePackageFileManifest { files = manifest.files });

                GamePackageFileManifest oldManifest = JsonUtility.FromJson<GamePackageFileManifest>(File.ReadAllText(oldFileManifestPath));
                List<GamePackageFileRecord> newFiles = CreateFileManifest(fullStageRoot);
                Dictionary<string, GamePackageFileRecord> oldFiles = oldManifest.files.ToDictionary(file => file.path);
                Dictionary<string, GamePackageFileRecord> newFileMap = newFiles.ToDictionary(file => file.path);

                List<GamePackageFileRecord> changedFiles = newFiles
                    .Where(file => !oldFiles.TryGetValue(file.path, out GamePackageFileRecord oldFile) || oldFile.hash != file.hash || oldFile.size != file.size)
                    .ToList();
                List<string> deletedFiles = oldFiles.Keys.Where(path => !newFileMap.ContainsKey(path)).OrderBy(path => path).ToList();

                string patchRoot = GetPatchStageRoot(context, profile);
                RecreateDirectory(patchRoot);
                foreach (GamePackageFileRecord file in changedFiles)
                {
                    string source = Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, file.path);
                    string destination = Path.Combine(patchRoot, file.path);
                    Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(destination));
                    File.Copy(source, destination, true);
                }

                GamePatchBuildManifest patchManifest = new GamePatchBuildManifest
                {
                    gameId = profile.gameId,
                    fromVersion = fromVersion,
                    toVersion = profile.packageVersion,
                    buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                    changedFiles = changedFiles,
                    deletedFiles = deletedFiles
                };
                WriteJson(Path.Combine(patchRoot, PatchManifestFileName), patchManifest);

                string outputDirectory = GetGameOutputDirectory(context, profile);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDirectory);
                string zipPath = Path.Combine(outputDirectory, ResolvePatchPackageName(profile, patchManifest.fromVersion));
                DeleteFileIfExists(zipPath);
                ZipUtility.CompressFolderToZip(zipPath, string.Empty, patchRoot);
                WritePatchPackageRecord(context, profile, patchRoot, zipPath, oldFileManifestPath, patchManifest, newFiles.Count);
                CleanupGeneratedYooAssetOutput(profile, yooAssetSource, context.Logger);
                context.Logger.Info($"[GamePatchPackage] Output: {zipPath}");
                PersistPackageVersion(profileAssetPath, profile.packageVersion);
                AssetDatabase.Refresh();
                return zipPath;
            });
        }

        private static T ExecuteWithVersionRollback<T>(GameBuildProfile profile, string previousVersion, FRFrameBuildLogger logger, Func<T> buildAction)
        {
            try
            {
                return buildAction();
            }
            catch
            {
                profile.packageVersion = previousVersion;
                logger.Warning($"[GamePackage] Build failed; restored package version to {previousVersion}.");
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static void PersistPackageVersion(string profileAssetPath, string packageVersion)
        {
            GameBuildProfile persistedProfile = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameBuildProfile>(profileAssetPath);
            if (persistedProfile == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to reload game build profile for version persistence: {profileAssetPath}");
            }

            persistedProfile.packageVersion = packageVersion;
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(persistedProfile);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        }

        public static string GetStageRoot(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile, string version)
        {
            return Path.Combine(GetGameOutputDirectory(context, profile), "Stage", version);
        }

        private static GamePackageBuildManifest CreateGameManifest(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return new GamePackageBuildManifest
            {
                gameId = profile.gameId,
                displayName = profile.displayName,
                packageName = profile.packageName,
                yooAssetPackageName = GetYooAssetPackageName(profile),
                version = profile.packageVersion,
                gameConfigLocation = ResolveGameConfigLocation(profile),
                hotUpdateAssemblyName = GetGameHotUpdateAssemblyFileName(profile),
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
            };
        }

        private static string ResolveGameConfigLocation(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.gameConfigLocation))
            {
                if (profile.gameConfigAsset == null)
                {
                    return profile.gameConfigLocation;
                }

                ValidateGameConfigAsset(profile.gameConfigAsset, profile);
                return profile.gameConfigLocation;
            }

            if (profile.gameConfigAsset == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置未设置：{profile.gameId}");
            }

            string assetPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(profile.gameConfigAsset);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置不是有效资产：{profile.gameId}");
            }

            ValidateGameConfigAsset(profile.gameConfigAsset, profile);
            return assetPath;
        }

        private static void ValidateGameConfigAsset(GamePackageConfig config, GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(config.entryScene))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置缺少入口场景：{profile.gameId}");
            }

            if (config.uiConfigGroup == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置缺少 UI 配置组：{profile.gameId}");
            }

            if (config.icon == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置缺少图标：{profile.gameId}");
            }

            if (config.backgroundVideo == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置缺少背景视频：{profile.gameId}");
            }

            ValidateAssetInPackage(config, config.uiConfigGroup, profile, "UI 配置组");
            ValidateAssetInPackage(config, config.icon, profile, "图标");
            ValidateAssetInPackage(config, config.backgroundVideo, profile, "背景视频");
        }

        private static void ValidateAssetInPackage(GamePackageConfig config, UnityEngine.Object asset, GameBuildProfile profile, string label)
        {
            string configPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(config).Replace('\\', '/');
            string assetPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset).Replace('\\', '/');
            string packageName = GetYooAssetPackageName(profile);
            if (!IsUnderGameRes(configPath, packageName) || !IsUnderGameRes(assetPath, packageName))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏运行时配置的{label}必须位于 Assets/GameRes/{packageName}/ 下：{assetPath}");
            }
        }

        private static bool IsUnderGameRes(string assetPath, string packageName)
        {
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath)
                && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName)
                && assetPath.StartsWith($"Assets/GameRes/{packageName}/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        private static string BuildAndGetYooAssetPackageDirectory(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            string packageName = GetYooAssetPackageName(profile);
            string packageDirectory;
            if (!profile.buildYooAsset)
            {
                packageDirectory = YooAssetPackageHelper.GetPackageVersionDirectory(packageName, profile.packageVersion);
                YooAssetPackageHelper.EnsureBuiltinCatalog(packageName, packageDirectory, context.Logger);
            }
            else
            {
                packageDirectory = YooAssetPackageHelper.ExecuteBuildYooAssetPackage(context, profile);
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageDirectory) || !Directory.Exists(packageDirectory))
            {
                throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"YooAsset build output not found: {packageDirectory}");
            }

            return packageDirectory;
        }

        private static void CleanupGeneratedYooAssetOutput(GameBuildProfile profile, string packageDirectory, FRFrameBuildLogger logger)
        {
            if (profile == null || !profile.buildYooAsset || !profile.yooAssetClearBuildOutputAfterPackage || string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageDirectory))
            {
                return;
            }

            string fullPackageDirectory = Path.GetFullPath(packageDirectory);
            if (!Directory.Exists(fullPackageDirectory))
            {
                return;
            }

            string packageVersionName = Path.GetFileName(fullPackageDirectory);
            string packageNameDirectory = Path.GetDirectoryName(fullPackageDirectory);
            string platformDirectory = packageNameDirectory == null ? null : Path.GetDirectoryName(packageNameDirectory);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageVersionName)
                || string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageNameDirectory)
                || string.IsNullOrEmpty(platformDirectory)
                || !string.Equals(Path.GetFileName(packageNameDirectory), GetYooAssetPackageName(profile), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                || !string.Equals(Path.GetFileName(platformDirectory), YooAssetConfigs.GetPlatformName(), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                logger.Warning($"[GamePackage] Skip YooAsset output cleanup because path is not a package version directory: {fullPackageDirectory}");
                return;
            }

            Directory.Delete(fullPackageDirectory, true);
            logger.Info($"[GamePackage] Cleaned YooAsset version output: {fullPackageDirectory}");

            string pipelineOutputDirectory = Path.Combine(packageNameDirectory, YooAssetPipelineOutputDirectoryName);
            if (Directory.Exists(pipelineOutputDirectory))
            {
                Directory.Delete(pipelineOutputDirectory, true);
                logger.Info($"[GamePackage] Cleaned YooAsset pipeline output: {pipelineOutputDirectory}");
            }
        }

        private static void CopyYooAssetPackage(string source, string destinationRoot, FRFrameBuildLogger logger)
        {
            CopyDirectory(source, destinationRoot);
            logger.Info($"[GamePackage] YooAsset package copied: {source}");
        }

        private static void CopyRuntimeFiles(GameBuildProfile profile, string destinationRoot, FRFrameBuildLogger logger)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.runtimeFilesRoot))
            {
                string source = profile.runtimeFilesRoot;
                if (!Path.IsPathRooted(source))
                {
                    source = Path.GetFullPath(source);
                }

                if (Directory.Exists(source))
                {
                    CopyDirectory(source, destinationRoot);
                    logger.Info($"[GamePackage] RuntimeFiles copied: {source}");
                }
                else
                {
                    logger.Warning($"[GamePackage] RuntimeFiles root not found: {source}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static void GenerateHybridCLRIfNeeded(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (!profile.includeHotUpdateAssembly)
            {
                return;
            }

            context.Logger.Info($"[GamePackage] 编译最新 HybridCLR 热更 DLL: {context.BuildTarget}");
            HybridCLRBuildHelper.ExecuteCompileDllOnly(context.BuildTarget);
        }

        private static void CopyGameHotUpdateAssembly(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile, string destinationRoot)
        {
            if (!profile.includeHotUpdateAssembly)
            {
                return;
            }

            string assemblyBytesFileName = GetGameHotUpdateAssemblyFileName(profile);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(assemblyBytesFileName))
            {
                return;
            }

            string assemblyDllFileName = assemblyBytesFileName.Substring(0, assemblyBytesFileName.Length - ".bytes".Length);
            string hotDllRoot = SettingsUtil.GetHotUpdateDllsOutputDirByTarget(context.BuildTarget);
            string source = Path.Combine(hotDllRoot, assemblyDllFileName);
            if (!File.Exists(source))
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException($"游戏热更 DLL 不存在，请先生成 HybridCLR：{source}", source);
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(destinationRoot);
            string destination = Path.Combine(destinationRoot, assemblyBytesFileName);
            File.Copy(source, destination, true);
            context.Logger.Info($"[GamePackage] Game hot update dll copied: {source} -> {destination}");
        }

        private static string GetGameHotUpdateAssemblyFileName(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (!profile.includeHotUpdateAssembly)
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string assemblyName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.hotUpdateAssemblyName) ? profile.gameId : profile.hotUpdateAssemblyName;
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(assemblyName) ? string.Empty : EnsureDllExtension(assemblyName) + ".bytes";
        }

        private static string EnsureDllExtension(string assemblyName)
        {
            return assemblyName.EndsWith(".dll", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? assemblyName : assemblyName + ".dll";
        }

        private static List<GamePackageFileRecord> CreateFileManifest(string root)
        {
            return Directory.GetFiles(root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path => Path.GetFileName(path) != FileManifestFileName)
                .Select(path => new GamePackageFileRecord
                {
                    path = ToRelativePath(root, path),
                    hash = ComputeHash(path),
                    size = new FileInfo(path).Length
                })
                .OrderBy(file => file.path)
                .ToList();
        }

        private static string ComputeHash(string path)
        {
            using (FileStream stream = File.OpenRead(path))
            using (SHA256 sha = SHA256.Create())
            {
                return BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(stream)).Replace("-", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();
            }
        }

        private static string ToRelativePath(string root, string path)
        {
            Uri rootUri = new Uri(AppendDirectorySeparatorChar(Path.GetFullPath(root)));
            Uri fileUri = new Uri(Path.GetFullPath(path));
            return Uri.UnescapeDataString(rootUri.MakeRelativeUri(fileUri).ToString()).Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar).Replace('\\', '/');
        }

        private static string AppendDirectorySeparatorChar(string path)
        {
            return path.EndsWith(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar.ToString()) ? path : path + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
        }

        private static void CopyDirectory(string source, string destination)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(destination);
            foreach (string directory in Directory.GetDirectories(source, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(directory.Replace(source, destination));
            }

            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(source, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                string destinationFile = file.Replace(source, destination);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(destinationFile));
                File.Copy(file, destinationFile, true);
            }
        }

        private static void RecreateDirectory(string path)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(path))
            {
                Directory.Delete(path, true);
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
        }

        private static void DeleteFileIfExists(string path)
        {
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.Delete(path);
            }
        }

        private static void DeleteHistoryFullPackageFiles(string outputDirectory, GameBuildProfile profile, FRFrameBuildLogger logger)
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(outputDirectory))
            {
                return;
            }

            string prefix = ResolveFullPackageName(profile).Split(new[] { profile.packageVersion }, StringSplitOptions.None)[0];
            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(outputDirectory, "*.zip", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                if (fileName.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    File.Delete(file);
                    logger.Info($"[GameFullPackage] History full package deleted: {file}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static void WriteJson(string path, object value)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
            File.WriteAllText(path, JsonUtility.ToJson(value, true));
        }

        private static void WriteFullPackageRecord(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile, string stageRoot, string zipPath, int fileCount)
        {
            GamePackageBuildRecord record = CreateBaseRecord(profile, "Full", stageRoot, zipPath);
            record.version = profile.packageVersion;
            record.toVersion = profile.packageVersion;
            record.totalFileCount = fileCount;
            WriteBuildRecord(context, profile, record);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, "build_info.json"), record);
        }

        private static void WritePatchPackageRecord(
            FRFrameBuildContext context,
            GameBuildProfile profile,
            string patchRoot,
            string zipPath,
            string oldFileManifestPath,
            GamePatchBuildManifest patchManifest,
            int totalFileCount)
        {
            GamePackageBuildRecord record = CreateBaseRecord(profile, "Patch", patchRoot, zipPath);
            record.version = profile.packageVersion;
            record.fromVersion = patchManifest.fromVersion;
            record.toVersion = patchManifest.toVersion;
            record.oldFileManifestPath = oldFileManifestPath;
            record.totalFileCount = totalFileCount;
            record.changedFileCount = patchManifest.changedFiles.Count;
            record.deletedFileCount = patchManifest.deletedFiles.Count;
            WriteBuildRecord(context, profile, record);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(patchRoot, "build_info.json"), record);
        }

        private static GamePackageBuildRecord CreateBaseRecord(GameBuildProfile profile, string buildType, string stageRoot, string zipPath)
        {
            return new GamePackageBuildRecord
            {
                gameId = profile.gameId,
                displayName = profile.displayName,
                packageName = profile.packageName,
                yooAssetPackageName = GetYooAssetPackageName(profile),
                buildType = buildType,
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                zipPath = zipPath,
                stageRoot = stageRoot
            };
        }

        private static void WriteBuildRecord(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile, GamePackageBuildRecord record)
        {
            string historyPath = Path.Combine(context.OutputRoot, "BuildRecords", "Games", string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.gameId) ? GetYooAssetPackageName(profile) : profile.gameId, "build_history.json");
            GamePackageBuildHistory history = File.Exists(historyPath)
                ? JsonUtility.FromJson<GamePackageBuildHistory>(File.ReadAllText(historyPath))
                : new GamePackageBuildHistory();
            history ??= new GamePackageBuildHistory();
            history.records ??= new List<GamePackageBuildRecord>();
            history.records.Add(record);
            WriteJson(historyPath, history);
        }

        private static string GetGameOutputDirectory(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            string outputRoot = string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.outputRoot) ? context.OutputRoot : profile.outputRoot;
            return Path.Combine(outputRoot, string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.gameId) ? GetYooAssetPackageName(profile) : profile.gameId);
        }

        private static string GetPatchStageRoot(FRFrameBuildContext context, GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return Path.Combine(GetGameOutputDirectory(context, profile), "PatchStage", profile.packageVersion);
        }

        private static string ResolveFullPackageName(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return profile.fullPackageNamePattern
                .Replace("{GameId}", profile.gameId)
                .Replace("{Version}", profile.packageVersion);
        }

        private static string ResolvePatchPackageName(GameBuildProfile profile, string fromVersion)
        {
            return profile.patchPackageNamePattern
                .Replace("{GameId}", profile.gameId)
                .Replace("{FromVersion}", fromVersion)
                .Replace("{ToVersion}", profile.packageVersion);
        }

        private static string GetYooAssetPackageName(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.yooAssetPackageName))
            {
                return profile.yooAssetPackageName;
            }

            return profile.packageName;
        }

        private static string GetVersionFromManifestPath(string manifestPath)
        {
            string directoryPath = Path.GetDirectoryName(manifestPath);
            string gameManifestPath = Path.Combine(directoryPath, GameManifestFileName);
            if (File.Exists(gameManifestPath))
            {
                GamePackageBuildManifest manifest = JsonUtility.FromJson<GamePackageBuildManifest>(File.ReadAllText(gameManifestPath));
                if (manifest != null && GamePackageVersion.TryParse(manifest.version, out _))
                {
                    return manifest.version;
                }
            }

            DirectoryInfo directory = new DirectoryInfo(directoryPath);
            return directory.Name;
        }

        private static GameBuildProfile RequireGameProfile(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context.GameProfile == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Game Build Profile is required.");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GetYooAssetPackageName(context.GameProfile)))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Game Build Profile packageName or yooAssetPackageName is required.");
            }

            return context.GameProfile;
        }

        [Serializable]
        private sealed class GamePackageFileManifest
        {
            public List<GamePackageFileRecord> files = new List<GamePackageFileRecord>();
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
    public static void ClearAllHotFixOutput()
````
