    // ============================================================
    // 生成 StreamingAssets/HotFix
    // ============================================================
    private static CopyStats BuildStreamingHotFix(BuildTarget target, IEnumerable<string> excludedAssemblies = null)
    {
        string platform = GetPlatformName(target);

        string aotSrcDir = SettingsUtil.GetAssembliesPostIl2CppStripDir(target);
        string hotSrcDir = SettingsUtil.GetHotUpdateDllsOutputDirByTarget(target);

        string streamingAOTDstDir = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, StreamingAOTFolder);
        string streamingHotDstDir = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, StreamingHotFolder);

        if (!Directory.Exists(aotSrcDir))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                $"[HotFix] AOT source dir not found: {aotSrcDir}\n请先执行 HybridCLR → Generate → All");
        }

        if (!Directory.Exists(hotSrcDir))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                $"[HotFix] HotUpdate source dir not found: {hotSrcDir}\n请先执行 HybridCLR → Generate → All");
        }

        // HybridCLR 9 no longer stores the supplementary AOT list in its settings.
        List<string> aotAssemblyNames = new List<string>
        {
            "DOTween",
            "System.Core",
            "UniTask",
            "Unity.InputSystem",
            "UnityEngine.CoreModule",
            "UnityEngine.JSONSerializeModule",
            "YooAsset",
            "mscorlib",
            "System",
        };

        List<string> hotUpdateDlls = SettingsUtil.HotUpdateAssemblyFilesExcludePreserved;
        if (hotUpdateDlls == null || hotUpdateDlls.Count == 0)
        {
            throw new Exception("[HotFix] SettingsUtil.HotUpdateAssemblyFilesExcludePreserved 为空！");
        }

        HashSet<string> excludedAssemblyNames = CreateAssemblyNameSet(excludedAssemblies);
        hotUpdateDlls = hotUpdateDlls
            .Where(dll => !excludedAssemblyNames.Contains(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(EnsureDllExtension(dll))))
            .ToList();
        if (hotUpdateDlls.Count == 0)
        {
            throw new Exception("[HotFix] 主包 HotUpdate 列表为空，请确认是否把所有 DLL 都配置成游戏包 DLL。");
        }

        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] Platform = {platform}");
        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] AOT source = {aotSrcDir}");
        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] HotUpdate source = {hotSrcDir}");

        EnsureDirectoryExists("Assets/StreamingAssets");
        GetCurrentStreamVersion(StreamingRoot);

        ClearDirectory(StreamingRoot);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(streamingAOTDstDir);
        Directory.CreateDirectory(streamingHotDstDir);

        CopyStats stats = new CopyStats
        {
            AOTExpected = CountValidEntries(aotAssemblyNames),
            HotExpected = CountValidEntries(hotUpdateDlls)
        };

        // =========================
        // AOT
        // =========================
        List<string> copiedAOTNames = new List<string>();

        foreach (string asmName in aotAssemblyNames)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(asmName))
                continue;

            string dllFileName = EnsureDllExtension(asmName);
            string src = Path.Combine(aotSrcDir, dllFileName);

            if (!File.Exists(src))
            {
                stats.AOTMissing++;
                Debug.LogWarning($"[HotFix] AOT file not found, skip: {src}");
                continue;
            }

            string bytesFileName = dllFileName + ".bytes";
            string dst = Path.Combine(streamingAOTDstDir, bytesFileName);

            File.Copy(src, dst, true);
            copiedAOTNames.Add(bytesFileName);
            stats.AOTCopied++;

            Debug.Log($"[HotFix] AOT Copy: {src} -> {dst}");
        }

        string aotListPath = Path.Combine(streamingAOTDstDir, AOTListFile);
        File.WriteAllText(aotListPath, string.Join("\n", copiedAOTNames));
        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] AOT list written: {aotListPath}");

        // =========================
        // HotUpdate
        // =========================
        List<string> copiedHotUpdateNames = new List<string>();

        foreach (string dll in hotUpdateDlls)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dll))
                continue;

            string dllFileName = EnsureDllExtension(dll);
            string src = Path.Combine(hotSrcDir, dllFileName);

            if (!File.Exists(src))
            {
                stats.HotMissing++;
                Debug.LogWarning($"[HotFix] HotUpdate dll not found, skip: {src}");
                continue;
            }

            string bytesFileName = dllFileName + ".bytes";
            string dst = Path.Combine(streamingHotDstDir, bytesFileName);

            File.Copy(src, dst, true);
            copiedHotUpdateNames.Add(bytesFileName);
            stats.HotCopied++;

            Debug.Log($"[HotFix] HotUpdate Copy: {src} -> {dst}");
        }

        string hotUpdateListPath = Path.Combine(streamingHotDstDir, HotUpdateListFile);
        File.WriteAllText(hotUpdateListPath, string.Join("\n", copiedHotUpdateNames));
        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] HotUpdate list written: {hotUpdateListPath}");

        if (stats.AOTMissing > 0 || stats.HotMissing > 0 || stats.AOTCopied != stats.AOTExpected || stats.HotCopied != stats.HotExpected)
        {
            throw new Exception(
                "[HotFix] HybridCLR copy output incomplete.\n" +
                $"AOT Expected={stats.AOTExpected}, Copied={stats.AOTCopied}, Missing={stats.AOTMissing}\n" +
                $"HotUpdate Expected={stats.HotExpected}, Copied={stats.HotCopied}, Missing={stats.HotMissing}");
        }

        string streamingVersionPath = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, VersionFile);
        NormalizeStreamVersionText(streamingVersionPath);
        
        return stats;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 同步 StreamingAssets/HotFix -> GameRes/Common/DllBytes/HotFix
    // ============================================================
    private static void SyncStreamingToGameRes()
    {
        string gameResHotFixDstDir = Path.Combine(GameResRoot, GameResHotFixFolder);

        if (!Directory.Exists(StreamingRoot))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(
                $"[HotFix] Streaming source not found: {StreamingRoot}\n请先执行 Copy HybridCLR To StreamingAssets Only");
        }

        string streamingVersionPath = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, VersionFile);
        string streamingAOTDir = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, StreamingAOTFolder);
        string streamingHotDir = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, StreamingHotFolder);

        bool hasVersion = File.Exists(streamingVersionPath);
        bool hasAOTDir = Directory.Exists(streamingAOTDir);
        bool hasHotDir = Directory.Exists(streamingHotDir);

        if (!hasVersion && !hasAOTDir && !hasHotDir)
        {
            throw new Exception(
                $"[HotFix] Streaming source looks invalid: {StreamingRoot}\n" +
                $"缺少 version.txt / AOTMeta / HotDll，请先生成 StreamingAssets 热更目录。");
        }

        EnsureDirectoryExists("Assets/GameRes");
        EnsureDirectoryExists(GameResRoot);

        ClearDirectory(gameResHotFixDstDir);
        CopyDirectoryFiltered(StreamingRoot, gameResHotFixDstDir);
        
        string gameResVersionPath = Path.Combine(gameResHotFixDstDir, VersionFile);
        File.WriteAllText(gameResVersionPath, _currentStreamVersion);

        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] Full HotFix folder copied:");
        Debug.Log($"         {StreamingRoot}");
        Debug.Log($"         -> {gameResHotFixDstDir}");
        Debug.Log($"[HotFix] GameRes version written: {gameResVersionPath} = {_currentStreamVersion}");
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 统计输出
    // ============================================================
    private static void PrintStats(string title, CopyStats stats)
    {
        Debug.Log(
            "[HotFix] ===== Summary =====\n" +
            $"[HotFix] Task: {title}\n" +
            $"[HotFix] AOT      Expected={stats.AOTExpected}, Copied={stats.AOTCopied}, Missing={stats.AOTMissing}\n" +
            $"[HotFix] HotUpdate Expected={stats.HotExpected}, Copied={stats.HotCopied}, Missing={stats.HotMissing}"
        );
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 平台名
    // ============================================================
    private static string GetPlatformName(BuildTarget target)
    {
        switch (target)
        {
            case BuildTarget.Android:
                return "Android";
            case BuildTarget.iOS:
                return "iOS";
            case BuildTarget.StandaloneWindows:
            case BuildTarget.StandaloneWindows64:
                return "StandaloneWindows64";
            case BuildTarget.StandaloneOSX:
                return "StandaloneOSX";
            case BuildTarget.WebGL:
                return "WebGL";
            default:
                return target.ToString();
        }
    }

    private static void EnsureActiveBuildTarget(BuildTarget target)
    {
        if (EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget != target)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"[HotFix] Active build target is {EditorUserBuildSettings.activeBuildTarget}, but requested target is {target}. " +
                "Run Prepare Build Settings before generating HybridCLR output.");
        }
    }

    private static void ReleaseBuildMemory()
    {
        GC.Collect();
        GC.WaitForPendingFinalizers();
        GC.Collect();
        Debug.Log("[HotFix] Released managed build memory.");
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 保证 dll 后缀
    // ============================================================
    private static string EnsureDllExtension(string fileName)
    {
        return fileName.EndsWith(".dll", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
            ? fileName
            : fileName + ".dll";
    }

    private static HashSet<string> CreateAssemblyNameSet(IEnumerable<string> assemblies)
    {
        HashSet<string> names = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        if (assemblies == null)
        {
            return names;
        }

        foreach (string assembly in assemblies)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assembly))
            {
                names.Add(Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(EnsureDllExtension(assembly.Trim())));
            }
        }

        return names;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 规范化版本文本：必须为可解析整数，读取streampatch的verion，没有用默认值，有就递增1
    // ============================================================
    private static void GetCurrentStreamVersion(string streamingPath)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(streamingPath))
        {
            Debug.Log($"{streamingPath} not exist, so use default");
            return;
        }
        
        string streamingVersionPath = Path.Combine(StreamingRoot, VersionFile);
        _configManager.Load(streamingVersionPath);
        string streamingVersion = _configManager.GetValue("GameBoot", "version", _currentStreamVersion);
        
        _currentStreamVersion = streamingVersion;
        Debug.Log($"GetCurrentStreamVersion {_currentStreamVersion}");
    }
    
    private static void NormalizeStreamVersionText(string streamingVersionPath)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(streamingVersionPath))
        {
            Debug.Log($"NormalizeStreamVersionText {streamingVersionPath} not exist, so create");
            File.WriteAllText(streamingVersionPath, string.Empty);
        }
        
        _configManager.Load(streamingVersionPath);
        
        if (!int.TryParse(_currentStreamVersion, out int versionValue))
        {
            Debug.LogError($"NormalizeStreamVersionText {_currentStreamVersion} is not a valid integer version: {_currentStreamVersion}");
            return;
        }
        
        versionValue = versionValue + 1;
        _currentStreamVersion = versionValue.ToString();
        
        _configManager.SetValue("GameBoot", "version", _currentStreamVersion);
        _configManager.Save(streamingVersionPath);
        Debug.Log($"NormalizeStreamVersionText Streaming version written: {streamingVersionPath} = {_currentStreamVersion}");
        AssetDatabase.Refresh();
    }
    
    // ============================================================
    // 统计有效项数量
    // ============================================================
    private static int CountValidEntries(List<string> entries)
    {
        if (entries == null || entries.Count == 0)
            return 0;

        int count = 0;
        foreach (string entry in entries)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(entry))
                count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 确保目录存在
    // ============================================================
    private static void EnsureDirectoryExists(string path)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(path))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 清理目录和对应 meta
    // ============================================================
    private static void ClearDirectory(string path)
    {
        if (Directory.Exists(path))
        {
            FileUtil.DeleteFileOrDirectory(path);
        }

        string metaPath = path + ".meta";
        if (File.Exists(metaPath))
        {
            FileUtil.DeleteFileOrDirectory(metaPath);
        }
    }

    // ============================================================
    // 递归复制目录，过滤 .meta
    // ============================================================
    private static void CopyDirectoryFiltered(string sourceDir, string destinationDir)
    {
        if (!Directory.Exists(sourceDir))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Source directory not found: {sourceDir}");
        }

        Directory.CreateDirectory(destinationDir);

        foreach (string filePath in Directory.GetFiles(sourceDir))
        {
            if (filePath.EndsWith(".meta", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(filePath);
            string destFilePath = Path.Combine(destinationDir, fileName);
            File.Copy(filePath, destFilePath, true);
        }

        foreach (string dirPath in Directory.GetDirectories(sourceDir))
        {
            if (dirPath.EndsWith(".meta", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                continue;

            string dirName = Path.GetFileName(dirPath);
            string destSubDir = Path.Combine(destinationDir, dirName);
            CopyDirectoryFiltered(dirPath, destSubDir);
        }
    }
}
#endif

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Unity.SharpZipLib.Utils;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public static class MainPackageBuildUtility
    {
        public const string MainManifestFileName = "main_manifest.json";
        public const string FileManifestFileName = "file_manifest.json";
        public const string PatchManifestFileName = "main_patch_manifest.json";
        public const string PublishManifestFileName = "publish_manifest.json";

        public static string BuildPublishPackage(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = RequireBuildProfile(context);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.publishMainPackageZipPath) || !File.Exists(profile.publishMainPackageZipPath))
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("发布聚合包需要先选择主包 zip。", profile.publishMainPackageZipPath);
            }

            string version = GamePackageVersion.Parse(profile.packageVersion).ToString();
            string stageRoot = Path.Combine(GetPublishOutputDirectory(context, profile), "Stage", version);
            RecreateDirectory(stageRoot);

            string mainZipName = Path.GetFileName(profile.publishMainPackageZipPath);
            string mainZipStagePath = Path.Combine(stageRoot, "MainPackage", mainZipName);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(mainZipStagePath));
            File.Copy(profile.publishMainPackageZipPath, mainZipStagePath, true);

            PublishPackageBuildManifest manifest = new PublishPackageBuildManifest
            {
                version = version,
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                mainPackageZip = $"MainPackage/{mainZipName}"
            };

            string gamesRoot = Path.Combine(stageRoot, "Games");
            Directory.CreateDirectory(gamesRoot);
            foreach (string gameZipPath in GetValidGameZipPaths(profile))
            {
                string gameZipName = Path.GetFileName(gameZipPath);
                File.Copy(gameZipPath, Path.Combine(gamesRoot, gameZipName), true);
                manifest.gamePackageZips.Add($"Games/{gameZipName}");
            }

            WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, PublishManifestFileName), manifest);
            string outputDirectory = GetPublishOutputDirectory(context, profile);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDirectory);
            string zipPath = Path.Combine(outputDirectory, profile.publishPackageNamePattern.Replace("{Version}", version));
            DeleteFileIfExists(zipPath);
            ZipUtility.CompressFolderToZip(zipPath, string.Empty, stageRoot);
            context.Logger.Info($"[PublishPackage] Output: {zipPath}");
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            return zipPath;
        }

        public static string FindLatestMainPackageZip(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            return FindLatestZip(Path.Combine(context.OutputRoot, "MainPackage"), "MainPackage_*.zip");
        }

        public static List<string> FindLatestGamePackageZips(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            List<string> result = new List<string>();
            if (context.BuildProfile?.selectedGameProfiles == null)
            {
                return result;
            }

            foreach (GameBuildProfile gameProfile in context.BuildProfile.selectedGameProfiles)
            {
                if (gameProfile == null)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string outputRoot = string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.outputRoot) ? context.OutputRoot : gameProfile.outputRoot;
                string gameDirectoryName = string.IsNullOrEmpty(gameProfile.gameId) ? GetYooAssetPackageName(gameProfile) : gameProfile.gameId;
                string zipPath = FindLatestZip(Path.Combine(outputRoot, gameDirectoryName), "*.zip");
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(zipPath))
                {
                    result.Add(zipPath);
                }
            }

            return result;
        }

        private static List<string> GetValidGameZipPaths(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            profile.publishGamePackageZipPaths ??= new List<string>();
            return profile.publishGamePackageZipPaths
                .Where(path => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(path) && File.Exists(path))
                .ToList();
        }

        private static string FindLatestZip(string root, string pattern)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(root) || !Directory.Exists(root))
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            string[] files = Directory.GetFiles(root, pattern, SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly);
            if (files.Length == 0)
            {
                files = Directory.GetFiles(root, "*.zip", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly);
            }

            return files.OrderByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc).FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
        }

        public static string BuildFullPackage(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = RequireBuildProfile(context);
            profile.packageVersion = GamePackageVersion.Parse(profile.packageVersion).NextFull().ToString();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(profile);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();

            string stageRoot = GetStageRoot(context, profile.packageVersion);
            RecreateDirectory(stageRoot);
            BuildStage(context, stageRoot);

            MainPackageBuildManifest manifest = CreateMainManifest(profile);
            manifest.files = CreateFileManifest(stageRoot);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, MainManifestFileName), manifest);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, FileManifestFileName), new MainPackageFileManifest { files = manifest.files });

            string outputDirectory = GetMainOutputDirectory(context);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDirectory);
            if (profile.clearHistoryMainFullPackages)
            {
                DeleteHistoryFullPackageFiles(outputDirectory, profile, context.Logger);
            }

            string zipPath = Path.Combine(outputDirectory, ResolveMainFullPackageName(profile));
            DeleteFileIfExists(zipPath);
            ZipUtility.CompressFolderToZip(zipPath, string.Empty, stageRoot);
            WriteFullPackageRecord(context, stageRoot, zipPath, manifest.files.Count);
            context.Logger.Info($"[MainFullPackage] Output: {zipPath}");
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            return zipPath;
        }

        public static string BuildPatchPackage(FRFrameBuildContext context, string oldFileManifestPath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(oldFileManifestPath) || !File.Exists(oldFileManifestPath))
            {
                throw new FileNotFoundException("旧主包 file_manifest.json 不存在。", oldFileManifestPath);
            }

            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = RequireBuildProfile(context);
            string fromVersion = GetVersionFromManifestPath(oldFileManifestPath);
            GamePackageVersion oldVersion = GamePackageVersion.Parse(fromVersion);
            GamePackageVersion nextVersion = GamePackageVersion.Parse(profile.packageVersion).NextPatch();
            if (!oldVersion.IsSameMajor(nextVersion))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"主包大版本已变化，不能构建补丁包：旧版本 {fromVersion}，当前版本 {nextVersion}。请构建主包整包。");
            }

            profile.packageVersion = nextVersion.ToString();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(profile);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();

            string fullStageRoot = GetStageRoot(context, profile.packageVersion);
            RecreateDirectory(fullStageRoot);
            BuildStage(context, fullStageRoot);

            MainPackageBuildManifest manifest = CreateMainManifest(profile);
            manifest.files = CreateFileManifest(fullStageRoot);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, MainManifestFileName), manifest);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, FileManifestFileName), new MainPackageFileManifest { files = manifest.files });

            MainPackageFileManifest oldManifest = JsonUtility.FromJson<MainPackageFileManifest>(File.ReadAllText(oldFileManifestPath));
            List<MainPackageFileRecord> oldFiles = oldManifest?.files ?? new List<MainPackageFileRecord>();
            List<MainPackageFileRecord> newFiles = CreateFileManifest(fullStageRoot);
            Dictionary<string, MainPackageFileRecord> oldFileMap = oldFiles.ToDictionary(file => file.path);
            Dictionary<string, MainPackageFileRecord> newFileMap = newFiles.ToDictionary(file => file.path);
            List<MainPackageFileRecord> changedFiles = newFiles
                .Where(file => !oldFileMap.TryGetValue(file.path, out MainPackageFileRecord oldFile) || oldFile.hash != file.hash || oldFile.size != file.size)
                .ToList();
            List<string> deletedFiles = oldFileMap.Keys.Where(path => !newFileMap.ContainsKey(path)).OrderBy(path => path).ToList();

            string patchRoot = GetPatchStageRoot(context, profile.packageVersion);
            RecreateDirectory(patchRoot);
            foreach (MainPackageFileRecord file in changedFiles)
            {
                string source = Path.Combine(fullStageRoot, file.path);
                string destination = Path.Combine(patchRoot, file.path);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(destination));
                File.Copy(source, destination, true);
            }

            MainPatchBuildManifest patchManifest = new MainPatchBuildManifest
            {
                fromVersion = fromVersion,
                toVersion = profile.packageVersion,
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                changedFiles = changedFiles,
                deletedFiles = deletedFiles
            };
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(patchRoot, PatchManifestFileName), patchManifest);

            string outputDirectory = GetMainOutputDirectory(context);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDirectory);
            string zipPath = Path.Combine(outputDirectory, ResolveMainPatchPackageName(profile, fromVersion));
            DeleteFileIfExists(zipPath);
            ZipUtility.CompressFolderToZip(zipPath, string.Empty, patchRoot);
            WritePatchPackageRecord(context, patchRoot, zipPath, oldFileManifestPath, patchManifest, newFiles.Count);
            context.Logger.Info($"[MainPatchPackage] Output: {zipPath}");
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            return zipPath;
        }

        public static string FindDefaultOldFileManifest(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            FRFrameBuildProfile profile = RequireBuildProfile(context);
            string currentVersion = profile.packageVersion;
            string currentManifest = Path.Combine(GetStageRoot(context, currentVersion), FileManifestFileName);
            if (File.Exists(currentManifest))
            {
                return currentManifest;
            }

            GamePackageVersion version = GamePackageVersion.Parse(currentVersion);
            string stageRoot = Path.Combine(GetMainOutputDirectory(context), "Stage");
            if (!Directory.Exists(stageRoot))
            {
                return string.Empty;
            }

            return Directory.GetFiles(stageRoot, FileManifestFileName, SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path => IsValidOldManifest(path, version))
                .OrderByDescending(path => GetManifestVersion(path).full)
                .ThenByDescending(path => GetManifestVersion(path).patch)
                .ThenByDescending(File.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
                .FirstOrDefault() ?? string.Empty;
        }

        private static bool IsValidOldManifest(string path, GamePackageVersion currentVersion)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                return false;
            }

            GamePackageVersion manifestVersion = GetManifestVersion(path);
            return manifestVersion.IsSameMajor(currentVersion);
        }

        private static GamePackageVersion GetManifestVersion(string path)
        {
            string versionDirectory = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetDirectoryName(path)).Name;
            return GamePackageVersion.TryParse(versionDirectory, out GamePackageVersion version) ? version : GamePackageVersion.Default;
        }

        public static string GetStageRoot(FRFrameBuildContext context, string version)
        {
            return Path.Combine(GetMainOutputDirectory(context), "Stage", version);
        }

        private static void BuildStage(FRFrameBuildContext context, string stageRoot)
        {
            BootstrapConfigExporter.Export(context);
            CopyDirectory("Assets/StreamingAssets/HotFix", Path.Combine(stageRoot, "HotFix"), context.Logger, true);
            CopyDirectory(Path.Combine(Application.streamingAssetsPath, BootstrapFileNames.DirectoryName), Path.Combine(stageRoot, BootstrapFileNames.DirectoryName), context.Logger, false);
        }

        private static MainPackageBuildManifest CreateMainManifest(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return new MainPackageBuildManifest
            {
                version = profile.packageVersion,
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
            };
        }

        private static List<MainPackageFileRecord> CreateFileManifest(string root)
        {
            return Directory.GetFiles(root, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
                .Where(path => Path.GetFileName(path) != FileManifestFileName && !IsMetaFile(path))
                .Select(path => new MainPackageFileRecord
                {
                    path = ToRelativePath(root, path),
                    hash = ComputeHash(path),
                    size = new FileInfo(path).Length
                })
                .OrderBy(file => file.path)
                .ToList();
        }

        private static string ComputeHash(string path)
        {
            using (FileStream stream = File.OpenRead(path))
            using (SHA256 sha = SHA256.Create())
            {
                return BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(stream)).Replace("-", string.Empty).ToLowerInvariant();
            }
        }

        private static string ToRelativePath(string root, string path)
        {
            Uri rootUri = new Uri(AppendDirectorySeparatorChar(Path.GetFullPath(root)));
            Uri fileUri = new Uri(Path.GetFullPath(path));
            return Uri.UnescapeDataString(rootUri.MakeRelativeUri(fileUri).ToString()).Replace('/', Path.DirectorySeparatorChar).Replace('\\', '/');
        }

        private static string AppendDirectorySeparatorChar(string path)
        {
            return path.EndsWith(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar.ToString()) ? path : path + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
        }

        private static bool IsMetaFile(string path)
        {
            return Path.GetExtension(path).Equals(".meta", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        private static void CopyDirectory(string source, string destination, FRFrameBuildLogger logger, bool required)
        {
            if (!Directory.Exists(source))
            {
                if (required)
                {
                    throw new DirectoryNotFoundException(source);
                }

                logger.Warning($"[MainPackage] 目录不存在，跳过：{source}");
                return;
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(destination);
            foreach (string directory in Directory.GetDirectories(source, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                Directory.CreateDirectory(directory.Replace(source, destination));
            }

            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(source, "*", SearchOption.AllDirectories))
            {
                if (IsMetaFile(file))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string destinationFile = file.Replace(source, destination);
                Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(destinationFile));
                File.Copy(file, destinationFile, true);
            }

            logger.Info($"[MainPackage] 目录已复制：{source} -> {destination}");
        }

        private static void RecreateDirectory(string path)
        {
            if (Directory.Exists(path))
            {
                Directory.Delete(path, true);
            }

            Directory.CreateDirectory(path);
        }

        private static void DeleteFileIfExists(string path)
        {
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.Delete(path);
            }
        }

        private static void DeleteHistoryFullPackageFiles(string outputDirectory, FRFrameBuildProfile profile, FRFrameBuildLogger logger)
        {
            string prefix = ResolveMainFullPackageName(profile).Split(new[] { profile.packageVersion }, StringSplitOptions.None)[0];
            foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(outputDirectory, "*.zip", SearchOption.TopDirectoryOnly))
            {
                string fileName = Path.GetFileName(file);
                if (fileName.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    File.Delete(file);
                    logger.Info($"[MainFullPackage] 历史整包已删除：{file}");
                }
            }
        }

        private static void WriteJson(string path, object value)
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(Path.GetDirectoryName(path));
            File.WriteAllText(path, JsonUtility.ToJson(value, true));
        }

        private static void WriteFullPackageRecord(FRFrameBuildContext context, string stageRoot, string zipPath, int fileCount)
        {
            MainPackageBuildRecord record = CreateBaseRecord(context.BuildProfile, "Full", stageRoot, zipPath);
            record.version = context.BuildProfile.packageVersion;
            record.toVersion = context.BuildProfile.packageVersion;
            record.totalFileCount = fileCount;
            WriteBuildRecord(context, record);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(stageRoot, "build_info.json"), record);
        }

        private static void WritePatchPackageRecord(FRFrameBuildContext context, string patchRoot, string zipPath, string oldFileManifestPath, MainPatchBuildManifest patchManifest, int totalFileCount)
        {
            MainPackageBuildRecord record = CreateBaseRecord(context.BuildProfile, "Patch", patchRoot, zipPath);
            record.version = context.BuildProfile.packageVersion;
            record.fromVersion = patchManifest.fromVersion;
            record.toVersion = patchManifest.toVersion;
            record.oldFileManifestPath = oldFileManifestPath;
            record.totalFileCount = totalFileCount;
            record.changedFileCount = patchManifest.changedFiles.Count;
            record.deletedFileCount = patchManifest.deletedFiles.Count;
            WriteBuildRecord(context, record);
            WriteJson(Path.Combine(patchRoot, "build_info.json"), record);
        }

        private static MainPackageBuildRecord CreateBaseRecord(FRFrameBuildProfile profile, string buildType, string stageRoot, string zipPath)
        {
            return new MainPackageBuildRecord
            {
                buildType = buildType,
                buildTime = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"),
                zipPath = zipPath,
                stageRoot = stageRoot,
                version = profile.packageVersion
            };
        }

        private static void WriteBuildRecord(FRFrameBuildContext context, MainPackageBuildRecord record)
        {
            string historyPath = Path.Combine(context.OutputRoot, "BuildRecords", "MainPackage", "build_history.json");
            MainPackageBuildHistory history = File.Exists(historyPath)
                ? JsonUtility.FromJson<MainPackageBuildHistory>(File.ReadAllText(historyPath))
                : new MainPackageBuildHistory();
            history ??= new MainPackageBuildHistory();
            history.records ??= new List<MainPackageBuildRecord>();
            history.records.Add(record);
            WriteJson(historyPath, history);
        }

        private static string GetMainOutputDirectory(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            return Path.Combine(context.OutputRoot, "MainPackage");
        }

        private static string GetPatchStageRoot(FRFrameBuildContext context, string version)
        {
            return Path.Combine(GetMainOutputDirectory(context), "PatchStage", version);
        }

        private static string GetPublishOutputDirectory(FRFrameBuildContext context, FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            string outputRoot = string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.publishOutputRoot) ? context.OutputRoot : profile.publishOutputRoot;
            return Path.Combine(outputRoot, "PublishPackage");
        }

        private static string GetYooAssetPackageName(GameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.yooAssetPackageName) ? profile.packageName : profile.yooAssetPackageName;
        }

        private static string ResolveMainFullPackageName(FRFrameBuildProfile profile)
        {
            return profile.mainFullPackageNamePattern.Replace("{Version}", profile.packageVersion);
        }

        private static string ResolveMainPatchPackageName(FRFrameBuildProfile profile, string fromVersion)
        {
            return profile.mainPatchPackageNamePattern
                .Replace("{FromVersion}", fromVersion)
                .Replace("{ToVersion}", profile.packageVersion);
        }

        private static string GetVersionFromManifestPath(string manifestPath)
        {
            string directoryPath = Path.GetDirectoryName(manifestPath);
            string mainManifestPath = Path.Combine(directoryPath, MainManifestFileName);
            if (File.Exists(mainManifestPath))
            {
                MainPackageBuildManifest manifest = JsonUtility.FromJson<MainPackageBuildManifest>(File.ReadAllText(mainManifestPath));
                if (manifest != null && GamePackageVersion.TryParse(manifest.version, out _))
                {
                    return manifest.version;
                }
            }

            return new DirectoryInfo(directoryPath).Name;
        }

        private static FRFrameBuildProfile RequireBuildProfile(FRFrameBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context.BuildProfile == null)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException("FRFrame Build Profile is required.");
            }

            return context.BuildProfile;
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

## File: Editor/BuildTools/MainPatchPackageBuildStep.cs

#if UNITY_EDITOR
namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class MainPatchPackageBuildStep : IFRFrameBuildStep
    {
        private readonly string _oldFileManifestPath;

````csharp
using FRFrame;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Unity.SharpZipLib.Utils;
using YooAsset;
using YooAsset.Editor;

public static class YooAssetPackageHelper
{
    private const string BuiltinCatalogFileName = "BuiltinCatalog.bytes";

    [MenuItem("FRFrame/Build/打包压缩YooAsset Package")]
    public static void PackYooAssetPackage()
    {
        ExecutePackYooAssetPackage();
    }

    public static void ExecuteBuildAndPackYooAssetPackage(FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildContext context)
    {
        if (context == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        }

        List<FRFrame.Editor.GameBuildProfile> profiles = GetBuildGameProfiles(context).ToList();
        if (profiles.Count == 0)
        {
            context.Logger.Info("[YooAsset] 未选择游戏配置，跳过非默认游戏包构建。");
            return;
        }

        foreach (FRFrame.Editor.GameBuildProfile profile in profiles)
        {
            string packageName = GetYooAssetPackageName(profile);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏配置 {profile.name} 未填写 YooAsset 包名或运行时包名。");
            }

            if (packageName == "DefaultPackage")
            {
                context.Logger.Info("[YooAsset] DefaultPackage 由主包流程处理，跳过游戏包构建。");
                continue;
            }

            ExecuteBuildYooAssetPackage(packageName, profile.packageVersion, context.BuildTarget, context.Logger);
            ExecutePackYooAssetPackage(packageName, profile.packageVersion, context.Logger);
        }
    }

    public static string ExecuteBuildYooAssetPackage(FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildContext context, FRFrame.Editor.GameBuildProfile profile)
    {
        if (context == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
        }

        if (profile == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(profile));
        }

        string packageName = GetYooAssetPackageName(profile);
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"游戏配置 {profile.name} 未填写 YooAsset 包名或运行时包名。");
        }

        string packageVersion = string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.packageVersion)
            ? DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd-HHmmss")
            : profile.packageVersion;
        string outputRoot = ResolveBuildOutputRoot(profile.yooAssetBuildOutputRoot);
        string buildinRoot = ResolveBuildinFileRoot(profile.yooAssetBuildinFileRoot);
        string versionOutputPath = Path.Combine(outputRoot, YooAssetConfigs.GetPlatformName(), packageName, packageVersion);
        if (Directory.Exists(versionOutputPath))
        {
            if (!profile.yooAssetOverwriteOutput)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"YooAsset package output already exists: {versionOutputPath}");
            }

            context.Logger.Warning($"[YooAsset] Delete existing package version output: {versionOutputPath}");
            Directory.Delete(versionOutputPath, true);
        }

        IBuildPipeline pipeline;
        BuildParameters buildParameters;
        switch (profile.yooAssetBuildPipeline)
        {
            case EBuildPipeline.LegacyBuildPipeline:
                LegacyBuildParameters legacyParameters = new LegacyBuildParameters();
                pipeline = new LegacyBuildPipeline();
                buildParameters = legacyParameters;
                legacyParameters.CompressOption = profile.yooAssetCompressOption;
                legacyParameters.StripUnityVersion = profile.yooAssetStripUnityVersion;
                legacyParameters.DisableWriteTypeTree = profile.yooAssetDisableWriteTypeTree;
                break;
            case EBuildPipeline.ScriptableBuildPipeline:
                ScriptableBuildParameters scriptableParameters = new ScriptableBuildParameters();
                pipeline = new FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameScriptableBuildPipeline();
                buildParameters = scriptableParameters;
                scriptableParameters.CompressOption = profile.yooAssetCompressOption;
                scriptableParameters.StripUnityVersion = profile.yooAssetStripUnityVersion;
                scriptableParameters.DisableWriteTypeTree = profile.yooAssetDisableWriteTypeTree;
                scriptableParameters.BuiltinShadersBundleName = profile.yooAssetBuiltinShadersBundleName;
                scriptableParameters.MonoScriptsBundleName = profile.yooAssetMonoScriptsBundleName;
                break;
            default:
                throw new NotSupportedException($"当前游戏整包不支持 YooAsset 构建管线: {profile.yooAssetBuildPipeline}");
        }

        buildParameters.BuildOutputRoot = outputRoot;
        buildParameters.BundledFileRoot = buildinRoot;
        buildParameters.BuildPipeline = profile.yooAssetBuildPipeline.ToString();
        buildParameters.BuildBundleType = (int)EBundleType.AssetBundle;
        buildParameters.BuildTarget = context.BuildTarget;
        buildParameters.PackageName = packageName;
        buildParameters.PackageVersion = packageVersion;
        buildParameters.PackageNote = profile.yooAssetPackageNote;
        buildParameters.ClearBuildCacheFiles = profile.yooAssetClearBuildCacheFiles;
        buildParameters.UseAssetDependencyDB = profile.yooAssetUseAssetDependencyDB;
        buildParameters.EnableSharePackRule = profile.yooAssetEnableSharePackRule;
        buildParameters.SingleReferencedPackAlone = profile.yooAssetSingleReferencedPackAlone;
        buildParameters.VerifyBuildingResult = profile.yooAssetVerifyBuildingResult;
        buildParameters.FileNameStyle = profile.yooAssetFileNameStyle;
        buildParameters.BundledCopyOption = profile.yooAssetBuildinFileCopyOption;
        buildParameters.BundledCopyParams = profile.yooAssetBuildinFileCopyParams;
        buildParameters.BundleEncryptor = new EncryptionNone();
        buildParameters.ManifestEncryptor = new ManifestEncryptorNone();
        buildParameters.ManifestDecryptor = new ManifestDecryptorNone();

        context.Logger.Info($"[YooAsset] Build package: {packageName}, version: {packageVersion}, target: {context.BuildTarget}, pipeline: {profile.yooAssetBuildPipeline}");
        context.Logger.Info($"[YooAsset] OutputRoot: {outputRoot}, BuildinRoot: {buildinRoot}, Compress: {profile.yooAssetCompressOption}, FileName: {profile.yooAssetFileNameStyle}");
        BuildResult result = pipeline.Run(buildParameters, true);
        if (!result.Success)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"YooAsset build failed: {packageName}, task: {result.FailedTask}, error: {result.ErrorInfo}\n{result.ErrorStack}");
        }

        EnsureBuiltinCatalog(packageName, result.OutputPackageDirectory, context.Logger);
        context.Logger.Info($"[YooAsset] Build output: {result.OutputPackageDirectory}");
        AssetDatabase.Refresh();
        return result.OutputPackageDirectory;
    }

    public static string ExecuteBuildYooAssetPackage(string packageName, string packageVersion, BuildTarget buildTarget, FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildLogger logger = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("YooAsset package name is empty.");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageVersion))
        {
            packageVersion = DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd-HHmmss");
        }

        string versionOutputPath = GetPackageVersionOutputPath(packageName, packageVersion);
        if (Directory.Exists(versionOutputPath))
        {
            logger?.Warning($"[YooAsset] Delete existing package version output: {versionOutputPath}");
            Directory.Delete(versionOutputPath, true);
        }

        ScriptableBuildParameters buildParameters = new ScriptableBuildParameters
        {
            BuildOutputRoot = BundleBuilderHelper.GetDefaultBuildOutputRoot(),
            BundledFileRoot = BundleBuilderHelper.GetStreamingAssetsRoot(),
            BuildPipeline = nameof(ScriptableBuildPipeline),
            BuildBundleType = (int)EBundleType.AssetBundle,
            BuildTarget = buildTarget,
            PackageName = packageName,
            PackageVersion = packageVersion,
            VerifyBuildingResult = true,
            EnableSharePackRule = true,
            BundledCopyParams = string.Empty,
            CompressOption = ECompressOption.LZ4,
            ClearBuildCacheFiles = false,
            BuiltinShadersBundleName = string.Empty,
            MonoScriptsBundleName = string.Empty,
            DisableWriteTypeTree = false
        };

        logger?.Info($"[YooAsset] Build package: {packageName}, version: {packageVersion}, target: {buildTarget}");
        IBuildPipeline pipeline = new FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameScriptableBuildPipeline();
        BuildResult result = pipeline.Run(buildParameters, true);
        if (!result.Success)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException($"YooAsset build failed: {packageName}, task: {result.FailedTask}, error: {result.ErrorInfo}\n{result.ErrorStack}");
        }

        EnsureBuiltinCatalog(packageName, result.OutputPackageDirectory, logger);
        logger?.Info($"[YooAsset] Build output: {result.OutputPackageDirectory}");
        AssetDatabase.Refresh();
        return result.OutputPackageDirectory;
    }

    public static void ExecutePackYooAssetPackage()
    {
        string yooAssetBuildRootPath =
            $"{BundleBuilderHelper.GetDefaultBuildOutputRoot()}/{YooAssetConfigs.GetPlatformName()}";
        Debug.Log(yooAssetBuildRootPath);

        foreach (BundleCollectorPackage package in BundleCollectorSettingData.Setting.Packages)
        {
            string packagePath = $"{yooAssetBuildRootPath}/{package.PackageName}";
            Debug.Log(packagePath);

            if (package.PackageName == "DefaultPackage")
            {
                continue;
            }

            ExecutePackYooAssetPackage(package.PackageName);
        }
    }

    public static string ExecutePackYooAssetPackage(string packageName, FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildLogger logger = null)
    {
        return ExecutePackYooAssetPackage(packageName, null, logger);
    }

    public static string ExecutePackYooAssetPackage(string packageName, string packageVersion, FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildLogger logger = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("YooAsset package name is empty.");
        }

        string yooAssetBuildRootPath = Path.Combine(BundleBuilderHelper.GetDefaultBuildOutputRoot(), YooAssetConfigs.GetPlatformName());
        string folderPath = string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageVersion)
            ? GetLatestRealVersionDirectory(packageName)
            : GetPackageVersionDirectory(packageName, packageVersion);
        EnsureBuiltinCatalog(packageName, folderPath, logger);
        string outPathName = Path.Combine(yooAssetBuildRootPath, packageName + ".zip");
        if (File.Exists(outPathName))
        {
            File.Delete(outPathName);
        }

        ZipUtility.CompressFolderToZip(outPathName, string.Empty, folderPath);
        logger?.Info($"[YooAsset] Package zip: {folderPath} -> {outPathName}");
        Debug.Log($"压缩成功： from {folderPath} to {outPathName}");
        return outPathName;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// YooAsset 3.x 的 BuiltinFileSystem 必须通过 BuiltinCatalog.bytes 建立文件索引。
    /// 外置离线包使用完整构建输出作为自定义内置根目录，因此需要为该目录单独生成 Catalog。
    /// </summary>
    public static void EnsureBuiltinCatalog(string packageName, string packageDirectory, FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildLogger logger = null)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
        {
            throw new ArgumentException("YooAsset package name is empty.", nameof(packageName));
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageDirectory) || !Directory.Exists(packageDirectory))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"YooAsset package directory not found: {packageDirectory}");
        }

        Type helperType = typeof(YooAssets).Assembly.GetType("YooAsset.BuiltinCatalogHelper", throwOnError: true);
        MethodInfo createMethod = helperType.GetMethod(
            "CreateFile",
            BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static,
            binder: null,
            types: new[] { typeof(IManifestDecryptor), typeof(string), typeof(string) },
            modifiers: null);
        if (createMethod == null)
        {
            throw new MissingMethodException(helperType.FullName, "CreateFile");
        }

        try
        {
            object result = createMethod.Invoke(null, new object[] { null, packageName, packageDirectory });
            if (!(result is bool succeeded) || !succeeded)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed to create YooAsset builtin catalog: {packageName}");
            }
        }
        catch (TargetInvocationException exception) when (exception.InnerException != null)
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Failed to create YooAsset builtin catalog: {packageName}",
                exception.InnerException);
        }

        string catalogPath = Path.Combine(packageDirectory, BuiltinCatalogFileName);
        if (!File.Exists(catalogPath) || new FileInfo(catalogPath).Length == 0)
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("YooAsset builtin catalog was not generated.", catalogPath);
        }

        logger?.Info($"[YooAsset] Builtin catalog generated: {catalogPath}");
    }

    [MenuItem("FRFrame/Build/生成YooAssetConfig到StreamAsset")]
    public static void CreateYooAssetConfigJson()
    {
        ExecuteCreateYooAssetConfigJson();
    }

    public static void ExecuteCreateYooAssetConfigJson()
    {
        Debug.LogWarning("旧版 FRFMYooAssetPackages 导出入口已停用，请使用 FRFrame 构建窗口导出 Bootstrap 启动配置。");
    }

    private static IEnumerable<FRFrame.Editor.GameBuildProfile> GetBuildGameProfiles(FRFrame.Editor.FRFrameBuildContext context)
    {
        if (context.GameProfile != null)
        {
            yield return context.GameProfile;
            yield break;
        }

        if (context.BuildProfile?.selectedGameProfiles == null)
        {
            yield break;
        }

        foreach (FRFrame.Editor.GameBuildProfile profile in context.BuildProfile.selectedGameProfiles)
        {
            if (profile != null)
            {
                yield return profile;
            }
        }
    }

    private static string GetYooAssetPackageName(FRFrame.Editor.GameBuildProfile profile)
    {
        if (profile == null)
        {
            return string.Empty;
        }

        return string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.yooAssetPackageName) ? profile.packageName : profile.yooAssetPackageName;
    }

    public static string GetPackageVersionDirectory(string packageName, string packageVersion)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("YooAsset package name is empty.");
        }

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageVersion))
        {
            return GetLatestRealVersionDirectory(packageName);
        }

        string versionPath = GetPackageVersionOutputPath(packageName, packageVersion);
        if (!Directory.Exists(versionPath) || IsSimulateDirectory(versionPath))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"YooAsset package version output not found: {versionPath}");
        }

        return versionPath;
    }

    public static string GetLatestRealVersionDirectory(string packageName)
    {
        string packagePath = GetPackageOutputRoot(packageName);
        if (!Directory.Exists(packagePath))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"YooAsset package output not found: {packagePath}");
        }

        string latest = Directory.GetDirectories(packagePath)
            .Where(dir => !IsSimulateDirectory(dir))
            .OrderByDescending(Directory.GetLastWriteTimeUtc)
            .FirstOrDefault();

        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(latest))
        {
            throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"YooAsset package version output not found: {packagePath}");
        }

        return latest;
    }

    private static string GetPackageOutputRoot(string packageName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(packageName))
        {
            throw new InvalidOperationException("YooAsset package name is empty.");
        }

        return Path.Combine(BundleBuilderHelper.GetDefaultBuildOutputRoot(), YooAssetConfigs.GetPlatformName(), packageName);
    }

    private static string ResolveBuildOutputRoot(string outputRoot)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(outputRoot))
        {
            return BundleBuilderHelper.GetDefaultBuildOutputRoot();
        }

        return Path.IsPathRooted(outputRoot)
            ? Path.GetFullPath(outputRoot).Replace('\\', '/')
            : Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", outputRoot)).Replace('\\', '/');
    }

    private static string ResolveBuildinFileRoot(string buildinFileRoot)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(buildinFileRoot))
        {
            return BundleBuilderHelper.GetStreamingAssetsRoot();
        }

        return Path.IsPathRooted(buildinFileRoot)
            ? Path.GetFullPath(buildinFileRoot).Replace('\\', '/')
            : Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(Application.dataPath, "..", buildinFileRoot)).Replace('\\', '/');
    }

    private static string GetPackageVersionOutputPath(string packageName, string packageVersion)
    {
        return Path.Combine(GetPackageOutputRoot(packageName), packageVersion);
    }

    private static bool IsSimulateDirectory(string path)
    {
        return string.Equals(Path.GetFileName(path), "Simulate", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
    }
}
````

#if UNITY_EDITOR

using System;

using ExcelDataReader;
using Newtonsoft.Json;

using UnityEngine;

//  | 注释 | 角色ID | 名字 | 稀有度 | 生命 | 攻击 | 头像地址 |
//  |---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
//  | 字段名 | id | name | rarity | hp | atk | avatarAddress |
//  | 类型 | int | string | string | int | int | string |
//  | 数据 | 1001 | 绯樱 | SSR | 1200 | 300 | icon_1001 |
//  | 数据 | 1002 | 白羽 | SR | 900 | 220 | icon_1002 |

// 第 1 行：中文注释
// 第 2 行：字段名，必须和 C# 字段名一致
// 第 3 行：字段类型，可写可不完全依赖，主要用于给策划看
// 第 4 行开始：正式数据

//

// List<long>
// List<float>
// List<double>
// List<string>
// 
// enum
// 
// 复杂对象 JSON    [{"id":1,"count":10}]

/// <summary>
/// 配置输出类型。
/// </summary>
public enum ConfigOutputType
{
    Json,
    ScriptableObject
}

/// <summary>
/// 单张配置表导出定义。
/// 用于一键导出全部配置。
/// </summary>
public class ConfigExportDefine
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Excel 文件路径。
    /// 可以是绝对路径，也可以是相对于项目根目录的路径。
    /// 例如：
    /// ../Configs/Excel/Character.xlsx
    /// D:/Project/Configs/Excel/Character.xlsx
    /// </summary>
    public string excelPath;

    /// <summary>
    /// Sheet 名。
    /// 如果为空，则默认读取第一个可用 Sheet。
    /// </summary>

    /// </summary>

    /// <summary>

    /// <summary>
    /// 输出目录。
    /// JSON 可以是绝对路径或 Assets 下路径。

/// <summary>

/// 实际项目中，建议把所有配置表都注册在这里，
