/// <summary>
/// 通用 Excel 配置导出器。
/// 
/// 功能：
/// 1. Excel -> List<TConfig>
/// 2. 自动字段映射
/// 3. 自动类型转换
/// 4. 自动 id 重复校验
/// 5. 调用每行配置的 Validate
/// 6. 导出 JSON
/// 7. 导出 ScriptableObject
/// </summary>
public static class ExcelConfigExporter
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 第几行是字段名。
    /// 0 表示 Excel 第一行。
    /// 当前约定：第二行是字段名。
    /// </summary>
    private const int FieldNameRow = 1;

    /// <summary>
    /// 第几行是字段类型。
    /// 当前约定：第三行是字段类型。
    /// </summary>
    private const int FieldTypeRow = 2;

    /// <summary>
    /// 第几行开始是数据。
    /// 当前约定：第四行开始是数据。
    /// </summary>
    private const int DataStartRow = 3;

    /// <summary>
    /// 导出 Excel 为 JSON。
    /// </summary>
    public static List<TConfig> ExportToJson<TConfig>(
        string excelPath,
        string sheetName,
        string outputDir
    )
        where TConfig : IConfigRow, new()
    {
        excelPath = NormalizeExcelPath(excelPath);
        outputDir = NormalizeOutputDir(outputDir);

        List<TConfig> rows = ReadExcelSheet<TConfig>(excelPath, sheetName);

        string tableName = typeof(TConfig).Name;
        ValidateRows(rows, tableName);

        if (!Directory.Exists(outputDir))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);
        }

        string outputPath = Path.Combine(outputDir, tableName + ".json");
        outputPath = outputPath.Replace("\\", "/");

        string json = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(rows, Formatting.Indented);
        File.WriteAllText(outputPath, json, new UTF8Encoding(false));

        AssetDatabase.Refresh();

        Debug.LogFormat("导出 JSON 成功：{0}，数量：{1}", outputPath, rows.Count);

        return rows;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 导出 Excel 为 ScriptableObject。
    /// 
    /// 要求：
    /// TAsset 里必须有一个 public 字段：
    /// public List<TConfig> items;
    /// </summary>
    public static TAsset ExportToScriptableObject<TConfig, TAsset>(
        string excelPath,
        string sheetName,
        string outputDir
    )
        where TConfig : IConfigRow, new()
        where TAsset : ScriptableObject
    {
        excelPath = NormalizeExcelPath(excelPath);
        outputDir = NormalizeOutputDir(outputDir);

        if (!outputDir.StartsWith("Assets"))
        {
            throw new Exception("导出 ScriptableObject 时，输出目录必须在 Assets 下，例如：Assets/Game/Configs/SO");
        }

        List<TConfig> rows = ReadExcelSheet<TConfig>(excelPath, sheetName);

        string tableName = typeof(TConfig).Name;
        ValidateRows(rows, tableName);

        if (!Directory.Exists(outputDir))
        {
            Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);
        }

        string assetPath = Path.Combine(outputDir, typeof(TAsset).Name + ".asset");
        assetPath = assetPath.Replace("\\", "/");

        TAsset asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TAsset>(assetPath);

        if (asset == null)
        {
            asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<TAsset>();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(asset, assetPath);
        }

        FieldInfo itemsField = typeof(TAsset).GetField(
            "items",
            BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance
        );

        if (itemsField == null)
        {
            throw new Exception(typeof(TAsset).Name + " 中找不到 public 字段 items");
        }

        Type requireType = typeof(List<TConfig>);

        if (itemsField.FieldType != requireType)
        {
            throw new Exception(string.Format(
                "{0}.items 类型错误。当前类型：{1}，需要类型：{2}",
                typeof(TAsset).Name,
                itemsField.FieldType.FullName,
                requireType.FullName
            ));
        }

        itemsField.SetValue(asset, rows);

        EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
        AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
        AssetDatabase.Refresh();

        Debug.LogFormat("导出 ScriptableObject 成功：{0}，数量：{1}", assetPath, rows.Count);

        return asset;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 读取 Excel 指定 Sheet，并转换成 List<TConfig>。
    /// 如果 sheetName 为空，则读取第一个不以 # 开头的 Sheet。
    /// </summary>
    public static List<TConfig> ReadExcelSheet<TConfig>(
        string excelPath,
        string sheetName
    )
        where TConfig : IConfigRow, new()
    {
        excelPath = NormalizeExcelPath(excelPath);

        if (!File.Exists(excelPath))
        {
            throw new FileNotFoundException("Excel 文件不存在：" + excelPath);
        }

        RegisterEncodingProvider();

        using (FileStream stream = File.Open(excelPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.ReadWrite))
        {
            using (IExcelDataReader reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream))
            {
                do
                {
                    string currentSheetName = reader.Name;

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentSheetName))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (currentSheetName.StartsWith("#"))
                    {
                        continue;
                    }

                    bool match;

                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sheetName))
                    {
                        match = true;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        match = string.Equals(currentSheetName, sheetName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                    }

                    if (match)
                    {
                        return ReadCurrentSheet<TConfig>(reader, excelPath, currentSheetName);
                    }
                }
                while (reader.NextResult());
            }
        }

        throw new Exception(string.Format("Excel 中找不到 Sheet：{0}，Excel：{1}", sheetName, excelPath));
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 读取当前 Sheet。
    /// </summary>
    private static List<TConfig> ReadCurrentSheet<TConfig>(
        IExcelDataReader reader,
        string excelPath,
        string sheetName
    )
        where TConfig : IConfigRow, new()
    {
        List<List<object>> table = new List<List<object>>();

        while (reader.Read())
        {
            List<object> row = new List<object>();

            for (int i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                row.Add(reader.GetValue(i));
            }

            table.Add(row);
        }

        if (table.Count <= DataStartRow)
        {
            throw new Exception(string.Format("Sheet 数据行不足：{0}/{1}", excelPath, sheetName));
        }

        List<object> fieldNameRow = table[FieldNameRow];
        List<object> fieldTypeRow = table[FieldTypeRow];

        Dictionary<string, FieldInfo> fieldMap = typeof(TConfig)
            .GetFields(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance)
            .ToDictionary(f => f.Name, f => f);

        List<TConfig> result = new List<TConfig>();

        for (int rowIndex = DataStartRow; rowIndex < table.Count; rowIndex++)
        {
            List<object> row = table[rowIndex];

            if (IsEmptyRow(row))
            {
                continue;
            }

            string firstCell = GetCellString(row, 0).Trim();

            // 如果第一列以 # 开头，整行跳过，用作注释行。
            if (firstCell.StartsWith("#"))
            {
                continue;
            }

            TConfig item = new TConfig();

            for (int colIndex = 0; colIndex < fieldNameRow.Count; colIndex++)
            {
                string fieldName = GetCellString(fieldNameRow, colIndex).Trim();
                string excelType = GetCellString(fieldTypeRow, colIndex).Trim();

                // 字段名为空，跳过该列。
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(fieldName))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                // 字段名以 # 开头，跳过该列。
                if (fieldName.StartsWith("#"))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                FieldInfo fieldInfo;

                if (!fieldMap.TryGetValue(fieldName, out fieldInfo))
                {
                    Debug.LogWarningFormat(
                        "Excel 字段在 C# 类型中不存在，已跳过。Excel：{0}，Sheet：{1}，字段：{2}，类型：{3}",
                        excelPath,
                        sheetName,
                        fieldName,
                        typeof(TConfig).Name
                    );

                    continue;
                }

                object rawValue = colIndex < row.Count ? row[colIndex] : null;

                try
                {
                    object value = ConvertCellValue(rawValue, fieldInfo.FieldType, excelType);
                    fieldInfo.SetValue(item, value);
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    throw new Exception(
                        string.Format(
                            "解析单元格失败：Excel：{0}，Sheet：{1}，行：{2}，列：{3}，字段：{4}，目标类型：{5}，原始值：{6}",
                            excelPath,
                            sheetName,
                            rowIndex + 1,
                            colIndex + 1,
                            fieldName,
                            fieldInfo.FieldType.Name,
                            rawValue
                        ),
                        e
                    );
                }
            }

            result.Add(item);
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 统一校验配置。
    /// </summary>
    public static void ValidateRows<TConfig>(
        List<TConfig> rows,
        string tableName
    )
        where TConfig : IConfigRow
    {
        ConfigValidateContext context = new ConfigValidateContext(tableName);

        HashSet<int> idSet = new HashSet<int>();

        for (int i = 0; i < rows.Count; i++)
        {
            TConfig row = rows[i];

            if (row == null)
            {
                context.Error(string.Format("第 {0} 行为空", i + 1));
                continue;
            }

            int id = row.GetId();

            if (id <= 0)
            {
                context.Error(string.Format("存在非法 id：{0}", id));
            }

            if (!idSet.Add(id))
            {
                context.Error(string.Format("id 重复：{0}", id));
            }

            row.Validate(context);
        }

        if (context.HasError)
        {
            throw new Exception("配置校验失败：" + tableName);
        }

        Debug.LogFormat("配置校验通过：{0}，数量：{1}", tableName, rows.Count);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 单元格值转换为目标字段类型。
    /// </summary>
    private static object ConvertCellValue(
        object rawValue,
        Type targetType,
        string excelType
    )
    {
        string value = rawValue == null ? "" : rawValue.ToString().Trim();

        // Nullable<T> 处理。
        Type nullableType = Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(targetType);

        if (nullableType != null)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
            {
                return null;
            }

            targetType = nullableType;
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(string))
        {
            return value;
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(int))
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? 0 : Convert.ToInt32(Convert.ToDouble(value));
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(long))
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? 0L : Convert.ToInt64(Convert.ToDouble(value));
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(float))
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? 0f : Convert.ToSingle(value);
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(double))
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) ? 0d : Convert.ToDouble(value);
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(bool))
        {
            return ParseBool(value);
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(int[]))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToInt32(Convert.ToDouble(s)));
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(long[]))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToInt64(Convert.ToDouble(s)));
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(float[]))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToSingle(s));
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(double[]))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToDouble(s));
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(string[]))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => s);
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(List<int>))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToInt32(Convert.ToDouble(s))).ToList();
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(List<long>))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToInt64(Convert.ToDouble(s))).ToList();
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(List<float>))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToSingle(s)).ToList();
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(List<double>))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => Convert.ToDouble(s)).ToList();
        }

        if (targetType == typeof(List<string>))
        {
            return ParseArray(value, s => s).ToList();
        }

        if (targetType.IsEnum)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
            {
                return Activator.CreateInstance(targetType);
            }

            return Enum.Parse(targetType, value, true);
        }

        // 复杂对象：允许 Excel 单元格里写 JSON。
        // 例如字段类型是 SomeData，单元格里写 {"a":1,"b":"xxx"}
        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
        {
            return JsonConvert.DeserializeObject(value, targetType);
        }

        if (targetType.IsValueType)
        {
            return Activator.CreateInstance(targetType);
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 解析数组。
    /// 支持英文逗号、中文逗号、分号、竖线分隔。
    /// 例如：
    /// 1,2,3
    /// 1，2，3
    /// 1;2;3
    /// 1|2|3
    /// </summary>
    private static T[] ParseArray<T>(string value, Func<string, T> parser)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            return new T[0];
        }

        string[] parts = value.Split(
            new[] { ',', '，', ';', '；', '|', '|' },
            StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries
        );

        T[] result = new T[parts.Length];

        for (int i = 0; i < parts.Length; i++)
        {
            result[i] = parser(parts[i].Trim());
        }

        return result;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 解析 bool。
    /// 支持：
    /// true / false
    /// 1 / 0
    /// yes / no
    /// y / n
    /// 是 / 否
    /// </summary>
    private static bool ParseBool(string value)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
        {
            return false;
        }

        value = value.Trim().ToLower();

        return value == "true"
               || value == "1"
               || value == "yes"
               || value == "y"
               || value == "是";
    }

    private static string GetCellString(List<object> row, int index)
    {
        if (row == null)
        {
            return "";
        }

        if (index < 0 || index >= row.Count)
        {
            return "";
        }

        return row[index] == null ? "" : row[index].ToString();
    }

    private static bool IsEmptyRow(List<object> row)
    {
        if (row == null || row.Count == 0)
        {
            return true;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < row.Count; i++)
        {
            object cell = row[i];

            if (cell != null && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(cell.ToString()))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 标准化 Excel 路径。
    /// 支持：
    /// 1. 绝对路径
    /// 2. 相对于项目根目录的路径，例如 ../Configs/Excel/Character.xlsx
    /// </summary>
    private static string NormalizeExcelPath(string path)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(path))
        {
            throw new Exception("Excel 路径为空");
        }

        path = path.Replace("\\", "/");

        if (Path.IsPathRooted(path))
        {
            return Path.GetFullPath(path).Replace("\\", "/");
        }

        string projectRoot = Directory.GetParent(Application.dataPath).FullName;
        string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(projectRoot, path));
        return fullPath.Replace("\\", "/");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 标准化输出目录。
    /// 如果是 Assets 开头，转成绝对路径给 File.WriteAllText 用。
    /// 
    /// 注意：
    /// ScriptableObject 导出需要 Assets 相对路径。
    /// 所以 SO 导出前会再次检查。
    /// </summary>
    private static string NormalizeOutputDir(string outputDir)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(outputDir))
        {
            throw new Exception("输出目录为空");
        }

        outputDir = outputDir.Replace("\\", "/");

        if (outputDir.StartsWith("Assets"))
        {
            return outputDir;
        }

        if (Path.IsPathRooted(outputDir))
        {
            return Path.GetFullPath(outputDir).Replace("\\", "/");
        }

        string projectRoot = Directory.GetParent(Application.dataPath).FullName;
        string fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(Path.Combine(projectRoot, outputDir));
        return fullPath.Replace("\\", "/");
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 注册编码。
    /// 
    /// CodePagesEncodingProvider 属于 System.Text.Encoding.CodePages 程序集，
    /// 有些 Unity 工程默认没有引用，所以这里用反射方式调用，避免编译报错。
    /// 
    /// 如果只读取 .xlsx，一般不需要这个。
    /// 如果需要读取老版 .xls，建议额外导入 System.Text.Encoding.CodePages.dll。
    /// </summary>
    private static void RegisterEncodingProvider()
    {
        try
        {
            Type providerType = Type.GetType(
                "System.Text.CodePagesEncodingProvider, System.Text.Encoding.CodePages"
                );

            if (providerType == null)
            {
                // 找不到说明当前工程没有 System.Text.Encoding.CodePages。
                // 只读 .xlsx 时通常没关系。
                Debug.LogWarning(
                    "未找到 System.Text.Encoding.CodePages。只读取 .xlsx 通常没问题；如果要读取 .xls，请导入 System.Text.Encoding.CodePages.dll。"
                    );
                return;
            }

            PropertyInfo instanceProperty = providerType.GetProperty(
                "Instance",
                BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static
                );

            if (instanceProperty == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance 获取失败。");
                return;
            }

            object providerInstance = instanceProperty.GetValue(null, null);

            MethodInfo registerMethod = typeof(Encoding).GetMethod(
                "RegisterProvider",
                BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static
                );

            if (registerMethod == null)
            {
                Debug.LogWarning("Encoding.RegisterProvider 方法不存在。");
                return;
            }

            registerMethod.Invoke(null, new object[] { providerInstance });
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogWarning("注册 CodePagesEncodingProvider 失败：" + e.Message);
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 配置导出菜单。
/// </summary>
public static class ConfigExportMenu
{
    [MenuItem("Tools/Config/打开通用配置导出窗口")]
    public static void OpenWindow()
    {
        ConfigExportWindow.Open();
    }

    [MenuItem("Tools/Config/一键导出全部配置")]
    public static void ExportAll()
    {
        int successCount = 0;
        int failCount = 0;

        foreach (ConfigExportDefine define in ConfigExportRegistry.Defines)
        {
            try
            {
                ExportByDefine(define);
                successCount++;
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                failCount++;
                Debug.LogErrorFormat(
                    "导出配置失败。Excel：{0}，Sheet：{1}，类型：{2}\n{3}",
                    define.excelPath,
                    define.sheetName,
                    define.configType != null ? define.configType.Name : "null",
                    e
                );
            }
        }

        AssetDatabase.Refresh();

        Debug.LogFormat("一键导出全部配置完成。成功：{0}，失败：{1}", successCount, failCount);

        if (failCount > 0)
        {
            throw new Exception("有配置导出失败，请查看 Console");
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 根据注册表定义导出。
    /// 因为泛型类型运行时才知道，所以这里用反射调用泛型方法。
    /// </summary>
    public static void ExportByDefine(ConfigExportDefine define)
    {
        if (define == null)
        {
            throw new ArgumentNullException("define");
        }

        if (define.configType == null)
        {
            throw new Exception("configType 为空");
        }

        if (!typeof(IConfigRow).IsAssignableFrom(define.configType))
        {
            throw new Exception("配置类型必须实现 IConfigRow：" + define.configType.FullName);
        }

        if (define.outputType == ConfigOutputType.Json)
        {
            MethodInfo method = typeof(ExcelConfigExporter)
                .GetMethod("ExportToJson", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static);

            MethodInfo genericMethod = method.MakeGenericMethod(define.configType);

            InvokeAndUnwrap(genericMethod, null, new object[]
            {
                define.excelPath,
                define.sheetName,
                define.outputDir
            });
        }
        else if (define.outputType == ConfigOutputType.ScriptableObject)
        {
            if (define.assetType == null)
            {
                throw new Exception("导出 ScriptableObject 时 assetType 不能为空");
            }

            if (!typeof(ScriptableObject).IsAssignableFrom(define.assetType))
            {
                throw new Exception("assetType 必须继承 ScriptableObject：" + define.assetType.FullName);
            }

            MethodInfo method = typeof(ExcelConfigExporter)
                .GetMethod("ExportToScriptableObject", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static);

            MethodInfo genericMethod = method.MakeGenericMethod(define.configType, define.assetType);

            InvokeAndUnwrap(genericMethod, null, new object[]
            {
                define.excelPath,
                define.sheetName,
                define.outputDir
            });
        }
        else
        {
            throw new Exception("不支持的输出类型：" + define.outputType);
        }
    }

    private static object InvokeAndUnwrap(MethodInfo method, object obj, object[] parameters)
    {
        try
        {
            return method.Invoke(obj, parameters);
        }
        catch (TargetInvocationException e)
        {
            if (e.InnerException != null)
            {
                throw e.InnerException;
            }

            throw;
        }
    }
}

/// <summary>
/// 通用配置导出窗口。
/// 
/// 用法：
/// Tools/Config/打开通用配置导出窗口
/// 
/// 输入：
/// 1. Excel 路径
/// 2. Sheet 名
/// 3. 配置类型名，例如 CharacterConfig
/// 4. 输出类型 Json / ScriptableObject
/// 5. 输出目录
/// 6. 如果导出 SO，额外输入 SO 类型名，例如 CharacterConfigAsset
/// </summary>
public class ConfigExportWindow : EditorWindow
{
    private string _excelPath = "";
    private string _sheetName = "";
    private string _configTypeName = "CharacterConfig";
    private string _assetTypeName = "CharacterConfigAsset";
    private ConfigOutputType _outputType = ConfigOutputType.Json;
    private string _outputDir = "Assets/Game/Configs/Json";

    public static void Open()
    {
        ConfigExportWindow window = GetWindow<ConfigExportWindow>("通用配置导出");
        window.minSize = new Vector2(650, 280);
        window.Show();
    }

    private void OnGUI()
    {
        EditorGUILayout.Space();

        EditorGUILayout.LabelField("通用 Excel 配置导出工具", EditorStyles.boldLabel);

        EditorGUILayout.Space();

        DrawExcelPath();

        _sheetName = EditorGUILayout.TextField(
            new GUIContent("Sheet 名", "如果为空，则读取第一个不以 # 开头的 Sheet"),
            _sheetName
        );

        _configTypeName = EditorGUILayout.TextField(
            new GUIContent("配置类型名", "例如 CharacterConfig"),
            _configTypeName
        );

        _outputType = (ConfigOutputType)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup(
            new GUIContent("输出类型"),
            _outputType
        );

        if (_outputType == ConfigOutputType.ScriptableObject)
        {
            _assetTypeName = EditorGUILayout.TextField(
                new GUIContent("SO 类型名", "例如 CharacterConfigAsset"),
                _assetTypeName
            );
        }

        DrawOutputDir();

        EditorGUILayout.Space();

        EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(
            "Excel 表格约定：\n" +
            "第 1 行：中文注释\n" +
            "第 2 行：字段名，必须和 C# public 字段名一致\n" +
            "第 3 行：字段类型\n" +
            "第 4 行开始：正式数据\n\n" +
            "如果导出 ScriptableObject，SO 类型中必须有 public List<TConfig> items 字段。",
            MessageType.Info
        );

        EditorGUILayout.Space();

        if (GUILayout.Button("导出当前配置", GUILayout.Height(35)))
        {
            ExportCurrent();
        }

        EditorGUILayout.Space();

        if (GUILayout.Button("一键导出注册表中的全部配置", GUILayout.Height(28)))
        {
            ConfigExportMenu.ExportAll();
        }
    }

    private void DrawExcelPath()
    {
        EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

        _excelPath = EditorGUILayout.TextField(
            new GUIContent("Excel 路径"),
            _excelPath
        );

        if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(70)))
        {
            string path = EditorUtility.OpenFilePanel("选择 Excel 文件", "", "xlsx,xls");

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                _excelPath = path.Replace("\\", "/");
            }
        }

        EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
    }

    private void DrawOutputDir()
    {
        EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();

        _outputDir = EditorGUILayout.TextField(
            new GUIContent("输出目录"),
            _outputDir
        );

        if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(70)))
        {
            string defaultPath = Application.dataPath;

            string path = EditorUtility.OpenFolderPanel("选择输出目录", defaultPath, "");

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
            {
                path = path.Replace("\\", "/");

                // 如果选择的是 Assets 内目录，自动转换为 Assets/xxx 相对路径。
                if (path.StartsWith(Application.dataPath))
                {
                    _outputDir = "Assets" + path.Substring(Application.dataPath.Length);
                }
                else
                {
                    _outputDir = path;
                }
            }
        }

        EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
    }

    private void ExportCurrent()
    {
        try
        {
            Type configType = FindType(_configTypeName);

            if (configType == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("找不到配置类型：" + _configTypeName);
                return;
            }

            if (!typeof(IConfigRow).IsAssignableFrom(configType))
            {
                Debug.LogError("配置类型必须实现 IConfigRow：" + configType.FullName);
                return;
            }

            ConfigExportDefine define = new ConfigExportDefine
            {
                excelPath = _excelPath,
                sheetName = _sheetName,
                configType = configType,
                outputType = _outputType,
                outputDir = _outputDir
            };

            if (_outputType == ConfigOutputType.ScriptableObject)
            {
                Type assetType = FindType(_assetTypeName);

                if (assetType == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogError("找不到 SO 类型：" + _assetTypeName);
                    return;
                }

                if (!typeof(ScriptableObject).IsAssignableFrom(assetType))
                {
                    Debug.LogError("SO 类型必须继承 ScriptableObject：" + assetType.FullName);
                    return;
                }

                define.assetType = assetType;
            }

            ConfigExportMenu.ExportByDefine(define);

            Debug.Log("当前配置导出完成");
        }
        catch (Exception e)
        {
            Debug.LogError("导出失败：\n" + e);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 根据类型名查找类型。
    /// 支持：
    /// 1. 完整命名空间类型名
    /// 2. 简短类型名
    /// </summary>
    private static Type FindType(string typeName)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(typeName))
        {
            return null;
        }

        Assembly[] assemblies = AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies();

        // 先尝试完整类型名。
        for (int i = 0; i < assemblies.Length; i++)
        {
            Type type = assemblies[i].GetType(typeName);

            if (type != null)
            {
                return type;
            }
        }

        // 再尝试短类型名。
        for (int i = 0; i < assemblies.Length; i++)
        {
            Type[] types;

            try
            {
                types = assemblies[i].GetTypes();
            }
            catch (ReflectionTypeLoadException e)
            {
                types = e.Types.Where(t => t != null).ToArray();
            }

            for (int j = 0; j < types.Length; j++)
            {
                Type type = types[j];

                if (type != null && type.Name == typeName)
                {
                    return type;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}

#endif
````

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFrameFsmDiagnosticsWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private readonly List<FsmDebugInfo> _debugInfos = new List<FsmDebugInfo>();
        private Vector2 _scroll;
        private string _filter;

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Diagnostics/FSM Diagnostics")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            GetWindow<FRFrameFsmDiagnosticsWindow>("FSM Diagnostics");
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            _filter = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Filter", _filter);
            if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh"))
                Repaint();

            if (!Application.isPlaying)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("FSM diagnostics are available in Play Mode.", MessageType.Info);
                return;
            }

            FsmManager manager = FRFM.Fsm;
            FsmManagerStatistics statistics = manager.GetStatistics();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Active", statistics.ActiveCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Total Created", statistics.TotalCreated.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Total Disposed", statistics.TotalDisposed.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Total Auto Removed", statistics.TotalAutoRemoved.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Task FSM", statistics.TaskFsmCount.ToString());

            manager.GetAllDebugInfo(_debugInfos);
            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            for (int i = 0; i < _debugInfos.Count; i++)
            {
                FsmDebugInfo info = _debugInfos[i];
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_filter) && !ContainsFilter(info))
                    continue;

                EditorGUILayout.BeginVertical("box");
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(info.Name, EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Type", info.TypeName ?? string.Empty);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Owner", $"{info.OwnerName} {info.OwnerTypeName}");
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Current State", info.CurrentStateName ?? string.Empty);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Run Time", info.RunTime.ToString("F2"));
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("State Count", info.StateCount.ToString());
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Paused", info.IsPaused.ToString());
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Task", info.IsTask.ToString());
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Task State", info.TaskState.ToString());
                DrawList("States", info.StateNames);
                DrawList("Blackboard", info.BlackboardKeys);
                DrawHistory(info.StateHistory);
                EditorGUILayout.EndVertical();
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }

        private bool ContainsFilter(FsmDebugInfo info)
        {
            return (info.Name != null && info.Name.IndexOf(_filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0) ||
                   (info.TypeName != null && info.TypeName.IndexOf(_filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0) ||
                   (info.OwnerName != null && info.OwnerName.IndexOf(_filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0) ||
                   (info.CurrentStateName != null && info.CurrentStateName.IndexOf(_filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
        }

        private static void DrawList(string title, IReadOnlyList<string> values)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(title, EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            if (values == null)
                return;

            for (int i = 0; i < values.Count; i++)
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("  ", values[i]);
        }

        private static void DrawHistory(IReadOnlyList<FsmStateChangeRecord> records)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("State History", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            if (records == null)
                return;

            for (int i = 0; i < records.Count; i++)
            {
                FsmStateChangeRecord record = records[i];
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"  {record.Frame}", $"{record.FromState} -> {record.ToState} @ {record.Time:F2}");
            }
        }
    }

using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public sealed class FRFrameRuntimeDiagnosticsWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private int _tab;
        private Vector2 _scroll;
        private string _filter;

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Diagnostics/Runtime Diagnostics")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            GetWindow<FRFrameRuntimeDiagnosticsWindow>("FRFrame Diagnostics");
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            _tab = GUILayout.Toolbar(_tab, new[] { "Resource", "Packages", "GameObject Pools", "Object Pools", "Reference Pools", "Warnings" });
            _filter = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Filter", _filter);

            if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh"))
                Repaint();

            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            switch (_tab)
            {
                case 0:
                    DrawResourceAssets();
                    break;
                case 1:
                    DrawPackages();
                    break;
                case 2:
                    DrawGameObjectPools();
                    break;
                case 3:
                    DrawObjectPools();
                    break;
                case 4:
                    DrawReferencePools();
                    break;
                case 5:
                    DrawWarnings();
                    break;
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }

        private void DrawResourceAssets()
        {
            var resource = FRFM.Resource;
            if (resource == null || resource.Diagnostics == null) return;
            var assets = resource.Diagnostics.GetAssetSnapshots();
            for (int i = 0; i < assets.Count; i++)
            {
                var asset = assets[i];
                if (!PassFilter(asset.Key.ToString())) continue;
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(asset.Key.ToString(), $"Ref:{asset.RefCount} {asset.State} {asset.Residency}");
            }
        }

        private void DrawPackages()
        {
            var resource = FRFM.Resource;
            if (resource == null) return;
            var packages = resource.GetAllPackageInfos();
            for (int i = 0; i < packages.Count; i++)
            {
                var package = packages[i];
                if (!PassFilter(package.PackageName)) continue;
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(package.PackageName, $"{package.State} Default:{package.IsDefaultPackage} Version:{package.Version}");
            }
        }

        private void DrawGameObjectPools()
        {
            var pool = FRFM.Pool?.GameObjectPool;
            if (pool == null) return;
            var buckets = pool.GetBucketSnapshots();
            for (int i = 0; i < buckets.Count; i++)
            {
                var bucket = buckets[i];
                if (!PassFilter(bucket.Key.ToString())) continue;
                EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(bucket.Key.ToString(), $"Inactive:{bucket.InactiveCount} Max:{bucket.MaxInactiveCount}");
                if (GUILayout.Button("Clear", GUILayout.Width(60))) pool.Clear(bucket.Key);
                EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            }
        }

        private void DrawObjectPools()
        {
            var objectPool = FRFM.Pool?.ObjectPool;
            if (objectPool == null) return;
            var snapshots = objectPool.GetSnapshots();
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshots.Count; i++)
            {
                var snapshot = snapshots[i];
                if (!PassFilter(snapshot.Name)) continue;
                EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(snapshot.Name, $"Active:{snapshot.CountActive} Inactive:{snapshot.CountInactive} Hit:{snapshot.HitCount} Miss:{snapshot.MissCount}");
                if (GUILayout.Button("Clear", GUILayout.Width(60))) objectPool.ClearPool(snapshot.Name);
                EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            }
        }

        private void DrawReferencePools()
        {
            var referencePool = FRFM.Pool?.ReferencePool;
            if (referencePool == null) return;
            var snapshots = referencePool.GetSnapshots();
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshots.Count; i++)
            {
                var snapshot = snapshots[i];
                string name = snapshot.Type != null ? snapshot.Type.FullName : string.Empty;
                if (!PassFilter(name)) continue;
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(name, $"Cached:{snapshot.CachedCount} Max:{snapshot.MaxCachedCount}");
            }
        }

        private void DrawWarnings()
        {
            var resource = FRFM.Resource;
            if (resource == null || resource.Diagnostics == null) return;
            var warnings = resource.Diagnostics.CreateSnapshot().Warnings;
            for (int i = 0; i < warnings.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!PassFilter(warnings[i])) continue;
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(warnings[i], MessageType.Warning);
            }
        }

        private bool PassFilter(string text)
        {
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(_filter) || (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && text.ToLower().Contains(_filter.ToLower()));
        }
    }
}
#endif

#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Callbacks;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public static class FRLogConsoleRedirector
    {
        private static readonly Regex StackRegex = new Regex(@"\(at (?<path>.+\.cs):(?<line>\d+)\)", RegexOptions.Compiled);
        private static bool _isRedirecting;

        [OnOpenAsset(0)]
        public static bool OnOpenAsset(int instanceId, int line)
        {
            if (_isRedirecting)
            {
                return false;
            }

            string stackTrace = GetConsoleStackTrace();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(stackTrace) || !stackTrace.Contains("FRFrame"))
            {
                return false;
            }

            MatchCollection matches = StackRegex.Matches(stackTrace);
            foreach (Match match in matches)
            {
                string path = match.Groups["path"].Value.Replace('\\', '/');
                if (IsLogInfrastructurePath(path))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (!int.TryParse(match.Groups["line"].Value, out int targetLine))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                string assetPath = ToAssetPath(path);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(assetPath))
                {
                    UnityEngine.Object asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.Object>(assetPath);
                    if (asset != null)
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            _isRedirecting = true;
                            AssetDatabase.OpenAsset(asset, targetLine);
                        }
                        finally
                        {
                            _isRedirecting = false;
                        }

                        return true;
                    }
                }
            }

            return false;
        }

        private static string GetConsoleStackTrace()
        {
            Type consoleWindowType = typeof(EditorWindow).Assembly.GetType("UnityEditor.ConsoleWindow");
            EditorWindow consoleWindow = EditorWindow.focusedWindow;
            if (consoleWindow == null || consoleWindow.GetType() != consoleWindowType)
            {
                return null;
            }

            object activeText = consoleWindowType.GetField("m_ActiveText", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic)?.GetValue(consoleWindow);
            return activeText as string;
        }

        private static bool IsLogInfrastructurePath(string path)
        {
            string fileName = Path.GetFileName(path);
            return fileName == "FRLog.cs"
                || fileName == "FRLogger.cs"
                || fileName == "UnityFRLogHandler.cs"
                || fileName == "FileFRLogHandler.cs"
                || fileName == "FRLogStackTraceUtility.cs";
        }

        private static string ToAssetPath(string path)
        {
            string projectRoot = Directory.GetParent(UnityEngine.Application.dataPath).FullName.Replace('\\', '/');
            if (path.StartsWith(projectRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return path.Substring(projectRoot.Length + 1);
            }

            if (path.StartsWith("Assets/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || path.StartsWith("Packages/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                return path;
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Build;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    public static class FRLogScriptingDefineSymbols
    {
        private static readonly string[] LogDefines =
        {
            FRLogDefineSymbols.EnableLog,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.Debug,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.Info,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.Warning,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.Error,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.Fatal,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.DebugAndAbove,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.InfoAndAbove,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.WarningAndAbove,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.ErrorAndAbove,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.FatalAndAbove,
            FRLogDefineSymbols.File
        };

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Disable All Logs")]
        public static void DisableAllLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines();
        }

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Enable All Logs")]
        public static void EnableAllLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines(FRLogDefineSymbols.EnableLog);
        }

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Enable Debug And Above Logs")]
        public static void EnableDebugAndAboveLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines(FRLogDefineSymbols.DebugAndAbove);
        }

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Enable Info And Above Logs")]
        public static void EnableInfoAndAboveLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines(FRLogDefineSymbols.InfoAndAbove);
        }

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Enable Warning And Above Logs")]
        public static void EnableWarningAndAboveLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines(FRLogDefineSymbols.WarningAndAbove);
        }

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Enable Error And Above Logs")]
        public static void EnableErrorAndAboveLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines(FRLogDefineSymbols.ErrorAndAbove);
        }

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Log/Enable Fatal And Above Logs")]
        public static void EnableFatalAndAboveLogs()
        {
            SetLogDefines(FRLogDefineSymbols.FatalAndAbove);
        }

        public static void SetLogDefines(params string[] targetDefines)
        {
            NamedBuildTarget namedBuildTarget = NamedBuildTarget.FromBuildTargetGroup(EditorUserBuildSettings.selectedBuildTargetGroup);
            HashSet<string> defines = ReadDefines(namedBuildTarget);
            RemoveLogDefines(defines);
            foreach (string define in targetDefines)
            {
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(define))
                {
                    defines.Add(define);
                }
            }

            PlayerSettings.SetScriptingDefineSymbols(namedBuildTarget, string.Join(";", defines.OrderBy(value => value)));
        }

        public static HashSet<string> ReadDefines(NamedBuildTarget namedBuildTarget)
        {
            string current = PlayerSettings.GetScriptingDefineSymbols(namedBuildTarget);
            return new HashSet<string>(current.Split(';').Select(value => value.Trim()).Where(value => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)));
        }

        public static void RemoveLogDefines(HashSet<string> defines)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < LogDefines.Length; i++)
            {
                defines.Remove(LogDefines[i]);
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif

            if (!Application.isPlaying || FRFM.Save == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Save Diagnostics is available in Play Mode.", MessageType.Info);
                return;
            }

            SaveDiagnosticsSnapshot snapshot = FRFM.Save.CreateSnapshot();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Summary", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Root Path", snapshot.RootPath ?? string.Empty);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Cache Count", snapshot.CacheCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Dirty Count", snapshot.DirtyCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Save Failure Count", snapshot.SaveFailureCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Load Failure Count", snapshot.LoadFailureCount.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Backup Restore Count", snapshot.BackupRestoreCount.ToString());

            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if (GUILayout.Button("Flush"))
                FRFM.Save.FlushAsync().Forget();
            if (GUILayout.Button("Open Folder") && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(snapshot.RootPath))
                EditorUtility.RevealInFinder(snapshot.RootPath);
            if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh"))
                Repaint();
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();

            EditorGUILayout.Space(8f);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Dirty Items", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            for (int i = 0; i < snapshot.DirtyItems.Count; i++)
            {
                SaveDirtySnapshot item = snapshot.DirtyItems[i];
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(item.Key.ToString(), item.TypeName);
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.UIElements;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FRFrame.Editor
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 一些静态 helper。
    /// 
    /// 单独抽成 helper，便于：
    /// 1. Window / Validator / 其他工具类复用
    /// 2. 后续继续拆分时避免重复代码
    /// </summary>
    public static class UIConfigEditorWindowHelper
    {
        public static string ConvertAssetPathToResourcesRuntimePath(string assetPath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assetPath))
                return null;

            return assetPath.Replace("\\", "/");
        }

        public static string TryLoadPrefabAtRuntimeStylePath(string runtimePath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(runtimePath))
                return null;

            string normalized = runtimePath.Replace("\\", "/");
            GameObject prefab = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(normalized);
            return prefab != null ? normalized : null;
        }

        public static string FindBestRuntimeAssetPathByName(string prefabName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(prefabName))
                return null;

            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets($"{prefabName} t:Prefab");
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid).Replace("\\", "/");
                return path;
            }

            return null;
        }

        public static string GuessNameFromAssetPath(string assetPath)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(assetPath))
                return null;

            return Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(assetPath.Replace("\\", "/"));
        }

        public static string GetShortTypeName(string typeName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(typeName))
                return null;

            int idx = typeName.LastIndexOf('.');
            return idx >= 0 ? typeName.Substring(idx + 1) : typeName;
        }

        public static Type FindTypeByName(string typeName)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(typeName))
                return null;

            Type type = Type.GetType(typeName);
            if (type != null)
                return type;

            foreach (Assembly assembly in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies())
            {
                try
                {
                    type = assembly.GetType(typeName);
                    if (type != null)
                        return type;
                }
                catch
                {
                }
            }

            foreach (Assembly assembly in AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies())
            {
                Type[] types;
                try
                {
                    types = assembly.GetTypes();
                }
                catch
                {
                    continue;
                }

                foreach (Type t in types)
                {
                    if (t.Name == typeName)
                        return t;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        public static string TryFindTypeFullName(string shortTypeName)
        {
            Type type = FindTypeByName(shortTypeName);
            return type?.FullName;
        }

        public static bool ContainsIgnoreCase(string src, string key)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(src) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(key))
                return false;

            return src.IndexOf(key, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
        }

        public static void EnsureFolderExists(string folderPath)
        {
            folderPath = folderPath.Replace("\\", "/");
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(folderPath))
                return;

            string[] parts = folderPath.Split('/');
            string current = parts[0];
            for (int i = 1; i < parts.Length; i++)
            {
                string next = $"{current}/{parts[i]}";
                if (!AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(next))
                {
                    AssetDatabase.CreateFolder(current, parts[i]);
                }

                current = next;
            }
        }
    }

        private void EnsureUnconfiguredToolbar()
        {
            if (_unconfiguredListView == null || _unconfiguredListView.parent == null)
                return;

            VisualElement parent = _unconfiguredListView.parent;

            if (parent.Q<VisualElement>("unconfigured-extra-toolbar") != null)
                return;

            VisualElement toolbar = new VisualElement
            {
                name = "unconfigured-extra-toolbar"
            };
            toolbar.style.flexDirection = FlexDirection.Row;
            toolbar.style.alignItems = Align.Center;
            toolbar.style.marginTop = 4;
            toolbar.style.marginBottom = 4;

            _unconfiguredOnlyWithPrefabToggle = new Toggle("仅显示有同名Prefab")
            {
                value = _unconfiguredOnlyWithPrefab
            };
            _unconfiguredOnlyWithPrefabToggle.RegisterValueChangedCallback(evt =>
            {
                _unconfiguredOnlyWithPrefab = evt.newValue;
                RefreshUnconfiguredListView();
            });

            _addSelectedUnconfiguredButton = new Button(AddSelectedUnconfiguredToCurrentGroup)
            {
                text = "加入选中项"
            };
            _addSelectedUnconfiguredButton.style.marginLeft = 8;

            Button clearSelectionButton = new Button(() =>
                {
                    _selectedUnconfiguredTypes.Clear();
                    _unconfiguredListView?.ClearSelection();
                    RefreshStatusLabel();
                })
                {
                    text = "清空选择"
                };
            clearSelectionButton.style.marginLeft = 4;

            toolbar.Add(_unconfiguredOnlyWithPrefabToggle);
            toolbar.Add(_addSelectedUnconfiguredButton);
            toolbar.Add(clearSelectionButton);

            int listIndex = parent.IndexOf(_unconfiguredListView);
            if (listIndex >= 0)
                parent.Insert(listIndex, toolbar);
            else
                parent.Add(toolbar);
        }

        {
            if (_groupSearchField != null)
            {
                _groupSearchField.RegisterValueChangedCallback(evt =>
                {
                    _groupSearch = evt.newValue ?? string.Empty;
                    RefreshGroupListView();
                });
