````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Stable first blocking condition for one granted ability.</summary>
    public enum GameplayAbilityBlockReason
    {
        None, InvalidHandle, AlreadyActive, MissingRequiredTag, BlockedByTag,
        BlockedByAbility, Cost, NoCharges, Cooldown, AlreadyPreparing
    }

    /// <summary>Read-only activation and timing snapshot. Charge values are zero for normal-cooldown abilities.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayAbilityStatus
    {
        public GameplayAbilityBlockReason BlockReason { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityPhase Phase { get; }
        public bool CanActivate => BlockReason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None;
        public int CurrentCharges { get; }
        public int MaxCharges { get; }
        public float RechargeRemaining { get; }
        public float RechargeDuration { get; }
        public float CooldownRemaining { get; }
        public float CooldownDuration { get; }

        public GameplayAbilityStatus(GameplayAbilityBlockReason blockReason, int currentCharges, int maxCharges,
            float rechargeRemaining, float rechargeDuration, float cooldownRemaining, float cooldownDuration,
            GameplayAbilityPhase phase = GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive)
        {
            BlockReason = blockReason;
            Phase = phase;
            CurrentCharges = currentCharges;
            MaxCharges = maxCharges;
            RechargeRemaining = rechargeRemaining;
            RechargeDuration = rechargeDuration;
            CooldownRemaining = cooldownRemaining;
            CooldownDuration = cooldownDuration;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// 管理一个 Owner 已 Grant Ability 的显式激活与 Charge 生命周期；不读取 Unity 时间、不推进 Effect。
    /// 主路径绑定 IGameplayAbilityHost；调用方保证它的 Tags、Effects 与来源分配器同属一个运行域。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityContainer
    {
        private readonly IGameplayAbilityHost _host;
        private readonly GameplayTagContainer _ownerTags;
        private readonly GameplayEffectContainer _ownerEffects;
        private readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator _sourceIdAllocator;
        private readonly object _handleOwner = new object();
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplayAbilityHandle, Entry> _entries =
            new Dictionary<GameplayAbilityHandle, Entry>();
        private long _lastSequence;
        private bool _activationCommitInProgress;
        private readonly Dictionary<IDisposable, Entry> _lifetimeOwners = new Dictionary<IDisposable, Entry>(LifetimeComparer.Instance);
        private readonly HashSet<GameplayEffectHandle> _cleanupEffects = new HashSet<GameplayEffectHandle>();
        private readonly HashSet<GameplayEffectLayerHandle> _cleanupLayers = new HashSet<GameplayEffectLayerHandle>();
        /// <summary>Container-scoped synchronous notification after all cleanup attempts; it is not authored continuation.</summary>
        public event Action<GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation> Terminated;
        /// <summary>Latest terminated scope in this container, retained after grant removal.</summary>
        public GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation LastTermination { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// 绑定 Owner 的标签、Effect 与运行域来源分配器；验证 owner 身份和 AttributeSet。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayAbilityContainer(IGameplayAbilityHost host,
            GameplaySourceIdAllocator sourceIdAllocator)
        {
            _host = host ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (!host.OwnerId.IsValid || host.TargetId != host.OwnerId)
                throw new ArgumentException("Ability host must have matching valid owner and target IDs.", nameof(host));
            _ownerTags = host.Tags ?? throw new ArgumentException("Host tags are required.", nameof(host));
            _ownerEffects = host.Effects ?? throw new ArgumentException("Host effects are required.", nameof(host));
            if (!ReferenceEquals(host.Attributes, _ownerEffects.TargetAttributes))
                throw new ArgumentException("Host attributes must belong to its Effect container.", nameof(host));
            _sourceIdAllocator = sourceIdAllocator ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sourceIdAllocator));
        }

        /// <summary>Verifies a borrowed host/domain binding without exposing mutable container internals.</summary>
        public bool IsBoundTo(IGameplayAbilityHost host, GameplaySourceIdAllocator allocator) =>
            ReferenceEquals(_host, host) && ReferenceEquals(_sourceIdAllocator, allocator);

        /// <summary>
        /// 授予一份 Ability Definition 并返回本容器内唯一 Handle。
        /// 同一个 Definition 可以多次 Grant，每份授权拥有独立活动状态。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayAbilityHandle Grant(GameplayAbilityDefinition definition, int level = 1)
        {
            if (definition == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if (level < 1 || level > definition.MaxLevel) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(level));

            long sequence = checked(_lastSequence + 1);
            var handle = new GameplayAbilityHandle(_handleOwner, sequence);
            _entries.Add(handle, new Entry(definition, handle, level));
            _lastSequence = sequence;
            return handle;
        }

        /// <summary>Reads the current grant level without evaluating eligibility, costs or allocating
        /// a diagnostic snapshot. Foreign, removed and default handles return false and level zero.</summary>
        public bool TryGetLevel(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, out int level)
        {
            if (_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry)) { level = entry.Level; return true; }
            level = 0;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>Changes an inactive grant within its definition's level range. Active/preparing grants
        /// reject upgrades so an in-flight execution cannot silently change level.</summary>
        public bool TrySetLevel(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, int level)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry) || entry.Phase != GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive ||
                entry.Committing || entry.Activating || level < 1 || level > entry.Definition.MaxLevel) return false;
            entry.Level = level;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Creates a detached cast/child context from an active grant. Level and activation source
        /// are captured once; later End/Upgrade does not rewrite this snapshot.</summary>
        public bool TryCreateExecutionContext(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, GameplayTargetData target,
            out GameplayContext context)
        {
            context = null;
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry) || !entry.IsActive) return false;
            context = new GameplayContext(_host.OwnerId, target, entry.ActivationSourceId,
                entry.ActiveContext?.Values, entry.Level);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 移除一份已 Grant Ability，摘除 Grant 后完整清理 Preparing/Active 的 owned scope；
        /// 已开始的冷却 Effect 不会因此移除。无效、外部容器或已移除 Handle 返回 false。
        /// </summary>
        public bool Remove(GameplayAbilityHandle handle)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry))
                return false;

            if(entry.Activating&&!entry.IsActive)return false;

            _entries.Remove(handle); // Detach the grant before external cleanup can reenter.
            if (entry.Phase != GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive)
                FinishActivation(entry, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Removed);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 查询当前是否可以激活：Handle 必须仍被本容器拥有、当前非 Active、满足全部 RequiredTags，
        /// 且不命中 BlockedTag、Charge 耗尽或 Cooldown Effect 的 GrantedTag。标签使用层级查询。
        /// </summary>
        public bool CanActivate(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => GetStatus(handle).CanActivate;

        /// <summary>
        /// 按 Active、required、blocked、active Ability relation、Cost、Charge、Cooldown 的固定优先级
        /// 返回首个阻止原因，同时保留此 Grant 的充能/冷却快照。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayAbilityStatus GetStatus(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => GetStatus(handle, false);

        /// <summary>Eligibility with this call's captured scalar inputs. Does not store the context or spend resources.</summary>
        public GameplayAbilityStatus GetStatus(GameplayAbilityHandle handle,GameplayContext context)
        {ValidateContext(context);return GetStatus(handle,false,context);}
        private GameplayAbilityStatus GetStatus(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, bool committing,GameplayContext context=null)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry))
                return new GameplayAbilityStatus(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.InvalidHandle, 0, 0, 0f, 0f, 0f, 0f);

            GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition charge = entry.Definition.Charge;
            GameplayEffectDefinition cooldown = entry.Definition.CooldownEffect;
            float cooldownRemaining = 0f;
            if (cooldown != null)
                _ownerEffects.TryGetRemainingDuration(entry.LastCooldownEffectHandle, out cooldownRemaining);
            GameplayAbilityBlockReason reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None;
            if (_activationCommitInProgress || entry.Activating) reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.AlreadyPreparing;
            else if (entry.IsActive) reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.AlreadyActive;
            else if (!committing && entry.Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Preparing) reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.AlreadyPreparing;

            if (reason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None)
                foreach (GameplayTag requiredTag in entry.Definition.RequiredTags)
                    if (!_ownerTags.HasTag(requiredTag)) { reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.MissingRequiredTag; break; }

            if (reason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None)
                foreach (GameplayTag blockedTag in entry.Definition.BlockedTags)
                    if (_ownerTags.HasTag(blockedTag)) { reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.BlockedByTag; break; }

            if (reason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None)
                foreach (Entry active in OrderedEntries())
                    if (active.IsActive && MatchesAny(active.Definition.BlockAbilitiesWithTags,
                            entry.Definition.AbilityTags))
                    { reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.BlockedByAbility; break; }

            if (reason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None && entry.Definition.Cost != null &&
                !(entry.Definition.Cost is IGameplayAbilityContextCost contextCost ? contextCost.CanPay(_host,entry.Level,context??entry.ActiveContext) : entry.Definition.Cost is IGameplayAbilityLevelCost levelCost ?
                    levelCost.CanPay(_host, entry.Level) : entry.Definition.Cost.CanPay(_host)))
                reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cost;

            if (reason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None && charge != null && entry.CurrentCharges == 0)
                reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.NoCharges;
            if (reason == GameplayAbilityBlockReason.None && cooldown != null)
                foreach (GameplayTag cooldownTag in cooldown.GrantedTags)
                    if (_ownerTags.HasTag(cooldownTag)) { reason = GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cooldown; break; }

            return new GameplayAbilityStatus(reason, entry.CurrentCharges, charge?.MaxCharges ?? 0,
                entry.RechargeRemaining, charge?.RechargeDuration ?? 0f,
                cooldownRemaining, cooldown?.DurationValue!=null?entry.LastCooldownDuration:cooldown?.Duration??0f, entry.Phase);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Advances only per-grant sequential recharge; the owner separately advances Effects.
        /// Accumulation stays double, while boundary comparisons use authored float time.
        /// End/Cancel do not refund charges, and spending another charge does not reset an ongoing recharge.
        /// </summary>
        public void Advance(float amount)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(amount) || amount < 0f) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(amount));
            if(_activationCommitInProgress)throw new InvalidOperationException("Ability clock cannot advance during activation commit.");
            foreach (Entry entry in OrderedEntries())
            {
                if (!_entries.ContainsKey(entry.Handle)) continue;
                if (entry.Phase != GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive && HasAnyOwnerTag(entry.Definition.OngoingBlockedTags))
                    FinishActivation(entry, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.OngoingBlocked);
                if (!_entries.ContainsKey(entry.Handle)) continue;
                GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition charge = entry.Definition.Charge;
                if (charge == null || entry.CurrentCharges == charge.MaxCharges) continue;
                entry.RechargeElapsed += amount;
                while (entry.CurrentCharges < charge.MaxCharges &&
                    (float)entry.RechargeElapsed >= (float)entry.NextRechargeAt)
                {
                    entry.CurrentCharges++;
                    entry.NextRechargeAt += charge.RechargeDuration;
                }
                if (entry.CurrentCharges == charge.MaxCharges)
                {
                    // A full grant has no pending schedule; excess Advance must not carry into the next cast.
                    entry.RechargeElapsed = 0d;
                    entry.NextRechargeAt = 0d;
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 门禁通过后暂存可撤销的 tags/cooldown/activation contributions，再原子支付并提交活动状态和 Charge。
        /// 支付拒绝或提交前异常不执行初始动作，静默撤销暂存贡献。成功提交后初始 Execution 恰好执行一次；
        /// 其异常传播但不退款、不撤销已发布结果，活动 grant 仍拥有清理责任，可正常 Cancel/Remove。
        /// </summary>
        public bool TryActivate(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => TryActivate(handle, null);

        /// <summary>Attach this execution's context only when activation succeeds; End/Cancel/Remove clear it.</summary>
        public bool TryActivate(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, GameplayContext context) => TryActivateCore(handle, context, false);

        /// <summary>Reserves this grant without spending Cost/Charge or applying tags/effects. No cast timer is created.</summary>
        public bool TryBeginActivation(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, GameplayContext context = null)
        {
            if (!GetStatus(handle,false,context).CanActivate) return false;
            ValidateContext(context);
            Entry entry = _entries[handle];
            entry.ActiveContext = context?.WithAbilityLevel(entry.Level);
            entry.Phase = GameplayAbilityPhase.Preparing;
            return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Revalidates current gates and commits the saved Begin context exactly once. Failure terminates preparation.</summary>
        public bool TryCommitActivation(GameplayAbilityHandle handle)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry) || entry.Phase != GameplayAbilityPhase.Preparing || entry.Committing) return false;
            entry.Committing = true;
            try
            {
                bool success = TryActivateCore(handle, entry.ActiveContext, true);
                if (!success && entry.Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Preparing)
                    FinishActivation(entry, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.CommitRejected);
                return success;
            }
            catch (Exception error)
            {
                if (entry.Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Preparing)
                {
                    try { FinishActivation(entry, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.CommitRejected); }
                    catch (Exception cleanup) { throw new AggregateException(error, cleanup); }
                }
                throw;
            }
            finally { entry.Committing = false; }
        }
        private void ValidateContext(GameplayContext context)
        {
            if (context != null && context.InstigatorId != _host.OwnerId)
                throw new ArgumentException("Activation context instigator must be the Ability owner.", nameof(context));
        }
        private bool TryActivateCore(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, GameplayContext context, bool committing)
        {
            if (!GetStatus(handle, committing,context).CanActivate)
                return false;
            ValidateContext(context);

            Entry entry = _entries[handle];
            GameplaySourceId activationSourceId = _sourceIdAllocator.Allocate();
            GameplayEffectHandle cooldownEffectHandle = default;
            GameplayEffectApplicationContext cooldownApplication=null;
            float cooldownDuration=0;
            var activationEffectHandles = new List<GameplayEffectHandle>();
            entry.Activating = true;
            bool committed=false,attemptOpen=true;
            _activationCommitInProgress=true;_ownerEffects.BeginActivationAttempt();
            try
            {
                foreach (GameplayTag ownedTag in entry.Definition.ActivationOwnedTags)
                    _ownerTags.AddTag(ownedTag, activationSourceId);

                if (entry.Definition.CooldownEffect != null){
                    var cooldown=entry.Definition.CooldownEffect;
                    if(cooldown.DurationValue==null)cooldownEffectHandle=_ownerEffects.Apply(cooldown);
                    else{
                        var cooldownContext=new GameplayContext(_host.OwnerId,new GameplayTargetData(_host.OwnerId),activationSourceId,context?.Values,entry.Level);
                        cooldownApplication=new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(cooldownContext,_host,cooldownContext.Values.AsSetByCallerValues());
                        cooldownEffectHandle=_ownerEffects.Apply(cooldown,cooldownApplication).ActiveHandle;
                    }
                    if(!cooldownEffectHandle.IsValid){RollbackAttempt(activationSourceId,cooldownEffectHandle,activationEffectHandles);return false;}
                    _ownerEffects.TryGetAppliedDuration(cooldownEffectHandle,out cooldownDuration);
                }

                if (entry.Definition.ActivationEffects.Count > 0)
                {
                    var selfContext = new GameplayContext(_host.OwnerId,
                        new GameplayTargetData(_host.OwnerId), context?.EffectiveSourceId ?? _host.OwnerId,
                        context?.Values, entry.Level);
                    var application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(selfContext, _host,
                        // Explicit per-application snapshot; missing keys are not implicit zero.
                        selfContext.Values.AsSetByCallerValues());
                    foreach (GameplayEffectDefinition effect in entry.Definition.ActivationEffects)
                    {
                        GameplayEffectApplicationResult result = _ownerEffects.StageActivation(effect, application);
                        if (!result.Succeeded)
                        {
                            RollbackAttempt(activationSourceId, cooldownEffectHandle, activationEffectHandles);
                            return false;
                        }
                        activationEffectHandles.Add(result.ActiveHandle);
                    }
                }

                if (entry.Definition.Cost != null && !(entry.Definition.Cost is IGameplayAbilityContextCost contextCost ? contextCost.TryCommit(_host,entry.Level,context) : entry.Definition.Cost is IGameplayAbilityLevelCost levelCost ?
                    levelCost.TryCommit(_host, entry.Level) : entry.Definition.Cost.TryCommit(_host)))
                {
                    RollbackAttempt(activationSourceId, cooldownEffectHandle, activationEffectHandles);
                    return false;
                }

                entry.ActivationSourceId = activationSourceId;
                entry.LastCooldownEffectHandle = cooldownEffectHandle;
                entry.LastCooldownDuration=cooldownDuration;entry.LastCooldownApplication=cooldownApplication;
                entry.ActiveContext = context?.WithAbilityLevel(entry.Level);
                entry.OwnedEffectHandles.AddRange(activationEffectHandles);
                entry.Phase = GameplayAbilityPhase.Active;
                if (entry.Definition.Charge != null)
                {
                    if (entry.CurrentCharges == entry.Definition.Charge.MaxCharges)
                    {
                        entry.RechargeElapsed = 0d;
                        entry.NextRechargeAt = entry.Definition.Charge.RechargeDuration;
                    }
                    entry.CurrentCharges--;
                }
                committed=true;
                _activationCommitInProgress=false;_ownerEffects.EndActivationAttempt();attemptOpen=false;
                foreach (Entry other in OrderedEntries())
                    if (other != entry && other.Phase != GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive &&
                        MatchesAny(entry.Definition.CancelAbilitiesWithTags, other.Definition.AbilityTags))
                        FinishActivation(other, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.CancelledByAbility);
                foreach(var effect in activationEffectHandles)
                {
                    if(!entry.IsActive)break; // An initial action may terminate the successful grant.
                    _ownerEffects.CommitActivationInitial(effect);
                }
                return true;
            }
            catch
            {
                if (!committed)
                    RollbackAttempt(activationSourceId, cooldownEffectHandle, activationEffectHandles);
                throw;
            }
            finally { if(attemptOpen)_ownerEffects.EndActivationAttempt();_activationCommitInProgress=false;entry.Activating = false; }
        }

        private void RollbackAttempt(GameplaySourceId source, GameplayEffectHandle cooldown,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectHandle> effects)
        {
            for (int i = effects.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                _ownerEffects.AbortActivation(effects[i]);
            if (cooldown.IsValid) _ownerEffects.AbortActivation(cooldown);
            _ownerTags.RemoveTagsFromSource(source);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Registers cleanup of a newly created, still active Effect in this owner's Effect container.
        /// Only an active grant and NewActiveEffect result are accepted; merged stack results never
        /// transfer ownership. Duplicate registration on the same grant succeeds without adding a relation.
        /// A handle already owned by another grant is rejected. End, Cancel and grant removal remove
        /// registered Effects; their clocks and state remain solely in EffectContainer.
        /// Normal cooldowns stay independent unless explicitly registered by the caller.
        /// Callers must register against the activation that created the result, before it ends.
        /// </summary>
        public bool TryOwnEffect(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, GameplayEffectApplicationResult application)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out Entry entry) || !entry.IsActive ||
                application.Outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.NewActiveEffect ||
                !_ownerEffects.IsActive(application.ActiveHandle) || _cleanupEffects.Contains(application.ActiveHandle))
                return false;

            foreach (Entry other in _entries.Values)
            {
                if (other != entry && other.OwnedEffectHandles.Contains(application.ActiveHandle)) return false;
                if (other.OwnedLayers.Exists(layer => layer.EffectHandle == application.ActiveHandle && _ownerEffects.IsLayerActive(layer))) return false;
            }
            foreach (var layer in _cleanupLayers) if (layer.EffectHandle == application.ActiveHandle) return false;

            // Passive event/completion cycles can replace an Effect many times within one activation.
            // Compact at successful registration, without subscribing to Effect removal events.
            entry.OwnedEffectHandles.RemoveAll(handle => !_ownerEffects.IsActive(handle));
            if (!entry.OwnedEffectHandles.Contains(application.ActiveHandle))
                entry.OwnedEffectHandles.Add(application.ActiveHandle);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>仅查询本容器内指定 Grant 当前是否处于 Active；无效或已移除 Handle 返回 false。</summary>
        public bool IsActive(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) =>
            _entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry) && entry.IsActive;

        /// <summary>Return the context of an active grant; a context-free activation returns false.</summary>
        public bool TryGetActiveContext(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, out GameplayContext context)
        {
            if (_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry) && entry.IsActive && entry.ActiveContext != null)
            {
                context = entry.ActiveContext;
                return true;
            }
            context = null;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 查询指定 Grant 最近一次成功激活时由它自身启动、且仍活动的冷却 Effect 剩余时长。
        /// End/Cancel 不影响查询；外部同标签 Effect 只会阻止激活，不属于该 Grant 的自身冷却。
        /// 无效、其他容器、已移除 Grant、无自身冷却或冷却已到期时返回 false，并将 remaining 置为 0。
        /// </summary>
        public bool TryGetCooldownRemaining(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, out float remaining)
        {
            if (_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry))
                return _ownerEffects.TryGetRemainingDuration(entry.LastCooldownEffectHandle, out remaining);

            remaining = 0f;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 正常结束一次 Active Ability，清理 ActivationOwnedTags、初始及动态登记的 Effect handles，回到 Inactive。
        /// 已开始的冷却继续由 EffectContainer 管理；非 Active 或外部 Handle 返回 false。
        /// </summary>
        public bool End(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => Finish(handle, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Ended, false);

        /// <summary>Terminates Preparing or Active. Precommit cancellation has no resource payment to refund.</summary>
        public bool Cancel(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => Finish(handle, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Cancelled, true);

        private bool Finish(GameplayAbilityHandle handle, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason reason, bool preparing)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out Entry entry) || entry.Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive ||
                (!preparing && !entry.IsActive)) return false;
            if(entry.Activating&&!entry.IsActive)return false;
            FinishActivation(entry, reason);
            return true;
        }
        private void FinishActivation(Entry entry, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason reason)
        {
            var observation = new GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation(entry.Definition, entry.Handle, entry.Phase, entry.ActiveContext, reason);
            var source = entry.ActivationSourceId;
            var effects = entry.OwnedEffectHandles.ToArray();
            var layers = entry.OwnedLayers.ToArray();
            var lifetimes = entry.OwnedLifetimes.ToArray();
            entry.LastTermination = observation;
            entry.Phase = GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive;
            entry.ActivationSourceId = default;
            entry.ActiveContext = null;
            entry.OwnedEffectHandles.Clear(); entry.OwnedLayers.Clear(); entry.OwnedLifetimes.Clear();
            // Keep cleanup reservations until the old resource is actually released, even under reentrant activation.
            foreach (var effect in effects) _cleanupEffects.Add(effect);
            foreach (var layer in layers) _cleanupLayers.Add(layer);
            var errors = new List<Exception>();
            void Attempt(Action action) { try { action(); } catch (Exception error) { errors.Add(error); } }
            if (source.IsValid) Attempt(() => _ownerTags.RemoveTagsFromSource(source));
            foreach (var effect in effects)
            {
                Attempt(() => _ownerEffects.Remove(effect, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OwnerCleanup));
                _cleanupEffects.Remove(effect);
            }
            foreach (var layer in layers)
            {
                Attempt(() => _ownerEffects.RemoveLayer(layer, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OwnerCleanup));
                _cleanupLayers.Remove(layer);
            }
            foreach (var lifetime in lifetimes)
            {
                Attempt(() => { if (lifetime is IGameplayAbilityTerminationAwareLifetime aware) aware.Terminate(observation); else lifetime.Dispose(); });
                _lifetimeOwners.Remove(lifetime);
            }
            LastTermination = observation;
            if (Terminated != null)
                foreach (Action<GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation> observer in Terminated.GetInvocationList())
                    Attempt(() => observer(observation));
            if (errors.Count > 0) throw new AggregateException("Ability termination cleanup failed.", errors);
        }

        /// <summary>Uses the existing per-grant phase; IsActive remains committed-only.</summary>
        public bool IsPreparing(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => _entries.TryGetValue(handle, out var entry) && entry.Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Preparing;
        /// <summary>True for either Preparing or committed Active; no polling is needed for owned cleanup.</summary>
        public bool IsEngaged(GameplayAbilityHandle handle) => _entries.TryGetValue(handle, out var entry) && entry.Phase != GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive;

        /// <summary>Owns an idempotent disposable within Preparing/Active. Reference identity is exclusive across grants.</summary>
        public bool TryOwnLifetime(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, IDisposable lifetime)
        {
            if (lifetime == null || !_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) || entry.Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive) return false;
            if (_lifetimeOwners.TryGetValue(lifetime, out var owner))
                return owner == entry && entry.OwnedLifetimes.Exists(item => ReferenceEquals(item, lifetime));
            _lifetimeOwners.Add(lifetime, entry); entry.OwnedLifetimes.Add(lifetime); return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Unlinks a naturally completed child without disposing it.</summary>
        public bool ReleaseOwnedLifetime(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, IDisposable lifetime)
        {
            if (lifetime == null || !_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) ||
                !_lifetimeOwners.TryGetValue(lifetime, out var owner) || owner != entry) return false;
            int index = entry.OwnedLifetimes.FindIndex(item => ReferenceEquals(item, lifetime));
            if (index < 0) return false;
            entry.OwnedLifetimes.RemoveAt(index); _lifetimeOwners.Remove(lifetime); return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Owns only this newly-created contribution, including the first layer of a merged entry.</summary>
        public bool TryOwnEffectLayer(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, GameplayEffectApplicationResult application)
        {
            var layer = application.LayerHandle;
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) || !entry.IsActive || !layer.IsValid ||
                (application.Outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.NewActiveEffect && application.Outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.StackIncreased) ||
                !_ownerEffects.IsLayerActive(layer) || _cleanupEffects.Contains(layer.EffectHandle) || _cleanupLayers.Contains(layer)) return false;
            foreach (var other in _entries.Values)
            {
                if (other.OwnedEffectHandles.Contains(layer.EffectHandle)) return false;
                if (other != entry && other.OwnedLayers.Contains(layer)) return false;
            }
            entry.OwnedLayers.RemoveAll(item => !_ownerEffects.IsLayerActive(item));
            if (!entry.OwnedLayers.Contains(layer)) entry.OwnedLayers.Add(layer);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Edits only this grant's own normal cooldown Effect; external same-tag blockers remain untouched.</summary>
        public bool TrySetCooldownRemaining(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, float remaining)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(remaining) || remaining < 0) return false;
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) || entry.Definition.CooldownEffect == null) return false;
            if (_ownerEffects.IsActive(entry.LastCooldownEffectHandle))
                return _ownerEffects.TrySetSimpleDurationRemaining(entry.LastCooldownEffectHandle, remaining);
            if (remaining == 0) return true;
            var handle = _ownerEffects.ApplySimpleDuration(entry.Definition.CooldownEffect,entry.LastCooldownApplication,remaining);
            if (!handle.IsValid) return false;
            entry.LastCooldownEffectHandle = handle;
            return _ownerEffects.TrySetSimpleDurationRemaining(handle, remaining);
        }
        /// <summary>Adds/reduces only own normal cooldown from its current remaining; crossing zero clears it.</summary>
        public bool TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, float delta)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(delta)) return false;
            TryGetCooldownRemaining(ability, out float remaining);
            double value = Math.Max(0d, (double)remaining + delta);
            return value <= float.MaxValue && TrySetCooldownRemaining(ability, (float)value);
        }
        /// <summary>Restarts at the last successful cast's frozen authored duration. Constant CD
        /// can restart before the first cast; value-driven CD requires a captured successful cast.</summary>
        public bool TryResetCooldown(GameplayAbilityHandle ability) => _entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) &&
            entry.Definition.CooldownEffect != null && (entry.Definition.CooldownEffect.DurationValue==null||entry.LastCooldownDuration>0) &&
            TrySetCooldownRemaining(ability,entry.Definition.CooldownEffect.DurationValue==null?entry.Definition.CooldownEffect.Duration:entry.LastCooldownDuration);
        /// <summary>Count edits preserve a running sequential recharge phase; reaching full clears it.</summary>
        public bool TrySetCharges(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, int charges)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) || entry.Definition.Charge == null ||
                charges < 0 || charges > entry.Definition.Charge.MaxCharges) return false;
            var policy = entry.Definition.Charge;
            if (charges == policy.MaxCharges) { entry.RechargeElapsed = 0; entry.NextRechargeAt = 0; }
            else if (entry.CurrentCharges == policy.MaxCharges) { entry.RechargeElapsed = 0; entry.NextRechargeAt = policy.RechargeDuration; }
            entry.CurrentCharges = charges; return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Restores/consumes charges without resetting a running recharge phase. Out-of-range edits fail unchanged.</summary>
        public bool TryAdjustCharges(GameplayAbilityHandle ability, int delta)
        {
            if (!_entries.TryGetValue(ability, out var entry) || entry.Definition.Charge == null) return false;
            long value = (long)entry.CurrentCharges + delta;
            return value >= 0 && value <= entry.Definition.Charge.MaxCharges && TrySetCharges(ability, (int)value);
        }
        private sealed class LifetimeComparer : IEqualityComparer<IDisposable>
        {
            internal static readonly LifetimeComparer Instance = new LifetimeComparer();
            public bool Equals(IDisposable a, IDisposable b) => ReferenceEquals(a, b);
            public int GetHashCode(IDisposable value) => RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(value);
        }

        private List<Entry> OrderedEntries()
        {
            var ordered = new List<Entry>(_entries.Values);
            ordered.Sort((a, b) => a.Handle.Sequence.CompareTo(b.Handle.Sequence));
            return ordered;
        }

        /// <summary>Captures grants in Handle order using the authoritative, side-effect-free status query.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayGrantedAbilitySnapshot> GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()
        {
            var ordered = OrderedEntries();
            var result = new List<GameplayGrantedAbilitySnapshot>(ordered.Count);
            foreach (Entry entry in ordered)
                result.Add(new GameplayGrantedAbilitySnapshot(entry.Handle, entry.Definition,
                    GetStatus(entry.Handle), entry.IsActive, entry.ActiveContext,
                    entry.OwnedEffectHandles.FindAll(_ownerEffects.IsActive).Count,
                    entry.OwnedLayers.FindAll(_ownerEffects.IsLayerActive).Count, entry.OwnedLifetimes.Count, entry.LastTermination, entry.Level));
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }

        private bool HasAnyOwnerTag(IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> tags)
        {
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in tags)
                if (_ownerTags.HasTag(tag)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        private static bool MatchesAny(IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> relations,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> identities)
        {
            foreach (GameplayTag relation in relations)
                foreach (GameplayTag identity in identities)
                    if (identity == relation || identity.IsDescendantOf(relation)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        private sealed class Entry
        {
            internal readonly GameplayAbilityDefinition Definition;
            internal readonly GameplayAbilityHandle Handle;
            internal int Level;
            internal readonly List<GameplayEffectHandle> OwnedEffectHandles = new List<GameplayEffectHandle>();
            internal GameplaySourceId ActivationSourceId;
            internal GameplayEffectHandle LastCooldownEffectHandle;
            internal float LastCooldownDuration;
            internal GameplayEffectApplicationContext LastCooldownApplication;
            internal GameplayContext ActiveContext;
            internal GameplayAbilityPhase Phase;
            internal bool IsActive => Phase == GameplayAbilityPhase.Active;
            internal bool Committing;
            internal bool Activating;
            internal GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation LastTermination;
            internal readonly List<GameplayEffectLayerHandle> OwnedLayers = new List<GameplayEffectLayerHandle>();
            internal readonly List<IDisposable> OwnedLifetimes = new List<IDisposable>();
            internal int CurrentCharges;
            internal double RechargeElapsed;
            internal double NextRechargeAt;
            internal float RechargeRemaining => (float)Math.Max(0d, NextRechargeAt - RechargeElapsed);

            internal Entry(GameplayAbilityDefinition definition, GameplayAbilityHandle handle, int level)
            {
                Definition = definition;
                Handle = handle;
                Level = level;
                CurrentCharges = definition.Charge?.MaxCharges ?? 0;
            }
        }

    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 不可变的 Ability 静态定义，只描述激活条件、激活期间拥有的标签与互斥的冷却/充能策略。
    /// Definition 不保存 Grant Handle、激活来源或活动状态，可以被多个 Container 共享。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityDefinition
    {
        /// <summary>激活前必须全部满足的标签；每项均使用层级查询。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> RequiredTags { get; }

        /// <summary>激活前任意命中即阻止激活的标签；每项均使用层级查询。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> BlockedTags { get; }

        /// <summary>本次 Ability 处于 Active 期间，由独立 Activation Source 提供的 exact 标签。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> ActivationOwnedTags { get; }
        /// <summary>Ability 定义身份，不写入 owner 的状态标签容器。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> AbilityTags { get; }
        /// <summary>成功激活后，取消本 owner 中身份匹配的其他活动 Ability。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> CancelAbilitiesWithTags { get; }
        /// <summary>活动期间阻止身份匹配的其他 Ability 激活。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> BlockAbilitiesWithTags { get; }
        /// <summary>活动后命中任一 owner 标签时，由 Advance 取消本 Ability。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> OngoingBlockedTags { get; }
        public IGameplayAbilityCost Cost { get; }
        /// <summary>Allowed grant level range is 1..MaxLevel; the current level belongs to each grant.</summary>
        public int MaxLevel { get; }
        /// <summary>由一次活动生命周期独占的持续 Effect；End/Cancel/Remove 清理。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectDefinition> ActivationEffects { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// 激活提交时应用的可选冷却 Effect。其 GrantedTags 同时是 CanActivate 查询的冷却标签。
        /// 冷却必须是无属性修饰、至少提供一个标签的常量 Duration Effect，不允许 DurationValue override。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayEffectDefinition CooldownEffect { get; }

        /// <summary>Optional per-grant sequential charge policy, mutually exclusive with CooldownEffect.</summary>
        public GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition Charge { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// 创建不可变 Ability 定义。三组标签都会被防御性复制并以只读集合公开；
        /// null 集合、无效标签及同时配置两种时间门禁会被拒绝。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayAbilityDefinition(
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> requiredTags,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> blockedTags,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> activationOwnedTags,
            GameplayEffectDefinition cooldownEffect = null,
            GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition charge = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> abilityTags = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> cancelAbilitiesWithTags = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> blockAbilitiesWithTags = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> ongoingBlockedTags = null,
            IGameplayAbilityCost cost = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectDefinition> activationEffects = null,
            int maxLevel = 1)
        {
            if (maxLevel < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxLevel));
            MaxLevel = maxLevel;
            RequiredTags = CopyTags(requiredTags, nameof(requiredTags));
            BlockedTags = CopyTags(blockedTags, nameof(blockedTags));
            ActivationOwnedTags = CopyTags(activationOwnedTags, nameof(activationOwnedTags));
            AbilityTags = CopyTags(abilityTags ?? Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), nameof(abilityTags));
            CancelAbilitiesWithTags = CopyTags(cancelAbilitiesWithTags ?? Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), nameof(cancelAbilitiesWithTags));
            BlockAbilitiesWithTags = CopyTags(blockAbilitiesWithTags ?? Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), nameof(blockAbilitiesWithTags));
            OngoingBlockedTags = CopyTags(ongoingBlockedTags ?? Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), nameof(ongoingBlockedTags));
            var effectCopy = new List<GameplayEffectDefinition>();
            if (activationEffects != null)
                foreach (GameplayEffectDefinition effect in activationEffects)
                {
                    if (effect == null || effect.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant ||
                        effect.Stacking != null)
                        throw new ArgumentException("Activation effects must be unstacked persistent effects.", nameof(activationEffects));
                    effectCopy.Add(effect);
                }
            ActivationEffects = new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayEffectDefinition>(effectCopy);
            Cost = cost;

            if (cooldownEffect != null)
            {
                if (cooldownEffect.DurationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Cooldown effect must use the Duration policy.", nameof(cooldownEffect));
                if (cooldownEffect.GrantedTags.Count == 0)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Cooldown effect must grant at least one tag.", nameof(cooldownEffect));
                if (cooldownEffect.Modifiers.Count != 0)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Cooldown effect must not contain attribute modifiers.", nameof(cooldownEffect));
                if (cooldownEffect.Period != 0f || cooldownEffect.PeriodValue!=null || cooldownEffect.Executions.Count != 0 || cooldownEffect.CompletionExecutions.Count != 0 ||
                    cooldownEffect.Stacking != null || !cooldownEffect.ApplicationRequirements.IsEmpty ||
                    !cooldownEffect.OngoingRequirements.IsEmpty)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Cooldown must be a simple Duration and GrantedTag effect.", nameof(cooldownEffect));
            }

            if (cooldownEffect != null && charge != null)
                throw new ArgumentException("Charge and normal cooldown cannot be configured together.", nameof(charge));

            CooldownEffect = cooldownEffect;
            Charge = charge;
        }

        private static IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> CopyTags(
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> tags,
            string parameterName)
        {
            if (tags == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(parameterName);

            var copy = new List<GameplayTag>();
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in tags)
            {
                if (!tag.IsValid)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Ability tags must be valid.", parameterName);
                copy.Add(tag);
            }

            return new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayTag>(copy);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Immutable sequential recharge policy; mutable charge counts live in each granted ability.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition
    {
        public int MaxCharges { get; }
        public float RechargeDuration { get; }

        public GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(int maxCharges, float rechargeDuration)
        {
            if (maxCharges <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxCharges));
            if (!float.IsFinite(rechargeDuration) || rechargeDuration <= 0f)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(rechargeDuration));
            MaxCharges = maxCharges;
            RechargeDuration = rechargeDuration;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 某个 GameplayAbilityContainer 内一次 Grant 的身份，只能用于产生它的容器，default 无效。
    /// Handle 与 Definition、Activation SourceId 及冷却 Effect Handle 均不是同一种身份。
    /// IsValid 只表示 Handle 曾被分配，不表示对应 Grant 仍存在或当前处于 Active。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayAbilityHandle : IEquatable<GameplayAbilityHandle>
    {
        private readonly object _owner;
        private readonly long _sequence;

        public bool IsValid => _owner != null && _sequence != 0;
        internal long Sequence => _sequence;
        /// <summary>Container-local grant sequence for read-only diagnostics.</summary>
        public long LocalSequence => _sequence;

        internal GameplayAbilityHandle(object owner, long sequence)
        {
            _owner = owner;
            _sequence = sequence;
        }

        public bool Equals(GameplayAbilityHandle other) =>
            ReferenceEquals(_owner, other._owner) && _sequence == other._sequence;

        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is GameplayAbilityHandle other && Equals(other);

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                return ((_owner == null ? 0 : RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(_owner)) * 397) ^ _sequence.GetHashCode();
            }
        }

        public static bool operator ==(GameplayAbilityHandle left, GameplayAbilityHandle right) => left.Equals(right);
        public static bool operator !=(GameplayAbilityHandle left, GameplayAbilityHandle right) => !left.Equals(right);
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Optional exact termination cause for an owned lifetime. Called once instead of
    /// IDisposable.Dispose after the cast is detached. Spatial callbacks distinguish normal End
    /// from cancellation; implementations must release their resource even when an observer throws.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayAbilityTerminationAwareLifetime : System.IDisposable
    {
        void Terminate(GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation observation);
    }
    /// <summary>Preparing reserves only this grant; resources and activation tags are committed only in Active.</summary>
    public enum GameplayAbilityPhase { Inactive, Preparing, Active }
    /// <summary>Why a Preparing or Active scope terminated. Observers run once after cleanup; they do not drive authored continuation.</summary>
    public enum GameplayAbilityTerminationReason { Ended, Cancelled, Removed, OngoingBlocked, CancelledByAbility, CommitRejected }
    /// <summary>Detached scope observation after authoritative detachment and all cleanup attempts.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation
    {
        public GameplayAbilityDefinition Definition { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityPhase Phase { get; }
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityTerminationReason Reason { get; }
        internal GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation(GameplayAbilityDefinition definition, GameplayAbilityHandle handle,
            GameplayAbilityPhase phase, GameplayContext context, GameplayAbilityTerminationReason reason)
        { Definition = definition; Handle = handle; Phase = phase; Context = context; Reason = reason; }
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>One signed resource change: negative spends BaseValue, positive grants BaseValue.
    /// Modifiers are not spendable balances. Formula values read a self application at the grant level
    /// with captured Context/Caller inputs supplied by the activation request.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayAttributeCostEntry
    {
        public GameplayAttributeId Attribute { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue Delta { get; }
        /// <summary>Pre-change balance gate, including positive exchanges. Actual XH signed
        /// Mana +10 requires an existing balance of 10; this is not a second cost execution.</summary>
        public float MinimumBalance {get;}
        public GameplayAttributeCostEntry(GameplayAttributeId attribute, IGameplayFloatValue delta,float minimumBalance=0)
        {
            if (!attribute.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Resource attribute is invalid.", nameof(attribute));
            Attribute = attribute;
            Delta = delta ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(delta));
            if(!float.IsFinite(minimumBalance)||minimumBalance<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(minimumBalance));MinimumBalance=minimumBalance;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>First-party multi-resource payment. Repeated resource entries are aggregated; all amounts
    /// and balances are checked before mutation. The resource store commits the complete batch atomically.
    /// Single-threaded like AttributeSet; no Effect clock or game-specific host is required.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAttributeAbilityCost : IGameplayAbilityContextCost
    {
        private readonly GameplayAttributeCostEntry[] _entries;
        public GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(IEnumerable<GameplayAttributeCostEntry> entries)
        {
            if (entries == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(entries));
            var copy = new List<GameplayAttributeCostEntry>();
            foreach (var entry in entries)
            {
                if (!entry.Attribute.IsValid || entry.Delta == null) throw new ArgumentException("Invalid payment entry.", nameof(entries));
                copy.Add(entry);
            }
            _entries = copy.ToArray();
        }
        public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host) => CanPay(host, 1);
        public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host) => TryCommit(host, 1);
        public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host, int level) => CanPay(host,level,null);
        public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host, int level)=>TryCommit(host,level,null);
        public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host,int level,GameplayContext context)
        {try{return Prepare(host,level,context,out _);}catch(KeyNotFoundException){return false;}}
        public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host, int level,GameplayContext context)
        {
            Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId,float> updates;
            try{if (!Prepare(host, level,context,out updates)) return false;}catch(KeyNotFoundException){return false;}
            Store(host).SetBalancesAtomic(updates); return true;
        }
        private static IGameplayResourceStore Store(IGameplayAbilityHost host) =>
            host is IGameplayResourceTarget target ? target.Resources : host.Attributes;
        private bool Prepare(IGameplayAbilityHost host, int level,GameplayContext context,out Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float> updates)
        {
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if(context!=null&&context.InstigatorId!=host.OwnerId)throw new ArgumentException("Cost context owner mismatch.",nameof(context));
            var self=(context??new GameplayContext(host.OwnerId,new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId))).WithAbilityLevel(level).WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId));
            var application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(self,host,self.Values.AsCostCallerValues());
            var deltas = new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float>();
            var store = Store(host) ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Resource store is unavailable.");
            foreach (var entry in _entries)
            {
                if (!store.TryGetBalance(entry.Attribute, out float balance)||balance<entry.MinimumBalance) { updates = null; return false; }
                deltas.TryGetValue(entry.Attribute, out float previous);
                float sum = previous + GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(entry.Delta, application);
                if (!float.IsFinite(sum)) throw new ArithmeticException("Resource payment delta must be finite.");
                deltas[entry.Attribute] = sum;
            }
            updates = new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float>(deltas.Count);
            foreach (var pair in deltas)
            {
                if (!store.TryGetBalance(pair.Key, out float before)) { updates = null; return false; }
                float after = before + pair.Value;
                if (!float.IsFinite(after)) throw new ArithmeticException("Resource payment balance must be finite.");
                if (pair.Value < 0 && after < 0) { updates = null; return false; }
                if (store is AttributeSet attributes) attributes.GetAttribute(pair.Key).ValidateBaseValueChange(after);
                updates.Add(pair.Key, after);
            }
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>按游戏自定义的有效属性键管理运行时属性，不静默创建或覆盖。</summary>
    public sealed class AttributeSet : IGameplayResourceStore
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, GameplayAttribute> _attributes =
            new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, GameplayAttribute>();

        /// <summary>重复注册抛出 ArgumentException，原属性及其修饰器保持不变。</summary>
        public GameplayAttribute Register(GameplayAttributeId id, float baseValue)
        {
            ValidateId(id);
            if (_attributes.ContainsKey(id))
                throw new ArgumentException("Attribute is already registered: " + id, nameof(id));
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(baseValue);
            _attributes.Add(id, attribute);
            return attribute;
        }

        public bool Contains(GameplayAttributeId id)
        {
            ValidateId(id);
            return _attributes.ContainsKey(id);
        }

        /// <summary>有效但未注册的键抛出 KeyNotFoundException；default 键抛出 ArgumentException。</summary>
        public GameplayAttribute GetAttribute(GameplayAttributeId id)
        {
            ValidateId(id);
            if (!_attributes.TryGetValue(id, out GameplayAttribute attribute))
                throw new KeyNotFoundException("Attribute is not registered: " + id);
            return attribute;
        }

        public float GetCurrentValue(GameplayAttributeId id) => GetAttribute(id).CurrentValue;

        /// <summary>Captures registered values and modifier sources without exposing the backing map.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAttributeEntrySnapshot> GetEntriesSnapshot()
        {
            var ids = new List<GameplayAttributeId>(_attributes.Keys);
            ids.Sort((a, b) => string.CompareOrdinal(a.Value, b.Value));
            var entries = new List<GameplayAttributeEntrySnapshot>(ids.Count);
            foreach (GameplayAttributeId id in ids)
            {
                GameplayAttribute attribute = _attributes[id];
                entries.Add(new GameplayAttributeEntrySnapshot(id, attribute.BaseValue,
                    attribute.CurrentValue, attribute.GetModifiersSnapshot()));
            }
            return entries.AsReadOnly();
        }
        public void SetBaseValue(GameplayAttributeId id, float baseValue) => GetAttribute(id).SetBaseValue(baseValue);

        /// <summary>Resource balances use BaseValue; additive/multiplicative modifiers are not spendable currency.</summary>
        public bool TryGetBalance(GameplayAttributeId id, out float balance)
        {
            ValidateId(id); balance = 0;
            if (!_attributes.TryGetValue(id, out var attribute)) return false;
            balance = attribute.BaseValue; return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Validates the resulting aggregate for every attribute before mutating any resource.
        /// This synchronous container emits no callbacks between preflight and commit.</summary>
        public void SetBalancesAtomic(IReadOnlyDictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float> balances)
        {
            if (balances == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(balances));
            var updates = new List<KeyValuePair<GameplayAttribute, float>>();
            foreach (var pair in balances)
            {
                var attribute = GetAttribute(pair.Key); attribute.ValidateBaseValueChange(pair.Value);
                updates.Add(new KeyValuePair<GameplayAttribute, float>(attribute, pair.Value));
            }
            foreach (var pair in updates) pair.Key.SetBaseValue(pair.Value);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 遍历所有已注册属性，返回总移除数量。无效来源抛出 ArgumentException。
        /// 若清理会造成任一属性数值溢出，则不修改任何属性。本容器按单线程同步使用。
        /// </summary>
        public int RemoveModifiersFromSource(GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            if (!sourceId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Source ID must be valid.", nameof(sourceId));
            foreach (GameplayAttribute attribute in _attributes.Values)
                attribute.ValidateSourceRemoval(sourceId);
            int removed = 0;
            foreach (GameplayAttribute attribute in _attributes.Values)
                removed += attribute.RemoveModifiersFromSource(sourceId);
            return removed;
        }

        private static void ValidateId(GameplayAttributeId id)
        {
            if (!id.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Attribute ID must be valid.", nameof(id));
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Attribute/GameplayAttribute.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 纯规则属性：(BaseValue + Sum(Add)) * Product(Multiply)。无游戏规则 Clamp、事件或时间驱动。
    /// 变更立即重算；非法输入或聚合溢出抛出异常，并保持此属性变更前的状态。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAttribute
    {
        private readonly object _handleOwner = new object();
        private List<Entry> _modifiers = new List<Entry>();
        private long _lastSequence;

        public float BaseValue { get; private set; }
        public float CurrentValue { get; private set; }

        /// <summary>Returns a detached copy in the attribute's canonical aggregation order.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAttributeModifier> GetModifiersSnapshot()
        {
            var copy = new List<GameplayAttributeModifier>(_modifiers.Count);
            foreach (Entry entry in _modifiers) copy.Add(entry.Modifier);
            copy.Sort((left, right) =>
            {
                int operation = left.Operation.CompareTo(right.Operation);
                if (operation != 0) return operation;
                int magnitude = left.Magnitude.CompareTo(right.Magnitude);
                return magnitude != 0 ? magnitude : left.SourceId.Value.CompareTo(right.SourceId.Value);
            });
            return copy.AsReadOnly();
        }

        public GameplayAttribute(float baseValue)
        {
            ValidateBaseValue(baseValue);
            BaseValue = baseValue;
            CurrentValue = baseValue;
        }

        public void SetBaseValue(float baseValue)
        {
            ValidateBaseValue(baseValue);
            float current = Calculate(baseValue, _modifiers);
            BaseValue = baseValue;
            CurrentValue = current;
        }

        // Atomic multi-resource payment validates every resulting aggregate before changing any balance.
        internal void ValidateBaseValueChange(float baseValue)
        {
            ValidateBaseValue(baseValue);
            Calculate(baseValue, _modifiers);
        }

        public GameplayModifierHandle AddModifier(GameplayAttributeModifier modifier)
        {
            GameplayAttributeModifier.Validate(modifier.Operation, modifier.Magnitude, modifier.SourceId);
            long sequence = checked(_lastSequence + 1);
            var handle = new GameplayModifierHandle(_handleOwner, sequence);
            var candidate = new List<Entry>(_modifiers) { new Entry(handle, modifier) };
            candidate.Sort(CompareEntries);
            float current = Calculate(BaseValue, candidate);
            _modifiers = candidate;
            _lastSequence = sequence;
            CurrentValue = current;
            return handle;
        }

        /// <summary>无效、属于其他属性或已移除的 Handle 返回 false，且不修改任何数值。</summary>
        public bool RemoveModifier(GameplayModifierHandle handle)
        {
            int index = _modifiers.FindIndex(entry => entry.Handle == handle);
            if (index < 0) return false;
            var candidate = new List<Entry>(_modifiers);
            candidate.RemoveAt(index);
            float current = Calculate(BaseValue, candidate);
            _modifiers = candidate;
            CurrentValue = current;
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>移除指定有效来源的全部修饰，返回移除数量；来源不存在时为 0。</summary>
        public int RemoveModifiersFromSource(GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            if (!sourceId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Source ID must be valid.", nameof(sourceId));
            var candidate = new List<Entry>(_modifiers);
            int removed = candidate.RemoveAll(entry => entry.Modifier.SourceId == sourceId);
            if (removed == 0) return 0;
            float current = Calculate(BaseValue, candidate);
            _modifiers = candidate;
            CurrentValue = current;
            return removed;
        }

        // AttributeSet 批量清理先验证所有属性，再执行移除，避免溢出造成部分清理。
        // Effect layer cleanup has the same atomic preflight, but selects exact handles rather than a shared source.
        internal void ValidateModifierRemoval(IReadOnlyCollection<GameplayModifierHandle> handles)
        { Calculate(BaseValue, _modifiers.FindAll(entry => !ContainsHandle(handles, entry.Handle))); }

        internal void RemoveModifiers(IReadOnlyCollection<GameplayModifierHandle> handles)
        {
            var candidate = _modifiers.FindAll(entry => !ContainsHandle(handles, entry.Handle));
            float current = Calculate(BaseValue, candidate);
            _modifiers = candidate;
            CurrentValue = current;
        }

        private static bool ContainsHandle(IReadOnlyCollection<GameplayModifierHandle> handles, GameplayModifierHandle handle)
        { foreach (var item in handles) if (item == handle) return true; return false; }

        // 本模块同步使用且不触发回调，两遍之间不会被内部规则改写。
        internal void ValidateSourceRemoval(GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            var candidate = _modifiers.FindAll(entry => entry.Modifier.SourceId != sourceId);
            Calculate(BaseValue, candidate);
        }

        private static void ValidateBaseValue(float value)
        {
            if (float.IsNaN(value) || float.IsInfinity(value))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value), "Base value must be finite.");
        }

        private static int CompareEntries(Entry left, Entry right)
        {
            int operation = left.Modifier.Operation.CompareTo(right.Modifier.Operation);
            return operation != 0 ? operation : left.Modifier.Magnitude.CompareTo(right.Modifier.Magnitude);
        }

        private static float Calculate(float baseValue, List<Entry> modifiers)
        {
            // 按 Operation/Magnitude 的规范顺序计算，避免浮点加乘顺序随添加顺序变化。
            // double 仅用于中间聚合，公开值仍为 float；不承诺无限精度或跨平台确定性。
            double additive = 0d;
            double multiplier = 1d;
            foreach (Entry entry in modifiers)
            {
                GameplayAttributeModifier modifier = entry.Modifier;
                if (modifier.Operation == GameplayModifierOperation.Add)
                    additive += modifier.Magnitude;
                else
                    multiplier *= modifier.Magnitude;
            }

            double result = (baseValue + additive) * multiplier;
            if (double.IsNaN(result) || double.IsInfinity(result) || result > float.MaxValue || result < -float.MaxValue)
                throw new OverflowException("Aggregated attribute value must be representable as a finite float.");
            return (float)result;
        }

        private readonly struct Entry
        {
            internal readonly GameplayModifierHandle Handle;
            internal readonly GameplayAttributeModifier Modifier;

            internal Entry(GameplayModifierHandle handle, GameplayAttributeModifier modifier)
            {
                Handle = handle;
                Modifier = modifier;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Attribute/GameplayAttributeModifier.cs
````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>不可变的属性修饰数据；同一数据可添加多次，每次添加有独立 Handle。</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayAttributeModifier
    {
        public GameplayModifierOperation Operation { get; }
        public float Magnitude { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId SourceId { get; }

        public GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation operation, float magnitude, GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            Validate(operation, magnitude, sourceId);
            Operation = operation;
            Magnitude = magnitude;
            SourceId = sourceId;
        }

        // 构造检查之外，添加入口也必须拒绝绕过构造器的 default struct。
        internal static void Validate(GameplayModifierOperation operation, float magnitude, GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            if (operation != GameplayModifierOperation.Add && operation != GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(operation));
            if (float.IsNaN(magnitude) || float.IsInfinity(magnitude))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(magnitude), "Magnitude must be finite.");
            if (!sourceId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Source ID must be valid.", nameof(sourceId));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Static Ability contract, built once per session. No grant handle, activation state or resource balance is cached in the asset.</summary>
    [System.Serializable, UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityDefinitionData : GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload
    {
        public override System.Type DefinitionType => typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinition);
        public override object BuildDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);

        [Min(1), Tooltip("每份授予实例的等级上限；运行等级不写回共享资产。")]
        public int MaxLevel = 1;
        /// <summary>Owner state required before activation, using runtime hierarchical queries.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] RequiredTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Owner state preventing activation; these are not Ability identity tags.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] BlockedTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Owner tags supplied by this activation source until End/Cancel/Remove.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] ActivationOwnedTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Definition identity for Ability relations; never added to owner state.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] AbilityTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Identity queries of other active abilities to cancel after successful activation.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] CancelAbilitiesWithTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Identity queries of other abilities prevented from activating while this one is active.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] BlockAbilitiesWithTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Owner state that cancels this active ability when its container next advances.</summary>
        public GameplayTagReference[] OngoingBlockedTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        /// <summary>Optional simple Duration/GrantedTag effect. DurationValue is evaluated once
        /// from the successful cast level/input and frozen; mutually exclusive with Charge.</summary>
        public GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset CooldownEffect;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayAbilityChargeAuthoring Charge;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring Cost;
        /// <summary>Unstacked persistent effects owned and removed by the activation lifecycle.</summary>
        public GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset[] ActivationEffects = Array.Empty<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>();

        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            if (MaxLevel < 1) v.Error(p + ".MaxLevel", "MaxLevel must be positive.");
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".RequiredTags", RequiredTags);
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".BlockedTags", BlockedTags);
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".ActivationOwnedTags", ActivationOwnedTags);
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".AbilityTags", AbilityTags);
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".CancelAbilitiesWithTags", CancelAbilitiesWithTags);
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".BlockAbilitiesWithTags", BlockAbilitiesWithTags);
            ValidateTags(v, p + ".OngoingBlockedTags", OngoingBlockedTags);
            if (CooldownEffect != null)
            {
                string path = p + ".CooldownEffect";
                v.Asset(CooldownEffect, path);
                if (CooldownEffect.DurationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                    v.Error(path + ".DurationPolicy", "Cooldown requires Duration policy.");
                if (CooldownEffect.GrantedTags != null && CooldownEffect.GrantedTags.Length == 0)
                    v.Error(path + ".GrantedTags", "Cooldown must grant at least one tag.");
                if (CooldownEffect.Modifiers != null && CooldownEffect.Modifiers.Length != 0)
                    v.Error(path + ".Modifiers", "Cooldown cannot contain modifiers.");
                if (CooldownEffect.Period != 0f) v.Error(path + ".Period", "Cooldown cannot be periodic.");
                if (CooldownEffect.PeriodValue != null) v.Error(path + ".PeriodValue", "Cooldown cannot have a dynamic period.");
                if (CooldownEffect.Executions != null && CooldownEffect.Executions.Length != 0)
                    v.Error(path + ".Executions", "Cooldown cannot contain executions.");
                if (CooldownEffect.Stacking != null) v.Error(path + ".Stacking", "Cooldown cannot stack.");
                if (CooldownEffect.CompletionExecutions != null && CooldownEffect.CompletionExecutions.Length != 0)
                    v.Error(path + ".CompletionExecutions", "Normal Ability cooldown uses context-free Apply; use a context-aware rule effect for completion.");
                if (HasRequirements(CooldownEffect.ApplicationRequirements))
                    v.Error(path + ".ApplicationRequirements", "Cooldown cannot have application requirements.");
                if (HasRequirements(CooldownEffect.OngoingRequirements))
                    v.Error(path + ".OngoingRequirements", "Cooldown cannot have ongoing requirements.");
            }
            if (Charge != null)
            {
                Charge.Validate(v, p + ".Charge");
                if (CooldownEffect != null) v.Error(p + ".Charge", "Charge and normal cooldown are mutually exclusive.");
            }
            Cost?.Validate(v, p + ".Cost");
            if (ActivationEffects == null) v.Error(p + ".ActivationEffects", "Activation effect list is null.");
            else for (int i = 0; i < ActivationEffects.Length; i++)
            {
                var effect = ActivationEffects[i];
                string path = p + $".ActivationEffects[{i}]";
                v.Asset(effect, path);
                if (effect == null) continue;
                if (effect.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)
                    v.Error(path + ".DurationPolicy", "Activation effect must be persistent.");
                if (effect.Stacking != null) v.Error(path + ".Stacking", "Activation effect must be unstacked.");
            }
        }

        private static bool HasRequirements(GameplayTagQueryAuthoring query) => query != null &&
            ((query.All?.Length ?? 0) != 0 || (query.Any?.Length ?? 0) != 0 || (query.None?.Length ?? 0) != 0);

        private static void ValidateTags(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string path, GameplayTagReference[] tags)
        {
            if (tags == null) { v.Error(path, "Tag list is null."); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < tags.Length; i++) v.Tag(tags[i], path + $"[{i}]");
        }

        /// <summary>Builds Ability, Cost and referenced effects in the same identity-preserving session.</summary>
        public GameplayAbilityDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            return context.Build(this, () =>
            {
                var effects = new List<GameplayEffectDefinition>();
                for (int i = 0; i < ActivationEffects.Length; i++) { int at = i; effects.Add(context.ResolveDefinition(ActivationEffects[i], this, "ActivationEffects.Array.data[" + i + "]", () => ActivationEffects[at].Build(context))); }
                var cost = Cost?.Build(context);
                if (Cost != null && cost == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Configured Cost.Build returned null.");
                return new GameplayAbilityDefinition(GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(RequiredTags),
                    GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(BlockedTags), GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(ActivationOwnedTags),
                    context.ResolveOptionalDefinition(CooldownEffect, this, nameof(CooldownEffect), () => CooldownEffect.Build(context)), Charge?.Build(), GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(AbilityTags),
                    GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(CancelAbilitiesWithTags), GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(BlockAbilitiesWithTags),
                    GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(OngoingBlockedTags), cost, effects, MaxLevel);
            });
        }
    
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Standard resource payment; costs mutate owner Attribute BaseValue atomically.
    /// Values may use Level, self attributes/resources and captured Context/Caller input. Both scalar
    /// namespaces read the same captured cast input for costs; no additional mutable cost state exists.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring : GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring
    {
        public Entry[] Resources = Array.Empty<Entry>();
        [Serializable]
        public sealed class Entry
        {
            public GameplayAttributeReference Attribute;
            [Min(0)]public float MinimumBalance;
            [Tooltip("负数扣除资源，正数增加资源；余额以 BaseValue 为准。")]
            [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Delta = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = -20 };
        }
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path)
        {
            if (Resources == null || Resources.Length == 0) { validation.Error(path + ".Resources", "Configure at least one resource."); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < Resources.Length; i++)
            {
                string p = path + $".Resources[{i}]";
                if (Resources[i] == null) { validation.Error(p, "Missing resource entry."); continue; }
                validation.Attribute(Resources[i].Attribute, p + ".Attribute");
                validation.Finite(Resources[i].MinimumBalance,p+".MinimumBalance");if(Resources[i].MinimumBalance<0)validation.Error(p+".MinimumBalance","余额门禁不能为负。");
                if (Resources[i].Delta == null) validation.Error(p + ".Delta", "Missing signed delta.");
                else
                {
                    Resources[i].Delta.Validate(validation, p + ".Delta");
                    try { new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[] { new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(Resources[i].Attribute.Build(), Resources[i].Delta.Build()) }); }
                    catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException || ex is FormatException || ex is ArithmeticException)
                    { validation.Error(p + ".Delta", ex.Message); }
                }
            }
        }
        public override IGameplayAbilityCost Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            var entries = new List<GameplayAttributeCostEntry>();
            foreach (var entry in Resources) entries.Add(new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(entry.Attribute.Build(), entry.Delta.Build(),entry.MinimumBalance));
            return new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(entries);
        }
    }
}
````
