````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplayAuthoringBuildContext
    {
        internal Func<GameplayDefinitionAsset, object, string, Type, object> GraphDefinitionResolver;
        internal Func<object, string, bool> GraphBindingExists;
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload, object> _localValues =
            new Dictionary<GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload, object>();

        /// <summary>Resolves an embedded graph binding when compiling V2, or the explicitly
        /// shared asset's ordinary builder. Local graph definitions never require SO proxies.</summary>
        public T ResolveDefinition<T>(GameplayDefinitionAsset legacy, object owner, string slot, Func<T> sharedBuilder) where T : class
        {
            if (GraphDefinitionResolver != null)
            {
                object resolved = GraphDefinitionResolver(legacy, owner, slot, typeof(T));
                if (resolved != null) return (T)resolved;
            }
            if (legacy == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Missing definition binding: " + slot);
            return sharedBuilder();
        }

        /// <summary>Optional resource bindings remain absent unless explicitly configured.</summary>
        public T ResolveOptionalDefinition<T>(GameplayDefinitionAsset legacy, object owner, string slot, Func<T> sharedBuilder) where T : class =>
            legacy == null && !(GraphBindingExists?.Invoke(owner, slot) ?? false) ? null : ResolveDefinition(legacy, owner, slot, sharedBuilder);

        /// <summary>Identity cache for plain embedded definition builders. The graph compiler
        /// validates the concrete payload and detects cycles before entering this factory.</summary>
        public T Build<T>(GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload payload, Func<T> factory) where T : class
        {
            if (_localValues.TryGetValue(payload, out var existing)) return (T)existing;
            T value = factory();
            if (value == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("A local definition builder returned null.");
            _localValues.Add(payload, value);
            return value;
        }

        /// <summary>Records the graph entity's persistent provenance for actual runtime actions.
        /// Migrated nodes retain their original DefinitionId/managed-reference identity.</summary>
        public void RegisterGraphActionSource(IGameplaySkillAction action, string sourceId, long actionId)
        {
            if (action == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(sourceId) || actionId < 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("A graph action requires a valid persistent source.");
            _actionSources[action] = new GameplaySkillTraceSource(sourceId, actionId);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Authored child callback list; the game owns callback routing and the child's disposable lifetime.</summary>
    [System.Serializable, UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayContinuationDefinitionData : GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload
    {
        public override System.Type DefinitionType => typeof(GameplayContinuationDefinition);
        public override object BuildDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);

        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] Actions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();
        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            if (Actions == null) { v.Error(p+".Actions","Missing action list."); return; }
            for (int i=0;i<Actions.Length;i++)
            {
                string path=p+".Actions["+i+"]";
                if (Actions[i]==null) v.Error(path,"Null action.");
                else { Actions[i].Validate(v,path); Actions[i].ValidateReferences(v,path); }
            }
        }
        public GameplayContinuationDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if(context==null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            return context.Build(this,()=> { var actions=new List<IGameplaySkillAction>(); foreach(var action in Actions) actions.Add(context.BuildAction(action)); return new GameplayContinuationDefinition(actions); });
        }
    
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [System.Serializable, UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayEffectDefinitionData : GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload
    {
        public override System.Type DefinitionType => typeof(GameplayEffectDefinition);
        public override object BuildDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);

        public GameplayEffectDurationPolicy DurationPolicy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant;
        public float Duration;
        public float Period;
        public GameplayTagReference[] EffectTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        public GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy PeriodicStart;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring DurationValue;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring PeriodValue;
        public GameplayEffectModifierAuthoring[] Modifiers = Array.Empty<GameplayEffectModifierAuthoring>();
        public GameplayTagReference[] GrantedTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring Stacking;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayTagQueryAuthoring ApplicationRequirements;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayTagQueryAuthoring OngoingRequirements;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring[] Executions = Array.Empty<GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring>();
        /// <summary>Only Duration natural expiry runs these, after modifiers, tags and handle have been removed.</summary>
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring[] CompletionExecutions = Array.Empty<GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring>();

        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Enum(DurationPolicy, p + ".DurationPolicy"); v.Finite(Duration, p + ".Duration"); v.Finite(Period, p + ".Period");
            if (DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration && Duration <= 0) v.Error(p + ".Duration", "Duration must be positive.");
            if (Period < 0) v.Error(p + ".Period", "Period must be nonnegative.");
            v.Enum(PeriodicStart, p + ".PeriodicStart");
            DurationValue?.Validate(v, p + ".DurationValue"); PeriodValue?.Validate(v, p + ".PeriodValue");
            if (DurationValue != null && DurationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration) v.Error(p + ".DurationValue", "Requires Duration policy.");

        public GameplayEffectDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            return context.Build(this, () =>
            {
                var modifiers = new List<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>();
                foreach (var item in Modifiers) modifiers.Add(item.Build());
                var executions = new List<IGameplayEffectExecution>();
                foreach (var item in Executions) executions.Add(item.Build());
                var completions = new List<IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution>();
                foreach (var item in CompletionExecutions) completions.Add(item.Build(context));
                return new GameplayEffectDefinition(DurationPolicy, Duration, Period, modifiers,
                    GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(GrantedTags), executions, Stacking?.Build(context),
                    ApplicationRequirements?.Build(), OngoingRequirements?.Build(), completions,
                    GameplayTagQueryAuthoring.BuildTags(EffectTags), PeriodicStart, DurationValue?.Build(), PeriodValue?.Build());
            });
        }
    
    }
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph

    /// <summary>Structured compilation diagnostics keep stable source paths available to the
    /// Workbench; callers can navigate the actual payload instead of parsing a stack trace.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayGraphCompilationException:InvalidOperationException
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> Issues {get;}
        public GameplayGraphCompilationException(IEnumerable<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> issues):this(issues.ToArray()){}
````

````csharp
        public static GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition Build(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, GameplayAuthoringGraph graph, GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {

            ValidateStructure(graph, validation, document.name);

            return context.Build(document, () => new GameplayGraphCompiler(document, graph, context).Compile());
        }
        /// <summary>Builds an explicitly requested local library entry for existing hosts such
        /// as the Lab's restore-charge/reduce-CD buttons. It uses this graph's bindings and

        public static T BuildLocalResource<T>(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string localId,GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) where T:class
        {

            var compiler=new GameplayGraphCompiler(document,document.AuthoringGraph,context);
            var previous=context.GraphDefinitionResolver;var previousExists=context.GraphBindingExists;
            context.GraphDefinitionResolver=compiler.Resolve;context.GraphBindingExists=compiler.HasBinding;

            finally{context.GraphDefinitionResolver=previous;context.GraphBindingExists=previousExists;}
        }

        /// <summary>Checks the same actual arrays used by compilation before an Editor mutation
        /// commits. Incomplete draft values do not disable structural authoring.</summary>
        public static void ValidateActionOrder(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {

            foreach (var timeline in graph.Timelines)
            {
                var reachable=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Reachable(graph);
                bool owned=graph.Nodes.Any(n=>reachable.Contains(n.Id)&&n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==timeline.Id)&&(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring);
                if (owned) foreach (var entry in timeline.Events.Where(e => e.TimeSeconds > 0))

        private GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition Compile()
        {
            var previousResolver = _context.GraphDefinitionResolver;
            var previousExists = _context.GraphBindingExists;
            _context.GraphDefinitionResolver = Resolve;
            _context.GraphBindingExists = HasBinding;
            try
            {
                // Match the existing document's build/source ordering, including additional rules.
                var additional = _graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Select(BuildRule).ToArray();
                var abilityNode = _nodes[_graph.AbilityNodeId];
                var ability = (GameplayAbilityNodePayload)abilityNode.Payload;
                GameplayAbilityDefinition builtAbility;
                if (ability.Settings is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)
                    builtAbility = (GameplayAbilityDefinition)BuildPayload(abilityNode.Id, ability.Settings, ability.Definitions);
                else if (ability.Settings == null && ability.Definitions.Count == 1 && ability.Definitions[0].PropertyPath == "Settings" &&
                    ability.Definitions[0].External is GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset)
                    builtAbility = (GameplayAbilityDefinition)Bound(ability.Definitions[0]);
                else throw new InvalidOperationException("技能施放必须使用内嵌 Ability 值或明确共享的释放配置。");
                var rule = BuildRule(_graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId);
                if ((_document.Mode == GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active || _document.RunRulesOnPassiveActivation) &&
                    (!(((GameplayRuleNodePayload)_nodes[_graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId].Payload).Trigger is GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring trigger) ||
                     trigger.EventTag.Name != _document.CastEvent.Name || ((GameplayRuleNodePayload)_nodes[_graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId].Payload).Once))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("主动入口必须消费正式 CastEvent 且 Once=false。");
                var values = _document.Defaults.Select(d => new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(d.Key.Build(), d.Value));
                return new GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition(_document.SkillId, builtAbility, rule,
                    _document.Mode == GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active || _document.RunRulesOnPassiveActivation ? _document.CastEvent.Build() : default,
                    _document.Mode, _document.Subject, new GameplayContextValues(values), additional,
                    Array.ConvertAll(_document.LearningRequirements, r => r.Build()), _context.GetActionSourcesSnapshot(), _document.DefinitionId,
                    _document.RunRulesOnPassiveActivation);
            }
            finally { _context.GraphDefinitionResolver = previousResolver; _context.GraphBindingExists = previousExists; }
        }

        private GameplaySkillDefinition BuildRule(string id)
        {
            if (_built.TryGetValue(id, out var cached)) return (GameplaySkillDefinition)cached;
            var payload = (GameplayRuleNodePayload)_nodes[id].Payload;
            var v = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
            if (payload.Trigger == null || payload.Target == null || payload.Conditions == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("规则缺少触发、目标或条件。");
            payload.Trigger.Validate(v, id + ".Trigger"); payload.Target.Validate(v, id + ".Target");
            foreach (var condition in payload.Conditions) { if (condition == null) v.Error(id, "缺少规则条件。"); else condition.Validate(v, id + ".Conditions"); }
            Throw(v);
            var actions = BuildOutput(id, "Actions", false);
            if (actions.Length == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("规则至少需要一个正式行为。");
            var result = new GameplaySkillDefinition(payload.Trigger.Build(), payload.Conditions.Select(c => c.Build()), payload.Target.Build(), actions, payload.Once, payload.PreserveTriggerContext);
            _built.Add(id, result); return result;
        }

        private object BuildResource(string id)
        {
            if (_built.TryGetValue(id, out var cached)) return cached;
            if (!_active.Add(id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("定义引用存在循环：" + id);
            try
            {
                object result;
                if (_timelines.TryGetValue(id, out var timeline)) result = BuildTimeline(timeline);
                else if (_definitions.TryGetValue(id, out var definition)) result = BuildPayload(id, definition.Payload, definition.Definitions);
                else throw new InvalidOperationException("局部定义不存在：" + id);
                _built.Add(id, result); return result;
            }
            finally { _active.Remove(id); }
        }

        private GameplaySequenceDefinition BuildTimeline(GameplayAuthoringTimeline timeline)
        {
            if(timeline.Events.Count==0)throw new InvalidOperationException("已执行的时间编排至少需要一个真实事件；请添加行为或结束施放。");
            var reachable=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Reachable(_graph);
            bool owned=_graph.Nodes.Any(n=>reachable.Contains(n.Id)&&n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==timeline.Id)&&(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring);
            var markers = new List<GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition>();
            foreach (var entry in timeline.Events.OrderBy(e => e.Order))
            {
                if (entry.Target == null || entry.Conditions == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("时间事件缺少目标或条件：" + entry.Id);
                var v = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext(); entry.Target.Validate(v, entry.Id + ".Target");
                foreach (var condition in entry.Conditions) { if (condition == null) v.Error(entry.Id, "缺少事件条件。"); else condition.Validate(v, entry.Id + ".Conditions"); }
                Throw(v);
                var actions = BuildChain(entry.EntryNodeId, owned && entry.TimeSeconds > 0);
                markers.Add(new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(entry.TimeSeconds, entry.Conditions.Select(c => c.Build()), entry.Target.Build(), actions));
            }
            return new GameplaySequenceDefinition(timeline.DurationSeconds, markers);
        }

        private IGameplaySkillAction[] BuildOutput(string owner, string port, bool guarded)
        {
            var entries = Edges(owner, port).Select(e => e.ToNodeId).ToArray();
            if (guarded) ValidateGuardedArray(entries, new HashSet<string>());
            return entries.SelectMany(id => BuildChain(id, guarded)).ToArray();
        }

        // Validate the whole real array, including separate ordered roots and cached/shared
        // nodes. Definition memoization must never hide a later guarded use of the same node.
        private void ValidateGuardedArray(IEnumerable<string> entries, HashSet<string> checkedNodes)
        {
            var ids = new List<string>();
            Action<string> append = null;
            append = id => { ids.Add(id); foreach (var edge in Edges(id, "Then")) append(edge.ToNodeId); };
            foreach (string id in entries) append(id);
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.Count - 1; i++)
                if (((GameplayActionNodePayload)_nodes[ids[i]].Payload).Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("已受 OwnedSequence 生命周期守卫的同一动作数组，不能在 End 后追加执行。");
            foreach (string id in ids)
                if (checkedNodes.Add(id))
                    foreach (var port in GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(((GameplayActionNodePayload)_nodes[id].Payload).Action))
                        ValidateGuardedArray(Edges(id, port.Path).Select(e => e.ToNodeId), checkedNodes);
        }

        private IGameplaySkillAction[] BuildChain(string id, bool guarded)
        {
            if (guarded) ValidateGuardedArray(new[] { id }, new HashSet<string>());
            var ids = new List<string>();
            Action<string> collect = null;
            collect = nodeId => { ids.Add(nodeId); foreach (var edge in Edges(nodeId, "Then")) collect(edge.ToNodeId); };
            collect(id);
            if (guarded)
                for (int i = 0; i < ids.Count - 1; i++)
                    if (((GameplayActionNodePayload)_nodes[ids[i]].Payload).Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("已受 OwnedSequence 生命周期守卫的同一动作数组，不能在 End 后追加执行。");
            return ids.Select(nodeId => BuildAction(nodeId, guarded)).ToArray();
        }

        private IGameplaySkillAction BuildAction(string id, bool guarded)
        {
            if (_built.TryGetValue(id, out var cached)) return (IGameplaySkillAction)cached;
            if (!_active.Add(id)) throw new InvalidOperationException("行为或回调循环：" + id);
            try
            {
                var record = _nodes[id]; var payload = (GameplayActionNodePayload)record.Payload;
                if (payload.Action == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("丢失行为类型：" + id);
                var action = (GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(payload.Action);
                RejectLegacyRelationships(action, id);
                foreach (var slot in GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(action))
                    slot.Value = BuildOutput(id, slot.Path, guarded).Select(a => (GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)new CompiledAction(a)).ToArray();
                Push(id, action, payload.Definitions);
                try
                {
                    var v = Validation(id); action.Validate(v, id); action.ValidateReferences(v, id); Throw(v);
                    var result = action.Build(_context);
                    if(_conditionalInputs.TryGetValue(id,out var required))result=new GameplayGraphInputGuard(result,required,
                        new GameplaySkillTraceSource(string.IsNullOrEmpty(record.SourceDefinitionId)?_document.DefinitionId:record.SourceDefinitionId,
                            record.SourceActionId>=0?record.SourceActionId:StableActionId(record.Id),_document.DefinitionId));
                    _context.RegisterGraphActionSource(result, string.IsNullOrEmpty(record.SourceDefinitionId) ? _document.DefinitionId : record.SourceDefinitionId,
                        record.SourceActionId >= 0 ? record.SourceActionId : StableActionId(record.Id));
                    _built.Add(id, result); return result;
                }
                finally { _scopes.Pop(); }
            }
            finally { _active.Remove(id); }
        }

        private object BuildPayload(string id, GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload source, List<GameplayDefinitionBinding> bindings)
        {
            if (source == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("丢失局部定义 Payload：" + id);
            var payload = (GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(source);
            RejectLegacyRelationships(payload, id);
            if(payload is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect)bindings=ActiveCallbacks(id,effect,bindings);
            foreach (var slot in GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(payload))
                slot.Value = BuildOutput(id, slot.Path, false).Select(a => (GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)new CompiledAction(a)).ToArray();
            Push(id, payload, bindings);
            try { var v = Validation(id); payload.Validate(v, id); Throw(v); return payload.BuildDefinition(_context); }
            finally { _scopes.Pop(); }
        }

        // A disconnected executor remains authoring data with its stable identity and flags.
        // Only connected callbacks are lowered. Never rewrite the author's overflow policy.
        private List<GameplayDefinitionBinding> ActiveCallbacks(string id,GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect,List<GameplayDefinitionBinding> bindings)
        {
            var before=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(effect).ToArray();
            var connected=new HashSet<string>(before.Where(s=>Edges(id,s.Key).Any()||bindings.Any(b=>b.PropertyPath==s.Path)).Select(s=>s.Key));
            effect.CompletionExecutions=effect.CompletionExecutions.Where(e=>!(e is GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring)||connected.Contains("Completion/"+e.AuthoringId)).ToArray();
            if(effect.Stacking!=null){
                bool hadExecutors=effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Length>0;
                effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions=effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Where(e=>!(e is GameplayApplyEffectOnOverflowAuthoring)||connected.Contains("Overflow/"+e.AuthoringId)).ToArray();
                if(hadExecutors&&effect.Stacking.Overflow==GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow&&effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Length==0)effect.Stacking.Overflow=GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject;
            }
            var after=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(effect).ToDictionary(s=>s.Key);

        }

        private static void RejectLegacyRelationships(object payload, string id)
        {
            if (GameplayGraphFields.ResourceSlots(payload).Any(s => s.Value != null))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("行为 Payload 不允许保留历史 SO 执行引用：" + id);
            if (GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(payload).Any(s => ((GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[])s.Value)?.Length > 0))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("动作数组必须由显式连接拥有：" + id);
        }

        private void Push(string id, object payload, List<GameplayDefinitionBinding> bindings)
        {
            if (bindings == null || bindings.Any(b => b == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.PropertyPath) ||
                (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.LocalId) == (b.External != null))) ||
                bindings.GroupBy(b => b.PropertyPath).Any(g => g.Count() > 1))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("局部/共享定义引用必须唯一且明确：" + id);
            _scopes.Push(new BindingScope { Id = id, Bindings = bindings, Paths = GameplayGraphFields.ObjectPaths(payload),Payload=payload });
        }

        private GameplayAuthoringValidationContext Validation(string id)
        {
            var v = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
            v.GraphAssetValidation = (asset, path) =>
            {
                if (_scopes.Count == 0) return false;
                var scope = _scopes.Peek();
                string relative = GameplayGraphFields.NormalizePath(path.StartsWith(id + ".", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? path.Substring(id.Length + 1) : path);
                var matches = scope.Bindings.Where(b => b.PropertyPath == relative || b.PropertyPath.StartsWith(relative + ".Array.data[", StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToArray();
                if (matches.Length == 0){
                    if(!GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(scope.Payload).Any(s=>s.Path==relative&&Edges(scope.Id,s.Key).Any()))return false;
                    try{ResolveBinding(scope,relative);}catch(Exception error){v.Error(path,error.Message);}return true;
                }
                foreach (var binding in matches)
                {
                    try { Bound(binding); } catch (Exception e) { v.Error(path, e.Message); }
                }
                return true;
            };
            return v;
        }

        private bool HasBinding(object owner, string slot)
        {
            if (_scopes.Count == 0 || !_scopes.Peek().Paths.TryGetValue(owner, out var prefix)) return false;
            string path = prefix.Length == 0 ? slot : prefix + "." + slot;
            var scope=_scopes.Peek();path=GameplayGraphFields.NormalizePath(path);
            return scope.Bindings.Any(b => b.PropertyPath == path)||GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(scope.Payload).Any(s=>s.Path==path&&Edges(scope.Id,s.Key).Any());
        }

        private object Resolve(GameplayDefinitionAsset legacy, object owner, string slot, Type expected)
        {
            if (_scopes.Count == 0 || !_scopes.Peek().Paths.TryGetValue(owner, out var prefix)) return null;
            string path = GameplayGraphFields.NormalizePath(prefix.Length == 0 ? slot : prefix + "." + slot);
            object result = ResolveBinding(_scopes.Peek(),path);
            if (!expected.IsInstanceOfType(result)) throw new InvalidOperationException("定义引用类型错误：" + path + "，需要 " + expected.Name);
            return result;
        }
        private object ResolveBinding(BindingScope scope,string path)
        {
            var binding=scope.Bindings.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath==path);if(binding!=null)return Bound(binding);
            var callback=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(scope.Payload).SingleOrDefault(s=>s.Path==path);
            if(callback!=null){var edge=Edges(scope.Id,callback.Key).SingleOrDefault();if(edge!=null){
                var target=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.EffectBinding(_nodes[edge.ToNodeId]);if(target!=null)return Bound(target);
            }}throw new InvalidOperationException("缺少必需的定义引用："+scope.Id+"."+path);
        }

        private object Bound(GameplayDefinitionBinding binding) => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.LocalId)
            ? BuildResource(binding.LocalId) : binding.External != null ? binding.External.BuildSharedDefinition(_context)
            : throw new InvalidOperationException("定义引用已丢失：" + binding.PropertyPath);

        private static void Throw(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v)
        { if (v.HasErrors) throw new GameplayGraphCompilationException(v.Issues); }

        public static long StableActionId(string id)
        {
            unchecked { ulong value = 14695981039346656037UL; foreach (char c in id) { value ^= c; value *= 1099511628211UL; } return (long)(value & 0x7fffffffffffffffUL); }
        }

        // Compiler-only bridge for existing nested action factories. Never persisted or installed
        // as an authoring source, and never introduces another executable rule implementation.
        private sealed class CompiledAction : GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
        {
            private readonly IGameplaySkillAction _action;
            internal CompiledAction(IGameplaySkillAction action) { _action = action; }
            public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) { }
            public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => _action;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

    /// <summary>Proven values and optional caller values are different facts. Optional inputs

            {Actor=TriggerActor=actor;Point=TriggerPoint=point;OptionalActor=OptionalTriggerActor=optionalActor;OptionalPoint=OptionalTriggerPoint=optionalPoint;Note=note;}
            private Inputs(bool actor,bool point,string note,bool optionalActor,bool optionalPoint,Inputs trigger)

        }

        private static Inputs Target(GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring target,Inputs input,bool timeline=false)=>
            target is GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring?input.With(true,false,"显式自身"):
            target is GameplaySkillPointTargetAuthoring?input.With(false,true,"显式地点"):
            timeline?input.With(input.TriggerActor,input.TriggerPoint,"时间事件读取原 TriggerEvent.Context",input.OptionalTriggerActor,input.OptionalTriggerPoint):input;
        public static HashSet<string> Reachable(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {

                if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)||!visits.Add(id+":"+effectOnly))return;result.Add(id);
                var node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==id);var definition=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==id);
                foreach(var b in node?.Payload.Definitions??definition?.Definitions??new List<GameplayDefinitionBinding>())visit(b.LocalId,false);
                if(effectOnly)return;
                var timeline=graph.Timelines.Find(t=>t.Id==id);if(timeline!=null)foreach(var e in timeline.Events)visit(e.EntryNodeId,false);
                foreach(var e in graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==id))visit(e.ToNodeId,e.InputPortKey==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input);
            };visit(graph.AbilityNodeId,false);visit(graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId,false);foreach(var id in graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds)visit(id,false);return result;
        }
        public static Inputs Output(object payload,string port,Inputs input)

            if(payload is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring){
                if(port=="EachTarget")return input.With(true,true,"搜索的有效逐目标 Actor/Point");
                if(port=="NoTargets"||port=="Completed"||port=="Then")return input.With(false,true,"搜索完成/无目标不保证 Actor；先以地点重新搜索");
            }
            if(payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData)return input.With(port=="OnHit",true,"弹体仅 OnHit 保证 Actor");
            if (payload is GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring && port == "OnBroken")
                return input.With(true, true, "护盾耗尽后提供破盾者与地点");
            if (payload is GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring && port == "OnExpired")
                return input.With(true, input.Point, "自然到期后提供原护盾目标");
            if(payload is GameplayAreaDefinitionData){
                if(port=="OnEnd")return input;

        private static object Payload(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string id)

        private static Requirement Required(object value)

        private static Requirement Optional(Inputs input)=>(input.OptionalActor?Requirement.Actor|Requirement.PrimaryActor:Requirement.None)|(input.OptionalPoint?Requirement.Point:Requirement.None);
        public static string Describe(Requirement required)=>((required&(Requirement.Actor|Requirement.PrimaryActor))!=0?"有效目标 Actor":"")+((required&(Requirement.Actor|Requirement.PrimaryActor))!=0&&(required&Requirement.Point)!=0?" + ":"")+((required&Requirement.Point)!=0?"地点 Point":"");
        private static string Impossible(Requirement required,Inputs input)
        {var missing=Missing(required,input)&~Optional(input);return missing==Requirement.None?null:"此行为需要"+Describe(missing)+"。"+input.Note;}
        private static Dictionary<string,List<Inputs>> Analyze(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            var inputs=new Dictionary<string,List<Inputs>>();var seen=new HashSet<string>();Action<string,Inputs,bool> visit=null;visit=(id,input,effectOnly)=>{
                if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)||!seen.Add(id+":"+input.Actor+":"+input.Point+":"+input.OptionalActor+":"+input.OptionalPoint+":"+input.TriggerActor+":"+input.TriggerPoint+":"+input.OptionalTriggerActor+":"+input.OptionalTriggerPoint+":"+effectOnly))return;
                if(!effectOnly){if(!inputs.TryGetValue(id,out var list))inputs[id]=list=new List<Inputs>();list.Add(input);}
                var node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==id);var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==id);

                foreach(var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==id))visit(edge.ToNodeId,Output(Payload(graph,id),edge.OutputPortKey,input),edge.InputPortKey==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input);
            };

            return inputs;
        }
        /// <summary>Conditional requirements are not compile-time guarantees. The compiler gates
        /// each consumer at its actual execution point, including branch/Timeline context.</summary>
        public static Dictionary<string,Requirement> ConditionalInputs(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {

        private static string Reason(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,Dictionary<string,List<Inputs>> inputs,string owner,string port,string target,string inputPort,bool scheduled)
        {
            if(inputPort!="Execute")return null;var node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==target);if(!(node?.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload))return null;
            GameplayScheduledEntry entry=null;if(scheduled){var timeline=graph.Timelines.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.Events.Any(e=>e.Id==owner));if(timeline==null)return "时间事件已改变，请重新拖线。";entry=timeline.Events.Single(e=>e.Id==owner);owner=timeline.Id;}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph
{
    /// <summary>Effect-to-Effect callbacks are typed references to the actual completion/overflow
    /// executors, never SkillAction arrays. Stable callback IDs survive inspector array reorder.
    /// A receiver's Effect input consumes its definition only, not its Execute/Then action chain.</summary>
    public static class GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks
    {
        public const string Completion="AddCompletion",Overflow="AddOverflow",Input="Effect";
        public sealed class Slot {public string Key,Path;public bool IsCompletion;}
        public static IEnumerable<Slot> Slots(object value)
        {
            if(!(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect))yield break;
            for(int i=0;i<effect.CompletionExecutions.Length;i++)if(effect.CompletionExecutions[i] is GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring completion)
                yield return new Slot{Key="Completion/"+completion.AuthoringId,Path="CompletionExecutions.Array.data["+i+"].Effect",IsCompletion=true};
            if(effect.Stacking!=null)for(int i=0;i<effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Length;i++)if(effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions[i] is GameplayApplyEffectOnOverflowAuthoring overflow)
                yield return new Slot{Key="Overflow/"+overflow.AuthoringId,Path="Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Array.data["+i+"].Effect"};
        }
        public static string[] Ports(object value){if(!(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect))return Array.Empty<string>();var ports=new List<string>();if(effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)ports.Add(Completion);if(effect.Stacking?.Overflow==GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow)ports.Add(Overflow);return ports.Concat(Slots(value).Select(s=>s.Key)).ToArray();}
        public static bool IsPort(object value,string key)=>Ports(value).Contains(key);
        public static GameplayDefinitionBinding EffectBinding(GameplayAuthoringNode node)=>
            (node?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring||(node?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring?
                node.Payload.Definitions.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Effect"):null;
        public static string Add(GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect,bool completion)
        {
            if(completion){var item=new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring();effect.CompletionExecutions=effect.CompletionExecutions.Concat(new[]{item}).ToArray();return "Completion/"+item.AuthoringId;}
            if(effect.Stacking==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("请先配置叠层及 ExecuteOverflow。");
            var overflow=new GameplayApplyEffectOnOverflowAuthoring();effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions=effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Concat(new[]{overflow}).ToArray();return "Overflow/"+overflow.AuthoringId;
        }
        public static void Remove(GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect,string key)
        {
            if(key.StartsWith("Completion/",StringComparison.Ordinal))effect.CompletionExecutions=effect.CompletionExecutions.Where(e=>"Completion/"+e.AuthoringId!=key).ToArray();
            else if(effect.Stacking!=null){effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions=effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Where(e=>"Overflow/"+e.AuthoringId!=key).ToArray();if(effect.Stacking.OverflowExecutions.Length==0)effect.Stacking.Overflow=GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject;}
        }
        /// <summary>Lossless format upgrade: replace old callback configuration bindings with
        /// explicit typed edges. No executor, ownership flag, effect value or shared identity changes.</summary>
        public static bool ExposeBindings(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            bool changed=false;
            foreach(var local in graph.LocalDefinitions.ToArray())foreach(var slot in Slots(local.Payload).ToArray()){
                var binding=local.Definitions.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath==slot.Path);if(binding==null)continue;
                var target=graph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n=>{var b=EffectBinding(n);return b!=null&&b.LocalId==binding.LocalId&&b.External==binding.External;});
                if(target==null){var source=graph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n=>n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==local.Id));
                    var resource=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId);
                    target=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Title=resource?.Name??binding.External?.name??"后续效果",Position=(source?.Position??Vector2.zero)+new Vector2(350,180),
                        SourceDefinitionId=resource?.SourceDefinitionId,Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring()}};
                    target.Payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath="Effect",LocalId=binding.LocalId,External=binding.External});graph.Nodes.Add(target);
                }
                local.Definitions.Remove(binding);graph.Connections.Add(new GameplayAuthoringConnection{FromNodeId=local.Id,OutputPortKey=slot.Key,ToNodeId=target.Id,InputPortKey=Input});changed=true;
            }return changed;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph
{
    /// <summary>Cached serialization metadata for existing polymorphic authoring values.
    /// This traverses only one in-memory payload; it never discovers assets or registers types.</summary>
    public static class GameplayGraphFields
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<Type, FieldInfo[]> Fields = new Dictionary<Type, FieldInfo[]>();
        public static FieldInfo[] SerializedFields(Type type)
        {
            if (Fields.TryGetValue(type, out var result)) return result;
            var all = new List<FieldInfo>();
            for (var t = type; t != null && t != typeof(object); t = t.BaseType)
                all.AddRange(t.GetFields(BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly)
                    .Where(f => !f.IsStatic && !f.IsNotSerialized && (f.IsPublic ||
                        f.IsDefined(typeof(SerializeField), false) || f.IsDefined(typeof(SerializeReference), false))));
            result = all.OrderBy(f => f.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
            Fields.Add(type, result);
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>Clones ordinary serialized values, preserving real Unity resource references.
        /// The clone is never added to an asset; it is the compiler's disposable parameter copy.</summary>
        public static object Clone(object value) => value == null ? null : JsonUtility.FromJson(JsonUtility.ToJson(value), value.GetType());

        public sealed class Slot
        {
            public object Owner;
            public FieldInfo Field;
            public int Index = -1;
            public string Path;
            public Type ValueType => Index >= 0 ? Field.FieldType.GetElementType() : Field.FieldType;
            public object Value
            {
                get => Index >= 0 ? ((Array)Field.GetValue(Owner)).GetValue(Index) : Field.GetValue(Owner);
                set { if (Index >= 0) ((Array)Field.GetValue(Owner)).SetValue(value, Index); else Field.SetValue(Owner, value); }
            }
        }

        public static List<Slot> ResourceSlots(object root)
        {
            var slots = new List<Slot>();
            Walk(root, "", new HashSet<object>(), (owner, field, path) =>
            {
                if (typeof(GameplayDefinitionAsset).IsAssignableFrom(field.FieldType))
                { slots.Add(new Slot { Owner = owner, Field = field, Path = path }); return false; }
                if (field.FieldType.IsArray && typeof(GameplayDefinitionAsset).IsAssignableFrom(field.FieldType.GetElementType()))
                {
                    var array = field.GetValue(owner) as Array;
                    for (int i = 0; i < (array?.Length ?? 0); i++) slots.Add(new Slot { Owner = owner, Field = field, Index = i, Path = path + ".Array.data[" + i + "]" });
                    return false;
                }
                return true;
            });
            return slots;
        }

        public static List<Slot> ActionArrays(object root)
        {
            var slots = new List<Slot>();
            Walk(root, "", new HashSet<object>(), (owner, field, path) =>
            {
                if (field.FieldType == typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[]))
                { slots.Add(new Slot { Owner = owner, Field = field, Path = path }); return false; }
                return !typeof(UnityEngine.Object).IsAssignableFrom(field.FieldType);
            });
            return slots;
        }

        public static Dictionary<object, string> ObjectPaths(object root)
        {
            var result = new Dictionary<object, string>();
            if (root != null) result[root] = "";
            Walk(root, "", new HashSet<object>(), (owner, field, path) =>
            {
                object value = field.GetValue(owner);
                if (value != null && !value.GetType().IsValueType && !(value is string) && !(value is UnityEngine.Object))
                {
                    if (value is Array array) { for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++) if (array.GetValue(i) != null) result[array.GetValue(i)] = path + ".Array.data[" + i + "]"; }
                    else result[value] = path;
                }
                return true;
            });
            return result;
        }

        private static void Walk(object value, string path, HashSet<object> seen, Func<object, FieldInfo, string, bool> visit)
        {
            if (value == null || value is string || value is UnityEngine.Object) return;
            var type = value.GetType();
            if (type.IsPrimitive || type.IsEnum) return;
            if (!type.IsValueType && !seen.Add(value)) return;
            foreach (var field in SerializedFields(type))
            {
                string childPath = path.Length == 0 ? field.Name : path + "." + field.Name;
                if (!visit(value, field, childPath)) continue;
                object child = field.GetValue(value);
                if (child is Array array)
                {
                    for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++) Walk(array.GetValue(i), childPath + ".Array.data[" + i + "]", seen, visit);
                }
                else Walk(child, childPath, seen, visit);
            }
        }

        public static string NormalizePath(string path) =>
            System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Replace(path ?? "", @"(?<!data)\[(\d+)\]", ".Array.data[$1]");

        /// <summary>These outputs map one-to-one to an actual action array. Then is compiled
        /// into the caller's ordered array; it does not introduce a runtime graph reader.</summary>
        public static string[] OutputPorts(GameplayAuthoringNode node)
        {
            if (node.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload) return new[] { "Actions" };
            if (node.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action && action.Action != null)
                return new[] { "Then" }.Concat(ActionArrays(action.Action).Select(s => s.Path)).ToArray();
            return Array.Empty<string>();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph
{
    /// <summary>Compiler-only gate for optional caller input. It runs immediately before the
    /// actual consumer, so an unchosen branch is never rejected and sequence ownership guards,
    /// context outputs and source tracing retain their existing runtime behavior.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplayGraphInputGuard : IGameplaySkillAction, IGameplaySkillContextAction, IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction
    {
        private readonly IGameplaySkillAction _action;
        private readonly GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement _required;
        private readonly GameplaySkillTraceSource _source;
        internal GameplayGraphInputGuard(IGameplaySkillAction action,GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement required,GameplaySkillTraceSource source)
        {_action=action;_required=required;_source=source;}
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData trigger,IGameplaySkillHost host)=>ExecuteGuarded(context,trigger,host,null).Result;
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData trigger,IGameplaySkillHost host)=>ExecuteGuarded(context,trigger,host,null);
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteGuarded(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData trigger,IGameplaySkillHost host,Func<bool> canContinue)
        {
            if(canContinue!=null&&!canContinue())return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected,context);
            var data=context.TargetData;var missing=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.None;
            Func<GameplaySourceId,bool> live=id=>id.IsValid&&(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor)||actor.World.TryGetActor(id,out _));
            if((_required&GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.Actor)!=0&&!live(data.PrimaryTargetId)&&!data.Targets.Any(live))missing|=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.Actor;
            if((_required&GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.PrimaryActor)!=0&&!live(data.PrimaryTargetId))missing|=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.PrimaryActor;
            if((_required&GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.Point)!=0&&!data.HasPoint)missing|=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.Point;
            if(missing!=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement.None){
                if(host is IGameplaySkillTraceSink sink)try{sink.RecordSkillTrace(new GameplaySkillTraceRecord(host.OwnerId,context,trigger.EventTag,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ContextRejected,"调用者输入",detail:"缺少"+GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Describe(missing),source:_source));}catch{ /* Observation cannot alter execution. */ }
                return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected,context);
            }
            if(_action is IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction guarded)return guarded.ExecuteGuarded(context,trigger,host,canContinue);
            if(_action is IGameplaySkillContextAction contextual)return contextual.ExecuteWithContext(context,trigger,host);
            return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(_action.Execute(context,trigger,host),context);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Authoring/Graph/GameplayGraphPortPolicy.cs
````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph
{
    /// <summary>Static reachability of existing runtime callbacks. Editor compatibility and
    /// compiler validation share it; it does not simulate spatial queries or infer a host.</summary>
    public static class GameplayGraphPortPolicy
    {
        public static string Unavailable(object payload,string port)
        {
            if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(port))return null;
            if(payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile && port=="OnArrive" &&
               projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight && projectile.StraightDestination==GameplayStraightDestinationMode.Direction)
                return "方向直射不会到达固定终点；请使用射程结束，或改为固定终点模式后连接到达。";
            if(payload is GameplayAreaDefinitionData area&&port=="OnTick"&&area.TickInterval is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring tick&&tick.Value<=0)
                return "区域周期必须大于零；持续停留是每步回调，不等同于周期。";
            if(payload is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect){
                if((port==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion||port.StartsWith("Completion/",StringComparison.Ordinal))&&effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                    return "自然完成仅在 Duration 自然到期时执行；先断开此分支再切换策略。";
                if((port==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Overflow||port.StartsWith("Overflow/",StringComparison.Ordinal))&&effect.Stacking?.Overflow!=GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow)
                    return "溢出分支仅由 ExecuteOverflow 策略消费。";
            }
            return null;
        }
        public static string Unavailable(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string owner,string port)
        {
            var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==owner);
            return Unavailable(local?.Payload,port);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
    {
````

````csharp
        public bool HasMagnitude;
        public float Magnitude;

        public float Duration;

        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path)
        {
            base.Validate(validation, path);
            validation.Tag(CueTag, path + ".CueTag");
            if (HasMagnitude) validation.Finite(Magnitude, path + ".Magnitude");
            if (HasDuration)

                if (Duration <= 0f) validation.Error(path + ".Duration", "Cue duration must be positive.");
            }
        }

        public override GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) =>
            new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(Time, CueTag.Build(),
                HasMagnitude ? Magnitude : (float?)null, HasDuration ? Duration : (float?)null);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "FRFrame Gameplay/Sequence Definition")]
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset : GameplayDefinitionAsset
    {
        public float Duration;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] Markers =
            Array.Empty<GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring>();

        public override object BuildSharedDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path)
        {
            validation.Finite(Duration, path + ".Duration");
            if (Duration < 0f) validation.Error(path + ".Duration", "Sequence duration must be nonnegative.");
            if (Markers == null) { validation.Error(path + ".Markers", "Marker list is null."); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < Markers.Length; i++)
            {
                var marker = Markers[i];
                string markerPath = path + $".Markers[{i}]";
                if (marker == null) { validation.Error(markerPath, "Null marker."); continue; }
                marker.Validate(validation, markerPath);
                if (marker.Time > Duration) validation.Error(markerPath + ".Time", "Marker exceeds sequence duration.");
            }
        }

        public GameplaySequenceDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            return context.Build(this, () =>
            {
                var markers = new List<GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition>();
                foreach (var marker in Markers) markers.Add(marker.Build(context));
                return new GameplaySequenceDefinition(Duration, markers);
            });
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Authored marker-time Skill step. Reuses Skill nodes and the same asset build session.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring : GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring
    {
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring[] Conditions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring>();
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring Target;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] Actions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();

        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path)
        {
            base.Validate(validation, path);
            if (Conditions == null) validation.Error(path + ".Conditions", "Condition list is null.");
            else for (int i = 0; i < Conditions.Length; i++)
                if (Conditions[i] == null) validation.Error(path + $".Conditions[{i}]", "Null condition.");
                else Conditions[i].Validate(validation, path + $".Conditions[{i}]");
            if (Target == null) validation.Error(path + ".Target", "Missing target.");
            else Target.Validate(validation, path + ".Target");
            if (Actions == null || Actions.Length == 0) validation.Error(path + ".Actions", "At least one action is required.");
            else for (int i = 0; i < Actions.Length; i++)
                if (Actions[i] == null) validation.Error(path + $".Actions[{i}]", "Null action.");
                else
                {
                    Actions[i].Validate(validation, path + $".Actions[{i}]");
                    Actions[i].ValidateReferences(validation, path + $".Actions[{i}]");
                }
        }

        public override GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            var conditions = new List<IGameplaySkillCondition>();
            foreach (var condition in Conditions) conditions.Add(condition.Build());
            var actions = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>();
            foreach (var action in Actions) actions.Add(context.BuildAction(action));
            return new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(Time, conditions, Target.Build(), actions);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
            Tags?.Validate(v,p+".Tags");
            if(Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight&&StraightDestination==GameplayStraightDestinationMode.CapturedDestination)
                v.Warning(p+".StraightDestination","固定终点捕获目标位置（无目标时使用点位），不跟随移动目标。MaxHits优先于到达；MaxRange不足或Duration先耗尽分别Range/Completed，不执行OnArrive。请检查Speed×Duration和MaxRange能覆盖目标距离。");
            else if(Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight&&OnArrive!=null&&OnArrive.Length>0)
                v.Warning(p+".OnArrive","方向直射仅按射程/寿命结束，不触发OnArrive；需要到达回调请选择固定终点模式。");
            GameplaySpatialAuthoringUtility.Validate(OnHit,v,p+".OnHit");GameplaySpatialAuthoringUtility.Validate(OnArrive,v,p+".OnArrive");
            GameplaySpatialAuthoringUtility.Validate(OnRange,v,p+".OnRange");GameplaySpatialAuthoringUtility.Validate(OnCancelled,v,p+".OnCancelled");
            v.Finite(DirectionAngle,p+".DirectionAngle");
            foreach(var offset in new[]{Control1Offset,Control2Offset,LaunchOffset,DestinationOffset})if(!float.IsFinite(offset.x)||!float.IsFinite(offset.y)||!float.IsFinite(offset.z))v.Error(p,"Projectile offsets must be finite.");
        }
    
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "FRFrame Gameplay/角色战斗配置")]
    public sealed class GameplayActorProfileAsset : GameplayDefinitionAsset
    {
        public GameplayCombatMappingAuthoring Combat = new GameplayCombatMappingAuthoring();
        public GameplayProfileSkillAuthoring[] StartingSkills=Array.Empty<GameplayProfileSkillAuthoring>();
        public GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring[] Attributes = {
            new GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("Health"), Value = 1000 },
            new GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("MaxHealth"), Value = 1000 },
            new GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("Attack"), Value = 100 },
            new GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("Defense"), Value = 0 },
            new GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("Shield"), Value = 0 },
            new GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("Mana"), Value = 100 } };
        public override object BuildSharedDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            if (Combat == null) { v.Error(p + ".Combat", "Missing combat mapping."); return; }
            if (Attributes == null) { v.Error(p + ".Attributes", "Missing initial attributes."); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < Attributes.Length; i++)
                if (Attributes[i] == null) v.Error(p + $".Attributes[{i}]", "Missing attribute.");
                else { v.Attribute(Attributes[i].Attribute, p + $".Attributes[{i}].Attribute"); v.Finite(Attributes[i].Value, p + $".Attributes[{i}].Value"); }
            if(StartingSkills==null)v.Error(p+".StartingSkills","Missing starting skills.");
            else {var ids=new HashSet<int>();for(int i=0;i<StartingSkills.Length;i++){
                var entry=StartingSkills[i];if(entry==null){v.Error(p,"Missing profile skill.");continue;}
                v.Asset(entry.Skill,p+".StartingSkills["+i+"].Skill");
                if(entry.Skill!=null&&(!ids.Add(entry.Skill.SkillId)||entry.Level<1||entry.Level>entry.Skill.EffectiveMaxLevel))v.Error(p,"角色技能 ID 必须唯一且等级在有效范围内。");
            }}
            try { CreateAttributes(); } catch (ArgumentException ex) { v.Error(p, ex.Message); }
        }
        private GameplayActorProfile CreateAttributes()
        {
            var values = new List<KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId, float>>();
            foreach (var value in Attributes) { if (value == null) throw new ArgumentException("Missing initial attribute."); values.Add(new KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId, float>(value.Attribute.Build(), value.Value)); }
            return new GameplayActorProfile(values, Combat.Build());
        }
        public GameplayActorProfile Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => context.Build(this,()=>{
            CreateAttributes();var attributes=new List<KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId,float>>();foreach(var value in Attributes)attributes.Add(new KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId,float>(value.Attribute.Build(),value.Value));
            var skills=new List<(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,int level)>();foreach(var entry in StartingSkills)skills.Add((entry.Skill.Build(context),entry.Level));
            return new GameplayActorProfile(attributes,Combat.Build(),skills);
        });
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayCombatMappingAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayAttributeReference Health = new GameplayAttributeReference("Health");
        public GameplayAttributeReference MaxHealth = new GameplayAttributeReference("MaxHealth");
        public GameplayAttributeReference Shield = new GameplayAttributeReference("Shield");
        public GameplayAttributeReference Defense = new GameplayAttributeReference("Defense");
        public GameplayAttributeReference MagicDefense;
        public GameplayCombatAttributeMap Build() => new GameplayCombatAttributeMap(Health.Build(), MaxHealth.Build(),
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Shield.Value) ? default : Shield.Build(), string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Defense.Value) ? default : Defense.Build(),string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(MagicDefense.Value)?default:MagicDefense.Build());
    }
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayInitialAttributeAuthoring { public GameplayAttributeReference Attribute; public float Value; }
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayDamageStageAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayDamageStageKind Kind;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Value = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 1 };
    }
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring : GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayDamageType DamageType;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Amount = new GameplayFormulaFloatValueAuthoring { Expression = "Caster.Attack * (1.45 + Level * 0.15)" };
        [Tooltip("列表顺序就是结算顺序；护盾最多一项，全部计算成功后才一次提交 HP/Shield。")]
        public GameplayDamageStageAuthoring[] Stages = {
            new GameplayDamageStageAuthoring { Kind = GameplayDamageStageKind.Immunity },
            new GameplayDamageStageAuthoring { Kind = GameplayDamageStageKind.Miss },
            new GameplayDamageStageAuthoring { Kind = GameplayDamageStageKind.Defense },
            new GameplayDamageStageAuthoring { Kind = GameplayDamageStageKind.Critical, Value = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 2 } },
            new GameplayDamageStageAuthoring { Kind = GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield } };
        public GameplayTagQueryAuthoring Immunity = new GameplayTagQueryAuthoring();
        [Tooltip("可选。伤害提交后用标准治疗回复施法者；仅在实际扣除 HP 时执行。公式可读取 Context.Data.Standard.Combat.AppliedDamage。")]
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring HealInstigatorAmount;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Enum(DamageType,p+".DamageType");
            if (Amount == null) v.Error(p + ".Amount", "Missing damage amount."); else Amount.Validate(v, p + ".Amount");
            Immunity?.Validate(v, p + ".Immunity");
            HealInstigatorAmount?.Validate(v, p + ".HealInstigatorAmount");
            if (Stages == null) { v.Error(p + ".Stages", "Missing stage list."); return; }
            int shields = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < Stages.Length; i++)
            {
                if (Stages[i] == null) { v.Error(p + $".Stages[{i}]", "Missing stage."); continue; }
                v.Enum(Stages[i].Kind, p + $".Stages[{i}].Kind");
                if (Stages[i].Kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield) shields++;
                if (Stages[i].Value == null) v.Error(p + $".Stages[{i}].Value", "Missing stage value.");
                else Stages[i].Value.Validate(v, p + $".Stages[{i}].Value");
            }
            if (shields > 1) v.Error(p + ".Stages", "Shield stage must not appear twice.");
        }
        public override IGameplayEffectExecution Build()
        {
            var stages = new List<GameplayDamageStage>(); foreach (var stage in Stages) stages.Add(new GameplayDamageStage(stage.Kind, stage.Value.Build()));
            return new GameplayDamageExecution(Amount.Build(), stages, Immunity?.Build(),DamageType,HealInstigatorAmount?.Build());
        }
    }
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring : GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring
    {
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Amount = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 50 };
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p) { if (Amount == null) v.Error(p, "Missing heal value."); else Amount.Validate(v, p + ".Amount"); }
        public override IGameplayEffectExecution Build() => new GameplayHealExecution(Amount.Build());
    }
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring : GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring
    {
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Amount = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 50 };
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p) { if (Amount == null) v.Error(p, "Missing shield value."); else Amount.Validate(v, p + ".Amount"); }
        public override IGameplayEffectExecution Build() => new GameplayShieldExecution(Amount.Build());
    }
}
````

````csharp
        public FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard.GameplayProjectileDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => context.Build(this, () => CaptureValues().Build(context));
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Standard search with actual logical/Physics consumers. All dimensions use the common
    /// value AST; authoring callback lists build in the same identity-preserving session.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring : GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplaySearchShape Shape = GameplaySearchShape.Sector;
        public GameplaySpatialPlane Plane = GameplaySpatialPlane.XY;
        public GameplaySearchOrigin Origin;
        [Tooltip("所选原点的世界坐标偏移；用于脚底Actor与技能查询中心不同的真实绑定。")]
        public Vector3 OriginOffset;
        public GameplaySearchDirection Direction;
        [Tooltip("绝对角度或朝向偏移，单位度；与实际查询/范围预览共用表达式。")]
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring DirectionAngle = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 0 };
        [Tooltip("线/盒/射线/胶囊长度使用原点到所选目标/地点的距离；不会读取 Length。")]
        public bool LengthFromTarget;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Radius = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 6 };
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Angle = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 120 };
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Length = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 6 };
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Width = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 2 };
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Height = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 1 };
        public GameplayFactionFilter Faction = GameplayFactionFilter.Enemies;
        public GameplayTagQueryAuthoring Tags = new GameplayTagQueryAuthoring();
        public int LayerMask = -1;
        [Min(1)] public int MaxTargets = 32;
        public GameplayTargetOrder Order = GameplayTargetOrder.Nearest;
        public bool IncludeSelf;
        [Tooltip("跳过输入的主要目标，例如弹体命中后为子弹重选目标。")]
        public bool ExcludePrimaryTarget;
        [Tooltip("每次选最近的未访问目标，再从命中地点重选。目标上限是总次数。")]
        public bool RepeatFromResult;
        [Range(0,1), Tooltip("下一跳的倍率乘此值。逐目标下游读取 Context.Data.Standard.Search.Multiplier。")]
        public float RepeatMultiplier = 1;
        [Tooltip("世界坐标单元中心；按 CellSize 对所在格进行匹配，不依赖 Physics。")]
        public Vector3[] Cells = Array.Empty<Vector3>();
        public float CellSize = 1;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] EachTarget = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] Completed = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] NoTargets = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Enum(Shape, p + ".Shape"); v.Enum(Plane, p + ".Plane"); v.Enum(Origin, p + ".Origin");
            if (RepeatFromResult && (Shape != GameplaySearchShape.Circle || !(RepeatMultiplier >= 0 && RepeatMultiplier <= 1)))
                v.Error(p + ".RepeatFromResult", "逐次重选需要圆形查询与 0–1 的倍率。");
            if(!float.IsFinite(OriginOffset.x)||!float.IsFinite(OriginOffset.y)||!float.IsFinite(OriginOffset.z))v.Error(p+".OriginOffset","原点偏移必须有限。");
            if (Directional) { v.Enum(Direction,p+".Direction"); DirectionAngle?.Validate(v,p+".DirectionAngle"); }
            if (UsesLength && LengthFromTarget && Direction != GameplaySearchDirection.ToPrimaryTarget && Direction != GameplaySearchDirection.ToContextPoint)
                v.Error(p+".LengthFromTarget","两点长度要求线/盒/射线/胶囊，方向选择目标或地点。");
            v.Enum(Faction, p + ".Faction"); v.Enum(Order, p + ".Order");
            if (MaxTargets < 1) v.Error(p + ".MaxTargets", "MaxTargets must be positive.");
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells && (!float.IsFinite(CellSize) || CellSize <= 0)) v.Error(p + ".CellSize", "CellSize must be finite and positive.");
            if (UsesRadius) Value(v, p + ".Radius", Radius);
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector) { Value(v, p + ".Angle", Angle);
                if (Angle is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring constant && constant.Value > 360) v.Error(p + ".Angle", "Angle must be at most 360 degrees."); }
            if (UsesLength && !LengthFromTarget) Value(v, p + ".Length", Length);
            if (UsesWidth) Value(v, p + ".Width", Width);
            Value(v, p + ".Height", Height);
            Tags?.Validate(v, p + ".Tags");
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells) {
                if (Cells == null || Cells.Length == 0) v.Error(p + ".Cells", "Configure grid cells.");
                else for (int i = 0; i < Cells.Length; i++) { v.Finite(Cells[i].x, p + ".Cells.X"); v.Finite(Cells[i].y, p + ".Cells.Y"); v.Finite(Cells[i].z, p + ".Cells.Z"); }
            }
            Actions(v, p + ".EachTarget", EachTarget); Actions(v, p + ".Completed", Completed); Actions(v, p + ".NoTargets", NoTargets);
        }
        private static void Value(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p, GameplayFloatValueAuthoring value)
        {
            if (value == null) { v.Error(p, "Missing dimension."); return; } value.Validate(v, p);
            if (value is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring constant && constant.Value <= 0) v.Error(p, "Dimension must be positive.");
        }
        private static void Actions(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p, GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] actions)
        {
            if (actions == null) { v.Error(p, "Callback list is null."); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < actions.Length; i++) if (actions[i] == null) v.Error(p + $"[{i}]", "Missing action."); else actions[i].Validate(v, p + $"[{i}]");
        }
        public override void ValidateReferences(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            foreach (var list in new[] { EachTarget, Completed, NoTargets })
                if (list != null) for (int i = 0; i < list.Length; i++) list[i]?.ValidateReferences(v, p + $".Callbacks[{i}]");
        }
        public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            var cells = new List<GameplayPoint>(); if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells && Cells != null) foreach (var cell in Cells) cells.Add(new GameplayPoint(cell.x, cell.y, cell.z));
            return new GameplaySearchTargetAction(Shape, Plane, Origin, Dimension(Radius,UsesRadius), Dimension(Angle,Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector), Dimension(Length,UsesLength && !LengthFromTarget), Dimension(Width,UsesWidth), Height.Build(),
                Faction, Tags?.Build(), LayerMask, MaxTargets, Order, IncludeSelf,
                Build(EachTarget, context), Build(Completed, context), Build(NoTargets, context), cells, Shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells ? CellSize : 1,
                Directional ? Direction : GameplaySearchDirection.OwnerFacing, Directional ? DirectionAngle?.Build() : null,
                UsesLength && LengthFromTarget,new GameplayPoint(OriginOffset.x,OriginOffset.y,OriginOffset.z),
                ExcludePrimaryTarget, RepeatFromResult, RepeatMultiplier);
        }
        // Inactive dimensions remain serialized drafts. Never build/evaluate their AST until a shape consumes them.
        private bool UsesRadius => Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Circle || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Capsule;
        private bool UsesLength => Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Box || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Line || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Capsule;
        private bool UsesWidth => Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Box || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Line || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray;
        internal bool Directional => Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector || UsesLength;
        private static IGameplayFloatValue Dimension(GameplayFloatValueAuthoring value,bool used) => used ? value.Build() : new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1);
        private static IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> Build(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] nodes, GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        { foreach (var node in nodes) yield return context.BuildAction(node); }
    }
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring : GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset Effect;
        public bool OwnedByAbility;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Asset(Effect, p + ".Effect");
            if (OwnedByAbility && Effect != null && Effect.Stacking != null) v.Error(p + ".OwnedByAbility", "Ability-owned target effects must be unstacked; shared Area buffs use contribution leases.");
        }
        public override void ValidateReferences(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p) => v.Asset(Effect, p + ".Effect");
        public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => new GameplayApplyToTargetsAction(context.ResolveDefinition(Effect, this, nameof(Effect), () => Effect.Build(context)), OwnedByAbility);
    }
}
````
