````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Player-safe skill identity and installation entry. Schema 2 owns one embedded
    /// behavior graph; immutable runtime definitions are compiled values, never editable mirrors.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillDocumentAsset : GameplayDefinitionAsset
    {
        [Min(1)] public int SkillId = 2010;
        public string DisplayName = "新技能";
        public Sprite Icon;
        [SerializeField] private int authoringSchemaVersion = 1;
        [SerializeField] private Graph.GameplayAuthoringGraph authoringGraph;
        public int AuthoringSchemaVersion => authoringSchemaVersion;
        public Graph.GameplayAuthoringGraph AuthoringGraph => authoringGraph;
        /// <summary>Commits a prevalidated V2 source for migration/new-document transactions.
        /// The caller owns Undo. Old execution roots are cleared so there is one authority.</summary>
        public void SetAuthoringGraph(Graph.GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            if (graph == null || graph.Version != Graph.GameplayAuthoringGraph.CurrentVersion)
                throw new ArgumentException("A supported authoring graph is required.", nameof(graph));
            authoringGraph = graph; authoringSchemaVersion = Graph.GameplayAuthoringGraph.CurrentVersion;
            Ability = null; Rules = null; AdditionalRules = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>();
        }
        /// <summary>Effective authoring metadata used by scene equipment validation. V2 never
        /// falls back to an obsolete Ability SO when its graph is incomplete.</summary>
        public int EffectiveMaxLevel
        {
            get
            {
                if (authoringSchemaVersion != 2) return 0;
                var node = authoringGraph?.Nodes.Find(n => n.Id == authoringGraph.AbilityNodeId);
                var ability = node?.Payload as Graph.GameplayAbilityNodePayload;
                if (ability?.Settings is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData settings) return settings.MaxLevel;
                return (ability?.Definitions.Find(b => b.PropertyPath == "Settings")?.External as GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset)?.MaxLevel ?? 0;
            }
        }
        /// <summary>Display-only cost source for the existing skill-slot snapshot. Payment is
        /// still performed exclusively by the installed immutable Ability definition.</summary>
        public GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring EffectiveCost
        {
            get
            {
                if (authoringSchemaVersion != 2) return null;
                var node = authoringGraph?.Nodes.Find(n => n.Id == authoringGraph.AbilityNodeId);
                var ability = node?.Payload as Graph.GameplayAbilityNodePayload;
                if (ability?.Settings is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData settings) return settings.Cost;
                return (ability?.Definitions.Find(b => b.PropertyPath == "Settings")?.External as GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset)?.Cost;
            }
        }
        [SerializeField,HideInInspector] private GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset Ability;
        [SerializeField,HideInInspector] private GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset Rules;
        [SerializeField,HideInInspector] private GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset[] AdditionalRules = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>();
        public GameplayStandardActivationMode Mode;
        public bool RunRulesOnPassiveActivation;
        public GameplayStandardEventSubject Subject = GameplayStandardEventSubject.OwnerTarget;
        public GameplayTagReference CastEvent;
        public GameplayScalarInputAuthoring[] Defaults = Array.Empty<GameplayScalarInputAuthoring>();
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillLearningRequirementAuthoring[] LearningRequirements=Array.Empty<GameplaySkillLearningRequirementAuthoring>();
        public override object BuildSharedDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            if (SkillId <= 0) v.Error(p + ".SkillId", "SkillId must be positive.");
            if(LearningRequirements==null)v.Error(p+".LearningRequirements","Missing learning requirements.");
            else for(int i=0;i<LearningRequirements.Length;i++){
                if(LearningRequirements[i]==null)v.Error(p+".LearningRequirements["+i+"]","Missing learning requirement.");
                else LearningRequirements[i].Validate(v,p+".LearningRequirements["+i+"]");
            }
            if (authoringSchemaVersion == 2) Graph.GameplayGraphCompiler.ValidateStructure(authoringGraph, v, p + ".AuthoringGraph");
            else v.Error(p,"Unsupported authoring schema. Only the embedded behavior graph can build.");
            v.Enum(Mode, p + ".Mode"); v.Enum(Subject, p + ".Subject");
            if(RunRulesOnPassiveActivation&&Mode!=GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive)v.Error(p,"仅被动技能可配置启动规则。");
            if (Mode == GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active||RunRulesOnPassiveActivation)
            {
                v.Tag(CastEvent, p + ".CastEvent");
            }
            if (Defaults == null) v.Error(p + ".Defaults", "Scalar defaults are null.");
            else
            {
                var keys = new HashSet<string>();
                for (int i = 0; i < Defaults.Length; i++)
                {
                    if (Defaults[i] == null) { v.Error(p + $".Defaults[{i}]", "Missing scalar input."); continue; }
                    v.Tag(Defaults[i].Key, p + $".Defaults[{i}].Key"); v.Finite(Defaults[i].Value, p + $".Defaults[{i}].Value");
                    if (!keys.Add(Defaults[i].Key.Name)) v.Error(p + $".Defaults[{i}]", "Duplicate default key.");
                }
            }
        }
        public GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if(authoringSchemaVersion==2)return Graph.GameplayGraphCompiler.Build(this,authoringGraph,context);
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported skill authoring schema. Only Schema 2 behavior graphs are executable.");
        }
        /// <summary>Explicit local library binding used by non-cast Lab controls. The stable ID
        /// selects the same embedded values that the Workbench edits.</summary>
        public T BuildLocalResource<T>(string localId,GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) where T:class
        {
            if(authoringSchemaVersion!=2)throw new InvalidOperationException("Local resources require a Schema 2 behavior graph.");
            return Graph.GameplayGraphCompiler.BuildLocalResource<T>(this,localId,context);
        }

    }
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayScalarInputAuthoring { public GameplayTagReference Key; public float Value; }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    internal static class GameplaySpatialAuthoringUtility
    {
        internal static IGameplaySkillAction[] Build(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] actions,GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)=>Array.ConvertAll(actions,a=>context.BuildAction(a));
        internal static void Validate(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] actions,GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)
        {
            if(actions==null){validation.Error(path,"Callback list is null.");return;}
            for(int i=0;i<actions.Length;i++)if(actions[i]==null)validation.Error(path+"["+i+"]","Action is null.");else actions[i].Validate(validation,path+"["+i+"]");
        }
        internal static void Value(GameplayFloatValueAuthoring value,GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)
        {if(value==null)validation.Error(path,"Value is required.");else value.Validate(validation,path);}
    }
}
````

````csharp
{
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    public enum GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity { Error, Warning }

    /// <summary>A location-aware content diagnostic, independent of UnityEditor.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue
    {
        public readonly GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity Severity;
        public readonly string Path;
        public readonly string Message;
        public GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity severity, string path, string message)
        { Severity = severity; Path = path; Message = message; }
        public override string ToString() => $"{Severity} at {Path}: {Message}";
    }

    /// <summary>Collects path-aware errors for an asset graph; Asset detects recursive references without building runtime state.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAuthoringValidationContext
    {
        internal Func<GameplayDefinitionAsset, string, bool> GraphAssetValidation;
        private readonly List<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> _issues = new List<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue>();
        private readonly HashSet<GameplayDefinitionAsset> _active = new HashSet<GameplayDefinitionAsset>();
        private readonly HashSet<(GameplayDefinitionAsset, string)> _validated = new HashSet<(GameplayDefinitionAsset, string)>();
        private readonly HashSet<(string, string)> _reported = new HashSet<(string, string)>();
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> Issues => _issues;
        public bool HasErrors => _issues.Exists(issue => issue.Severity == GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error);
        /// <summary>Coalesces identical diagnostics at the same path, retaining diagnostics at every distinct source location.</summary>
        public void Error(string path, string message)
        {
            if (_reported.Add((path, message)))
                _issues.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error, path, message));
        }
        /// <summary>Non-blocking author guidance, displayed beside content errors in the workbench.</summary>
        public void Warning(string path,string message)
        {
            if(_reported.Add((path,message)))_issues.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning,path,message));
        }
        public void Asset(GameplayDefinitionAsset asset, string path)
        {
            if (GraphAssetValidation != null && GraphAssetValidation(asset, path)) return;
            if (asset == null) { Error(path, "Missing asset reference."); return; }
            if (_active.Contains(asset)) { Error(path, "Circular asset reference."); return; }
            if (!_validated.Add((asset, path))) return;
            _active.Add(asset);
            try { asset.Validate(this, path); }
            finally { _active.Remove(asset); }
        }
        public void Tag(GameplayTagReference tag, string path)
        {
            try { tag.Build(); } catch (ArgumentException ex) { Error(path, ex.Message); }
        }
        public void Attribute(GameplayAttributeReference attribute, string path)
        {
            try { attribute.Build(); } catch (ArgumentException ex) { Error(path, ex.Message); }
        }
        public void Enum<T>(T value, string path) where T : struct
        { if (!System.Enum.IsDefined(typeof(T), value)) Error(path, $"Unsupported {typeof(T).Name}: {value}."); }
        public void Finite(float value, string path)
        { if (!float.IsFinite(value)) Error(path, "Value must be finite."); }
    }

    /// <summary>Static serialized definition; runtime state and built definitions live outside the asset.</summary>
    public abstract class GameplayDefinitionAsset : ScriptableObject
    {
        public const int CurrentSchemaVersion = 1;
        [SerializeField] private string definitionId;
        [SerializeField] private int schemaVersion = CurrentSchemaVersion;
        public string DefinitionId => definitionId;
        /// <summary>Optional author-facing capability limits; not serialized gameplay state.</summary>
        public virtual string CapabilityNote=>null;
        public int SchemaVersion => schemaVersion;
        [SerializeField, HideInInspector] private bool migrationHistoryOnly;
        /// <summary>Preserved migration material is inspectable but cannot be edited as a
        /// second skill source. Actual shared runtime resources never receive this marker.</summary>
        public bool MigrationHistoryOnly => migrationHistoryOnly;
#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public void MarkMigrationHistoryOnly(bool historyOnly=true) => migrationHistoryOnly = historyOnly;
#endif
        /// <summary>Exports plain authoring values for the explicit V1 migrator or conversion
        /// between a local definition and a deliberately shared library definition. It does not
        /// create an SO or mutate this source; unsupported definition families fail explicitly.</summary>
        public virtual Graph.GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload CaptureGraphValues() =>
            throw new NotSupportedException("No V2 value builder for " + GetType().FullName);
        /// <summary>Explicit shared-resource compilation seam used by V2 reference bindings.
        /// Concrete sources delegate to their existing identity-cached immutable builder.</summary>
        public virtual object BuildSharedDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) =>
            throw new NotSupportedException("No shared definition builder for " + GetType().FullName);

        public void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path)
        {
            if (validation == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(validation));
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(definitionId)) validation.Error(path + ".DefinitionId", "DefinitionId is required.");
            if (schemaVersion != CurrentSchemaVersion) validation.Error(path + ".SchemaVersion", $"Unsupported schema {schemaVersion}; expected {CurrentSchemaVersion}.");
            ValidateContent(validation, path);
        }
        protected abstract void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path);

        /// <summary>Explicit editor-callable seam. No older schema exists yet, so no asset is mutated.</summary>
        public virtual bool TryMigrateOneVersion() => false;

        /// <summary>
        /// Completes exactly one schema migration step after a derived asset has migrated its own fields.
        /// Keeps the serialized version private while making the migration seam usable without UnityEditor/reflection.
        /// </summary>
        protected void CompleteOneVersionMigration(int expectedFromVersion)
        {
            if (schemaVersion != expectedFromVersion)
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Cannot migrate schema {schemaVersion}; expected {expectedFromVersion}.");
            if (expectedFromVersion < 0 || expectedFromVersion >= CurrentSchemaVersion)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(expectedFromVersion),
                    $"Migration target {expectedFromVersion + 1} must not exceed current schema {CurrentSchemaVersion}.");
            schemaVersion = expectedFromVersion + 1;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One build session: preserves asset identity, caches each runtime Definition, and rejects recursive builds.</summary>
    public sealed partial class GameplayAuthoringBuildContext
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplayDefinitionAsset, object> _built = new Dictionary<GameplayDefinitionAsset, object>();
        private readonly HashSet<GameplayDefinitionAsset> _active = new HashSet<GameplayDefinitionAsset>();
        private GameplayDefinitionAsset _current;
        private readonly Dictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource> _actionSources=new Dictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource>();
        /// <summary>Builds the original action unchanged and records its native serialized identity.
        /// Unsaved/transient nodes without an assigned identity remain explicitly unlocatable.</summary>
        public IGameplaySkillAction BuildAction(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring authoring,Func<IGameplaySkillAction> factory=null)
        {
            var owner=_current;var result=factory!=null?factory():authoring.Build(this);
            if(owner!=null){long id=UnityEngine.Serialization.ManagedReferenceUtility.GetManagedReferenceIdForObject(owner,authoring);
                if(id>=0)_actionSources[result]=new GameplaySkillTraceSource(owner.DefinitionId,id);}
            return result;
        }
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource> GetActionSourcesSnapshot()=>
            new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyDictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource>(new Dictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource>(_actionSources));
        public T Build<T>(GameplayDefinitionAsset asset, Func<T> factory) where T : class
        {
            if (asset == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));
            if (factory == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(factory));
            if (_built.TryGetValue(asset, out object existing)) return (T)existing;
            if (!_active.Add(asset)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"Circular authoring asset: {asset.name} ({asset.DefinitionId}).");
            var previous=_current;_current=asset;
            try
            {
                var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
                validation.Asset(asset, asset.name);
                if (validation.HasErrors) throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Join(" | ", validation.Issues));
                T result;
                try { result = factory(); }
                catch (Exception ex) when (ex is ArgumentException || ex is InvalidOperationException)
                { throw new InvalidOperationException($"Failed building {asset.name} ({asset.DefinitionId}): {ex.Message}", ex); }
                _built.Add(asset, result);
                return result;
            }
            finally { _current=previous;_active.Remove(asset); }
        }
    }

    [Serializable]
    public struct GameplayTagReference
    {
        public string Name;
        public GameplayTagReference(string name) { Name = name; }
        public GameplayTag Build() => new GameplayTag(Name);
    }

    [Serializable]
    public struct GameplayAttributeReference
    {
        public string Value;
        public GameplayAttributeReference(string value) { Value = value; }
        public GameplayAttributeId Build() => new GameplayAttributeId(Value);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayEffectModifierAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayAttributeReference Attribute;
        public GameplayModifierOperation Operation;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Magnitude;
        public void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Attribute(Attribute, p + ".Attribute"); v.Enum(Operation, p + ".Operation");
            if (Magnitude == null) v.Error(p + ".Magnitude", "Missing magnitude.");
            else Magnitude.Validate(v, p + ".Magnitude");
        }
        public GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition Build() =>
            new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attribute.Build(), Operation, Magnitude.Build());
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayTagQueryAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayTagReference[] All = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        public GameplayTagReference[] Any = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        public GameplayTagReference[] None = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
        public void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        { ValidateList(v, p + ".All", All); ValidateList(v, p + ".Any", Any); ValidateList(v, p + ".None", None); }
        private static void ValidateList(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p, GameplayTagReference[] values)
        {
            if (values == null) { v.Error(p, "Tag list is null."); return; }
            for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++) v.Tag(values[i], p + "[" + i + "]");
        }
        public GameplayTagQuery Build() => new GameplayTagQuery(BuildTags(All), BuildTags(Any), BuildTags(None));
        internal static GameplayTag[] BuildTags(GameplayTagReference[] values)
        {
            var tags = new GameplayTag[values.Length];
            for (int i = 0; i < tags.Length; i++) tags[i] = values[i].Build();
            return tags;
        }
    }

    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayTagReference StackKey;
        public GameplayEffectStackAggregation Aggregation;
        public int MaxStacks = 1;
        public GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy DurationRefresh;
        public GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy PeriodReset;
        public GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy Overflow;
        public GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy Lifetime;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring[] OverflowExecutions = Array.Empty<GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring>();
        public void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Tag(StackKey, p + ".StackKey"); v.Enum(Aggregation, p + ".Aggregation");
            if (MaxStacks < 1) v.Error(p + ".MaxStacks", "MaxStacks must be positive.");
            v.Enum(DurationRefresh, p + ".DurationRefresh"); v.Enum(PeriodReset, p + ".PeriodReset"); v.Enum(Overflow, p + ".Overflow");
            v.Enum(Lifetime, p + ".Lifetime");
            if (Lifetime == GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.IndependentLayerLifetime && DurationRefresh != GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh)
                v.Error(p + ".DurationRefresh", "Independent layer lifetime requires NeverRefresh.");
            if (OverflowExecutions == null) v.Error(p + ".OverflowExecutions", "Null overflow list.");
            else
            {
                if ((Overflow == GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow) != (OverflowExecutions.Length > 0))
                    v.Error(p + ".OverflowExecutions", "Only ExecuteOverflow requires nonempty rules.");
                for (int i = 0; i < OverflowExecutions.Length; i++)
                {
                    string path = p + $".OverflowExecutions[{i}]";
                    if (OverflowExecutions[i] == null) v.Error(path, "Null overflow execution.");
                    else { OverflowExecutions[i].Validate(v, path); OverflowExecutions[i].ValidateReferences(v, path); }
                }
            }
        }
        public GameplayEffectStackingDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context = null)
        {
            var rules = new List<IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution>();
            foreach (var item in OverflowExecutions) rules.Add(item.Build(context));
            return new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(StackKey.Build(), Aggregation, MaxStacks, DurationRefresh, PeriodReset, Overflow, Lifetime, rules);
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Game-specific executions derive here without extending FRFrame's runtime model.</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public abstract class GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring
    {
        public abstract void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path);
        public abstract IGameplayEffectExecution Build();
    }

}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Player-safe completion extension. References participate in recursive validation and one build session.</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public abstract class GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring
    {
        [UnityEngine.HideInInspector,Graph.GameplayAuthoringIdentity] public string AuthoringId=Graph.GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
        public abstract void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path);
        public virtual void ValidateReferences(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) { }
        public abstract IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context);
    }

    /// <summary>Generic natural-expiry continuation applying a referenced effect to the same target.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring : GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset Effect;
        public bool OwnedByAbility;
        /// <summary>Optional explicit installed skill whose currently active grant owns the continuation.
        /// Zero retains the original activation. Used when a cooldown survives passive disengagement.</summary>
        public int OwnerSkillId;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path)
        {if(OwnerSkillId<0||OwnerSkillId>0&&!OwnedByAbility)validation.Error(path,"续接技能ID必须非负且使用技能所有权。");}
        public override void ValidateReferences(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) =>
            validation.Asset(Effect, path + ".Effect");
        public override IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) =>
            OwnedByAbility?(IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution)new FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard.GameplayApplyOwnedEffectOnCompletionExecution(context.ResolveDefinition(Effect, this, nameof(Effect), () => Effect.Build(context)),OwnerSkillId):
                new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionExecution(context.ResolveDefinition(Effect, this, nameof(Effect), () => Effect.Build(context)));
    }

    /// <summary>Built immutable continuation; no rule clock or mutable target is held in the execution.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionExecution : IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinition Effect { get; }
        public GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionExecution(GameplayEffectDefinition effect) =>
            Effect = effect ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effect));
        public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext completion) => completion.Apply(Effect);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Authorable finite rule curve. Runtime owns a detached copy and has no Unity dependency.</summary>
    [Serializable,Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayCurveFloatValueAuthoring : GameplayFloatValueAuthoring
    {
        [Serializable] public struct Point {public float Input,Output;public Point(float input,float output){Input=input;Output=output;}}
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Input=new GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValueAuthoring();
        [Tooltip("分段线性插值；输入必须严格递增，范围外保持首尾值。")]
        public Point[] Keys={new Point(1,1),new Point(10,10)};
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)
        {
            if(Input==null){validation.Error(path+".Input","Missing curve input.");return;}Input.Validate(validation,path+".Input");
            try{new GameplayCurveFloatValue(new GameplayConstantFloatValue(0),KeySnapshot());}
            catch(ArgumentException ex){validation.Error(path+".Keys",ex.Message);}
        }
        private System.Collections.Generic.KeyValuePair<float,float>[] KeySnapshot()=>
            Keys==null?null:Array.ConvertAll(Keys,p=>new System.Collections.Generic.KeyValuePair<float,float>(p.Input,p.Output));
        public override IGameplayFloatValue Build()=>new GameplayCurveFloatValue(Input.Build(),KeySnapshot());
    }
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValueAuthoring : GameplayFloatValueAuthoring
    {
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) { }
        public override IGameplayFloatValue Build() => new GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValue();
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Authoring registry for one scope. Catalog ownership has no effect on Runtime identity.</summary>
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "FRFrame Gameplay/Reference Catalog")]
    public sealed class GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset : ScriptableObject
    {
        [Tooltip("Tag owner. Use FRFrame for framework contracts or Shared for shared game content.")]
        public string Scope;
        [Tooltip("Other authoring scopes hosted by this same game.")]
        public string[] ScopeAliases = Array.Empty<string>();
        [Tooltip("Optional project folder that owns standalone authoring assets, e.g. Assets/GameRes/MyGame.")]
        public string AssetRoot;
        public string[] Tags = Array.Empty<string>();
        public string[] Attributes = Array.Empty<string>();

        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> Validate()
        {
            var issues = new List<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue>();
            ValidateEntries(Tags, "Tags", value => new GameplayTag(value), issues);
            ValidateEntries(Attributes, "Attributes", value => new GameplayAttributeId(value), issues);
            return issues;
        }

        private static void ValidateEntries<T>(string[] values, string path, Func<string, T> construct,
            List<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> issues)
        {
            if (values == null)
            {
                issues.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error, path, "List is null."));
                return;
            }
            var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            for (int i = 0; i < values.Length; i++)
            {
                string entryPath = path + "[" + i + "]";
                try { construct(values[i]); }
                catch (ArgumentException ex)
                {
                    issues.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error, entryPath, ex.Message));
                    continue;
                }
                if (!seen.Add(values[i]))
                    issues.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error, entryPath,
                        "Duplicate canonical identity: " + values[i]));
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "FRFrame Gameplay/Skill Definition")]
    public sealed class GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset : GameplayDefinitionAsset
    {
        [SerializeField] private string displayName;
        /// <summary>Presentation-only label; it never enters the built rule definition.</summary>
        public string DisplayName => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(displayName) ? name : displayName;
        public bool Once;
        [Tooltip("主动技能的正式 Cast 入口保留施放来源、等级与参数；普通旧事件技能默认保持 Owner Context。")]
        public bool PreserveTriggerContext;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring Trigger;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring[] Conditions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring>();
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring Target;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] Actions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();

        public override object BuildSharedDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            if (Trigger == null) v.Error(p + ".Trigger", "Missing trigger."); else Trigger.Validate(v, p + ".Trigger");
            if (Conditions == null) v.Error(p + ".Conditions", "Condition list is null.");
            else for (int i = 0; i < Conditions.Length; i++)
                if (Conditions[i] == null) v.Error(p + $".Conditions[{i}]", "Null condition.");
                else Conditions[i].Validate(v, p + $".Conditions[{i}]");
            if (Target == null) v.Error(p + ".Target", "Missing target."); else Target.Validate(v, p + ".Target");
            if (Actions == null || Actions.Length == 0) v.Error(p + ".Actions", "At least one action is required.");
            else for (int i = 0; i < Actions.Length; i++)
                if (Actions[i] == null) v.Error(p + $".Actions[{i}]", "Null action.");
                else Actions[i].Validate(v, p + $".Actions[{i}]");
        }
        public GameplaySkillDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            return context.Build(this, () =>
            {
                var conditions = new List<IGameplaySkillCondition>();
                foreach (var item in Conditions) conditions.Add(item.Build());
                var actions = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>();
                foreach (var item in Actions) actions.Add(context.BuildAction(item));
                return new GameplaySkillDefinition(Trigger.Build(), conditions, Target.Build(), actions, Once, PreserveTriggerContext);
            });
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName = "FRFrame Gameplay/Skill Catalog")]
    public sealed class GameplaySkillDefinitionCatalogAsset : ScriptableObject
    {
        public GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset[] Skills = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>();
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<string, GameplaySkillDefinition> Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (Skills == null) throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}: Skill list is null.");
            var result = new Dictionary<string, GameplaySkillDefinition>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            for (int i = 0; i < Skills.Length; i++)
            {
                var skill = Skills[i];
                if (skill == null) throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}.Skills[{i}]: Missing skill asset.");
                var definition = skill.Build(context);
                if (result.ContainsKey(skill.DefinitionId)) throw new InvalidOperationException($"{name}.Skills[{i}]: Duplicate DefinitionId '{skill.DefinitionId}'.");
                result.Add(skill.DefinitionId, definition);
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring
{
    /// <summary>Nested action tree, directly serialized without graph IDs/edges. Cycles are rejected before Build.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring : GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
    {
        [UnityEngine.SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring Condition;
        [UnityEngine.SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] TrueActions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();
        [UnityEngine.SerializeReference] public GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] FalseActions = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillActionAuthoring>();
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) => ValidateTree(validation, path, new HashSet<GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring>());
        // Validate owns both nested content and asset references so callers do not visit each branch twice.
        private void ValidateTree(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p, HashSet<GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring> active)
        {
            if (!active.Add(this)) { v.Error(p, "Circular branch action tree."); return; }
            try
            {
                if (Condition == null) v.Error(p + ".Condition", "Missing branch condition."); else Condition.Validate(v, p + ".Condition");
                ValidateActions(TrueActions, v, p + ".TrueActions", active); ValidateActions(FalseActions, v, p + ".FalseActions", active);
            }
            finally { active.Remove(this); }
        }
        private static void ValidateActions(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] actions, GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p, HashSet<GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring> active)
        {
            if (actions == null) { v.Error(p, "Missing action list."); return; }
            for (int i=0; i<actions.Length; i++)
            {
                string path = p + "[" + i + "]";
                if (actions[i] == null) v.Error(path, "Null action.");
                else if (actions[i] is GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring branch) branch.ValidateTree(v, path, active);
                else { actions[i].Validate(v, path); actions[i].ValidateReferences(v, path); }
            }
        }
        public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => BuildTree(context, new HashSet<GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring>());
        private IGameplaySkillAction BuildTree(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context, HashSet<GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring> active)
        {
            if (!active.Add(this)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Circular branch action tree.");
            try { return new GameplaySkillBranchAction(Condition.Build(), BuildActions(TrueActions, context, active), BuildActions(FalseActions, context, active)); }
            finally { active.Remove(this); }
        }
        private static IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> BuildActions(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] actions, GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context, HashSet<GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring> active)
        {
            var built = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>();
            foreach (var action in actions) built.Add(context.BuildAction(action,()=>action is GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring branch ? branch.BuildTree(context, active) : action.Build(context)));
            return built;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Finite context scalar comparison, used by authored Branch conditions.</summary>
    /// <summary>Compares a typed scalar from the current branch context; missing keys are false.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplaySkillContextValueConditionAuthoring : GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayTagReference Key;
        public GameplaySkillContextComparison Comparison;
        public float Constant;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p) { v.Tag(Key,p+".Key"); v.Enum(Comparison,p+".Comparison"); v.Finite(Constant,p+".Constant"); }
        public override IGameplaySkillCondition Build() => new GameplaySkillContextValueCondition(Key.Build(), Comparison, Constant);
    }
    /// <summary>Writes a constant to the derived context; no mutable value is stored in the asset at runtime.</summary>
    /// <summary>Produces an immutable context snapshot with one authored finite scalar added/replaced.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplaySkillSetContextValueActionAuthoring : GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayTagReference Key;
        public float Value;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p) { v.Tag(Key,p+".Key"); v.Finite(Value,p+".Value"); }
        public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => new GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction(Key.Build(),Value);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 一次伤害计算的输入，由调用者提供来源、基础伤害和属性容器。
    /// 属性容器是当前运行状态的引用，不是快照；计算期间调用者和 Modifier 都不得修改它们。
    /// Context 不执行命中判定、扣血或生命周期管理。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DamageContext
    {
        /// <summary>有效的运行时来源 ID，不是配置表 ID。</summary>
        public GameplaySourceId SourceId { get; }
        /// <summary>未经管线处理的有限、非负伤害；0 是合法输入，负数不用于表达治疗。</summary>
        public float BaseDamage { get; }
        /// <summary>可选来源属性；没有来源单位属性的伤害可以传 null。</summary>
        public AttributeSet SourceAttributes { get; }
        /// <summary>必需的目标属性容器，仅供计算读取。</summary>
        public AttributeSet TargetAttributes { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional execution context; when present it is the authority for SourceId.</summary>
        public GameplayContext GameplayContext { get; }

        /// <summary>构造输入；无效来源、负数/非有限伤害或空目标会被拒绝。</summary>
        public DamageContext(GameplaySourceId sourceId, float baseDamage, AttributeSet targetAttributes,
            AttributeSet sourceAttributes = null)
        {
            if (!sourceId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Source ID must be valid.", nameof(sourceId));
            if (float.IsNaN(baseDamage) || float.IsInfinity(baseDamage) || baseDamage < 0f)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(baseDamage), "Damage must be finite and nonnegative.");
            if (targetAttributes == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(targetAttributes));

            SourceId = sourceId;
            BaseDamage = baseDamage;
            TargetAttributes = targetAttributes;
            SourceAttributes = sourceAttributes;
        }

        /// <summary>Use an execution context as the single source authority for this damage calculation.</summary>
        public DamageContext(GameplayContext gameplayContext, float baseDamage, AttributeSet targetAttributes,
            AttributeSet sourceAttributes = null)
            : this((gameplayContext ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(gameplayContext))).EffectiveSourceId,
                baseDamage, targetAttributes, sourceAttributes)
        {
            GameplayContext = gameplayContext;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Combat/DamagePipeline.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 由调用者组装的有序计算管线，无内建默认阶段，不执行命中、扣血或死亡处理。
    /// 同步调用；计算期间不得更改阶段列表或 Context 引用的属性。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DamagePipeline
    {
        private readonly List<IDamageModifier> _modifiers = new List<IDamageModifier>();

        /// <summary>追加一个非空阶段；添加顺序就是计算顺序，重复添加会执行多次。</summary>
        public void AddModifier(IDamageModifier modifier)
        {
            if (modifier == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifier));
            _modifiers.Add(modifier);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 从 BaseDamage 开始依次计算，空管线原样返回。
        /// null Context 抛 ArgumentNullException；阶段输出负数或非有限数时抛 InvalidOperationException，
        /// 停止后续阶段且不产生结果。阶段自身的异常直接传播。
        /// </summary>
        public DamageResult Calculate(DamageContext context)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));

            float damage = context.BaseDamage;
            float absorbed = 0; DamageResultFlags flags = DamageResultFlags.None;
            foreach (IDamageModifier modifier in _modifiers)
            {
                bool stop = false;
                if (modifier is IDamageResultModifier rich)
                {
                    var stage = rich.Calculate(context, damage); damage = stage.Damage;
                    absorbed += stage.Absorbed; flags |= stage.Flags; stop = stage.Stop;
                }
                else damage = modifier.Modify(context, damage);
                if (float.IsNaN(damage) || float.IsInfinity(damage) || damage < 0f)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Damage modifier returned an invalid value: " +
                        modifier.GetType().Name);
                if (!float.IsFinite(absorbed)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Absorption must be finite.");
                if (stop) break;
            }

            return new DamageResult(context.BaseDamage, damage, absorbed, flags);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Combat/DamageResult.cs
````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 管线产出的不可变计算结果。FinalDamage 是应造成的伤害，不是实际扣除的生命值。
    /// 真正应用到生命、限制剩余生命和处理死亡属于调用方的后续职责。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct DamageResult
    {
        /// <summary>本次 Context 的原始伤害，不受 Modifier 修改。</summary>
        public float BaseDamage { get; }
        /// <summary>按顺序经过全部 Modifier 后的有限、非负伤害；不做取整或最低伤害保底。</summary>
        public float FinalDamage { get; }
        public float AbsorbedDamage { get; }
        public DamageResultFlags Flags { get; }
        public bool IsCritical => (Flags & DamageResultFlags.Critical) != 0;
        public bool IsMiss => (Flags & DamageResultFlags.Miss) != 0;
        public bool IsImmune => (Flags & DamageResultFlags.Immune) != 0;

        internal DamageResult(float baseDamage, float finalDamage)
            : this(baseDamage, finalDamage, 0, DamageResultFlags.None) { }

        internal DamageResult(float baseDamage, float finalDamage, float absorbed, DamageResultFlags flags)
        {
            BaseDamage = baseDamage;
            FinalDamage = finalDamage;
            AbsorbedDamage = absorbed; Flags = flags;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    [Flags]
    public enum DamageResultFlags { None = 0, Critical = 1, Miss = 2, Immune = 4, ShieldBroken = 8 }
    /// <summary>Pure stage output. Absorption is predicted, not committed; the standard execution
    /// consumes HP/Shield only once, after the complete calculation succeeds.</summary>
    public readonly struct DamageStageResult
    {
        public float Damage { get; }
        public float Absorbed { get; }
        public DamageResultFlags Flags { get; }
        public bool Stop { get; }
        public DamageStageResult(float damage, float absorbed = 0, DamageResultFlags flags = DamageResultFlags.None, bool stop = false)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(damage) || damage < 0 || !float.IsFinite(absorbed) || absorbed < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(damage));
            Damage = damage; Absorbed = absorbed; Flags = flags; Stop = stop;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Optional metadata on the existing ordered DamagePipeline, preserving legacy numeric modifiers.</summary>
    public interface IDamageResultModifier : IDamageModifier
    {
        DamageStageResult Calculate(DamageContext context, float currentDamage);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 演示防御阶段：currentDamage * 100 / (100 + max(0, Defense))。
    /// 属性键由调用者提供，不定义游戏专属属性；每次读取目标的 CurrentValue，不修改属性或生命。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DefenseDamageModifier : IDamageModifier
    {
        private readonly GameplayAttributeId _defenseAttributeId;

        /// <summary>指定防御属性键。default 键抛 ArgumentException；键需在目标属性集中注册。</summary>
        public DefenseDamageModifier(GameplayAttributeId defenseAttributeId)
        {
            if (!defenseAttributeId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Defense attribute ID must be valid.", nameof(defenseAttributeId));
            _defenseAttributeId = defenseAttributeId;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 按目标当前防御计算；负防御按 0 参与本公式，不回写属性。
        /// 缺少防御属性时传播 KeyNotFoundException，避免把漏配静默当作零防御。
        /// null Context 或非法伤害分别抛 ArgumentNullException、ArgumentOutOfRangeException。
        /// </summary>
        public float Modify(DamageContext context, float currentDamage)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (float.IsNaN(currentDamage) || float.IsInfinity(currentDamage) || currentDamage < 0f)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(currentDamage), "Damage must be finite and nonnegative.");

            float defense = context.TargetAttributes.GetCurrentValue(_defenseAttributeId);
            // double 中间值避免先乘 100 时产生不必要的 float 溢出。
            return (float)(currentDamage * 100d / (100d + Math.Max(0d, defense)));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Read-only identity and target snapshot for one gameplay execution.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayContext
    {
        public GameplaySourceId InstigatorId { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional actual rule source; an absent source means the instigator is effective.</summary>
        public GameplaySourceId SourceId { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId EffectiveSourceId => SourceId.IsValid ? SourceId : InstigatorId;
        /// <summary>Original cast/source identity; deriving a child SourceId never rewrites this provenance.</summary>
        public GameplaySourceId OriginSourceId { get; }
        /// <summary>Identity of this instigator's execution/cast. Child sources preserve it even
        /// when a summoned actor explicitly inherits a different birth OriginSourceId.</summary>
        public GameplaySourceId ActivationSourceId { get; }
        public GameplayTargetData TargetData { get; }
        public GameplayContextValues Values { get; }
        /// <summary>Captured grant level for this execution; child target/source contexts preserve it.</summary>
        public int AbilityLevel { get; }

        /// <summary>Derives a new target snapshot, preserving instigator, source and values.</summary>
        public GameplayContext WithTarget(GameplayTargetData target) => new GameplayContext(InstigatorId, target, SourceId, Values, AbilityLevel, OriginSourceId, ActivationSourceId);
        /// <summary>Derives a child source. Default source retains the instigator fallback.</summary>
        public GameplayContext WithSource(GameplaySourceId source) => new GameplayContext(InstigatorId, TargetData, source, Values, AbilityLevel, OriginSourceId, ActivationSourceId);
        /// <summary>Explicit spawn-causality binding. Ordinary child WithSource/WithTarget calls
        /// retain the chosen origin; this never changes the actual instigator or current cast source.</summary>
        public GameplayContext WithOriginSource(GameplaySourceId origin)
        {if(!origin.IsValid)throw new ArgumentException("Origin must be valid.",nameof(origin));return new GameplayContext(InstigatorId,TargetData,SourceId,Values,AbilityLevel,origin,ActivationSourceId);}
        /// <summary>Replaces the immutable scalar snapshot; null uses Empty as in the constructor.</summary>
        public GameplayContext WithValues(GameplayContextValues values) => new GameplayContext(InstigatorId, TargetData, SourceId, values, AbilityLevel, OriginSourceId,ActivationSourceId);
        /// <summary>Captures a level without mutating this execution or a shared Definition.</summary>
        public GameplayContext WithAbilityLevel(int level) => level == AbilityLevel ? this :
            new GameplayContext(InstigatorId, TargetData, SourceId, Values, level, OriginSourceId,ActivationSourceId);

        public GameplayContext(GameplaySourceId instigatorId, GameplayTargetData targetData,
            GameplaySourceId sourceId = default, GameplayContextValues values = null, int abilityLevel = 1)
            : this(instigatorId, targetData, sourceId, values, abilityLevel, sourceId.IsValid ? sourceId : instigatorId,sourceId.IsValid ? sourceId : instigatorId) { }

        private GameplayContext(GameplaySourceId instigatorId, GameplayTargetData targetData,
            GameplaySourceId sourceId, GameplayContextValues values, int abilityLevel, GameplaySourceId originSourceId,GameplaySourceId activationSourceId)
        {
            if (!instigatorId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Instigator ID must be valid.", nameof(instigatorId));
            InstigatorId = instigatorId;
            TargetData = targetData ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(targetData));
            SourceId = sourceId;
            Values = values ?? GameplayContextValues.Empty;
            if (abilityLevel < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(abilityLevel));
            AbilityLevel = abilityLevel;
            OriginSourceId = originSourceId;
            ActivationSourceId = activationSourceId;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Core/GameplayContextValues.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>整条执行链共享的有限 float 输入快照；不同于单次 Effect 的 SetByCaller。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayContextValues
    {
        public static readonly GameplayTag TriggerMagnitudeKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Context.Trigger.Magnitude");
        public static GameplayContextValues Empty { get; } =
            new GameplayContextValues(Array.Empty<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>>());
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<GameplayTag, float> _values;

        public GameplayContextValues(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>> values)
        {
            if (values == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(values));
            var copy = new Dictionary<GameplayTag, float>();
            foreach (var pair in values)
            {
                if (!pair.Key.IsValid || !float.IsFinite(pair.Value) || copy.ContainsKey(pair.Key))
                    throw new ArgumentException("Context values require unique valid tags and finite floats.", nameof(values));
                copy.Add(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            }
            _values = new ReadOnlyDictionary<GameplayTag, float>(copy);
        }

        /// <summary>Reads an optional scalar without exposing the backing dictionary.</summary>
        public bool TryGetValue(GameplayTag key, out float value)
        {
            if (!key.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Context value key must be valid.", nameof(key));
            return _values.TryGetValue(key, out value);
        }
        /// <summary>Returns a new snapshot with this key added/replaced; the input snapshot never changes.</summary>
        public GameplayContextValues WithValue(GameplayTag key, float value)
        {
            if (!key.IsValid || !float.IsFinite(value)) throw new ArgumentException("Context values require valid tags and finite floats.");
            var copy = new Dictionary<GameplayTag, float>();
            foreach (var pair in _values) copy.Add(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            copy[key] = value;
            return new GameplayContextValues(copy);
        }
        /// <summary>Returns a new scalar snapshot; the supplied snapshot wins duplicate keys.
        /// Used to combine captured cast defaults with explicit input, without mutating either source.</summary>
        public GameplayContextValues Merge(GameplayContextValues values)
        {
            if (values == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(values));
            var copy = new Dictionary<GameplayTag, float>();
            foreach (var pair in _values) copy.Add(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            foreach (var pair in values._values) copy[pair.Key] = pair.Value;
            return new GameplayContextValues(copy);
        }

        public float GetRequiredValue(GameplayTag key)
        {
            if (!key.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Context value key must be valid.", nameof(key));
            if (!_values.TryGetValue(key, out float value))
                throw new KeyNotFoundException("Missing context value: " + key);
            return value;
        }
        /// <summary>Explicit consumer boundary: makes a detached per-application Caller snapshot
        /// from captured chain inputs. Core Effect Apply never performs this conversion implicitly;
        /// Standard consumers use it unless an explicit effect caller snapshot is supplied.</summary>
        public GameplaySetByCallerValues AsSetByCallerValues()=>_values.Count==0?GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty:new GameplaySetByCallerValues(_values);
        internal GameplaySetByCallerValues AsCostCallerValues()=>AsSetByCallerValues();
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Immutable rule-layer request for presentation; contains no view assets.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayCueRequest
    {
        public GameplayTag CueTag { get; }
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public float? Magnitude { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional rule-owned timing for a presentation that must meet a later cue.</summary>
        public float? Duration { get; }

        public GameplayCueRequest(GameplayTag cueTag, GameplayContext context, float? magnitude = null,
            float? duration = null)
        {
            if (!cueTag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Cue tag must be valid.", nameof(cueTag));
            if (magnitude.HasValue && !float.IsFinite(magnitude.Value))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(magnitude));
            if (duration.HasValue && (!float.IsFinite(duration.Value) || duration.Value <= 0f))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(duration));
            CueTag = cueTag;
            Context = context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            Magnitude = magnitude;
            Duration = duration;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 调用者提供的运行时来源标识；本模块不分配全局 ID。
    /// 任意非零 long 均有效，default 的 0 表示无效，不能用于添加或按来源移除 Modifier。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct GameplaySourceId : IEquatable<GameplaySourceId>
    {
        public long Value { get; }
        public bool IsValid => Value != 0;

        public GameplaySourceId(long value)
        {
            if (value == 0)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value), "Source ID must be nonzero.");
            Value = value;
        }

        public bool Equals(GameplaySourceId other) => Value == other.Value;
        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is GameplaySourceId other && Equals(other);
        public override int GetHashCode() => Value.GetHashCode();
        public override string ToString() => Value.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
        public static bool operator ==(GameplaySourceId left, GameplaySourceId right) => left.Equals(right);
        public static bool operator !=(GameplaySourceId left, GameplaySourceId right) => !left.Equals(right);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 为一个 Gameplay 运行域顺序分配非零来源标识。
    /// 同一运行域中的所有运行时来源必须共享同一个实例，不可与手写 ID 或其他分配器产生的 ID 混用。
    /// 分配器按单线程同步使用，已发出的标识不会回收或复用；耗尽 long 正数范围时抛出 OverflowException。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySourceIdAllocator
    {
        private long _lastValue;

        /// <summary>
        /// 返回一个从未由此分配器发出过的新 GameplaySourceId；正数范围耗尽时抛出 OverflowException。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplaySourceId Allocate()
        {
            long value = checked(_lastValue + 1);
            _lastValue = value;
            return new GameplaySourceId(value);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>The optional primary target and point captured for one execution.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayTargetData
    {
        public GameplaySourceId PrimaryTargetId { get; }
        public bool HasPrimaryTarget => PrimaryTargetId.IsValid;
        public GameplayPoint Point { get; }
        public bool HasPoint { get; }
        public GameplayArea Area { get; }
        public bool HasArea { get; }
        /// <summary>Resolved target IDs in deterministic execution order; empty means no multi-target result.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySourceId> Targets { get; }

        public GameplayTargetData(GameplaySourceId primaryTargetId, GameplayPoint? point = null)
            : this(primaryTargetId, point, null, null) { }

        public GameplayTargetData(GameplaySourceId primaryTargetId, GameplayPoint? point,
            GameplayArea? area, IEnumerable<GameplaySourceId> targets)
        {
            PrimaryTargetId = primaryTargetId;
            HasPoint = point.HasValue;
            Point = point.GetValueOrDefault();
            HasArea = area.HasValue;
            Area = area.GetValueOrDefault();
            var copy = targets == null ? new List<GameplaySourceId>() : new List<GameplaySourceId>(targets);
            if (targets != null && primaryTargetId.IsValid && !copy.Contains(primaryTargetId))
                throw new ArgumentException("Primary target must belong to resolved targets.", nameof(targets));
            foreach (GameplaySourceId id in copy)
                if (!id.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Target IDs must be valid.", nameof(targets));
            if (new HashSet<GameplaySourceId>(copy).Count != copy.Count)
                throw new ArgumentException("Resolved target IDs must be unique.", nameof(targets));
            Targets = copy.AsReadOnly();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;

using UnityEditor.Compilation;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Editor-only selection of public external cost nodes. All edits use serialized properties and Undo.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAbilityCostEditor
    {
        public static IReadOnlyList<Type> Types() => GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Types(typeof(GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring));

        public static void SetCost(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset asset, Type type)
        {
            if (asset == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));
            if (type != null && !Types().Contains(type)) throw new ArgumentException("Not a discoverable cost authoring type.", nameof(type));
            Undo.RecordObject(asset, "Change Ability Cost");
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
            serialized.FindProperty("Cost").managedReferenceValue = type == null ? null : Activator.CreateInstance(type);
            serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
        }
    }

    [CustomEditor(typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset))]
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityDefinitionEditor : UnityEditor.Editor
    {
        public override void OnInspectorGUI() => GameplayAuthoringInspector.Draw(serializedObject);
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Reference/GameplayActionOrderValidation.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>A native shared-definition diagnostic location; contains no editable graph state.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplayWorkbenchDiagnostic
    {
        internal UnityEngine.Object Source;
        internal string Path,Message;
        internal GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity Severity;
    }
    /// <summary>Read-only checks against the actual consumer's lifetime guard. End/Cancel ends
    /// an Ability, not every Runner. Unknown/unowned callers receive conditional guidance.</summary>
    internal static class GameplayActionOrderValidation
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<UnityEngine.Object,GameplayDefinitionAssetReference[]> References=new Dictionary<UnityEngine.Object,GameplayDefinitionAssetReference[]>();
        private static bool _referencesReady;
        private static readonly Unity.Profiling.ProfilerMarker GuardSample=new Unity.Profiling.ProfilerMarker("FRFrame.Workbench.GuardedArray");
        internal static void InvalidateReferences()=>_referencesReady=false;
        internal static void SourceChanged(UnityEngine.Object source)
        {if(_referencesReady&&source is GameplayDefinitionAsset definition)References[source]=SequenceReferences(definition);}
        static GameplayActionOrderValidation()
        {
            EditorApplication.projectChanged+=()=>_referencesReady=false;
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed+=()=>_referencesReady=false;
            GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Changed+=changes=>{
                if(!_referencesReady)return;
                foreach(var source in changes.Select(c=>c.Source).OfType<GameplayDefinitionAsset>().Distinct())
                    References[source]=SequenceReferences(source);
            };
        }
        private static GameplayDefinitionAssetReference[] Callers(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence)
        {
            if(!_referencesReady){
                References.Clear();
                var sources=AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:"+nameof(GameplayDefinitionAsset),new[]{"Assets"}).Select(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath).Distinct().SelectMany(AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath).OfType<GameplayDefinitionAsset>()
                    .Concat(UnityEngine.Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<GameplayDefinitionAsset>().Where(s=>!EditorUtility.IsPersistent(s)||EditorUtility.IsDirty(s))).Distinct();
                foreach(var source in sources)References[source]=SequenceReferences(source);
                _referencesReady=true;
            }
            return References.Where(p=>p.Key).SelectMany(p=>p.Value).Where(r=>r.Target==sequence&&StillReferences(r,sequence)).ToArray();
        }
        // This index answers only "who consumes this Sequence?". Recursively scanning every
        // root repeats shared closures and resolving unrelated Prefab/Skeleton/Material fields
        // can load their resources. Filter the serialized slot before resolving its value.
        private static GameplayDefinitionAssetReference[] SequenceReferences(GameplayDefinitionAsset source)
        {
            var result=new List<GameplayDefinitionAssetReference>();
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){
                var property=so.GetIterator();
                while(property.Next(true)){
                    if(property.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference)continue;
                    string type=property.type;
                    bool sequenceSlot=type=="PPtr<$GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>"||type=="PPtr<$GameplayDefinitionAsset>"||type=="PPtr<$Object>"||type=="PPtr<Object>";
                    if(sequenceSlot&&property.objectReferenceValue is GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence)
                        result.Add(new GameplayDefinitionAssetReference(source,sequence,property.propertyPath));
                }
            }
            return result.ToArray();
        }
        private static bool StillReferences(GameplayDefinitionAssetReference reference,GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence)
        {using(var so=new SerializedObject(reference.Source))return so.FindProperty(reference.PropertyPath)?.objectReferenceValue==sequence;}
        internal const string AfterEnd = "本事件已有结束/取消动作；不能在它后面追加。请选择该 End 动作的『在此动作之前插入…』，或调整 End 位置。";
        internal const string EndBeforeSuccessors = "结束/取消动作必须放在当前动作组末尾；请先调整后继动作，不能让现有动作变为不可达。";
        internal const string Conditional = "End / Cancel 只结束 Ability；后续动作仍可能继续执行，取决于宿主的终止守卫。普通 Rule 允许结束后的清理动作；没有合法 Standard Grant 时 End 会被拒绝并停止当前链。";

        /// <summary>Only delayed, exclusively OwnedSequence consumers prove cancellation of
        /// this entry before its next action. StartSkill executes time-zero markers before the
        /// owning lease is attached. Shared/direct/unknown callers cannot be called unreachable.</summary>
        internal static bool GuardedArray(UnityEngine.Object source,string path)
        {
            using var sample=GuardSample.Auto();
            if(!(source is GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence)||string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)||!path.StartsWith("Markers.Array.data[",StringComparison.Ordinal))return false;
            int end=path.IndexOf(']');if(end<0)return false;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){
                var time=so.FindProperty(path.Substring(0,end+1)+".Time");
                if(time==null||time.floatValue<=0)return false;
                string root=path.Substring(0,end+1)+".Actions",cursor=path;
                // Only inline Branch/Search consumers inherit this marker's Runner guard.
                // A Move.OnArrive/OnCancelled callback has its own later lifetime, including
                // ending callbacks which deliberately permit cleanup after detachment.
                while(cursor!=root){
                    int dot=cursor.LastIndexOf('.');if(dot<0)return false;
                    string field=cursor.Substring(dot+1),parentPath=cursor.Substring(0,dot);
                    var parent=so.FindProperty(parentPath);
                    var value=parent?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference?parent.managedReferenceValue:null;
                    if(!(value is GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring&&(field=="TrueActions"||field=="FalseActions")||
                         value is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring&&(field=="EachTarget"||field=="Completed"||field=="NoTargets")))return false;
                    cursor=GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands.ActionArray(parentPath);if(cursor==null)return false;
                }
            }
            // Include subassets and callers in other files; looking only at the local workspace
            // would incorrectly reject a shared sequence also used by an unowned PlaySequence.
            // Unity includes derived definitions in this single base-type query. Avoid the
            // catalog scanner's per-concrete-type searches on every Inspector repaint.
            var callers=Callers(sequence);
            return callers.Length>0&&callers.All(r=>{
                int dot=r.PropertyPath.LastIndexOf('.');if(dot<0)return false;
                using(var so=new SerializedObject(r.Source)){
                    var parent=so.FindProperty(r.PropertyPath.Substring(0,dot));
                    return parent?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&parent.managedReferenceValue is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring;
                }
            });
        }

        internal static string PlacementReason(UnityEngine.Object source,string path,int at,object value,int removeAt=-1)
        {
            if(value!=null&&!(value is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring))return null;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){
                var array=so.FindProperty(path);
                if(array==null||!array.isArray)return "动作归属已改变，请重新选择。";
                var values=new List<object>();
                for(int i=0;i<array.arraySize;i++){
                    var item=array.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                    if(item.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference)return null;
                    values.Add(item.managedReferenceValue);
                }
                if(removeAt>=0){values.RemoveAt(removeAt);if(removeAt<at)at--;}
                at=Math.Min(at,values.Count);
                bool after=values.Take(at).Any(a=>a is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring);
                bool cuts=value is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring&&at<values.Count;
                if(!after&&!cuts||!GuardedArray(source,path))return null;
                return after?AfterEnd:EndBeforeSuccessors;
            }
        }
        internal static string UnreachableReason(UnityEngine.Object source,string path)
        {
            var issue=OrderDiagnostic(source,path);
            return issue?.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error?issue.Message:null;
        }
        internal static string ContinuationWarning(UnityEngine.Object source,string path)
        {
            var issue=OrderDiagnostic(source,path);
            return issue?.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning?issue.Message:null;
        }
        private static GameplayWorkbenchDiagnostic OrderDiagnostic(UnityEngine.Object source,string path)
        {
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source))
                for(string cursor=path;!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cursor);){
                    int split=cursor.LastIndexOf(".Array.data[",StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    if(split<0)break;
                    string arrayPath=cursor.Substring(0,split);
                    int end=cursor.IndexOf(']',split);
                    if(end<0||!int.TryParse(cursor.Substring(split+12,end-split-12),out int at))break;
                    var array=so.FindProperty(arrayPath);
                    if(array!=null&&array.isArray)for(int i=0;i<Math.Min(at,array.arraySize);i++){
                        var item=array.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                        if(item.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&item.managedReferenceValue is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring){
                            bool guarded=GuardedArray(source,arrayPath);
                            string location=source.name+" / "+path+" 位于 "+item.propertyPath+" 的结束/取消之后。";
                            return new GameplayWorkbenchDiagnostic{Source=source,Path=path,Severity=guarded?GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error:GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning,
                                Message=guarded?"不可达动作（已知延时 OwnedSequence 守卫）："+location+"请将此动作移到 End 之前，或删除多余动作；不会自动调整配置。":"条件提示："+location+Conditional};
                        }
                    }
                    cursor=arrayPath;
                }
            return null;
        }
        internal static IReadOnlyList<GameplayWorkbenchDiagnostic> Scan(IEnumerable<UnityEngine.Object> sources)
        {
            var issues=new List<GameplayWorkbenchDiagnostic>();
            foreach(var source in sources.Where(s=>s!=null).Distinct())using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){
                var item=so.GetIterator();
                while(item.Next(true))if(item.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&item.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring){
                    var issue=OrderDiagnostic(source,item.propertyPath);
                    if(issue!=null)issues.Add(issue);
                }
            }
            return issues;
        }
    }
}
````
