````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Explicit game-side dependency declaration. Framework definitions use serialized traversal instead.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayAuthoringDependencyProvider
    {
        bool Supports(Object source);
        IEnumerable<GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge> Dependencies(Object source);
    }

    /// <summary>A reference location, not a copied definition. Callbacks are editor-only, explicit user actions.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge
    {
        public Object Source { get; }
        public Object Target { get; }
        public string PropertyPath { get; }
        public string Label { get; }
        public Type ExpectedType { get; }
        public bool Missing => Target == null;
        public Action Open { get; }
        public Action Ping { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional provider repair. Must record Undo, touch only this reference and never SaveAll.</summary>
        public Action Fix { get; }
        public GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge(Object source, Object target, string path, string label,
            Type expectedType, Action open = null, Action ping = null, Action fix = null)
        {
            Source = source; Target = target; PropertyPath = path; Label = label; ExpectedType = expectedType;
            Open = open; Ping = ping; Fix = fix;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>One canonical asset with multiple incoming reference locations.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode
    {
        public Object Asset { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge> Edges => _edges;
        public IReadOnlyList<string> InlineAuthoringPaths => _inlinePaths;
        internal readonly List<GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge> _edges = new List<GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge>();
        internal readonly List<string> _inlinePaths = new List<string>();
        internal GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode(Object asset) { Asset = asset; }
    }

    /// <summary>Cycle-safe gameplay dependency projection. Ordinary resources are leaves unless a provider opts in.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAuthoringDependencyGraph
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<Object, GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode> _nodes = new Dictionary<Object, GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode>();
        public IReadOnlyCollection<GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode> Nodes => _nodes.Values;
        public GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode Root { get; private set; }
        public GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode Find(Object asset) => asset != null && _nodes.TryGetValue(asset, out var node) ? node : null;
        /// <summary>Traverses only a consumed definition's reference closure. Editor workspace
        /// banks and unconnected drafts must not select a runtime host or animation controller.</summary>
        public static GameplayAuthoringDependencyGraph BuildDefinition(GameplayDefinitionAsset definition)
        {
            var graph=new GameplayAuthoringDependencyGraph();
            if(definition!=null)graph.Root=graph.Visit(definition);
            return graph;
        }
        private GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode Visit(Object asset)
        {
            if (_nodes.TryGetValue(asset, out var existing)) return existing;
            var node = new GameplayAuthoringDependencyNode(asset);
            _nodes.Add(asset, node);
            if (asset is GameplayDefinitionAsset)
            {
                using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset))
                foreach (var property in GameplayAuthoringProperties.Walk(serialized))
                {
                    if (property.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference && property.managedReferenceValue != null)
                        node._inlinePaths.Add(property.propertyPath + " · " + property.managedReferenceValue.GetType().Name);
                    if (property.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference || property.name == "m_Script") continue;
                    if(asset is GameplaySkillDocumentAsset skill && skill.AuthoringSchemaVersion==2 && property.propertyPath.StartsWith("authoringGraph.LegacyResources",StringComparison.Ordinal))continue;
                    Type expected = GameplayAuthoringProperties.ReferenceType(property);
                    Object target = property.objectReferenceValue;
                    if (!(target is GameplayDefinitionAsset) &&
                        (expected == null || !typeof(GameplayDefinitionAsset).IsAssignableFrom(expected))) continue;
                    node._edges.Add(new GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge(asset, target, property.propertyPath,
                        property.propertyPath, expected ?? target?.GetType()));
                }
            }
            else foreach (var provider in GameplayAuthoringProviders.Dependencies)
                if (provider.Supports(asset)) node._edges.AddRange(provider.Dependencies(asset));
            foreach (var edge in node._edges) if (edge.Target != null) Visit(edge.Target);
            return node;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Serialized traversal preserves source paths, including nested managed references, without recursing a managed cycle.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAuthoringProperties
    {
        public static IEnumerable<SerializedProperty> Walk(SerializedObject serialized)
        {
            var property = serialized.GetIterator();
            var ancestors = new List<(int depth, long id)>();
            bool enter = true;
            while (property.NextVisible(enter))
            {
                ancestors.RemoveAll(x => x.depth >= property.depth);
                enter = property.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.String;
                if (property.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference && property.managedReferenceValue != null)
                {
                    long id = property.managedReferenceId;
                    enter = !ancestors.Any(x => x.id == id);
                    if (enter) ancestors.Add((property.depth, id));
                }
                yield return property.Copy();
            }
        }
        public static Type ReferenceType(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            string type = property.type;
            if (type.StartsWith("PPtr<$", StringComparison.Ordinal) && type.EndsWith(">", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                string name = type.Substring(6, type.Length - 7);
                if (name == "Object") return typeof(Object);
                if (name == "GameObject") return typeof(GameObject);
                if (name == "Sprite") return typeof(Sprite);
                return TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<ScriptableObject>().FirstOrDefault(t => t.Name == name);
            }
            return property.objectReferenceValue?.GetType();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Explicit repair writes one serialized reference. Assignment is undoable; destination creation never saves unrelated assets.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAuthoringDependencyRepair
    {
        public static void Assign(GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge edge, Object target)
        {
            if (edge.Source == null) throw new ArgumentException("Missing source.");
            if (target != null && edge.ExpectedType != null && !edge.ExpectedType.IsInstanceOfType(target))
                throw new ArgumentException("Incompatible reference type.");
            using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(edge.Source))
            {
                var property = serialized.FindProperty(edge.PropertyPath);
                if (property == null || property.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Reference location no longer exists.");
                Type currentType = GameplayAuthoringProperties.ReferenceType(property);
                if (target != null && currentType != null && !currentType.IsInstanceOfType(target))
                    throw new ArgumentException("Reference type changed; refresh dependencies first.");
                property.objectReferenceValue = target;
                serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();
            }
        }
        public static ScriptableObject CreateAndAssign(GameplayAuthoringDependencyEdge edge, string destination)
        {
            Type type = edge.ExpectedType;
            if (type == null || type.IsAbstract || !typeof(ScriptableObject).IsAssignableFrom(type))
                throw new ArgumentException("This edge requires a provider repair or an existing resource.");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(destination) || !destination.StartsWith("Assets/", StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                destination.Contains("../") || destination.Contains("\\") ||
                !destination.EndsWith(".asset", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) || System.IO.File.Exists(destination))
                throw new ArgumentException("Choose a new .asset destination inside Assets.");
            // Validate the source before creating anything.
            using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(edge.Source))
                if (serialized.FindProperty(edge.PropertyPath)?.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Reference location no longer exists.");
            int group = Undo.GetCurrentGroup();
            Undo.SetCurrentGroupName("Create & Assign dependency");
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance(type);
            if (asset is GameplayDefinitionAsset)
            {
                using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset))
                {
                    serialized.FindProperty("definitionId").stringValue = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
                    serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
                }
            }
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(asset, destination);
            Undo.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(asset, "Create dependency");
            Assign(edge, asset);
            Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(group);
            return asset;
        }
    }

    internal static class GameplayAuthoringProviders
    {
        internal static readonly IGameplayAuthoringDependencyProvider[] Dependencies = Discover<IGameplayAuthoringDependencyProvider>();
        internal static readonly IGameplayRangePreviewProvider[] Ranges = Discover<IGameplayRangePreviewProvider>();
        private static T[] Discover<T>() => TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<T>()
            .Where(t => !t.IsAbstract && !t.IsInterface && !t.Assembly.GetName().Name.EndsWith(".Tests", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            .OrderBy(t => t.FullName, StringComparer.Ordinal).Select(t => (T)Activator.CreateInstance(t)).ToArray();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object=UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>One business field description for Project and Workbench. Descriptors contain
    /// paths/conditions only; all values and Undo belong to the real SerializedObject.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema
    {
        private static readonly HashSet<string> OpenInactive=new HashSet<string>();
        private static readonly IGameplayBusinessInspectorProvider[] Providers=TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplayBusinessInspectorProvider>()
            .Where(t=>!t.IsAbstract&&t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes)!=null).OrderBy(t=>t.FullName)
            .Select(t=>(IGameplayBusinessInspectorProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(t)).ToArray();
        public static object Value(Object source,string path="")
        {
            if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return source;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){var p=so.FindProperty(path);return p?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference?p.managedReferenceValue:p?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.Generic&&!p.isArray?p.boxedValue:null;}
        }
        /// <summary>Read-only card text from the same live source as the two Inspector hosts.
        /// Cards do not maintain a third editable field list.</summary>
        public static string Summary(GameplayAuthoringLocation node)
        {
            var value=Value(node.Source,node.Path);
            if(value is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring search)
                return search.Shape+" · "+search.Plane+" · "+search.Faction+"\n半径 "+Number(search.Radius)+" · 目标上限 "+search.MaxTargets+" · 每目标 "+(search.EachTarget?.Length??0)+" 项";
            if(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset effect)
                return effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant&&effect.Executions?.Length==1?
                    effect.Executions[0] is GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring hit?"伤害 · "+hit.DamageType+" / "+Number(hit.Amount):
                    effect.Executions[0] is GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring healing?"治疗 · "+Number(healing.Amount):
                    effect.Executions[0] is GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring ward?"护盾 · "+Number(ward.Amount):"瞬时效果 · "+effect.name:
                    effect.DurationPolicy+(effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration?" · 持续 "+effect.Duration.ToString("0.###")+"s":"")+(effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant?" · 周期 "+effect.Period.ToString("0.###")+"s":"")+"\n执行 "+(effect.Executions?.Length??0)+" 项"+(effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration?" · 自然完成 "+(effect.CompletionExecutions?.Length??0)+" 项":"");
            if(value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset projectile)
                return projectile.Motion+(projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight?" / "+projectile.StraightDestination:"")+" · "+projectile.Plane+"\n速度 "+Number(projectile.Speed)+" · 射程 "+Number(projectile.MaxRange)+" · 命中上限 "+projectile.MaxHits;
            if(value is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset area)
                return area.Shape+" · "+area.Plane+" · 持续 "+Number(area.Duration)+"s\n周期 "+Number(area.TickInterval)+"s · Aura "+(area.Aura?.Length??0)+" 项";
            if(value is GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring damage)return damage.DamageType+" · "+Number(damage.Amount)+"\n结算阶段 "+(damage.Stages?.Length??0)+" 项";
            if(value is GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring heal)return "治疗 · "+Number(heal.Amount);
            if(value is GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring shield)return "护盾 · "+Number(shield.Amount);
            if(value is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring targets)return targets.Effect==null?"未连接效果":"对已解析目标应用效果\n"+targets.Effect.name;
            if(value is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring end)return end.Cancel?"取消当前施法并清理来源":"结束当前施法并清理来源";
            if(value is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)return GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(value.GetType()).DisplayName;
            return string.Join("\n",node.Summary.Split('\n').Take(2));
        }
        private static string Number(GameplayFloatValueAuthoring value)=>value is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring constant?constant.Value.ToString("0.###"):
            value is GameplayFormulaFloatValueAuthoring formula?formula.Expression:value==null?"缺失":"动态数值";
        /// <summary>Provider groups plus every remaining direct serialized field. New fields cannot
        /// disappear merely because a compact business provider predates them.</summary>
        public static GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup[] Describe(GameplayAuthoringLocation node,string scope)
        {
            var provider=Providers.FirstOrDefault(p=>(p.AuthoringScope=="Common"||p.AuthoringScope==scope)&&p.Supports(node));
            var groups=provider?.Groups(node).ToList()??new List<GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup>();
            var covered=new HashSet<string>(groups.Where(g=>g.Source==node.Source).SelectMany(g=>g.Paths));
            var remaining=new List<string>();
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(node.Source)){
                var root=node.Path.Length==0?null:so.FindProperty(node.Path);var cursor=root?.Copy()??so.GetIterator();
                var end=root?.GetEndProperty();bool enter=true;
                while(cursor.NextVisible(enter)){
                    enter=false;if(end!=null&&SerializedProperty.EqualContents(cursor,end))break;
                    if(cursor.name=="m_Script"||cursor.name=="CompositionLayout"||covered.Contains(cursor.propertyPath))continue;
                    remaining.Add(cursor.propertyPath);
                }
            }
            foreach(var group in remaining.GroupBy(p=>GameplayAuthoringInspector.HasBusinessLabel(p.Split('.').Last())?GameplayAuthoringInspector.Group(p.Split('.').Last()):"高级 / 扩展字段"))
                groups.Add(new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(node.Source,group.Key,"正式来源字段；未显示的条件字段保留原值。",group.ToArray()){Advanced=group.Key=="高级 / 扩展字段"});
            return groups.ToArray();
        }
        public static bool Visible(object owner,string field)
        {
            if(owner is GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring cue){if(field=="Duration")return cue.HasDuration;if(field=="Magnitude")return cue.HasMagnitude;}
            if(owner is GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring move){if(field=="Blocked")return move.UseControlGate;}
            if(owner is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring search){
                bool length=search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Box||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Line||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Ray||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Capsule;
                if(field=="Direction"||field=="DirectionAngle")return length||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Sector;
                if(field=="LengthFromTarget")return length;
                if(field=="Radius")return search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Circle||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Sector||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Capsule;
                if(field=="Angle")return search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Sector;
                if(field=="Length")return length&&!search.LengthFromTarget;
                if(field=="Width")return search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Box||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Line||search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Ray;
                if(field=="Cells"||field=="CellSize")return search.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.GridCells;
            }
            if(owner is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset effect){
                if(field=="Duration"||field=="DurationValue")return effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;
                if(field=="PeriodicStart")return effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant&&(effect.Period>0||effect.PeriodValue!=null);
                if(field=="Period"||field=="PeriodValue"||field=="Stacking"||field=="Modifiers"||field=="GrantedTags"||field=="OngoingRequirements")return effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant;
                if(field=="CompletionExecutions")return effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;
            }
            if(owner is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset projectile){
                if(field=="StraightDestination")return projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight;
                // Arc bends perpendicular to the rotated launch direction; the other curves
                // sample their captured points/control points or world-up height instead.
                if(field=="DirectionAngle")return projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight||projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Arc;
                if(field=="CurveHeight")return projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Arc||projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Parabolic;
                if(field=="Control1Offset"||field=="Control2Offset")return projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Bezier;
            }
            if(owner is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset area){
                if(field=="Radius")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Circle||area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Sector;
                if(field=="Angle")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Sector;
                if(field=="Length"||field=="Width")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Box;
                if(field=="Cells"||field=="CellSize")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Cells;
            }
            return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Static impossibility disables a port. Environment-dependent callbacks remain
        /// connectable with a Host/context explanation, never a promise of unconditional firing.</summary>
        public static string Unavailable(object owner,string field)
        {
            if(owner is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset projectile&&field=="OnArrive"&&projectile.Motion==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight&&projectile.StraightDestination==GameplayStraightDestinationMode.Direction)
                return "Direction 没有自然到达；改用 CapturedDestination 并提供点/目标，或连接 OnRange。原回调数据保留。";
            if(field.StartsWith("On",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&owner is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset area&&area.TickInterval is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring interval&&interval.Value<=0)
                return "Area TickInterval 必须大于 0；当前配置无法创建运行实例。";
            if(owner is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset effect&&field=="CompletionExecutions"&&effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                return "仅 Duration 自然到期触发；Instant、Infinite、Cancel、Dispel 不触发。";
            if(owner is GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring stack&&field=="OverflowExecutions"&&stack.Overflow!=GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow)
                return "仅 ExecuteOverflow 消费此独立 Overflow 数组；改变策略不会删除旧配置。";
            return null;
        }
        public static string FieldUnavailable(Object source,string path)
        {
            int dot=path.LastIndexOf('.');return Unavailable(Value(source,dot<0?"":path.Substring(0,dot)),dot<0?path:path.Substring(dot+1));
        }
        public static string CallbackNote(object owner,string field)
        {
            if(!field.StartsWith("On",StringComparison.Ordinal))return null;
            if(owner is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset)return "需要 StandardActor、有效 cast grant 和空间 Host；保留 Target / Point / Source / Level。"+
                (field=="OnCancelled"?"仅 Cancelled / TargetLost，Duration 自然 Completed 不触发。":field=="OnArrive"?"CapturedDestination 需点或目标；HitLimit / Range / Duration 可先终止。":field=="OnRange"?"达到 MaxRange，与 Duration 自然完成不同。":"逐段 Swept Query；MaxHits 可令弹体提前结束。");
            if(owner is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset)return "需要有效 Actor / grant / 空间 Host；Physics2D 仅 XY。"+
                (field=="OnExit"?"先释放本区域 Aura lease，再执行 OnExit；无需伪造 RemoveEffect 连线。":field=="OnTick"?"正 TickInterval；TickOnEnter 可在入场当刻触发。":field=="OnStay"?"仅 activeDelta > 0 时逐步执行。":field=="OnEnd"?"结束时释放全部 Inside/Aura，再运行 OnEnd。":"进入区域时派发，Aura 必须是持久 Effect。");
            return null;
        }
        public static void Draw(GameplayAuthoringLocation node,string scope)
        {
            if(node.Path.Length==0&&GameplayAnimationSourceInspectors.For(node.Source)!=null){using(var source=new SerializedObject(node.Source))GameplayAnimationSourceInspectors.DrawShared(source);return;}
            var nodeValue=Value(node.Source,node.Path);
            var inactive=new List<(Object source,string path)>();
            using(GameplayAuthoringInspector.UseScope(scope))foreach(var group in Describe(node,scope)){
                if(group.Advanced){string advanced=node.Handle.Key+".extension";bool open=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(OpenInactive.Contains(advanced),group.Title,true);if(open)OpenInactive.Add(advanced);else OpenInactive.Remove(advanced);if(!open)continue;}
                GUILayout.Space(5);GUILayout.Label(group.Title,EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(group.Note))EditorGUILayout.LabelField(group.Note,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                using(var so=new SerializedObject(group.Source)){
                    foreach(string path in group.Paths){
                        // A provider can serve both logical and Unity-prefab subclasses. Only
                        // fields actually present on this source belong to its Inspector.
                        var p=so.FindProperty(path);if(p==null)continue;
                        int dot=path.LastIndexOf('.');var owner=Value(group.Source,dot<0?"":path.Substring(0,dot));
                        if(!GameplaySkillFieldSchema.IsValueFieldVisible(owner,p.name))continue;
                        if(!Visible(owner,p.name)){inactive.Add((group.Source,path));continue;}
                        if(owner is GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset&&p.name=="Charge"){
                            bool enabled=p.managedReferenceValue!=null;
                            bool next=EditorGUILayout.Toggle("使用充能（与普通冷却互斥）",enabled);
                            if(next!=enabled){p.managedReferenceValue=next?new GameplayAbilityChargeAuthoring():null;if(next)so.FindProperty("CooldownEffect").objectReferenceValue=null;}
                            if(!next)continue;
                        }
                        string disabled=Unavailable(owner,p.name),note=CallbackNote(owner,p.name);
                        using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(disabled!=null||group.ReadOnly.Contains(path))){
                            if(owner is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring&&p.name=="Cancel")
                                p.boolValue=EditorGUILayout.Popup("结束类型",p.boolValue?1:0,new[]{"正常结束","取消结束"})==1;
                            else if(group.Choices.TryGetValue(path,out var choices))p.intValue=EditorGUILayout.IntPopup(GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(p),p.intValue,choices.Select(c=>new GUIContent(c)).ToArray(),Enumerable.Range(0,choices.Length).ToArray());
                            else GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(p,group.Labels.TryGetValue(path,out var label)?new GUIContent(label):GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(p));
                        }
                        if(disabled!=null)EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(disabled,MessageType.Warning);
                        else if(note!=null)EditorGUILayout.LabelField(note,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                    }
                    if(so.ApplyModifiedProperties())foreach(var path in group.Paths)GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(group.Source,path);
                }
            }
            if(inactive.Count>0){
                string key=node.Handle.Key;bool open=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(OpenInactive.Contains(key),"未启用配置 · "+inactive.Count+" 项（保留原值）",true);
                if(open)OpenInactive.Add(key);else OpenInactive.Remove(key);
                if(open)foreach(var item in inactive)using(var so=new SerializedObject(item.source)){
                    GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(so.FindProperty(item.path));
                    if(so.ApplyModifiedProperties())GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(item.source,item.path);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
        public static bool HasBusinessLabel(string field)=>Labels.ContainsKey(field);
        public static GUIContent Label(SerializedProperty property){
            if(Labels.TryGetValue(property.name,out var label))return new GUIContent(label);
            if(property.name.StartsWith("data[",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&int.TryParse(property.name.Substring(5,property.name.Length-6),out int index))return new GUIContent("配置 "+(index+1));
            return new GUIContent(property.displayName,"扩展字段；内部路径可在高级来源中查看。");
        }
        public static void Field(SerializedProperty property)
        {if(property!=null)Field(property,Label(property));}
        public static void Field(SerializedProperty property,GUIContent caption)
        {
            if(property==null)return;
            string control=ControlName(property.serializedObject.targetObject,property.propertyPath,_fieldContext);
            GUI.SetNextControlName(control);
            using(new Unity.Profiling.ProfilerMarker("FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.AuthoringField").Auto()){
                if(OwnedArray(property))DrawProperty(EditorGUILayout.GetControlRect(false,PropertyHeight(property)),property,caption);
                else EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(property,caption,true);
            }
            if(_focusRequest==control&&Event.current.type==EventType.Repaint){EditorGUI.FocusTextInControl(control);_focusRequest=null;}
            if(_fieldContext=="Inspector")FocusedFieldControl=GUI.GetNameOfFocusedControl();
            if(FocusedFieldControl==control&&Event.current.type==EventType.Repaint){FocusedFieldRect=GUILayoutUtility.GetLastRect();FocusedFieldScreenRect=new Rect(GUIUtility.GUIToScreenPoint(FocusedFieldRect.position),FocusedFieldRect.size);}
        }
        // Native ReorderableList minus/size controls bypass subasset ownership. Keep advanced
        // nested action arrays editable, but route removal through the same audited command.
        private static bool OwnedArray(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            if(!property.isArray||property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.String||property.arraySize==0)return false;
            var first=property.GetArrayElementAtIndex(0);
            if(first.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference)return false;
            string type=first.managedReferenceFieldTypename;
            return type.EndsWith("GameplaySkillActionAuthoring",StringComparison.Ordinal)||
                type.EndsWith("GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring",StringComparison.Ordinal)||
                type.EndsWith("GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring",StringComparison.Ordinal)||
                type.EndsWith("GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring",StringComparison.Ordinal)||
                type.EndsWith("GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring",StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }
        internal static float PropertyHeight(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            if(!OwnedArray(property))return EditorGUI.GetPropertyHeight(property,true);
            float height=EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight;
            if(property.isExpanded)for(int i=0;i<property.arraySize;i++)height+=EditorGUI.GetPropertyHeight(property.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i),true)+EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight+6;
            return height;
        }
        internal static void DrawProperty(Rect rect,SerializedProperty property,GUIContent caption)
        {
            string unavailable=GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema.FieldUnavailable(property.serializedObject.targetObject,property.propertyPath);
            if(unavailable!=null)caption=new GUIContent(caption.text,caption.tooltip+"\n"+unavailable);
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(unavailable!=null))DrawPropertyCore(rect,property,caption);
        }
        private static void DrawPropertyCore(Rect rect,SerializedProperty property,GUIContent caption)
        {
            if(property.name=="Cancel"&&property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.Boolean){
                int dot=property.propertyPath.LastIndexOf('.');
                var parent=dot<0?null:property.serializedObject.FindProperty(property.propertyPath.Substring(0,dot));
                if(parent?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&parent.managedReferenceValue is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring){
                    property.boolValue=EditorGUI.Popup(rect,"结束类型",property.boolValue?1:0,new[]{"正常结束","取消结束"})==1;return;
                }
            }
            if(!OwnedArray(property)){EditorGUI.PropertyField(rect,property,caption,true);return;}
            float line=EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight;
            property.isExpanded=EditorGUI.Foldout(new Rect(rect.x,rect.y,rect.width-30,line),property.isExpanded,new GUIContent(caption.text+" · "+property.arraySize,caption.tooltip),true);
            string appendReason=GameplayActionOrderValidation.PlacementReason(property.serializedObject.targetObject,property.propertyPath,property.arraySize,null);
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(appendReason!=null))if(GUI.Button(new Rect(rect.xMax-26,rect.y,26,line),new GUIContent("+",appendReason))){
                int at=property.arraySize;property.InsertArrayElementAtIndex(at);property.GetArrayElementAtIndex(at).managedReferenceValue=null;
                property.serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(property.serializedObject.targetObject);
                return;
            }
            if(!property.isExpanded)return;
            float y=rect.y+line+4;
            for(int i=0;i<property.arraySize;i++){
                var item=property.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);float height=EditorGUI.GetPropertyHeight(item,true);
                // Reserve a small Inspector toolbar, not a permanent right gutter through every
                // nested field. Otherwise completion Effect references collapse to a few pixels.
                EditorGUI.LabelField(new Rect(rect.x+12,y,Mathf.Max(0,rect.width-94),line),"顺序 / 删除",EditorStyles.miniLabel);
                string up=i==0?null:GameplayActionOrderValidation.PlacementReason(property.serializedObject.targetObject,property.propertyPath,i-1,item.managedReferenceValue,i);
                string down=i+1==property.arraySize?null:GameplayActionOrderValidation.PlacementReason(property.serializedObject.targetObject,property.propertyPath,i+2,item.managedReferenceValue,i);
                using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(i==0||up!=null))if(GUI.Button(new Rect(rect.xMax-78,y,24,line),new GUIContent("↑",up))){property.MoveArrayElement(i,i-1);return;}
                using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(i+1==property.arraySize||down!=null))if(GUI.Button(new Rect(rect.xMax-52,y,24,line),new GUIContent("↓",down))){property.MoveArrayElement(i,i+1);return;}
                using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode))if(GUI.Button(new Rect(rect.xMax-26,y,26,line),new GUIContent("×","删除动作 / 事件并检查独占素材…"))){
                    var source=property.serializedObject.targetObject;var handle=GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(source,item.propertyPath);
                    property.serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                    EditorApplication.delayCall+=()=>{
                        if(!source)return;
                        try{
                            GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands.Remove(source,handle.ResolvePath());
                        }
                        catch(Exception e){EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("不能删除此配置",e.Message,"了解");}
                    };
                    return;
                }
                EditorGUI.PropertyField(new Rect(rect.x+12,y+line+2,rect.width-12,height),item,new GUIContent("配置 "+(i+1)),true);
                y+=height+line+6;
            }
        }
        public static void Draw(SerializedObject serialized,bool showHelp=true)
        {
            serialized.UpdateIfRequiredOrScript();
            if(serialized.targetObject is GameplayDefinitionAsset history && history.MigrationHistoryOnly){DrawMigrationHistory(serialized);return;}
            GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema.Draw(new GameplayAuthoringLocation{Source=serialized.targetObject,Path=""},GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Scope(serialized.targetObject));
        }
        public static void DrawMigrationHistory(SerializedObject serialized)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("只读迁移来源 / 历史。正式技能请在 正式主技能中编辑。",MessageType.Info);
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(true)){
                var iterator=serialized.GetIterator();bool enter=true;
                while(iterator.NextVisible(enter)){enter=false;if(iterator.name!="m_Script"&&iterator.name!="migrationHistoryOnly")EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(iterator,true);}
            }
        }
        internal static string Group(string field)
        {
            switch(field) {
                case "RequiredTags": case "BlockedTags": return "释放门禁";

    public abstract class GameplayDefinitionInspector : UnityEditor.Editor

        public override void OnInspectorGUI()

                var sources=GameplayAuthoringDependencyGraph.BuildDefinition(orderRoot).Nodes.Select(n=>(UnityEngine.Object)n.Asset);
                foreach(var issue in GameplayActionOrderValidation.Scan(sources)){
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(issue.Message,issue.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error?MessageType.Error:MessageType.Warning);
                    if(GUILayout.Button("定位结束后动作 · "+issue.Source.name+" / "+issue.Path)){
                        SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillWorkbench.OpenSource(issue.Source as GameplayDefinitionAsset,issue.Path);
                    }
                }
            }
            GameplayAuthoringInspector.Draw(serializedObject);
            AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(target,out string guid,out long id);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("正式来源 · "+AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(target)+" / 子对象 #"+id,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
            if(target is GameplayDefinitionAsset&&GUILayout.Button("在同一技能工作台定位")){
                SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillWorkbench.OpenSource(target as GameplayDefinitionAsset);
            }
            if (target is GameplayDefinitionAsset definition && GUILayout.Button("校验配置"))
            {
                var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext(); validation.Asset(definition, definition.name);
                if (!validation.HasErrors) Debug.Log("配置校验通过", target);
                foreach (var issue in validation.Issues) Debug.LogWarning(issue.ToString(), target);
            }
        }
    }
````

````csharp
    /// <summary>A source location, never execution data. Embedded identities survive array edits.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAuthoringLocation
    {
        private Object _source;
        private string _path;
        private GameplaySourceHandle _handle;
        public Object Source { get => _source ? _source : _handle?.Owner; set { if(_source!=value){_source=value;_handle=null;} } }
        public string Path { get => Handle.ResolvePath(); set { _path=value??"";_handle=null; } }
        public GameplaySourceHandle Handle => _handle ?? (_handle=GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(_source,_path??""));
        public string Title, Summary, Lane;
        /// <summary>Transient scope/terminal explanation; never an authored action or serialized graph state.</summary>
        public string FlowHint;
        public bool Animation;
        /// <summary>Canonical marker time for display only; null for non-marker locations.</summary>
        public float? Time;
        public GameplayNodeVisualKind Kind;
        public GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset Sequence;
        /// <summary>Exact canonical marker path; time is display data, never marker identity. Null means no unique marker.</summary>
        private string _originMarkerPath;
        private GameplaySourceHandle _originMarker;
        public string OriginMarkerPath {
            get {if(_originMarkerPath==null)return null;return (_originMarker??(_originMarker=GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(Sequence,_originMarkerPath))).ResolvePath();}
            set {_originMarkerPath=value;_originMarker=null;}
        }
        public string Key => Handle.Key;
    }
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>The four serialized skill roles. Array order is the execution order; no edge data is stored.</summary>
    public enum SkillNodeRole { Trigger, Condition, Target, Action }

    public readonly struct SkillNodeLocation
    {
        public readonly SkillNodeRole Role;
        public readonly int Index;
        public readonly long Id;
        public readonly string Path;
        public readonly bool IsNull;
        public string Key => IsNull ? Role + ":null:" + Path : Role + ":" + Id;
        public SkillNodeLocation(SkillNodeRole role, int index, SerializedProperty property)
        {
            Role = role;
            Index = index;
            Id = property.managedReferenceId;
            Path = property.propertyPath;
            IsNull = property.managedReferenceValue == null;
        }
    }
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Reference/GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Editor-only invalidation, not a source cache. Only actual serialized mutations enqueue source/path pairs.
    /// Explicit writers and Unity Undo/ObjectChange callbacks converge into one deferred batch; no Repaint polling.</summary>
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public static class GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges
    {
        public readonly struct Change
        {
            public readonly Object Source;
            public readonly string Path;
            public Change(Object source,string path) { Source=source;Path=path??""; }
        }
        private static readonly Dictionary<Object,HashSet<string>> Pending=new Dictionary<Object,HashSet<string>>();
        private static bool _scheduled;
        public static event Action<IReadOnlyList<Change>> Changed;
        static GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges()
        {
            Undo.postprocessModifications+=OnModifications;
            ObjectChangeEvents.changesPublished+=OnObjectChanges;
        }
        public static void Notify(Object source,string path="")
        {
            if(source==null || !(source is ScriptableObject)) return;
            GameplayActionOrderValidation.SourceChanged(source);
            if(!Pending.TryGetValue(source,out var paths)) Pending.Add(source,paths=new HashSet<string>());
            paths.Add(path??"");
            if(_scheduled) return;
            _scheduled=true;EditorApplication.update+=Flush;
        }
        private static UndoPropertyModification[] OnModifications(UndoPropertyModification[] modifications)
        {
            foreach(var modification in modifications)
            {
                var value=modification.currentValue;var previous=modification.previousValue;
                if(value!=null && (previous==null || value.value!=previous.value || value.objectReference!=previous.objectReference))
                    Notify(value.target,value.propertyPath);
            }
            return modifications;
        }
        private static void OnObjectChanges(ref ObjectChangeEventStream stream)
        {
            for(int i=0;i<stream.length;i++)
                if(stream.GetEventType(i)==ObjectChangeKind.ChangeAssetObjectProperties)
                {
                    stream.GetChangeAssetObjectPropertiesEvent(i,out var change);
                    var source=EditorUtility.InstanceIDToObject(change.instanceId);
                    // Document layout events are already covered precisely by Undo paths. They must not rebuild rule data.
                    Notify(source);
                }
        }
        private static void Flush()
        {
            _scheduled=false;EditorApplication.update-=Flush;
            var batch=Pending.Where(p=>p.Key!=null).SelectMany(p=>p.Value.Select(path=>new Change(p.Key,path))).ToArray();
            Pending.Clear();
            if(batch.Length>0) Changed?.Invoke(batch);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Compilation;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Explicit game-owned scope resolution. Raw assets can opt into their game's picker scope.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayAuthoringScopeProvider { string Scope(Object asset); }
    /// <summary>One discovery/filter policy for every managed authoring selector; Editor/test nodes cannot enter Player content.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog
    {
        private static Dictionary<string,string> _documentScopes;
        static GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog(){EditorApplication.projectChanged+=()=>_documentScopes=null;}
        public static Type BaseType(SkillNodeRole role) => role == SkillNodeRole.Trigger ? typeof(GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring) :
            role == SkillNodeRole.Condition ? typeof(GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring) : role == SkillNodeRole.Target ? typeof(GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring) : typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring);
        public static string Scope(Object asset)
        {
            if (asset is GameplaySkillDocumentAsset skill && skill.AuthoringSchemaVersion == 2) return skill.AuthoringGraph?.Scope;
            if(asset!=null){
                string path=AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset);
                if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)){
                    if(_documentScopes==null){
                        _documentScopes=new Dictionary<string,string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                        foreach(var document in SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillWorkbench.Documents())
                            _documentScopes[AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(document)]=document.AuthoringGraph?.Scope??"";
                    }
                    if(_documentScopes.TryGetValue(path,out var ownedScope)&&!string.IsNullOrEmpty(ownedScope))return ownedScope;
                }
            }
            foreach (var type in TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplayAuthoringScopeProvider>().Where(t => !t.IsAbstract))
            { string scope = ((IGameplayAuthoringScopeProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(type)).Scope(asset); if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(scope)) return scope; }
            return GameplayAuthoringInspector.CurrentScope??"";
        }
        public static IReadOnlyList<Type> Types(Type baseType)
        {
            var players = new HashSet<string>(CompilationPipeline.GetAssemblies(AssembliesType.Player)
                .Where(a => (a.flags & AssemblyFlags.EditorAssembly) == 0 && !a.name.EndsWith(".Tests", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .Select(a => a.name));
            return TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom(baseType).Concat(new[] { baseType })
                .Where(t => t.IsClass && !t.IsAbstract && !t.ContainsGenericParameters && (t.IsPublic || t.IsNestedPublic) &&
                    t.IsSerializable && t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null && players.Contains(t.Assembly.GetName().Name))
                .Distinct().OrderBy(t => t.FullName, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
        }
        public static IReadOnlyList<Type> Query(Type baseType, string scope, string search = "", bool otherGames = false, bool samples = false)
        {
            return Types(baseType).Where(t => {
                var d = GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(t);
                bool scopeMatch = string.IsNullOrEmpty(scope) || d.AuthoringScope == "FRFrame" || d.AuthoringScope == "Common" || d.AuthoringScope == scope || otherGames;
                return scopeMatch && (!d.IsSample || samples) && (string.IsNullOrEmpty(search) ||
                    (d.DisplayName + " " + d.CategoryPath + " " + d.Summary + " " + d.Keywords + " " + t.FullName).IndexOf(search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0);
            }).ToArray();
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Searchable, scoped picker shared by graph, Timeline, nested drawers and Cost.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAuthoringTypePicker : EditorWindow
    {
        private Type _baseType; private string _scope, _search = ""; private bool _other, _samples, _officialOnly;
        private Action<Type> _choose; private Vector2 _scroll;

        public static void Show(Type baseType, Object source, Action<Type> choose, string scope = null, string search = "",Func<Type,string> unavailable=null,string contextNote=null)
        {

                        var item=type;var descriptor=GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(item);

                        var label=new GUIContent(GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Category(item)+"/"+descriptor.DisplayName+(reason==null?"":" · 不可用"),reason??descriptor.Summary);
                        if(reason!=null)menu.AddDisabledItem(label);
                        else menu.AddItem(label,false,()=>{try{string current=unavailable?.Invoke(item)??SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillTypeAvailability.Reason(source as GameplaySkillDocumentAsset,item);if(current!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException(current);choose(item);}catch(Exception error){v2.Canvas.Feedback?.Invoke(error.Message);}});
                    }

            if (GUILayout.Button("清空配置")) Pick(null);

        public static void Property(Type baseType, SerializedProperty property, bool append = false)
        {
            Object source = property.serializedObject.targetObject;
            var handle=GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(source,property.propertyPath);
            string expected=append?null:property.managedReferenceFullTypename;
            Show(baseType, source, type => {
                if (source == null) return;

                using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(source))
                {

                    if(selected==null||!append&&selected.managedReferenceFullTypename!=expected)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("原字段已被另一个编辑入口替换，请重新选择配置类型。");
                    if(type!=null&&!GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Query(baseType,GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Scope(source),samples:true).Contains(type))
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("此类型在当前 Scope 不可用。");
                    if(baseType==typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)&&type!=null){
                        string array=append?path:GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands.ActionArray(path);
                        if(array!=null){
                            int at=append?selected.arraySize:int.Parse(path.Substring(path.LastIndexOf('[')+1).TrimEnd(']'));
                            string order=GameplayActionOrderValidation.PlacementReason(source,array,at,Activator.CreateInstance(type),append?-1:at);
                            if(order!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException(order);
                        }
                    }
                    if(!append&&selected.managedReferenceValue!=null){
                        if(selected.managedReferenceValue.GetType()==type)return;
                        if(type==null&&(selected.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring||selected.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring))
                            throw new InvalidOperationException("这是必需的触发 / 目标配置，请选择替代类型，不能清空。");
                        var labels=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();var field=selected.Copy();var end=field.GetEndProperty();
                        if(field.NextVisible(true))do{if(SerializedProperty.EqualContents(field,end))break;labels.Add(GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(field).text);}while(field.NextVisible(false)&&labels.Count<8);
                        if(!EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("替换配置类型", "将替换「"+GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(selected.managedReferenceValue.GetType()).DisplayName+"」及其字段：\n"+string.Join("、",labels)+"\n已有配置资源保留，不自动清理；可用一次 Undo 恢复。","替换","取消"))return;
                        if(type==null&&(selected.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring||selected.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring)){
                            GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands.Remove(source,path);return;
                        }
                    }
                    if (append) { if (type == null) return; int i = selected.arraySize; selected.arraySize++; selected = selected.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i); }
                    selected.managedReferenceValue = type == null ? null : Activator.CreateInstance(type);
                    selected.isExpanded = true; if(serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties()) GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(source,path);
                }
            });
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Minimal production Inspector type selection for Effect timing/stack/overflow nodes, including game extensions.</summary>
    public abstract class GameplayEffectCapabilityDrawer : PropertyDrawer
    {
        protected abstract Type NodeType { get; }
        private static float Line => EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight;
        public override float GetPropertyHeight(SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label)
        {
            float height = Line;
            if (property.isExpanded && (property.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference || property.managedReferenceValue != null))
                foreach (var child in Children(property)) height += GameplayAuthoringInspector.PropertyHeight(child) + 2;
            return height;
        }
        public override void OnGUI(Rect position, SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label)
        {
            if(label.text.StartsWith("Element",StringComparison.Ordinal)) {
                int left=property.propertyPath.LastIndexOf('['),right=property.propertyPath.LastIndexOf(']');
                if(left>=0&&right>left&&int.TryParse(property.propertyPath.Substring(left+1,right-left-1),out int index))
                    label=new GUIContent((property.propertyPath.StartsWith("Markers",StringComparison.Ordinal)?"标记 ":"配置 ")+(index+1),property.propertyPath);
            }
            EditorGUI.BeginProperty(position, label, property);
            var row = new Rect(position.x, position.y, position.width, Line);
            float selectorWidth=Mathf.Min(180,Mathf.Max(80,row.width*.55f));
            var selector = new Rect(row.xMax-selectorWidth,row.y,selectorWidth,Line);
            row.width-=selectorWidth+4;
            property.isExpanded = EditorGUI.Foldout(row, property.isExpanded, label, true);
            bool managed=property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference;
            if(managed){
                string caption = property.managedReferenceValue == null ? "选择配置类型" :
                    SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(property.managedReferenceValue.GetType()).DisplayName;
                if (GUI.Button(selector, caption, EditorStyles.popup))GameplayAuthoringTypePicker.Property(NodeType, property);
            }
            if (property.isExpanded && (!managed || property.managedReferenceValue != null))
            {
                EditorGUI.indentLevel++;
                float y = position.y + Line + 2;
                foreach (var child in Children(property))
                {
                    float height = GameplayAuthoringInspector.PropertyHeight(child);
                    GameplayAuthoringInspector.DrawProperty(new Rect(position.x,y,position.width,height), child, GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(child)); y += height + 2;
                }
                EditorGUI.indentLevel--;
            }
            EditorGUI.EndProperty();
        }
        private static System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<SerializedProperty> Children(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            var child = property.Copy(); var end = child.GetEndProperty();
            if (!child.NextVisible(true)) yield break;
            do { if (SerializedProperty.EqualContents(child,end)) yield break;
                if(child.name=="Value"&&property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&property.managedReferenceValue is GameplayCooldownActionAuthoring cooldown&&cooldown.Operation==Standard.GameplayCooldownOperation.Restart)continue;
                if(!GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema.Visible(property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference?property.managedReferenceValue:null,child.name))continue;
                yield return child.Copy(); } while (child.NextVisible(false));
        }
    }
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayFloatValueAuthoring), true)]
    public sealed class GameplayEffectTimingValueDrawer : GameplayEffectCapabilityDrawer { protected override Type NodeType => typeof(GameplayFloatValueAuthoring); }
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring), true)]
    public sealed class GameplayEffectOverflowDrawer : GameplayEffectCapabilityDrawer { protected override Type NodeType => typeof(GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring); }
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring))]
    public sealed class GameplayEffectStackingDrawer : GameplayEffectCapabilityDrawer { protected override Type NodeType => typeof(GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring); }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Reference/GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Editor ownership and visibility for canonical Tag registrations.</summary>
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public static class GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider
    {
        public const string Framework = "FRFrame";
        public const string Shared = "Shared";
        private static GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset[] _catalogs;

        static GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider() => EditorApplication.projectChanged += () => _catalogs = null;

        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset> Catalogs =>
            _catalogs ??= AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset", new[] { "Assets" })
                .Select(guid => AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset>(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid)))
                .Where(asset => asset != null)
                .OrderBy(OwnerScope, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();

        public static string OwnerScope(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog) =>
            string.IsNullOrEmpty(catalog.Scope) ? Framework : catalog.Scope;

        /// <summary>Retains the framework registry entry point for project-wide Attributes.</summary>
        public static GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset Find(out string error) => Find(Framework, out error);

        public static GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset Find(string scope, out string error)
        {
            var matches = Catalogs.Where(catalog => OwnerScope(catalog) == scope || catalog.ScopeAliases.Contains(scope)).ToArray();
            // A single pre-split registry has no serialized scope and still serves its project.
            if (matches.Length == 0 && Catalogs.Count == 1 && string.IsNullOrEmpty(Catalogs[0].Scope))
            { error = null; return Catalogs[0]; }
            error = matches.Length == 1 ? null : matches.Length == 0
                ? $"Scope「{scope}」没有 Reference Catalog。"
                : $"Scope「{scope}」有多个 Reference Catalog。";
            return matches.Length == 1 ? matches[0] : null;
        }

        public static string Scope(Object asset)
        {
            if (asset == null) return null;
            var path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset);
            var document = asset as GameplaySkillDocumentAsset ?? AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(path) as GameplaySkillDocumentAsset;
            return Scope(path, document != null && document.AuthoringSchemaVersion == 2 ? document.AuthoringGraph?.Scope : null);
        }

        internal static string Scope(string assetPath, string declaredScope)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(declaredScope) && declaredScope != Framework)
                return Find(declaredScope, out _) is GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset declared ? OwnerScope(declared) : declaredScope;
            // Legacy framework sample documents use FRFrame for node availability and live in the Lab.
            var folderOwner = Catalogs.Where(catalog => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(catalog.AssetRoot) &&
                    assetPath.StartsWith(catalog.AssetRoot.TrimEnd('/') + "/", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                .OrderByDescending(catalog => catalog.AssetRoot.Length).FirstOrDefault();
            return folderOwner != null ? OwnerScope(folderOwner) : declaredScope;
        }

        internal static bool CanRead(string sourceScope, string ownerScope) =>
            ownerScope == Framework || ownerScope == sourceScope || (ownerScope == Shared && sourceScope != Framework);

        internal static IEnumerable<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset> Visible(string scope) =>
            Catalogs.Where(catalog => CanRead(scope, OwnerScope(catalog)));

        /// <summary>Preflights one write against every owner before changing any catalog or document.</summary>
        internal static string[] WithRegistrations(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog, IEnumerable<string> tags)
        {
            var additions = tags.Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
            foreach (string tag in additions)
            {
                if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, tag))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("无效的 Gameplay Tag · " + tag);
                var other = Catalogs.FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate != catalog && candidate.Tags.Contains(tag, StringComparer.Ordinal));
                if (other != null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"{tag} 已由「{OwnerScope(other)}」登记。");
            }
            return catalog.Tags.Concat(additions).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
        }

        /// <summary>Registers game-owned Tags from standalone content builders.</summary>
        public static void RegisterTags(string scope, IEnumerable<string> tags)
        {
            var catalog = Find(scope, out string error);
            if (catalog == null) throw new InvalidOperationException(error);
            var visible = new HashSet<string>(Visible(OwnerScope(catalog)).SelectMany(owner => owner.Tags), StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var next = WithRegistrations(catalog, tags.Where(tag => !visible.Contains(tag)));
            if (next.SequenceEqual(catalog.Tags, StringComparer.Ordinal)) return;
            Undo.RecordObject(catalog, "登记 Gameplay Tag");
            catalog.Tags = next;
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(catalog);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(catalog);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Reference/GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    public readonly struct GameplayReferenceDiagnostic
    {
        public readonly string Location;
        public readonly string Message;
        public GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(string location, string message)
        { Location = location; Message = message; }
        public override string ToString() => Location + ": " + Message;
    }

    public sealed class GameplayReferenceDiagnosticReport
    {
        public readonly List<GameplayReferenceDiagnostic> Errors = new List<GameplayReferenceDiagnostic>();
        /// <summary>Non-blocking author guidance; retained separately from invalid content/catalog references.</summary>
        public readonly List<GameplayReferenceDiagnostic> Warnings = new List<GameplayReferenceDiagnostic>();
        public int AssetCount;
        public int SerializedReferenceCount;
        public int SourceFileCount;
        public int SourceLiteralCount;
        public int AuthoringValidationErrors;
        public int MissingTagReferences;
        public int OutOfScopeTagReferences;
        public int MissingAttributeReferences;
        public int MissingCodeLiterals;
    }

    /// <summary>Combines 12A recursive validation with Editor-only catalog membership checks.</summary>
    public static class GameplayReferenceDiagnostics
    {
        public static GameplayReferenceDiagnosticReport Scan(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> selectedAssets = null,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> selectedLiterals = null)
        {
            var report = new GameplayReferenceDiagnosticReport();
            bool project = catalog == null;
            var catalogs = project ? GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Catalogs : new[] { catalog };
            if (project) catalog = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(out _);
            if (catalog == null) report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic("Catalog", "需要唯一的 FRFrame Catalog。"));
            var assets = (selectedAssets ?? GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets()).ToArray();
            var references = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(assets);
            var literals = selectedLiterals ?? GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanProductionCode();
            report.AssetCount = assets.Length;
            report.SerializedReferenceCount = references.Count;
            report.SourceLiteralCount = literals.Count;
            report.SourceFileCount = GameplayReferenceScanner.CountProductionSourceFiles();

            var owners = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var scopes = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var entry in catalogs)
            {
                string owner = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope(entry);
                string path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(entry);
                foreach (string scope in entry.ScopeAliases.Prepend(owner))
                    if (!IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, scope) || scope.Contains(".") || !scopes.Add(scope))
                        report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(path + ".Scope", "无效或重复的 Scope · " + scope));
                foreach (var issue in entry.Validate())
                    report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(path + "." + issue.Path, issue.Message));
                foreach (string tag in entry.Tags ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                    if (tag != null && !owners.TryAdd(tag, owner) && owners[tag] != owner)
                        report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(path + ".Tags", $"重复登记 {tag} · {owners[tag]} / {owner}"));
            }
            var attributes = new HashSet<string>(catalog?.Attributes ?? Array.Empty<string>(), StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var sourceScopes = project ? references.Select(reference=>reference.Source).Concat(assets).Distinct()
                .ToDictionary(source=>source,source=>GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(source)) : null;
            foreach (GameplayDefinitionAsset asset in assets)
            {
                var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
                validation.Asset(asset, AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset));
                foreach (var issue in validation.Issues)
                {
                    var diagnostic=new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(issue.Path, issue.Message);
                    if(issue.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning)report.Warnings.Add(diagnostic);
                    else {report.Errors.Add(diagnostic);report.AuthoringValidationErrors++;}
                }
            }
            foreach(var issue in SkillAuthoring.GameplayActionOrderValidation.Scan(assets)){
                var diagnostic=new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(issue.Source)+"."+issue.Path,issue.Message);
                if(issue.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning)report.Warnings.Add(diagnostic);
                else{report.Errors.Add(diagnostic);report.AuthoringValidationErrors++;}
            }
            foreach (var reference in references)
            {
                if (!IsValid(reference.Kind, reference.Value)) continue; // 12A already reports invalid authoring values.
                if (reference.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag)
                {
                    string location = reference.AssetPath + "." + reference.PropertyPath;
                    if (!owners.TryGetValue(reference.Value, out string owner))
                    { report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(location, "Unregistered Tag: " + reference.Value)); report.MissingTagReferences++; }
                    else if (project && sourceScopes[reference.Source] is string scope && !GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.CanRead(scope,owner))
                    { report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(location,$"{scope} 无法引用 {owner} 的私有 Tag · {reference.Value}")); report.OutOfScopeTagReferences++; }
                }
                if (reference.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute && !attributes.Contains(reference.Value))
                { report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(reference.AssetPath + "." + reference.PropertyPath, "Unregistered Attribute: " + reference.Value)); report.MissingAttributeReferences++; }
            }
            foreach (var literal in literals)
            {
                bool valid = IsValid(literal.Kind, literal.Value);
                bool present = literal.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag ? owners.ContainsKey(literal.Value) : attributes.Contains(literal.Value);
                if (valid && present) continue;
                report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(literal.SourcePath + ":" + literal.Line,
                    (valid ? "Unregistered" : "Invalid") + " production " + literal.Kind + " literal: " + literal.Value));
                report.MissingCodeLiterals++;
            }
            if (project)
                foreach (string sourcePath in sourceScopes.Where(pair=>pair.Value==GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Shared)
                    .Select(pair=>AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(pair.Key)).Where(path=>path.Length>0).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal))
                    foreach (string dependency in AssetDatabase.GetDependencies(sourcePath,false))
                    {
                        string scope=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(dependency));
                        if(scope!=null&&!GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.CanRead(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Shared,scope))
                            report.Errors.Add(new GameplayReferenceDiagnostic(sourcePath,$"Shared 内容引用了 {scope} 的私有资产 · {dependency}"));
                    }
            return report;
        }

        public static bool IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind kind, string value)
        {
            try
            {
                if (kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag) new GameplayTag(value);
                else new GameplayAttributeId(value);
                return true;
            }
            catch (ArgumentException) { return false; }
        }
    }
}
````
