````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Project authoring registry, typed reference diagnostics and conservative Tag refactor UI.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayReferenceEditorWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private enum Tab { Tags, Attributes, Diagnostics }
        private Tab _tab;
        private GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset _catalog;
        [SerializeField] private string _scope;
        private string _search = string.Empty;
        private string _selectedTag;
        private string _newTag = string.Empty;
        private string _newAttribute = string.Empty;
        private string _renameTarget = string.Empty;
        private GameplayTagRefactorPreview _preview;
        private GameplayReferenceDiagnosticReport _report;
        private IReadOnlyList<GameplaySerializedReference> _references = Array.Empty<GameplaySerializedReference>();
        private IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> _literals = Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, bool> _expanded = new Dictionary<string, bool>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private Vector2 _scroll;
        private Vector2 _tagDetailScroll;

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Gameplay/References")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            var source = (focusedWindow as SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillWorkbench)?.Document ?? Selection.activeObject;
            OpenForScope(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(source));
        }

        internal static void OpenForScope(string scope)
        {
            var window = GetWindow<GameplayReferenceEditorWindow>("Gameplay References");
            window.minSize = new Vector2(580,320);
            if(scope!=null)window.SelectScope(scope);
            window.Focus();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            EditorApplication.projectChanged += OnProjectChanged;
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed += OnProjectChanged;
        }
        private void OnDisable()
        {
            EditorApplication.projectChanged -= OnProjectChanged;
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed -= OnProjectChanged;
        }
        private void OnProjectChanged()
        {
            _report = null; _preview = null;
            Repaint();
        }

        private void SelectScope(string scope)
        {
            _scope = scope; _selectedTag = null; _preview = null;
            _expanded.Clear(); _scroll = _tagDetailScroll = Vector2.zero;
        }

        private void Refresh()
        {
            var assets = GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets();
            _references = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(assets);
            _literals = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanProductionCode();
            _report = GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan(null, assets, _literals);
            _preview = null;
            Repaint();
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal(EditorStyles.toolbar);
            _tab = (Tab)GUILayout.Toolbar((int)_tab, new[] { "Tags", "Attributes", "Diagnostics" }, EditorStyles.toolbarButton);
            if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(65))) Refresh();
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            _catalog = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(out string error);
            if (_catalog == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(error, MessageType.Error);
                return;
            }
            if(_tab==Tab.Tags)
            {
                var scopes = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Catalogs.Select(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope)
                    .Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).Prepend("").ToArray();
                int selected = Math.Max(0,Array.IndexOf(scopes,_scope??""));
                int next = EditorGUILayout.Popup("Tag Scope",selected,scopes.Select(scope=>scope==""?"全工程":scope).ToArray());
                if(next!=selected)SelectScope(scopes[next]);
            }
            _search = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Search", _search);
            if(_tab==Tab.Tags){DrawTags();return;}
            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            if(_tab==Tab.Attributes)DrawAttributes();else DrawDiagnostics();
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }

        private void DrawTags()
        {
            var catalogs = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Catalogs;
            var visible = string.IsNullOrEmpty(_scope) ? catalogs : GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Visible(_scope);
            var owners = visible.SelectMany(catalog=>catalog.Tags.Select(tag=>(tag,catalog)))
                .Where(entry=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.tag))
                .ToLookup(entry=>entry.tag,entry=>entry.catalog,StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var tags = owners.Select(group=>group.Key).ToArray();
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_scope)?"全工程浏览。选择具体 Scope 后可登记。":
                $"显示 {_scope} 和可引用的共享 Tag。新 Tag 登记到 {_scope}。", MessageType.Info);
            float detailWidth=Mathf.Clamp(position.width*.38f,290,440);
            using(new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                using(var list=new EditorGUILayout.ScrollViewScope(_scroll,GUILayout.Width(position.width-detailWidth-8)))
                {
                    _scroll=list.scrollPosition;
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_search))
                        foreach (var child in GameplayReferenceTree.Project(tags).Children.Values) DrawTreeNode(child, 0,owners);
                    else foreach (string tag in tags.Where(x => x.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                                 .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal)) DrawTagRow(tag,owners[tag]);
                }
                using(var details=new EditorGUILayout.ScrollViewScope(_tagDetailScroll,GUILayout.Width(detailWidth)))
                {
                    _tagDetailScroll=details.scrollPosition;
                    DrawTagDetails(owners);
                }
            }
        }

        private void DrawTagDetails(ILookup<string,GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset> owners)
        {
            _newTag = EditorGUILayout.TextField("New Tag / Child", _newTag);
            var target = string.IsNullOrEmpty(_scope)?null:GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(_scope,out _);
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(target==null))
            {
                if (GUILayout.Button("Add Tag")) AddTag(target,_newTag);
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedTag)))
                    if (GUILayout.Button("Add Child")) AddTag(target,_selectedTag + "." + _newTag);
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            EditorGUILayout.Space(8);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Selected", _selectedTag ?? "(none)");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_selectedTag)) return;
            var selectedOwners=owners[_selectedTag].ToArray();
            if(selectedOwners.Length==1)
            {
                var owner=selectedOwners[0];
                using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(true))EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("所属 Catalog",owner,typeof(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset),false);
                string ownerScope=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope(owner);
                if(ownerScope!=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Shared&&ownerScope!=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Framework&&
                    GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("提升此 Tag 到 Shared","移动登记归属，各游戏可引用同一个原字符串。")))
                    Promote(owner,_selectedTag);
            }
            if(_report!=null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Serialized references (subtree)",
                    _references.Count(x => x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag && GameplayTagRefactorService.Matches(x.Value, _selectedTag)).ToString());
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Code literals (subtree)",
                    _literals.Count(x => x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag && GameplayTagRefactorService.Matches(x.Value, _selectedTag)).ToString());
            }
            _renameTarget = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Rename to", _renameTarget);
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if (GUILayout.Button("预览全工程重命名"))
                _preview = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewProjectRename(_selectedTag, _renameTarget);
            if (GUILayout.Button("预览全工程删除"))
                _preview = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewProjectDelete(_selectedTag);
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            DrawPreview();
        }

        private void DrawTreeNode(GameplayReferenceTreeNode node, int depth,ILookup<string,GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset> owners)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal(); GUILayout.Space(depth * 14f);
            if (node.Children.Count > 0)
            {
                bool expanded = !_expanded.TryGetValue(node.FullPath, out bool value) || value;
                _expanded[node.FullPath] = GUILayout.Toggle(expanded, expanded ? "▾" : "▸", EditorStyles.label, GUILayout.Width(15f));
            }
            else GUILayout.Space(15f);
            if (GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent(node.Segment + (node.IsDefined ? "" : " (group)"), node.FullPath),
                    _selectedTag == node.FullPath ? EditorStyles.toolbarButton : EditorStyles.linkLabel))
            { _selectedTag = node.FullPath; _renameTarget = node.FullPath; _preview = null; }
            if (node.IsDefined) DrawOwners(owners[node.FullPath]);
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            if (node.Children.Count > 0 && _expanded[node.FullPath])
                foreach (var child in node.Children.Values) DrawTreeNode(child, depth + 1,owners);
        }
        private void DrawTagRow(string path,IEnumerable<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset> owners)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if (GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent(path, path), EditorStyles.linkLabel))
            { _selectedTag = path; _renameTarget = path; _preview = null; }
            DrawOwners(owners);
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }
        private static void DrawOwners(IEnumerable<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset> owners) =>
            GUILayout.Label(string.Join(" / ",owners.Select(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope)),EditorStyles.miniLabel);
        private void DrawPreview()
        {
            if (_preview == null) return;
            EditorGUILayout.Space(8);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(_preview.IsDelete ? "Delete preview" : "Rename preview", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Catalog entries", _preview.AffectedCatalogTags.Count.ToString());
            foreach(var pair in _preview.CatalogChanges)
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope(pair.Key),pair.Value.Length.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Serialized references", _preview.AffectedReferences.Count.ToString());
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("C# literals", _preview.AffectedCode.Count.ToString());
            foreach (string error in _preview.Errors) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(error, MessageType.Error);
            foreach (var literal in _preview.AffectedCode)
                if (GUILayout.Button(literal.SourcePath + ":" + literal.Line + "  " + literal.Value, EditorStyles.linkLabel))
                    Ping(literal.SourcePath, literal.Line);
            foreach (var reference in _preview.AffectedReferences)
                if (GUILayout.Button(reference.AssetPath + "  " + reference.PropertyPath, EditorStyles.linkLabel))
                    Ping(reference.AssetPath);
            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!_preview.CanApply))
                if (GUILayout.Button("Apply with Undo"))
                {
                    try { GameplayTagRefactorService.Apply(_preview); Refresh(); }
                    catch (Exception ex) { EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("Tag refactor failed", ex.Message, "OK"); Refresh(); }
                }
            if (GUILayout.Button("Cancel Preview")) _preview = null;
        }

        private void DrawAttributes()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Catalog entries register existing attribute identities for authoring; they do not create Runtime Attributes.", MessageType.Info);
            foreach (string value in (_catalog.Attributes ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                         .Where(x => x != null && x.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                         .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal))
            {
                EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(value, GUILayout.MinWidth(150));
                if(_report!=null){
                    GUILayout.Label("assets " + CountSerialized(GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute, value), GUILayout.Width(75));
                    GUILayout.Label("code " + CountCode(GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute, value), GUILayout.Width(70));
                }
                if (GUILayout.Button("Remove", GUILayout.Width(65))) RemoveAttribute(value);
                EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            }
            _newAttribute = EditorGUILayout.TextField("New identity", _newAttribute);
            if (GUILayout.Button("Add Attribute Entry")) AddAttribute(_newAttribute);
        }

        private void DrawDiagnostics()
        {
            if (_report == null) Refresh();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"Assets {_report.AssetCount}, serialized references {_report.SerializedReferenceCount}, " +
                $"source files {_report.SourceFileCount}, code literals {_report.SourceLiteralCount}", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"Errors {_report.Errors.Count}: 12A {_report.AuthoringValidationErrors}, " +
                $"missing Tag {_report.MissingTagReferences}, out of scope {_report.OutOfScopeTagReferences}, missing Attribute {_report.MissingAttributeReferences}, " +
                $"code literal {_report.MissingCodeLiterals}");
            if (_report.Errors.Count == 0) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("All project references are valid.", MessageType.Info);
            foreach (GameplayReferenceDiagnostic warning in _report.Warnings)
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(warning.ToString(), MessageType.Warning);
            foreach (GameplayReferenceDiagnostic error in _report.Errors)
                if (GUILayout.Button(error.ToString(), EditorStyles.linkLabel))
                {
                    string path = error.Location;
                    int cs = path.IndexOf(".cs:", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    if (cs >= 0)
                    { int.TryParse(path.Substring(cs + 4), out int line); Ping(path.Substring(0, cs + 3), line); }
                    else
                    { int asset = path.IndexOf(".asset", StringComparison.Ordinal); if (asset >= 0) Ping(path.Substring(0, asset + 6)); }
                }
        }

        private int CountSerialized(GameplayReferenceKind kind, string value) =>
            _references.Count(x => x.Kind == kind && StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(x.Value, value));
        private int CountCode(GameplayReferenceKind kind, string value) =>
            _literals.Count(x => x.Kind == kind && StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(x.Value, value));

        private void AddTag(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog,string value)
        {
            try
            {
                var next = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.WithRegistrations(catalog,new[]{value});
                if(next.SequenceEqual(catalog.Tags,StringComparer.Ordinal))return;
                Undo.RecordObject(catalog,"登记 Gameplay Tag");
                catalog.Tags=next;
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(catalog);AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(catalog);
                _selectedTag=value;_renameTarget=value;OnProjectChanged();
            }
            catch(InvalidOperationException error){EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("登记 Gameplay Tag",error.Message,"关闭");}
        }
        private void Promote(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset owner,string tag)
        {
            var shared=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Shared,out string error);
            if(shared==null||GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Catalogs.Count(catalog=>catalog.Tags.Contains(tag,StringComparer.Ordinal))!=1)
            {EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("提升到 Shared",error??"Tag 归属存在冲突。","关闭");return;}
            Undo.RecordObjects(new UnityEngine.Object[]{owner,shared},"提升 Gameplay Tag 到 Shared");
            owner.Tags=owner.Tags.Where(value=>value!=tag).ToArray();
            shared.Tags=shared.Tags.Append(tag).ToArray();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(owner);EditorUtility.SetDirty(shared);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(owner);AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(shared);OnProjectChanged();
        }
        private void AddAttribute(string value)
        {
            if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute, value))
            { EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("Invalid Attribute", "Enter a valid attribute identity.", "OK"); return; }
            if ((_catalog.Attributes ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Contains(value, StringComparer.Ordinal)) return;
            Undo.RecordObject(_catalog, "Add Gameplay Attribute entry");
            _catalog.Attributes = (_catalog.Attributes ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Concat(new[] { value }).ToArray();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(_catalog); AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); Refresh();
        }
        private void RemoveAttribute(string value)
        {
            var liveReferences = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets());
            var liveLiterals = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanProductionCode();
            if (liveReferences.Any(x => x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute && StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(x.Value, value)) ||
                liveLiterals.Any(x => x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute && StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(x.Value, value)))
            { EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("Referenced Attribute", "Remove serialized and C# references first. Attribute rename is not supported in 12B.", "OK"); return; }
            Undo.RecordObject(_catalog, "Remove Gameplay Attribute entry");
            _catalog.Attributes = _catalog.Attributes.Where(x => !StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(x, value)).ToArray();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(_catalog); AssetDatabase.SaveAssets(); Refresh();
        }
        private static void Ping(string path, int line = 0)
        {
            var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(path);
            if (asset == null) return;
            EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(asset);
            if (line > 0) AssetDatabase.OpenAsset(asset, line);
            else Selection.activeObject = asset;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    internal sealed class GameplayReferencePickerPopup : PopupWindowContent
    {
        private readonly GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset _catalog;
        private readonly string _scope;
        private readonly GameplayReferenceKind _kind;
        private readonly Action<string> _choose;
        private readonly Dictionary<string, bool> _expanded = new Dictionary<string, bool>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private string _search = string.Empty;
        private Vector2 _scroll;

        internal GameplayReferencePickerPopup(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog, GameplayReferenceKind kind, string scope, Action<string> choose)
        { _catalog = catalog; _kind = kind; _scope = scope; _choose = choose; }
        public override Vector2 GetWindowSize() => new Vector2(390f, 370f);
        public override void OnGUI(Rect rect)
        {
            GUILayout.Label(_kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag ? "标签 · "+(_scope ?? "共享范围") : "已注册属性", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _search = EditorGUILayout.TextField("搜索", _search);
            _scroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            if (_kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag)
            {
                var tags = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Visible(_scope).SelectMany(catalog=>catalog.Tags).Distinct(StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_search))
                    foreach (var child in GameplayReferenceTree.Project(tags).Children.Values) DrawNode(child, 0);
                else foreach (string tag in tags.Where(x => x != null && x.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                             .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal)) DrawChoice(tag, tag, 0);
            }
            else foreach (string attribute in (_catalog.Attributes ?? Array.Empty<string>())
                         .Where(x => x != null && x.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0)
                         .OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal)) DrawChoice(attribute, attribute, 0);
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
            if (_kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag && GUILayout.Button("打开 Reference 管理"))
            { GameplayReferenceEditorWindow.OpenForScope(_scope); editorWindow.Close(); }
        }
        private void DrawNode(GameplayReferenceTreeNode node, int depth)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            GUILayout.Space(depth * 13f);
            if (node.Children.Count > 0)
            {
                bool expanded = !_expanded.TryGetValue(node.FullPath, out bool value) || value;
                bool next = GUILayout.Toggle(expanded, expanded ? "▾" : "▸", EditorStyles.label, GUILayout.Width(14f));
                _expanded[node.FullPath] = next;
            }
            else GUILayout.Space(14f);
            if (node.IsDefined)
            {
                if (GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent(node.Segment, node.FullPath), EditorStyles.linkLabel)) Choose(node.FullPath);
            }
            else GUILayout.Label(new GUIContent(node.Segment + "（分组）", node.FullPath), EditorStyles.label);
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            if (node.Children.Count > 0 && _expanded[node.FullPath])
                foreach (var child in node.Children.Values) DrawNode(child, depth + 1);
        }
        private void DrawChoice(string label, string value, int depth)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal(); GUILayout.Space(depth * 13f);
            if (GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent(label, value), EditorStyles.linkLabel)) Choose(value);
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }
        private void Choose(string value) { _choose(value); editorWindow.Close(); }
    }

    internal static class GameplayReferenceDrawerGUI
    {
        internal static void Draw(Rect position, SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label,
            GameplayReferenceKind kind, string childName)
        {
            SerializedProperty child = property.FindPropertyRelative(childName);
            if (child == null) { EditorGUI.LabelField(position, label.text, "缺少引用字段"); return; }
            EditorGUI.BeginProperty(position, label, property);
            Rect content = EditorGUI.PrefixLabel(position, label);
            float height = EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight;
            var raw = new Rect(content.x, content.y, Mathf.Max(50f, content.width - 83f), height);
            var pick = new Rect(raw.xMax + 3f, content.y, 48f, height);
            var clear = new Rect(pick.xMax + 3f, content.y, 29f, height);
            var catalog = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(out string discoveryError);
            var targets = property.serializedObject.targetObjects;
            var scopes = kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag ? targets.Select(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope).Distinct().ToArray() : Array.Empty<string>();
            string scope = scopes.Length == 1 ? scopes[0] : null;
            bool TagAvailable(string tag) => scopes.All(source => GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Visible(source).Any(owner => owner.Tags.Contains(tag,StringComparer.Ordinal)));
            string value = child.stringValue;
            bool known = catalog != null && (kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag
                ? TagAvailable(value)
                : (catalog.Attributes ?? Array.Empty<string>()).Contains(value, StringComparer.Ordinal));
            bool invalid = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value) && (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(kind, value) || !known);
            Color old = GUI.color;
            if (invalid && !child.hasMultipleDifferentValues) GUI.color = new Color(1f, .65f, .55f);
            EditorGUI.showMixedValue = child.hasMultipleDifferentValues;
            EditorGUI.PropertyField(raw, child, GUIContent.none);
            EditorGUI.showMixedValue = false;
            GUI.color = old;
            if (catalog == null) GUI.Label(pick, new GUIContent("!", discoveryError));
            else if (GUI.Button(pick, new GUIContent("选择", invalid ? "当前 Scope 不可用或未登记。可在 Reference 检查归属。" : value)))
            {
                string path=child.propertyPath;
                property.serializedObject.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                var handles=targets.Select(target=>GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(target,path)).ToArray();
                PopupWindow.Show(pick, new GameplayReferencePickerPopup(catalog, kind, scope,
                    selected => {try{
                        if(kind==GameplayReferenceKind.Tag&&handles.Any(handle=>!GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Visible(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(handle.Owner))
                            .Any(owner=>owner.Tags.Contains(selected,StringComparer.Ordinal))))throw new InvalidOperationException("此 Tag 已不在当前 Scope 中。");
                        ApplyChoice(handles,selected);
                    }catch(InvalidOperationException e){EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("引用位置已变化",e.Message,"关闭");}}));
            }
            if (GUI.Button(clear, new GUIContent("×", "清空此引用"))) child.stringValue = string.Empty;
            EditorGUI.EndProperty();
        }

        internal static void ApplyChoice(GameplaySourceHandle[] handles,string value)
        {
            // The popup may outlive a reorder in the other Inspector. Resolve every native
            // managed identity before recording Undo; never write its old array index.
            var paths=new string[handles.Length];
            for(int i=0;i<handles.Length;i++){
                if(!handles[i].TryResolve(out paths[i]))throw new InvalidOperationException("原配置已删除或替换，请重新打开选择器。");
                using(var source=new SerializedObject(handles[i].Owner))if(source.FindProperty(paths[i])?.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.String)throw new InvalidOperationException("原引用字段已改变，请重新选择。");
            }
            GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands.Transaction("选择正式 Gameplay 引用",handles.Select(h=>h.Owner).ToArray(),()=>{
                for(int i=0;i<handles.Length;i++)using(var source=new SerializedObject(handles[i].Owner)){
                    source.FindProperty(paths[i]).stringValue=value;source.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
                }
            });
        }
    }

    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayTagReference))]
    public sealed class GameplayTagReferenceDrawer : PropertyDrawer
    {
        private const int VisibleChoices = 6;
        private GameplaySkillDocumentAsset _openDocument;
        private string _openPath, _search = "";

        private static bool IsContextKey(SerializedProperty property, out bool producer)
        {
            var owner = GameplaySkillContextVariables.FieldOwner(property);
            producer = GameplaySkillContextVariables.IsProducer(owner);
            return producer || GameplaySkillContextVariables.IsReader(owner);
        }

        private bool IsOpen(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string path) => _openDocument == document && _openPath == path;

        private (string Key, string Label)[] Filter((string Key, string Label)[] choices) => choices.Where(choice =>
            choice.Key.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0 ||
            choice.Label.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0).Take(VisibleChoices).ToArray();

        public override float GetPropertyHeight(SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label)
        {
            if (!IsContextKey(property, out bool producer)) return base.GetPropertyHeight(property, label);
            int rows = 2;
            var document = (GameplaySkillDocumentAsset)property.serializedObject.targetObject;
            string path = property.propertyPath;
            if (!producer && IsOpen(document, path))
                rows += 1 + Math.Max(1, Filter(GameplaySkillContextVariables.For(document).Choices(path)).Length);
            return rows * EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight + (rows - 1) * EditorGUIUtility.standardVerticalSpacing;
        }

        public override void OnGUI(Rect position, SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label)
        {
            if (!IsContextKey(property, out bool producer))
            {
                GameplayReferenceDrawerGUI.Draw(position, property, label, GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, "Name");
                return;
            }
            var document = (GameplaySkillDocumentAsset)property.serializedObject.targetObject;
            var child = property.FindPropertyRelative("Name");
            string path = property.propertyPath;
            var variables = GameplaySkillContextVariables.For(document);
            string warning = producer
                ? (GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, child.stringValue) ? null : "请输入有效的 Context 键。")
                : variables.Warning(path, child.stringValue);
            float height = EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight;
            float step = height + EditorGUIUtility.standardVerticalSpacing;
            var row = new Rect(position.x, position.y, position.width, height);
            label = new GUIContent(producer ? "定义局部变量" : "Context 变量", "局部变量无需登记全局 Tag。");
            EditorGUI.BeginProperty(position, label, property);
            var input = EditorGUI.PrefixLabel(row, label);
            if (!producer) input.width -= 49f;
            child.stringValue = EditorGUI.DelayedTextField(input, child.stringValue);
            var choices = producer ? Array.Empty<(string Key, string Label)>() : variables.Choices(path);
            bool open = IsOpen(document, path);
            if (!producer)
            {
                var button = new Rect(input.xMax + 3f, input.y, 46f, height);
                bool changed = GUI.changed;
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(choices.Length == 0 && !open))
                    if (GUI.Button(button, new GUIContent(open ? "收起" : "选择", "搜索当前路径可读取的技能变量")))
                    {
                        _openDocument = open ? null : document;
                        _openPath = open ? null : path;
                        _search = "";
                    }
                GUI.changed = changed;
            }
            string caption = warning ?? (producer ? "技能局部定义 · 仅沿实际执行链传递" :
                choices.FirstOrDefault(choice => choice.Key == child.stringValue).Label);
            row.y += step;
            EditorGUI.LabelField(row,
                new GUIContent(caption, caption), warning == null ? EditorStyles.miniLabel : EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            if (open && !producer)
            {
                row.y += step;
                var visible = Filter(choices);
                bool changed = GUI.changed;
                _search = EditorGUI.TextField(row, new GUIContent("搜索变量", "输入名称或完整键过滤当前路径的变量"), _search);
                GUI.changed = changed;
                if (visible.Length == 0)
                {
                    row.y += step;
                    EditorGUI.LabelField(row, "没有匹配的可读变量", EditorStyles.miniLabel);
                }
                foreach (var choice in visible)
                {
                    row.y += step;
                    if (!GUI.Button(row, new GUIContent(choice.Label, choice.Key), EditorStyles.miniButton)) continue;
                    child.stringValue = choice.Key;
                    _openDocument = null;
                    _openPath = null;
                }
            }
            EditorGUI.EndProperty();
        }
    }

    {
        public override void OnGUI(Rect position, SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label) =>
            GameplayReferenceDrawerGUI.Draw(position, property, label, GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute, "Value");
    }
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Reference/GameplayReferenceScanner.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    public enum GameplayReferenceKind { Tag, Attribute }

    /// <summary>One typed serialized reference, identified by asset and SerializedProperty path.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplaySerializedReference
    {
        public readonly string AssetPath;
        public readonly string PropertyPath;
        public readonly string Value;
        public readonly GameplayReferenceKind Kind;
        public readonly GameplayDefinitionAsset Source;
        public GameplaySerializedReference(string assetPath, string propertyPath, string value, GameplayReferenceKind kind)
            : this(null,assetPath,propertyPath,value,kind) { }
        internal GameplaySerializedReference(GameplayDefinitionAsset source, string assetPath, string propertyPath, string value, GameplayReferenceKind kind)
        { Source = source; AssetPath = assetPath; PropertyPath = propertyPath; Value = value; Kind = kind; }
    }

    public readonly struct GameplayCodeLiteralReference
    {
        public readonly string SourcePath;
        public readonly int Line;
        public readonly string Value;
        public readonly GameplayReferenceKind Kind;
        public GameplayCodeLiteralReference(string sourcePath, int line, string value, GameplayReferenceKind kind)
        { SourcePath = sourcePath; Line = line; Value = value; Kind = kind; }
    }

    /// <summary>A definition asset reference, including those inside external SerializeReference authoring nodes.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayDefinitionAssetReference
    {
        public readonly GameplayDefinitionAsset Source;
        public readonly GameplayDefinitionAsset Target;
        public readonly string PropertyPath;
        public GameplayDefinitionAssetReference(GameplayDefinitionAsset source, GameplayDefinitionAsset target, string path)
        { Source = source; Target = target; PropertyPath = path; }
    }

    /// <summary>Read-only typed serialized traversal and read-only production constructor literal scan.</summary>
    public static class GameplayReferenceScanner
    {
        private static readonly Regex LiteralPattern = new Regex(
            @"\bnew\s+(?:(?:global::)?FRFrame\.Gameplay\.)?Gameplay(Tag|AttributeId)\s*\(\s*""([^""\r\n]*)""\s*\)", RegexOptions.Compiled);

        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplayDefinitionAsset> FindDefinitionAssets()
        {
            var assets = new List<GameplayDefinitionAsset>();
            var guids = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (Type type in TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<GameplayDefinitionAsset>())
            {
                if (type.IsAbstract) continue;
                foreach (string guid in AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:" + type.Name, new[] { "Assets" }))
                    guids.Add(guid);
            }
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                assets.AddRange(AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(path).OfType<GameplayDefinitionAsset>().Where(a=>!a.MigrationHistoryOnly));
            }
            assets.Sort((a, b) => StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(a), AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(b)));
            return assets;
        }

        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplaySerializedReference> ScanAssets(IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> assets)
        {
            var result = new List<GameplaySerializedReference>();
            var roots = assets.ToArray();
            var reachable = new HashSet<GameplayDefinitionAsset>(roots.Where(x => x != null));
            foreach (var reference in ScanDefinitionReferences(roots)) reachable.Add(reference.Target);
            foreach (GameplayDefinitionAsset asset in reachable.OrderBy(x => AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(x), StringComparer.Ordinal))
            {
                if (asset == null) continue;
                string assetPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset);
                var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
                SerializedProperty property = serialized.GetIterator();
                bool enterChildren = true;
                while (property.NextVisible(enterChildren))
                {
                    enterChildren = true;
                    GameplayReferenceKind kind;
                    string field;
                    if (property.type == nameof(GameplayTagReference))
                    {
                        var owner = GameplaySkillContextVariables.FieldOwner(property);
                        if (GameplaySkillContextVariables.IsProducer(owner) || GameplaySkillContextVariables.IsReader(owner)) continue;
                        kind = GameplayReferenceKind.Tag;
                        field = "Name";
                    }
                    else if (property.type == nameof(GameplayAttributeReference))
                    { kind = GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute; field = "Value"; }
                    else continue;
                    SerializedProperty child = property.FindPropertyRelative(field);
                    if (child != null && child.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.String)
                        result.Add(new GameplaySerializedReference(asset, assetPath, child.propertyPath, child.stringValue, kind));
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>Read-only, cycle-safe traversal of referenced definition assets; does not build or save content.</summary>
        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplayDefinitionAssetReference> ScanDefinitionReferences(IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> assets)
        {
            var result = new List<GameplayDefinitionAssetReference>();
            var seen = new HashSet<GameplayDefinitionAsset>();
            var pending = new Queue<GameplayDefinitionAsset>(assets);
            while (pending.Count > 0)
            {
                var asset = pending.Dequeue();
                if (asset == null || !seen.Add(asset)) continue;
                var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
                var property = serialized.GetIterator();
                while (property.NextVisible(true))
                {
                    if (property.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference ||
                        !(property.objectReferenceValue is GameplayDefinitionAsset target)) continue;
                    result.Add(new GameplayDefinitionAssetReference(asset, target, property.propertyPath));
                    pending.Enqueue(target);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> ScanProductionCode()
        {
            var result = new List<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>();
            foreach (string file in ProductionSourceFiles())
            {
                string path = file.Replace('\\', '/');
                string source = File.ReadAllText(file);
                foreach (Match match in LiteralPattern.Matches(source))
                {
                    int line = 1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < match.Index; i++) if (source[i] == '\n') line++;
                    result.Add(new GameplayCodeLiteralReference(path, line, match.Groups[2].Value,
                        match.Groups[1].Value == "Tag" ? GameplayReferenceKind.Tag : GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute));
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        public static int CountProductionSourceFiles() => ProductionSourceFiles().Count();

        private static IEnumerable<string> ProductionSourceFiles()
        {
            foreach (string root in new[] { "Assets/FRFrame/Gameplay", "Assets/Scripts" })
            {
                if (!Directory.Exists(root)) continue;
                foreach (string file in Directory.GetFiles(root, "*.cs", SearchOption.AllDirectories).OrderBy(x => x, StringComparer.Ordinal))
                {
                    string path = file.Replace('\\', '/');
                    if (!path.Contains("/Tests/") && !path.Contains("/Generated/")) yield return file;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Ephemeral display projection; only full paths in the catalog are identities.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayReferenceTreeNode
    {
        public string Segment { get; }
        public string FullPath { get; }
        public bool IsDefined { get; internal set; }
        public SortedDictionary<string, GameplayReferenceTreeNode> Children { get; } =
            new SortedDictionary<string, GameplayReferenceTreeNode>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        internal GameplayReferenceTreeNode(string segment, string fullPath) { Segment = segment; FullPath = fullPath; }
    }

    public static class GameplayReferenceTree
    {
        public static GameplayReferenceTreeNode Project(IEnumerable<string> canonicalTags)
        {
            if (canonicalTags == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(canonicalTags));
            var root = new GameplayReferenceTreeNode("", "");
            foreach (string tag in canonicalTags)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(tag)) continue;
                GameplayReferenceTreeNode node = root;
                foreach (string segment in tag.Split('.'))
                {
                    string path = node.FullPath.Length == 0 ? segment : node.FullPath + "." + segment;
                    if (!node.Children.TryGetValue(segment, out GameplayReferenceTreeNode child))
                    {
                        child = new GameplayReferenceTreeNode(segment, path);
                        node.Children.Add(segment, child);
                    }
                    node = child;
                }
                node.IsDefined = true;
            }
            return root;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Native field transactions for shared definitions and reference pickers.
    /// Formal behavior mutations belong to GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.</summary>
    internal static class GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands
    {
        internal static string ActionArray(string path)
        {
            int at=(path??"").LastIndexOf(".Array.data[",StringComparison.Ordinal);
            return at<0?null:path.Substring(0,at);
        }
        internal static void Transaction(string label,Object[] sources,Action edit)
        {
            sources=sources.Where(s=>s).Distinct().ToArray();
            var before=sources.ToDictionary(s=>s,EditorJsonUtility.ToJson);
            Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();int group=Undo.GetCurrentGroup();
            Undo.SetCurrentGroupName(label);Undo.RecordObjects(sources,label);
            try {
                edit();
                foreach(var source in sources)if(before[source]!=EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(source)){
                    EditorUtility.SetDirty(source);GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(source);
                }
                Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(group);
            } catch {Undo.RevertAllDownToGroup(group);throw;}
        }
        /// <summary>Unlinks one native array entry. Referenced shared assets are never deleted.</summary>
        internal static void Remove(Object source,string path)
        {
            string arrayPath=ActionArray(path);
            if(arrayPath==null||!path.EndsWith("]",StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("请选择一个有效的数组条目。");
            int index=int.Parse(path.Substring(arrayPath.Length+12).TrimEnd(']'));
            Transaction("删除共享配置条目",new[]{source},()=>{
                using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(source)){
                    var array=serialized.FindProperty(arrayPath);
                    if(array==null||index<0||index>=array.arraySize)throw new InvalidOperationException("原条目已改变。");
                    int size=array.arraySize;array.DeleteArrayElementAtIndex(index);
                    if(array.arraySize==size)array.DeleteArrayElementAtIndex(index);
                    serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
                }
            });
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Editor identity of a real SO or an embedded serialized location. Array indexes are
    /// lookup hints only: an embedded object is anchored to its owner's managedReferenceId.
    /// Deleted/replaced objects fail resolution instead of falling back to an occupied old index.</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplaySourceHandle
    {
        [SerializeField] private Object _owner;
        [SerializeField] private string _guid, _originalPath, _anchorPath, _suffix;
        [SerializeField] private string _guardArray, _guardSignature;
        [SerializeField] private string _managedType;
        [SerializeField] private long _fileId, _managedId = -1;
        [SerializeField] private bool _valid, _guardNullSlot;

        public Object Owner
        {
            get
            {
                if (!_owner && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_guid))
                {
                    string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(_guid);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))
                        _owner = AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(path).FirstOrDefault(o =>
                            AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(o, out string _, out long id) && id == _fileId);
                }
                return _owner;
            }
        }
        public long ManagedReferenceId => _managedId;
        public string OriginalPath => _originalPath;
        public string AssetKey => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_guid) ? _guid + "@" + _fileId + ":" : "scratch@" + (_owner ? _owner.GetInstanceID() : 0) + ":";
        public string Key => AssetKey + (_managedId >= 0 ? "mr@" + _managedId + _suffix : "field@" + _originalPath);

        public static GameplaySourceHandle Capture(Object owner, string path = "")
        {
            var handle = new GameplaySourceHandle { _owner = owner, _originalPath = path ?? "", _suffix = "" };
            if (!owner) return handle;
            if(!EditorUtility.IsPersistent(owner)||!AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(owner,out handle._guid,out handle._fileId))
            {handle._guid=null;handle._fileId=0;}
            if (handle._originalPath.Length == 0) { handle._valid = true; return handle; }
            using (var so = new SerializedObject(owner))
            {
                if (Find(so,handle._originalPath) == null) return handle;
                handle._valid = true;
                string candidate = handle._originalPath;
                while (candidate.Length > 0)
                {
                    var property = Find(so,candidate);
                    if (property?.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference && property.managedReferenceId >= 0)
                    {
                        handle._managedId = property.managedReferenceId;
                        handle._managedType = property.managedReferenceFullTypename;
                        handle._anchorPath = candidate;
                        handle._suffix = handle._originalPath.Substring(candidate.Length);
                        break;
                    }
                    int dot = candidate.LastIndexOf('.');
                    candidate = dot >= 0 ? candidate.Substring(0, dot) : "";
                }
                var original=Find(so,handle._originalPath);
                if(original.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&original.managedReferenceId<0){
                    int at=handle._originalPath.LastIndexOf(".Array.data[",StringComparison.Ordinal);
                    if(at>=0&&handle._originalPath.EndsWith("]",StringComparison.Ordinal)){
                        string arrayPath=handle._originalPath.Substring(0,at);
                        handle._guardArray=handle._managedId>=0?arrayPath.Substring(handle._anchorPath.Length):arrayPath;
                        handle._guardSignature=ArraySignature(Find(so,arrayPath));
                        handle._guardNullSlot=true;
                    }
                }
            }
            return handle;
        }
        public bool TryResolve(out string path)
        {
            path = null;
            var owner = Owner;
            if (!owner || !_valid) return false;
            if (_originalPath.Length == 0) { path = ""; return true; }
            using (var so = new SerializedObject(owner))
            {
                if (_managedId >= 0)
                {
                    var anchor = Find(so,_anchorPath);
                    if (anchor?.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference || anchor.managedReferenceId != _managedId)
                        anchor = GameplayAuthoringProperties.Walk(so).FirstOrDefault(p =>
                            p.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference && p.managedReferenceId == _managedId);
                    if (anchor == null) return false;
                    if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_managedType)&&anchor.managedReferenceFullTypename!=_managedType)return false;
                    _anchorPath = anchor.propertyPath;
                    path = _anchorPath + _suffix;
                }
                else path = _originalPath;
                if(_guardNullSlot){
                    string guardPath=_managedId>=0?_anchorPath+_guardArray:_guardArray;
                    if(ArraySignature(Find(so,guardPath))!=_guardSignature)return false;
                }
                return Find(so,path) != null;
            }
        }
        // Unity's FindProperty can emit a native Error for a once-valid out-of-bounds path.
        // Bounds-check each array before resolving the cached lookup hint.
        private static SerializedProperty Find(SerializedObject so,string path){
            if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return null;
            var parts=path.Split('.');var property=so.FindProperty(parts[0]);
            for(int i=1;i<parts.Length&&property!=null;i++){
                if(parts[i]=="Array"&&i+1<parts.Length&&parts[i+1].StartsWith("data[",StringComparison.Ordinal)){
                    string token=parts[++i];
                    if(!property.isArray||!int.TryParse(token.Substring(5,token.Length-6),out int index)||index<0||index>=property.arraySize)return null;
                    property=property.GetArrayElementAtIndex(index);
                }else property=property.FindPropertyRelative(parts[i]);
            }
            return property;
        }
        private static string ArraySignature(SerializedProperty array)=>array==null||!array.isArray?null:
            string.Join(",",Enumerable.Range(0,array.arraySize).Select(i=>array.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i).managedReferenceId.ToString()));
        public string ResolvePath()
        {
            if (TryResolve(out string path)) return path;
            throw new InvalidOperationException("原配置已删除或身份已改变，请重新选择；不会写入旧数组位置。");
        }
        /// <summary>Read-only compatibility key for pre-U6 layouts; never written to a formal source.</summary>
        public string LegacyKey
        {
            get
            {
                var owner = Owner;
                string guid = _guid;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(guid)) guid = "scratch@" + (owner ? owner.GetInstanceID() : 0);
                if (owner && !AssetDatabase.IsMainAsset(owner)) guid += "@" + (_fileId != 0 ? _fileId : owner.GetInstanceID());
                return guid + ":" + _originalPath;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>First-party business groups over the actual serialized source; no parameter mirror.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayStandardBusinessInspector : IGameplayBusinessInspectorProvider
    {
        public string AuthoringScope=>"Common";
        private static object Value(GameplayAuthoringLocation node)
        {
            if(node.Path.Length==0)return node.Source;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(node.Source)){
                var property=so.FindProperty(node.Path);
                return property?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference?property.managedReferenceValue:null;
            }
        }
        public bool Supports(GameplayAuthoringLocation node)
        {
            var value=Value(node);
            if((value is GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)||value is GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset||value is GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset||(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData)||
                value is GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring||value is GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring||value is GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring||value is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring||
                value is GameplayFloatValueAuthoring||value is GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring||value is GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring||value is GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring||
                value?.GetType().Name=="GameplayPresentationCueAsset"||value?.GetType().Name=="GameplayFloatingTextAsset"||value?.GetType().Name=="GameplayPresentationCueData"||value?.GetType().Name=="GameplayFloatingTextData")return true;
            return value is GameplayDispelEffectsActionAuthoring || value is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring ||
                value is GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring || value is GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring || value is GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring ||
                value is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring || value is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring || value is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring ||
                value is GameplaySkillDocumentAsset || (value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData) || (value is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayAreaDefinitionData) || (value is GameplaySummonDefinitionAsset || value is GameplaySummonDefinitionData) || value is GameplaySpawnSummonActionAuthoring ||
                value is GameplaySpawnProjectileActionAuthoring || value is GameplaySpawnAreaActionAuthoring || value is GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring || value is GameplayRotateToPointActionAuthoring || value is GameplayChangeStateActionAuthoring || value is GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring || value is GameplayCaptureCombatRollActionAuthoring || value is GameplayCaptureValueActionAuthoring || value is GameplayCooldownActionAuthoring || value is GameplayActorProfileAsset;
        }
        public IEnumerable<GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup> Groups(GameplayAuthoringLocation node)
        {
            string prefix=node.Path.Length==0?"":node.Path+".";
            foreach(var group in Describe(Value(node)))yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(node.Source,group.Title,group.Note,group.Paths.Select(p=>prefix+p).ToArray()){Advanced=group.Advanced};
        }
        /// <summary>Shared business sections for both persisted V1 library resources and embedded
        /// V2 values. Metadata contains relative field names only, with no graph or SO proxy.</summary>
        public static IEnumerable<GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup> Describe(object value)
        {
            if((value is GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)){
                yield return Group("释放门禁 / 生命周期标签","标签来自正式能力定义；Formation/舰种等游戏规则不进入通用能力。","AbilityTags","RequiredTags","BlockedTags","ActivationOwnedTags","CancelAbilitiesWithTags","BlockAbilitiesWithTags","OngoingBlockedTags");
                yield return Group("费用 / 冷却 / 充能","资源变化负数为扣除；先检查释放前最低余额。普通冷却与充能互斥。","Cost","CooldownEffect","Charge");
                yield return Group("激活效果","持续效果归本次授权所有。","ActivationEffects","MaxLevel");
            }
            else if(value is GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset || value is FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.GameplayRuleNodePayload){
                yield return Group("触发 / 生命周期","被动事件与主动施放复用正式规则；不是第二份Graph执行状态。","Trigger","Once","PreserveTriggerContext");
                yield return Group("条件 / 明确目标","保留Context可能只有地点；需要逐目标效果时先显式选取或搜索Actor。","Conditions","Target");
                yield return Group("动作顺序","按正式数组顺序执行；右键时间事件可调整同帧顺序。","Actions");
            }
            else if(value is GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset){
                yield return Group("正式编排时长","以秒保存，帧只是编辑器刻度。End与总时长独立，不随动画自动改动。","Duration");
                // The Timeline already selects each real marker/action. Recursively drawing
                // the complete expanded array on every card drag repaints offscreen fields.
                var markers=Group("完整事件数组 / 高级编辑","通常从轨道选择单个事件或动作；展开后编辑同一份正式数组。","Markers");
                markers.Advanced=true;yield return markers;
            }
            else if(value is GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring){
                yield return Group("事件时刻 / 目标 / 条件","Time以秒保存；更改数组顺序不会替换事件身份。","Time","Target","Conditions");
                yield return Group("业务动作 / 表现","所有动作消费正式Source；Cue只有配置真实Duration才显示持续区间。","Actions","Effect","CueTag","HasMagnitude","Magnitude","HasDuration","Duration");
            }
            else if((value is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData)){
                yield return Group("持续 / 周期（秒）","Period=0不执行周期；动态数值沿用正式求值器，非启用字段保留旧值。","DurationPolicy","Duration","DurationValue","Period","PeriodValue","PeriodicStart");
                yield return Group("标签 / 应用与持续门禁","EffectTags用于驱散分类，GrantedTags在存续期间贡献标签。","EffectTags","GrantedTags","ApplicationRequirements","OngoingRequirements");
                yield return Group("属性修改 / 结算","所有Execution均可配置，按正式数组顺序执行。","Modifiers","Executions");
                yield return Group("叠层 / 溢出 / 自然完成","Overflow与Completion是不同的typed数组；取消/驱散不运行自然完成。","Stacking","CompletionExecutions");
            }
            else if(value is GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring||value is GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring||value is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring||value is GameplayFloatValueAuthoring||value is GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring||value is GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring||value is GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring)
                yield return Group(value is GameplayFloatValueAuthoring?"数值来源 / 求值":value is GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring?"资源消耗 / 释放前检查":value is GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring?"条件判定":value is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring?"明确目标 / 地点":"事件 / 后续回调","直接编辑真实嵌入配置；类型替换会提示字段丢失，可Undo恢复。",Fields(value));
            else if(value?.GetType().Name=="GameplayPresentationCueAsset"||value?.GetType().Name=="GameplayFloatingTextAsset")
                yield return Group("表现资源 / 位置 / 反馈","由已安装表现后端消费；不推进Gameplay时间。",Fields(value));
            else if(value is GameplayDispelEffectsActionAuthoring)yield return Group("驱散效果分类","作用于明确选择的目标；匹配 EffectTags，移除原因是 Dispel，不触发自然到期动作。至少选择一个 All/Any 分类。","EffectTags");

                var dimensions=new List<string>();

                yield return Group("正式范围数值","可用常量、等级表、公式；形状切换保留原有配置。",dimensions.ToArray());

        }
        private static readonly Dictionary<System.Type,string[]> FieldCache=new Dictionary<System.Type,string[]>();
        private static string[] Fields(object value){var type=value.GetType();if(!FieldCache.TryGetValue(type,out var fields))FieldCache[type]=fields=type.GetFields(System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Public).Where(f=>!f.IsNotSerialized&&GameplayAuthoringInspector.HasBusinessLabel(f.Name)).Select(f=>f.Name).ToArray();return fields;}

        { return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,title,note,fields); }
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Localizes ordinary authoring children without introducing another managed selector.</summary>
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayEffectModifierAuthoring))]
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayAbilityChargeAuthoring))]
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring.Entry))]
    public class GameplayStructuredAuthoringDrawer : PropertyDrawer
    {
        public override float GetPropertyHeight(SerializedProperty property,GUIContent label)
        {
            float height=EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight;
            if(property.isExpanded) foreach(var child in Children(property)) height+=EditorGUI.GetPropertyHeight(child,true)+2;
            return height;
        }
        public override void OnGUI(Rect rect,SerializedProperty property,GUIContent label)
        {
            if(label.text.StartsWith("Element",System.StringComparison.Ordinal))label=GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(property);
            EditorGUI.BeginProperty(rect,label,property);
            property.isExpanded=EditorGUI.Foldout(new Rect(rect.x,rect.y,rect.width,EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight),property.isExpanded,label,true);
            if(property.isExpanded) {
                float y=rect.y+EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight+2;EditorGUI.indentLevel++;
                foreach(var child in Children(property)) {
                    float height=EditorGUI.GetPropertyHeight(child,true);
                    EditorGUI.PropertyField(new Rect(rect.x,y,rect.width,height),child,GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(child),true);y+=height+2;
                }
                EditorGUI.indentLevel--;
            }
            EditorGUI.EndProperty();
        }
        private static System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable<SerializedProperty> Children(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            var child=property.Copy();var end=child.GetEndProperty();
            if(!child.NextVisible(true)) yield break;
            do {if(SerializedProperty.EqualContents(child,end))yield break;yield return child.Copy();}while(child.NextVisible(false));
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Reference/GameplayTagRefactorService.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Immutable preview of one exact or dot-boundary subtree operation.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayTagRefactorPreview
    {
        public GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset Catalog { get; internal set; }
        public string OldPath { get; internal set; }
        public string NewPath { get; internal set; }
        public bool IsDelete { get; internal set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayDefinitionAsset> Assets { get; internal set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> CodeLiterals { get; internal set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySerializedReference> AffectedReferences { get; internal set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> AffectedCode { get; internal set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<string> AffectedCatalogTags { get; internal set; }
        internal IReadOnlyDictionary<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset,string[]> CatalogChanges { get; set; }
        public IReadOnlyList<string> Errors { get; internal set; }
        internal bool UseProjectAssets { get; set; }
        internal bool UseProductionCode { get; set; }
        public bool CanApply => Errors.Count == 0;
    }

    /// <summary>Typed SerializedProperty refactor with code-literal blockers and one Undo transaction.</summary>
    public static class GameplayTagRefactorService
    {
        public static GameplayTagRefactorPreview PreviewRename(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog,
            string oldPath, string newPath, IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> assets = null,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> codeLiterals = null) =>
            Preview(catalog, oldPath, newPath, false, assets, codeLiterals);

        public static GameplayTagRefactorPreview PreviewDelete(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog,
            string path, IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> assets = null,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> codeLiterals = null) =>
            Preview(catalog, path, null, true, assets, codeLiterals);

        public static GameplayTagRefactorPreview PreviewProjectRename(string oldPath, string newPath) =>
            Preview(null, oldPath, newPath, false, null, null);

        public static GameplayTagRefactorPreview PreviewProjectDelete(string path) =>
            Preview(null, path, null, true, null, null);

        private static GameplayTagRefactorPreview Preview(GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog,
            string oldPath, string newPath, bool delete, IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> selectedAssets,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> selectedLiterals)
        {
            var assets = (selectedAssets ?? GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets()).ToArray();
            var literals = selectedLiterals ?? GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanProductionCode();
            var catalogs = catalog != null ? new[] { catalog } : GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Catalogs;
            var changes = catalogs.ToDictionary(entry=>entry,entry=>entry.Tags.Where(tag=>Matches(tag,oldPath)).ToArray())
                .Where(pair=>pair.Value.Length>0).ToDictionary(pair=>pair.Key,pair=>pair.Value);
            var catalogTags = changes.Values.SelectMany(tags=>tags).ToArray();
            var references = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(assets)
                .Where(reference => reference.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag && Matches(reference.Value, oldPath)).ToArray();
            var code = literals.Where(literal => literal.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag && Matches(literal.Value, oldPath)).ToArray();
            var errors = new List<string>();
            if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, oldPath)) errors.Add("Old Tag path is invalid.");
            if (!delete && !GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, newPath)) errors.Add("New Tag path is invalid.");
            if (!delete && StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(oldPath, newPath)) errors.Add("New Tag path equals old path.");
            if (catalogTags.Length == 0) errors.Add("No exact or descendant catalog Tag exists.");
            if (code.Length > 0) errors.Add($"{code.Length} production C# literal(s) still use the old Tag; update code manually first.");
            if (delete && references.Length > 0) errors.Add($"{references.Length} serialized reference(s) still use the Tag.");
            if (!delete)
            {
                var final = catalogs.SelectMany(entry=>entry.Tags).Select(tag => Matches(tag, oldPath) ? Map(tag, oldPath, newPath) : tag);
                var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                foreach (string tag in final)
                {
                    if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, tag)) errors.Add("Invalid target Tag: " + tag);
                    if (tag != null && !seen.Add(tag)) errors.Add("Target collision: " + tag);
                }
            }
            return new GameplayTagRefactorPreview
            {
                Catalog = catalog, OldPath = oldPath, NewPath = newPath, IsDelete = delete,
                Assets = assets, CodeLiterals = literals, AffectedReferences = references,
                AffectedCode = code, AffectedCatalogTags = catalogTags, CatalogChanges = changes, Errors = errors,
                UseProjectAssets = selectedAssets == null,
                UseProductionCode = selectedLiterals == null
            };
        }

        public static void Apply(GameplayTagRefactorPreview preview)
        {
            if (preview == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(preview));
            if (!preview.CanApply) throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Join(" | ", preview.Errors));
            // Re-preview immediately: asset references or code may have changed since the UI displayed this preview.
            IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionAsset> freshAssets =
                preview.UseProjectAssets ? GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets() : preview.Assets;
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayCodeLiteralReference> freshLiterals =
                preview.UseProductionCode ? GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanProductionCode() : preview.CodeLiterals;
            var fresh = Preview(preview.Catalog, preview.OldPath, preview.NewPath, preview.IsDelete,
                freshAssets, freshLiterals);
            if (!fresh.CanApply) throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Join(" | ", fresh.Errors));
            if (preview.CatalogChanges.Count != fresh.CatalogChanges.Count ||
                preview.CatalogChanges.Any(pair=>!fresh.CatalogChanges.TryGetValue(pair.Key,out var tags)||!pair.Value.SequenceEqual(tags,StringComparer.Ordinal)) ||
                !preview.AffectedReferences.Select(x => (x.Source,x.PropertyPath,x.Value))
                    .SequenceEqual(fresh.AffectedReferences.Select(x => (x.Source,x.PropertyPath,x.Value))))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Catalog or serialized references changed since Preview; preview again.");
            int group = Undo.GetCurrentGroup();
            Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();
            group = Undo.GetCurrentGroup();
            Undo.SetCurrentGroupName(preview.IsDelete ? "Delete Gameplay Tag" : "Rename Gameplay Tag");
            try
            {
                if (!fresh.IsDelete)
                {
                    foreach (var byAsset in fresh.AffectedReferences.GroupBy(x => x.Source))
                    {
                        var asset = byAsset.Key;
                        Undo.RecordObject(asset, "Rename Gameplay Tag references");
                        using var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
                        serialized.Update();
                        foreach (GameplaySerializedReference reference in byAsset)
                        {
                            var property = serialized.FindProperty(reference.PropertyPath);
                            if (property == null || property.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.String ||
                                !StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(property.stringValue, reference.Value))
                                throw new InvalidOperationException("Reference changed: " + byAsset.Key + "." + reference.PropertyPath);
                            property.stringValue = Map(reference.Value, fresh.OldPath, fresh.NewPath);
                        }
                        serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                        EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
                    }
                }
                foreach(var entry in fresh.CatalogChanges.Keys)
                {
                    Undo.RecordObject(entry, "Update Gameplay Tag catalog");
                    entry.Tags = fresh.IsDelete
                        ? entry.Tags.Where(tag => !Matches(tag, fresh.OldPath)).ToArray()
                        : entry.Tags.Select(tag => Matches(tag, fresh.OldPath) ? Map(tag, fresh.OldPath, fresh.NewPath) : tag).ToArray();
                    EditorUtility.SetDirty(entry);
                }
                var post = GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan(fresh.Catalog, fresh.Assets,
                    preview.UseProductionCode ? fresh.CodeLiterals : preview.CodeLiterals);
                if (post.Errors.Count > 0)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Post-refactor diagnostics: " + string.Join(" | ", post.Errors.Take(5)));
                foreach(var entry in fresh.CatalogChanges.Keys)AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(entry);
                foreach(var asset in fresh.AffectedReferences.Select(reference=>reference.Source).Distinct())
                    AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(asset);
                Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(group);
            }
            catch
            {
                Undo.RevertAllDownToGroup(group);
                throw;
            }
        }

        public static bool Matches(string value, string prefix) => value != null && prefix != null &&
            (StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(value, prefix) || value.StartsWith(prefix + ".", StringComparison.Ordinal));

        private static string Map(string value, string oldPath, string newPath) =>
            newPath + value.Substring(oldPath.Length);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Debugging;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.RuntimeDebugger
{
    /// <summary>Pure selection and Freeze state for the Editor window; it owns no gameplay runtime object.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayRuntimeDebuggerModel
    {
        public GameplayRuntimeDebugSnapshot Snapshot { get; private set; }
        public GameplaySourceId SelectedUnitSourceId { get; private set; }
        public string SelectedUnitGroup {get;private set;}
        public bool Frozen { get; set; }

        public void SelectUnit(GameplaySourceId sourceId,string group=null){SelectedUnitSourceId=sourceId;SelectedUnitGroup=group;}

        public void Refresh(IGameplayRuntimeDebugSource source)
        {
            if (source == null)
            {
                Clear();
                return;
            }
            if (Frozen) return;
            Snapshot = source.CaptureSnapshot();
            if (Snapshot == null || Snapshot.Units.Count == 0)
            {
                SelectedUnitSourceId = default;SelectedUnitGroup=null;
                return;
            }
            foreach (GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot unit in Snapshot.Units)
                if (unit.SourceId == SelectedUnitSourceId&&(SelectedUnitGroup==null||unit.Group==SelectedUnitGroup)){SelectedUnitGroup=unit.Group;return;}
            SelectedUnitSourceId = Snapshot.Units[0].SourceId;SelectedUnitGroup=Snapshot.Units[0].Group;
        }

        public GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot SelectedUnit()
        {
            if (Snapshot == null) return null;
            foreach (GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot unit in Snapshot.Units)
                if (unit.SourceId == SelectedUnitSourceId&&(SelectedUnitGroup==null||unit.Group==SelectedUnitGroup)) return unit;
            return null;
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            Snapshot = null;
            SelectedUnitSourceId = default;
            SelectedUnitGroup=null;
            Frozen = false;
        }

        public static bool Matches(string text, string filter) =>
            string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter) ||
            (text?.IndexOf(filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ?? -1) >= 0;

        public static bool MatchesUnit(GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot unit, string filter)
        {
            if (Matches(unit.DisplayName, filter) || Matches(unit.Group, filter)) return true;
            foreach (GameplayDebugSection section in unit.Sections)
            {
                if (Matches(section.Name, filter)) return true;
                foreach (string line in section.Lines)
                    if (Matches(line, filter)) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
````
