using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Debugging;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.RuntimeDebugger
{
    /// <summary>Read-only scene provider viewer. Editor update only captures state; it never advances rules.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayRuntimeDebuggerWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private readonly GameplayRuntimeDebuggerModel _model = new GameplayRuntimeDebuggerModel();
        private readonly List<IGameplayRuntimeDebugSource> _sources = new List<IGameplayRuntimeDebugSource>();
        private int _sourceIndex;
        private bool _autoRefresh = true;
        private double _lastRefresh;
        private string _search = string.Empty;
        private string _sourceHighlight = string.Empty;
        private Vector2 _unitScroll;
        private Vector2 _detailScroll;

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Gameplay/Runtime Debugger")]
        public static void Open() => GetWindow<GameplayRuntimeDebuggerWindow>("Runtime Debugger");

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            EditorApplication.update += OnEditorUpdate;
            EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged += OnPlayModeChanged;
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            EditorApplication.update -= OnEditorUpdate;
            EditorApplication.playModeStateChanged -= OnPlayModeChanged;
            _sources.Clear();
            _model.Clear();
        }

        private void OnPlayModeChanged(PlayModeStateChange change)
        {
            if (change == PlayModeStateChange.ExitingPlayMode || change == PlayModeStateChange.EnteredEditMode)
            {
                _sources.Clear();
                _model.Clear();
                Repaint();
            }
        }

        private void OnEditorUpdate()
        {
            if (!EditorApplication.isPlaying) return;
            if (EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup - _lastRefresh < .125d) return;
            if (_autoRefresh) Refresh();
            else
            {
                _lastRefresh = EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;
                DiscoverSources();
                if (_sources.Count == 0) Repaint();
            }
        }

        private void DiscoverSources()
        {
            IGameplayRuntimeDebugSource selected = _sourceIndex < _sources.Count ? _sources[_sourceIndex] : null;
            _sources.Clear();
            foreach (MonoBehaviour behaviour in UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsByType<MonoBehaviour>(
                         FindObjectsInactive.Exclude, FindObjectsSortMode.None))
                if (behaviour != null && behaviour.isActiveAndEnabled &&
                    behaviour is IGameplayRuntimeDebugSource source)
                    _sources.Add(source);
            _sources.Sort((a, b) => string.CompareOrdinal(a.DisplayName, b.DisplayName));
            int retained = _sources.FindIndex(source => ReferenceEquals(source, selected));
            if (selected != null && retained < 0) _model.Clear();
            if (retained >= 0) _sourceIndex = retained;
            if (_sourceIndex >= _sources.Count) _sourceIndex = 0;
        }

        private void Refresh()
        {
            _lastRefresh = EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;
            DiscoverSources();
            _model.Refresh(_sources.Count == 0 ? null : _sources[_sourceIndex]);
            Repaint();
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            if (!EditorApplication.isPlaying)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Enter Play Mode to inspect a Gameplay source.", MessageType.Info);
                return;
            }
            if (_sources.Count == 0) DiscoverSources();
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope(EditorStyles.toolbar))
            {
                string[] names = new string[_sources.Count];
                for (int i = 0; i < names.Length; i++) names[i] = _sources[i].DisplayName;
                if (names.Length > 0)
                {
                    int next = EditorGUILayout.Popup(_sourceIndex, names, GUILayout.Width(220));
                    if (next != _sourceIndex) { _sourceIndex = next; Refresh(); }
                }
                else GUILayout.Label("No provider", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(220));
                if (GUILayout.Button("Refresh", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(60))) Refresh();
                _autoRefresh = GUILayout.Toggle(_autoRefresh, "Auto", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(50));
                _model.Frozen = GUILayout.Toggle(_model.Frozen, "Freeze", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(65));
                _search = GUILayout.TextField(_search, GUI.skin.FindStyle("ToolbarSeachTextField") ??
                    EditorStyles.toolbarTextField, GUILayout.MinWidth(100));
            }
            if (_model.Snapshot == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Waiting for a live scene provider.", MessageType.Info);
                return;
            }
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Tick " + _model.Snapshot.TickVersion +
                "   Paused " + _model.Snapshot.IsPaused +
                "   Units " + _model.Snapshot.Units.Count, EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                _sourceHighlight = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Highlight SourceId", _sourceHighlight);
                if (GUILayout.Button("Copy Snapshot", GUILayout.Width(110)))
                    EditorGUIUtility.systemCopyBuffer = BuildSnapshotText();
            }
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(GUILayout.Width(230)))
                {
                    _unitScroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_unitScroll);
                    foreach (GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot unit in _model.Snapshot.Units)
                    {
                        if (!GameplayRuntimeDebuggerModel.MatchesUnit(unit, _search)) continue;
                        bool selected = unit.SourceId == _model.SelectedUnitSourceId&&unit.Group==_model.SelectedUnitGroup;
                        if (GUILayout.Toggle(selected, unit.DisplayName, "Button")) _model.SelectUnit(unit.SourceId,unit.Group);
                    }
                    EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
                }
                _detailScroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_detailScroll);
                GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot current = _model.SelectedUnit();
                if (current != null)
                    foreach (GameplayDebugSection section in current.Sections)
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField(section.Name, EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                        foreach (string line in section.Lines)
                        {
                            if (!GameplayRuntimeDebuggerModel.Matches(line, _search)) continue;
                            Color old = GUI.contentColor;
                            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_sourceHighlight) &&
                                TryGetSourceId(line, out string visibleSource) &&
                                visibleSource == _sourceHighlight) GUI.contentColor = Color.yellow;
                            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                            {
                                EditorGUILayout.SelectableLabel(line, GUILayout.Height(EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight));
                                if(TryGetActionLocation(line,out string definitionId,out long nodeId)&&
                                    GUILayout.Button("定位动作",GUILayout.Width(75)))LocateAction(definitionId,nodeId,ReadDocumentId(line));
                                if (section.Name == "Effects" && TryGetSourceId(line, out string effectSource) &&
                                    GUILayout.Button("Focus source", GUILayout.Width(95)))
                                    _sourceHighlight = effectSource;
                            }
                            GUI.contentColor = old;
                        }
                        EditorGUILayout.Space(6);
                    }
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Events", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                foreach (GameplayEventHistoryEntry entry in _model.Snapshot.RecentEvents)
                {
                    string line = entry.Sequence + " " + entry.Data.EventTag +
                        " Instigator=" + entry.Data.InstigatorId + " Target=" + entry.Data.TargetId +
                        " Magnitude=" + entry.Data.Magnitude;
                    if (GameplayRuntimeDebuggerModel.Matches(line, _search))
                        EditorGUILayout.SelectableLabel(line, GUILayout.Height(EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight));
                }
                EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
            }
        }

        private string BuildSnapshotText()
        {
            var lines = new List<string>();
            foreach (GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot unit in _model.Snapshot.Units)
            {
                lines.Add(unit.DisplayName);
                foreach (GameplayDebugSection section in unit.Sections)
                {
                    lines.Add("[" + section.Name + "]");
                    lines.AddRange(section.Lines);
                }
            }
            foreach (GameplayEventHistoryEntry entry in _model.Snapshot.RecentEvents)
                lines.Add("Event " + entry.Sequence + " " + entry.Data.EventTag);
            return string.Join("\n", lines);
        }

        private static bool TryGetSourceId(string line, out string sourceId)
        {
            sourceId = null;
            int start = line.IndexOf("SourceId=", StringComparison.Ordinal);
            if (start < 0) return false;
            start += "SourceId=".Length;
            int end = start;
            if (end < line.Length && line[end] == '-') end++;
            while (end < line.Length && char.IsDigit(line[end])) end++;
            if (end == start || (end == start + 1 && line[start] == '-')) return false;
            sourceId = line.Substring(start, end - start);
            return true;
        }

        private static bool TryGetActionLocation(string line,out string definitionId,out long nodeId)
        {
            definitionId=null;nodeId=-1;
            var tokens=line.Split(' ');
            var asset=tokens.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.StartsWith("SourceAsset=",StringComparison.Ordinal));
            var node=tokens.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.StartsWith("NodeId=",StringComparison.Ordinal));
            if(asset==null||node==null||!long.TryParse(node.Substring(7),out nodeId))return false;
            definitionId=Uri.UnescapeDataString(asset.Substring(12));return nodeId>=0;
        }

        /// <summary>Resolves a saved native node only on explicit navigation. Duplicate identities,
        /// deleted nodes and unavailable workspace mappings never select an arbitrary result.</summary>
        private static string ReadDocumentId(string line)
        {
            var token=line.Split(' ').FirstOrDefault(t=>t.StartsWith("SourceDocument=",StringComparison.Ordinal));
            return token==null?null:Uri.UnescapeDataString(token.Substring(15));
        }
        public static bool LocateAction(string definitionId,long nodeId,string documentId=null)
        {

            var matches=SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillWorkbench.Documents().Where(d=>d.AuthoringSchemaVersion==2&&(string.IsNullOrEmpty(documentId)||d.DefinitionId==documentId))
                .SelectMany(d=>d.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Where(n=>n.Payload is FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.GameplayActionNodePayload&&
                    (string.IsNullOrEmpty(n.SourceDefinitionId)?d.DefinitionId:n.SourceDefinitionId)==definitionId&&
                    (n.SourceActionId>=0?n.SourceActionId:FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.GameplayGraphCompiler.StableActionId(n.Id))==nodeId).Select(n=>(document:d,node:n))).ToArray();
            if(matches.Length==1){SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillWorkbench.Open(matches[0].document,matches[0].node.Id);return true;}
            if(matches.Length>1){Debug.LogWarning("Trace 来源有多个调用位置，请在对应主技能中选择调用；未随意选择节点。");return false;}
            var assets=GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets().Where(a=>!a.MigrationHistoryOnly&&a.DefinitionId==definitionId).ToArray();
            if(assets.Length!=1){Debug.LogWarning("Trace 定位失败：来源已删除或定义标识重复。");return false;}
            var source=assets[0];string path=null;
            using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(source)){var property=serialized.GetIterator();while(property.Next(true))if(property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&property.managedReferenceId==nodeId){path=property.propertyPath;break;}}
            if(path==null){Debug.LogWarning("Trace 定位失败：原动作已删除或替换。");return false;}
            Selection.activeObject=source;EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(source);GameplayAuthoringInspector.RequestFieldFocus(source,path);
            return true;

        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public interface IGameplayAnimationSourceInspector
    {
        bool Supports(UnityEngine.Object source);
        void DrawCore(SerializedObject source);
        void DrawAdvanced(SerializedObject source);
        string Summary(UnityEngine.Object source);
        float ClipDuration(UnityEngine.Object source);
        string BindingWarning(UnityEngine.Object source,GameObject subject);
        string[] SourceFields(UnityEngine.Object source);
    }
    /// <summary>Optional compact asset/clip picker for the shared animation card.
    /// Backend playback options remain in the right Inspector, without duplicate core controls.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayCompactAnimationSourceInspector
    {
        void DrawCompact(SerializedObject source);
        void DrawPlayback(SerializedObject source);
    }
    public static class GameplayAnimationSourceInspectors
    {
        private static readonly IGameplayAnimationSourceInspector[] Providers=TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplayAnimationSourceInspector>()
            .Where(t=>!t.IsAbstract&&t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes)!=null).Select(t=>(IGameplayAnimationSourceInspector)Activator.CreateInstance(t)).ToArray();
        public static IGameplayAnimationSourceInspector For(UnityEngine.Object source)=>Providers.FirstOrDefault(p=>p.Supports(source));
        /// <summary>The native Inspector and Workbench use the identical SDK controls, common
        /// playback fields and advanced section; no parallel animation parameter surface.</summary>
        public static void DrawShared(SerializedObject source)
        {
            var provider=For(source.targetObject);if(provider==null)return;source.UpdateIfRequiredOrScript();
            GUILayout.Label("动画资源 / 已安装后端",EditorStyles.boldLabel);provider.DrawCore(source);
            GUILayout.Label("播放 / 生命周期",EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            string[] common={"Speed","Priority","Channel","Loop","RestorePrevious"};
            foreach(var name in common){
                if((name=="Speed"||name=="Loop")&&provider.SourceFields(source.targetObject).Contains(name))continue;
                var property=source.FindProperty(name);
                if(name=="Loop")GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(property,new GUIContent("循环播放"));
                else GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(property);
            }
            string key="FRFrame.Animation.Fields."+GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(source.targetObject).Key;
            bool advanced=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(SessionState.GetBool(key,false),"变体 / 混合 / 高级动画参数",true);SessionState.SetBool(key,advanced);
            if(advanced)provider.DrawAdvanced(source);
            var covered=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>(provider.SourceFields(source.targetObject).Concat(common));
            var extra=source.GetIterator();var remaining=new System.Collections.Generic.List<string>();
            if(extra.NextVisible(true))do{if(extra.name!="m_Script"&&!covered.Contains(extra.name))remaining.Add(extra.propertyPath);}while(extra.NextVisible(false));
            bool details=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(SessionState.GetBool(key+".source",false),"高级来源 / 扩展字段",true);SessionState.SetBool(key+".source",details);
            if(details)foreach(var path in remaining)GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(source.FindProperty(path));
            if(source.ApplyModifiedProperties())GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(source.targetObject);
        }
        public static UnityEngine.Object Resolve(UnityEngine.Object source,string path)
        {
            if(source==null)return null;
            if(For(source)!=null)return source;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){
                var property=so.FindProperty(path??"");
                var animation=property?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference?property.FindPropertyRelative("Animation"):null;
                return animation?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference?animation.objectReferenceValue:null;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object = UnityEngine.Object;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public enum GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind { Circle, Sector, Line }
    /// <summary>Transient editor projection of current rule fields; never serialized or executed.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayRangePreviewShape
    {
        public readonly GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind Kind;
        public readonly string Label;
        public readonly float Radius, Angle, Length, Width, OffsetAngle;
        public readonly GameplaySearchGeometry Geometry;
        public GameplayRangePreviewShape(GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind kind, string label, float radius = 0,
            float angle = 0, float length = 0, float width = 0, float offsetAngle = 0, GameplaySearchGeometry geometry = null)
        { Kind = kind; Label = label; Radius = radius; Angle = angle; Length = length; Width = width; OffsetAngle = offsetAngle; Geometry = geometry; }
    }
    /// <summary>Stable source identity. Providers receive a fresh serialized source on every read, including unsaved Undo changes.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayRangePreviewContext
    {
        public readonly Object Asset;
        public readonly string PropertyPath;
        public readonly int AbilityLevel;
        public readonly GameplayActorProfileAsset Profile;
        public GameplayRangePreviewContext(Object asset, string propertyPath, int abilityLevel = 1, GameplayActorProfileAsset profile = null)
        { Asset = asset; PropertyPath = propertyPath; AbilityLevel = abilityLevel; Profile = profile; }
    }
    public interface IGameplayRangePreviewProvider
    {
        bool Supports(GameplayRangePreviewContext context, SerializedProperty property);
        GameplayRangePreviewShape Read(GameplayRangePreviewContext context, SerializedProperty property);
    }
    public static class GameplayRangePreview
    {
        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplayRangePreviewContext> Sources(Object asset)
        {
            var result = new List<GameplayRangePreviewContext>();
            if (asset == null) return result;
            using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset))
            {
                var root = new GameplayRangePreviewContext(asset, null);
                if (GameplayAuthoringProviders.Ranges.Any(p => p.Supports(root, null))) result.Add(root);
                foreach (var property in GameplayAuthoringProperties.Walk(serialized))
                {
                    var context = new GameplayRangePreviewContext(asset, property.propertyPath);
                    if (GameplayAuthoringProviders.Ranges.Any(p => p.Supports(context, property))) result.Add(context);
                }
            }
            return result;
        }
        public static bool TryRead(GameplayRangePreviewContext context, out GameplayRangePreviewShape shape)
            => TryRead(context, out shape, out _);
        public static bool TryRead(GameplayRangePreviewContext context, out GameplayRangePreviewShape shape, out string error)
        {
            error = null;
            shape = default;
            if (context.Asset == null) return false;
            using (var serialized = new SerializedObject(context.Asset))
            {
                var property = context.PropertyPath == null ? null : serialized.FindProperty(context.PropertyPath);
                if (context.PropertyPath != null && property == null) return false;
                foreach (var provider in GameplayAuthoringProviders.Ranges)
                    if (provider.Supports(context, property)) {
                        try { shape = provider.Read(context, property); return true; }
                        catch (Exception ex) { error = ex.Message; return false; }
                    }
            }
            return false;
        }
        /// <summary>+X schematic only; no Physics, targeting query or gameplay clock.</summary>
        public static void Draw(Rect rect, GameplayRangePreviewShape shape)
        {
            if (Event.current.type != EventType.Repaint) return;
            if(shape.Geometry!=null){DrawCanonicalGeometry(rect,shape.Geometry);return;}
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(rect, new Color(.1f, .12f, .14f));
            Vector2 origin = new Vector2(rect.x + rect.width * .35f, rect.center.y);
            float extent = Mathf.Max(.01f, shape.Kind == GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind.Line ? Mathf.Max(shape.Length, shape.Width) : shape.Radius);
            float scale = Mathf.Min(rect.width * .42f, rect.height * .42f) / extent;
            Vector3 Point(float distance, float degrees) => origin + new Vector2(Mathf.Cos(degrees * Mathf.Deg2Rad), -Mathf.Sin(degrees * Mathf.Deg2Rad)) * distance * scale;
            Color old = Handles.color;
            Handles.BeginGUI();
            try
            {
                Handles.color = new Color(.2f, .8f, 1f);
                if (shape.Kind == GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind.Line)
                {
                    float a = shape.OffsetAngle;
                    Vector3 side = (Point(shape.Width / 2, a + 90) - (Vector3)origin);
                    Vector3 end = Point(shape.Length, a);
                    Handles.DrawAAPolyLine(2f, (Vector3)origin + side, end + side, end - side, (Vector3)origin - side, (Vector3)origin + side);
                }
                else
                {
                    float angle = shape.Kind == GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind.Circle ? 360 : shape.Angle;
                    var points = new Vector3[65];
                    for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++) points[i] = Point(shape.Radius, shape.OffsetAngle - angle / 2 + angle * i / 64f);
                    Handles.DrawAAPolyLine(2f, points);
                    if (angle < 360) Handles.DrawAAPolyLine(2f, points[0], origin, points[64]);
                }
                Handles.color = Color.white;
                Handles.DrawAAPolyLine(2f, origin, Point(extent, 0));
                Handles.Label(Point(extent, 0), "+X");
                Handles.Label(origin, "0");
            }
            finally { Handles.color = old; Handles.EndGUI(); }
        }
        private static void DrawCanonicalGeometry(Rect rect, GameplaySearchGeometry geometry)
        {
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(rect,new Color(.1f,.12f,.14f));
            if(geometry.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Single){GUI.Label(rect,"Single：查询指定目标身份，不定义面积。");return;}
            float extent=Mathf.Max(1,geometry.BoundsRadius)*1.05f;
            const int columns=64,rows=40;
            float cellWidth=rect.width/columns,cellHeight=rect.height/rows;
            for(int y=0;y<rows;y++)for(int x=0;x<columns;x++){
                float px=((x+.5f)/columns*2-1)*extent,py=(1-(y+.5f)/rows*2)*extent;
                var point=geometry.Plane==GameplaySpatialPlane.XZ?new GameplayPoint(geometry.Origin.X+px,geometry.Origin.Y,geometry.Origin.Z+py):
                    new GameplayPoint(geometry.Origin.X+px,geometry.Origin.Y+py,geometry.Origin.Z);
                if(geometry.Contains(geometry.SingleTarget,point))EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(rect.x+x*cellWidth,rect.y+y*cellHeight,cellWidth+.1f,cellHeight+.1f),new Color(.12f,.65f,.8f,.75f));
            }
            GUI.Label(new Rect(rect.x+4,rect.y+4,rect.width-8,20),geometry.Plane==GameplaySpatialPlane.ThreeDimensional?"3D / XY 中心切片（非整个立体）":geometry.Plane+" / 同一 Contains 规则");
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(rect.center.x-1,rect.center.y-5,2,10),Color.white);
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(rect.center.x-5,rect.center.y-1,10,2),Color.white);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Editor presentation projection. Implementations must never tick Gameplay Runtime or modify Skill assets.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillPreviewProvider
    {
        string DisplayName { get; }
        bool CanPreview(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill);
        IGameplaySkillPreviewSession CreateSession(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill);
    }
    /// <summary>Optional preference for previews consuming the playable document's actual resources.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayPlayableDocumentPreviewProvider { }

    /// <summary>Disposable preview state, including game-specific subject selection and rendering.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillPreviewSession : IDisposable
    {
        float Duration { get; }
        void UpdateContext(GameplaySkillPreviewContext context);
        void DrawControls();
        void Seek(float seconds);
        void Render(Rect viewport);
    }

    /// <summary>Optional recoverable backend diagnostics consumed by the V2 source navigator.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillPreviewDiagnostics
    {
        string Error { get; }
        void Retry();
    }

    /// <summary>The currently selected authoring projection. Sequence is supplied by the Workbench, never guessed by a provider.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillPreviewContext
    {
        public GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset Skill { get; }
        public SkillNodeLocation? SelectedNode { get; }
        public GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset Sequence { get; }
        public GameplaySkillDocumentAsset Document { get; }
        public string AuthoringScope { get; }
        public UnityEngine.Object Source { get; }
        public string PropertyPath { get; }
        public UnityEngine.Object PresentationSource { get; }
        /// <summary>Absolute sequence start of the selected presentation. Standalone resource previews start at zero.</summary>
        public float PresentationStartSeconds {get;}

        public GameplaySkillPreviewContext(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill, SkillNodeLocation? selectedNode,
            GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence, GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document = null,
            UnityEngine.Object source = null, string propertyPath = null, UnityEngine.Object presentationSource = null,float presentationStartSeconds=0)
        {
            Skill = skill;
            SelectedNode = selectedNode;
            Sequence = sequence;
            Document = document; Source = source; PropertyPath = propertyPath; PresentationSource = presentationSource;
            PresentationStartSeconds=presentationStartSeconds;
            AuthoringScope = document == null ? GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Scope(skill) : document.AuthoringGraph?.Scope;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Deterministic Editor-only provider discovery with failure isolation.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillPreviewProviders
    {
        private static readonly Type[] Types = TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplaySkillPreviewProvider>()
            .Where(t => !t.IsAbstract && t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null)
            .OrderBy(t => t.AssemblyQualifiedName, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();

        public static IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillPreviewProvider> For(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill, bool playableDocument = false)
        {
            var result = new List<IGameplaySkillPreviewProvider>();
            foreach (Type type in Types)
                try
                {
                    var provider = (IGameplaySkillPreviewProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
                    if (provider.CanPreview(skill)) result.Add(provider);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { Debug.LogWarning("Skill preview provider " + type.FullName + ": " + ex.Message); }
            return playableDocument?result.OrderByDescending(p=>p is IGameplayPlayableDocumentPreviewProvider).ToArray():result;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Builds the current serialized search definition, then calls its exact runtime request
    /// constructor. Preview inputs are explicit, transient test parameters, not a second skill source.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayStandardRangePreview : IGameplayRangePreviewProvider
    {
        public bool Supports(GameplayRangePreviewContext context, SerializedProperty property)=>
            property?.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference && property.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring;
        public GameplayRangePreviewShape Read(GameplayRangePreviewContext context, SerializedProperty property)
        {
            var source=(GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring)property.managedReferenceValue;
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
            {
                var actor=world.CreateActor(default,1);
                if(context.Profile!=null)context.Profile.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()).Initialize(actor);
                else{
                    actor.Attributes.Register(new GameplayAttributeId("Attack"),100);
                    actor.Attributes.Register(new GameplayAttributeId("Health"),10000);
                    actor.Attributes.Register(new GameplayAttributeId("MaxHealth"),10000);
                    actor.Attributes.Register(new GameplayAttributeId("Mana"),100);
                    actor.Attributes.Register(new GameplayAttributeId("Shield"),0);
                    actor.Attributes.Register(new GameplayAttributeId("Defense"),0);
                }
                var target=world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(3,0,3),2);
                var entry=AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(context.Asset)) as GameplaySkillDocumentAsset;
                var scalarDefaults=new List<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>>();
                if(entry?.Defaults!=null)foreach(var item in entry.Defaults)if(item!=null)scalarDefaults.Add(new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(item.Key.Build(),item.Value));
                var defaults=new GameplayContextValues(scalarDefaults);
                var input=new GameplayContext(actor.Id,new GameplayTargetData(target.Id,target.Position),values:defaults,abilityLevel:Math.Max(1,context.AbilityLevel));
                var action=(GameplaySearchTargetAction)source.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext());
                if(!action.TryCreateRequest(input,actor,out var request))throw new InvalidOperationException("当前预览输入缺少合法搜索原点/方向，或两个端点重合。");
                var geometry=request.Geometry;
                return new GameplayRangePreviewShape(GameplayRangePreviewShapeKind.Sector,"正式范围 / "+geometry.Shape,geometry.Radius,
                    geometry.Angle,geometry.Length,geometry.Width,geometry:geometry);
            }
        }
    }
}

        private bool ContextCompatible(Port first,Port second,Func<string,string,string,string,bool,string> check){if((first.userData as Socket)?.Config!=null)return (first.userData as Socket).Config==(second.userData as Socket)?.Config;var from=(Socket)(first.direction==Direction.Output?first:second).userData;var to=(Socket)(first.direction==Direction.Input?first:second).userData;

        private GraphViewChange Change(GraphViewChange change)
        {
            if (_loading) return change;
            if (change.edgesToCreate?.Count>0||change.elementsToRemove?.OfType<Edge>().Any()==true)
            {
                var pending=change.edgesToCreate?.Select(e=>(source:(Socket)e.output.userData,target:(Socket)e.input.userData)).ToArray()??Array.Empty<(Socket source,Socket target)>();
                var removed=change.elementsToRemove?.OfType<Edge>().Select(e=>e.userData as Socket).Where(s=>s!=null).ToArray()??Array.Empty<Socket>();
                change.edgesToCreate?.Clear();change.elementsToRemove?.Clear();
                if(pending.Any(p=>p.source.Config!=null)||removed.Any(e=>e.Config!=null)){
                    foreach(var edge in removed.Where(e=>e.Config!=null))if(!pending.Any(p=>p.source.Config==edge.Config))DetachPolicy(edge.Config);
                    foreach(var item in pending.Where(p=>p.source.Config!=null))if(item.source.Config==item.target.Config&&_policyDrafts.Any(p=>p.Key==PolicyKey(item.source.Config)))ReconnectPolicy(item.source.Config);
                    return change;
                }
                Try(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document,"重连正式行为",graph=>{
                    foreach(var edge in removed){
                        if(edge.Scheduled){if(!pending.Any(p=>p.source.Scheduled&&p.source.Owner==edge.Owner))foreach(var timeline in graph.Timelines)timeline.Events.RemoveAll(e=>e.Id==edge.Owner);}
                        else {var old=graph.Connections.SingleOrDefault(e=>e.Id==edge.Owner);if(old!=null&&pending.Any(p=>p.source.Owner==old.FromNodeId&&p.source.Port==old.OutputPortKey))graph.Connections.Remove(old);else GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.DisconnectInGraph(graph,edge.Owner);}
                    }
                    foreach(var item in pending){
                        if(item.source.Scheduled)graph.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events).Single(e=>e.Id==item.source.Owner).EntryNodeId=item.target.Owner;
                        else{
                            GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.ConnectInGraph(graph,item.source.Owner,item.source.Port,item.target.Owner,item.target.Port);
                        }
                    }
                }));
            }
            if (change.movedElements != null)
            {
                foreach(var card in change.movedElements.OfType<Node>().Where(n=>n.viewDataKey.StartsWith("Config:",StringComparison.Ordinal))){string key=GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".Policy."+card.viewDataKey.Substring(7);SessionState.SetVector3(key,card.GetPosition().position);SessionState.SetBool(key+".Moved",true);} var positions = change.movedElements.OfType<Node>().Where(n=>!n.viewDataKey.StartsWith("Config:",StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToDictionary(n => n.viewDataKey, n => n.GetPosition().position);
                if(BusinessReading||_explicitLayoutPreview){if(_layoutPreview==null)_layoutPreview=_nodes.ToDictionary(p=>p.Key,p=>p.Value.GetPosition().position);foreach(var pair in positions)_layoutPreview[pair.Key]=pair.Value;SaveViewState();}
                else if (positions.Count > 0) Try(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.MoveNodes(_document, positions)); }
            return change;
        }

        internal bool EditingText()
        {

            for(var focus=panel?.focusController?.focusedElement as VisualElement;focus!=null;focus=focus.parent)
                if(focus is TextField||focus is FloatField||focus is IntegerField)return true;
            return false;

        private void RemoveSelected(IEnumerable<ISelectable> elements=null)
        {
            if (!_document) return;
            var chosen=(elements??selection).ToArray();
            var edges=chosen.OfType<Edge>().Select(e=>e.userData as Socket).Where(s=>s!=null).ToArray();
            // An edge operation cannot inherit a previously selected card and delete it.
            // Removing nodes remains an explicit node-only selection operation.
            var cards=edges.Length>0?Array.Empty<Node>():chosen.OfType<Node>().ToArray();
            foreach(string role in edges.Select(e=>e.Config).Where(r=>r!=null).Distinct().ToArray())DetachPolicy(role);
            var policies=cards.Where(n=>n.viewDataKey.StartsWith("Config:",StringComparison.Ordinal)).Select(n=>n.viewDataKey.Substring(7)).Distinct().ToArray();
            var selected = SelectedBehaviorIds(cards).ToArray();
            if(selected.Length==0&&policies.Length==0&&!edges.Any(e=>e.Config==null))return;
            if (selected.Contains(_document.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId)) { DeleteMain?.Invoke(); return; }
            Try(() => {
                if(policies.Length>0)Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(ConfigurationOwner,"删除配置节点");
                GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document, "删除所选节点 / 连接", graph => {
                foreach (var edge in edges.Where(s=>s.Config==null)) { if (edge.Scheduled) foreach (var timeline in graph.Timelines) timeline.Events.RemoveAll(e => e.Id == edge.Owner); else GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.DisconnectInGraph(graph,edge.Owner); }
                if(policies.Length>0){
                    var ability=(GameplayAbilityNodePayload)graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==graph.AbilityNodeId).Payload;
                    var settings=(GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)ability.Settings;
                    var released=policies.Contains("Recharge")?ability.Definitions.Where(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect").Select(b=>b.LocalId).ToArray():Array.Empty<string>();
                    if(policies.Contains("Cost"))settings.Cost=null;
                    if(policies.Contains("Recharge")){settings.Charge=null;ability.Definitions.RemoveAll(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect");}
                    GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CollectReleased(graph,released);
                }
                GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.DeleteFromGraph(graph, selected);
                });
                _policyDrafts.RemoveAll(p=>policies.Any(role=>p.Key==PolicyKey(role)));
            });
        }
        public override void BuildContextualMenu(ContextualMenuPopulateEvent evt)
        {

                string action=_selectedInlineAction;evt.menu.AppendAction("时间事件 / 展开独立卡片",_=>RevealTimelineAction(action));
                evt.menu.AppendAction("时间事件 / 选择整个编排",_=>{SelectNodeWithoutCamera(inlineOwner);Selected?.Invoke(inlineOwner);});
            }

            foreach(var selected in selection.OfType<Node>().Select(n=>_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(d=>d.Id==n.viewDataKey)).Where(n=>n?.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload)){
                string id=selected.Id;bool active=_document.AuthoringGraph.PrimaryRuleNodeId==id||_document.AuthoringGraph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Contains(id);

        public void ShowMenu(Vector2? anchor = null, string timeline = null, float? seconds = null, Socket source=null)
        { CreationLink=source==null?null:new GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreationLink{Owner=source.Owner,Port=source.Port,Scheduled=source.Scheduled,Input=_document.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Any(d=>d.Id==source.Owner&&GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.IsPort(d.Payload,source.Port))?GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input:"Execute"};CreationPosition=anchor.HasValue?contentViewContainer.WorldToLocal(anchor.Value):CreationCenter;GameplaySkillCreationMenu.Show(this, source!=null?"从此端口创建并连接":timeline == null ? "创建节点" : "此帧创建并安排", menu => Populate?.Invoke(menu, CreationPosition, timeline, seconds), anchor); }

using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;
using Node=UnityEditor.Experimental.GraphView.Node;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplayBehaviorGraphView
    {
        private void AddSpatialLifecycleGuidance(Node card,GameplayAuthoringNode node)
        {
            if(!GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.StartsSpatialLifetime(node))return;
            var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;
            var active=Reachable(graph);
            bool pending=graph.Nodes.Any(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring&&!active.Contains(n.Id));
            var binding=node.Payload.Definitions.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Projectile"||b.PropertyPath=="Area"||b.PropertyPath=="Summon");
            var resource=graph.LocalDefinitions.SingleOrDefault(d=>d.Id==binding?.LocalId)?.Payload;
            string ownership=binding==null?"尚未配置真实空间资源。":binding.External?"生命周期归属由共享资源配置；共享来源只读。":resource is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile&&!projectile.CancelOnAbilityEnd?"当前弹体由世界托管；结束或取消技能不会清理弹体。":"当前对象随施放结束 / 取消清理。";
            var endIds=graph.Nodes.Where(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring).Select(n=>n.Id).ToHashSet();
            var current=graph.Connections.Where(e=>endIds.Contains(e.ToNodeId)&&(e.FromNodeId==node.Id&&e.OutputPortKey=="Then"||binding!=null&&e.FromNodeId==binding.LocalId)).Select(e=>e.OutputPortKey+" → "+GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Name(graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==e.ToNodeId),graph)).ToArray();
            var label=new Label((pending?"结束策略待决 · 原结束节点保留，尚未接入执行流程\n":"")+"启动后继续立即返回，不等待对象结束。"+ownership+(current.Length>0?"\n直接结束关联："+string.Join("；",current):"")){
                name="SpatialLifecycleSummary",style={whiteSpace=WhiteSpace.Normal,fontSize=11,marginLeft=10,marginRight=10,color=new Color(1,.77f,.4f)}};
            card.extensionContainer.Add(label);
            var choose=new Button(()=>ShowSpatialEndChoices(node.Id)){text="选择 / 替换真实结束策略…"};
            choose.SetEnabled(!EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode&&!GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(_document));card.extensionContainer.Add(choose);
        }

        private void ShowSpatialEndChoices(string nodeId)
        {
            GameplaySkillCreationMenu.Show(this,"持续行为：选择结束策略",menu=>{
                var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;var node=graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==nodeId);
                var binding=node.Payload.Definitions.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Projectile"||b.PropertyPath=="Area"||b.PropertyPath=="Summon");
                if(binding==null){menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("先配置真实弹体、区域或召唤资源"));return;}
                var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.SingleOrDefault(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId);
                if(local==null){menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("共享来源只读：先明确转为本地配置"));return;}
                var ends=graph.Nodes.Where(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring).ToArray();
                if(ends.Length==0)menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("先从真实回调拖出创建「结束技能」"));
                foreach(var end in ends){
                    string endId=end.Id,title=end.Title+"（"+(System.Array.IndexOf(ends,end)+1)+"）";
                    foreach(var slot in GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(local.Payload)){
                        string port=slot.Path;
                        string caption=port=="OnEnd"?"自然结束后结束技能":port=="OnHit"?"首次命中即结束（清理余下飞行）":port=="OnArrive"?"到达终点后结束技能":port=="OnRange"?"达到射程后结束技能":null;
                        if(caption==null)continue;
                        string reason=GameplayGraphPortPolicy.Unavailable(graph,local.Id,port);
                        var content=new GUIContent("保持施放 / "+caption+" / "+title,reason);
                        if(reason!=null)menu.AddDisabledItem(content);
                        else menu.AddItem(content,false,()=>ReplaceSpatialEnd(nodeId,endId,port,false));
                    }
                    if(local.Payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData)menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("世界托管（结束或取消不清理弹体） / "+title),false,()=>ReplaceSpatialEnd(nodeId,endId,"Then",true));
                }
                menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("超时：从启动后继续创建真实时间编排，安排原结束节点"));
                if(local.Payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData)menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("弹体没有统一寿命结束回调；命中、到达与射程是不同事件"));
                else menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("区域 / 召唤暂不支持脱离施放的世界托管"));
            });
        }

        private void ReplaceSpatialEnd(string nodeId,string endId,string port,bool worldOwned)=>Try(()=>{

using System;

    public sealed partial class GameplayBehaviorGraphView

        private static string FollowKey(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string timeline)=>GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(document)+".FollowMain."+timeline;
        internal static bool FollowsMainAnimation(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)=>document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Any(t=>SessionState.GetString(FollowKey(document,t.Id),"").Length>0);
        /// <summary>Explicit editor preference updates the existing duration; it creates no runtime clock or end event.</summary>
        internal static void FollowMainAnimationDurations(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            foreach(var timeline in graph.Timelines){
                string main=SessionState.GetString(FollowKey(document,timeline.Id),"");
                var entry=timeline.Events.FirstOrDefault(e=>e.EntryNodeId==main);
                if(entry!=null&&GameplaySkillFieldSchema.TryDuration(graph,main,out _,out _,out float duration))
                    timeline.DurationSeconds=Mathf.Max(timeline.Events.Max(e=>e.TimeSeconds),entry.TimeSeconds+duration);
            }
        }
        private void AddMainAnimationControls(Node card,string owner,GameplayAuthoringTimeline timeline)
        {
            string main=timeline.Events.Select(e=>e.EntryNodeId).FirstOrDefault(IsTimelineInline);
            if(main==null)card.extensionContainer.Add(new Button(()=>ShowMainAnimationMenu(null,timeline)){text="＋ 设置主动画（可选）",tooltip="主动画使用真实 Animation Action 和唯一 Schedule；无动画也能执行。"});
        }
        private void ShowMainAnimationMenu(string main,GameplayAuthoringTimeline timeline)
        {

                foreach(var type in GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Query(typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring),_document.AuthoringGraph.Scope).Where(t=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(t).IsAnimation)){
                    var action=(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)Activator.CreateInstance(type);

                        var label=new GUIContent(GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(type).DisplayName+"/"+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Name(valueType));
                        string reason=GameplaySkillTypeAvailability.Reason(_document,type);
                        if(reason!=null){label.tooltip=reason;menu.AddDisabledItem(label);continue;}
                        menu.AddItem(label,false,()=>Try(()=>{
                            if(main==null)GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateAction(_document,(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)Activator.CreateInstance(actionType),"主动画",CreationCenter,(GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload)Activator.CreateInstance(value),path,timeline.Id,0);
                            else GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document,"更换主动画后端",g=>{
                                var node=g.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==main);var old=node.Payload.Definitions.Select(b=>b.LocalId).ToArray();
                                var local=new GameplayLocalDefinition{Name="主动画",SourceDefinitionId=_document.DefinitionId,Payload=(GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload)Activator.CreateInstance(value)};
                                node.Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)Activator.CreateInstance(actionType)};
                                node.Payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath=path,LocalId=local.Id});g.LocalDefinitions.Add(local);GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CollectReleased(g,old);
                            });

                    }

        /// <summary>Edits the same inline animation and schedule from the right business Inspector.</summary>
        internal void DrawMainAnimationSettings(string selected)
        {
            string owner=selected!=null&&_inlineOwners.TryGetValue(selected,out var timelineOwner)?timelineOwner:selected;
            var node=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==owner);if(node==null)return;
            foreach(var current in _document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Where(t=>node.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id))){
                string main=current.Events.Select(e=>e.EntryNodeId).FirstOrDefault(IsTimelineInline);if(main==null)continue;
                string timelineId=current.Id;var occurrence=current.Events.Single(e=>e.EntryNodeId==main);string entry=occurrence.Id;

                    string followKey=FollowKey(_document,timelineId);bool follow=SessionState.GetString(followKey,"")==main;

                    if(next!=follow){SessionState.SetString(followKey,next?main:"");if(next)Try(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document,"编排跟随主动画",g=>{}));}
                    if(GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("编排时长覆盖动画","其它事件与 End 时点不变")))Try(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document,"编排长度覆盖主动画",g=>{

                    GUIUtility.ExitGUI();

                var liveEvent=liveTimeline.Events.Single(e=>e.Id==entry);
                _cardSerialized.UpdateIfRequiredOrScript();
                var entryProperty=_cardSerialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.Timelines")

                var paths=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>();

                if(paths.Count>0)GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ApplyFields(_cardSerialized,_document,false,paths);

            }
        }

using System;

        }
        /// <summary>Creates the visible configuration cards through the same typed Ability fields
        /// as the card menu. Re-selecting existing content never resets it or moves its card.</summary>
        internal void AddConfigurationEntries(IGameplaySkillCreationMenu menu,Vector2 position)
        {

                string selection=kind;var caption=new GUIContent("技能/"+kind,"创建独立配置节点并自动关联当前技能；已有同类配置则保留。冷却与充能互斥，更换前会确认。");
                if(!(AbilityPayload.Settings is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)||GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(_document)){caption.tooltip="当前技能使用共享释放配置或处于只读范例视图；请先选择可编辑的本地技能配置。";menu.AddDisabledItem(caption);}

                    var settings=(GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)AbilityPayload.Settings;
                    bool created=role=="Cost"?settings.Cost!=null:settings.Charge!=null||AbilityPayload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect");
                    if(!created)return;

        private void ShowPolicyChoices(string role)
        {
            GameplaySkillCreationMenu.Show(this,role=="Cost"?"更换消耗配置":"更换冷却 / 充能配置",menu=>{
                if(_policyDrafts.Any(p=>p.Key==PolicyKey(role)))menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("重新关联已解绑配置"),false,()=>ReconnectPolicy(role));

        }
        private void ChangeCost(Type type,bool replace)
        {
            if(!replace&&((GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)AbilityPayload.Settings).Cost?.GetType()==type){PolicySelected?.Invoke("Cost");return;}

        private void PositionPolicies()

        private void DetachPolicy(string role)
        {

            if(role=="Cost"?settings.Cost==null:settings.Charge==null&&!AbilityPayload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect"))return;

        }
        private void ReconnectPolicy(string role)

            var settings=(GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)AbilityPayload.Settings;

            }));
        }

                        var tags=effect.FindPropertyRelative("GrantedTags");GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(tags);paths.Add(tags.propertyPath);
                    }}
                }
                if(EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ApplyFields(so,_document,false,paths);
            }
        }

        private void EditCostResources(int removeIndex)
        {
            bool add=removeIndex<0;
            Try(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document,add?"添加消耗资源项":"移除消耗资源项",graph=>{
                var ability=(GameplayAbilityNodePayload)graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==graph.AbilityNodeId).Payload;
                var cost=(GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring)((GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)ability.Settings).Cost;
                cost.Resources=add
                    ?cost.Resources.Append(new GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring.Entry{
                        Attribute=cost.Resources.Length==0?new GameplayAttributeReference("Mana"):cost.Resources[0].Attribute,
                        Delta=new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring{Value=0}
                    }).ToArray()
                    :cost.Resources.Where((_,index)=>index!=removeIndex).ToArray();
            },structural:false,invalidation:GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Local(new[]{_document.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId})));
            GUIUtility.ExitGUI();
        }
    }
}

        private void StylePorts(Node card,bool alignSides)

            if(alignSides)ports.style.justifyContent=Justify.SpaceBetween;
            foreach(var side in new[]{card.inputContainer,card.outputContainer}){

                side.style.flexDirection=FlexDirection.Column;

            foreach(var port in cardPorts){
                if((port.userData as Socket)?.Scheduled==true)continue;
                var socket=port.userData as Socket;var data=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==card.viewDataKey);var action=(data?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
                if(socket?.Port=="Then"){
                    bool cue=action!=null&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).IsPresentationCue;
                    bool starts=action is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySpawnProjectileActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySpawnAreaActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySpawnSummonActionAuthoring;
                    port.portName=cue?"开始播放后继续":starts?"启动后继续":"继续主链";
                    port.tooltip=cue?"成功启动特效或音频后立即执行下游，不等待播放结束。":starts?"启动编排、弹体、区域或召唤后立即继续；不等待其结束。结束回调请使用对应生命周期出口。":"此行为及其分支完成后继续主链；保留它输出的实际上下文。";
                }
                if(action is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring){
                    if(socket?.Port=="Completed"){port.portName="完成 · 结果集";port.tooltip="搜索后调用一次，包含完整结果集；也可能为空，不能假定存在目标。";}
                    if(socket?.Port=="EachTarget")port.tooltip="对每个有效目标分别执行；下游接收该目标和采样地点。";
                    if(socket?.Port=="NoTargets"){port.portName="未找到目标";port.tooltip="没有有效目标时调用；只有搜索中心地点，不提供 Actor。";}

                var connector=port.Q("connector");if(connector!=null){connector.style.width=12;connector.style.height=12;connector.style.minWidth=12;connector.style.flexShrink=0;}
                if(port.portType==typeof(GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset)){

                }

        }

        }
        private void RefreshContextContracts(bool force=false)

        private void AddCallbackCreationMenu(ContextualMenuPopulateEvent evt)

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;
using UnityEditor.Experimental.GraphView;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplayBehaviorGraphView
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string,int> _nodeIndexes=new Dictionary<string,int>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>> _consumerCards=new Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string,List<Port>> _portsByCard=new Dictionary<string,List<Port>>();
        private readonly HashSet<UnityEngine.Object> _externalSources=new HashSet<UnityEngine.Object>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _externalDependencyGuids=new HashSet<string>();
        private Dictionary<string,GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement> _contextContracts=new Dictionary<string,GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Requirement>();
        private Func<string,string,string,string,bool,string> _connectionChecker;
        public bool UsesExternal(UnityEngine.Object source){
            if(!source||source==_document)return false;if(_externalSources.Contains(source))return true;if(_externalDependencyGuids.Count==0)return false;
            string path=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(source);return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)&&_externalDependencyGuids.Contains(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(path));
        }
        // Derived view dependencies only. Rebuilt with topology, never used as execution data.
        private void IndexPresentation()
        {
            _nodeIndexes.Clear();_consumerCards.Clear();_externalSources.Clear();_externalDependencyGuids.Clear();_connectionChecker=null;
            if(!_document)return;var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;
            var definitions=graph.LocalDefinitions.ToDictionary(d=>d.Id);var timelines=graph.Timelines.ToDictionary(t=>t.Id);
            for(int i=0;i<graph.Nodes.Count;i++){
                var node=graph.Nodes[i];_nodeIndexes[node.Id]=i;
                string card=node.Id==graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId&&InlinePrimaryRule(_document)?graph.AbilityNodeId:node.Id;
                var seen=new HashSet<string>();Visit(node.Id,node.Payload.Definitions);
                void Visit(string owner,IEnumerable<GameplayDefinitionBinding> bindings){
                    if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(owner)||!seen.Add(owner))return;
                    if(!_consumerCards.TryGetValue(owner,out var cards))_consumerCards[owner]=cards=new HashSet<string>();cards.Add(card);
                    foreach(var b in bindings){if(b.External)_externalSources.Add(b.External);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.LocalId))continue;
                        if(definitions.TryGetValue(b.LocalId,out var local))Visit(local.Id,local.Definitions);
                        if(timelines.TryGetValue(b.LocalId,out var timeline)){Visit(timeline.Id,Array.Empty<GameplayDefinitionBinding>());foreach(var e in timeline.Events)Visit(e.EntryNodeId,graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==e.EntryNodeId)?.Payload.Definitions??new List<GameplayDefinitionBinding>());}
                    }
                }
            }
            foreach(var source in _externalSources){string path=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(source);if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))_externalDependencyGuids.UnionWith(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.GetDependencies(path,true).Select(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID).Where(guid=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(guid)));}
        }
        private GameplayAuthoringNode Record(string id)
        {
            if(!_document||!_nodeIndexes.TryGetValue(id,out int at))return null;
            var nodes=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes;
            return at<nodes.Count&&nodes[at].Id==id?nodes[at]:null;
        }
        /// <summary>Only changed owners and their shared/Timeline consumers are recomputed.
        /// Context analysis is cached until a semantic edit; changed contracts alone touch ports.</summary>
        public void RefreshPresentation(GameplaySkillAuthoringChange change)
        {
            if(!_document)return;
            bool full=change==null||change.Unknown;
            if(full)IndexPresentation();
            var affected=new HashSet<string>();
            if(full)affected.UnionWith(_nodes.Keys);
            else foreach(string owner in change.Owners){if(_consumerCards.TryGetValue(owner,out var cards))affected.UnionWith(cards);if(_nodes.ContainsKey(owner))affected.Add(owner);}
            var active=Reachable(_document.AuthoringGraph);
            long sample=System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            using(new Unity.Profiling.ProfilerMarker("FRFrame.Workbench.Summaries").Auto())try{
                foreach(string id in affected){var data=Record(id);if(data==null||!_nodes.TryGetValue(id,out var node))continue;NodePresentationUpdateCount++;
                    if(change?.Layout==true){var position=_layoutPreview!=null&&_layoutPreview.TryGetValue(id,out var projected)?projected:data.Position;if(node.GetPosition().position!=position)node.SetPosition(new Rect(position,node.GetPosition().size));if(HasTimeline(data)){float width=TimelineWidth(data);node.style.width=width;node.style.minWidth=width;node.style.maxWidth=width;}}
                    string title=GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Name(data,_document.AuthoringGraph);if(node.title!=title)node.title=title;
                    Set("ExecutionStatus",(active.Contains(id)?"正式执行":data.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload?"未启用 · 不参与执行":"未接入执行流程 · 不参与执行")+(data.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.External)?" · 共享来源":" · 本地"));
                    var editors=node.extensionContainer.Query<GameplaySkillCardEditor>().ToList();foreach(var editor in editors)editor.Refresh();
                    Set("BusinessSummary",GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.CardSummary(data,_document.AuthoringGraph,editors.Any(e=>e.HasFields)));
                    if(data.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload)Set("AbilitySummary",_document.Mode==FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard.GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active?"主动技能":"被动技能");
                    foreach(var binding in data.Payload.Definitions){var definition=_document.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId);if(definition!=null)Set("Definition-"+definition.Id,DefinitionSummary(definition));}
                    foreach(var label in node.extensionContainer.Query<Label>(className:"animation-source").ToList()){var animation=Record((string)label.userData);if(animation==null)continue;object values=GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.AnimationValues(animation,_document.AuthoringGraph);string text=IsTimelineInline(animation.Id)?(values==null?"动画资源未配置":GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Name(values.GetType()))+" · "+(animation.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.External)?"共享，只读":"本地"):GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.EventLabel(animation,_document.AuthoringGraph)+" · 参数在独立动画卡";if(label.text!=text)label.text=text;}
                    foreach(var timeline in _document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Where(t=>data.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id))){var entries=timeline.Events.Where(e=>!IsTimelineInline(e.EntryNodeId)).OrderBy(e=>e.TimeSeconds).ThenBy(e=>e.Order).ToArray();for(int i=0;i<entries.Length;i++)if(_outputs.TryGetValue(Key(entries[i].Id,"Schedule"),out var port)){string caption="#"+(i+1)+" "+(entries[i].TimeSeconds*timeline.FramesPerSecond).ToString("0.#")+"f";if(port.portName!=caption){port.tooltip="◇ 真实时间调度 · "+caption+"\n事件 "+entries[i].Id+"\n单击编号定位；Order、目标与条件见该事件。";}}}
                    foreach(var timelineView in node.Query<GameplaySkillTimeline>().ToList())timelineView.InvalidatePresentation();
                    node.MarkDirtyRepaint();
                    void Set(string name,string value){var label=node.extensionContainer.Q<Label>(name);if(label!=null){if(label.text!=value)label.text=value;label.style.display=string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)?DisplayStyle.None:DisplayStyle.Flex;}}
                }
                if(full||affected.Contains(_document.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId))foreach(var policy in _policyCards.Values)foreach(var editor in policy.Query<GameplaySkillCardEditor>().ToList())editor.Refresh();
                if(full||change.Context){_connectionChecker=null;RefreshPortPolicy(full?null:affected);RefreshContextContracts();}
            }finally{SummaryRefreshMilliseconds+=(System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()-sample)*1000d/System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency;}
        }
    }
}

    public sealed partial class GameplayBehaviorGraphView
