        // Only the view is compacted. The same stable action, event, binding and position remain
        // in the document; shared, branched or explicitly revealed behavior always retains a card.
        private readonly Dictionary<string,string> _compactOwners=new Dictionary<string,string>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string,string> _inlineOwners=new Dictionary<string,string>();
        private string _selectedInlineAction;
        private Dictionary<string,Vector2> _layoutPreview;
        private Vector3 _layoutPan,_layoutZoom;
        /// <summary>Whether dragging edits only the session reading projection, including before its first layout frame.</summary>
        public bool BusinessReading {get;private set;}
        /// <summary>Notifies the workbench view selector without changing authoring data.</summary>
        public Action<bool> ViewModeChanged;
        private bool _explicitLayoutPreview;
        private string _focusAfterLayout,_readableFocusId;
        [Serializable] private sealed class ReadingLayout {public List<string> Ids;public List<Vector2> Positions;}
        private string CameraKey=>GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+(BusinessReading?".Reading":"");
        /// <summary>Switches only the editor projection. Business-view dragging stays in
        /// SessionState; fields and typed connections still edit the one source document.</summary>
        public void SetBusinessReading(bool reading)
        {
            if(!_document||BusinessReading==reading)return;
            SaveViewState();_layoutPreview=null;_explicitLayoutPreview=false;BusinessReading=reading;
            SessionState.SetString(GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".ViewMode",reading?"Reading":"Author");
            if(reading)RestoreReadingLayout();else SynchronizeLayout();
            RestoreCamera();ViewModeChanged?.Invoke(reading);
            Feedback?.Invoke(reading?"业务阅读 · 拖动只保存会话排布；参数与连接仍编辑正式源。":"作者布局 · 保留源坐标；移动节点使用正常 Undo。");
        }
        private void RestoreReadingLayout()
        {
            if(!BusinessReading)return; // A queued reading-layout pass cannot overwrite a later switch to author layout.
            // Before the first panel layout GraphView reports NaN dimensions, not just zero.
            if(_nodes.Values.Any(n=>!float.IsFinite(n.GetPosition().width)||!float.IsFinite(n.GetPosition().height)||n.GetPosition().height<=1)){
                var source=_document;int generation=RefreshCount;schedule.Execute(()=>{if(_document==source&&RefreshCount==generation&&panel!=null)RestoreReadingLayout();}).StartingIn(50);return;
            }
            string json=SessionState.GetString(GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".ReadingLayout","");
            var saved=json.Length==0?null:JsonUtility.FromJson<ReadingLayout>(json);
            if(saved!=null&&saved.Ids.Count==saved.Positions.Count&&saved.Positions.All(p=>float.IsFinite(p.x)&&float.IsFinite(p.y))){
                // Topology edits do not request a reflow. Retain existing view positions and
                // place newly visible/created cards at their actual authoring coordinates.
                var remembered=saved.Ids.Select((id,i)=>new{id,position=saved.Positions[i]}).ToDictionary(p=>p.id,p=>p.position);
                _layoutPreview=_nodes.Keys.ToDictionary(id=>id,id=>remembered.TryGetValue(id,out var position)?position:Record(id).Position);
                foreach(var p in _layoutPreview){var card=_nodes[p.Key];card.SetPosition(new Rect(p.Value,card.GetPosition().size));}
            }else ArrangeLayout();
            PositionPolicies();
            if(_focusAfterLayout!=null){string focus=_focusAfterLayout;_focusAfterLayout=null;FocusNode(focus);}
        }
        private void RestoreViewMode(bool switched)
        {
            if(switched){
                string key=GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document);
                // Only an explicit ViewMode is a preference; old author Pan/Zoom stays available.
                BusinessReading=SessionState.GetString(key+".ViewMode","Reading")=="Reading";
            }
            _explicitLayoutPreview=false;ViewModeChanged?.Invoke(BusinessReading);
            if(BusinessReading)RestoreReadingLayout();
            if(switched){var source=_document;int generation=RefreshCount;schedule.Execute(()=>{if(_document==source&&RefreshCount==generation&&_readableFocusId==null&&_focusAfterLayout==null)RestoreCamera();}).StartingIn(120);}
        }
        private float TimelineWidth(GameplayAuthoringNode data)
        {
            if(data.Size.x>0)return Mathf.Max(440,data.Size.x);
            var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;
            bool animated=graph.Timelines.Where(t=>data.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id)).SelectMany(t=>t.Events)
                .Any(e=>graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==e.EntryNodeId)?.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload p&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(p.Action.GetType()).IsAnimation);
            return animated?800:Mathf.Clamp(layout.width>0?layout.width-70:820,480,860);
        }

        /// <summary>Shows a derived arrangement without writing Node.Position. Only the explicit
        /// Apply action persists one Undo transaction; cancel restores the authored layout.</summary>
        public void PreviewLayout()
        {
            if(!_document)return;
            if(BusinessReading){Feedback?.Invoke("业务阅读不需应用；要整理持久坐标请先切换作者布局。");return;}
            if(_layoutPreview==null){_layoutPan=viewTransform.position;_layoutZoom=viewTransform.scale;}
            _explicitLayoutPreview=true;ArrangeLayout();FocusMainFlow();
            Feedback?.Invoke("作者布局预览未写入；应用后一次 Undo 可恢复，取消还原原视图。");
        }
        private void ArrangeLayout()
        {
            // Breadth-first ranks are finite even with back edges. They organize the view,
            // never imply new execution order; actual typed edges remain the authority.
            var links=edges.Where(e=>(e.userData as Socket)?.Config==null&&e.input?.node!=null&&e.output?.node!=null).Select(e=>(from:e.output.node.viewDataKey,to:e.input.node.viewDataKey)).Distinct().ToArray();
            var ranks=new Dictionary<string,int>();var queue=new Queue<string>();
            string root=_document.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId;
            if(_nodes.ContainsKey(root)){ranks[root]=0;queue.Enqueue(root);}
            while(queue.Count>0){string id=queue.Dequeue();foreach(var link in links.Where(e=>e.from==id))if(!ranks.ContainsKey(link.to)){ranks[link.to]=ranks[id]+1;queue.Enqueue(link.to);}}
            foreach(string id in _nodes.Keys)if(!ranks.ContainsKey(id))ranks[id]=1;
            // A Search's immediate Cue can share its visual business row; its real Then edge
            // still identifies the dependency instead of suggesting a second scheduled event.
            foreach(var link in links){var from=Record(link.from);var to=Record(link.to);if((from?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring&&
                (to?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring action&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).VisualKind==GameplayNodeVisualKind.Presentation&&!GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).IsAnimation)ranks[link.to]=ranks[link.from];}
            int terminal=ranks.Values.DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max()+1;
            foreach(string id in _nodes.Keys)if((Record(id)?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring)ranks[id]=terminal;
            _layoutPreview=new Dictionary<string,Vector2>();float y=40;
            foreach(var row in ranks.GroupBy(p=>p.Value).OrderBy(g=>g.Key)){
                var cards=row.OrderBy(p=>Record(p.Key)?.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.Action.GetType()).VisualKind==GameplayNodeVisualKind.Presentation?1:0).ThenBy(p=>Record(p.Key)?.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.Action.GetType()).IsAnimation?1:0).ThenBy(p=>_nodes[p.Key].GetPosition().x).Select(p=>_nodes[p.Key]).ToArray();
                for(int first=0;first<cards.Length;first+=2){
                    var line=cards.Skip(first).Take(2).ToArray();float width=line.Sum(n=>n.GetPosition().width)+80*(line.Length-1);float x=40+Mathf.Max(0,(720-width)*.5f),height=0;
                    foreach(var card in line){var rect=card.GetPosition();var pos=new Vector2(x,y);_layoutPreview[card.viewDataKey]=pos;card.SetPosition(new Rect(pos,rect.size));x+=rect.width+80;height=Mathf.Max(height,rect.height);}y+=height+65;
                }
            }
            PositionPolicies();
        }
        /// <summary>Explicit session-only reflow after editing; authored Node.Position remains unchanged.</summary>
        public void ReflowReading(){if(!BusinessReading)return;ArrangeLayout();SaveViewState();FocusMainFlow();}
        /// <summary>Readable camera navigation over current view positions. It never moves data.</summary>
        public void FocusMainFlow()
        {
            if(!_document||_nodes.Count==0)return;
            var first=_nodes.TryGetValue(_document.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId,out var root)?root:_nodes.Values.First();
            var rect=first.GetPosition();if(_layoutPreview!=null&&_layoutPreview.TryGetValue(first.viewDataKey,out var projected))rect.position=projected;float zoom=Mathf.Min(1,Mathf.Max(.85f,(layout.width-60)/Mathf.Max(320,rect.width)));
            float left=_layoutPreview!=null?_layoutPreview.Values.Min(p=>p.x):edges.Where(e=>e.output?.node==first&&e.input?.node!=null).Select(e=>e.input.node.GetPosition().x).Append(rect.x).Min();
            PositionPolicies();
            left=Mathf.Min(left,_policyCards.Values.Select(n=>n.style.left.value.value).DefaultIfEmpty(left).Min());
            float top=Mathf.Min(rect.y,_policyCards.Values.Select(n=>n.style.top.value.value).DefaultIfEmpty(rect.y).Min());
            UpdateViewTransform(new Vector3(35-left*zoom,30-top*zoom,0),Vector3.one*zoom);
        }
        public void FocusSelectionReadable(){var card=selection.OfType<Node>().FirstOrDefault();if(card==null){FocusMainFlow();return;}if(card.viewDataKey.StartsWith("Config:",StringComparison.Ordinal))FocusReadable(card);else FocusNode(card.viewDataKey);}
        private void FocusReadable(Node card){_readableFocusId=card.viewDataKey;var rect=card.GetPosition();if(_layoutPreview!=null&&_layoutPreview.TryGetValue(card.viewDataKey,out var position))rect.position=position;float zoom=Mathf.Clamp((layout.width-50)/Mathf.Max(320,rect.width),.4f,1);UpdateViewTransform(new Vector3(Mathf.Max(25,(layout.width-rect.width*zoom)*.5f)-rect.x*zoom,35-rect.y*zoom,0),Vector3.one*zoom);}
        public void ApplyLayoutPreview(){if(!_explicitLayoutPreview||_layoutPreview==null)return;var positions=_layoutPreview;_layoutPreview=null;_explicitLayoutPreview=false;Try(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.MoveNodes(_document,positions));}
        public void CancelLayoutPreview(){if(!_explicitLayoutPreview)return;_layoutPreview=null;_explicitLayoutPreview=false;SynchronizeLayout();UpdateViewTransform(_layoutPan,_layoutZoom);}
        /// <summary>The exact scheduled occurrence selected by the Timeline, for its Inspector.</summary>
        public string SelectedEventId {get;private set;}
        public void ClearEventSelection(){SelectedEventId=null;}
        public void SetPreviewCursor(string owner,float seconds){if(!_document)return;var node=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==owner);if(node==null)return;foreach(var binding in node.Payload.Definitions)if(_timelineStates.TryGetValue(_document.GetInstanceID()+":"+binding.LocalId,out var state))state.Cursor=seconds;}
        internal float? PreviewCursor(string owner){var node=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==owner);if(node!=null)foreach(var binding in node.Payload.Definitions)if(_timelineStates.TryGetValue(_document.GetInstanceID()+":"+binding.LocalId,out var state))return state.Cursor;return null;}
        /// <summary>Whether an eligible leaf animation is currently edited inside its owning Timeline.</summary>
        public bool IsTimelineInline(string id)=>id!=null&&_inlineOwners.ContainsKey(id);
        private void BuildTimelinePresentation(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            _compactOwners.Clear();_inlineOwners.Clear();
            var uses=graph.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events.Select(e=>new{timeline=t,entry=e})).Where(x=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(x.entry.EntryNodeId)).GroupBy(x=>x.entry.EntryNodeId).ToDictionary(g=>g.Key,g=>g.ToArray());
            foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){
                var action=(node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;if(action==null)continue;
                var descriptor=GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType());
                if(!descriptor.IsAnimation)continue; // End remains a real terminal card in the business flow.
                if(!uses.TryGetValue(node.Id,out var calls)||calls.Length!=1||graph.Connections.Any(e=>e.FromNodeId==node.Id||e.ToNodeId==node.Id))continue;
                if(calls[0].entry.Conditions.Length>0||!(calls[0].entry.Target is GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring))continue;
                string timeline=calls[0].timeline.Id;var owners=graph.Nodes.Where(n=>n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==timeline)).ToArray();if(owners.Length!=1||owners[0].Id==node.Id)continue;
                var resources=new HashSet<string>();Action<string> visit=null;visit=id=>{if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)||!resources.Add(id))return;var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==id);if(local!=null)foreach(var binding in local.Definitions)visit(binding.LocalId);};
                foreach(var binding in node.Payload.Definitions)visit(binding.LocalId);
                if(graph.Connections.Any(e=>resources.Contains(e.FromNodeId)))continue;
                if(_inlineOwners.Values.Contains(owners[0].Id))continue;
                _compactOwners[node.Id]=owners[0].Id;
                if(!SessionState.GetBool(GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".Standalone."+node.Id,false))_inlineOwners[node.Id]=owners[0].Id;
            }
        }
        private IEnumerable<string> SelectedBehaviorIds(IEnumerable<Node> cards)
        {
            foreach(var card in cards.Where(c=>!c.viewDataKey.StartsWith("Config:",StringComparison.Ordinal)))yield return _selectedInlineAction!=null&&_inlineOwners.TryGetValue(_selectedInlineAction,out var owner)&&card.viewDataKey==owner?_selectedInlineAction:card.viewDataKey;
        }
        private void SelectScheduledEntry(string eventId,string ownerId=null)
        {
            var timeline=_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.Events.Any(e=>e.Id==eventId));var entry=timeline?.Events.FirstOrDefault(e=>e.Id==eventId);if(entry==null)return;
            SelectedEventId=eventId;
            ownerId=ownerId??_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n=>n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==timeline.Id))?.Id;
            if(ownerId!=null)PreviewSeeked?.Invoke(ownerId,eventId,entry.TimeSeconds);
            if(_timelineStates.TryGetValue(_document.GetInstanceID()+":"+timeline.Id,out var state)){state.SelectedEventId=eventId;state.Save();}
            SelectNodeWithoutCamera(entry.EntryNodeId);HighlightBehavior(entry.EntryNodeId);Selected?.Invoke(entry.EntryNodeId);MarkDirtyRepaint();
            // IMGUI event rows can leave keyboard focus in the previous Inspector container.
            // Return it to the selected behavior so native Copy/Paste/Delete reach GraphView.
            schedule.Execute(()=>{if(panel!=null)Focus();});
        }
        private void HighlightBehavior(string id)
        {
            foreach(var timeline in _document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines)
                if(_timelineStates.TryGetValue(_document.GetInstanceID()+":"+timeline.Id,out var state)){state.SelectedNodeId=id;state.SelectedEventId=timeline.Events.Any(e=>e.Id==SelectedEventId&&e.EntryNodeId==id)?SelectedEventId:null;}
            foreach(var wire in edges){var socket=wire.userData as Socket;bool related=wire.input?.node?.viewDataKey==id||wire.output?.node?.viewDataKey==id||socket?.Scheduled==true&&_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events).Any(e=>e.Id==socket.Owner&&e.EntryNodeId==id);wire.edgeControl.edgeWidth=related?4:2;}
        }
        /// <summary>Explicit advanced view action. Reveals the existing behavior without creating
        /// a node, execution edge, SO, Undo record or dirty source.</summary>
        public void RevealTimelineAction(string id)
        {
            if(!_compactOwners.ContainsKey(id)){Selected?.Invoke(id);FocusNode(id);return;}
            SessionState.SetBool(GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".Standalone."+id,true);Load(_document);Selected?.Invoke(id);FocusNode(id);
        }
        private void CompactTimelineAction(string id)
        {
            if(!_compactOwners.ContainsKey(id))return;
            SessionState.SetBool(GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".Standalone."+id,false);Load(_document);SelectNodeWithoutCamera(id);Selected?.Invoke(id);
        }
        private void ResourcePort(Node card,GameplayLocalDefinition definition,GameplayDefinitionBinding binding,string key)
        {
            var port=AddPort(card,definition.Id,key);string role=binding.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect"?"冷却":definition.Payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData?"弹体":definition.Payload is GameplayAreaDefinitionData?"区域":definition.Payload is GameplayEffectDefinitionData?"效果":null;
            if(role=="冷却"&&(key==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion||key.StartsWith("Completion/",StringComparison.Ordinal)))port.portName=key==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion?"冷却到期 · 添加效果":"冷却到期 · 续接效果";
            else if(role!=null&&role!="效果")port.portName=role+" · "+port.portName;
            if(GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(definition.Payload).Any(s=>s.Key==key)){
                var slots=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(definition.Payload).Where(s=>s.IsCompletion==key.StartsWith("Completion/",StringComparison.Ordinal)).ToList();
                port.portName=(role=="冷却"?"冷却到期":key.StartsWith("Completion/",StringComparison.Ordinal)?"到期":"溢出")+" → 效果 "+(slots.FindIndex(s=>s.Key==key)+1);
                if(!_document.AuthoringGraph.Connections.Any(e=>e.FromNodeId==definition.Id&&e.OutputPortKey==key))port.portName+=" · 待接";
            }else if(key==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion||key==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Overflow)
                port.portName=role=="冷却"?"＋ 冷却到期":key==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion?"＋ 到期效果":"＋ 溢出效果";
            port.tooltip=port.portName+"\n"+port.tooltip;
        }
    }
}

using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEngine;
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Transient semantic role; containers never inherit their children's execution role.</summary>
    public enum GameplayNodeVisualKind { Neutral, Ability, Condition, Sequence, Target, Effect, Presentation, Continuation, World, Action, End }
    public static class GameplayNodeVisuals
    {
        public static readonly string[] Labels={"配置","释放 / 消耗 / 冷却","条件 / 分支","编排 / 动画","目标搜索","伤害 / 效果","表现","后续 / 完成","世界行为","规则动作","结束技能 / 终止"};
        private static readonly Color[] Colors={new Color(.48f,.52f,.58f),new Color(.95f,.57f,.25f),new Color(.94f,.78f,.27f),new Color(.30f,.61f,.94f),new Color(.22f,.76f,.88f),new Color(.91f,.35f,.39f),new Color(.36f,.78f,.43f),new Color(.72f,.48f,.92f),new Color(.20f,.70f,.65f),new Color(.42f,.58f,.84f),new Color(.83f,.47f,.62f)};
        public static Color Color(GameplayNodeVisualKind kind)=>Colors[(int)kind];
        public static GameplayNodeVisualKind Classify(object value)
        {
            if(value is GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring || value is GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Condition;
            if(value is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring || value is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Target;
            if(value is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.End;
            if(value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset || value is GameplaySummonDefinitionAsset || value is GameplaySpawnSummonActionAuthoring || value is GameplaySpawnProjectileActionAuthoring || value is GameplaySpawnAreaActionAuthoring || value is GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring || value is GameplayRotateToPointActionAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.World;
            if(value is GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring || value is GameplayAbilityChargeAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Ability;
            if(value is GameplayContinuationDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring || value is GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Continuation;
            if(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset || value is GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring || value is GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring || value is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring || value is GameplayDispelEffectsActionAuthoring || value is GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring || value is GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Effect;
            if(value is GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Presentation;
            if(value is GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset || value is GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring || value is GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring || value is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring || value is GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Sequence;
            if(value is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring) return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Action;
            return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Neutral;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>A read-only lease for explicit physical asset operations. Any project, scene,
    /// Undo or on-disk input change invalidates the audit. It loads no artwork and never saves
    /// the user's pending edits. Revalidation happens immediately before synchronous mutation.</summary>
    [InitializeOnLoad]
    public sealed class GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease
    {
        private static long _revision;
        private readonly long _start;
        private readonly Dictionary<string,string> _files;
        private readonly bool _physical;
        static GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease()
        {
            EditorApplication.projectChanged+=()=>_revision++;
            EditorApplication.hierarchyChanged+=()=>_revision++;
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed+=()=>_revision++;
            Undo.postprocessModifications+=changes=>{_revision++;return changes;};
        }
        private GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease(bool physical)
        {
            _physical=physical;RequireSaved(physical);_start=_revision;
            _files=Paths().ToDictionary(p=>p,Stamp,StringComparer.Ordinal);
        }
        public static GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease Capture(bool physical=true)=>new GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease(physical);
        private static string[] Paths()=>AssetDatabase.GetAllAssetPaths().Where(p=>p.StartsWith("Assets/",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&File.Exists(p)).OrderBy(p=>p,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
        private static string Stamp(string path)
        {
            var file=new FileInfo(path);var meta=new FileInfo(path+".meta");
            return file.Length+":"+file.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks+":"+(meta.Exists?meta.Length+":"+meta.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks:"missing");
        }
        public static void RequireSaved(bool physical=true)
        {
            if(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode||EditorApplication.isCompiling||EditorApplication.isUpdating)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("退出 Play 并等待导入/编译完成后重试资产审计。");
            for(int i=0;physical&&i<UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.sceneCount;i++)if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i).isDirty)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("存在未保存的 Scene；审计没有保存或删除任何内容。");
            if(Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<ScriptableObject>().Any(a=>AssetDatabase.Contains(a)&&EditorUtility.IsDirty(a)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("存在未保存的资源；请先处理自己的修改，再重新审计。");
        }
        public void Revalidate()
        {
            RequireSaved(_physical);
            if(_revision!=_start)throw new InvalidOperationException("审计期间项目、Scene 或编辑状态发生变化；请重新审计。");
            var paths=Paths();
            if(paths.Length!=_files.Count||paths.Any(p=>!_files.TryGetValue(p,out var stamp)||stamp!=Stamp(p)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("审计输入文件或 meta 已变更；没有提交物理操作。");
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Whole-file deletion is an explicit asset operation. Audit indexed dependency
    /// paths in bounded editor slices, without loading their art or running during ordinary Delete.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillAssetDeletion
    {
        public static void Begin(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, Action<bool,string> completed)
        {
            if (!document || !AssetDatabase.Contains(document) || AssetDatabase.IsSubAsset(document))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("只能物理删除独立的主技能文件；嵌入技能需明确处理容器归属。");
            if (EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("退出 Play 后才能删除正式资源。");
            for(int i=0;i<UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.sceneCount;i++)
                if(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.GetSceneAt(i).isDirty)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("存在未保存的 Scene；请先保存或还原，以便按真实引用审计物理删除。");
            if(UnityEngine.Resources.FindObjectsOfTypeAll<UnityEngine.ScriptableObject>().Any(a=>a!=document&&AssetDatabase.Contains(a)&&EditorUtility.IsDirty(a)))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("存在未保存的资源；请先保存或还原，以便审计其真实引用。");
            string target = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(document);
            var lease=GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease.Capture();
            string guid = AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(target);
            string[] paths = AssetDatabase.GetAllAssetPaths().Where(p => p.StartsWith("Assets/",StringComparison.Ordinal) && p != target && File.Exists(p)).ToArray();
            var users = new List<string>(); int cursor = 0; bool invalidated=false;

            EditorApplication.projectChanged+=changed;
            EditorApplication.CallbackFunction step = null;
            step = () => {
                try {
                    double stop = EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup + .008; int count = 0;
                    while (cursor < paths.Length && count++ < 128 && EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup < stop) {
                        string path = paths[cursor++];
                        if (AssetDatabase.GetDependencies(path,false).Contains(target)) users.Add(path);
                    }
                    if (cursor < paths.Length) return;
                    EditorApplication.update -= step;EditorApplication.projectChanged-=changed;
                    if (users.Count != 0) { completed(false,"保留主技能：仍被 " + users.Count + " 个文件引用。\n" + string.Join("\n",users.Take(8))); return; }
                    if (invalidated || !document || EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode || AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(target) != guid)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("审计期间目标或 Editor 状态已改变；没有删除文件。");
                    lease.Revalidate();
                    if (!AssetDatabase.MoveAssetToTrash(target)) throw new IOException("Unity 未能将主技能移入回收站："+target);
                    completed(true,"引用审计完成，主技能已移入回收站。");
                } catch (Exception error) { EditorApplication.update -= step;EditorApplication.projectChanged-=changed; completed(false,error.Message); }
            };
            EditorApplication.update += step;
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Ephemeral editor invalidation, resolved to stable authoring IDs before Apply.
    /// It is never serialized or consumed by the compiler. Unknown writers retain full fallback.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillAuthoringChange
    {
        public bool Unknown {get;private set;}
        public bool Structural {get;private set;}
        public bool Context {get;private set;}
        public bool Layout {get;private set;}
        public IReadOnlyCollection<string> Owners {get;private set;}
        private GameplaySkillAuthoringChange() { }
        private static readonly HashSet<string> StructuralFields=new HashSet<string>{"Action","Payload","Settings","Target","Trigger","size","Mode","CastEvent","Scope","Once"};
        private static readonly HashSet<string> ContextFields=new HashSet<string>{"Target","Trigger","Conditions","PreserveTriggerContext","Shape","Origin","Direction","Directional","RotateOwner","DurationPolicy","Motion","StraightDestination","Overflow","Period","PeriodValue","TickInterval","Cancel"};
        public static GameplaySkillAuthoringChange Full(bool structural=false)=>new GameplaySkillAuthoringChange{Unknown=true,Structural=structural,Context=true,Owners=Array.Empty<string>()};
        public static GameplaySkillAuthoringChange Local(IEnumerable<string> owners,bool layout=false)=>new GameplaySkillAuthoringChange{Owners=owners.Where(x=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(x)).Distinct().ToArray(),Layout=layout};
        /// <summary>Array indexes are used only while resolving this immediate edit. Consumers
        /// receive stable IDs; later reorder/Undo cannot redirect an old invalidation.</summary>
        public static GameplaySkillAuthoringChange Fields(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,IEnumerable<string> paths,bool structural=false)
        {
            if(paths==null)return Full(structural);
            var change=new GameplaySkillAuthoringChange();var owners=new HashSet<string>();var graph=document.AuthoringGraph;
            foreach(string path in paths.Distinct()){
                if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))return Full(structural);
                string relative=path,owner=graph.AbilityNodeId;
                if(path.StartsWith("authoringGraph.",StringComparison.Ordinal)){
                    if(Resolve("Nodes",graph.Nodes.Count,i=>graph.Nodes[i].Id)||Resolve("LocalDefinitions",graph.LocalDefinitions.Count,i=>graph.LocalDefinitions[i].Id)||Resolve("Timelines",graph.Timelines.Count,i=>graph.Timelines[i].Id)) { }
                    else if(path=="authoringGraph.Scope")change.Structural=true;
                    else return Full(structural);
                }
                if(owner!=null)owners.Add(owner);
                string[] fields=relative.Split('.');string leaf=fields.Last();
                if(StructuralFields.Contains(leaf)||fields.Contains("Definitions")||fields.Contains("CastEvent")||fields.Contains("Trigger")&&fields.Contains("EventTag")||leaf=="Conditions")change.Structural=true;
                if(fields.Any(ContextFields.Contains))change.Context=true;
                if(fields.Any(f=>f=="Position"||f=="Size"))change.Layout=true;
                bool Resolve(string collection,int count,Func<int,string> identity){
                    string prefix="authoringGraph."+collection+".Array.data[";
                    if(!path.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal))return false;
                    int end=path.IndexOf(']',prefix.Length);int index;
                    if(end<0||!int.TryParse(path.Substring(prefix.Length,end-prefix.Length),out index)||index<0||index>=count)return false;
                    owner=identity(index);relative=path.Substring(Math.Min(end+2,path.Length));return true;
                }
            }
            change.Owners=owners.ToArray();change.Structural|=structural;
            return change.Owners.Count==0?Full(change.Structural):change;
        }
    }
}

            var references=template?GameplaySkillCopyReferences.Audit(template):null;

            if(references!=null&&references.Where(r=>r.CooldownGroup!=null).GroupBy(r=>r.CooldownGroup).Any(g=>g.Any(r=>preserve.Contains(r.Path))&&g.Any(r=>!preserve.Contains(r.Path))))throw new ArgumentException("本地冷却的授予、门禁和业务引用必须整组独立化或整组共享。");

            string catalogJson=catalog?EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(catalog):null;

            var document = template?UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(template):ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset>();
            Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();int undoGroup=Undo.GetCurrentGroup();bool catalogTouched=false,created=false;

            var graph = new GameplayAuthoringGraph { Scope = scope };

                var generatedTags=template?GameplaySkillCopyReferences.Apply(document,references,preserve,catalogScope):new List<string>();
                generatedTags.Add(document.CastEvent.Name);

                CreationFailureInjection?.Invoke("after-create");

                CreationFailureInjection?.Invoke("after-catalog-save");

            }

                if(created&&AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(path)==document){if(!AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path))throw new InvalidOperationException("创建失败且 Unity 未能清理新文件："+path);}

        internal static string GeneratedSkillTag(string scope,string prefix,string suffix) =>
            prefix+(scope==GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Framework?"":scope+".")+suffix;

        /// <summary>Reference viewing is a workbench mode, never a second skill runtime source.</summary>
        internal static GameplaySkillDocumentAsset ReadOnlyDocument;
        internal static bool IsReadOnly(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)=>document&&document==ReadOnlyDocument;
        private static GameplayAuthoringGraph CopyGraph(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset source,GameplaySkillDocumentAsset destination)
        {
            var original=source.AuthoringGraph;
            var ids=original.Nodes.Select(n=>n.Id).Concat(original.LocalDefinitions.Select(d=>d.Id)).Concat(original.Timelines.Select(t=>t.Id)).Concat(original.Connections.Select(e=>e.Id)).Concat(original.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events).Select(e=>e.Id)).ToHashSet();
            string json=JsonUtility.ToJson(original);
            foreach(System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match match in System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Matches(json,"\"AuthoringId\":\"([a-f0-9]{32})\""))ids.Add(match.Groups[1].Value);
            foreach(string id in ids)json=json.Replace(id,GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId());
            var graph=JsonUtility.FromJson<GameplayAuthoringGraph>(json);
            foreach(var node in graph.Nodes){node.SourceDefinitionId=destination.DefinitionId;node.SourceActionId=-1;}
            foreach(var local in graph.LocalDefinitions)local.SourceDefinitionId=destination.DefinitionId;
            foreach(var timeline in graph.Timelines)timeline.SourceDefinitionId=destination.DefinitionId;
            return graph;
        }

        public static string CreateRule(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, Vector2 position)
        {
            string id = GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
            Transaction(document, "创建触发规则", graph => {
                graph.Nodes.Add(new GameplayAuthoringNode { Id = id, Title = "触发规则", Position = position, Payload = new GameplayRuleNodePayload {
                    Trigger = new GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring { EventTag = document.CastEvent }, Target = new GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring() } });
                // New rules stay drafts until explicitly enabled after connecting real actions.
            }); return id;
        }

        public static void Transaction(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string label, Action<GameplayAuthoringGraph> change, bool structural=true, GameplaySkillAuthoringChange invalidation=null, IEnumerable<string> generatedTags=null)
        {
            Editable(document);
            var graph = (GameplayAuthoringGraph)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(document.AuthoringGraph);
            GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.ExposeBindings(graph);
            change(graph);
            GameplayBehaviorGraphView.FollowMainAnimationDurations(document,graph);
            GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.ExposeBindings(graph);
            var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
            GameplayGraphCompiler.ValidateStructure(graph, validation, label, false);
            if (validation.HasErrors) throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Join("\n", validation.Issues));
            GameplayGraphCompiler.ValidateActionOrder(graph);
            GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset catalog=null;string[] nextTags=null;
            if(generatedTags!=null){
                catalog=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(document),out string error);
                if(!catalog)throw new InvalidOperationException(error);
                nextTags=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.WithRegistrations(catalog,generatedTags);
            }
            if(catalog&&EditorUtility.IsDirty(catalog))throw new InvalidOperationException("Tag Catalog 有未保存修改；先保存后创建自动Tag。");
            Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(document, label);
            if(catalog&&!nextTags.SequenceEqual(catalog.Tags)){Undo.RecordObject(catalog,label);catalog.Tags=nextTags;EditorUtility.SetDirty(catalog);AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(catalog);}
            document.SetAuthoringGraph(graph); EditorUtility.SetDirty(document);
            Publish(document,invalidation??GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Full(structural));
        }

        private static void Editable(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        {
            if(IsReadOnly(document))throw new InvalidOperationException("只读范例；请先以此创建新技能。");
            if (!document || document.AuthoringSchemaVersion != 2 || document.AuthoringGraph == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("此数据格式不能创作，请使用 Schema 2 正式技能。");
            if (EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode) throw new InvalidOperationException("请退出 Play 后编辑正式技能。");
        }

        /// <summary>Removes a resource-array entry and shifts its explicit bindings together.
        /// Other references to the same local definition and external assets remain intact.</summary>
        public static void RemoveResourceEntry(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string ownerId,string path,int index)
        {
            Transaction(document,"移除资源引用",graph=>{
                var node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==ownerId);var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==ownerId);
                object payload=node?.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload ability?ability.Settings:node?.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action?action.Action:local?.Payload;
                var bindings=node?.Payload.Definitions??local.Definitions;
                var slot=GameplayGraphFields.ResourceSlots(payload).Single(s=>s.Path==path+".Array.data["+index+"]");
                var array=(Array)slot.Field.GetValue(slot.Owner);var next=Array.CreateInstance(array.GetType().GetElementType(),array.Length-1);
                int at=0;for(int i=0;i<array.Length;i++)if(i!=index)next.SetValue(array.GetValue(i),at++);
                slot.Field.SetValue(slot.Owner,next);
                string prefix=path+".Array.data[";var released=new List<string>();
                foreach(var binding in bindings.ToArray())if(binding.PropertyPath.StartsWith(prefix,StringComparison.Ordinal)){
                    int end=binding.PropertyPath.IndexOf(']',prefix.Length);int old=int.Parse(binding.PropertyPath.Substring(prefix.Length,end-prefix.Length));
                    if(old==index){released.Add(binding.LocalId);bindings.Remove(binding);}
                    else if(old>index)binding.PropertyPath=prefix+(old-1)+binding.PropertyPath.Substring(end);
                }
                CollectOwned(graph,released.Where(id=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)));
            });
        }

        public static void NotifyFields(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        { Publish(document,GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Full()); }
        public static void NotifyFields(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,GameplaySkillAuthoringChange change)=>Publish(document,change);

        public static string CreateAction(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, GameplaySkillActionAuthoring action, string title,
            Vector2 position, GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload definition = null, string slot = null, string timelineId = null, float? seconds = null, CreationLink link=null, IEnumerable<string> generatedTags=null)
        {
            string id = GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
            Transaction(document, "创建 " + title, graph =>
            {
                var payload = new GameplayActionNodePayload { Action = action };
                var node = new GameplayAuthoringNode { Id = id, Title = title, Payload = payload, Position = position, SourceDefinitionId = document.DefinitionId };
                graph.Nodes.Add(node);
                if (definition != null)
                {
                    var local = new GameplayLocalDefinition { Name = title, SourceDefinitionId = document.DefinitionId, Payload = definition };
                    graph.LocalDefinitions.Add(local); payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding { PropertyPath = slot, LocalId = local.Id });
                }
                ConnectCreated(graph,link,id);
                if (timelineId != null)
                {
                    var timeline = graph.Timelines.Single(t => t.Id == timelineId);
                    timeline.Events.Add(new GameplayScheduledEntry { TimeSeconds = seconds ?? 0, EntryNodeId = id,
                        Order = timeline.Events.Count == 0 ? 0 : timeline.Events.Max(e => e.Order) + 1, Target = new GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring() });
                }
            },generatedTags:generatedTags);
            return id;
        }

        public static string CreateSequence(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, Vector2 position,CreationLink link=null)
        {
            string id = GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
            Transaction(document, "创建时间编排", graph =>
            {
                var timeline = new GameplayAuthoringTimeline { Name = "时间编排", SourceDefinitionId = document.DefinitionId };
                graph.Timelines.Add(timeline);
                var payload = new GameplayActionNodePayload { Action = new GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring() };
                payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding { PropertyPath = "Sequence", LocalId = timeline.Id });
                graph.Nodes.Add(new GameplayAuthoringNode { Id = id, Title = "时间编排", Payload = payload, Position = position, SourceDefinitionId = document.DefinitionId });
                ConnectCreated(graph,link,id);
            });
            return id;
        }

        /// <summary>Explicitly creates a private callback receiver. Only this macro assigns
        /// ownership; connecting a pre-existing draft never transfers its ownership. The overflow
        /// variant also enables ExecuteOverflow with its first executor in the same transaction.</summary>
        public static string CreateOwnedEffectCallback(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string owner,string port,GameplayEffectDefinitionData values,Vector2 position)
        {
            string id=GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
            Transaction(document,"创建随所有者删除的后续效果",graph=>{
                // The explicit overflow menu enables the policy and its first real executor
                // together; an ExecuteOverflow policy with an empty rule list is not valid.
                if(port==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Overflow)((GameplayEffectDefinitionData)graph.LocalDefinitions.Single(d=>d.Id==owner).Payload).Stacking.Overflow=GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow;
                var local=new GameplayLocalDefinition{Name="后续效果",Payload=values,SourceDefinitionId=document.DefinitionId};
                var node=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Id=id,Title="后续效果",Position=position,CallbackOwnerDefinitionId=owner,Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring()}};
                node.Payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath="Effect",LocalId=local.Id});
                graph.LocalDefinitions.Add(local);graph.Nodes.Add(node);ConnectInGraph(graph,owner,port,id,GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input);
            });return id;
        }

        /// <summary>Deletes the executor and its flags explicitly. Ordinary disconnect keeps it
        /// as pending authoring configuration with the same stable callback identity.</summary>
        public static void RemoveEffectCallback(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string owner,string port)=>Transaction(document,"删除生命周期回调及配置",graph=>{
            var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Single(d=>d.Id==owner);var effect=(GameplayEffectDefinitionData)local.Payload;
            graph.Connections.RemoveAll(e=>e.FromNodeId==owner&&e.OutputPortKey==port);GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Remove(effect,port);
        });

        /// <summary>An explicit template inserts ordinary, editable graph entities as a draft.
        /// The author connects its sequence to a rule; no hidden scheduling is inferred.</summary>
        public static string CreateDamageTemplate(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, Vector2 position)
        {
            string id=GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
            Transaction(document,"创建逐目标伤害模板",graph=>{
                var timeline=new GameplayAuthoringTimeline{Name="逐目标伤害编排",DurationSeconds=1};
                var effect=new GameplayLocalDefinition{Name="逐目标伤害",Payload=new GameplayEffectDefinitionData{
                    DurationPolicy=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant,Executions=new GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring[]{new GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring()}}};
                var sequence=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Id=id,Title="伤害编排",Position=position,Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=new GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring()}};
                sequence.Payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath="Sequence",LocalId=timeline.Id});
                var search=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Title="搜索目标",Position=position+new Vector2(490,0),Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=new GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring()}};
                var damage=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Title="造成伤害",Position=position+new Vector2(820,0),Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring()}};
                damage.Payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath="Effect",LocalId=effect.Id});
                var end=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Title="结束施放",Position=position+new Vector2(490,330),Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload{Action=new GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring()}};
                timeline.Events.Add(new GameplayScheduledEntry{EntryNodeId=search.Id,TimeSeconds=8f/30,Target=new GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring()});
                timeline.Events.Add(new GameplayScheduledEntry{EntryNodeId=end.Id,TimeSeconds=1,Order=1,Target=new GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring()});
                graph.Nodes.AddRange(new[]{sequence,search,damage,end});graph.Timelines.Add(timeline);graph.LocalDefinitions.Add(effect);
                graph.Connections.Add(new GameplayAuthoringConnection{FromNodeId=search.Id,OutputPortKey="EachTarget",ToNodeId=damage.Id});
            });return id;
        }

        /// <summary>One creation transaction can consume a dragged real execution/schedule port.
        /// No authoring data or Undo is published until the complete connection validates.</summary>
        public sealed class CreationLink {public string Owner,Port,Input="Execute";public bool Scheduled;}
        private static void ConnectCreated(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,CreationLink link,string id)
        {
            if(link==null)return;
            if(link.Scheduled){graph.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events).Single(e=>e.Id==link.Owner).EntryNodeId=id;return;}
            var old=graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==link.Owner&&e.OutputPortKey==link.Port).ToArray();
            var end=old.Length==1?graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==old[0].ToNodeId):null;
            bool insert=end?.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload terminal&&terminal.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring;
            if(insert)graph.Connections.Remove(old[0]);
            ConnectInGraph(graph,link.Owner,link.Port,id,link.Input);
            if(insert){
                var node=graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==id);var timeline=graph.Timelines.FirstOrDefault(t=>node.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id));
                if(timeline!=null)timeline.Events.Add(new GameplayScheduledEntry{EntryNodeId=end.Id,TimeSeconds=timeline.DurationSeconds,Target=new GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring()});
                else if(!StartsSpatialLifetime(node)&&GameplayGraphFields.OutputPorts(node).Contains("Then"))ConnectInGraph(graph,id,"Then",end.Id);
            }
        }

        internal static bool StartsSpatialLifetime(GameplayAuthoringNode node)=>node.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload p&&
            (p.Action is GameplaySpawnProjectileActionAuthoring||p.Action is GameplaySpawnAreaActionAuthoring||p.Action is GameplaySpawnSummonActionAuthoring);

        /// <summary>Author-selected ending for an actual spatial callback, or an explicitly
        /// world-owned local projectile. Replaces direct End associations from this start/its
        /// local resource in one Undo; other callback chains keep their authored behavior.
        /// Callers must review those retained paths or reused local consumers before replacement.
        /// No wait port, persisted policy mirror or shared SO write is introduced.</summary>
        public static void SetSpatialEnd(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,string endId,string port,bool worldOwned=false,bool reviewedRelatedPaths=false)
        {
            Transaction(document,"选择异步行为结束策略",graph=>{
                var node=graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==nodeId);
                if(!StartsSpatialLifetime(node)||!((graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==endId).Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring))throw new ArgumentException("请选择持续行为及真实结束节点。");
                var binding=node.Payload.Definitions.Single(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Projectile"||b.PropertyPath=="Area"||b.PropertyPath=="Summon");
                if(binding.External)throw new InvalidOperationException("共享来源只读；先明确转为本地配置再选择结束策略。");
                var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Single(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId);
                if(worldOwned&&!(local.Payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData))throw new InvalidOperationException("当前只有弹体支持脱离施放的世界托管。");
                if(!worldOwned&&!GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(local.Payload).Any(s=>s.Path==port))throw new ArgumentException("此资源没有所选生命周期出口。");
                if(!reviewedRelatedPaths&&SpatialEndReview(graph,nodeId)!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException("此行为还有手工回调或复用关系；请在结束策略菜单审核将保留和替换的连接。");
                if(local.Payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile)projectile.CancelOnAbilityEnd=!worldOwned;
                var ends=graph.Nodes.Where(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring).Select(n=>n.Id).ToHashSet();
                graph.Connections.RemoveAll(e=>ends.Contains(e.ToNodeId)&&(e.FromNodeId==nodeId&&e.OutputPortKey=="Then"||e.FromNodeId==local.Id));
                ConnectInGraph(graph,worldOwned?nodeId:local.Id,worldOwned?"Then":port,endId);
            });
        }

        // The graph itself remains the policy source after reopen/Undo. A direct End can be
        // replaced without removing damage/VFX receivers. Handwritten chains may end elsewhere;
        // show them and their shared local consumers instead of guessing their ownership.
        internal static string SpatialEndReview(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string nodeId)
        {
            var node=graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==nodeId);
            string local=node.Payload.Definitions.Single(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Projectile"||b.PropertyPath=="Area"||b.PropertyPath=="Summon").LocalId;
            var ends=graph.Nodes.Where(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring).Select(n=>n.Id).ToHashSet();
            var outgoing=graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==local||e.FromNodeId==nodeId&&e.OutputPortKey=="Then").ToArray();
            var replaced=outgoing.Where(e=>ends.Contains(e.ToNodeId)).ToArray();
            var retained=outgoing.Where(e=>!ends.Contains(e.ToNodeId)).ToArray();
            var consumers=graph.Nodes.Where(n=>n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==local)).ToArray();
            if(retained.Length==0&&replaced.Select(e=>e.ToNodeId).Distinct().Count()<=1&&consumers.Length<=1)return null;
            string Describe(GameplayAuthoringConnection e)=>e.OutputPortKey+" → "+GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Name(graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==e.ToNodeId),graph);
            return "替换直接结束关联：\n"+(replaced.Length==0?"（尚无）":string.Join("\n",replaced.Select(Describe)))+
                "\n\n完整保留手工回调及后继；其中的手工结束仍然生效：\n"+(retained.Length==0?"（无）":string.Join("\n",retained.Select(Describe)))+
                (consumers.Length>1?"\n\n此局部资源共用于以下动作，本次也影响这些调用者：\n"+string.Join("\n",consumers.Select(n=>GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Name(n,graph))):"");
        }

        public static void Connect(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string ownerId, string port, string targetId, bool scheduled = false,string inputPort="Execute")
        {
            Transaction(document, "连接正式行为", graph =>
            {
                if (scheduled)
                {
                    var entry = graph.Timelines.SelectMany(t => t.Events).Single(e => e.Id == ownerId);
                    if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.EntryNodeId)) throw new InvalidOperationException("时间事件已有入口；请先断开原连接。");
                    entry.EntryNodeId = targetId; return;
                }
                ConnectInGraph(graph,ownerId,port,targetId,inputPort);
            });
        }

        public static void Disconnect(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string id, bool scheduled = false)
        {
            Transaction(document, "断开执行", graph =>
            {
                if (scheduled)
                {
                    // A schedule without an entry is not a fake runtime event; remove that invocation.
                    foreach (var timeline in graph.Timelines) timeline.Events.RemoveAll(e => e.Id == id);
                }
                else DisconnectInGraph(graph,id);
            });
        }

        /// <summary>Timeline region resizing edits the actual typed constant declared by its
        /// integration metadata. It does not invent an End event or a separate duration source.</summary>
        public static void ResizeConstantDuration(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string localId,string valuePath,float seconds)
        {
            if(!float.IsFinite(seconds)||seconds<=0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(seconds));
            Transaction(document,"调整表现持续时间",graph=>{
                var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Single(d=>d.Id==localId);
                var value=GameplayGraphFields.ObjectPaths(local.Payload).Single(p=>p.Value==valuePath).Key as GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring;
                if(value==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("持续配置已改变，请重新选择此事件。");value.Value=seconds;
            },false,GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Local(new[]{localId}));
        }
        public static void MoveEvent(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string eventId, float seconds)
        {
            Transaction(document, "移动时间事件", graph =>
            {
                var owner = graph.Timelines.Single(t => t.Events.Any(e => e.Id == eventId));
                owner.Events.Single(e => e.Id == eventId).TimeSeconds = Mathf.Clamp(seconds, 0, owner.DurationSeconds);
            },false,GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Local(new[]{document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Single(t=>t.Events.Any(e=>e.Id==eventId)).Id}));
        }
        public static void Schedule(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string timelineId, string nodeId, float seconds)
        {
            Transaction(document,"安排已有行为",graph=>{
                var timeline=graph.Timelines.Single(t=>t.Id==timelineId);
                timeline.Events.Add(new GameplayScheduledEntry{EntryNodeId=nodeId,TimeSeconds=seconds,
                    Order=timeline.Events.Count==0?0:timeline.Events.Max(e=>e.Order)+1,Target=new GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring()});
            });
        }

        public static void MoveNodes(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, Vector2> positions)
        {
            Editable(document); Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(document, "移动行为节点");
            foreach (var node in document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes) if (positions.TryGetValue(node.Id, out var value)) node.Position = value;
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(document); Publish(document,GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Local(positions.Keys,true));
        }

        public static void Delete(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, IEnumerable<string> nodeIds)
        {
            var selected = new HashSet<string>(nodeIds);
            Transaction(document, "删除所选行为", graph => DeleteFromGraph(graph, selected));
        }
        internal static void DeleteFromGraph(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph, IEnumerable<string> nodeIds)
        {
                var selected = new HashSet<string>(nodeIds);
                if (selected.Contains(graph.AbilityNodeId))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("主卡请明确选择『清空技能内容』或『删除整个技能文件』。");
                var released = graph.Nodes.Where(n => selected.Contains(n.Id)).SelectMany(n => n.Payload.Definitions)
                    .Select(b => b.LocalId).Where(id => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)).ToArray();
                foreach (var id in selected)
                {
                    foreach(var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.ToNodeId==id&&e.InputPortKey==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input).ToArray())DisconnectInGraph(graph,edge.Id);
                    graph.Nodes.RemoveAll(n => n.Id == id);
                    graph.Connections.RemoveAll(e => e.FromNodeId == id || e.ToNodeId == id);
                    foreach (var timeline in graph.Timelines) timeline.Events.RemoveAll(e => e.EntryNodeId == id);
                    graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Remove(id);
                    if (graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId == id) graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId = null;
                }
                CollectOwned(graph, released);
        }

        public static void ReorderEvent(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string eventId, int direction)
        {
            Transaction(document, "调整同帧事件顺序", graph => {
                var timeline = graph.Timelines.Single(t => t.Events.Any(e => e.Id == eventId));
                var entry = timeline.Events.Single(e => e.Id == eventId);
                var peers = timeline.Events.Where(e => e.TimeSeconds == entry.TimeSeconds).OrderBy(e => e.Order).ToList();
                int at = peers.IndexOf(entry), next = Mathf.Clamp(at + direction, 0, peers.Count - 1);
                int order = peers[next].Order; peers[next].Order = entry.Order; entry.Order = order;
            },false);
        }

        /// <summary>Collects only definitions formerly owned by deleted calls. Unused migration
        /// drafts remain inspectable; shared external SOs are never removed by ordinary Delete.</summary>
        private static void CollectOwned(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph, IEnumerable<string> released)
        {
            var candidates = new HashSet<string>(released);
            bool changed;
            do
            {
                changed = false;
                var used = new HashSet<string>(graph.Nodes.SelectMany(n => n.Payload.Definitions).Concat(graph.LocalDefinitions.SelectMany(d => d.Definitions))
                    .Select(b => b.LocalId).Where(id => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)));
                foreach (var timeline in graph.Timelines.Where(t => candidates.Contains(t.Id) && !used.Contains(t.Id)).ToArray())
                {
                    var owned = new HashSet<string>();
                    Action<string> gather = null;
                    gather = id => { if (!owned.Add(id)) return; foreach (var e in graph.Connections.Where(e => e.FromNodeId == id)) gather(e.ToNodeId); };
                    foreach (var entry in timeline.Events) gather(entry.EntryNodeId);
                    var incomingElsewhere = new HashSet<string>(graph.Connections.Where(e => !owned.Contains(e.FromNodeId)).Select(e => e.ToNodeId)
                        .Concat(graph.Timelines.Where(t => t != timeline).SelectMany(t => t.Events).Select(e => e.EntryNodeId)));
                    var retained = new HashSet<string>();
                    Action<string> retain = null;
                    retain = id => { if (!owned.Contains(id) || !retained.Add(id)) return; foreach (var e in graph.Connections.Where(e => e.FromNodeId == id)) retain(e.ToNodeId); };
                    foreach (string id in incomingElsewhere) retain(id);
                    owned.ExceptWith(retained);
                    foreach (var binding in graph.Nodes.Where(n => owned.Contains(n.Id)).SelectMany(n => n.Payload.Definitions))
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.LocalId)) candidates.Add(binding.LocalId);
                    graph.Nodes.RemoveAll(n => owned.Contains(n.Id));
                    graph.Connections.RemoveAll(e => owned.Contains(e.FromNodeId) || owned.Contains(e.ToNodeId));
                    graph.Timelines.Remove(timeline); changed = true;
                }
                foreach (var definition in graph.LocalDefinitions.Where(d => candidates.Contains(d.Id) && !used.Contains(d.Id)).ToArray())
                {
                    foreach(var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==definition.Id&&e.InputPortKey==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input).ToArray()){
                        var receiver=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==edge.ToNodeId);
                        if(receiver?.CallbackOwnerDefinitionId==definition.Id&&!graph.Connections.Any(e=>e.ToNodeId==edge.ToNodeId&&e.FromNodeId!=definition.Id)&&!graph.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events).Any(e=>e.EntryNodeId==edge.ToNodeId))DeleteFromGraph(graph,new[]{edge.ToNodeId});
                    }
                    foreach(var receiver in graph.Nodes.Where(n=>n.CallbackOwnerDefinitionId==definition.Id))receiver.CallbackOwnerDefinitionId=null;
                    foreach (var binding in definition.Definitions) if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.LocalId)) candidates.Add(binding.LocalId);
                    graph.Connections.RemoveAll(e => e.FromNodeId == definition.Id);
                    graph.LocalDefinitions.Remove(definition); changed = true;
                }
            } while (changed);
        }

        public static void Clear(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        {
            Transaction(document, "清空技能内容", graph =>
            {
                graph.Nodes.Clear(); graph.Connections.Clear(); graph.Timelines.Clear(); graph.LocalDefinitions.Clear();
                var ability = new GameplayAuthoringNode { Title = "技能施放", Payload = new GameplayAbilityNodePayload { Settings = new GameplayAbilityDefinitionData() } };
                graph.Nodes.Add(ability); graph.AbilityNodeId = ability.Id; graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId = null; graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Clear();
            });
        }

        public static void Copy(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, IEnumerable<string> nodeIds)
        {
            var selected = new HashSet<string>(nodeIds);
            if(selected.Contains(document.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId)||document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Any(n=>selected.Contains(n.Id)&&n.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload))throw new InvalidOperationException("主施放卡不能复制为第二个根；请选择行为或触发规则。");
            var graph = (GameplayAuthoringGraph)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(document.AuthoringGraph);
            var needed = new HashSet<string>(selected);
            var defs = new HashSet<string>(); var timelines = new HashSet<string>();
            bool changed;
            do
            {
                int count = needed.Count + defs.Count + timelines.Count;
                foreach (var node in graph.Nodes.Where(n => needed.Contains(n.Id)))
                    foreach (var binding in node.Payload.Definitions.Where(b => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.LocalId)))
                    { if (graph.Timelines.Any(t => t.Id == binding.LocalId)) timelines.Add(binding.LocalId); else defs.Add(binding.LocalId); }
                foreach (var definition in graph.LocalDefinitions.Where(d => defs.Contains(d.Id)))
                    foreach (var binding in definition.Definitions.Where(b => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.LocalId))) defs.Add(binding.LocalId);
                foreach (var timeline in graph.Timelines.Where(t => timelines.Contains(t.Id))) foreach (var entry in timeline.Events) needed.Add(entry.EntryNodeId);
                foreach (var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e => (needed.Contains(e.FromNodeId) || defs.Contains(e.FromNodeId)) && e.OutputPortKey != "Then")) needed.Add(edge.ToNodeId);
                foreach (var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e => needed.Contains(e.FromNodeId) && e.OutputPortKey == "Then" && !selected.Contains(e.FromNodeId))) needed.Add(edge.ToNodeId);
                changed = count != needed.Count + defs.Count + timelines.Count;
            } while (changed);
            graph.Nodes.RemoveAll(n => !needed.Contains(n.Id)); graph.LocalDefinitions.RemoveAll(d => !defs.Contains(d.Id));
            graph.Timelines.RemoveAll(t => !timelines.Contains(t.Id));
            graph.Connections.RemoveAll(e => !(needed.Contains(e.FromNodeId) || defs.Contains(e.FromNodeId)) || !needed.Contains(e.ToNodeId));
            graph.LegacyResources.Clear(); _clipboard = graph;
        }

        public static string[] Paste(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, Vector2 offset,bool activateRules=true)
        {
            if (_clipboard == null) return Array.Empty<string>();
            var copy = (GameplayAuthoringGraph)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(_clipboard);
            var map = new Dictionary<string, string>();
            foreach (string id in copy.Nodes.Select(n => n.Id).Concat(copy.LocalDefinitions.Select(d => d.Id)).Concat(copy.Timelines.Select(t => t.Id))
                .Concat(copy.Timelines.SelectMany(t => t.Events).Select(e => e.Id))) map[id] = GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId();
            foreach (var node in copy.Nodes)
            {
                node.Id = map[node.Id]; node.Position += offset; node.SourceActionId = -1; node.SourceDefinitionId = document.DefinitionId;
                node.CallbackOwnerDefinitionId=!string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.CallbackOwnerDefinitionId)&&map.TryGetValue(node.CallbackOwnerDefinitionId,out var owner)?owner:null;
                foreach (var b in node.Payload.Definitions) if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.LocalId)) b.LocalId = map[b.LocalId];
            }
            foreach (var d in copy.LocalDefinitions) { d.Id = map[d.Id]; d.SourceDefinitionId = document.DefinitionId; foreach (var b in d.Definitions) if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(b.LocalId)) b.LocalId = map[b.LocalId]; }
            foreach (var timeline in copy.Timelines) { timeline.Id = map[timeline.Id]; foreach (var e in timeline.Events) { e.Id = map[e.Id]; e.EntryNodeId = map[e.EntryNodeId]; } }
            foreach (var edge in copy.Connections) { edge.Id = GameplayAuthoringGraph.NewId(); edge.FromNodeId = map[edge.FromNodeId]; edge.ToNodeId = map[edge.ToNodeId]; }
            Transaction(document, activateRules?"粘贴为正式规则 / 行为":"粘贴为未启用规则 / 未接入行为", graph => { graph.Nodes.AddRange(copy.Nodes); graph.LocalDefinitions.AddRange(copy.LocalDefinitions); graph.Timelines.AddRange(copy.Timelines); graph.Connections.AddRange(copy.Connections);
                if(activateRules)foreach(var rule in copy.Nodes.Where(n=>n.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload))ActivateRule(graph,rule.Id,true);
            });
            return copy.Nodes.Select(n => n.Id).ToArray();
        }
        public static void SetRuleActive(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,bool active)=>Transaction(document,active?"启用正式触发规则":"停用触发规则",graph=>ActivateRule(graph,nodeId,active));
        private static void ActivateRule(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string nodeId,bool active)
        {
            if(!(graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==nodeId).Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload))throw new InvalidOperationException("请选择触发规则。");
            if(!active){if(graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId==nodeId)throw new InvalidOperationException("主施放入口不能停用；可清空技能内容。");graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Remove(nodeId);return;}
            if(!graph.Connections.Any(e=>e.FromNodeId==nodeId&&e.OutputPortKey=="Actions"))throw new InvalidOperationException("请先连接真实行为，再启用此规则。");
            if(graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId==nodeId||graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Contains(nodeId))return;
            if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId))graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId=nodeId;else graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Add(nodeId);
        }
        public static int LocalUseCount(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string id)=>graph.Nodes.SelectMany(n=>n.Payload.Definitions).Concat(graph.LocalDefinitions.SelectMany(d=>d.Definitions)).Count(b=>b.LocalId==id);
        public static void DeleteLocalDefinition(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string id)=>Transaction(document,"删除未使用局部配置",graph=>{
            int count=LocalUseCount(graph,id);if(count>0)throw new InvalidOperationException("此配置仍有 "+count+" 处引用；先解除引用。");
            CollectOwned(graph,new HashSet<string>{id});
        });
        internal static void CollectReleased(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,IEnumerable<string> ids)=>CollectOwned(graph,new HashSet<string>(ids.Where(id=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id))));
        internal static void ConnectInGraph(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string owner,string port,string target,string input="Execute")
        {
            if(input==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input){
                var source=graph.LocalDefinitions.Single(d=>d.Id==owner);var effect=source.Payload as GameplayEffectDefinitionData;
                if(effect==null||GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.EffectBinding(graph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==target))==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("生命周期端口需要真实 Effect 定义输入。");
                string blocked=GameplayGraphPortPolicy.Unavailable(effect,port);if(blocked!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException(blocked);
                if(port==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion||port==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Overflow)port=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Add(effect,port==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion);
                else if(graph.Connections.Any(e=>e.FromNodeId==owner&&e.OutputPortKey==port))throw new InvalidOperationException("回调已有连接；请先断开。");
            }
            var peers=graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==owner&&e.OutputPortKey==port).ToArray();if(peers.Any(e=>e.ToNodeId==target))throw new InvalidOperationException("执行关系已存在。");
            graph.Connections.Add(new GameplayAuthoringConnection{FromNodeId=owner,OutputPortKey=port,ToNodeId=target,InputPortKey=input,Order=peers.Length==0?0:peers.Max(e=>e.Order)+1});
        }
        internal static void DisconnectInGraph(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string id)
        {
            var edge=graph.Connections.SingleOrDefault(e=>e.Id==id);if(edge==null)return;
            graph.Connections.Remove(edge);
        }
    }
}

            {"Nearest","最近"},{"Farthest","最远"},{"Random","随机"},{"Distance","按距离"},
            {"Restart","重新开始"},{"Reduce","减少"},{"Increase","增加"},{"Reset","重置"},{"Set","设置"},{"Clear","清除"},
            {"Add","加法"},{"Multiply","乘法"},{"Override","覆盖"},{"Replace","替换"},

            {"AggregateByTarget","按目标"},{"AggregateBySource","按来源 ID"},{"AggregateByInstigator","按施法者"},
            {"SharedEntryLifetime","共享时长"},{"IndependentLayerLifetime","各层独立时长"},
            {"RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication","成功施加时刷新"},{"NeverRefresh","不刷新"},
            {"NeverReset","不重置周期"},{"ResetOnSuccessfulApplication","成功施加时重置周期"},
            {"AfterFirstPeriod","首次间隔后"},{"Immediately","立即"},{"Reject","拒绝新增"},{"RefreshExistingAtLimit","到上限时刷新"},{"ExecuteOverflow","执行溢出效果"}
        };
        internal static string Display(string name)=>Labels.TryGetValue(name,out var label)?label:name;
        internal static List<string> Options(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            var names=property.enumNames;var labels=names.Select(Display).ToArray();

    }

    /// <summary>Derived card bindings. Stable owner IDs are resolved again after Undo/reorder;
    /// no values, SO copies, or execution data are retained by this adapter.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillCardFields
    {
        public sealed class Binding

        private static readonly IGameplaySkillCardFieldProvider[] Providers = TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplaySkillCardFieldProvider>()
            .Where(t => !t.IsAbstract && t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null).OrderBy(t => t.FullName)
            .Select(t => (IGameplaySkillCardFieldProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(t)).ToArray();

        public static List<Binding> Describe(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string nodeId)
        {
            using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(document))return Describe(document,nodeId,serialized);
        }
        internal static List<Binding> Describe(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,SerializedObject so,bool animationHeader=false)
        {
            var result = new List<Binding>();
            var graph = document.AuthoringGraph;
            int index = graph.Nodes.FindIndex(n => n.Id == nodeId);
            if (index < 0) return result;
            var node = graph.Nodes[index];
            string root = "authoringGraph.Nodes.Array.data[" + index + "].Payload";
            {
                Func<bool> sourceGuard=null;
                if (node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload ability)
                {
                    Add("DisplayName", "技能名称");
                    if (GameplayBehaviorGraphView.InlinePrimaryRule(document))
                    {
                        int ruleIndex=graph.Nodes.FindIndex(n=>n.Id==graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId);
                        Add("authoringGraph.Nodes.Array.data["+ruleIndex+"].Payload.Target","施放目标");
                    }
                }
                else if (node.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload rule)
                {
                    if (rule.Trigger is GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring) Add(root + ".Trigger.EventTag", "触发事件");
                    Add(root + ".Once", "仅一次");
                    Add(root+".Target","目标来源");
                }
                else if (node.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action) Values(action.Action, root + ".Action");

                foreach (var binding in node.Payload.Definitions)
                {
                    if(node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload&&binding.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect")continue;
                    var actionValues=(node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
                    // Historical nested bindings may accompany a lowered explicit child. Only
                    // the actual resource consumer owns its editor, never a Search wrapper.
                    if(actionValues!=null&&!GameplayGraphFields.ResourceSlots(actionValues).Any(s=>s.Path==binding.PropertyPath))continue;
                    if (binding.External)
                    { result.Add(new Binding { Label = "共享来源", Summary = GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.SharedSummary(binding.External) }); continue; }
                    int localIndex = graph.LocalDefinitions.FindIndex(d => d.Id == binding.LocalId);
                    if (localIndex < 0) continue;
                    var definition = graph.LocalDefinitions[localIndex];
                    sourceGuard=GameplaySkillFieldSchema.CaptureBinding(document,nodeId,binding.PropertyPath,binding.LocalId);
                    string prefix = "authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Array.data[" + localIndex + "].Payload";
                    if (binding.PropertyPath == "CooldownEffect" && definition.Payload is GameplayEffectDefinitionData cd)
                    { if (cd.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration) Add(prefix + (cd.DurationValue == null ? ".Duration" : ".DurationValue"), "冷却秒数", cd.DurationValue != null); }
                    else Values(definition.Payload, prefix);
                }

                void Add(string path, string label, bool value = false,IReadOnlyList<string> choices=null)
                {
                    var property = so.FindProperty(path);
                    if (property == null) return;
                    string summary = null;string sourcePath=value?path:null;
                    if (value)
                    {
                        if (property.managedReferenceValue is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring) {path += ".Value";label+=" · 常量";}
                        else {var ast=property.managedReferenceValue;string kind=ast is GameplaySetByCallerFloatValueAuthoring?"Caller":ast is GameplayAttributeFloatValueAuthoring?"属性":ast is GameplayFormulaFloatValueAuthoring?"Formula":"表达式";summary=kind+" · "+GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Value(ast as GameplayFloatValueAuthoring);}
                    }
                    result.Add(new Binding { Path = path, Label = label, Summary = summary,SourcePath=sourcePath,Choices=choices,SourceGuard=sourceGuard });
                }
                void Values(object values, string prefix)
                {
                    foreach (var field in CoreFields(values).Concat(Providers.SelectMany(p => p.CardFields(values))))
                    {
                        if(animationHeader&&(field.Path=="SkinNames"||field.Path=="TrackIndex"||field.Path=="Channel"))continue;
                        Add(prefix + "." + field.Path, field.Label, field.FloatValue,field.Choices);
