````csharp
        }

        internal static List<Binding> DescribePolicy(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,string role)
        {
            var graph=document.AuthoringGraph;int index=graph.Nodes.FindIndex(n=>n.Id==nodeId);var result=new List<Binding>();
            if(index<0||!(graph.Nodes[index].Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload ability)||!(ability.Settings is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData settings))return result;
            string root="authoringGraph.Nodes.Array.data["+index+"].Payload.Settings";
            void Scalar(string path,string label)=>result.Add(new Binding{Path=path,Label=label});
            void Value(string path,string label,GameplayFloatValueAuthoring value,Func<bool> guard=null){result.Add(new Binding{Path=value is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring?path+".Value":path,Label=label+(value is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring?" · 常量":""),SourcePath=path,Summary=value is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring?null:GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Value(value),SourceGuard=guard});}
            if(role=="Cost"&&settings.Cost is GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring cost){
                for(int i=0;i<cost.Resources.Length;i++){string entry=root+".Cost.Resources.Array.data["+i+"]";Scalar(entry+".Attribute","资源属性");Value(entry+".Delta","资源变化",cost.Resources[i].Delta);}
            }else if(role=="Recharge"&&settings.Charge!=null){Scalar(root+".Charge.MaxCharges","最大充能");Scalar(root+".Charge.RechargeDuration","回充秒数");}
            else if(role=="Recharge"){
                var binding=ability.Definitions.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect");
                if(binding?.External)result.Add(new Binding{Label="共享冷却 · 只读",Summary=GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.SharedSummary(binding.External)});
                int local=graph.LocalDefinitions.FindIndex(d=>d.Id==binding?.LocalId);
                if(local>=0&&graph.LocalDefinitions[local].Payload is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect){
                    string prefix="authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Array.data["+local+"].Payload";var guard=GameplaySkillFieldSchema.CaptureBinding(document,nodeId,"CooldownEffect",binding.LocalId);
                    if(effect.DurationValue!=null)Value(prefix+".DurationValue","冷却秒数",effect.DurationValue,guard);else {Scalar(prefix+".Duration","冷却秒数");result.Last().SourceGuard=guard;}
                    result.Add(new Binding{Label="冷却状态",Summary=string.Join(" / ",effect.GrantedTags.Select(t=>t.Name))});
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        private static IEnumerable<GameplaySkillCardField> CoreFields(object value)
        {
            if (value is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring search)
            {
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Shape", "搜索形状");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Faction", "阵营");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Origin", "中心来源");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("IncludeSelf", "包含施法者");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("MaxTargets", "目标上限");
                foreach(string direction in new[]{"Direction","DirectionAngle","LengthFromTarget","CellSize"})
                    if(GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema.Visible(search,direction))yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(direction,direction=="Direction"?"方向来源":direction=="DirectionAngle"?"方向偏转":direction=="LengthFromTarget"?"长度跟随目标":"网格尺寸",direction=="DirectionAngle");
                foreach (string dimension in new[] { "Radius", "Angle", "Length", "Width" })
                    if (GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema.Visible(search, dimension))
                        yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(dimension, dimension == "Radius" ? "半径" : dimension == "Angle" ? "角度" : dimension == "Length" ? "长度" : "宽度", true);
            }
            if (value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect)
            {
                if (effect.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                    yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(effect.DurationValue == null ? "Duration" : "DurationValue", "持续秒数", effect.DurationValue != null);
                if (effect.DurationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)
                    yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(effect.PeriodValue == null ? "Period" : "PeriodValue", "周期间隔", effect.PeriodValue != null);
                if(effect.Stacking!=null){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Stacking.StackKey","叠层标识");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Stacking.MaxStacks","叠层上限");}
                // A compound effect keeps its real execution ordering in the advanced editor.
                if (effect.Executions.Length == 1 && effect.Modifiers.Length == 0)
                {
                    string prefix = "Executions.Array.data[0].";
                    if (effect.Executions[0] is GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring)
                    { yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(prefix + "DamageType", "伤害类型"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(prefix + "Amount", "伤害数值", true); }
                    else if (effect.Executions[0] is GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring || effect.Executions[0] is GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring)
                        yield return new GameplaySkillCardField(prefix + "Amount", "结算数值", true);
                }
            }
            if (value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile)
            {
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Motion", "运动轨迹"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Plane", "空间平面");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Speed", "速度", true); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Duration", "存续秒数", true);
                if(projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight)yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("StraightDestination","终点来源");
                if(projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight||projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Arc)yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("DirectionAngle","方向偏转");
                if(projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Arc||projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Parabolic)yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("CurveHeight","曲线高度",true);
            }
            if (value is GameplayAreaDefinitionData area)
            {
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Shape", "区域形状"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Plane", "空间平面");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Origin", "中心来源"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Faction", "阵营");
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Duration", "持续秒数", true); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("TickInterval", "周期间隔", true);
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("TickOnEnter", "进入立即周期"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("FollowOwner", "跟随施法者");
                if (area.Shape == GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Circle || area.Shape == GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Sector) yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Radius", "半径", true);
                if (area.Shape == GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Sector) yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Angle", "角度", true);
                if (area.Shape == GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Box)
                { yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Length", "长度", true); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Width", "宽度", true); }
            }
            if (value is GameplaySummonDefinitionData)
            { yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Duration", "持续秒数", true); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("AutoCast", "自动施放"); }
            if (value is GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring)
            { yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Mode", "位移方式"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Distance", "距离", true); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Speed", "速度", true); }
            if (value is GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring)
            { yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Amount", "护盾数值", true); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Duration", "持续秒数", true); }
            if (value is GameplayRotateToPointActionAuthoring) yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("RotateOwner", "转向自身");
            if(value is GameplayCooldownActionAuthoring cooldown){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("SkillId","技能 ID（0当前）");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Operation","冷却操作");if(cooldown.Operation!=Standard.GameplayCooldownOperation.Restart)yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Value","变化数值",true);}
            if(value is GameplayCaptureCombatRollActionAuthoring){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("CriticalChance","暴击概率",true);yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("MissChance","未命中概率",true);}
            if (value is GameplayCaptureValueActionAuthoring)

            if (value is GameplaySkillSetContextValueActionAuthoring)
            { yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Key", "定义局部变量"); yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Value", "数值"); }
            if (value is GameplayChangeStateActionAuthoring) yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("State", "行为状态");
            if (value is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring) yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Cancel", "以取消结束");

        /// <summary>Validates only the edited payload at the external editor boundary, then uses
        /// the existing native-buffer Apply/Undo/notification chain. Failure leaves source clean.</summary>
        public static bool Apply(SerializedObject serialized, GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string path, out string error)
        {
            if(GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(document)){error="只读范例；请先创建副本。";serialized.Update();return false;}
            var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
            if (path.StartsWith("authoringGraph.Nodes.", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                int end = path.IndexOf(".Payload", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                var payload = GameplayGraphFields.Clone(serialized.FindProperty(path.Substring(0, end) + ".Payload").managedReferenceValue);
                GameplaySkillFieldSchema.SetPending(payload,path.Substring(end+9),serialized.FindProperty(path));
                if (payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action) action.Action.Validate(validation, "卡片");
                if (payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload ability&&ability.Settings is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData settings)
                {settings.Cost?.Validate(validation,"卡片.Cost");settings.Charge?.Validate(validation,"卡片.Charge");}
                if (payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload rule) {rule.Trigger?.Validate(validation,"卡片.Trigger");rule.Target?.Validate(validation,"卡片.Target");}
            }
            else if (path.StartsWith("authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                int end = path.IndexOf(".Payload", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                var payload=(GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(serialized.FindProperty(path.Substring(0, end) + ".Payload").managedReferenceValue);
                GameplaySkillFieldSchema.SetPending(payload,path.Substring(end+9),serialized.FindProperty(path));
                payload.Validate(validation,"卡片");
            }
            int payloadAt=path.IndexOf(".Payload",StringComparison.Ordinal);
            string relative=payloadAt<0?path:"卡片"+path.Substring(payloadAt+8).Replace(".Array.data[","[");
            if(relative.StartsWith("卡片.Action.",StringComparison.Ordinal))relative="卡片."+relative.Substring(10);
            if(relative.StartsWith("卡片.Settings.",StringComparison.Ordinal))relative="卡片."+relative.Substring(12);
            var issues=validation.Issues.Where(issue=>issue.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error&&
                (issue.Path=="卡片"||relative==issue.Path||relative.StartsWith(issue.Path+".",StringComparison.Ordinal)||issue.Path.StartsWith(relative+".",StringComparison.Ordinal))).ToArray();
            error = issues.Length>0 ? string.Join("\n", issues) : null;
            if (error != null) { serialized.Update(); return false; }
            bool changed = GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ApplyFields(serialized, document, false, new[] { path });
            if (!changed) error = GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Error(document);
            return changed;
        }
    }

        internal void Refresh()

            string signature=string.Join("|",_fields.Select(f=>f.Path+":"+f.Label+":"+f.Editable+":"+string.Join(",",f.Choices??Array.Empty<string>())));
            if(signature==_signature){_current=true;SetEnabled(!EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode&&!GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(_document));foreach(var sync in _sync)sync();return;}
            _signature=signature;Invalidate();Clear();_sync.Clear();

                _playbackRow=new VisualElement{name="AnimationPlaybackRow",style={flexDirection=FlexDirection.Row,alignItems=Align.Center,flexWrap=Wrap.Wrap}};
                Add(_resourceRow);Add(_playbackRow);
            }
            for(int i=0;i<_fields.Count;i++)
            {
                int slot=i;var field=_fields[i];
                if(!field.Editable){
                    var row=new VisualElement{style={flexDirection=FlexDirection.Row}};if(_compact)row.style.width=Length.Percent(100);
                    var text=new Label{style={flexGrow=1,whiteSpace=WhiteSpace.Normal,fontSize=12}};
                    text.style.whiteSpace=WhiteSpace.Normal;
                    text.RegisterCallback<ClickEvent>(e=>{Advanced?.Invoke(_fields[slot].Path);e.StopPropagation();});row.Add(text);Add(row);
                    _sync.Add(()=>{text.text=_fields[slot].Label+" · "+_fields[slot].Summary;text.tooltip=_fields[slot].Label+" · "+_fields[slot].Summary+"\n单击定位此高级字段";});continue;
                }

                    if(_compact){control.style.flexGrow=1;control.style.flexShrink=1;control.style.minWidth=200;control.style.marginRight=6;(p.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ObjectReference?_resourceRow:_playbackRow).Add(control);}else Add(control);

                        Bind(new UnityEditor.UIElements.ObjectField(field.Label){objectType=type,allowSceneObjects=false},path,q=>q.objectReferenceValue,(q,v)=>q.objectReferenceValue=v);break;
                    case SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference:
                        if(p.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring){

                            var names=types.Select(t=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(t).DisplayName).ToList();

                            Bind(select,path,q=>names[Math.Max(0,Array.IndexOf(types,q.managedReferenceValue.GetType()))],(q,v)=>q.managedReferenceValue=Activator.CreateInstance(types[names.IndexOf(v)]));
                        }break;

                            var control=new TextField(field.Label){isDelayed=local||path.Contains(".Trigger.EventTag")};
                            var row=local?null:new VisualElement{style={flexDirection=FlexDirection.Row}};
                            Bind(control,path+".Name",q=>q.stringValue,(q,v)=>q.stringValue=v,row);
                            if(local)control.tooltip="在当前 Context 中定义变量，无需登记全局 Tag。改名会同步此定义唯一绑定的读取。";
                            else{
                                control.style.flexGrow=1;
                                var button=new Button{ text="选",tooltip="按当前 Scope 搜索已登记的 Tag" };
                                button.clicked+=()=>{
                                    string scope=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(_document);
                                    var canvas=GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameplayBehaviorGraphView>();
                                    if(canvas==null)return;
                                    GameplaySkillCreationMenu.Show(canvas,"选择 Gameplay Tag",menu=>{
                                        menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("管理 Reference"),false,()=>GameplayReferenceEditorWindow.OpenForScope(scope));
                                        foreach(var catalog in GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Visible(scope))
                                            foreach(string tag in catalog.Tags.OrderBy(value=>value,StringComparer.Ordinal))
                                                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope(catalog)+"/"+tag,tag),tag==control.value,()=>{
                                                    if(control.panel!=null&&GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Visible(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(_document))
                                                        .Any(owner=>owner.Tags.Contains(tag,StringComparer.Ordinal)))control.value=tag;
                                                });
                                    },button.worldBound.center);
                                };
                                row.Add(button);Add(row);
                            }
                        }
                        else if(p.boxedValue is GameplayAttributeReference)Bind(new TextField(field.Label),path+".Value",q=>q.stringValue,(q,v)=>q.stringValue=v);
                        break;
                }
            }
            if(_compact){
                _resourceRow.Add(new Button(()=>Advanced?.Invoke(null)){name="MainAnimationSettings",text="动画设置…",tooltip="在右侧编辑轨道、通道、皮肤、变体与主动画调度",style={width=92}});
                var duration=new Label{name="MainAnimationDuration",style={fontSize=11,marginLeft=6}};_playbackRow.Add(duration);
                _sync.Add(()=>{var timeline=_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.FirstOrDefault(t=>t.Events.Any(e=>e.EntryNodeId==_nodeId));duration.text=GameplaySkillFieldSchema.TryDuration(_document.AuthoringGraph,_nodeId,out _,out _,out float seconds)?seconds.ToString("0.###")+"s / 编排 "+timeline?.DurationSeconds.ToString("0.###")+"s":"";});
            }
            else if(_fields.Any(f=>f.SourcePath!=null||!f.Editable))Add(new Button(()=>{var menu=new GenericMenu();foreach(var source in _fields.Where(f=>f.SourcePath!=null||!f.Editable)){string path=source.SourcePath??source.Path;menu.AddItem(new GUIContent(source.Label+" / 数值来源与高级"),false,()=>Advanced?.Invoke(path));}menu.ShowAsContext();}){text="数值来源 / 高级参数",tooltip="显式切换常量、Formula、Caller或属性来源；保留验证及 Undo"});
            _error=new HelpBox("",HelpBoxMessageType.Error);_error.style.display=DisplayStyle.None;Add(_error);
            _current=true;SetEnabled(!EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode&&!GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(_document));
            foreach(var sync in _sync)sync();
        }
        // Reject stale FocusOut writes while bindings are being resolved again. Keep the
        // rendered appearance intact; a pending structural refresh must not grey the canvas.
        internal void Invalidate(){_current=false;}
        private void Bind<T>(BaseField<T> control,string path,Func<SerializedProperty,T> read,Action<SerializedProperty,T> write,VisualElement row=null)
        {
            control.name=path;var source=_serialized.FindProperty(path);control.tooltip=source.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.Enum?string.Join(" / ",source.enumNames)+"\n"+path:path;control.style.fontSize=12;
            float labelWidth=_compact?(control is Toggle?35:70):92;
            control.labelElement.style.minWidth=labelWidth;control.labelElement.style.maxWidth=labelWidth;
            if(row!=null)row.Add(control);
            else if(_compact){control.style.width=control is Toggle?75:155;control.style.marginRight=6;control.style.flexShrink=0;_playbackRow.Add(control);}else Add(control);
            _sync.Add(()=>{var p=_serialized.FindProperty(path);if(p==null)return;var value=read(p);if(!EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(control.value,value))control.SetValueWithoutNotify(value);});
            var sourceGuard=_fields.First(f=>f.Path==path||path.StartsWith(f.Path+".",StringComparison.Ordinal)).SourceGuard;
            control.RegisterValueChangedCallback(e=>{
                if(!_current||sourceGuard!=null&&!sourceGuard())return;
                _serialized.UpdateIfRequiredOrScript();var p=_serialized.FindProperty(path);write(p,e.newValue);
                bool applied=GameplaySkillCardFields.Apply(_serialized,_document,path,out var error);
                if(!applied)control.SetValueWithoutNotify(read(_serialized.FindProperty(path)));
                _error.text=error==null?"":control.label+" · "+error;_error.style.display=error==null?DisplayStyle.None:DisplayStyle.Flex;
                e.StopPropagation();
            });
        }
    }
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/SkillAuthoring/GameplaySkillContextVariables.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Editor projection of scalar bindings along the same ordered arrays the compiler builds.
    /// A binding is available only on every invocation of the field. Producer paths are retained
    /// to distinguish an unambiguous rename from a same-name write on an independent path.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplaySkillContextVariables
    {
        private static ConditionalWeakTable<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset, GameplaySkillContextVariables> Cache = new();
        private static readonly Regex FormulaTokens = new(@"(?<![\w.])(?:Context|Caller)\.([\p{L}\p{Nd}_.]+)");
        private static readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> Empty =
            new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
        private readonly Dictionary<string, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>>> _inputs = new();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, (string Key, string Title)> _producers = new();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _references = new();
        private readonly Dictionary<string, string> _locations = new();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _formulaPaths = new();

        static GameplaySkillContextVariables()
        {
            GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.DetailedChanged += (document, change) => { if (!change.Layout) Cache.Remove(document); };
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed += () => Cache = new();
        }

        internal static GameplaySkillContextVariables For(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document) =>
            Cache.GetValue(document, source => new GameplaySkillContextVariables(source));

        internal static bool IsProducer(Type type) =>
            type == typeof(GameplayCaptureValueActionAuthoring) || type == typeof(GameplaySkillSetContextValueActionAuthoring);

        internal static bool IsReader(Type type) =>
            type == typeof(GameplaySkillContextValueConditionAuthoring) || type == typeof(GameplayContextFloatValueAuthoring) ||
            type == typeof(GameplaySetByCallerFloatValueAuthoring);

        internal static Type FieldOwner(SerializedProperty property)
        {
            if (property.name != "Key" || property.serializedObject.isEditingMultipleObjects ||
                !(property.serializedObject.targetObject is GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document) ||
                document.AuthoringSchemaVersion != 2) return null;
            string path = property.propertyPath;
            var owner = property.serializedObject.FindProperty(path.Substring(0, path.Length - 4));
            return owner?.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference ? owner.managedReferenceValue?.GetType() : null;
        }

        private GameplaySkillContextVariables(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        {
            var graph = document.AuthoringGraph;
            var nodes = graph.Nodes.Select((node, i) => (node, path: $"authoringGraph.Nodes.Array.data[{i}].Payload"))
                .ToDictionary(item => item.node.Id);
            var definitions = graph.LocalDefinitions.Select((definition, i) => (definition, path: $"authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Array.data[{i}].Payload"))
                .ToDictionary(item => item.definition.Id);
            var timelines = graph.Timelines.Select((timeline, i) => (timeline, path: $"authoringGraph.Timelines.Array.data[{i}].Events"))
                .ToDictionary(item => item.timeline.Id);
            var edges = graph.Connections.ToLookup(edge => (edge.FromNodeId, edge.OutputPortKey));
            var active = new HashSet<string>();
            foreach (var (node, path) in nodes.Values)
            {
                var action = (node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
                var key = action is GameplayCaptureValueActionAuthoring capture ? capture.Key.Name :
                    (action as GameplaySkillSetContextValueActionAuthoring)?.Key.Name;
                if (action != null && IsProducer(action.GetType()))
                    _producers[path + ".Action.Key"] = (key, node.Title);
            }

            var defaults = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            for (int i = 0; i < document.Defaults.Length; i++)
            {
                string key = document.Defaults[i].Key.Name;
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(key)) continue;
                string path = $"Defaults.Array.data[{i}].Key";
                _producers[path] = (key, "技能默认输入");
                defaults[key] = new HashSet<string> { path };
            }
            string triggerMagnitude = GameplayContextValues.TriggerMagnitudeKey.Name;
            _producers[triggerMagnitude] = (triggerMagnitude, "触发事件强度");
            defaults[triggerMagnitude] = new HashSet<string> { triggerMagnitude };

            foreach (var id in graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Prepend(graph.PrimaryRuleNodeId))
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) || !nodes.TryGetValue(id, out var rule)) continue;
                // Rule conditions see the incoming trigger. Installed defaults are merged for Actions.
                Observe(rule.path, id, rule.node.Payload, Empty);
                RunOutput(id, "Actions", defaults);
            }

            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> RunOutput(string id, string port,
                IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> input)
            {
                foreach (var edge in edges[(id, port)].OrderBy(edge => edge.Order))
                    if (edge.InputPortKey == "Execute") input = RunAction(edge.ToNodeId, input);
                return input;
            }

            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> RunAction(string id, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> input)
            {
                if (!nodes.TryGetValue(id, out var item) || !(item.node.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload payload) ||
                    payload.Action == null || !active.Add(id)) return input;
                string path = item.path + ".Action";
                Observe(path, id, payload.Action, input);
                foreach (var binding in payload.Definitions) VisitDefinition(binding.LocalId, input);
                if (_producers.TryGetValue(path + ".Key", out var producer) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(producer.Key))
                    input = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>(input, StringComparer.Ordinal)
                        { [producer.Key] = new HashSet<string> { path + ".Key" } };
                else if (payload.Action is GameplayCaptureCombatRollActionAuthoring roll)
                {
                    var captured = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>(input, StringComparer.Ordinal);
                    foreach (string key in new[] { GameplayDamageExecution.CriticalKey.Name, GameplayDamageExecution.MissKey.Name })
                    {
                        if (roll.PreserveExisting && captured.ContainsKey(key)) continue;
                        string source = path + "." + key;
                        _producers[source] = (key, "捕获暴击 / 未命中");
                        captured[key] = new HashSet<string> { source };
                    }
                    input = captured;
                }
                else if (payload.Action is GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring)
                    input = Merge(RunOutput(id, "TrueActions", input), RunOutput(id, "FalseActions", input));
                else if (payload.Action is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring search)
                {
                    var each = input;
                    if (search.RepeatFromResult)
                    {
                        string key = GameplaySearchTargetAction.SearchMultiplierKey.Name;
                        string source = path + ".RepeatMultiplier";
                        _producers[source] = (key, "逐次搜索倍率");
                        each = new Dictionary<string, HashSet<string>>(input, StringComparer.Ordinal) { [key] = new HashSet<string> { source } };
                    }
                    RunOutput(id, "EachTarget", each);
                    RunOutput(id, "NoTargets", input);
                    input = RunOutput(id, "Completed", input);
                }
                else
                    foreach (var slot in GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(payload.Action))
                        RunOutput(id, slot.Path, payload.Action is GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring ||
                            payload.Action is GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring ? input : Empty);

                input = RunOutput(id, "Then", input);
                active.Remove(id);
                return input;
            }

            void VisitDefinition(string id, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> input)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) || !active.Add(id)) return;
                if (timelines.TryGetValue(id, out var schedule))
                    for (int i = 0; i < schedule.timeline.Events.Count; i++)
                    {
                        var entry = schedule.timeline.Events[i];
                        // Each marker starts with the Context captured when the sequence started.
                        Observe($"{schedule.path}.Array.data[{i}]", entry.Id, entry, input);
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(entry.EntryNodeId)) RunAction(entry.EntryNodeId, input);
                    }
                else if (definitions.TryGetValue(id, out var item))
                {
                    var payload = item.definition.Payload;
                    Observe(item.path, id, payload, input);
                    foreach (var binding in item.definition.Definitions) VisitDefinition(binding.LocalId, input);
                    bool spatial = payload is GameplayAreaDefinitionData || payload is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData ||
                        payload is GameplaySummonDefinitionData;
                    foreach (var slot in GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(payload))
                        RunOutput(id, slot.Path, spatial ? input : Empty);
                    foreach (var slot in GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(payload))
                        foreach (var edge in edges[(id, slot.Key)])
                            VisitDefinition(GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.EffectBinding(nodes[edge.ToNodeId].node)?.LocalId, input);
                }
                active.Remove(id);
            }
        }

        private void Observe(string root, string id, object payload, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> input)
        {
            if (_inputs.TryGetValue(root, out var previous))
            {
                _inputs[root] = Merge(previous, input);
                return;
            }
            _inputs[root] = input;
            foreach (var pair in GameplayGraphFields.ObjectPaths(payload))
            {
                string path = string.IsNullOrEmpty(pair.Value) ? root : root + "." + pair.Value;
                if (IsReader(pair.Key.GetType()))
                    _locations[path] = string.IsNullOrEmpty(pair.Value) ? id : id + "." + pair.Value;
                switch (pair.Key)
                {
                    case GameplaySkillContextValueConditionAuthoring condition: _references[path + ".Key"] = condition.Key.Name; break;
                    case GameplayContextFloatValueAuthoring context: _references[path + ".Key"] = context.Key.Name; break;
                    case GameplaySetByCallerFloatValueAuthoring caller: _references[path + ".Key"] = caller.Key.Name; break;
                    case GameplayFormulaFloatValueAuthoring _: _formulaPaths.Add(path + ".Expression"); break;
                }
            }
        }

        private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> Merge(
            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> left, IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> right) =>
            left.Where(pair => right.ContainsKey(pair.Key)).ToDictionary(pair => pair.Key,
                pair => new HashSet<string>(pair.Value.Concat(right[pair.Key])), StringComparer.Ordinal);

        private IReadOnlyDictionary<string, HashSet<string>> Input(string path)
        {
            for (int end = path.LastIndexOf('.'); end >= 0; end = path.LastIndexOf('.', end - 1))
                if (_inputs.TryGetValue(path.Substring(0, end), out var result)) return result;
            return Empty;
        }

        internal (string Key, string Label)[] Choices(string path) => Input(path)
            .Where(pair => GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, pair.Key))
            .OrderBy(pair => pair.Key, StringComparer.Ordinal)
            .Select(pair =>
            {
                string name = ObjectNames.NicifyVariableName(pair.Key.Substring(pair.Key.LastIndexOf('.') + 1));
                string source = string.Join(" / ", pair.Value.Select(id => _producers[id].Title).Where(title => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(title)).Distinct());
                return (pair.Key, source.Length == 0 ? name : name + " · " + source);
            }).ToArray();

        internal string Warning(string path, string key)
        {
            if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, key)) return "请输入有效的 Context 键。";
            if (Input(path).ContainsKey(key)) return null;
            return _producers.Values.Any(producer => producer.Key == key)
                ? "此键在技能中有定义，但并非每条到达路径都携带该值。"
                : "此处没有可达的生产者。若由外部传入，需由调用方保证有值。";
        }

        internal IEnumerable<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> Diagnostics()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _references)
            {
                if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, pair.Value)) continue;
                string warning = Warning(pair.Key, pair.Value);
                if (warning != null)
                    yield return new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning,
                        _locations[pair.Key.Substring(0, pair.Key.Length - 4)] + ".Key", pair.Value + " · " + warning);
            }
        }

        /// <summary>Stages the declaration and its uniquely bound reads in the same Undo edit.</summary>
        internal void StageRenames(SerializedObject serialized, HashSet<string> paths)
        {
            foreach (string changed in paths.ToArray())
            {
                string path = changed.EndsWith(".Name", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? changed.Substring(0, changed.Length - 5) : changed;
                if (!_producers.TryGetValue(path, out var producer) || !path.StartsWith("authoringGraph.Nodes.", StringComparison.Ordinal)) continue;
                string key = serialized.FindProperty(path + ".Name").stringValue;
                if (key == producer.Key) continue;
                if (!GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(GameplayReferenceKind.Tag, key))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("请输入有效的 Context 键。");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(producer.Key)) continue;
                bool Bound(string reader) => Input(reader).TryGetValue(producer.Key, out var sources) &&
                    sources.Count == 1 && sources.Contains(path);
                var readers = _references.Where(pair => pair.Value == producer.Key && Bound(pair.Key)).Select(pair => pair.Key + ".Name").ToArray();
                var formulas = _formulaPaths.Where(Bound).Select(serialized.FindProperty).Where(property => property != null &&
                    FormulaTokens.Matches(property.stringValue).Cast<Match>().Any(match => match.Groups[1].Value == producer.Key)).ToArray();
                if (readers.Length == 0 && formulas.Length == 0) continue;
                if (_producers.Any(pair => pair.Key != path && pair.Value.Key == key))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("已有同名定义。请先选一个新键，避免改名后读取其它来源。");
                if (formulas.Length != 0 && key.Any(c => !char.IsLetterOrDigit(c) && c != '_' && c != '.'))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("此键用于公式，改名时只可使用字母、数字、下划线和点。");
                foreach (string reader in readers)
                {
                    serialized.FindProperty(reader).stringValue = key;
                    paths.Add(reader);
                }
                foreach (var formula in formulas)
                {
                    formula.stringValue = FormulaTokens.Replace(formula.stringValue, match => match.Groups[1].Value == producer.Key
                        ? match.Value.Substring(0, match.Value.IndexOf('.') + 1) + key : match.Value);
                    paths.Add(formula.propertyPath);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/SkillAuthoring/GameplaySkillCopyReferences.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Copy-time review of typed, embedded business references. Paths address the
    /// source and its clone; external Unity objects are never traversed or modified.</summary>
    internal static class GameplaySkillCopyReferences
    {
        internal sealed class Reference
        {
            internal string Path, Description, CooldownGroup, TagSuffix;
            internal bool IsSelf, IsTag;
            internal int LocalStackOrdinal;
            internal string TargetTag(int id,string scope)=>LocalStackOrdinal>0
                ? GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.GeneratedSkillTag(scope,"Effect.Stack.","S"+id+".Copy"+LocalStackOrdinal)
                : CooldownGroup!=null
                ? GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.GeneratedSkillTag(scope,"Cooldown.Skill.",id+TagSuffix)
                : GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.GeneratedSkillTag(scope,"Event.Created.","S"+id);
        }

        internal static List<Reference> Audit(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset source)
        {
            var result=new List<Reference>();
            string scopedCooldown=GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.GeneratedSkillTag(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(source),"Cooldown.Skill.",source.SkillId.ToString());
            var ability=(GameplayAbilityNodePayload)source.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==source.AuthoringGraph.AbilityNodeId).Payload;
            var binding=ability.Definitions.SingleOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect");
            var cooldown=source.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.SingleOrDefault(d=>d.Id==binding?.LocalId)?.Payload as GameplayEffectDefinitionData;
            // Binding, not a naming convention, establishes the local CD identity. Every
            // embedded use of a granted tag travels with that group, including business queries.
            var privateTags=cooldown?.GrantedTags.Select(t=>t.Name).Where(t=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(t)).Distinct().ToList()??new List<string>();
            var sharedTags=(binding?.External as GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset)?.GrantedTags.Select(t=>t.Name).ToHashSet()??new HashSet<string>();
            var localStackKeys=source.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Select(d=>d.Payload).OfType<GameplayEffectDefinitionData>()
                .Where(d=>d.Stacking!=null).Select(d=>d.Stacking.StackKey.Name).Distinct().ToList();
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(source)){
                var field=so.GetIterator();
                while(field.Next(true)){
                    if(field.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference){
                        string member=null;
                        if(field.managedReferenceValue is GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring)member="OwnerSkillId";
                        else if(field.managedReferenceValue is GameplayCooldownActionAuthoring||field.managedReferenceValue is GameplayLearningSkillRequirementAuthoring)member="SkillId";
                        if(member!=null){
                            var id=field.FindPropertyRelative(member);
                            if(id.intValue>0)result.Add(new Reference{Path=id.propertyPath,IsSelf=id.intValue==source.SkillId,Description=member+" = "+id.intValue});
                        }
                    }
                    if(!field.isArray&&field.type==nameof(GameplayTagReference)&&field.propertyPath!="CastEvent"){
                        var tag=field.FindPropertyRelative("Name");string value=tag.stringValue;
                        if(field.name=="StackKey"&&field.propertyPath.StartsWith("authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.",System.StringComparison.Ordinal)
                           &&!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value)){
                            result.Add(new Reference{Path=tag.propertyPath,IsSelf=true,IsTag=true,
                                LocalStackOrdinal=localStackKeys.IndexOf(value)+1,Description="局部叠层键 "+value});
                            continue;
                        }
                        // Retained, detached authoring drafts still keep the established
                        // explicit self-ID contract (e.g. 7002); arbitrary names require a binding.
                        int at=privateTags.IndexOf(value);bool cooldownTag=at>=0||value=="Cooldown.Skill."+source.SkillId||value==scopedCooldown;
                        bool own=(value==source.CastEvent.Name||cooldownTag)&&!sharedTags.Contains(value);
                        if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))result.Add(new Reference{Path=tag.propertyPath,IsSelf=own,IsTag=true,CooldownGroup=own&&cooldownTag?value:null,TagSuffix=at>=0&&privateTags.Count>1?".Tag"+(at+1):"",Description="Tag = "+value+(own&&cooldownTag?"（自身冷却及其全部引用）":sharedTags.Contains(value)?"（外部冷却，共享只读）":"")});
                    }
                }
            }
            for(int i=0;i<source.Defaults.Length;i++){
                var value=source.Defaults[i];
                // Scalar keys are application contracts, not arbitrary numbers. Only an
                // explicitly named skill identity is proposed as self; other defaults stay.
                bool identity=value.Key.Name.EndsWith(".SourceSkillId")||value.Key.Name.EndsWith(".OwnerSkillId")||value.Key.Name.EndsWith(".SkillId");
                result.Add(new Reference{Path="Defaults.Array.data["+i+"].Value",IsSelf=identity&&value.Value==source.SkillId,Description=value.Key.Name+" = "+value.Value});
            }
            return result;
        }

        internal static List<string> Apply(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset copy,List<Reference> references,ICollection<string> preserve,string scope)
        {
            var tags=new List<string>();
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(copy)){
                foreach(var reference in references){
                    if(!reference.IsSelf||preserve.Contains(reference.Path))continue;
                    var field=so.FindProperty(reference.Path);
                    if(reference.IsTag){field.stringValue=reference.TargetTag(copy.SkillId,scope);tags.Add(field.stringValue);}
                    else if(field.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.Integer)field.intValue=copy.SkillId;
                    else field.floatValue=copy.SkillId;
                }
                so.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
            }
            return tags;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>In-memory migration comparator over immutable runtime values, callback captures,
    /// source maps, ordering and real resource GUID/fileID. No snapshots are written to disk.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillDefinitionSemantics
    {
        /// <summary>Normalizes only CLR type metadata for the explicit namespace move; never business string values.</summary>
        private static string TypeName(Type type)=>type.FullName.Replace("FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.V2.","FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.");
        public static string Capture(object definition,IReadOnlyDictionary<UnityEngine.Object,string> originalResourceIdentities=null)
        {
            var seen = new Dictionary<object,int>(); var output = new StringBuilder(); int count=0;
            Action<object> visit=null;
            visit=value=>{
                if(++count>100000)throw new InvalidOperationException("Definition snapshot exceeds bound.");
                if(value==null){output.Append("null;");return;}
                if(value is UnityEngine.Object missing&&missing==null){output.Append("null;");return;}
                var type=value.GetType();
                if(value is string text){output.Append("s").Append(text.Length).Append(':').Append(text).Append(';');return;}
                if(type.IsPrimitive||type.IsEnum||value is decimal){output.Append(TypeName(type)).Append(':').Append(Convert.ToString(value,CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)).Append(';');return;}
                var unity=value as UnityEngine.Object;
                if(unity){
                    string identity;
                    if(originalResourceIdentities!=null&&originalResourceIdentities.TryGetValue(unity,out var original))identity=original;
                    else {if(!AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(unity,out string guid,out long id))throw new InvalidOperationException("Nonpersistent runtime resource: "+unity.name);identity=guid+":"+id;}
                    output.Append("resource:").Append(TypeName(type)).Append(':').Append(identity).Append(';');
                    if(!(unity is GameplayDefinitionAsset))return;
                }
                if(!type.IsValueType){if(seen.TryGetValue(value,out int old)){output.Append('@').Append(old).Append(';');return;}seen.Add(value,seen.Count);}
                if(value is Delegate factory){foreach(var invocation in factory.GetInvocationList()){
                    output.Append("factory:").Append(GameplaySkillDelegateSemantics.Signature(invocation.Method)).Append(';');visit(invocation.Target);
                }return;}
                if(value is IDictionary map){output.Append("map{");foreach(DictionaryEntry entry in map){visit(entry.Key);visit(entry.Value);}output.Append("};");return;}
                if(value is IEnumerable list){output.Append("list[");foreach(var item in list)visit(item);output.Append("];");return;}
                bool author=unity is GameplayDefinitionAsset;output.Append(author?"author-data:":TypeName(type)).Append('{');
                var fields=new List<FieldInfo>();
                for(var current=type;current!=null&&current!=typeof(ScriptableObject)&&current!=typeof(UnityEngine.Object);current=current.BaseType)
                    fields.AddRange(current.GetFields(BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Instance|BindingFlags.DeclaredOnly|(author?0:BindingFlags.NonPublic)));
                foreach(var field in fields.Where(f=>!f.IsStatic&&!f.IsNotSerialized&&!f.IsDefined(typeof(FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.GameplayAuthoringIdentityAttribute),false)).OrderBy(f=>f.Name,StringComparer.Ordinal)){output.Append(field.Name).Append('=');visit(field.GetValue(value));}
                output.Append("};");
            };
            visit(definition);
            // Factories were moved once from an SO adapter into the same plain-data builder.
            // Compiler-generated closure ordinals are not gameplay semantics. Captures remain.
            string result=Regex.Replace(output.ToString(),"(Gameplay(?:Unity|Spine|Live2D)?Animation|GameplayUnitySummon)(?:Asset|Data)","$1Values");
            result=Regex.Replace(result,@"<>c__DisplayClass\d+_\d+","<>c__DisplayClass");
            result=Regex.Replace(result,@"<>9__\d+_\d+","<>9__");
            // Both values select the same root binding in the existing Unity consumer.
            return result.Replace("<Binding>k__BackingField=null;","<Binding>k__BackingField=s0:;");
        }
        public static void RequireEqual(string before, object after, string label)
        {
            string current=Capture(after);if(before==current)return;
            int at=0;while(at<Math.Min(before.Length,current.Length)&&before[at]==current[at])at++;
            throw new InvalidOperationException(label+" runtime semantics differ at "+at+". Before: "+before.Substring(Math.Max(0,at-60),Math.Min(180,before.Length-Math.Max(0,at-60)))+"; After: "+current.Substring(Math.Max(0,at-60),Math.Min(180,current.Length-Math.Max(0,at-60))));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Reflection.Emit;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Compares callback implementation, independently of compiler closure ordinals.
    /// Generated callbacks use their IL and resolved business members, not metadata tokens or
    /// lambda names. Captured values are compared separately by the definition comparator.</summary>
    internal static class GameplaySkillDelegateSemantics
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<short,OpCode> Codes=typeof(OpCodes).GetFields(BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.Static)
            .Where(f=>f.FieldType==typeof(OpCode)).Select(f=>(OpCode)f.GetValue(null)).ToDictionary(c=>c.Value);
        private static readonly Dictionary<MethodInfo,string> Cache=new Dictionary<MethodInfo,string>();
        private static string Name(string name)
        {
            name=(name??"").Replace("FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.V2.","FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.");
            name=Regex.Replace(name, "(Gameplay(?:Unity|Spine|Live2D)?Animation|GameplayUnitySummon)(?:Asset|Data)","$1Values");
            name=Regex.Replace(name,@"<>9__\d+_\d+","<>9__");
            return Regex.Replace(name,@"<>c__DisplayClass\d+_\d+","<>c__DisplayClass");
        }
        internal static string Signature(MethodInfo method)=>Signature(method,new HashSet<MethodInfo>());
        private static string Signature(MethodInfo method,HashSet<MethodInfo> active)
        {
            if(Cache.TryGetValue(method,out var saved))return saved;
            if(!active.Add(method))return "recursive:"+Name(method.DeclaringType?.FullName)+":"+Name(method.ReturnType.FullName);
            try{
                bool generated=method.Name.Contains("<")||method.DeclaringType?.Name.Contains("<")==true;
                var signature=new StringBuilder(Name(method.DeclaringType?.FullName)).Append("::").Append(generated?"callback":method.Name)
                    .Append('(').Append(string.Join(",",method.GetParameters().Select(p=>Name(p.ParameterType.FullName)))).Append(")->").Append(Name(method.ReturnType.FullName));
                var body=method.GetMethodBody();
                if(body==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Cannot prove callback implementation: "+method);
                foreach(var local in body.LocalVariables)signature.Append("local:").Append(Name(local.LocalType.FullName));
                var bytes=body.GetILAsByteArray();int cursor=0;
                while(cursor<bytes.Length){
                    short code=bytes[cursor++];if(code==0xfe)code=(short)(0xfe00|bytes[cursor++]);var op=Codes[code];
                    signature.Append('|').Append(op.Name).Append(':');
                    switch(op.OperandType){
                        case OperandType.InlineNone:break;
                        case OperandType.ShortInlineI:case OperandType.ShortInlineVar:case OperandType.ShortInlineBrTarget:signature.Append(bytes[cursor++]);break;
                        case OperandType.InlineVar:signature.Append(BitConverter.ToUInt16(bytes,cursor));cursor+=2;break;
                        case OperandType.InlineI8:case OperandType.InlineR:signature.Append(BitConverter.ToString(bytes,cursor,8));cursor+=8;break;
                        case OperandType.InlineSwitch:
                            int count=BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes,cursor);signature.Append(BitConverter.ToString(bytes,cursor,4+count*4));cursor+=4+count*4;break;
                        case OperandType.InlineField:case OperandType.InlineMethod:case OperandType.InlineType:case OperandType.InlineTok:
                            int token=BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes,cursor);cursor+=4;
                            var member=method.Module.ResolveMember(token,method.DeclaringType?.GetGenericArguments(),method.IsGenericMethod?method.GetGenericArguments():null);
                            var called=member as MethodInfo;
                            if(called!=null&&(called.Name.Contains("<")||called.DeclaringType?.Name.Contains("<")==true))signature.Append(Signature(called,active));
                            else signature.Append(Name(member.DeclaringType?.FullName)).Append("::").Append(Name(member.ToString()));
                            break;
                        case OperandType.InlineString:signature.Append(method.Module.ResolveString(BitConverter.ToInt32(bytes,cursor)));cursor+=4;break;
                        case OperandType.InlineSig:throw new InvalidOperationException("Unproven callback signature operand: "+method);
                        default:signature.Append(BitConverter.ToString(bytes,cursor,4));cursor+=4;break;
                    }
                }
                foreach(var clause in body.ExceptionHandlingClauses)signature.Append("exception:").Append(clause.Flags).Append(':').Append(clause.TryOffset).Append(':').Append(clause.TryLength).Append(':').Append(clause.HandlerOffset).Append(':').Append(clause.HandlerLength).Append(':').Append(clause.Flags==ExceptionHandlingClauseOptions.Clause?Name(clause.CatchType?.FullName):"");
                using(var sha=SHA256.Create())saved=BitConverter.ToString(sha.ComputeHash(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(signature.ToString())));
                Cache.Add(method,saved);return saved;
            }finally{active.Remove(method);}
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
{
    /// <summary>Real AssetDatabase folders and typed document identities. Reuses V1's wrapped,
    /// virtualized native rows and bounded indentation; no dependency/art loading on repaint.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplaySkillDocumentBrowser
    {
        private sealed class Folder {
            internal string Name, Path;

        private readonly HashSet<string> _closed=new HashSet<string>();

        internal GameplaySkillDocumentBrowser(){var state=JsonUtility.FromJson<State>(EditorPrefs.GetString(StateKey,JsonUtility.ToJson(new State())));_search=state.Search;_scroll=state.Scroll;_closed.UnionWith(state.Closed);}

        internal Action<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset> Select;
        internal void Reveal(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document) { _reveal=document;if(document){string path=AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(document);_closed.RemoveWhere(folder=>path.StartsWith(folder,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));}_rows=null; }
        internal bool Changed(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document) {
            if(!document||!AssetDatabase.Contains(document))return false;string identity=document.SkillId+":"+document.DisplayName+":"+(document.AuthoringGraph?.Scope??"待迁移");
            int id=document.GetInstanceID();if(_identities.TryGetValue(id,out var previous)&&previous==identity)return false;_identities[id]=identity;_root=null;_rows=null;return true;
        }
        internal void Draw(IReadOnlyList<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset> documents,GameplaySkillDocumentAsset selected,float width)
        {
            if(_rowStyle==null)_rowStyle=new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.miniButton){wordWrap=true,fontSize=13,alignment=TextAnchor.MiddleLeft,fixedHeight=0,padding=new RectOffset(8,5,5,5)};
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();GUI.SetNextControlName("SkillDocumentBrowser");
            string next=EditorGUILayout.TextField(_search,EditorStyles.toolbarSearchField);
            if(GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("◎","展开并定位当前技能"),EditorStyles.miniButton,GUILayout.Width(24))){next="";Reveal(selected);}
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();

            if(!ReferenceEquals(_documents,documents)){_documents=documents;_root=null;_rows=null;}
            if(_root==null)BuildTree();

            if(_rows==null||Mathf.Abs(width-_width)>.5f){_width=width;_height=0;_rows=new List<Row>();Layout(_root,0);}
            var viewport=GUILayoutUtility.GetRect(0,100000,0,100000,GUILayout.ExpandHeight(true),GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true));
            if(_reveal&&Event.current.type==EventType.Repaint&&viewport.height>30){var row=_rows.Find(r=>r.Document==_reveal);if(row!=null)_scroll.y=Mathf.Max(0,row.Rect.y-viewport.height*.3f);_reveal=null;}
            _scroll=GUI.BeginScrollView(viewport,_scroll,new Rect(0,0,width,_height));
            foreach(var row in _rows){
                if(row.Rect.yMax<_scroll.y||row.Rect.y>_scroll.y+viewport.height)continue;

                if(Event.current.isMouse&&Event.current.button!=0)continue;
                var label=new Rect(rect.x,rect.y,Mathf.Max(40,rect.width-26),rect.height-3);
                if(GUI.Toggle(label,document==selected,row.Label,_rowStyle)&&document!=selected)Select?.Invoke(document);
                if(GUI.Button(new Rect(rect.xMax-24,rect.y+5,24,24),new GUIContent("◎","定位主技能文件"),EditorStyles.miniButton)){Selection.activeObject=document;EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(document);}
            }

                var entries=_rows.Where(r=>r.Document).ToList();int at=entries.FindIndex(r=>r.Document==selected);
                if(entries.Count>0){var document=entries[Mathf.Clamp(at+(Event.current.keyCode==KeyCode.DownArrow?1:-1),0,entries.Count-1)].Document;Select?.Invoke(document);_reveal=document;}Event.current.Use();

        private void BuildTree()

                string search=document.SkillId+" "+document.DisplayName+" "+path+" "+(document.AuthoringGraph?.Scope??"待迁移");

        }
        private void Layout(Folder folder,int depth)
        {

            foreach(var child in folder.Children.Values)Layout(child,depth+1);
            foreach(var document in folder.Entries.OrderBy(d=>d.SkillId)){
                string path=AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(document);string title=string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(document.DisplayName)?document.name:document.DisplayName;
                var label=new GUIContent(title+"  #"+document.SkillId+"\n"+System.IO.Path.GetFileName(path),path+"\nScope: "+(document.AuthoringGraph?.Scope??"待迁移"));
                float indent=Mathf.Min(depth,3)*8;float height=Mathf.Max(46,_rowStyle.CalcHeight(label,Mathf.Max(60,_width-indent-26)))+3;
                _rows.Add(new Row{Document=document,Label=label,Indent=indent,Rect=new Rect(0,_height,_width,height)});_height+=height;
            }
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Editor-session preferences keyed by the actual document GUID/fileID. Observing,
    /// folding, scrolling and preview choices never dirty the formal skill or create a graph SO.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillEditorState
    {
        private static readonly System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string> Migrated=new System.Collections.Generic.HashSet<string>();
        public static string Key(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc)
        {
            if(!doc||!AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(doc,out string guid,out long id))
                return "FRFrame.SkillAuthoring.Transient."+(doc?doc.GetInstanceID():0);
            string key="FRFrame.SkillAuthoring."+guid+":"+id;
            if(Migrated.Add(key)&&!SessionState.GetBool(key+".CanonicalKeys",false)){
                string old="FRFrame.V2."+guid+":"+id;
                SessionState.SetVector3(key+".Pan",SessionState.GetVector3(old+".Pan",UnityEngine.Vector3.zero));
                SessionState.SetFloat(key+".Zoom",SessionState.GetFloat(old+".Zoom",1));
                foreach(string suffix in new[]{".Profile",".InlinePreview"})SessionState.SetString(key+suffix,SessionState.GetString(old+suffix,""));
                SessionState.SetBool(key+".TurnClock",SessionState.GetBool(old+".TurnClock",false));
                if(doc.AuthoringGraph!=null){
                    foreach(var node in doc.AuthoringGraph.Nodes){
                        SessionState.SetBool(key+".Card."+node.Id,SessionState.GetBool(old+".Card."+node.Id,node.Expanded));
                        SessionState.SetBool(key+".Standalone."+node.Id,SessionState.GetBool(old+".Standalone."+node.Id,false));
                    }
                    foreach(var timeline in doc.AuthoringGraph.Timelines)SessionState.SetString(key+".Timeline."+timeline.Id,SessionState.GetString(old+".Timeline."+timeline.Id,""));
                }
                SessionState.SetBool(key+".CanonicalKeys",true);
            }
            return key;
        }
        public static GameplayActorProfileAsset PreviewProfile(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc)=>AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayActorProfileAsset>(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(SessionState.GetString(Key(doc)+".Profile","")));
        public static bool TurnClock(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc)=>SessionState.GetBool(Key(doc)+".TurnClock",false);
        public static void CreationPreferences(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc,GameplayActorProfileAsset profile,bool turns)
        {SessionState.SetString(Key(doc)+".Profile",profile?AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(profile)):"");SessionState.SetBool(Key(doc)+".TurnClock",turns);}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using UnityEditor.Experimental.GraphView;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;
using System.Linq;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>GraphView's native hit-tested curve, with distinct scheduled/inline business
    /// connections. Source ports and the existing GraphView deletion/selection still own it.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplaySkillExecutionEdge : Edge
    {
        internal bool Scheduled;
        // Curves remain visible across a card, but its fields, markers and native sockets own input there.
        private bool OverCard(Vector2 point){var graph=GetFirstAncestorOfType<GameplayBehaviorGraphView>();return graph!=null&&graph.IsCardPoint(this.ChangeCoordinatesTo(graph.contentViewContainer,point));}
        public override bool ContainsPoint(Vector2 localPoint)=>!OverCard(localPoint)&&base.ContainsPoint(localPoint);
        protected override EdgeControl CreateEdgeControl()=>new BusinessCurve(this);
        private sealed class BusinessCurve:EdgeControl
        {
            private readonly GameplaySkillExecutionEdge _owner;
            public override bool ContainsPoint(Vector2 localPoint)=>!_owner.OverCard(this.ChangeCoordinatesTo(_owner,localPoint))&&base.ContainsPoint(localPoint);
            internal BusinessCurve(GameplaySkillExecutionEdge owner)
            {
                _owner=owner;generateVisualContent+=ctx=>{
                    var points=controlPoints;if(points==null||points.Length<4)return;
                    var direction=(points[3]-points[2]).normalized;var tip=points[3]-layout.position-direction*9;var normal=new Vector2(-direction.y,direction.x);
                    var paint=ctx.painter2D;paint.fillColor=owner.Scheduled?new Color(.94f,.68f,.3f):inputColor;paint.BeginPath();paint.MoveTo(tip);
                    paint.LineTo(tip-direction*(owner.Scheduled?6:9)+normal*4);
                    if(owner.Scheduled)paint.LineTo(tip-direction*12);
                    paint.LineTo(tip-direction*(owner.Scheduled?6:9)-normal*4);paint.ClosePath();paint.Fill();
                };
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
    /// <summary>One field renderer for the Project Inspector and Workbench. Relationships are

    public static class GameplaySkillFieldSchema

        private static readonly IGameplaySkillValueEditor[] Providers = TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplaySkillValueEditor>()

            .OrderBy(t => t.FullName).Select(t => (IGameplaySkillValueEditor)Activator.CreateInstance(t)).ToArray();

        private static readonly Dictionary<Type, Type> CoreValues = new Dictionary<Type, Type> {
            {typeof(GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset),typeof(GameplayEffectDefinitionData)},
            {typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset),typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionData)},
            {typeof(GameplayContinuationDefinitionAsset),typeof(GameplayContinuationDefinitionData)},
            {typeof(GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset),typeof(GameplayProjectileDefinitionData)},
            {typeof(GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset),typeof(GameplayAreaDefinitionData)},
            {typeof(GameplaySummonDefinitionAsset),typeof(GameplaySummonDefinitionData)} };
        private sealed class EditState { internal bool Structural; internal readonly HashSet<string> Paths=new HashSet<string>(); }
        private static HashSet<string> _fieldChanges;
        private sealed class FieldCapture:IDisposable { private readonly HashSet<string> _previous;internal FieldCapture(EditState edit){_previous=_fieldChanges;_fieldChanges=edit.Paths;}public void Dispose(){_fieldChanges=_previous;} }
        private static void Field(SerializedProperty property,GUIContent caption=null){if(property==null||CardSummary(property))return;EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();if(property.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.Enum){var options=GameplaySkillBusinessLabels.Options(property).Select((label,i)=>new GUIContent(label,property.enumNames[i])).ToArray();property.enumValueIndex=EditorGUILayout.Popup(caption??GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(property),property.enumValueIndex,options);}else GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(property,caption??GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(property));if(EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())_fieldChanges?.Add(property.propertyPath);}
        private static readonly HashSet<string> Open = new HashSet<string>();
        private static readonly HashSet<string> ClosedSections = new HashSet<string>();
        private static readonly Dictionary<int,string> Errors = new Dictionary<int,string>();
        private static HashSet<string> _cardPaths;
        public static string Error(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document) => Errors.TryGetValue(document.GetInstanceID(),out var error)?error:null;
        // managedReferenceValue/boxedValue return the live managed object, not pending native
        // child edits. Overlay only supplied fields on a disposable value clone before validation.
        internal static void SetPending(object owner,string relative,SerializedProperty pending)
        {
            string[] parts=relative.Replace(".Array.data[","[").Split('.');
            Assign(owner,0);
            object Assign(object current,int at)
            {
                string part=parts[at];int bracket=part.IndexOf('[');
                var field=GameplayGraphFields.SerializedFields(current.GetType()).Single(f=>f.Name==(bracket<0?part:part.Substring(0,bracket)));

        private static object PendingValue(SerializedProperty property,Type declared=null)
        {

                Type element=declared.IsArray?declared.GetElementType():declared.GetGenericArguments()[0];
                var list=declared.IsArray?(System.Collections.IList)Array.CreateInstance(element,property.arraySize):(System.Collections.IList)Activator.CreateInstance(declared);
                for(int i=0;i<property.arraySize;i++){var item=PendingValue(property.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i),element);if(declared.IsArray)list[i]=item;else list.Add(item);}return list;
            }

            if(value==null||property.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.Generic&&property.propertyType!=SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference)return value;
            var copy=GameplayGraphFields.Clone(value);
            foreach(var field in GameplayGraphFields.SerializedFields(copy.GetType())){var child=property.FindPropertyRelative(field.Name);if(child!=null)field.SetValue(copy,PendingValue(child,field.FieldType));}
            return copy;
        }
        /// <summary>Captures the actual initiating binding, including nested local-source routes.
        /// Direct local-definition editing has no node binding and uses its own source lifetime.</summary>
        public static Func<bool> CaptureBinding(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string ownerId,string path,string expectedLocalId)
        {
            var parent=CurrentSourceGuard;
            return ()=>{
                if(!document||parent!=null&&!parent())return false;
                var graph=document.AuthoringGraph;
                var bindings=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==ownerId)?.Payload.Definitions??graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==ownerId)?.Definitions;
                return bindings?.Any(b=>b.PropertyPath==path&&b.LocalId==expectedLocalId&&!b.External)==true;
            };
        }
        /// <summary>The current IMGUI source route; providers capture it before deferring a write.</summary>
        public static Func<bool> CurrentSourceGuard {get;private set;}
        private sealed class SourceScope:IDisposable
        {
            private readonly Func<bool> _previous=CurrentSourceGuard;
            internal SourceScope(Func<bool> guard){CurrentSourceGuard=guard;}
            public void Dispose(){CurrentSourceGuard=_previous;}
        }
        private sealed class CardResponsibility:IDisposable
        {
            private readonly HashSet<string> _previous=_cardPaths;
            internal CardResponsibility(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,bool enabled,SerializedObject serialized,bool animationHeader)
            { _cardPaths=enabled?new HashSet<string>(GameplaySkillCardFields.Describe(document,nodeId,serialized,animationHeader).Where(f=>f.Editable).Select(f=>f.Path)):null; }

        private static bool CardSummary(SerializedProperty property)
        {

            return true; // The card is the primary presentation; do not repeat scalar labels here.
        }
        public static void RevealField(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string path)
        {
            ClosedSections.RemoveWhere(key=>key.StartsWith(document.GetInstanceID()+":",StringComparison.Ordinal));
            using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(document)){string current="";foreach(string part in path.Split('.')){current=current.Length==0?part:current+"."+part;var property=serialized.FindProperty(current);if(property!=null)property.isExpanded=true;}}
        }
        /// <summary>Validates the pending native serialized buffer before Apply records Undo or
        /// dirties the asset. Rejected field changes are discarded without touching the source.</summary>
        public static bool ApplyFields(SerializedObject serialized, GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, bool validateStructure = true, IEnumerable<string> changedPaths = null)
        {
            if(GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(document)){serialized.Update();return false;}
            if(!serialized.hasModifiedProperties)return false;
            try{
                if(changedPaths!=null&&changedPaths.Any(path=>path.EndsWith(".Action.Key",StringComparison.Ordinal)||path.EndsWith(".Action.Key.Name",StringComparison.Ordinal))){
                    var paths=new HashSet<string>(changedPaths);
                    GameplaySkillContextVariables.For(document).StageRenames(serialized,paths);
                    changedPaths=paths;
                }
                var invalidation=GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Fields(document,changedPaths,validateStructure);
                if(GameplayBehaviorGraphView.FollowsMainAnimation(document)){
                    var followed=(GameplayAuthoringGraph)PendingValue(serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph"));
                    GameplayBehaviorGraphView.FollowMainAnimationDurations(document,followed);
                    for(int i=0;i<followed.Timelines.Count;i++)serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.Timelines").GetArrayElementAtIndex(i).FindPropertyRelative("DurationSeconds").floatValue=followed.Timelines[i].DurationSeconds;
                    invalidation=GameplaySkillAuthoringChange.Full(invalidation.Structural);
                }
                if(validateStructure||invalidation.Structural||invalidation.Context){
                var staged=changedPaths==null?(GameplayAuthoringGraph)PendingValue(serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph")):(GameplayAuthoringGraph)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(document.AuthoringGraph);
                if(changedPaths!=null)foreach(string path in changedPaths.Where(p=>p.StartsWith("authoringGraph.",StringComparison.Ordinal)))SetPending(staged,path.Substring(15),serialized.FindProperty(path));
                var validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();GameplayGraphCompiler.ValidateStructure(staged,validation,"字段",false);
                if(validation.HasErrors)throw new InvalidOperationException(string.Join("\n",validation.Issues));
                GameplayGraphCompiler.ValidateActionOrder(staged);
                }
                Errors.Remove(document.GetInstanceID());bool changed=serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();if(changed)GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.NotifyFields(document,invalidation);return changed;
            }catch(Exception error){Errors[document.GetInstanceID()]=error.Message;serialized.Update();return false;}
        }
        public static IEnumerable<Type> Values(Type resource) => CoreValues.Where(p => resource.IsAssignableFrom(p.Key)).Select(p => p.Value)
            .Concat(Providers.SelectMany(p => p.ValueTypes(resource))).Distinct();
        internal static IEnumerable<(string Name, GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload Value)> CreationPresets(Type valueType)
            => Providers.OfType<IGameplaySkillValueCreationPresets>().SelectMany(p => p.CreationPresets(valueType));

        public static bool TryDuration(GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,string nodeId,out string localId,out string path,out float seconds){
            localId=null;path=null;seconds=0;var node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==nodeId);if(node==null)return false;
            foreach(var binding in node.Payload.Definitions){var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId);object values=local?.Payload;if(values==null&&binding.External){try{values=binding.External.CaptureGraphValues();}catch(NotSupportedException){}}if(values==null)continue;
                foreach(var provider in Providers.OfType<IGameplaySkillValueDuration>())if(provider.TryReadDuration(values,out path,out seconds)){localId=local?.Id;return seconds>0;}}

             type == typeof(GameplayAreaDefinitionData) ? "逻辑区域" : type == typeof(GameplaySummonDefinitionData) ? "逻辑召唤" :
             type == typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionData) ? "释放 / 消耗 / 冷却" : "后续规则");

        public static string NodeName(GameplayAuthoringNode node)
        {
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.Title)) return node.Title;
            if (node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload) return "技能施放";
            if (node.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload) return "触发规则";

        public static string PortName(string path)
        {
            if(path==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Completion)return "自然完成 · 添加效果";
            if(path==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Overflow)return "叠层溢出 · 添加效果";
            if(path.StartsWith("Completion/",StringComparison.Ordinal))return "自然完成 · 续接效果";
            if(path.StartsWith("Overflow/",StringComparison.Ordinal))return "叠层溢出 · 续接效果";
            if (path == "Then") return "后续执行";
            var key = path.Split('.').Last();
            return key == "Actions" ? "执行" : key == "EachTarget" ? "每个目标" : key == "Completed" ? "搜索完成" :
                key == "NoTargets" ? "无目标" : key == "TrueActions" ? "满足条件" : key == "FalseActions" ? "不满足" :
                key == "OnHit" ? "命中" : key == "OnArrive" ? "到达" : key == "OnRange" ? "射程结束" :
                key == "OnEnter" ? "进入" : key == "OnExit" ? "离开" : key == "OnTick" ? "周期" : key=="OnStay"?"持续停留（每步）":
                key == "OnEnd" ? "结束" : key == "OnCancelled" ? "取消" :
                key == "OnBroken" ? "耗尽 · 破盾者" : key == "OnExpired" ? "到期 · 原目标" :
                ObjectNames.NicifyVariableName(path);
        }

        public static void Draw(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string nodeId, string definitionId = null, bool cardFields = false)
        {
            if(!document)return;
            using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(document))Draw(serialized,document,nodeId,definitionId,cardFields);
        }
        /// <summary>Draws against the canvas-owned buffer; does not dispose it or cache property paths.</summary>
        internal static void Draw(SerializedObject serialized,GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,string definitionId,bool cardFields,bool animationHeader=false)
        {
            if (!document) return;
            if(Errors.TryGetValue(document.GetInstanceID(),out string error))EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(error,MessageType.Error);
            if (document.AuthoringSchemaVersion != 2) { EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("此数据格式不能直接编辑；请选择 Schema 2 正式技能。", MessageType.Warning); return; }
            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode||GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(document)))
            using (new CardResponsibility(document,nodeId,cardFields&&definitionId==null,serialized,animationHeader))
````
