            using (GameplayAuthoringInspector.UseScope(document.AuthoringGraph.Scope))
            {
                if(cardFields){
                    var selected=document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==nodeId);
                    GUILayout.Label(selected==null?"高级配置":GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Name(selected,document.AuthoringGraph),EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                    EditorGUILayout.LabelField("配置来源",AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(document));
                    GUILayout.Label("Scope · "+document.AuthoringGraph.Scope+" · 常用值在画布直接编辑；以下为高级配置。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                }
                serialized.UpdateIfRequiredOrScript();var edit=new EditState();using(var capture=new FieldCapture(edit)){EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
                if (definitionId != null)
                {
                    int i = document.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.FindIndex(d => d.Id == definitionId);
                    if (i >= 0) DrawDefinition(document, serialized, i, new HashSet<string>(),edit);
                }
                else
                {
                    int i = document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.FindIndex(n => n.Id == nodeId);
                    if(i<0&&nodeId!=null){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("此行为已移除；撤销可恢复，或选择其它行为继续编辑。",MessageType.Info);return;}
                    if (i < 0 || document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes[i].Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload){
                        string identityKey="Identity:"+document.GetInstanceID();
                        if(!cardFields)DrawIdentity(serialized);
                        else{bool open=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(Open.Contains(identityKey),"技能身份 / 事件 / 默认输入",true);if(open){Open.Add(identityKey);DrawIdentity(serialized);}else Open.Remove(identityKey);}
                    }
                    if (i >= 0)
                    {
                        var node = document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes[i];
                        if(!cardFields)GUILayout.Label(NodeName(node), EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                        var root = serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.Nodes").GetArrayElementAtIndex(i);
                        Field(root.FindPropertyRelative("Title"), new GUIContent("卡片别名", "只改变画布标题；正式技能显示名在施放卡编辑。"));
                        var payload = root.FindPropertyRelative("Payload");
                        if (node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload ability)
                        {
                            if(GameplayBehaviorGraphView.InlinePrimaryRule(document)){
                                int ruleIndex=document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.FindIndex(n=>n.Id==document.AuthoringGraph.PrimaryRuleNodeId);var rule=document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes[ruleIndex];
                                string key="PrimaryRule:"+document.GetInstanceID();
                                string caption=((GameplayRuleNodePayload)rule.Payload).Target is GameplaySkillPointTargetAuthoring
                                    ?"施放触发 / 固定地点坐标":"施放触发 / 目标（高级）";
                                bool open=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(Open.Contains(key),caption,true);
                                if(open){Open.Add(key);DrawValue(document,serialized,serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.Nodes").GetArrayElementAtIndex(ruleIndex).FindPropertyRelative("Payload"),rule.Id,rule.Payload.Definitions,"",new HashSet<string>(),edit);}else Open.Remove(key);
                            }
                            if (ability.Settings != null) DrawValue(document, serialized, payload.FindPropertyRelative("Settings"), node.Id, ability.Definitions, "", new HashSet<string>(),edit);
                            else DrawBinding(document, serialized, node.Id, ability.Definitions, "Settings", typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset), new HashSet<string>(),edit);
                        }
                        else if (node.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload action)
                            DrawValue(document, serialized, payload.FindPropertyRelative("Action"), node.Id, action.Definitions, "", new HashSet<string>(),edit);
                        else DrawValue(document, serialized, payload, node.Id, node.Payload.Definitions, "", new HashSet<string>(),edit);
                    }
                }
                if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()) ApplyFields(serialized,document,edit.Structural,edit.Paths);
                }
            }
        }
        private static void DrawIdentity(SerializedObject serialized)
        {
            GUILayout.Label("正式技能", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            foreach (string field in new[] { "SkillId", "DisplayName", "Icon", "Mode", "RunRulesOnPassiveActivation", "Subject", "CastEvent", "Defaults", "LearningRequirements" })
                Field(serialized.FindProperty(field));
            var scope = serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.Scope");
            Field(scope, new GUIContent("创作 Scope"));
        }
        private static void DrawDefinition(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc, SerializedObject serialized, int index, HashSet<string> visited,EditState edit)
        {
            var definition = doc.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions[index];
            if (!visited.Add(definition.Id)) { EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("局部引用循环。", MessageType.Error); return; }
            GUILayout.Label(definition.Name + " · 内嵌配置", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            var p = serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions").GetArrayElementAtIndex(index);
            Field(p.FindPropertyRelative("Name"), new GUIContent("名称"));
            DrawValue(doc, serialized, p.FindPropertyRelative("Payload"), definition.Id, definition.Definitions, "", visited,edit);
            visited.Remove(definition.Id);
        }
        private static void DrawValue(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc, SerializedObject serialized, SerializedProperty root,
            string ownerId, List<GameplayDefinitionBinding> bindings, string bindingPrefix, HashSet<string> visited,EditState edit)
        {
            if (root == null) return;
            object value = root.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference ? root.managedReferenceValue : root.boxedValue;
            if (value == null) return;
            var resources = GameplayGraphFields.ResourceSlots(value).ToDictionary(s => s.Path, s => s.ValueType);
            var arrays = new HashSet<string>(GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(value).Select(s => s.Path));
            string inactiveKey="Inactive:"+doc.GetInstanceID()+":"+root.propertyPath;bool showInactive=Open.Contains(inactiveKey);
            DrawChildren(root, value, "");
            if(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData||value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData||value is GameplayAreaDefinitionData){
                bool next=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(showInactive,"高级 / 显示当前策略未启用的配置",true);
                if(next)Open.Add(inactiveKey);else Open.Remove(inactiveKey);
                if(next)GUILayout.Label("切换策略保留原配置；有校验冲突时可在此清除不再使用的字段。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
            }
            void DrawChildren(SerializedProperty parent, object owner, string relative)
            {
                var children=new List<SerializedProperty>();var cursor=parent.Copy();var end=parent.GetEndProperty();
                if(cursor.NextVisible(true))do{
                    if(SerializedProperty.EqualContents(cursor,end))break;
                    if(IsValueFieldVisible(owner,cursor.name))children.Add(cursor.Copy());
                }while(cursor.NextVisible(false));
                var sections=ValueSections.SelectMany(p=>p.Sections(owner)).ToList();if(sections.Count==0)sections=GameplayStandardBusinessInspector.Describe(owner).ToList();
                var covered=new HashSet<string>(sections.SelectMany(g=>g.Paths));
                var rest=children.Where(p=>!covered.Contains(p.name)&&p.name!="Definitions").Select(p=>p.name).ToArray();
                if(rest.Length>0)sections.Add(new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,sections.Count==0?"业务配置":"其它配置",null,rest));
                foreach(var section in sections){
                    var fields=section.Paths.Select(name=>children.Find(p=>p.name==name)).Where(p=>p!=null&&(showInactive||Visible(owner,p.name))).ToArray();
                    if(fields.Length==0)continue;
                    bool showHeading=sections.Count>1||section.Note!=null;
                    string sectionKey=doc.GetInstanceID()+":"+parent.propertyPath+":"+section.Title;
                    if(showHeading){
                        bool open=!ClosedSections.Contains(sectionKey);bool next=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(open,section.Title,true,EditorStyles.foldoutHeader);
                        if(next)ClosedSections.Remove(sectionKey);else ClosedSections.Add(sectionKey);
                        if(!next)continue;
                        if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(section.Note))GUILayout.Label(section.Note,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                    }
                    foreach(var it in fields){
                    string path = relative.Length == 0 ? it.name : relative + "." + it.name;
                    string bindingPath = bindingPrefix.Length == 0 ? path : bindingPrefix + "." + path;
                    if (it.name == "Definitions") continue;
                    if(!showInactive&&!Visible(owner,it.name))continue;
                    if(_cardPaths!=null&&owner is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData&&(it.name=="Cost"||it.name=="Charge"||it.name=="CooldownEffect")){EditorGUILayout.LabelField(GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(it),new GUIContent("在对应消耗、冷却或充能节点编辑；复杂值从节点进入"));continue;}
                    if(CardSummary(it)){
                        // The target dropdown owns the type choice. Its configuration still belongs here.
                        if(it.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference&&it.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring target)
                            DrawChildren(it,target,path);
                        else
                            foreach(var provider in Providers.OfType<IGameplaySkillFieldControlProvider>())if(provider.DrawSourceLink(root,it))break;
                        continue;
                    }

                    if (arrays.Contains(path)) { EditorGUILayout.LabelField(PortName(path), "在画布端口连接行为", EditorStyles.miniLabel); continue; }
                    if (resources.TryGetValue(path, out var resource)) { DrawBinding(doc, serialized, ownerId, bindings, bindingPath, resource, visited,edit); continue; }
                    var fieldInfo = GameplayGraphFields.SerializedFields(owner.GetType()).FirstOrDefault(f => f.Name == it.name);
                    Type fieldType = fieldInfo?.FieldType;
                    if (fieldType != null && fieldType.IsArray && typeof(GameplayDefinitionAsset).IsAssignableFrom(fieldType.GetElementType()))
                    {
                        GUILayout.Label(GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(it));
                        for (int j = 0; j < it.arraySize; j++) {
                            DrawBinding(doc, serialized, ownerId, bindings, bindingPath + ".Array.data[" + j + "]", fieldType.GetElementType(), visited,edit);
                            if(GUILayout.Button("移除此引用 #"+(j+1))){ApplyFields(serialized,doc);GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.RemoveResourceEntry(doc,ownerId,bindingPath,j);GUIUtility.ExitGUI();}
                        }
                        if (GUILayout.Button("添加引用")) { it.InsertArrayElementAtIndex(it.arraySize); it.GetArrayElementAtIndex(it.arraySize - 1).objectReferenceValue = null;edit.Structural=true; }
                        continue;
                    }
                    EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();bool provided=Providers.Any(p => p.DrawField(root,it));if(EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())edit.Paths.Add(it.propertyPath);if(provided)continue;
                    if (it.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference || it.isArray && it.propertyType != SerializedPropertyType.String ||
                        it.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.Generic && !(it.boxedValue is GameplayTagReference) && !(it.boxedValue is GameplayAttributeReference))
                        DrawStructured(it.Copy(), fieldType, path);
                    else {
                        bool policy=it.name=="Motion"||it.name=="StraightDestination"||it.name=="DurationPolicy"||it.name=="Overflow";
                        if(policy)EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();Field(it);if(policy&&EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())edit.Structural=true;
                    }
                    }
                    if(showHeading)GUILayout.Space(7);
                }
            }
            void DrawStructured(SerializedProperty p, Type fieldType, string path)
            {
                if (p.isArray)
                {
                    p.isExpanded = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(p.isExpanded, GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(p).text + " · " + p.arraySize, true);
                    if (!p.isExpanded) return;
                    EditorGUI.indentLevel++;
                    for (int j = 0; j < p.arraySize; j++)
                    {
                        var element = p.GetArrayElementAtIndex(j); Type elementType = fieldType?.GetElementType();
                        EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal(); GUILayout.Label("顺序 " + (j + 1), EditorStyles.miniLabel);
                        if (GUILayout.Button("↑", GUILayout.Width(25)) && j > 0) { p.MoveArrayElement(j, j - 1);edit.Structural=true; GUI.changed = true; }
                        if (GUILayout.Button("↓", GUILayout.Width(25)) && j + 1 < p.arraySize) { p.MoveArrayElement(j, j + 1);edit.Structural=true; GUI.changed = true; }
                        if (GUILayout.Button("×", GUILayout.Width(25))) {
                            object item=element.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference?element.managedReferenceValue:null;
                            string callbackKey=item is GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring completion?"Completion/"+completion.AuthoringId:item is GameplayApplyEffectOnOverflowAuthoring overflow?"Overflow/"+overflow.AuthoringId:null;
                            if(callbackKey!=null){EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();ApplyFields(serialized,doc);GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.RemoveEffectCallback(doc,ownerId,callbackKey);GUIUtility.ExitGUI();}
                            p.DeleteArrayElementAtIndex(j);edit.Structural=true; GUI.changed = true; EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal(); break;
                        }
                        EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
                        DrawStructured(element, elementType, path + ".Array.data[" + j + "]");
                    }
                    if (GUILayout.Button("添加 " + GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(p).text))
                    {
                        edit.Structural=true;
                        if (fieldType?.GetElementType() is Type type && !type.IsAbstract)
                        { int at = p.arraySize++; var e = p.GetArrayElementAtIndex(at); if (e.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference) e.managedReferenceValue = Activator.CreateInstance(type); GUI.changed = true; }
                        else Pick(p, fieldType?.GetElementType(), true);
                    }
                    EditorGUI.indentLevel--; return;
                }
                if (p.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference)
                {
                    var current = p.managedReferenceValue;
                    EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal(); GUILayout.Label(GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(p));
                    if (GUILayout.Button(current == null ? "选择配置…" : GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(current.GetType()).DisplayName)) Pick(p, fieldType, false);
                    EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
                    if (current != null) { EditorGUI.indentLevel++; DrawChildren(p, current, path); EditorGUI.indentLevel--; }
                }
                else if (p.propertyType == SerializedPropertyType.Generic)
                { object current = p.boxedValue; if (current != null) { GUILayout.Label(GameplayAuthoringInspector.Label(p), EditorStyles.boldLabel); EditorGUI.indentLevel++; DrawChildren(p, current, path); EditorGUI.indentLevel--; } }
                else Field(p);
            }
            void Pick(SerializedProperty property, Type type, bool append)
            {
                if (type == null) return;
                string propertyPath = property.propertyPath;
                if(serialized.hasModifiedProperties&&!ApplyFields(serialized,doc))return;
                var handle=GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(doc,propertyPath);
                string expected=append?null:property.managedReferenceFullTypename;
                GameplayAuthoringTypePicker.Show(type, doc, selected => {
                    using (var so = new SerializedObject(doc)) {
                        var target = so.FindProperty(handle.ResolvePath()); if (target == null||!append&&target.managedReferenceFullTypename!=expected)throw new InvalidOperationException("字段已被替换或重排，请重新选择配置。");
                        if(selected!=null&&!GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Query(type,doc.AuthoringGraph.Scope).Contains(selected))throw new InvalidOperationException("此类型在当前 Scope 不可用。");
                        if(!append&&selected==null&&(target.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring||target.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring))throw new InvalidOperationException("这是必需的触发或目标配置，请选择替代类型。");
                        if(!append&&target.managedReferenceValue!=null&&target.managedReferenceValue.GetType()!=selected){if(!EditorUtility.DisplayDialog("替换业务配置","将替换「"+GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(target.managedReferenceValue.GetType()).DisplayName+"」及其字段；一次 Undo 可恢复原配置。","替换","取消"))return;}
                        if (append) { int at = target.arraySize++; target.GetArrayElementAtIndex(at).managedReferenceValue = selected == null ? null : Activator.CreateInstance(selected); }
                        else target.managedReferenceValue = selected == null ? null : Activator.CreateInstance(selected);
                        ApplyFields(so,doc);
                    }
                }, doc.AuthoringGraph.Scope);
            }
        }
        private static bool Visible(object owner,string field)
        {
            if(owner is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect){
                if(field=="Duration"||field=="DurationValue"||field=="CompletionExecutions")return effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;
                if(field=="Period"||field=="PeriodValue"||field=="PeriodicStart"||field=="Stacking"||field=="Modifiers"||field=="GrantedTags"||field=="OngoingRequirements")return effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant;
            }
            if(owner is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile){
                if(field=="StraightDestination")return projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight;
                if(field=="DirectionAngle")return projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight||projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Arc;
                if(field=="CurveHeight")return projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Arc||projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Parabolic;
                if(field=="Control1Offset"||field=="Control2Offset")return projectile.Motion==Standard.GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Bezier;
            }
            if(owner is GameplayAreaDefinitionData area){
                if(field=="Radius")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Circle||area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Sector;
                if(field=="Angle")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Sector;
                if(field=="Length"||field=="Width")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Box;
                if(field=="Cells"||field=="CellSize")return area.Shape==GameplayAreaAuthoringShape.Cells;
            }
            return GameplayAuthoringFieldSchema.Visible(owner,field);
        }
        private static void DrawBinding(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc, SerializedObject serialized, string ownerId,
            List<GameplayDefinitionBinding> bindings, string path, Type resourceType, HashSet<string> visited,EditState edit)
        {
            var binding = bindings.FirstOrDefault(b => b.PropertyPath == path);
            var callback=GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(doc.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==ownerId)?.Payload).SingleOrDefault(s=>s.Path==path);
            var callbackEdge=callback==null?null:doc.AuthoringGraph.Connections.SingleOrDefault(e=>e.FromNodeId==ownerId&&e.OutputPortKey==callback.Key&&e.InputPortKey==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input);
            if(callback!=null){
                if(callbackEdge!=null){
                    var target=doc.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Single(n=>n.Id==callbackEdge.ToNodeId);EditorGUILayout.LabelField("续接效果",GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(target));
                    if(GUILayout.Button("定位后续效果"))GameplaySkillWorkbench.Open(doc,target.Id);
                    if(GUILayout.Button("断开连接 · 保留回调配置")){GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Disconnect(doc,callbackEdge.Id);GUIUtility.ExitGUI();}
                }else{
                    EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("待重连：拥有标志、技能 ID 和回调策略均保留；此执行器尚不参与运行。溢出没有活动执行器时拒绝本次溢出。",MessageType.Warning);
                    if(GUILayout.Button("选择后续效果…")){
                        var menu=new GenericMenu();foreach(var target in doc.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Where(n=>GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.EffectBinding(n)!=null)){
                            string targetId=target.Id;menu.AddItem(new GUIContent(NodeName(target)),false,()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Connect(doc,ownerId,callback.Key,targetId,false,GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input));
                        }menu.ShowAsContext();
                    }
                }
                if(GUILayout.Button("删除此回调及配置（可撤销）")){GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.RemoveEffectCallback(doc,ownerId,callback.Key);GUIUtility.ExitGUI();}return;
            }
            string label = path == "Settings" ? "释放配置" : path == "Effect" ? "效果" : path == "Animation" ? "动画" : path == "Cue" ? "特效 / 音效" : path == "CooldownEffect" ? "冷却效果" : path.Split('.').Last();
            EditorGUILayout.BeginVertical(EditorStyles.helpBox);
            var local = binding == null ? null : doc.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d => d.Id == binding.LocalId);
            var timeline = binding == null ? null : doc.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Find(t => t.Id == binding.LocalId);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField(label, timeline != null ? "时间编排 · " + timeline.Name : local != null ? "内嵌 · " + local.Name : binding?.External ? "共享资源" : "未配置（可选字段保持空）");
            if (local != null)
            {
                string key = doc.GetInstanceID() + ":" + ownerId + ":" + path;
                bool open = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(!ClosedSections.Contains(key), Name(local.Payload.GetType()), true);
                if (open) { ClosedSections.Remove(key); using(new SourceScope(CaptureBinding(doc,ownerId,path,local.Id)))DrawDefinition(doc, serialized, doc.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.IndexOf(local), visited,edit); } else ClosedSections.Add(key);
            }
            else if (binding?.External)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("来源",binding.External,resourceType,false);
                string key="Shared:"+doc.GetInstanceID()+":"+ownerId+":"+path;
                bool open=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(Open.Contains(key),"共享资源业务配置",true);
                if(open){Open.Add(key);using(var shared=new SerializedObject(binding.External))GameplayAuthoringInspector.Draw(shared);}else Open.Remove(key);
                if(GUILayout.Button("定位共享资源")){Selection.activeObject=binding.External;EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(binding.External);}
            }
            if (timeline == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                if (GUILayout.Button("选择 / 新建…"))
                {
                    ApplyFields(serialized,doc);
                    var menu = new GenericMenu();
                    foreach (var type in Values(resourceType))
                    {
                        var presets=CreationPresets(type).ToArray();
                        if(presets.Length==0)
                            menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("新建内嵌/"+Name(type)),false,()=>Bind(doc,ownerId,path,type,null,null));
                        else
                            foreach(var preset in presets)
                                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("新建内嵌/"+preset.Name),false,()=>BindValue(doc,ownerId,path,preset.Value,preset.Name,null,null,false));
                    }
                    foreach (var d in doc.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Where(d => Values(resourceType).Any(t => t.IsInstanceOfType(d.Payload))))
                    { string id = d.Id; menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("复用本技能/" + d.Name), false, () => Bind(doc, ownerId, path, null, id, null)); }
                    menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("解除引用 / 删除独占局部配置"), false, () => Bind(doc, ownerId, path, null, null, null));
                    menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("解除引用 / 保留局部配置"), false, () => Bind(doc, ownerId, path, null, null, null,true)); menu.ShowAsContext();
                }

                EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
                string sharedKey="ChooseShared:"+doc.GetInstanceID()+":"+ownerId+":"+path;
                bool chooseShared=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(Open.Contains(sharedKey),"改用外部共享资源",true);
                if(chooseShared){Open.Add(sharedKey);var external=(GameplayDefinitionAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("共享来源",binding?.External,resourceType,false);if(external!=binding?.External){ApplyFields(serialized,doc);Bind(doc,ownerId,path,null,null,external);}}else Open.Remove(sharedKey);
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndVertical();
        }
        public static void Bind(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc, string ownerId, string path, Type create, string localId, GameplayDefinitionAsset external,bool keepReleasedDraft=false)
            => BindValue(doc,ownerId,path,create==null?null:(GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload)Activator.CreateInstance(create),
                create==null?null:Name(create),localId,external,keepReleasedDraft);

        private static void BindValue(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc,string ownerId,string path,GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload value,
            string name,string localId,GameplayDefinitionAsset external,bool keepReleasedDraft)
        {
            GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(doc, "配置正式资源", graph => {
                var node = graph.Nodes.Find(n => n.Id == ownerId);
                var bindings = node?.Payload.Definitions ?? graph.LocalDefinitions.Single(d => d.Id == ownerId).Definitions;
                var released=bindings.Where(b=>b.PropertyPath==path).Select(b=>b.LocalId).Where(id=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)).ToArray();
                if(path=="Settings"&&node?.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload ability){
                    ability.Settings=value;
                    bindings.RemoveAll(b=>b.PropertyPath==path);
                    if(external)bindings.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath=path,External=external});return;
                }
                if (value != null) { var local = new GameplayLocalDefinition { Name = name, Payload = value, SourceDefinitionId = doc.DefinitionId }; graph.LocalDefinitions.Add(local); localId = local.Id; }
                bindings.RemoveAll(b => b.PropertyPath == path);
                if (localId != null || external) bindings.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding { PropertyPath = path, LocalId = localId, External = external });
                if(!keepReleasedDraft)GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CollectReleased(graph,released);
            });
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Cheap typed host metadata over current values and explicitly shared resources.
    /// It neither discovers project assets nor creates a spatial backend.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillHostRequirements
    {
        public static IEnumerable<GameplaySpatialPlane> Planes(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        {
            foreach(var action in document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Select(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action).OfType<GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring>())yield return action.Plane;
            foreach(var value in document.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Select(d=>d.Payload)){
                if(value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile)yield return projectile.Plane;
                if(value is GameplayAreaDefinitionData area)yield return area.Plane;
            }
            foreach(var value in document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.SelectMany(n=>n.Payload.Definitions).Concat(document.AuthoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.SelectMany(d=>d.Definitions)).Select(b=>b.External)){
                if(value is GameplayProjectileDefinitionAsset projectile)yield return projectile.Plane;
                if(value is GameplayAreaDefinitionAsset area)yield return area.Plane;
            }
        }
        public static string Physics2DReason(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)=>Planes(document).Any(p=>p!=GameplaySpatialPlane.XY)?"此技能使用 XZ / 3D 范围；Physics2D 仅支持 XY，请选择 Logical / Physics3D Host。":null;
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using Object=UnityEngine.Object;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Explicit physical cleanup only. Uses indexed dependencies and streamed exact
    /// GUID/fileID references; never loads project artwork to discover consumers. Ordinary node
    /// Delete does not call this audit.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillLegacyCleanup : IDisposable
    {
        private static readonly Regex Header=new Regex(@"^--- !u!\d+ &(-?\d+)",RegexOptions.Compiled);
        private static readonly Regex Reference=new Regex(@"\{fileID:\s*(-?\d+)(?:,\s*guid:\s*([a-fA-F0-9]{32}))?[^}]*\}",RegexOptions.Compiled);
        private readonly Dictionary<string,Object> _candidates=new Dictionary<string,Object>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>> _incoming=new Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>> _outgoing=new Dictionary<string,HashSet<string>>();
        private readonly Dictionary<string,byte[]> _backups=new Dictionary<string,byte[]>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _paths=new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _kept=new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _formal=new HashSet<string>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _touched=new HashSet<string>();
        private GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease _lease;
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset,string> _semantics=new Dictionary<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset,string>();
        private string[] _scan;private int _cursor;
        public bool Complete {get;private set;}
        public string Failure {get;private set;}
        public int Examined => _cursor;
        public int CandidateCount=>_candidates.Count;
        public int RemovableCount=>Complete?_candidates.Keys.Count(id=>!_kept.Contains(id)):0;
        public int KeptCount=>_kept.Count;
        public int DeletedObjects {get;private set;}
        public int DeletedFiles {get;private set;}
        /// <summary>Stops a read-only audit when its owner closes; a cancelled lease cannot commit.</summary>
        public void Dispose(){EditorApplication.update-=Advance;if(!Complete){Complete=true;Failure="审计已取消，没有修改资产。";}}
        public static GameplaySkillLegacyCleanup Begin(IEnumerable<string> originalSourcePaths)
        {
            var audit=new GameplaySkillLegacyCleanup();
            audit._lease=GameplaySkillAssetAuditLease.Capture();
            var documents=GameplaySkillWorkbench.Documents().Where(d=>d.AuthoringSchemaVersion==2).ToArray();
            var live=new HashSet<Object>(documents.SelectMany(d=>GameplayAuthoringDependencyGraph.BuildDefinition(d).Nodes).Select(n=>n.Asset));
            foreach(var document in documents)audit._semantics.Add(document,GameplaySkillDefinitionSemantics.Capture(document.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext())));
            foreach(string path in originalSourcePaths.Distinct())
            {
                var objects=AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(path);
                foreach(var obj in objects)
                {
                    bool obsolete=obj is GameplayDefinitionAsset&&!(obj is GameplaySkillDocumentAsset)&&!live.Contains(obj);
                    if(!obsolete)continue;
                    string id=Identity(obj);audit._candidates[id]=obj;audit._incoming[id]=new HashSet<string>();audit._paths.Add(path);
                }
            }
            audit._scan=AssetDatabase.GetAllAssetPaths().Where(p=>p.StartsWith("Assets/",StringComparison.Ordinal)&&File.Exists(p)).ToArray();
            EditorApplication.update+=audit.Advance;return audit;
        }
        private void Advance()
        {
            try
            {
                double stop=EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup+.008;int work=0;
                while(_cursor<_scan.Length&&work++<128&&EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup<stop)
                {
                    string path=_scan[_cursor++];
                    if(!_paths.Contains(path)&&!AssetDatabase.GetDependencies(path,false).Any(_paths.Contains))continue;
                    ReadReferences(path);
                }
                if(_cursor<_scan.Length)return;
                EditorApplication.update-=Advance;
                foreach(var pair in _incoming)if(pair.Value.Any(source=>!_candidates.ContainsKey(source)))_kept.Add(pair.Key);
                // A file containing a genuine live/shared child must retain its main object.
                foreach(string path in _paths)
                {
                    var objects=AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(path);
                    if(objects.Any(o=>!_candidates.ContainsKey(Identity(o))||_kept.Contains(Identity(o))))
                    {string main=Identity(AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(path));if(_candidates.ContainsKey(main))_kept.Add(main);}
                }
                bool changed;do{changed=false;foreach(string source in _kept.ToArray())if(_outgoing.TryGetValue(source,out var targets))foreach(string id in targets)if(_candidates.ContainsKey(id)){
                    if(_kept.Add(id))changed=true;if(_formal.Contains(source)&&_formal.Add(id))changed=true;
                }}while(changed);
                Complete=true;Debug.Log("A2 exact-reference cleanup audit: "+CandidateCount+" candidates, "+RemovableCount+" removable; "+KeptCount+" retained for real references/history/container identity. No assets changed.");
            }
            catch(Exception error){EditorApplication.update-=Advance;Failure=error.ToString();Complete=true;Debug.LogException(error);}
        }
        private bool IsHistoryReference(string path,string source,string target)
        {
            // Only an exact V2 archive slot can classify an incoming use as editor history.
            // Other hosts/assets, including unknown editor consumers, remain formal and editable.
            foreach(var doc in GameplaySkillWorkbench.Documents().Where(d=>AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(d)==path&&Identity(d)==source)){
                if(!doc.AuthoringGraph.LegacyResources.Any(l=>Identity(l.Resource)==target))continue;
                return !GameplayAuthoringDependencyGraph.BuildDefinition(doc).Nodes.Any(n=>Identity(n.Asset)==target);
            }return false;
        }
        private void ReadReferences(string path)
        {
            using(var reader=new StreamReader(path))
            {
                var headerBytes=new char[5];int headerLength=reader.Read(headerBytes,0,5);if(headerLength<5||new string(headerBytes)!="%YAML"){
                    // Indexed native/binary dependencies cannot prove a particular fileID unused.
                    // Conservatively protect all candidates in the referenced asset paths.
                    var dependencies=new HashSet<string>(AssetDatabase.GetDependencies(path,false));
                    foreach(var candidate in _candidates)if(dependencies.Contains(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(candidate.Value))){_kept.Add(candidate.Key);_formal.Add(candidate.Key);}
                    return;
                }
                string guid=AssetDatabase.AssetPathToGUID(path),source=guid+":0",line;
                while((line=reader.ReadLine())!=null)
                {
                    var header=Header.Match(line);if(header.Success){source=guid+":"+header.Groups[1].Value;continue;}
                    foreach(Match match in Reference.Matches(line))
                    {
                        string target=(match.Groups[2].Success?match.Groups[2].Value:guid)+":"+match.Groups[1].Value;
                        if(!_candidates.ContainsKey(target))continue;
                        _incoming[target].Add(source);if(!_outgoing.TryGetValue(source,out var edges))_outgoing[source]=edges=new HashSet<string>();edges.Add(target);
                        if(!_candidates.ContainsKey(source)&&!IsHistoryReference(path,source,target))_formal.Add(target);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        public void Commit()
        {
            if(!Complete||Failure!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Exact reference audit has not completed successfully.");
            _lease.Revalidate();
            foreach(string path in _paths){_backups[path]=File.ReadAllBytes(path);if(File.Exists(path+".meta"))_backups[path+".meta"]=File.ReadAllBytes(path+".meta");}
            try
            {
                foreach(string path in _paths)
                {
                    var main=AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(path);var objects=AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(path);
                    if(objects.All(o=>_candidates.ContainsKey(Identity(o))&&!_kept.Contains(Identity(o))))
                    {_touched.Add(path);if(!AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path))throw new IOException("Cannot delete audited unused source file: "+path);DeletedObjects+=objects.Length;DeletedFiles++;continue;}
                    foreach(var obj in objects.Where(o=>o!=main&&_candidates.ContainsKey(Identity(o))&&!_kept.Contains(Identity(o))).ToArray())
                    {_touched.Add(path);AssetDatabase.RemoveObjectFromAsset(obj);Object.DestroyImmediate(obj,true);EditorUtility.SetDirty(main);DeletedObjects++;}
                    foreach(var source in objects.OfType<GameplayDefinitionAsset>().Where(a=>a&&_kept.Contains(Identity(a)))){bool history=!_formal.Contains(Identity(source));if(source.MigrationHistoryOnly==history)continue;_touched.Add(path);source.MarkMigrationHistoryOnly(history);EditorUtility.SetDirty(source);}
                    if(main&&_touched.Contains(path))AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(main);
                }
                foreach(var pair in _semantics)GameplaySkillDefinitionSemantics.RequireEqual(pair.Value,pair.Key.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()),pair.Key.name);
                Debug.Log("A2 cleanup: deleted "+DeletedObjects+" old objects / "+DeletedFiles+" unused files. Runtime definitions remain equivalent.");
            }
            catch
            {
                foreach(var backup in _backups.Where(p=>_touched.Contains(p.Key.EndsWith(".meta",StringComparison.Ordinal)?p.Key.Substring(0,p.Key.Length-5):p.Key)))File.WriteAllBytes(backup.Key,backup.Value);
                AssetDatabase.Refresh();throw;
            }
        }
        private static string Identity(Object value)
        {if(!value)return "null";AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(value,out string guid,out long id);return guid+":"+id;}
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Editor-only metadata for a SerializeReference skill node; it never participates in Build or Execute.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor
    {
        public string DisplayName { get; }
        public string CategoryPath { get; }
        public string Summary { get; }
        public string AuthoringScope { get; }
        public string Keywords { get; }
        public bool IsSample { get; }
        public GameplayNodeVisualKind? VisualKind { get; }
        public bool IsAnimation { get; }
        /// <summary>Starts a short-lived presentation without waiting for it to finish.</summary>
        public bool IsPresentationCue { get; }

        public GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor(string displayName, string categoryPath, string summary,
            string authoringScope = "FRFrame", string keywords = "", bool isSample = false, GameplayNodeVisualKind? visualKind = null, bool isAnimation = false, bool isPresentationCue = false)
        {
            DisplayName = displayName;
            CategoryPath = categoryPath;
            Summary = summary;
            AuthoringScope = authoringScope; Keywords = keywords; IsSample = isSample;
            VisualKind = visualKind; IsAnimation = isAnimation;
            IsPresentationCue = isPresentationCue;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Game Editor assemblies can describe their own nodes without a FRFrame-to-game reference.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptorProvider
    {
        bool Supports(Type nodeType);
        GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor Describe(Type nodeType, SerializedProperty property);
    }

    /// <summary>Stable TypeCache discovery; duplicate claims are reported and resolved by provider type name.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors
    {
        private static readonly Dictionary<Type,GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor> TypeDescriptions=new Dictionary<Type,GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor>();
        /// <summary>Business creation categories shared by canvas, port and field pickers.</summary>
        public static string Category(Type type)
        {
            if(type==typeof(GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring))return "时间/时间编排";
            if(type==typeof(GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring))return "目标与空间/搜索";
            if(type==typeof(GameplaySpawnProjectileActionAuthoring))return "目标与空间/弹体";
            if(type==typeof(GameplaySpawnAreaActionAuthoring))return "目标与空间/持续区域";
            if(type==typeof(GameplaySpawnSummonActionAuthoring))return "目标与空间/召唤";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring)||type==typeof(GameplayRotateToPointActionAuthoring))return "状态与位移/移动朝向";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayChangeStateActionAuthoring))return "状态与位移/行为状态";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring))return "控制/结束与取消";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayCooldownActionAuthoring))return "控制/运行时冷却与回充";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayCaptureValueActionAuthoring)||type==typeof(GameplaySkillSetContextValueActionAuthoring)||type==typeof(GameplayCaptureCombatRollActionAuthoring))return "数值与上下文/捕获与赋值";
            if(type==typeof(GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring))return "条件与触发/条件分支";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring)||type==typeof(GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring)||type==typeof(GameplayDispelEffectsActionAuthoring))return "效果/护盾与驱散";
            if(typeof(GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring).IsAssignableFrom(type)||type==typeof(GameplayAbilityChargeAuthoring))return "技能配置/消耗与冷却策略";
            if(typeof(GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring).IsAssignableFrom(type))return "条件与触发/条件";
            if(typeof(GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring).IsAssignableFrom(type))return "效果/瞬时";
            if(type==typeof(GameplayRotateToPointActionAuthoring))return "任务 / 高级显式控制（可选）";
            var descriptor=Get(type);
            if(descriptor.IsAnimation)return "时间与表现/独立动画控制";
            if(descriptor.VisualKind==GameplayNodeVisualKind.Presentation)return "时间与表现/特效音效与飘字";
            if(typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring).IsAssignableFrom(type))return descriptor.AuthoringScope=="FRFrame"?"控制/其它标准行为":descriptor.AuthoringScope+"/扩展行为";
            if(typeof(GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring).IsAssignableFrom(type))return "条件与触发/触发事件";
            return "效果 / 高级配置";
        }
        private static readonly Type[] ProviderTypes = TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptorProvider>()
            .Where(t => !t.IsAbstract && t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null)
            .OrderBy(t => t.AssemblyQualifiedName, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();

        public static GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor Get(Type type, SerializedProperty property = null)
        {
            if (type == null) return new GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor("缺失引用", "无效", "请检查节点引用");
            if(property==null&&TypeDescriptions.TryGetValue(type,out var cached))return cached;
            foreach (Type providerType in ProviderTypes)
            {
                try
                {
                    var provider = (IGameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptorProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(providerType);
                    if (!provider.Supports(type)) continue;
                    var result=provider.Describe(type, property) ?? Fallback(type);if(property==null)TypeDescriptions[type]=result;return result;
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { UnityEngine.Debug.LogWarning("Skill node descriptor " + providerType.FullName + ": " + ex.Message); }
            }
            return Fallback(type);
        }

        public static IReadOnlyList<string> DuplicateClaims(Type type)
        {
            var claims = new List<string>();
            foreach (Type providerType in ProviderTypes)
                try
                {
                    if (((IGameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptorProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(providerType)).Supports(type))
                        claims.Add(providerType.FullName);
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { claims.Add(providerType.FullName + " failed: " + ex.Message); }
            return claims.Count > 1 ? new[] { type.FullName + ": descriptor providers: " + string.Join(", ", claims) } :
                Array.Empty<string>();
        }

        /// <summary>Check every concrete projected role, including plugin Trigger, Condition and Target nodes.</summary>
        public static IReadOnlyList<string> DuplicateClaims(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill)
        {
            if (skill == null) return Array.Empty<string>();
            using var so = new SerializedObject(skill);
            return GameplayAuthoringProperties.Walk(so).Where(p=>p.propertyType==SerializedPropertyType.ManagedReference).Select(p=>p.managedReferenceValue?.GetType())
                .Where(type => type != null).Distinct().SelectMany(DuplicateClaims).ToArray();
        }

        private static GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor Fallback(Type type) =>
            new GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor(ObjectNames.NicifyVariableName(type.Name.Replace("Authoring", "")),
                "其它 / 技术类型 / " + type.Assembly.GetName().Name, "缺少编辑器说明；请为此类型提供 descriptor。", "Other", type.FullName, true);
    }

            if (property != null)
            {
                if (type == typeof(GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerAuthoring))
                    summary = "每 " + property.FindPropertyRelative("Interval")?.floatValue.ToString("0.##") + " 秒";
                else if (type == typeof(GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerAuthoring))
                    summary = "累计 " + property.FindPropertyRelative("RequiredCount")?.intValue + " 次事件";
                else if (type == typeof(GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring))
                    summary = "事件 · " + (property.FindPropertyRelative("EventTag")?.FindPropertyRelative("Name")?.stringValue ?? "未指定");
                else if (type == typeof(GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring)) summary = "以技能持有者为目标";
                else if (type == typeof(GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring))
                    summary = "效果 · " + (property.FindPropertyRelative("Effect")?.objectReferenceValue?.name ?? "未指定");
                else if (type == typeof(GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring))
                    summary = "序列 · " + (property.FindPropertyRelative("Sequence")?.objectReferenceValue?.name ?? "未指定");
            }
            return new GameplaySkillNodeEditorDescriptor(name, "FRFrame", summary);
        }
    }

using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Business metadata over the same payload used by the compiler. No asset search,
    /// factory execution or mutable runtime state is needed to draw a card.</summary>
    internal static class GameplaySkillNodeDisplay
    {
        internal static string Name(GameplayAuthoringNode node,GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            var action=(node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
            if(!(action is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring)&&!(action is GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring))return GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(node);
            var binding=node.Payload.Definitions.FirstOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Effect");
            var effect=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding?.LocalId)?.Payload as GameplayEffectDefinitionData;
            if(effect==null&&binding?.External is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset shared)effect=(GameplayEffectDefinitionData)shared.CaptureGraphValues();
            if(effect==null)return GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(node);
            string name=effect.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant?"持续 Buff":effect.Executions.Length==1&&effect.Modifiers.Length==0?
                effect.Executions[0] is GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring?"造成伤害":effect.Executions[0] is GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring?"治疗":effect.Executions[0] is GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring?"增加护盾":"施加效果":"复合效果";
            return string.IsNullOrEmpty(node.Title)||node.Title==name||node.Title==GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).DisplayName?name:name+" · "+node.Title;
        }
        internal static GameplayNodeVisualKind Kind(GameplayAuthoringNode node)
        {
            if(node?.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload)return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Ability;
            if(node?.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload)return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Condition;
            var action=(node?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
            if(action==null)return GameplayNodeVisualKind.Neutral;
            return GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).VisualKind??GameplayNodeVisuals.Classify(action);
        }
        internal static string Value(GameplayFloatValueAuthoring value)
        {
            if(value is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring constant)return constant.Value.ToString("0.###");
            if(value is GameplayFormulaFloatValueAuthoring formula)return formula.Expression;
            if(value is GameplayBinaryFloatValueAuthoring binary)return binary.Operation+"("+Value(binary.Left)+", "+Value(binary.Right)+")";
            if(value is GameplayAttributeFloatValueAuthoring attribute)return attribute.Source+"."+attribute.Attribute.Value;
            if(value is GameplayResourceFloatValueAuthoring resource)return resource.Source+"Resource."+resource.Resource.Value;
            if(value is GameplayContextFloatValueAuthoring context)return "Context."+context.Key.Name;
            if(value is GameplaySetByCallerFloatValueAuthoring caller)return "Caller."+caller.Key.Name;
            if(value is GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValueAuthoring)return "Level";
            if(value is GameplayStackCountFloatValueAuthoring)return "StackCount";
            if(value is GameplayLevelTableFloatValueAuthoring table)return "等级表 ["+string.Join(", ",table.Values.Take(4).Select(v=>v.ToString("0.###")))+"] · "+table.Values.Length+" 项";
            if(value is GameplayCurveFloatValueAuthoring curve)return "曲线("+Value(curve.Input)+") ["+string.Join(", ",curve.Keys.Take(4).Select(p=>p.Input.ToString("0.###")+":"+p.Output.ToString("0.###")))+"] · "+curve.Keys.Length+" 个点";
            return value==null?"未配置":GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(value.GetType()).DisplayName;
        }
        internal static string Cost(GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring cost)
        {
            if(cost==null)return "消耗 · 无";
            if(cost is GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring resources){
                var entries=resources.Resources??Array.Empty<GameplayAttributeAbilityCostAuthoring.Entry>();
                string text=string.Join(" / ",entries.Take(2).Select(e=>e==null?"待配置":e.Delta is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring constant?(constant.Value<0?"消耗 ":"获得 ")+e.Attribute.Value+" "+Math.Abs(constant.Value).ToString("0.###"):e.Attribute.Value+"变化 "+Value(e.Delta)));
                return text+(entries.Length>2?" · 另"+(entries.Length-2)+"项":"");
            }return "消耗 · "+GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(cost.GetType()).DisplayName;
        }
        internal static string Target(GameplaySkillTargetAuthoring target)=>target is GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring?"自身":target is GameplaySkillPointTargetAuthoring?"指定地点":target is GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring?"调用者目标 / 地点":target==null?"待配置":GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(target.GetType()).DisplayName;
        // Card fields own their values. This supplementary text contains only semantics which
        // are absent from those fields; full summaries remain useful in tooltips/diagnostics.
        internal static string CardSummary(GameplayAuthoringNode node,GameplayAuthoringGraph graph,bool hasFields)
        {
            if(node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload)return null;
            var action=(node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
            if(action is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring)return null;
            if(action is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring){
                var binding=node.Payload.Definitions.FirstOrDefault(b=>b.PropertyPath=="Effect");
                var effect=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding?.LocalId)?.Payload as GameplayEffectDefinitionData;
                if(effect==null)return null;
                string state=effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant?"瞬时结算":effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite?"无限持续":"持续效果";
                int count=effect.Executions.Length+effect.Modifiers.Length;
                return state+(count>1?" · 复合 "+count+" 项":"")+(!hasFields&&effect.Stacking!=null?" · 叠层上限 "+effect.Stacking.MaxStacks:"")+
                    (effect.GrantedTags.Length>0?"\n授予状态 · "+string.Join(" / ",effect.GrantedTags.Take(3).Select(t=>t.Name)):"");
            }
            return hasFields?null:Summary(node,graph);
        }
        internal static string SharedSummary(GameplayDefinitionAsset source)
        {
            object value=source.CaptureGraphValues();
            if(value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect)return Effect(effect,source.name)+" · 共享来源";
            if(value is GameplayAbilityDefinitionData ability)return source.name+" · "+Cost(ability.Cost)+(ability.Charge==null?"":" · 充能 "+ability.Charge.MaxCharges+" / "+ability.Charge.RechargeDuration+"s");
            return source.name+(GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ValueSummary(value) is string text?" · "+text:"")+" · 共享来源";
        }
        internal static string Summary(GameplayAuthoringNode node,GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            if(node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload)return "技能施放 · 消耗 / 冷却 / 充能";
            if(node.Payload is GameplayRuleNodePayload rule)return (rule.Trigger is GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring trigger?"事件 · "+trigger.EventTag.Name:"触发条件 · "+(rule.Trigger==null?"待配置":GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(rule.Trigger.GetType()).DisplayName))+"\n目标 · "+Target(rule.Target)+(rule.Conditions?.Length>0?" · 条件"+rule.Conditions.Length+"项":"");
            var action=(node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
            if(action is GameplayChangeStateActionAuthoring state)return "切换行为状态 · "+state.State;
            if(action is GameplayCooldownActionAuthoring cooldown)return "技能 "+(cooldown.SkillId==0?"当前施放":cooldown.SkillId.ToString())+" · "+cooldown.Operation+(cooldown.Operation==Standard.GameplayCooldownOperation.Restart?"":" · "+Value(cooldown.Value));
            if(action is GameplayCaptureCombatRollActionAuthoring roll)return "暴击 "+Value(roll.CriticalChance)+" · 未命中 "+Value(roll.MissChance)+(roll.PreserveExisting?" · 保留已有采样":"");
            if(action is GameplaySkillBranchActionAuthoring branch)return "判断 · "+(branch.Condition==null?"尚未配置":GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(branch.Condition.GetType()).DisplayName)+"\n满足 / 否则使用真实分支，条件细节在右侧配置";
            if(action is GameplaySkillSetContextValueActionAuthoring set)return set.Key.Name+" = "+set.Value;
            if(action is GameplayCaptureValueActionAuthoring capture)return "捕获 "+capture.Key.Name+" · "+Value(capture.Value);
            if(action is GameplayMoveTargetsActionAuthoring move)return move.Mode+" · 距离 "+Value(move.Distance)+" · 速度 "+Value(move.Speed);
            if(action is GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring shield)return "护盾 "+Value(shield.Amount)+" · "+Value(shield.Duration)+"s";
            if(action is GameplayRotateToPointActionAuthoring rotate)return rotate.RotateOwner?"自身朝向当前地点":"逐目标朝向当前地点";
            if(action is GameplayDispelEffectsActionAuthoring dispel)return "驱散分类 · "+string.Join(" / ",(dispel.EffectTags?.All??Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>()).Concat(dispel.EffectTags?.Any??Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>()).Select(t=>t.Name));
            if(action is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring search)return search.Shape+" · "+search.Plane+" · "+search.Faction+"\n半径 "+Value(search.Radius)+" · 目标上限 "+search.MaxTargets;
            if(action is GameplayEndAbilityActionAuthoring end)return end.Cancel?"取消当前施放并释放所属内容":"结束当前施放并释放所属内容";
            if(action is GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring){
                var timeline=graph.Timelines.Find(t=>node.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id));
                return timeline==null?"尚未绑定编排":timeline.DurationSeconds.ToString("0.###")+" 秒 · "+timeline.Events.Count+" 个时间事件";
            }
            var summaries=node.Payload.Definitions.Select(binding=>{
                var definition=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId);object values=definition?.Payload;
                if(values is GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect)return Effect(effect,definition.Name);
                if(binding.External is GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset shared)return Effect((GameplayEffectDefinitionData)shared.CaptureGraphValues(),shared.name)+" · 共享";
                if(values is GameplayProjectileDefinitionData projectile)return projectile.Motion+" · "+projectile.Plane+"\n速度 "+Value(projectile.Speed)+" · 存续 "+Value(projectile.Duration)+"s · 命中上限 "+projectile.MaxHits;
                if(values is GameplayAreaDefinitionData area)return area.Shape+" · "+area.Plane+"\n存续 "+Value(area.Duration)+"s · 周期 "+Value(area.TickInterval)+"s";
                return values==null?(binding.External?binding.External.name+" · 共享":null):GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ValueSummary(values)??definition.Name;
            }).Where(s=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)).ToArray();
            return summaries.Length==0?GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action?.GetType()).Summary:string.Join("\n",summaries);
        }
        internal static string EventLabel(GameplayAuthoringNode node,GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)
        {
            if(node==null)return "缺失入口";
            var action=(node.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
            if(action!=null&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).IsAnimation){
                var value=AnimationValues(node,graph);
                string summary=value==null?null:GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ValueSummary(value);return Name(node,graph)+(summary==null?"":" · "+summary)+"\n"+string.Join(" / ",node.Payload.Definitions.Select(b=>b.External?"共享 · "+b.External.name:"本地 · "+graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==b.LocalId)?.Name));
            }return Name(node,graph);
        }
        internal static object AnimationValues(GameplayAuthoringNode node,GameplayAuthoringGraph graph)=>node.Payload.Definitions.Select(b=>graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==b.LocalId)?.Payload??(b.External?b.External.CaptureGraphValues():null)).FirstOrDefault(v=>v!=null);
        private static string Effect(GameplayEffectDefinitionData effect,string name)
        {
            string duration=effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant?"瞬时":effect.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite?"无限持续":"持续 "+(effect.DurationValue==null?effect.Duration.ToString("0.###"):Value(effect.DurationValue))+"s";
            string execution=string.Join(" / ",effect.Executions.Select(e=>e is GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring damage?"伤害 "+Value(damage.Amount):e is GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring heal?"治疗 "+Value(heal.Amount):e is GameplayShieldExecutionAuthoring shield?"护盾 "+Value(shield.Amount):e==null?"缺少结算":GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(e.GetType()).DisplayName));
            string modifiers=string.Join(" / ",effect.Modifiers.Take(2).Select(m=>m.Attribute.Value+" "+m.Operation+" "+Value(m.Magnitude)));
            string tags=string.Join(" / ",effect.GrantedTags.Take(3).Select(t=>t.Name));
            int count=effect.Executions.Length+effect.Modifiers.Length;
            return name+" · "+duration+(count>1?" · 复合 "+count+" 项":"")+(effect.PeriodValue!=null||effect.Period>0?" · 每 "+(effect.PeriodValue==null?effect.Period.ToString("0.###"):Value(effect.PeriodValue))+"s":"")+"\n"+execution+
                (modifiers.Length>0?"\n属性 · "+modifiers+(effect.Modifiers.Length>2?" 等 "+effect.Modifiers.Length+" 项":""):"")+
                (tags.Length>0?"\n状态 · "+tags+(effect.GrantedTags.Length>3?" 等 "+effect.GrantedTags.Length+" 项":""):"")+
                (effect.Stacking!=null?"\n叠层上限 "+effect.Stacking.MaxStacks+" · "+effect.Stacking.Overflow:"");
        }
    }
    public interface IGameplaySkillValueDescription
    {
        string Summary(object values);
    }
}

using System;

    /// <summary>One retained row per occurrence. The middle time surface alone scrolls;

        [Serializable] internal sealed class ViewState {

            public string SelectedEventId;

            internal static ViewState Load(string key){var json=SessionState.GetString(key,"");var state=json.Length==0?new ViewState():JsonUtility.FromJson<ViewState>(json);state.Key=key;if(!json.Contains("\"FitDuration\""))state.FitDuration=true;return state;}
            internal void Save(){if(Key==null||Scroll==_savedScroll&&Zoom==_savedZoom&&Cursor==_savedCursor&&Seconds==_savedSeconds&&FitDuration==_savedFit&&SelectedEventId==_savedSelection)return;SessionState.SetString(Key,JsonUtility.ToJson(this));_savedScroll=Scroll;_savedZoom=Zoom;_savedCursor=Cursor;_savedSeconds=Seconds;_savedFit=FitDuration;_savedSelection=SelectedEventId;}
        }

        private sealed class Row {

        private bool _resizing,_scrubbing;
        private int _hotId;
        internal int RowCount=>_rows.Count;
        internal Action<float> CursorChanged;
        internal string SelectedEventId=>_state.SelectedEventId;
        internal bool HasAnimation;
        internal Func<string,bool> IsMainAnimation;
        internal Func<bool> IsPlaying;
        internal Action TogglePlaying;
        internal readonly Dictionary<string,Rect> VisibleEventScreenRects=new Dictionary<string,Rect>();
        internal readonly Dictionary<string,Rect> DurationHandleScreenRects=new Dictionary<string,Rect>();
        private float _cursor {get=>_state.Cursor;set=>_state.Cursor=value;}
        private float _zoom {get=>_state.Zoom;set=>_state.Zoom=value;}

        public GameplaySkillTimeline(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string node,string timeline,ViewState state,Action<float> add,Action<string> select,Action<string> reveal)
        {
            _document=document;_node=node;_timeline=timeline;_state=state;_add=add;_select=select;_reveal=reveal;
            name="TimelineRows";style.flexShrink=0;
            var rulerRow=new VisualElement{name="TimelineRuler",style={flexDirection=FlexDirection.Row,height=26}};
            rulerRow.Add(FixedLabel("时间 / 顺序"));
            _ruler=new IMGUIContainer(DrawRuler){style={flexGrow=1,minWidth=140,overflow=Overflow.Hidden}};
            rulerRow.Add(_ruler);rulerRow.Add(new VisualElement{style={width=36,flexShrink=0}});Add(rulerRow);
            _horizontal=new Scroller(0,0,value=>{_scroll=new Vector2(value,0);_state.Save();RepaintTime();},SliderDirection.Horizontal);
            _horizontal.name="TimelineHorizontalScroll";_horizontal.style.marginLeft=160;_horizontal.style.marginRight=36;
            RegisterCallback<DetachFromPanelEvent>(_=>CancelDrag());
            RegisterCallback<KeyDownEvent>(e=>{if(e.keyCode==KeyCode.Escape||(e.ctrlKey||e.commandKey)&&(e.keyCode==KeyCode.Z||e.keyCode==KeyCode.Y))CancelDrag();},TrickleDown.TrickleDown);
            _ruler.RegisterCallback<GeometryChangedEvent>(_=>RefreshGeometry());

        }
        private static Label FixedLabel(string text)=>new Label(text){style={width=160,flexShrink=0,fontSize=11,unityTextAlign=TextAnchor.MiddleLeft,paddingLeft=5,overflow=Overflow.Hidden,textOverflow=TextOverflow.Ellipsis}};
        internal void AttachPort(string id,Port port)
        {
            var row=_rows[id];row.PortArea.Add(port);port.portName="";port.name="Occurrence-"+id;
            port.style.position=Position.Relative;port.style.width=30;port.style.minWidth=30;port.style.height=26;port.style.flexShrink=0;port.style.paddingLeft=0;port.style.paddingRight=0;
            var connector=port.Q("connector");connector.style.width=12;connector.style.minWidth=12;connector.style.height=12;
            port.tooltip=row.Label.tooltip+"\n从行尾拖动真实调度连接";
            port.RegisterCallback<PointerDownEvent>(e=>{if(e.button==0)FocusEvent(id);},TrickleDown.TrickleDown);
        }
        internal void InvalidatePresentation()
        {
            var timeline=_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Find(t=>t.Id==_timeline);if(timeline==null)return;
            var entries=timeline.Events.Where(e=>IsMainAnimation?.Invoke(e.EntryNodeId)!=true).OrderBy(e=>e.TimeSeconds).ThenBy(e=>e.Order).ThenBy(e=>e.Id,StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
            for(int index=0;index<entries.Length;index++){
                var entry=entries[index];
                if(!_rows.TryGetValue(entry.Id,out var row)){
                    row=new Row{Element=new VisualElement{name="TimelineRow-"+entry.Id,style={flexDirection=FlexDirection.Row,height=30,flexShrink=0,backgroundColor=new Color(.16f,.17f,.2f)}}};
                    row.Label=FixedLabel("");row.Label.name="EventLabel-"+entry.Id;
                    var captured=row;row.Content=new IMGUIContainer(()=>DrawRow(captured)){cullingEnabled=true,name="TimeContent-"+entry.Id,style={flexGrow=1,minWidth=140,overflow=Overflow.Hidden}};
                    row.PortArea=new VisualElement{name="PortArea-"+entry.Id,style={width=36,flexShrink=0,alignItems=Align.Center,justifyContent=Justify.Center}};
                    row.Element.Add(row.Label);row.Element.Add(row.Content);row.Element.Add(row.PortArea);_rows.Add(entry.Id,row);
                    string id=entry.Id;row.Label.RegisterCallback<PointerDownEvent>(e=>{if(e.button==0){FocusEvent(id);e.StopPropagation();}});
                    row.Label.AddManipulator(new ContextualMenuManipulator(e=>PopulateMenu(e.menu,id)));
                }
                row.Entry=entry;var node=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==entry.EntryNodeId);
                row.Region=GameplaySkillFieldSchema.TryDuration(_document.AuthoringGraph,entry.EntryNodeId,out row.Local,out row.Path,out row.Duration);
                var action=(node?.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action;
                row.Label.text="#"+(index+1)+" "+(action!=null&&GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(action.GetType()).IsAnimation?GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.EventLabel(node,_document.AuthoringGraph).Split('\n')[0]:GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.Name(node,_document.AuthoringGraph));
                row.Label.tooltip=GameplaySkillNodeDisplay.EventLabel(node,_document.AuthoringGraph)+"\n"+(entry.TimeSeconds*timeline.FramesPerSecond).ToString("0.##")+"f · Order "+entry.Order+"\n事件 "+entry.Id+"\n行为 "+entry.EntryNodeId;
                if(IndexOf(row.Element)!=index+1)Insert(index+1,row.Element);
            }
            foreach(var id in _rows.Keys.Where(id=>!entries.Any(e=>e.Id==id)).ToArray()){_rows[id].Element.RemoveFromHierarchy();_rows.Remove(id);VisibleEventScreenRects.Remove(id);DurationHandleScreenRects.Remove(id);}
            Add(_horizontal);RefreshGeometry();RepaintTime();
        }
        private void RepaintTime(){_ruler.MarkDirtyRepaint();foreach(var row in _rows.Values)row.Content.MarkDirtyRepaint();}
        private void RefreshGeometry()
        {
            var timeline=_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Find(t=>t.Id==_timeline);if(timeline==null)return;
            float previousExtent=_extent,previousPixels=_pixels,previousWidth=_contentWidth;
            _extent=timeline.DurationSeconds;
            foreach(var row in _rows.Values)_extent=Mathf.Max(_extent,row.Entry.TimeSeconds+(row.Region?row.Duration:0));
            _contentWidth=Mathf.Max(140,_ruler.contentRect.width);
            _pixels=Mathf.Max(1,(_contentWidth-46)/Mathf.Max(.1f,_extent))*(_state.FitDuration?1:_zoom);
            float maximum=Mathf.Max(0,24+_extent*_pixels+22-_contentWidth);
            _horizontal.highValue=maximum;_horizontal.style.display=maximum>.5f?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
            _horizontal.value=Mathf.Clamp(_scroll.x,0,maximum);_scroll=new Vector2(_horizontal.value,0);
            if(_extent!=previousExtent||_pixels!=previousPixels||_contentWidth!=previousWidth)RepaintTime();
        }
        private void CancelDrag(){_scrubbing=false;_drag=null;_resizing=false;_durationOwner=null;_durationPath=null;if(_hotId!=0&&GUIUtility.hotControl==_hotId)GUIUtility.hotControl=0;_hotId=0;}
        private void Attempt(Action action){try{action();}catch(Exception error){Debug.LogWarning("时间编排拒绝修改："+error.Message);}}
        internal void DrawControls()
        {
            float previousCursor=_cursor;bool previousSeconds=_state.Seconds;
            var timeline=_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Find(t=>t.Id==_timeline);if(timeline==null)return;
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if(HasAnimation){
                if(GUILayout.Button(IsPlaying?.Invoke()==true?"暂停":"播放",GUILayout.Width(40)))TogglePlaying?.Invoke();
                if(GUILayout.Button("停止",GUILayout.Width(38))){_cursor=0;CursorChanged?.Invoke(_cursor);}
                if(GUILayout.Button("◀",GUILayout.Width(22))){_cursor=Mathf.Max(0,_cursor-1f/timeline.FramesPerSecond);CursorChanged?.Invoke(_cursor);}
                if(GUILayout.Button("▶",GUILayout.Width(22))){_cursor=Mathf.Min(timeline.DurationSeconds,_cursor+1f/timeline.FramesPerSecond);CursorChanged?.Invoke(_cursor);}
            }
            float shown=_state.Seconds?_cursor:_cursor*timeline.FramesPerSecond;
            float next=EditorGUILayout.FloatField(shown,GUILayout.Width(52));
            if(next!=shown){_cursor=Mathf.Clamp(_state.Seconds?next:next/timeline.FramesPerSecond,0,timeline.DurationSeconds);CursorChanged?.Invoke(_cursor);}
            _state.Seconds=GUILayout.Toggle(_state.Seconds,new GUIContent(_state.Seconds?"秒":"帧","只改变显示单位"),EditorStyles.miniButton,GUILayout.Width(28));
            GUILayout.Label((timeline.DurationSeconds*timeline.FramesPerSecond).ToString("0.#")+"f · "+timeline.FramesPerSecond+"fps",EditorStyles.miniLabel,GUILayout.Width(88));
            bool narrow=resolvedStyle.width<510;if(narrow){GUILayout.EndHorizontal();GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();}
            float zoom=GUILayout.HorizontalSlider(_state.FitDuration?1:_zoom,.5f,6,GUILayout.MinWidth(35),GUILayout.MaxWidth(85));
            if(zoom!=(_state.FitDuration?1:_zoom)){_zoom=zoom;_state.FitDuration=false;}
            if(GUILayout.Button("全时长",GUILayout.Width(48))){_zoom=1;_state.FitDuration=true;_scroll=Vector2.zero;}
            if(GUILayout.Button("+ 事件",GUILayout.Width(55)))_add?.Invoke(_cursor);
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();RefreshGeometry();if(previousCursor!=_cursor||previousSeconds!=_state.Seconds)RepaintTime();_state.Save();
        }

        internal void FocusEvent(string id)
        {
            _state.SelectedEventId=id;
            if(_rows.TryGetValue(id,out var row)){
                float x=24+row.Entry.TimeSeconds*_pixels;
                if(x<_scroll.x+24||x>_scroll.x+_contentWidth-22)_horizontal.value=Mathf.Clamp(x-32,0,_horizontal.highValue);
            }
            _select?.Invoke(id);_state.Save();RepaintTime();
        }
        private void PopulateMenu(DropdownMenu menu,string id)
        {
            var row=_rows[id];
            menu.AppendAction("此帧添加行为…",_=>_add?.Invoke(row.Entry.TimeSeconds));
            menu.AppendAction("同帧提前",_=>Attempt(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.ReorderEvent(_document,id,-1)));
            menu.AppendAction("同帧后移",_=>Attempt(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.ReorderEvent(_document,id,1)));

using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    /// <summary>Optional integration-owned availability checks used before a creation/picker
    /// write. Missing runtime/editor resource adapters are unavailable, not empty saved shells.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillTypeAvailability {string Unavailable(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,Type type);}
    public static class GameplaySkillTypeAvailability
    {
        private static readonly IGameplaySkillTypeAvailability[] Providers=TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<IGameplaySkillTypeAvailability>().Where(t=>!t.IsAbstract&&t.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes)!=null).Select(t=>(IGameplaySkillTypeAvailability)Activator.CreateInstance(t)).ToArray();
        public static string Reason(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,Type type)
        {
            if(type==null)return null;
            foreach(var provider in Providers){var reason=provider.Unavailable(document,type);if(reason!=null)return reason;}
            if(typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring).IsAssignableFrom(type)){
                var action=Activator.CreateInstance(type);foreach(var slot in GameplayGraphFields.ResourceSlots(action))
                    if(!GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Values(slot.ValueType).Any()&&slot.ValueType!=typeof(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset)&&slot.ValueType!=typeof(GameplayActorProfileAsset)&&slot.ValueType!=typeof(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset))return "此资源没有已安装的配置 / 运行后端："+slot.ValueType.Name;
            }return null;
        }
        internal static void Add(IGameplaySkillCreationMenu menu,GameplaySkillDocumentAsset doc,Type type,UnityEngine.GUIContent label,GenericMenu.MenuFunction action)
        {var reason=Reason(doc,type);if(reason!=null)menu.AddDisabledItem(new UnityEngine.GUIContent(label.text+" · 不可用",reason));else menu.AddItem(label,false,()=>{var current=Reason(doc,type);if(current!=null)throw new InvalidOperationException(current);action();});}
    }
}

            _browserWidth=EditorPrefs.GetFloat("FRFrame.Workbench.BrowserWidth",260);_inspectorWidth=EditorPrefs.GetFloat("FRFrame.Workbench.InspectorWidth",370);GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Changed+=ExternalChanged;EditorApplication.update+=PreviewTick;
            _inlinePreviewNode=_document?SessionState.GetString(GameplaySkillEditorState.Key(_document)+".InlinePreview",""):null;if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(_inlinePreviewNode))_inlinePreviewNode=null;BuildUI();
        }
