````csharp
        private void UndoChanged() {

            _diagnosticsStale=true;DisposePreview();string shape=Shape();
            if(shape!=_shape){Canvas?.Load(_document);_shape=shape;}else Canvas?.SynchronizeLayout();
            Canvas?.SelectNodeWithoutCamera(_selected);RememberSourceVersion();_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Repaint();

        }
        private void Changed(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,GameplaySkillAuthoringChange change)
        {
            long started=System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            bool browserChanged=_documentBrowser?.Changed(document)==true;
            if(document!=_document){if(browserChanged)_browser?.MarkDirtyRepaint();return;}
            _diagnosticsStale=true;if(PreviewAffected(change))DisposePreview();
            if(change.Structural)QueueRebuild();
            else if(change.Unknown)RefreshUnknown();
            else {Canvas?.RefreshPresentation(change);ScalarRefreshCount++;RefreshMeasured?.Invoke(false,(System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()-started)*1000d/System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency);}
            RememberSourceVersion();_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();if(browserChanged)_browser?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Repaint();
        }
        private void QueueRebuild()
        {
            if(_refreshPending)return;Canvas?.InvalidateFields();_refreshPending=true;
            rootVisualElement.schedule.Execute(()=>{long start=System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();_refreshPending=false;
                Canvas?.Load(_document);Canvas?.SelectNodeWithoutCamera(_selected);_shape=Shape();RememberSourceVersion();
                RefreshMeasured?.Invoke(true,(System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()-start)*1000d/System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency);});
        }
        private void RefreshUnknown()
        {
            string shape=Shape();if(shape!=_shape){_shape=shape;QueueRebuild();}
            else {long start=System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();Canvas?.SynchronizeLayout();ScalarRefreshCount++;RefreshMeasured?.Invoke(false,(System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()-start)*1000d/System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency);}
        }
        private string Shape(){
            ShapeAnalysisCount++;long sample=System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp();
            using(new Unity.Profiling.ProfilerMarker("FRFrame.Workbench.Shape").Auto())try{
            var g=_document?.AuthoringGraph;if(g==null)return "";
            var settings=(g.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==g.AbilityNodeId)?.Payload as GameplayAbilityNodePayload)?.Settings as GameplayAbilityDefinitionData;
            return string.Join(",",_detachedPolicies.Select(p=>p.Key))+"|"+settings?.Cost?.GetType().FullName+":"+(settings?.Charge!=null)+"|"+GameplayBehaviorGraphView.InlinePrimaryRule(_document)+":"+g.Scope+":"+g.AbilityNodeId+":"+g.PrimaryRuleNodeId+":"+string.Join(",",g.AdditionalRuleNodeIds)+"|"+
                string.Join("|",g.Nodes.Select(n=>n.Id+":"+n.Payload.GetType().Name+":"+(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action?.GetType().FullName+":"+string.Join(",",GameplayGraphFields.OutputPorts(n))+":"+string.Join(",",n.Payload.Definitions.Select(b=>b.PropertyPath+"="+b.LocalId+"@"+(b.External?b.External.GetInstanceID():0)))))+"|"+
                string.Join("|",g.LocalDefinitions.Select(d=>d.Id+":"+d.Payload.GetType().FullName+":"+string.Join(",",GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(d.Payload).Select(a=>a.Path).Concat(GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Slots(d.Payload).Select(s=>s.Key)))))+"|"+
                string.Join("|",g.Connections.Select(e=>e.Id+":"+e.FromNodeId+":"+e.OutputPortKey+":"+e.ToNodeId+":"+e.InputPortKey+":"+e.Order))+"|"+
                string.Join("|",g.Timelines.SelectMany(t=>t.Events).Select(e=>e.Id+":"+e.EntryNodeId+":"+(e.Conditions.Length>0)+":"+e.Target?.GetType().FullName));
            }
            finally{ShapeAnalysisMilliseconds+=(System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.GetTimestamp()-sample)*1000d/System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.Frequency;}
        }
        private void DrawBrowser()
        {
            _browserTab=_document?GUILayout.Toolbar(_browserTab,new[]{"文件夹 / 技能","未接入 / 资源"}):0;
            if(_browserTab==0){_documentBrowser.Draw(Documents(),_document,_browser.resolvedStyle.width);return;}
            _browserScroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_browserScroll);
            if (_document?.AuthoringGraph != null)
            {
                var graph = _document.AuthoringGraph; var active = GameplayBehaviorGraphView.Reachable(graph);
                GUILayout.Space(12); GUILayout.Label("未安排行为", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                foreach (var node in graph.Nodes.Where(n => !active.Contains(n.Id)))
                    if (GUILayout.Button(GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(node), EditorStyles.miniButton)) { _selected = node.Id; _definition = null; Canvas.FocusNode(node.Id); }
                var used = new HashSet<string>(graph.Nodes.SelectMany(n => n.Payload.Definitions).Concat(graph.LocalDefinitions.SelectMany(d => d.Definitions)).Select(b => b.LocalId));
                GUILayout.Label("资源 / 未使用配置", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                foreach (var d in graph.LocalDefinitions.Where(d => !used.Contains(d.Id)).ToArray()){
                    GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();if (GUILayout.Button(d.Name+" · 未使用", EditorStyles.miniButton)) { _definition = d.Id; _selected = null; }
                    if(GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("删除","删除这项未使用局部配置及独占依赖；一次 Undo 可恢复。"),GUILayout.Width(44))){Attempt(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.DeleteLocalDefinition(_document,d.Id));GUIUtility.ExitGUI();}GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
                }
                foreach (var legacy in graph.LegacyResources.ToArray())
                { using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(true)) EditorGUILayout.ObjectField(new GUIContent("只读历史",legacy.Reason), legacy.Resource, typeof(UnityEngine.Object), false);
                    if(GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent("移除历史登记（保留原资源）","只撤销此归档引用，不删除原 SO。原内容保留至另一次显式物理清理审计。"),EditorStyles.miniButton)){
                        Attempt(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Transaction(_document,"移除历史登记",g=>g.LegacyResources.RemoveAt(graph.LegacyResources.IndexOf(legacy))));GUIUtility.ExitGUI();
                    }
                }
                foreach (var shared in graph.Nodes.SelectMany(n => n.Payload.Definitions).Concat(graph.LocalDefinitions.SelectMany(d => d.Definitions)).Where(b => b.External).Select(b => b.External).Distinct())
                    if (GUILayout.Button("共享 · " + shared.name, EditorStyles.miniButton)) { Selection.activeObject = shared; EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(shared); }
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }
        private void DrawDetails()
        {

            float previousLabel=EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth;EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth=Mathf.Clamp(_inspector.resolvedStyle.width*.4f,110,170);
            _detailTab=GUILayout.Toolbar(_detailTab,new[]{"业务参数","预览 / 范围","Scene / 调试","校验"});
            _inspectorScroll = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_inspectorScroll);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_feedback)) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_feedback, MessageType.Info);
            if(!_document&&_sharedSource){using(var source=new SerializedObject(_sharedSource))GameplayAuthoringInspector.Draw(source);}
            else if (!_document) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("选择正式技能，或新建一个正式技能。", MessageType.Info);
            else {
                if(_detailTab==0){
                    if(_policySelection!=null)Canvas.DrawPolicy(_policySelection,true);
                    else if(Canvas.SelectedEventId==null){if(!Canvas.IsTimelineInline(_selected)||_definition!=null)using(GameplayAuthoringInspector.UseFieldContext("Inspector"))GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Draw(Canvas.SerializedSource,_document,_selected,_definition,true);}
                    else {GUILayout.Label("选中调度事件 · 行为参数在卡片编辑",EditorStyles.wordWrappedLabel);if(GUILayout.Button("行为高级参数")){Canvas.SelectNodeWithoutCamera(_selected);Canvas.ClearEventSelection();}}
                    if(_policySelection==null&&_definition==null&&Canvas.SelectedEventId==null)Canvas.DrawMainAnimationSettings(_selected);
                    DrawTimelineFields(Canvas.SerializedSource,_document,_selected,Canvas.SelectedEventId,Canvas);
                }
                else if(_detailTab==1){DrawRangePreview();DrawPreview();}
                else if(_detailTab==2){DrawInstallation();if(GUILayout.Button("打开 Runtime Debugger"))EditorWindow.GetWindow<FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.RuntimeDebugger.GameplayRuntimeDebuggerWindow>().Show();}else DrawDiagnostics();
                GUILayout.Space(10);
                if (_selected != null && GUILayout.Button("在图中定位")) Canvas.FocusNode(_selected);
                if(Canvas.IsTimelineInline(_selected)&&GUILayout.Button("在画布展开独立卡片"))Canvas.RevealTimelineAction(_selected);
                if (GUILayout.Button("主技能 Project Inspector")) Selection.activeObject = _document;
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();EditorGUIUtility.labelWidth=previousLabel;

        private void DrawInstallation()
        {
            if(_document.AuthoringGraph==null)return;var host=Hosts.FirstOrDefault(h=>h.Supports(_document));if(host==null){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("当前 Scope 未注册工作台试装 Host；请使用该游戏现有的 SkillData 安装链。",MessageType.Info);return;}
            GUILayout.Space(10);GUILayout.Label("真实 Scene 试装",EditorStyles.boldLabel);host.DrawSetup(_document);string reason=host.Unavailable(_document);
            if(reason!=null)EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(reason,MessageType.Info);
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(reason!=null))if(GUILayout.Button(_installation==null?"安装当前正式技能":"释放并重装"))Attempt(()=>{DisposeInstallation();_installation=host.Install(_document);});
            _installation?.Draw();if(_installation!=null&&GUILayout.Button("结束本窗口试装"))DisposeInstallation();
        }

        public static void DrawTimelineFields(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, string nodeId,string selectedEventId=null)
        {
            using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(document))DrawTimelineFields(serialized,document,nodeId,selectedEventId);
        }
        private static void DrawTimelineFields(SerializedObject serialized,GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document,string nodeId,string selectedEventId,GameplayBehaviorGraphView canvas=null)
        {
            var node = document.AuthoringGraph?.Nodes.Find(n => n.Id == nodeId); if (node == null) return;
            foreach (var timeline in document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.Where(t=>node.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id)||t.Events.Any(e=>e.EntryNodeId==node.Id)))
            {
                bool owns=node.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==timeline.Id);
                {
                    serialized.UpdateIfRequiredOrScript();
                    var p = serialized.FindProperty("authoringGraph.Timelines").GetArrayElementAtIndex(document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.IndexOf(timeline));
                    using var disabled=new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode||GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(document));
                    var paths=new HashSet<string>();EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck(); GUILayout.Label("时间编排", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                    if(owns)foreach (var f in new[] { "Name", "DurationSeconds", "FramesPerSecond" }){var field=p.FindPropertyRelative(f);EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(field,new GUIContent(f=="Name"?"编排名称":f=="DurationSeconds"?"总时长（秒）":"帧率 / 吸附"),true);if(EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())paths.Add(field.propertyPath);}
                    for (int i = 0; i < timeline.Events.Count; i++)
                    {
                        if(selectedEventId==null&&canvas?.IsTimelineInline(timeline.Events[i].EntryNodeId)==true)continue;
                        if(selectedEventId!=null&&timeline.Events[i].Id!=selectedEventId)continue;
                        if(!owns&&timeline.Events[i].EntryNodeId!=node.Id)continue;
                        if(!owns&&selectedEventId!=null&&timeline.Events.Any(e=>e.Id==selectedEventId&&e.EntryNodeId==node.Id)&&timeline.Events[i].Id!=selectedEventId)continue;
                        var entry = p.FindPropertyRelative("Events").GetArrayElementAtIndex(i); GUILayout.Label((timeline.Events[i].TimeSeconds*timeline.FramesPerSecond).ToString("0.##")+"f · "+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==timeline.Events[i].EntryNodeId))+" · #"+timeline.Events[i].Order, EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                        var time=entry.FindPropertyRelative("TimeSeconds");
                        float frame=time.floatValue*timeline.FramesPerSecond;float next=EditorGUILayout.FloatField("帧（秒数为运行权威）",frame);if(next!=frame){time.floatValue=next/timeline.FramesPerSecond;paths.Add(time.propertyPath);}
                        EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
                        GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(time,new GUIContent("时间（秒）"));
                        if(EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())paths.Add(time.propertyPath);
                        DrawScheduleOptions(entry,paths);
                    }
                    if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()) GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ApplyFields(serialized,document,false,paths);
                }
            }
        }
        internal static void DrawScheduleOptions(SerializedProperty entry,HashSet<string> paths)
        {
            foreach(var name in new[]{"Order","Conditions","Target"}){
                var field=entry.FindPropertyRelative(name);
                EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
                GameplayAuthoringInspector.Field(field);
                if(EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())paths.Add(field.propertyPath);
            }
        }

        private void Populate(IGameplaySkillCreationMenu menu, Vector2 position, string timeline, float? seconds)
        {
            if (!_document || _document.AuthoringGraph == null) return;
            var link=Canvas.CreationLink;
            // Inspect candidates against the real source contract without editing the document.
            var candidates=link==null?null:(GameplayAuthoringGraph)GameplayGraphFields.Clone(_document.AuthoringGraph);
            var candidate=new GameplayAuthoringNode{Payload=new GameplayActionNodePayload()};
            var candidateValue=new GameplayLocalDefinition();
            Func<string,string,string,string,bool,string> check=null;
            if(candidates!=null){candidates.Nodes.Add(candidate);candidates.LocalDefinitions.Add(candidateValue);check=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.ConnectionChecker(candidates);}
            string ContextReason(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring action,GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload value=null,string path=null){
                if(check==null)return null;
                if(link.Input==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input)return (action is GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring||action is GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring)&&value is GameplayEffectDefinitionData?null:"生命周期回调只接收效果定义，不执行普通行为；请选择伤害、治疗或Buff。";
                ((GameplayActionNodePayload)candidate.Payload).Action=action;candidate.Payload.Definitions.Clear();candidateValue.Payload=value;
                if(value!=null)candidate.Payload.Definitions.Add(new GameplayDefinitionBinding{PropertyPath=path,LocalId=candidateValue.Id});
                var reason=check(link.Owner,link.Port,candidate.Id,link.Input,link.Scheduled);
                return reason==null?null:reason+" 请改从搜索逐目标/弹体命中连接，或明确使用自身目标。";
            }
            if(timeline!=null){
                foreach(var node in _document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Where(n=>n.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload)){
                    string id=node.Id;menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("安排已有行为/"+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(node)+" · "+id.Substring(0,5)),false,()=>Attempt(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Schedule(_document,timeline,id,seconds??0)));
                }
            }
            if (timeline == null)
            {
                if(link==null)Canvas.AddConfigurationEntries(menu,position);
                if(link?.Input==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input)menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("技能/时间编排","效果生命周期只消费真实Effect定义，不能调用时间编排。"));
                else menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("技能/时间编排"), false, () => Create(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateSequence(_document, position,link)));
                if(link==null)menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("[模板]/逐目标伤害与结束"), false, () => Create(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateDamageTemplate(_document,position)));
                if(link==null)menu.AddItem(new GUIContent(_document.AuthoringGraph.PrimaryRuleNodeId==null?"技能/施放触发规则":"技能/附加触发规则"), false, () => Create(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateRule(_document, position)));
            }
            string effectReason=ContextReason(new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring(),new GameplayEffectDefinitionData(),"Effect");
            if(effectReason!=null){foreach(string title in new[]{"效果/瞬时/造成伤害","效果/瞬时/治疗","效果/持续与控制/Buff","效果/持续与控制/周期伤害（3层）","效果/持续与控制/周期治疗"})menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent(title,effectReason));}
            else{
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("效果/瞬时/造成伤害"), false, () => Effect("造成伤害", new GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring()));
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("效果/瞬时/治疗"), false, () => Effect("治疗", new GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring()));
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("效果/持续与控制/Buff"), false, () => Create(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateAction(_document, new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring(), "持续 Buff", position,
                    new GameplayEffectDefinitionData { DurationPolicy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, Duration = 10 }, "Effect", timeline, seconds,link)));
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("效果/持续与控制/周期伤害（3层）","真实持续Effect：4秒、每0.5秒伤害、最多3层；时长/周期/结算一起创建，后续由原字段编辑。"), false, () => Create(() => {string key="Effect.Stack.S"+_document.SkillId+".P"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");return GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateAction(_document, new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring(), "周期伤害", position,
                    new GameplayEffectDefinitionData { DurationPolicy=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,Duration=4,Period=.5f,
                        Executions=new GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring[]{new GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring()},
                        Stacking=new GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring{StackKey=new GameplayTagReference(key),MaxStacks=3} },"Effect",timeline,seconds,link,new[]{key});}));
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent("效果/持续与控制/周期治疗","真实持续Effect：4秒、每0.5秒治疗；不生成虚假的周期执行端口。"), false, () => Create(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateAction(_document,new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring(),"周期治疗",position,
                    new GameplayEffectDefinitionData{DurationPolicy=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,Duration=4,Period=.5f,Executions=new GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring[]{new GameplayHealExecutionAuthoring()}},"Effect",timeline,seconds,link)));
            }
            foreach (var type in GameplayAuthoringTypeCatalog.Query(typeof(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring), _document.AuthoringGraph.Scope))
            {
                if (type == typeof(GameplayOwnedSequenceActionAuthoring) || type == typeof(GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring) || type == typeof(GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring)) continue;
                var unavailable=GameplaySkillTypeAvailability.Reason(_document,type);if(unavailable!=null){menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent(GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Category(type)+"/"+GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(type).DisplayName+" · 不可用",unavailable));continue;}var descriptor = GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(type); var action = (GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
                var slot = GameplayGraphFields.ResourceSlots(action).FirstOrDefault();
                var values = slot == null ? new Type[0] : GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Values(slot.ValueType).ToArray();
                string category=GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Category(type);
                if(values.Length==0)AddOption(descriptor.DisplayName,descriptor.DisplayName,null);
                foreach(var valueType in values){
                    var presets=GameplaySkillFieldSchema.CreationPresets(valueType).ToArray();
                    if(presets.Length==0)
                        AddOption(descriptor.DisplayName+" · "+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.Name(valueType),descriptor.DisplayName,(GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload)Activator.CreateInstance(valueType));
                    else
                        foreach(var preset in presets)AddOption(preset.Name,preset.Name,preset.Value);
                }

                void AddOption(string label,string title,GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload value)
                {
                    string reason=ContextReason(action,value,slot?.Path);
                    var caption=new GUIContent(category+"/"+label,reason??descriptor.Summary);
                    if(reason!=null)menu.AddDisabledItem(caption);
                    else menu.AddItem(caption,false,()=>Create(()=>GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateAction(
                        _document,(GameplaySkillActionAuthoring)Activator.CreateInstance(type),title,position,value,slot?.Path,timeline,seconds,link)));
                }
            }
            void Effect(string title, GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring execution) => Create(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.CreateAction(_document, new GameplayApplyToTargetsActionAuthoring(), title, position,
                new GameplayEffectDefinitionData { DurationPolicy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, Executions = new[] { execution } }, "Effect", timeline, seconds,link));
        }
        private void Create(Func<string> command)
        { Attempt(() => { _policySelection=null;Canvas.ClearEventSelection(); _selected = command(); _definition = null;_details.MarkDirtyRepaint(); }); }
        private void DeleteMain()
        {

            if (!_document) return;
            var target = _document;
            int choice = EditorUtility.DisplayDialogComplex("删除主技能", "清空内容保留技能 ID、名称、图标和主文件。物理删除前会审计外部引用；仍被使用的文件不会删除。", "清空内容保留主技能", "取消", "删除整个主文件");
            if (choice == 0) Attempt(() => GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.Clear(target));
            else if (choice == 2) Attempt(() => GameplaySkillAssetDeletion.Begin(target,(deleted,message)=>{
                _feedback=message;
                if(deleted&&_document==target)SelectDocument(null);
                Repaint();
            }));

        }
        private void NewDocument()
        {
if(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode){_feedback="退出 Play 后创建正式技能。";return;}GameplaySkillWizard.Open(this);
        }
        private void Attempt(Action action) { try { action(); } catch (Exception e) { _feedback = e.Message; Repaint(); } }
    }
    internal static class GameplaySkillToolbarExtensions
    {
        internal static ToolbarToggle WithChanged(this ToolbarToggle toggle, Action<bool> callback)
        { toggle.RegisterValueChangedCallback(e => callback(e.newValue)); return toggle; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplaySkillWorkbench
    {
        private readonly List<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> _diagnostics=new List<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue>();
        private bool _diagnosticsStale=true;
        private Vector3? _returnPan;private Vector3 _returnScale;private string _returnNode;
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue> Diagnostics=>_diagnostics;
        public void ValidateDocument()
        {
            _diagnostics.Clear();_diagnosticsStale=false;if(!_document)return;
            var validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
            try{_document.Validate(validation,"技能");_diagnostics.AddRange(validation.Issues);_document.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext());}
            catch(GameplayGraphCompilationException error){foreach(var issue in error.Issues)if(!_diagnostics.Any(i=>i.Path==issue.Path&&i.Message==issue.Message))_diagnostics.Add(issue);}
            catch(Exception error){Exception cause=error;while(cause!=null&&!(cause is GameplayGraphCompilationException))cause=cause.InnerException;
                if(cause is GameplayGraphCompilationException structured){foreach(var issue in structured.Issues)if(!_diagnostics.Any(i=>i.Path==issue.Path&&i.Message==issue.Message))_diagnostics.Add(issue);}
                else _diagnostics.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error,"技能",error.Message));}
            var active=GameplayGraphContextPolicy.Reachable(_document.AuthoringGraph);
            foreach(var node in _document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Where(n=>!active.Contains(n.Id)))_diagnostics.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning,node.Id,"未接入执行流程，不参与执行："+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(node)));
            foreach(var node in _document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Where(n=>active.Contains(n.Id)&&(n.Payload as GameplayRuleNodePayload)?.Target is GameplaySkillContextTargetAuthoring))
                _diagnostics.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Warning,node.Id,"调用者输入契约：此规则保留 TriggerEvent.Context；宿主须提供下游所需 Actor / Point。地点回调之后仍按实际来源检查，不能假定自身。"));
            if(!_diagnostics.Any(i=>i.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error))
                _diagnostics.AddRange(GameplaySkillContextVariables.For(_document).Diagnostics());
            _feedback=_diagnostics.Any(i=>i.Severity==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error)?"编译未通过；点击校验条目定位同源字段。":"正式运行图编译通过；未接入流程的节点提示另列。";
            _detailTab=3;_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Repaint();
        }
        private void RecordPreviewError(string node,string message)
        {if(!_diagnostics.Any(i=>i.Path==node&&i.Message==message))_diagnostics.Add(new GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue(GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error,node,message));}
        private void DrawDiagnostics()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_diagnosticsStale?"配置已修改，以下诊断已过期；重新校验可更新。":"诊断对应当前正式数据；未接入流程的节点不参与执行。",_diagnosticsStale?MessageType.Warning:MessageType.Info);
            if(GUILayout.Button("重新校验正式技能"))ValidateDocument();
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!_returnPan.HasValue))if(GUILayout.Button("返回定位前的视角")){Canvas.UpdateViewTransform(_returnPan.Value,_returnScale);_selected=_returnNode;Canvas.SelectNodeWithoutCamera(_selected);_returnPan=null;}
            foreach(var group in _diagnostics.GroupBy(i=>i.Severity)){
                GUILayout.Label(group.Key==GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error?"错误 / 不可运行":"提示 / 未安排",EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                foreach(var issue in group){if(GUILayout.Button(new GUIContent(issue.Message,issue.Path),new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.miniButton){wordWrap=true,alignment=TextAnchor.MiddleLeft}))NavigateDiagnostic(issue);GUILayout.Label(issue.Path,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);}
            }
        }
        public void NavigateDiagnostic(GameplayAuthoringValidationIssue issue)
        {
            if(!_document||_document.AuthoringGraph==null||_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Count==0)return;var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;string path=issue.Path+" "+issue.Message;
            var edge=graph.Connections.FirstOrDefault(e=>path.Contains(e.Id));if(edge!=null)path+=" "+edge.FromNodeId;
            var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.FirstOrDefault(d=>path.Contains(d.Id));var node=graph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n=>path.Contains(n.Id));
            var timeline=graph.Timelines.FirstOrDefault(t=>path.Contains(t.Id)||t.Events.Any(e=>path.Contains(e.Id)));var entry=timeline?.Events.FirstOrDefault(e=>path.Contains(e.Id));
            if(entry!=null)node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==entry.EntryNodeId);
            if(node==null&&local!=null)node=graph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n=>n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==local.Id));
            if(node==null)node=graph.Nodes.FirstOrDefault(n=>n.Id==graph.AbilityNodeId);if(node==null)return;
            _returnPan=Canvas.viewTransform.position;_returnScale=Canvas.viewTransform.scale;_returnNode=_selected;_selected=node.Id;_definition=local?.Id;_detailTab=0;
            Canvas.FocusNode(node.Id);
            string property=local!=null?"authoringGraph.LocalDefinitions.Array.data["+graph.LocalDefinitions.IndexOf(local)+"].Payload":
                entry!=null?"authoringGraph.Timelines.Array.data["+graph.Timelines.IndexOf(timeline)+"].Events.Array.data["+timeline.Events.IndexOf(entry)+"]":
                "authoringGraph.Nodes.Array.data["+graph.Nodes.IndexOf(node)+"].Payload"+(node.Payload is GameplayActionNodePayload?".Action":node.Payload is GameplayAbilityNodePayload?".Settings":"");
            string id=local?.Id??entry?.Id??node.Id;int at=issue.Path.IndexOf(id,StringComparison.Ordinal);if(at>=0){string suffix=issue.Path.Substring(at+id.Length);if(suffix.StartsWith(".",StringComparison.Ordinal))property+=GameplayGraphFields.NormalizePath(suffix);}
            using(var serialized=new SerializedObject(_document)){while(serialized.FindProperty(property)==null&&property.Contains('.'))property=property.Substring(0,property.LastIndexOf('.'));}
            GameplaySkillFieldSchema.RevealField(_document,property);GameplayAuthoringInspector.RequestFieldFocus(_document,property);_inspectorScroll=Vector2.zero;_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Repaint();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplaySkillWorkbench
    {
        private sealed class SkillExample
        {
            internal GameplaySkillDocumentAsset Source;
            internal string Category,Host,Status,Lesson,Tags,Mechanisms,Keywords;
            internal int Complexity;
        }
        private VisualElement _examplePanel;
        private string _exampleSearch="";
        private Vector2 _exampleScroll;
        private List<SkillExample> _examples;
        private readonly HashSet<int> _exampleLessons=new HashSet<int>();
        private void ShowExamples()
        {
            _examplePanel?.RemoveFromHierarchy();
            _examples=Documents().Select(doc=>{
                var graph=doc.AuthoringGraph;
                var types=graph.Nodes.Select(n=>(n.Payload as GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action?.GetType().Name??n.Payload.GetType().Name).ToArray();
                bool Has(string word)=>types.Any(t=>t.IndexOf(word,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)>=0);
                // Index every concrete authored role, not only the first display category.
                // Descriptor vocabulary is shared with the real creation menus, including
                // plugin actions/conditions/values and callbacks inside local resources.
                var values=graph.Nodes.SelectMany(n=>GameplayGraphFields.ObjectPaths(n.Payload).Keys)
                    .Concat(graph.LocalDefinitions.SelectMany(d=>GameplayGraphFields.ObjectPaths(d.Payload).Keys)).ToArray();
                var descriptions=values.Where(v=>v is GameplaySkillActionAuthoring||v is GameplaySkillTriggerAuthoring||v is GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring||v is GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring||v is GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring||v is GameplayEffectOverflowAuthoring||v is GameplayFloatValueAuthoring)
                    .Select(v=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(v.GetType())).ToArray();
                var mechanisms=descriptions.Select(d=>d.CategoryPath+" · "+d.DisplayName).ToList();
                if(graph.Timelines.Count>0)mechanisms.Add("时间编排 Timeline 多时点与复用");
                if(values.OfType<GameplayEffectDefinitionData>().Any(e=>e.Period>0||e.PeriodValue!=null))mechanisms.Add("周期效果 Periodic");
                if(values.OfType<GameplayEffectDefinitionData>().Any(e=>e.CompletionExecutions.Length>0)||graph.LocalDefinitions.Any(d=>GameplayGraphFields.ActionArrays(d.Payload).Any(s=>s.Path=="OnEnd")))mechanisms.Add("生命周期 自然结束 到期回调");
                if(values.OfType<GameplayEffectDefinitionData>().Any(e=>e.Stacking!=null))mechanisms.Add("效果与叠层 Stack 溢出");
                if(values.OfType<GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring>().Any(search=>search.RepeatFromResult))mechanisms.Add("连锁 · 最近未访问目标 · 每跳倍率");
                if(values.OfType<GameplayDamageExecutionAuthoring>().Any(damage=>damage.HealInstigatorAmount!=null))mechanisms.Add("吸血 · 实际净 HP 伤害 · 治疗施法者");
                if(values.OfType<GameplayGrantTimedShieldActionAuthoring>().Any(shield=>graph.Connections.Any(e=>e.OutputPortKey=="OnBroken"||e.OutputPortKey=="OnExpired")))mechanisms.Add("盾破反击 · 自然到期");
                if(values.OfType<GameplaySpawnProjectileActionAuthoring>().Any(projectile=>projectile.LaunchFromTriggerPoint))mechanisms.Add("分裂弹 · 从命中点发射子弹");
                if(doc.Mode==FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard.GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive||graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Count>0)mechanisms.Add("被动与条件 事件监听");
                string mechanismIndex=string.Join(" · ",mechanisms.Distinct());
                string category=Has("Animation")?"主动画与时间":Has("SpawnArea")?"周期领域":Has("SpawnSummon")?"召唤单位":Has("SpawnProjectile")?"弹体与命中":Has("Branch")||graph.AdditionalRuleNodeIds.Count>0?"被动与条件":graph.Timelines.Any(t=>t.Events.Count>3)?"多时点与复用":graph.LocalDefinitions.Any(d=>d.Payload is GameplayEffectDefinitionData e&&e.Stacking!=null)?"效果与叠层":"即时效果与控制";
                bool privateHost=types.Any(t=>t.StartsWith("Conformance",StringComparison.Ordinal)||t.StartsWith("ExtensionLab",StringComparison.Ordinal));
                string host=graph.Scope=="XH"?"XHRehostParity":graph.Scope=="AzurLane"?"AzurLane 游戏安装链（工作台未注册）":"FRFrameGameplaySkillLab / 对应 "+graph.Scope+" Host";
                string route=category=="主动画与时间"?"时间编排 → 设置主动画 → 选择实际后端、骨骼/Clip/Skin → 从第8帧创建搜索 → 逐目标连接伤害 → 30帧安排结束。主动画偏移与逻辑总长独立。":
                    category=="周期领域"?"施放执行 → 生成持续区域 → 配置Duration/TickInterval与阵营 → 从区域每周期端口连接治疗或伤害；需要退出清理时用Aura/Exit，不用持续停留代替周期。":
                    category=="弹体与命中"?"施放执行 → 发射弹体 → 配置运动、速度、存续与命中上限 → 从实际OnHit端口接即时效果；继续主链表示发射后立即继续，不表示等命中。":
                    category=="召唤单位"?"施放执行 → 召唤正式单位 → 高级配置选择独立单位定义、其自身技能与归属 → 配置召回时限。召唤单位以自己的技能执行，不复用施法者身份。":
                    category=="被动与条件"?"创建附加触发规则 → 选择真实事件与目标 → 连接条件分支 → 满足/否则接实际行为 → 启用为正式规则。目标输入不能保证Actor时先搜索；从Context诊断定位修复。":
                    category=="多时点与复用"?"创建时间编排 → 此帧创建实际行为 → 在其它帧选择“安排已有行为”。复用保留一个Action，多条发生独立时间/Order；若段间参数不同，复制行为再独立安排。删除时间发生不删除行为。":
                    category=="效果与叠层"?"施放/搜索逐目标 → 持续Buff → 设置时长/周期/主要Execution与Stacking → 真自然到期或溢出端口接后续效果。取消归属通过OwnedByAbility明确，禁止伪造OnTick输出。":
                    "新建空白或即时起点 → 从施放执行创建搜索 → 逐目标接造成伤害/治疗 → 搜索继续主链接结束。常量在卡上编辑，Formula/Caller在高级编辑并保留类型；高级可设置复杂Modifier与Tag。";
                if(doc.SkillId==4130)route+=" 本例旧资产为12组Search→Heal，0.7至6.2秒每0.5秒调用；可在新副本复用同一Search→Heal多次发生，或明确改成Area Tick。两者首Tick和边界不能冒称逐时等价。";
                if(doc.SkillId==7005)route+=" 本例半径6、4秒、0.5秒周期、进入即Tick；完整驻留为9次伤害，OnEnd结束施放。取消即清理区域。";
                if(doc.SkillId==7006)route+=" 本例4/12/20帧复用同一Search→Heal50，自身也是友方；一次施放总治疗150。";
                if(doc.SkillId==7008)route+=" 本例4秒/0.5秒周期、最多3层；层数不自动倍乘伤害。第四次应用触发溢出伤害，自然到期治疗50；OwnedByAbility=false，因此瞬时施放结束后DoT继续，驱散不等于自然完成。";
                if(doc.SkillId==7009)route+=" 本例Mode=Passive，Subject=OwnerTarget，监听真实受击Hit；Owner当前Health<500才治疗当前目标50。试装面板发布者→敌人的测试事件不会冒充Owner受击；可让敌人安装7004面向Owner攻击验证。";
                if(doc.SkillId==7010)route+=" 本例共享SpatialActorProfile与独立7004技能；AutoCast开启、存续4秒、OnEnd结束施放。召唤技能以新单位自己的属性和身份执行。";
                bool u7=AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(doc).Contains("/FRFrameSkillLab/U7Examples/");
                if(u7){host="FRFrameGameplaySkillLab / 共用练习场";route+=" 进入共用练习场，或用 Scene / 调试 → 安装当前正式技能。剧毒爆发从零步骤与其余五例操作见 U7 Task。";}
                var ability=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==graph.AbilityNodeId)?.Payload as GameplayAbilityNodePayload;var settings=ability?.Settings as GameplayAbilityDefinitionData;
                string tags=(settings?.Cost!=null?"消耗 ":"")+(settings?.Charge!=null?"充能 ":"")+(ability?.Definitions.Any(b=>b.PropertyPath=="CooldownEffect")==true?"冷却 ":"")+(graph.Nodes.Any(n=>n.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.External))?"共享SO ":"");
                return new SkillExample{Source=doc,Category=category,Host=host,Tags=tags,Mechanisms=mechanismIndex,Keywords=string.Join(" ",descriptions.Select(d=>d.Keywords)),Complexity=graph.Nodes.Count>15?3:graph.Nodes.Count>7?2:1,Status=u7?"U7 标准范例 · Lab 可运行":privateHost?"特定样例Host；非通用能力":AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(doc).Contains("/AuthoringExamples/H1/")?(doc.SkillId==7003?"已由 GUI 复制改造并在 Lab 验证":doc.SkillId==7002||doc.SkillId>=7004&&doc.SkillId<=7010?"已由 GUI 从零重建并在 Lab 运行验证":"已由 GUI 创作；运行验收待完成"):"既有正式Runtime内容；GUI复刻待验证",Lesson=route};
            }).OrderBy(e=>e.Category,StringComparer.Ordinal).ThenBy(e=>e.Source.SkillId).ToList();
            _examplePanel=new VisualElement{name="SkillExampleLibrary",style={position=Position.Absolute,left=12,right=12,top=38,bottom=12,backgroundColor=new Color(.14f,.16f,.19f)}};
            _examplePanel.Add(new IMGUIContainer(DrawExamples){style={flexGrow=1}});rootVisualElement.Add(_examplePanel);_examplePanel.BringToFront();
        }
        private void DrawExamples()
        {
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();GUILayout.Label("技能范例 · 真实正式源与从零路线",EditorStyles.boldLabel);GUILayout.FlexibleSpace();if(GUILayout.Button("返回工作台",GUILayout.Width(110)))_examplePanel.RemoveFromHierarchy();GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            _exampleSearch=EditorGUILayout.TextField("机制组合 / 名称 / Scope / ID",_exampleSearch);
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("只读参考与新技能副本使用同一个工作台。状态不把Builder生成、Build成功或历史运行记录冒充本轮GUI验收。外部共享SO在副本中仍显式共享，只读定位。",MessageType.Info);
            _exampleScroll=EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_exampleScroll);
            var terms=_exampleSearch.Split(new[]{' ','\t','\u3000'},StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
            foreach(var example in _examples.Where(e=>terms.All(term=>(e.Category+e.Source.DisplayName+e.Source.AuthoringGraph.Scope+e.Source.SkillId+e.Tags+e.Mechanisms+e.Keywords).IndexOf(term,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)>=0))){
                GUILayout.BeginVertical(EditorStyles.helpBox);
                GUILayout.Label(example.Category+" · "+example.Source.DisplayName+" #"+example.Source.SkillId+" · 难度 "+example.Complexity,EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                GUILayout.Label("Scope: "+example.Source.AuthoringGraph.Scope+" | Host: "+example.Host,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                GUILayout.Label(example.Status+" · "+example.Tags,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                GUILayout.Label("机制索引："+example.Mechanisms,EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                GUILayout.Label(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(example.Source),EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                bool expanded=_exampleLessons.Contains(example.Source.SkillId);
                bool show=EditorGUILayout.Foldout(expanded,"从零教程 / 本例真实时间与参数",true);
                if(show!=expanded){if(show)_exampleLessons.Add(example.Source.SkillId);else _exampleLessons.Remove(example.Source.SkillId);}
                if(show){
                    GUILayout.Label(example.Lesson,EditorStyles.wordWrappedLabel);
                    GUILayout.Label("本例可能同时含多种机制；以下列出实际节点和回调，分类路线不是逐节点复刻已验收承诺。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                    var graph=example.Source.AuthoringGraph;
                    foreach(var timeline in graph.Timelines){

                        foreach(var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==node.Id))GUILayout.Label("  "+edge.OutputPortKey+" → "+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==edge.ToNodeId)),EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                    }
                    GUILayout.Label("运行：打开 "+example.Host+"，进入Play，再从工作台 Scene / 调试试装到当前角色；不自动重载或保存Scene。预期：观察真实数值/状态与Trace；取消后检查归属清理，暂停后时序冻结。共享来源只读定位；副本需要独立值时，先明确换为局部定义再改参数。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                }

                    SelectDocument(example.Source);_referenceView=true;GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.ReadOnlyDocument=example.Source;Canvas.SetBusinessReading(true);Canvas.Load(example.Source);_examplePanel.RemoveFromHierarchy();_feedback="只读范例：可浏览与试装；请以此创建新技能后编辑。";

                    SelectDocument(example.Source);_referenceView=true;GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.ReadOnlyDocument=example.Source;_detailTab=2;_examplePanel.RemoveFromHierarchy();_details.MarkDirtyRepaint();
                }

            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplaySkillWorkbench
    {
        private sealed class PreviewChoice {internal GameplayAuthoringNode Node;internal object Values;internal float Start;internal string Key,Label,Owner,EventId;}
        // Seconds are absolute within Root's timeline. ChoiceKey includes the occurrence path,
        // so reusing one animation action never aliases two scheduled previews.
        private sealed class PreviewSeekRequest {internal string ChoiceKey;internal float Seconds;}
        private sealed class PreviewState {internal IGameplaySkillPreviewSession Session;internal string Key,ChoiceKey;internal float Seconds;internal bool HasClock;internal PreviewSeekRequest Pending;}
        private readonly Dictionary<string,PreviewState> _previews=new Dictionary<string,PreviewState>();
        private PreviewState State(string root){if(!_previews.TryGetValue(root,out var state)){var cursor=Canvas.PreviewCursor(root);_previews[root]=state=new PreviewState{Seconds=cursor??0,HasClock=cursor.HasValue};}return state;}
        private void DisposePreview(){_previewChoices.Clear();_rangeKey=null;_previewPlaying=false;foreach(var state in _previews.Values){state.Session?.Dispose();state.Session=null;state.Key=null;}}
        private string _previewClockOwner;
        private readonly Dictionary<string,List<PreviewChoice>> _previewChoices=new Dictionary<string,List<PreviewChoice>>();
        private string _inlinePreviewNode;
        private bool PreviewAffected(GameplaySkillAuthoringChange change)
        {
            if(change.Unknown||change.Structural)return true;
            if(change.Layout)return false;
            var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;
            return change.Owners.Any(owner=>owner==graph.AbilityNodeId||graph.Timelines.Any(t=>t.Id==owner)||
                _previewChoices.Values.SelectMany(c=>c).Any(c=>c.Node.Id==owner||c.Owner==owner));
        }
        private List<PreviewChoice> PreviewChoices(string root)
        {
            if(root==null||!_document||_document.AuthoringGraph==null)return new List<PreviewChoice>();
            if(_previewChoices.TryGetValue(root,out var cached))return cached;
            var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;var result=new List<PreviewChoice>();var seen=new HashSet<string>();
            Action<string,float,string,string,bool> visit=null;
            visit=(id,time,origin,eventId,effectOnly)=>{
                if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)||!seen.Add(id+":"+origin+":"+effectOnly))return;
                var node=graph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==id);var local=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==id);var timeline=graph.Timelines.Find(t=>t.Id==id);
                if(timeline!=null){foreach(var entry in timeline.Events.OrderBy(e=>e.TimeSeconds).ThenBy(e=>e.Order))visit(entry.EntryNodeId,time+entry.TimeSeconds,origin+"/"+entry.Id,entry.Id,false);return;}
                foreach(var binding in node?.Payload.Definitions??local?.Definitions??new List<GameplayDefinitionBinding>()){
                    object values=graph.LocalDefinitions.Find(d=>d.Id==binding.LocalId)?.Payload;
                    if(values==null&&binding.External)try{values=binding.External.CaptureGraphValues();}catch(NotSupportedException){}
                    if(!effectOnly&&node!=null&&values!=null&&PreviewFactories.Any(p=>p.Supports(values)))result.Add(new PreviewChoice{Node=node,Values=values,Start=time,Owner=binding.LocalId,EventId=eventId,Key=origin+":"+id+":"+binding.PropertyPath,Label=time.ToString("0.###")+"s · "+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.NodeName(node)+" · "+string.Join("/",origin.Split('/').Select(part=>part.Substring(0,Math.Min(4,part.Length))))});
                    if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.LocalId))visit(binding.LocalId,time,origin,eventId,false);
                }
                if(effectOnly)return;
                foreach(var edge in graph.Connections.Where(e=>e.FromNodeId==id).OrderBy(e=>e.Order))visit(edge.ToNodeId,time,origin,eventId,edge.InputPortKey==GameplayGraphEffectCallbacks.Input);
            };
            visit(root,0,root,null,false);_previewChoices[root]=result;return result;
        }
        private bool HasPreview(string id)=>PreviewChoices(id).Any(c=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(((GameplayActionNodePayload)c.Node.Payload).Action.GetType()).IsAnimation);
        private void SetInlinePreview(string id,bool open)
        {
            _inlinePreviewNode=open?id:null;if(!open)DisposePreview();Repaint();
        }
        private void RequestPreviewSeek(string root,string eventId,float seconds)
        {
            Canvas.SetPreviewCursor(root,seconds);
            if(!HasPreview(root))return;
            var choices=PreviewChoices(root).Where(c=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(((GameplayActionNodePayload)c.Node.Payload).Action.GetType()).IsAnimation).ToList();
            var matches=choices.Where(c=>c.EventId==eventId).ToArray();
            var state=State(root);var choice=matches.Length==1?matches[0]:choices.Find(c=>c.Key==state.ChoiceKey);
            if(choice==null&&choices.Count==1)choice=choices[0];
            SetInlinePreview(root,true);_previewPlaying=false;_previewClockOwner=root;state.Seconds=seconds;state.HasClock=true;
            if(choice!=null){state.ChoiceKey=choice.Key;state.Pending=new PreviewSeekRequest{ChoiceKey=choice.Key,Seconds=seconds};}
            Repaint();
        }
        // Actual SDK creation is kept after event selection. A first-frame/configuration reload
        // cannot overwrite an earlier seek request with the animation's start offset.
        private void EnsurePreview(string root,PreviewChoice choice)
        {
            var state=State(root);string key=_document.GetInstanceID()+":"+choice.Key;
            if(state.Key!=key){
                state.Session?.Dispose();state.Session=null;state.Key=key;
                if(!state.HasClock)state.Seconds=choice.Start;
                try{state.Session=PreviewFactories.First(p=>p.Supports(choice.Values)).Create(_document,choice.Values,choice.Start);}
                catch(Exception error){_feedback=error.Message;RecordPreviewError(choice.Node.Id,error.Message);}
                state.HasClock=true;
            }
            if(state.Pending!=null&&state.Pending.ChoiceKey==choice.Key){state.Seconds=state.Pending.Seconds;state.Pending=null;}
            state.Session?.Seek(state.Seconds);Canvas.SetPreviewCursor(root,state.Seconds);
        }
        private float PreviewClockDuration(string root)
        {
            var node=_document.AuthoringGraph.Nodes.Find(n=>n.Id==root);
            var timeline=_document.AuthoringGraph.Timelines.FirstOrDefault(t=>node!=null&&node.Payload.Definitions.Any(b=>b.LocalId==t.Id));
            return timeline?.DurationSeconds??State(root).Session?.Duration??0;
        }
        private void TogglePreviewPlayback(string root)
        {
            var choices=PreviewChoices(root).Where(c=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(((GameplayActionNodePayload)c.Node.Payload).Action.GetType()).IsAnimation).ToList();
            var state=State(root);var choice=choices.Find(c=>c.Key==state.ChoiceKey)??(choices.Count==1?choices[0]:null);
            if(choice==null){_feedback="请先选择要预览的确切动画事件。";Repaint();return;}
            state.ChoiceKey=choice.Key;EnsurePreview(root,choice);_previewClockOwner=root;_previewPlaying=!_previewPlaying;_previewLast=EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;
        }
        private void DrawInlinePreview(string id)=>DrawPreview(id,true);
        private void DrawPreview(string root=null,bool inline=false)
        {
            if(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("编辑模式预览已暂停；请在真实 Scene / Runtime 调试中观察施放。",MessageType.Info);return;}
            var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;if(graph==null)return;root=root??_selected;
            if(!inline&&_inlinePreviewNode!=null){
                GUILayout.Label("编排卡使用同一时间光标；此处调整预览专用输入。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                State(_inlinePreviewNode).Session?.DrawControls();return;
            }
            var choices=PreviewChoices(root);
            if(inline)choices=choices.Where(c=>GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(((GameplayActionNodePayload)c.Node.Payload).Action.GetType()).IsAnimation).ToList();
            if(choices.Count==0){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("当前行为没有可用预览；请检查实际资源与后端。",MessageType.Info);return;}
            var state=State(root);int at=choices.FindIndex(c=>c.Key==state.ChoiceKey);
            if(choices.Count==1)at=0;
            else{
                var options=new[]{"选择动画事件 / 载体"}.Concat(choices.Select(c=>c.Label)).ToArray();
                int next=EditorGUILayout.Popup("预览事件",at+1,options)-1;
                if(next!=at&&next>=0){at=next;_previewPlaying=false;}
            }
            if(at<0){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("多个动画事件；选择上方载体或时间轴中的确切动画事件。",MessageType.Info);return;}
            var choice=choices[at];state.ChoiceKey=choice.Key;EnsurePreview(root,choice);var preview=state.Session;
            if(preview==null){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_feedback??"请配置实际资源。",MessageType.Warning);if(GUILayout.Button("配置修复后重试"))DisposePreview();return;}
            if(preview is IGameplaySkillPreviewDiagnostics diagnostic&&!string.IsNullOrEmpty(diagnostic.Error)){
                RecordPreviewError(choice.Node.Id,diagnostic.Error);EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(diagnostic.Error,MessageType.Error);
                if(GUILayout.Button("重试此预览"))diagnostic.Retry();return;
            }
            if(!inline){
                int fps=30;GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                if(GUILayout.Button(_previewPlaying&&_previewClockOwner==root?"暂停":"播放",GUILayout.Width(46))){_previewClockOwner=root;_previewPlaying=!_previewPlaying;_previewLast=EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;}
                if(GUILayout.Button("停止",GUILayout.Width(44))){_previewPlaying=false;state.Seconds=0;}
                if(GUILayout.Button("◀",GUILayout.Width(28))){_previewPlaying=false;state.Seconds-=1f/fps;}
                if(GUILayout.Button("▶",GUILayout.Width(28))){_previewPlaying=false;state.Seconds+=1f/fps;}
                state.Seconds=Mathf.Clamp(EditorGUILayout.FloatField(state.Seconds*fps)/fps,0,PreviewClockDuration(root));GUILayout.EndHorizontal();preview.Seek(state.Seconds);
            }
            float width=inline?Canvas.PreviewWidth(root):_inspector.resolvedStyle.width-35;
            var rect=GUILayoutUtility.GetRect(100,inline?Canvas.PreviewHeight(root):Mathf.Clamp(width*.46f,150,220),GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true));
            preview.Render(rect);
            if(!inline)preview.DrawControls();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

{

    {

        private bool _browserForced,_previewPlaying;
        private double _previewLast,_hostRepaintLast;
        private string _rangeKey;
        private FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplayRangePreviewShape _rangeShape;

        private void PreviewTick()
        {

            if(_installation!=null&&EditorApplication.isPlaying&&_detailTab==2&&hostNow-_hostRepaintLast>=.1){_hostRepaintLast=hostNow;_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Repaint();}
            if(!_previewPlaying||_previewClockOwner==null||!_previews.TryGetValue(_previewClockOwner,out var state)||state.Session==null)return;
            double now=EditorApplication.timeSinceStartup;state.Seconds+=(float)(now-_previewLast);_previewLast=now;
            float duration=PreviewClockDuration(_previewClockOwner);if(state.Seconds>duration){state.Seconds=duration;_previewPlaying=false;}
            state.Session.Seek(state.Seconds);Canvas.SetPreviewCursor(_previewClockOwner,state.Seconds);_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Canvas?.MarkDirtyRepaint();
        }
        private void DrawRangePreview(){
            var graph=_document.AuthoringGraph;int index=graph.Nodes.FindIndex(n=>n.Id==_selected);
            if(index<0||!((graph.Nodes[index].Payload as FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph.GameplayActionNodePayload)?.Action is GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring))return;
            _rangeLevel=Mathf.Clamp(EditorGUILayout.IntField("范围预览等级",_rangeLevel),1,_document.EffectiveMaxLevel);
            var context=new FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplayRangePreviewContext(_document,"authoringGraph.Nodes.Array.data["+index+"].Payload.Action",_rangeLevel);
            string key=_document.GetInstanceID()+":"+_selected+":"+_rangeLevel;
            if(_rangeKey!=key){_rangeKey=key;_rangeValid=FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplayRangePreview.TryRead(context,out _rangeShape,out _rangeError);}
            if(_rangeValid){GUILayout.Label(_rangeShape.Label,EditorStyles.boldLabel);FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplayRangePreview.Draw(GUILayoutUtility.GetRect(100,210,GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true)),_rangeShape);}
            else if(_rangeError!=null)EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_rangeError,MessageType.Warning);
        }
        // V1's native captured-pointer splitter: resizing a pane changes view geometry only.
        private static VisualElement PaneHandle(Action<float> move,Action save)
        {
            var handle=new VisualElement{style={width=5,flexShrink=0,backgroundColor=GameplayEditorStyles.Surface}};float previous=0;
            handle.RegisterCallback<PointerDownEvent>(e=>{if(e.button!=0)return;previous=e.position.x;handle.CapturePointer(e.pointerId);e.StopPropagation();});
            handle.RegisterCallback<PointerMoveEvent>(e=>{if(!handle.HasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))return;move(e.position.x-previous);previous=e.position.x;e.StopPropagation();});
            handle.RegisterCallback<PointerUpEvent>(e=>{if(!handle.HasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))return;handle.ReleasePointer(e.pointerId);save();e.StopPropagation();});return handle;
        }
        internal void OpenDetails(int tab=0)
        {
            _detailTab=tab;
            _inspectorScroll=Vector2.zero;
            if(!_inspectorOpen){
                _inspectorOpen=true;
                ApplyPaneWidths();
                SavePanePreferences();
            }
            _details.MarkDirtyRepaint();
        }

        private void ApplyPaneWidths()
        {
            if(_browser==null||_inspector==null)return;
            bool browser=_browserOpen&&(position.width>=1100||_browserForced);
            _browser.style.display=browser?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
            _browserHandle.style.display=browser?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
            _inspector.style.display=_inspectorOpen?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
            _inspectorHandle.style.display=_inspectorOpen?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
            float right=_inspectorOpen?Mathf.Clamp(_inspectorWidth,300,Mathf.Max(300,position.width-400)):0;

        }

                GUILayout.Label(new GUIContent(_document.DisplayName+"  #"+_document.SkillId+(EditorUtility.IsDirty(_document)?"  • 未保存":""),AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_document)),EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                GUILayout.FlexibleSpace();GUILayout.Label(new GUIContent(System.IO.Path.GetFileName(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_document)),AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_document)),EditorStyles.miniLabel);
                if(GUILayout.Button("定位源文件",EditorStyles.toolbarButton,GUILayout.Width(78))){Selection.activeObject=_document;EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(_document);}
            }else GUILayout.Label("选择技能或新建正式技能 · 单击节点直接编辑业务配置",EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }
        private void ExternalChanged(IReadOnlyList<GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Change> changes)
        {
            if(!_document)return;
            bool documentChanged=changes.Any(c=>c.Source==_document)&&EditorUtility.GetDirtyCount(_document)!=_knownDocumentDirtyCount;
            bool sharedChanged=changes.Any(c=>Canvas?.UsesExternal(c.Source)==true);
            // Native Apply also emits a deferred object notification. Its already-handled
            // dirty revision must not trigger a second full refresh. Unknown revisions and
            // all shared-source changes retain conservative topology/context fallback.
            if(!documentChanged&&!sharedChanged)return;
            _diagnosticsStale=true;_rangeKey=null;DisposePreview();_documentBrowser?.Changed(_document);RefreshUnknown();RememberSourceVersion();_details?.MarkDirtyRepaint();Repaint();
        }

    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.ShortcutManagement;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring
{
    public sealed partial class GameplaySkillWorkbench
    {
        [Serializable] private sealed class RecentDocument
        {
            public string Guid, Title, Path;
            public long FileId;
            [NonSerialized] internal GameplaySkillDocumentAsset Document;
        }
        [Serializable] private sealed class RecentDocuments { public List<RecentDocument> Items=new List<RecentDocument>(); }
        private RecentDocuments _recent;
        private bool _recentStale=true;
        private VisualElement _editingArea,_documentTools;
        private IMGUIContainer _welcome;
        private Vector2 _welcomeScroll;
        private static string ProjectKey=>"FRFrame.SkillAuthoring."+Application.dataPath;
        private static string RecentKey=>ProjectKey+".RecentDocuments";

        private void RecentSourcesChanged(){_recentStale=true;_welcome?.MarkDirtyRepaint();}
        private void LoadRecent()
        {
            if(_recent==null){
                _recent=JsonUtility.FromJson<RecentDocuments>(EditorPrefs.GetString(RecentKey,JsonUtility.ToJson(new RecentDocuments())));
                // Read the old Workspace index once. Only its explicit RuntimeDocument (or
                // an actual main Document) is accepted; never guess a child by path/name/ID.
                if(!EditorPrefs.HasKey(RecentKey)){
                    foreach(string guid in EditorPrefs.GetString("FRFrame.Workbench.Recent."+Application.dataPath,"").Split('|').Reverse()){
                        string path=AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);if(string.IsNullOrEmpty(path))continue;
                        var source=AssetDatabase.LoadMainAssetAtPath(path);if(!source)continue;
                        var document=source as GameplaySkillDocumentAsset;
                        if(!document)using(var so=new SerializedObject(source))document=so.FindProperty("RuntimeDocument")?.objectReferenceValue as GameplaySkillDocumentAsset;
                        if(document)RecordRecent(document);
                    }
                    SaveRecent();
                }
            }
            if(!_recentStale)return;_recentStale=false;
            foreach(var item in _recent.Items.ToArray()){
                string path=AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(item.Guid);
                item.Document=string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)?null:AssetDatabase.LoadAllAssetsAtPath(path).OfType<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset>()
                    .FirstOrDefault(d=>AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(d,out string guid,out long id)&&guid==item.Guid&&id==item.FileId);
                if(!item.Document){_recent.Items.Remove(item);continue;}
                item.Path=path;item.Title=item.Document.DisplayName+"  #"+item.Document.SkillId;
            }
            SaveRecent();
        }
        private void RecordRecent(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        {
            if(!AssetDatabase.TryGetGUIDAndLocalFileIdentifier(document,out string guid,out long id))return;
            _recent.Items.RemoveAll(e=>e.Guid==guid&&e.FileId==id);
            _recent.Items.Insert(0,new RecentDocument{Guid=guid,FileId=id,Document=document,Path=AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(document),Title=document.DisplayName+"  #"+document.SkillId});
            if(_recent.Items.Count>6)_recent.Items.RemoveRange(6,_recent.Items.Count-6);
        }
        private void RememberRecent(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
        {
            if(!document||!EditorUtility.IsPersistent(document))return;
            LoadRecent();RecordRecent(document);SaveRecent();_welcome?.MarkDirtyRepaint();
        }
        private void SaveRecent()=>EditorPrefs.SetString(RecentKey,JsonUtility.ToJson(_recent));
        private void OpenRecent(RecentDocument entry)
        {
            _recentStale=true;LoadRecent();
            var current=_recent.Items.FirstOrDefault(e=>e.Guid==entry.Guid&&e.FileId==entry.FileId);
            if(current?.Document)SelectDocument(current.Document);
            else {_feedback="该技能已移除；最近列表已更新。";Repaint();}
        }
        private void ShowHome(){_sharedSource=null;SelectDocument(null);_welcome?.MarkDirtyRepaint();}
        private void UpdateSurface()
        {
            if(_welcome==null)return;
            bool editing=_document||_sharedSource;
            _welcome.style.display=editing?DisplayStyle.None:DisplayStyle.Flex;
            _editingArea.style.display=editing?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
            _documentTools.style.display=_document?DisplayStyle.Flex:DisplayStyle.None;
        }
        private void ShowOpenDocumentMenu()
        {
            var menu=new GenericMenu();var documents=Documents();
            foreach(var doc in documents){
                var source=doc;string title=doc.DisplayName+" #"+doc.SkillId+" · "+doc.name;
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent((doc.AuthoringGraph?.Scope??"未迁移")+"/"+title,AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(doc)),doc==_document,()=>SelectDocument(source));
            }
            if(documents.Count==0)menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("尚无技能，请先新建"));
            menu.ShowAsContext();
        }
        private void ShowRecentDocumentMenu()
        {
            LoadRecent();
            var menu=new GenericMenu();
            foreach(var entry in _recent.Items)
                menu.AddItem(new GUIContent(entry.Title+" · "+System.IO.Path.GetFileName(entry.Path),entry.Path),
                    entry.Document==_document,()=>OpenRecent(entry));
            if(_recent.Items.Count==0)
                menu.AddDisabledItem(new GUIContent("暂无记录，打开技能后会出现在这里"));
            menu.ShowAsContext();
        }
        private void DrawWelcome()
        {
            LoadRecent();_welcomeScroll=EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_welcomeScroll);
            GUILayout.Space(24);GUILayout.Label("开始创作技能",new GUIStyle(EditorStyles.boldLabel){fontSize=20});

            GUILayout.Space(14);GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if(GUILayout.Button("＋ 新建技能",GUILayout.Width(160),GUILayout.Height(32)))NewDocument();
            if(GUILayout.Button("打开已有技能…",GUILayout.Width(160),GUILayout.Height(32)))ShowOpenDocumentMenu();
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_recent.Items.Count==0))

            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();GUILayout.Space(20);GUILayout.Label("最近使用 · 最多 6 份",EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            if(_recent.Items.Count==0)GUILayout.Label("打开一份技能后，这里会记住它的真实资产身份。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
            foreach(var entry in _recent.Items.ToArray())

        {
            EditorPrefs.SetBool(ProjectKey+".BrowserOpen",_browserOpen);
            EditorPrefs.SetBool(ProjectKey+".BrowserForced",_browserForced);
            EditorPrefs.SetBool(ProjectKey+".InspectorOpen",_inspectorOpen);

        }
        // Window context takes precedence over Unity's global New Scene / Save Scene.
        [Shortcut("FRFrame/Skill Workbench/New",typeof(GameplaySkillWorkbench),KeyCode.N,ShortcutModifiers.Action)]
        private static void NewShortcut(ShortcutArguments args)
        {
            var window=(GameplaySkillWorkbench)args.context;
            if(window.Canvas?.EditingText()==true||!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.compositionString))return;
            window.NewDocument();
        }
        [Shortcut("FRFrame/Skill Workbench/Save",typeof(GameplaySkillWorkbench),KeyCode.S,ShortcutModifiers.Action)]
        private static void SaveShortcut(ShortcutArguments args)=>((GameplaySkillWorkbench)args.context).SaveDocument();
        private void SaveDocument()=>Attempt(()=>{if(GameplaySkillAuthoringCommands.IsReadOnly(_document)){_feedback="只读范例；请以此创建新技能后保存。";return;}if(_document){AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(_document);_feedback="已保存同一主技能文件";}});
        private void OnWorkbenchKeyDown(KeyDownEvent e)
        {
            if(!(e.ctrlKey||e.commandKey))return;
            if(e.keyCode==KeyCode.S){
                SaveDocument();
                e.StopImmediatePropagation();e.PreventDefault();return;
            }
            if(e.keyCode!=KeyCode.N||Canvas?.EditingText()==true||!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Input.compositionString))return;
            NewDocument();e.StopImmediatePropagation();e.PreventDefault();
            // Ctrl+D/Copy/Paste/Delete keep GraphView's working native command route.
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline
{
    /// <summary>One shared geometry result for marker rendering and mouse hit testing.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout
    {
        public struct Entry
        {
            public int Index;
            public int Track;
            public Rect Rect;
        }

        /// <summary>The standalone timeline may present a pending drag without changing its
        /// source. Drawing and hit testing consume that same optional presentation time.</summary>
        public static List<Entry> Build(GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] markers, Rect area,
            float contentX, float pixelsPerSecond, Func<int,float> presentedTime = null)
        {
            var result = new List<Entry>();
            if (markers == null) return result;
            var laneEnd = new float[GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.TrackCount, 2];
            for (int track = 0; track < GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.TrackCount; track++)
                for (int lane = 0; lane < 2; lane++) laneEnd[track, lane] = float.NegativeInfinity;
            for (int i = 0; i < markers.Length; i++)
            {
                var marker = markers[i];
                int track = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Track(marker);
                if (track < 0) continue;
                float x = contentX + (presentedTime==null?marker.Time:presentedTime(i)) * pixelsPerSecond;
                float left = x - 3f;
                int lane = left >= laneEnd[track, 0] + 2f ? 0 :
                    left >= laneEnd[track, 1] + 2f ? 1 :
                    laneEnd[track, 0] <= laneEnd[track, 1] ? 0 : 1;
                laneEnd[track, lane] = left + GameplayEditorStyles.MarkerWidth;
                result.Add(new Entry { Index = i, Track = track,
                    Rect = new Rect(left,
                        area.y + GameplayEditorStyles.RulerHeight + track * GameplayEditorStyles.TrackHeight +
                        2f + lane * (GameplayEditorStyles.MarkerHeight + 1f),
                        GameplayEditorStyles.MarkerWidth, GameplayEditorStyles.MarkerHeight) });
            }
            return result;
        }

        public static int HitTest(IReadOnlyList<Entry> entries, Vector2 point, Rect content)
        {
            if (!content.Contains(point)) return -1;
            for (int i = entries.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
                if (entries[i].Rect.Contains(point)) return entries[i].Index;
            return -1;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline
{
    /// <summary>Editor operations on the Sequence asset itself; tracks are only type projections.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySequenceTimelineModel
    {
        public const int PreviewFramesPerSecond = 60;
        public const int TrackCount = 3;

        /// <summary>One mouse gesture owns one Undo record. Movement is a transient preview;
        /// only MouseUp writes the source, so an intervening Undo can restore it unambiguously.</summary>
        public sealed class MarkerDrag : IDisposable
        {
            private readonly GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset _asset;
            private readonly int _fps;
            private readonly GameplaySourceHandle _marker;
            private readonly float _original;
            private bool _ended;
            private float _previewTime;

            /// <summary>Time presented by the active gesture; not a serialized authoring value.</summary>
            public float PreviewTime => _previewTime;

            internal MarkerDrag(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index, int fps)
            {
                _asset = asset; _fps=fps;
                _marker = GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(asset,"Markers.Array.data["+index+"]");
                _original = asset.Markers[index].Time;
                _previewTime = _original;
            }

            public void Update(float seconds, bool snap)
            {
                if (_ended) return;
                int index=CurrentIndex;
                if(index<0){Cancel();return;}
                _previewTime = Mathf.Clamp(Snap(seconds, snap, _fps), 0f, Mathf.Max(0f, _asset.Duration));
            }

            /// <summary>Current slot of the original marker, or -1 after its identity was removed.</summary>
            public int CurrentIndex {get{
                if(!_marker.TryResolve(out string path))return -1;
                int start=path.LastIndexOf('['),end=path.LastIndexOf(']');
                return start>=0&&end>start&&int.TryParse(path.Substring(start+1,end-start-1),out int index)?index:-1;
            }}

            public void Cancel() { _ended=true; }
            public void End()
            {
                if (_ended) return;
                _ended = true;
                int index=CurrentIndex;if(index<0||!_asset)return;
                // Another editor/Undo may already have changed the same field. Never overwrite
                // its restored value with a gesture that has not been committed.
                if(!Mathf.Approximately(_asset.Markers[index].Time,_original)||Mathf.Approximately(_previewTime,_original))return;
                Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();int group=Undo.GetCurrentGroup();
                Undo.RegisterCompleteObjectUndo(_asset,"移动序列标记");
                WriteTime(_asset,index,_previewTime,false,false,_fps);
                Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(group);Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();
            }
            public void Dispose() => End();
        }

        public static int Track(GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring marker) =>
            marker is GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring ? 0 :
            marker is GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring ? 1 :
            marker is GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring ? 2 : -1;

        public static float Snap(float seconds, bool enabled, int fps=PreviewFramesPerSecond) =>
            enabled ? Mathf.Round(seconds * Math.Max(1,fps)) / (float)Math.Max(1,fps) : seconds;

        public static void SetTime(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index, float seconds, bool snap, int fps=PreviewFramesPerSecond)
        {
            WriteTime(asset, index, seconds, snap, true, fps);
        }

        public static MarkerDrag BeginDrag(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index, int fps=PreviewFramesPerSecond)
        {
            ValidateIndex(asset, index);
            return new MarkerDrag(asset, index, fps);
        }

        private static void ValidateIndex(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index)
        {
            if (asset == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));
            if (index < 0 || index >= asset.Markers.Length) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(index));
        }

        private static void WriteTime(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index, float seconds, bool snap, bool recordUndo, int fps)
        {
            ValidateIndex(asset, index);
            float value = Mathf.Clamp(Snap(seconds, snap, fps), 0f, Mathf.Max(0f, asset.Duration));
            if (Mathf.Approximately(asset.Markers[index].Time, value)) return;
            if (recordUndo) Undo.RecordObject(asset, "移动序列标记");
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
            serialized.FindProperty("Markers").GetArrayElementAtIndex(index).FindPropertyRelative("Time").floatValue = value;
            if(serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo()) GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(asset,"Markers.Array.data["+index+"].Time");
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
        }

        public static int Add(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring marker)
        {
            if (asset == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(asset));
            if (marker == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(marker));
            Undo.RecordObject(asset, "添加序列标记");
            var source = asset.Markers ?? Array.Empty<GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring>();
            var result = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[source.Length + 1];
            Array.Copy(source, result, source.Length);
            result[source.Length] = marker;
            asset.Markers = result;
            GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(asset,"Markers");
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
            return source.Length;
        }

        public static int Duplicate(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index)
        {
            if (asset == null || index < 0 || index >= asset.Markers.Length) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(index));
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
            var markers = serialized.FindProperty("Markers");
            var source = markers.GetArrayElementAtIndex(index).managedReferenceValue;
            var copy = Activator.CreateInstance(source.GetType());
            EditorJsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite(EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(source), copy);
            Undo.RecordObject(asset, "复制序列标记");
            markers.InsertArrayElementAtIndex(index + 1);
            markers.GetArrayElementAtIndex(index + 1).managedReferenceValue = copy;
            if(serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties()) GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(asset,"Markers");
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
            return index + 1;
        }

        public static void Delete(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset, int index)
        {
            if (asset == null || index < 0 || index >= asset.Markers.Length) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(index));
            GameplaySharedAuthoringCommands.Remove(asset,"Markers.Array.data["+index+"]");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
````
