````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline
{
    /// <summary>Shared Sequence asset panel. Standalone Timeline and Skill Workbench use this same editor surface.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel
    {
        private GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset _sequence;
        private readonly Action _repaint;
        private Vector2 _inspectorScroll;
        private int _selected = -1, _dragging = -1, _dragControl;
        private GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.MarkerDrag _drag;
        private float _playhead, _zoom = 1f, _horizontalSeconds, _presentationDuration, _dragGrabOffsetPixels;
        private bool _fitToWindow = true;
        private bool _snap = true, _frames;
        private bool _showMarker = true, _showEvents, _showValidation;
        private string[] _issues = Array.Empty<string>();
        private const float LabelWidth = GameplayEditorStyles.TrackHeaderWidth;
        private const float TrackHeight = GameplayEditorStyles.TrackHeight;
        private string _scope="FRFrame";
        private long _selectedReference=-1;
        private float _selectedTime;
        public int FramesPerSecond { get; private set; }=60;
        public event Action<int> MarkerSelected;
        public event Action<int> AddRequested;
        public void ConfigureScope(string scope)
        {
            _scope=scope??"FRFrame";FramesPerSecond=_scope=="XH"?30:Mathf.Clamp(EditorPrefs.GetInt("FRFrame.Timeline.FPS."+_scope,60),1,240);_frames=true;
        }
        public GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset CurrentSequence => _sequence;
        public int SelectedMarker => _selected;
        public float Playhead => _playhead;
        internal bool IsDragging=>_drag!=null;
        /// <summary>Editor display range may extend past rule Sequence duration to show a presentation animation.</summary>
        public float DisplayDuration => Mathf.Max(_sequence == null ? 0f : _sequence.Duration, _presentationDuration);
        public event Action<float> PlayheadChanged;

        public GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel(Action repaint) { _repaint = repaint ?? (() => { }); }
        public void Select(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence)
        {
            if (_sequence == sequence) return;
            CancelDrag();
            _sequence = sequence;
            _selected = -1;_selectedReference=-1;
            _playhead = _horizontalSeconds = 0f;
            _presentationDuration = 0f;
            _fitToWindow = true;
            Validate();
            PlayheadChanged?.Invoke(_playhead);
            _repaint();
        }
        public void OnUndo() { CancelDrag();Validate();if(_sequence!=null&&_selected>=0){float time=_sequence.Markers[_selected].Time;if(!Mathf.Approximately(time,_selectedTime))SetPlayhead(time);_selectedTime=time;}_repaint(); }
        /// <summary>Workbench navigation selects the canonical marker inspector without moving its time or advancing gameplay.</summary>
        public void SelectMarker(int index)
        {
            if (_sequence == null || index < 0 || index >= _sequence.Markers.Length) return;
            CancelDrag();
            _selected = index;
            _selectedTime=_sequence.Markers[index].Time;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(_sequence)) _selectedReference=so.FindProperty("Markers").GetArrayElementAtIndex(index).managedReferenceId;
            _showMarker = true;
            _repaint();
        }
        public void CancelDrag()
        {
            _drag?.Cancel();
            _drag = null;
            _dragging = -1;
            if (_dragControl != 0 && GUIUtility.hotControl == _dragControl) GUIUtility.hotControl = 0;
            _dragControl = 0;
            _dragGrabOffsetPixels = 0f;
            Validate();
            _repaint();
        }
        public void Validate()
        {
            _issues = GameplaySequenceTimelineValidation.Check(_sequence).ToArray();
            if(_sequence!=null&&_selectedReference>=0) {
                using(var so=new SerializedObject(_sequence)) {
                    var array=so.FindProperty("Markers");_selected=-1;
                    for(int i=0;i<array.arraySize;i++) if(array.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i).managedReferenceId==_selectedReference){_selected=i;break;}
                }
            }
            if(_sequence==null || _selected>=_sequence.Markers.Length) _selected=-1;
        }
        private float PresentedTime(int index)=>_drag!=null&&_drag.CurrentIndex==index?_drag.PreviewTime:_sequence.Markers[index].Time;

        public void SetPlayhead(float seconds)
        {
            _playhead = Mathf.Clamp(seconds, 0f, DisplayDuration);
            PlayheadChanged?.Invoke(_playhead);
            _repaint();
        }
        public void SetPresentationDuration(float seconds)
        {
            _presentationDuration = Mathf.Max(0f, seconds);
            if (_playhead > DisplayDuration) SetPlayhead(DisplayDuration);
        }
        public void DrawTimeline(float viewportWidth, float presentationDuration = 0f,bool compact=false)
        {
            SetPresentationDuration(presentationDuration);
            GUILayout.BeginVertical(GUILayout.Width(viewportWidth), GUILayout.ExpandHeight(!compact));
            if (_sequence == null)
            { GUILayout.FlexibleSpace(); GUILayout.Label("从左侧选择 Sequence Asset", EditorStyles.centeredGreyMiniLabel); GUILayout.FlexibleSpace(); GUILayout.EndVertical(); return; }
            if (_fitToWindow)
                _zoom = Mathf.Clamp((Mathf.Max(500f, viewportWidth) - LabelWidth - 45f) /
                    (Mathf.Max(.1f, DisplayDuration) * 220f), .25f, 8f);
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal(EditorStyles.toolbar);
            if (viewportWidth >= 760f)
            { GUILayout.Label(_sequence.name, EditorStyles.boldLabel, GUILayout.MaxWidth(210f)); GUILayout.Space(8f); }
            _frames = GUILayout.Toggle(_frames, _frames ? "帧" : "秒", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(40));
            _snap = GUILayout.Toggle(_snap, "吸附 1/"+FramesPerSecond+"秒", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(95));
            GUILayout.Label(new GUIContent(FramesPerSecond+"f = 1.000s（创作刻度）","只改变编辑器显示 / 吸附，Runtime 按秒；不是 Spine 或 Unity 渲染帧率。"),EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            int fps;using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_scope=="XH"))fps=EditorGUILayout.IntField(FramesPerSecond,GUILayout.Width(35));
            if(fps!=FramesPerSecond){FramesPerSecond=Mathf.Clamp(fps,1,240);EditorPrefs.SetInt("FRFrame.Timeline.FPS."+_scope,FramesPerSecond);}
            GUILayout.Label("FPS",GUILayout.Width(25));
            GUILayout.Label("缩放", GUILayout.Width(30));
            float zoom = GUILayout.HorizontalSlider(_zoom, .25f, 8f, GUILayout.Width(100));
            if (!Mathf.Approximately(zoom, _zoom)) { _zoom = zoom; _fitToWindow = false; }
            GUILayout.Label(_zoom.ToString("0.0") + "×", GUILayout.Width(35));
            if (GUILayout.Button("适配", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(40)))
            { _fitToWindow = true; _horizontalSeconds = 0f; }
            if(!compact)GUILayout.FlexibleSpace();
            GUILayout.Label(viewportWidth >= 760f
                ? $"预览 {_playhead:0.000}s  ·  序列 {_sequence.Duration:0.###}s  ·  显示 {DisplayDuration:0.###}s"
                : $"{_playhead:0.000}s / {DisplayDuration:0.###}s", EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();

            float pixelsPerSecond = 220f * _zoom;
            float visibleWidth = Mathf.Max(200f, viewportWidth - LabelWidth - 24f);
            float maxScroll = Mathf.Max(0f, DisplayDuration - visibleWidth / pixelsPerSecond);
            _horizontalSeconds = GUILayout.HorizontalSlider(_horizontalSeconds, 0f, maxScroll);
            Rect area = GUILayoutUtility.GetRect(100f,
                GameplayEditorStyles.RulerHeight + TrackHeight * GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.TrackCount + 2f, GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true));
            DrawCanvas(area, pixelsPerSecond);
            if(!compact)GUILayout.FlexibleSpace();
            GUILayout.EndVertical();
        }

        private void AddMarker(int track)
        {
            if (_sequence == null || _playhead > _sequence.Duration) return;
            if(AddRequested!=null){AddRequested.Invoke(track);return;}
            GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring marker = track == 0
                ? (GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring)new GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring { Time = _playhead }
                : track == 1 ? (GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring)new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = _playhead }
                : new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring { Time = _playhead, Target = new GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring() };
            SelectMarker(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Add(_sequence, marker));MarkerSelected?.Invoke(_selected);
            Validate();
            _repaint();
        }

        private void DrawCanvas(Rect area, float scale)
        {
            int canvasControl = GUIUtility.GetControlID(FocusType.Passive, area);
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(area, GameplayEditorStyles.Surface);
            Rect ruler = new Rect(area.x + LabelWidth, area.y, area.width - LabelWidth,
                GameplayEditorStyles.RulerHeight);
            float contentX = ruler.x - _horizontalSeconds * scale;
            Rect content = new Rect(ruler.x, area.y + GameplayEditorStyles.RulerHeight,
                ruler.width, TrackHeight * GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.TrackCount);
            for (int track = 0; track < GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.TrackCount; track++)
            {
                float rowY = content.y + track * TrackHeight;
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(area.x, rowY, area.width, TrackHeight),
                    track == 0 ? GameplayEditorStyles.TrackA : GameplayEditorStyles.TrackB);
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(area.x, rowY, LabelWidth, TrackHeight), GameplayEditorStyles.Panel);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(area.x + 8f, rowY + 4f, LabelWidth - 35f, 20f),
                    track == 0 ? "效果 Effect" : track == 1 ? "表现 Cue" : "规则 SkillStep", EditorStyles.miniBoldLabel);
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_playhead > _sequence.Duration))
                    if (GUI.Button(new Rect(area.x + LabelWidth - 27f, rowY + 6f, 21f, 20f),
                        new GUIContent("+", track == 0 ? "在播放头添加效果" : track == 1 ? "在播放头添加表现" : "在播放头添加规则步骤"),
                        EditorStyles.miniButton)) AddMarker(track);
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(area.x, rowY + TrackHeight - 1f, area.width, 1f),
                    GameplayEditorStyles.Grid);
            }
            EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(ruler.x - 1f, area.y, 1f, area.height), GameplayEditorStyles.Grid);
            float endX = contentX + _sequence.Duration * scale;
            if (DisplayDuration > _sequence.Duration && endX < area.xMax)
            {
                float tailX = Mathf.Max(ruler.x, endX);
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(tailX, content.y, area.xMax - tailX, content.height),
                    GameplayEditorStyles.Tail);
                if (area.xMax - tailX > 110f)
                    GUI.Label(new Rect(tailX + 8f, content.y + 4f, 110f, 18f), "表现动画预览", EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            }
            float step = scale >= 440f ? .1f : scale >= 180f ? .25f : .5f;
            int first = Mathf.Max(0, Mathf.CeilToInt(_horizontalSeconds / step));
            for (int n = first; n * step <= DisplayDuration + .0001f; n++)
            {
                float time = n * step, x = contentX + time * scale;
                if (x > area.xMax) break;
                if (x < ruler.x) continue;
                bool major = n % (step == .1f ? 5 : 2) == 0;
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(x, area.y + (major ? 12f : 22f), 1f,
                    area.height - (major ? 12f : 22f)), GameplayEditorStyles.Grid * (major ? 1.2f : .75f));
                if (major) GUI.Label(new Rect(x + 3f, area.y, 72f, 17f), _frames ?
                    Mathf.RoundToInt(time * FramesPerSecond).ToString() + "f" : time.ToString("0.##") + "s", EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            }
            if (endX >= ruler.x && endX <= area.xMax)
            {
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(endX, area.y + 1f, 2f, area.height - 1f), GameplayEditorStyles.RuleEnd);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(endX + 4f, area.y + 15f, 95f, 17f), "序列结束", EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            }
            List<GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.Entry> markers = GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.Build(
                _sequence.Markers, area, contentX, scale, PresentedTime);
            foreach (var entry in markers)
            {
                Rect box = entry.Rect;
                if (box.xMax < content.x || box.x > content.xMax) continue;
                Color accent = entry.Track == 0 ? GameplayEditorStyles.Effect :
                    entry.Track == 1 ? GameplayEditorStyles.Cue : GameplayEditorStyles.ActionNode;
                Color fill = Color.Lerp(GameplayEditorStyles.Panel, accent,
                    entry.Index == _selected ? .62f : PresentedTime(entry.Index) <= _playhead ? .48f : .25f);
                GUI.BeginGroup(content);
                Rect local = new Rect(box.x - content.x, box.y - content.y, box.width, box.height);
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(local, fill);
                if (entry.Index == _selected)
                {
                    EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(local.x, local.y, local.width, 2f), GameplayEditorStyles.Accent);
                    EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(local.x, local.yMax - 2f, local.width, 2f), GameplayEditorStyles.Accent);
                }
                GUI.Label(new Rect(local.x + 6f, local.y, local.width - 10f, local.height),
                    (_frames?Mathf.RoundToInt(PresentedTime(entry.Index)*FramesPerSecond)+"f":PresentedTime(entry.Index).ToString("0.###")+"s")+" · "+MarkerName(_sequence.Markers[entry.Index]), GameplayEditorStyles.MarkerText);
                GUI.EndGroup();
            }
            float playX = contentX + _playhead * scale;
            if (playX >= ruler.x && playX <= area.xMax)
            {
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(playX, area.y + 7f, 2f, area.height - 7f), GameplayEditorStyles.Playhead);
                GUI.Label(new Rect(playX - 5f, area.y - 4f, 18f, 18f), "▼", EditorStyles.miniBoldLabel);
            }
            HandleCanvasEvents(area, ruler, content, contentX, scale, markers, canvasControl);
        }

        private static string MarkerName(GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring marker) =>
            marker is GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring cue ?
                (string.IsNullOrEmpty(cue.CueTag.Name) ? "Cue · 未指定" : cue.CueTag.Name) :
            marker is GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring effect ?
                EffectName(effect.Effect) :
            marker is GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring step ?
                (step.Actions?.Length==1 && step.Actions[0] is GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring apply ? EffectName(apply.Effect) : $"SkillStep · {step.Actions?.Length ?? 0} Actions") : "Marker";

        private static string EffectName(GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset effect)
        {
            if(effect==null) return "Effect · 未指定";
            if(effect.Executions?.Length!=1 || effect.Executions[0]==null) return effect.name;
            using(var so=new SerializedObject(effect)) {
                var execution=so.FindProperty("Executions").GetArrayElementAtIndex(0);
                return SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillNodeDescriptors.Get(effect.Executions[0].GetType(),execution).DisplayName;
            }
        }

        private void HandleCanvasEvents(Rect area, Rect ruler, Rect content, float contentX, float scale,
            IReadOnlyList<GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.Entry> markers, int canvasControl)
        {
            Event evt = Event.current;
            if (_drag != null)
            {
                if (evt.type == EventType.MouseDrag && GUIUtility.hotControl == _dragControl)
                {
                    _drag.Update((evt.mousePosition.x - _dragGrabOffsetPixels - contentX) / scale, _snap);
                    _selectedTime=_drag.PreviewTime;SetPlayhead(_selectedTime);
                    Validate(); evt.Use(); _repaint(); return;
                }
                if (evt.type == EventType.MouseUp || evt.type == EventType.Ignore)
                {
                    _drag.End(); _drag = null; _dragging = -1;
                    if (GUIUtility.hotControl == _dragControl) GUIUtility.hotControl = 0;
                    _dragControl = 0; _dragGrabOffsetPixels = 0f; evt.Use(); _repaint(); return;
                }
            }
            if (!area.Contains(evt.mousePosition)) return;
            if (evt.type == EventType.MouseDown && evt.button == 0)
            {
                int hit=GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.HitTest(markers, evt.mousePosition, content);
                if (hit >= 0)
                {
                    SelectMarker(hit);SetPlayhead(_sequence.Markers[hit].Time);MarkerSelected?.Invoke(hit);
                    _dragging = _selected;
                    _dragGrabOffsetPixels = evt.mousePosition.x -
                        (contentX + _sequence.Markers[_selected].Time * scale);
                    _dragControl = canvasControl;
                    GUIUtility.hotControl = _dragControl;
                    _drag = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.BeginDrag(_sequence, _selected,FramesPerSecond);
                }
                else if (evt.mousePosition.y <= ruler.yMax && evt.mousePosition.x >= ruler.x)
                    _playhead = Mathf.Clamp(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Snap((evt.mousePosition.x - contentX) / scale, _snap,FramesPerSecond), 0f, DisplayDuration);
                PlayheadChanged?.Invoke(_playhead); evt.Use(); _repaint();
            }
            else if (evt.type == EventType.MouseDrag && evt.button == 0 && evt.mousePosition.x >= ruler.x)
            {
                float time = (evt.mousePosition.x - contentX) / scale;
                _playhead = Mathf.Clamp(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Snap(time, _snap,FramesPerSecond), 0f, DisplayDuration);
                PlayheadChanged?.Invoke(_playhead); evt.Use(); _repaint();
            }
        }

        public void DrawInspector(float width = 320f, float availableHeight = 0f)
        {
            GUILayoutOption[] outer = availableHeight > 0f
                ? new[] { GUILayout.Width(width), GUILayout.Height(availableHeight) }
                : new[] { GUILayout.Width(width), GUILayout.ExpandHeight(true) };
            GUILayout.BeginVertical(EditorStyles.helpBox, outer);
            GUILayout.Label("检查器 / 校验", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _inspectorScroll = availableHeight > 0f
                ? GUILayout.BeginScrollView(_inspectorScroll, GUILayout.Height(Mathf.Max(80f, availableHeight - 30f)))
                : GUILayout.BeginScrollView(_inspectorScroll, GUILayout.ExpandHeight(true));
            if (_sequence != null)
            {
                var serialized = new SerializedObject(_sequence);
                serialized.Update();
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serialized.FindProperty("definitionId"), new GUIContent("定义 ID"));
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(serialized.FindProperty("Duration"), new GUIContent("总时长（秒）"));
                if (_selected >= 0 && _selected < _sequence.Markers.Length)
                {
                    GUILayout.Space(8f);
                    _showMarker = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(_showMarker,
                        "标记 " + _selected + " · " + MarkerName(_sequence.Markers[_selected]), true);
                    if (_showMarker)
                    {
                        float currentTime=_sequence.Markers[_selected].Time;
                        float entered=EditorGUILayout.FloatField(_frames?"事件帧":"事件秒",_frames?currentTime*FramesPerSecond:currentTime);
                        float seconds=_frames?entered/FramesPerSecond:entered;
                        if(!Mathf.Approximately(seconds,currentTime)) {
                            if(seconds<0||seconds>_sequence.Duration) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("事件超出正式总时长：不会自动改时长或裁剪此输入。",MessageType.Warning);
                            else {serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.SetTime(_sequence,_selected,seconds,false,FramesPerSecond);serialized=new SerializedObject(_sequence);}
                        }
                        var marker = serialized.FindProperty("Markers").GetArrayElementAtIndex(_selected);
                        EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(marker, true);
                        if (marker.managedReferenceValue is GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring)
                            GameplaySequenceSkillStepEditor.DrawNodeMenus(marker);
                        GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                        if (GUILayout.Button("复制")) { serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties(); SelectMarker(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Duplicate(_sequence, _selected));MarkerSelected?.Invoke(_selected); serialized = new SerializedObject(_sequence); }
                        if (GUILayout.Button("删除")) { serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties(); GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Delete(_sequence, _selected); _selected = -1; serialized = new SerializedObject(_sequence); }
                        GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
                    }
                }
                if (serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties()) { GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(_sequence); EditorUtility.SetDirty(_sequence); Validate(); }
                GUILayout.Space(8f);
                _showEvents = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(_showEvents,
                    "标记列表 · " + _sequence.Markers.Length + "（重叠时在此选取）", true);
                if (_showEvents)
                    foreach (var pair in _sequence.Markers.Select((marker, index) => (marker, index))
                        .Where(pair => pair.marker != null).OrderBy(pair => pair.marker.Time).ThenBy(pair => pair.index))
                {
                    string label = (pair.marker.Time <= _playhead + .00001f ? "✓  " : "·  ") +
                        pair.marker.Time.ToString("0.000") + "s  " + MarkerName(pair.marker);
                    if (GUILayout.Toggle(_selected == pair.index, label, EditorStyles.miniButton) &&
                        _selected != pair.index)
                    { SelectMarker(pair.index);SetPlayhead(pair.marker.Time);MarkerSelected?.Invoke(pair.index); }
                }
                GUILayout.Space(8f);
                _showValidation = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(_showValidation,
                    "校验 · " + (_issues.Length == 0 ? "无错误" : _issues.Length + " 项错误"), true);
                if (_showValidation)
                    foreach (string issue in _issues) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(issue, MessageType.Error);
            }
            GUILayout.EndScrollView();
            GUILayout.EndVertical();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Editor/Timeline/GameplaySequenceTimelineValidation.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline
{
    /// <summary>Combines 12A asset validation with 12B reference-catalog membership.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySequenceTimelineValidation
    {
        public static IReadOnlyList<string> Check(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence)
        {
            var issues = new List<string>();
            if (sequence == null) return issues;
            var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();
            validation.Asset(sequence, AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(sequence));
            issues.AddRange(validation.Issues.Select(issue => issue.ToString()));
            var catalog = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(out string error);
            if (catalog == null) { issues.Add(error); return issues; }
            var attributes = new HashSet<string>(catalog.Attributes, StringComparer.Ordinal);
            var owners = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Catalogs.SelectMany(owner=>owner.Tags.Select(tag=>(tag,owner)))
                .ToLookup(entry=>entry.tag,entry=>GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.OwnerScope(entry.owner),StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach (var reference in GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(new[] { sequence }))
            {
                string scope=GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Scope(reference.Source);
                bool present = reference.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag
                    ? owners[reference.Value].Any(owner=>scope==null||GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.CanRead(scope,owner))
                    : attributes.Contains(reference.Value);
                if (GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.IsValid(reference.Kind, reference.Value) && !present)
                    issues.Add(reference.AssetPath + "." + reference.PropertyPath + ": Unregistered " +
                        reference.Kind + " " + reference.Value);
            }
            return issues;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline
{
    /// <summary>Standalone host for the same Sequence panel embedded in the Skill Workbench.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceTimelineWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel _panel;
        private string _search = string.Empty;
        private Vector2 _browserScroll;
        private string[] _assetPaths = Array.Empty<string>();
        public GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset CurrentSequence => _panel?.CurrentSequence;
        public int SelectedMarker => _panel?.SelectedMarker ?? -1;
        public float Playhead => _panel?.Playhead ?? 0f;

        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Gameplay/Skill Timeline")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            var window = GetWindow<GameplaySequenceTimelineWindow>();
            window.titleContent = new GUIContent("技能时间轴");
            window.minSize = new Vector2(1060, 540);
            window.Show();
        }

        private void OnEnable()
        {
            _panel = new GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel(Repaint);
            Undo.undoRedoPerformed += _panel.OnUndo;
            EditorApplication.projectChanged += RefreshBrowser;
            RefreshBrowser();
            if (Selection.activeObject is GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset selected) Select(selected);
        }

        private void OnDisable()
        {
            _panel?.CancelDrag();
            if (_panel != null) Undo.undoRedoPerformed -= _panel.OnUndo;
            EditorApplication.projectChanged -= RefreshBrowser;
        }

        private void OnLostFocus() => _panel?.CancelDrag();

        private void RefreshBrowser()
        {
            _assetPaths = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset", new[] { "Assets" })
                .Select(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath).OrderBy(path => path, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToArray();
            Repaint();
        }

        public void Select(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset sequence) => _panel.Select(sequence);

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal(EditorStyles.toolbar);
            var sequence = CurrentSequence;
            GUILayout.Label(sequence == null ? "选择 Sequence Asset" : sequence.name + "  ·  " + sequence.DefinitionId +
                (EditorUtility.IsDirty(sequence) ? "  *" : ""), EditorStyles.toolbarButton);
            GUILayout.FlexibleSpace();
            if (GUILayout.Button("校验", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(45))) _panel.Validate();
            if (GUILayout.Button("保存", EditorStyles.toolbarButton, GUILayout.Width(45)) && sequence != null)
            { AssetDatabase.SaveAssetIfDirty(sequence); _panel.Validate(); }
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            DrawBrowser();
            _panel.DrawTimeline(position.width - 550f);
            _panel.DrawInspector();
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }

        private void DrawBrowser()
        {
            GUILayout.BeginVertical(EditorStyles.helpBox, GUILayout.Width(230), GUILayout.ExpandHeight(true));
            GUILayout.Label("序列资源", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _search = EditorGUILayout.TextField("搜索", _search);
            _browserScroll = GUILayout.BeginScrollView(_browserScroll);
            foreach (string path in _assetPaths)
            {
                var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>(path);
                if (asset == null || (asset.name.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) < 0 &&
                    asset.DefinitionId.IndexOf(_search, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) < 0)) continue;
                bool chosen = asset == CurrentSequence;
                if (GUILayout.Toggle(chosen, asset.name, EditorStyles.toolbarButton) && !chosen) Select(asset);
            }
            GUILayout.EndScrollView();
            GUILayout.EndVertical();
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Effect/GameplayAttributeDeltaExecution.cs
````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Standard Instant/periodic scalar change to the target's BaseValue. The shared value
    /// expression is evaluated with the real application context; no mutable state lives in this execution.
    /// HP clamp/death/damage pipeline semantics are separate policies, not implied by this generic change.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAttributeDeltaExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
    {
        public GameplayAttributeId Attribute { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue Delta { get; }
        public GameplayAttributeDeltaExecution(GameplayAttributeId attribute, IGameplayFloatValue delta)
        {
            if (!attribute.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Attribute must be valid.", nameof(attribute));
            Attribute = attribute;
            Delta = delta ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(delta));
        }
        public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
        {
            if (application == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(application));
            var attribute = application.Target.Attributes.GetAttribute(Attribute);
            attribute.SetBaseValue(attribute.BaseValue + GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(Delta, application));
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Effect/GameplayEffectApplicationContext.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Effect execution 对目标的最小通用规则视图；不假定任何生命资源模型。</summary>
    public interface IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
    {
        GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
        AttributeSet Attributes { get; }
        GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>Instant 或周期 Effect 的同步行为；异常向调用方传播，已执行行为不回滚。</summary>
    public interface IGameplayEffectExecution
    {
        void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application);
    }

    /// <summary>精确 GameplayTag 键到有限 float 的不可变本次调用值快照。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySetByCallerValues
    {
        /// <summary>供无需运行值的 context-aware Effect application 共用的不可变空快照。</summary>
        public static GameplaySetByCallerValues Empty { get; } =
            new GameplaySetByCallerValues(Array.Empty<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>>());
        private readonly IReadOnlyDictionary<GameplayTag, float> _values;
        public int Count => _values.Count;

        public GameplaySetByCallerValues(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>> values)
        {
            if (values == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(values));
            var copy = new Dictionary<GameplayTag, float>();
            foreach (KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float> pair in values)
            {
                if (!pair.Key.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("SetByCaller key must be valid.", nameof(values));
                if (!float.IsFinite(pair.Value)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(values));
                if (copy.ContainsKey(pair.Key)) throw new ArgumentException("Duplicate SetByCaller key.", nameof(values));
                copy.Add(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            }
            _values = new ReadOnlyDictionary<GameplayTag, float>(copy);
        }

        public bool TryGetValue(GameplayTag key, out float value)
        {
            if (!key.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("SetByCaller key must be valid.", nameof(key));
            return _values.TryGetValue(key, out value);
        }

        public float GetRequiredValue(GameplayTag key)
        {
            if (!TryGetValue(key, out float value)) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Missing SetByCaller key: " + key);
            return value;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>引用已有 GameplayContext 身份快照，只补 execution target 与本次运行值。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectApplicationContext
    {
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget Target { get; }
        public GameplaySetByCallerValues SetByCaller { get; }
        /// <summary>真实 Instigator 的属性视图；与 EffectiveSourceId 无关。</summary>
        public AttributeSet InstigatorAttributes { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId InstigatorAttributeOwnerId { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional actual instigator capability; permits resource-backed values without duplicating balances.</summary>
        public IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget InstigatorTarget { get; }
        public int StackCount { get; }

        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext(GameplayContext context, IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget target,
            GameplaySetByCallerValues setByCaller, AttributeSet instigatorAttributes = null,
            GameplaySourceId instigatorAttributeOwnerId = default, int stackCount = 1,
            IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget instigatorTarget = null)
        {
            Context = context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            Target = target ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(target));
            SetByCaller = setByCaller ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(setByCaller));
            if (!target.TargetId.IsValid || context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId != target.TargetId)
                throw new ArgumentException("Effect execution target must match the context primary target.", nameof(target));
            if (target.Attributes == null || target.Tags == null)
                throw new ArgumentException("Effect execution target must provide attributes and tags.", nameof(target));
            if (stackCount < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(stackCount));
            if (instigatorTarget == null && context.InstigatorId == target.TargetId) instigatorTarget = target;
            if (instigatorTarget != null && instigatorAttributes == null)
            {
                instigatorAttributes = instigatorTarget.Attributes; instigatorAttributeOwnerId = instigatorTarget.TargetId;
            }
            if (instigatorAttributes == null && context.InstigatorId == target.TargetId)
            {
                instigatorAttributes = target.Attributes;
                instigatorAttributeOwnerId = target.TargetId;
            }
            if (instigatorAttributes != null && instigatorAttributeOwnerId != context.InstigatorId)
                throw new ArgumentException("Instigator attribute owner must match context InstigatorId.",
                    nameof(instigatorAttributeOwnerId));
            if (instigatorAttributes == null && instigatorAttributeOwnerId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Instigator attribute owner requires attributes.", nameof(instigatorAttributeOwnerId));
            InstigatorAttributes = instigatorAttributes;
            if (instigatorTarget != null && (instigatorTarget.TargetId != context.InstigatorId ||
                !ReferenceEquals(instigatorTarget.Attributes, instigatorAttributes)))
                throw new ArgumentException("Instigator capability must match the captured owner and attribute view.", nameof(instigatorTarget));
            InstigatorTarget = instigatorTarget;
            InstigatorAttributeOwnerId = instigatorAttributeOwnerId;
            StackCount = stackCount;
        }

        internal GameplayEffectApplicationContext WithStackCount(int count) => count == StackCount ? this :
            new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(Context, Target, SetByCaller,
                InstigatorAttributes, InstigatorAttributeOwnerId, count, InstigatorTarget);
    }

    /// <summary>Effect 申请的执行、聚合或上限处理结果。</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome
    {
        InstantExecuted,
        NewActiveEffect,
        StackIncreased,
        RefreshedAtLimit,
        RejectedAtLimit,
        RejectedByRequirements,
        OverflowExecuted
    }

    /// <summary>一次 Effect 申请的明确结果；拒绝叠层仍指向原活动 Handle。</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayEffectApplicationResult
    {
        public GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome Outcome { get; }
        public bool Succeeded { get; }
        /// <summary>Whether a handle was returned. Reentrant executions may remove it; query Container.IsActive for live state.</summary>
        public bool HasActiveHandle { get; }
        public GameplayEffectHandle ActiveHandle { get; }
        public int StackCount { get; }

        /// <summary>Only a real newly-created contribution produces a layer handle.</summary>
        public GameplayEffectLayerHandle LayerHandle { get; }

        internal GameplayEffectApplicationResult(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome outcome,
            GameplayEffectHandle handle, int stackCount, GameplayEffectLayerHandle layerHandle = default)
        {
            Outcome = outcome;
            Succeeded = outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedAtLimit &&
                outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedByRequirements;
            ActiveHandle = handle;
            HasActiveHandle = handle.IsValid;
            StackCount = stackCount;
            LayerHandle = layerHandle;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Effect 所提供的一条不可变属性修饰定义。
    /// SourceId 不属于静态定义，而由每次 Apply 创建的 Effect 实例独立持有。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition
    {
        public GameplayAttributeId AttributeId { get; }
        public GameplayModifierOperation Operation { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue MagnitudeValue { get; }
        /// <summary>仅旧常量构造器的静态 magnitude；动态值通过 MagnitudeValue 求值。</summary>
        public float Magnitude => MagnitudeValue is GameplayConstantFloatValue constant ? constant.Value :
            throw new InvalidOperationException("Dynamic modifier has no static magnitude.");

        public GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(
            GameplayAttributeId attributeId,
            GameplayModifierOperation operation,
            float magnitude)
            : this(attributeId, operation, new GameplayConstantFloatValue(magnitude))
        { }

        public GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(
            GameplayAttributeId attributeId, GameplayModifierOperation operation,
            IGameplayFloatValue magnitudeValue)
        {
            if (!attributeId.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Attribute ID must be valid.", nameof(attributeId));
            if (operation != GameplayModifierOperation.Add && operation != GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(operation));
            MagnitudeValue = magnitudeValue ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(magnitudeValue));

            AttributeId = attributeId;
            Operation = operation;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Immediate execution also runs on successful increase/refresh, never rejection or overflow.</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy { AfterFirstPeriod, ExecuteOnApplication }
    /// <summary>Shared keeps the legacy entry clock; independent expires each real contribution on the same owner timeline.</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy { SharedEntryLifetime, IndependentLayerLifetime }
    /// <summary>NaturalExpiry can only be produced by the container clock, never by a public removal request.</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectRemovalCause { NaturalExpiry, Explicit, Dispel, OngoingRequirementMismatch, OwnerCleanup, Overflow }

    /// <summary>Container-local contribution identity; validity does not imply the layer is still alive.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayEffectLayerHandle : IEquatable<GameplayEffectLayerHandle>
    {
        public GameplayEffectHandle EffectHandle { get; }
        public long LocalSequence { get; }
        public bool IsValid => EffectHandle.IsValid && LocalSequence > 0;
        internal GameplayEffectLayerHandle(GameplayEffectHandle effect, long sequence)
        { EffectHandle = effect; LocalSequence = sequence; }
        public bool Equals(GameplayEffectLayerHandle other) => EffectHandle == other.EffectHandle && LocalSequence == other.LocalSequence;
        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is GameplayEffectLayerHandle other && Equals(other);
        public override int GetHashCode() => (EffectHandle.GetHashCode() * 397) ^ LocalSequence.GetHashCode();
        public static bool operator ==(GameplayEffectLayerHandle a, GameplayEffectLayerHandle b) => a.Equals(b);
        public static bool operator !=(GameplayEffectLayerHandle a, GameplayEffectLayerHandle b) => !a.Equals(b);
    }

    /// <summary>Classification query against the effect itself, never its target's granted state tags.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectQuery
    {
        public GameplayTagQuery EffectTags { get; }
        public GameplayEffectQuery(GameplayTagQuery effectTags) => EffectTags = effectTags ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effectTags));
        internal bool Matches(GameplayEffectDefinition definition)
        {
            foreach (var required in EffectTags.All) if (!Has(definition.EffectTags, required)) return false;
            if (EffectTags.Any.Count > 0)
            {
                bool any = false;
                foreach (var tag in EffectTags.Any) if (Has(definition.EffectTags, tag)) { any = true; break; }
                if (!any) return false;
            }
            foreach (var tag in EffectTags.None) if (Has(definition.EffectTags, tag)) return false;
            return true;
        }
        private static bool Has(IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> tags, GameplayTag required)
        {
            foreach (var tag in tags) if (tag == required || tag.IsDescendantOf(required)) return true;
            return false;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Detached notification after all contributions and the entry have been removed.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectRemovalObservation
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinition Definition { get; }
        public GameplayEffectHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId SourceId { get; }
        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext ApplicationContext { get; }
        public int StackCount { get; }
        public GameplayEffectRemovalCause Cause { get; }
        internal GameplayEffectRemovalObservation(GameplayEffectDefinition definition, GameplayEffectHandle handle,
            GameplaySourceId source, GameplayEffectApplicationContext application, int count, GameplayEffectRemovalCause cause)
        { Definition = definition; Handle = handle; SourceId = source; ApplicationContext = application; StackCount = count; Cause = cause; }
    }

    /// <summary>Ordered synchronous overflow rule. Completed actions stay committed when a later action throws.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution { void Execute(GameplayEffectOverflowContext context); }
    /// <summary>Incoming application identity and explicit seams into the same lifecycle owner.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectOverflowContext
    {
        private readonly GameplayEffectContainer _container;
        public GameplayEffectHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application { get; }
        public int StackCount { get; }
        internal GameplayEffectOverflowContext(GameplayEffectContainer container, GameplayEffectHandle handle,
            GameplayEffectApplicationContext application, int count)
        { _container = container; Handle = handle; Application = application.WithStackCount(count); StackCount = count; }
        public GameplayEffectApplicationResult Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition next) => _container.Apply(next, Application);
        public bool RemoveCurrent() => _container.Remove(Handle, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Overflow);
        public bool RemoveLayer(GameplayEffectLayerHandle layer) => layer.EffectHandle == Handle &&
            _container.RemoveLayer(layer, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Overflow);
    }

    /// <summary>Detached layer identity, original application, and independent remaining lifetime (null for infinite).</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayEffectLayerSnapshot
    {
        public GameplayEffectLayerHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext ApplicationContext { get; }
        public float? Remaining { get; }
        public float AppliedDuration { get; }
        internal GameplayEffectLayerSnapshot(GameplayEffectLayerHandle handle, GameplayEffectApplicationContext application,
            float? remaining, float duration)
        { Handle = handle; ApplicationContext = application; Remaining = remaining; AppliedDuration = duration; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Ordered synchronous continuation, called only after a Duration effect naturally expires and is cleaned up.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
    {
        void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext completion);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Immutable completed-instance view. Apply preserves the original application identity and target,
    /// but creates a new instance and period phase. New entries start advancing on the next host Advance.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectCompletionContext
    {
        private readonly GameplayEffectContainer _container;
        public GameplayEffectDefinition Definition { get; }
        public GameplayEffectHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId SourceId { get; }
        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application { get; }

        internal GameplayEffectCompletionContext(GameplayEffectContainer container,
            GameplayEffectDefinition definition, GameplayEffectHandle handle, GameplaySourceId sourceId,
            GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
        {
            _container = container;
            Definition = definition;
            Handle = handle;
            SourceId = sourceId;
            Application = application;
        }

        /// <summary>Applies to the same target using the completed application's Context, Instigator and SetByCaller snapshot.</summary>
        public GameplayEffectApplicationResult Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition next) => _container.Apply(next, Application);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Single lifecycle owner for aggregate effects and exact layer contributions; time is supplied by the host.</summary>
    public sealed partial class GameplayEffectContainer
    {
        private readonly AttributeSet _target;
        private readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator _sourceIdAllocator;
        private readonly GameplayTagContainer _targetTags;
        private readonly object _handleOwner = new object();
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplayEffectHandle, Entry> _entries = new Dictionary<GameplayEffectHandle, Entry>();
        private long _lastSequence;
        internal AttributeSet TargetAttributes => _target;
        /// <summary>Synchronous post-cleanup observation. G3 remains the natural-expiry continuation authority.</summary>
        public event Action<GameplayEffectRemovalObservation> Removed;
        public GameplayEffectRemovalObservation LastRemoval { get; private set; }
        public GameplayEffectContainer(AttributeSet target, GameplaySourceIdAllocator sourceIdAllocator) : this(target, sourceIdAllocator, null) { }
        public GameplayEffectContainer(AttributeSet target, GameplaySourceIdAllocator sourceIdAllocator, GameplayTagContainer targetTags)
        { _target = target ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(target)); _sourceIdAllocator = sourceIdAllocator ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sourceIdAllocator)); _targetTags = targetTags; }

        private List<Entry> OrderedEntries()
        { var entries = new List<Entry>(_entries.Values); entries.Sort((a,b) => a.Handle.Sequence.CompareTo(b.Handle.Sequence)); return entries; }
        /// <summary>Detached ordered capture without advancing rule time.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayActiveEffectSnapshot> GetActiveEntriesSnapshot()
        {
            var result = new List<GameplayActiveEffectSnapshot>();
            foreach (var e in OrderedEntries())
            {
                var layers = new List<GameplayEffectLayerSnapshot>();
                foreach (var l in e.Layers) layers.Add(new GameplayEffectLayerSnapshot(l.Handle, l.Application,
                    e.Finite ? (float?)Math.Max(0d, (e.Independent ? l.ExpiresAt : e.ExpiresAt) - e.Elapsed) : null, l.Duration));
                result.Add(new GameplayActiveEffectSnapshot(e.Handle, e.Definition, e.SourceId, e.Application?.Context,
                    e.StackCount, e.Finite ? (float?)e.Remaining : null, e.Period > 0 ? (float?)e.PeriodRemaining : null,
                    e.Duration, e.Period, layers));
            }
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectHandle> GetMatchingEffects(GameplayEffectQuery query)
        {
            if (query == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(query));
            var result = new List<GameplayEffectHandle>();
            foreach (var e in OrderedEntries()) if (query.Matches(e.Definition)) result.Add(e.Handle);
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }
        /// <summary>Snapshots handles before callbacks; new entries created during removal are never included.</summary>
        public int RemoveMatching(GameplayEffectQuery query, GameplayEffectRemovalCause cause = GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Dispel)
        {
            ValidateRemovalRequest(cause);
            var handles = GetMatchingEffects(query); int count = 0;
            foreach (var handle in handles) if (RemoveEntry(handle, cause)) count++;

        /// <summary>Legacy entry for nonperiodic/nonstacked persistent effects with context-free values.</summary>
        public GameplayEffectHandle Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition definition)
        {
            if (definition == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if (definition.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant || definition.Period > 0 || definition.Stacking != null || definition.CompletionExecutions.Count > 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("This effect requires context-aware Apply.");
            foreach (var m in definition.Modifiers) if (m.MagnitudeValue.RequiresApplicationContext) throw new InvalidOperationException("Dynamic modifiers require context.");
            if (definition.DurationValue?.RequiresApplicationContext == true || definition.PeriodValue?.RequiresApplicationContext == true)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Dynamic timing requires context.");
            if (!MeetsRequirements(definition)) return default;
            return CreateEntry(definition, null, EvaluateTiming(definition, null)).Handle;
        }
        /// <summary>Evaluates and freezes incoming timing before mutation. Execution exceptions propagate after commit.</summary>
        public GameplayEffectApplicationResult Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition definition, GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            => ApplyPersistent(definition, application, false);
        /// <summary>Ability commit stages only reversible contributions. Initial executions remain
        /// pending until the grant's cost/state transaction has succeeded.</summary>

        private GameplayEffectApplicationResult ApplyPersistent(GameplayEffectDefinition definition, GameplayEffectApplicationContext application,bool deferInitial)
        {

                throw new ArgumentException("Execution target must belong to this container.", nameof(application));
            if (!MeetsRequirements(definition)) return new GameplayEffectApplicationResult(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedByRequirements, default, 0);
            if (definition.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)
            {
                foreach (var execution in definition.Executions) execution.Execute(application.WithStackCount(1));
                return new GameplayEffectApplicationResult(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.InstantExecuted, default, 0);
            }
            var existing = definition.Stacking == null ? null : FindStackEntry(definition, application.Context);
            application = application.WithStackCount(existing == null ? 1 : Math.Min(existing.StackCount + 1, definition.Stacking.MaxStacks));
            var timing = EvaluateTiming(definition, application);
            if (existing != null) return ReapplyStack(existing, application, timing);

            var layer = entry.Layers[0].Handle;
            entry.ActivationInitialPending=deferInitial;

        private static Timing EvaluateTiming(GameplayEffectDefinition d, GameplayEffectApplicationContext app)
        {

            float period = d.PeriodValue == null ? d.Period : GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(d.PeriodValue, app);
            if (d.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration && (!float.IsFinite(duration) || duration <= 0)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(duration));
            if (d.Period > 0 && (!float.IsFinite(period) || period <= 0)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(period));

        private Entry CreateEntry(GameplayEffectDefinition d, GameplayEffectApplicationContext app, Timing timing)

            var e = new Entry(new GameplayEffectHandle(_handleOwner, sequence), d, source, app, timing);
            try

                foreach (var tag in d.GrantedTags) _targetTags.AddTag(tag, source);
                _entries.Add(e.Handle, e);

        private Layer CreateLayer(Entry e, GameplayEffectApplicationContext app, Timing timing)

            try
            {
                foreach (var m in e.Definition.Modifiers)
                {
                    var attribute = _target.GetAttribute(m.AttributeId);
                    var handle = attribute.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(m.Operation, GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(m.MagnitudeValue, app), e.SourceId));

                }
            }
            catch { CleanupLayer(layer); throw; }

        }
        private bool MeetsRequirements(GameplayEffectDefinition d) =>

            (d.OngoingRequirements.IsEmpty || d.OngoingRequirements.Matches(RequireTags()));
        private GameplayTagContainer RequireTags() => _targetTags ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Requirements need target tags.");
        private bool MeetsOngoing(Entry e) => e.Definition.OngoingRequirements.IsEmpty || e.Definition.OngoingRequirements.Matches(RequireTags());
        private Entry FindStackEntry(GameplayEffectDefinition d, GameplayContext context)
        {
            var incoming = d.Stacking;
            foreach (var e in _entries.Values)
            {
                var active = e.Definition.Stacking;
                if (active == null || active.StackKey != incoming.StackKey) continue;
                if (active.Aggregation != incoming.Aggregation) throw new InvalidOperationException("Stack key collides with a different aggregation policy.");
                if (incoming.Aggregation == GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateBySource && e.Application.Context.EffectiveSourceId != context.EffectiveSourceId) continue;
                if (incoming.Aggregation == GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByInstigator && e.Application.Context.InstigatorId != context.InstigatorId) continue;
                if (!ReferenceEquals(e.Definition, d)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Stack key collides with a different Effect definition.");
                return e;
            }
            return null;
        }
        private GameplayEffectApplicationResult ReapplyStack(Entry e, GameplayEffectApplicationContext app, Timing timing)
        {
            var s = e.Definition.Stacking;
            if (e.StackCount >= s.MaxStacks)
            {
                if (s.Overflow == GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject) return new GameplayEffectApplicationResult(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedAtLimit, e.Handle, e.StackCount);
                if (s.Overflow == GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow)
                {
                    var context = new GameplayEffectOverflowContext(this, e.Handle, app, e.StackCount);
                    foreach (var rule in s.OverflowExecutions) rule.Execute(context);
                    bool active = _entries.ContainsKey(e.Handle);
                    return new GameplayEffectApplicationResult(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.OverflowExecuted, active ? e.Handle : default, active ? e.StackCount : 0);
                }
                CommitReapplication(e, app, timing); ExecuteInitial(e, app);

            }

        private static void CommitReapplication(Entry e, GameplayEffectApplicationContext app, Timing timing)

        private static void CleanupLayer(Layer layer)

        /// <summary>Double timeline with public float crossing; projection never feeds elapsed. Period executes before coincident layer expiry.</summary>
        public void Advance(float amount)

        private void AdvanceEntries(float amount)

                double end = e.Elapsed + amount;
                while (_entries.ContainsKey(e.Handle))
                {
                    double expiry = e.Finite ? e.NextExpiry : double.PositiveInfinity;
                    double boundary = Math.Min(e.Period > 0 ? e.NextPeriodAt : double.PositiveInfinity, expiry);
                    if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(boundary) || (float)boundary > (float)end) { e.Elapsed = end; break; }

        private void AdvanceBoundary(Entry e, double boundary)

            var due = new List<Layer>();

                    else { CleanupLayer(layer); e.Layers.Remove(layer); SelectSurvivingApplication(e); }

        public bool IsActive(GameplayEffectHandle handle) => _entries.ContainsKey(handle);
        /// <summary>Tests the exact live contribution, rather than just its shared entry. Area aura

        // Ability normal cooldown edits preserve this container's sole timeline authority.
        internal bool TrySetSimpleDurationRemaining(GameplayEffectHandle handle, float remaining)

                entry.Period != 0 || entry.Definition.Modifiers.Count != 0 || entry.Definition.CompletionExecutions.Count != 0)

        /// <summary>Ability's explicit cooldown edit reuses the original simple Definition
        /// and this container's ownership, with an already resolved positive duration.</summary>
        internal GameplayEffectHandle ApplySimpleDuration(GameplayEffectDefinition definition,GameplayEffectApplicationContext application,float duration)
        {
            if(!float.IsFinite(duration)||duration<=0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(duration));
            if(definition.DurationPolicy!=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration||definition.Period!=0||definition.PeriodValue!=null||definition.Stacking!=null||definition.Modifiers.Count!=0||definition.Executions.Count!=0||definition.CompletionExecutions.Count!=0||!definition.ApplicationRequirements.IsEmpty||!definition.OngoingRequirements.IsEmpty)
                throw new ArgumentException("Explicit cooldown duration requires a simple tag-only Effect.");
            if(application!=null&&!ReferenceEquals(application.Target.Attributes,_target))throw new ArgumentException("Cooldown application must target this container.");
            return CreateEntry(definition,application,new Timing(duration,0)).Handle;
        }
        internal bool TryGetAppliedDuration(GameplayEffectHandle handle,out float duration)
        {if(_entries.TryGetValue(handle,out var entry)){duration=entry.Duration;return true;}duration=0;return false;}
        public bool TryGetRemainingDuration(GameplayEffectHandle handle, out float remaining)
        { if (_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out var e) && e.Finite) { remaining = e.Remaining; return true; } remaining = 0; return false; }
        public bool TryGetPeriodRemaining(GameplayEffectHandle handle, out float remaining)
        { if (_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out var e) && e.Period > 0) { remaining = e.PeriodRemaining; return true; } remaining = 0; return false; }
        public bool TryGetStackCount(GameplayEffectHandle handle, out int count)
        { if (_entries.TryGetValue(handle, out var e)) { count = e.StackCount; return true; } count = 0; return false; }
        private readonly struct Timing
        { internal readonly float Duration, Period; internal Timing(float duration, float period) { Duration = duration; Period = period; } }
        private readonly struct Contribution
        { internal readonly GameplayAttribute Attribute; internal readonly GameplayModifierHandle Handle; internal Contribution(GameplayAttribute a, GameplayModifierHandle h) { Attribute = a; Handle = h; } }
        private sealed class Layer
        {
            internal readonly GameplayEffectLayerHandle Handle;
            internal readonly GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application;
            internal readonly float Duration;
            internal readonly double ExpiresAt;
            internal readonly List<Contribution> Contributions = new List<Contribution>();
            internal Layer(GameplayEffectLayerHandle h, GameplayEffectApplicationContext a, float duration, double expiresAt)
            { Handle = h; Application = a; Duration = duration; ExpiresAt = expiresAt; }
        }
        private sealed class Entry
        {
            internal readonly GameplayEffectHandle Handle;
            internal readonly GameplayEffectDefinition Definition;
            internal readonly GameplaySourceId SourceId;
            internal readonly List<Layer> Layers = new List<Layer>();
            internal GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application;
            internal double Elapsed, ExpiresAt, NextPeriodAt;
            internal float Duration, Period;
            internal long LastLayerSequence;
            internal bool ActivationInitialPending;
            internal bool Finite => Definition.DurationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;
            internal bool Independent => Definition.Stacking?.Lifetime == GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.IndependentLayerLifetime;
            internal int StackCount => Layers.Count;
            internal double NextExpiry { get { if (!Independent) return ExpiresAt; double next = double.PositiveInfinity; foreach (var l in Layers) next = Math.Min(next, l.ExpiresAt); return next; } }
            internal float Remaining { get { double last = ExpiresAt; if (Independent) { last = 0; foreach (var l in Layers) last = Math.Max(last, l.ExpiresAt); } return (float)Math.Max(0d, last - Elapsed); } }
            internal float PeriodRemaining => (float)Math.Max(0d, NextPeriodAt - Elapsed);
            internal Entry(GameplayEffectHandle h, GameplayEffectDefinition d, GameplaySourceId s, GameplayEffectApplicationContext a, Timing t)
            { Handle = h; Definition = d; SourceId = s; Application = a; Duration = t.Duration; Period = t.Period; ExpiresAt = t.Duration; NextPeriodAt = t.Period; }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    public sealed partial class GameplayEffectContainer
    {
        private bool _groupAdvancing;
        private bool _singleAdvancing;
        private int _activationAttempts;
        internal void BeginActivationAttempt()=>_activationAttempts++;
        internal void EndActivationAttempt()=>_activationAttempts--;
        /// <summary>Advances a host's distinct Effect containers once on the same supplied step.
        /// Existing entries meet at chronological boundaries before callbacks, so cross-target
        /// layers/refreshes use their actual birth boundary. New entries start next step, matching
        /// single-container snapshot semantics. The supplied order breaks simultaneous ties.
        /// Containers still own all handles, elapsed values and cleanup; no second clock is stored.</summary>
        public static void AdvanceTogether(IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectContainer> containers, float amount)
        {
            if (containers == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(containers));
            if (!float.IsFinite(amount) || amount < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(amount));
            var unique = new HashSet<GameplayEffectContainer>();
            var owners = new List<GameplayEffectContainer>();
            var entries = new List<GroupEntry>();
            foreach (var container in containers)
            {
                if (container == null || !unique.Add(container)) throw new ArgumentException("Supply distinct, non-null Effect containers.", nameof(containers));
                if (container._groupAdvancing || container._singleAdvancing || container._activationAttempts>0) throw new InvalidOperationException("Grouped Effect Advance cannot be nested or run during activation commit.");
                owners.Add(container);
                foreach (var entry in container.OrderedEntries()) entries.Add(new GroupEntry(container, entry, amount));
            }
            foreach (var container in owners) container._groupAdvancing = true;
            try
            {
                double offset = 0;
                while (true)
                {
                    GroupEntry selected = null; double nextOffset = double.PositiveInfinity, boundary = 0;
                    bool removedMismatch = false;
                    foreach (var item in entries)
                    {
                        if (!item.Active) continue;
                        if (!item.Owner.MeetsOngoing(item.Value))
                        { item.Owner.RemoveEntry(item.Value.Handle, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OngoingRequirementMismatch); removedMismatch = true; break; }
                        double next = Math.Min(item.Value.Period > 0 ? item.Value.NextPeriodAt : double.PositiveInfinity,
                            item.Value.Finite ? item.Value.NextExpiry : double.PositiveInfinity);
                        if (double.IsPositiveInfinity(next) || (float)next > (float)item.End) continue;
                        double candidate = Math.Min(amount, Math.Max(offset, next - item.Start));
                        if (candidate < nextOffset) { selected = item; nextOffset = candidate; boundary = next; }
                    }
                    if (removedMismatch) continue; // Removal observers may change another entry's schedule.
                    if (selected == null) { Align(entries, amount); break; }
                    offset = nextOffset; Align(entries, offset);
                    if (!selected.Active) continue;
                    if (!selected.Owner.MeetsOngoing(selected.Value))
                    { selected.Owner.RemoveEntry(selected.Value.Handle, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OngoingRequirementMismatch); continue; }
                    selected.Owner.AdvanceBoundary(selected.Value, boundary);
                }
            }
            finally { foreach (var container in owners) container._groupAdvancing = false; }
        }
        private static void Align(List<GroupEntry> entries, double offset)
        { foreach (var entry in entries) if (entry.Active) entry.Value.Elapsed = Math.Min(entry.Start + offset, entry.End); }
        private sealed class GroupEntry
        {
            internal readonly GameplayEffectContainer Owner;
            internal readonly Entry Value;
            internal readonly double Start, End;
            internal bool Active => Owner._entries.ContainsKey(Value.Handle);
            internal GroupEntry(GameplayEffectContainer owner, Entry value, float amount)
            { Owner = owner; Value = value; Start = value.Elapsed; End = Start + amount; }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 不可变的 Effect 静态定义，不保存目标、Handle 或剩余时间。
    /// Duration 的单位由推进容器的宿主时钟决定；Infinite/Instant 将 Duration 规范为 0。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectDefinition
    {
        public GameplayEffectDurationPolicy DurationPolicy { get; }
        public float Duration { get; }
        /// <summary>0 表示非周期；正数表示两次 execution 之间的宿主规则时间。</summary>
        public float Period { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional per-application values, frozen before any persistent state is committed.</summary>
        public IGameplayFloatValue DurationValue { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue PeriodValue { get; }
        public GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy PeriodicStart { get; }
        /// <summary>What this effect is; never contributed to the target tag container.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> EffectTags { get; }
        /// <summary>null 表示每次 Apply 独立成一个实例；否则按显式 StackKey 聚合。</summary>
        public GameplayEffectStackingDefinition Stacking { get; }
        /// <summary>每次 Apply 前检查目标标签；拒绝时不分配来源或修改现有 stack。</summary>
        public GameplayTagQuery ApplicationRequirements { get; }
        /// <summary>持续 Effect 每次规则推进前检查；失配时移除整个活动 Entry。</summary>
        public GameplayTagQuery OngoingRequirements { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition> Modifiers { get; }
        /// <summary>按定义顺序执行的行为；Instant 执行一次，周期 Effect 每到 Period 执行一次。</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplayEffectExecution> Executions { get; }
        /// <summary>Authored order, executed once after natural Duration expiry cleanup; interruptions never run these.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution> CompletionExecutions { get; }

        /// <summary>
        /// 此定义在应用期间提供的 exact 标签。集合只读，来源由每个 Effect 实例独立分配。
        /// </summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> GrantedTags { get; }

        public GameplayEffectDefinition(
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy durationPolicy,
            float duration,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition> modifiers)
            : this(durationPolicy, duration, modifiers, new GameplayTag[0])
        {
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 创建同时提供属性修饰与标签贡献的不可变定义。两组输入都会被防御性复制；
        /// 标签来源不保存在 Definition 中，而由每次 Apply 的 Effect 实例分配。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayEffectDefinition(
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy durationPolicy,
            float duration,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition> modifiers,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> grantedTags)
            : this(durationPolicy, duration, modifiers, grantedTags, Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>())
        {
        }

        public GameplayEffectDefinition(
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy durationPolicy,
            float duration,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition> modifiers,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> grantedTags,
            IEnumerable<IGameplayEffectExecution> executions)
            : this(durationPolicy, duration, 0f, modifiers, grantedTags, executions)
        {
        }

        /// <summary>带周期的不可变定义；旧构造器的 Period 默认为 0。</summary>
        public GameplayEffectDefinition(
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy durationPolicy,
            float duration,
            float period,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition> modifiers,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> grantedTags,
            IEnumerable<IGameplayEffectExecution> executions)
            : this(durationPolicy, duration, period, modifiers, grantedTags, executions, null)
        {
        }

        /// <summary>带可选聚合堆叠策略的不可变定义。</summary>
        public GameplayEffectDefinition(
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy durationPolicy,
            float duration,
            float period,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition> modifiers,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> grantedTags,
            IEnumerable<IGameplayEffectExecution> executions,
            GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stacking,
            GameplayTagQuery applicationRequirements = null,
            GameplayTagQuery ongoingRequirements = null,
            IEnumerable<IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution> completionExecutions = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> effectTags = null,
            GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy periodicStart = GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.AfterFirstPeriod,
            IGameplayFloatValue durationValue = null, IGameplayFloatValue periodValue = null)
        {
            if (durationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration &&
                durationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite &&
                durationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(durationPolicy));
            if (durationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration &&
                (float.IsNaN(duration) || float.IsInfinity(duration) || duration <= 0f))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(duration), "Duration must be finite and greater than zero.");
            if (!float.IsFinite(period) || period < 0f)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(period), "Period must be finite and nonnegative.");
            if (modifiers == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(modifiers));
            if (grantedTags == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(grantedTags));
            if (executions == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(executions));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy), periodicStart))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(periodicStart));
            if (durationValue != null && durationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                throw new ArgumentException("DurationValue requires Duration policy.");
            if ((periodValue != null || periodicStart != GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.AfterFirstPeriod) &&
                (durationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant || period <= 0f))
                throw new ArgumentException("Dynamic period and immediate start require a periodic persistent effect.");
            if (stacking?.Lifetime == GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.IndependentLayerLifetime &&
                durationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                throw new ArgumentException("Independent layer lifetime requires Duration policy.");
            var classification = new List<GameplayTag>(effectTags ?? Array.Empty<GameplayTag>());
            foreach (var tag in classification) if (!tag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Invalid EffectTag.");

            var modifierCopy = new List<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>();
            foreach (GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition modifier in modifiers)
            {
                if (modifier == null)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Modifiers must not contain null elements.", nameof(modifiers));
                modifierCopy.Add(modifier);
            }

            var tagCopy = new List<GameplayTag>();
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in grantedTags)
            {
                if (!tag.IsValid)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Granted tags must be valid.", nameof(grantedTags));
                tagCopy.Add(tag);
            }
            var executionCopy = new List<IGameplayEffectExecution>(executions);
            var completionCopy = new List<IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution>(completionExecutions ??
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution>());
            if (completionCopy.Contains(null))
                throw new ArgumentException("Completion executions must not contain null.", nameof(completionExecutions));
            if (completionCopy.Count > 0 && durationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration)
                throw new ArgumentException("Only Duration effects can have natural completion executions.", nameof(completionExecutions));
            if (executionCopy.Contains(null))
                throw new ArgumentException("Executions must not contain null.", nameof(executions));
            if (durationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)
            {
                if (ongoingRequirements != null && !ongoingRequirements.IsEmpty)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Instant effects cannot have ongoing requirements.", nameof(ongoingRequirements));
                if (period != 0f || stacking != null || modifierCopy.Count != 0 || tagCopy.Count != 0 || executionCopy.Count == 0)
                    throw new ArgumentException("Instant effects require executions and reject persistent modifiers or tags.");
            }
            else if ((period == 0f && executionCopy.Count != 0) ||
                     (period > 0f && executionCopy.Count == 0))
                throw new ArgumentException("Persistent effects require executions exactly when Period is positive.", nameof(executions));

            DurationPolicy = durationPolicy;
            Duration = durationPolicy == GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration ? duration : 0f;
            Period = period;
            DurationValue = durationValue;
            PeriodValue = periodValue;
            PeriodicStart = periodicStart;
            EffectTags = classification.AsReadOnly();
            Stacking = stacking;
            ApplicationRequirements = applicationRequirements ?? GameplayTagQuery.Empty;
            OngoingRequirements = ongoingRequirements ?? GameplayTagQuery.Empty;
            Modifiers = new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(modifierCopy);
            GrantedTags = new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayTag>(tagCopy);
            Executions = new ReadOnlyCollection<IGameplayEffectExecution>(executionCopy);
            CompletionExecutions = new ReadOnlyCollection<IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution>(completionCopy);
        }
    }
}
````
