````csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 一次 Effect Apply 的容器内身份，只能用于产生它的 GameplayEffectContainer，default 无效。
    /// Handle 用于调用方精确寻址 Effect；它不是清理 Attribute Modifier 所用的 SourceId。
    /// IsValid 只表示 Handle 曾被分配，不表示对应 Effect 当前仍处于活动状态。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayEffectHandle : IEquatable<GameplayEffectHandle>
    {
        private readonly object _owner;
        private readonly long _sequence;

        public bool IsValid => _owner != null && _sequence != 0;
        internal long Sequence => _sequence;
        /// <summary>Container-local sequence for read-only diagnostics; not a global identity.</summary>
        public long LocalSequence => _sequence;

        internal GameplayEffectHandle(object owner, long sequence)
        {
            _owner = owner;
            _sequence = sequence;
        }

        public bool Equals(GameplayEffectHandle other) =>
            ReferenceEquals(_owner, other._owner) && _sequence == other._sequence;

        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is GameplayEffectHandle other && Equals(other);

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                return ((_owner == null ? 0 : RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(_owner)) * 397) ^ _sequence.GetHashCode();
            }
        }

        public static bool operator ==(GameplayEffectHandle left, GameplayEffectHandle right) => left.Equals(right);
        public static bool operator !=(GameplayEffectHandle left, GameplayEffectHandle right) => !left.Equals(right);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>同目标内按 StackKey 或再按有效来源聚合。</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectStackAggregation
    {
        AggregateByTarget,
        AggregateBySource,
        /// <summary>Groups contributions by the originating actor across independent casts.</summary>
        AggregateByInstigator
    }

    /// <summary>成功重施加时是否重置共享 Duration。</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy
    {
        RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
        NeverRefresh
    }

    /// <summary>成功重施加时是否重置下一次周期执行计时。</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy
    {
        ResetOnSuccessfulApplication,
        NeverReset
    }

    /// <summary>达到层数上限时拒绝申请，或接受并刷新原实例。</summary>
    public enum GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy
    {
        Reject,
        RefreshExistingAtLimit,
        ExecuteOverflow
    }

    /// <summary>持续 Effect 的不可变聚合身份、层数上限及成功重施加策略。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectStackingDefinition
    {
        public GameplayTag StackKey { get; }
        public GameplayEffectStackAggregation Aggregation { get; }
        public int MaxStacks { get; }
        public GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy DurationRefresh { get; }
        public GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy PeriodReset { get; }
        public GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy Overflow { get; }
        public GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy Lifetime { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution> OverflowExecutions { get; }

        public GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(GameplayTag stackKey,
            GameplayEffectStackAggregation aggregation, int maxStacks,
            GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy durationRefresh,
            GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy periodReset,
            GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy overflow,
            GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy lifetime = GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.SharedEntryLifetime,
            IEnumerable<IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution> overflowExecutions = null)
        {
            if (!stackKey.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Stack key must be valid.", nameof(stackKey));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayEffectStackAggregation), aggregation))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(aggregation));
            if (maxStacks < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxStacks));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy), durationRefresh))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(durationRefresh));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy), periodReset))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(periodReset));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy), overflow))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(overflow));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy), lifetime)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(lifetime));
            if (lifetime == GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.IndependentLayerLifetime &&
                durationRefresh != GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh)
                throw new ArgumentException("Independent layers cannot refresh a shared duration.");
            var rules = new List<IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution>(overflowExecutions ?? Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution>());
            if (rules.Contains(null) || (overflow == GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow) != (rules.Count > 0))
                throw new ArgumentException("ExecuteOverflow requires rules; other policies reject them.");

            StackKey = stackKey;
            Aggregation = aggregation;
            MaxStacks = maxStacks;
            DurationRefresh = durationRefresh;
            PeriodReset = periodReset;
            Overflow = overflow;
            Lifetime = lifetime;
            OverflowExecutions = rules.AsReadOnly();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 一次同步 Gameplay Event 的不可变规则数据。
    /// InstigatorId 与 TargetId 可为 default，表示事件没有对应的 Gameplay 来源；Magnitude 可为任意有限值。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayEventData
    {
        public GameplayTag EventTag { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId InstigatorId { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
        public float Magnitude { get; }
        /// <summary>Optional immutable child/hit envelope. Legacy events leave this null.</summary>
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public bool HasContext => Context != null;

        /// <summary>Preserves the full source, target geometry and scalar snapshot with consistent event IDs.</summary>
        public GameplayEventData(GameplayTag eventTag, GameplayContext context, float magnitude)
            : this(eventTag, (context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context))).InstigatorId,
                context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, magnitude)
        { Context = context; }


        /// <summary>
        /// 创建事件数据。eventTag 必须有效，magnitude 必须为有限值；来源身份允许为 default。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayEventData(
            GameplayTag eventTag,
            GameplaySourceId instigatorId,
            GameplaySourceId targetId,
            float magnitude)
        {
            if (!eventTag.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Event tag must be valid.", nameof(eventTag));
            if (float.IsNaN(magnitude) || float.IsInfinity(magnitude))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(magnitude), "Event magnitude must be finite.");

            Context = null;
            EventTag = eventTag;
            InstigatorId = instigatorId;
            TargetId = targetId;
            Magnitude = magnitude;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 同步分发规则层 Gameplay Event 的实例容器。
    /// 精确标签或订阅标签的后代会匹配；回调按注册顺序执行，异常直接传播并停止本次后续分发。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEventDispatcher
    {
        private readonly object _handleOwner = new object();
        private readonly List<Subscription> _subscriptions = new List<Subscription>();
        private readonly GameplayEventHistoryEntry[] _history;
        private int _historyStart;
        private int _historyCount;
        private long _publishSequence;
        private long _lastSequence;

        /// <summary>History is disabled by default; a positive capacity retains only the newest events.</summary>
        public GameplayEventDispatcher(int historyCapacity = 0)
        {
            if (historyCapacity < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(historyCapacity));
            _history = new GameplayEventHistoryEntry[historyCapacity];
        }

        /// <summary>Returns an oldest-to-newest detached history copy.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayEventHistoryEntry> GetHistorySnapshot()
        {
            var result = new List<GameplayEventHistoryEntry>(_historyCount);
            for (int i = 0; i < _historyCount; i++)
                result.Add(_history[(_historyStart + i) % _history.Length]);
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 订阅 eventTag 及其后代事件。标签必须有效，callback 不能为 null。
        /// 每次调用都创建独立订阅，并返回只能由本 Dispatcher 取消的 Handle。
        /// </summary>
        public GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle Subscribe(
            GameplayTag eventTag,
            Action<GameplayEventData> callback)
        {
            if (!eventTag.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Event tag must be valid.", nameof(eventTag));
            if (callback == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(callback));

            long sequence = checked(_lastSequence + 1);
            var handle = new GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle(_handleOwner, sequence);
            _subscriptions.Add(new Subscription(handle, eventTag, callback));
            _lastSequence = sequence;
            return handle;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 取消本 Dispatcher 的一项订阅。default、其他 Dispatcher 的 Handle 或已取消订阅返回 false。
        /// 已被当前 Publish 快照捕获的回调仍会在该次发布中执行。
        /// </summary>
        public bool Unsubscribe(GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle handle)
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _subscriptions.Count; i++)
            {
                if (_subscriptions[i].Handle != handle)
                    continue;

                _subscriptions.RemoveAt(i);
                return true;
            }

            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 按注册顺序同步发布事件。先快照全部匹配回调，因此分发期间的订阅变更只影响后续 Publish。
        /// default 或其他无效数据会在任何回调执行前被拒绝；回调异常原样传播并停止后续回调。
        /// </summary>
        public void Publish(GameplayEventData data)
        {
            Validate(data);

            long sequence = checked(++_publishSequence);
            if (_history.Length > 0)
            {
                int index = (_historyStart + _historyCount) % _history.Length;
                _history[index] = new GameplayEventHistoryEntry(sequence, data);
                if (_historyCount < _history.Length) _historyCount++;
                else _historyStart = (_historyStart + 1) % _history.Length;
            }

            var callbacks = new List<Action<GameplayEventData>>();
            foreach (Subscription subscription in _subscriptions)
            {
                if (data.EventTag == subscription.EventTag ||
                    data.EventTag.IsDescendantOf(subscription.EventTag))
                    callbacks.Add(subscription.Callback);
            }

            foreach (Action<GameplayEventData> callback in callbacks)
                callback(data);
        }

        private static void Validate(GameplayEventData data)
        {
            if (!data.EventTag.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Event data must contain a valid event tag.", nameof(data));
            if (float.IsNaN(data.Magnitude) || float.IsInfinity(data.Magnitude))
                throw new ArgumentException("Event data magnitude must be finite.", nameof(data));
        }

        private sealed class Subscription
        {
            internal readonly GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle Handle;
            internal readonly GameplayTag EventTag;
            internal readonly Action<GameplayEventData> Callback;

            internal Subscription(
                GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle handle,
                GameplayTag eventTag,
                Action<GameplayEventData> callback)
            {
                Handle = handle;
                EventTag = eventTag;
                Callback = callback;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 某个 GameplayEventDispatcher 内一次订阅的身份，只能用于产生它的 Dispatcher，default 无效。
    /// IsValid 只表示 Handle 曾被分配，不表示对应订阅当前仍存在；它不是 GameplaySourceId。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle : IEquatable<GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle>
    {
        private readonly object _owner;
        private readonly long _sequence;

        public bool IsValid => _owner != null && _sequence != 0;

        internal GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle(object owner, long sequence)
        {
            _owner = owner;
            _sequence = sequence;
        }

        public bool Equals(GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle other) =>
            ReferenceEquals(_owner, other._owner) && _sequence == other._sequence;

        public override bool Equals(object obj) =>
            obj is GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle other && Equals(other);

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            unchecked
            {
                return ((_owner == null ? 0 : RuntimeHelpers.GetHashCode(_owner)) * 397) ^
                       _sequence.GetHashCode();
            }
        }

        public static bool operator ==(
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle left,
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle right) => left.Equals(right);

        public static bool operator !=(
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle left,
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle right) => !left.Equals(right);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions
{
    /// <summary>Existing container operations; Begin/Commit separate preparation from irreversible activation.</summary>
    public enum GameplayAbilityCommandKind { Activate, Begin, Commit, Cancel, End }
    /// <summary>Controller request snapshot, not an activation decision, queue, retry or cooldown authority.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayAbilityCommand
    {
        public GameplayAbilityCommandKind Kind { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityCommand(GameplayAbilityCommandKind kind, GameplayAbilityHandle handle, GameplayContext context = null)
        {
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayAbilityCommandKind), kind)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kind));
            Kind = kind; Handle = handle; Context = context;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Synchronous forwarding only. The container rechecks all rules; Commit uses its stored preparing context.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAbilityCommandExecutor
    {
        public static bool Execute(GameplayAbilityContainer container, GameplayAbilityCommand command)
        {
            if (container == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(container));
            switch (command.Kind)
            {
                case GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Activate: return container.TryActivate(command.Handle, command.Context);
                case GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Begin: return container.TryBeginActivation(command.Handle, command.Context);
                case GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Commit: return container.TryCommitActivation(command.Handle);
                case GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Cancel: return container.Cancel(command.Handle);
                case GameplayAbilityCommandKind.End: return container.End(command.Handle);
                default: throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(command));
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions
{
    /// <summary>Shared child callback plumbing. Owns no motion, timer or Ability polling; can be owned by TryOwnLifetime.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayChildRuleBinding : IDisposable
    {
        public GameplayContext BaseContext { get; }
        private readonly IGameplaySkillHost _host;
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }
        public GameplayChildRuleBinding(GameplayContext original, GameplaySourceId childSource, IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (original == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(original));
            if (!childSource.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Child source must be valid.", nameof(childSource));
            _host = host ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            BaseContext = original.WithSource(childSource);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Overlays hit-local scalars on the original immutable Values; unspecified keys are retained and matching keys overwritten.
        /// Null/empty overrides retain the original snapshot. Overrides are applied in enumeration order through WithValue
        /// (valid tags and finite values required); BaseContext never changes. Target is captured per callback.
        /// </summary>
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution Signal(GameplayTag eventTag, GameplayTargetData target,
            GameplayContinuationDefinition continuation, IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>> valueOverrides = null, float magnitude = 0)
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, BaseContext);
            if (continuation == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(continuation));
            var merged = BaseContext.Values;
            if (valueOverrides != null)
                foreach (var pair in valueOverrides) merged = merged.WithValue(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            var context = BaseContext.WithTarget(target).WithValues(merged);
            var trigger = new GameplayEventData(eventTag, context, magnitude);
            return continuation.Execute(context, trigger, _host, () => !IsDisposed);
        }
        public void Dispose() { IsDisposed = true; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions

    /// <summary>Source-relative or explicit-direction movement; physical trajectory and collision belong to the driver.</summary>
    public enum GameplayDisplacementMode { PushFromSource, PullToSource, Directional }
    /// <summary>Movement request: distance and speed are the only rate model. Game driver resolves source/target positions at Start.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayDisplacementRequest
    {
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId EffectiveSourceId => Context.EffectiveSourceId;
        public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
        public GameplayDisplacementMode Mode { get; }
        public GameplayDirection? Direction { get; }
        public float Distance { get; }
        public float Speed { get; }
        public GameplayDisplacementRequest(GameplayContext context, GameplaySourceId targetId, GameplayDisplacementMode mode,
            float distance, float speed, GameplayDirection? direction = null)
        {
            Context = context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (!targetId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Target must be valid.", nameof(targetId));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayDisplacementMode), mode)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(mode));
            if (!float.IsFinite(distance) || distance <= 0 || !float.IsFinite(speed) || speed <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(distance));
            if (mode == GameplayDisplacementMode.Directional ? !direction.HasValue || !direction.Value.IsValid : direction.HasValue)
                throw new ArgumentException("Only Directional requires an explicit initialized direction.", nameof(direction));
            TargetId = targetId; Mode = mode; Distance = distance; Speed = speed; Direction = direction;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Game-owned physical simulation. Returned lifetime supports cancellation; no Effect/Ability/Sequence clock is advanced here.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayDisplacementDriver
    {
        IDisposable Start(GameplayDisplacementRequest request);
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Extensions/Runtime/GameplayEffectLease.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions
{
    /// <summary>Exclusive cleanup of a captured contribution; does not scan definitions/tags or advance the container.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectLease : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly GameplayEffectContainer _container;
        public GameplayEffectHandle Handle { get; }
        public GameplayEffectLayerHandle Layer { get; }
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>Current exact contribution liveness; a surviving shared entry does not keep an expired layer alive.</summary>
        public bool IsActive => !IsDisposed && (Layer.IsValid ? _container.IsLayerActive(Layer) : _container.IsActive(Handle));
        private GameplayEffectLease(GameplayEffectContainer container, GameplayEffectHandle handle, GameplayEffectLayerHandle layer)
        { _container = container; Handle = handle; Layer = layer; }
        /// <summary>
        /// Captures only NewActiveEffect/StackIncreased results from this container. Prefers the first/new exact layer.
        /// Refresh, overflow, rejection and instant results confer no cleanup ownership. A removed entry returns false;
        /// a layer removed reentrantly while its shared entry survives can be captured, but cleanup is a harmless no-op.
        /// The caller must assign each contribution to only one owner and not also register whole-entry Ability ownership.
        /// </summary>
        public static bool TryCapture(GameplayEffectContainer container, GameplayEffectApplicationResult application, out GameplayEffectLease lease)
        {
            if (container == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(container));
            lease = null;
            if ((application.Outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.NewActiveEffect && application.Outcome != GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.StackIncreased) ||
                !container.IsActive(application.ActiveHandle)) return false;
            if (application.Outcome == GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.StackIncreased && !application.LayerHandle.IsValid) return false;
            lease = new GameplayEffectLease(container, application.ActiveHandle, application.LayerHandle);
            return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Explicit whole-entry lease for an exclusively owned handle (e.g. legacy unstacked Apply). Never use on a shared stack entry.</summary>
        public static GameplayEffectLease OwnEntry(GameplayEffectContainer container, GameplayEffectHandle handle)
        {
            if (container == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(container));
            if (!handle.IsValid || !container.IsActive(handle)) throw new ArgumentException("Handle must be active in this container.", nameof(handle));
            return new GameplayEffectLease(container, handle, default);
        }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return;
            IsDisposed = true; // Mark first: removal observers may reenter cleanup.
            if (Layer.IsValid) _container.RemoveLayer(Layer, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OwnerCleanup);
            else _container.Remove(Handle, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OwnerCleanup);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>One lease per target for one source. World membership remains with the game; Clear is reusable.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectLeaseSet
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplaySourceId, GameplayEffectLease> _leases = new Dictionary<GameplaySourceId, GameplayEffectLease>();
        public int Count => _leases.Count;
        public bool Contains(GameplaySourceId target) => _leases.ContainsKey(target);
        public void AddOrReplace(GameplaySourceId target, GameplayEffectLease lease)
        {
            if (!target.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Target must be valid.", nameof(target));
            if (lease == null || lease.IsDisposed) throw new ArgumentException("Lease must be live.", nameof(lease));
            _leases.TryGetValue(target, out var old);
            if (ReferenceEquals(old, lease)) return;
            _leases[target] = lease;
            old?.Dispose();
        }
        public bool Remove(GameplaySourceId target)
        {
            if (!_leases.TryGetValue(target, out var lease)) return false;
            _leases.Remove(target);
            lease.Dispose();
            return true;
        }
        public void Clear()
        {
            var owned = new List<GameplayEffectLease>(_leases.Values);
            _leases.Clear();
            List<Exception> errors = null;
            foreach (var lease in owned)
                try { lease.Dispose(); } catch (Exception ex) { (errors ?? (errors = new List<Exception>())).Add(ex); }
            if (errors != null) throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions
{
    /// <summary>World-neutral geometry; Line means a forward length with a full perpendicular width.</summary>
    public enum GameplaySpatialShape { Circle, Sector, Line }
    /// <summary>Finite, normalized world-space direction. Default is invalid; adapters choose their coordinate convention.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayDirection
    {
        public float X { get; }
        public float Y { get; }
        public float Z { get; }
        public bool IsValid => X != 0 || Y != 0 || Z != 0;
        public GameplayDirection(float x, float y, float z = 0)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(x) || !float.IsFinite(y) || !float.IsFinite(z)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(x));
            double length = Math.Sqrt((double)x*x + (double)y*y + (double)z*z);
            if (length == 0) throw new ArgumentException("Direction must be non-zero.");
            X = (float)(x/length); Y = (float)(y/length); Z = (float)(z/length);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Immutable geometry and context snapshot. Resolver owns current-world filtering and deterministic ordering.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySpatialQuery
    {
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public GameplayPoint Origin { get; }
        public GameplayDirection Direction { get; }
        public GameplaySpatialShape Shape { get; }
        public float Radius { get; }
        public float Angle { get; }
        public float Length { get; }
        public float Width { get; }
        public int MaxTargets { get; }
        public GameplaySpatialQuery(GameplayContext context, GameplayPoint origin, GameplayDirection direction,
            GameplaySpatialShape shape, int maxTargets, float radius = 0, float angle = 0, float length = 0, float width = 0)
        {
            Context = context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (!direction.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Direction must be initialized.", nameof(direction));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySpatialShape), shape)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(shape));
            if (maxTargets <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxTargets));
            foreach (float value in new[] { radius, angle, length, width })
                if (!float.IsFinite(value) || value < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(radius));
            if (shape == GameplaySpatialShape.Line ? length <= 0 || width <= 0 || radius != 0 || angle != 0 :
                radius <= 0 || length != 0 || width != 0 || (shape == GameplaySpatialShape.Circle ? angle != 0 : angle <= 0 || angle > 360))
                throw new ArgumentException("Provide exactly the dimensions of the selected shape.");
            Origin = origin; Direction = direction; Shape = shape; MaxTargets = maxTargets;
            Radius = radius; Angle = angle; Length = length; Width = width;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Returns unique valid IDs in deterministic order, at most MaxTargets. No Unity types cross this boundary.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySpatialQueryResolver
    {
        GameplayTargetData Resolve(GameplaySpatialQuery query);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity;
using Live2D.Cubism.Core;
using Live2D.Cubism.Framework;
using Live2D.Cubism.Framework.Pose;
using Live2D.Cubism.Rendering;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Live2D
{
    /// <summary>Actual Cubism motion clip sampling and native model update, driven by the existing
    /// presentation delta. Automatic procedural/motion writers are paused only while this lease owns the model.
    /// This deterministic clip backend does not reproduce Cubism's motion fade controller.</summary>
    [System.Serializable, UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayLive2DAnimationData:GameplayAnimationData
    {
        public GameObject ModelPrefab;
        public AnimationClip Motion;
        public override string BackendName=>"Live2D Cubism";
        public override string ClipLabel=>Motion?Motion.name:"待选择 Motion";
        public override string CapabilityNote=>"Cubism AnimationClip 采样：Preview 与 Runtime 同源，支持速度、循环、优先级与结束恢复。当前不支持 Cubism MotionFade、多层混合或权重变体；同一模型的冲突通道会明确拒绝。";
        public override void ConfigurePreviewCamera(Camera camera)
        {
            // Installed Cubism URP explicitly filters out CameraType.Preview. Use its actual Game
            // render path on this isolated temporary camera instead of rendering picking meshes.
            camera.cameraType=CameraType.Game;
        }
        public override UnityEngine.Object SubjectResource=>ModelPrefab;
        public override GameObject CreatePreviewSubject()
        {if(ModelPrefab==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Cubism prefab is required.");return Instantiate(ModelPrefab);}
        protected override GameplayAnimationDefinition CreateDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            var clip=Motion;var loop=Loop;var restore=RestorePrevious;
            if(clip==null||clip.length<=0)throw new InvalidOperationException("A nonempty Cubism motion is required.");
            return new GameplayAnimationDefinition(Channel,Priority,Speed.Build(),(subject,cast)=>
            {
                var model=subject.GetComponentInChildren<CubismModel>(true);
                if(model==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Subject has no real Cubism model.");
                return new Player(model,clip,loop,restore);
            },writes:subject=>new[]{new GameplayAnimationWriteTarget(subject.GetComponentInChildren<CubismModel>(true),"CubismModel",-1)});
        }
        protected override void ValidateAnimation(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)
        {
            if(ModelPrefab==null||ModelPrefab.GetComponentInChildren<CubismModel>(true)==null)validation.Error(path+".ModelPrefab","Real Cubism model prefab is required.");
            if(Motion==null||Motion.length<=0)validation.Error(path+".Motion","A nonempty Cubism motion is required.");
        }
        private sealed class Player:IGameplayAnimationPlayer
        {
            private static readonly Dictionary<CubismModel,Player> Owners=new Dictionary<CubismModel,Player>();
            private readonly CubismModel _model;
            private readonly AnimationClip _clip;
            private readonly bool _restore;
            private readonly List<(Behaviour component,bool enabled)> _writers=new List<(Behaviour,bool)>();
            private float[] _parameters,_parts;
            private CubismPoseController _pose;
            private bool _poseManaged;
            private float _last=-1;
            private readonly AnimationEvent[] _events;
            private bool _started,_disposed;
            public float Duration=>_clip.length;
            public bool Loop { get; }
            public bool IsInterrupted=>_model==null||(_started&&(!Owners.TryGetValue(_model,out var owner)||!ReferenceEquals(owner,this)));
            public event Action<string> AnimationEvent;
            internal Player(CubismModel model,AnimationClip clip,bool loop,bool restore){_model=model;_clip=clip;Loop=loop;_restore=restore;_events=clip.events;}
            public void Seek(float seconds)
            {
                if(_disposed)return;
                if(!float.IsFinite(seconds)||seconds<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(seconds));
                if(!_started)
                {
                    if(Owners.ContainsKey(_model))throw new InvalidOperationException("Cubism model has a conflicting animation channel.");
                    _parameters=Array.ConvertAll(_model.Parameters,p=>p.Value);_parts=Array.ConvertAll(_model.Parts,p=>p.Opacity);
                    _pose=_model.GetComponent<CubismPoseController>();
                    if(_pose!=null){_poseManaged=_pose.HasUpdateController;_pose.HasUpdateController=true;}
                    foreach(var component in _model.GetComponents<Behaviour>())
                        if(component is Animator||component is CubismUpdateController||component is ICubismUpdatable&&!(component is CubismRenderController)&&!(component is CubismPoseController))
                        {_writers.Add((component,component.enabled));component.enabled=false;}
                    Owners.Add(_model,this);_started=true;
                }
                if(IsInterrupted)return;
                _clip.SampleAnimation(_model.gameObject,Loop?seconds%Duration:Math.Min(seconds,Duration));
                // Pose performs opacity/link resolution without advancing a clock. It is necessary
                // for clipped parts to match Runtime even when no Editor frame has run yet.
                _pose?.OnLateUpdate();
                RefreshModel();
                float previous=_last;_last=seconds;
                if(seconds<previous)return;
                foreach(var value in _events)
                {
                    if(_disposed)break;
                    if(!Loop){if(value.time>previous&&value.time<=seconds)AnimationEvent?.Invoke(value.functionName);}
                    else
                    {
                        double crossing=value.time+Math.Max(0,Math.Floor((previous-value.time)/Duration)+1)*Duration;
                        while(!_disposed&&crossing<=seconds){AnimationEvent?.Invoke(value.functionName);crossing+=Duration;}
                    }
                }
            }
            private void RefreshModel()
            {_model.ForceUpdateNow();var renderer=_model.GetComponent<CubismRenderController>();if(renderer!=null)renderer.OnLateUpdate();}
            public void Dispose()
            {
                if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;
                if(!_started||_model==null)return;
                if(!IsInterrupted)
                {
                    Owners.Remove(_model);
                    if(_restore)
                    {
                        for(int i=0;i<_parameters.Length;i++)_model.Parameters[i].Value=_parameters[i];
                        for(int i=0;i<_parts.Length;i++)_model.Parts[i].Opacity=_parts[i];
                        RefreshModel();
                    }
                    foreach(var writer in _writers)if(writer.component!=null)writer.component.enabled=writer.enabled;
                    if(_pose!=null)_pose.HasUpdateController=_poseManaged;
                }
                _writers.Clear();
            }
        }
    
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity;
using Live2D.Cubism.Core;
using Live2D.Cubism.Framework;
using Live2D.Cubism.Framework.Pose;
using Live2D.Cubism.Rendering;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Live2D
{
    /// <summary>Actual Cubism motion clip sampling and native model update, driven by the existing
    /// presentation delta. Automatic procedural/motion writers are paused only while this lease owns the model.
    /// This deterministic clip backend does not reproduce Cubism's motion fade controller.</summary>
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName="FRFrame/Gameplay/Animation/Live2D")]
    public sealed class GameplayLive2DAnimationAsset:GameplayAnimationAsset
    {
        public GameObject ModelPrefab;

        public AnimationClip Motion;

        public override GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload CaptureGraphValues() => CaptureValues();
        private GameplayLive2DAnimationData CaptureValues() => new GameplayLive2DAnimationData { ModelPrefab = ModelPrefab, Motion = Motion, Channel = Channel, Priority = Priority, Loop = Loop, RestorePrevious = RestorePrevious, Speed = Speed };
        public override string BackendName => CaptureValues().BackendName;
        public override string CapabilityNote => CaptureValues().CapabilityNote;
        public override GameObject CreatePreviewSubject() => CaptureValues().CreatePreviewSubject();
        public override void ConfigurePreviewCamera(Camera camera) => CaptureValues().ConfigurePreviewCamera(camera);
        protected override GameplayAnimationDefinition CreateDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => CaptureValues().Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateAnimation(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) => CaptureValues().Validate(validation, path);

    }
}
````

````csharp
            string next=EditorGUILayout.TextField("搜索皮肤",state.Filter);if(next!=state.Filter){state.Filter=next;state.Page=0;}
            var skins=(GameplaySpineSourceInspector.Index(skeleton)?.Skins??Array.Empty<string>()).Where(s=>s.IndexOf(state.Filter,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)>=0).ToArray();
            int pages=Math.Max(1,(skins.Length+49)/50);state.Page=Mathf.Clamp(state.Page,0,pages-1);
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();if(GUILayout.Button("上一页"))state.Page=Math.Max(0,state.Page-1);GUILayout.Label((state.Page+1)+" / "+pages);if(GUILayout.Button("下一页"))state.Page=Math.Min(pages-1,state.Page+1);GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            foreach(string skin in skins.Skip(state.Page*50).Take(50)){
                int at=-1;for(int i=0;i<field.arraySize;i++)if(field.GetArrayElementAtIndex(i).stringValue==skin){at=i;break;}
                bool chosen=EditorGUILayout.ToggleLeft(skin,at>=0);
                if(chosen&&at<0){int index=field.arraySize++;field.GetArrayElementAtIndex(index).stringValue=skin;}
                else if(!chosen&&at>=0)field.DeleteArrayElementAtIndex(at);
            }
            return true;
        }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using Spine.Unity;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Spine.Editor
{
    /// <summary>GUID/path search with 50-row pages. No skeleton or thumbnail is loaded while
    /// opening/filtering; only an explicitly chosen row is loaded after its target is validated.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplaySpineSkeletonPicker : EditorWindow
    {
        private static string[] CachedPaths,CachedGuids;
        private static bool IndexStale=true;
        private string[] _paths=Array.Empty<string>(),_guids=Array.Empty<string>();
        private int[] _visible=Array.Empty<int>();
        private string _search="",_error;
        private int _page;
        private const int PageSize=50;
        private Vector2 _scroll;
        private Func<SkeletonDataAsset,bool> _apply;
        private Func<bool> _valid;
        static GameplaySpineSkeletonPicker(){EditorApplication.projectChanged+=()=>IndexStale=true;}

        internal static void Open(Func<SkeletonDataAsset,bool> apply,Func<bool> valid)
        {
            Rect host=focusedWindow?focusedWindow.position:new Rect(160,100,900,600);
            var window=CreateInstance<GameplaySpineSkeletonPicker>();window._apply=apply;window._valid=valid;
            window.titleContent=new GUIContent("安全选择 Spine 骨骼");window.minSize=new Vector2(520,360);window.ShowUtility();
            window.position=new Rect(host.center.x-340,host.center.y-260,680,520);
        }
        internal static void Draw(SerializedProperty property,Func<SkeletonDataAsset,bool> choose=null,Func<bool> valid=null)
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Spine 骨骼 · 拖入或安全搜索",EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            Rect drop=GUILayoutUtility.GetRect(80,34,GUILayout.ExpandWidth(true));var current=property.objectReferenceValue;
            GUI.Box(drop,current?current.name:"从 Project 拖入 SkeletonDataAsset",EditorStyles.helpBox);
            var evt=Event.current;
            if(GUI.enabled&&(valid==null||valid())&&drop.Contains(evt.mousePosition)&&(evt.type==EventType.DragUpdated||evt.type==EventType.DragPerform)){
                var value=DragAndDrop.objectReferences.OfType<SkeletonDataAsset>().FirstOrDefault();
                DragAndDrop.visualMode=value?DragAndDropVisualMode.Link:DragAndDropVisualMode.Rejected;
                if(value&&evt.type==EventType.DragPerform){DragAndDrop.AcceptDrag();GUI.changed|=SetReference(property,value);}
                evt.Use();
            }
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if(GUILayout.Button("安全搜索骨骼…")){
                if(choose!=null)Open(choose,valid);
                else {
                    var handle=GameplaySourceHandle.Capture(property.serializedObject.targetObject,property.propertyPath);
                    Open(value=>{
                        if(!handle.TryResolve(out string path))return false;
                        using(var so=new SerializedObject(handle.Owner))return ApplyReference(so.FindProperty(path),value);
                    },()=>handle.Owner&&handle.TryResolve(out _)&&!EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode);
                }
            }
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!current)){
                if(GUILayout.Button("定位",GUILayout.Width(48)))EditorGUIUtility.PingObject(current);
                if(GUILayout.Button("清空",GUILayout.Width(48))&&(valid==null||valid()))GUI.changed|=SetReference(property,null);
            }
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }
        // Both main SO and local Schema2 editors use this one pending-buffer mutation.
        // Clearing a skeleton intentionally leaves an authoring draft until a real clip is chosen.
        internal static bool SetReference(SerializedProperty property,SkeletonDataAsset selected)
        {
            if(property.objectReferenceValue==selected)return false;
            property.objectReferenceValue=selected;
            string prefix=property.propertyPath.Substring(0,property.propertyPath.Length-"Skeleton".Length);
            property.serializedObject.FindProperty(prefix+"AnimationName").stringValue="";
            property.serializedObject.FindProperty(prefix+"SkinNames").arraySize=0;
            var initial=property.serializedObject.FindProperty(prefix+"PreviewInitialAnimation");if(initial!=null)initial.stringValue="";
            return true;
        }
        internal static bool ApplyReference(SerializedProperty property,SkeletonDataAsset selected)
        {
            if(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode)return false;
            if(!SetReference(property,selected))return true;
            var so=property.serializedObject;string prefix=property.propertyPath.Substring(0,property.propertyPath.Length-"Skeleton".Length);
            Undo.SetCurrentGroupName("选择 Spine 骨骼");
            if(so.targetObject is GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document)
                return GameplaySkillFieldSchema.ApplyFields(so,document,false,new[]{property.propertyPath,prefix+"AnimationName",prefix+"SkinNames",prefix+"PreviewInitialAnimation"});
            bool changed=so.ApplyModifiedProperties();if(changed)GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(so.targetObject,property.propertyPath);return changed;
        }
        private void OnEnable(){RefreshIndex();EditorApplication.projectChanged+=RefreshIndex;}
        private void OnDisable(){EditorApplication.projectChanged-=RefreshIndex;_apply=null;_valid=null;}
        private void RefreshIndex()
        {
            if(CachedPaths==null||IndexStale){
                CachedGuids=AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:SkeletonDataAsset",new[]{"Assets"});
                CachedPaths=CachedGuids.Select(AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath).ToArray();IndexStale=false;
            }
            _guids=CachedGuids;_paths=CachedPaths;Filter();Repaint();
        }
        private void Filter()
        {
            _visible=Enumerable.Range(0,_paths.Length).Where(i=>string.IsNullOrEmpty(_search)||_paths[i].IndexOf(_search,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)>=0||_guids[i].IndexOf(_search,StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)>=0).ToArray();
            _page=0;_scroll=Vector2.zero;
        }
        private void OnGUI()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("仅检索名称 / 路径 / GUID；选定一项后才加载",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
            string next=EditorGUILayout.TextField("搜索",_search);if(next!=_search){_search=next;Filter();}
            bool valid=_apply!=null&&_valid!=null&&_valid();
            if(!valid)EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("原编辑位置已失效；请取消并从当前字段重新打开。",MessageType.Warning);
            if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_error))EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_error,MessageType.Warning);
            int pages=Math.Max(1,(_visible.Length+PageSize-1)/PageSize);_page=Mathf.Clamp(_page,0,pages-1);
            GUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            if(GUILayout.Button("上一页",GUILayout.Width(70)))_page=Math.Max(0,_page-1);
            GUILayout.Label(_visible.Length+" 项 · "+(_page+1)+" / "+pages);
            if(GUILayout.Button("下一页",GUILayout.Width(70)))_page=Math.Min(pages-1,_page+1);
            GUILayout.EndHorizontal();
            _scroll=EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!valid))foreach(int index in _visible.Skip(_page*PageSize).Take(PageSize))
                if(GUILayout.Button(_paths[index],EditorStyles.miniButton,GUILayout.Height(34))){
                    var selected=AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<SkeletonDataAsset>(_paths[index]);
                    if(_apply(selected)){Close();GUIUtility.ExitGUI();}
                    _error="未应用选择；原字段可能已改变，请重新打开。";
                }
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();if(GUILayout.Button("取消"))Close();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using Spine.Unity;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Spine.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Disposable EditMode-only Spine viewport. It never advances a Gameplay clock.</summary>
    public sealed class SpinePreviewRenderer : IDisposable
    {
        private SkeletonAnimation _skeleton;
        private Renderer _renderer;
        private GameObject _cameraObject;
        private Camera _camera;
        private RenderTexture _texture;

        public void Load(SkeletonDataAsset asset, string[] skinNames = null, Material material = null)
        {
            Dispose();
            if (asset == null) return;
            try
            {
                _skeleton = SkeletonAnimation.NewSkeletonAnimationGameObject(asset, true);
                if (_skeleton == null || !_skeleton.valid)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Spine skeleton did not initialize.");
                _skeleton.gameObject.hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave;
                _skeleton.gameObject.layer = 30;
                _renderer = _skeleton.GetComponent<Renderer>();
                if (material != null && _renderer.sharedMaterial != null)
                    _skeleton.CustomMaterialOverride[_renderer.sharedMaterial] = material;
                if (skinNames != null && skinNames.Length > 0)
                {
                    var skin = new global::Spine.Skin("Editor preview");
                    foreach (string name in skinNames)
                    { var part = _skeleton.Skeleton.Data.FindSkin(name); if (part != null) skin.AddSkin(part); }
                    _skeleton.Skeleton.SetSkin(skin); _skeleton.Skeleton.SetSlotsToSetupPose();
                }
                _renderer.enabled = true;
                _skeleton.LateUpdate(); // Build the first mesh before using its bounds for camera framing.
                _cameraObject = new GameObject("Skill Spine Preview Camera")
                    { hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave, layer = 30 };
                _camera = _cameraObject.AddComponent<Camera>();
                _camera.clearFlags = CameraClearFlags.SolidColor;
                _camera.backgroundColor = FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.GameplayEditorStyles.PreviewBackground;
                _camera.cullingMask = 1 << 30;
                _camera.orthographic = true;
                _camera.enabled = false;
                _camera.transform.position = new Vector3(0f, 0f, -10f);
                _texture = new RenderTexture(512, 320, 16, RenderTextureFormat.ARGB32)
                    { hideFlags = HideFlags.HideAndDontSave };
                _texture.Create();
                _camera.targetTexture = _texture;
                var bounds = _renderer.bounds;
                _camera.transform.position = new Vector3(bounds.center.x, bounds.center.y, -10f);
                _camera.orthographicSize = Mathf.Max(.5f, bounds.extents.y * 1.3f,
                    bounds.extents.x * 1.3f / _camera.aspect);
                _renderer.enabled = false;
            }
            catch { Dispose(); throw; }
        }

        public void Seek(global::Spine.Animation animation, float seconds)
        {
            if (_skeleton == null || animation == null) return;
            _skeleton.Skeleton.SetToSetupPose();
            _skeleton.AnimationState.ClearTracks();
            var entry = _skeleton.AnimationState.SetAnimation(0, animation, false);
            entry.TrackTime = Mathf.Clamp(seconds, 0f, animation.Duration);
            entry.TimeScale = 0f;
            _skeleton.Update(0f);
            _renderer.enabled = true;
            try { _skeleton.LateUpdate(); }
            finally { _renderer.enabled = false; }
        }

        public void Render(Rect viewport)
        {
            if (_camera == null || _texture == null) return;
            if (Event.current.type != EventType.Repaint) return;
            _renderer.enabled = true;
            try { _camera.Render(); }
            finally { _renderer.enabled = false; }
            EditorGUI.DrawPreviewTexture(viewport, _texture, null, ScaleMode.ScaleToFit);
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_camera != null) _camera.targetTexture = null;
            if (_skeleton != null) UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(_skeleton.gameObject);
            if (_cameraObject != null) UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(_cameraObject);
            if (_texture != null) { _texture.Release(); UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(_texture); }
            _skeleton = null;
            _renderer = null;
            _camera = null;
            _cameraObject = null;
            _texture = null;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Spine.Unity;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Spine.Editor
{
    /// <summary>A transient character choice for a Spine preview, supplied by a game Editor assembly.</summary>
    public sealed class SpinePreviewSubject
    {
        public string DisplayName { get; }
        public SkeletonDataAsset Asset { get; }
        public bool IsDefault { get; }
        public string[] SkinNames { get; }
        public UnityEngine.Material Material { get; }

        public SpinePreviewSubject(string displayName, SkeletonDataAsset asset, bool isDefault = false, string[] skinNames = null, UnityEngine.Material material = null)
        {
            DisplayName = displayName;
            Asset = asset;
            IsDefault = isDefault;
            SkinNames = skinNames;
            Material = material;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Optional game-side asset resolver and semantic animation hints. Rendering remains in the integration.</summary>
    public interface ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider
    {
        IReadOnlyList<SpinePreviewSubject> GetSubjects();
        string IdleAnimation(SkeletonDataAsset asset);
        string AnimationForCue(SkeletonDataAsset asset, string cueTag);
    }
    /// <summary>Scoped automatic selection; manual subject browsing remains unrestricted.</summary>
    public interface IScopedSpinePreviewSubjectProvider
    {
        string AuthoringScope { get; }
        bool SupportsPresentationSource(UnityEngine.Object source);
        SpinePreviewSubject Resolve(FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillPreviewContext context);
        string Animation(FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillPreviewContext context);
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using Spine.Unity;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Spine.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Optional framework Spine integration discovered through the generic Editor preview seam.</summary>
    public sealed class SpineSkillPreviewProvider : IGameplaySkillPreviewProvider
    {
        public string DisplayName => "Spine";
        public bool CanPreview(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill) =>
            !EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode;
        public IGameplaySkillPreviewSession CreateSession(GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset skill)
        {
            var session = new SpineSkillPreviewSession();
            session.UpdateContext(new GameplaySkillPreviewContext(skill, null, null));
            return session;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Owns Spine subject/animation selection and a disposable presentation viewport.</summary>
    public sealed class SpineSkillPreviewSession : IGameplaySkillPreviewSession
    {
        private sealed class Entry
        {
            public readonly SpinePreviewSubject Subject;
            public readonly ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider Provider;
            public Entry(SpinePreviewSubject subject, ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider provider)
            { Subject = subject; Provider = provider; }
        }

        private readonly SpinePreviewRenderer _renderer = new SpinePreviewRenderer();
        private readonly List<Entry> _subjects = new List<Entry>();
        private GameplaySkillPreviewContext _context;
        private ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider _subjectProvider;
        private SkeletonDataAsset _asset;
        private string[] _animations = Array.Empty<string>();
        private int _subjectIndex, _animationIndex;
        private float _time;
        private string _warning, _cue;
        private bool _actionCue, _followSequenceCues = true;
        private string _automaticContextKey;
        private SpinePreviewSubject _resolvedSubject;

        public SkeletonDataAsset SkeletonDataAsset => _asset;
        public IReadOnlyList<string> AnimationNames => _animations;
        public string CurrentCueTag => _cue;
        public bool FollowSequenceCues
        {
            get => _followSequenceCues;
            set { _followSequenceCues = value; Seek(Mathf.Min(_time, Duration)); }
        }
        /// <summary>Presentation range includes the selected animation and every mapped Cue animation after its start time.</summary>
        public float Duration
        {
            get
            {
                float duration = Mathf.Max(_context?.Sequence?.Duration ?? 0f, SelectedAnimation?.Duration ?? 0f);
                if (!_followSequenceCues) return SelectedAnimation?.Duration ?? 0f;
                if (_asset == null || _subjectProvider == null || _context?.Sequence?.Markers == null) return duration;
                foreach (var cue in _context.Sequence.Markers.OfType<GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring>())
                {
                    string name = _subjectProvider.AnimationForCue(_asset, cue.CueTag.Name);
                    var animation = string.IsNullOrEmpty(name) ? null : _asset.GetSkeletonData(false)?.FindAnimation(name);
                    if (animation != null) duration = Mathf.Max(duration, cue.Time + animation.Duration);
                }
                return duration;
            }
        }
        public string CurrentAnimationName => _animationIndex < _animations.Length ? _animations[_animationIndex] : null;
        private global::Spine.Animation SelectedAnimation => _asset?.GetSkeletonData(false)?.FindAnimation(
            _animationIndex < _animations.Length ? _animations[_animationIndex] : string.Empty);

        public SpineSkillPreviewSession()
        {
            foreach (Type type in TypeCache.GetTypesDerivedFrom<ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider>()
                .Where(type => !type.IsAbstract && type.GetConstructor(Type.EmptyTypes) != null)
                .OrderBy(type => type.AssemblyQualifiedName, StringComparer.Ordinal))
            {
                try
                {
                    var provider = (ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
                    foreach (var subject in provider.GetSubjects() ?? Array.Empty<SpinePreviewSubject>())
                        if (subject?.Asset != null) _subjects.Add(new Entry(subject, provider));
                }
                catch (Exception ex) { Debug.LogWarning("Spine preview subjects " + type.FullName + ": " + ex.Message); }
            }
        }

        public void UpdateContext(GameplaySkillPreviewContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
            var candidates=_subjects.Select(e=>e.Provider).Distinct().OfType<IScopedSpinePreviewSubjectProvider>().ToArray();
            var scoped=context?.PresentationSource==null ? null : candidates.FirstOrDefault(p=>p.SupportsPresentationSource(context.PresentationSource));
            scoped=scoped ?? candidates.FirstOrDefault(p=>p.AuthoringScope==context?.AuthoringScope);
            string key = (context?.Document == null ? "" : context.Document.GetInstanceID().ToString()) + ":" + context?.AuthoringScope +
                ":" + context?.PresentationSource?.GetInstanceID() + ":" + scoped?.Animation(context);
            if (key != _automaticContextKey)
            {
                _automaticContextKey = key;
                _resolvedSubject = scoped?.Resolve(context);
                if (_resolvedSubject != null)
                {
                    var provider = (ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider)scoped;
                    int index = _subjects.FindIndex(e => e.Provider.GetType() == provider.GetType() && e.Subject.Asset == _resolvedSubject.Asset);
                    _subjectIndex = index + 1; LoadAsset(_resolvedSubject.Asset, provider);
                    string animation = scoped.Animation(context); if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(animation)) SetAnimation(animation);
                }
                else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(context?.AuthoringScope)) { _resolvedSubject = null; SelectSubject(0); }
            }
            Seek(_time);
        }

        public void DrawControls()
        {
            string[] names = new[] { "手动选择 Spine" }.Concat(_subjects.Select(entry => entry.Subject.DisplayName)).ToArray();
            int index = EditorGUILayout.Popup("预览角色", _subjectIndex, names);
            if (index != _subjectIndex) SelectSubject(index);
            var selected = (SkeletonDataAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Spine Asset", _asset,
                typeof(SkeletonDataAsset), false);
            if (selected != _asset) SetSkeletonDataAsset(selected);
            if (_animations.Length > 0)
            {
                int animation = EditorGUILayout.Popup("Animation", _animationIndex, _animations);
                if (animation != _animationIndex) SetAnimation(_animations[animation]);
            }
            if (_context?.Sequence != null)
            {
                bool follow = EditorGUILayout.ToggleLeft("跟随 Sequence Cue（关闭后单独预览所选动画）", _followSequenceCues);
                if (follow != _followSequenceCues) FollowSequenceCues = follow;
            }
            if (SelectedAnimation != null)
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("动画长度", SelectedAnimation.Duration.ToString("0.###") + "s" +
                    (Duration > SelectedAnimation.Duration ? "  ·  含 Cue 后续至 " + Duration.ToString("0.###") + "s" : ""));
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_warning)) EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_warning, MessageType.Warning);
        }

        private void SelectSubject(int index)
        {
            _subjectIndex = index;
            var entry = index > 0 && index <= _subjects.Count ? _subjects[index - 1] : null;
            _resolvedSubject = entry?.Subject;
            LoadAsset(entry?.Subject.Asset, entry?.Provider);
        }

        /// <summary>Direct framework use is possible without any game subject provider.</summary>
        public void SetSkeletonDataAsset(SkeletonDataAsset asset)
        {
            _subjectIndex = 0;
            _resolvedSubject = null;
            LoadAsset(asset, null);
        }

        public void SetAnimation(string name)
        {
            int index = Array.IndexOf(_animations, name);
            if (index < 0) return;
            _animationIndex = index;
            Seek(Mathf.Min(_time, Duration));
        }

        private void LoadAsset(SkeletonDataAsset asset, ISpinePreviewSubjectProvider provider)
        {
            _asset = asset;
            _subjectProvider = provider;
            _warning = null;
            _animations = asset?.GetSkeletonData(false)?.Animations.Select(animation => animation.Name).ToArray()
                ?? Array.Empty<string>();
            string idle = provider?.IdleAnimation(asset);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(idle))
                idle = new[] { "normal", "stand", "stand2", "idle", "sit" }
                    .FirstOrDefault(name => _animations.Contains(name));
            _animationIndex = Mathf.Max(0, Array.IndexOf(_animations, idle));
            try { _renderer.Load(asset, _resolvedSubject?.SkinNames, _resolvedSubject?.Material); Seek(Mathf.Min(_time, Duration)); }
            catch (Exception ex) { _warning = ex.Message; }
        }

        public void Seek(float seconds)
        {
            _time = Mathf.Max(0f, seconds);
            var cue = (_followSequenceCues ? _context?.Sequence?.Markers : null)?.OfType<GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring>()
                .Where(marker => marker.Time <= _time + .00001f)
                .OrderBy(marker => marker.Time).LastOrDefault();
            _cue = cue?.CueTag.Name;
            string actionName = _subjectProvider?.AnimationForCue(_asset, _cue);
            var action = string.IsNullOrEmpty(actionName) ? null : _asset?.GetSkeletonData(false)?.FindAnimation(actionName);
            _actionCue = action != null;
            _renderer.Seek(action ?? SelectedAnimation, _actionCue && cue != null ? _time - cue.Time : _time);
        }

        public void Render(Rect viewport)
        {
            if (_asset == null) { EditorGUI.HelpBox(viewport, "选择 SkeletonDataAsset 以预览 Spine。", MessageType.Info); return; }
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_warning)) { EditorGUI.HelpBox(viewport, _warning, MessageType.Warning); return; }
            _renderer.Render(viewport);
            if (Event.current.type == EventType.Repaint && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_cue))
            {
                EditorGUI.DrawRect(new Rect(viewport.x, viewport.y, viewport.width, 25f),
                    _actionCue ? new Color(.58f, .26f, .17f, .9f) : new Color(.20f, .38f, .59f, .9f));
                GUI.Label(new Rect(viewport.x + 5f, viewport.y + 3f, viewport.width - 10f, 20f),
                    "Cue · " + _cue, EditorStyles.whiteMiniLabel);
            }
        }

        public void Dispose() => _renderer.Dispose();
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity;
using Spine.Unity;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Spine
{
    /// <summary>One real Spine animation source shared by Runtime and preview. Level variants select
    /// the highest eligible minimum level; optional weights share captured selection with Preview.
    /// No mutable TrackEntry lives here.</summary>
    [System.Serializable, UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplaySpineAnimationData : GameplayAnimationData
    {
        public SkeletonDataAsset Skeleton;
        public string AnimationName;
        public int TrackIndex;
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity;
using Spine.Unity;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Spine
{
    /// <summary>One real Spine animation source shared by Runtime and preview. Level variants select
    /// the highest eligible minimum level; optional weights share captured selection with Preview.
    /// No mutable TrackEntry lives here.</summary>
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName="FRFrame/Gameplay/Animation/Spine")]
    public sealed class GameplaySpineAnimationAsset : GameplayAnimationAsset
    {
        public SkeletonDataAsset Skeleton;

        public string AnimationName;

        public int TrackIndex;

        [Min(0)]public float BlendDuration;

        /// <summary>Optional starting pose of the disposable preview/Lab subject. Runtime animation
        /// commands always blend from the actual host track; this does not replace AnimationName.</summary>
        public string PreviewInitialAnimation;

        public string[] SkinNames = Array.Empty<string>();

        public Material Material;

        public LevelVariant[] Variants = Array.Empty<LevelVariant>();

        public bool WeightedVariants;

        [Serializable] public sealed class LevelVariant { public int MinimumLevel=1; public string AnimationName; public float Weight=1; }
        public override GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload CaptureGraphValues() => CaptureValues();
        private GameplaySpineAnimationData CaptureValues() => new GameplaySpineAnimationData { Skeleton = Skeleton, AnimationName = AnimationName, TrackIndex = TrackIndex, BlendDuration = BlendDuration, PreviewInitialAnimation = PreviewInitialAnimation, SkinNames = SkinNames, Material = Material, Variants = Variants, WeightedVariants = WeightedVariants, Channel = Channel, Priority = Priority, Loop = Loop, RestorePrevious = RestorePrevious, Speed = Speed };
        public override string BackendName => CaptureValues().BackendName;
        public override GameObject CreatePreviewSubject() => CaptureValues().CreatePreviewSubject();
        protected override GameplayAnimationDefinition CreateDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => CaptureValues().Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateAnimation(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) => CaptureValues().Validate(validation, path);

    }
}
````

````csharp
        }
        private Bounds SubjectBounds()
        {
            var renderers=_subject.GetComponentsInChildren<Renderer>();
            var bounds=renderers.Length>0?renderers[0].bounds:new Bounds(_subject.transform.position,Vector3.one);
            foreach(var renderer in renderers)bounds.Encapsulate(renderer.bounds);
            return bounds;
        }
        private void Release()
        {
            _captureVariantRoll=false;
            _cuePreview?.Dispose();_cuePreview=null;
            _player?.Dispose();_player=null;
            _preview?.Cleanup();_preview=null;
            if(_subject!=null)UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(_subject);_subject=null;
        }
        public void Dispose(){Release();_source=null;_cueSource=null;_textSource=null;_values=null;_cueValues=null;_textValues=null;}
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Scans actual controller states into formal Source variants. Preview the impact first;
    /// applying records one Undo and never edits the controller, clips or prefab.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAnimatorVariantGenerator:EditorWindow
    {
        private GameplayUnityAnimationAsset _source;
        private GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.LevelVariant[] _preview;
        private string _error;
        private Vector2 _scroll;
        [MenuItem("FRFrame/Gameplay/Animation/Animator Variant Generator")]
        public static void Open()=>GetWindow<GameplayAnimatorVariantGenerator>("动画变体扫描");
        public static GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.LevelVariant[] Scan(GameplayUnityAnimationAsset source)
        {
            if(source==null||source.PreviewPrefab==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("选择有真实Prefab的Animator动画Source。");
            var animator=source.PreviewPrefab.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>(true);
            var controller=animator==null?null:animator.runtimeAnimatorController as AnimatorController;
            if(controller==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("需要实际AnimatorController；OverrideController请先选择其原Controller的Source。");
            if(source.Layer<0||source.Layer>=controller.layers.Length)throw new InvalidOperationException("Source Layer不在Controller中。");
            var layer=controller.layers[source.Layer];var result=new List<GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.LevelVariant>();
            Collect(layer.stateMachine,layer.name,result);
            if(result.Count==0)throw new InvalidOperationException("本层无直接AnimationClip状态；BlendTree需单独配置，扫描不会猜测其播放语义。");
            return result.ToArray();
        }
        private static void Collect(AnimatorStateMachine machine,string prefix,List<GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.LevelVariant> result)
        {
            foreach(var state in machine.states)if(state.state.motion is AnimationClip clip&&clip.length>0)
                result.Add(new GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.LevelVariant{MinimumLevel=1,Clip=clip,StateName=prefix+"."+state.state.name,Weight=1});
            foreach(var nested in machine.stateMachines)Collect(nested.stateMachine,prefix+"."+nested.stateMachine.name,result);
        }
        public static void Apply(GameplayUnityAnimationAsset source,GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.LevelVariant[] preview)
        {
            if(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode)throw new InvalidOperationException("退出Play Mode后应用。");
            var actual=Scan(source);
            if(preview==null||preview.Length!=actual.Length)throw new InvalidOperationException("Controller已变化，请重新扫描。");
            for(int i=0;i<actual.Length;i++)if(preview[i]==null||preview[i].Clip!=actual[i].Clip||preview[i].StateName!=actual[i].StateName)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Controller已变化，请重新扫描。");
            Undo.RecordObject(source,"生成正式动画变体");source.Variants=actual;source.WeightedVariants=true;
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(source);GameplayAuthoringSourceChanges.Notify(source);
        }
        private void OnGUI()
        {
            var selected=(GameplayUnityAnimationAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("正式动画Source",_source,typeof(GameplayUnityAnimationAsset),false);
            if(selected!=_source){_source=selected;_preview=null;_error=null;}
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("扫描实际Layer与嵌套状态路径。应用会替换此Source的Variants（Lv1、权重1），保留主动画；可一次Undo。不会修改Controller或动画资源。",MessageType.Info);
            if(GUILayout.Button("扫描 / Dry-run"))try{_preview=Scan(_source);_error=null;}catch(Exception ex){_preview=null;_error=ex.Message;}
            if(_error!=null)EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(_error,MessageType.Warning);
            if(_preview==null)return;
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("仅影响Source",AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_source));
            _scroll=EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scroll);
            foreach(var variant in _preview)EditorGUILayout.LabelField(variant.StateName,variant.Clip.name);
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
            using(new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(EditorApplication.isPlayingOrWillChangePlaymode))
                if(GUILayout.Button("应用到正式Source（一次Undo）"))try{Apply(_source,_preview);_error=null;}catch(Exception ex){_error=ex.Message;}
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity.Editor
````
