````csharp
    /// <summary>Unity backends expose their real plain-data sources to the shared V2 editor.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillUnityValueEditor : IGameplaySkillValueEditor, IGameplaySkillPreviewFactory, IGameplaySkillValueDescription, IGameplaySkillValueSections, IGameplaySkillValueDuration, IGameplaySkillCardFieldProvider, IGameplaySkillValueCreationPresets
    {
        public IEnumerable<GameplaySkillCardField> CardFields(object values)
        {
            if(values is GameplayAnimationData){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Channel","播放通道");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Speed","速度",true);yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Loop","循环");}
            if(values is GameplayUnityAnimationData){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Clip","动画剪辑");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("StateName","状态名");}
            if(values is GameplayPresentationCueData cue){
                bool audio=cue.Kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio;
                yield return audio?new GameplaySkillCardField("Clip","音频片段"):new GameplaySkillCardField("Prefab","特效预制体");
                if(!audio)yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("RecycleWhenParticlesFinish","播完回收");
                if(IsFieldVisible(cue,"Duration"))yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Duration",audio?"停止时限":"回收时限",true);
                yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Origin","播放位置");
                if(IsFieldVisible(cue,"Binding"))yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Binding","挂点（空为根）");
                if(IsFieldVisible(cue,"Follow"))yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Follow","跟随位置");
            }
            if(values is GameplayFloatingTextData text){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Prefab","战斗结算飘字");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Duration","持续秒数");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("FixedPoint","固定世界位置");if(!text.FixedPoint){yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Binding","结果目标挂点");yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("Follow","跟随结果目标");}yield return new GameplaySkillCardField("RequestedHealing","治疗显示请求值");}
        }
        public bool TryReadDuration(object values,out string path,out float seconds){
            if(values is GameplayUnityAnimationData animation&&animation.Clip&&animation.Speed is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring speed&&speed.Value>0){path=null;seconds=animation.Clip.length/speed.Value;return true;}
            path=null;seconds=0;if(values is GameplayPresentationCueData cue&&IsFieldVisible(cue,"Duration")&&cue.Duration is GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring duration){path="Duration";seconds=duration.Value;return true;}return false;
        }
        public IEnumerable<GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup> Sections(object values){
            if(values is GameplayAnimationData){
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,"后端 / 模型 / 动画","选择实际资源后筛选真实动画；不创建资源副本。","Backend","Skeleton","PreviewPrefab","ModelPrefab","Clip","Motion","AnimationName","StateName","TrackIndex","Layer","PreviewInitialAnimation","Material","SkinNames");
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,"播放 / 混合 / 所有权","预览与 Runtime 共用这些值；Loop 和 Speed 不改变正式 End 时点。","Loop","Speed","BlendDuration","BlendSeconds","Channel","Priority","RestorePrevious");
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,"等级变体 / 权重","保持正式资源的等级选择及权重规则。","Variants","WeightedVariants");
            }
            if(values is GameplayFloatingTextData){
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,"战斗结果 / 锚定","读取已经提交的 combat feedback；不使用任意上下文 Key。","Prefab","FixedPoint","Point","Binding","Follow","Offset","RequestedHealing","SuppressEmptyHealing");
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,"格式 / 颜色 / 动效",null,"Duration","DamagePrefix","NumberFormat","CriticalPrefix","MissText","ImmuneText","ShieldPrefix","DamageColor","CriticalColor","SupportColor","MissColor","RiseSpeed","Acceleration","VelocitySpread","FadeStartRatio");
            }
            if(values is GameplayPresentationCueData cue){
                bool audio=cue.Kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio;
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,audio?"音频资源":"特效资源",null,audio?"Clip":"Prefab");
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,audio?"播放位置":"位置 / 缩放 / 朝向",null,"Origin","Binding","Offset","Scale","Follow","MirrorFacing");
                if(audio)
                    yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,"音频播放",null,"Volume","Pitch","AudioLoop");
                yield return new GameplayBusinessInspectorGroup(null,audio?"停止与清理":"回收与清理",
                    audio?"时限以秒计。到期停止音频，随技能清理可能提前停止。":"一次性粒子可以播完回收。循环或其它特效请用手动时限，随技能清理可以提前回收。",
                    "RecycleWhenParticlesFinish","Duration","OwnedByAbility");
            }
        }
        public string Summary(object values) {
            if(values is GameplayFloatingTextData text)return "真实战斗结算：伤害 / 治疗 / 暴击 / 护盾\n"+(text.FixedPoint?"固定世界位置":(string.IsNullOrEmpty(text.Binding)?"结果目标根节点":"结果目标挂点 "+text.Binding)+(text.Follow?" · 跟随":" · 不跟随"));
            if(values is GameplayAnimationData animation)return animation.BackendName+" · "+animation.ClipLabel+" · 通道 "+animation.Channel+"\n"+(animation.Loop?"循环":"单次")+" · 速度 "+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.FloatSummary(animation.Speed);
            if(values is GameplayPresentationCueData cue)return (cue.Kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio?"音效":"特效")+" · "+(cue.Kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio?(cue.Clip?cue.Clip.name:"待选择音频"):(cue.Prefab?cue.Prefab.name:"待选择特效"))+"\n"+(cue.Origin==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.PositionSource.ContextPoint?"固定上下文地点":(cue.Origin==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.PositionSource.Owner?"施法者":"主目标")+" · "+(string.IsNullOrEmpty(cue.Binding)?"根节点":cue.Binding)+(cue.Follow?" · 跟随":" · 不跟随"))+"\n"+(IsFieldVisible(cue,"Duration")?"时限 "+GameplaySkillFieldSchema.FloatSummary(cue.Duration)+"s":"播完回收");
            return null;
        }
        public IEnumerable<(string Name, GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload Value)> CreationPresets(Type valueType)
        {
            if (valueType != typeof(GameplayPresentationCueData)) yield break;
            yield return ("播放特效", new GameplayPresentationCueData {
                Kind=GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Vfx,RecycleWhenParticlesFinish=true,OwnedByAbility=false
            });
            yield return ("播放音频", new GameplayPresentationCueData { Kind = GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio });
        }

        public IEnumerable<Type> ValueTypes(Type resource)
        {
            if (resource.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(GameplayUnityAnimationAsset))) yield return typeof(GameplayUnityAnimationData);
            if (resource.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(GameplayPresentationCueAsset))) yield return typeof(GameplayPresentationCueData);
            if (resource.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(GameplayFloatingTextAsset))) yield return typeof(GameplayFloatingTextData);
            if (resource.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(GameplayUnityProjectileAsset))) yield return typeof(GameplayUnityProjectileData);
            if (resource.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(GameplayUnityAreaAsset))) yield return typeof(GameplayUnityAreaData);
            if (resource.IsAssignableFrom(typeof(GameplayUnitySummonAsset))) yield return typeof(GameplayUnitySummonData);
        }
        public string Name(Type type) => type == typeof(GameplayUnityAnimationData) ? "Animator / Playables" : type == typeof(GameplayPresentationCueData) ? "特效 / 音效" :
            type == typeof(GameplayFloatingTextData) ? "战斗飘字" : type == typeof(GameplayUnityProjectileData) ? "Unity 弹体" : type == typeof(GameplayUnityAreaData) ? "Unity 区域" : type == typeof(GameplayUnitySummonData) ? "Unity 召唤" : null;
        public bool IsFieldVisible(object values,string field)
        {
            GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind kind;
            GameplayPresentationCueAsset.PositionSource origin;
            bool autoRecycle;
            if(values is GameplayPresentationCueData cue){
                if(field=="Kind")return false;
                kind=cue.Kind;
                origin=cue.Origin;
                autoRecycle=cue.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish;
            }else if(values is GameplayPresentationCueAsset shared){
                kind=shared.Kind;
                origin=shared.Origin;
                autoRecycle=shared.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish;
            }else return true;

            switch(field){
                case "Prefab": case "Scale": case "MirrorFacing": case "RecycleWhenParticlesFinish":
                    return kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Vfx;
                case "Clip": case "Volume": case "Pitch": case "AudioLoop":
                    return kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio;
                case "Binding": case "Follow":
                    return origin!=GameplayPresentationCueAsset.PositionSource.ContextPoint;
                case "Duration":
                    return kind!=GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Vfx||!autoRecycle;
                default:
                    return true;
            }
        }
        public bool DrawField(SerializedProperty root,SerializedProperty field)=>false;
        public bool Supports(object values) => values is GameplayAnimationData || values is GameplayPresentationCueData || values is GameplayFloatingTextData;
        public IGameplaySkillPreviewSession Create(GameplaySkillDocumentAsset document, object values, float startSeconds)
        { var session = new GameplayAnimationPreviewSession(); session.UpdateValues(document, values, startSeconds); return session; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Reflection;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity.Editor
{
    /// <summary>Disposable presentation-only preview of the actual cue/widget prefab. Uses the
    /// built Runtime source and absolute particle/text time, without a rule world, damage or clock.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplayUnityCuePreview:IDisposable
    {
        private PreviewRenderUtility _preview;
        private GameplayPresentationCueDefinition _cue;
        private GameplayFloatingTextDefinition _text;
        private ParticleSystem[] _particles=Array.Empty<ParticleSystem>();
        private GameplayFloatingTextWidget _widget;
        private Vector3 _start;
        internal GameObject Subject {get;private set;}
        internal Camera Camera=>_preview?.camera;
        internal float Duration {get;private set;}
        internal GameplayUnityCuePreview(GameplayPresentationCueAsset cue,GameplayFloatingTextAsset text,GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            : this(cue?.CaptureGraphValues() as GameplayPresentationCueData, text?.CaptureGraphValues() as GameplayFloatingTextData, application) { }
        internal GameplayUnityCuePreview(GameplayPresentationCueData cue,GameplayFloatingTextData text,GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
        {
            try{
                var build=new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
                if(cue!=null){
                    _cue=cue.Build(build);
                    if(!_cue.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish)Duration=GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_cue.Duration,application);
                }
                else{_text=text.Build(build);Duration=_text.Duration;}
                if(_cue?.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish!=true&&(!float.IsFinite(Duration)||Duration<=0))
                    throw new ArithmeticException("Presentation duration must be positive.");
                if(_cue?.Kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio)return;
                var prefab=_cue!=null?_cue.Prefab:_text.Prefab;
                if(prefab==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Select an existing presentation prefab.");
                Subject=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab);Subject.hideFlags=HideFlags.HideAndDontSave;
                _start=_cue!=null?_cue.Offset:_text.Offset;Subject.transform.position=_start;
                _preview=new PreviewRenderUtility();_preview.AddSingleGO(Subject);
                _preview.camera.cameraType=CameraType.Game;_preview.camera.orthographic=true;
                _preview.camera.clearFlags=CameraClearFlags.Color;_preview.camera.backgroundColor=new Color(.12f,.14f,.18f);
                _preview.camera.nearClipPlane=.01f;_preview.camera.farClipPlane=100;
                _preview.lights[0].intensity=1;_preview.lights[0].transform.rotation=Quaternion.Euler(40,40,0);
                _particles=Subject.GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>(true);
                if(_cue?.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish==true)Duration=EstimateParticlePreviewDuration();
                foreach(var particles in _particles){var main=particles.main;main.stopAction=ParticleSystemStopAction.None;particles.Stop(false,ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmittingAndClear);}
                if(_text!=null){
                    _widget=Subject.GetComponent<GameplayFloatingTextWidget>();
                    _widget.OpenStandalone(new GameplayFloatingTextContent("PREVIEW",text.DamageColor));
                    var canvas=Subject.GetComponent<Canvas>();if(canvas!=null)canvas.worldCamera=_preview.camera;
                }
                Seek(0,true);
                var bounds=new Bounds(_start,Vector3.one);
                foreach(var renderer in Subject.GetComponentsInChildren<Renderer>(true))bounds.Encapsulate(renderer.bounds);
                _preview.camera.transform.position=bounds.center+new Vector3(0,0,-10);
                _preview.camera.orthographicSize=Mathf.Max(.7f,bounds.extents.y*1.3f,bounds.extents.x);
            }catch{Dispose();throw;}
        }
        internal void Seek(float seconds,bool started)
        {
            if(Subject==null)return;
            bool visible=started&&(_cue?.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish==true||seconds<Duration);
            Subject.SetActive(visible);if(!visible)return;
            foreach(var particles in _particles){particles.Simulate(seconds,false,true,true);particles.Pause(false);}
            if(_widget!=null){Subject.transform.position=_start+Vector3.up*(seconds*_text.RiseSpeed);_widget.SetOpacity(1-seconds/Duration);}
        }
        // The standalone scrubber needs a finite range. Runtime uses actual particle completion.
        private float EstimateParticlePreviewDuration()
        {
            float duration=1;
            foreach(var particles in _particles){
                if(!particles.gameObject.activeInHierarchy)continue;
                var main=particles.main;
                var trails=particles.trails;
                float lifetime=Peak(main.startLifetime);
                if(trails.enabled&&!trails.dieWithParticles)lifetime+=lifetime*Peak(trails.lifetime);
                duration=Mathf.Max(duration,(Peak(main.startDelay)+main.duration+lifetime)/main.simulationSpeed);
            }
            return duration;

            float Peak(ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve value)
            {
                if(value.mode==ParticleSystemCurveMode.Constant||value.mode==ParticleSystemCurveMode.TwoConstants)
                    return value.constantMax;
                float max=value.curveMax.keys.Select(k=>k.value).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max();
                if(value.mode==ParticleSystemCurveMode.TwoCurves)
                    max=Mathf.Max(max,value.curveMin.keys.Select(k=>k.value).DefaultIfEmpty(0).Max());
                return max*value.curveMultiplier;
            }
        }
        internal void DrawControls()
        {
            if(_cue?.RecycleWhenParticlesFinish==true)
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("播完回收 · 预览范围估算",Duration.ToString("0.###")+" 秒");
            else EditorGUILayout.LabelField("正式表现素材 / 持续秒",Duration.ToString("0.###"));
            if(_cue?.Kind==GameplayPresentationCueAsset.CueKind.Audio){
                EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("音频素材",_cue.Clip,typeof(AudioClip),false);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("运行音量 / 音高",_cue.Volume+" / "+_cue.Pitch);
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("试听原Clip为标准音高；Play安装使用配置音量、音高和Loop。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
                if(GUILayout.Button("试听现有音频（一次）")){
                    var utility=AppDomain.CurrentDomain.GetAssemblies().Select(a=>a.GetType("UnityEditor.AudioUtil")).FirstOrDefault(t=>t!=null);
                    var play=utility?.GetMethod("PlayPreviewClip",BindingFlags.Static|BindingFlags.Public|BindingFlags.NonPublic);
                    if(play==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Installed Editor audio audition is unavailable.");
                    play.Invoke(null,new object[]{_cue.Clip,0,false});
                }
            }
            else EditorGUILayout.LabelField(_text!=null?"飘字为样式预览；实际数字只来自已提交的战斗结果。":"独立素材预览；Origin / Follow 由实际 Runtime Host 绑定。",EditorStyles.wordWrappedMiniLabel);
        }
        internal void Render(Rect viewport)
        {

            GUI.DrawTexture(viewport,_preview.EndPreview(),ScaleMode.ScaleToFit,false);
        }
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEditor.Animations;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity.Editor
{
    public sealed class GameplayUnitySourceInspector:IGameplayAnimationSourceInspector
    {
        public bool Supports(Object source)=>source is GameplayUnityAnimationAsset||source?.GetType().Name=="GameplayLive2DAnimationAsset";
        public void DrawCore(SerializedObject source)
        {
            if(source.targetObject is GameplayUnityAnimationAsset asset){
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(source.FindProperty("Backend"),new GUIContent("播放后端"));
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(source.FindProperty("PreviewPrefab"),new GUIContent("载体 Prefab / Controller"));
                if(asset.Backend==GameplayUnityAnimationAsset.PlaybackBackend.AnimatorState){
                    var controller=asset.PreviewPrefab?.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>(true)?.runtimeAnimatorController as AnimatorController;
                    if(controller==null){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("请选择含真实AnimatorController的载体Prefab。",MessageType.Warning);return;}
                    var layer=source.FindProperty("Layer");var names=controller.layers.Select(l=>l.name).ToArray();
                    if(names.Length==0){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Controller没有动画层。",MessageType.Warning);return;}
                    int valid=layer.intValue>=0&&layer.intValue<names.Length?layer.intValue:-1;
                    int selected=EditorGUILayout.Popup("Animator 层",valid,names);
                    if(selected!=valid&&selected>=0)layer.intValue=selected;
                    if(layer.intValue<0||layer.intValue>=names.Length){EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("请选择Controller中实际存在的层。",MessageType.Warning);return;}
                    var states=new List<string>();Collect(controller.layers[layer.intValue].stateMachine,names[layer.intValue],states);
                    var state=source.FindProperty("StateName");int current=states.IndexOf(state.stringValue);
                    int next=EditorGUILayout.Popup("真实 State",current,states.ToArray());
                    if(next>=0&&next!=current){state.stringValue=states[next];var selectedState=FindState(controller.layers[layer.intValue].stateMachine,names[layer.intValue],state.stringValue);if(selectedState?.motion is AnimationClip selectedClip)source.FindProperty("Clip").objectReferenceValue=selectedClip;}
                    if(current<0)EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("Controller中未找到「"+state.stringValue+"」。请选择真实State。",MessageType.Warning);
                    var actual=FindState(controller.layers[layer.intValue].stateMachine,names[layer.intValue],state.stringValue)?.motion as AnimationClip;
                    if(actual!=null&&source.FindProperty("Clip").objectReferenceValue!=actual){
                        EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("所选State实际使用「"+actual.name+"」；当前Clip绑定不同。",MessageType.Warning);
                        if(GUILayout.Button("按真实State绑定Clip"))source.FindProperty("Clip").objectReferenceValue=actual;
                    }
                }
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(source.FindProperty("Clip"),new GUIContent("动画 Clip"));
            }else{
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(source.FindProperty("ModelPrefab"),new GUIContent("Cubism 模型 Prefab"));
                EditorGUILayout.PropertyField(source.FindProperty("Motion"),new GUIContent("Cubism 动画 Clip"));
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("同源Clip采样；不支持Cubism MotionFade混合。",MessageType.Info);
            }
        }
        private static void Collect(AnimatorStateMachine machine,string prefix,List<string> states)
        {foreach(var state in machine.states)states.Add(prefix+"."+state.state.name);foreach(var child in machine.stateMachines)Collect(child.stateMachine,prefix+"."+child.stateMachine.name,states);}

        {foreach(var state in machine.states)if(prefix+"."+state.state.name==path)return state.state;foreach(var child in machine.stateMachines){var found=FindState(child.stateMachine,prefix+"."+child.stateMachine.name,path);if(found!=null)return found;}return null;}
        public void DrawAdvanced(SerializedObject source)
        {

            }
        }
        public string[] SourceFields(Object source)=>source is GameplayUnityAnimationAsset?new[]{"Backend","PreviewPrefab","Layer","StateName","Clip","BlendDuration","Variants","WeightedVariants"}:new[]{"ModelPrefab","Motion"};
        public string Summary(Object source)

    }
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>SDK-neutral Unity animation source. Actual SDK assets implement the player factory;
    /// backend-specific resources/variants are authored once here for both Runtime and Editor preview.
    /// Runtime state lives in a per-cast player/lease, never in this shared asset.</summary>
    [System.Serializable, UnityEngine.Scripting.Preserve]
    public abstract class GameplayAnimationData : GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload
    {
        public override System.Type DefinitionType => typeof(GameplayAnimationDefinition);
        public override object BuildDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => Build(context);

        public string Channel = "Body";
        public int Priority = 10;
        public bool Loop;
        public bool RestorePrevious = true;
        [SerializeReference] public GameplayFloatValueAuthoring Speed = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 1 };
        public abstract string BackendName { get; }
        /// <summary>Actual authored clip/state name for Timeline and Inspector summaries.</summary>
        public abstract string ClipLabel {get;}
        /// <summary>Actual model/skeleton identity used by a host to reject incompatible subjects.</summary>
        public abstract UnityEngine.Object SubjectResource {get;}
        public abstract GameObject CreatePreviewSubject();
        /// <summary>Optional SDK render policy for the disposable preview camera; never changes project renderer assets.</summary>
        public virtual void ConfigurePreviewCamera(Camera camera) { }
        protected abstract GameplayAnimationDefinition CreateDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context);
        public GameplayAnimationDefinition Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)=>context.Build(this,()=>CreateDefinition(context));
        protected override void ValidateContent(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)
        {
            if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(Channel))validation.Error(path+".Channel","Channel is required.");
            if(Speed==null)validation.Error(path+".Speed","Speed is required.");else Speed.Validate(validation,path+".Speed");
            ValidateAnimation(validation,path);
        }
        protected abstract void ValidateAnimation(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path);
    
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Shares component-wide manual sampling flags across independent native layers/tracks.
    /// The first writer captures baseline state; only the last writer restores it. Used by Animator
    /// and Spine players, including direct Editor preview players.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAnimationSubjectLease : IDisposable
    {
        private sealed class State { internal int Count; internal Action Restore; }
        private static readonly Dictionary<Component,State> States=new Dictionary<Component,State>();
        private readonly Component _target;private bool _disposed;
        private GameplayAnimationSubjectLease(Component target)=>_target=target;
        public static GameplayAnimationSubjectLease Acquire(Component target,Action enter,Action restore)
        {
            if(!States.TryGetValue(target,out var state)){
                enter();state=new State{Restore=restore};States.Add(target,state);
            }
            state.Count++;return new GameplayAnimationSubjectLease(target);
        }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;
            if(!States.TryGetValue(_target,out var state)||--state.Count>0)return;
            States.Remove(_target);if(_target!=null)state.Restore();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Highest eligible level band, then stable authored weights within that band.
    /// Preview/SDK sampling consumes only a captured scalar; it never advances a random stream.</summary>
    public static class GameplayAnimationVariantSelector
    {
        public static readonly GameplayTag RollKey=new GameplayTag("Data.Presentation.Animation.VariantRoll");
        public static GameplayContext Capture(GameplayContext context,IGameplayRandomSource random)
        {
            if(context.Values.TryGetValue(RollKey,out var existing)){ValidateRoll(existing);return context;}
            double roll=(random??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(random))).NextUnitInterval();
            if(!double.IsFinite(roll)||roll<0||roll>=1)throw new ArithmeticException("Animation variant roll must be in [0,1).");
            // Conversion to float can round a valid double up to 1.
            return context.WithValues(context.Values.WithValue(RollKey,Math.Min((float)roll,.99999994f)));
        }
        public static int Select<T>(IReadOnlyList<T> variants,GameplayContext context,Func<T,int> minimum,Func<T,float> weight,bool weighted)
        {
            int band=0,first=-1;
            for(int i=0;i<variants.Count;i++)if(variants[i]!=null&&minimum(variants[i])<=context.AbilityLevel&&minimum(variants[i])>band)
            {band=minimum(variants[i]);first=i;}
            if(first<0||!weighted)return first;
            context.Values.TryGetValue(RollKey,out var roll);ValidateRoll(roll);
            double total=0;int last=first;
            for(int i=0;i<variants.Count;i++)if(variants[i]!=null&&minimum(variants[i])==band)
            {float value=weight(variants[i]);if(!float.IsFinite(value)||value<=0)throw new ArithmeticException("Animation weights must be positive and finite.");total+=value;last=i;}
            double threshold=roll*total;
            for(int i=0;i<variants.Count;i++)if(variants[i]!=null&&minimum(variants[i])==band)
            {threshold-=weight(variants[i]);if(threshold<0)return i;}
            return last;
        }
        private static void ValidateRoll(float roll){if(!float.IsFinite(roll)||roll<0||roll>=1)throw new ArithmeticException("Animation variant roll must be in [0,1).");}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Reusable world-space UIWidget. Existing Core UI owns initialization/visibility and
    /// event cleanup; Core Pool owns reuse. Motion/fade is sampled by the actor's presentation driver.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayFloatingTextWidget:UIWidget,IPoolRecycleHandler
    {
        private TMP_Text _text;
        private Color _color;
        private TMP_FontAsset _font;
        private Material _material;
        internal TMP_FontAsset FontOverride { get; set; }
        public string DisplayText=>_text==null?string.Empty:_text.text;
        protected override void OnInit()
        {
            _text=GetComponentInChildren<TMP_Text>(true);if(_text==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Floating widget requires TMP text.");
            // Preview and learning scenes must not add glyphs or atlas pixels to a shared asset.
            // A pooled widget keeps its own dynamic font/atlas until the widget is destroyed.
            var source=FontOverride!=null?FontOverride:_text.font;
            if(source!=null){
                if(FontOverride!=null)_text.font=source;
                if(source.sourceFontFile!=null){
                    _font=TMP_FontAsset.CreateFontAsset(source.sourceFontFile,(int)source.faceInfo.pointSize,source.atlasPadding,source.atlasRenderMode,source.atlasWidth,source.atlasHeight,AtlasPopulationMode.Dynamic);
                }
                // TMP_FontAsset.OnDestroy destroys its atlas and material even in Static mode.
                // Borrow the immutable static font itself instead of cloning an atlas-owning object.
                var atlasTextures=_font!=null?_font.atlasTextures:source.atlasTextures;
                if(_font!=null){_font.hideFlags=HideFlags.HideAndDontSave;foreach(var atlas in atlasTextures)if(atlas!=null)atlas.hideFlags=HideFlags.HideAndDontSave;}
                _material=Instantiate(source.material);_material.hideFlags=HideFlags.HideAndDontSave;
                if(atlasTextures.Length>0)_material.mainTexture=atlasTextures[0];
                if(_font!=null){Release(_font.material);_font.material=_material;_text.font=_font;}
                _text.fontSharedMaterial=_material;
            }
        }
        protected override void OnDestroy()
        {
            base.OnDestroy();
            // Dynamic font owns its private atlas/material; static font is never destroyed here.
            if(_font!=null)Release(_font);else Release(_material);
        }
        private static void Release(UnityEngine.Object value){if(value==null)return;if(Application.isPlaying)Destroy(value);else DestroyImmediate(value);}
        protected override void OnOpen(object userData)=>OnRefresh(userData);
        protected override void OnRefresh(object userData)
        {
            if(!(userData is GameplayFloatingTextContent content))throw new ArgumentException("Floating content is required.",nameof(userData));
            _text.text=content.Text;_color=content.Color;_text.color=_color;_text.raycastTarget=false;_text.textWrappingMode=TextWrappingModes.NoWrap;
        }
        public void SetOpacity(float opacity)
        {if(_text==null)return;var color=_color;color.a*=Mathf.Clamp01(opacity);_text.color=color;}
        public void OnRecycleToPool(){SetVisible(false);if(_text!=null)_text.text=string.Empty;}
    }
    public readonly struct GameplayFloatingTextContent
    {
        public string Text {get;}
        public Color Color {get;}
        public GameplayFloatingTextContent(string text,Color color){Text=text;Color=color;}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Adapts the existing FRFrame Core/Fsm. Explicit aliases preserve host transition policy.
    /// Borrowed controllers are neither destroyed nor ticked unless the caller requests it.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayFsmBehaviourAdapter : IGameplayBehaviourDriver
    {
        private readonly FsmController _controller;
        private readonly Dictionary<string,Type> _states;
        private readonly bool _advance, _ownsController;
        private bool _disposed;
        public string CurrentState => _controller.CurrentStateName;
        public GameplayFsmBehaviourAdapter(FsmController controller, IReadOnlyDictionary<string,Type> states,
            bool advanceWithWorld=false, bool ownsController=false)
        {
            _controller=controller??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(controller));
            if(controller.IsDisposed)throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(controller));
            if(states==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(states));
            _states=new Dictionary<string,Type>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
            foreach(var state in states)
            {
                if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(state.Key)||state.Value==null||!controller.TryGetState(state.Value,out _))
                    throw new ArgumentException("Every state alias must reference a registered host state.",nameof(states));
                _states.Add(state.Key,state.Value);
            }
            _advance=advanceWithWorld;_ownsController=ownsController;
        }
        public bool TryChangeState(string state)
            => !_disposed && !_controller.IsDisposed && state!=null && _states.TryGetValue(state,out var type) && _controller.ChangeState(type);
        public void Advance(float amount)
        {
            if(!float.IsFinite(amount)||amount<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(amount));
            if(!_disposed&&_advance)_controller.Update(amount,amount);
        }
        public void Dispose(){if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;if(_ownsController)_controller.Dispose();}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    [Serializable,Preserve]
    public sealed class GameplayPlayAnimationActionAuthoring:GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
    {
        public GameplayAnimationAsset Animation;
        public bool Queue;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)=>validation.Asset(Animation,path+".Animation");
        public override void ValidateReferences(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation,string path)=>validation.Asset(Animation,path+".Animation");
        public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)=>new Action(context.ResolveDefinition(Animation, this, nameof(Animation), () => Animation.Build(context)),Queue);
        private sealed class Action:IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            private readonly GameplayAnimationDefinition _definition;
            private readonly bool _queue;
            internal Action(GameplayAnimationDefinition definition,bool queue){_definition=definition;_queue=queue;}
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
            {
                if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
                if(!(actor.Presentation is GameplayUnityAnimationController controller))
                {
                    actor.RecordSkillTrace(new GameplaySkillTraceRecord(actor.Id,context,triggerEvent.EventTag,
                        GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionRejected,"AnimationRejected",detail:"PresentationControllerMissing"));
                    return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
                }
                // Presentation priority is not a combat gate. Skill eligibility belongs to Ability tags/conditions.
                if(_queue)controller.TryQueue(_definition,context);else controller.TryPlay(_definition,context);return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Game-side temporary Workbench installations. Disposal restores configuration, level and
    /// passive engagement, not the interrupted cast, cooldown, charges or elapsed effect state.</summary>
    public class GameplaySkillOverrides
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<(GameplayStandardActor actor,int id),Slot> _slots=new Dictionary<(GameplayStandardActor,int),Slot>();

        /// <summary>Build and validate the source before calling. A stale lease cannot remove a newer
        /// installation; a failed replacement reinstalls the previously engaged configuration.</summary>
        public Lease Install(GameplayStandardActor actor,GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition definition,int level)
        {
            if(actor==null||actor.IsDisposed)throw new ArgumentException("An active scene actor is required.");
            if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if(level<1||level>definition.Ability.MaxLevel)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(level));
            var key=(actor,definition.SkillId);
            if(!_slots.TryGetValue(key,out var slot)||!slot.OwnsCurrent){
                slot=new Slot(actor,definition.SkillId,()=>{if(_slots.TryGetValue(key,out var current)&&ReferenceEquals(current,slot))_slots.Remove(key);});_slots[key]=slot;
            }
            return slot.Install(definition,level);
        }

        /// <summary>The current installation of this lease, including restoration after a nested override.
        /// Suspended leases expose a disposed skill and cannot cast until restored.</summary>
        public sealed class Lease:IDisposable
        {
            private readonly Slot _slot;
            internal Snapshot Saved;
            internal bool Released;
            public GameplayInstalledSkill Skill {get;internal set;}
            internal Lease(Slot slot,Snapshot saved){_slot=slot;Saved=saved;}
            public void Dispose(){if(Released)return;Released=true;_slot.Release(this);}
        }

        internal sealed class Snapshot
        {
            internal GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition Definition;
            internal int Level;
            internal bool PassiveActive;
            internal static Snapshot Capture(GameplayInstalledSkill skill)=>skill==null?null:new Snapshot{
                Definition=skill.Definition,
                Level=skill.Actor.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot().Single(s=>s.Handle==skill.Grant).Level,
                PassiveActive=skill.Actor.Abilities.IsActive(skill.Grant)};
            internal GameplayInstalledSkill Restore(GameplayStandardActor actor)=>actor.InstallDocument(Definition,Level,PassiveActive);
        }
        internal sealed class Slot
        {
            private readonly GameplayStandardActor _actor;
            private readonly int _id;
            private readonly Action _forget;
            private readonly Snapshot _baseline;
            private readonly List<Lease> _leases=new List<Lease>();
            private GameplayInstalledSkill Current=>_actor.InstalledSkills.FirstOrDefault(s=>s.Definition.SkillId==_id);
            internal bool OwnsCurrent=>_leases.Count==0||ReferenceEquals(Current,_leases[_leases.Count-1].Skill);
            internal Slot(GameplayStandardActor actor,int id,Action forget){_actor=actor;_id=id;_forget=forget;_baseline=Snapshot.Capture(Current);}
            internal Lease Install(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition definition,int level)
            {
                var previous=Snapshot.Capture(Current);
                if(_leases.Count>0)_leases[_leases.Count-1].Saved=previous;
                Current?.Dispose();
                var lease=new Lease(this,new Snapshot{Definition=definition,Level=level,PassiveActive=true});
                try{lease.Skill=lease.Saved.Restore(_actor);}
                catch{
                    if(previous!=null){var restored=previous.Restore(_actor);if(_leases.Count>0)_leases[_leases.Count-1].Skill=restored;}
                    if(_leases.Count==0)_forget();
                    throw;
                }
                _leases.Add(lease);return lease;
            }
            internal void Release(Lease lease)
            {
                if(_leases.Count==0||!ReferenceEquals(_leases[_leases.Count-1],lease))return;
                bool owns=OwnsCurrent;
                while(_leases.Count>0&&_leases[_leases.Count-1].Released)_leases.RemoveAt(_leases.Count-1);
                if(owns&&!_actor.IsDisposed){
                    lease.Skill.Dispose();
                    var saved=_leases.Count>0?_leases[_leases.Count-1].Saved:_baseline;
                    if(saved!=null){var restored=saved.Restore(_actor);if(_leases.Count>0)_leases[_leases.Count-1].Skill=restored;}
                }
                if(_leases.Count==0)_forget();
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Debugging;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Detached inspection of the actual world/container state. Capture never advances,
    /// publishes events or rebuilds Definitions; reusable by game-owned hosts and the default Unity host.</summary>
    public static class GameplayStandardDebugSnapshot
    {
        public static IReadOnlyList<GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot> Units(GameplayStandardWorld world,string group="Standard")
        {
            var result=new List<GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot>();if(world==null)return result.AsReadOnly();
            var spatial=world.GetSpatialSnapshot();
            foreach(var actor in world.Actors){
                var attributes=actor.Attributes.GetEntriesSnapshot().Select(a=>a.Id+" = "+a.CurrentValue);
                var resourceIds=new HashSet<GameplayAttributeId>(actor.Attributes.GetEntriesSnapshot().Select(a=>a.Id));
                if(actor.CombatAttributes!=null){resourceIds.Add(actor.CombatAttributes.Health);resourceIds.Add(actor.CombatAttributes.MaxHealth);resourceIds.Add(actor.CombatAttributes.Shield);}
                var resources=new List<string>();foreach(var id in resourceIds.OrderBy(id=>id.ToString()))if(id.IsValid&&actor.Resources.TryGetBalance(id,out float balance))resources.Add(id+" Balance="+balance);
                var skills=actor.InstalledSkills.Select(s=>"SkillId="+s.Definition.SkillId+" Phase="+s.Status.Phase+" LastActivation="+(s.LastCastContext?.ActivationSourceId.ToString()??"None"));
                var tags=actor.Tags.GetContributionsSnapshot().Select(t=>t.ExactTag+" / SourceIds="+string.Join(",",t.SourceIds));
                var effects=actor.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Select(e=>"Handle="+e.Handle.LocalSequence+" SourceId="+e.SourceId+" Root="+(e.ApplicationContext?.OriginSourceId.ToString()??"None")+" Level="+(e.ApplicationContext?.AbilityLevel.ToString()??"None")+
                    " Stack="+e.StackCount+" Remaining="+(e.Remaining?.ToString("0.###")??"Infinite")+" Period="+(e.PeriodRemaining?.ToString("0.###")??"None")+" Tags="+string.Join(",",e.Definition.GrantedTags));
                var abilities=actor.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot().Select(a=>"Grant="+a.Handle.LocalSequence+" Level="+a.Level+" Phase="+a.Status.Phase+" CD="+a.Status.CooldownRemaining+" Charge="+a.Status.CurrentCharges+" Recharge="+a.Status.RechargeRemaining+" OwnedEffects="+a.OwnedEffectsCount+" Layers="+a.OwnedLayersCount+" Lifetimes="+a.OwnedLifetimesCount);
                var sequences=actor.Sequences.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Select(s=>"Handle="+s.Handle.LocalSequence+" SourceId="+s.Context.EffectiveSourceId+" Elapsed="+s.Elapsed+" Next="+s.NextMarkerIndex+" / Time="+s.NextMarkerTime);
                var operations=new List<string>();foreach(var operation in spatial)if(ReferenceEquals(operation.Owner,actor)){
                    string line=operation.GetType().Name+" SourceId="+operation.Id+" Root="+operation.Context.OriginSourceId+" Activation="+operation.Context.ActivationSourceId+" Level="+operation.Context.AbilityLevel+" Position=("+operation.Position.X+","+operation.Position.Y+","+operation.Position.Z+")";
                    if(operation is GameplayProjectile projectile)line+=" Hits="+projectile.HitCount+" Distance="+projectile.DistanceTravelled;
                    if(operation is GameplayAreaOperation area)line+=" Inside="+area.InsideCount+" Armed="+area.IsArmed+" Triggers="+area.TriggerCount;
                    operations.Add(line);
                }
                var trace=actor.SkillTrace.Snapshot().Select(t=>t.order+" "+t.record.Stage+" "+t.record.Operation+"["+t.record.ActionIndex+"] Event="+t.record.EventTag+
                    (t.record.Context==null?"":" SourceId="+t.record.Context.EffectiveSourceId+" Root="+t.record.Context.OriginSourceId+" Activation="+t.record.Context.ActivationSourceId+" Level="+t.record.Context.AbilityLevel)+
                    (t.record.Source.IsValid?" SourceAsset="+Uri.EscapeDataString(t.record.Source.DefinitionId)+" NodeId="+t.record.Source.NodeId+" SourceDocument="+Uri.EscapeDataString(t.record.Source.DocumentId??""):"")+" "+t.record.Detail);
                result.Add(new GameplayDebugUnitSnapshot(actor.Id,group+" / Actor "+actor.Id,group,new[]{
                    new GameplayDebugSection("Attributes",attributes),new GameplayDebugSection("Resources",resources),new GameplayDebugSection("Skills",skills),new GameplayDebugSection("Tags / Sources",tags),new GameplayDebugSection("Effects",effects),new GameplayDebugSection("Abilities",abilities),
                    new GameplayDebugSection("Sequences",sequences),new GameplayDebugSection("Spatial / Aura",operations),new GameplayDebugSection("Skill Trace"+(actor.SkillTrace.Enabled?"":" (disabled)"),trace),
                    new GameplayDebugSection("Combat",new[]{actor.LastCombatOutcome.HasValue?actor.LastCombatOutcome.Value.Kind+" applied="+actor.LastCombatOutcome.Value.Applied:"No committed result"})}));
            }
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Official scene binding to the neutral actor composition. Profile/skill assets are built
    /// once; mutable state stays in Actor. Supplied collider centres are the canonical query anchor.</summary>
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(-900)]
    public sealed class GameplayUnityActorBinding : MonoBehaviour
    {
        public GameplayUnityWorldHost Host;
        public GameplayActorProfileAsset Profile;
        public GameplayFloatingTextAsset FloatingText;
        public GameplaySkillDocumentAsset[] Skills = Array.Empty<GameplaySkillDocumentAsset>();
        public int Faction;
        public Vector3 Facing = Vector3.right;
        public Collider2D Body2D;
        public Collider Body3D;
        public GameplayStandardActor Actor { get; private set; }
        private void Start()
        {
            if (Host == null || Host.World == null || Profile == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Actor requires its world and formal profile.");
            var build = new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
            Actor = Host.World.CreateActor(ReadPosition(), Faction, gameObject.layer, ReadPosition, WritePosition, ReadFacing, WriteFacing);
            try
            {
                Profile.Build(build).Initialize(Actor);
                Actor.Presentation = new GameplayUnityAnimationController(Actor,gameObject){FloatingText=FloatingText==null?null:FloatingText.Build(build)};
                Actor.Facing = new Extensions.GameplayDirection(Facing.x, Facing.y, Facing.z);
                foreach (var skill in Skills) { if (skill == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Skill document binding is missing."); Actor.InstallDocument(skill.Build(build)); }
            }
            catch { Actor.Dispose(); Actor = null; throw; }
        }
        private GameplayPoint ReadPosition()
        {
            Vector3 position = Body3D != null ? Body3D.bounds.center : Body2D != null ? Body2D.bounds.center : transform.position;
            return new GameplayPoint(position.x, position.y, position.z);
        }
        private void Update()
        {
            if (Actor == null) return;
            Actor.Layer = gameObject.layer;
            Actor.Facing = new Extensions.GameplayDirection(Facing.x, Facing.y, Facing.z);
        }
        private void WritePosition(GameplayPoint point)
        {
            var anchor = ReadPosition();
            transform.position += new Vector3(point.X-anchor.X,point.Y-anchor.Y,point.Z-anchor.Z);
        }
        private Extensions.GameplayDirection ReadFacing()=>new Extensions.GameplayDirection(Facing.x,Facing.y,Facing.z);
        private void WriteFacing(Extensions.GameplayDirection direction)
        {
            Facing=new Vector3(direction.X,direction.Y,direction.Z);
            if(Body3D!=null)transform.rotation=Quaternion.LookRotation(Facing,Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(Facing,Vector3.up))>.99f?Vector3.forward:Vector3.up);
            else transform.rotation=Quaternion.Euler(0,0,Mathf.Atan2(Facing.y,Facing.x)*Mathf.Rad2Deg);
        }
        /// <summary>Attaches a game's already registered actor without creating any containers/clock.</summary>
        public void BindExisting(GameplayStandardActor actor) { if (Actor != null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Actor already bound."); Actor = actor ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actor)); enabled = false; }
        /// <summary>Detaches only this borrowed binding before its pooled view is reused. Actor
        /// disposal remains the owner's responsibility; form/scene bindings cannot be stolen.</summary>
        public void UnbindExisting(GameplayStandardActor actor)
        {if(enabled||!ReferenceEquals(Actor,actor))throw new InvalidOperationException("Existing actor binding mismatch.");Actor=null;}
        private void OnDestroy() { if (enabled) Actor?.Dispose(); Actor = null; }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring.Graph;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Animations;
using UnityEngine.Playables;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Actual Animator state or manual Playables clip. The subject may render sprites or
    /// meshes; the same definition and clip are used for preview and Runtime. Movement remains a rule action.</summary>
    [CreateAssetMenu(menuName="FRFrame/Gameplay/Animation/Animator or Playables")]
    public sealed class GameplayUnityAnimationAsset:GameplayAnimationAsset
    {
        public PlaybackBackend Backend;

        public GameObject PreviewPrefab;

        public AnimationClip Clip;

        public string StateName;

        public int Layer;

        [Min(0)]public float BlendDuration;

        public LevelVariant[] Variants=Array.Empty<LevelVariant>();

        public bool WeightedVariants;

        public enum PlaybackBackend { AnimatorState, PlayablesClip }

        [Serializable] public sealed class LevelVariant { public int MinimumLevel=1; public AnimationClip Clip; public string StateName; public float Weight=1; }
        public override GameplayLocalDefinitionPayload CaptureGraphValues() => CaptureValues();
        private GameplayUnityAnimationData CaptureValues() => new GameplayUnityAnimationData { Backend = Backend, PreviewPrefab = PreviewPrefab, Clip = Clip, StateName = StateName, Layer = Layer, BlendDuration = BlendDuration, Variants = Variants, WeightedVariants = WeightedVariants, Channel = Channel, Priority = Priority, Loop = Loop, RestorePrevious = RestorePrevious, Speed = Speed };
        public override string BackendName => CaptureValues().BackendName;
        public override GameObject CreatePreviewSubject() => CaptureValues().CreatePreviewSubject();
        protected override GameplayAnimationDefinition CreateDefinition(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) => CaptureValues().Build(context);
        protected override void ValidateAnimation(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) => CaptureValues().Validate(validation, path);

    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Per-actor presentation only. Higher priority preempts; equal priority is an explicit
    /// replay; lower priority is ignored. Uses the existing host delta, samples before new markers,
    /// and joins the exact cast lifetime. No rule container or second gameplay clock is created.</summary>
    public sealed partial class GameplayUnityAnimationController : IGameplayPresentationDriver
    {
        public GameplayStandardActor Actor { get; }
        public GameObject Subject { get; }
        /// <summary>Presentation-only variant stream. Kept separate from World combat randomness;
        /// explicit captured RollKey inputs bypass it and are shared with Editor preview.</summary>
        public IGameplayRandomSource AnimationRandom {get;set;}=new GameplaySeededRandomSource(1);
        private readonly Dictionary<string,Playback> _channels = new Dictionary<string,Playback>();
        private static readonly HashSet<Playback> PhysicalPlayers=new HashSet<Playback>();
        private static readonly HashSet<GameplayUnityAnimationController> Controllers=new HashSet<GameplayUnityAnimationController>();
        private static int ReplacingPhysicalPlayers;
        private bool _disposed;
        /// <summary>Observable presentation refusal; does not change combat eligibility or cost.</summary>
        public string LastAnimationRejection {get;private set;}
        public event Action<GameplayContext,string> AnimationRejected;
        private bool RejectAnimation(GameplayAnimationDefinition definition,GameplayContext context,string reason)
        {
            LastAnimationRejection=$"{reason}; source={context?.EffectiveSourceId}; channel={definition.Channel}; priority={definition.Priority}";
            Actor.RecordSkillTrace(new GameplaySkillTraceRecord(Actor.Id,context,default,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionRejected,
                "AnimationRejected",detail:LastAnimationRejection));
            if(AnimationRejected!=null)foreach(Action<GameplayContext,string> observer in AnimationRejected.GetInvocationList())
                try{observer(context,LastAnimationRejection);}catch{ /* Diagnostics cannot gate gameplay. */ }
            return false;
        }
        public GameplayUnityAnimationController(GameplayStandardActor actor,GameObject subject)
        {Actor=actor??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actor));Subject=subject!=null?subject:throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(subject));Actor.CombatChanged+=OnFloatingCombat;Controllers.Add(this);}
        public bool TryPlay(GameplayAnimationDefinition definition,GameplayContext context)
        {
            if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if(_disposed||Actor.IsDisposed)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"OwnerDisposed");
            if(Subject==null)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"SubjectMissing");
            if(context==null||!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(Actor,context,out var grant))return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"ActiveGrantMissing");
            if(_channels.TryGetValue(definition.Channel,out var previous)&&previous.Priority>definition.Priority)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"PriorityDenied by "+previous.Priority);
            GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] writes;
            try{writes=definition.ResolveWrites(Subject);}catch(Exception ex){return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"PhysicalTargetMissing: "+ex.Message);}
            var conflicts=new List<Playback>();
            foreach(var existing in PhysicalPlayers)
                if(existing.Owner==this&&existing.Channel==definition.Channel||Conflicts(existing.Writes,writes))
                {
                    if(existing.Priority>definition.Priority)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"PhysicalPriorityDenied by "+existing.Channel+"/"+existing.Priority+" on "+string.Join(",",Array.ConvertAll(writes,w=>w.ToString())));
                    conflicts.Add(existing);
                }
            var application=PresentationValueContext(context);
            float speed=GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(definition.Speed,application);
            if(!float.IsFinite(speed)||speed<=0)throw new ArithmeticException("Animation speed must be positive.");
            if(definition.CaptureVariantRoll)context=GameplayAnimationVariantSelector.Capture(context,AnimationRandom);
            // Preflight factory before replacing a valid clip. A malformed resource cannot erase the previous channel.
            IGameplayAnimationPlayer player;
            try {player=definition.Create(Subject,context);}
            catch(Exception ex){RejectAnimation(definition,context,"BackendOrResourceFailure: "+ex.Message);throw;}
            if(player==null){RejectAnimation(definition,context,"BackendUnsupported: no player");throw new InvalidOperationException("Animation backend returned no real player.");}
            if(!float.IsFinite(player.Duration)||player.Duration<=0){player.Dispose();RejectAnimation(definition,context,"InvalidResourceDuration");throw new InvalidOperationException("Animation duration must be positive.");}
            _replacingChannels.Add(definition.Channel);
            ReplacingPhysicalPlayers++;
            foreach(var conflict in conflicts)_replacingChannels.Add(conflict.Channel);
            try{foreach(var conflict in conflicts)conflict.Dispose();}
            finally{_replacingChannels.Clear();ReplacingPhysicalPlayers--;}
            var playback=new Playback(this,definition.Channel,definition.Priority,context,grant,player,speed,writes);
            _channels[definition.Channel]=playback;
            PhysicalPlayers.Add(playback);
            if(!Actor.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(grant,playback)){playback.Dispose();return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"GrantLifetimeEnded");}
            try {player.Seek(0);PromoteQueue(definition.Channel);return true;}catch{playback.Dispose();throw;}
        }
        public void Advance(float amount)
        {
            if(_disposed)return;
            if(!float.IsFinite(amount)||amount<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(amount));
            var cues=_cues.ToArray();
            var floating=_floating.ToArray();
            foreach(var playback in new List<Playback>(_channels.Values))playback.Advance(amount);
            foreach(var cue in cues)cue.Advance(amount);
            foreach(var text in floating)text.Advance(amount);
            FlushCombatText();
            _ownedAudio?.Update(amount,amount);
        }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;
            Controllers.Remove(this);
            Actor.CombatChanged-=OnFloatingCombat;
            _pendingCombatText.Clear();
            foreach(var playback in new List<Playback>(_channels.Values))playback.Dispose();_channels.Clear();
            DisposeQueues();
            foreach(var cue in _cues.ToArray())cue.Dispose();
            foreach(var text in _floating.ToArray())text.Dispose();
            _ownedPool?.ClearAll();_ownedAudio?.Destroy();
        }
        private sealed class Playback:IDisposable
        {
            private readonly GameplayUnityAnimationController _owner;
            private readonly string _channel;
            private readonly GameplayContext _context;
            private readonly GameplayAbilityHandle _grant;
            private readonly IGameplayAnimationPlayer _player;
            private readonly float _speed;
            private double _elapsed;
            private bool _disposed;
            internal int Priority { get; }
            internal string Channel=>_channel;
            internal GameplayUnityAnimationController Owner=>_owner;
            internal GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] Writes {get;}
            internal Playback(GameplayUnityAnimationController owner,string channel,int priority,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,IGameplayAnimationPlayer player,float speed,GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] writes)
            {_owner=owner;_channel=channel;Priority=priority;_context=context;_grant=grant;_player=player;_speed=speed;Writes=writes;_player.AnimationEvent+=OnEvent;}
            private void OnEvent(string name)
            {
                if(_disposed)return;
                // Native event names are exposed through a typed signal for actual game/definition event mapping.
                _owner.AnimationEvent?.Invoke(_context,name);
            }
            internal void Advance(float delta)
            {
                if(_disposed)return;
                if(_player.IsInterrupted){Dispose();return;}
                _elapsed+=(double)delta*_speed;
                float time=(float)Math.Min(float.MaxValue,_elapsed);
                // Looping backends receive absolute time so they can preserve event crossings.
                _player.Seek(_player.Loop?time:Math.Min(time,_player.Duration));
                if(!_player.Loop&&_elapsed>=_player.Duration)Dispose();
            }
            public void Dispose()
            {
                if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;_player.AnimationEvent-=OnEvent;
                if(_owner._channels.TryGetValue(_channel,out var current)&&ReferenceEquals(current,this))_owner._channels.Remove(_channel);
                PhysicalPlayers.Remove(this);
                _owner.Actor.Abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(_grant,this);_player.Dispose();

            }
        }
        public event Action<GameplayContext,string> AnimationEvent;
        private static bool Conflicts(GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] a,GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] b)
        {foreach(var first in a)foreach(var second in b)if(first.Conflicts(second))return true;return false;}
        private GameplayEffectApplicationContext PresentationValueContext(GameplayContext context)
        {
            var target=Actor;
            if(!context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget)context=context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(Actor.Id,context.TargetData.HasPoint?(GameplayPoint?)context.TargetData.Point:null));
            if(context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget&&!Actor.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId,out target))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Presentation value target is not present in this world.");
            return new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context,target,context.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(),Actor.Attributes,Actor.Id,instigatorTarget:Actor);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using TMPro;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Presentation policy for committed combat outcomes on this actor.</summary>
    public enum GameplayCombatTextMode
    {
        [InspectorName("自动 · 技能显式优先")] AutomaticWithOverrides,
        [InspectorName("仅技能显式")] ExplicitOnly,
        [InspectorName("关闭反馈")] Disabled
    }

    public sealed partial class GameplayUnityAnimationController
    {
        private readonly List<FloatingLease> _floating=new List<FloatingLease>();
        private readonly List<(GameplayCombatOutcome Outcome, bool Shown)> _pendingCombatText =
            new List<(GameplayCombatOutcome, bool)>();
        /// <summary>Automatic feedback fills unclaimed outcomes at the next presentation step.</summary>
        public GameplayCombatTextMode CombatTextMode { get; set; }
        /// <summary>Fallback style for automatic feedback when the selector has no style.</summary>
        public GameplayFloatingTextDefinition FloatingText {get;set;}
        /// <summary>Optional game-side resource selection over a committed outcome, never a rule or clock.</summary>
        public Func<GameplayCombatOutcome,GameplayFloatingTextDefinition> FloatingTextSelector {get;set;}
        /// <summary>Optional host font for text the authored prefab font cannot render.</summary>
        public TMP_FontAsset FloatingTextFallbackFont {get;set;}
        public Camera FloatingTextCamera {get;set;}
        public int ActiveFloatingTextCount=>_floating.Count;
        private void OnFloatingCombat(GameplayCombatOutcome outcome)
        {
            _pendingCombatText.Add((outcome, false));
        }

        // Only a current, still pending result may be claimed. Independent commits stay in
        // the queue even when an authored action claims the last result on this actor.
        internal bool TryShowAuthoredCombatText(GameplayFloatingTextDefinition definition, GameplayContext context)
        {
            if (!Actor.LastCombatOutcome.HasValue) return false;
            var outcome = Actor.LastCombatOutcome.Value;
            if (!ReferenceEquals(outcome.ExecutionContext, context) ||
                outcome.Context.EffectiveSourceId != context.EffectiveSourceId ||
                outcome.Context.OriginSourceId != context.OriginSourceId ||
                outcome.Context.ActivationSourceId != context.ActivationSourceId) return false;

            for (int i = _pendingCombatText.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                var pending = _pendingCombatText[i];
                if (!ReferenceEquals(pending.Outcome.Context, outcome.Context) || !pending.Outcome.Equals(outcome)) continue;
                if (pending.Shown || CombatTextMode == GameplayCombatTextMode.Disabled) return true;
                if (!ShowFloatingText(definition, outcome)) return false;
                _pendingCombatText[i] = (outcome, true);
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        private void FlushCombatText()
        {
            if (CombatTextMode == GameplayCombatTextMode.AutomaticWithOverrides)
                foreach (var pending in _pendingCombatText)
                {
                    if (pending.Shown) continue;
                    try
                    {
                        var definition = FloatingTextSelector?.Invoke(pending.Outcome) ?? FloatingText;
                        if (definition != null) ShowFloatingText(definition, pending.Outcome);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex) { Debug.LogException(ex, Subject); }
                }
            _pendingCombatText.Clear();
        }
        /// <summary>Actor-owned short feedback over an already committed outcome. It can outlive
        /// the instigator cast; target disposal and presentation disposal always release it.</summary>
        public bool ShowFloatingText(GameplayFloatingTextDefinition definition,GameplayCombatOutcome outcome)
        {
            if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if(outcome.Context==null)throw new ArgumentException("Committed feedback context required.",nameof(outcome));
            if(_disposed||Subject==null||Actor.IsDisposed||outcome.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId!=Actor.Id)return false;
            if(definition.SuppressEmptyHealing&&outcome.Kind==GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Heal&&outcome.Applied==0)return false;
            var content=definition.Format(outcome);
            TMP_FontAsset fontOverride=null;
            if(FloatingTextFallbackFont!=null&&!string.IsNullOrEmpty(content.Text))
            {
                var font=definition.Prefab.GetComponentInChildren<TMP_Text>(true).font;
                foreach(char character in content.Text)
                    if(font==null||!font.HasCharacter(character,true))
                    {
                        fontOverride=FloatingTextFallbackFont;
                        break;
                    }
            }
            var pool=SpatialViewPool;
            string viewId=definition.Prefab.GetInstanceID().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            if(fontOverride!=null)viewId+="/"+fontOverride.GetInstanceID().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
            var key=new ResourceKey("Gameplay.FloatingText",viewId);
            var view=pool.GetOrCreate(key,definition.Prefab.name,definition.Prefab);
            try
            {
                foreach(var child in view.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true))child.gameObject.layer=Subject.layer;
                var anchor=string.IsNullOrEmpty(definition.Binding)?Subject.transform:Subject.transform.Find(definition.Binding)??Subject.transform;
                view.transform.SetParent(definition.Follow&&!definition.Point.HasValue?anchor:null,false);view.transform.position=(definition.Point??anchor.position)+definition.Offset+Vector3.up*(_floating.Count*.5f);
                var widget=view.GetComponent<GameplayFloatingTextWidget>();
                widget.FontOverride=fontOverride;
                widget.OpenStandalone(content);

                if(camera!=null){view.transform.rotation=camera.transform.rotation;var canvas=view.GetComponent<Canvas>();if(canvas!=null)canvas.worldCamera=camera;}
                _floating.Add(new FloatingLease(this,pool,key,view,widget,definition));return true;
            }
            catch{pool.Release(key,definition.Prefab.name,view);throw;}
        }
        private sealed class FloatingLease:IDisposable
        {
            private readonly GameplayUnityAnimationController _owner;private readonly GameObjectPoolModule _pool;private readonly ResourceKey _key;
            private readonly GameObject _view;private readonly GameplayFloatingTextWidget _widget;private readonly GameplayFloatingTextDefinition _definition;
            private readonly Vector3 _start;private double _age;private bool _disposed;
            private Vector3 _velocity,_travel;
            internal FloatingLease(GameplayUnityAnimationController owner,GameObjectPoolModule pool,ResourceKey key,GameObject view,GameplayFloatingTextWidget widget,GameplayFloatingTextDefinition definition)
            {_owner=owner;_pool=pool;_key=key;_view=view;_widget=widget;_definition=definition;_start=definition.Follow&&!definition.Point.HasValue?view.transform.localPosition:view.transform.position;
                var spread=definition.VelocitySpread;_velocity=Vector3.up*definition.RiseSpeed+new Vector3(UnityEngine.Random.Range(-spread.x,spread.x),UnityEngine.Random.Range(-spread.y,spread.y),UnityEngine.Random.Range(-spread.z,spread.z));}
            internal void Advance(float amount)
            {
                if(_disposed)return;if(_view==null||_owner.Actor.IsDisposed){Dispose();return;}
                double next=Math.Min(_definition.Duration,_age+amount);float step=(float)(next-_age);_age=next;
                _velocity+=_definition.Acceleration*step;_travel+=_velocity*step;var position=_start+_travel;
                if(_definition.Follow&&!_definition.Point.HasValue)_view.transform.localPosition=position;else _view.transform.position=position;
                _widget.SetOpacity(Mathf.Clamp01((1-(float)(_age/_definition.Duration))/(1-_definition.FadeStartRatio)));
                if(_age>=_definition.Duration)Dispose();
            }
            public void Dispose()
            {if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;_owner._floating.Remove(this);if(_view!=null)_pool.Release(_key,_definition.Prefab.name,_view);}
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    public sealed partial class GameplayUnityAnimationController
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string,List<QueuedPlayback>> _queues=new Dictionary<string,List<QueuedPlayback>>();
        private readonly HashSet<string> _replacingChannels=new HashSet<string>();
        private static long _queueOrder;
        private static bool _promotingQueues;
        /// <summary>Queued source factory failures are observable; a bad request is released, and
        /// the next surviving request may start. No gameplay hit/cost is driven by this event.</summary>
        public event Action<GameplayContext,string> AnimationQueueFailed;
        public int QueuedCount {get{int count=0;foreach(var queue in _queues.Values)count+=queue.Count;return count;}}
        /// <summary>FIFO on the authored channel, bound to the request's exact active cast. Native
        /// resources are acquired only when promoted. A looping current playback needs explicit replay/cancel.
        /// Each channel is bounded to 32 requests so authoring mistakes cannot accumulate indefinitely.</summary>
        public bool TryQueue(GameplayAnimationDefinition definition,GameplayContext context)
        {
            if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if(_disposed||Actor.IsDisposed)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"OwnerDisposed");
            if(Subject==null)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"SubjectMissing");
            if(context==null||!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(Actor,context,out var grant))return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"ActiveGrantMissing");
            GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] writes;
            try{writes=definition.ResolveWrites(Subject);}catch(Exception ex){return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"PhysicalTargetMissing: "+ex.Message);}
            bool occupied=_channels.ContainsKey(definition.Channel);
            foreach(var playback in PhysicalPlayers)occupied|=Conflicts(playback.Writes,writes);
            occupied|=EarlierQueuedConflict(writes,long.MaxValue);
            if(!occupied)return TryPlay(definition,context);
            if(!_queues.TryGetValue(definition.Channel,out var queue)){queue=new List<QueuedPlayback>();_queues.Add(definition.Channel,queue);}
            if(queue.Count>=32)return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"QueueFull (32)");
            if(definition.CaptureVariantRoll)context=GameplayAnimationVariantSelector.Capture(context,AnimationRandom);
            var request=new QueuedPlayback(this,definition,context,grant,++_queueOrder);queue.Add(request);
            if(!Actor.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(grant,request)){request.Dispose();return RejectAnimation(definition,context,"GrantLifetimeEnded");}PromoteQueue(definition.Channel);return true;
        }
        private static bool EarlierQueuedConflict(GameplayAnimationWriteTarget[] writes,long order)
        {
            foreach(var controller in Controllers)foreach(var queue in controller._queues.Values)foreach(var request in queue)
                if(request.Order<order&&GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(controller.Actor,request.Context,out _)){
                    try{if(Conflicts(request.Definition.ResolveWrites(controller.Subject),writes))return true;}
                    catch{ /* Invalid targets are diagnosed and released when their channel head promotes. */ }
                }
            return false;
        }
        private void PromoteQueue(string channel)
        {
            if(ReplacingPhysicalPlayers>0||_promotingQueues)return;
            _promotingQueues=true;
            try
            {
                bool changed;
                do
                {
                    changed=false;
                    var fronts=new List<QueuedPlayback>();foreach(var controller in Controllers)foreach(var queue in controller._queues.Values)if(queue.Count>0)fronts.Add(queue[0]);
                    fronts.Sort((a,b)=>a.Order.CompareTo(b.Order));
                    foreach(var request in fronts)
                    {
                        var owner=request.Owner;
                        if(!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(owner.Actor,request.Context,out _)){request.Dispose();changed=true;continue;}
                        try
                        {
                            var writes=request.Definition.ResolveWrites(owner.Subject);
                            bool occupied=owner._channels.ContainsKey(request.Definition.Channel);
                            foreach(var playback in PhysicalPlayers)occupied|=Conflicts(playback.Writes,writes);
                            occupied|=EarlierQueuedConflict(writes,request.Order);
                            if(occupied)continue;
                            request.Dispose();changed=true;owner.TryPlay(request.Definition,request.Context);
                        }
                        catch(Exception ex){request.Dispose();changed=true;owner.RejectAnimation(request.Definition,request.Context,"QueueBackendFailure: "+ex.Message);owner.AnimationQueueFailed?.Invoke(request.Context,ex.Message);}
                    }
                }while(changed);
            }
            finally{_promotingQueues=false;}
        }
        private void DisposeQueues()
        {
            var requests=new List<QueuedPlayback>();foreach(var queue in _queues.Values)requests.AddRange(queue);
            foreach(var request in requests)request.Dispose();_queues.Clear();
        }
        private sealed class QueuedPlayback:IDisposable
        {
            private readonly GameplayUnityAnimationController _owner;
            private readonly GameplayAbilityHandle _grant;
            private bool _disposed;
            internal GameplayAnimationDefinition Definition {get;}
            internal GameplayContext Context {get;}
            internal long Order {get;}
            internal GameplayUnityAnimationController Owner=>_owner;
            internal QueuedPlayback(GameplayUnityAnimationController owner,GameplayAnimationDefinition definition,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,long order)
            {_owner=owner;Definition=definition;Context=context;_grant=grant;Order=order;}
            public void Dispose()
            {
                if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;
                if(_owner._queues.TryGetValue(Definition.Channel,out var queue)){queue.Remove(this);if(queue.Count==0)_owner._queues.Remove(Definition.Channel);}
                _owner.Actor.Abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(_grant,this);
            }
        }
    }
}
````
