````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Real Physics2D broadphase followed by the exact same centre geometry/filter used by
    /// the logical backend. Collider ownership resolution is injected or uses the official actor binding.
    /// Duplicate colliders never duplicate targets; there is no independent rule Update.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayPhysics2DBackend : IGameplaySpatialQueryBackend
    {
        private readonly GameplayStandardWorld _world;
        private readonly Func<Collider2D, IGameplaySpatialActor> _resolve;
        private readonly bool _useColliderGeometry;
        /// <param name="useColliderGeometry">Opt in when a presentation's actor anchor is at its feet:
        /// circles and swept capsules use the collider surface; directional searches use its bounds centre.
        /// Identity, faction, tags and targetability still come from the registered actor.</param>
        public GameplayPhysics2DBackend(GameplayStandardWorld world, Func<Collider2D, IGameplaySpatialActor> resolve = null, bool useColliderGeometry = false)
        { _world = world ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(world)); _resolve = resolve ?? (c => c.GetComponentInParent<GameplayUnityActorBinding>()?.Actor); _useColliderGeometry=useColliderGeometry; }
        public GameplayTargetData Query(GameplaySpatialSearchRequest request)
        {
            if (request.Geometry.Plane != GameplaySpatialPlane.XY) throw new InvalidOperationException("Physics2D backend supports XY queries; select logical/Physics3D for XZ or 3D.");
            if (request.Geometry.Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Single) return request.Select(_world.Actors);
            Physics2D.SyncTransforms();
            var g = request.Geometry;
            var candidates = new List<IGameplaySpatialActor>();
            foreach (var collider in Physics2D.OverlapCircleAll(new Vector2(g.Origin.X, g.Origin.Y), g.BoundsRadius,
                request.LayerMask, g.Origin.Z - g.Height / 2, g.Origin.Z + g.Height / 2))
            {
                var actor = _resolve(collider);
                if (actor != null && _world.TryGetActor(actor.Id, out var registered) && ReferenceEquals(actor, registered))
                    candidates.Add(_useColliderGeometry ? new ColliderCandidate(actor,ContactPoint(collider,g)) : actor);
            }
            return request.Select(candidates);
        }
        private static Vector3 ContactPoint(Collider2D collider,GameplaySearchGeometry geometry)
        {
            var centre=collider.bounds.center;
            if(geometry.Shape!=GameplaySearchShape.Circle&&geometry.Shape!=GameplaySearchShape.Capsule)return centre;
            var origin=new Vector2(geometry.Origin.X,geometry.Origin.Y);
            var axisPoint=origin;
            if(geometry.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Capsule){
                var direction=new Vector2(geometry.Direction.X,geometry.Direction.Y).normalized;
                axisPoint+=direction*Mathf.Clamp(Vector2.Dot((Vector2)centre-origin,direction),0,geometry.Length);
            }
            var contact=collider.ClosestPoint(axisPoint);
            return new Vector3(contact.x,contact.y,centre.z);
        }
        private sealed class ColliderCandidate : IGameplaySpatialActor
        {
            private readonly IGameplaySpatialActor _actor;
            public GameplayPoint Position {get;}
            public GameplaySourceId Id=>_actor.Id;
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags=>_actor.Tags;
            public int Faction=>_actor.Faction;
            public int Layer=>_actor.Layer;
            public bool IsTargetable=>_actor.IsTargetable;
            public ColliderCandidate(IGameplaySpatialActor actor,Vector3 centre)
            {_actor=actor;Position=new GameplayPoint(centre.x,centre.y,centre.z);}
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Real Physics3D sphere broadphase with shared exact sphere/cone/box/capsule/grid filtering.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayPhysics3DBackend : IGameplaySpatialQueryBackend
    {
        private readonly GameplayStandardWorld _world;
        private readonly Func<Collider, IGameplaySpatialActor> _resolve;
        public GameplayPhysics3DBackend(GameplayStandardWorld world, Func<Collider, IGameplaySpatialActor> resolve = null)
        { _world = world ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(world)); _resolve = resolve ?? (c => c.GetComponentInParent<GameplayUnityActorBinding>()?.Actor); }
        public GameplayTargetData Query(GameplaySpatialSearchRequest request)
        {
            if (request.Geometry.Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Single) return request.Select(_world.Actors);
            Physics.SyncTransforms();
            var g = request.Geometry; var candidates = new List<IGameplaySpatialActor>();
            foreach (var collider in Physics.OverlapSphere(new Vector3(g.Origin.X, g.Origin.Y, g.Origin.Z), g.BoundsRadius,
                request.LayerMask, QueryTriggerInteraction.Collide))
            {
                var actor = _resolve(collider);
                if (actor != null && _world.TryGetActor(actor.Id, out var registered) && ReferenceEquals(actor, registered)) candidates.Add(actor);
            }
            return request.Select(candidates);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    /// <summary>Actual scene projection for neutral spatial rules. Shares the actor's existing
    /// FRFrame pool; never ticks a motion, collision, lifetime or gameplay container.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplayUnitySpatialViewFactory:IGameplaySpatialViewFactory
    {
        private readonly GameObject _prefab;
        private readonly GameplaySpatialPlane _plane;
        internal GameplayUnitySpatialViewFactory(GameObject prefab,GameplaySpatialPlane plane){_prefab=prefab;_plane=plane;}
        public IGameplaySpatialView Create(GameplayStandardActor actor,GameplayContext context)
        {
            if(!(actor.Presentation is GameplayUnityAnimationController presentation))throw new InvalidOperationException("Unity spatial view requires the actual actor presentation binding.");
            var pool=presentation.SpatialViewPool;var key=new ResourceKey("Gameplay.DirectPrefab",_prefab.GetInstanceID().ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            var view=pool.GetOrCreate(key,_prefab.name,_prefab);
            view.transform.SetParent(null,false);
            foreach(var child in view.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>())child.gameObject.layer=presentation.Subject.layer;
            foreach(var particles in view.GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>()){var main=particles.main;main.stopAction=ParticleSystemStopAction.None;particles.Stop(false,ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmittingAndClear);particles.Play(false);}
            return new View(view,pool,key,_prefab.name,_plane);
        }
        private sealed class View:IGameplaySpatialView
        {
            private GameObject _view;
            private readonly GameObjectPoolModule _pool;
            private readonly ResourceKey _key;
            private readonly string _location;
            private readonly GameplaySpatialPlane _plane;
            internal View(GameObject view,GameObjectPoolModule pool,ResourceKey key,string location,GameplaySpatialPlane plane){_view=view;_pool=pool;_key=key;_location=location;_plane=plane;}
            public void Sync(GameplayPoint point,GameplayDirection direction)
            {
                if(_view==null)return;_view.transform.position=new Vector3(point.X,point.Y,point.Z);
                _view.transform.rotation=_plane==GameplaySpatialPlane.XY?Quaternion.Euler(0,0,Mathf.Atan2(direction.Y,direction.X)*Mathf.Rad2Deg):
                    Quaternion.LookRotation(new Vector3(direction.X,direction.Y,direction.Z),Mathf.Abs(direction.Y)>.99f?Vector3.forward:Vector3.up);
            }
            public void Dispose()
            {
                if(_view==null)return;
                foreach(var particles in _view.GetComponentsInChildren<ParticleSystem>())particles.Stop(false,ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmittingAndClear);
                _pool.Release(_key,_location,_view);_view=null;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Debugging;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity
{
    public enum GameplayUnitySpatialBackend { Logical, Physics2D, Physics3D }
    /// <summary>Default Unity world driver; advances existing Core containers once per caller step.
    /// Turn hosts may disable AutomaticAdvance and call Advance explicitly. Backend queries never tick rules.</summary>
    [DefaultExecutionOrder(1000)]
    public sealed class GameplayUnityWorldHost : MonoBehaviour, IGameplayRuntimeDebugSource
    {
        public GameplayUnitySpatialBackend SpatialBackend;
        public bool AutomaticAdvance = true;
        public bool CollectSkillTrace;
        public GameplayStandardWorld World { get; private set; }
        private long _tick;
        public string DisplayName => "FRFrame Standard / " + name;
        private void Awake()
        {
            World = new GameplayStandardWorld();
            World.Spatial = SpatialBackend == GameplayUnitySpatialBackend.Physics2D ? (IGameplaySpatialQueryBackend)new GameplayPhysics2DBackend(World) :
                SpatialBackend == GameplayUnitySpatialBackend.Physics3D ? new GameplayPhysics3DBackend(World) : World.Spatial;
        }
        private void Update() { if (AutomaticAdvance) { Physics.SyncTransforms(); Physics2D.SyncTransforms(); Advance(Time.deltaTime); } }
        public void Advance(float amount) { if(World!=null){foreach(var actor in World.Actors)actor.SkillTrace.Enabled=CollectSkillTrace;World.Advance(amount);} _tick++; }
        private void OnDestroy() { World?.Dispose(); World = null; }
        public GameplayRuntimeDebugSnapshot CaptureSnapshot()
        {
            return new GameplayRuntimeDebugSnapshot(_tick, !AutomaticAdvance, GameplayStandardDebugSnapshot.Units(World), World?.Events.GetHistorySnapshot() ?? Array.Empty<GameplayEventHistoryEntry>());
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Sequence/GameplaySequenceContainer.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Owns marker timing and execution. The host explicitly advances it; Effects keep their own lifetime.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceContainer
    {
        private readonly object _handleOwner = new object();
        private readonly List<Entry> _active = new List<Entry>();
        private readonly List<GameplayCueRequest> _cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
        private long _lastId;

        public int ActiveCount => _active.Count;
        /// <summary>Emitted once after detaching a completed/cancelled/cleared sequence, for owned cleanup.</summary>
        public event Action<GameplaySequenceTermination> Terminated;

        /// <summary>Captures marker progress in Start order without executing any marker.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayActiveSequenceSnapshot> GetActiveEntriesSnapshot()
        {
            var result = new List<GameplayActiveSequenceSnapshot>(_active.Count);
            foreach (Entry entry in _active)
            {
                float? next = entry.NextIndex < entry.Definition.Markers.Count
                    ? entry.Definition.Markers[entry.NextIndex].Time : (float?)null;
                result.Add(new GameplayActiveSequenceSnapshot(entry.Handle, entry.Definition,
                    entry.Context, (float)entry.Elapsed, entry.NextIndex, next));
            }
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }

        /// <summary>Starts Cue/ApplyEffect content without an event. SkillStep content requires StartSkill.</summary>
        public GameplaySequenceHandle Start(GameplaySequenceDefinition definition, GameplayContext context,
            IGameplaySkillHost host) => StartInternal(definition, context, host, null);

        /// <summary>Captures the actual Skill trigger event; marker-time steps never synthesize an event.</summary>
        public GameplaySequenceHandle StartSkill(GameplaySequenceDefinition definition, GameplayContext context,
            GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (!triggerEvent.EventTag.IsValid)
                throw new ArgumentException("Skill-started Sequence requires a valid trigger event.", nameof(triggerEvent));
            return StartInternal(definition, context, host, triggerEvent);
        }

        private GameplaySequenceHandle StartInternal(GameplaySequenceDefinition definition, GameplayContext context,
            IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData? triggerEvent)
        {
            if (definition == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (!triggerEvent.HasValue)
                foreach (var marker in definition.Markers)
                    if (marker is GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("SkillStep requires StartSkill with the original trigger event.");
            var handle = new GameplaySequenceHandle(_handleOwner, checked(++_lastId));
            var entry = new Entry(handle, definition, context, host, triggerEvent);
            _active.Add(entry);
            ExecuteThrough(entry, 0f);
            if (Complete(entry)) Finish(entry, GameplaySequenceTerminationReason.Completed);
            return handle;
        }

        /// <summary>Advances entries that existed before this call; Start itself never consumes a past delta.</summary>
        public void Advance(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime < 0f) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(deltaTime));
            // Actions may start or cancel Sequences. Snapshot membership, not mutable list indexes.
            foreach (Entry entry in _active.ToArray())
            {
                if (entry.Cancelled) continue;
                double next = Math.Min((double)entry.Definition.Duration, entry.Elapsed + (double)deltaTime);
                ExecuteThrough(entry, next);
                entry.Elapsed = next;
            }
            foreach (var entry in _active.ToArray())
                if (Complete(entry)) Finish(entry, GameplaySequenceTerminationReason.Completed);
        }

        /// <summary>Moves this rule step's Cue requests to the host output in deterministic execution order.</summary>
        public void DrainCues(ICollection<GameplayCueRequest> destination)
        {
            if (destination == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(destination));
            foreach (var cue in _cues) destination.Add(cue);
            _cues.Clear();
        }

        public bool IsActive(GameplaySequenceHandle handle) =>
            handle.Owner == _handleOwner && _active.Exists(entry => entry.Handle.Id == handle.Id);

        public bool Cancel(GameplaySequenceHandle handle)
        {
            if (handle.Owner != _handleOwner) return false;
            Entry entry = _active.Find(item => item.Handle.Id == handle.Id);
            if (entry == null) return false;
            Finish(entry, GameplaySequenceTerminationReason.Cancelled);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>Idempotent cancellation relation only; neither advances nor owns Sequence rule time.</summary>
        public IDisposable CreateCancellationLease(GameplaySequenceHandle handle)
        {
            if (handle.Owner != _handleOwner) throw new ArgumentException("Sequence handle belongs to another container.", nameof(handle));
            return new CancellationLease(this, handle);
        }
        private sealed class CancellationLease : IDisposable
        {
            private GameplaySequenceContainer _container;
            private readonly GameplaySequenceHandle _handle;
            internal CancellationLease(GameplaySequenceContainer container, GameplaySequenceHandle handle) { _container = container; _handle = handle; }
            public void Dispose() { var container = _container; _container = null; container?.Cancel(_handle); }
        }

        /// <summary>Discards pending marker work and undrained Cues; does not remove Effects already applied.</summary>
        public void Clear()
        {
            var entries = _active.ToArray();
            foreach (Entry entry in entries) entry.Cancelled = true;
            _active.Clear();
            _cues.Clear();
            List<Exception> errors = null;
            foreach (var entry in entries)
                try { Finish(entry, GameplaySequenceTerminationReason.Cleared); }
                catch (Exception ex) { (errors ?? (errors = new List<Exception>())).Add(ex); }
            if (errors != null) throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }

        private void Finish(Entry entry, GameplaySequenceTerminationReason reason)
        {
            if (entry.Terminated) return;
            entry.Terminated = true; entry.Cancelled = true; _active.Remove(entry);
            var observation = new GameplaySequenceTermination(entry.Handle, entry.Context, reason);
            List<Exception> errors = null;
            if (Terminated != null)
                foreach (Action<GameplaySequenceTermination> observer in Terminated.GetInvocationList())
                    try { observer(observation); } catch (Exception ex) { (errors ?? (errors = new List<Exception>())).Add(ex); }
            if (errors != null) throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }

        private void ExecuteThrough(Entry entry, double time)
        {
            var markers = entry.Definition.Markers;
            // Content/API time is float. Compare its rounded projection, but never accumulate that rounding.
            // This preserves short authored boundaries such as 3/30 + 1/30 == 4/30 in the public time domain.
            float authoredTime = (float)time;
            while (!entry.Cancelled && entry.NextIndex < markers.Count && markers[entry.NextIndex].Time <= authoredTime)
            {
                var marker = markers[entry.NextIndex++];
                if (marker is GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition cue)
                    _cues.Add(new GameplayCueRequest(cue.CueTag, entry.Context, cue.Magnitude, cue.Duration));
                else if (marker is GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition effect)
                {
                    if (entry.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId != entry.Host.OwnerId)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Sequence ApplyEffect marker currently requires Self target.");
                    if (entry.Host is IGameplaySkillEffectHost routed)
                        routed.ApplyEffect(entry.Context, effect.Effect, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);
                    else
                        entry.Host.Effects.Apply(effect.Effect, new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(
                            entry.Context, entry.Host, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
                }
                else if (marker is GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition step)
                    ExecuteStep(entry, step);
            }
        }

        private static void ExecuteStep(Entry entry, GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition step)
        {
            GameplayEventData triggerEvent = entry.TriggerEvent.Value;
            foreach (var condition in step.Conditions)
                if (entry.Cancelled || !GameplaySkillActionRunner.Evaluate(condition, entry.Context, triggerEvent, entry.Host)) return;
            if (entry.Cancelled) return;
            GameplayTargetData target = step.Target.Resolve(entry.Host, triggerEvent);
            if (target == null || entry.Cancelled) return;
            var context = entry.Context.WithTarget(target);
            GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(step.Actions, context, triggerEvent, entry.Host, () => !entry.Cancelled);
        }

        private static bool Complete(Entry entry) =>
            (float)entry.Elapsed >= entry.Definition.Duration && entry.NextIndex >= entry.Definition.Markers.Count;

        private sealed class Entry
        {
            public bool Terminated;
            public readonly GameplaySequenceHandle Handle;
            public readonly GameplaySequenceDefinition Definition;
            public readonly GameplayContext Context;
            public readonly IGameplaySkillHost Host;
            public readonly GameplayEventData? TriggerEvent;
            public bool Cancelled;
            // Keep one precise rule timeline: per-step float rounding can delay a long authored marker by a frame.
            // Authored times and public snapshots remain float; never feed snapshot rounding back into scheduling.
            public double Elapsed;
            public int NextIndex;
            public Entry(GameplaySequenceHandle handle, GameplaySequenceDefinition definition,
                GameplayContext context, IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData? triggerEvent)
            { Handle = handle; Definition = definition; Context = context; Host = host; TriggerEvent = triggerEvent; }
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Sequence/GameplaySequenceDefinition.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Immutable marker schedule. Equal-time markers retain their authored array order.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceDefinition
    {
        public float Duration { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition> Markers { get; }

        public GameplaySequenceDefinition(float duration, IEnumerable<GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition> markers)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(duration) || duration < 0f) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(duration));
            if (markers == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(markers));
            Duration = duration;
            var ordered = new List<(GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition marker, int index)>();
            foreach (var marker in markers)
            {
                if (marker == null) throw new ArgumentException("Markers cannot contain null.", nameof(markers));
                if (marker.Time > duration) throw new ArgumentException("Marker exceeds sequence duration.", nameof(markers));
                ordered.Add((marker, ordered.Count));
            }
            ordered.Sort((a, b) =>
            {
                int timeOrder = a.marker.Time.CompareTo(b.marker.Time);
                return timeOrder != 0 ? timeOrder : a.index.CompareTo(b.index);
            });
            var copy = new List<GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition>(ordered.Count);
            foreach (var item in ordered) copy.Add(item.marker);
            Markers = new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition>(copy);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Identity of one active Sequence entry; a handle cannot control another container.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplaySequenceHandle
    {
        internal readonly object Owner;
        internal readonly long Id;
        internal GameplaySequenceHandle(object owner, long id) { Owner = owner; Id = id; }
        public bool IsValid => Owner != null && Id > 0;
        /// <summary>Container-local sequence for read-only diagnostics.</summary>
        public long LocalSequence => Id;
    }
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>One immutable moment inside a Sequence. Time uses the host's rule-time seconds.</summary>
    public abstract class GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition
    {
        public float Time { get; }

        protected GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition(float time)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(time) || time < 0f) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(time));
            Time = time;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Applies an existing Effect at this moment; its later lifetime belongs only to EffectContainer.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition : GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinition Effect { get; }

        public GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition(float time, GameplayEffectDefinition effect) : base(time) =>
            Effect = effect ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effect));
    }

    /// <summary>Emits a presentation request without holding a prefab or animation reference.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition : GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition
    {
        public GameplayTag CueTag { get; }
        public float? Magnitude { get; }
        public float? Duration { get; }

        public GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(float time, GameplayTag cueTag, float? magnitude = null,
            float? duration = null) : base(time)
        {
            if (!cueTag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Cue tag must be valid.", nameof(cueTag));
            if (magnitude.HasValue && !float.IsFinite(magnitude.Value)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(magnitude));
            if (duration.HasValue && (!float.IsFinite(duration.Value) || duration.Value <= 0f))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(duration));
            CueTag = cueTag;
            Magnitude = magnitude;
            Duration = duration;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Resolves a Skill step at marker time using the Sequence host and original trigger event.
    /// Conditions and target read current host state; actions receive a new target snapshot with
    /// the activation identity and values. Rejection stops only this step, without rollback.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition : GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillCondition> Conditions { get; }
        public IGameplaySkillTarget Target { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> Actions { get; }

        public GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(float time,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillCondition> conditions, IGameplaySkillTarget target,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> actions) : base(time)
        {
            if (conditions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(conditions));
            if (actions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actions));
            Target = target ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(target));
            var conditionCopy = new List<IGameplaySkillCondition>(conditions);
            var actionCopy = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>(actions);
            if (conditionCopy.Contains(null)) throw new ArgumentException("Conditions cannot contain null.", nameof(conditions));
            if (actionCopy.Count == 0 || actionCopy.Contains(null))
                throw new ArgumentException("Actions must contain at least one non-null action.", nameof(actions));
            Conditions = new ReadOnlyCollection<IGameplaySkillCondition>(conditionCopy);
            Actions = new ReadOnlyCollection<IGameplaySkillAction>(actionCopy);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>技能执行所需的 owner 服务；游戏层可实现扩展接口提供专属动作，Core 不认识游戏对象。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillHost : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
    {
        GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
        GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>仅包装现有 owner 规则容器，不拥有其生命周期。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillOwnerHost : IGameplaySkillHost
    {
        public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
        public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }
        public AttributeSet Attributes { get; }
        public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }

        public GameplaySkillOwnerHost(GameplaySourceId ownerId, GameplayTagContainer tags,
            AttributeSet attributes, GameplayEffectContainer effects)
        {
            if (!ownerId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Owner ID must be valid.", nameof(ownerId));
            OwnerId = ownerId;
            Tags = tags ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tags));
            Attributes = attributes ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(attributes));
            Effects = effects ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effects));
        }
    }

    /// <summary>不可变触发器定义；每次 Bind 为一个 owner 创建独立订阅及可变状态。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition
    {
        IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding Bind(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventDispatcher events,
            Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered);
    }

    /// <summary>一个 owner 的触发器运行态；Dispose 清理其事件订阅。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding : IDisposable { }

    /// <summary>仅由需要规则时间的触发器绑定实现；时间由宿主显式提供。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillAdvanceableTriggerBinding
    {
        void Advance(float deltaTime);
    }

    /// <summary>09A 的简单事件触发器；具体标签是静态内容，订阅属于每个 Bind 产生的运行态。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition : IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition
    {
        public GameplayTag EventTag { get; }

        public GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(GameplayTag eventTag)
        {
            if (!eventTag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Event tag must be valid.", nameof(eventTag));
            EventTag = eventTag;
        }

        public IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding Bind(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventDispatcher events,
            Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered)
        {
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (events == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(events));
            if (onTriggered == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(onTriggered));
            return new EventBinding(events, events.Subscribe(EventTag, onTriggered));
        }

        private sealed class EventBinding : IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding
        {
            private readonly GameplayEventDispatcher _events;
            private readonly GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle _subscription;
            private bool _disposed;

            public EventBinding(GameplayEventDispatcher events, GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle subscription)
            {
                _events = events;
                _subscription = subscription;
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_disposed) return;
                _disposed = true;
                _events.Unsubscribe(_subscription);
            }
        }
    }

    /// <summary>读取 owner 当前规则状态的技能条件；失败时不解析目标或执行动作。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillCondition
    {
        bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent);
    }

    /// <summary>将一次技能的目标解析为已有 TargetData；null 表示本次没有有效目标。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillTarget
    {
        GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent);
    }

    /// <summary>动作结果；Rejected 停止本次技能后续动作与成功反馈。</summary>
    public enum GameplaySkillActionResult { Succeeded, Rejected }

    /// <summary>执行已解析的技能动作；09A 的 Effect Action 只作用于 Self。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host);
    }

    /// <summary>游戏可将通用 ApplyEffect Action 路由到自己的 typed execution target。</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillEffectHost
    {
        GameplayEffectApplicationResult ApplyEffect(GameplayContext context,
            GameplayEffectDefinition effect, GameplaySetByCallerValues values);
    }

    /// <summary>只读技能配置。订阅、owner 和 once 状态属于各自的 GameplaySkillRuntime。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillDefinition
    {
        public IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition Trigger { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillCondition> Conditions { get; }
        public IGameplaySkillTarget Target { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> Actions { get; }
        public bool Once { get; }
        /// <summary>Opt-in for authored casts: retain the matching owner's event provenance/values.
        /// Legacy ordinary skills keep their established owner context when false.</summary>
        public bool PreserveTriggerContext { get; }

        public GameplaySkillDefinition(IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition trigger, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillCondition> conditions,
            IGameplaySkillTarget target, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> actions, bool once,
            bool preserveTriggerContext = false)
        {
            Trigger = trigger ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(trigger));
            if (conditions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(conditions));
            if (actions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actions));
            Target = target ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(target));
            var conditionCopy = new List<IGameplaySkillCondition>(conditions);
            var actionCopy = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>(actions);
            if (conditionCopy.Contains(null)) throw new ArgumentException("Conditions cannot contain null.", nameof(conditions));
            if (actionCopy.Count == 0 || actionCopy.Contains(null))
                throw new ArgumentException("Actions must contain at least one non-null action.", nameof(actions));
            Conditions = new ReadOnlyCollection<IGameplaySkillCondition>(conditionCopy);
            Actions = new ReadOnlyCollection<IGameplaySkillAction>(actionCopy);
            Once = once;
            PreserveTriggerContext = preserveTriggerContext;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>一个 owner 的独立技能运行态；借用已有 EventDispatcher，释放时取消订阅。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillRuntime : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly GameplaySkillDefinition _definition;
        private readonly IGameplaySkillHost _host;
        private readonly Action<GameplayContext> _onExecuted;
        private readonly IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding _triggerBinding;
        private readonly Func<GameplayEventData, GameplayContext, GameplayContext> _executionContext;
        private bool _disposed;

        public bool HasTriggered => ActivationCount > 0;
        /// <summary>Shared immutable configuration; runtime counters remain on this instance.</summary>
        public GameplaySkillDefinition Definition => _definition;
        public bool IsDisposed => _disposed;
        /// <summary>Last successfully executed immutable context; null before the first activation.</summary>
        public GameplayContext LastExecutionContext { get; private set; }
        public int ActivationCount { get; private set; }
        /// <summary>本 owner 的独立触发器绑定，可供调试或类型化运行态检查。</summary>
        public IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding TriggerBinding => _triggerBinding;

        public GameplaySkillRuntime(GameplaySkillDefinition definition, IGameplaySkillHost host,
            GameplayEventDispatcher events, Action<GameplayContext> onExecuted = null,
            Func<GameplayEventData, GameplayContext, GameplayContext> executionContext = null)
        {
            _definition = definition ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            _host = host ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (!_host.OwnerId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Host owner ID must be valid.", nameof(host));
            if (events == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(events));
            _onExecuted = onExecuted;
            _executionContext = executionContext;
            _triggerBinding = _definition.Trigger.Bind(_host, events, OnTriggered)
                ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Skill trigger did not return a binding.");
        }

        private void OnTriggered(GameplayEventData triggerEvent)
        {
            if (_disposed || (_definition.Once && HasTriggered)) return;
            GameplaySkillTrace.Write(_host,triggerEvent.Context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.Triggered,"Rule");
            foreach (IGameplaySkillCondition condition in _definition.Conditions)
                if (!condition.Evaluate(_host, triggerEvent)){GameplaySkillTrace.Write(_host,triggerEvent.Context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ConditionRejected,condition.GetType().Name);return;}
            GameplayTargetData target = _definition.Target.Resolve(_host, triggerEvent);
            if (target == null){GameplaySkillTrace.Write(_host,triggerEvent.Context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.TargetRejected,_definition.Target.GetType().Name);return;}
            var context = new GameplayContext(_host.OwnerId, target, _host.OwnerId,
                new GameplayContextValues(new[] { new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(
                    GameplayContextValues.TriggerMagnitudeKey, triggerEvent.Magnitude) }));
            // Ordinary skills retain their established owner/source and TriggerMagnitude context.
            // Only the owner's captured cast level is propagated; rich child provenance uses continuations.
            if (triggerEvent.Context != null && triggerEvent.Context.InstigatorId == _host.OwnerId)
                context = _definition.PreserveTriggerContext ? triggerEvent.Context.WithTarget(target)
                    .WithValues(triggerEvent.Context.Values.WithValue(GameplayContextValues.TriggerMagnitudeKey, triggerEvent.Magnitude)) :
                    context.WithAbilityLevel(triggerEvent.Context.AbilityLevel);
            // Optional per-installation cast scope adapter. Definitions remain immutable; null suppresses
            // execution for an unrelated event/inactive grant. Legacy callers do not install this adapter.
            if (_executionContext != null)
            {
                context = _executionContext(triggerEvent, context);
                if (context == null){GameplaySkillTrace.Write(_host,triggerEvent.Context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ContextRejected,"Installation scope");return;}
                if (context.InstigatorId != _host.OwnerId) throw new InvalidOperationException("Skill execution instigator must match its owner.");
            }
            var execution = GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_definition.Actions, context, triggerEvent, _host);
            if (execution.Result == GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected) return;
            ActivationCount++;
            LastExecutionContext = execution.Context;
            _onExecuted?.Invoke(execution.Context);
        }

        /// <summary>推进本 owner 的时间型触发器；事件型触发器无需逐步回调。</summary>
        public void Advance(float deltaTime)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime < 0f)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(deltaTime));
            if (_disposed) return;
            if (_triggerBinding is IGameplaySkillAdvanceableTriggerBinding advanceable)
                advanceable.Advance(deltaTime);
        }

        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed) return;
            _disposed = true;
            _triggerBinding.Dispose();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>最小 required/blocked owner Tag 条件，使用现有层级 HasTag 语义。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillTagCondition : IGameplaySkillCondition
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> Required { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> Blocked { get; }

        public GameplaySkillTagCondition(IEnumerable<GameplayTag> required, IEnumerable<GameplayTag> blocked)
        {
            if (required == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(required));
            if (blocked == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(blocked));
            var requiredCopy = new List<GameplayTag>(required);
            var blockedCopy = new List<GameplayTag>(blocked);
            if (requiredCopy.Exists(tag => !tag.IsValid) || blockedCopy.Exists(tag => !tag.IsValid))
                throw new ArgumentException("Condition tags must be valid.");
            Required = new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayTag>(requiredCopy);
            Blocked = new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayTag>(blockedCopy);
        }

        public bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent)
        {
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in Required)
                if (!host.Tags.HasTag(tag)) return false;
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in Blocked)
                if (host.Tags.HasTag(tag)) return false;
            return true;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>只解析技能 owner 本人，不查询场景或游戏单位。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillSelfTarget : IGameplaySkillTarget
    {
        public GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent) =>
            host != null ? new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId) :
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
    }

    /// <summary>使用 owner 已有的 EffectContainer 对 Self 应用不可变 Effect。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillApplyEffectAction : IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinition Effect { get; }

        public GameplaySkillApplyEffectAction(GameplayEffectDefinition effect) =>
            Effect = effect ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effect));

        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId != host.OwnerId)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("ApplyEffect Action currently requires Self target.");
            GameplayEffectApplicationResult result = host is IGameplaySkillEffectHost routed
                ? routed.ApplyEffect(context, Effect, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty)
                : host.Effects.Apply(Effect, new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(
                    context, host, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
            return result.Succeeded ? GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded : GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>与常量比较 owner 属性当前值的操作；不比较 BaseValue。</summary>
    public enum GameplaySkillAttributeComparison
    {
        Less,
        LessOrEqual,
        Greater,
        GreaterOrEqual
    }

    /// <summary>不可变的当前属性值条件；缺失属性沿用 AttributeSet 的失败语义。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillAttributeCondition : IGameplaySkillCondition
    {
        public GameplayAttributeId AttributeId { get; }
        public GameplaySkillAttributeComparison Comparison { get; }
        public float Constant { get; }

        public GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(GameplayAttributeId attributeId,
            GameplaySkillAttributeComparison comparison, float constant)
        {
            if (!attributeId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Attribute ID must be valid.", nameof(attributeId));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySkillAttributeComparison), comparison))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(comparison));
            if (!float.IsFinite(constant)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(constant));
            AttributeId = attributeId;
            Comparison = comparison;
            Constant = constant;
        }

        public bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent)
        {
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            float current = host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(AttributeId);
            switch (Comparison)
            {
                case GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Less: return current < Constant;
                case GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.LessOrEqual: return current <= Constant;
                case GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Greater: return current > Constant;
                case GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.GreaterOrEqual: return current >= Constant;
                default: throw new InvalidOperationException("Unsupported attribute comparison.");
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>不可变的规则时间间隔定义；每个 owner 的剩余时间由独立 Binding 持有。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition : IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition
    {
        public GameplayTag SignalTag { get; }
        public float Interval { get; }

        public GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(GameplayTag signalTag, float interval)
        {
            if (!signalTag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Signal tag must be valid.", nameof(signalTag));
            if (!float.IsFinite(interval) || interval <= 0f)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(interval));
            SignalTag = signalTag;
            Interval = interval;
        }

        public IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding Bind(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventDispatcher events,
            Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered)
        {
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (!host.OwnerId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Host owner ID must be valid.", nameof(host));
            if (events == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(events));
            if (onTriggered == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(onTriggered));
            return new Binding(host.OwnerId, SignalTag, Interval, onTriggered);
        }

        /// <summary>单个 owner 的间隔进度；到点先消费本次间隔，再传递原因 payload。</summary>
        public sealed class Binding : IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding, IGameplaySkillAdvanceableTriggerBinding
        {
            private readonly GameplaySourceId _ownerId;
            private readonly GameplayTag _signalTag;
            private readonly float _interval;
            private readonly Action<GameplayEventData> _onTriggered;
            private bool _disposed;
            private double _elapsed;
            private double _nextTriggerAt;
            /// <summary>Float observation of the precise pending interval; observations never feed back into scheduling.</summary>
            public float Remaining => (float)Math.Max(0d, _nextTriggerAt - _elapsed);
            public float Interval => _interval;

            internal Binding(GameplaySourceId ownerId, GameplayTag signalTag, float interval,
                Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered)
            {
                _ownerId = ownerId;
                _signalTag = signalTag;
                _interval = interval;
                _onTriggered = onTriggered;
                _nextTriggerAt = interval;
            }

            public void Advance(float deltaTime)
            {
                if (!float.IsFinite(deltaTime) || deltaTime < 0f)
                    throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(deltaTime));
                if (_disposed) return;
                _elapsed += deltaTime;
                while ((float)_elapsed >= (float)_nextTriggerAt)
                {
                    // Commit before invoking callbacks, including reentrant Advance or Dispose.
                    _nextTriggerAt += _interval;
                    _onTriggered(new GameplayEventData(_signalTag, _ownerId, default, _interval));
                    if (_disposed) return;
                }
            }

            public void Dispose() => _disposed = true;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>同一 owner 的指定事件累计 N 次后触发；定义可共享，计数和订阅属于每次 Bind。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerDefinition : IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition
    {
        public GameplayTag EventTag { get; }
        public int RequiredCount { get; }

        public GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerDefinition(GameplayTag eventTag, int requiredCount)
        {
            if (!eventTag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Event tag must be valid.", nameof(eventTag));
            if (requiredCount <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(requiredCount));
            EventTag = eventTag;
            RequiredCount = requiredCount;
        }

        public IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding Bind(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventDispatcher events,
            Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered)
        {
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            if (!host.OwnerId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Host owner ID must be valid.", nameof(host));
            if (events == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(events));
            if (onTriggered == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(onTriggered));
            return new Binding(host.OwnerId, EventTag, RequiredCount, events, onTriggered);
        }

        /// <summary>单个 owner 的计数与订阅；达到阈值时先清零再回调，回调失败也不重放。</summary>
        public sealed class Binding : IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding
        {
            private readonly GameplaySourceId _ownerId;
            private readonly int _requiredCount;
            private readonly GameplayEventDispatcher _events;
            private readonly Action<GameplayEventData> _onTriggered;
            private readonly GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle _subscription;
            private bool _disposed;

            public int CurrentCount { get; private set; }
            public int RequiredCount => _requiredCount;

            internal Binding(GameplaySourceId ownerId, GameplayTag eventTag, int requiredCount,
                GameplayEventDispatcher events, Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered)
            {
                _ownerId = ownerId;
                _requiredCount = requiredCount;
                _events = events;
                _onTriggered = onTriggered;
                _subscription = events.Subscribe(eventTag, OnEvent);
            }

            private void OnEvent(GameplayEventData data)
            {
                if (_disposed || data.InstigatorId != _ownerId) return;
                CurrentCount++;
                if (CurrentCount < _requiredCount) return;
                CurrentCount = 0;
                _onTriggered(data);
            }

            public void Dispose()
            {
                if (_disposed) return;
                _disposed = true;
                _events.Unsubscribe(_subscription);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Opt-in side interface; implement alongside IGameplaySkillAction to carry immutable output to the next action.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillContextAction
    {
        GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host);
    }
    /// <summary>Opt-in condition view of the current action-chain context.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillContextCondition
    {
        bool EvaluateContext(GameplayContext context, IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent);
    }
    /// <summary>Successful execution must supply a context; rejection stops the chain without rollback.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplaySkillActionExecution
    {
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Result { get; }
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult result, GameplayContext context)
        {
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySkillActionResult), result)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(result));
            if (result == GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded && context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            Result = result; Context = context;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Composite actions propagate the caller's cancellation guard to every nested action.
    /// Used by first-party Branch and standard Search each/completed/no-target callbacks.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction
    {
        GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteGuarded(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue);
    }
    /// <summary>One ordered runner for Skill, SkillStep, nested branches and child continuation. Owns no time or lifetime.</summary>
    public static class GameplaySkillActionRunner
    {
        /// <summary>Legacy successes carry the same context. The optional guard stops pending actions after host cancellation.</summary>
        public static GameplaySkillActionExecution Execute(IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> actions, GameplayContext context,
            GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue = null)
        {
            if (actions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actions));
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (host == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(host));
            int index=0;
            foreach (var action in actions)
            {
                if (canContinue != null && !canContinue()) return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, context);
                if (action == null) throw new ArgumentException("Actions cannot contain null.", nameof(actions));
                GameplaySkillActionExecution execution;
                GameplaySkillTrace.Write(host,context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionStarted,action?.GetType().Name,index,action:action);
                try{
                    if (action is IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction guarded) execution = guarded.ExecuteGuarded(context, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
                    else if (action is IGameplaySkillContextAction contextual) execution = contextual.ExecuteWithContext(context, triggerEvent, host);
                    else execution = new GameplaySkillActionExecution(action.Execute(context, triggerEvent, host), context);
                }catch(Exception error){GameplaySkillTrace.Write(host,context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionFailed,action?.GetType().Name,index,error.Message,action);throw;}
                if (execution.Result == GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected){GameplaySkillTrace.Write(host,context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionRejected,action?.GetType().Name,index,action:action);return execution;}
                if (execution.Result != GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded || execution.Context == null)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Successful contextual action must return a non-null Context.");
                context = execution.Context;
                GameplaySkillTrace.Write(host,context,triggerEvent,GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionSucceeded,action.GetType().Name,index++,action:action);
            }
            return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded, context);
        }
        /// <summary>Context-aware conditions opt in; legacy conditions retain their host/event contract.</summary>
        public static bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillCondition condition, GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) =>
            condition is IGameplaySkillContextCondition contextual ? contextual.EvaluateContext(context, host, triggerEvent) : condition.Evaluate(host, triggerEvent);
    }
    /// <summary>Exactly one nested action list executes, then its context merges into the outer ordered list. No loops or waits.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillBranchAction : IGameplaySkillAction, IGameplaySkillContextAction, IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction
    {
        public IGameplaySkillCondition Condition { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> TrueActions { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> FalseActions { get; }
        public GameplaySkillBranchAction(IGameplaySkillCondition condition, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> trueActions, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> falseActions)
        { Condition = condition ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(condition)); TrueActions = Copy(trueActions); FalseActions = Copy(falseActions); }
        internal static IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> Copy(IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> actions)
        {
            if (actions == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actions));
            var copy = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>(actions);
            if (copy.Contains(null)) throw new ArgumentException("Actions cannot contain null.", nameof(actions));
            return copy.AsReadOnly();
        }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteWithContext(context, triggerEvent, host).Result;
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteGuarded(context, triggerEvent, host, null);
        GameplaySkillActionExecution IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction.ExecuteGuarded(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue) => ExecuteGuarded(context, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
        private GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteGuarded(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue) =>
            GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(GameplaySkillActionRunner.Evaluate(Condition, context, triggerEvent, host) ? TrueActions : FalseActions, context, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
    }
    /// <summary>Scalar comparisons for context values; a missing key never matches, including NotEqual.</summary>
    public enum GameplaySkillContextComparison { Equal, NotEqual, Less, LessOrEqual, Greater, GreaterOrEqual }
    /// <summary>Reads the current branch input scalar; legacy direct evaluation requires an explicit event Context envelope.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillContextValueCondition : IGameplaySkillCondition, IGameplaySkillContextCondition
    {
        public GameplayTag Key { get; }
        public GameplaySkillContextComparison Comparison { get; }
        public float Constant { get; }
        public GameplaySkillContextValueCondition(GameplayTag key, GameplaySkillContextComparison comparison, float constant)
        {
            if (!key.IsValid || !float.IsFinite(constant)) throw new ArgumentException("Valid key and finite constant required.");
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySkillContextComparison), comparison)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(comparison));
            Key = key; Comparison = comparison; Constant = constant;
        }
        public bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent) => triggerEvent.HasContext && EvaluateContext(triggerEvent.Context, host, triggerEvent);
        public bool EvaluateContext(GameplayContext context, IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent)
        {
            if (context == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            if (!context.Values.TryGetValue(Key, out float value)) return false;
            switch (Comparison)
            {
                case GameplaySkillContextComparison.Equal: return value == Constant;
                case GameplaySkillContextComparison.NotEqual: return value != Constant;
                case GameplaySkillContextComparison.Less: return value < Constant;
                case GameplaySkillContextComparison.LessOrEqual: return value <= Constant;
                case GameplaySkillContextComparison.Greater: return value > Constant;
                default: return value >= Constant;
            }
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Writes one typed finite scalar to a derived immutable context, for subsequent value/branch consumers.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction : IGameplaySkillAction, IGameplaySkillContextAction
    {
        public GameplayTag Key { get; }
        public float Value { get; }
        public GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction(GameplayTag key, float value)
        { if (!key.IsValid || !float.IsFinite(value)) throw new ArgumentException("Valid key and finite value required."); Key = key; Value = value; }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteWithContext(context, triggerEvent, host).Result;
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) =>
            new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded, context.WithValues(context.Values.WithValue(Key, Value)));
    }
    /// <summary>Immutable callback action list for game-owned child hit/arrive/enter/exit. No trigger, timer or mutable owner.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayContinuationDefinition
    {
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> Actions { get; }
        public GameplayContinuationDefinition(IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> actions) { Actions = GameplaySkillBranchAction.Copy(actions); }
        /// <summary>Executes with the explicit callback context. An optional child-disposed guard stops pending actions without polling Ability.</summary>
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue = null) =>
            GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(Actions, context, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    public enum GameplaySkillTraceStage { Triggered, ConditionRejected, TargetRejected, ContextRejected, ActionStarted, ActionSucceeded, ActionRejected, ActionFailed }
    /// <summary>Optional authored location, with no Unity reference. The asset identity and
    /// managed-reference ID describe the original Source, never a second executable graph.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplaySkillTraceSource
    {
        public string DefinitionId {get;}
        public long NodeId {get;}
        public string DocumentId {get;}
        public bool IsValid=>!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DefinitionId)&&NodeId>=0;
        public GameplaySkillTraceSource(string definitionId,long nodeId,string documentId=null){DefinitionId=definitionId;NodeId=nodeId;DocumentId=documentId;}
    }
    public interface IGameplaySkillTraceSourceProvider
    {bool TryGetActionSource(IGameplaySkillAction action,GameplayContext context,out GameplaySkillTraceSource source);}
    /// <summary>Detached observation of an existing synchronous rule/action. Context is immutable;
    /// ordering is supplied by the observer, with no new rule clock or execution authority.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplaySkillTraceRecord
    {
        public GameplaySourceId OwnerId {get;}
        public GameplayContext Context {get;}
        public GameplayTag EventTag {get;}
        public GameplaySkillTraceStage Stage {get;}
        public string Operation {get;}
        public int ActionIndex {get;}
        public string Detail {get;}
        public GameplaySkillTraceSource Source {get;}
        public GameplaySkillTraceRecord(GameplaySourceId owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayTag eventTag,GameplaySkillTraceStage stage,string operation,int actionIndex=-1,string detail=null,GameplaySkillTraceSource source=default)
        {OwnerId=owner;Context=context;EventTag=eventTag;Stage=stage;Operation=operation;ActionIndex=actionIndex;Detail=detail;Source=source;}
    }
    /// <summary>Optional diagnostics only. Observer exceptions are isolated from gameplay;
    /// observers must never mutate/advance rules while recording a trace.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySkillTraceSink {void RecordSkillTrace(GameplaySkillTraceRecord record);}
    internal static class GameplaySkillTrace
    {
        internal static void Write(IGameplaySkillHost host,GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData trigger,GameplaySkillTraceStage stage,string operation,int index=-1,string detail=null,IGameplaySkillAction action=null)
        {
            if(!(host is IGameplaySkillTraceSink sink))return;
            try{GameplaySkillTraceSource source=default;if(action!=null&&host is IGameplaySkillTraceSourceProvider provider)provider.TryGetActionSource(action,context,out source);
                sink.RecordSkillTrace(new GameplaySkillTraceRecord(host.OwnerId,context,trigger.EventTag,stage,operation,index,detail,source));}
            catch{ /* Diagnostics cannot change payment, ordering, cleanup or rule exceptions. */ }
        }
    }
}
````
