using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Immutable mapping to a game's actual resources; no unit names, inventory or save objects.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayCombatAttributeMap
    {
        public GameplayAttributeId Health { get; }
        public GameplayAttributeId MaxHealth { get; }
        public GameplayAttributeId Shield { get; }
        public GameplayAttributeId Defense { get; }
        public GameplayAttributeId MagicDefense {get;}
        public GameplayCombatAttributeMap(GameplayAttributeId health, GameplayAttributeId maxHealth, GameplayAttributeId shield, GameplayAttributeId defense,GameplayAttributeId magicDefense=default)
        {
            if (!health.IsValid || !maxHealth.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Health and MaxHealth mappings are required.");
            if (health == maxHealth || (shield.IsValid && (shield == health || shield == maxHealth))) throw new ArgumentException("Resource mappings must be distinct.");
            Health = health; MaxHealth = maxHealth; Shield = shield; Defense = defense;MagicDefense=magicDefense;
        }
    }
    public enum GameplayCombatOutcomeKind { Damage, Heal, Shield }
    /// <summary>Actual post-commit rule producers. Damage includes miss/immunity/absorption;
    /// Hit excludes miss and immunity but includes full shield absorption. Magnitude is applied
    /// resource change. Subject filtering uses the original instigator and actual target.</summary>
    public static class GameplayCombatEvents
    {
        public static readonly GameplayTag Damage = new GameplayTag("Event.Standard.Combat.Damage");
        public static readonly GameplayTag Hit = new GameplayTag("Event.Standard.Combat.Hit");
        public static readonly GameplayTag Heal = new GameplayTag("Event.Standard.Combat.Heal");
        public static readonly GameplayTag Shield = new GameplayTag("Event.Standard.Combat.Shield");
        /// <summary>Authored scalar policy (1 = suppress retaliation). Outcomes still publish;
        /// retaliation rules check this captured value, ordinary hit chains remain observable.</summary>
        public static readonly GameplayTag NoRetaliate = new GameplayTag("Data.Standard.Combat.NoRetaliate");
        /// <summary>Optional root-cast scalar: maximum reaction hops, integer 0..16. Default 16.
        /// Set in SkillDocument Defaults or captured input; cannot raise the World safety limit.</summary>
        public static readonly GameplayTag MaxChainDepth = new GameplayTag("Data.Standard.Combat.MaxChainDepth");
    }
    /// <summary>Defense routing: physical uses Defense, magical uses MagicDefense, true bypasses
    /// only Defense stages. Authored immunity/miss/shield/minimum ordering still applies.</summary>
    public enum GameplayDamageType { Physical, Magical, True }
    /// <summary>Committed feedback. Applied is actual resource change, distinct from calculated damage/overheal.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayCombatOutcome
    {
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        /// <summary>Input of the action that committed this result. Per-target effect application
        /// may derive a separate Context for the actual recipient.</summary>
        public GameplayContext ExecutionContext { get; }
        public GameplayCombatOutcomeKind Kind { get; }
        public DamageResult Damage { get; }
        public float Applied { get; }
        public float Overflow { get; }
        public float Before { get; }
        public float After { get; }
        public GameplayDamageType DamageType {get;}
        public GameplayCombatOutcome(GameplayContext context, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind kind, DamageResult damage, float applied, float overflow, float before, float after,GameplayDamageType damageType=GameplayDamageType.Physical)
            : this(context, kind, damage, applied, overflow, before, after, damageType, context) { }

        private GameplayCombatOutcome(GameplayContext context, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind kind, DamageResult damage,
            float applied, float overflow, float before, float after, GameplayDamageType damageType, GameplayContext executionContext)
        {
            Context = context; ExecutionContext = executionContext; Kind = kind; Damage = damage;
            Applied = applied; Overflow = overflow; Before = before; After = after; DamageType = damageType;
        }

        internal GameplayCombatOutcome WithExecutionContext(GameplayContext executionContext) =>
            new GameplayCombatOutcome(Context, Kind, Damage, Applied, Overflow, Before, After, DamageType, executionContext);
    }
    public enum GameplayDamageStageKind { Immunity, Miss, Defense, Critical, Shield, Minimum, Scale }
    public sealed class GameplayDamageStage
    {
        public GameplayDamageStageKind Kind { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue Value { get; }
        public GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind kind, IGameplayFloatValue value = null)
        {
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayDamageStageKind), kind)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kind));
            Kind = kind; Value = value ?? new GameplayConstantFloatValue(kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Critical ? 2 : 1);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Official damage Effect execution on the existing DamagePipeline. Stages are pure;
    /// final HP/Shield commit is atomic. Explicit captured Critical/Miss values give deterministic
    /// preview/runtime inputs. A fully absorbed hit stops Minimum, avoiding damage through a full shield.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayDamageExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
    {
        public static readonly GameplayTag CriticalKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Standard.Critical");
        public static readonly GameplayTag MissKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Standard.Miss");
        /// <summary>The net HP loss in this committed damage execution, available only to its heal.</summary>
        public static readonly GameplayTag AppliedDamageKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Standard.Combat.AppliedDamage");
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _amount;
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<GameplayDamageStage> _stages;
        private readonly GameplayTagQuery _immunity;
        private readonly GameplayHealExecution _healInstigator;
        public GameplayDamageType DamageType {get;}
        public GameplayDamageExecution(IGameplayFloatValue amount, IEnumerable<GameplayDamageStage> stages,
            GameplayTagQuery immunity = null, GameplayDamageType damageType = GameplayDamageType.Physical,
            IGameplayFloatValue healInstigatorAmount = null)
        {
            _amount = amount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(amount));
            if(!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayDamageType),damageType))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(damageType));DamageType=damageType;
            var copy = new List<GameplayDamageStage>(stages ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(stages)));
            if (copy.Contains(null)) throw new ArgumentException("Damage stage is null.");
            int shields = 0; foreach (var stage in copy) if (stage.Kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield) shields++;
            if (shields > 1) throw new ArgumentException("Only one shield stage may consume the captured capacity.");
            _stages = copy.AsReadOnly(); _immunity = immunity ?? GameplayTagQuery.Empty;
            if (healInstigatorAmount != null) _healInstigator = new GameplayHealExecution(healInstigatorAmount);
        }
        public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
        {
            if (!(application.Target is GameplayStandardActor target) || target.CombatAttributes == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Damage requires a standard target with a combat profile.");
            var map = target.CombatAttributes; float initial = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_amount, application);
            if (initial < 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Damage must be nonnegative; use Heal for restoration.");
            var pipeline = new DamagePipeline();
            foreach (var stage in _stages)
            {
                if (stage.Kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Defense)
                {
                    if(DamageType==GameplayDamageType.True)continue;
                    var defense=DamageType==GameplayDamageType.Magical?map.MagicDefense:map.Defense;
                    if (!defense.IsValid) throw new InvalidOperationException("Damage-type defense mapping is missing.");
                    pipeline.AddModifier(new DefenseDamageModifier(defense)); continue;
                }
                float value = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(stage.Value, application);
                if (value < 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Damage stage value must be nonnegative.");
                float shield = 0;
                if (stage.Kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield && (!map.Shield.IsValid || !target.Resources.TryGetBalance(map.Shield, out shield)))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Shield mapping is unavailable.");
                bool immune = !_immunity.IsEmpty && _immunity.Matches(target.Tags);
                bool critical = application.Context.Values.TryGetValue(CriticalKey, out float crit) && crit != 0;
                bool miss = application.Context.Values.TryGetValue(MissKey, out float missed) && missed != 0;
                pipeline.AddModifier(new Stage(stage.Kind, value, Math.Max(0, shield), immune, critical, miss));
            }
            var result = pipeline.Calculate(new DamageContext(application.Context, initial, target.Attributes, application.InstigatorAttributes));
            if (!target.Resources.TryGetBalance(map.Health, out float health)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Health resource is missing.");
            float applied = Math.Min(Math.Max(0, health), result.FinalDamage);
            Func<Action> commitShieldOwnership=null;
            var balances = new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float> { [map.Health] = Math.Max(0, health - applied) };
            if (result.AbsorbedDamage > 0)
            {
                if (!target.Resources.TryGetBalance(map.Shield, out float shield)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Shield resource is missing.");
                balances.Add(map.Shield, Math.Max(0, shield - result.AbsorbedDamage));
                commitShieldOwnership=target.Shields.PrepareConsumption(result.AbsorbedDamage,shield,application.Context);
            }
            target.Resources.SetBalancesAtomic(balances);
            var shieldBreakCallbacks = commitShieldOwnership?.Invoke();
            if (applied > 0 && balances[map.Health] == 0) target.Shields.RemoveCallbackShieldsOnDeath();
            target.ReportCombat(new GameplayCombatOutcome(application.Context, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Damage, result,
                applied, Math.Max(0, result.FinalDamage - applied), health, balances[map.Health],DamageType));
            if (_healInstigator != null && applied > 0 &&
                target.World.TryGetActor(application.Context.InstigatorId, out var instigator) &&
                instigator.CombatAttributes != null && instigator.IsTargetable)
            {
                var heal = application.Context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(instigator.Id, instigator.Position))
                    .WithValues(application.Context.Values.WithValue(AppliedDamageKey, applied));
                _healInstigator.Execute(new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(heal, instigator,
                    heal.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(), instigator.Attributes, instigator.Id, instigatorTarget: instigator));
            }
            shieldBreakCallbacks?.Invoke();
        }
        private sealed class Stage : IDamageResultModifier
        {
            private readonly GameplayDamageStageKind _kind; private readonly float _value, _shield;
            private readonly bool _immune, _critical, _miss;
            public Stage(GameplayDamageStageKind kind, float value, float shield, bool immune, bool critical, bool miss)
            { _kind = kind; _value = value; _shield = shield; _immune = immune; _critical = critical; _miss = miss; }
            public float Modify(DamageContext context, float currentDamage) => Calculate(context, currentDamage).Damage;
            public DamageStageResult Calculate(DamageContext context, float damage)
            {
                if (_kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Immunity && _immune) return new DamageStageResult(0, flags: DamageResultFlags.Immune, stop: true);
                if (_kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Miss && _miss) return new DamageStageResult(0, flags: DamageResultFlags.Miss, stop: true);
                if (_kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Critical && _critical) return new DamageStageResult(damage * _value, flags: DamageResultFlags.Critical);
                if (_kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Minimum) return new DamageStageResult(Math.Max(damage, _value));
                if (_kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Scale) return new DamageStageResult(damage * _value);
                if (_kind == GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield)
                {
                    float absorbed = Math.Min(damage, _shield);
                    return new DamageStageResult(damage - absorbed, absorbed,
                        _shield > 0 && absorbed >= _shield ? DamageResultFlags.ShieldBroken : DamageResultFlags.None,
                        absorbed > 0 && absorbed >= damage);
                }
                return new DamageStageResult(damage);
            }
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Standard heal on the mapped actual resource; bounded by MaxHealth, with explicit overheal feedback.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayHealExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
    {
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _amount;
        public GameplayHealExecution(IGameplayFloatValue amount) => _amount = amount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(amount));
        public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
        {
            if (!(application.Target is GameplayStandardActor target) || target.CombatAttributes == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Heal requires a combat profile.");
            var map = target.CombatAttributes; float amount = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_amount, application);
            if (amount < 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Heal must be nonnegative.");
            if (!target.Resources.TryGetBalance(map.Health, out float before)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Health resource is missing.");
            float maximum = target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(map.MaxHealth);
            float applied = Math.Min(amount, Math.Max(0, maximum - before));
            target.Resources.SetBalancesAtomic(new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float> { [map.Health] = before + applied });
            target.ReportCombat(new GameplayCombatOutcome(application.Context, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Heal, default, applied, amount - applied, before, before + applied));
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Instant shield capacity addition. Timed/owned contributions are a separate Effect lease operation.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayShieldExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
    {
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _amount;
        public GameplayShieldExecution(IGameplayFloatValue amount) => _amount = amount ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(amount));
        public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
        {
            if (!(application.Target is GameplayStandardActor target) || target.CombatAttributes == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Shield requires a combat profile.");
            var map = target.CombatAttributes;
            if (!map.Shield.IsValid || !target.Resources.TryGetBalance(map.Shield, out float before)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Shield resource is missing.");
            float amount = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_amount, application);
            if (amount < 0) throw new ArithmeticException("Shield must be nonnegative.");
            target.Resources.SetBalancesAtomic(new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId, float> { [map.Shield] = before + amount });
            target.ReportCombat(new GameplayCombatOutcome(application.Context, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Shield, default, amount, 0, before, before + amount));
        }
    }
}

using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Injected gameplay randomness; returns a finite number in [0,1). It is never read by
    /// animation/Editor sampling, and does not own a rule timer.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayRandomSource { double NextUnitInterval(); }
    /// <summary>Explicit seeded local sequence. Supply a game's source to the World when another

    }

            bool missNeeded=!_preserve||!context.Values.TryGetValue(GameplayDamageExecution.MissKey,out _);

            if(missNeeded)values=values.WithValue(GameplayDamageExecution.MissKey,Roll(actor.World.Random,miss)?1:0);

        private static bool Roll(IGameplayRandomSource source,float chance)

            double value=source.NextUnitInterval();if(!double.IsFinite(value)||value<0||value>=1)throw new ArithmeticException("Random source must return [0,1).");
            return value<chance;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Consumable shield ownership over the actual Shield resource. EffectContainer alone
    /// owns expiry; each contribution has an exact unstacked Effect lease. FIFO consumes owned shields
    /// before unowned capacity, and removal subtracts only that contribution's unspent remainder.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayShieldContributions : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly GameplayStandardActor _target;
        private readonly List<GameplayShieldContribution> _entries=new List<GameplayShieldContribution>();
        private bool _disposed;
        internal GameplayShieldContributions(GameplayStandardActor target)
        {_target=target;target.Effects.Removed+=OnRemoved;}
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayShieldContribution> Snapshot()=>_entries.ToArray();
        internal GameplayShieldContribution Add(GameplayContext context,GameplayEffectLease lease,float amount)
        {
            if(_disposed)throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(GameplayShieldContributions));
            float before=Balance();Reconcile(before);
            var entry=new GameplayShieldContribution(this,context,lease,amount);
            _target.Resources.SetBalancesAtomic(new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId,float>{{_target.CombatAttributes.Shield,before+amount}});
            _entries.Add(entry);return entry;
        }
        private float Balance()
        {
            if(_target.CombatAttributes==null||!_target.CombatAttributes.Shield.IsValid||!_target.Resources.TryGetBalance(_target.CombatAttributes.Shield,out float balance))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Shield mapping is unavailable.");
            return balance;
        }
        private void Reconcile(float actual)
        {
            double total=0;foreach(var entry in _entries)total+=entry.Remaining;
            double removed=Math.Max(0,total-Math.Max(0,actual));
            foreach(var entry in _entries){float take=(float)Math.Min(removed,entry.Remaining);entry.Remaining-=take;removed-=take;}
        }
        /// <summary>Prepares ownership allocation before the atomic resource write. Apply the returned
        /// commit only after that write succeeds; resource stores must use the synchronous Core contract.</summary>
        internal Func<Action> PrepareConsumption(float amount,float before, GameplayContext hit)
        {
            Reconcile(before);var updates=new List<(GameplayShieldContribution entry,float remaining)>();
            foreach (var entry in _entries)
            {
                float take = Math.Min(amount, entry.Remaining);
                if (take > 0) updates.Add((entry, entry.Remaining - take));
                amount -= take;
                if (amount <= 0) break;
            }
            return () =>
            {
                Action callbacks = null;
                foreach (var update in updates)
                    if (!update.entry.IsDisposed) update.entry.Remaining = update.remaining;
                foreach (var update in updates)
                {
                    var entry = update.entry;
                    if (entry.IsDisposed || update.remaining > 0 || (entry.Broken == null && entry.Expired == null)) continue;
                    var broken = entry.Broken;
                    Remove(entry, true);
                    if (broken != null) callbacks += () => broken(hit);
                }
                return callbacks;
            };
        }
        private void OnRemoved(GameplayEffectRemovalObservation observation)
        {
            foreach (var entry in _entries.ToArray())
            {
                if (entry.Lease.IsActive) continue;
                var expired = observation.Handle == entry.EffectHandle && observation.Cause == GameplayEffectRemovalCause.NaturalExpiry
                    ? entry.Expired : null;
                Remove(entry, false);
                expired?.Invoke();
            }
        }
        internal void RemoveCallbackShieldsOnDeath()
        {
            foreach (var entry in _entries.ToArray())
                if (entry.Broken != null || entry.Expired != null) Remove(entry, true);
        }
        internal void Remove(GameplayShieldContribution entry,bool removeEffect)
        {
            if(entry.IsDisposed)return;
            if (entry.Remaining > 0)
            {
                float before = Balance();
                Reconcile(before);
                if (entry.Remaining > 0)
                    _target.Resources.SetBalancesAtomic(new Dictionary<GameplayAttributeId,float>{{_target.CombatAttributes.Shield,Math.Max(0,before-entry.Remaining)}});
            }
            _entries.Remove(entry);entry.MarkRemoved();
            if(removeEffect)entry.Lease.Dispose();
        }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if(_disposed)return;_disposed=true;_target.Effects.Removed-=OnRemoved;
            foreach(var entry in _entries.ToArray())Remove(entry,true);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Exact remaining consumable capacity. Context preserves root/level; lease supplies the
    /// existing Effect lifetime. Cancel/expiry never remove another shield's remaining capacity.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayShieldContribution : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly GameplayShieldContributions _owner;
        internal GameplayEffectLease Lease {get;}
        public GameplayContext Context {get;}
        public GameplayEffectHandle EffectHandle=>Lease.Handle;
        public float Remaining {get;internal set;}
        public bool IsDisposed {get;private set;}
        internal Action ReleaseBinding;
        internal Action<GameplayContext> Broken;
        internal Action Expired;
        internal GameplayShieldContribution(GameplayShieldContributions owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayEffectLease lease,float amount)
        {_owner=owner;Context=context;Lease=lease;Remaining=amount;}
        internal void MarkRemoved(){IsDisposed=true;Remaining=0;Broken=null;Expired=null;ReleaseBinding?.Invoke();ReleaseBinding=null;}
        public void Dispose()=>_owner.Remove(this,true);
    }
    /// <summary>Grants a separate timed shield using an actual Effect clock; no time lives in this action.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction : IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _amount;
        private readonly GameplayEffectDefinition _lifetime;
        private readonly bool _ownedByAbility;
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> _onBroken, _onExpired;
        public GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction(IGameplayFloatValue amount,IGameplayFloatValue duration,bool ownedByAbility=false,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onBroken = null, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onExpired = null)
        {
            _amount=amount??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(amount));
            _lifetime=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,1,0,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(),null,
                effectTags:new[]{new GameplayTag("Effect.Standard.Shield")},durationValue:duration??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(duration)));
            _ownedByAbility=ownedByAbility;
            _onBroken = GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onBroken);
            _onExpired = GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onExpired);
        }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor)||!context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget||!actor.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId,out var target)||target.CombatAttributes==null)
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            GameplayAbilityHandle grant=default;
            if(_ownedByAbility&&!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,context,out grant))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var application=new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context,target,context.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(),actor.Attributes,actor.Id,instigatorTarget:actor);
            float amount=GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_amount,application);if(amount<0)throw new ArithmeticException("Shield must be nonnegative.");
            var result=target.Effects.Apply(_lifetime,application);
            if(!GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(target.Effects,result,out var lease))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            GameplayShieldContribution contribution=null;
            try
            {
                contribution=target.Shields.Add(context,lease,amount);
                if (_onBroken.Count > 0) contribution.Broken = hit =>
                {
                    if (!actor.IsTargetable || !target.IsTargetable ||
                        !actor.World.TryGetActor(hit.InstigatorId, out var breaker) || !breaker.IsTargetable) return;
                    var retaliate = context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(breaker.Id, breaker.Position));
                    GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_onBroken, retaliate,
                        new GameplayEventData(new GameplayTag("Event.Standard.Shield.Broken"), retaliate, 1), actor);
                };
                if (_onExpired.Count > 0) contribution.Expired = () =>
                {
                    if (!actor.IsTargetable || !target.IsTargetable) return;
                    GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_onExpired, context,
                        new GameplayEventData(new GameplayTag("Event.Standard.Shield.Expired"), context, 1), actor);
                };
                if(_ownedByAbility&&!actor.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(grant,contribution)){contribution.Dispose();return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;}
                if(_ownedByAbility)contribution.ReleaseBinding=()=>actor.Abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(grant,contribution);
            }
            catch{if(contribution!=null)contribution.Dispose();else lease.Dispose();throw;}
            target.Resources.TryGetBalance(target.CombatAttributes.Shield,out float after);
            target.ReportCombat(new GameplayCombatOutcome(context,GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Shield,default,amount,0,after-amount,after));
            return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Persistent region policy. Aura entries are contribution-owned by each region; ordinary
    /// enter/tick actions retain their own authored effect policies. Never shares membership in an SO.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAreaDefinition
    {
        public GameplaySearchShape Shape {get;}
        public GameplaySpatialPlane Plane {get;}
        public GameplaySearchOrigin Origin {get;}
        public GameplayPoint OriginOffset {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Radius {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Angle {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Length {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Width {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Height {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Duration {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue TickInterval {get;}
        public bool TickOnEnter {get;}
        public bool FollowOwner {get;}
        public bool EndOnOwnerDeath { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue ArmingDelay {get;}
        /// <summary>0 means unlimited entries. A positive limit finishes after that many successful
        /// enter callbacks, using the same cleanup path as expiry/cancel (trap placement semantics).</summary>
        public int TriggerLimit {get;}
        public GameplayFactionFilter Faction {get;}
        public GameplayTagQuery Tags {get;}
        public int LayerMask {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayPoint> Cells {get;}
        public float CellSize {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectDefinition> Aura {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnEnter {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnTick {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnExit {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnEnd {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnStay {get;}
        public IGameplaySpatialViewFactory View {get;}
        public GameplayAreaDefinition(GameplaySearchShape shape,GameplaySpatialPlane plane,GameplaySearchOrigin origin,IGameplayFloatValue radius,
            IGameplayFloatValue angle,IGameplayFloatValue length,IGameplayFloatValue width,IGameplayFloatValue height,IGameplayFloatValue duration,IGameplayFloatValue tickInterval,
            bool tickOnEnter=true,bool followOwner=false,GameplayFactionFilter faction=GameplayFactionFilter.Enemies,GameplayTagQuery tags=null,int layerMask=-1,
            IEnumerable<GameplayEffectDefinition> aura=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onEnter=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onTick=null,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onExit=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onEnd=null,IEnumerable<GameplayPoint> cells=null,float cellSize=1,IGameplaySpatialViewFactory view=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onStay=null,
            IGameplayFloatValue armingDelay=null,int triggerLimit=0,GameplayPoint originOffset=default,
            bool endOnOwnerDeath=false)
        {
            if(shape!=GameplaySearchShape.Circle&&shape!=GameplaySearchShape.Sector&&shape!=GameplaySearchShape.Box&&shape!=GameplaySearchShape.GridCells)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(shape));
            if(!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySpatialPlane),plane)||!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySearchOrigin),origin)||!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayFactionFilter),faction))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(plane));
            Shape=shape;Plane=plane;Origin=origin;Radius=radius??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(radius));Angle=angle??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(angle));
            OriginOffset=originOffset;
            Length=length??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(length));Width=width??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(width));Height=height??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(height));
            Duration=duration??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(duration));TickInterval=tickInterval??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tickInterval));
            TickOnEnter=tickOnEnter;FollowOwner=followOwner;Faction=faction;Tags=tags??GameplayTagQuery.Empty;LayerMask=layerMask;
            EndOnOwnerDeath = endOnOwnerDeath;
            if(triggerLimit<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(triggerLimit));TriggerLimit=triggerLimit;ArmingDelay=armingDelay??new GameplayConstantFloatValue(0);
            var effects=new List<GameplayEffectDefinition>(aura??Array.Empty<GameplayEffectDefinition>());
            if(effects.Exists(e=>e==null||e.DurationPolicy==GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant))throw new ArgumentException("Aura requires persistent effect contributions.");
            Aura=effects.AsReadOnly();OnEnter=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onEnter);OnTick=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onTick);OnExit=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onExit);OnEnd=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onEnd);
            OnStay=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onStay);
            Cells=new List<GameplayPoint>(cells??Array.Empty<GameplayPoint>()).AsReadOnly();CellSize=cellSize;View=view;
            if(!float.IsFinite(cellSize)||cellSize<=0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(cellSize));
        }
    }
    /// <summary>World-owned persistent region. One query supplies enter/exit/tick membership each step.
    /// An aura contribution cleans up on exit, region end, cast cancellation and owner cleanup;
    /// overlapping sources and shared stack layers are never removed by a definition scan.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAreaOperation:GameplaySpatialOperation
    {
        private readonly GameplayAreaDefinition _definition;
        private readonly float _radius,_angle,_length,_width,_height,_duration,_period;
        private readonly float _arming;
        private readonly GameplayPoint _initialPosition;
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplaySourceId,GameplayEffectLease[]> _inside=new Dictionary<GameplaySourceId,GameplayEffectLease[]>();
        private double _age;
        private long _ticks;
        public int InsideCount=>_inside.Count;
        public bool IsArmed=>!IsDisposed&&_age>=_arming;
        public int TriggerCount {get;private set;}
        internal GameplayAreaOperation(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,GameplayAreaDefinition definition)
            :base(owner,context,grant,definition.View)
        {
            _definition=definition;
            _radius=definition.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Circle||definition.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Sector?GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Radius,owner,context,"Area radius"):1;
            _angle=definition.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Sector?GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Angle,owner,context,"Area angle"):120;
            _length=definition.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Box?GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Length,owner,context,"Area length"):1;
            _width=definition.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.Box?GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Width,owner,context,"Area width"):1;
            _height=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Height,owner,context,"Area height");_duration=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Duration,owner,context,"Area duration");
            _period=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.TickInterval,owner,context,"Area period");
            _arming=GameplaySpatialMath.Finite(definition.ArmingDelay,owner,context);
            if(_arming<0||_arming>=_duration)throw new ArithmeticException("Area arming delay must be nonnegative and shorter than its duration.");
            if(definition.Origin==GameplaySearchOrigin.ContextPoint)
            {if(!context.TargetData.HasPoint)throw new InvalidOperationException("Area requires a captured point.");Position=context.TargetData.Point;}
            else if(definition.Origin==GameplaySearchOrigin.PrimaryTarget)
            {if(!owner.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId,out var target))throw new InvalidOperationException("Area target is missing.");Position=target.Position;}
            Position=new GameplayPoint(Position.X+definition.OriginOffset.X,Position.Y+definition.OriginOffset.Y,Position.Z+definition.OriginOffset.Z);
            _initialPosition=Position;
            Geometry(); // Validate before registration/visibility.
        }
        private GameplaySearchGeometry Geometry()
        {
            IReadOnlyList<GameplayPoint> cells=_definition.Cells;
            if(_definition.Shape==GameplaySearchShape.GridCells&&_definition.FollowOwner)
            {
                var shifted=new GameplayPoint[cells.Count];
                for(int i=0;i<shifted.Length;i++)shifted[i]=new GameplayPoint(cells[i].X+Position.X-_initialPosition.X,cells[i].Y+Position.Y-_initialPosition.Y,cells[i].Z+Position.Z-_initialPosition.Z);
                cells=shifted;
            }
            return new GameplaySearchGeometry(_definition.Shape,_definition.Plane,Position,Direction,_radius,_angle,_length,_width,_height,cells:cells,cellSize:_definition.CellSize);
        }
        protected override void OnStart(){if(IsArmed)UpdateMembership();}
        internal override void Advance(float delta)
        {
            if(Owner.IsDisposed){Dispose();return;}
            if (_definition.EndOnOwnerDeath && !Owner.IsTargetable)
            {
                Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Died);
                return;
            }
            double next=Math.Min(_duration,_age+(double)delta);
            double boundaries=Math.Floor(Math.Max(0,next-_arming)/_period);
            if(boundaries-_ticks>4096)throw new InvalidOperationException("Area step exceeds the callback budget; advance the world in smaller steps.");
            long due=(long)boundaries;
            float activeDelta=(float)(Math.Max(0,next-_arming)-Math.Max(0,_age-_arming));
            _age=next;
            if(_definition.FollowOwner){var origin=Owner.Position;var offset=_definition.OriginOffset;Position=new GameplayPoint(origin.X+offset.X,origin.Y+offset.Y,origin.Z+offset.Z);Direction=Owner.Facing;Notify();}
            if(!IsArmed)return;
            UpdateMembership();
            if(activeDelta>0&&_definition.OnStay.Count>0)foreach(var id in SortedInside())
                if(!IsDisposed&&Owner.World.TryGetActor(id,out var target)&&target.IsTargetable)
                    Run(_definition.OnStay,At(id,target.Position),"Event.Standard.Area.Stay",activeDelta);
            while(!IsDisposed&&_ticks<due)
            {
                _ticks++;
                foreach(var id in SortedInside())
                    if(!IsDisposed&&Owner.World.TryGetActor(id,out var target)&&target.IsTargetable)
                        Run(_definition.OnTick,At(id,target.Position),"Event.Standard.Area.Tick",(float)(_ticks*_period));
            }
            if(!IsDisposed&&_age>=_duration)Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Completed);
        }
        private GameplaySourceId[] SortedInside(){var ids=new List<GameplaySourceId>(_inside.Keys);ids.Sort((a,b)=>a.Value.CompareTo(b.Value));return ids.ToArray();}
        private void UpdateMembership()
        {
            var selected=Owner.World.Spatial.Query(new GameplaySpatialSearchRequest(Context,Geometry(),Owner.Faction,_definition.Faction,_definition.Tags,_definition.LayerMask));
            var current=new HashSet<GameplaySourceId>(selected.Targets);
            foreach(var id in SortedInside())if(!current.Contains(id))Exit(id);
            foreach(var id in selected.Targets)
            {
                if(IsDisposed)return;
                if(!Owner.World.TryGetActor(id,out var target)||!target.IsTargetable)continue;
                bool entered=!_inside.TryGetValue(id,out var leases);
                if(entered){leases=new GameplayEffectLease[_definition.Aura.Count];_inside.Add(id,leases);}
                for(int i=0;i<leases.Length&&!IsDisposed;i++)
                {
                    if(leases[i]?.IsActive==true)continue;
                    leases[i]?.Dispose();leases[i]=null;
                    var result=Owner.ApplyEffect(At(id,target.Position),_definition.Aura[i]);
                    if(GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(target.Effects,result,out var lease))
                    {if(IsDisposed)lease.Dispose();else leases[i]=lease;}
                }
                if(entered&&!IsDisposed)
                {
                    var context=At(id,target.Position);Run(_definition.OnEnter,context,"Event.Standard.Area.Enter");
                    if(IsDisposed)return;
                    TriggerCount++;
                    if(_definition.TickOnEnter&&!IsDisposed)Run(_definition.OnTick,context,"Event.Standard.Area.Tick",0);
                    if(!IsDisposed&&_definition.TriggerLimit>0&&TriggerCount>=_definition.TriggerLimit){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.HitLimit);return;}
                }
            }
        }
        private void Exit(GameplaySourceId id)
        {
            if(!_inside.TryGetValue(id,out var leases))return;_inside.Remove(id);
            List<Exception> errors=null;
            foreach(var lease in leases)try{lease?.Dispose();}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}
            var point=Owner.World.TryGetActor(id,out var target)?target.Position:Position;
            try{Run(_definition.OnExit,At(id,point),"Event.Standard.Area.Exit",1,IsDisposed);}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}
            if(errors!=null)throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }
        protected override void OnFinished(GameplaySpatialEndReason reason)
        {
            List<Exception> errors=null;
            foreach(var id in SortedInside())try{Exit(id);}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}
            try{Run(_definition.OnEnd,Context,"Event.Standard.Area.End",(float)reason,true);}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}
            if(errors!=null)throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class GameplayStandardWorld
    {
        public GameplayAreaOperation SpawnArea(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayAreaDefinition definition)
        {if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));ValidateSpatialOwner(owner,context,out var grant);return RegisterSpatial(new GameplayAreaOperation(owner,context,grant,definition),grant);}
    }
    public sealed class GameplaySpawnAreaAction:IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public GameplayAreaDefinition Definition {get;}
        public GameplaySpawnAreaAction(GameplayAreaDefinition definition)=>Definition=definition??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor)||!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,context,out var grant))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;return actor.World.SpawnArea(actor,context,Definition)!=null?GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded:GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;}
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Actual displacement using existing request semantics. One target has one active
    /// command; equal/higher priority interrupts, lower priority is ignored. Direction is captured
    /// at start unless pull explicitly follows the moving source. Detached commands remain world-owned.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayMovementOperation:GameplaySpatialOperation
    {
        public GameplayStandardActor Target {get;}
        public GameplayDisplacementRequest Request {get;}
        public int Priority {get;}
        public float Travelled {get;private set;}
        private readonly GameplayTagQuery _blocked;
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> _arrive,_cancel;
        private readonly float _distance;
        private readonly bool _followSource;
        private readonly float _minimumSeparation, _duration;
        private float _age;
        internal GameplayMovementOperation(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,
            GameplayStandardActor target,GameplayDisplacementRequest request,int priority,GameplayTagQuery blocked,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> arrive,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> cancelled,bool cancelOnAbilityEnd=true,
            bool followSource=false,float minimumSeparation=0,float duration=0):base(owner,context,grant,null,cancelOnAbilityEnd)
        {
            _followSource=followSource;_minimumSeparation=minimumSeparation;_duration=duration;
            Target=target;Request=request;Priority=priority;_blocked=blocked;
            _arrive=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(arrive);_cancel=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(cancelled);Position=target.Position;
            Direction=request.Mode==GameplayDisplacementMode.Directional?request.Direction.Value:
                request.Mode==GameplayDisplacementMode.PushFromSource?GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(owner.Position,target.Position,owner.Facing):GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(target.Position,owner.Position,owner.Facing);
            _distance=request.Mode==GameplayDisplacementMode.PullToSource&&!followSource?Math.Min(request.Distance,Math.Max(0,GameplaySpatialMath.Distance(target.Position,owner.Position)-minimumSeparation)):request.Distance;
        }
        protected override void OnStart(){if(_distance==0)Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Arrived);}
        internal override void Advance(float delta)
        {
            if(Target.IsDisposed||!Target.IsTargetable){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.TargetLost);return;}
            if(_blocked!=null&&_blocked.Matches(Target.Tags)){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Controlled);return;}
            if(_followSource&&Request.Mode==GameplayDisplacementMode.PullToSource)
                Direction=GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(Target.Position,Owner.Position,Direction);
            float step=Math.Min(_distance-Travelled,Request.Speed*delta);

                step=Math.Min(step,Math.Max(0,GameplaySpatialMath.Distance(Target.Position,Owner.Position)-_minimumSeparation));
            if(_duration>0)step=Math.Min(step,Request.Speed*Math.Max(0,_duration-_age));

        }
        protected override void OnFinished(GameplaySpatialEndReason reason)
        {
            Owner.World.DetachMovement(this);
            if(reason==GameplaySpatialEndReason.Arrived)Run(_arrive,At(Target.Id,Position),"Event.Standard.Move.Arrive",Travelled,true);
            else if(reason!=GameplaySpatialEndReason.Completed)Run(_cancel,At(Target.Id,Position),"Event.Standard.Move.Cancelled",(float)reason,true);
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class GameplayStandardWorld
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplaySourceId,GameplayMovementOperation> _movements=new Dictionary<GameplaySourceId,GameplayMovementOperation>();
        internal void DetachMovement(GameplayMovementOperation operation)
        {if(_movements.TryGetValue(operation.Target.Id,out var current)&&ReferenceEquals(current,operation))_movements.Remove(operation.Target.Id);}
        public GameplayMovementOperation StartMovement(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayDisplacementRequest request,int priority=10,
            GameplayTagQuery blocked=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onArrive=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onCancelled=null,
            bool cancelOnAbilityEnd=true,bool followSource=false,float minimumSeparation=0,float duration=0)
        {
            if(!float.IsFinite(minimumSeparation)||minimumSeparation<0||!float.IsFinite(duration)||duration<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(minimumSeparation));
            if(request==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request));ValidateSpatialOwner(owner,request.Context,out var grant);
            if(!TryGetActor(request.TargetId,out var target)||!target.IsTargetable||blocked!=null&&blocked.Matches(target.Tags))return null;
            _movements.TryGetValue(target.Id,out var previous);
            if(previous!=null&&!previous.IsDisposed&&previous.Priority>priority)return null;
            var operation=new GameplayMovementOperation(owner,request.Context,grant,target,request,priority,blocked,onArrive,onCancelled,cancelOnAbilityEnd,followSource,minimumSeparation,duration);
            _movements[target.Id]=operation;
            try
            {
                previous?.Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Interrupted);
                if(operation.IsDisposed)return null;
                return RegisterSpatial(operation,grant);
            }
            catch{operation.Dispose();throw;}
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Immediate heading command for the actual actor authority, including 2D/3D/logical bindings.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayRotateToPointAction:IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public bool RotateOwner {get;}
        public GameplayRotateToPointAction(bool rotateOwner=true)=>RotateOwner=rotateOwner;
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor owner))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var target=owner;if(!RotateOwner&&!owner.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId,out target))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var point=context.TargetData.HasPoint?context.TargetData.Point:owner.Position;
            target.Facing=GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(target.Position,point,target.Facing);return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
        }
    }
    public sealed class GameplayMoveTargetsAction:IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public GameplayDisplacementMode Mode {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Distance {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Speed {get;}
        public int Priority {get;}
        public GameplayTagQuery Blocked {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnArrive {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnCancelled {get;}
        public bool CancelOnAbilityEnd {get;}
        public bool FollowSource {get;}
        public float MinimumSeparation {get;}
        public float Duration {get;}
        public GameplayMoveTargetsAction(GameplayDisplacementMode mode,IGameplayFloatValue distance,IGameplayFloatValue speed,int priority=10,GameplayTagQuery blocked=null,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onArrive=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onCancelled=null,
            bool cancelOnAbilityEnd=true,bool followSource=false,float minimumSeparation=0,float duration=0)
        {
            if(!float.IsFinite(minimumSeparation)||minimumSeparation<0||!float.IsFinite(duration)||duration<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(minimumSeparation));
            CancelOnAbilityEnd=cancelOnAbilityEnd;FollowSource=followSource;MinimumSeparation=minimumSeparation;Duration=duration;
            if(!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayDisplacementMode),mode))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(mode));
            Mode=mode;Distance=distance??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(distance));Speed=speed??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(speed));
            Priority=priority;Blocked=blocked;OnArrive=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onArrive);OnCancelled=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onCancelled);
        }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor)||!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,context,out var grant))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var ids=context.TargetData.Targets.Count>0?context.TargetData.Targets:context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget?new[]{context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId}:Array.Empty<GameplaySourceId>();
            foreach(var id in ids)
            {
                if(!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,context,out grant))break;
                if(!actor.World.TryGetActor(id,out var target))continue;
                var targeted=context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(id,target.Position));
                float distance=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(Distance,actor,targeted,"Movement distance"),speed=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(Speed,actor,targeted,"Movement speed");
                actor.World.StartMovement(actor,new GameplayDisplacementRequest(targeted,id,Mode,distance,speed,Mode==GameplayDisplacementMode.Directional?(GameplayDirection?)actor.Facing:null),Priority,Blocked,OnArrive,OnCancelled,CancelOnAbilityEnd,FollowSource,MinimumSeparation,Duration);
            }
            return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
        }
    }

using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    public enum GameplayProjectileMotionKind { Straight, Homing, Arc, Parabolic, Bezier }
    /// <summary>Direction preserves legacy range shots; CapturedDestination stops at the launch point/target snapshot.</summary>
    public enum GameplayStraightDestinationMode { Direction, CapturedDestination }
    /// <summary>Immutable launch inputs. Duration/Speed/Height are captured at spawn; a homing
    /// target's actual current position is supplied at sampling time, not copied into a shared asset.</summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayProjectileLaunch
    {
        public GameplayPoint Origin {get;}
        public GameplayPoint Destination {get;}
        public GameplayDirection Direction {get;}
        public GameplaySpatialPlane Plane {get;}
        public float Speed {get;}
        public float Duration {get;}
        public float Height {get;}
        public GameplayProjectileLaunch(GameplayPoint origin,GameplayPoint destination,GameplayDirection direction,GameplaySpatialPlane plane,float speed,float duration,float height)
        {Origin=origin;Destination=destination;Direction=direction;Plane=plane;Speed=speed;Duration=duration;Height=height;}
    }
    /// <summary>Per-projectile motion instance. A custom strategy receives the world's existing delta
    /// and absolute local age; it must not create a timer, move a Unity object or invoke another world step.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayProjectileMotion
    {GameplayPoint Sample(double age,float delta,GameplayPoint current,GameplayPoint? liveTarget);bool Arrived {get;}}
    public interface IGameplayProjectileMotionDefinition { IGameplayProjectileMotion Create(GameplayProjectileLaunch launch); }
    /// <summary>Actual standard straight/homing and planar arc/world-up parabola/cubic Bezier sampling.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition:IGameplayProjectileMotionDefinition
    {
        public GameplayProjectileMotionKind Kind {get;}
        public GameplayPoint Control1Offset {get;}
        public GameplayPoint Control2Offset {get;}
        public GameplayStraightDestinationMode StraightDestination {get;}
        public GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition(GameplayProjectileMotionKind kind,GameplayPoint control1Offset=default,GameplayPoint control2Offset=default,
            GameplayStraightDestinationMode straightDestination=GameplayStraightDestinationMode.Direction)
        {if(!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayProjectileMotionKind),kind)||!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayStraightDestinationMode),straightDestination))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(kind));Kind=kind;Control1Offset=control1Offset;Control2Offset=control2Offset;StraightDestination=straightDestination;}
        public IGameplayProjectileMotion Create(GameplayProjectileLaunch launch)=>new Motion(this,launch);
        private sealed class Motion:IGameplayProjectileMotion
        {
            private readonly GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition _definition;
            private readonly GameplayProjectileLaunch _launch;
            public bool Arrived {get;private set;}
            internal Motion(GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition definition,GameplayProjectileLaunch launch){_definition=definition;_launch=launch;}
            public GameplayPoint Sample(double age,float delta,GameplayPoint current,GameplayPoint? liveTarget)
            {
                if(_definition.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight)
                {
                    if(_definition.StraightDestination==GameplayStraightDestinationMode.Direction)
                        return GameplaySpatialMath.Offset(current,_launch.Direction,_launch.Speed*delta);
                    float remaining=GameplaySpatialMath.Distance(current,_launch.Destination);
                    float travel=Math.Min(remaining,_launch.Speed*delta);Arrived=travel>=remaining;
                    return Arrived?_launch.Destination:GameplaySpatialMath.Offset(current,_launch.Direction,travel);
                }
                if(_definition.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Homing)
                {
                    var target=liveTarget??_launch.Destination;float distance=GameplaySpatialMath.Distance(current,target);
                    float travel=Math.Min(distance,_launch.Speed*delta);Arrived=travel>=distance;
                    return GameplaySpatialMath.Offset(current,GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(current,target,_launch.Direction),travel);
                }
                float t=(float)Math.Min(1,age/_launch.Duration);Arrived=t>=1;
                if(_definition.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Bezier)
                {
                    var a=_launch.Origin;var d=_launch.Destination;
                    var b=new GameplayPoint(a.X+_definition.Control1Offset.X,a.Y+_definition.Control1Offset.Y,a.Z+_definition.Control1Offset.Z);
                    var c=new GameplayPoint(d.X+_definition.Control2Offset.X,d.Y+_definition.Control2Offset.Y,d.Z+_definition.Control2Offset.Z);
                    return GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(a,b,t),GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(b,c,t),t),
                        GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(b,c,t),GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(c,d,t),t),t);
                }
                var point=GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(_launch.Origin,_launch.Destination,t);
                float height=_launch.Height*4*t*(1-t);
                if(_definition.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Parabolic)return new GameplayPoint(point.X,point.Y+height,point.Z);
                // Arc bends within the selected logical plane; Parabolic uses actual world-up Y.
                if(_launch.Plane==GameplaySpatialPlane.XZ)return new GameplayPoint(point.X-_launch.Direction.Z*height,point.Y,point.Z+_launch.Direction.X*height);
                return new GameplayPoint(point.X-_launch.Direction.Y*height,point.Y+_launch.Direction.X*height,point.Z);
            }
        }
    }
    public sealed class GameplayProjectileDefinition
    {
        public IGameplayProjectileMotionDefinition Motion {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Speed {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Duration {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue HitRadius {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue MaxRange {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Height {get;}
        public GameplaySpatialPlane Plane {get;}
        public GameplayFactionFilter Faction {get;}
        public GameplayTagQuery Tags {get;}
        public int LayerMask {get;}
        /// <summary>Total distinct targets allowed, including the first hit; never a per-frame counter.</summary>
        public int MaxHits {get;}
        public bool RequiresLiveTarget {get;}
        public bool OnlyHitPrimaryTarget { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnHit {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnArrive {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnRange {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnCancelled {get;}
        public IGameplaySpatialViewFactory View {get;}
        public bool CancelOnAbilityEnd {get;}
        public GameplayPoint LaunchOffset {get;}
        public GameplayPoint DestinationOffset {get;}
        public float DirectionAngle {get;}
        public GameplayProjectileDefinition(IGameplayProjectileMotionDefinition motion,IGameplayFloatValue speed,IGameplayFloatValue duration,
            IGameplayFloatValue hitRadius,IGameplayFloatValue maxRange,IGameplayFloatValue height,GameplaySpatialPlane plane=GameplaySpatialPlane.XY,
            GameplayFactionFilter faction=GameplayFactionFilter.Enemies,GameplayTagQuery tags=null,int layerMask=-1,int maxHits=1,bool requiresLiveTarget=false,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onHit=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onArrive=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onRange=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onCancelled=null,IGameplaySpatialViewFactory view=null,
            bool cancelOnAbilityEnd=true,GameplayPoint launchOffset=default,GameplayPoint destinationOffset=default,float directionAngle=0,
            bool onlyHitPrimaryTarget=false)
        {
            Motion=motion??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(motion));Speed=speed??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(speed));Duration=duration??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(duration));
            HitRadius=hitRadius??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(hitRadius));MaxRange=maxRange??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(maxRange));Height=height??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(height));
            if(!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySpatialPlane),plane)||!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayFactionFilter),faction)||maxHits<1)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxHits));
            Plane=plane;Faction=faction;Tags=tags??GameplayTagQuery.Empty;LayerMask=layerMask;MaxHits=maxHits;RequiresLiveTarget=requiresLiveTarget;
            OnlyHitPrimaryTarget = onlyHitPrimaryTarget;
            OnHit=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onHit);OnArrive=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onArrive);OnRange=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onRange);OnCancelled=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onCancelled);View=view;
            CancelOnAbilityEnd=cancelOnAbilityEnd;LaunchOffset=launchOffset;DestinationOffset=destinationOffset;
            if(!float.IsFinite(directionAngle))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(directionAngle));DirectionAngle=directionAngle;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>World-owned projectile; swept centre geometry prevents tunnelling for each sampled
    /// segment. Curves use at most 1/60s segments. Hit identities, level and callbacks survive target/source derivation.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayProjectile:GameplaySpatialOperation
    {
        private readonly GameplayProjectileDefinition _definition;
        private readonly IGameplayProjectileMotion _motion;
        private readonly float _duration,_radius,_range;
        private readonly GameplaySourceId _target;
        private readonly HashSet<GameplaySourceId> _hits=new HashSet<GameplaySourceId>();
        private double _age;
        public float DistanceTravelled {get;private set;}
        public int HitCount=>_hits.Count;
        internal GameplayProjectile(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,GameplayProjectileDefinition definition,
            GameplayPoint? launchPoint = null)
            :base(owner,context,grant,definition.View,definition.CancelOnAbilityEnd)
        {
            _definition=definition;_duration=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Duration,owner,context,"Projectile duration");
            var launch = launchPoint ?? Position;
            Position=new GameplayPoint(launch.X+definition.LaunchOffset.X,launch.Y+definition.LaunchOffset.Y,launch.Z+definition.LaunchOffset.Z);
            _radius=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.HitRadius,owner,context,"Hit radius");_range=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.MaxRange,owner,context,"Max range");
            float speed=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Speed,owner,context,"Speed");
            float height=GameplaySpatialMath.Finite(definition.Height,owner,context);
            _target=context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId==owner.Id?default:context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId;
            GameplayPoint destination=GameplaySpatialMath.Offset(Position,Direction,_range);
            if(_target!=owner.Id&&owner.World.TryGetActor(_target,out var target))destination=target.Position;
            else if(context.TargetData.HasPoint)destination=context.TargetData.Point;
            destination=new GameplayPoint(destination.X+definition.DestinationOffset.X,destination.Y+definition.DestinationOffset.Y,destination.Z+definition.DestinationOffset.Z);
            if(definition.Motion is GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition pointMotion && pointMotion.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight &&
                pointMotion.StraightDestination==GameplayStraightDestinationMode.CapturedDestination &&
                !context.TargetData.HasPoint && !owner.World.TryGetActor(_target,out _))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Straight captured destination requires an explicit point or target.");
            if(definition.RequiresLiveTarget&&(_target==owner.Id||!owner.World.TryGetActor(_target,out var live)||!live.IsTargetable))throw new InvalidOperationException("Homing projectile requires a live explicit target.");
            Direction=GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(Position,destination,Direction);
            if(definition.DirectionAngle!=0){
                double radians=definition.DirectionAngle*Math.PI/180,c=Math.Cos(radians),s=Math.Sin(radians);
                float x=Direction.X,y=Direction.Y,z=Direction.Z;
                Direction=definition.Plane==GameplaySpatialPlane.XY?new GameplayDirection((float)(x*c-y*s),(float)(x*s+y*c),z):
                    definition.Plane==GameplaySpatialPlane.XZ?new GameplayDirection((float)(x*c-z*s),y,(float)(x*s+z*c)):
                    new GameplayDirection(x,(float)(y*c-z*s),(float)(y*s+z*c));

        }
        internal override void Advance(float delta)
        {
            if(Owner.IsDisposed){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Cancelled);return;}
            double endpoint=Math.Min(_duration,_age+(double)delta);
            while(_age<endpoint&&!IsDisposed)
            {
                bool linear=_definition.Motion is GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition standard&&(standard.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight||standard.Kind==GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Homing);
                double nextAge=linear||endpoint-_age<=1d/60?endpoint:_age+1d/60;
                float step=(float)(nextAge-_age);

                {if(!Owner.World.TryGetActor(_target,out var target)||!target.IsTargetable){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.TargetLost);return;}liveTarget=target.Position;}
                var previous=Position;_age=nextAge;var next=_motion.Sample(_age,step,Position,liveTarget);
                float distance=GameplaySpatialMath.Distance(previous,next),rangeLeft=_range-DistanceTravelled;
                bool reachedRange=distance>=rangeLeft;
                bool rangeClipped=distance>rangeLeft;
                if(rangeClipped&&distance>0){next=GameplaySpatialMath.Lerp(previous,next,rangeLeft/distance);distance=rangeLeft;}
                Direction=GameplaySpatialMath.Direction(previous,next,Direction);Position=next;DistanceTravelled+=distance;Notify();
                var geometry=distance>0?new GameplaySearchGeometry(GameplaySearchShape.Capsule,_definition.Plane,previous,Direction,_radius,length:distance,height:_radius*2):
                    new GameplaySearchGeometry(GameplaySearchShape.Circle,_definition.Plane,previous,Direction,_radius,height:_radius*2);
                var selected=Owner.World.Spatial.Query(new GameplaySpatialSearchRequest(Context,geometry,Owner.Faction,_definition.Faction,_definition.Tags,_definition.LayerMask));
                foreach(var id in selected.Targets)
                {
                    if(IsDisposed)break;
                    if ((_definition.OnlyHitPrimaryTarget && id != _target) ||
                        !Owner.World.TryGetActor(id,out var target)||!target.IsTargetable||!_hits.Add(id))continue;
                    var hit=At(id,target.Position);Run(_definition.OnHit,hit,"Event.Standard.Projectile.Hit",DistanceTravelled);
                    if(!IsDisposed&&_hits.Count>=_definition.MaxHits)Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.HitLimit);
                }
                if(IsDisposed)return;
                if(_motion.Arrived&&!rangeClipped){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Arrived);return;}
                if(reachedRange){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Range);return;}
            }
            if(!IsDisposed&&_age>=_duration)Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Completed);
        }
        protected override void OnFinished(GameplaySpatialEndReason reason)
        {
            if(reason==GameplaySpatialEndReason.Arrived)Run(_definition.OnArrive,At(_target,Position),"Event.Standard.Projectile.Arrive",DistanceTravelled,true);
            else if(reason==GameplaySpatialEndReason.Range)Run(_definition.OnRange,At(_target,Position),"Event.Standard.Projectile.Range",DistanceTravelled,true);
            else if(reason==GameplaySpatialEndReason.Cancelled||reason==GameplaySpatialEndReason.TargetLost)Run(_definition.OnCancelled,At(_target,Position),"Event.Standard.Projectile.Cancelled",DistanceTravelled,true);
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class GameplayStandardWorld
    {
        public GameplayProjectile SpawnProjectile(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayProjectileDefinition definition)
        {if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));ValidateSpatialOwner(owner,context,out var grant);return RegisterSpatial(new GameplayProjectile(owner,context,grant,definition),grant);}

        internal GameplayProjectile SpawnProjectileFromAction(GameplayStandardActor owner, GameplayContext context,
            GameplayProjectileDefinition definition, GameplayPoint? launchPoint, GameplayContext trigger)
        {
            if (IsDisposed || owner.IsDisposed) return null;
            if (!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(owner, context, out var grant) &&
                (definition.CancelOnAbilityEnd || trigger == null || trigger.ActivationSourceId != context.ActivationSourceId ||
                 !_spatial.Exists(operation => operation.Owner == owner && !operation.OwnedByAbility && operation.Id == trigger.EffectiveSourceId)))
                return null;
            return RegisterSpatial(new GameplayProjectile(owner, context, grant, definition, launchPoint), grant);
        }
    }
    public sealed class GameplaySpawnProjectileAction:IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public GameplayProjectileDefinition Definition {get;}
        private readonly bool _launchFromTriggerPoint;
        public GameplaySpawnProjectileAction(GameplayProjectileDefinition definition, bool launchFromTriggerPoint = false)
        {
            Definition = definition ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
            _launchFromTriggerPoint = launchFromTriggerPoint;
        }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor) ||
                ((Definition.RequiresLiveTarget || Definition.OnlyHitPrimaryTarget) &&
                 (!actor.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, out var target) || !target.IsTargetable || target == actor)))
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var trigger = triggerEvent.Context;
            if (_launchFromTriggerPoint && (trigger == null || !trigger.TargetData.HasPoint)) return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var projectile = actor.World.SpawnProjectileFromAction(actor, context, Definition,
                _launchFromTriggerPoint ? trigger.TargetData.Point : (GameplayPoint?)null, trigger);
            return projectile != null ? GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded : GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    public enum GameplaySearchShape { Circle, Sector, Box, Line, Ray, Capsule, Single, GridCells }
    public enum GameplaySpatialPlane { XY, XZ, ThreeDimensional }

    /// <summary>Immutable, world-neutral target geometry shared by query, authoring preview and runtime.
    /// Box/Line start at Origin and extend forward by Length; Width/Height are full sizes.
    /// Circle/Sector in XY/XZ have finite Height thickness. In 3D they are a sphere/cone.
    /// Target inclusion tests actor centres, rather than backend-specific collider surfaces.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySearchGeometry
    {
        public GameplaySearchShape Shape { get; }
        public GameplaySpatialPlane Plane { get; }
        public GameplayPoint Origin { get; }
        public GameplayDirection Direction { get; }
        public float Radius { get; }
        public float Angle { get; }
        public float Length { get; }
        public float Width { get; }
        public float Height { get; }
        public GameplaySourceId SingleTarget { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayPoint> Cells { get; }
        public float CellSize { get; }

        public GameplaySearchGeometry(GameplaySearchShape shape, GameplaySpatialPlane plane, GameplayPoint origin,
            GameplayDirection direction, float radius = 1, float angle = 120, float length = 1,
            float width = 1, float height = 1, GameplaySourceId singleTarget = default,
            IEnumerable<GameplayPoint> cells = null, float cellSize = 1)
        {
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySearchShape), shape) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySpatialPlane), plane))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(shape));
            if (!direction.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Direction must be initialized.", nameof(direction));
            foreach (float value in new[] { radius, length, width, height, cellSize })
                if (!float.IsFinite(value) || value <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(radius), "Dimensions must be finite and positive.");
            if (!float.IsFinite(angle) || angle <= 0 || angle > 360) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(angle));
            if (shape == GameplaySearchShape.Single && !singleTarget.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Single target is required.");
            if (plane != GameplaySpatialPlane.ThreeDimensional && (plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY ?
                direction.X == 0 && direction.Y == 0 : direction.X == 0 && direction.Z == 0))
                throw new ArgumentException("Direction must have a component in the selected plane.");
            var copied = cells == null ? new List<GameplayPoint>() : new List<GameplayPoint>(cells);
            if (shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells && copied.Count == 0) throw new ArgumentException("Grid cells are required.");
            Shape = shape; Plane = plane; Origin = origin; Direction = direction;
            Radius = radius; Angle = angle; Length = length; Width = width; Height = height;
            SingleTarget = singleTarget; Cells = copied.AsReadOnly(); CellSize = cellSize;
        }

        /// <summary>Conservative 3D broadphase radius; final inclusion always uses Contains.</summary>
        public float BoundsRadius
        {
            get
            {
                double extent = Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Circle || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector ? Radius :
                    Math.Sqrt((double)Length * Length + (double)Width * Width / 4) + Radius;
                if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells)
                    foreach (var cell in Cells) extent = Math.Max(extent, Math.Sqrt(DistanceSquared(Origin, cell)) + CellSize);
                return (float)Math.Min(float.MaxValue, Math.Sqrt(extent * extent + (double)Height * Height / 4));
            }
        }
        public bool Contains(GameplaySourceId id, GameplayPoint position)
        {
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Single) return id == SingleTarget;
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.GridCells)
            {
                foreach (var cell in Cells)
                    if (CellCoordinate(position.X) == CellCoordinate(cell.X) &&
                        CellCoordinate(Plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY ? position.Y : position.Z) ==
                        CellCoordinate(Plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY ? cell.Y : cell.Z) &&
                        Math.Abs(Plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY ? position.Z - cell.Z : position.Y - cell.Y) <= Height / 2)
                        return true;
                return false;
            }
            double x = (double)position.X - Origin.X, y = (double)position.Y - Origin.Y, z = (double)position.Z - Origin.Z;
            double fx = Direction.X, fy = Direction.Y, fz = Direction.Z;
            if (Plane != GameplaySpatialPlane.ThreeDimensional)
            {
                if (Math.Abs(Plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY ? z : y) > Height / 2) return false;
                if (Plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY) { z = 0; fz = 0; } else { y = 0; fy = 0; }
                double norm = Math.Sqrt(fx * fx + fy * fy + fz * fz); fx /= norm; fy /= norm; fz /= norm;
            }
            double distanceSquared = x * x + y * y + z * z;
            double along = x * fx + y * fy + z * fz;
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Circle || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector)
            {
                if (distanceSquared > (double)Radius * Radius) return false;
                return Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Circle || distanceSquared == 0 ||
                    along / Math.Sqrt(distanceSquared) >= Math.Cos(Angle * Math.PI / 360) - 1e-7;
            }
            if (Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Capsule || Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray)
            {
                double nearest = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(Length, along));
                double dx = x - fx * nearest, dy = y - fy * nearest, dz = z - fz * nearest;
                double radius = Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray ? Width / 2 : Radius;
                return dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= radius * radius;
            }
            if (along < 0 || along > Length) return false;
            if (Plane != GameplaySpatialPlane.ThreeDimensional)
                return Math.Max(0, distanceSquared - along * along) <= (double)Width * Width / 4;
            // Stable local right/up basis; when forward is vertical, choose Z as the auxiliary up.
            double ux = 0, uy = Math.Abs(fy) > .999 ? 0 : 1, uz = Math.Abs(fy) > .999 ? 1 : 0;
            double rx = uy * fz - uz * fy, ry = uz * fx - ux * fz, rz = ux * fy - uy * fx;
            double rightNorm = Math.Sqrt(rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz); rx /= rightNorm; ry /= rightNorm; rz /= rightNorm;
            ux = fy * rz - fz * ry; uy = fz * rx - fx * rz; uz = fx * ry - fy * rx;
            return Math.Abs(x * rx + y * ry + z * rz) <= Width / 2 && Math.Abs(x * ux + y * uy + z * uz) <= Height / 2;
        }
        private double CellCoordinate(float coordinate) => Math.Floor((double)coordinate / CellSize);
        public static double DistanceSquared(GameplayPoint a, GameplayPoint b)
        {
            double x = (double)a.X - b.X, y = (double)a.Y - b.Y, z = (double)a.Z - b.Z;
            return x * x + y * y + z * z;
        }
    }
}
