````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    public enum GameplaySearchOrigin { Owner, ContextPoint, PrimaryTarget }
    /// <summary>Direction is resolved at the same sampling time as the query. Absolute angles
    /// and offsets use degrees from +X toward +Y in XY, or +X toward +Z in XZ/3D;
    /// point modes preserve all three axes.</summary>
    public enum GameplaySearchDirection { OwnerFacing, ToPrimaryTarget, ToContextPoint, AbsoluteAngle }
    /// <summary>Official target-search business action. Expressions are sampled at this action's rule time.
    /// Each callback sees one target; completed sees the full deterministic list. Empty output is explicit,
    /// never a fallback to Self. Nested callbacks share the Sequence cancellation guard.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySearchTargetAction : IGameplaySkillAction, IGameplaySkillContextAction, IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction
    {
        private readonly GameplaySearchShape _shape;
        private readonly GameplaySpatialPlane _plane;
        private readonly GameplaySearchOrigin _origin;
        private readonly GameplayPoint _originOffset;
        private readonly GameplaySearchDirection _direction;
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _directionAngle;
        private readonly bool _lengthFromTarget;
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _radius, _angle, _length, _width, _height;
        private readonly GameplayFactionFilter _faction;
        private readonly GameplayTagQuery _tags;
        private readonly int _layerMask, _maxTargets;
        private readonly GameplayTargetOrder _order;
        private readonly bool _includeSelf;
        private readonly bool _excludePrimaryTarget, _repeatFromResult;
        private readonly float _repeatMultiplier;
        /// <summary>Per-result multiplier in a repeated search. The first result receives 1.</summary>
        public static readonly GameplayTag SearchMultiplierKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Standard.Search.Multiplier");
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<GameplayPoint> _cells;
        private readonly float _cellSize;
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> _each, _completed, _empty;
        public GameplaySearchTargetAction(GameplaySearchShape shape, GameplaySpatialPlane plane, GameplaySearchOrigin origin,
            IGameplayFloatValue radius, IGameplayFloatValue angle, IGameplayFloatValue length, IGameplayFloatValue width, IGameplayFloatValue height,
            GameplayFactionFilter faction, GameplayTagQuery tags, int layerMask, int maxTargets, GameplayTargetOrder order, bool includeSelf,
            IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> each, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> completed, IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> empty,
            IEnumerable<GameplayPoint> cells = null, float cellSize = 1,
            GameplaySearchDirection direction = GameplaySearchDirection.OwnerFacing,
            IGameplayFloatValue directionAngle = null, bool lengthFromTarget = false,GameplayPoint originOffset=default,
            bool excludePrimaryTarget = false, bool repeatFromResult = false, float repeatMultiplier = 1)
        {
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySearchShape), shape) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySpatialPlane), plane) ||
                !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySearchOrigin), origin)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(shape));
            _shape = shape; _plane = plane; _origin = origin;
            _originOffset=originOffset;
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplaySearchDirection), direction)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(direction));
            if (lengthFromTarget && (direction != GameplaySearchDirection.ToPrimaryTarget && direction != GameplaySearchDirection.ToContextPoint ||
                shape != GameplaySearchShape.Box && shape != GameplaySearchShape.Line && shape != GameplaySearchShape.Ray && shape != GameplaySearchShape.Capsule))
                throw new ArgumentException("Endpoint length requires a directional segment and a point/target direction.", nameof(lengthFromTarget));
            _direction = direction; _directionAngle = directionAngle ?? new GameplayConstantFloatValue(0); _lengthFromTarget = lengthFromTarget;
            _radius = radius ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(radius)); _angle = angle ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(angle));
            _length = length ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(length)); _width = width ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(width));
            _height = height ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(height));
            _faction = faction; _tags = tags; _layerMask = layerMask; _maxTargets = maxTargets; _order = order; _includeSelf = includeSelf;
            _excludePrimaryTarget = excludePrimaryTarget;
            _repeatFromResult = repeatFromResult;
            _repeatMultiplier = repeatMultiplier;
            _each = Copy(each); _completed = Copy(completed); _empty = Copy(empty);
            _cells = new List<GameplayPoint>(cells ?? Array.Empty<GameplayPoint>()).AsReadOnly(); _cellSize = cellSize;
        }
        private static IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> Copy(IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> source)
        {
            var list = new List<IGameplaySkillAction>(source ?? Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillAction>());
            if (list.Contains(null)) throw new ArgumentException("Callback action cannot be null."); return list.AsReadOnly();
        }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteWithContext(context, triggerEvent, host).Result;
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteGuarded(context, triggerEvent, host, null);
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteGuarded(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue)
        {
            if (!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor) || actor.IsDisposed) throw new InvalidOperationException("Search requires the official standard actor/world host.");
            if (!TryCreateRequest(context, actor, out var request)) return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, context);
            GameplayTargetData targets;
            if (_repeatFromResult)
            {
                var selected = new List<GameplaySourceId>();
                var visited = new HashSet<GameplaySourceId>();
                GameplayPoint origin = request.Geometry.Origin;
                float multiplier = 1;
                for (int step = 0; step < _maxTargets && (canContinue == null || canContinue()); step++)
                {
                    var targetsAtStep = actor.World.Spatial.Query(request);
                    var id = targetsAtStep.PrimaryTargetId;
                    if (!id.IsValid || !actor.World.TryGetActor(id, out var target)) break;
                    var point = target.Position;
                    selected.Add(id);
                    visited.Add(id);
                    var single = context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(id, point, null, new[] { id }))
                        .WithValues(context.Values.WithValue(SearchMultiplierKey, multiplier));
                    var result = GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_each, single, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
                    if (result.Result == GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected) return result;
                    multiplier *= _repeatMultiplier;
                    if (step + 1 < _maxTargets && !actor.IsDisposed)
                        TryCreateRequest(context, actor, out request, point, visited);
                    else break;
                }
                targets = new GameplayTargetData(selected.Count > 0 ? selected[0] : default, origin, null, selected);
            }
            else
            {
                targets = actor.World.Spatial.Query(request);
                foreach (var id in targets.Targets)
                {
                    if (!actor.World.TryGetActor(id, out var target)) continue;
                    var single = context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(id, target.Position, null, new[] { id }));
                    var result = GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_each, single, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
                    if (result.Result == GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected) return result;
                }
            }
            var resultContext = context.WithTarget(targets);
            if (targets.Targets.Count == 0)
            {
                var result = GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_empty, resultContext, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
                if (result.Result == GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected) return result;
            }
            return GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(_completed, resultContext, triggerEvent, host, canContinue);
        }
        /// <summary>Side-effect-free canonical request used by both runtime query and Editor preview.
        /// Only dimensions used by the selected shape evaluate their AST; inactive fields are retained
        /// for authoring shape switches and cannot fail an unrelated search at runtime.</summary>
        public bool TryCreateRequest(GameplayContext context, GameplayStandardActor actor, out GameplaySpatialSearchRequest request) =>
            TryCreateRequest(context, actor, out request, null, null);
        private bool TryCreateRequest(GameplayContext context, GameplayStandardActor actor, out GameplaySpatialSearchRequest request,
            GameplayPoint? previousHit, HashSet<GameplaySourceId> visited)
        {
            if (context == null || actor == null) throw new ArgumentNullException();
            if (actor.IsDisposed) throw new ObjectDisposedException(nameof(actor));
            request = null;
            GameplayPoint origin = actor.Position;
            if (previousHit.HasValue) origin = previousHit.Value;
            else if (_origin == GameplaySearchOrigin.ContextPoint)
            {
                if (!context.TargetData.HasPoint) return false;
                origin = context.TargetData.Point;
            }
            else if (_origin == GameplaySearchOrigin.PrimaryTarget)
            {
                if (!actor.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, out var primary)) return false;
                origin = primary.Position;
            }
            origin=new GameplayPoint(origin.X+_originOffset.X,origin.Y+_originOffset.Y,origin.Z+_originOffset.Z);
            var self = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id)), actor,
                context.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(), actor.Attributes, actor.Id);
            var direction = actor.Facing;
            float endpointLength = 0;
            bool directional = _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Box ||
                _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Line || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Capsule;
            if (directional)
            {
                if (_direction == GameplaySearchDirection.ToPrimaryTarget || _direction == GameplaySearchDirection.ToContextPoint)
                {
                    GameplayPoint endpoint;
                    if (_direction == GameplaySearchDirection.ToContextPoint)
                    { if (!context.TargetData.HasPoint) return false; endpoint = context.TargetData.Point; }
                    else
                    { if (!actor.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, out var target)) return false; endpoint = target.Position; }
                    float x = endpoint.X - origin.X, y = endpoint.Y - origin.Y, z = endpoint.Z - origin.Z;
                    if (_plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY) z = 0;
                    else if (_plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XZ) y = 0;
                    double distance = Math.Sqrt((double)x*x + (double)y*y + (double)z*z);
                    if (distance == 0 || distance > float.MaxValue) return false;
                    endpointLength = (float)distance; direction = new GameplayDirection(x,y,z);
                }
                double angle = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_directionAngle,self) * Math.PI / 180;
                if (!double.IsFinite(angle)) throw new ArithmeticException("Search direction angle must be finite.");
                if (_direction == GameplaySearchDirection.AbsoluteAngle) direction = new GameplayDirection(1,0,0);
                double cosine = Math.Cos(angle), sine = Math.Sin(angle);
                direction = _plane == GameplaySpatialPlane.XY ?
                    new GameplayDirection((float)(direction.X*cosine-direction.Y*sine),(float)(direction.X*sine+direction.Y*cosine),direction.Z) :
                    new GameplayDirection((float)(direction.X*cosine-direction.Z*sine),direction.Y,(float)(direction.X*sine+direction.Z*cosine));
            }
            var geometry = new GameplaySearchGeometry(_shape, _plane, origin, direction,
                _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Circle || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Capsule ? GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_radius, self) : 1,
                _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector ? GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_angle, self) : 120,
                _lengthFromTarget ? endpointLength : _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Box || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Line || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Capsule ? GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_length, self) : 1,
                _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Box || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Line || _shape == GameplaySearchShape.Ray ? GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_width, self) : 1,
                GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_height, self), context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, _cells, _cellSize);
            request = new GameplaySpatialSearchRequest(context, geometry, actor.Faction,
                _faction, _tags, _layerMask, _repeatFromResult ? 1 : _maxTargets,
                _repeatFromResult ? GameplayTargetOrder.Nearest : _order, _includeSelf,
                _excludePrimaryTarget || visited != null
                    ? id => (_excludePrimaryTarget && id == context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId) || (visited != null && visited.Contains(id))
                    : null);
            return true;
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Standard/Runtime/Spatial/GameplaySpatialBackend.cs

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    public interface IGameplaySpatialActor
    {
        GameplaySourceId Id { get; }
        GameplayPoint Position { get; }
        GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }
        int Faction { get; }
        int Layer { get; }
        bool IsTargetable { get; }
    }
    public enum GameplayFactionFilter { Any, Allies, Enemies }
    public enum GameplayTargetOrder { Nearest, Farthest, SourceId }

    /// <summary>Shared deterministic target policy; Physics and logical backends only supply candidates.
    /// Tag queries are hierarchical, layer 0 is valid, and deduplication precedes the target limit.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySpatialSearchRequest
    {
        public GameplayContext Context { get; }
        public GameplaySearchGeometry Geometry { get; }
        public GameplayTagQuery Tags { get; }
        public GameplayFactionFilter Faction { get; }
        public int SourceFaction { get; }
        public int LayerMask { get; }
        public int MaxTargets { get; }
        public GameplayTargetOrder Order { get; }
        public bool IncludeSelf { get; }
        private readonly Predicate<GameplaySourceId> _excluded;
        public GameplaySpatialSearchRequest(GameplayContext context, GameplaySearchGeometry geometry,
            int sourceFaction, GameplayFactionFilter faction = GameplayFactionFilter.Enemies,
            GameplayTagQuery tags = null, int layerMask = -1, int maxTargets = int.MaxValue,
            GameplayTargetOrder order = GameplayTargetOrder.Nearest, bool includeSelf = false,
            Predicate<GameplaySourceId> excluded = null)
        {
            Context = context ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(context));
            Geometry = geometry ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(geometry));
            if (maxTargets < 1) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(maxTargets));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayFactionFilter), faction) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayTargetOrder), order))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(faction));
            SourceFaction = sourceFaction; Faction = faction; Tags = tags ?? GameplayTagQuery.Empty;
            LayerMask = layerMask; MaxTargets = maxTargets; Order = order; IncludeSelf = includeSelf;
            _excluded = excluded;
        }
        public GameplayTargetData Select(IEnumerable<IGameplaySpatialActor> candidates)
        {
            if (candidates == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(candidates));
            var selected = new List<IGameplaySpatialActor>(); var seen = new HashSet<GameplaySourceId>();
            foreach (var actor in candidates)
            {
                if (actor == null || !actor.Id.IsValid || !actor.IsTargetable || actor.Tags == null || actor.Layer < 0 || actor.Layer > 31 ||
                    (!IncludeSelf && actor.Id == Context.InstigatorId) || (LayerMask & (1 << actor.Layer)) == 0 ||
                    (Faction == GameplayFactionFilter.Allies && actor.Faction != SourceFaction) ||
                    (Faction == GameplayFactionFilter.Enemies && actor.Faction == SourceFaction) ||
                    !Tags.Matches(actor.Tags) || !Geometry.Contains(actor.Id, actor.Position) ||
                    _excluded?.Invoke(actor.Id) == true || !seen.Add(actor.Id)) continue;
                selected.Add(actor);
            }
            selected.Sort((a, b) =>
            {
                int distance = Order == GameplayTargetOrder.SourceId ? 0 :
                    GameplaySearchGeometry.DistanceSquared(Geometry.Origin, a.Position).CompareTo(GameplaySearchGeometry.DistanceSquared(Geometry.Origin, b.Position));
                if (Order == GameplayTargetOrder.Farthest) distance = -distance;
                return distance != 0 ? distance : a.Id.Value.CompareTo(b.Id.Value);
            });
            var ids = new List<GameplaySourceId>();
            for (int i = 0; i < selected.Count && i < MaxTargets; i++) ids.Add(selected[i].Id);
            GameplayArea? area = Geometry.Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Circle || Geometry.Shape == GameplaySearchShape.Sector ?
                new GameplayArea(Geometry.Origin, Geometry.Radius) : (GameplayArea?)null;
            return new GameplayTargetData(ids.Count > 0 ? ids[0] : default, Geometry.Origin, area, ids);
        }
    }
    public interface IGameplaySpatialQueryBackend { GameplayTargetData Query(GameplaySpatialSearchRequest request); }

    /// <summary>Out-of-box live logical/grid query; no Unity object, collider or Update dependency.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayLogicalSpatialBackend : IGameplaySpatialQueryBackend
    {
        private readonly Func<IEnumerable<IGameplaySpatialActor>> _actors;
        public GameplayLogicalSpatialBackend(Func<IEnumerable<IGameplaySpatialActor>> actors) => _actors = actors ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actors));
        public GameplayTargetData Query(GameplaySpatialSearchRequest request) =>
            (request ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(request))).Select(_actors());
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Preserves the actual event's target snapshot, including captured point and multi-target list.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillContextTarget:IGameplaySkillTarget
    { public GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host,GameplayEventData triggerEvent)=>triggerEvent.Context?.TargetData; }
    /// <summary>Explicit captured world point; absence of an actor target is meaningful.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillPointTarget:IGameplaySkillTarget
    {private readonly GameplayPoint _point;public GameplaySkillPointTarget(GameplayPoint point)=>_point=point;public GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host,GameplayEventData data)=>new GameplayTargetData(default,_point);}
    public enum GameplaySpatialEndReason { Completed, HitLimit, Arrived, Range, Cancelled, TargetLost, Controlled, Interrupted, Died }
    /// <summary>Optional presentation only; receives rule positions and never owns a rule clock.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySpatialView:IDisposable { void Sync(GameplayPoint position,GameplayDirection direction); }
    public interface IGameplaySpatialViewFactory { IGameplaySpatialView Create(GameplayStandardActor actor,GameplayContext context); }
    /// <summary>One cast-owned transient spatial operation. Definition is immutable; this instance
    /// stores motion/membership only. Effect/Ability/Sequence ownership remains in the existing containers.</summary>
    public abstract class GameplaySpatialOperation:IGameplayAbilityTerminationAwareLifetime
    {
        public GameplayStandardActor Owner {get;}
        public GameplayContext Context {get;}
        /// <summary>False means a committed entity is owned by World/actor cleanup, not its
        /// launching grant. Its captured source and callbacks survive End/Cancel.</summary>
        public bool OwnedByAbility {get;}
        public GameplaySourceId Id=>Context.EffectiveSourceId;
        public GameplayPoint Position {get;protected set;}
        public GameplayDirection Direction {get;protected set;}
        public bool IsDisposed {get;private set;}
        public GameplaySpatialEndReason? EndReason {get;private set;}
        public event Action<GameplaySpatialOperation> Changed;
        public event Action<GameplaySpatialOperation,GameplaySpatialEndReason> Ended;
        private readonly GameplayAbilityHandle _grant;
        private readonly IGameplaySpatialViewFactory _factory;
        private IGameplaySpatialView _view;
        protected GameplaySpatialOperation(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,IGameplaySpatialViewFactory factory,bool ownedByAbility=true)
        {
            Owner=owner;Context=context.WithSource(owner.World.Sources.Allocate());_grant=grant;_factory=factory;
            Position=owner.Position;Direction=owner.Facing;
            OwnedByAbility=ownedByAbility;
        }
        internal void Start()
        {
            if(_factory!=null)_view=_factory.Create(Owner,Context)??throw new InvalidOperationException("Spatial backend returned no actual view.");
            if(IsDisposed){_view?.Dispose();_view=null;return;}
            Notify();OnStart();
        }
        protected virtual void OnStart() { }
        internal abstract void Advance(float delta);
        protected void Notify(){if(IsDisposed)return;_view?.Sync(Position,Direction);Changed?.Invoke(this);}
        protected GameplayContext At(GameplaySourceId target,GameplayPoint point)=>Context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(target,point,null,target.IsValid?new[]{target}:Array.Empty<GameplaySourceId>()));
        protected void Run(IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> actions,GameplayContext context,string signal,float magnitude=1,bool ending=false)
        {
            if(Owner.IsDisposed||Owner.World.IsDisposed||(!ending&&IsDisposed))return;
            var data=new GameplayEventData(new GameplayTag(signal),context,magnitude);
            GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(actions,context,data,Owner,()=>!Owner.IsDisposed&&!Owner.World.IsDisposed&&(ending||!IsDisposed));
            if(!Owner.IsDisposed&&!Owner.World.IsDisposed&&(ending||!IsDisposed))Owner.Events.Publish(data);
        }
        public void Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason reason)
        {
            if(IsDisposed)return;IsDisposed=true;EndReason=reason;
            Owner.World.DetachSpatial(this);Owner.Abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(_grant,this);
            List<Exception> errors=null;
            try{OnFinished(reason);}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}
            try{_view?.Dispose();}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}finally{_view=null;}
            try{Ended?.Invoke(this,reason);}catch(Exception ex){(errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex);}
            if(errors!=null)throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }
        protected virtual void OnFinished(GameplaySpatialEndReason reason) { }
        public void Dispose()=>Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Cancelled);
        public void Terminate(GameplayAbilityTerminationObservation observation)=>
            Finish(observation.Reason==GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Ended?GameplaySpatialEndReason.Completed:GameplaySpatialEndReason.Cancelled);
    }
    public sealed partial class GameplayStandardWorld
    {
        private readonly List<GameplaySpatialOperation> _spatial=new List<GameplaySpatialOperation>();
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySpatialOperation> GetSpatialSnapshot()=>_spatial.ToArray();
        internal void DetachSpatial(GameplaySpatialOperation operation)=>_spatial.Remove(operation);
        internal T RegisterSpatial<T>(T operation,GameplayAbilityHandle grant) where T:GameplaySpatialOperation
        {
            _spatial.Add(operation);
            if(operation.OwnedByAbility&&!operation.Owner.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(grant,operation)){operation.Dispose();return null;}
            try{operation.Start();return operation;}catch{operation.Dispose();throw;}
        }
        internal void ValidateSpatialOwner(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,out GameplayAbilityHandle grant)
        {
            grant=default;
            if(IsDisposed||owner==null||owner.World!=this||owner.IsDisposed||!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(owner,context,out grant))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Spatial work requires an active cast in this world.");
        }
    }
    internal static class GameplaySpatialMath
    {
        internal static float Distance(GameplayPoint a,GameplayPoint b)=> (float)Math.Sqrt((double)(b.X-a.X)*(b.X-a.X)+(double)(b.Y-a.Y)*(b.Y-a.Y)+(double)(b.Z-a.Z)*(b.Z-a.Z));
        internal static GameplayPoint Lerp(GameplayPoint a,GameplayPoint b,float t)=>new GameplayPoint(a.X+(b.X-a.X)*t,a.Y+(b.Y-a.Y)*t,a.Z+(b.Z-a.Z)*t);
        internal static GameplayPoint Offset(GameplayPoint a,GameplayDirection d,float distance)=>new GameplayPoint(a.X+d.X*distance,a.Y+d.Y*distance,a.Z+d.Z*distance);
        internal static GameplayDirection Direction(GameplayPoint a,GameplayPoint b,GameplayDirection fallback)=>Distance(a,b)>0?new GameplayDirection(b.X-a.X,b.Y-a.Y,b.Z-a.Z):fallback;
        internal static float Positive(IGameplayFloatValue value,GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,string name)
        {
            float result=Finite(value,owner,context);
            if(result<=0)throw new ArithmeticException(name+" must be positive and finite.");return result;
        }
        internal static float Finite(IGameplayFloatValue value,GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context)
        {
            var target=owner;
            if(context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget)owner.World.TryGetActor(context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId,out target);
            target=target??owner;
            var targeted=context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(target.Id));
            float result=GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(value,new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(targeted,target,targeted.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(),owner.Attributes,owner.Id,instigatorTarget:owner));
            return result;
        }
        internal static IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> Actions(IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> actions)
        {var copy=new List<IGameplaySkillAction>(actions??Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillAction>());if(copy.Exists(a=>a==null))throw new ArgumentException("Callback actions cannot be null.");return copy.AsReadOnly();}
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Optional integration binding of a newly created actor and its view lease. It must
    /// use the existing world, create no second clock, and leave profile initialization to Standard.</summary>
    public interface IGameplaySummonFactory
    { GameplaySummonBinding Create(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayPoint position); }
    public sealed class GameplaySummonBinding
    {
        public GameplayStandardActor Actor {get;}
        public IDisposable View {get;}
        public GameplaySummonBinding(GameplayStandardActor actor,IDisposable view=null){Actor=actor??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actor));View=view;}
    }
    /// <summary>Immutable first-party summoned unit composition. Its actor owns normal containers,
    /// skill levels are inherited/clamped, and lifetime advances in the existing spatial phase.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySummonDefinition
    {
        public GameplayActorProfile Profile {get;}public IGameplayFloatValue Duration {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition> Skills {get;}public bool AutoCast {get;}
        public IGameplaySummonFactory Factory {get;}public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnSpawn {get;}public IReadOnlyList<IGameplaySkillAction> OnEnd {get;}
        public GameplaySummonDefinition(GameplayActorProfile profile,IGameplayFloatValue duration,IEnumerable<GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition> skills=null,bool autoCast=false,
            IGameplaySummonFactory factory=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onSpawn=null,IEnumerable<IGameplaySkillAction> onEnd=null)
        {
            Profile=profile??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(profile));Duration=duration??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(duration));
            var copy=new List<GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition>(skills??Array.Empty<GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition>());if(copy.Contains(null))throw new ArgumentException("Summon skill is null.");
            Skills=copy.AsReadOnly();AutoCast=autoCast;Factory=factory;OnSpawn=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onSpawn);OnEnd=GameplaySpatialMath.Actions(onEnd);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Cast-owned actual summoned actor, not a pooled rule container. End/death/cancel
    /// remove the actor, its grants/controllers, and finally the optional view lease exactly once.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySummonOperation:GameplaySpatialOperation
    {
        private readonly GameplaySummonDefinition _definition;private readonly float _duration;private double _age;private GameplaySummonBinding _binding;
        public GameplayStandardActor SummonedActor=>_binding?.Actor;
        internal GameplaySummonOperation(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplayAbilityHandle grant,GameplaySummonDefinition definition)
            :base(owner,context,grant,null)
        {_definition=definition;_duration=GameplaySpatialMath.Positive(definition.Duration,owner,context,"Summon duration");if(context.TargetData.HasPoint)Position=context.TargetData.Point;}
        protected override void OnStart()
        {
            var previous=new HashSet<GameplayStandardActor>(Owner.World.Actors);
            var binding=_definition.Factory?.Create(Owner,Context,Position)??new GameplaySummonBinding(Owner.World.CreateActor(Position,Owner.Faction,Owner.Layer));
            var actor=binding.Actor;
            if(actor.World!=Owner.World||actor.IsDisposed||actor.BorrowsContainers||previous.Contains(actor))
            {binding.View?.Dispose();throw new InvalidOperationException("Factory must create a fresh owned actor in the same world.");}
            _binding=binding;
            _definition.Profile.Initialize(actor);actor.SpawnOriginSourceId=Context.OriginSourceId;
            foreach(var skill in _definition.Skills)actor.InstallDocument(skill,Math.Min(Context.AbilityLevel,skill.Ability.MaxLevel));
            if(_definition.AutoCast)actor.Behaviour=new GameplaySkillSelectionPolicy(actor,s=>s.Definition.SkillId,s=>SelectTarget(actor));
            actor.CombatChanged+=OnCombat;Run(_definition.OnSpawn,At(actor.Id,actor.Position),"Event.Standard.Summon.Spawn");
        }
        private GameplayTargetData SelectTarget(GameplayStandardActor actor)
        {
            GameplayStandardActor selected=null;float nearest=float.PositiveInfinity;
            foreach(var target in Owner.World.Actors)
                if(target.IsTargetable&&target.Id!=actor.Id&&target.Faction!=actor.Faction)
                {float distance=GameplaySpatialMath.Distance(actor.Position,target.Position);if(distance<nearest){nearest=distance;selected=target;}}
            return selected==null?null:new GameplayTargetData(selected.Id,selected.Position);
        }
        private void OnCombat(GameplayCombatOutcome outcome){if(SummonedActor!=null&&!SummonedActor.IsTargetable)Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Died);}
        internal override void Advance(float delta)
        {
            if(SummonedActor==null||SummonedActor.IsDisposed){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.TargetLost);return;}
            if(!SummonedActor.IsTargetable){Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Died);return;}
            Position=SummonedActor.Position;Direction=SummonedActor.Facing;Notify();_age=Math.Min(_duration,_age+delta);
            if(_age>=_duration)Finish(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Completed);
        }
        protected override void OnFinished(GameplaySpatialEndReason reason)
        {
            if(_binding==null)return;var actor=_binding.Actor;actor.CombatChanged-=OnCombat;
            try{Run(_definition.OnEnd,At(actor.Id,actor.Position),"Event.Standard.Summon.End",(float)reason,true);}
            finally{try{actor.Dispose();}finally{_binding.View?.Dispose();}}
        }
    }
    public sealed partial class GameplayStandardWorld
    {
        public GameplaySummonOperation SpawnSummon(GameplayStandardActor owner,GameplayContext context,GameplaySummonDefinition definition)
        {if(definition==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));ValidateSpatialOwner(owner,context,out var grant);return RegisterSpatial(new GameplaySummonOperation(owner,context,grant,definition),grant);}
    }
    public sealed class GameplaySpawnSummonAction:IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        private readonly GameplaySummonDefinition _definition;
        public GameplaySpawnSummonAction(GameplaySummonDefinition definition)=>_definition=definition??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(definition));
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor)||!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,context,out _))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;return actor.World.SpawnSummon(actor,context,_definition)!=null?GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded:GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;}
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Static initial attributes plus combat resource mapping; mutable values only enter the actor at creation.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayActorProfile
    {
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId, float>> _attributes;
        public GameplayCombatAttributeMap Combat { get; }
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,int level)> _skills;
        public GameplayActorProfile(IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId, float>> attributes, GameplayCombatAttributeMap combat,
            IEnumerable<(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,int level)> startingSkills=null)
        {
            Combat = combat ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(combat));
            var copy = new List<KeyValuePair<GameplayAttributeId, float>>(); var keys = new HashSet<GameplayAttributeId>();
            foreach (var pair in attributes ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(attributes)))
            {
                if (!pair.Key.IsValid || !float.IsFinite(pair.Value) || !keys.Add(pair.Key)) throw new ArgumentException("Initial attributes require unique valid IDs and finite values.");
                copy.Add(pair);
            }
            if (!keys.Contains(combat.Health) || !keys.Contains(combat.MaxHealth)) throw new ArgumentException("Health/MaxHealth must be initialized.");
            float health = copy.Find(p => p.Key == combat.Health).Value, max = copy.Find(p => p.Key == combat.MaxHealth).Value;
            if (max <= 0 || health < 0 || health > max) throw new ArgumentException("Initial Health must be within positive MaxHealth.");
            _attributes = copy.AsReadOnly();
            var skills=new List<(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,int level)>(startingSkills??Array.Empty<(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,int level)>());
            var ids=new HashSet<int>();
            foreach(var entry in skills)if(entry.skill==null||entry.level<1||entry.level>entry.skill.Ability.MaxLevel||!ids.Add(entry.skill.SkillId))throw new ArgumentException("Profile skills require distinct IDs and valid levels.");
            _skills=skills.AsReadOnly();
        }
        public void Initialize(GameplayStandardActor actor)
        {
            if (actor == null || actor.IsDisposed || actor.BorrowsContainers) throw new ArgumentException("Initialize a new standard actor; borrowed games retain their existing state.");
            foreach (var pair in _attributes) if (actor.Attributes.Contains(pair.Key)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Profile cannot overwrite existing attributes.");
            foreach (var pair in _attributes) actor.Attributes.Register(pair.Key, pair.Value);
            actor.CombatAttributes = Combat;
            // Static defaults are resolved before battle. Installation still uses the actor's
            // unique containers; Profile never retains mutable grants.
            try{foreach(var entry in _skills)actor.InstallDocument(entry.skill,entry.level);}
            catch{actor.Dispose();throw;}
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Natural-expiry reapplication owned by an active grant. Zero skill ID requires the
    /// original activation; an explicit ID resolves that installed skill's current activation.
    /// The completed application still preserves its source/value snapshot. An inactive skill
    /// never receives a Buff; a passive re-engaged during suppression owns its resumed Buff.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayApplyOwnedEffectOnCompletionExecution:IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
    {
        private readonly GameplayEffectDefinition _effect;
        private readonly int _ownerSkillId;
        public GameplayApplyOwnedEffectOnCompletionExecution(GameplayEffectDefinition effect,int ownerSkillId=0)
        {if(ownerSkillId<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(ownerSkillId));_effect=effect??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effect));_ownerSkillId=ownerSkillId;}
        public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext completion)
        {
            if(!(completion.Application.Target is GameplayStandardActor actor))return;
            GameplayAbilityHandle grant=default;
            if(_ownerSkillId>0){foreach(var skill in actor.InstalledSkills)if(!skill.IsDisposed&&skill.Definition.SkillId==_ownerSkillId&&actor.Abilities.IsActive(skill.Grant)){grant=skill.Grant;break;}if(!grant.IsValid)return;}
            else if(!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,completion.Application.Context,out grant))return;
            var result=completion.Apply(_effect);
            if(result.Outcome==GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.NewActiveEffect&&!actor.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(grant,result)){
                actor.Effects.Remove(result.ActiveHandle);throw new InvalidOperationException("Completion effect ownership was rejected.");
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>First-party effect action for every resolved target. Uses each target's sole EffectContainer.
    /// Optional activation cleanup is registered as exact leases, including foreign-target effects;
    /// it never asks an Ability to own a foreign container's handle or scans by Definition.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayApplyToTargetsAction : IGameplaySkillAction, IGameplaySkillContextAction, IGameplaySkillGuardedContextAction
    {
        public GameplayEffectDefinition Effect { get; }
        public bool OwnedByAbility { get; }
        public GameplayApplyToTargetsAction(GameplayEffectDefinition effect, bool ownedByAbility = false)
        {
            Effect = effect ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(effect)); OwnedByAbility = ownedByAbility;
            if (ownedByAbility && effect.Stacking != null) throw new ArgumentException("Ability-owned target effects must be unstacked; Area uses contribution leases for shared stacks.");
        }
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteWithContext(context, triggerEvent, host).Result;
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host) => ExecuteGuarded(context, triggerEvent, host, null);
        public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteGuarded(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host, Func<bool> canContinue)
        {
            if (!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor) || actor.IsDisposed) throw new InvalidOperationException("Standard target effects require a standard world actor.");
            GameplayAbilityHandle owner = default;
            if (OwnedByAbility && Effect.DurationPolicy != GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)
            {
                if (!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor, context, out owner))
                    return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, context);
            }
            var ids = context.TargetData.Targets.Count > 0 ? context.TargetData.Targets :
                context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget ? new[] { context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId } : Array.Empty<GameplaySourceId>();
            foreach (var id in ids)
            {
                if (canContinue != null && !canContinue()) return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, context);
                if (!actor.World.TryGetActor(id, out var target)) continue;
                var targeted = context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(id, target.Position, null, new[] { id }));
                var result = actor.ApplyEffect(targeted, Effect, null, context);
                if (!result.Succeeded) return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, context);
                if (owner.IsValid && GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(target.Effects, result, out var lease))
                {
                    var owned = new GameplayOwnedTargetEffectLease(actor.Abilities, owner, target.Effects, lease);
                    if (!actor.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(owner, owned))
                    {
                        owned.Dispose(); return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected, context);
                    }
                }
            }
            return new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded, context);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Evaluates once at this actual action/target boundary and writes an immutable context
    /// scalar for subsequent actions and child callbacks. Use Context/Caller key values to read the
    /// captured result; ordinary Attribute values continue to read live attributes.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayCaptureValueAction : IGameplaySkillAction,IGameplaySkillContextAction

        public GameplayCaptureValueAction(GameplayTag key,IGameplayFloatValue value)
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    public enum GameplayCooldownOperation { SetRemaining, AdjustRemaining, Restart, SetCharges, AdjustCharges }
    /// <summary>Authored command for this actor's actual grant. SkillId=0 resolves only the
    /// captured active cast; a positive ID selects one installed skill on the same actor.
    /// All changes go through the existing Ability container, with no additional cooldown clock.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayCooldownAction:IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public int SkillId {get;}
        public GameplayCooldownOperation Operation {get;}
        public IGameplayFloatValue Value {get;}
        public GameplayCooldownAction(int skillId,GameplayCooldownOperation operation,IGameplayFloatValue value)
        {if(skillId<0||!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayCooldownOperation),operation))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(skillId));SkillId=skillId;Operation=operation;Value=value??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(value));}
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData triggerEvent,IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if(!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor)||actor.IsDisposed)return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            GameplayAbilityHandle handle=default;
            if(SkillId==0){if(!GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor,context,out handle))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;}
            else foreach(var skill in actor.InstalledSkills)if(!skill.IsDisposed&&skill.Definition.SkillId==SkillId){handle=skill.Grant;break;}
            if(!handle.IsValid)return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            bool succeeded;
            if(Operation==GameplayCooldownOperation.Restart)succeeded=actor.Abilities.TryResetCooldown(handle);
            else{
                float value=GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(Value,new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context,actor,context.Values.AsSetByCallerValues()));
                if(!float.IsFinite(value))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
                switch(Operation){
                    case GameplayCooldownOperation.SetRemaining:succeeded=actor.Abilities.TrySetCooldownRemaining(handle,value);break;
                    case GameplayCooldownOperation.AdjustRemaining:succeeded=actor.Abilities.TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(handle,value);break;
                    default:
                        if((double)value<int.MinValue||(double)value>int.MaxValue||value!=MathF.Truncate(value))return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
                        succeeded=Operation==GameplayCooldownOperation.SetCharges?actor.Abilities.TrySetCharges(handle,(int)value):actor.Abilities.TryAdjustCharges(handle,(int)value);break;
                }
            }
            return succeeded?GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded:GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Dispels classified effects on explicitly selected targets using their existing
    /// containers. Classification uses EffectTags, not granted state tags. Removal is a Dispel,
    /// so it never runs natural-expiry continuations. Empty selection never falls back to self.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayDispelEffectsAction : IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public GameplayEffectQuery Query { get; }

        public GameplayDispelEffectsAction(GameplayEffectQuery query)
        {
            Query = query ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(query));
            if (query.EffectTags.All.Count == 0 && query.EffectTags.Any.Count == 0)
                throw new ArgumentException("Select at least one effect classification to dispel.", nameof(query));
        }

        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (host is GameplayStandardActor disposed && disposed.IsDisposed) return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var ids = context.TargetData.Targets.Count > 0 ? context.TargetData.Targets :
                context.TargetData.HasPrimaryTarget ? new[] { context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId } : Array.Empty<GameplaySourceId>();
            if (ids.Count == 0) return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var containers = new List<GameplayEffectContainer>();
            var visited = new HashSet<GameplayEffectContainer>();
            foreach (var id in ids)
            {
                GameplayEffectContainer effects;
                if (id == host.OwnerId) effects = host.Effects;
                else if (host is GameplayStandardActor actor && !actor.IsDisposed && actor.World.TryGetActor(id, out var target))
                    effects = target.Effects;
                else return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
                if (visited.Add(effects)) containers.Add(effects);
            }
            // Resolve all targets before changing any container. RemoveMatching snapshots its
            // own handles; effects created by removal observers are not recursively dispelled.
            foreach (var container in containers) container.RemoveMatching(Query, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Dispel);
            return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Push-based release of a foreign-target effect cleanup relation. Target expiry/despawn
    /// removes the Ability's stale relation; Ability End removes only this exact target effect.</summary>
    internal sealed class GameplayOwnedTargetEffectLease : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly GameplayAbilityContainer _abilities;
        private readonly GameplayAbilityHandle _ability;
        private readonly GameplayEffectContainer _effects;
        private readonly GameplayEffectLease _lease;
        private bool _disposed;
        public GameplayOwnedTargetEffectLease(GameplayAbilityContainer abilities, GameplayAbilityHandle ability,
            GameplayEffectContainer effects, GameplayEffectLease lease)
        { _abilities = abilities; _ability = ability; _effects = effects; _lease = lease; _effects.Removed += Removed; }
        private void Removed(GameplayEffectRemovalObservation observation) { if (observation.Handle == _lease.Handle) Dispose(); }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed) return; _disposed = true; _effects.Removed -= Removed;
            _abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(_ability, this); _lease.Dispose();
        }
    }
    internal sealed class GameplayOwnedSequenceLease : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly GameplayStandardActor _actor;
        private readonly GameplayAbilityHandle _ability;
        private readonly GameplaySequenceHandle _sequence;
        private bool _disposed;
        public GameplayOwnedSequenceLease(GameplayStandardActor actor, GameplayAbilityHandle ability, GameplaySequenceHandle sequence)
        { _actor = actor; _ability = ability; _sequence = sequence; _actor.Sequences.Terminated += Ended; }
        private void Ended(GameplaySequenceTermination observation) { if (observation.Handle.Equals(_sequence)) Dispose(); }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed) return; _disposed = true; _actor.Sequences.Terminated -= Ended;
            _actor.Abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(_ability, this); _actor.Sequences.Cancel(_sequence);
        }
    }
    public static class GameplayStandardActivation
    {
        /// <summary>Resolves only this actor's active grant using the captured activation identity,
        /// including summoned actors whose birth origin belongs to the parent's cast.</summary>
        public static bool TryFindGrant(GameplayStandardActor actor, GameplayContext context, out GameplayAbilityHandle handle)
        {
            handle = default;
            if (actor.IsDisposed || context.InstigatorId != actor.Id) return false;
            foreach (var grant in actor.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot())
                if (grant.IsActive && actor.Abilities.TryCreateExecutionContext(grant.Handle, new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id), out var cast) &&
                    cast.ActivationSourceId == context.ActivationSourceId) { handle = grant.Handle; return true; }
            return false;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Starts the existing Sequence clock and attaches its cancellation/cleanup relation to the cast.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayOwnedSequenceAction : IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public GameplaySequenceDefinition Sequence { get; }
        public GameplayOwnedSequenceAction(GameplaySequenceDefinition sequence) => Sequence = sequence ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(sequence));
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor) || !GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor, context, out var grant))
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            var handle = actor.Sequences.StartSkill(Sequence, context, triggerEvent, actor);
            if (!actor.Sequences.IsActive(handle)) return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            var lease = new GameplayOwnedSequenceLease(actor, grant, handle);
            if (actor.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(grant, lease)) return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            lease.Dispose(); return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
        }
    }
    public sealed class GameplayEndAbilityAction : IGameplaySkillAction
    {
        public bool Cancel { get; }
        public GameplayEndAbilityAction(bool cancel = false) => Cancel = cancel;
        public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
        {
            if (!(host is GameplayStandardActor actor) || !GameplayStandardActivation.TryFindGrant(actor, context, out var grant))
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
            return (Cancel ? actor.Abilities.Cancel(grant) : actor.Abilities.End(grant)) ? GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded : GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    public enum GameplayStandardActivationMode { Active, Passive }
    public enum GameplayStandardEventSubject { OwnerInstigator, OwnerTarget, OwnerEither, Any }
    /// <summary>One skill entry referencing the existing immutable Ability and Skill Definitions.
    /// No duplicate cost, animation, target or timeline fields are stored here.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition
    {
        public int SkillId { get; }
        public string DiagnosticDocumentId {get;}
        public GameplayAbilityDefinition Ability { get; }
        public GameplaySkillDefinition Rules { get; }
        public GameplayTag CastEvent { get; }
        public GameplayStandardActivationMode Mode { get; }
        /// <summary>Explicitly dispatches the primary CastEvent after passive binding. This allows
        /// a gated startup rule to wait for a persistent suppression cooldown without refusing activation.</summary>
        public bool RunRulesOnPassiveActivation {get;}
        public GameplayStandardEventSubject Subject { get; }
        public GameplayContextValues Defaults { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySkillDefinition> AdditionalRules { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplaySkillLearningRequirement> LearningRequirements {get;}
        /// <summary>Optional immutable diagnostic provenance. It does not affect execution.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyDictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource> ActionSources {get;}
        public GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition(int skillId, GameplayAbilityDefinition ability, GameplaySkillDefinition rules,
            GameplayTag castEvent, GameplayStandardActivationMode mode = GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active,
            GameplayStandardEventSubject subject = GameplayStandardEventSubject.OwnerTarget, GameplayContextValues defaults = null,
            IEnumerable<GameplaySkillDefinition> additionalRules = null,IEnumerable<GameplaySkillLearningRequirement> learningRequirements=null,
            IReadOnlyDictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource> actionSources=null,string diagnosticDocumentId=null,bool runRulesOnPassiveActivation=false)
        {
            if (skillId <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(skillId));
            SkillId = skillId; Ability = ability ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(ability));
            DiagnosticDocumentId=diagnosticDocumentId;
            Rules = rules ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(rules));
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayStandardActivationMode), mode) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayStandardEventSubject), subject))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(mode));
            if ((mode == GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active||runRulesOnPassiveActivation) && (!(rules.Trigger is GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition trigger) ||
                !castEvent.IsValid || trigger.EventTag != castEvent || rules.Once))
                throw new ArgumentException("Active skill requires its real CastEvent trigger and repeatable rules.");
            CastEvent = castEvent; Mode = mode; Subject = subject; Defaults = defaults ?? GameplayContextValues.Empty;
            if(runRulesOnPassiveActivation&&mode!=GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive)throw new ArgumentException("Passive startup applies only to passive skills.");
            RunRulesOnPassiveActivation=runRulesOnPassiveActivation;
            var supplemental = new List<GameplaySkillDefinition>(additionalRules ?? Array.Empty<GameplaySkillDefinition>());
            var unique = new HashSet<GameplaySkillDefinition>();
            foreach (var rule in supplemental)
                if (rule == null || ReferenceEquals(rule, rules) || !unique.Add(rule)) throw new ArgumentException("Additional rules must be distinct and non-null.");
            AdditionalRules = supplemental.AsReadOnly();
            var prerequisites=new List<GameplaySkillLearningRequirement>(learningRequirements??Array.Empty<GameplaySkillLearningRequirement>());
            if(prerequisites.Exists(p=>p==null))throw new ArgumentException("Missing learning prerequisite.");
            LearningRequirements=prerequisites.AsReadOnly();
            var sources=new Dictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource>();
            if(actionSources!=null)foreach(var pair in actionSources)sources.Add(pair.Key,pair.Value);
            ActionSources=new System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyDictionary<IGameplaySkillAction,GameplaySkillTraceSource>(sources);
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Per-actor installed skill. Core owns grant/Effect/Sequence state; this entry installs the
    /// real producer/subscription and input route. End/Cancel physically disposes the current binding,
    /// so passive rule cleanup is push-based. Upgrade only changes an inactive grant.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayInstalledSkill : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly List<GameplaySkillRuntime> _bindings = new List<GameplaySkillRuntime>();
        public GameplayStandardActor Actor { get; }
        public GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition Definition { get; }
        public GameplayAbilityHandle Grant { get; }
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }
        public GameplayContext LastCastContext { get; private set; }
        public GameplayAbilityStatus Status => Actor.Abilities.GetStatus(Grant);
        internal GameplayInstalledSkill(GameplayStandardActor actor, GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition definition, int level)
        { Actor = actor; Definition = definition; Grant = actor.Abilities.Grant(definition.Ability, level); }
        public bool TryUpgrade(int level) => !IsDisposed && Actor.Abilities.TrySetLevel(Grant, level);
        /// <summary>True means activation committed payment, even if its synchronous initial
        /// effects already ended/cancelled it. Such an activation has no binding or CastEvent;
        /// Status, termination observation and trace distinguish it from precommit refusal.</summary>
        public bool TryCast(GameplayTargetData target = null, GameplayContextValues input = null)
        {
            if (IsDisposed || Definition.Mode != GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active || !Actor.IsTargetable) return false;
            var request=new GameplayContext(Actor.Id,target??new GameplayTargetData(Actor.Id,Actor.Position),values:Definition.Defaults.Merge(input??GameplayContextValues.Empty));
            try
            {
                if (!Actor.Abilities.TryActivate(Grant,request)) return false;
                if (!CanBindCommittedActivation(request)) return true;
                Bind(target ?? new GameplayTargetData(Actor.Id, Actor.Position), input);
                Actor.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(Definition.CastEvent, LastCastContext, 1));
                return true;
            }
            catch { Actor.Abilities.Cancel(Grant); throw; }
        }
        /// <summary>Explicit passive activation/re-engagement. True includes a paid activation
        /// immediately ended by initial effects; no listener is installed for that dead grant.</summary>
        public bool ActivatePassive()
        {
            if (IsDisposed || Definition.Mode != GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive || !Actor.IsTargetable) return false;
            var request=new GameplayContext(Actor.Id,new GameplayTargetData(Actor.Id,Actor.Position),values:Definition.Defaults);
            try { if (!Actor.Abilities.TryActivate(Grant,request)) return false; if (!CanBindCommittedActivation(request)) return true; Bind(new GameplayTargetData(Actor.Id, Actor.Position), null); if(Definition.RunRulesOnPassiveActivation)Actor.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(Definition.CastEvent,LastCastContext,1)); return true; }
            catch { Actor.Abilities.Cancel(Grant); throw; }
        }
        private bool CanBindCommittedActivation(GameplayContext request)
        {
            if (Actor.Abilities.IsActive(Grant)) return true;
            Unbind();
            LastCastContext = null; // Never expose an older cast as this already-ended activation.
            var termination = Actor.Abilities.LastTermination;
            Actor.RecordSkillTrace(new GameplaySkillTraceRecord(Actor.Id, request, default,
                GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionSucceeded, "ActivationEndedBeforeBinding",
                detail: "Payment committed; no binding/CastEvent. " +
                    (termination != null && termination.Handle == Grant ? termination.Reason.ToString() : "Grant inactive")));
            return false;
        }
        private void Bind(GameplayTargetData target, GameplayContextValues input)
        {
            Unbind();
            if (!Actor.Abilities.TryCreateExecutionContext(Grant, target, out var root)) throw new InvalidOperationException("Cast grant became inactive before binding.");
            LastCastContext = root.WithValues(Definition.Defaults.Merge(input ?? GameplayContextValues.Empty));
            if(Actor.SpawnOriginSourceId.IsValid)LastCastContext=LastCastContext.WithOriginSource(Actor.SpawnOriginSourceId);
            GameplayContext captured = LastCastContext;
            BindRule(Definition.Rules, captured, true);
            foreach (var rule in Definition.AdditionalRules) BindRule(rule, captured, false);
        }
        private void BindRule(GameplaySkillDefinition rule, GameplayContext captured, bool primary)
        {
            var binding = Actor.InstallSkill(rule, (trigger, resolved) =>
            {
                if (primary && Definition.Mode == GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active &&
                    (trigger.InstigatorId != Actor.Id || trigger.Context == null ||
                     trigger.Context.OriginSourceId != captured.OriginSourceId ||
                     trigger.Context.ActivationSourceId!=captured.ActivationSourceId)) return null;
                if ((!primary || Definition.Mode == GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive) && !SubjectMatches(trigger)) return null;
                var inherited = trigger.Context?.Values ?? GameplayContextValues.Empty;
                return captured.WithTarget(resolved.TargetData).WithValues(inherited.Merge(captured.Values)
                    .WithValue(GameplayContextValues.TriggerMagnitudeKey, trigger.Magnitude));
            });
            _bindings.Add(binding);
            if (!Actor.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(Grant, binding)) { Actor.UninstallSkill(binding); _bindings.Remove(binding); throw new InvalidOperationException("Skill listener ownership was rejected."); }
        }
        private void Unbind() { foreach (var binding in _bindings) Actor.UninstallSkill(binding); _bindings.Clear(); }
        private bool SubjectMatches(GameplayEventData trigger) => Definition.Subject == GameplayStandardEventSubject.Any ||
            (Definition.Subject != GameplayStandardEventSubject.OwnerTarget && trigger.InstigatorId == Actor.Id) ||
            (Definition.Subject != GameplayStandardEventSubject.OwnerInstigator && trigger.TargetId == Actor.Id);
        public bool Cancel() => !IsDisposed && Actor.Abilities.Cancel(Grant);
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return; IsDisposed = true;
            Actor.DetachDocument(this);
            Unbind();
            Actor.Abilities.Remove(Grant);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Pre-battle learning prerequisite. Values come from an explicit player/build
    /// snapshot; no inventory, UI or active battle container is queried.</summary>
    public abstract class GameplaySkillLearningRequirement
    {
        public string Reason {get;}
        protected GameplaySkillLearningRequirement(string reason){Reason=reason??"学习前置未满足";}
        public abstract bool IsMet(int targetLevel,GameplayLearnedSkillSet learned,GameplayContextValues values);
    }
    public sealed class GameplayLearningScalarRequirement:GameplaySkillLearningRequirement
    {
        public GameplayTag Key {get;}
        public float Minimum {get;}
        public float PerLevel {get;}
        public GameplayLearningScalarRequirement(GameplayTag key,float minimum,float perLevel=0,string reason=null):base(reason)
        {if(!key.IsValid||!float.IsFinite(minimum)||!float.IsFinite(perLevel))throw new ArgumentException("学习数值需要合法 Key 和有限阈值。");Key=key;Minimum=minimum;PerLevel=perLevel;}
        public override bool IsMet(int targetLevel,GameplayLearnedSkillSet learned,GameplayContextValues values)
        {return values.TryGetValue(Key,out float value)&&value>=Minimum+PerLevel*(targetLevel-1);}
    }
    public sealed class GameplayLearningSkillRequirement:GameplaySkillLearningRequirement
    {
        public int SkillId {get;}
        public int Level {get;}
        public GameplayLearningSkillRequirement(int skillId,int level=1,string reason=null):base(reason)
        {if(skillId<=0||level<=0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(skillId));SkillId=skillId;Level=level;}
        public override bool IsMet(int targetLevel,GameplayLearnedSkillSet learned,GameplayContextValues values)=>learned.LevelOf(SkillId)>=Level;
    }
    /// <summary>Save-compatible plain grant data. No Definition, runtime handle, cooldown or
    /// active effect is persisted. Resolve SkillId against the current definitions when loading.</summary>
    [Serializable]
    public sealed class GameplayLearnedSkillEntry
    {
        public int SkillId;
        public int Level;
        public GameplayLearnedSkillEntry(){}
        public GameplayLearnedSkillEntry(int id,int level){SkillId=id;Level=level;}
    }
    /// <summary>Persistent learned levels separate from battle grants. Learning/upgrading checks
    /// every prerequisite before mutation; trusted saves restore atomically after full validation.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayLearnedSkillSet
    {
        private Dictionary<int,int> _levels=new Dictionary<int,int>();
        public int LevelOf(int id)=>_levels.TryGetValue(id,out int level)?level:0;
        public bool TryLearnOrUpgrade(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,GameplayContextValues values,out string reason)
        {
            if(!CanLearnOrUpgrade(skill,values,out reason))return false;
            _levels[skill.SkillId]=LevelOf(skill.SkillId)+1;return true;
        }
        /// <summary>Read-only preview of the same gate used by commit; checking eligibility cannot upgrade.</summary>
        public bool CanLearnOrUpgrade(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,GameplayContextValues values,out string reason)
        {
            if(skill==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(skill));
            int next=LevelOf(skill.SkillId)+1;
            if(next>skill.Ability.MaxLevel){reason="技能已满级";return false;}
            foreach(var prerequisite in skill.LearningRequirements)
                if(!prerequisite.IsMet(next,this,values??GameplayContextValues.Empty)){reason=prerequisite.Reason;return false;}
            reason=null;return true;
        }
        public GameplayLearnedSkillEntry[] Snapshot()
        {
            var ids=new List<int>(_levels.Keys);ids.Sort();var result=new GameplayLearnedSkillEntry[ids.Count];
            for(int i=0;i<ids.Count;i++)result[i]=new GameplayLearnedSkillEntry(ids[i],_levels[ids[i]]);return result;
        }
        /// <summary>Restores trusted progression, without re-paying learning requirements.
        /// Unknown/duplicate IDs and invalid levels reject the entire snapshot.</summary>
        public void Restore(IEnumerable<GameplayLearnedSkillEntry> entries,Func<int,GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition> resolve)
        {
            if(entries==null||resolve==null)throw new ArgumentNullException();var copy=new Dictionary<int,int>();
            foreach(var entry in entries){
                if(entry==null||entry.SkillId<=0||entry.Level<=0||copy.ContainsKey(entry.SkillId))throw new ArgumentException("学习快照含无效或重复技能。");
                var definition=resolve(entry.SkillId);
                if(definition==null||definition.SkillId!=entry.SkillId||entry.Level>definition.Ability.MaxLevel)throw new ArgumentException("学习快照无法匹配当前技能定义/等级。");
                copy.Add(entry.SkillId,entry.Level);
            }
            _levels=copy;
        }
        /// <summary>Installs resolved learned levels onto a new battle actor, reusing its actual
        /// Ability container. Failure removes only grants installed by this call.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayInstalledSkill> Install(GameplayStandardActor actor,Func<int,GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition> resolve)
        {
            if(actor==null||resolve==null)throw new ArgumentNullException();
            var definitions=new List<(GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition skill,int level)>();
            foreach(var entry in Snapshot()){
                var skill=resolve(entry.SkillId);
                if(skill==null||skill.SkillId!=entry.SkillId||entry.Level>skill.Ability.MaxLevel)throw new ArgumentException("学习技能无法解析。");
                foreach(var existing in actor.InstalledSkills)if(existing.Definition.SkillId==entry.SkillId)throw new InvalidOperationException("角色已有该技能。");
                definitions.Add((skill,entry.Level));
            }
            var installed=new List<GameplayInstalledSkill>();
            try{foreach(var entry in definitions)installed.Add(actor.InstallDocument(entry.skill,entry.level));return installed.AsReadOnly();}
            catch{foreach(var skill in installed)skill.Dispose();throw;}
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Gameplay/Standard/Runtime/GameplaySkillSelectionPolicy.cs
````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Small priority-based automatic cast policy. Uses actual installed grants and their
    /// eligibility; no cooldown mirror, state machine or timer service. Host/FSM supplies each delta.
    /// At most one cast per decision, stable installed order breaks ties, missed decisions do not burst.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillSelectionPolicy:IGameplayBehaviourDriver
    {
        private readonly GameplayStandardActor _actor;
        private readonly Func<GameplayInstalledSkill,int> _priority;
        private readonly Func<GameplayInstalledSkill,GameplayTargetData> _target;
        private readonly float _interval;
        private double _elapsed;
        private bool _disposed;
        public string CurrentState=>"AutoCast policy";
        public bool TryChangeState(string state)=>false; // State transitions belong to the existing host FSM.
        void IGameplayBehaviourDriver.Advance(float amount)=>Advance(amount);
        public void Dispose()=>_disposed=true;
        public int LastSelectedSkillId { get; private set; }
        public GameplaySkillSelectionPolicy(GameplayStandardActor actor,Func<GameplayInstalledSkill,int> priority,
            Func<GameplayInstalledSkill,GameplayTargetData> target,float interval=1)
        {
            _actor=actor??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(actor));
            _priority=priority??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(priority));_target=target??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(target));
            if(!float.IsFinite(interval)||interval<=0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(interval));_interval=interval;
        }
        public bool Advance(float amount)
        {
            if(!float.IsFinite(amount)||amount<0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(amount));
            if(_disposed||_actor.IsDisposed||!_actor.IsTargetable)return false;
            _elapsed=Math.Min(_interval,_elapsed+amount);if(_elapsed<_interval)return false;
            var skills=_actor.InstalledSkills.Where(s=>!s.IsDisposed).ToArray();
            if(skills.Any(s=>s.Status.Phase==GameplayAbilityPhase.Active))return false;
            _elapsed=0;
            foreach(var skill in skills.Where(s=>s.Definition.Mode==GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active).OrderByDescending(_priority))
            {
                var target=_target(skill);if(target==null||!skill.TryCast(target))continue;
                LastSelectedSkillId=skill.Definition.SkillId;return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>Bounded per-actor diagnostic history. Disabled by default; does not tick rules
    /// or keep mutable runtime references. Snapshot survives subsequent recording/cleanup.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillTraceBuffer
    {
        private readonly Queue<(long order,GameplaySkillTraceRecord record)> _entries=new Queue<(long,GameplaySkillTraceRecord)>();
        private long _order;
        public int Capacity {get;}
        public bool Enabled {get;set;}
        public GameplaySkillTraceBuffer(int capacity=128){if(capacity<=0)throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(capacity));Capacity=capacity;}
        internal void Record(GameplaySkillTraceRecord record)
        {if(!Enabled)return;while(_entries.Count>=Capacity)_entries.Dequeue();_entries.Enqueue((++_order,record));}
        public IReadOnlyList<(long order,GameplaySkillTraceRecord record)> Snapshot()=>Array.AsReadOnly(_entries.ToArray());
        public void Clear()=>_entries.Clear();
    }
}
````
