````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard
{
    /// <summary>First-party host composition for real-time or turn-driven games. Reuses the existing rule
    /// containers; Advance is the only world entry for their clocks. Backends/presenters never call it.
    /// No persistent player data, Unity object, resource path or game-specific unit type is stored here.</summary>
    public sealed partial class GameplayStandardWorld : IDisposable
    {
        private readonly List<GameplayStandardActor> _actors = new List<GameplayStandardActor>();
        private readonly List<GameplayStandardActor> _stepActors = new List<GameplayStandardActor>();
        private readonly List<GameplaySpatialOperation> _stepSpatial = new List<GameplaySpatialOperation>();
        private readonly List<GameplayEffectContainer> _stepEffects = new List<GameplayEffectContainer>();
        private readonly IReadOnlyList<GameplayStandardActor> _actorView;
        private bool _advancing;
        private bool _publishingCombat;
        private readonly Queue<CombatDispatch> _combatQueue = new Queue<CombatDispatch>();
        private int _combatDepth, _combatAccepted, _combatAllowedDepth;
        private GameplaySourceId _combatRoot;
        /// <summary>Per causal chain limits; independent attacks start a fresh budget.</summary>
        public const int CombatChainDepthLimit = 16, CombatChainOutcomeLimit = 128;
        /// <summary>Latest bounded-chain diagnostic, also recorded in the actual reporter's trace.</summary>
        public string LastCombatDispatchDiagnostic { get; private set; }
        private readonly struct CombatDispatch
        {
            public readonly GameplayStandardActor Reporter;
            public readonly GameplayCombatOutcome Outcome;
            public readonly int Depth;
            public CombatDispatch(GameplayStandardActor reporter, GameplayCombatOutcome outcome, int depth)
            { Reporter = reporter; Outcome = outcome; Depth = depth; }
        }
        public GameplaySourceIdAllocator Sources { get; }
        public IGameplayRandomSource Random {get;}
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayStandardActor> Actors => _actorView;
        public IGameplaySpatialQueryBackend Spatial { get; set; }
        public GameplayEventDispatcher Events { get; } = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
        /// <summary>Committed outcomes drain in stable FIFO order in the current rule domain.
        /// Nested reactions enqueue without recursive dispatcher calls. Only exhausted causal
        /// chains are suppressed; a later independent attack receives a fresh budget.</summary>
        internal void PublishCombat(GameplayStandardActor reporter,GameplayCombatOutcome outcome)
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return;
            int depth = _publishingCombat ? _combatDepth + 1 : 0;
            if (!_publishingCombat)
            {
                _combatAccepted = 0; _combatRoot = outcome.Context.EffectiveSourceId; _combatAllowedDepth = CombatChainDepthLimit;
                if(outcome.Context.Values.TryGetValue(GameplayCombatEvents.MaxChainDepth,out float authoredDepth))
                    _combatAllowedDepth=(int)Math.Max(0,Math.Min(CombatChainDepthLimit,Math.Floor(authoredDepth)));
            }
            if (depth > _combatAllowedDepth || _combatAccepted >= CombatChainOutcomeLimit)
            {
                LastCombatDispatchDiagnostic = $"CombatChainBudgetExceeded root={_combatRoot} source={outcome.Context.EffectiveSourceId} depth={depth}/{_combatAllowedDepth} accepted={_combatAccepted}/{CombatChainOutcomeLimit}";
                reporter.RecordSkillTrace(new GameplaySkillTraceRecord(reporter.Id, outcome.Context, GameplayCombatEvents.Damage,
                    GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionRejected, "CombatDispatch", detail: LastCombatDispatchDiagnostic));
                return;
            }
            _combatAccepted++;
            _combatQueue.Enqueue(new CombatDispatch(reporter, outcome, depth));
            if (_publishingCombat) return;
            _publishingCombat = true;
            try
            {
                while (!IsDisposed && _combatQueue.Count > 0)
                {
                    var pending = _combatQueue.Dequeue();
                    reporter = pending.Reporter; outcome = pending.Outcome; _combatDepth = pending.Depth;
                    if (reporter.IsDisposed) continue;
                    var tag = outcome.Kind == GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Damage ? GameplayCombatEvents.Damage :
                        outcome.Kind == GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Heal ? GameplayCombatEvents.Heal : GameplayCombatEvents.Shield;
                    // Borrowed actors may use their game's actual dispatcher. Route to both real
                    // actor domains, once when shared, rather than publishing into a disconnected bus.
                    var dispatchers=new List<GameplayEventDispatcher>();
                    if(TryGetActor(outcome.Context.InstigatorId,out var instigator))dispatchers.Add(instigator.Events);
                    if(!dispatchers.Contains(reporter.Events))dispatchers.Add(reporter.Events);
                    foreach(var dispatcher in dispatchers){
                        if(IsDisposed)break;
                        dispatcher.Publish(new GameplayEventData(tag,outcome.Context,outcome.Applied));
                        if (!IsDisposed && outcome.Kind == GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Damage && !outcome.Damage.IsMiss && !outcome.Damage.IsImmune)
                            dispatcher.Publish(new GameplayEventData(GameplayCombatEvents.Hit,outcome.Context,outcome.Applied));
                    }
                }
            }
            finally { _publishingCombat = false; _combatQueue.Clear(); _combatDepth = 0; }
        }
        public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }

        public GameplayStandardActor CreateActor(GameplayPoint position, int faction = 0, int layer = 0,

        public GameplayStandardActor RegisterBorrowedActor(IGameplayAbilityHost host, GameplayAbilityContainer abilities,
            GameplaySequenceContainer sequences, GameplayEventDispatcher events, Func<GameplayPoint> position,

        public void Advance(float amount) => Advance(amount, null);
        /// <summary>One step with an optional existing host's borrowed Sequence phase. Borrowed
        /// Abilities must already have advanced. Effects normally advance only owned actors; an
        /// explicit game-owned effect phase may combine these with its actual borrowed containers.
        /// That callback must advance every supplied owned container exactly once. Spatial work precedes all sequence markers;
        /// newborn work never consumes the delta before its creation.</summary>
        public void Advance(float amount, Action<float> advanceBorrowedSequences,
            Action<IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectContainer>,float> advanceEffects = null)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(amount) || amount < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(amount));
            if (IsDisposed) return;
            if (_advancing || _publishingCombat) throw new InvalidOperationException("World Advance cannot be nested inside a rule callback.");
            _advancing = true;
            try { AdvanceStep(amount, advanceBorrowedSequences, advanceEffects); }
            finally { _stepActors.Clear(); _stepSpatial.Clear(); _stepEffects.Clear(); _advancing = false; }
        }
        private void AdvanceStep(float amount, Action<float> advanceBorrowedSequences,
            Action<IReadOnlyList<GameplayEffectContainer>,float> advanceEffects)
        {
            // Snapshot membership once before callbacks, but reuse private storage between steps.
            // Advance rejects reentry; finally releases references even after callbacks throw/dispose.
            var actors = _stepActors; actors.AddRange(_actors);
            var spatial = _stepSpatial; spatial.AddRange(_spatial);
            foreach (var actor in actors) if (!actor.IsDisposed && !actor.BorrowsContainers) actor.Presentation?.Advance(amount);
            // Existing lifecycle clocks finish before marker/input actions. A target effect created by
            // this step's Sequence/Skill must never consume a delta that preceded its creation.
            var effectContainers = _stepEffects;
            foreach (var actor in actors) if (!actor.IsDisposed && !actor.BorrowsContainers) effectContainers.Add(actor.Effects);
            if(advanceEffects==null)GameplayEffectContainer.AdvanceTogether(effectContainers, amount);
            else advanceEffects(new List<GameplayEffectContainer>(effectContainers).AsReadOnly(), amount); // External callbacks may retain their detached list.
            foreach (var actor in actors) if (!actor.IsDisposed && !actor.BorrowsContainers) actor.Abilities.Advance(amount);
            foreach (var operation in spatial) if (!operation.IsDisposed) operation.Advance(amount);
            advanceBorrowedSequences?.Invoke(amount);
            foreach (var actor in actors) if (!actor.IsDisposed && !actor.BorrowsContainers) actor.Sequences.Advance(amount);
            foreach (var actor in actors) if (!actor.IsDisposed) actor.AdvanceSkills(amount);
            // Decisions run after this step's clocks. A cast chosen here starts at age zero.
            foreach (var actor in actors) if (!actor.IsDisposed) actor.Behaviour?.Advance(amount);
        }
        internal void Detach(GameplayStandardActor actor)
        {
            _actors.Remove(actor);
            List<Exception> errors=null;
            foreach(var operation in _spatial.ToArray())
                if(ReferenceEquals(operation.Owner,actor))
                    try { operation.Dispose(); } catch(Exception ex) { (errors??(errors=new List<Exception>())).Add(ex); }
            if(errors!=null)throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (IsDisposed) return; IsDisposed = true;
            _combatQueue.Clear();
            List<Exception> errors = null;
            foreach (var operation in _spatial.ToArray())
                try { operation.Dispose(); } catch (Exception ex) { (errors ?? (errors = new List<Exception>())).Add(ex); }
            foreach (var actor in _actors.ToArray())
                try { actor.Dispose(); } catch (Exception ex) { (errors ?? (errors = new List<Exception>())).Add(ex); }
            _actors.Clear();
            if (errors != null) throw new AggregateException(errors);
        }
    }

                values ?? context.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(), Attributes, Id, instigatorTarget: this);
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 不可变的点号层级标签，身份按区分大小写的 Ordinal 字符串比较。
    /// 不裁剪名称；拒绝空层级和任何空白字符。default 无效。
    /// </summary>
    public readonly struct GameplayTag : IEquatable<GameplayTag>
    {
        public string Name { get; }
        public bool IsValid => Name != null;

        public GameplayTag(string name)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
                throw new ArgumentException("Tag name must not be null or empty.", nameof(name));
            for (int i = 0; i < name.Length; i++)
            {
                if (char.IsWhiteSpace(name[i]) ||
                    (name[i] == '.' && (i == 0 || i == name.Length - 1 || name[i - 1] == '.')))
                    throw new ArgumentException("Tag name must contain nonempty segments and no whitespace.", nameof(name));
            }
            Name = name;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 是否为 parent 的严格后代（不包含自身）；任一标签无效则返回 false。
        /// 点号必须位于完整层级边界，State.Stunned 不是 State.Stun 的后代。
        /// </summary>
        public bool IsDescendantOf(GameplayTag parent) =>
            IsValid && parent.IsValid && Name.Length > parent.Name.Length &&
            Name[parent.Name.Length] == '.' && Name.StartsWith(parent.Name, StringComparison.Ordinal);

        public bool Equals(GameplayTag other) => StringComparer.Ordinal.Equals(Name, other.Name);
        public override bool Equals(object obj) => obj is GameplayTag other && Equals(other);
        // 哈希仅供集合分桶；Equals 始终比较完整名称，不把哈希当作语义 ID。
        public override int GetHashCode() => Name == null ? 0 : StringComparer.Ordinal.GetHashCode(Name);
        public override string ToString() => Name ?? string.Empty;
        public static bool operator ==(GameplayTag left, GameplayTag right) => left.Equals(right);
        public static bool operator !=(GameplayTag left, GameplayTag right) => !left.Equals(right);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>
    /// 按 exact 标签保存来源集合，单线程同步使用。父标签仅在层级查询中成立，不物理添加。
    /// 同来源对同 exact 标签只有一份贡献，source + tag 已足以精确撤销，因此不需要 Tag Handle。
    /// 所有入口拒绝无效标签或无效来源，抛出 ArgumentException。
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class GameplayTagContainer
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<GameplayTag, HashSet<GameplaySourceId>> _contributions =
            new Dictionary<GameplayTag, HashSet<GameplaySourceId>>();

        /// <summary>Captures exact tags and all sources in deterministic order.</summary>
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTagContributionSnapshot> GetContributionsSnapshot()
        {
            var tags = new List<GameplayTag>(_contributions.Keys);
            tags.Sort((a, b) => string.CompareOrdinal(a.Name, b.Name));
            var result = new List<GameplayTagContributionSnapshot>(tags.Count);
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in tags)
            {
                var sources = new List<GameplaySourceId>(_contributions[tag]);
                sources.Sort((a, b) => a.Value.CompareTo(b.Value));
                result.Add(new GameplayTagContributionSnapshot(tag, sources));
            }
            return result.AsReadOnly();
        }

        /// <summary>添加一份 exact 贡献；新贡献返回 true，同来源重复添加返回 false。</summary>
        public bool AddTag(GameplayTag tag, GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            ValidateTag(tag);
            ValidateSource(sourceId);
            if (!_contributions.TryGetValue(tag, out HashSet<GameplaySourceId> sources))
            {
                sources = new HashSet<GameplaySourceId>();
                _contributions.Add(tag, sources);
            }
            return sources.Add(sourceId);
        }

        /// <summary>只撤销指定来源的 exact 贡献；不存在返回 false，不影响其他来源或子标签。</summary>
        public bool RemoveTag(GameplayTag tag, GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            ValidateTag(tag);
            ValidateSource(sourceId);
            if (!_contributions.TryGetValue(tag, out HashSet<GameplaySourceId> sources) || !sources.Remove(sourceId))
                return false;
            if (sources.Count == 0) _contributions.Remove(tag);
            return true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// 撤销一个来源的所有 exact 贡献，返回撤销的贡献数（不是最终消失的标签数）。
        /// 其他来源仍贡献的标签继续存在；来源不存在返回0。
        /// </summary>
        public int RemoveTagsFromSource(GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            ValidateSource(sourceId);
            int removed = 0;
            var emptyTags = new List<GameplayTag>();
            foreach (var pair in _contributions)
            {
                if (!pair.Value.Remove(sourceId)) continue;
                removed++;
                if (pair.Value.Count == 0) emptyTags.Add(pair.Key);
            }
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in emptyTags) _contributions.Remove(tag);
            return removed;
        }

        /// <summary>层级查询：拥有自身或任一后代则为 true；只有父标签不能满足子标签查询。</summary>
        public bool HasTag(GameplayTag tag)
        {
            ValidateTag(tag);
            foreach (GameplayTag owned in _contributions.Keys)
                if (owned == tag || owned.IsDescendantOf(tag)) return true;
            return false;
        }

        /// <summary>精确查询：必须有来源明确贡献该完整名称，子标签不算。</summary>
        public bool HasTagExact(GameplayTag tag)
        {
            ValidateTag(tag);
            return _contributions.ContainsKey(tag);
        }

        private static void ValidateTag(GameplayTag tag)
        {
            if (!tag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Tag must be valid.", nameof(tag));
        }

        private static void ValidateSource(GameplaySourceId sourceId)
        {
            if (!sourceId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Source ID must be valid.", nameof(sourceId));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>不可变目标标签查询；All 全满足、非空 Any 至少一项、None 全不满足，均使用 HasTag 层级语义。</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayTagQuery
    {
        public static GameplayTagQuery Empty { get; } = new GameplayTagQuery(
            Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>());

        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> All { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> Any { get; }
        public IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> None { get; }
        public bool IsEmpty => All.Count == 0 && Any.Count == 0 && None.Count == 0;

        public GameplayTagQuery(IEnumerable<GameplayTag> all,
            IEnumerable<GameplayTag> any, IEnumerable<GameplayTag> none)
        {
            All = Copy(all, nameof(all));
            Any = Copy(any, nameof(any));
            None = Copy(none, nameof(none));
        }

        public bool Matches(GameplayTagContainer tags)
        {
            if (tags == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(tags));
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in All)
                if (!tags.HasTag(tag)) return false;
            if (Any.Count > 0)
            {
                bool matched = false;
                foreach (GameplayTag tag in Any)
                    if (tags.HasTag(tag)) { matched = true; break; }
                if (!matched) return false;
            }
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in None)
                if (tags.HasTag(tag)) return false;
            return true;
        }

        private static IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag> Copy(IEnumerable<GameplayTag> tags, string name)
        {
            if (tags == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(name);
            var copy = new List<GameplayTag>();
            foreach (GameplayTag tag in tags)
            {
                if (!tag.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Query tags must be valid.", name);
                copy.Add(tag);
            }
            return new ReadOnlyCollection<GameplayTag>(copy);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>不可变 float 规则值；实现不得保存每次应用的运行态。</summary>
    public interface IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        bool RequiresApplicationContext { get; }
        float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context);
    }

    public readonly struct GameplayValueEvaluationContext
    {
        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application { get; }
        public int StackCount => Application?.StackCount ?? 1;
        public GameplayValueEvaluationContext(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application) => Application = application;
        public GameplayEffectApplicationContext RequireApplication() => Application ??
            throw new InvalidOperationException("This value requires an Effect application context.");
    }

    /// <summary>统一进行 null 和有限值校验的规则数值入口。</summary>
    public static class GameplayValueEvaluator
    {
        public static float Evaluate(IGameplayFloatValue value, GameplayEffectApplicationContext application = null)
        {
            if (value == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(value));
            if (value.RequiresApplicationContext && application == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Value requires an Effect application context.");
            float result = value.Evaluate(new GameplayValueEvaluationContext(application));
            if (!float.IsFinite(result)) throw new ArithmeticException("Gameplay value must be finite.");
            return result;
        }
    }

    public sealed class GameplayConstantFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public float Value { get; }
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => false;
        public GameplayConstantFloatValue(float value)
        {
            if (!float.IsFinite(value)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value));
            Value = value;
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) => Value;
    }

    public sealed class GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public GameplayTag Key { get; }
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(GameplayTag key)
        { if (!key.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Key must be valid.", nameof(key)); Key = key; }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) =>
            context.RequireApplication().SetByCaller.GetRequiredValue(Key);
    }

    public sealed class GameplayContextFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public GameplayTag Key { get; }
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public GameplayContextFloatValue(GameplayTag key)
        { if (!key.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Key must be valid.", nameof(key)); Key = key; }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) =>
            context.RequireApplication().Context.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key);
    }

    public enum GameplayValueAttributeSource { Instigator, Target }

    public sealed class GameplayAttributeFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public GameplayValueAttributeSource Source { get; }
        public GameplayAttributeId AttributeId { get; }
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public GameplayAttributeFloatValue(GameplayValueAttributeSource source, GameplayAttributeId attributeId)
        {
            if (source != GameplayValueAttributeSource.Instigator && source != GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target)
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(source));
            if (!attributeId.IsValid) throw new ArgumentException("Attribute ID must be valid.", nameof(attributeId));
            Source = source; AttributeId = attributeId;
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context)
        {
            var application = context.RequireApplication();
            AttributeSet attributes = Source == GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target ?
                application.Target.Attributes : application.InstigatorAttributes;
            if (attributes == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("Instigator attribute view is unavailable.");
            if (!attributes.Contains(AttributeId))
            {
                var actor = Source == GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target ? application.Target : application.InstigatorTarget;
                if (actor is IGameplayResourceTarget resources && resources.Resources.TryGetBalance(AttributeId, out float balance)) return balance;
            }
            return attributes.GetCurrentValue(AttributeId);
        }
    }

    public sealed class GameplayStackCountFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) => context.RequireApplication().StackCount;
    }

    public enum GameplayBinaryFloatOperation { Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide, Min, Max }

    public sealed class GameplayBinaryFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public GameplayBinaryFloatOperation Operation { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue Left { get; }
        public IGameplayFloatValue Right { get; }
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => Left.RequiresApplicationContext || Right.RequiresApplicationContext;
        public GameplayBinaryFloatValue(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation operation,
            IGameplayFloatValue left, IGameplayFloatValue right)
        {
            if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation), operation))
                throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(operation));
            Left = left ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(left));
            Right = right ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(right));
            Operation = operation;
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context)
        {
            float a = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(Left, context.Application);
            float b = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(Right, context.Application);
            if (Operation == GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Divide && b == 0f)
                throw new DivideByZeroException("Gameplay value division by zero.");
            float result;
            switch (Operation)
            {
                case GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Add: result = a + b; break;
                case GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Subtract: result = a - b; break;
                case GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Multiply: result = a * b; break;
                case GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Divide: result = a / b; break;
                case GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Min: result = Math.Min(a, b); break;
                default: result = Math.Max(a, b); break;
            }
            if (!float.IsFinite(result)) throw new ArithmeticException("Gameplay formula must be finite.");
            return result;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stateless game-specific calculation; receives the current application snapshot and must return a finite value.</summary>
    public interface IGameplayCustomFloatCalculation
    {
        float Calculate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context);
    }

    public sealed class GameplayCustomFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public IGameplayCustomFloatCalculation Calculation { get; }
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public GameplayCustomFloatValue(IGameplayCustomFloatCalculation calculation) =>
            Calculation = calculation ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(calculation));
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) => Calculation.Calculate(context);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Globalization;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Compiles a bounded, invariant-culture arithmetic expression into existing immutable value nodes.
    /// Supports Level, StackCount, Caster./Target. attributes, Context./Caller. keys,
    /// + - * /, min/max/clamp and parentheses. No reflection, scripts, or silent zero fallback.
    /// Text is authoring source; the returned tree is the sole runtime evaluator.</summary>
    public static class GameplayFormula
    {
        public static IGameplayFloatValue Compile(string expression)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(expression)) throw new FormatException("Formula is empty.");
            if (expression.Length > 4096) throw new FormatException("Formula exceeds 4096 characters.");
            return new Parser(expression).Compile();
        }

        private sealed class Parser
        {
            private readonly string _text;
            private int _position, _depth, _nodes;
            public Parser(string text) => _text = text;
            public IGameplayFloatValue Compile()
            {
                var value = Sum();
                Space();
                if (_position != _text.Length) throw Error("Unexpected token");
                // Constant errors are authoring errors, not deferred until the first cast.
                if (!value.RequiresApplicationContext) GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(value);
                return value;
            }
            private IGameplayFloatValue Sum()
            {
                var value = Product();
                while (true)
                {
                    if (Take('+')) value = Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Add, value, Product());
                    else if (Take('-')) value = Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Subtract, value, Product());
                    else return value;
                }
            }
            private IGameplayFloatValue Product()
            {
                var value = Primary();
                while (true)
                {
                    if (Take('*')) value = Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Multiply, value, Primary());
                    else if (Take('/')) value = Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Divide, value, Primary());
                    else return value;
                }
            }
            private IGameplayFloatValue Primary()
            {
                if (++_depth > 64) throw Error("Formula nesting exceeds 64");
                if (++_nodes > 256) throw Error("Formula exceeds 256 nodes");
                try
                {
                    if (Take('+')) return Primary();
                    if (Take('-')) return Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Subtract, new GameplayConstantFloatValue(0), Primary());
                    if (Take('(')) { var value = Sum(); Require(')'); return value; }
                    Space();
                    if (_position >= _text.Length) throw Error("Expected a value");
                    char first = _text[_position];
                    if (char.IsDigit(first) || first == '.') return Number();
                    int start = _position;
                    while (_position < _text.Length && (char.IsLetterOrDigit(_text[_position]) ||
                        _text[_position] == '_' || _text[_position] == '.')) _position++;
                    if (_position == start) throw Error("Expected a number or identifier");
                    string name = _text.Substring(start, _position - start);
                    if (Take('('))
                    {
                        var a = Sum(); Require(','); var b = Sum();
                        if (name == "clamp") { Require(','); var c = Sum(); Require(')'); return new GameplayClampFloatValue(a, b, c); }
                        Require(')');
                        if (name == "min") return Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Min, a, b);
                        if (name == "max") return Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Max, a, b);
                        throw Error("Unknown function: " + name);
                    }
                    if (name == "Level") return new GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValue();
                    if (name == "StackCount") return new GameplayStackCountFloatValue();
                    int dot = name.IndexOf('.');
                    if (dot <= 0 || dot == name.Length - 1) throw Error("Unknown identifier: " + name);
                    string prefix = name.Substring(0, dot), key = name.Substring(dot + 1);
                    if(prefix=="Resource"||prefix=="CasterResource"||prefix=="TargetResource")return new GameplayResourceFloatValue(
                        prefix=="TargetResource"?GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target:GameplayValueAttributeSource.Instigator,new GameplayAttributeId(key));
                    if (prefix == "Caster" || prefix == "Target") return new GameplayAttributeFloatValue(
                        prefix == "Caster" ? GameplayValueAttributeSource.Instigator : GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target,
                        new GameplayAttributeId(key));
                    if (prefix == "Context") return new GameplayContextFloatValue(new GameplayTag(key));
                    if (prefix == "Caller") return new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(new GameplayTag(key));
                    throw Error("Unknown identifier: " + name);
                }
                finally { _depth--; }
            }
            private IGameplayFloatValue Number()
            {
                int start = _position;
                while (_position < _text.Length && (char.IsDigit(_text[_position]) || _text[_position] == '.')) _position++;
                if (_position < _text.Length && (_text[_position] == 'e' || _text[_position] == 'E'))
                {
                    _position++;
                    if (_position < _text.Length && (_text[_position] == '+' || _text[_position] == '-')) _position++;
                    while (_position < _text.Length && char.IsDigit(_text[_position])) _position++;
                }
                if (!float.TryParse(_text.Substring(start, _position - start), NumberStyles.Float,
                    CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, out float value) || !float.IsFinite(value)) throw Error("Invalid finite number");
                return new GameplayConstantFloatValue(value);
            }
            private IGameplayFloatValue Binary(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation operation, IGameplayFloatValue left, IGameplayFloatValue right)
            {
                if (++_nodes > 256) throw Error("Formula exceeds 256 nodes");
                if (operation == GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Divide && !right.RequiresApplicationContext &&
                    GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(right) == 0) throw Error("Division by zero");
                return new GameplayBinaryFloatValue(operation, left, right);
            }
            private void Space() { while (_position < _text.Length && char.IsWhiteSpace(_text[_position])) _position++; }
            private bool Take(char token)
            {
                Space(); if (_position >= _text.Length || _text[_position] != token) return false;
                _position++; return true;
            }
            private void Require(char token) { if (!Take(token)) throw Error("Expected '" + token + "'"); }
            private FormatException Error(string message) => new FormatException(message + " at character " + (_position + 1) + ".");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Immutable piecewise linear numeric curve. Input uses the common value AST;
    /// values outside the authored domain clamp to endpoints. Keys must be finite and strictly
    /// increasing; this is a rule curve, not a Unity animation or weighted tangent curve.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayCurveFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        private readonly KeyValuePair<float,float>[] _keys;
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _input;
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext=>_input.RequiresApplicationContext;
        public GameplayCurveFloatValue(IGameplayFloatValue input,IEnumerable<KeyValuePair<float,float>> keys)
        {
            _input=input??throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(input));
            if(keys==null)throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(keys));
            var copy=new List<KeyValuePair<float,float>>();
            foreach(var key in keys){
                if(!float.IsFinite(key.Key)||!float.IsFinite(key.Value)||(copy.Count>0&&key.Key<=copy[copy.Count-1].Key))
                    throw new ArgumentException("Curve keys must be finite and strictly increasing.",nameof(keys));
                copy.Add(key);
            }
            if(copy.Count==0)throw new ArgumentException("Curve needs at least one key.",nameof(keys));
            _keys=copy.ToArray();
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context)
        {
            float x=GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_input,context.Application);
            if(x<=_keys[0].Key)return _keys[0].Value;
            for(int i=1;i<_keys.Length;i++)if(x<=_keys[i].Key){
                var a=_keys[i-1];var b=_keys[i];
                double t=((double)x-a.Key)/((double)b.Key-a.Key);
                return (float)(a.Value+((double)b.Value-a.Value)*t);
            }
            return _keys[_keys.Length-1].Value;
        }
    }
    /// <summary>Reads the captured cast level, never a mutable shared Definition or live grant.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) => context.RequireApplication().Context.AbilityLevel;
    }

    /// <summary>Discrete one-based level table. Levels beyond the authored table clamp to its last entry.
    /// A defensive copy prevents authoring changes from rewriting already built Definitions.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayLevelTableFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        private readonly float[] _values;
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => true;
        public GameplayLevelTableFloatValue(IEnumerable<float> values)
        {
            if (values == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(values));
            var copy = new List<float>();
            foreach (float value in values)
            {
                if (!float.IsFinite(value)) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(values));
                copy.Add(value);
            }
            if (copy.Count == 0) throw new ArgumentException("Level table cannot be empty.", nameof(values));
            _values = copy.ToArray();
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) =>
            _values[Math.Min(context.RequireApplication().Context.AbilityLevel, _values.Length) - 1];
    }

    /// <summary>Clamps an expression using the same runtime evaluator as Effect magnitudes.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayClampFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _value, _minimum, _maximum;
        public IGameplayFloatValue Value => _value;
        public IGameplayFloatValue Minimum => _minimum;
        public IGameplayFloatValue Maximum => _maximum;
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext => _value.RequiresApplicationContext ||
            _minimum.RequiresApplicationContext || _maximum.RequiresApplicationContext;
        public GameplayClampFloatValue(IGameplayFloatValue value, IGameplayFloatValue minimum, IGameplayFloatValue maximum)
        {
            _value = value ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(value));
            _minimum = minimum ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(minimum));
            _maximum = maximum ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(maximum));
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context)
        {
            float minimum = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_minimum, context.Application);
            float maximum = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_maximum, context.Application);
            if (minimum > maximum) throw new ArithmeticException("Clamp minimum exceeds maximum.");
            return Math.Max(minimum, Math.Min(maximum, GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_value, context.Application)));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Reads the actual spendable resource balance, never the modified attribute aggregate.
    /// A resource capability is authoritative; hosts without it use the existing AttributeSet BaseValue.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayResourceFloatValue : IGameplayFloatValue
    {
        public GameplayValueAttributeSource Source {get;}
        public GameplayAttributeId Resource {get;}
        public bool RequiresApplicationContext=>true;
        public GameplayResourceFloatValue(GameplayValueAttributeSource source,GameplayAttributeId resource)
        {
            if(!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(GameplayValueAttributeSource),source))throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(source));
            if(!resource.IsValid)throw new ArgumentException("Resource key is required.",nameof(resource));Source=source;Resource=resource;
        }
        public float Evaluate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context)
        {
            var application=context.RequireApplication();
            var actor=Source==GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target?application.Target:application.InstigatorTarget;
            IGameplayResourceStore store=actor is IGameplayResourceTarget resources?resources.Resources:
                Source==GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target?application.Target.Attributes:application.InstigatorAttributes;
            if(store==null)throw new InvalidOperationException("Resource owner view is unavailable.");
            if(!store.TryGetBalance(Resource,out float balance))throw new KeyNotFoundException("Resource balance is unavailable: "+Resource);
            return balance;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Ability
{
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityCompletionTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Root = new GameplayTag("Ability.Test");
        private static readonly GameplayTag A = new GameplayTag("Ability.Test.A");
        private static readonly GameplayTag B = new GameplayTag("Ability.Test.B");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Other = new GameplayTag("Ability.Other");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Active = new GameplayTag("State.Test.Active");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Stun = new GameplayTag("State.Test.Stun");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Cooldown = new GameplayTag("Cooldown.Test.Ability");

        [Test]
        public void AbilityIdentityRelationsBlockAndCancelInGrantOrderWithoutRefund()
        {
            var setup = new Setup();
            var identity = new[] { A };
            var first = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(abilityTags: identity,
                block: new[] { B }, charge: new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(1, 5f)));
            identity[0] = Other;
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(first), Is.True);
            var blocked = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(abilityTags: new[] { B }));
            var unrelated = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(abilityTags: new[] { Other }));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(blocked).BlockReason,
                Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.BlockedByAbility));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.CanActivate(unrelated), Is.True);
            var cancel = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(cancel: new[] { Root }));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(cancel), Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.IsActive(first), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(first).CurrentCharges, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(blocked).CanActivate, Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(A), Is.False, "Ability identity is not an owner state tag.");
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(first).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.NoCharges));
        }

        [Test]
        public void OngoingStunCancelsAndCleansActivationTagsEffectsAndContext()
        {
            var setup = new Setup();
            var effect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Active });
            var handle = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(owned: new[] { A }, ongoing: new[] { Stun },
                activationEffects: new[] { effect }));
            var context = new GameplayContext(setup.Host.OwnerId,
                new GameplayTargetData(new GameplaySourceId(900)));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle, context), Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(A), Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Active), Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out _), Is.True);
            setup.Host.Tags.AddTag(Stun, setup.Ids.Allocate());
            setup.Abilities.Advance(0f);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(A), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Active), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out _), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void CostStatusCommitFailureAndChargePreserveTransaction()
        {
            var setup = new Setup();
            var cost = new ResourceCost(2);
            var effect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Active });
            var handle = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(owned: new[] { A }, cost: cost,
                charge: new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(2, 3f), activationEffects: new[] { effect }));
            setup.Host.Resource = 1;
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(handle).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cost));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.False);
            setup.Host.Resource = 5;
            setup.Host.RejectPayment = true;
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Resource, Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(handle).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(A) || setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Active), Is.False);
            setup.Host.RejectPayment = false;
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Resource, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(handle).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.End(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(handle).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ActivationEffectRejectionRollsBackEarlierEffectsAndCooldown()
        {
            var setup = new Setup();
            var noStun = new GameplayTagQuery(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { Stun });
            var firstEffect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Active });
            var rejectedEffect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, 0f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), null, noStun);
            var cooldown = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown });
            var handle = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(owned: new[] { A }, cooldown: cooldown,
                activationEffects: new[] { firstEffect, rejectedEffect }));
            setup.Host.Tags.AddTag(Stun, setup.Ids.Allocate());
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(A) || setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Active) ||
                setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Cooldown), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out _), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void FailedCostCommitRemovesCooldownAndActivationEffects()
        {
            var setup = new Setup();
            setup.Host.Resource = 5;
            setup.Host.RejectPayment = true;
            var cooldown = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown });
            var activeEffect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Active });
            var handle = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(owned: new[] { A }, cooldown: cooldown,
                cost: new ResourceCost(2), activationEffects: new[] { activeEffect }));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Resource, Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(A) || setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Active) ||
                setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Cooldown), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void CooldownValidationAndSelfTargetPeriodicContext()
        {
            var setup = new Setup();
            var capture = new CaptureExecution();
            var periodic = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 4f, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { capture });
            var handle = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(activationEffects: new[] { periodic }));
            var source = setup.Ids.Allocate();
            var context = new GameplayContext(setup.Host.OwnerId,
                new GameplayTargetData(new GameplaySourceId(900)), source);
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle, context), Is.True);
            setup.Host.Effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(setup.Host.OwnerId));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(source));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.Remove(handle), Is.True);
            var invalidCooldown = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 4f, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown },
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { capture });
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Definition(cooldown: invalidCooldown));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Definition(activationEffects: new[] {
                new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f, 0f,
                    Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                    new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { capture }) }));
        }

        [Test]
        public void CooldownRejectsNonSimpleEffectsAndContextMismatchFailsBeforeActivation()
        {
            var noStun = new GameplayTagQuery(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { Stun });
            var modifiers = new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(
                new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Ability.Stat"), GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 1f) };
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Definition(cooldown: new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown })));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Definition(cooldown: new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, modifiers, new[] { Cooldown })));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Definition(cooldown: new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown },
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), null, noStun)));
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Test.Cooldown"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 2,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Definition(cooldown: new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown },
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking)));

            var setup = new Setup();
            var handle = setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(cooldown: new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown })));
            var wrong = new GameplayContext(setup.Ids.Allocate(),
                new GameplayTargetData(setup.Host.OwnerId));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle, wrong));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Cooldown), Is.False);
        }

        /// <summary>Prevents irreversible initial execution on rejected/throwing payment and
        /// guards the distinct paid, exactly-once postcommit exception boundary.</summary>
        [TestCase(0)] [TestCase(1)] [TestCase(2)] [TestCase(3)]
        public void InitialExecutionStartsOnlyAfterAtomicPayment(int mode)
        {
            var setup=new Setup();setup.Host.Resource=20;
            var execution=new InitialExecution(setup,mode==3);
            var effect=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,3,1,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),new[]{Active},new IGameplayEffectExecution[]{execution},null,
                periodicStart:GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.ExecuteOnApplication);
            var cooldown=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,5,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),new[]{Cooldown});
            bool useCharge=mode%2==0;
            GameplayAbilityHandle handle=default;
            var cost=new AtomicCost(mode,()=>{
                Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>setup.Abilities.Advance(.5f));
                Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>setup.Host.Effects.Advance(.5f));
                Assert.That(setup.Abilities.Remove(handle),Is.False,"Precommit removal cannot detach the in-flight grant.");
            });
            handle=setup.Abilities.Grant(Definition(owned:new[]{A},cooldown:useCharge?null:cooldown,cost:cost,
                charge:useCharge?new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(2,8):null,activationEffects:new[]{effect}));
            execution.Handle=handle;
            int removals=0;setup.Host.Effects.Removed+=notification=>removals++;
            if(mode==1||mode==3)Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle));
            else Assert.That(setup.Abilities.TryActivate(handle),Is.EqualTo(mode==2));
            bool paid=mode>=2;
            Assert.That(execution.Calls,Is.EqualTo(paid?1:0));
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Resource,Is.EqualTo(paid?5:20));
            Assert.That(setup.Abilities.IsActive(handle),Is.EqualTo(paid));
            if(useCharge)Assert.That(setup.Abilities.GetStatus(handle).CurrentCharges,Is.EqualTo(paid?1:2));
            Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Cooldown),Is.EqualTo(paid&&!useCharge));
            Assert.That(removals,Is.Zero,"Unpublished failed contributions must not emit Removed events.");
            if(paid){Assert.That(execution.Reentered,Is.False);setup.Abilities.Cancel(handle);Assert.That(setup.Host.Tags.HasTag(Active),Is.False);}
            else Assert.That(setup.Host.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Count,Is.Zero);
        }
        private sealed class AtomicCost:IGameplayAbilityCost
        {
            private readonly int _mode;private readonly Action _before;
            internal AtomicCost(int mode,Action before){_mode=mode;_before=before;}
            public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host)=>((Host)host).Resource>=20;
            public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host){_before();if(_mode==1)throw new InvalidOperationException("Payment rejected");if(_mode==0)return false;((Host)host).Resource-=5;return true;}
        }
        private sealed class InitialExecution:IGameplayEffectExecution
        {
            private readonly Setup _setup;private readonly bool _throws;
            internal int Calls;internal bool Reentered;internal GameplayAbilityHandle Handle;
            internal InitialExecution(Setup setup,bool throws){_setup=setup;_throws=throws;}
            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application){Calls++;Reentered=_setup.Abilities.TryActivate(Handle);_setup.Host.Resource-=10;if(_throws)throw new InvalidOperationException("Committed initial execution");}
        }
        private static GameplayAbilityDefinition Definition(GameplayTag[] abilityTags = null,
            GameplayTag[] owned = null, GameplayTag[] cancel = null, GameplayTag[] block = null,
            GameplayTag[] ongoing = null, GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition charge = null,
            GameplayEffectDefinition cooldown = null, IGameplayAbilityCost cost = null,
            GameplayEffectDefinition[] activationEffects = null) =>
            new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                owned ?? Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), cooldown, charge, abilityTags: abilityTags,
                cancelAbilitiesWithTags: cancel, blockAbilitiesWithTags: block,
                ongoingBlockedTags: ongoing, cost: cost, activationEffects: activationEffects);

        private sealed class Setup
        {
            public readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator Ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public readonly Host Host;
            public readonly GameplayAbilityContainer Abilities;
            public Setup()
            {
                Host = new Host(Ids.Allocate(), Ids);
                Abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(Host, Ids);
            }
        }

        private sealed class Host : IGameplayAbilityHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public int Resource;
            public bool RejectPayment;
            public Host(GameplaySourceId id, GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids)
            { OwnerId = id; Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, ids, Tags); }
        }

        private sealed class ResourceCost : IGameplayAbilityCost
        {
            private readonly int _amount;
            public ResourceCost(int amount) { _amount = amount; }
            public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host) => ((Host)host).Resource >= _amount;
            public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host)
            {
                var typed = (Host)host;
                if (typed.RejectPayment || typed.Resource < _amount) return false;
                typed.Resource -= _amount;
                return true;
            }
        }

        private sealed class CaptureExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
        {
            public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Last;
            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application) { Last = application; }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Ability
{
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityContainerTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Owned = new GameplayTag("State.Casting");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Cooldown = new GameplayTag("Cooldown.Test");

        private static GameplayAbilityContainer CreateAbilities(GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids,
            AttributeSet attributes, GameplayTagContainer tags, GameplayEffectContainer effects) =>
            new GameplayAbilityContainer(new TestHost(ids.Allocate(), attributes, tags, effects), ids);

        private sealed class TestHost : IGameplayAbilityHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; }
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }

            public TestHost(GameplaySourceId ownerId, AttributeSet attributes,
                GameplayTagContainer tags, GameplayEffectContainer effects)
            { OwnerId = ownerId; Attributes = attributes; Tags = tags; Effects = effects; }
        }

        // A presentation query must not execute affordability/user callbacks for any grant.
        [Test]
        public void LevelQueryReadsOnlyItsGrantAndRejectsRemovedOrForeignHandles()
        {
            var ids=new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();var attributes=new AttributeSet();var tags=new GameplayTagContainer();
            var effects=new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes,ids,tags);
            var abilities=CreateAbilities(ids,attributes,tags,effects);
            var foreign=CreateAbilities(ids,attributes,tags,effects);
            var definition=new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),cost:new QueryForbiddenCost(),maxLevel:5);
            var handle=abilities.Grant(definition);var other=foreign.Grant(definition);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetLevel(handle,out var level),Is.True);Assert.That(level,Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(abilities.TrySetLevel(handle,5),Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetLevel(handle,out level),Is.True);Assert.That(level,Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetLevel(other,out level),Is.False);Assert.That(level,Is.Zero);
            abilities.Remove(handle);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetLevel(handle,out level),Is.False);Assert.That(level,Is.Zero);
        }
        private sealed class QueryForbiddenCost:IGameplayAbilityCost
        {
            public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host)=>throw new InvalidOperationException("Level reads cannot evaluate cost.");
            public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host)=>throw new InvalidOperationException("Level reads cannot commit cost.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void RequiredAndBlockedTags_UseHierarchicalQueriesAndDefinitionCopies()
        {
            var sources = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, sources, tags);
            var abilities = CreateAbilities(sources, attributes, tags, effects);
            var required = new[] { new GameplayTag("State.Ready"), new GameplayTag("Equipment") };
            var blocked = new[] { new GameplayTag("State.Control"), new GameplayTag("State.Dead") };
            var definition = new GameplayAbilityDefinition(required, blocked, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>());
            required[0] = new GameplayTag("Changed.Required");
            blocked[0] = new GameplayTag("Changed.Blocked");
            var handle = abilities.Grant(definition);
            var stateSource = sources.Allocate();
            tags.AddTag(new GameplayTag("State.Ready.Combat"), stateSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.False, "Required必须全部满足。");
            tags.AddTag(new GameplayTag("Equipment.Weapon"), stateSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.True);
            var stunSource = sources.Allocate();
            tags.AddTag(new GameplayTag("State.Control.Stun"), stunSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.False);
            tags.RemoveTagsFromSource(stunSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.False, "Active不能再次激活。");
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out float remaining), Is.False,
                "未配置冷却的Ability成功激活后也没有自身冷却Handle。");
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ActivationOwnedTags_EndCancelAndFailedCooldownCleanOnlyTheirSource()
        {
            var sources = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, sources, tags);
            var abilities = CreateAbilities(sources, attributes, tags, effects);
            var external = sources.Allocate();
            tags.AddTag(Owned, external);
            var ownedInput = new[] { Owned };
            var definition = new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), ownedInput);
            ownedInput[0] = new GameplayTag("Changed.Owned");
            var handle = abilities.Grant(definition);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.End(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.True, "外部来源仍贡献同名标签。");
            tags.RemoveTagsFromSource(external);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.Cancel(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.End(handle), Is.False);

            // 故意漏绑Effect目标Tags，触发真实Apply失败，验证激活的失败一致性。
            var unboundAttributes = new AttributeSet();
            var unboundEffects = new GameplayEffectContainer(unboundAttributes, sources);
            var failing = CreateAbilities(sources, unboundAttributes, tags, unboundEffects);
            var failingHandle = failing.Grant(DefinitionWithCooldown());
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => failing.TryActivate(failingHandle));
            Assert.That(failing.IsActive(failingHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.False);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Cooldown), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void CooldownIsOwnedByEffects_AndSurvivesEndCancelAndGrantRemoval()
        {
            var sources = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, sources, tags);
            var abilities = CreateAbilities(sources, attributes, tags, effects);
            var handle = abilities.Grant(DefinitionWithCooldown());
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(default(GameplayAbilityHandle), out float remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(5f));
            Assert.That(abilities.End(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(5f));
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.False);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Cooldown), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.True,
                "失败激活不能覆盖最近一次成功启动的冷却Handle。");
            effects.Advance(4f);
            Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(1f));
            effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.Cancel(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Cooldown), Is.True);
            effects.Advance(5f);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.Remove(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(handle, out remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(abilities.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Owned), Is.False);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Cooldown), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.False);
            effects.Advance(5f);
            Assert.That(tags.HasTagExact(Cooldown), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SameDefinitionGrants_HaveIndependentHandlesAndActivationSources()
        {

        [Test]
        public void ChargeConsumesOnlySuccessfulActivationsAndPreservesSequentialOverflow()
        {
            var sources = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, sources, tags);
            var abilities = CreateAbilities(sources, attributes, tags, effects);
            var charge = new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(3, 2f);
            var definition = new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new[] { new GameplayTag("State.Control") }, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), charge: charge);
            var first = abilities.Grant(definition);
            var second = abilities.Grant(definition);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).CanActivate, Is.True);
            var stunSource = sources.Allocate();
            tags.AddTag(new GameplayTag("State.Control.Stun"), stunSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(first), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.BlockedByTag));
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(3));
            tags.RemoveTagsFromSource(stunSource);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            {
                Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(first), Is.True);
                Assert.That(abilities.End(first), Is.True);
                if (i == 0) abilities.Advance(.5f);
            }
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.NoCharges));
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(first), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(second).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(3), "Each grant owns its charge state.");
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).RechargeRemaining, Is.EqualTo(1.5f));
            abilities.Advance(5.5f);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).RechargeRemaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(abilities.Remove(first), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(first).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.InvalidHandle));
        }

            var sources = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, sources, tags);
            var abilities = CreateAbilities(sources, attributes, tags, effects);
            var handle = abilities.Grant(DefinitionWithCooldown());
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            abilities.End(handle);
            abilities.Advance(10f);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(handle).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cooldown));
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(handle).CooldownRemaining, Is.EqualTo(5f));
            effects.Advance(5f);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(handle).CanActivate, Is.True);
        }

        private static GameplayAbilityDefinition DefinitionWithCooldown()
        {
            var cooldown = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Cooldown });
            return new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { Owned }, cooldown);
        }
    }
}
````
