````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections;
using System.Reflection;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Ability
{
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityEffectOwnershipTests
    {
        private sealed class Setup : IGameplayAbilityHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public GameplayAbilityContainer Abilities { get; }
            public readonly GameplayAbilityHandle Ability;
            public Setup(GameplayEffectDefinition cooldown = null)
            {
                var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
                OwnerId = ids.Allocate();
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, ids, Tags);
                Abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(this, ids);
                Ability = Abilities.Grant(Definition(cooldown));
                Assert.That(Abilities.TryActivate(Ability), Is.True);
            }
            public GameplayEffectApplicationResult Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition effect = null) =>
                Effects.Apply(effect ?? Effect(), new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(
                    new GameplayContext(OwnerId, new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId)), this,
                    GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
        }

        private static GameplayAbilityDefinition Definition(GameplayEffectDefinition cooldown = null) =>
            new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), cooldown);

        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy policy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite,
            GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stacking = null, GameplayTagQuery application = null, GameplayTagQuery ongoing = null) =>
            new GameplayEffectDefinition(policy, 1f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking, application, ongoing);

        // Test-only inspection of cleanup relations avoids adding a public mutable list or debugger API.
        private static int OwnedCount(Setup s)
        {
            var entries = (IDictionary)typeof(GameplayAbilityContainer).GetField("_entries",
                BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).GetValue(s.Abilities);
            var entry = entries[s.Ability];
            return ((ICollection)entry.GetType().GetField("OwnedEffectHandles",
                BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic).GetValue(entry)).Count;
        }

        [TestCase("End")][TestCase("Cancel")][TestCase("Remove")]
        public void DynamicNewEffectIsRemovedByEveryAbilityFinishPath(string finish)
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var result = s.Apply();
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.True);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.EqualTo(1));
            bool done = finish == "End" ? s.Abilities.End(s.Ability) :
                finish == "Cancel" ? s.Abilities.Cancel(s.Ability) : s.Abilities.Remove(s.Ability);
            Assert.That(done, Is.True);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
        }

        [TestCase("Expire")][TestCase("Remove")][TestCase("Ongoing")]
        public void EarlierEffectRemovalLeavesSafeStaleRelation(string removal)
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var blocked = new GameplayTag("State.Blocked");
            var query = new GameplayTagQuery(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { blocked });
            var result = s.Apply(Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, ongoing: query));
            s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result);
            if (removal == "Remove") s.Effects.Remove(result.ActiveHandle);
            else if (removal == "Expire") s.Effects.Advance(1f);
            else { s.Tags.AddTag(blocked, s.OwnerId); s.Effects.Advance(0f); }
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.End(s.Ability), Is.True);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void InactiveRemovedInvalidAndForeignGrantsCannotOwnEffects()
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var other = new Setup(); var result = s.Apply();
            var inactive = s.Abilities.Grant(Definition());
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(inactive, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(other.Ability, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(default, result), Is.False);
            s.Abilities.Remove(inactive);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(inactive, result), Is.False);
            s.Abilities.End(s.Ability);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.True);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ForeignDefaultAndStaleEffectsCannotBeRegistered()
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var foreign = new Setup(); var result = s.Apply();
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, foreign.Apply()), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, default), Is.False);
            s.Effects.Remove(result.ActiveHandle);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DuplicateIsIdempotentAndAnotherGrantCannotTakeSameResult()
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var result = s.Apply();
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.True);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.True);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.EqualTo(1));
            var other = s.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); s.Abilities.TryActivate(other);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(other, result), Is.False);
            s.Abilities.End(other);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.True);
            s.Abilities.End(s.Ability);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
        }

        [TestCase(2, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit, GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.StackIncreased)]
        [TestCase(1, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit, GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RefreshedAtLimit)]
        [TestCase(1, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject, GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedAtLimit)]
        public void MergedOrRejectedStackCannotBeStolen(int limit, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy overflow,
            GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome expected)
        {
            var s = new Setup();
            var stack = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Shared"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, limit,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication, overflow);
            var definition = Effect(stacking: stack); var existing = s.Apply(definition); var result = s.Apply(definition);
            Assert.That(result.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(expected));
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.Zero);
            s.Abilities.End(s.Ability);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(existing.ActiveHandle), Is.True);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RequirementsRejectionCannotMutateOwnership()
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var query = new GameplayTagQuery(new[] { new GameplayTag("State.Missing") },
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>());
            var result = s.Apply(Effect(application: query));
            Assert.That(result.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedByRequirements));
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result), Is.False);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void NormalCooldownRemainsIndependentOfDynamicCleanup()
        {
            var cooldown = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { new GameplayTag("Cooldown.Test") });
            var s = new Setup(cooldown); var result = s.Apply();
            s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, result); s.Abilities.End(s.Ability);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryGetCooldownRemaining(s.Ability, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(5f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RepeatedReplacementCompactsStaleRelationsAndKeepsOtherLiveEffects()
        {
            var s = new Setup(); var persistent = s.Apply(); s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, persistent);
            for (int i = 0; i < 256; i++)
            {
                var next = s.Apply(); Assert.That(s.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(s.Ability, next), Is.True);
                Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.EqualTo(2));
                s.Effects.Remove(next.ActiveHandle);
            }
            s.Abilities.End(s.Ability);
            Assert.That(s.Effects.IsActive(persistent.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(OwnedCount(s), Is.Zero);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Ability
{
    /// <summary>Guards clock edits, no-spend preparation and exclusive cleanup; visible skill behavior lives in the Lab.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayAbilityLifecycleTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag CdTag = new GameplayTag("Cooldown.Test.Lifecycle");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Block = new GameplayTag("State.Test.Interrupted");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Identity = new GameplayTag("Ability.Test.Scope");
        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Effect(float duration = 8, GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stack = null) =>
            new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, duration, 0,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { CdTag }, Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stack);
        private static GameplayAbilityDefinition Definition(GameplayEffectDefinition cd = null, GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition charge = null, IGameplayAbilityCost cost = null) =>
            new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { Block }, new[] { Identity }, cd, charge,
                abilityTags: new[] { Identity }, ongoingBlockedTags: new[] { Block }, cost: cost);
        private sealed class Host : IGameplayAbilityHost, IGameplaySkillHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public GameplayAbilityContainer Abilities { get; }
            public GameplaySourceIdAllocator Ids { get; } = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public int Resource = 10;
            public Host() { OwnerId = Ids.Allocate(); Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, Ids, Tags); Abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(this, Ids); }
            public GameplayContext Context => new GameplayContext(OwnerId, new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId));
            public GameplayEffectApplicationResult Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition definition) => Effects.Apply(definition,
                new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(Context, this, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
        }
        private sealed class Cost : IGameplayAbilityCost
        {
            public bool Reject;
            public int Commits;
            public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host) => ((Host)host).Resource >= 2;
            public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host)
            { if (Reject || !CanPay(host)) return false; ((Host)host).Resource -= 2; Commits++; return true; }
        }
        private sealed class Lifetime : IDisposable
        {
            public int Calls;
            public Action Cleanup;
            public void Dispose() { Calls++; Cleanup?.Invoke(); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void CooldownEditsOnlyOwnEffectAndUsesEffectClock()
        {
            var h = new Host(); var definition = Effect(); var a = h.Abilities.Grant(Definition(cd: definition));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryActivate(a), Is.True); h.Abilities.End(a);
            var external = h.Effects.Apply(definition); h.Effects.Advance(1);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(a, -2), Is.True);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CooldownRemaining, Is.EqualTo(5));
            h.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(external, out float other); Assert.That(other, Is.EqualTo(7));
            h.Abilities.TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(a, 6); Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CooldownRemaining, Is.EqualTo(11));
            h.Abilities.TrySetCooldownRemaining(a, 3); h.Effects.Advance(3);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CooldownRemaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cooldown));
            h.Abilities.TryResetCooldown(a); Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CooldownRemaining, Is.EqualTo(8));
            h.Abilities.TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(a, -20); Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CooldownRemaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(h.Effects.IsActive(external), Is.True);
            Assert.That(h.Effects.LastRemoval.Cause, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Explicit));
            h.Effects.Remove(external); h.Abilities.TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(a, 2); h.Effects.Advance(2);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.CanActivate(a), Is.True);
            var keyed=new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(new GameplayTag("Data.Test.CD"));
            var dynamicCooldown=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,1,0,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),new[]{CdTag},Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(),null,
                durationValue:new GameplayBinaryFloatValue(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Add,new GameplayAbilityLevelFloatValue(),keyed));
            var dynamicDefinition=new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),dynamicCooldown,maxLevel:10);
            var b=h.Abilities.Grant(dynamicDefinition,5);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryResetCooldown(b),Is.False,"Value-driven restart requires a previous successful cast capture.");
            var input=h.Context.WithValues(GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(new GameplayTag("Data.Test.CD"),2));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryActivate(b,input),Is.True);h.Abilities.End(b);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(b).CooldownDuration,Is.EqualTo(7));
            h.Effects.Advance(7);h.Abilities.TrySetLevel(b,10);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryResetCooldown(b),Is.True);Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(b).CooldownRemaining,Is.EqualTo(7),"Restart preserves last cast timing, never re-evaluates against a later grant level.");
            h.Abilities.TrySetCooldownRemaining(b,0);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryActivate(b,input),Is.True);h.Abilities.End(b);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(b).CooldownDuration,Is.EqualTo(12));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryAdjustCooldownRemaining(b,-3),Is.True);Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(b).CooldownRemaining,Is.EqualTo(9));
        }
        [Test]
        public void ChargeEditsPreservePhaseAndFullClearsSchedule()
        {
            var h = new Host(); var a = h.Abilities.Grant(Definition(charge: new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(3,3)));
            h.Abilities.TrySetCharges(a, 0); h.Abilities.Advance(1);
            h.Abilities.TryAdjustCharges(a, 1); Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).RechargeRemaining, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryAdjustCharges(a, 3), Is.False);
            h.Abilities.TryAdjustCharges(a, -1); h.Abilities.Advance(2);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(1));
            h.Abilities.TrySetCharges(a, 3); h.Abilities.Advance(20); h.Abilities.TryAdjustCharges(a, -1);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).RechargeRemaining, Is.EqualTo(3));
            for (int i=0; i<90; i++) h.Abilities.Advance(1f/30);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(3));
        }
        [Test]
        public void PreparingCancelDoesNotSpendAndCommitIsOnce()
        {
            var h=new Host(); var cost=new Cost(); var a=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition(charge:new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(3,3),cost:cost));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryBeginActivation(a,h.Context),Is.True);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.IsActive(a),Is.False); Assert.That(h.Tags.HasTag(Identity),Is.False);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CurrentCharges,Is.EqualTo(3)); Assert.That(h.Resource,Is.EqualTo(10));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.End(a),Is.False); h.Abilities.Cancel(a);
            Assert.That(h.Resource,Is.EqualTo(10));
            var context=h.Context; h.Abilities.TryBeginActivation(a,context);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryCommitActivation(a),Is.True); Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryCommitActivation(a),Is.False);
            Assert.That(cost.Commits,Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(h.Resource,Is.EqualTo(8));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetStatus(a).CurrentCharges,Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].ActiveContext,Is.SameAs(context));
        }
        [TestCase("CostGate")][TestCase("BlockTag")][TestCase("Payment")]
        public void CommitRejectionCleansPreparationWithoutPaymentResidue(string failure)
        {
            var h=new Host(); var cost=new Cost(); var a=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition(cd:Effect(),cost:cost));
            h.Abilities.TryBeginActivation(a,h.Context); var child=new Lifetime(); h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,child);
            if(failure=="CostGate") h.Resource=0; else if(failure=="BlockTag") h.Tags.AddTag(Block,h.OwnerId); else cost.Reject=true;
            int resource=h.Resource;
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryCommitActivation(a),Is.False); Assert.That(h.Resource,Is.EqualTo(resource));
            Assert.That(cost.Commits,Is.Zero); Assert.That(h.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(),Is.Empty);
            Assert.That(h.Tags.HasTag(Identity),Is.False); Assert.That(child.Calls,Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.LastTermination.Reason,Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.CommitRejected));
        }
        [TestCase(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Ended)] [TestCase(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Cancelled)]
        [TestCase(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Removed)] [TestCase(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.OngoingBlocked)]
        [TestCase(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.CancelledByAbility)]
        public void TerminalCleanupDetachesAndAttemptsEveryResourceDespiteExceptions(GameplayAbilityTerminationReason reason)
        {
            var h=new Host(); var a=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); h.Abilities.TryActivate(a,h.Context);
            var sibling=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); h.Abilities.TryBeginActivation(sibling);
            var first=new Lifetime { Cleanup=()=> { Assert.That(h.Abilities.IsEngaged(a),Is.False); throw new InvalidOperationException("cleanup"); } };
            var second=new Lifetime(); var released=new Lifetime();
            h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,first); Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,first),Is.True);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(sibling,first),Is.False);
            h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,second); h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,released); h.Abilities.ReleaseOwnedLifetime(a,released);
            int notices=0; h.Abilities.Terminated += o=> { if(o.Handle==a) { notices++; throw new InvalidOperationException("observer"); } };
            h.Abilities.Terminated += o=> { if(o.Handle==a) notices++; };
            Action terminate=()=> { if(reason==GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Ended) h.Abilities.End(a);
                else if(reason==GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Cancelled) h.Abilities.Cancel(a);
                else if(reason==GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.Removed) h.Abilities.Remove(a);
                else if(reason==GameplayAbilityTerminationReason.OngoingBlocked) { h.Tags.AddTag(Block,h.OwnerId); h.Abilities.Advance(0); }
                else { var canceller=h.Abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),cancelAbilitiesWithTags:new[]{Identity})); h.Abilities.TryActivate(canceller); } };
            Assert.Throws<AggregateException>(()=>terminate()); Assert.That(first.Calls,Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(second.Calls,Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(released.Calls,Is.Zero); Assert.That(notices,Is.EqualTo(2)); Assert.That(h.Tags.HasTag(Identity),Is.False);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.LastTermination.Reason,Is.EqualTo(reason)); Assert.That(h.Abilities.Cancel(a),Is.False);
        }
        [Test]
        public void ScopeOwnsSkillSubscriptionAndSequenceLeaseWithoutPolling()
        {
            var h=new Host(); var a=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); h.Abilities.TryActivate(a);
            var events=new GameplayEventDispatcher(); var hit=new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"); var cues=new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            var skill=new GameplaySkillRuntime(new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(hit),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),
                new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),new IGameplaySkillAction[]{new GameplaySkillApplyEffectAction(new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite,0,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>()))},false),h,events);
            var sequences=new GameplaySequenceContainer(); var definition=new GameplaySequenceDefinition(3,new[]{new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(2,hit)});
            var sequence=sequences.Start(definition,h.Context,h); var lease=sequences.CreateCancellationLease(sequence);
            h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,skill); h.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(a,lease);
            events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(hit,h.OwnerId,h.OwnerId,0)); Assert.That(skill.ActivationCount,Is.EqualTo(1));
            h.Abilities.Cancel(a); lease.Dispose(); events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(hit,h.OwnerId,h.OwnerId,0));
            sequences.Advance(3); sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(skill.IsDisposed,Is.True); Assert.That(skill.ActivationCount,Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(cues,Is.Empty);
            var completed=sequences.Start(definition,h.Context,h); sequences.Advance(3); sequences.CreateCancellationLease(completed).Dispose();
            Assert.That(sequences.ActiveCount,Is.Zero);
        }
        [Test]
        public void MergedLayersHaveExclusiveGrantOwnershipAndCleanupPreservesOtherContribution()
        {
            var h=new Host(); var a=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); var b=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); h.Abilities.TryActivate(a); h.Abilities.TryActivate(b);
            var stack=new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Stack.Test.Owned"),GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject);
            var definition=Effect(20,stack); var first=h.Apply(definition); var second=h.Apply(definition);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffectLayer(a,first),Is.True); Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffectLayer(a,first),Is.True);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffectLayer(b,first),Is.False); Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(b,first),Is.False);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffectLayer(b,second),Is.True);
            h.Abilities.Cancel(a); h.Effects.TryGetStackCount(second.ActiveHandle,out int count); Assert.That(count,Is.EqualTo(1));
            h.Abilities.Remove(b); Assert.That(h.Effects.IsActive(second.ActiveHandle),Is.False);
            Assert.That(h.Effects.LastRemoval.Cause,Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OwnerCleanup));
            h.Abilities.TryActivate(a); var whole=h.Apply(definition); Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffect(a,whole),Is.True);
            var c=h.Abilities.Grant(Definition()); h.Abilities.TryActivate(c); var merged=h.Apply(definition);
            Assert.That(h.Abilities.TryOwnEffectLayer(c,merged),Is.False); h.Abilities.Cancel(a);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Ability
{
    public sealed class GameplayContextTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void PointTargetAndEffectiveSourceFlowIntoDamage()
        {
            var instigator = new GameplaySourceId(11);
            var target = new GameplaySourceId(22);
            var data = new GameplayTargetData(target, new GameplayPoint(12f, -3f));
            var context = new GameplayContext(instigator, data);
            var damage = new DamageContext(context, 7f, new AttributeSet());

            Assert.That(context.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(instigator));
            Assert.That(data.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(target));
            Assert.That(data.HasPoint, Is.True);
            Assert.That(data.Point.X, Is.EqualTo(12f));
            Assert.That(damage.GameplayContext, Is.SameAs(context));
            Assert.That(damage.SourceId, Is.EqualTo(context.EffectiveSourceId));
            var sourced = new GameplayContext(instigator, data, new GameplaySourceId(33));
            Assert.That(sourced.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(new GameplaySourceId(33)));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AbilityRetainsOnlyActiveSuccessfulContext()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, ids, tags);
            var owner = ids.Allocate();
            var abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(new TestAbilityHost(owner, attributes, tags, effects), ids);
            var block = new GameplayTag("State.Control.Stun");
            var handle = abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new[] { block }, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
            var context = new GameplayContext(owner, new GameplayTargetData(default));
            var blockSource = ids.Allocate();
            tags.AddTag(block, blockSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle, context), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out _), Is.False);
            tags.RemoveTagsFromSource(blockSource);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle, context), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out GameplayContext active), Is.True);
            Assert.That(active, Is.SameAs(context));
            Assert.That(abilities.End(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle, context), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.Cancel(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle, context), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.Remove(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryGetActiveContext(handle, out _), Is.False);
        }

        private sealed class TestAbilityHost : IGameplayAbilityHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; }
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public TestAbilityHost(GameplaySourceId owner, AttributeSet attributes,
                GameplayTagContainer tags, GameplayEffectContainer effects)
            { OwnerId = owner; Attributes = attributes; Tags = tags; Effects = effects; }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Ability
{
    /// <summary>Guards level/source snapshots, exact formula/charge boundaries and atomic resource payment.
    /// Visual skill behavior belongs to the permanent Skill Lab rather than a test per acceptance bullet.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayProductizedValueTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Mana = new GameplayAttributeId("Mana");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Energy = new GameplayAttributeId("Energy");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Attack");

        [Test]
        public void GrantLevelAndChildSnapshotsRemainIndependentAcrossUpgrade()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var host = new Host(ids);
            var abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(host, ids);
            var definition = new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), maxLevel: 10);
            var first = abilities.Grant(definition, 5); var second = abilities.Grant(definition, 1);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(first), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TrySetLevel(first, 10), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryCreateExecutionContext(first, new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId), out var cast), Is.True);
            var child = cast.WithSource(ids.Allocate()).WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId))
                .WithValues(GameplayContextValues.Empty);
            Assert.That(child.AbilityLevel, Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(abilities.End(first), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.TrySetLevel(first, 10), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].Level, Is.EqualTo(10));
            Assert.That(abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[1].Level, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(cast.AbilityLevel, Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(abilities.TrySetLevel(second, 11), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void FormulaUsesCapturedLevelLiveAttributesAndFailsClosed()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var host = new Host(ids);
            var expression = GameplayFormula.Compile("Caster.Attack * (1.45 + Level * 0.15)");
            var levels = new[] { 1, 5, 10 }; var expected = new[] { 160f, 220f, 295f };
            for (int i = 0; i < levels.Length; i++)
            {
                var context = new GameplayContext(host.OwnerId, new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId), abilityLevel: levels[i]);
                var application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context, host, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);
                Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(expression, application), Is.EqualTo(expected[i]).Within(.001f));
            }
            var cast = new GameplayContext(host.OwnerId, new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId), abilityLevel: 5);
            var capture = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(cast, host, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);
            float snapshotted = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(expression, capture);
            host.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Attack, 200);
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(expression, capture), Is.EqualTo(440).Within(.001f));
            Assert.That(snapshotted, Is.EqualTo(220).Within(.001f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(GameplayFormula.Compile("clamp(max(Level, 2), 1, 4)"), capture), Is.EqualTo(4));
            var source = new[] { 1.6f, 2.2f }; var table = new GameplayLevelTableFloatValue(source); source[1] = 99;
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(table, capture), Is.EqualTo(2.2f));
            Assert.Throws<FormatException>(() => GameplayFormula.Compile("Caster.Attack / 0"));
            Assert.Throws<FormatException>(() => GameplayFormula.Compile("Unknown + 1"));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(GameplayFormula.Compile("Caster.Missing"), capture));
            var modifier=host.Attributes.GetAttribute(Mana).AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add,50,ids.Allocate()));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(GameplayFormula.Compile("Caster.Mana"),capture),Is.EqualTo(150));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(GameplayFormula.Compile("Resource.Mana + TargetResource.Mana"),capture),Is.EqualTo(200),"Spendable formulas must not include the live modifier aggregate.");
            host.Attributes.GetAttribute(Mana).RemoveModifier(modifier);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ResourcePaymentAndChargeCommitAreAtomicAndDoNotRestartRecharge()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var host = new Host(ids);
            host.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Energy, 0);
            var rejected = new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[] {
                new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(Mana, new GameplayConstantFloatValue(-20)),
                new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(Energy, new GameplayConstantFloatValue(-1)) });
            Assert.That(rejected.TryCommit(host, 1), Is.False);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Mana), Is.EqualTo(100));
            var payment = new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[] {
                new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(Mana, GameplayFormula.Compile("-4 * Level")) });
            var abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(host, ids);
            var definition = new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), charge: new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(2, 8), cost: payment, maxLevel: 10);
            var grant = abilities.Grant(definition, 5);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(grant), Is.True); abilities.End(grant);
            abilities.Advance(3);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(grant), Is.True); abilities.End(grant);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(grant), Is.False);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Mana), Is.EqualTo(60));
            var contextPayment=new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[]{new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(Mana,GameplayFormula.Compile("-Caller.Cost.Amount * Context.Cost.Factor"))});
            var contextGrant=abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),cost:contextPayment));
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(contextGrant).BlockReason,Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cost),"Missing captured inputs fail eligibility without paying.");
            var amountKey=new GameplayTag("Cost.Amount");
            var inputs=GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(amountKey,12).WithValue(new GameplayTag("Cost.Factor"),2);
            var request=new GameplayContext(host.OwnerId,new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId),values:inputs);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryBeginActivation(contextGrant,request),Is.True);
            host.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Mana,10);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryCommitActivation(contextGrant),Is.False);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Mana),Is.EqualTo(10));
            host.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Mana,60);
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(contextGrant,request),Is.True);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Mana),Is.EqualTo(36));
            Assert.That(abilities.TryCreateExecutionContext(contextGrant,new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId),out var captured),Is.True);
            Assert.That(captured.Values.GetRequiredValue(amountKey),Is.EqualTo(12));
            abilities.End(contextGrant);
            host.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Mana,60); // Resume the original charge/recharge boundary below.
            abilities.Advance(5);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(grant).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(grant), Is.True); abilities.End(grant);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Mana), Is.EqualTo(40));
            var refund = new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[] { new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(Mana, new GameplayConstantFloatValue(20)) });
            Assert.That(refund.TryCommit(host), Is.True);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Mana), Is.EqualTo(60));
        }

        private sealed class Host : IGameplayAbilityHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public Host(GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids)
            {
                OwnerId = ids.Allocate();
                Attributes.Register(Mana, 100); Attributes.Register(Energy, 100); Attributes.Register(Attack, 100);
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, ids, Tags);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Attribute
{
    public sealed class AttributeSetTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Defense = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Defense");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Unknown = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Unknown");

        [Test]
        public void Register_QueryAndSetBaseValue_UseTheRegisteredAttribute()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();
            GameplayAttribute registered = set.Register(Attack, 10f);

            Assert.That(set.Contains(Attack), Is.True);
            Assert.That(set.Contains(Unknown), Is.False);
            Assert.That(set.GetAttribute(Attack), Is.SameAs(registered));
            Assert.That(set.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));

            set.SetBaseValue(Attack, -5f);

            Assert.That(registered.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(-5f));
            Assert.That(set.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(-5f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Register_DuplicateIdThrowsWithoutOverwritingTheOriginal()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();
            GameplayAttribute original = set.Register(Attack, 10f);

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.Register(Attack, 99f));

            Assert.That(set.GetAttribute(Attack), Is.SameAs(original));
            Assert.That(set.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void UnknownValidId_HasExplicitQueryAndMutationBehavior()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();

            Assert.That(set.Contains(Unknown), Is.False);
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => set.GetAttribute(Unknown));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => set.GetCurrentValue(Unknown));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => set.SetBaseValue(Unknown, 1f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void InvalidId_IsRejectedByEveryAttributeSetEntryPoint()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();
            GameplayAttributeId invalid = default;

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.Register(invalid, 1f));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.Contains(invalid));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.GetAttribute(invalid));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.GetCurrentValue(invalid));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.SetBaseValue(invalid, 1f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RegisterAndSetBaseValue_RejectNonFiniteValuesTransactionally()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => set.Register(Attack, float.NaN));
            Assert.That(set.Contains(Attack), Is.False);

            set.Register(Attack, 4f);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => set.SetBaseValue(Attack, float.NegativeInfinity));

            Assert.That(set.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(4f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveModifiersFromSource_RemovesMatchesAcrossAllAttributes()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();
            GameplayAttribute attack = set.Register(Attack, 10f);
            GameplayAttribute defense = set.Register(Defense, 20f);
            var removedSource = new GameplaySourceId(10);
            var retainedSource = new GameplaySourceId(20);

            attack.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f, removedSource));
            attack.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 2f, retainedSource));
            defense.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 3f, removedSource));
            defense.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 0.5f, removedSource));

            int removed = set.RemoveModifiersFromSource(removedSource);

            Assert.That(removed, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(set.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(20f));
            Assert.That(set.GetCurrentValue(Defense), Is.EqualTo(20f));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => set.RemoveModifiersFromSource(default));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveModifiersFromSource_WhenOneAttributeOverflows_LeavesEveryAttributeUnchanged()
        {
            var set = new AttributeSet();
            var removedSource = new GameplaySourceId(10);
            var retainedSource = new GameplaySourceId(20);

            GameplayAttribute normal = set.Register(Attack, 10f);
            normal.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(
                GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f, removedSource));

            GameplayAttribute overflowing = set.Register(Defense, float.MaxValue);
            overflowing.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(
                GameplayModifierOperation.Add, -float.MaxValue / 2f, removedSource));
            GameplayModifierHandle multiplier = overflowing.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(
                GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 2f, retainedSource));
            float overflowingValueBefore = overflowing.CurrentValue;

            Assert.Throws<OverflowException>(() => set.RemoveModifiersFromSource(removedSource));
            Assert.That(normal.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(12f));
            Assert.That(overflowing.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(overflowingValueBefore));

            Assert.That(overflowing.RemoveModifier(multiplier), Is.True);
            Assert.That(set.RemoveModifiersFromSource(removedSource), Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(normal.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(overflowing.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Attribute
{
    public sealed class GameplayAttributeTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplaySourceId SourceA = new GameplaySourceId(1);
        private static readonly GameplaySourceId SourceB = new GameplaySourceId(2);

        [Test]
        public void ConstructorAndSetBaseValue_KeepCurrentValueInSync()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(12f);

            Assert.That(attribute.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(12f));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(12f));

            attribute.SetBaseValue(-4f);

            Assert.That(attribute.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(-4f));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(-4f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AddModifiers_AreSummed()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(3f, SourceA));
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(-1f, SourceB));

            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(12f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void MultiplyModifiers_AreMultiplied()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(1.5f, SourceA));
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(0.8f, SourceB));

            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(12f).Within(0.0001f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AddAndMultiply_UseTheFixedAggregationFormula()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(2f, SourceA));
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(5f, SourceB));

            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(30f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void SetBaseValue_RecalculatesWithExistingAddAndMultiplyModifiers()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(5f, SourceA));
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(2f, SourceB));

            attribute.SetBaseValue(20f);

            Assert.That(attribute.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(20f));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(50f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void EquivalentModifiers_ProduceTheSameResultRegardlessOfInsertionOrder()
        {
            var first = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            first.AddModifier(Add(16777216f, SourceA));
            first.AddModifier(Add(1f, SourceA));
            first.AddModifier(Add(-16777216f, SourceA));
            first.AddModifier(Multiply(1.25f, SourceB));
            first.AddModifier(Multiply(0.8f, SourceB));

            var second = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            second.AddModifier(Multiply(0.8f, SourceB));
            second.AddModifier(Add(-16777216f, SourceA));
            second.AddModifier(Add(16777216f, SourceA));
            second.AddModifier(Multiply(1.25f, SourceB));
            second.AddModifier(Add(1f, SourceA));

            Assert.That(first.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(11f));
            Assert.That(second.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(first.CurrentValue));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveModifier_RemovesOnlyTheOwnedLiveHandle()
        {
            var first = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            GameplayModifierHandle firstHandle = first.AddModifier(Add(3f, SourceA));
            GameplayModifierHandle retainedHandle = first.AddModifier(Add(7f, SourceB));
            var other = new GameplayAttribute(20f);
            GameplayModifierHandle foreignHandle = other.AddModifier(Add(5f, SourceA));

            Assert.That(first.RemoveModifier(default), Is.False);
            Assert.That(first.RemoveModifier(foreignHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(first.RemoveModifier(firstHandle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(first.RemoveModifier(firstHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(first.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(17f));
            Assert.That(other.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(25f));
            Assert.That(retainedHandle.IsValid, Is.True);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RepeatedModifierAdds_ReturnDistinctHandlesAndRemovedHandlesAreNotReused()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(1f);
            GameplayAttributeModifier modifier = Add(2f, SourceA);

            GameplayModifierHandle first = attribute.AddModifier(modifier);
            GameplayModifierHandle second = attribute.AddModifier(modifier);
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(5f));

            Assert.That(attribute.RemoveModifier(first), Is.True);
            GameplayModifierHandle third = attribute.AddModifier(modifier);

            Assert.That(first, Is.Not.EqualTo(second));
            Assert.That(third, Is.Not.EqualTo(first));
            Assert.That(third, Is.Not.EqualTo(second));
            Assert.That(first != second, Is.True);
            Assert.That(third == default, Is.False);
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(5f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveModifiersFromSource_RemovesOnlyMatchingModifiers()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(10f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(2f, SourceA));
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(3f, SourceA));
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(5f, SourceB));

            int removed = attribute.RemoveModifiersFromSource(SourceA);

            Assert.That(removed, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(15f));
            Assert.That(attribute.RemoveModifiersFromSource(SourceA), Is.Zero);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => attribute.RemoveModifiersFromSource(default));
        }

        [TestCase(0f)]
        [TestCase(-2f)]
        public void Multiply_AllowsZeroAndNegativeMagnitudes(float magnitude)
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(-3f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(magnitude, SourceA));

            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(-3f * magnitude));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ValueObjects_ExposeValidityAndOrdinalIdentity()
        {
            var upper = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
            var same = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
            var lower = new GameplayAttributeId("test.attack");
            var negativeSource = new GameplaySourceId(-7);

            Assert.That(upper.Value, Is.EqualTo("Test.Attack"));
            Assert.That(upper.IsValid, Is.True);
            Assert.That(default(GameplayAttributeId).IsValid, Is.False);
            Assert.That(upper.Equals(same), Is.True);
            Assert.That(upper == same, Is.True);
            Assert.That(upper != lower, Is.True);
            Assert.That(upper.GetHashCode(), Is.EqualTo(same.GetHashCode()));

            Assert.That(negativeSource.Value, Is.EqualTo(-7));
            Assert.That(negativeSource.IsValid, Is.True);
            Assert.That(default(GameplaySourceId).IsValid, Is.False);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplaySourceId(0));
        }

        [TestCase(null)]
        [TestCase("")]
        [TestCase("   ")]
        public void AttributeId_RejectsMissingValues(string value)
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayAttributeId(value));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Modifier_ExposesItsValuesAndRejectsInvalidConstruction()
        {
            var modifier = new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, -2f, SourceA);

            Assert.That(modifier.Operation, Is.EqualTo(GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply));
            Assert.That(modifier.Magnitude, Is.EqualTo(-2f));
            Assert.That(modifier.SourceId.Value, Is.EqualTo(SourceA.Value));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
                new GameplayAttributeModifier((GameplayModifierOperation)99, 1f, SourceA));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
                new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, float.NaN, SourceA));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
                new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, float.PositiveInfinity, SourceA));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() =>
                new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 1f, default));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Attribute_RejectsNonFiniteValuesAndDefaultModifier()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayAttribute(float.NaN));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayAttribute(float.NegativeInfinity));

            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(1f);

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => attribute.SetBaseValue(float.PositiveInfinity));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => attribute.AddModifier(default));
            Assert.That(attribute.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(1f));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(1f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void AddModifier_WhenResultOverflows_IsTransactional()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(float.MaxValue);

            Assert.Throws<OverflowException>(() => attribute.AddModifier(Add(float.MaxValue, SourceA)));

            Assert.That(attribute.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue));

            GameplayModifierHandle handle = attribute.AddModifier(Add(-float.MaxValue, SourceA));
            Assert.That(handle.IsValid, Is.True);
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SetBaseValue_WhenResultOverflows_IsTransactional()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(1f);
            attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(float.MaxValue, SourceA));

            Assert.Throws<OverflowException>(() => attribute.SetBaseValue(2f));

            Assert.That(attribute.BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(1f));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveModifier_WhenResultOverflows_IsTransactional()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(float.MaxValue);
            GameplayModifierHandle additive = attribute.AddModifier(Add(-float.MaxValue / 2f, SourceA));
            GameplayModifierHandle multiplier = attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(2f, SourceB));
            float before = attribute.CurrentValue;

            Assert.Throws<OverflowException>(() => attribute.RemoveModifier(additive));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(before));

            Assert.That(attribute.RemoveModifier(multiplier), Is.True);
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue / 2f));
            Assert.That(attribute.RemoveModifier(additive), Is.True);
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveModifiersFromSource_WhenResultOverflows_IsTransactional()
        {
            var attribute = new GameplayAttribute(float.MaxValue);
            attribute.AddModifier(Add(-float.MaxValue / 2f, SourceA));
            GameplayModifierHandle multiplier = attribute.AddModifier(Multiply(2f, SourceB));
            float before = attribute.CurrentValue;

            Assert.Throws<OverflowException>(() => attribute.RemoveModifiersFromSource(SourceA));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(before));

            Assert.That(attribute.RemoveModifier(multiplier), Is.True);
            Assert.That(attribute.RemoveModifiersFromSource(SourceA), Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(attribute.CurrentValue, Is.EqualTo(float.MaxValue));
        }

        private static GameplayAttributeModifier Add(float magnitude, GameplaySourceId source)
        {
            return new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, magnitude, source);
        }

        private static GameplayAttributeModifier Multiply(float magnitude, GameplaySourceId source)
        {
            return new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, magnitude, source);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Combat
{
    public sealed class DamagePipelineTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplaySourceId Source = new GameplaySourceId(1);
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Health = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Health");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Defense = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Defense");

        [Test]
        public void EmptyPipeline_PreservesBaseDamageAndDoesNotChangeAttributes()
        {
            var sourceAttributes = new AttributeSet();
            sourceAttributes.Register(Attack, 22f);
            var targetAttributes = new AttributeSet();
            targetAttributes.Register(Health, 73f);
            var context = new DamageContext(Source, 18f, targetAttributes, sourceAttributes);

            DamageResult result = new DamagePipeline().Calculate(context);

            Assert.That(result.BaseDamage, Is.EqualTo(18f));
            Assert.That(result.FinalDamage, Is.EqualTo(18f));
            Assert.That(context.SourceId, Is.EqualTo(Source));
            Assert.That(context.SourceAttributes, Is.SameAs(sourceAttributes));
            Assert.That(context.TargetAttributes, Is.SameAs(targetAttributes));
            Assert.That(targetAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Health), Is.EqualTo(73f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DefenseModifier_UsesCurrentNonNegativeDefenseValue()
        {
            var targetAttributes = new AttributeSet();
            targetAttributes.Register(Defense, 0f);
            targetAttributes.Register(Health, 73f);
            var context = new DamageContext(Source, 100f, targetAttributes);
            var pipeline = new DamagePipeline();
            pipeline.AddModifier(new DefenseDamageModifier(Defense));
            float[] defenses = { 0f, 100f, 300f, -20f };
            float[] expectedDamage = { 100f, 50f, 25f, 100f };

            for (int i = 0; i < defenses.Length; i++)
            {
                targetAttributes.SetBaseValue(Defense, defenses[i]);

                DamageResult result = pipeline.Calculate(context);

                Assert.That(result.FinalDamage, Is.EqualTo(expectedDamage[i]).Within(0.0001f));
            }

            // -20 基础防御 +120 Modifier =100，验证读取的是 CurrentValue。
            targetAttributes.GetAttribute(Defense).AddModifier(
                new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 120f, Source));
            Assert.That(pipeline.Calculate(context).FinalDamage, Is.EqualTo(50f));
            Assert.That(targetAttributes.GetAttribute(Defense).BaseValue, Is.EqualTo(-20f));
            Assert.That(targetAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Health), Is.EqualTo(73f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ModifierRegistrationOrder_DeterminesTheResult()
        {
            var context = new DamageContext(Source, 10f, new AttributeSet());
            var addThenDouble = new DamagePipeline();
            addThenDouble.AddModifier(new AddTenModifier());
            addThenDouble.AddModifier(new DoubleModifier());
            var doubleThenAdd = new DamagePipeline();
            doubleThenAdd.AddModifier(new DoubleModifier());
            doubleThenAdd.AddModifier(new AddTenModifier());

            DamageResult first = addThenDouble.Calculate(context);
            DamageResult second = doubleThenAdd.Calculate(context);

            Assert.That(first.BaseDamage, Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(first.FinalDamage, Is.EqualTo(40f));
            Assert.That(second.BaseDamage, Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(second.FinalDamage, Is.EqualTo(30f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void InvalidDamageInputAndModifierOutput_ThrowExplicitExceptions()
        {
            var targetAttributes = new AttributeSet();

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
                new DamageContext(Source, -1f, targetAttributes));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
                new DamageContext(Source, float.NaN, targetAttributes));

            var pipeline = new DamagePipeline();
            pipeline.AddModifier(new NonFiniteModifier());
            var context = new DamageContext(Source, 10f, targetAttributes);

            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => pipeline.Calculate(context));
        }

        private sealed class AddTenModifier : IDamageModifier
        {
            public float Modify(DamageContext context, float currentDamage) => currentDamage + 10f;
        }

        private sealed class DoubleModifier : IDamageModifier
        {
            public float Modify(DamageContext context, float currentDamage) => currentDamage * 2f;
        }

        private sealed class NonFiniteModifier : IDamageModifier
        {
            public float Modify(DamageContext context, float currentDamage) => float.PositiveInfinity;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    /// <summary>Non-periodic Duration regression authority: one timeline for expiry, refresh and observations.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayDurationBoundaryTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Active = new GameplayTag("Test.DurationBoundary.Active");
        private static readonly GameplayTag StackKey = new GameplayTag("Test.DurationBoundary.Stack");

        private sealed class Host : IGameplayAbilityHost, IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
        {
            public readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator Ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application { get; }
            public int Completions;

            public Host()
            {
                OwnerId = Ids.Allocate();
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, Ids, Tags);
                Application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(OwnerId,
                    new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId)), this, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);
            }

            public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext completion)
            {
                Assert.That(Effects.IsActive(completion.Handle), Is.False);
                Assert.That(Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.False);
                Completions++;
            }

            public GameplayEffectDefinition Definition(float duration = 3f, bool completion = false,
                GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stacking = null) => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                    GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, duration, 0f,
                    Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Active },
                    Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking,
                    completionExecutions: completion ? new IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution[] { this } : null);

            public void AssertActive(GameplayEffectHandle handle)
            {
                Assert.That(Effects.IsActive(handle), Is.True);
                Assert.That(Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.True);
                Assert.That(Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float remaining), Is.True);
                Assert.That(remaining, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0f));
                Assert.That(Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot()[0].Remaining, Is.EqualTo(remaining));
            }

            public void AssertExpired(GameplayEffectHandle handle)
            {
                Assert.That(Effects.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
                Assert.That(Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.False);
                Assert.That(Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float remaining), Is.False);
                Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(), Is.Empty);
            }
        }

        [TestCase(1, 3f, false)]
        [TestCase(90, 1f / 30f, false)]
        [TestCase(180, 1f / 60f, false)]
        [TestCase(1, 3f, true)]
        [TestCase(90, 1f / 30f, true)]
        [TestCase(180, 1f / 60f, true)]
        public void AuthoredThreeSecondsExpiresAtBoundaryAcrossPartitions(int steps, float delta, bool completion)
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var definition = host.Definition(completion: completion);
            var handle = completion ? host.Effects.Apply(definition, host.Application).ActiveHandle :
                host.Effects.Apply(definition);
            for (int i = 1; i < steps; i++)
            {
                host.Effects.Advance(delta);
                host.AssertActive(handle);
                Assert.That(host.Completions, Is.Zero);
            }
            host.Effects.Advance(delta);
            host.AssertExpired(handle);
            Assert.That(host.Completions, Is.EqualTo(completion ? 1 : 0));
            host.Effects.Advance(delta);
            Assert.That(host.Completions, Is.EqualTo(completion ? 1 : 0), "No second completion after expiry.");
        }

        private static GameplayEffectStackingDefinition Stack(GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy refresh,
            GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy overflow) => new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(StackKey,
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1, refresh,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset, overflow);

        [TestCase(90, 1f / 30f)]
        [TestCase(180, 1f / 60f)]
        public void SuccessfulRefreshMovesHorizonFromCurrentElapsed(int steps, float delta)
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var definition = host.Definition(completion: true, stacking: Stack(
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit));
            var handle = host.Effects.Apply(definition, host.Application).ActiveHandle;
            host.Effects.Advance(1.25f);
            var reapplied = host.Effects.Apply(definition, host.Application);
            Assert.That(reapplied.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RefreshedAtLimit));
            Assert.That(reapplied.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(handle));
            Assert.That(host.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(3f));
            for (int i = 1; i < steps; i++)
            {
                host.Effects.Advance(delta);
                host.AssertActive(handle);
                Assert.That(host.Completions, Is.Zero);
            }
            host.Effects.Advance(delta);
            host.AssertExpired(handle);
            Assert.That(host.Completions, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [TestCase(GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit)]
        [TestCase(GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject)]
        public void NeverRefreshOrRejectedReapplyPreservesOriginalHorizon(
            GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy refresh, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy overflow)
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var definition = host.Definition(stacking: Stack(refresh, overflow));
            var handle = host.Effects.Apply(definition, host.Application).ActiveHandle;
            for (int i = 0; i < 60; i++) host.Effects.Advance(1f / 60f);
            host.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float before);
            var reapplied = host.Effects.Apply(definition, host.Application);
            Assert.That(reapplied.Succeeded, Is.EqualTo(overflow != GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject));
            host.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float after);
            Assert.That(after, Is.EqualTo(before));
            for (int i = 60; i < 179; i++) host.Effects.Advance(1f / 60f);
            host.AssertActive(handle);
            host.Effects.Advance(1f / 60f);
            host.AssertExpired(handle);
        }

        [Test]
        public void NonAlignedDurationDoesNotExpireAtPreviousFrame()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var handle = host.Effects.Apply(host.Definition(.31f));
            for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) host.Effects.Advance(1f / 30f);
            host.AssertActive(handle);
            host.Effects.Advance(1f / 30f);
            host.AssertExpired(handle);
        }

        [Test]
        public void ImmediatelyPreviousRepresentableTimeDoesNotExpireEarly()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var handle = host.Effects.Apply(host.Definition());
            const float previous = 2.999999761581421f;
            host.Effects.Advance(previous);
            host.AssertActive(handle);
            host.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float remaining);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(3f - previous));
            host.Effects.Advance(3f - previous);
            host.AssertExpired(handle);
        }

        [TestCase(90, 1f / 30f)]
        [TestCase(180, 1f / 60f)]
        public void NormalAbilityCooldownRestoresActivationAtAuthoredBoundary(int steps, float delta)
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(host, host.Ids);
            var handle = abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), host.Definition()));
            Assert.That(abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True);
            abilities.End(handle);
            for (int i = 1; i < steps; i++)
            {
                host.Effects.Advance(delta);
                Assert.That(host.Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.True);
                Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.False);
                Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(handle).BlockReason, Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityBlockReason.Cooldown));
            }
            host.Effects.Advance(delta);
            Assert.That(host.Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.False);
            Assert.That(abilities.CanActivate(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(abilities.GetStatus(handle).CooldownRemaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(host.Completions, Is.Zero);
        }
    }
}
````
