using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    /// <summary>Guards exact contribution ownership, boundary ordering and callback snapshot semantics, which visual QA cannot reliably prove.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayEffectCapabilityTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag DurationKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Duration"), PeriodKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Period");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Stat = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Stat");
        private sealed class Target : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
        {
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public Target(GameplaySourceId id) { TargetId = id; Attributes.Register(Stat, 100); }
        }
        private sealed class Capture : IGameplayEffectExecution
        { public readonly List<GameplayEffectApplicationContext> Calls = new List<GameplayEffectApplicationContext>(); public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext app) => Calls.Add(app); }
        private sealed class Overflow : IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution
        { public Action<GameplayEffectOverflowContext> Action; public void Execute(GameplayEffectOverflowContext context) => Action(context); }
        private sealed class Completion : IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
        { public int Count; public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext context) => Count++; }
        private static GameplayEffectApplicationContext App(Target target, GameplaySourceId source, float duration = 3, float period = 1) =>
            new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(source, new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId)), target,
                new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(DurationKey,duration), new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(PeriodKey,period) }));
        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Definition(Capture capture = null, GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stacking = null, Completion completion = null,
            GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy start = GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.AfterFirstPeriod, bool dynamic = true) =>
            new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 3, capture == null ? 0 : 1,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Stat, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 10) }, new[] { new GameplayTag("State.Test.Active") },
                capture == null ? Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>() : new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { capture }, stacking,
                completionExecutions: completion == null ? null : new IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution[] { completion }, effectTags: new[] { new GameplayTag("Effect.Debuff.Poison") },
                periodicStart: start, durationValue: dynamic ? new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(DurationKey) : null,
                periodValue: dynamic && capture != null ? new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(PeriodKey) : null);
        private static GameplayEffectStackingDefinition Stack(GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy lifetime = GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.IndependentLayerLifetime,
            GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy overflow = GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject, IGameplayEffectOverflowExecution rule = null,
            GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy reset = GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset) =>
            new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Stack.Test"), GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh, reset, overflow, lifetime, rule == null ? null : new[] { rule });

        [Test]
        public void Cleanse_SnapshotsClassificationAndObservesDispelWithoutForgingCompletion()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var target = new Target(ids.Allocate()); var c = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var completion = new Completion(); var d = Definition(completion: completion);
            var a = c.Apply(d, App(target, ids.Allocate())); var b = c.Apply(d, App(target, ids.Allocate()));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(new GameplayTag("Effect.Debuff")), Is.False);
            var order = new List<GameplayEffectHandle>(); GameplayEffectHandle created = default;
            c.Removed += o => { order.Add(o.Handle); Assert.That(o.Cause, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Dispel)); if (o.Handle == a.ActiveHandle) created = c.Apply(d, App(target, ids.Allocate())).ActiveHandle; };
            var query = new GameplayEffectQuery(new GameplayTagQuery(new[] { new GameplayTag("Effect.Debuff") }, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
            Assert.That(c.RemoveMatching(query), Is.EqualTo(2)); CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { a.ActiveHandle,b.ActiveHandle },order);
            Assert.That(c.IsActive(created), Is.True); Assert.That(completion.Count, Is.Zero);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => c.Remove(created, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.NaturalExpiry));
        }
        [Test]
        public void TimingSnapshot_RefreshResetUsesIncomingAndNeverPoliciesPreserveSchedule()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var target = new Target(ids.Allocate()); var c = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes,ids,target.Tags);
            var capture = new Capture(); var d = Definition(capture);
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => c.Apply(d));
            var a = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),3,1)); var b = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),6,2));
            var snapshots = c.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(); Assert.That(snapshots[0].AppliedDuration, Is.EqualTo(3)); Assert.That(snapshots[1].AppliedPeriod, Is.EqualTo(2));
            c.Advance(1); Assert.That(capture.Calls.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            c.Remove(a.ActiveHandle); c.Remove(b.ActiveHandle);
            var refresh = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Stack.Refresh"),GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication,GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit);
            d = Definition(capture, refresh); a = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),3,1)); c.Advance(.5f); c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),6,2));
            snapshots = c.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(); Assert.That(snapshots[0].Remaining, Is.EqualTo(6)); Assert.That(snapshots[0].PeriodRemaining, Is.EqualTo(2));
            c.Remove(a.ActiveHandle); d = Definition(capture,Stack(GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.SharedEntryLifetime));
            a = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),3,1)); c.Advance(.5f); c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),6,2));
            snapshots = c.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(); Assert.That(snapshots[0].AppliedDuration,Is.EqualTo(3)); Assert.That(snapshots[0].AppliedPeriod,Is.EqualTo(1));
            var legacy = Definition(dynamic:false); c.Remove(a.ActiveHandle); var h = c.Apply(legacy); c.Advance(3); Assert.That(c.IsActive(h),Is.False);
        }
        [Test]
        public void ImmediateAndIndependentExpiry_PreserveFinalPeriodAndSurvivingContext()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var target = new Target(ids.Allocate()); var c = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes,ids,target.Tags);
            var capture = new Capture(); var completion = new Completion(); var d = Definition(capture,Stack(),completion,GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.ExecuteOnApplication);
            var a = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),3)); c.Advance(1);
            var source = ids.Allocate(); var b = c.Apply(d,App(target,source,1));
            Assert.That(capture.Calls.Count,Is.EqualTo(3)); Assert.That(capture.Calls[2].StackCount,Is.EqualTo(2));
            c.Advance(1); Assert.That(capture.Calls[3].StackCount,Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Stat),Is.EqualTo(110)); Assert.That(c.RemoveLayer(b.LayerHandle),Is.False);
            c.Advance(1); Assert.That(capture.Calls[4].StackCount,Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(capture.Calls[4].Context.EffectiveSourceId,Is.EqualTo(capture.Calls[0].Context.EffectiveSourceId));
            Assert.That(c.IsActive(a.ActiveHandle),Is.False); Assert.That(completion.Count,Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(c.LastRemoval.Cause,Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.NaturalExpiry));
        }
        [Test]
        public void LayerRemoval_IsContainerScopedAndRetractsOnlyItsExactModifiers()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var target = new Target(ids.Allocate()); var c = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes,ids,target.Tags);
            var otherTarget = new Target(ids.Allocate()); var other = new GameplayEffectContainer(otherTarget.Attributes,ids,otherTarget.Tags);
            var d = Definition(stacking:Stack()); var a = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate())); var b = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate(),8));
            Assert.That(a.LayerHandle,Is.Not.EqualTo(b.LayerHandle)); Assert.That(other.RemoveLayer(a.LayerHandle),Is.False);
            Assert.That(c.RemoveLayer(a.LayerHandle),Is.True); Assert.That(c.RemoveLayer(a.LayerHandle),Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Stat),Is.EqualTo(110)); Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(new GameplayTag("State.Test.Active")),Is.True);
            c.RemoveLayer(b.LayerHandle); Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Stat),Is.EqualTo(100)); Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(new GameplayTag("State.Test.Active")),Is.False);
        }
        [Test]
        public void Overflow_CommitsAuthoredOrderAndCreatesNoPhantomLayer()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(); var target = new Target(ids.Allocate()); var c = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes,ids,target.Tags);
            var next = Definition(dynamic:false); var rule = new Overflow { Action = ctx => { Assert.That(ctx.StackCount,Is.EqualTo(3)); ctx.Apply(next); ctx.RemoveCurrent(); } };
            var d = Definition(stacking:Stack(overflow:GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow,rule:rule));
            for (int i=0;i<3;i++) c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate()));
            var result = c.Apply(d,App(target,ids.Allocate())); Assert.That(result.Outcome,Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.OverflowExecuted));
            Assert.That(result.Succeeded,Is.True); Assert.That(result.LayerHandle.IsValid,Is.False); Assert.That(result.HasActiveHandle,Is.False);
            Assert.That(c.LastRemoval.Cause,Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Overflow)); Assert.That(c.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Count,Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Stat),Is.EqualTo(110));
        }

        [Test]
        public void InstigatorStacksAcrossCastSourcesAndOverflowsOnlyItsOwnGroup()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var first = ids.Allocate();
            var second = ids.Allocate();
            int bursts = 0;
            var rule = new Overflow { Action = context => { bursts++; context.RemoveCurrent(); } };
            var definition = Definition(stacking: new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Test.Instigator"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByInstigator, 5, GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.ExecuteOverflow,
                overflowExecutions: new[] { rule }),
                dynamic: false);

            GameplayEffectApplicationResult Cast(GameplaySourceId instigator) => effects.Apply(definition,
                new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(instigator, new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId), ids.Allocate()),
                    target, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));

            Cast(second);
            for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++) Assert.That(Cast(first).StackCount, Is.EqualTo(i));
            Assert.That(bursts, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(Cast(first).Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.OverflowExecuted));
            Assert.That(bursts, Is.EqualTo(1));
            var remaining = effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot();
            Assert.That(remaining.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(remaining[0].ApplicationContext.InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(second));
            Assert.That(Cast(first).StackCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }
    }
}

  }
  static GameplayEffectDefinition Definition(IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution[] completions=null,IGameplayEffectExecution period=null,GameplayTagQuery ongoing=null)=>new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,3,period==null?0:1,new[]{new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Value,GameplayModifierOperation.Add,5)},new[]{Active},period==null?Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>():new[]{period},null,null,ongoing,completions);

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    public sealed class GameplayEffectContainerTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Invincible = new GameplayTag("State.Invincible");

        [Test]
        public void Duration_ExpiresAndRestoresAttribute()
        {
            var target = new AttributeSet();
            target.Register(Attack, 100f);
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, new GameplaySourceIdAllocator());
            var handle = container.Apply(Boost(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration));

            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(130f).Within(0.0001f));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(5f));
            container.Advance(4f);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(1f));
            container.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(100f));
            Assert.That(container.Remove(handle), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Infinite_PersistsUntilRemovedByItsOwnContainer()
        {
            var target = new AttributeSet();
            target.Register(Attack, 100f);
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, allocator);
            var other = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, allocator);
            var handle = container.Apply(Boost(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite));

            container.Advance(100000f);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out float remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(other.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle, out remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(other.Remove(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.Remove(default(GameplayEffectHandle)), Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(130f).Within(0.0001f));
            Assert.That(container.Remove(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(100f));
            Assert.That(container.Remove(handle), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void SameDefinition_HasIndependentInstancesAndPreservesOtherSources()
        {
            var target = new AttributeSet();
            var attack = target.Register(Attack, 100f);
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            attack.AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 10f, allocator.Allocate()));
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, allocator);
            var definition = Boost(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration);
            var first = container.Apply(definition);
            container.Advance(2f);
            var second = container.Apply(definition);

            Assert.That(first, Is.Not.EqualTo(second));
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(185.9f).Within(0.0001f));
            Assert.That(container.Remove(first), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(second), Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(143f).Within(0.0001f));
            container.Advance(3f);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(second), Is.True);
            container.Advance(2f);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(110f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void FailedApply_RollsBackPartialModifiersAndAllowsLaterApplications()
        {
            var target = new AttributeSet();
            target.Register(Attack, 100f);
            var defense = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Defense");
            target.Register(defense, 20f);
            var missing = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Missing");
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, new GameplaySourceIdAllocator());
            var existing = container.Apply(Boost(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite));
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                new[]
                {
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 50f),
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(defense, GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 2f),
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(missing, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 1f)
                });

            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => container.Apply(definition));
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(130f).Within(0.0001f));
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(defense), Is.EqualTo(20f));
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(existing), Is.True);
            var later = container.Apply(Boost(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration));
            container.Advance(5f);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(later), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.Remove(existing), Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(100f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ModifierAndGrantedTag_TwoInstancesRemoveOneAndExpireTheOther()
        {
            var target = new AttributeSet();
            target.Register(Attack, 100f);
            var targetTags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, new GameplaySourceIdAllocator(), targetTags);
            var modifiers = new List<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>
            {
                new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 1.3f)
            };
            var grantedTags = new List<GameplayTag> { Invincible };
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, modifiers, grantedTags);
            modifiers.Clear();
            grantedTags.Clear();

            var first = container.Apply(definition);
            var second = container.Apply(definition);

            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(169f).Within(0.0001f));
            Assert.That(targetTags.HasTagExact(Invincible), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.Remove(first), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(second), Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(130f).Within(0.0001f));
            Assert.That(targetTags.HasTagExact(Invincible), Is.True);

            container.Advance(5f);

            Assert.That(container.IsActive(second), Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(100f));
            Assert.That(targetTags.HasTagExact(Invincible), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void FailedApply_RollsBackPartialAttributesAndDoesNotChangeExistingTags()
        {
            var target = new AttributeSet();
            target.Register(Attack, 100f);
            var missing = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Missing");
            var preserved = new GameplayTag("State.Preserved");
            var transient = new GameplayTag("State.Transient");
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var targetTags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            targetTags.AddTag(preserved, allocator.Allocate());
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,
                5f,
                new[]
                {
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 50f),
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(missing, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 1f)
                },
                new[] { preserved, transient });

            var withoutTags = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, allocator);
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => withoutTags.Apply(definition));
            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(100f));

            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target, allocator, targetTags);
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => container.Apply(definition));

            Assert.That(target.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(100f));
            Assert.That(targetTags.HasTagExact(preserved), Is.True);
            Assert.That(targetTags.HasTagExact(transient), Is.False);
        }

        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Boost(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy policy)
        {
            return new GameplayEffectDefinition(policy, 5f, new[]
            {
                new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 1.3f)
            });
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    public sealed class GameplayEffectStackingTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Stack.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Defense = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Stack.Defense");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Key = new GameplayTag("Effect.Test.Stack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Granted = new GameplayTag("State.Test.Stack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag ValueKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Stack.Value");

        [Test]
        public void StackingDefinition_ValidatesAndLegacyApplyFailsBeforeAllocation()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => Stack(default, GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => Stack(Key, (GameplayEffectStackAggregation)99));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(Key,
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 0,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(Key,
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1,
                (GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy)99,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(Key,
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                (GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy)99, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(Key,
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset, (GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy)99));
            var stacking = Stack(Key, GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f, 0f, Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { new Capture() }, stacking));

            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var definition = Definition(stacking);
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => container.Apply(definition));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(14f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.False);
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(2));
            var ordinary = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>());
            var normal = container.Apply(ordinary, Application(ids.Allocate(), target, 0f));
            Assert.That(normal.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.NewActiveEffect));
            Assert.That(normal.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetStackCount(normal.ActiveHandle, out int count), Is.True);
            Assert.That(count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            container.Remove(normal.ActiveHandle);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetStackCount(normal.ActiveHandle, out count), Is.False);
            Assert.That(count, Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void AggregateBySource_OneHandleOneSourceAndRefreshAtLimit()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var sourceA = ids.Allocate();
            var sourceB = ids.Allocate();
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var definition = Definition(Stack(Key, GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateBySource));
            var a1 = container.Apply(definition, Application(sourceA, target, 1f));
            Assert.That(a1.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.NewActiveEffect));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(16f));
            container.Advance(5f);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(a1.ActiveHandle, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(2f));
            var a2 = container.Apply(definition, Application(sourceA, target, 2f));
            Assert.That(a2.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.StackIncreased));
            Assert.That(a2.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(a1.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(a2.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(18f));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(a1.ActiveHandle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(7f));
            var b1 = container.Apply(definition, Application(sourceB, target, 3f));
            Assert.That(b1.ActiveHandle, Is.Not.EqualTo(a1.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(20f));
            var a3 = container.Apply(definition, Application(sourceA, target, 4f));
            Assert.That(a3.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(22f));
            container.Advance(3f);
            var cap = container.Apply(definition, Application(sourceA, target, 5f));
            Assert.That(cap.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RefreshedAtLimit));
            Assert.That(cap.Succeeded, Is.True);
            Assert.That(cap.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(a1.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(cap.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(a1.ActiveHandle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(7f));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(22f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.True);
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(6), "Only two aggregate entries allocate Effect sources.");
            Assert.That(container.Remove(a1.ActiveHandle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(16f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.True);
            container.Advance(4f);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(14f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void AggregateByTarget_CollisionAndRejectPreserveExistingState()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var sourceA = ids.Allocate();
            var sourceB = ids.Allocate();
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var capture = new Capture();
            var stacking = Stack(Key, GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,
                max: 2, duration: GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                period: GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
                overflow: GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject);
            var definition = Definition(stacking, 2f, capture);
            var firstApplication = Application(sourceA, target, 1f);
            var secondApplication = Application(sourceB, target, 2f);
            var rejectedApplication = Application(sourceB, target, 3f);
            var first = container.Apply(definition, firstApplication);
            container.Advance(.5f);
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => container.Apply(
                Definition(stacking, 2f, capture), secondApplication));
            var second = container.Apply(definition, secondApplication);
            Assert.That(second.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(first.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(second.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(first.ActiveHandle, out float duration), Is.True);
            Assert.That(duration, Is.EqualTo(6.5f));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(first.ActiveHandle, out float period), Is.True);
            Assert.That(period, Is.EqualTo(1.5f));
            var rejected = container.Apply(definition, rejectedApplication);
            Assert.That(rejected.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedAtLimit));
            Assert.That(rejected.Succeeded, Is.False);
            Assert.That(rejected.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(first.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(rejected.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(first.ActiveHandle, out duration), Is.True);
            Assert.That(duration, Is.EqualTo(6.5f));
            container.Advance(1.5f);
            Assert.That(capture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1), "A stacked periodic Entry executes once per period.");
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context, Is.SameAs(secondApplication.Context));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.SetByCaller.GetRequiredValue(ValueKey), Is.EqualTo(2f));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(sourceB));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(18f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodResetAndLayerFailure_AreIndependentOfDurationAndOldContributions()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var source = ids.Allocate();
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var capture = new Capture();
            var reset = Definition(Stack(Key, GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,
                period: GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication), 2f, capture);
            var first = container.Apply(reset, Application(source, target, 1f));
            container.Advance(1.5f);
            var next = container.Apply(reset, Application(source, target, 2f));
            Assert.That(next.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(first.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(first.ActiveHandle, out float period), Is.True);
            Assert.That(period, Is.EqualTo(2f));
            container.Advance(.5f);
            Assert.That(capture.Calls, Is.Zero);
            container.Remove(first.ActiveHandle);

            target.Attributes.Register(Defense, 1f);
            var failing = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 7f, 2f,
                new[]
                {
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f),
                    new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Defense, GameplayModifierOperation.Add,
                        float.MaxValue * .6f)
                }, new[] { Granted }, new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { capture },
                Stack(new GameplayTag("Effect.Test.Rollback"), GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,
                    period: GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset));
            var original = Application(source, target, 4f);
            var active = container.Apply(failing, original);
            container.Advance(1.5f);
            Assert.Throws<OverflowException>(() => container.Apply(failing,
                Application(source, target, 9f)));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(16f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetStackCount(active.ActiveHandle, out int count), Is.True);
            Assert.That(count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(active.ActiveHandle, out float duration), Is.True);
            Assert.That(duration, Is.EqualTo(5.5f));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(active.ActiveHandle, out period), Is.True);
            Assert.That(period, Is.EqualTo(.5f));
            container.Advance(.5f);
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context, Is.SameAs(original.Context));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.SetByCaller.GetRequiredValue(ValueKey), Is.EqualTo(4f));
            Assert.That(container.Remove(active.ActiveHandle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(14f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RefreshAtLimit_ReplacesPeriodicApplicationWithoutMultiplyingExecution()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var sourceA = ids.Allocate();
            var sourceB = ids.Allocate();
            var capture = new Capture();
            var definition = Definition(Stack(Key, GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,
                max: 1, period: GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset), 2f, capture);
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var first = container.Apply(definition, Application(sourceA, target, 1f));
            container.Advance(1f);
            var latest = Application(sourceB, target, 9f);
            var refreshed = container.Apply(definition, latest);
            Assert.That(refreshed.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RefreshedAtLimit));
            Assert.That(refreshed.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(first.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(refreshed.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(16f));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(first.ActiveHandle, out float period), Is.True);
            Assert.That(period, Is.EqualTo(1f));
            container.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(capture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context, Is.SameAs(latest.Context));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.Context.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(sourceB));
            Assert.That(capture.Last.SetByCaller.GetRequiredValue(ValueKey), Is.EqualTo(9f));
        }

        private static GameplayEffectStackingDefinition Stack(GameplayTag key,
            GameplayEffectStackAggregation aggregation, int max = 3,
            GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy duration =
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
            GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy period = GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
            GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy overflow = GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit) =>
            new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(key, aggregation, max, duration, period, overflow);

        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Definition(GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stacking,
            float period = 0f, IGameplayEffectExecution execution = null) =>
            new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 7f, period,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f) },
                new[] { Granted }, execution == null ? Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>() :
                    new[] { execution }, stacking);

        private static GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application(GameplaySourceId source,
            Target target, float value) =>
            new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(
                new GameplayContext(source, new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId)), target,
                new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[]
                {
                    new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(ValueKey, value)
                }));

        private sealed class Target : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
        {
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();

            public Target(GameplaySourceId targetId)
            {
                TargetId = targetId;
                Attributes.Register(Attack, 14f);
            }
        }

        private sealed class Capture : IGameplayEffectExecution
        {
            public int Calls;
            public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Last;
            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            {
                Calls++;
                Last = application;
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    public sealed class GameplayEffectTagRequirementTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Stun = new GameplayTag("State.Stun");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Ready = new GameplayTag("State.Ready");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Guard = new GameplayTag("State.Guard");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Requirement.Attack");
        private static GameplayTagQuery NoStun => new GameplayTagQuery(
            Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { Stun });

        [Test]
        public void Query_EmptyAllAnyNoneHierarchyAndInvalidInputs()
        {
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            tags.AddTag(new GameplayTag("State.Ready.Fast"), ids.Allocate());
            tags.AddTag(Guard, ids.Allocate());
            Assert.That(GameplayTagQuery.Empty.Matches(tags), Is.True);
            var input = new[] { Ready };
            var query = new GameplayTagQuery(input, new[] { Guard }, new[] { Stun });
            input[0] = Stun;
            Assert.That(query.All[0], Is.EqualTo(Ready));
            Assert.That(query.Matches(tags), Is.True);
            Assert.That(new GameplayTagQuery(new[] { Stun }, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()).Matches(tags), Is.False);
            Assert.That(new GameplayTagQuery(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { Stun },
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()).Matches(tags), Is.False);
            Assert.That(new GameplayTagQuery(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new[] { Ready }).Matches(tags), Is.False);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => new GameplayTagQuery(null,
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayTagQuery(new[] { default(GameplayTag) },
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => query.Matches(null));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ApplicationRejectsInstantAndStackReapplyBeforeAnyMutation()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var execution = new CountingExecution();
            var instant = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution }, null, NoStun);
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Requirement.Stack"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit);
            var persistent = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 7f, 0f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f) },
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking, NoStun);
            var application = ApplyContext(target);
            var first = effects.Apply(persistent, application);
            Assert.That(first.Succeeded, Is.True);
            effects.Advance(2f);
            target.Tags.AddTag(Stun, ids.Allocate());
            var rejectedInstant = effects.Apply(instant, application);
            var rejectedStack = effects.Apply(persistent, application);
            Assert.That(rejectedInstant.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedByRequirements));
            Assert.That(rejectedStack.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedByRequirements));
            Assert.That(rejectedInstant.Succeeded || rejectedStack.Succeeded, Is.False);
            Assert.That(rejectedInstant.HasActiveHandle || rejectedStack.HasActiveHandle, Is.False);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(effects.TryGetStackCount(first.ActiveHandle, out int count), Is.True);
            Assert.That(count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(first.ActiveHandle, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(5f));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(16f));
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(4), "Rejected applications allocate no source ID.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void OngoingMismatchRemovesWholeStackAndNeverResurrects()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Requirement.Ongoing"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit);
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 7f, 0f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f) },
                new[] { Guard }, Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking, NoStun, NoStun);
            var application = ApplyContext(target);
            var first = effects.Apply(definition, application);
            effects.Apply(definition, application);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(18f));
            var stunSource = ids.Allocate();
            target.Tags.AddTag(Stun, stunSource);
            effects.Advance(0f);
            Assert.That(effects.IsActive(first.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(14f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(Guard), Is.False);
            target.Tags.RemoveTag(Stun, stunSource);
            effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(effects.IsActive(first.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            var restarted = effects.Apply(definition, application);
            Assert.That(restarted.ActiveHandle, Is.Not.EqualTo(first.ActiveHandle));
            Assert.That(restarted.StackCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void NewPersistentRequirementFailureHasNoEntryOrSourceAndPeriodCannotFire()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var execution = new CountingExecution();
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), new[] { Guard },
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution }, null, GameplayTagQuery.Empty, NoStun);
            var stunSource = ids.Allocate();
            target.Tags.AddTag(Stun, stunSource);
            var rejected = effects.Apply(definition, ApplyContext(target));
            Assert.That(rejected.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RejectedByRequirements));
            Assert.That(rejected.HasActiveHandle, Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(Guard), Is.False);
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(3));
            target.Tags.RemoveTag(Stun, stunSource);
            var applied = effects.Apply(definition, ApplyContext(target));
            target.Tags.AddTag(Stun, ids.Allocate());
            effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(effects.IsActive(applied.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(Guard), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicExecutionLosingOngoingRequirementStopsLargeDelta()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var execution = new CountingExecution { StunOnFirst = true };
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 8f, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution }, null, NoStun, NoStun);
            var result = effects.Apply(definition, ApplyContext(target));
            effects.Advance(5f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(effects.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution }, null, null, NoStun));
        }

        private static GameplayEffectApplicationContext ApplyContext(Target target) =>
            new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(target.TargetId,
                new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId)), target, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);

        private sealed class Target : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
        {
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public Target(GameplaySourceId id) { TargetId = id; Attributes.Register(Attack, 14f); }
        }

        private sealed class CountingExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
        {
            public int Calls;
            public bool StunOnFirst;
            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            {
                Calls++;
                if (StunOnFirst && Calls == 1)
                    application.Target.Tags.AddTag(Stun, application.Target.TargetId);
            }
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    public sealed class GameplayFloatValueTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Value.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag CallerKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Value.Caller");
        private static readonly GameplayTag ContextKey = new GameplayTag("Data.Value.Context");

        [Test]
        public void TypedValuesUseImmutableInputsFiniteMathAndCustomCalculation()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var source = new Target(ids.Allocate(), 20f);
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate(), 8f);
            var input = new[] { new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(ContextKey, 3f) };
            var values = new GameplayContextValues(input);
            input[0] = new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(ContextKey, 99f);
            var context = new GameplayContext(source.TargetId,
                new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId), ids.Allocate(), values);
            var application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context, target,
                new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(CallerKey, 4f) }),
                source.Attributes, source.TargetId, 3);
            Assert.That(context.Values.GetRequiredValue(ContextKey), Is.EqualTo(3f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayConstantFloatValue(2f)), Is.EqualTo(2f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(CallerKey), application), Is.EqualTo(4f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayContextFloatValue(ContextKey), application), Is.EqualTo(3f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayAttributeFloatValue(
                GameplayValueAttributeSource.Instigator, Attack), application), Is.EqualTo(20f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayAttributeFloatValue(
                GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target, Attack), application), Is.EqualTo(8f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayStackCountFloatValue(), application), Is.EqualTo(3f));
            Assert.That(GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayCustomFloatValue(new QuarterSum()), application), Is.EqualTo(7f));
            Assert.That(Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Add, 8f, 2f), Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Subtract, 8f, 2f), Is.EqualTo(6f));
            Assert.That(Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Multiply, 8f, 2f), Is.EqualTo(16f));
            Assert.That(Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Divide, 8f, 2f), Is.EqualTo(4f));
            Assert.That(Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Min, 8f, 2f), Is.EqualTo(2f));
            Assert.That(Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Max, 8f, 2f), Is.EqualTo(8f));
            Assert.Throws<DivideByZeroException>(() => Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Divide, 8f, 0f));
            Assert.Throws<ArithmeticException>(() => GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(
                new GameplayCustomFloatValue(new NonFinite()), application));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(
                new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(new GameplayTag("Data.Missing")), application));
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(
                new GameplayContextFloatValue(new GameplayTag("Data.Missing")), application));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(
                new GameplayAttributeFloatValue(GameplayValueAttributeSource.Instigator, Attack),
                new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(source.TargetId,
                    new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId)), target, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty)));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context, target,
                GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty, source.Attributes, target.TargetId));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DynamicModifierSnapshotsAtApplyAndEachNewStackLayer()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate(), 10f);
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var value = new GameplayBinaryFloatValue(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Multiply,
                new GameplayAttributeFloatValue(GameplayValueAttributeSource.Instigator, Attack),
                new GameplayConstantFloatValue(.3f));
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Test.ValueStack"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject);
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 0f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, value) },
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking);
            var unstacked = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, value) });
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => effects.Apply(unstacked));
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(2));
            var first = effects.Apply(definition, Application(target));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f));
            target.Attributes.GetAttribute(Attack).SetBaseValue(20f);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(23f), "Existing contribution is fixed.");
            effects.Apply(definition, Application(target));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(29.9f).Within(.0001f));
            Assert.That(effects.TryGetStackCount(first.ActiveHandle, out int count), Is.True);
            Assert.That(count, Is.EqualTo(2));
            effects.Remove(first.ActiveHandle);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(20f));
            var constant = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 1f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f) });
            var handle = effects.Apply(constant);
            Assert.That(handle.IsValid, Is.True);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(22f));
            var countStack = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 0f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add,
                    new GameplayStackCountFloatValue()) }, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), stacking);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) effects.Apply(countStack, Application(target));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(28f),
                "New layers capture resulting stack counts 1+2+3.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicAttributeIsLiveAndStackCountFormulaExecutesOncePerPeriod()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate(), 10f);
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var execution = new CaptureExecution(new GameplayBinaryFloatValue(
                GameplayBinaryFloatOperation.Multiply, new GameplayConstantFloatValue(2f),
                new GameplayStackCountFloatValue()));
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Test.PeriodValue"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 3,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject);
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution }, stacking);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) effects.Apply(definition, Application(target));
            effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(execution.Last, Is.EqualTo(6f));
            var live = new CaptureExecution(new GameplayAttributeFloatValue(
                GameplayValueAttributeSource.Target, Attack));
            var liveEffect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 3f, 1f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { live });
            effects.Apply(liveEffect, Application(target));
            effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(live.Last, Is.EqualTo(10f));
            target.Attributes.GetAttribute(Attack).SetBaseValue(17f);
            effects.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(live.Last, Is.EqualTo(17f));

            var instant = new CaptureExecution(new GameplayStackCountFloatValue());
            var instantEffect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f, 0f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { instant });
            effects.Apply(instantEffect, Application(target, 7));
            Assert.That(instant.Last, Is.EqualTo(1f),
                "EffectContainer owns non-stack StackCount semantics.");
        }

        private static float Eval(GameplayBinaryFloatOperation op, float left, float right) =>
            GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(new GameplayBinaryFloatValue(op,
                new GameplayConstantFloatValue(left), new GameplayConstantFloatValue(right)));

        private static GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application(Target target, int stackCount = 1) =>
            new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(target.TargetId,
                new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId)), target, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty,
                stackCount: stackCount);

        private sealed class Target : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
        {
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public Target(GameplaySourceId id, float attack)
            { TargetId = id; Attributes.Register(Attack, attack); }
        }
        private sealed class CaptureExecution : IGameplayEffectExecution
        {
            private readonly IGameplayFloatValue _value;
            public int Calls;
            public float Last;
            public CaptureExecution(IGameplayFloatValue value) { _value = value; }
            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            { Calls++; Last = GameplayValueEvaluator.Evaluate(_value, application); }
        }
        private sealed class QuarterSum : IGameplayCustomFloatCalculation
        {
            public float Calculate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) =>
                (context.Application.InstigatorAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack) +
                 context.Application.Target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack)) * .25f;
        }
        private sealed class NonFinite : IGameplayCustomFloatCalculation
        { public float Calculate(GameplayValueEvaluationContext context) => float.PositiveInfinity; }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    public sealed class GameplayInstantEffectTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Key = new GameplayTag("Data.Effect.Test.Amount");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");

        [Test]
        public void SetByCaller_IsImmutableFiniteAndExactKey()
        {
            var input = new List<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>> { Pair(Key, 4f) };
            var values = new GameplaySetByCallerValues(input);
            input[0] = Pair(Key, 99f);
            Assert.That(values.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(values.GetRequiredValue(Key), Is.EqualTo(4f));
            Assert.That(values.TryGetValue(new GameplayTag("Data.Effect.Test"), out _), Is.False);
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => values.GetRequiredValue(new GameplayTag("Missing")));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { Pair(default, 1f) }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { Pair(Key, float.NaN) }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { Pair(Key, 1f), Pair(Key, 2f) }));
            Assert.That(new GameplaySetByCallerValues(Array.Empty<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>>()).Count, Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void Instant_ExecutesInOrderWithoutHandleEntryOrSourceAllocation()
        {
            var first = new Capture();
            var second = new Capture();
            var definition = Instant(first, second);
            Assert.That(definition.Duration, Is.Zero);
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(allocator.Allocate());
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, allocator, target.Tags);
            var context = new GameplayContext(allocator.Allocate(), new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId));
            var application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context, target,
                new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { Pair(Key, 4f) }));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => container.Apply(definition));
            var result = container.Apply(definition, application);
            Assert.That(result.HasActiveHandle, Is.False);
            Assert.That(result.ActiveHandle.IsValid, Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetRemainingDuration(result.ActiveHandle, out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(result.ActiveHandle, out _), Is.False);
            Assert.That(first.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(second.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(first.Last, Is.SameAs(application));
            Assert.That(allocator.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(3), "Instant must not allocate an active source.");
            container.Advance(100f);
            Assert.That(first.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void DefinitionAndApplication_ValidatePolicyAndTarget()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(

                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>()));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f,

                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { new Capture() }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(

            var values = new GameplaySetByCallerValues(Array.Empty<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>>());
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context, other, values));

        [Test]

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicDefinitionAndLegacyApply_ValidateBeforeSourceAllocation()
        {
            var execution = new Capture();

            Assert.That(new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 2f,
                emptyModifiers).Period, Is.Zero);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(

            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 0f, 1f, emptyModifiers, emptyTags,
                new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution }));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 2f, 1f, emptyModifiers, emptyTags,
                Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>()));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(

            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            target.Attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var tag = new GameplayTag("State.LegacyRejected");
            var periodic = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 3f, 1f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 5f) },
                new[] { tag }, new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution });
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => container.Apply(periodic));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(tag), Is.False);
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(2));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicDuration_ExecutesAtFinalBoundaryThenExpiresAndRemoveStopsTicks()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var application = Application(ids, target, 4f);
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var execution = new Capture();
            var result = container.Apply(Periodic(3f, 1f, execution), application);
            Assert.That(result.HasActiveHandle, Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(result.ActiveHandle, out float period), Is.True);
            Assert.That(period, Is.EqualTo(1f));
            container.Advance(.5f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.Zero);
            container.Advance(.5f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(execution.Last, Is.SameAs(application));
            container.Advance(2f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(result.ActiveHandle, out period), Is.False);
            Assert.That(period, Is.Zero);
            var shortExecution = new Capture();
            var shortResult = container.Apply(Periodic(2.5f, 1f, shortExecution), application);
            container.Advance(2.5f);
            Assert.That(shortExecution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(shortResult.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            var removed = container.Apply(Periodic(3f, 1f, shortExecution), application);
            Assert.That(container.Remove(removed.ActiveHandle), Is.True);
            container.Advance(4f);
            Assert.That(shortExecution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(2));
        }

        [Test]
        public void InfinitePeriodic_LargeDeltaAndReapplicationKeepIndependentSnapshots()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            var firstApplication = Application(ids, target, 4f);
            var secondApplication = Application(ids, target, 7f);
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var execution = new Capture();
            var definition = Periodic(0f, 1f, execution, GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite);
            var first = container.Apply(definition, firstApplication);
            container.Advance(3.4f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(first.ActiveHandle, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(.6f).Within(.00001f));
            var second = container.Apply(definition, secondApplication);
            container.Advance(.6f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(4));
            Assert.That(execution.Last, Is.SameAs(firstApplication));
            Assert.That(execution.Last.SetByCaller.GetRequiredValue(Key), Is.EqualTo(4f));
            Assert.That(container.TryGetPeriodRemaining(second.ActiveHandle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(.4f).Within(.00001f));
            container.Advance(.4f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(execution.Last, Is.SameAs(secondApplication));
            Assert.That(ids.Allocate().Value, Is.EqualTo(6), "Only two applications allocate Effect sources.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicFailure_CommitsScheduleAndFinalTickCleansUp()
        {

            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(1f));

            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicEntry_OwnsModifierTagAndExecutionUntilExpiry()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var target = new Target(ids.Allocate());
            target.Attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
            var tag = new GameplayTag("State.PeriodicTest");
            var execution = new Capture();
            var definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 2f, 1f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 5f) },
                new[] { tag }, new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { execution });
            var container = new GameplayEffectContainer(target.Attributes, ids, target.Tags);
            var result = container.Apply(definition, Application(ids, target, 3f));
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(15f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(tag), Is.True);
            container.Advance(2f);
            Assert.That(execution.Calls, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(container.IsActive(result.ActiveHandle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTagExact(tag), Is.False);
        }

        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Periodic(float duration, float period,
            IGameplayEffectExecution execution,
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy policy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration) =>
            new GameplayEffectDefinition(policy, duration, period,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                new[] { execution });

        private static GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application(GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids,
            Target target, float value) =>
            new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(
                new GameplayContext(ids.Allocate(), new GameplayTargetData(target.TargetId)), target,
                new GameplaySetByCallerValues(new[] { Pair(Key, value) }));

        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Instant(params IGameplayEffectExecution[] executions) =>
            new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, 99f,
                Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), executions);

        private static KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float> Pair(GameplayTag key, float value) =>
            new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(key, value);

        private sealed class Capture : IGameplayEffectExecution
        {
            public int Calls;
            public bool Throw;
            public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Last;

            {
                Calls++;
                Last = application;
                if (Throw) throw new InvalidOperationException("test failure");
            }
        }

        private sealed class Target : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget
        {
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public Target(GameplaySourceId id) { TargetId = id; }
        }
    }
