## File: Tests/Gameplay/EditMode/Effect/GameplayPeriodicBoundaryTests.cs
````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Effect
{
    /// <summary>Regression authority for C1: periodic scheduling and expiry share one rule clock.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayPeriodicBoundaryTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Boundary.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Granted = new GameplayTag("State.Boundary.Active");

        [TestCase(10f, 1, 10f, 10)]
        [TestCase(10f, 10, 1f, 10)]
        [TestCase(10f, 50, .2f, 10)]
        [TestCase(10f, 300, 1f / 30f, 10)]
        [TestCase(10f, 600, 1f / 60f, 10)]
        [TestCase(3f, 1, 3f, 3)]
        [TestCase(3f, 180, 1f / 60f, 3)]
        public void PartitionedExpiry_ExecutesFinalPeriodBeforeSourceCleanup(
            float duration, int steps, float delta, int expected)
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            fixture.Start(duration);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.Zero, "Application is not a periodic execution.");
            fixture.OnTick = application =>
            {
                Assert.That(fixture.Effects.IsActive(fixture.Handle), Is.True);
                Assert.That(application.Target.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.True);
                Assert.That(application.Target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(15f));
            };
            for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++)
            {
                fixture.Effects.Advance(delta);
                fixture.AssertObservation();
            }
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(expected));
            fixture.AssertRemoved();
        }

        [TestCase(2.5f, 2)]
        [TestCase(.5f, 0)]
        [TestCase(.99999994f, 0)] // Immediately preceding representable float below Period=1.
        [TestCase(1.00000012f, 1)] // Immediately following representable float above Period=1.
        public void ExpiryComparedToPeriod_DoesNotInventNearbyTick(float duration, int expected)
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            fixture.Start(duration);
            fixture.Effects.Advance(2.5f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(expected));
            fixture.AssertRemoved();
        }

        [Test]
        public void AdvanceJustBeforePeriod_WaitsForActualBoundary()
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            fixture.Start(3f);
            fixture.Effects.Advance(.99999994f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.Zero);
            fixture.AssertObservation();
            fixture.Effects.Advance(1f - .99999994f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void LargeDelta_StopsAtFiniteExpiryButInfiniteKeepsPhase()
        {
            var finite = new Fixture();
            finite.Start(10f);
            finite.Effects.Advance(12f);
            Assert.That(finite.Calls, Is.EqualTo(10));
            finite.AssertRemoved();

            var infinite = new Fixture();
            infinite.Start(0f, policy: GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite);
            infinite.Effects.Advance(10.25f);
            Assert.That(infinite.Calls, Is.EqualTo(10));
            Assert.That(infinite.Effects.IsActive(infinite.Handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(infinite.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(infinite.Handle, out float remaining), Is.False);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(infinite.Effects.TryGetPeriodRemaining(infinite.Handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(.75f));
        }

        [TestCase(GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset, .6f, 10)]
        [TestCase(GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication, 1f, 10)]
        public void RefreshAtLimit_RefreshesExpiryAndKeepsOrResetsOnePeriodSchedule(
            GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy reset, float nextPeriod, int expected)
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Boundary.Stack"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                reset, GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit);
            fixture.Start(10f, stacking);
            fixture.Effects.Advance(.4f);
            var latest = fixture.Application(fixture.TargetId);
            var result = fixture.Effects.Apply(fixture.Definition, latest);
            Assert.That(result.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RefreshedAtLimit));
            Assert.That(result.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(fixture.Handle));
            Assert.That(fixture.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(fixture.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(fixture.Handle, out float remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(10f));
            Assert.That(fixture.Effects.TryGetPeriodRemaining(fixture.Handle, out remaining), Is.True);
            Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(nextPeriod).Within(.000001f));
            fixture.OnTick = application => Assert.That(application.Context, Is.SameAs(latest.Context));
            // Exact binary partition: tests refreshed coincidence without another rounded countdown.
            for (int i = 0; i < 40; i++) fixture.Effects.Advance(.25f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(expected));
            fixture.AssertRemoved();
        }

        [Test]
        public void PartitionedFinalThrow_CleansOwnedStateWithoutReplay()
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            fixture.Start(3f);
            fixture.OnTick = application =>
            {
                if (fixture.Calls == 3) throw new InvalidOperationException("final tick");
            };
            for (int i = 0; i < 179; i++) fixture.Effects.Advance(1f / 60f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => fixture.Effects.Advance(1f / 60f));
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(3));
            fixture.AssertRemoved();
            fixture.Effects.Advance(10f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(3));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ReapplyDuringExecution_UsesCommittedBoundaryAndRemainingAdvance()
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Boundary.Callback"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit);
            fixture.Start(2f, stacking);
            fixture.OnTick = application =>
            {
                if (fixture.Calls == 1) fixture.Effects.Apply(fixture.Definition, application);
            };
            fixture.Effects.Advance(3f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(3));
            fixture.AssertRemoved();
        }

        /// <summary>Guards stale final-boundary expiry after a successful callback refresh, including remaining large-delta time.</summary>
        [TestCase(2f, 2, 2f, 1f)]
        [TestCase(3.5f, 3, .5f, .5f)]
        public void FinalBoundaryReapply_UsesRefreshedExpiryBeforeNaturalCompletion(
            float firstAdvance, int expectedCalls, float remaining, float nextPeriod)
        {
            var fixture = new Fixture();
            var stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Effect.Boundary.FinalRefresh"),
                GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget, 1,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication,
                GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.RefreshExistingAtLimit);
            fixture.Start(2f, stacking, completion: true);
            int naturalRemovals = 0;
            fixture.Effects.Removed += observation =>
            {
                Assert.That(observation.Cause, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.NaturalExpiry));
                Assert.That(fixture.Completions, Is.EqualTo(1));
                naturalRemovals++;
            };
            var latest = fixture.Application(fixture.TargetId);
            fixture.OnTick = application =>
            {
                Assert.That(fixture.Effects.IsActive(fixture.Handle), Is.True);
                Assert.That(fixture.Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.True);
                if (fixture.Calls == 2)
                {
                    var result = fixture.Effects.Apply(fixture.Definition, latest);
                    Assert.That(result.Outcome, Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectApplicationOutcome.RefreshedAtLimit));
                    Assert.That(result.ActiveHandle, Is.EqualTo(fixture.Handle));
                }
                else if (fixture.Calls > 2)
                    Assert.That(application.Context, Is.SameAs(latest.Context));
            };
            fixture.OnComplete = () =>
            {
                Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(4));
                fixture.AssertRemoved(); // Completion observes cleanup after the real final period.
            };

            fixture.Effects.Advance(firstAdvance);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(expectedCalls));
            Assert.That(fixture.Effects.IsActive(fixture.Handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(fixture.Completions, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(naturalRemovals, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(fixture.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(fixture.Handle, out float duration), Is.True);
            Assert.That(duration, Is.EqualTo(remaining));
            Assert.That(fixture.Effects.TryGetPeriodRemaining(fixture.Handle, out float period), Is.True);
            Assert.That(period, Is.EqualTo(nextPeriod));
            fixture.AssertObservation();

            fixture.Effects.Advance(4f - firstAdvance);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(4));
            Assert.That(fixture.Completions, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(naturalRemovals, Is.EqualTo(1));
            fixture.AssertRemoved();
            fixture.Effects.Advance(10f);
            Assert.That(fixture.Calls, Is.EqualTo(4));
            Assert.That(fixture.Completions, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(naturalRemovals, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        private sealed class Fixture : IGameplayEffectExecutionTarget, IGameplayEffectExecution, IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
        {
            private readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator _ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId { get; }
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public readonly GameplayEffectContainer Effects;
            public GameplayEffectHandle Handle;
            public GameplayEffectDefinition Definition;
            public int Calls;
            public Action<GameplayEffectApplicationContext> OnTick;
            public int Completions;
            public Action OnComplete;

            public Fixture()
            {
                TargetId = _ids.Allocate();
                Attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, _ids, Tags);
            }

            public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application(GameplaySourceId source) =>
                new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(source,
                    new GameplayTargetData(TargetId)), this, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);

            public void Start(float duration, GameplayEffectStackingDefinition stacking = null,
                GameplayEffectDurationPolicy policy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, bool completion = false)
            {
                Definition = new GameplayEffectDefinition(policy, duration, 1f,
                    new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 5f) },
                    new[] { Granted }, new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { this }, stacking,
                    completionExecutions: completion ? new IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution[] { this } : null);
                Handle = Effects.Apply(Definition, Application(_ids.Allocate())).ActiveHandle;
            }

            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            {
                Calls++;
                OnTick?.Invoke(application);
            }

            public void AssertObservation()
            {
                if (!Effects.IsActive(Handle)) return;
                Assert.That(Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(Handle, out float duration), Is.True);
                Assert.That(Effects.TryGetPeriodRemaining(Handle, out float period), Is.True);
                Assert.That(duration, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0f));
                Assert.That(period, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0f));
                Assert.That(float.IsNaN(duration) || float.IsInfinity(duration) ||
                    float.IsNaN(period) || float.IsInfinity(period), Is.False);
                var snapshot = Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot()[0];
                Assert.That(snapshot.Remaining, Is.EqualTo(duration));
                Assert.That(snapshot.PeriodRemaining, Is.EqualTo(period));
            }

            public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext completion)
            {
                Completions++;
                OnComplete?.Invoke();
            }

            public void AssertRemoved()
            {
                Assert.That(Effects.IsActive(Handle), Is.False);
                Assert.That(Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(Handle, out float duration), Is.False);
                Assert.That(Effects.TryGetPeriodRemaining(Handle, out float period), Is.False);
                Assert.That(duration, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(period, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
                Assert.That(Tags.HasTagExact(Granted), Is.False);
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Event
{
    public sealed class GameplayEventDispatcherTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Damage = new GameplayTag("Event.Combat.Damage");
        private static readonly GameplayTag DamageApplied = new GameplayTag("Event.Combat.Damage.Applied");

        [Test]
        public void HierarchyAndRegistrationOrder_DeliverParentForChildButNotChildForParent()
        {
            var dispatcher = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var calls = new List<string>();
            dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, _ => calls.Add("parent-first"));
            dispatcher.Subscribe(DamageApplied, _ => calls.Add("child"));
            dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, _ => calls.Add("parent-last"));

            dispatcher.Publish(Data(DamageApplied));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(
                new[] { "parent-first", "child", "parent-last" },
                calls);

            calls.Clear();
            dispatcher.Publish(Data(Damage));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "parent-first", "parent-last" }, calls);
        }

        [Test]
        public void PublishSnapshot_DefersAdditionAndStillInvokesRemovedLaterCallback()
        {
            var dispatcher = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var calls = new List<string>();
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle first = default;
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle later = default;
            GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle added = default;

            first = dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, _ =>
            {
                calls.Add("first");
                dispatcher.Unsubscribe(first);
                dispatcher.Unsubscribe(later);
                if (!added.IsValid)
                    added = dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, __ => calls.Add("added"));
            });
            later = dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, _ => calls.Add("later"));

            dispatcher.Publish(Data(DamageApplied));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "first", "later" }, calls);

            calls.Clear();
            dispatcher.Publish(Data(DamageApplied));
            CollectionAssert.AreEqual(new[] { "added" }, calls);
        }

        [Test]
        public void HandlesValidationAndCallbackExceptions_KeepDispatcherOwnershipAndFailFast()
        {
            var dispatcher = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var other = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            int calls = 0;
            var handle = dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, _ => throw new InvalidOperationException("expected"));
            dispatcher.Subscribe(Damage, _ => calls++);

            Assert.That(default(GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle).IsValid, Is.False);
            Assert.That(other.Unsubscribe(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(dispatcher.Unsubscribe(default), Is.False);
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => dispatcher.Publish(default));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => dispatcher.Publish(Data(DamageApplied)));
            Assert.That(calls, Is.Zero, "异常后的回调不应继续执行。");
            Assert.That(dispatcher.Unsubscribe(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(dispatcher.Unsubscribe(handle), Is.False);

            dispatcher.Publish(Data(DamageApplied));
            Assert.That(calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        private static GameplayEventData Data(GameplayTag eventTag) =>
            new GameplayEventData(eventTag, new GameplaySourceId(1), new GameplaySourceId(2), 3f);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Sequence
{
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceSkillStepTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Signal = new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Cast");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Key = new GameplayTag("Value.Test.Power");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");

        [Test]
        public void MarkerReadsCurrentWorldAndPreservesActivationIdentityValuesAndRealEvent()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var oldTarget = new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId);
            var source = host.Ids.Allocate();
            var values = new GameplayContextValues(new[] { new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag, float>(Key, 42f) });
            var activation = new GameplayContext(host.OwnerId, oldTarget, source, values);
            var trigger = new GameplayEventData(Signal, source, host.OwnerId, 9f);
            GameplayContext executed = null;
            GameplayEventData observed = default;
            var target = new Target((h, e) => { observed = e; return new GameplayTargetData(((Host)h).WorldTarget); });
            var action = new ActionNode((c, e, h) => { executed = c; observed = e; return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; });
            var definition = Schedule(.5f, target, action);
            var play = new GameplaySkillPlaySequenceAction(definition);
            play.Execute(activation, trigger, host);
            host.WorldTarget = host.Ids.Allocate(); // World/facing resolver inputs change after Start.
            host.Sequences.Advance(.49f);
            Assert.That(target.Calls, Is.Zero);
            host.Sequences.Advance(.01f);
            Assert.That(executed.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(host.WorldTarget));
            Assert.That(executed, Is.Not.SameAs(activation));
            Assert.That(executed.InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(activation.InstigatorId));
            Assert.That(executed.SourceId, Is.EqualTo(source));
            Assert.That(executed.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(source));
            Assert.That(executed.Values, Is.SameAs(values));
            Assert.That(activation.TargetData, Is.SameAs(oldTarget));
            Assert.That(observed.EventTag, Is.EqualTo(Signal));
            Assert.That(observed.InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(trigger.InstigatorId));
            Assert.That(observed.TargetId, Is.EqualTo(trigger.TargetId));
            Assert.That(observed.Magnitude, Is.EqualTo(9f));
            Assert.That(host.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]

                new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(.5f, new[] { condition }, target, new[] { action }),

        [Test]

            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => host.Sequences.Start(definition, host.Context(), host));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => host.Sequences.StartSkill(definition, host.Context(), default, host));
            Assert.That(host.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);

        [Test]

        {
            var host = new Host();

            var child = Schedule(.1f, new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(), new ActionNode((c,e,h) => {
                log.Add(2); return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; }));
            var parent = new GameplaySequenceDefinition(.5f, new GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition[] {
                new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(.5f, Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),
                    new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(), new[] { new ActionNode((c,e,h) => {
                        log.Add(1); host.Sequences.Clear(); host.Sequences.StartSkill(child, c, e, h);
                        return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; }) }),
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(.5f, new GameplayTag("Cue.Test.Cancelled")) });
            host.Sequences.StartSkill(parent, host.Context(), host.Event(), host);
            host.Sequences.StartSkill(child, host.Context(), host.Event(), host);

        private static GameplaySequenceDefinition Schedule(float time, IGameplaySkillTarget target, IGameplaySkillAction action) =>
            new GameplaySequenceDefinition(time, new[] { new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(time,
                Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(), target, new[] { action }) });
        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Boost() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
            new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 3f) });

        private sealed class Host : IGameplaySkillHost, IGameplaySequenceHost
        {

            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId WorldTarget;
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public GameplaySequenceContainer Sequences { get; } = new GameplaySequenceContainer();
            public Host() { OwnerId = Ids.Allocate(); WorldTarget = OwnerId; Attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, Ids, Tags); }
            public GameplayContext Context() => new GameplayContext(OwnerId, new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId));
            public GameplayEventData Event() => new GameplayEventData(Signal, OwnerId, OwnerId, 3f);
        }
        private sealed class Target : IGameplaySkillTarget
        {
            private readonly Func<IGameplaySkillHost, GameplayEventData, GameplayTargetData> _resolve;
            public int Calls;
            public Target(Func<IGameplaySkillHost, GameplayEventData, GameplayTargetData> resolve) { _resolve = resolve; }
            public GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData e) { Calls++; return _resolve(host, e); }
        }
        private sealed class Condition : IGameplaySkillCondition
        {
            private readonly Func<IGameplaySkillHost, GameplayEventData, bool> _evaluate;
            public int Calls;
            public Condition(Func<IGameplaySkillHost, GameplayEventData, bool> evaluate) { _evaluate = evaluate; }
            public bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData e) { Calls++; return _evaluate(host, e); }
        }
        private sealed class ActionNode : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            private readonly Func<GameplayContext, GameplayEventData, IGameplaySkillHost, GameplaySkillActionResult> _execute;
            public ActionNode(Func<GameplayContext, GameplayEventData, IGameplaySkillHost, GameplaySkillActionResult> execute) { _execute = execute; }
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext c, GameplayEventData e, IGameplaySkillHost h) => _execute(c,e,h);
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Sequence
{
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Charge = new GameplayTag("Cue.Test.Charge");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Release = new GameplayTag("Cue.Test.Release");

        [Test]
        public void StartRunsZeroOnlyAndAdvanceKeepsAuthoredOrderAtSameTime()
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            var markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition[] {
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(.5f, Release),
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(0f, Charge),
                new GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition(.5f, Boost()),
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(.5f, Charge) };
            var definition = new GameplaySequenceDefinition(.5f, markers);
            markers[0] = null;
            Assert.That(definition.Markers.Select(m => m.Time), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 0f, .5f, .5f, .5f }));
            var context = owner.Context();
            var handle = owner.Sequences.Start(definition, context, owner.Host);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Charge }));
            Assert.That(cues[0].Context, Is.SameAs(context));
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
            owner.Sequences.Advance(.49f);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            owner.Sequences.Advance(.01f);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Charge, Release, Charge }));
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(1f);
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void NewStartAfterAdvanceDoesNotConsumeOldDeltaAndPauseFreezesTime()
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            var definition = new GameplaySequenceDefinition(.05f,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(.05f, Release) });
            owner.Sequences.Advance(.1f);
            owner.Sequences.Start(definition, owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues, Is.Empty);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
            owner.Sequences.Advance(.05f);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Release }));
        }

        [Test]
        public void EffectLifetimeOutlivesSequenceAndClearDoesNotRemoveIt()
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            owner.Sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(.5f,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition(.5f, Boost()) }),
                owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(.5f);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f));
            owner.Sequences.Clear();
            owner.Effects.Advance(4.99f);
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f));
            owner.Effects.Advance(.02f);
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void CueMetadataAndMultipleStartsDrainOnceInStartOrder()
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            var definition = new GameplaySequenceDefinition(0f,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(0f, Charge, 2f, .5f) });
            var first = owner.Context();
            var second = owner.Context();
            owner.Sequences.Start(definition, first, owner.Host);
            owner.Sequences.Start(definition, second, owner.Host);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Count, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(cues[0].Context, Is.SameAs(first));
            Assert.That(cues[1].Context, Is.SameAs(second));
            Assert.That(cues[0].Magnitude, Is.EqualTo(2f));
            Assert.That(cues[0].Duration, Is.EqualTo(.5f));
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Count, Is.EqualTo(2));

        [TestCase(30, 250)]
        [TestCase(60, 500)]
        public void LongTimelineExecutesEndOnFinalFrameAndCompletesExactlyOnce(int rate, int frames)
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            float end = 250f / 30f;
            var handle = owner.Sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(end,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(end, Release) }), owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            for (int i = 1; i < frames; i++) owner.Sequences.Advance(1f / rate);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues, Is.Empty);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.IsActive(handle), Is.True);
            var snapshot = owner.Sequences.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Single();
            Assert.That(snapshot.Elapsed, Is.InRange(0f, end));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Single().Elapsed, Is.EqualTo(snapshot.Elapsed));
            owner.Sequences.Advance(1f / rate);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Release }));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(), Is.Empty);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(1f);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [TestCase(0)] [TestCase(1)] [TestCase(2)] [TestCase(3)]
        public void LongTimelinePartitionsKeepAllCrossedMarkersAndAuthoredOrder(int partition)
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            float end = 250f / 30f;
            var handle = owner.Sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(end,
                new GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition[] {
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(0, Charge),
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(7f / 30, Release),
                    new GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition(18f / 30, Boost()),
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(end, Release),
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(end, Charge) }), owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            if (partition == 0) owner.Sequences.Advance(end);
            else if (partition == 1)
            { owner.Sequences.Advance(249f / 30); owner.Sequences.Advance(1f / 30); }
            else
            {
                int rate = partition == 2 ? 30 : 60;
                int frames = partition == 2 ? 250 : 500;
                for (int i = 0; i < frames; i++) owner.Sequences.Advance(1f / rate);
            }
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Charge, Release, Release, Charge }));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(owner.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f));
            Assert.That(owner.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void FineTimelineDoesNotExecuteFutureMarkerEarly()
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            var handle = owner.Sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(.31f,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(.31f, Release) }), owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) owner.Sequences.Advance(1f / 30);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues, Is.Empty);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.IsActive(handle), Is.True);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(1f / 30);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Release }));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
        }

        [TestCase(4f / 30, 3f / 30, 1f / 30)]
        [TestCase(16f / 30, 7f / 30, 9f / 30)]
        [TestCase(22f / 30, 7f / 30, 15f / 30)]
        public void ShortPartitionsRetainFloatAuthoredBoundary(float end, float first, float second)
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            owner.Sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(end,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(end, Release) }), owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            owner.Sequences.Advance(first);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues, Is.Empty);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(second);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Release }));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
        }

        [TestCase(4f / 30)] [TestCase(250f / 30)]
        public void ImmediatelyPrecedingRepresentableAuthoredTimeDoesNotCrossMarker(float end)
        {
            var owner = new Owner();
            float preceding = BitConverter.Int32BitsToSingle(BitConverter.SingleToInt32Bits(end) - 1);
            var handle = owner.Sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(end,
                new[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(end, Release) }), owner.Context(), owner.Host);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(preceding);
            owner.Sequences.Advance(0);
            var cues = new List<GameplayCueRequest>();
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues, Is.Empty, "Even one representable float time before the marker is still future.");
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.IsActive(handle), Is.True);
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Single().Elapsed, Is.EqualTo(preceding));
            owner.Sequences.Advance(end - preceding);
            owner.Sequences.DrainCues(cues);
            Assert.That(cues.Select(c => c.CueTag), Is.EqualTo(new[] { Release }));
            Assert.That(owner.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
        }

        private static GameplayEffectDefinition Boost() => new GameplayEffectDefinition(
            GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
            new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 3f) });

        private sealed class Owner
        {
            private readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator _ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public readonly AttributeSet Attributes = new AttributeSet();
            public readonly GameplaySequenceContainer Sequences = new GameplaySequenceContainer();
            public readonly GameplayEffectContainer Effects;
            public readonly GameplaySkillOwnerHost Host;
            public Owner()
            {
                Attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
                var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, _ids, tags);
                Host = new GameplaySkillOwnerHost(_ids.Allocate(), tags, Attributes, Effects);
            }
            public GameplayContext Context() => new GameplayContext(Host.OwnerId, new GameplayTargetData(Host.OwnerId));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Skill
{
    public sealed class GameplaySkillIntervalAndAttributeTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Signal = new GameplayTag("Trigger.Skill.Interval.Test");
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Attack.Test");

        [Test]
        public void AttributeCondition_ValidatesAndComparesCurrentValue()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(default,
                GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Less, 1f));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(Attack,
                GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Less, float.NaN));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(Attack,
                (GameplaySkillAttributeComparison)99, 1f));
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var host = Host(ids, 10f);
            host.Attributes.GetAttribute(Attack).AddModifier(new GameplayAttributeModifier(
                GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 5f, ids.Allocate()));
            Assert.That(new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(Attack, GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Less, 15f)
                .Evaluate(host, default), Is.False);
            Assert.That(new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(Attack, GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.LessOrEqual, 15f)
                .Evaluate(host, default), Is.True);
            Assert.That(new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(Attack, GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Greater, 10f)
                .Evaluate(host, default), Is.True);
            Assert.That(new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(Attack, GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.GreaterOrEqual, 15f)
                .Evaluate(host, default), Is.True);
            Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => new GameplaySkillAttributeCondition(
                new GameplayAttributeId("Missing"), GameplaySkillAttributeComparison.Less, 1f)
                .Evaluate(host, default));
        }

        [Test]
        public void Interval_ConsumesRejectedThresholdPreservesOverflowAndSeparatesOwners()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(default, 6f));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => new GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(Signal, 0f));
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var first = Host(ids, 10f);
            var second = Host(ids, 10f);
            var events = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var gate = new Gate { Open = false };
            var action = new Capture();
            var definition = new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(Signal, 6f),
                new[] { gate }, new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(), new[] { action }, false);
            using (var a = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, first, events))
            using (var b = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, second, events))
            {
                var bindingA = (GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition.Binding)a.TriggerBinding;
                var bindingB = (GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition.Binding)b.TriggerBinding;
                a.Advance(5.9f);
                Assert.That(a.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(bindingB.Remaining, Is.EqualTo(6f));
                a.Advance(.1f);
                Assert.That(a.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(bindingA.Remaining, Is.EqualTo(6f).Within(.0001f));
                gate.Open = true;
                a.Advance(13f);
                Assert.That(a.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
                Assert.That(bindingA.Remaining, Is.EqualTo(5f).Within(.0001f));
                Assert.That(action.Last.EventTag, Is.EqualTo(Signal));
                Assert.That(action.Last.InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(first.OwnerId));
                Assert.That(action.Last.TargetId.IsValid, Is.False);
                Assert.That(action.Last.Magnitude, Is.EqualTo(6f));
                b.Advance(6f);
                Assert.That(b.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(action.Last.InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(second.OwnerId));
                a.Dispose();
                a.Advance(6f);
                Assert.That(a.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
                Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() => b.Advance(float.NaN));
            }
        }

        private static GameplaySkillOwnerHost Host(GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids, float attack)
        {
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            attributes.Register(Attack, attack);
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            return new GameplaySkillOwnerHost(ids.Allocate(), tags, attributes,
                new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, ids, tags));
        }

        private sealed class Gate : IGameplaySkillCondition
        {
            public bool Open;
            public bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent) => Open;
        }

        private sealed class Capture : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            public GameplayEventData Last;
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
            {
                Last = triggerEvent;
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Skill
{
    public sealed class GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Fired = new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Weapon.Fired");

        [Test]
        public void SharedDefinition_CountsOnlyOwnerResetsBeforeCallbackAndCarriesThresholdEvent()
        {
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(() =>
                new GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerDefinition(Fired, 0));
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var events = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var ownerA = ids.Allocate();
            var ownerB = ids.Allocate();
            var trigger = new GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerDefinition(Fired, 5);
            var condition = new GateCondition { Open = false };
            var target = new CapturingSelfTarget();
            var action = new CapturingAction();
            var definition = new GameplaySkillDefinition(trigger, new[] { condition }, target,
                new[] { action }, once: false);
            using (var first = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, Host(ownerA, ids), events))
            using (var second = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, Host(ownerB, ids), events))
            {
                var a = (GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerDefinition.Binding)first.TriggerBinding;
                var b = (GameplaySkillOwnerEventCountTriggerDefinition.Binding)second.TriggerBinding;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) events.Publish(Event(ownerA, i));
                events.Publish(Event(ownerB, 10));
                Assert.That(a.CurrentCount, Is.EqualTo(4));
                Assert.That(b.CurrentCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                events.Publish(Event(ownerA, 5));
                Assert.That(a.CurrentCount, Is.Zero, "The threshold is consumed even when a condition rejects execution.");
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);

                condition.Open = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) events.Publish(Event(ownerA, i));
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                var fifth = Event(ownerA, 55);
                events.Publish(fifth);
                Assert.That(a.CurrentCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(second.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(target.LastEvent, Is.EqualTo(fifth));
                Assert.That(action.LastEvent, Is.EqualTo(fifth));
                Assert.That(action.LastContext.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(ownerA));

                for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) events.Publish(Event(ownerA, i));
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
                Assert.That(a.CurrentCount, Is.Zero);
                first.Dispose();
                events.Publish(Event(ownerA, 99));
                Assert.That(a.CurrentCount, Is.Zero);
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) events.Publish(Event(ownerB, i));
                Assert.That(second.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(b.CurrentCount, Is.Zero);
            }
        }

        private static IGameplaySkillHost Host(GameplaySourceId owner, GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids)
        {
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            return new GameplaySkillOwnerHost(owner, tags, attributes,
                new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, ids, tags));
        }

        private static GameplayEventData Event(GameplaySourceId owner, float magnitude) =>
            new GameplayEventData(Fired, owner, default, magnitude);

        private sealed class GateCondition : IGameplaySkillCondition
        {
            public bool Open;
            public bool Evaluate(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent) => Open;
        }

        private sealed class CapturingSelfTarget : IGameplaySkillTarget
        {
            public GameplayEventData LastEvent;
            public GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent)
            {
                LastEvent = triggerEvent;
                return new GameplayTargetData(host.OwnerId);
            }
        }

        private sealed class CapturingAction : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            public GameplayEventData LastEvent;
            public GameplayContext LastContext;
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
            {
                LastEvent = triggerEvent;
                LastContext = context;
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Skill
{
    /// <summary>Guards immutable carry, exactly-one branch and nested cancellation; child visuals are verified in the permanent Lab.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplaySkillRuleFlowTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Key=new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Flow");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Signal=new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Flow");
        private sealed class Host : IGameplaySkillHost,IGameplaySkillTraceSink
        {
            public readonly List<GameplaySkillTraceRecord> Trace=new List<GameplaySkillTraceRecord>();
            public bool ThrowTrace;
            public void RecordSkillTrace(GameplaySkillTraceRecord record){if(ThrowTrace)throw new InvalidOperationException("diagnostic failure");Trace.Add(record);}
            public GameplaySourceIdAllocator Ids { get; }=new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId=>OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; }=new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }=new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public Host() { OwnerId=Ids.Allocate(); Effects=new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes,Ids,Tags); }
            public GameplayContext Context()=>new GameplayContext(OwnerId,new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId));
            public GameplayEventData Event()=>new GameplayEventData(Signal,OwnerId,OwnerId,7);
        }
        private sealed class Legacy : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            private readonly Func<GameplayContext,GameplaySkillActionResult> _run;
            public Legacy(Func<GameplayContext,GameplaySkillActionResult> run) { _run=run; }
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData evt,IGameplaySkillHost host)=>_run(context);
        }
        private sealed class ContextAction : IGameplaySkillAction,IGameplaySkillContextAction
        {
            private readonly Func<GameplayContext,GameplaySkillActionExecution> _run;
            public ContextAction(Func<GameplayContext,GameplaySkillActionExecution> run) { _run=run; }
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData evt,IGameplaySkillHost host)=>throw new AssertionException("Context interface was not used");
            public GameplaySkillActionExecution ExecuteWithContext(GameplayContext context,GameplayEventData evt,IGameplaySkillHost host)=>_run(context);
        }
        private static Legacy Read(Action<GameplayContext> action)=>new Legacy(c=> { action(c); return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; });

        [Test]
        public void LegacyRunnerAndSkillKeepOrderContextAndOwnerEventSemantics()
        {
            var h=new Host(); var order=new List<int>(); GameplayContext first=null;
            var actions=new IGameplaySkillAction[] { Read(c=> { first=c; order.Add(1); }),Read(c=> { Assert.That(c,Is.SameAs(first)); order.Add(2); }) };
            var input=h.Context(); var execution=GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(actions,input,h.Event(),h);
            Assert.That(execution.Context,Is.SameAs(input)); Assert.That(order,Is.EqualTo(new[]{1,2})); order.Clear();
            var events=new GameplayEventDispatcher(); var definition=new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(Signal),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),actions,false);
            using(var skill=new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition,h,events))
            {
                events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(Signal,input.WithSource(h.Ids.Allocate()),9));
                Assert.That(order,Is.EqualTo(new[]{1,2})); Assert.That(skill.LastExecutionContext,Is.SameAs(first));
                Assert.That(skill.LastExecutionContext.SourceId,Is.EqualTo(h.OwnerId),"Ordinary Skill still constructs its owner context.");
                Assert.That(skill.LastExecutionContext.Values.GetRequiredValue(GameplayContextValues.TriggerMagnitudeKey),Is.EqualTo(9));
            }
        }
        [Test]
        public void ContextOutputFeedsNextActionAndRejectedStopsWithoutChangingInput()
        {
            var h=new Host(); var input=h.Context(); var child=h.Ids.Allocate(); var target=new GameplayTargetData(h.Ids.Allocate()); int calls=0;
            var actions=new IGameplaySkillAction[] {
                new ContextAction(c=>new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded,c.WithSource(child).WithTarget(target).WithValues(c.Values.WithValue(Key,42)))),
                Read(c=> { calls++; Assert.That(c.SourceId,Is.EqualTo(child)); Assert.That(c.TargetData,Is.SameAs(target)); Assert.That(c.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(42)); }),
                new ContextAction(c=>new GameplaySkillActionExecution(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected,c)),Read(c=>calls++) };
            var result=new GameplayContinuationDefinition(actions).Execute(input,h.Event(),h);
            Assert.That(result.Result,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected)); Assert.That(calls,Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(input.SourceId.IsValid,Is.False); Assert.That(input.Values.TryGetValue(Key,out _),Is.False);
            Assert.That(h.Trace.Count,Is.EqualTo(6));Assert.That(h.Trace[1].Context.SourceId,Is.EqualTo(child));Assert.That(h.Trace[5].Stage,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillTraceStage.ActionRejected));
            h.ThrowTrace=true;
            Assert.That(new GameplayContinuationDefinition(actions).Execute(input,h.Event(),h).Result,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected),"Diagnostic failures never change ordered execution or rejection.");
            var ruleError=new InvalidOperationException("actual rule error");
            Assert.That(Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(new IGameplaySkillAction[]{new Legacy(c=>throw ruleError)},input,h.Event(),h)),Is.SameAs(ruleError));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(new IGameplaySkillAction[]{new ContextAction(c=>default)},input,h.Event(),h));
            var events=new GameplayEventDispatcher(); var skillDefinition=new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(Signal),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),new IGameplaySkillAction[]{new GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction(Key,25)},false);
            using(var skill=new GameplaySkillRuntime(skillDefinition,h,events)) { events.Publish(h.Event()); Assert.That(skill.LastExecutionContext.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(25)); }
        }
        [TestCase(2,20)][TestCase(3,30)]
        public void BranchChoosesExactlyOneAndMergeReadsItsOutput(int inputValue,int expected)
        {
            var h=new Host(); var context=h.Context().WithValues(GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(Key,inputValue)); int yes=0,no=0,merge=0;
            var branch=new GameplaySkillBranchAction(new GameplaySkillContextValueCondition(Key,GameplaySkillContextComparison.Equal,2),
                new IGameplaySkillAction[]{Read(c=>yes++),new GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction(Key,20)},
                new IGameplaySkillAction[]{Read(c=>no++),new GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction(Key,30)});
            var result=GameplaySkillActionRunner.Execute(new IGameplaySkillAction[]{branch,Read(c=> { merge++; Assert.That(c.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(expected)); })},context,h.Event(),h);
            Assert.That(yes,Is.EqualTo(inputValue==2?1:0)); Assert.That(no,Is.EqualTo(inputValue==3?1:0)); Assert.That(merge,Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(result.Context.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(expected)); Assert.That(context.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(inputValue));
            var empty=new GameplaySkillBranchAction(new GameplaySkillContextValueCondition(Key,GameplaySkillContextComparison.Equal,inputValue),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillAction>(),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillAction>());
            Assert.That(empty.ExecuteWithContext(context,h.Event(),h).Context,Is.SameAs(context));
        }
        [Test]
        public void RichEventAndDerivationPreserveIdentityGeometryAndImmutableScalars()
        {
            var h=new Host(); var target=h.Ids.Allocate(); var original=h.Context().WithValues(GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(Key,5));
            var data=new GameplayTargetData(target,new GameplayPoint(4,2),new GameplayArea(new GameplayPoint(4,2),3),new[]{target,h.OwnerId});
            var child=original.WithSource(h.Ids.Allocate()).WithTarget(data).WithValues(original.Values.WithValue(Key,9));
            var events=new GameplayEventDispatcher(); GameplayEventData observed=default; events.Subscribe(Signal,e=>observed=e);
            events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(Signal,child,10));
            Assert.That(observed.Context,Is.SameAs(child)); Assert.That(observed.InstigatorId,Is.EqualTo(original.InstigatorId)); Assert.That(observed.TargetId,Is.EqualTo(target));
            Assert.That(observed.Context.TargetData,Is.SameAs(data)); Assert.That(observed.Context.TargetData.Point.X,Is.EqualTo(4)); Assert.That(data.Targets.Count,Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(observed.Context.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(9)); Assert.That(original.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(5));
            Assert.That(child.WithSource(default).EffectiveSourceId,Is.EqualTo(original.InstigatorId)); Assert.That(h.Event().HasContext,Is.False);
        }
        [TestCase("Cancel")][TestCase("Clear")]
        public void SkillStepDataflowStaysLocalAndNestedBranchHonorsCancellation(string termination)
        {
            var h=new Host(); var sequences=new GameplaySequenceContainer(); var root=h.Context().WithValues(GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(Key,1));
            GameplayContext first=null,second=null;
            Func<float,IGameplaySkillAction[],GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition> step=(time,actions)=>new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(time,Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),actions);
            var definition=new GameplaySequenceDefinition(2,new GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition[]{
                step(1,new IGameplaySkillAction[]{new GameplaySkillSetContextValueAction(Key,8),Read(c=>first=c)}),step(2,new IGameplaySkillAction[]{Read(c=>second=c)}) });
            sequences.StartSkill(definition,root,h.Event(),h); sequences.Advance(2);
            Assert.That(first.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(8)); Assert.That(second.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(1)); Assert.That(root.Values.GetRequiredValue(Key),Is.EqualTo(1));
            int pending=0; GameplaySequenceHandle handle=default; var branch=new GameplaySkillBranchAction(new GameplaySkillContextValueCondition(Key,GameplaySkillContextComparison.Equal,1),
                new IGameplaySkillAction[]{Read(c=> { if(termination=="Cancel") sequences.Cancel(handle); else sequences.Clear(); }),Read(c=>pending++)},Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillAction>());
            handle=sequences.StartSkill(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(2,new GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition[]{step(1,new IGameplaySkillAction[]{branch,Read(c=>pending++)}),step(2,new IGameplaySkillAction[]{Read(c=>pending++)})}),root,h.Event(),h);
            sequences.Advance(2); Assert.That(pending,Is.Zero); Assert.That(sequences.ActiveCount,Is.Zero);
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Skill
{
    public sealed class GameplaySkillRuntimeTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Attack = new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Attack");
        private static readonly GameplayTag BattleStart = new GameplayTag("Event.Test.BattleStart");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Ready = new GameplayTag("State.Ready");

        [Test]
        public void RejectedEffectStopsLaterActionsAndConsumesTimerWithoutSuccessCue()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var ownerId = ids.Allocate();
            var tags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var attributes = new AttributeSet();
            attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
            var effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(attributes, ids, tags);
            var blocked = new GameplayTag("State.Test.Blocked");
            var noBlocked = new GameplayTagQuery(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), new[] { blocked });
            var effect = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f, 0f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Add, 2f) },
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(), null, noBlocked);
            var later = new CountingAction();
            var definition = new GameplaySkillDefinition(
                new GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(BattleStart, 3f),
                Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(), new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),
                new IGameplaySkillAction[] { new GameplaySkillApplyEffectAction(effect), later }, false);
            int cues = 0;
            var skillHost = new GameplaySkillOwnerHost(ownerId, tags, attributes, effects);
            using (var skill = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, skillHost,
                       new GameplayEventDispatcher(), _ => cues++))
            {
                var source = ids.Allocate();
                tags.AddTag(blocked, source);
                skill.Advance(3f);
                Assert.That(skill.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(cues, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(later.Calls, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
                tags.RemoveTag(blocked, source);
                skill.Advance(2f);
                Assert.That(skill.ActivationCount, Is.Zero, "Rejected timer interval was consumed.");
                skill.Advance(1f);
                Assert.That(skill.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(cues, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(later.Calls, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(attributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(12f));
            }
        }

        private sealed class CountingAction : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            public int Calls;
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context,
                GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
            {
                Calls++;
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void SharedDefinition_ConditionsSelfOnceAndDisposeRemainPerOwner()
        {
            var boost = new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 5f,
                new[] { new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Attack, GameplayModifierOperation.Multiply, 1.3f) });
            var conditions = new List<IGameplaySkillCondition>
                { new GameplaySkillTagCondition(new[] { Ready }, Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()) };
            var actions = new List<IGameplaySkillAction> { new GameplaySkillApplyEffectAction(boost) };
            var definition = new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(BattleStart), conditions,
                new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(), actions, true);
            conditions.Clear();
            actions.Clear();
            Assert.That(definition.Conditions.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(definition.Actions.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(BattleStart),
                Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(), new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),
                Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillAction>(), true));
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var events = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var firstAttributes = new AttributeSet();
            firstAttributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
            var secondAttributes = new AttributeSet();
            secondAttributes.Register(Attack, 20f);
            var firstTags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var secondTags = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var firstId = ids.Allocate();
            var secondId = ids.Allocate();
            var firstEffects = new GameplayEffectContainer(firstAttributes, ids, firstTags);
            var secondEffects = new GameplayEffectContainer(secondAttributes, ids, secondTags);
            GameplayContext firstContext = null;
            GameplayContext secondContext = null;
            using (var first = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition,
                       new GameplaySkillOwnerHost(firstId, firstTags, firstAttributes, firstEffects), events,
                       context => firstContext = context))
            using (var second = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition,
                       new GameplaySkillOwnerHost(secondId, secondTags, secondAttributes, secondEffects), events,
                       context => secondContext = context))
            {
                firstTags.AddTag(Ready, ids.Allocate());
                events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Unrelated"), default, default, 0f));
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(BattleStart, default, default, 0f));
                Assert.That(firstAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(13f).Within(.0001f));
                Assert.That(secondAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(20f));
                Assert.That(firstContext.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(firstId));
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                secondTags.AddTag(Ready, ids.Allocate());
                events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(BattleStart, default, default, 0f));
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(second.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(secondContext.EffectiveSourceId, Is.EqualTo(secondId));
                Assert.That(secondAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(26f).Within(.0001f));
                firstEffects.Advance(5f);
                Assert.That(firstAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
            }
            events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(BattleStart, default, default, 0f));
            Assert.That(firstAttributes.GetCurrentValue(Attack), Is.EqualTo(10f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void OwnerScopedTrigger_PreservesEventThroughTargetAndTypedHostActions()
        {
            var ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var events = new GameplayEventDispatcher();
            var ownerA = new ProbeHost(ids.Allocate(), ids);
            var ownerB = new ProbeHost(ids.Allocate(), ids);
            var targetA = ids.Allocate();
            var targetB = ids.Allocate();
            var trigger = new OwnerScopedTriggerDefinition(BattleStart);
            var target = new EventTarget();
            var actionA = new HostAction();
            var actionB = new HostAction();
            var definition = new GameplaySkillDefinition(trigger, Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(), target,
                new IGameplaySkillAction[] { actionA, actionB }, true);
            GameplayContext successContext = null;
            using (var first = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, ownerA, events,
                       context => successContext = context))
            using (var second = new GameplaySkillRuntime(definition, ownerB, events))
            {
                var firstBinding = (OwnerScopedTriggerDefinition.Binding)first.TriggerBinding;
                var secondBinding = (OwnerScopedTriggerDefinition.Binding)second.TriggerBinding;
                Assert.That(firstBinding, Is.Not.SameAs(secondBinding));

                var firstEvent = new GameplayEventData(BattleStart, ownerA.OwnerId, targetA, 7f);
                events.Publish(firstEvent);
                Assert.That(firstBinding.AcceptedCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(secondBinding.AcceptedCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(first.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(second.ActivationCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(target.LastEvent, Is.EqualTo(firstEvent));
                Assert.That(successContext.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(targetA));
                Assert.That(actionA.LastEvent, Is.EqualTo(firstEvent));
                Assert.That(actionA.LastContext, Is.SameAs(actionB.LastContext));
                Assert.That(actionA.LastContext, Is.SameAs(successContext));
                Assert.That(successContext.Values.GetRequiredValue(
                    GameplayContextValues.TriggerMagnitudeKey), Is.EqualTo(7f));
                Assert.That(ownerA.FireCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
                Assert.That(ownerB.FireCount, Is.Zero);

                events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(BattleStart, ownerB.OwnerId, targetB, 3f));
                Assert.That(firstBinding.AcceptedCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(secondBinding.AcceptedCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(second.ActivationCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(ownerB.FireCount, Is.EqualTo(2));
                first.Dispose();
                events.Publish(firstEvent);
                Assert.That(firstBinding.AcceptedCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
            }
        }

        private interface IProbeActionHost
        {
            void Fire(GameplayContext context);
        }

        private sealed class ProbeHost : IGameplaySkillHost, IProbeActionHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public int FireCount { get; private set; }

            public ProbeHost(GameplaySourceId ownerId, GameplaySourceIdAllocator ids)
            {
                OwnerId = ownerId;
                Attributes.Register(Attack, 10f);
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, ids, Tags);
            }

            public void Fire(GameplayContext context)
            {
                Assert.That(context.InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(OwnerId));
                FireCount++;
            }
        }

        private sealed class OwnerScopedTriggerDefinition : IGameplaySkillTriggerDefinition
        {
            private readonly GameplayTag _eventTag;

            public OwnerScopedTriggerDefinition(GameplayTag eventTag) => _eventTag = eventTag;

            public IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding Bind(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventDispatcher events,
                Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered) => new Binding(host.OwnerId, _eventTag, events, onTriggered);

            public sealed class Binding : IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding
            {
                private readonly GameplayEventDispatcher _events;
                private readonly GameplayEventSubscriptionHandle _handle;
                private readonly GameplaySourceId _ownerId;
                private readonly Action<GameplayEventData> _onTriggered;
                public int AcceptedCount { get; private set; }

                public Binding(GameplaySourceId ownerId, GameplayTag eventTag, GameplayEventDispatcher events,
                    Action<GameplayEventData> onTriggered)
                {
                    _ownerId = ownerId;
                    _events = events;
                    _onTriggered = onTriggered;
                    _handle = events.Subscribe(eventTag, OnEvent);
                }

                private void OnEvent(GameplayEventData data)
                {
                    if (data.InstigatorId != _ownerId) return;
                    AcceptedCount++;
                    _onTriggered(data);
                }

                public void Dispose() => _events.Unsubscribe(_handle);
            }
        }

        private sealed class EventTarget : IGameplaySkillTarget
        {
            public GameplayEventData LastEvent { get; private set; }

            public GameplayTargetData Resolve(IGameplaySkillHost host, GameplayEventData triggerEvent)
            {
                LastEvent = triggerEvent;
                return new GameplayTargetData(triggerEvent.TargetId);
            }
        }

        private sealed class HostAction : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            public GameplayContext LastContext { get; private set; }
            public GameplayEventData LastEvent { get; private set; }

            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
            {
                LastContext = context;
                LastEvent = triggerEvent;
                ((IProbeActionHost)host).Fire(context);
                return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Tag
{
    public sealed class GameplayTagContainerTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void HierarchicalQueries_RespectSegmentBoundariesCaseAndStrictDescendants()
        {
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var container = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var stun = new GameplayTag("State.Control.Stun");
            var control = new GameplayTag("State.Control");

            Assert.That(stun.IsDescendantOf(control), Is.True);
            Assert.That(stun.IsDescendantOf(stun), Is.False);
            Assert.That(stun.IsDescendantOf(default(GameplayTag)), Is.False);
            Assert.That(new GameplayTag("State.Stunned").IsDescendantOf(new GameplayTag("State.Stun")), Is.False);

            Assert.That(container.AddTag(stun, allocator.Allocate()), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(new GameplayTag("State")), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(control), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(stun), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTagExact(stun), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTagExact(control), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(new GameplayTag("State.Control.Stunned")), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(new GameplayTag("state.control")), Is.False);

            var parentOnly = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var source = allocator.Allocate();
            parentOnly.AddTag(control, source);
            Assert.That(parentOnly.HasTag(stun), Is.False);
            parentOnly.AddTag(stun, source);
            Assert.That(parentOnly.RemoveTag(control, source), Is.True);
            Assert.That(parentOnly.HasTagExact(control), Is.False);
            Assert.That(parentOnly.HasTag(control), Is.True, "精确移除父贡献不能删除子贡献。");
        }

        [Test]
        public void SameExactTag_FromTwoSources_RemainsUntilBothContributionsAreRemoved()
        {
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var firstSource = allocator.Allocate();
            var secondSource = allocator.Allocate();
            var container = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var invincible = new GameplayTag("State.Invincible");

            Assert.That(container.AddTag(invincible, firstSource), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.AddTag(invincible, secondSource), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.RemoveTag(invincible, firstSource), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTagExact(invincible), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.RemoveTag(invincible, secondSource), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(invincible), Is.False);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RemoveTagsFromSource_RemovesExactContributionsAndPreservesOtherSource()
        {
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var removedSource = allocator.Allocate();
            var retainedSource = allocator.Allocate();
            var container = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var stun = new GameplayTag("State.Control.Stun");
            var haste = new GameplayTag("State.Buff.Haste");
            var barrier = new GameplayTag("State.Defense.Barrier");

            container.AddTag(stun, removedSource);
            container.AddTag(haste, removedSource);
            container.AddTag(stun, retainedSource);
            container.AddTag(barrier, retainedSource);

            Assert.That(container.RemoveTagsFromSource(removedSource), Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(container.HasTagExact(stun), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(haste), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.HasTag(new GameplayTag("State.Defense")), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.RemoveTagsFromSource(removedSource), Is.Zero);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DuplicateContribution_IsIdempotentAndOneRemoveClearsIt()
        {
            var allocator = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            var source = allocator.Allocate();
            var container = new GameplayTagContainer();
            var silenced = new GameplayTag("State.Control.Silenced");

            Assert.That(container.AddTag(silenced, source), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.AddTag(silenced, source), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.RemoveTag(silenced, source), Is.True);
            Assert.That(container.HasTagExact(silenced), Is.False);
            Assert.That(container.RemoveTag(silenced, source), Is.False);
        }
    }
}
````
