````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay
{
    /// <summary>Guards R0's actual clock regressions without duplicating the existing container suites.</summary>
    public sealed class GameplayRuleClockBoundaryTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayTag Signal = new GameplayTag("Test.Clock.Interval");
        private static readonly GameplayTag Active = new GameplayTag("Test.Clock.Active");

        [TestCase("coarse")]
        [TestCase("30fps")]
        [TestCase("60fps")]
        [TestCase("irregular")]
        [TestCase("exact")]
        [TestCase("previous-float")]
        public void SharedBoundaryMatrix_UsesAuthoredFloatCrossing(string partition)
        {
            var finite = new Host();
            var infinite = new Host();
            var ability = finite.Grant(1);
            finite.Cast(ability);
            int intervals = 0;
            using (var binding = new GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(Signal, 3f)
                .Bind(finite, new GameplayEventDispatcher(), e => intervals++))
            {
                var plain = finite.Effects.Apply(new GameplayEffectDefinition(
                    GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 3f, Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>()));
                var periodic = finite.StartPeriodic();
                var perpetual = infinite.StartPeriodic(infinite: true);
                var sequences = new GameplaySequenceContainer();
                var sequence = sequences.Start(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(3f,
                    new GameplaySequenceMarkerDefinition[] { new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerDefinition(3f, Signal) }),
                    finite.Application.Context, finite);
                double elapsed = 0d;
                foreach (float delta in Partition(partition))
                {
                    elapsed += delta;
                    finite.Abilities.Advance(delta);
                    ((IGameplaySkillAdvanceableTriggerBinding)binding).Advance(delta);
                    finite.Effects.Advance(delta);
                    infinite.Effects.Advance(delta);
                    sequences.Advance(delta);
                    bool due = (float)elapsed >= 3f;
                    Assert.That(finite.Abilities.GetStatus(ability).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(due ? 1 : 0), "Charge");
                    Assert.That(intervals, Is.EqualTo(due ? 1 : 0), "Interval");
                    Assert.That(finite.Effects.IsActive(plain), Is.EqualTo(!due), "Duration");
                    Assert.That(sequences.IsActive(sequence), Is.EqualTo(!due), "Sequence");
                    Assert.That(finite.Effects.IsActive(periodic), Is.EqualTo(!due), "Periodic expiry");
                    int expectedTicks = (float)elapsed >= 3f ? 3 : (float)elapsed >= 2f ? 2 : (float)elapsed >= 1f ? 1 : 0;
                    Assert.That(finite.Ticks, Is.EqualTo(expectedTicks), "Finite periodic");
                    Assert.That(infinite.Ticks, Is.EqualTo(expectedTicks), "Infinite periodic");
                    Assert.That(infinite.Effects.IsActive(perpetual), Is.True);
                    Assert.That(((GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition.Binding)binding).Remaining, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(0f));
                }
                // No replay when the same public boundary is observed without additional rule time.
                int ticks = infinite.Ticks;
                infinite.Effects.Advance(0f);
                Assert.That(infinite.Ticks, Is.EqualTo(ticks));
            }
        }

        [Test]
        public void RechargeAndInterval_CatchUpWithoutResetOrDisposedReplay()
        {
            var host = new Host();
            var ability = host.Grant(3);
            host.Cast(ability);
            host.Abilities.Advance(1f);
            host.Cast(ability); // Existing sequential recharge must retain its first second.
            host.Abilities.Advance(2f);
            Assert.That(host.Abilities.GetStatus(ability).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(host.Abilities.GetStatus(ability).RechargeRemaining, Is.EqualTo(3f));
            host.Cast(ability);
            host.Abilities.Advance(6.5f);
            Assert.That(host.Abilities.GetStatus(ability).CurrentCharges, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(host.Abilities.GetStatus(ability).RechargeRemaining, Is.Zero);
            host.Cast(ability); // Catch-up remainder from a full grant must not become ghost progress.
            Assert.That(host.Abilities.GetStatus(ability).RechargeRemaining, Is.EqualTo(3f));

            var payloads = new List<GameplayEventData>();
            IGameplaySkillTriggerBinding binding = null;
            binding = new GameplaySkillIntervalTriggerDefinition(Signal, 3f)
                .Bind(host, new GameplayEventDispatcher(), e =>
                {
                    payloads.Add(e);
                    if (payloads.Count == 2) binding.Dispose();
                });
            ((IGameplaySkillAdvanceableTriggerBinding)binding).Advance(10f);
            Assert.That(payloads.Count, Is.EqualTo(2), "Dispose inside callback stops the remaining catch-up.");
            Assert.That(payloads[0].EventTag, Is.EqualTo(Signal));
            Assert.That(payloads[0].InstigatorId, Is.EqualTo(host.OwnerId));
            Assert.That(payloads[0].Magnitude, Is.EqualTo(3f));
            ((IGameplaySkillAdvanceableTriggerBinding)binding).Advance(10f);
            Assert.That(payloads.Count, Is.EqualTo(2));
        }

        [Test]
        public void PeriodicProjection_PreservesPreciseProgressAndFinalCleanupOrder()
        {
            var finite = new Host();
            var handle = finite.StartPeriodic(completion: true);
            var infinite = new Host();
            infinite.StartPeriodic(infinite: true);
            foreach (float delta in Partition("irregular"))
            {
                finite.Effects.Advance(delta);
                infinite.Effects.Advance(delta);
            }
            Assert.That(finite.Order, Is.EqualTo(new[] { "tick", "tick", "tick", "completion" }));
            Assert.That(finite.Effects.IsActive(handle), Is.False);
            Assert.That(finite.Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.False);
            finite.Effects.Advance(10f);
            Assert.That(finite.Order.Count, Is.EqualTo(4));

            // The irregular sum is just below 3d, although its public float projection is 3f.
            // Snapping Elapsed to a due 3/4/5 boundary would invent a sixth tick in the next step.
            infinite.Effects.Advance(2f);
            infinite.Effects.Advance(.9999997615814209f);
            Assert.That(infinite.Ticks, Is.EqualTo(5), "Float projection must never feed back into accumulated time.");
        }

        private static IEnumerable<float> Partition(string partition)
        {
            if (partition == "coarse") { yield return 3f; yield break; }
            if (partition == "exact") { yield return 2.5f; yield return .5f; yield break; }
            if (partition == "previous-float") { yield return 2.9999997615814209f; yield break; }
            if (partition == "irregular")
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++)
                { yield return .013f; yield return .047f; yield return .11f; yield return .03f; }
                yield break;
            }
            int steps = partition == "30fps" ? 90 : 180;
            float delta = partition == "30fps" ? 1f / 30f : 1f / 60f;
            for (int i = 0; i < steps; i++) yield return delta;
        }

        private sealed class Host : IGameplayAbilityHost, IGameplaySkillHost,
            IGameplayEffectExecution, IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
        {
            private readonly GameplaySourceIdAllocator _ids = new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId => OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; } = new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; } = new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public GameplayAbilityContainer Abilities { get; }
            public GameplayEffectApplicationContext Application { get; }
            public readonly List<string> Order = new List<string>();
            public int Ticks;

            public Host()
            {
                OwnerId = _ids.Allocate();
                Effects = new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes, _ids, Tags);
                Abilities = new GameplayAbilityContainer(this, _ids);
                Application = new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(OwnerId,
                    new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId)), this, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);
            }

            public GameplayAbilityHandle Grant(int charges) => Abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(
                Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                charge: new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(charges, 3f)));

            public void Cast(GameplayAbilityHandle handle)
            { Assert.That(Abilities.TryActivate(handle), Is.True); Abilities.End(handle); }

            public GameplayEffectHandle StartPeriodic(bool infinite = false, bool completion = false) =>
                Effects.Apply(new GameplayEffectDefinition(infinite ? GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite :
                    GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, 3f, 1f, Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),
                    new[] { Active }, new IGameplayEffectExecution[] { this }, null,
                    completionExecutions: completion ? new IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution[] { this } : null),
                    Application).ActiveHandle;

            public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext application)
            { Assert.That(Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.True); Ticks++; Order.Add("tick"); }

            public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext completion)
            {
                Assert.That(Effects.IsActive(completion.Handle), Is.False);
                Assert.That(Tags.HasTagExact(Active), Is.False);
                Order.Add("completion");
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay
{
    public sealed class GameplayShieldContributionTests
    {
        /// <summary>Prevents expired/cancelled shields from subtracting later or unowned capacity;
        /// a failing hit must leave both actual balance and per-source remaining amounts intact.</summary>
        [Test]
        public void ConsumedShieldExpiryAndExactCleanupPreserveOtherCapacity()
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
            {
                var caster=world.CreateActor(default);var target=world.CreateActor(default);
                var hp=new GameplayAttributeId("Health");var max=new GameplayAttributeId("MaxHealth");var shield=new GameplayAttributeId("Shield");
                target.Attributes.Register(hp,100);target.Attributes.Register(max,100);target.Attributes.Register(shield,20);
                target.CombatAttributes=new GameplayCombatAttributeMap(hp,max,shield,default);
                var callerKey=new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Shield.Amount");
                var context=new GameplayContext(caster.Id,new GameplayTargetData(target.Id),abilityLevel:5,values:GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(callerKey,50));
                new GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction(new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(callerKey),N(2)).Execute(context,default,caster);
                new GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction(N(60),N(4)).Execute(context,default,caster);
                var entries=target.Shields.Snapshot();Assert.That(entries.Count,Is.EqualTo(2));
                var application=new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context,target,GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty,caster.Attributes,caster.Id,instigatorTarget:caster);
                var absorption=new GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield);
                new GameplayDamageExecution(N(70),new[]{absorption}).Execute(application);
                Assert.That(entries[0].Remaining,Is.Zero);Assert.That(entries[1].Remaining,Is.EqualTo(40));
                Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(shield),Is.EqualTo(60));
                var invalid=new GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind.Scale,GameplayFormula.Compile("Context.Missing"));
                Assert.Throws<System.Collections.Generic.KeyNotFoundException>(()=>new GameplayDamageExecution(N(10),new[]{absorption,invalid}).Execute(application));
                Assert.That(entries[1].Remaining,Is.EqualTo(40));Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(shield),Is.EqualTo(60));
                world.Advance(2);Assert.That(entries[0].IsDisposed,Is.True);Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(shield),Is.EqualTo(60));
                entries[1].Dispose();entries[1].Dispose();Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(shield),Is.EqualTo(20));
                Assert.That(target.Shields.Snapshot().Count,Is.Zero);Assert.That(target.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Count,Is.Zero);
                var grant=caster.Abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
                Assert.That(caster.Abilities.TryActivate(grant),Is.True);
                caster.Abilities.TryCreateExecutionContext(grant,new GameplayTargetData(target.Id),out var cast);
                new GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction(N(30),N(1),true).Execute(cast,default,caster);
                world.Advance(1);Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(shield),Is.EqualTo(20));
                Assert.That(caster.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].OwnedLifetimesCount,Is.Zero,"Expiry must release the completed relation from the still-active cast.");
                new GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction(N(50),N(10),true).Execute(cast,default,caster);
                caster.Abilities.Cancel(grant);Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(shield),Is.EqualTo(20));
                Assert.That(target.Shields.Snapshot().Count,Is.Zero);
            }
        }
        private static IGameplayFloatValue N(float value)=>new GameplayConstantFloatValue(value);
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay
{

        [Test]
        public void GeometryAndFilteringUseStableUniqueOrderAndRealBoundaries()
        {
            using (var world = new GameplayStandardWorld())
            {
                var source = world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(0, 0), 1);
                var first = world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(2, 0), 2);
                var second = world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(2, 0), 2);
                var ally = world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(1, 0), 1);
                var geometry = new GameplaySearchGeometry(GameplaySearchShape.Sector, GameplaySpatialPlane.XY, source.Position, source.Facing, radius: 6, angle: 120);
                Assert.That(geometry.Contains(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(6, 0)), Is.True);
                Assert.That(geometry.Contains(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(3, 5.196152f)), Is.True);
                Assert.That(geometry.Contains(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(6.01f, 0)), Is.False);
                Assert.That(geometry.Contains(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(0, 2)), Is.False);
                var context = new GameplayContext(source.Id, new GameplayTargetData(source.Id));
                var request = new GameplaySpatialSearchRequest(context, geometry, 1, maxTargets: 2);
                Assert.That(request.Select(new IGameplaySpatialActor[] { second, second, ally, first, source }).Targets,
                    Is.EqualTo(new[] { first.Id, second.Id }));
                var cell = new GameplaySearchGeometry(GameplaySearchShape.GridCells, GameplaySpatialPlane.XZ, source.Position,
                    new GameplayDirection(1, 0), cells: new[] { new GameplayPoint(-.5f, 0, 2.5f) });
                Assert.That(cell.Contains(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(-.1f, 0, 2.1f)), Is.True);
                Assert.That(cell.Contains(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(.1f, 0, 2.1f)), Is.False);
                var anchor = new GameplayPoint(1, 0);
                var bound = world.CreateActor(anchor, 2, readPosition: () => anchor, writePosition: p => anchor = p);
                anchor = new GameplayPoint(4, 0);
                Assert.That(bound.Position.X, Is.EqualTo(4), "A physics/presentation binding cannot be a stale copied position.");
                bound.Position = new GameplayPoint(5, 0);
                Assert.That(anchor.X, Is.EqualTo(5), "Movement commits to the actual bound anchor.");
                var pointContext = new GameplayContext(source.Id, new GameplayTargetData(first.Id, new GameplayPoint(0,5)));
                var segment = new GameplaySearchTargetAction(GameplaySearchShape.Line, GameplaySpatialPlane.XY, GameplaySearchOrigin.Owner,
                    Number(1),Number(120),GameplayFormula.Compile("Context.UnusedLength"),Number(1),Number(1),
                    GameplayFactionFilter.Enemies,null,-1,32,GameplayTargetOrder.Nearest,false,null,null,null,
                    direction:GameplaySearchDirection.ToContextPoint,lengthFromTarget:true);
                Assert.That(segment.TryCreateRequest(pointContext,source,out var segmentRequest),Is.True);
                Assert.That(segmentRequest.Geometry.Length,Is.EqualTo(5));
                Assert.That(segmentRequest.Geometry.Contains(first.Id,new GameplayPoint(0,2)),Is.True);
                Assert.That(segmentRequest.Geometry.Contains(first.Id,new GameplayPoint(2,0)),Is.False);
                Assert.That(segment.TryCreateRequest(new GameplayContext(source.Id,new GameplayTargetData(first.Id,source.Position)),source,out _),Is.False,"Coincident endpoints cannot silently use facing.");
            }
        }

                Assert.That(committed.Context,Is.SameAs(captured));

                Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Health), Is.EqualTo(980));

                Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Health), Is.EqualTo(1000));
                Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Shield), Is.EqualTo(100));
                Assert.That(target.LastCombatOutcome.Value.Applied, Is.Zero, "Minimum must not pierce a fully absorbing shield.");
                var invalid = new GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind.Minimum, GameplayFormula.Compile("1 / Context.Missing"));
                Assert.Throws<KeyNotFoundException>(() => new GameplayDamageExecution(new GameplayConstantFloatValue(100), new[] { shield, invalid }).Execute(application));
                Assert.That(target.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Shield), Is.EqualTo(100), "Failing calculations cannot consume shield before HP commit.");
            }

        [Test]
        public void CausalCombatQueueDeliversRetaliationAndChainsAndBoundsOnlyTheCurrentLoop()
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
            {
                var a=world.CreateActor(default,1);var b=world.CreateActor(default,2);var c=world.CreateActor(default,2);
                foreach(var actor in new[]{a,b,c}) {Configure(actor);actor.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Shield,0);actor.SkillTrace.Enabled=true;}
                var order=new List<string>();
                Action<GameplayStandardActor,GameplayStandardActor,bool> strike=(from,to,noRetaliate)=>{
                    var values=noRetaliate?GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(GameplayCombatEvents.NoRetaliate,1):GameplayContextValues.Empty;
                    var context=new GameplayContext(from.Id,new GameplayTargetData(to.Id),values:values);
                    new GameplayDamageExecution(Number(10),Array.Empty<GameplayDamageStage>()).Execute(
                        new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context,to,GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty,from.Attributes,from.Id,instigatorTarget:from));
                };
                var hit=world.Events.Subscribe(GameplayCombatEvents.Hit,data=>{
                    order.Add(data.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId==b.Id?"B":data.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId==a.Id?"A":"C");
                    if(data.Context.Values.TryGetValue(GameplayCombatEvents.NoRetaliate,out float blocked)&&blocked>0)return;
                    if(data.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId==b.Id){strike(b,a,true);strike(b,c,true);}
                });
                strike(a,b,false);
                Assert.That(order,Is.EqualTo(new[]{"B","A","C"}),"Nested legal outcomes drain FIFO, shared buses receive each once.");
                foreach(var actor in new[]{a,b,c})Assert.That(actor.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Health),Is.EqualTo(990));
                world.Events.Unsubscribe(hit);order.Clear();
                int loopEvents=0;
                var loop=world.Events.Subscribe(GameplayCombatEvents.Hit,data=>{loopEvents++;strike(data.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId==a.Id?a:b,data.Context.TargetData.PrimaryTargetId==a.Id?b:a,false);});
                strike(a,b,false);
                Assert.That(loopEvents,Is.EqualTo(GameplayStandardWorld.CombatChainDepthLimit+1));
                Assert.That(world.LastCombatDispatchDiagnostic,Does.Contain("CombatChainBudgetExceeded"));
                loopEvents=0;
                var limited=new GameplayContext(a.Id,new GameplayTargetData(b.Id),values:GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(GameplayCombatEvents.MaxChainDepth,1));
                new GameplayDamageExecution(Number(10),Array.Empty<GameplayDamageStage>()).Execute(new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(limited,b,limited.Values.AsSetByCallerValues(),a.Attributes,a.Id,instigatorTarget:a));
                Assert.That(loopEvents,Is.EqualTo(2),"A root author may lower the chain limit without suppressing its legal first reaction.");
                Assert.That(world.LastCombatDispatchDiagnostic,Does.Contain("depth=2/1"));
                world.Events.Unsubscribe(loop);
                world.Events.Subscribe(GameplayCombatEvents.Hit,data=>order.Add("Independent"));
                strike(a,c,false);Assert.That(order,Is.EqualTo(new[]{"Independent"}),"Loop exhaustion cannot consume a later player's budget.");
            }
        }

                            GameplayTargetOrder.Nearest, false, new[] { new GameplayApplyToTargetsAction(buff, true) }, null, null) });
                var sequence = new GameplaySequenceDefinition(5, new[] { step });

                var installed = source.InstallDocument(new GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition(2010, ability, rules, signal, additionalRules: new[] { additional }), 5);
                Assert.That(installed.TryCast(), Is.True);
                world.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(signal, new GameplayContext(source.Id, new GameplayTargetData(source.Id)), 1));
                Assert.That(source.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.EqualTo(1), "An unrelated cast event from the same owner cannot replay this grant.");
                world.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(followup, new GameplayContext(target.Id, new GameplayTargetData(source.Id)), 7));
                Assert.That(observations, Is.EqualTo(1));

                world.Advance(8f / 30);
                var active = target.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(); Assert.That(active.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(active[0].ApplicationContext.AbilityLevel, Is.EqualTo(5));
                Assert.That(active[0].ApplicationContext.OriginSourceId, Is.EqualTo(installed.LastCastContext.OriginSourceId));
                Assert.That(target.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(active[0].Handle, out float remaining), Is.True);
                Assert.That(remaining, Is.EqualTo(2), "New marker target effect cannot consume the marker's past step.");
                world.Advance(2);
                Assert.That(target.Tags.HasTag(tag), Is.False);
                Assert.That(source.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].OwnedLifetimesCount, Is.EqualTo(3), "Expired foreign lease relation must release; two listeners/Sequence remain.");
                Assert.That(installed.Cancel(), Is.True);
                Assert.That(source.Sequences.ActiveCount, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(source.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].OwnedLifetimesCount, Is.Zero);
                world.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(followup, new GameplayContext(target.Id, new GameplayTargetData(source.Id)), 7));
                Assert.That(observations, Is.EqualTo(1), "Cancel must physically remove supplemental subscriptions.");
                var passiveActor=world.CreateActor(default);

                var passiveCooldown=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,1,0,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),new[]{new GameplayTag("Cooldown.Test.Passive")},Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(),null,durationValue:new GameplaySetByCallerFloatValue(inputKey));
                var passiveAbility=new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),passiveCooldown);
                var passive=passiveActor.InstallDocument(new GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition(2011,passiveAbility,rules,default,GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive,
                    defaults:GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(inputKey,3)));

        }
        /// <summary>Guards cross-actor reapplication against consuming pre-birth time, including
        /// independent layers, shared refresh/period reset and completion-born entries.</summary>
        [TestCase(false,false)][TestCase(true,false)][TestCase(false,true)][TestCase(true,true)]
        public void CrossActorEffectCallbacksShareBoundaryAndDoNotAgeNewbornEntries(bool reverse,bool independent)
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld()){
                var first=world.CreateActor(default);var second=world.CreateActor(default);
                var source=reverse?second:first;var target=reverse?first:second;
                var application=new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(source.Id,new GameplayTargetData(target.Id)),target,GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty);
                var ticks=new List<int>();int completed=0;
                var stacking=new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Test.World.Stack"),GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,2,
                    independent?GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh:GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.RefreshOnSuccessfulApplication,
                    GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.ResetOnSuccessfulApplication,GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject,
                    independent?GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.IndependentLayerLifetime:GameplayEffectStackLifetimePolicy.SharedEntryLifetime);
                var buff=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,.5f,.5f,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                    new[]{new CallbackExecution(a=>ticks.Add(a.StackCount))},stacking,completionExecutions:new[]{new CallbackCompletion(c=>completed++)});
                var handle=target.Effects.Apply(buff,application).ActiveHandle;
                GameplayEffectHandle newborn=default;
                var child=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,.1f,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>());
                var trigger=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,.25f,.25f,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                    new[]{new CallbackExecution(a=>{Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>source.Effects.Advance(0));target.Effects.Apply(buff,application);})},null,
                    completionExecutions:new[]{new CallbackCompletion(c=>newborn=target.Effects.Apply(child,application).ActiveHandle)});
                source.Effects.Apply(trigger,new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(new GameplayContext(source.Id,new GameplayTargetData(source.Id)),source,GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
                world.Advance(.6f);
                Assert.That(target.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(handle,out float remaining),Is.True);
                Assert.That(remaining,Is.EqualTo(.15f).Within(.000001f),"Refresh must anchor to the .25 callback, not the target's old or end-of-step clock.");
                Assert.That(target.Effects.TryGetPeriodRemaining(handle,out float period),Is.True);Assert.That(period,Is.EqualTo(.15f).Within(.000001f));
                Assert.That(target.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot()[0].StackCount,Is.EqualTo(independent?1:2));
                Assert.That(target.Effects.TryGetRemainingDuration(newborn,out float age),Is.True);Assert.That(age,Is.EqualTo(.1f));
                Assert.That(ticks,Is.Empty);world.Advance(.15f);
                Assert.That(ticks,Is.EqualTo(new[]{independent?1:2}));Assert.That(completed,Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(target.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(),Is.Empty);
            }
        }
        /// <summary>Prevents an initial postcommit exception from leaving an installed skill

        [Test]
        public void InstalledSkillCancelsPaidActivationWhenInitialExecutionThrows()
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld()){
                var actor=world.CreateActor(default,1);var mana=new GameplayAttributeId("Mana");actor.Attributes.Register(mana,20);
                var active=new GameplayTag("State.Test.R2.Initial");var cooling=new GameplayTag("Cooldown.Test.R2.Initial");int calls=0;
                var initial=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,3,1,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),new[]{active},
                    new IGameplayEffectExecution[]{new GameplayAttributeDeltaExecution(mana,Number(-10)),new CallbackExecution(a=>{calls++;throw new InvalidOperationException("Committed initial failure");})},null,
                    periodicStart:GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.ExecuteOnApplication);
                var cooldown=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,5,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),new[]{cooling});
                var ability=new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),cooldown,
                    cost:new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[]{new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(mana,Number(-5))}),activationEffects:new[]{initial});

                var rule=new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(signal),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),new[]{(IGameplaySkillAction)new ObserveAction(c=>{})},false);

                world.Advance(1);Assert.That(calls,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(actor.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot().Count,Is.EqualTo(1),"Only the paid cooldown survives.");
            }
        }

                Assert.That(actor.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(),Is.Empty);Assert.That(actor.Tags.HasTag(new GameplayTag("State.C1.Attempt")),Is.False);

                missing.Dispose();

                        cost:new RejectCommitCost(),activationEffects:new[]{effect}),rules,signal,defaults:defaults));

        /// <summary>Prevents binding a paid but already-ended grant, including passive re-engagement;
        /// an actual Damage event synchronously terminates it before TryActivate returns.</summary>
        [TestCase(false)] [TestCase(true)]
        public void InstalledSkillAcceptsInitialTerminationWithoutBindingOrCastEvent(bool passive)
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld()){
                var actor=world.CreateActor(default,1);Configure(actor);actor.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Shield,0);
                var mana=new GameplayAttributeId("Mana");actor.Attributes.Register(mana,20);actor.SkillTrace.Enabled=true;
                var initial=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,3,1,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                    new IGameplayEffectExecution[]{new GameplayDamageExecution(Number(10),Array.Empty<GameplayDamageStage>())},null,
                    periodicStart:GameplayEffectPeriodicStartPolicy.ExecuteOnApplication);
                var signal=new GameplayTag("Event.Test.C1.End");int ruleCalls=0,casts=0;
                var rules=new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(signal),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),
                    new[]{new ObserveAction(c=>ruleCalls++)},false);
                var skill=actor.InstallDocument(new GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition(2295,
                    new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                        charge:new GameplayAbilityChargeDefinition(2,8),cost:new GameplayAttributeAbilityCost(new[]{new GameplayAttributeCostEntry(mana,Number(-5))}),activationEffects:new[]{initial}),
                    rules,signal,passive?GameplayStandardActivationMode.Passive:GameplayStandardActivationMode.Active));
                // InstallDocument auto-engages passive content before this test can attach its observer.
                if(passive){skill.Cancel();world.Advance(8);actor.Attributes.SetBaseValue(mana,20);actor.SkillTrace.Clear();}
                var damage=world.Events.Subscribe(GameplayCombatEvents.Damage,e=>{if(passive)skill.Cancel();else actor.Abilities.End(skill.Grant);});
                var cast=world.Events.Subscribe(signal,e=>casts++);
                for(int i=0;i<2;i++){
                    Assert.That(passive?skill.ActivatePassive():skill.TryCast(),Is.True);
                    Assert.That(skill.Status.Phase,Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityPhase.Inactive));Assert.That(skill.Status.CurrentCharges,Is.EqualTo(1));
                    Assert.That(actor.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(mana),Is.EqualTo(20-5*(i+1)));Assert.That(skill.LastCastContext,Is.Null);
                    Assert.That(actor.Effects.GetActiveEntriesSnapshot(),Is.Empty);Assert.That(actor.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].OwnedLifetimesCount,Is.Zero);
                    world.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(signal,new GameplayContext(actor.Id,new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id)),1));
                    Assert.That(ruleCalls,Is.Zero);world.Advance(8);
                }
                Assert.That(casts,Is.EqualTo(2),"Only the two explicitly published test signals, never a dead-grant CastEvent.");
                Assert.That(actor.SkillTrace.Snapshot()[0].Item2.Operation,Is.EqualTo("ActivationEndedBeforeBinding"));
                world.Events.Unsubscribe(damage);world.Events.Unsubscribe(cast);
                Assert.That(passive?skill.ActivatePassive():skill.TryCast(),Is.True,"Normal activation remains reusable after removing the terminating observer.");
                Assert.That(skill.Status.Phase,Is.EqualTo(GameplayAbilityPhase.Active));
                if(passive)world.Events.Publish(new GameplayEventData(signal,new GameplayContext(actor.Id,new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id)),1));
                Assert.That(ruleCalls,Is.EqualTo(1));skill.Cancel();
            }
        }
        // Reused step buffers must preserve birth boundaries and recover after an interrupted callback.
        [Test]
        public void WorldStepSnapshotExcludesNewbornAndRecoversAfterCallbackThrows()
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld()){
                var first=world.CreateActor(default,1);int firstTicks=0,newbornTicks=0;bool fail=true;
                first.Behaviour=new CallbackBehaviour(()=>{
                    firstTicks++;
                    if(!fail)return;fail=false;
                    var newborn=world.CreateActor(default,2);
                    newborn.Behaviour=new CallbackBehaviour(()=>newbornTicks++);
                    Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>world.Advance(0));
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("interrupted step");
                });
                Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>world.Advance(.1f));
                Assert.That(newbornTicks,Is.Zero,"A newborn cannot receive the delta before its creation.");
                world.Advance(.1f);
                Assert.That(firstTicks,Is.EqualTo(2));Assert.That(newbornTicks,Is.EqualTo(1),"The next step must not retain duplicate snapshot entries.");
            }
        }
        private sealed class CallbackBehaviour:IGameplayBehaviourDriver
        {
            private readonly Action _advance;internal CallbackBehaviour(Action advance)=>_advance=advance;
            public string CurrentState=>"Test";public bool TryChangeState(string state)=>false;
            public void Advance(float amount)=>_advance();public void Dispose(){}
        }
        private sealed class RejectCommitCost:IGameplayAbilityCost
        {public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host)=>true;public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host)=>false;}
        private sealed class CallbackExecution:IGameplayEffectExecution
        {private readonly Action<GameplayEffectApplicationContext> _action;internal CallbackExecution(Action<GameplayEffectApplicationContext> action)=>_action=action;public void Execute(GameplayEffectApplicationContext context)=>_action(context);}
        private sealed class CallbackCompletion:IGameplayEffectCompletionExecution
        {private readonly Action<GameplayEffectCompletionContext> _action;internal CallbackCompletion(Action<GameplayEffectCompletionContext> action)=>_action=action;public void Execute(GameplayEffectCompletionContext context)=>_action(context);}
        [Test]
        public void DamageFollowupUsesEachCommittedHpLossWithoutReusingEarlierResults()
        {
            using var world = new GameplayStandardWorld();
            var source = world.CreateActor(default);
            var first = world.CreateActor(default);
            var second = world.CreateActor(default);
            Configure(source);
            Configure(first);
            Configure(second);
            source.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Health, 500);
            first.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Health, 20);
            first.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Shield, 0);
            var execution = new GameplayDamageExecution(Number(40),
                new[] { new GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield) },
                healInstigatorAmount: GameplayFormula.Compile("Context.Data.Standard.Combat.AppliedDamage * 0.35"));
            var heals = new List<GameplayCombatOutcome>();
            source.CombatChanged += heals.Add;
            var context = new GameplayContext(source.Id, new GameplayTargetData(first.Id), world.Sources.Allocate(),
                GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(GameplayDamageExecution.AppliedDamageKey, 1000));

            void Hit(GameplayStandardActor target) => execution.Execute(new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(
                context.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(target.Id)), target, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty,
                source.Attributes, source.Id, instigatorTarget: source));

            Hit(first);
            Hit(second);
            Hit(first);
            Assert.That(heals.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(heals[0].Applied, Is.EqualTo(7).Within(.001));
            Assert.That(heals[0].Context.ActivationSourceId, Is.EqualTo(context.ActivationSourceId));
            Assert.That(source.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Health), Is.EqualTo(507).Within(.001));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ShieldBreakConsumesTheLeaseAndUsesTheBreakerWithoutAnExpiryCallback()
        {
            using var world = new GameplayStandardWorld();
            var owner = world.CreateActor(default);
            var breaker = world.CreateActor(default);
            Configure(owner);
            Configure(breaker);
            owner.Attributes.SetBaseValue(Shield, 0);
            var broken = new List<GameplayContext>();
            var expired = new List<GameplayContext>();
            var grant = new GameplayGrantTimedShieldAction(Number(40), Number(1),
                onBroken: new[] { new ObserveAction(broken.Add) },
                onExpired: new[] { new ObserveAction(expired.Add) });
            var self = new GameplayContext(owner.Id, new GameplayTargetData(owner.Id));
            grant.Execute(self, default, owner);
            var hit = new GameplayContext(breaker.Id, new GameplayTargetData(owner.Id));
            var damage = new GameplayDamageExecution(Number(40), new[] { new GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind.Shield) });
            damage.Execute(new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(hit, owner, GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
            Assert.That(owner.Shields.Snapshot(), Is.Empty);
            Assert.That(broken.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(broken[0].TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(breaker.Id));
            world.Advance(2);
            Assert.That(expired, Is.Empty);

            grant.Execute(self, default, owner);
            world.Advance(1);
            Assert.That(expired.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(expired[0].TargetData.PrimaryTargetId, Is.EqualTo(owner.Id));
            grant.Execute(self, default, owner);
            owner.Effects.Remove(owner.Shields.Snapshot()[0].EffectHandle, GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Dispel);
            world.Advance(1);
            Assert.That(expired.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(broken.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        private static IGameplayFloatValue Number(float value) => new GameplayConstantFloatValue(value);
        private sealed class ObserveAction : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            private readonly Action<GameplayContext> _observe;
            internal ObserveAction(Action<GameplayContext> observe) => _observe = observe;
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext context, GameplayEventData triggerEvent, IGameplaySkillHost host)
            { _observe(context); return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; }
        }
        private static void Configure(GameplayStandardActor target)
        {
            target.Attributes.Register(Health, 1000); target.Attributes.Register(MaxHealth, 1000);
            target.Attributes.Register(Shield, 40); target.Attributes.Register(Defense, 100);
            target.CombatAttributes = new GameplayCombatAttributeMap(Health, MaxHealth, Shield, Defense);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
        [Test]
        public void SweptProjectileKeepsCastProvenanceAndDoesNotConsumeItsBirthStep()
        {
            using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
            {
                var caster=world.CreateActor(default,1);world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(3,0),2);world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(4,0),2);
                var hits=new List<GameplayContext>();int cancels=0;
                var projectile=new GameplayProjectileDefinition(new GameplayProjectileMotionDefinition(GameplayProjectileMotionKind.Straight),N(8),N(2),N(.2f),N(10),N(1),maxHits:2,
                    onHit:new[]{(IGameplaySkillAction)new Observe(c=>hits.Add(c))},onCancelled:new[]{(IGameplaySkillAction)new Observe(c=>cancels++)});
                var marker=new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition(.5f,Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),new[]{(IGameplaySkillAction)new GameplaySpawnProjectileAction(projectile)});
                var skill=Install(caster,new GameplayOwnedSequenceAction(new GameplaySequenceDefinition(3,new[]{marker})));
                Assert.That(skill.TryCast(),Is.True);
                world.Advance(.5f);var operation=(GameplayProjectile)world.GetSpatialSnapshot()[0];
                Assert.That(operation.Position.X,Is.Zero,"A marker-born projectile cannot consume the past half-second.");
                world.Advance(.5f);
                Assert.That(hits.Count,Is.EqualTo(2),"One swept step crosses both targets without duplicate collider/target hits.");
                foreach(var hit in hits){Assert.That(hit.AbilityLevel,Is.EqualTo(5));Assert.That(hit.OriginSourceId,Is.EqualTo(skill.LastCastContext.OriginSourceId));Assert.That(hit.EffectiveSourceId,Is.EqualTo(operation.Id));}
                Assert.That(operation.EndReason,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySpatialEndReason.HitLimit));
                world.Advance(.1f);Assert.That(hits.Count,Is.EqualTo(2));
                var ended=world.SpawnProjectile(caster,skill.LastCastContext,projectile);
                caster.Abilities.End(skill.Grant);Assert.That(ended.EndReason,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySpatialEndReason.Completed));Assert.That(cancels,Is.Zero,"Normal End must not execute OnCancelled.");
                Assert.That(skill.TryCast(),Is.True);world.SpawnProjectile(caster,skill.LastCastContext,projectile);skill.Cancel();
````

````csharp
using System;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay
{
    public sealed class GameplayTypedCombatTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void DamageTypeRoutesDefenseAndRandomCaptureDoesNotRerollExplicitInputs()
        {
            var random=new CountingRandom();using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld(random:random))
            {
                var caster=world.CreateActor(default);var target=world.CreateActor(default);
                var hp=new GameplayAttributeId("Health");var max=new GameplayAttributeId("MaxHealth");var defense=new GameplayAttributeId("Defense");var magic=new GameplayAttributeId("MagicDefense");
                target.Attributes.Register(hp,1000);target.Attributes.Register(max,1000);target.Attributes.Register(defense,100);target.Attributes.Register(magic,300);
                target.CombatAttributes=new GameplayCombatAttributeMap(hp,max,default,defense,magic);
                var context=new GameplayContext(caster.Id,new GameplayTargetData(target.Id));
                var roll=new GameplayCaptureCombatRollAction(N(.5f),N(.2f));
                var captured=roll.ExecuteWithContext(context,default,caster).Context;
                Assert.That(random.Reads,Is.EqualTo(2));Assert.That(captured.Values.GetRequiredValue(GameplayDamageExecution.CriticalKey),Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(captured.Values.GetRequiredValue(GameplayDamageExecution.MissKey),Is.Zero);
                roll.ExecuteWithContext(captured,default,caster);Assert.That(random.Reads,Is.EqualTo(2),"Captured inputs must not reroll in nested callbacks.");
                Assert.Throws<ArithmeticException>(()=>new GameplayCaptureCombatRollAction(N(.5f),N(2)).ExecuteWithContext(context,default,caster));Assert.That(random.Reads,Is.EqualTo(2),"Validate both chances before consuming randomness.");
                var application=new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(context,target,GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty,caster.Attributes,caster.Id,instigatorTarget:caster);
                var types=new[]{GameplayDamageType.Physical,GameplayDamageType.Magical,GameplayDamageType.True};var expected=new[]{50,25,100};
                for(int i=0;i<types.Length;i++)
                {
                    new GameplayDamageExecution(N(100),new[]{new GameplayDamageStage(GameplayDamageStageKind.Defense)},damageType:types[i]).Execute(application);
                    Assert.That(target.LastCombatOutcome.Value.Applied,Is.EqualTo(expected[i]));Assert.That(target.LastCombatOutcome.Value.DamageType,Is.EqualTo(types[i]));
                }
            }
        }
        private static IGameplayFloatValue N(float value)=>new GameplayConstantFloatValue(value);
        private sealed class CountingRandom:IGameplayRandomSource
        {public int Reads;public double NextUnitInterval()=>++Reads==1?.25:.75;}
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Scripting;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Editor
{
    /// <summary>External assembly cost used only in temporary editor assets; no game resource enters FRFrame.</summary>
    [Serializable, Preserve]
    public sealed class AbilityAuthoringTestCost : GameplayAbilityCostAuthoring
    {
        public float Amount = 2f;
        public GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset SharedEffect;
        public GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset Dependency;
        public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext v, string p)
        {
            v.Finite(Amount, p + ".Amount");
            if (SharedEffect != null) v.Asset(SharedEffect, p + ".SharedEffect");
            if (Dependency != null) v.Asset(Dependency, p + ".Dependency");
        }
        public override IGameplayAbilityCost Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context)
        {
            Dependency?.Build(context);
            return new AbilityAuthoringTestBuiltCost(Amount, SharedEffect?.Build(context));
        }
    }

    public sealed class AbilityAuthoringTestBuiltCost : IGameplayAbilityCost
    {
        public readonly float Amount;
        public readonly GameplayEffectDefinition Effect;
        public AbilityAuthoringTestBuiltCost(float amount, GameplayEffectDefinition effect) { Amount = amount; Effect = effect; }
        public bool CanPay(IGameplayAbilityHost host) => true;
        public bool TryCommit(IGameplayAbilityHost host) => true;
    }

    public sealed class GameplayAbilityAuthoringTests
    {
        private const string Folder = "Assets/Tests/GameplayAbilityG2Temp";
        private readonly List<UnityEngine.Object> _objects = new List<UnityEngine.Object>();
        private static readonly string[] TagFields = { "RequiredTags", "BlockedTags", "ActivationOwnedTags", "AbilityTags",
            "CancelAbilitiesWithTags", "BlockAbilitiesWithTags", "OngoingBlockedTags" };

        [TearDown]
        public void Cleanup()
        {
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(Folder)) AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(Folder);
            foreach (var obj in _objects) if (obj != null) UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(obj);
            _objects.Clear();
        }

        [Test]
        public void FullContractUsesSharedBuildSessionAndCopiesAllSevenTagSets()
        {
            var ability = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>();
            foreach (string field in TagFields) typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset).GetField(field)
                .SetValue(ability, new[] { new GameplayTagReference("G2." + field) });
            var cooldown = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, "G2.Cooldown");
            var active = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, "G2.Buff");
            ability.CooldownEffect = cooldown;
            ability.ActivationEffects = new[] { active };
            ability.Cost = new AbilityAuthoringTestCost { Amount = 3f, SharedEffect = active };
            var context = new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
            var built = ability.Build(context);
            foreach (string field in TagFields)
            {
                var actual = (IReadOnlyList<GameplayTag>)typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinition).GetProperty(field).GetValue(built);
                Assert.That(actual.Select(t => t.ToString()), Is.EqualTo(new[] { "G2." + field }));
            }
            Assert.That(built.CooldownEffect, Is.SameAs(cooldown.Build(context)));
            Assert.That(built.ActivationEffects.Single(), Is.SameAs(active.Build(context)));
            var cost = (AbilityAuthoringTestBuiltCost)built.Cost;
            Assert.That(cost.Amount, Is.EqualTo(3f));
            Assert.That(cost.Effect, Is.SameAs(built.ActivationEffects[0]));
            Assert.That(ability.Build(context), Is.SameAs(built));
            ability.RequiredTags[0] = new GameplayTagReference("G2.Changed");
            Assert.That(built.RequiredTags[0].ToString(), Is.EqualTo("G2.RequiredTags"));
            Assert.That(ability.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()), Is.Not.SameAs(built));
        }

        // Prevents normal cooldown activation/reset from using different full-duration authorities.
        [Test]
        public void CooldownAcceptsFrozenDurationButRejectsPeriodOverridesAcrossAllLayers()
        {
            var ability = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>();
            var cooldown = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, "G2.CD");
            cooldown.DurationValue = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 4f };
            ability.CooldownEffect = cooldown;
            var builtEffect = cooldown.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext());
            var validation = Validate(ability);
            Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.False,"H1 evaluates and freezes DurationValue at successful activation.");
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(()=>new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),builtEffect));
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(()=>ability.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
            cooldown.PeriodValue=new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring{Value=1};
            cooldown.Period=1;
            cooldown.Executions=new GameplayEffectExecutionAuthoring[]{new GameplayAttributeDeltaExecutionAuthoring{Attribute=new GameplayAttributeReference("Health"),Delta=new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring{Value=0}}};
            builtEffect=cooldown.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext());validation=Validate(ability);

            bool runtimeRejected = false, buildRejected = false;
            try
            {
                new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),
                    Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(), builtEffect);
            }
            catch (ArgumentException) { runtimeRejected = true; }
            try { ability.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()); }
            catch (InvalidOperationException) { buildRejected = true; }
            bool pathError = validation.Issues.Any(issue =>
                issue.Path == "Ability.CooldownEffect.PeriodValue" &&
                issue.Severity == GameplayAuthoringIssueSeverity.Error);
            Assert.That(new[] { runtimeRejected, pathError, buildRejected }, Is.EqualTo(new[] { true, true, true }),
                "Cooldown remains a simple tag-only effect; all layers reject a dynamic period.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void ChargeBuildAndMutualExclusionHaveFieldPaths()
        {
            var ability = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>();
            ability.Charge = new GameplayAbilityChargeAuthoring { MaxCharges = 3, RechargeDuration = 2f };
            var built = ability.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext());
            Assert.That(built.Charge.MaxCharges, Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(built.Charge.RechargeDuration, Is.EqualTo(2f));
            Assert.That(built.CooldownEffect, Is.Null);
            ability.CooldownEffect = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, "G2.CD");
            Assert.That(Validate(ability).Issues.Any(i => i.Path == "Ability.Charge"), Is.True);
            ability.Charge.MaxCharges = 0; ability.Charge.RechargeDuration = float.NaN;
            var paths = Validate(ability).Issues.Select(i => i.Path).ToArray();
            Assert.That(paths, Does.Contain("Ability.Charge.MaxCharges"));
            Assert.That(paths, Does.Contain("Ability.Charge.RechargeDuration"));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => ability.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
        }

        [Test]
        public void BrokenTagsCooldownAndActivationReferencesReportPathsBeforeBuild()
        {
            var ability = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>();
            ability.RequiredTags = new[] { new GameplayTagReference("bad..tag") };
            var cooldown = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite, "G2.CD");
            cooldown.GrantedTags = Array.Empty<GameplayTagReference>();
            cooldown.Modifiers = new[] { new GameplayEffectModifierAuthoring { Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("G2.Power"),
                Magnitude = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 1 } } };
            cooldown.Stacking = new GameplayEffectStackingAuthoring { StackKey = new GameplayTagReference("G2.Stack") };
            cooldown.ApplicationRequirements = new GameplayTagQueryAuthoring { All = new[] { new GameplayTagReference("G2.Require") } };
            ability.CooldownEffect = cooldown;
            var instant = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant, "G2.Instant");
            ability.ActivationEffects = new[] { null, instant, cooldown };
            ability.Cost = new AbilityAuthoringTestCost { Amount = float.NaN };
            string[] paths = Validate(ability).Issues.Select(i => i.Path).ToArray();
            foreach (string path in new[] { "RequiredTags[0]", "CooldownEffect.DurationPolicy", "CooldownEffect.GrantedTags",
                "CooldownEffect.Modifiers", "CooldownEffect.Stacking", "CooldownEffect.ApplicationRequirements",
                "ActivationEffects[0]", "ActivationEffects[1].DurationPolicy", "ActivationEffects[2].Stacking", "Cost.Amount" })
                Assert.That(paths, Does.Contain("Ability." + path));
            Assert.That(paths.Count(p => p == "Ability.ActivationEffects[0]"), Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => ability.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ExternalCostCyclesAreRejectedWithoutPoisoningBuildSession()
        {
            var a = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>(); var b = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>();
            a.Cost = new AbilityAuthoringTestCost { Dependency = b };
            b.Cost = new AbilityAuthoringTestCost { Dependency = a };
            Assert.That(Validate(a).Issues.Any(i => i.Path == "Ability.Cost.Dependency.Cost.Dependency" && i.Message.Contains("Circular")), Is.True);
            var context = new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => a.Build(context));
            b.Cost = null;
            Assert.That(a.Build(context).Cost, Is.TypeOf<AbilityAuthoringTestBuiltCost>());
        }

        [Test]
        public void CostPickerRejectsEditorTestTypesAndManagedReferencesStillSerialize()
        {
            var ability = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>(); Persist(ability, "Ability");
            Assert.That(GameplayAbilityCostEditor.Types(), Has.No.Member(typeof(AbilityAuthoringTestCost)));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => GameplayAbilityCostEditor.SetCost(ability, typeof(AbilityAuthoringTestCost)));
            Assert.That(ability.Cost, Is.Null);
            Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();
            // This temporary test asset exercises serialization independently of production picker policy.
            Undo.RecordObject(ability, "Test managed reference serialization");
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(ability);
            serialized.FindProperty("Cost").managedReferenceValue = new AbilityAuthoringTestCost();
            serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(ability);
            Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();
            Assert.That(EditorUtility.IsDirty(ability), Is.True);
            Assert.That(new SerializedObject(ability).FindProperty("Cost").managedReferenceValue, Is.TypeOf<AbilityAuthoringTestCost>());
            Undo.PerformUndo(); Assert.That(ability.Cost, Is.Null);
            Undo.PerformRedo(); Assert.That(ability.Cost, Is.TypeOf<AbilityAuthoringTestCost>());
            ((AbilityAuthoringTestCost)ability.Cost).Amount = 7f; EditorUtility.SetDirty(ability);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            var clone = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>();
            EditorJsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite(EditorJsonUtility.ToJson(ability), clone);
            Assert.That(clone.Cost, Is.TypeOf<AbilityAuthoringTestCost>());
            Assert.That(((AbilityAuthoringTestBuiltCost)clone.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()).Cost).Amount, Is.EqualTo(7f));
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(Folder + "/Ability.asset", ImportAssetOptions.ForceUpdate);
            Assert.That(((AbilityAuthoringTestCost)AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>(Folder + "/Ability.asset").Cost).Amount, Is.EqualTo(7f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void GenericScannerFindsAbilitySevenTagsAndReferencedEffectDiagnostics()
        {
            var ability = Asset<GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset>(); Persist(ability, "Ability");
            foreach (string field in TagFields) typeof(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset).GetField(field)
                .SetValue(ability, new[] { new GameplayTagReference("G2." + field) });
            Assert.That(GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets(), Does.Contain(ability));
            var refs = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(new[] { ability });
            Assert.That(refs.Count, Is.EqualTo(7));
            var catalog = Asset<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset>();
            catalog.Tags = TagFields.Select(f => "G2." + f).ToArray();
            var report = GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan(catalog, new[] { ability }, Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>());
            Assert.That(report.Errors, Is.Empty);
            var preview = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewRename(catalog, "G2", "G2Renamed", new[] { ability }, Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>());
            Assert.That(preview.AffectedReferences.Count, Is.EqualTo(7));
            ability.CooldownEffect = Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration, "G2.CD");
            ability.CooldownEffect.Duration = -1f;
            report = GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan(catalog, new[] { ability }, Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>());
            Assert.That(report.Errors.Any(e => e.Location.EndsWith(".CooldownEffect.Duration")), Is.True);
        }

        private T Asset<T>() where T : ScriptableObject
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<T>(); _objects.Add(asset);
            var definition = asset as GameplayDefinitionAsset;
            if (definition != null)
            {
                var so = new SerializedObject(asset); so.FindProperty("definitionId").stringValue = "G2." + _objects.Count;
                so.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
            }
            return asset;
        }
        private GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset Effect(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy policy, string tag)
        {
            var effect = Asset<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>(); effect.DurationPolicy = policy; effect.Duration = 1f;
            effect.GrantedTags = new[] { new GameplayTagReference(tag) }; return effect;
        }
        private static GameplayAuthoringValidationContext Validate(GameplayAbilityDefinitionAsset asset)
        {
            var v = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext(); v.Asset(asset, "Ability"); return v;
        }
        private static void Persist(GameplayDefinitionAsset asset, string name)
        {
            if (!AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(Folder)) AssetDatabase.CreateFolder("Assets/Tests", "GameplayAbilityG2Temp");
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(asset, Folder + "/" + name + ".asset");
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Editor
{
 public sealed class GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoringTests
 {
  static GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset Asset(string id="Test.Completion.Root")
  {var a=ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>();a.name=id;JsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite("{\"definitionId\":\""+id+"\"}",a);a.DurationPolicy=GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;a.Duration=3;return a;}
  [Test]public void EmptyCompletionRoundTripAndLegacyBuild()
  {var a=Asset();var b=Asset();try{JsonUtility.FromJsonOverwrite(JsonUtility.ToJson(a),b);Assert.That(b.CompletionExecutions,Is.Empty);Assert.That(b.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()).CompletionExecutions,Is.Empty);}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(a);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(b);}}
  [Test]public void ApplyCompletionUsesSameBuildIdentityAndSerializedReference()
  {var root=Asset();var next=Asset("Test.Completion.Next");try{root.CompletionExecutions=new GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring[]{new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring{Effect=next}};var context=new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();var built=root.Build(context);Assert.That(((GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionExecution)built.CompletionExecutions.Single()).Effect,Is.SameAs(next.Build(context)));var scan=GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanDefinitionReferences(new[]{root});Assert.That(scan.Single().Target,Is.SameAs(next));Assert.That(scan.Single().PropertyPath,Does.Contain("CompletionExecutions").And.Contain("Effect"));next.GrantedTags=new[]{new GameplayTagReference("Test.Completion.Nested")};Assert.That(GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(new[]{root}).Any(r=>r.Value=="Test.Completion.Nested"),Is.True);var catalog=ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset>();try{var report=GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan(catalog,new[]{root},Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>());Assert.That(report.Errors.Any(e=>e.Message.Contains("Test.Completion.Nested")),Is.True);}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(catalog);}}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(root);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(next);}}
  [Test]public void CircularCompletionReferenceRejectsWithChildPath()
  {var root=Asset();var next=Asset("Test.Completion.Next");try{root.CompletionExecutions=new GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring[]{new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring{Effect=next}};next.CompletionExecutions=new GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring[]{new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring{Effect=root}};var v=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();v.Asset(root,"Root");Assert.That(v.Issues.Any(i=>i.Path=="Root.CompletionExecutions[0].Effect.CompletionExecutions[0].Effect"&&i.Message.Contains("Circular")),Is.True);Assert.That(GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanDefinitionReferences(new[]{root}).Count,Is.EqualTo(2));Assert.That(Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>root.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext())).Message,Does.Contain("CompletionExecutions[0].Effect"));}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(root);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(next);}}
  [TestCase(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Instant)][TestCase(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite)]public void NonDurationCompletionIsRejected(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy policy)
  {var root=Asset();var next=Asset();try{root.DurationPolicy=policy;root.CompletionExecutions=new GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring[]{new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring{Effect=next}};var v=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();v.Asset(root,"Root");Assert.That(v.Issues.Any(i=>i.Path=="Root.CompletionExecutions"),Is.True);Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(()=>root.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(root);UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(next);}}
  [Test]public void NullCompletionAndMissingEffectHavePrecisePaths()
  {var root=Asset();try{root.CompletionExecutions=new GameplayEffectCompletionAuthoring[]{null,new GameplayApplyEffectOnCompletionAuthoring()};var v=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();v.Asset(root,"Root");Assert.That(v.Issues.Select(i=>i.Path),Does.Contain("Root.CompletionExecutions[0]").And.Contain("Root.CompletionExecutions[1].Effect"));}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(root);}}
 }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Editor
{
    public sealed class GameplayReferenceEditorTests
    {
        private const string CatalogPath = "Assets/Settings/FRFrameGameplayReferenceCatalog.asset";
        private const string TempFolder = "Assets/Tests/GameplayReferenceTemp";

        private static GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset ProductionCatalog =>
            AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset>(CatalogPath);

        [TearDown]
        public void Cleanup()
        {
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(TempFolder)) AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(TempFolder);
        }

        [Test]
        public void CatalogValidationAndTreeUseOnlyCanonicalOrdinalPaths()
        {
            var catalog = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset>();
            try
            {
                catalog.Tags = new[] { "Event.Combat.Battle.Start", "Event.Combat", "event.Combat", "Event.Combat" };
                catalog.Attributes = new[] { "AzurLane.Attack", "AzurLane.Attack", " " };
                Assert.That(catalog.Validate().Count, Is.EqualTo(3));
                var tree = GameplayReferenceTree.Project(new[] { "Event.Combat.Battle.Start" });
                Assert.That(tree.Children["Event"].IsDefined, Is.False);
                Assert.That(tree.Children["Event"].Children["Combat"].Children["Battle"].IsDefined, Is.False);
                Assert.That(tree.Children["Event"].Children["Combat"].Children["Battle"].Children["Start"].IsDefined, Is.True);
                Assert.That(GameplayTagRefactorService.Matches("Event.Combatant", "Event.Combat"), Is.False);
                Assert.That(GameplayTagRefactorService.Matches("Event.Combat.Battle", "Event.Combat"), Is.True);
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(catalog); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void ProductionCatalogCoversSourceAndAuthoringWithoutDiagnosticsErrors()
        {
            Assert.That(ProductionCatalog, Is.Not.Null);
            Assert.That(ProductionCatalog.Tags.Length, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(23));
            Assert.That(ProductionCatalog.Attributes, Does.Contain("AzurLane.Attack"));
            Assert.That(ProductionCatalog.Attributes, Does.Contain("AzurLane.Defense"));
            Assert.That(ProductionCatalog.Attributes, Does.Contain("AzurLane.MaxHealth"));
            Assert.That(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find(out string error), Is.SameAs(ProductionCatalog));
            Assert.That(error, Is.Null);
            var xh = GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find("XH", out _);
            Assert.That(xh.Tags, Does.Contain("CD.横扫").And.Contain("Event.Created.S2013"));
            Assert.That(ProductionCatalog.Tags, Does.Not.Contain("CD.横扫"));
            Assert.That(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find("LogicGrid", out _),
                Is.SameAs(GameplayReferenceCatalogProvider.Find("SkillLab", out _)));
            var report = GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan();
            Assert.That(report.AssetCount, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(report.SourceLiteralCount, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(22));
            Assert.That(report.Errors, Is.Empty);
            Assert.That(report.Warnings.Any(issue=>issue.Location.Contains("ReviewPointProjectile.asset.StraightDestination")),Is.True,
                "The formal point sample retains destination conflict guidance without turning valid content into a Catalog error.");
        }

        [Test]
        public void SerializedScannerFindsNestedAndManagedReferencesInProductionAssets()
        {
            var refs = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(GameplayReferenceScanner.FindDefinitionAssets());
            Assert.That(refs.Any(x => x.AssetPath.EndsWith("BattleStartAttackBoost.asset") &&
                                      x.Value == "Event.Combat.Battle.Start" && x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag), Is.True);
            Assert.That(refs.Count(x => x.AssetPath.EndsWith("PlayerAttackBoost.asset") &&
                                        x.Value == "AzurLane.Attack" && x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Attribute), Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(refs.Any(x => x.AssetPath.EndsWith("WeaponFiredSpecialBarrage.asset") &&
                                      x.Value == "Event.Combat.Weapon.Fired"), Is.True);
            var skill = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>();
            try
            {
                skill.Actions = new GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[]
                    { new TestExternalActionAuthoring { Marker = new GameplayTagReference("Test.External.Marker") } };
                var external = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(new GameplayDefinitionAsset[] { skill });
                Assert.That(external.Any(x => x.Value == "Test.External.Marker" && x.Kind == GameplayReferenceKind.Tag), Is.True);
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(skill); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void DiagnosticsSeparateAuthoringSyntaxFromCatalogMembership()
        {
            var effect = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>();
            try
            {
                SetId(effect, "effect.test.diagnostics");
                effect.DurationPolicy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;
                effect.Duration = 1f;
                effect.GrantedTags = new[] { new GameplayTagReference("Bad..Tag"), new GameplayTagReference("Test.Unregistered") };
                effect.Modifiers = new[] { new GameplayEffectModifierAuthoring
                {
                    Attribute = new GameplayAttributeReference("Test.UnknownAttribute"),
                    Operation = GameplayModifierOperation.Add,
                    Magnitude = new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring { Value = 1f }
                } };
                var report = GameplayReferenceDiagnostics.Scan(ProductionCatalog,
                    new GameplayDefinitionAsset[] { effect }, Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>());
                Assert.That(report.AuthoringValidationErrors, Is.GreaterThanOrEqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(report.MissingTagReferences, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(report.MissingAttributeReferences, Is.EqualTo(1));
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(effect); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void PrefixRefactorUpdatesOnlyTypedSerializedReferencesWithUndo()
        {
            AssetDatabase.CreateFolder("Assets/Tests", "GameplayReferenceTemp");
            var catalog = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplayReferenceCatalogAsset>();
            catalog.Tags = new[] { "Test.Refactor.Old", "Test.Refactor.Old.Child", "Test.Refactor.Older" };
            catalog.Attributes = Array.Empty<string>();
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(catalog, TempFolder + "/Catalog.asset");
            var effect = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>();
            SetId(effect, "effect.test.refactor");
            effect.DurationPolicy = GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration;
            effect.Duration = 1f;
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(effect, TempFolder + "/Effect.asset");
            var skill = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>();
            SetId(skill, "skill.test.refactor");
            skill.Trigger = new GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring { EventTag = new GameplayTagReference("Test.Refactor.Old") };
            skill.Conditions = new GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring[] { new GameplaySkillTagConditionAuthoring
            {
                Required = new[] { new GameplayTagReference("Test.Refactor.Old.Child") },
                Blocked = new[] { new GameplayTagReference("Test.Refactor.Older") }
            } };
            skill.Target = new GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring();
            skill.Actions = new GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] { new GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring { Effect = effect } };
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(skill, TempFolder + "/Skill.asset");
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            var preview = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewRename(catalog, "Test.Refactor.Old", "Test.Refactor.New",
                new GameplayDefinitionAsset[] { skill, effect }, Array.Empty<GameplayCodeLiteralReference>());
            Assert.That(preview.CanApply, Is.True, string.Join(" | ", preview.Errors));
            Assert.That(preview.AffectedCatalogTags.Count, Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(preview.AffectedReferences.Count, Is.EqualTo(2));
            GameplayTagRefactorService.Apply(preview);
            Assert.That(catalog.Tags, Does.Contain("Test.Refactor.New").And.Contain("Test.Refactor.New.Child")
                .And.Contain("Test.Refactor.Older"));
            Assert.That(((GameplaySkillEventTriggerAuthoring)skill.Trigger).EventTag.Name, Is.EqualTo("Test.Refactor.New"));
            Assert.That(((GameplaySkillTagConditionAuthoring)skill.Conditions[0]).Required[0].Name,
                Is.EqualTo("Test.Refactor.New.Child"));
            Assert.That(((GameplaySkillTagConditionAuthoring)skill.Conditions[0]).Blocked[0].Name,
                Is.EqualTo("Test.Refactor.Older"));
            Undo.PerformUndo();
            Assert.That(catalog.Tags, Does.Contain("Test.Refactor.Old"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RealCodeLiteralBlocksRenameAndReferencedDelete()
        {
            var rename = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewProjectRename(
                "Event.Combat.Battle.Start", "Event.Combat.Battle.Begin");
            Assert.That(rename.CanApply, Is.False);
            Assert.That(rename.AffectedCode.Any(x => x.SourcePath.EndsWith("CombatEvents.cs") &&
                                                      x.Value == "Event.Combat.Battle.Start"), Is.True);
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => GameplayTagRefactorService.Apply(rename));
            var delete = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewProjectDelete("Event.Combat.Battle.Start");
            Assert.That(delete.CanApply, Is.False);
            Assert.That(delete.AffectedReferences.Count, Is.GreaterThan(0));
            var collision = GameplayTagRefactorService.PreviewProjectRename("Event.Created.S2013","Event.Lab.Hit");
            Assert.That(collision.Errors, Does.Contain("Target collision: Event.Lab.Hit"));
        }

        private static void SetId(GameplayDefinitionAsset asset, string id)
        {
            var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
            serialized.FindProperty("definitionId").stringValue = id;
            serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
        }

        [Serializable]
        private sealed class TestExternalActionAuthoring : GameplaySkillActionAuthoring
        {
            public GameplayTagReference Marker;
            public override void Validate(GameplayAuthoringValidationContext validation, string path) =>
                validation.Tag(Marker, path + ".Marker");
            public override IGameplaySkillAction Build(GameplayAuthoringBuildContext context) =>
                throw new NotSupportedException("Scanner-only test action.");
        }
    }
````
