````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Editor
{
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceSkillStepEditorTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void NestedNodesBuildUsingSameEffectIdentityAndReferencesAreTraversed()
        {
            var sequence = Create<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>("Test.Step");
            var skill = Create<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>("Test.Skill");
            var effect = Create<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>("Test.Effect");
            effect.Duration = 1f;
            try
            {
                sequence.Duration = 1f;
                var step = ValidStep(effect);
                sequence.Markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] { step };
                skill.Actions = new GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] { new GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring { Sequence = sequence } };
                var build = new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
                var built = (GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerDefinition)sequence.Build(build).Markers[0];
                Assert.That(((GameplaySkillApplyEffectAction)built.Actions[0]).Effect, Is.SameAs(effect.Build(build)));
                Assert.That(built.Conditions.Count, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(built.Target, Is.TypeOf<GameplaySkillSelfTarget>());
                var references = GameplayReferenceScanner.ScanAssets(new[] { sequence });
                Assert.That(references.Any(r => r.PropertyPath.Contains("Conditions") && r.Value == "State.Test.Ready"), Is.True);
                // A nested reference cycle is diagnosed, and editor traversal terminates.
                step.Actions = new GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] { new GameplaySkillPlaySequenceActionAuthoring { Sequence = sequence } };
                var validation = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext(); validation.Asset(sequence, "Sequence");
                Assert.That(validation.Issues.Any(i => i.Message.Contains("Circular")), Is.True);
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(sequence); UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(skill); UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(effect); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void ValidationReportsNestedNullNodesAndInvalidChildReferencesWithPaths()
        {
            var asset = Create<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>("Test.BadStep");
            try
            {
                asset.Duration = 1f;
                asset.Markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] { new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring {
                    Time = .5f, Conditions = new GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring[] { null }, Target = null,
                    Actions = new GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] { null, new GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring() } } };
                var v = new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext(); v.Asset(asset, "Sequence");
                Assert.That(v.Issues.Any(i => i.Path.EndsWith("Conditions[0]")), Is.True);
                Assert.That(v.Issues.Any(i => i.Path.EndsWith(".Target")), Is.True);
                Assert.That(v.Issues.Any(i => i.Path.EndsWith("Actions[0]")), Is.True);
                Assert.That(v.Issues.Any(i => i.Path.EndsWith("Actions[1].Effect")), Is.True);
                Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => asset.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void TimelineAddsSelectsEditsDuplicatesAndSerializesNestedSkillNodes()
        {
            var asset = Create<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>("Test.TimelineStep");
            var effect = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset>(
                "Assets/GameRes/AzurLane/Config/Gameplay/Effects/TimedOverdrive.asset");
            Assert.That(effect, Is.Not.Null); // Timeline duplicates authored persistent references.
            try
            {
                asset.Duration = 1f;
                int index = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Add(asset, ValidStep(effect));
                Assert.That(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Track(asset.Markers[index]), Is.EqualTo(2));
                var area = new Rect(0, 0, 700, 180);
                var layout = GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.Build(asset.Markers, area, 142f, 200f);
                Assert.That(GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.HitTest(layout, layout[0].Rect.center, new Rect(142, 32, 558, 126)), Is.EqualTo(index));
                GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.SetTime(asset, index, .7f, false);
                int copy = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Duplicate(asset, index);
                var cloned = (GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring)asset.Markers[copy];
                Assert.That(cloned.Time, Is.EqualTo(.7f));
                Assert.That(cloned, Is.Not.SameAs(asset.Markers[index]));
                Assert.That(cloned.Target, Is.TypeOf<GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring>());
                Assert.That(((GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring)cloned.Actions[0]).Effect, Is.SameAs(effect));
                var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
                var node = serialized.FindProperty("Markers").GetArrayElementAtIndex(copy).FindPropertyRelative("Actions").GetArrayElementAtIndex(0);
                Assert.That(node.managedReferenceValue, Is.TypeOf<GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring>());
                node.FindPropertyRelative("Effect").objectReferenceValue = null;
                serialized.ApplyModifiedProperties();
                Assert.That(((GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring)cloned.Actions[0]).Effect, Is.Null);
                Assert.That(((GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring)((GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring)asset.Markers[index]).Actions[0]).Effect, Is.SameAs(effect));
            }
            finally { Undo.ClearUndo(asset); UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset); }
        }

        private static GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring ValidStep(GameplayEffectDefinitionAsset effect) =>
            new GameplaySequenceSkillStepMarkerAuthoring {
                Time = .5f, Conditions = new GameplaySkillConditionAuthoring[] {
                    new GameplaySkillTagConditionAuthoring { Required = new[] { new GameplayTagReference("State.Test.Ready") } } },
                Target = new GameplaySkillSelfTargetAuthoring(),
                Actions = new GameplaySkillActionAuthoring[] { new GameplaySkillApplyEffectActionAuthoring { Effect = effect } } };
        private static T Create<T>(string id) where T : GameplayDefinitionAsset
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<T>(); asset.name = id;
            var so = new SerializedObject(asset); so.FindProperty("definitionId").stringValue = id; so.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
            return asset;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Linq;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.Timeline;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;
using System.Reflection;
using UnityEngine.UIElements;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Editor
{
    public sealed class GameplaySequenceTimelineEditorTests
    {
        private const string Root = "Assets/GameRes/AzurLane/Config/Gameplay/";
        private static GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset Sequence => AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>(
            Root + "Sequences/TimedOverdriveSequence.asset");

        [Test]
        public void ProductionAssetBuildKeepsMarkerOrderAndEffectIdentity()
        {
            var asset = Sequence;
            Assert.That(asset, Is.Not.Null);
            Assert.That(asset.Markers.Select(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Track), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1, 0, 1 }));
            Assert.That(asset.Markers.Select(m => m.Time), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 0f, .5f, .5f }));
            var effect = ((GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring)asset.Markers[1]).Effect;
            var context = new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
            var built = asset.Build(context);
            Assert.That(((GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerDefinition)built.Markers[1]).Effect,
                Is.SameAs(effect.Build(context)));
            var skill = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplaySkillDefinitionAsset>(
                Root + "Skills/BattleStartTimedOverdrive.asset");
            var action = (GameplaySkillPlaySequenceAction)skill.Build(context).Actions.Single();
            Assert.That(action.Sequence, Is.SameAs(built));
            Assert.That(GameplaySequenceTimelineValidation.Check(asset), Is.Empty);
        }

        [Test]
        public void DragSnapWritesRealMarkerTimeAndUndoRestoresAuthoredArray()
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>();
            try
            {
                asset.Duration = 1f;
                asset.Markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] {
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .1f },
                    new GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring { Time = .2f },
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .3f } };
                GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.SetTime(asset, 1, .493f, true);
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[1].Time, Is.EqualTo(.5f).Within(.0001f));
                Assert.That(asset.Markers.Select(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Track), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 1, 0, 1 }));
                Undo.PerformUndo();
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[1].Time, Is.EqualTo(.2f).Within(.0001f));
                GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.SetTime(asset,1,.246f,true,30);
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[1].Time,Is.EqualTo(7f/30).Within(.0001f),"XH snaps to its display FPS rather than silently using 60.");
                Assert.That(GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Snap(12f/30,true,30),Is.EqualTo(.4f));
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void MarkerGestureRecordsOneUndoAndCancelRestoresOriginalTime()
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>();
            try
            {
                asset.Duration = 1f;
                asset.Markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] {
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .2f } };
                using (var drag = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.BeginDrag(asset, 0))
                {
                    Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects(); // MouseDown can end its editor frame before movement.
                    drag.Update(.3f, false);
                    Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();
                    drag.Update(.4f, false);
                    Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();
                    drag.Update(.5f, false);
                }
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time, Is.EqualTo(.5f));
                Undo.PerformUndo();
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time, Is.EqualTo(.2f));
                Undo.PerformRedo();
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time, Is.EqualTo(.5f));
                Undo.PerformUndo();
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time, Is.EqualTo(.2f));
                using (var drag = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.BeginDrag(asset, 0))
                {
                    drag.Update(.8f, false);
                    drag.Cancel();
                }
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time, Is.EqualTo(.2f));
                Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.SetTime(asset,0,.35f,false);Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();EditorUtility.ClearDirty(asset);
                using(var cancelled=GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.BeginDrag(asset,0)){cancelled.Update(.8f,false);Undo.FlushUndoRecordObjects();cancelled.Cancel();}
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time,Is.EqualTo(.35f));Assert.That(EditorUtility.IsDirty(asset),Is.False);
                Undo.PerformUndo();Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time,Is.EqualTo(.2f),"One Undo must reach the previous valid edit, not a cancelled gesture.");
                Undo.PerformRedo();Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time,Is.EqualTo(.35f));
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void CoincidentMarkersUseTheirOwnVisibleRectForHitTesting()
        {
            var markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] {
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .5f },
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .5f } };
            var canvas = new Rect(0f, 0f, 600f, 120f);
            var entries = GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.Build(markers, canvas, 142f, 200f);
            Assert.That(entries, Has.Count.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(entries[0].Rect.Overlaps(entries[1].Rect), Is.False);
            var content = new Rect(142f, 32f, 458f, 84f);
            Assert.That(GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.HitTest(entries, entries[0].Rect.center, content), Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.HitTest(entries, entries[1].Rect.center, content), Is.EqualTo(1));
        }

        [Test]
        public void NearbyMarkersKeepDistinctDrawAndHitRects()
        {
            var markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] {
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .5f },
                new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .505f } };
            var canvas = new Rect(0f, 0f, 600f, 120f);
            var entries = GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.Build(markers, canvas, 142f, 200f);
            var content = new Rect(142f, 32f, 458f, 84f);
            Assert.That(entries[0].Rect.Overlaps(entries[1].Rect), Is.False);
            for (int i = 0; i < entries.Count; i++)
                Assert.That(GameplaySequenceMarkerLayout.HitTest(entries, entries[i].Rect.center, content),
                    Is.EqualTo(entries[i].Index));
        }

        [Test]
        public void LosingTimelineFocusCancelsDragAndReleasesHotControl()
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>();
            int previousHotControl = GUIUtility.hotControl;
            try
            {
                asset.Duration = 1f;
                asset.Markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] {
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .2f } };
                var panel = new GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel(() => { });
                panel.Select(asset);
                var drag = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.BeginDrag(asset, 0);
                drag.Update(.6f, false);
                var flags = BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.NonPublic;
                typeof(GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel).GetField("_drag", flags).SetValue(panel, drag);
                typeof(GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel).GetField("_dragging", flags).SetValue(panel, 0);
                typeof(GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel).GetField("_dragControl", flags).SetValue(panel, 1234);
                GUIUtility.hotControl = 1234;

                panel.CancelDrag(); // Workbench and standalone window call this on focus loss.
                Assert.That(asset.Markers[0].Time, Is.EqualTo(.2f));
                Assert.That(GUIUtility.hotControl, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(typeof(GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel).GetField("_drag", flags).GetValue(panel), Is.Null);
                Assert.That(typeof(GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel).GetField("_dragging", flags).GetValue(panel), Is.EqualTo(-1));
            }
            finally
            {
                GUIUtility.hotControl = previousHotControl;
                UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset);
            }
        }



        [Test]
        public void MarkerOperationsUseSerializedManagedReferencesAndCanUndo()
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>();
            string path="Assets/Editor/FRFrameGameplay/TimelineGuard-"+Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")+".asset";
            try
            {
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(asset,path);
                asset.Duration = 1f;
                int index = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Add(asset,
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = .25f });
                Assert.That(index, Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(new SerializedObject(asset).FindProperty("Markers").GetArrayElementAtIndex(0)
                    .managedReferenceValue, Is.TypeOf<GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring>());
                int copy = GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Duplicate(asset, 0);
                Assert.That(copy, Is.EqualTo(1));
                Assert.That(asset.Markers.Select(m => m.Time), Is.EqualTo(new[] { .25f, .25f }));
                Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();
                DeleteMarkerAfterAudit(asset, 1);
                Assert.That(asset.Markers, Has.Length.EqualTo(1));
                Undo.PerformUndo();
                Assert.That(asset.Markers, Has.Length.EqualTo(2));
                var panel=new GameplaySequenceTimelinePanel(()=>{});panel.Select(asset);panel.SelectMarker(1);
                Undo.IncrementCurrentGroup();DeleteMarkerAfterAudit(asset,0);panel.Validate();
                Assert.That(panel.SelectedMarker,Is.Zero,"Same-time markers retain exact managed-reference identity when indices shift.");
                Undo.PerformUndo();panel.OnUndo();Assert.That(panel.SelectedMarker,Is.EqualTo(1));

            }
            finally { Undo.ClearUndo(asset);AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path); }
        }

        private static void DeleteMarkerAfterAudit(GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset asset,int index)=>GameplaySequenceTimelineModel.Delete(asset,index);

        [Test]
        public void ValidationReportsInvalidTimeMissingEffectAndUnregisteredCue()
        {
            var asset = ScriptableObject.CreateInstance<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>();
            try
            {
                var serialized = new SerializedObject(asset);
                serialized.FindProperty("definitionId").stringValue = "sequence.test.invalid";
                serialized.ApplyModifiedPropertiesWithoutUndo();
                asset.Duration = .5f;
                asset.Markers = new GameplaySequenceMarkerAuthoring[] {
                    new GameplaySequenceApplyEffectMarkerAuthoring { Time = .6f },
                    new GameplaySequenceCueMarkerAuthoring { Time = 0f,
                        CueTag = new GameplayTagReference("Cue.Test.Unregistered") } };
                var issues = GameplaySequenceTimelineValidation.Check(asset);
                Assert.That(issues.Any(i => i.Contains("Time")), Is.True);
                Assert.That(issues.Any(i => i.Contains("Effect")), Is.True);
                Assert.That(issues.Any(i => i.Contains("Unregistered") || i.Contains("No GameplayReferenceCatalog")), Is.True);
            }
            finally { UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(asset); }
        }

        [Test]
        public void ReimportedProductionAssetRetainsTimeAndReferencePickerField()
        {
            string path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(Sequence);
            AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(path, ImportAssetOptions.ForceUpdate);
            var reloaded = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplaySequenceDefinitionAsset>(path);
            Assert.That(reloaded.Markers.Select(m => m.Time), Is.EqualTo(new[] { 0f, .5f, .5f }));
            var property = new SerializedObject(reloaded).FindProperty("Markers").GetArrayElementAtIndex(0);
            Assert.That(property.FindPropertyRelative("CueTag"), Is.Not.Null);
            Assert.That(property.FindPropertyRelative("CueTag").type, Is.EqualTo(nameof(GameplayTagReference)));
        }
    }
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Extensions;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Extensions
{
    public sealed class GameplayExtensionProtocolTests
    {
        private static readonly GameplayAttributeId Speed=new GameplayAttributeId("Test.Speed");
        private sealed class Host : IGameplayAbilityHost,IGameplaySkillHost
        {
            public GameplaySourceIdAllocator Ids=new GameplaySourceIdAllocator();
            public GameplaySourceId OwnerId { get; }
            public GameplaySourceId TargetId=>OwnerId;
            public AttributeSet Attributes { get; }=new AttributeSet();
            public GameplayTagContainer Tags { get; }=new GameplayTagContainer();
            public GameplayEffectContainer Effects { get; }
            public GameplayAbilityContainer Abilities { get; }
            public Host() { OwnerId=Ids.Allocate(); Attributes.Register(Speed,100); Effects=new GameplayEffectContainer(Attributes,Ids,Tags); Abilities=new GameplayAbilityContainer(this,Ids); }
            public GameplayContext Context=>new GameplayContext(OwnerId,new GameplayTargetData(OwnerId));
            public GameplayEffectApplicationResult Apply(GameplayEffectDefinition d)=>Effects.Apply(d,new GameplayEffectApplicationContext(Context.WithSource(Ids.Allocate()),this,GameplaySetByCallerValues.Empty));
            public GameplayAbilityHandle Grant()=>Abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),new[]{new GameplayTag("State.Blocked")},Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
        }
        [Test]
        public void LeaseCleanupIsExactAcrossOverlapReplaceDispelAndExpiry()
        {
            var host=new Host();
            var stack=new GameplayEffectStackingDefinition(new GameplayTag("Stack.Test"),GameplayEffectStackAggregation.AggregateByTarget,2,
                GameplayEffectStackDurationRefreshPolicy.NeverRefresh,GameplayEffectStackPeriodResetPolicy.NeverReset,GameplayEffectStackOverflowPolicy.Reject);
            var definition=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite,0,0,
                new[]{new GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition(Speed,GameplayModifierOperation.Add,10)},Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<IGameplayEffectExecution>(),stack);
            var a=host.Apply(definition); var b=host.Apply(definition);
            Assert.That(GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(host.Effects,a,out var leaseA),Is.True);
            Assert.That(GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(host.Effects,b,out var leaseB),Is.True);
            Assert.That(GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(host.Effects,host.Apply(definition),out _),Is.False);
            var setA=new GameplayEffectLeaseSet(); var setB=new GameplayEffectLeaseSet();
            setA.AddOrReplace(host.OwnerId,leaseA); setB.AddOrReplace(host.OwnerId,leaseB);
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Speed),Is.EqualTo(120));
            setA.Remove(host.OwnerId); leaseA.Dispose();
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Speed),Is.EqualTo(110));
            Assert.That(host.Effects.LastRemoval,Is.Null,"Removing one shared layer does not remove the other source's entry.");
            host.Effects.Remove(b.ActiveHandle,GameplayEffectRemovalCause.Dispel); setB.Clear(); setB.Clear();
            Assert.That(host.Attributes.GetCurrentValue(Speed),Is.EqualTo(100));
            var duration=new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Duration,1,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>());
            GameplayEffectLease.TryCapture(host.Effects,host.Apply(duration),out var expiring); host.Effects.Advance(1); expiring.Dispose(); expiring.Dispose();
            var oldHandle=host.Effects.Apply(new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite,0,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>()));
            var newHandle=host.Effects.Apply(new GameplayEffectDefinition(GameplayEffectDurationPolicy.Infinite,0,Array.Empty<GameplayEffectAttributeModifierDefinition>()));
            setA.AddOrReplace(host.OwnerId,GameplayEffectLease.OwnEntry(host.Effects,oldHandle)); setA.AddOrReplace(host.OwnerId,GameplayEffectLease.OwnEntry(host.Effects,newHandle));
            Assert.That(host.Effects.IsActive(oldHandle),Is.False); Assert.That(host.Effects.IsActive(newHandle),Is.True); setA.Clear();
            Assert.That(host.Effects.LastRemoval.Cause,Is.EqualTo(GameplayEffectRemovalCause.OwnerCleanup));
        }
        [Test]
        public void AbilityCommandsForwardAndCommitRechecksCurrentContainerGates()
        {
            var host=new Host(); var grant=host.Grant(); var context=host.Context;
            bool Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind kind)=>GameplayAbilityCommandExecutor.Execute(host.Abilities,new GameplayAbilityCommand(kind,grant,context));
            Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Begin),Is.True);
            host.Tags.AddTag(new GameplayTag("State.Blocked"),host.OwnerId);
            Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Commit),Is.False); Assert.That(host.Abilities.IsActive(grant),Is.False);
            host.Tags.RemoveTagsFromSource(host.OwnerId);
            Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Begin),Is.True); Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Commit),Is.True);
            Assert.That(host.Abilities.TryGetActiveContext(grant,out var active),Is.True); Assert.That(active,Is.SameAs(context));
            Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Cancel),Is.True); Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Activate),Is.True);
            Assert.That(Execute(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.End),Is.True);
            Assert.That(GameplayAbilityCommandExecutor.Execute(host.Abilities,new GameplayAbilityCommand(GameplayAbilityCommandKind.Activate,default)),Is.False);
        }
        [Test]

        private sealed class Probe : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            public int Count; public GameplayContext Context; public GameplayEventData Event;
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext c,GameplayEventData e,IGameplaySkillHost h) { Count++; Context=c; Event=e; return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; }
        }
        private sealed class Stop : IGameplaySkillAction
        {
            public Action Callback;
            public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext c,GameplayEventData e,IGameplaySkillHost h) { Callback(); return GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded; }
        }
        [Test]
        public void ChildBindingCarriesRichIdentityAndStopsCallbacksAndPendingActionsOnDispose()
        {
            var host=new Host(); var key=new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Power"); var combo=new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Combo"); var crit=new GameplayTag("Data.Test.Crit");
            var original=host.Context.WithValues(GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(key,40).WithValue(combo,2));
            var child=new GameplayChildRuleBinding(original,host.Ids.Allocate(),host); var target=new GameplayTargetData(host.Ids.Allocate(),new GameplayPoint(2,4));
            var probe=new Probe(); var flow=new GameplayContinuationDefinition(new[]{probe});
            var result=child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,flow,magnitude:3);
            Assert.That(result.Result,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded)); Assert.That(probe.Context.InstigatorId,Is.EqualTo(original.InstigatorId));
            Assert.That(probe.Context.SourceId,Is.EqualTo(child.BaseContext.SourceId)); Assert.That(probe.Context.TargetData,Is.SameAs(target));
            Assert.That(probe.Context.Values,Is.SameAs(original.Values)); Assert.That(probe.Event.Context,Is.SameAs(probe.Context));
            child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,flow,Array.Empty<KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>>());
            Assert.That(probe.Context.Values,Is.SameAs(original.Values));
            var overrides=new[]{new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(crit,1),new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(combo,3)};
            result=child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,flow,overrides,magnitude:3);
            Assert.That(probe.Context.Values.GetRequiredValue(key),Is.EqualTo(40));
            Assert.That(probe.Context.Values.GetRequiredValue(crit),Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(probe.Context.Values.GetRequiredValue(combo),Is.EqualTo(3));
            Assert.That(child.BaseContext.Values,Is.SameAs(original.Values));
            Assert.That(child.BaseContext.Values.GetRequiredValue(key),Is.EqualTo(40));
            Assert.That(child.BaseContext.Values.GetRequiredValue(combo),Is.EqualTo(2));
            Assert.That(child.BaseContext.Values.TryGetValue(crit,out _),Is.False);
            Assert.That(probe.Context.InstigatorId,Is.EqualTo(original.InstigatorId));
            Assert.That(probe.Context.SourceId,Is.EqualTo(child.BaseContext.SourceId));
            Assert.That(probe.Context.TargetData,Is.SameAs(target));
            Assert.That(probe.Event.Context,Is.SameAs(probe.Context));
            Assert.That(result.Context,Is.SameAs(probe.Event.Context));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(()=>child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,flow,new[]{new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(default,1)}));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(()=>child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,flow,new[]{new KeyValuePair<GameplayTag,float>(crit,float.NaN)}));
            var grant=host.Grant(); host.Abilities.TryActivate(grant,original); Assert.That(host.Abilities.TryOwnLifetime(grant,child),Is.True);
            var stopping=new GameplayContinuationDefinition(new IGameplaySkillAction[]{new Stop { Callback=()=>host.Abilities.Cancel(grant) },probe});
            Assert.That(child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,stopping).Result,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected));
            child.Dispose(); Assert.That(child.Signal(new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Hit"),target,flow,overrides).Result,Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected)); Assert.That(probe.Count,Is.EqualTo(3));
        }
        private sealed class Driver : IGameplayDisplacementDriver,IDisposable
        { public GameplayDisplacementRequest Received; public IDisposable Start(GameplayDisplacementRequest r) { Received=r; return this; } public void Dispose() { } }
        [Test]
        public void DisplacementHasOneRateModelAndDriverReceivesExactSnapshot()
        {
            var host=new Host(); var driver=new Driver();
            var request=new GameplayDisplacementRequest(host.Context,host.OwnerId,GameplayDisplacementMode.Directional,3,2,new GameplayDirection(1,0));
            driver.Start(request); Assert.That(driver.Received,Is.SameAs(request)); Assert.That(request.EffectiveSourceId,Is.EqualTo(host.OwnerId));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(()=>new GameplayDisplacementRequest(host.Context,host.OwnerId,GameplayDisplacementMode.Directional,3,2));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(()=>new GameplayDisplacementRequest(host.Context,host.OwnerId,GameplayDisplacementMode.PullToSource,3,2,new GameplayDirection(1,0)));
            Assert.Throws<ArgumentOutOfRangeException>(()=>new GameplayDisplacementRequest(host.Context,host.OwnerId,GameplayDisplacementMode.PushFromSource,3,0));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Tests.UnityIntegration

        /// <summary>Protects Timeline preview against ignoring the formal speed/context expression.</summary>
        [Test]
        public void PreviewSpeedUsesCapturedInputsAndSamplesActualAnimatorTime()
        {
            var original=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayUnityAnimationAsset>("Assets/GameRes/GameplayValidation/FRFrameSkillLab/Resources/FRFrameSkillLab/AnimationAnimator.asset");
            var source=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(original);
            try
            {
                source.Speed=new GameplayFormulaFloatValueAuthoring{Expression="Context.Data.Standard.Critical * Level"};
                using(var preview=new FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity.Editor.GameplayAnimationPreviewSession())
                {
                    preview.SetValueContext(null,null,GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(GameplayDamageExecution.CriticalKey,2));
                    preview.UpdateContext(new FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillPreviewContext(null,null,null,presentationSource:source,presentationStartSeconds:.3f));
                    preview.Seek(.55f);Assert.That(preview.Duration,Is.EqualTo(.3f+source.Clip.length/2).Within(.0001f));
                    var animator=preview.PreviewSubject.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>();
                    Assert.That(animator.GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(source.Layer).normalizedTime,Is.EqualTo(.5f/source.Clip.length).Within(.0001f));
                }
            }
            finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(source);}
            var weighted=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayUnityAnimationAsset>("Assets/GameRes/GameplayValidation/FRFrameSkillLab/Resources/FRFrameSkillLab/AnimationAnimatorWeighted.asset"));
            try
            {
                foreach(var variant in weighted.Variants)variant.MinimumLevel=1;
                using(var preview=new FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity.Editor.GameplayAnimationPreviewSession())
                {
                    preview.SetValueContext(null,null,GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(GameplayAnimationVariantSelector.RollKey,.2499f));
                    preview.UpdateContext(new FRFrame.Gameplay.Editor.SkillAuthoring.GameplaySkillPreviewContext(null,null,null,presentationSource:weighted));preview.Seek(.5f);
                    var animator=preview.PreviewSubject.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>();
                    Assert.That(animator.GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).fullPathHash,Is.EqualTo(Animator.StringToHash("Base Layer.Scale")));
                    preview.SetValueContext(null,null,GameplayContextValues.Empty.WithValue(GameplayAnimationVariantSelector.RollKey,.25f));preview.Seek(.5f);
                    animator=preview.PreviewSubject.GetComponentInChildren<Animator>();
                    Assert.That(animator.GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).fullPathHash,Is.EqualTo(Animator.StringToHash("Base Layer.Turn")),"Exact 1:3 weight boundary selects the second real state.");
                }
            }
            finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(weighted);}

        {

        /// <summary>Guards priority rejection before allocation, replay cleanup, absolute loop event
        /// time and exactly-once cancellation. Visual clip correctness is verified in the permanent Lab.</summary>
        [Test]
        public void AnimationPriorityReplayAndCancellationOwnOnlyTheirCast()
        {
            var subject=new GameObject("Animation ownership guard");
            try
            {
                using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
                {
                    var actor=world.CreateActor(default,1);
                    var signal=new GameplayTag("Event.Test.Animation.Cast");
                    var rules=new GameplaySkillDefinition(new GameplaySkillEventTriggerDefinition(signal),Array.Empty<IGameplaySkillCondition>(),new GameplaySkillSelfTarget(),new[]{(IGameplaySkillAction)new Noop()},false);
                    var skill=actor.InstallDocument(new GameplaySkillDocumentDefinition(1,new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()),rules,signal));
                    Assert.That(skill.TryCast(),Is.True);
                    var target=world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(2,0),2);
                    var cast=skill.LastCastContext.WithTarget(new GameplayTargetData(target.Id));
                    var controller=new GameplayUnityAnimationController(actor,subject);actor.Presentation=controller;
                    var first=new Player();var replay=new Player();int rejectedFactory=0;
                    var high=new GameplayAnimationDefinition("Body",10,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>first);
                    var low=new GameplayAnimationDefinition("Body",1,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>{rejectedFactory++;return new Player();});
                    Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(high,cast),Is.True);
                    Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(low,cast),Is.False);
                    Assert.That(controller.LastAnimationRejection,Does.Contain("PriorityDenied"));
                    Assert.That(controller.LastAnimationRejection,Does.Contain("channel=Body"));
                    Assert.That(rejectedFactory,Is.Zero);
                    world.Advance(.25f);Assert.That(first.LastSeek,Is.EqualTo(.25f));
                    Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(new GameplayAnimationDefinition("Body",10,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>replay),cast),Is.True);
                    Assert.That(first.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(replay.LastSeek,Is.Zero);
                    world.Advance(2.5f);Assert.That(replay.LastSeek,Is.EqualTo(2.5f),"Loop backends need absolute time for crossing events.");
                    skill.Cancel();Assert.That(replay.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));
                    Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(low,cast),Is.False);
                    Assert.That(controller.LastAnimationRejection,Does.Contain("ActiveGrantMissing"));
                    world.Advance(1);controller.Dispose();Assert.That(replay.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));
                    Assert.That(actor.Abilities.GetGrantedEntriesSnapshot()[0].OwnedLifetimesCount,Is.Zero);
                    Assert.That(skill.TryCast(),Is.True);cast=skill.LastCastContext;
                    var finite=new Player{Repeats=false};var queued=new Player{Repeats=false};int queuedFactories=0;
                    controller=new GameplayUnityAnimationController(actor,subject);actor.Presentation=controller;
                    var random=new PresentationRandom();controller.AnimationRandom=random;
                    Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(new GameplayAnimationDefinition("Body",10,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>finite),cast),Is.True);
                    float capturedRoll=-1;
                    Assert.That(controller.TryQueue(new GameplayAnimationDefinition("Body",10,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>{queuedFactories++;c.Values.TryGetValue(GameplayAnimationVariantSelector.RollKey,out capturedRoll);return queued;},captureVariantRoll:true),cast),Is.True);
                    Assert.That(random.Calls,Is.EqualTo(1));
                    Assert.That(queuedFactories,Is.Zero);Assert.That(controller.QueuedCount,Is.EqualTo(1));
                    world.Advance(1);Assert.That(queuedFactories,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(queued.LastSeek,Is.Zero,"A promoted request cannot consume the previous clip's delta.");
                    Assert.That(capturedRoll,Is.EqualTo(.75f));Assert.That(random.Calls,Is.EqualTo(1),"Promotion/SDK sampling must not redraw queued variants.");
                    world.Advance(.25f);Assert.That(queued.LastSeek,Is.EqualTo(.25f));
                    controller.TryQueue(low,cast);skill.Cancel();Assert.That(controller.QueuedCount,Is.Zero);Assert.That(queued.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));
                }
            }
            finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(subject);}
        }
        /// <summary>Prevents cross-channel physical overwrites and queue starvation while allowing
        /// genuinely separate native tracks/layers to progress together.</summary>
        [Test]
        public void PhysicalSlotsArbitrateAcrossChannelsAndPromoteFifo()
        {
            var subject=new GameObject("Physical slot guard");
            try{using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld()){
                var actor=world.CreateActor(default,1);
                var handle=actor.Abilities.Grant(new GameplayAbilityDefinition(Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>(),Array.Empty<GameplayTag>()));
                var cast=new GameplayContext(actor.Id,new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id));Assert.That(actor.Abilities.TryActivate(handle,cast),Is.True);
                Assert.That(actor.Abilities.TryCreateExecutionContext(handle,new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id),out cast),Is.True);
                var controller=new GameplayUnityAnimationController(actor,subject);actor.Presentation=controller;
                var high=new Player{Repeats=false};var parallel=new Player();var first=new Player{Repeats=false};var second=new Player{Repeats=false};int denied=0;
                Func<string,int,int,Player,GameplayAnimationDefinition> source=(channel,priority,slot,player)=>new GameplayAnimationDefinition(channel,priority,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>player,
                    writes:s=>new[]{new GameplayAnimationWriteTarget(s,"Track",slot)});
                Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(source("High",100,0,high),cast),Is.True);
                Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(new GameplayAnimationDefinition("Low",1,new GameplayConstantFloatValue(1),(s,c)=>{denied++;return new Player();},writes:s=>new[]{new GameplayAnimationWriteTarget(s,"Track",0)}),cast),Is.False);
                Assert.That(controller.LastAnimationRejection,Does.Contain("PhysicalPriorityDenied"));Assert.That(denied,Is.Zero);
                Assert.That(controller.TryPlay(source("Parallel",1,1,parallel),cast),Is.True);
                Assert.That(controller.TryQueue(source("First",1,0,first),cast),Is.True);
                Assert.That(controller.TryQueue(source("Second",1,0,second),cast),Is.True);
                controller.Advance(1);Assert.That(high.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(first.LastSeek,Is.Zero);Assert.That(controller.QueuedCount,Is.EqualTo(1));
                controller.Advance(1);Assert.That(first.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(second.LastSeek,Is.Zero);Assert.That(parallel.Disposals,Is.Zero);
                actor.Abilities.Cancel(handle);Assert.That(second.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(parallel.Disposals,Is.EqualTo(1));Assert.That(controller.QueuedCount,Is.Zero);
            }}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(subject);}
        }
        private sealed class Noop:IGameplaySkillAction
        {public GameplaySkillActionResult Execute(GameplayContext c,GameplayEventData e,IGameplaySkillHost h)=>GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded;}
        private sealed class PresentationRandom:IGameplayRandomSource
        {internal int Calls;public double NextUnitInterval(){Calls++;return .75;}}
        private sealed class Player:IGameplayAnimationPlayer
        {
            public float Duration=>1;
````

## File: Tests/Gameplay/UnityIntegration/GameplayFloatingTextOwnershipTests.cs
````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity;
using System.Linq;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Tests.UnityIntegration
{
    public sealed class GameplayFloatingTextOwnershipTests
    {
        [Test]
        public void AuthoredFeedbackClaimsOnlyItsOutcomeAndUnclaimedResultsKeepTheirDefault()
        {
            var subject = new GameObject("Combat text target");
            var asset = Object.Instantiate(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayFloatingTextAsset>(
                "Assets/GameRes/GameplayValidation/XH/Gameplay/Standard/Feedback1001.asset"));
            asset.Follow = true;
            var authored = Object.Instantiate(asset);
            try
            {
                authored.DamagePrefix = "Execute ";
                authored.NumberFormat = "0.##";
                using var world = new GameplayStandardWorld();
                var attacker = world.CreateActor(default);
                var target = world.CreateActor(default);
                var build = new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext();
                var controller = new GameplayUnityAnimationController(target, subject) { FloatingText = asset.Build(build) };
                target.Presentation = controller;
                var action = new GameplayShowCombatTextActionAuthoring { Source = authored }.Build(build);
                var targetData = new GameplayTargetData(target.Id);
                var first = new GameplayContext(attacker.Id, targetData);
                var second = new GameplayContext(attacker.Id, targetData);
                target.ReportCombat(new GameplayCombatOutcome(first, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Damage, default, 5.4f, 0, 100, 94.6f));
                target.ReportCombat(new GameplayCombatOutcome(second, GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Damage, default, 12.25f, 0, 94.6f, 82.35f));
                Assert.That(action.Execute(first, default, attacker), Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected),
                    "A separate callback can share source IDs without owning the latest result.");
                Assert.That(action.Execute(second.WithSource(target.Id), default, attacker), Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected));
                Assert.That(action.Execute(second, default, attacker), Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded));
                Assert.That(action.Execute(second, default, attacker), Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded));
                Assert.That(controller.ActiveFloatingTextCount, Is.EqualTo(1));
                world.Advance(0);
                var labels = subject.GetComponentsInChildren<GameplayFloatingTextWidget>().Select(widget => widget.DisplayText);
                Assert.That(labels, Is.EquivalentTo(new[] { "Execute 12.25", "-5" }));
                Assert.That(action.Execute(second, default, attacker), Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected));
                world.Advance(2);
                Assert.That(controller.ActiveFloatingTextCount, Is.Zero);
            }
            finally { Object.DestroyImmediate(authored); Object.DestroyImmediate(asset); Object.DestroyImmediate(subject); }
        }

        /// <summary>Regression from real XH Stop Play: TMP destroys a cloned static font's borrowed
        /// asset atlas. Static fonts must remain borrowed; dynamic fonts must release their private atlas.</summary>
        [TestCase(false)][TestCase(true)]
        public void WidgetDestructionPreservesSharedFontAndReleasesOnlyPrivateFont(bool dynamic)
        {
            var shared=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TMPro.TMP_FontAsset>(dynamic?
                "Assets/GameRes/Common/Font/font_main_zht SDF.asset":"Assets/Plugins/TextMesh Pro/Resources/Fonts & Materials/LiberationSans SDF.asset");
            var sharedAtlas=shared.atlasTextures[0];var sharedMaterial=shared.material;
            var prefab=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>("Assets/GameRes/GameplayValidation/XH/Gameplay/Standard/XHCombatFloatingText.prefab");
            var root=Object.Instantiate(prefab);
            try{
                var text=root.GetComponentInChildren<TMPro.TMP_Text>(true);text.font=shared;
                var widget=root.GetComponentInChildren<GameplayFloatingTextWidget>(true);
                widget.OpenStandalone(new GameplayFloatingTextContent("+25",Color.green));
                var usedFont=text.font;var usedAtlas=usedFont.atlasTextures[0];var usedMaterial=text.fontSharedMaterial;
                Assert.That(usedFont==shared,Is.EqualTo(!dynamic));Assert.That(usedMaterial,Is.Not.SameAs(sharedMaterial));
                // EditMode does not dispatch OnDestroy for a runtime-only MonoBehaviour that has
                // never received Awake. Invoke that lifecycle boundary; real Stop Play is checked separately.
                typeof(GameplayFloatingTextWidget).GetMethod("OnDestroy",System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance|System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic).Invoke(widget,null);
                Object.DestroyImmediate(root);
                Assert.That(shared!=null&&sharedAtlas!=null&&sharedMaterial!=null,Is.True);
                Assert.That(shared.atlasTextures[0],Is.SameAs(sharedAtlas));Assert.That(shared.material,Is.SameAs(sharedMaterial));
                Assert.That(usedMaterial==null,Is.True);
                if(dynamic)Assert.That(usedFont==null&&usedAtlas==null,Is.True);
            }finally{if(root!=null)Object.DestroyImmediate(root);}
        }
        /// <summary>Protects standalone UI initialization, actual pool reuse, and target cleanup.
        /// Text appearance is verified in the permanent Lab, not duplicated by formatting cases.</summary>
        [Test]
        public void FeedbackReusesInitializedWidgetAndTargetCleanupReleasesIt()
        {
            var subject=new GameObject("Floating feedback ownership");
            try
            {
                using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
                {
                    var actor=world.CreateActor(default);var controller=new GameplayUnityAnimationController(actor,subject);actor.Presentation=controller;
                    var source=UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameplayFloatingTextAsset>("Assets/GameRes/GameplayValidation/FRFrameSkillLab/Resources/FRFrameSkillLab/CombatFloatingText.asset");
                    var definition=source.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext());
                    var context=new GameplayContext(actor.Id,new GameplayTargetData(actor.Id));
                    var outcome=new GameplayCombatOutcome(context,GameplayCombatOutcomeKind.Heal,default,25,0,50,75);
                    Assert.That(controller.ShowFloatingText(definition,outcome),Is.True);
                    var widget=subject.GetComponentInChildren<GameplayFloatingTextWidget>();Assert.That(widget.IsInitialized,Is.True);
                    Assert.That(widget.IsVisible,Is.True);Assert.That(widget.DisplayText,Is.EqualTo("+25"));
                    controller.Advance(definition.Duration);Assert.That(controller.ActiveFloatingTextCount,Is.Zero);Assert.That(widget.IsVisible,Is.False);
                    controller.ShowFloatingText(definition,outcome);Assert.That(subject.GetComponentInChildren<GameplayFloatingTextWidget>(),Is.SameAs(widget));
                    actor.Dispose();Assert.That(controller.ActiveFloatingTextCount,Is.Zero);Assert.That(widget==null,Is.True);
                }
            }
            finally{Object.DestroyImmediate(subject);}
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Standard;
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Unity;
using NUnit.Framework;

namespace FRFrame.Gameplay.Tests.UnityIntegration
{
    public sealed class GameplayFsmOwnershipTests
    {
        /// <summary>Protects actual host FSMs against double ticking and accidental disposal when borrowed.</summary>
        [TestCase(false)] [TestCase(true)]
        public void FsmAdapterHonoursClockOwnershipAndExplicitStateAliases(bool owned)
        {
            using(var fsm=new HostFsm())using(var world=new GameplayStandardWorld())
            {
                fsm.Initialize();var actor=world.CreateActor(new GameplayPoint(0,0));
                var adapter=new GameplayFsmBehaviourAdapter(fsm,new Dictionary<string,Type>{{"Idle",typeof(Idle)},{"Guard",typeof(Guard)}},owned,owned);
                actor.Behaviour=adapter;
                Assert.That(adapter.TryChangeState("Idle"),Is.True);
                Assert.That(new GameplayChangeStateAction("Missing").Execute(default,default,actor),Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Rejected));
                Assert.That(fsm.CurrentStateName,Is.EqualTo(nameof(Idle)));
                Assert.That(new GameplayChangeStateAction("Guard").Execute(default,default,actor),Is.EqualTo(GameplaySkillActionResult.Succeeded));
                world.Advance(.5f);Assert.That(fsm.RunTime,Is.EqualTo(owned?.5f:0));
                actor.Dispose();Assert.That(fsm.IsDisposed,Is.EqualTo(owned));
                Assert.That(adapter.TryChangeState("Idle"),Is.False);
                if(!owned){fsm.Update(.5f,.5f);Assert.That(fsm.RunTime,Is.EqualTo(.5f));}
            }
        }
        private sealed class HostFsm:FsmController
        {protected override void OnInitialize(){AddState<Idle>();AddState<Guard>();}}
        public sealed class Idle:FsmState { }
        public sealed class Guard:FsmState { }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using FRFrame.Gameplay.Authoring;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.Gameplay.Editor

    public sealed class GameplaySearchAuthoringTests
    {
        /// <summary>Protects shape switching: dormant broken drafts cannot block/build into an
        /// unrelated query, but become validation errors when their consuming shape is selected.</summary>
        [Test]
        public void InactiveDraftsSurviveShapeSwitchWithoutBlockingBuild()
        {
            var radius=new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring{Value=0};
            var search=new GameplaySearchTargetActionAuthoring{Shape=GameplaySearchShape.Single,Radius=radius,Angle=null,Length=null,Width=null,
                DirectionAngle=new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring{Value=float.NaN},LengthFromTarget=true,CellSize=0,Cells=null};
            var validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.False);
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(()=>search.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
            search.Shape=GameplaySearchShape.Circle;validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.True);
            Assert.That(search.Radius,Is.SameAs(radius));radius.Value=3;
            validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.False);
            foreach(GameplaySpatialPlane plane in System.Enum.GetValues(typeof(GameplaySpatialPlane))){
                search.Plane=plane;validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");
                Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.False);Assert.DoesNotThrow(()=>search.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
            }
            search.Shape=GameplaySearchShape.GridCells;search.Cells=new[]{UnityEngine.Vector3.zero};search.CellSize=1;
            validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.False);
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(()=>search.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
            search.Shape=GameplaySearchShape.Capsule;validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.True);
            search.Direction=GameplaySearchDirection.ToContextPoint;search.DirectionAngle=new GameplayConstantFloatValueAuthoring{Value=0};
            validation=new GameplayAuthoringValidationContext();search.Validate(validation,"Search");Assert.That(validation.HasErrors,Is.False,"Endpoint length does not consume the missing Length draft.");
            Assert.DoesNotThrow(()=>search.Build(new GameplayAuthoringBuildContext()));
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.UIExtensions
{
    public sealed class UIRuntimeExtensionsEditModeTests
    {
        private readonly List<Object> _created = new List<Object>();

        [Test] public void RedDotHierarchyReparentsAndRebindingReleasesOnlyItsBinding()
        {
            var tree=new UIRedDotTree();tree.SetParent("Learn","Skills");tree.SetParent("Restore","Skills");
            var go=new GameObject("Notification",typeof(RectTransform),typeof(Image),typeof(UIRedDotBinder));_created.Add(go);
            var graphic=go.GetComponent<Image>();go.GetComponent<UIRedDotBinder>().Bind(tree,"Skills",graphic);
            tree.Set("Learn",true);Assert.That(graphic.enabled,Is.True);tree.Set("Restore",true);tree.Set("Learn",false);Assert.That(graphic.enabled,Is.True);
            tree.SetParent("Restore","Other");Assert.That(graphic.enabled,Is.False);Assert.That(tree.IsVisible("Other"),Is.True);
            Assert.Throws<System.ArgumentException>(()=>tree.SetParent("Other","Restore"));
            int notifications=0;
            var subscription=tree.Subscribe("Learn",visible=>notifications++);
            subscription.Dispose();tree.Set("Learn",true);
            Assert.That(notifications,Is.EqualTo(1),"A disposed listener receives no further notifications.");
            Assert.That(graphic.enabled,Is.True);
            go.GetComponent<UIRedDotBinder>().Bind(tree,"Other",graphic);tree.Set("Restore",false);Assert.That(graphic.enabled,Is.False);
            tree.Set("Learn",false);tree.Set("Learn",true);Assert.That(graphic.enabled,Is.False,"Rebind releases the old listener.");
        }

        [TearDown]
        public void TearDown()
        {
            for (int i = _created.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (_created[i] != null)
                    Object.DestroyImmediate(_created[i]);
            }
            _created.Clear();
            Time.timeScale = 1f;
        }

        [Test]
        public void RichTextParser_MatchesNestedTagsWithTheSameName()
        {
            UIRichTextParseResult result = new UIRichTextParser().Parse("[b]outer[b]inner[/b]tail[/b]", new UIRichTextConfig());

            Assert.That(result.ParsedText, Is.EqualTo("<b>outer<b>inner</b>tail</b>"));
            Assert.That(result.Warnings, Is.Empty);
        }

        [Test]
        public void RichTextParser_GradientContainingLink_PreservesLinkAndWarnsAboutFallback()
        {
            var config = new UIRichTextConfig
            {
                gradientAliases = new List<UIRichTextGradientAlias>
                {
                    new UIRichTextGradientAlias { key = "Gold", fallbackColor = "#112233" }
                }
            };

            UIRichTextParseResult result = new UIRichTextParser().Parse("[gradient:gold][link:item:7]Loot[/link][/gradient]", config);

            Assert.That(result.ParsedText, Does.Contain("<link=\"item:7\">"));
            Assert.That(result.ParsedText, Does.StartWith("<color=#112233FF>"));
            Assert.That(result.Links, Has.Count.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(result.Warnings, Has.Some.Contains("TMP 标签"));
        }

        [Test]
        public void RichTextConfig_AliasesIgnoreCase_AndHashTracksConfigurationChanges()
        {
            var config = new UIRichTextConfig
            {
                spriteAliases = new List<UIRichTextSpriteAlias> { new UIRichTextSpriteAlias { key = "Coin", spriteName = "coin" } },
                colorAliases = new List<UIRichTextColorAlias> { new UIRichTextColorAlias { key = "Danger", color = Color.red } },
                gradientAliases = new List<UIRichTextGradientAlias> { new UIRichTextGradientAlias { key = "Gold", fallbackColor = "#ABCDEF" } }
            };

            Assert.That(config.TryGetSpriteAlias("cOiN", out UIRichTextSpriteAlias sprite), Is.True);
            Assert.That(sprite.spriteName, Is.EqualTo("coin"));
            Assert.That(config.TryGetColor("DANGER", out Color color), Is.True);
            Assert.That(color, Is.EqualTo(Color.red));
            Assert.That(config.TryGetGradient("gOlD", out UIRichTextGradientAlias gradient), Is.True);
            Assert.That(gradient.fallbackColor, Is.EqualTo("#ABCDEF"));

            int initialHash = config.ComputeContentHash();
            config.underlineLinks = !config.underlineLinks;
            int behaviorHash = config.ComputeContentHash();
            config.gradientAliases[0].fallbackColor = "#123456";
            int aliasHash = config.ComputeContentHash();

            Assert.That(behaviorHash, Is.Not.EqualTo(initialHash));
            Assert.That(aliasHash, Is.Not.EqualTo(behaviorHash));
        }

        [TestCase(UIRawImageFitMode.Contain, 100f, 50f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 1f)]
        [TestCase(UIRawImageFitMode.Cover, 100f, 100f, 0.25f, 0f, 0.5f, 1f)]
        [TestCase(UIRawImageFitMode.Fill, 100f, 100f, 0f, 0f, 1f, 1f)]
        public void RawImageFitter_FitsWideTextureIntoSquareContainer(
            UIRawImageFitMode mode, float width, float height,
            float uvX, float uvY, float uvWidth, float uvHeight)
        {
            GameObject container = Track(new GameObject("Container", typeof(RectTransform)));
            var containerRect = (RectTransform)container.transform;
            containerRect.sizeDelta = new Vector2(100f, 100f);
            GameObject imageObject = Track(new GameObject("Image", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(RawImage), typeof(UIRawImageFitter)));
            imageObject.transform.SetParent(container.transform, false);
            var texture = Track(new Texture2D(200, 100));
            var fitter = imageObject.GetComponent<UIRawImageFitter>();
            fitter.FitContainer = containerRect;
            fitter.UseUvRect = true;
            fitter.FitMode = mode;
            fitter.SetTexture(texture);

            var imageRect = (RectTransform)imageObject.transform;
            Rect uv = imageObject.GetComponent<RawImage>().uvRect;
            Assert.That(imageRect.rect.width, Is.EqualTo(width).Within(0.001f));
            Assert.That(imageRect.rect.height, Is.EqualTo(height).Within(0.001f));
            Assert.That(uv.x, Is.EqualTo(uvX).Within(0.001f));
            Assert.That(uv.y, Is.EqualTo(uvY).Within(0.001f));
            Assert.That(uv.width, Is.EqualTo(uvWidth).Within(0.001f));
            Assert.That(uv.height, Is.EqualTo(uvHeight).Within(0.001f));
        }

        [Test]
        public void ToggleGroupBinder_RefreshRemovesOldListenersAndDoesNotDuplicateNewOnes()
        {
            GameObject root = Track(new GameObject("ToggleGroup", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(ToggleGroup)));
            root.SetActive(false);
            var first = CreateToggle(root.transform, "First");
            var removed = CreateToggle(root.transform, "Removed");
            var binder = root.AddComponent<UIToggleGroupBinder>();
            binder.allowSwitchOff = true;
            binder.defaultIndex = -1;
            root.SetActive(true);
            binder.RefreshToggles();

            removed.transform.SetParent(null, false);
            var added = CreateToggle(root.transform, "Added");
            binder.RefreshToggles();
            binder.RefreshToggles();

            int callbacks = 0;
            binder.onSelectedIndexChanged.AddListener(_ => callbacks++);
            first.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(false);
            added.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(false);
            removed.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(true);
            removed.onValueChanged.Invoke(true);
            Assert.That(callbacks, Is.Zero, "Removed toggles must not retain binder listeners.");

            removed.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(false);
            added.SetIsOnWithoutNotify(true);
            added.onValueChanged.Invoke(true);
            Assert.That(callbacks, Is.EqualTo(1), "Repeated refreshes must bind exactly one listener.");
        }

        private Toggle CreateToggle(Transform parent, string name)
        {
            GameObject go = Track(new GameObject(name, typeof(RectTransform), typeof(Toggle)));
            go.transform.SetParent(parent, false);
            return go.GetComponent<Toggle>();
        }

        private T Track<T>(T value) where T : Object
        {
            _created.Add(value);
            return value;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using FRFrame;
using NUnit.Framework;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.EventSystems;
using UnityEngine.TestTools;
using UnityEngine.UI;

namespace FRFrame.Tests.UIExtensions
{
    public sealed class UIRuntimeExtensionsPlayModeTests
    {
        private readonly List<Object> _created = new List<Object>();

        [UnityTearDown]
        public IEnumerator TearDown()
        {
            Time.timeScale = 1f;
            for (int i = _created.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
            {
                if (_created[i] != null)
                    Object.Destroy(_created[i]);
            }
            _created.Clear();
            yield return null;
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator LongPress_MovePastToleranceCancelsWithoutLateLongPress_AndDisableClearsState()
        {
            EventSystem eventSystem = Track(new GameObject("EventSystem", typeof(EventSystem))).GetComponent<EventSystem>();
            var trigger = Track(new GameObject("LongPress", typeof(UILongPressTrigger))).GetComponent<UILongPressTrigger>();
            trigger.longPressThreshold = 0.04f;
            trigger.moveTolerance = 5f;
            trigger.useUnscaledTime = true;
            int longPresses = 0;
            int cancellations = 0;
            trigger.onLongPressed.AddListener(() => longPresses++);
            trigger.onCanceled.AddListener(() => cancellations++);

            trigger.OnPointerDown(Pointer(eventSystem, Vector2.zero));
            trigger.OnDrag(Pointer(eventSystem, new Vector2(6f, 0f)));
            yield return new WaitForSecondsRealtime(0.08f);
            Assert.That(cancellations, Is.EqualTo(1));
            Assert.That(longPresses, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(trigger.IsPressed, Is.False);

            trigger.OnPointerDown(Pointer(eventSystem, Vector2.zero));
            trigger.enabled = false;
            Assert.That(trigger.IsPressed, Is.False);
            Assert.That(trigger.IsLongPressed, Is.False);
            Assert.That(trigger.Progress, Is.Zero);
            yield return new WaitForSecondsRealtime(0.08f);
            Assert.That(longPresses, Is.Zero);
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator SnapScroll_ChangedStartsImmediately_AndOnlyFinalAnimationSettles()
        {
            UISnapScrollPage snap = CreateSnapScroll(0.3f);
            var events = new List<string>();
            snap.onPageChanged.AddListener(page => events.Add("changed:" + page));
            snap.onPageSettled.AddListener(page => events.Add("settled:" + page));

            snap.MoveToPage(1, true);
            Assert.That(events, Is.EqualTo(new[] { "changed:1" }));
            yield return new WaitForSecondsRealtime(0.02f);
            snap.MoveToPage(2, true);
            Assert.That(events, Is.EqualTo(new[] { "changed:1", "changed:2" }));
            float timeout = Time.realtimeSinceStartup + 1f;
            while (snap.IsSettling && Time.realtimeSinceStartup < timeout)
                yield return null;

            Assert.That(snap.IsSettling, Is.False, "The final page animation did not complete before the timeout.");
            Assert.That(events, Is.EqualTo(new[] { "changed:1", "changed:2", "settled:2" }));
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator SnapScroll_DisableCancelsLateSettledEvent()
        {
            UISnapScrollPage snap = CreateSnapScroll(0.04f);
            int settled = 0;
            snap.onPageSettled.AddListener(_ => settled++);

            snap.MoveToPage(1, true);
            snap.enabled = false;
            yield return new WaitForSecondsRealtime(0.08f);

            Assert.That(settled, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(snap.IsSettling, Is.False);
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator VirtualList_ClearRecyclesOldDataBeforeReset_AndReportsEmptyRange()
        {
            GameObject root = Track(new GameObject("List", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(ScrollRect), typeof(UIVirtualList)));
            root.SetActive(false);
            var rootRect = (RectTransform)root.transform;
            rootRect.sizeDelta = new Vector2(100f, 100f);
            GameObject contentObject = Track(new GameObject("Content", typeof(RectTransform)));
            contentObject.transform.SetParent(root.transform, false);
            var content = (RectTransform)contentObject.transform;
            content.sizeDelta = new Vector2(100f, 100f);
            var scrollRect = root.GetComponent<ScrollRect>();
            scrollRect.viewport = rootRect;
            scrollRect.content = content;
            GameObject prefab = Track(new GameObject("ItemPrefab", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(RecyclingProbeItem)));
            prefab.SetActive(false);

            var list = root.GetComponent<UIVirtualList>();
            list.Configure(scrollRect, rootRect, content, prefab, UIVirtualListLayoutMode.Vertical,
                new Vector2(100f, 30f), Vector2.zero, default, 1, 0, 8);
            list.Initialize(null, typeof(RecyclingProbeItem));
            UIItem visibleItem = null;
            Vector2Int lastRange = new Vector2Int(int.MinValue, int.MinValue);
            list.onItemVisible.AddListener((_, item) => visibleItem = item);
            list.onVisibleRangeChanged.AddListener((start, end) => lastRange = new Vector2Int(start, end));
            root.SetActive(true);
            object oldData = new object();
            list.SetDataList(new[] { oldData });
            yield return null;

            Assert.That(visibleItem, Is.Not.Null);
            visibleItem.SetSelected(true);
            var probe = (RecyclingProbeItem)visibleItem;
            list.Clear();

            Assert.That(probe.RecycledIndex, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(probe.RecycledData, Is.SameAs(oldData));
            Assert.That(probe.IndexSeenInsideRecycle, Is.Zero);
            Assert.That(probe.DataSeenInsideRecycle, Is.SameAs(oldData));
            Assert.That(visibleItem.Index, Is.EqualTo(-1));
            Assert.That(visibleItem.Data, Is.Null);
            Assert.That(visibleItem.IsSelected, Is.False);
            Assert.That(lastRange, Is.EqualTo(new Vector2Int(-1, -1)));
            list.GetVisibleRange(out int start, out int end);
            Assert.That(new Vector2Int(start, end), Is.EqualTo(new Vector2Int(-1, -1)));
        }

        [UnityTest]
        public IEnumerator ScrollText_DisableStopsPlaybackWithoutLateRecovery()
        {
            GameObject viewportObject = Track(new GameObject("Viewport", typeof(RectTransform)));
            viewportObject.SetActive(false);
            var viewport = (RectTransform)viewportObject.transform;
            viewport.sizeDelta = new Vector2(50f, 20f);
            GameObject textObject = Track(new GameObject("Text", typeof(RectTransform)));
            textObject.transform.SetParent(viewport, false);
            var textRoot = (RectTransform)textObject.transform;
            textRoot.sizeDelta = new Vector2(200f, 20f);
            var scrollText = viewportObject.AddComponent<UIScrollText>();
            scrollText.viewport = viewport;
            scrollText.textRoot = textRoot;
            scrollText.playOnEnable = false;
            scrollText.startDelay = 0.04f;
            viewportObject.SetActive(true);
            scrollText.Refresh();
            scrollText.Play();
            Assert.That(scrollText.IsOverflow, Is.True);
            Assert.That(scrollText.IsPlaying, Is.True);

            scrollText.enabled = false;
            Assert.That(scrollText.IsPlaying, Is.False);
            yield return new WaitForSecondsRealtime(0.1f);
            Assert.That(scrollText.IsPlaying, Is.False);
        }

        private UISnapScrollPage CreateSnapScroll(float duration)
        {
            GameObject root = Track(new GameObject("Snap", typeof(RectTransform), typeof(ScrollRect), typeof(UISnapScrollPage)));
            root.SetActive(false);
            var viewport = (RectTransform)root.transform;
            viewport.sizeDelta = new Vector2(100f, 100f);
            GameObject contentObject = Track(new GameObject("Content", typeof(RectTransform)));
            contentObject.transform.SetParent(root.transform, false);
            var content = (RectTransform)contentObject.transform;
            content.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
            content.anchorMax = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
            content.pivot = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
            content.sizeDelta = new Vector2(300f, 100f);
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            {
                GameObject page = Track(new GameObject("Page" + i, typeof(RectTransform)));
                page.transform.SetParent(content, false);
                var pageRect = (RectTransform)page.transform;
                pageRect.anchorMin = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
                pageRect.anchorMax = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
                pageRect.pivot = new Vector2(0f, 0.5f);
                pageRect.sizeDelta = new Vector2(100f, 100f);
                pageRect.anchoredPosition = new Vector2(i * 100f, 0f);
            }
            var scrollRect = root.GetComponent<ScrollRect>();
            scrollRect.viewport = viewport;
            scrollRect.content = content;
            var snap = root.GetComponent<UISnapScrollPage>();
            snap.scrollRect = scrollRect;
            snap.content = content;
            snap.snapDuration = duration;
            root.SetActive(true);
            snap.RefreshPages();
            return snap;
        }

        private static PointerEventData Pointer(EventSystem eventSystem, Vector2 position)
        {
            return new PointerEventData(eventSystem) { position = position };
        }

        private T Track<T>(T value) where T : Object
        {
            _created.Add(value);
            return value;
        }
    }

    public sealed class RecyclingProbeItem : UIItem
    {

        {
            RecycledIndex = index;
````
