````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D.Editor
{
    public sealed class Live2DBatchReimportWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private DefaultAsset _rootFolder;
        private bool _removeMissingScripts = true;
        private Vector2 _scrollPosition;
        private readonly List<string> _modelPaths = new List<string>();

        [MenuItem("Tools/Live2D/Migration/Batch Reimport Models (Cubism r5)")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            var window = GetWindow<Live2DBatchReimportWindow>("Live2D r5 Reimport");
            if (Selection.activeObject is DefaultAsset selectedFolder
                && AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(selectedFolder)))
            {
                window._rootFolder = selectedFolder;
                window.ScanModels();
            }
            window.Show();
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Cubism r5 Batch Reimport", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(
                "Recursively finds .model3.json files and forces Cubism to rebuild their imported assets and prefabs.",
                MessageType.Info);

            EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
            _rootFolder = (DefaultAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Root Folder", _rootFolder, typeof(DefaultAsset), false);
            if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())
                ScanModels();

            _removeMissingScripts = EditorGUILayout.ToggleLeft(
                "Remove missing scripts from existing model prefabs before reimport",
                _removeMissingScripts);

            if (_removeMissingScripts)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(
                    "Cubism r5 removed CubismMaskController. Cleanup prevents the r5 importer from failing while copying old prefab components. " +
                    "This removes every missing MonoBehaviour on each matching model prefab.",
                    MessageType.Warning);
            }

            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                if (GUILayout.Button("Scan"))
                    ScanModels();

                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_modelPaths.Count == 0))
                {
                    if (GUILayout.Button($"Reimport {_modelPaths.Count} Models"))
                        ConfirmAndReimport();
                }
            }

            EditorGUILayout.Space(8f);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"Models found: {_modelPaths.Count}", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _scrollPosition = EditorGUILayout.BeginScrollView(_scrollPosition);
            foreach (string modelPath in _modelPaths)
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField(modelPath, EditorStyles.miniLabel);
            EditorGUILayout.EndScrollView();
        }

        private void ScanModels()
        {
            _modelPaths.Clear();
            string rootPath = GetRootPath();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootPath))
            {
                Repaint();
                return;
            }

            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:TextAsset", new[] { rootPath });
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                if (path.EndsWith(".model3.json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    _modelPaths.Add(path);
            }

            _modelPaths.Sort(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            Repaint();
        }

        private string GetRootPath()
        {
            if (_rootFolder == null) return null;
            string path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_rootFolder);
            return AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(path) ? path : null;
        }

        private void ConfirmAndReimport()
        {
            string rootPath = GetRootPath();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootPath) || _modelPaths.Count == 0) return;

            string cleanupNotice = _removeMissingScripts
                ? "\n\nMissing MonoBehaviours on matching existing prefabs will be removed first."
                : string.Empty;
            bool confirmed = EditorUtility.DisplayDialog(
                "Batch Reimport Live2D Models",
                $"Force reimport {_modelPaths.Count} Live2D models under:\n{rootPath}{cleanupNotice}",
                "Reimport",
                "Cancel");
            if (!confirmed) return;

            ReimportModels(rootPath);
        }

        private void ReimportModels(string rootPath)
        {
            int succeeded = 0;
            int failed = 0;
            int removedMissingScripts = 0;
            bool canceled = false;

            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < _modelPaths.Count; i++)
                {
                    string modelPath = _modelPaths[i];
                    canceled = EditorUtility.DisplayCancelableProgressBar(
                        "Reimporting Live2D Models",
                        modelPath,
                        (float)i / _modelPaths.Count);
                    if (canceled) break;

                    try
                    {
                        string prefabPath = GetModelPrefabPath(modelPath);
                        if (_removeMissingScripts && AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(prefabPath) != null)
                            removedMissingScripts += RemoveMissingScripts(prefabPath);

                        AssetDatabase.ImportAsset(
                            modelPath,
                            ImportAssetOptions.ForceUpdate | ImportAssetOptions.ForceSynchronousImport);
                        succeeded++;
                    }
                    catch (Exception exception)
                    {
                        failed++;
                        Debug.LogError($"Live2D r5 reimport failed: {modelPath}\n{exception}");
                    }
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                EditorUtility.ClearProgressBar();
                AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
                AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            }

            string status = canceled ? "canceled" : "completed";
            Debug.Log(
                $"Live2D r5 batch reimport {status}. succeeded={succeeded}, failed={failed}, " +
                $"removedMissingScripts={removedMissingScripts}, root={rootPath}");
            EditorUtility.DisplayDialog(
                "Live2D Batch Reimport",
                $"Status: {status}\nSucceeded: {succeeded}\nFailed: {failed}\nRemoved missing scripts: {removedMissingScripts}",
                "OK");
        }

        private static string GetModelPrefabPath(string modelPath)
        {
            const string modelSuffix = ".model3.json";
            return modelPath.Substring(0, modelPath.Length - modelSuffix.Length) + ".prefab";
        }

        private static int RemoveMissingScripts(string prefabPath)
        {
            GameObject root = PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents(prefabPath);
            if (root == null) return 0;

            try
            {
                int removed = 0;
                foreach (Transform transform in root.GetComponentsInChildren<Transform>(true))
                    removed += GameObjectUtility.RemoveMonoBehavioursWithMissingScript(transform.gameObject);

                if (removed > 0)
                {
                    PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, prefabPath);
                    Debug.Log($"Removed {removed} missing script(s) before Live2D r5 reimport: {prefabPath}");
                }
                return removed;
            }
            finally
            {
                PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(root);
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D.Editor
{
    [CustomEditor(typeof(Live2DInteractionProfile))]
    public class Live2DInteractionProfileEditor : UnityEditor.Editor
    {
        private readonly List<string> _issues = new List<string>();

        public override void OnInspectorGUI()
        {
            DrawDefaultInspector();

            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            if (GUILayout.Button("Validate Profile")) Validate();

            if (_issues.Count == 0) return;
            EditorGUILayout.Space();
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Validation", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            foreach (string issue in _issues)
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox(issue, MessageType.Warning);
        }

        private void Validate()
        {
            _issues.Clear();
            var profile = (Live2DInteractionProfile)target;
            if (profile.motionLibrary == null) _issues.Add("Motion Library is not assigned.");
            if (profile.layouts == null || profile.layouts.Count == 0) _issues.Add("No interaction layouts configured.");

            var layoutIds = new HashSet<string>();
            if (profile.layouts != null)
            {
                foreach (var layout in profile.layouts)
                {
                    if (layout == null) continue;
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(layout.layoutId)) _issues.Add("Layout has empty layoutId.");
                    else if (!layoutIds.Add(layout.layoutId)) _issues.Add($"Duplicate layoutId: {layout.layoutId}");

                    if (layout.areas == null) continue;
                    foreach (var area in layout.areas)
                    {
                        if (area == null) continue;
                        if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(area.areaId)) _issues.Add($"Layout {layout.layoutId} has area with empty areaId.");
                        if (area.shapeType == Live2DTouchShapeType.Polygon && (area.normalizedPoints == null || area.normalizedPoints.Count < 3))
                            _issues.Add($"Area {area.areaId} uses Polygon but has fewer than 3 points.");
                        ValidateBindings(profile, area);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(profile.defaultLayoutId) && !layoutIds.Contains(profile.defaultLayoutId))
                _issues.Add($"Default layout not found: {profile.defaultLayoutId}");

            if (profile.layoutBindings != null)
            {
                foreach (var binding in profile.layoutBindings)
                {
                    if (binding == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(binding.layoutId)) continue;
                    if (!layoutIds.Contains(binding.layoutId)) _issues.Add($"Layout binding references missing layout: {binding.layoutId}");
                }
            }

            if (_issues.Count == 0) _issues.Add("No issues found.");
        }

        private void ValidateBindings(Live2DInteractionProfile profile, Live2DTouchArea area)
        {
            if (area.bindings == null) return;
            foreach (var binding in area.bindings)
            {
                if (binding == null || binding.actions == null) continue;
                foreach (var action in binding.actions)
                {
                    if (action == null) continue;
                    switch (action.actionType)
                    {
                        case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotion:
                            var library = action.motion.library != null ? action.motion.library : profile.motionLibrary;
                            if (library == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(action.motion.motionId) || !library.HasMotion(action.motion.motionId))
                                _issues.Add($"Area {area.areaId} references missing motion: {action.motion.motionId}");
                            break;
                        case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotionGroup:
                            if (profile.motionLibrary == null || profile.motionLibrary.GetGroup(action.groupId) == null)
                                _issues.Add($"Area {area.areaId} references missing group: {action.groupId}");
                            break;
                        case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayParameterAnimation:
                            if (action.parameterAnimation == null) _issues.Add($"Area {area.areaId} has empty parameter animation action.");
                            break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D.Editor
{
    [CustomPropertyDrawer(typeof(Live2DMotionReference))]
    public class Live2DMotionReferenceDrawer : PropertyDrawer
    {
        public override void OnGUI(Rect position, SerializedProperty property, GUIContent label)
        {
            EditorGUI.BeginProperty(position, label, property);
            position = EditorGUI.PrefixLabel(position, label);

            var libraryProperty = property.FindPropertyRelative("library");
            var motionIdProperty = property.FindPropertyRelative("motionId");
            float libraryWidth = Mathf.Max(120f, position.width * 0.45f);
            var libraryRect = new Rect(position.x, position.y, libraryWidth - 4f, EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight);
            var motionRect = new Rect(position.x + libraryWidth, position.y, position.width - libraryWidth, EditorGUIUtility.singleLineHeight);

            EditorGUI.PropertyField(libraryRect, libraryProperty, GUIContent.none);
            DrawMotionPopup(motionRect, libraryProperty.objectReferenceValue as Live2DMotionLibrary, motionIdProperty);
            EditorGUI.EndProperty();
        }

        private static void DrawMotionPopup(Rect rect, Live2DMotionLibrary library, SerializedProperty motionIdProperty)
        {
            if (library == null || library.clips == null || library.clips.Count == 0)
            {
                EditorGUI.PropertyField(rect, motionIdProperty, GUIContent.none);
                return;
            }

            var options = new List<string> { "<None>" };
            int selected = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < library.clips.Count; i++)
            {
                var clip = library.clips[i];
                if (clip == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(clip.motionId)) continue;
                string label = string.IsNullOrEmpty(clip.displayName) ? clip.motionId : $"{clip.displayName} ({clip.motionId})";
                options.Add(label);
                if (clip.motionId == motionIdProperty.stringValue) selected = options.Count - 1;
            }

            int next = EditorGUI.Popup(rect, selected, options.ToArray());
            if (next == selected) return;
            motionIdProperty.stringValue = next <= 0 ? string.Empty : library.clips[next - 1].motionId;
        }
    }
}
#endif
````

## File: Third/Live2d/Editor/Live2DNewMotionLibraryBuilderWindow.cs
````csharp
#if UNITY_EDITOR
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using Live2D.Cubism.Core;
using UnityEditor;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D.Editor
{
    public class Live2DNewMotionLibraryBuilderWindow : EditorWindow
    {
        private DefaultAsset _modelFolder;
        private DefaultAsset _batchRootFolder;
        private TextAsset _model3Json;
        private bool _createInteractionProfile = true;
        private bool _createDefaultTouchArea = true;
        private bool _overwriteDefaultTouchArea;
        private bool _overwriteClips = true;
        private bool _overwriteDefaultGroups = true;
        private bool _autoAttachControllerToPrefab = true;
        private bool _addSimpleAudioHandler = true;
        private string _librarySuffix = "_Live2DMotionLibrary";
        private string _profileSuffix = "_Live2DInteractionProfile";

        [MenuItem("Tools/Live2D/New Runtime/Build Library From Selected Folder")]
        public static void BuildFromSelectedFolder()
        {
            var window = GetWindow<Live2DNewMotionLibraryBuilderWindow>("Live2D Library Builder");
            if (Selection.activeObject is DefaultAsset folder) window._modelFolder = folder;
            window.Show();
        }

        [MenuItem("Tools/Live2D/New Runtime/Library Builder")]
        public static void Open()
        {
            GetWindow<Live2DNewMotionLibraryBuilderWindow>("Live2D Library Builder");
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Build New Live2D Runtime Assets", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _modelFolder = (DefaultAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Model Folder", _modelFolder, typeof(DefaultAsset), false);
            _model3Json = (TextAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Model3 Json", _model3Json, typeof(TextAsset), false);
            _librarySuffix = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Library Suffix", _librarySuffix);
            _profileSuffix = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Profile Suffix", _profileSuffix);
            _createInteractionProfile = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Create Interaction Profile", _createInteractionProfile);
            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(!_createInteractionProfile))
            {
                _createDefaultTouchArea = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Create Default Touch Area", _createDefaultTouchArea);
                _overwriteDefaultTouchArea = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Overwrite Default Touch Area", _overwriteDefaultTouchArea);
            }
            _overwriteClips = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Overwrite Clips", _overwriteClips);
            _overwriteDefaultGroups = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Overwrite Default Groups", _overwriteDefaultGroups);
            _autoAttachControllerToPrefab = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Auto Attach Controller To Prefab", _autoAttachControllerToPrefab);
            _addSimpleAudioHandler = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Add Simple Audio Handler", _addSimpleAudioHandler);

            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_modelFolder == null && _model3Json == null))
            {
                if (GUILayout.Button("Build")) Build();
                if (GUILayout.Button("Delete Generated Assets And Prefab Components")) DeleteCurrentFolderGeneratedData();
            }

            EditorGUILayout.Space(12);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Batch Build", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            _batchRootFolder = (DefaultAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Root Folder", _batchRootFolder, typeof(DefaultAsset), false);
            using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_batchRootFolder == null))
            {
                if (GUILayout.Button("Build All Child Model Folders")) BuildBatch();
                if (GUILayout.Button("Delete All Child Generated Assets And Prefab Components")) DeleteBatchGeneratedData();
            }
        }

        private void Build()
        {
            string folderPath = ResolveFolderPath();
            BuildFolder(folderPath, true);
        }

        private bool BuildFolder(string folderPath, bool selectLibrary)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(folderPath) || !AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(folderPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError("Live2D model folder is invalid.");
                return false;
            }

            var model3Json = ResolveModel3Json(folderPath);
            if (model3Json == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"model3.json not found under {folderPath}");
                return false;
            }

            string modelName = Path.GetFileName(folderPath);
            string libraryPath = $"{folderPath}/{modelName}{_librarySuffix}.asset";
            var library = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Live2DMotionLibrary>(libraryPath) ?? FindExistingAsset<Live2DMotionLibrary>(folderPath, _librarySuffix);
            if (library == null)
            {
                library = CreateInstance<Live2DMotionLibrary>();
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(library, libraryPath);
            }

            library.modelName = modelName;
            library.model3Json = model3Json;
            library.motionFolderPath = $"{folderPath}/motions";
            if (_overwriteClips) BuildClips(library, folderPath, model3Json);
            if (_overwriteDefaultGroups) BuildDefaultGroups(library);
            EnsureAllMotionsGroup(library);
            library.BuildRuntimeCache();
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(library);

            Live2DInteractionProfile profile = null;
            if (_createInteractionProfile) profile = CreateOrUpdateProfile(folderPath, modelName, library);
            if (_autoAttachControllerToPrefab) AttachControllerToPrefab(folderPath, modelName, library, profile);

            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            if (selectLibrary) Selection.activeObject = library;
            Debug.Log($"Live2D new runtime library built: {AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(library)}");
            return true;
        }

        private void BuildBatch()
        {
            string rootPath = _batchRootFolder != null ? AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_batchRootFolder) : null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootPath) || !AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(rootPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError("Live2D batch root folder is invalid.");
                return;
            }

            int success = 0;
            int skipped = 0;
            foreach (string folderPath in EnumerateModelFolders(rootPath))
            {
                try
                {
                    if (BuildFolder(folderPath, false)) success++;
                    else skipped++;
                }
                catch (Exception e)
                {
                    skipped++;
                    Debug.LogError($"Live2D batch build failed: {folderPath}\n{e}");
                }
            }
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            Debug.Log($"Live2D batch build completed. success={success}, skipped={skipped}, root={rootPath}");
        }

        private void DeleteCurrentFolderGeneratedData()
        {
            string folderPath = ResolveFolderPath();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(folderPath) || !AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(folderPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError("Live2D model folder is invalid.");
                return;
            }
            DeleteGeneratedData(folderPath);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
        }

        private void DeleteBatchGeneratedData()
        {
            string rootPath = _batchRootFolder != null ? AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_batchRootFolder) : null;
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(rootPath) || !AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(rootPath))
            {
                Debug.LogError("Live2D batch root folder is invalid.");
                return;
            }

            int count = 0;
            foreach (string folderPath in EnumerateModelFolders(rootPath))
            {
                DeleteGeneratedData(folderPath);
                count++;
            }
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            AssetDatabase.Refresh();
            Debug.Log($"Live2D batch delete completed. count={count}, root={rootPath}");
        }

        private void DeleteGeneratedData(string folderPath)
        {
            string modelName = Path.GetFileName(folderPath);
            RemoveControllerFromPrefab(folderPath, modelName);
            DeleteAssetIfExists<Live2DInteractionProfile>(folderPath, _profileSuffix, $"{folderPath}/{modelName}{_profileSuffix}.asset");
            DeleteAssetIfExists<Live2DMotionLibrary>(folderPath, _librarySuffix, $"{folderPath}/{modelName}{_librarySuffix}.asset");
            Debug.Log($"Live2D generated data deleted under {folderPath}");
        }

        private static void DeleteAssetIfExists<T>(string folderPath, string suffix, string preferredPath) where T : UnityEngine.Object
        {
            var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<T>(preferredPath) ?? FindExistingAsset<T>(folderPath, suffix);
            if (asset == null) return;
            string path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(asset);
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) AssetDatabase.DeleteAsset(path);
        }

        private void RemoveControllerFromPrefab(string folderPath, string modelName)
        {
            string prefabPath = FindPrefabPath(folderPath, modelName);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefabPath)) return;
            var root = PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents(prefabPath);
            try
            {
                bool changed = false;
                foreach (var controller in root.GetComponentsInChildren<Live2DMotionController>(true))
                {
                    DestroyImmediate(controller, true);
                    changed = true;
                }
                foreach (var audioHandler in root.GetComponentsInChildren<Live2DSimpleAudioEventHandler>(true))
                {
                    DestroyImmediate(audioHandler, true);
                    changed = true;
                }
                if (changed)
                {
                    PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, prefabPath);
                    Debug.Log($"Live2D components removed from prefab: {prefabPath}");
                }
            }
            finally
            {
                PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(root);
            }
        }

        private static IEnumerable<string> EnumerateModelFolders(string rootPath)
        {
            var result = new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:TextAsset", new[] { rootPath });
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                if (!path.EndsWith(".model3.json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) continue;
                string folder = Path.GetDirectoryName(path)?.Replace("\\", "/");
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(folder)) result.Add(folder);
            }
            return result;
        }

        private string ResolveFolderPath()
        {
            if (_modelFolder != null) return AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_modelFolder);
            if (_model3Json == null) return null;
            string jsonPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_model3Json);
            return Path.GetDirectoryName(jsonPath)?.Replace("\\", "/");
        }

        private TextAsset ResolveModel3Json(string folderPath)
        {
            if (_model3Json != null) return _model3Json;
            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:TextAsset", new[] { folderPath });
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                if (path.EndsWith(".model3.json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TextAsset>(path);
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static T FindExistingAsset<T>(string folderPath, string suffix) where T : UnityEngine.Object
        {
            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets($"t:{typeof(T).Name}", new[] { folderPath });
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                if (Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path).EndsWith(suffix, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    return AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<T>(path);
            }
            return null;
        }

        private static void BuildClips(Live2DMotionLibrary library, string folderPath, TextAsset model3Json)
        {
            library.clips.Clear();
            var paths = new SortedSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            string modelPath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(model3Json);
            string modelText = File.ReadAllText(modelPath);
            foreach (var path in ExtractMotionPaths(modelText)) paths.Add(path);

            string motionsFolder = $"{folderPath}/motions";
            if (AssetDatabase.IsValidFolder(motionsFolder))
            {
                foreach (string guid in AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:TextAsset", new[] { motionsFolder }))
                {
                    string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                    if (path.EndsWith(".motion3.json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) paths.Add(path.Substring(folderPath.Length + 1));
                }
            }

            foreach (string relativePath in paths)
            {
                string assetPath = relativePath.StartsWith("Assets/", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? relativePath : $"{folderPath}/{relativePath}";
                var motionAsset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TextAsset>(assetPath);
                if (motionAsset == null) continue;
                string motionId = Live2DMotionLibrary.NormalizeMotionId(Path.GetFileName(relativePath));
                var category = Live2DMotionLibrary.GuessCategory(motionId);
                library.clips.Add(new Live2DMotionClip
                {
                    motionId = motionId,
                    displayName = motionId,
                    motionAsset = motionAsset,
                    sourceFilePath = relativePath,
                    category = category,
                    defaultLayer = Live2DMotionLibrary.GuessDefaultLayer(category),
                    loopMode = GuessLoopMode(motionId, category),
                    interruptPolicy = GuessInterruptPolicy(category)
                });
            }
        }

        private static IEnumerable<string> ExtractMotionPaths(string json)
        {
            const string key = "\"File\"";
            int index = 0;
            while ((index = json.IndexOf(key, index, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) >= 0)
            {
                int colon = json.IndexOf(':', index + key.Length);
                if (colon < 0) yield break;
                int start = json.IndexOf('"', colon + 1);
                if (start < 0) yield break;
                int end = json.IndexOf('"', start + 1);
                if (end < 0) yield break;
                string path = json.Substring(start + 1, end - start - 1).Replace("\\", "/");
                if (path.EndsWith(".motion3.json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) yield return path;
                index = end + 1;
            }
        }

        private static Live2DLoopMode GuessLoopMode(string motionId, Live2DMotionCategory category)
        {
            string n = motionId.ToLowerInvariant();
            if (n.StartsWith("idle") || n.StartsWith("main")) return Live2DLoopMode.ForceLoop;
            if (n == "login") return Live2DLoopMode.ForceOnce;
            return category == Live2DMotionCategory.Effect ? Live2DLoopMode.UseSource : Live2DLoopMode.ForceOnce;
        }

        private static Live2DInterruptPolicy GuessInterruptPolicy(Live2DMotionCategory category)
        {
            return category == Live2DMotionCategory.Idle || category == Live2DMotionCategory.Base
                ? Live2DInterruptPolicy.QueueUntilFinish
                : Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade;
        }

        private static void BuildDefaultGroups(Live2DMotionLibrary library)
        {
            library.groups.Clear();
            AddGroup(library, "idle_base", Live2DSelectionMode.ShuffleBag, c => c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.Idle);
            AddGroup(library, "base_once", Live2DSelectionMode.ShuffleBag, c => c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.Base || c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.Transition);
            AddGroup(library, "touch", Live2DSelectionMode.ShuffleBag, c => c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.Touch || c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.TouchIdle);
            AddGroup(library, "drag", Live2DSelectionMode.ShuffleBag, c => c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.Drag);
            AddGroup(library, "effect", Live2DSelectionMode.First, c => c.category == Live2DMotionCategory.Effect);
        }

        private static void EnsureAllMotionsGroup(Live2DMotionLibrary library)
        {
            if (library == null) return;
            library.groups.RemoveAll(g => g != null && string.Equals(g.groupId, "all_motions", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            AddGroup(library, "all_motions", Live2DSelectionMode.ShuffleBag, c => true);
        }

        private static void AddGroup(Live2DMotionLibrary library, string groupId, Live2DSelectionMode mode, Predicate<Live2DMotionClip> match)
        {
            var group = new Live2DMotionGroup { groupId = groupId, displayName = groupId, selectionMode = mode };
            foreach (var clip in library.clips)
            {
                if (clip == null || !match(clip)) continue;
                group.candidates.Add(new Live2DMotionCandidate
                {
                    motion = new Live2DMotionReference { library = library, motionId = clip.motionId },
                    weight = 1f
                });
            }
            if (group.candidates.Count > 0) library.groups.Add(group);
        }

        private void AttachControllerToPrefab(string folderPath, string modelName, Live2DMotionLibrary library, Live2DInteractionProfile profile)
        {
            string prefabPath = FindPrefabPath(folderPath, modelName);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(prefabPath))
            {
                Debug.LogWarning($"Live2D prefab not found under {folderPath}");
                return;
            }

            var root = PrefabUtility.LoadPrefabContents(prefabPath);
            try
            {
                var model = root.GetComponentInChildren<CubismModel>(true);
                if (model == null)
                {
                    Debug.LogWarning($"CubismModel not found in prefab: {prefabPath}");
                    return;
                }

                var controller = model.GetComponent<Live2DMotionController>();
                if (controller == null) controller = model.gameObject.AddComponent<Live2DMotionController>();
                controller.cubismModel = model;
                controller.motionLibrary = library;
                controller.interactionProfile = profile;

                if (_addSimpleAudioHandler)
                {
                    var audioHandler = model.GetComponent<Live2DSimpleAudioEventHandler>();
                    if (audioHandler == null) audioHandler = model.gameObject.AddComponent<Live2DSimpleAudioEventHandler>();
                    controller.audioEventHandler = audioHandler;
                }

                PrefabUtility.SaveAsPrefabAsset(root, prefabPath);
                Debug.Log($"Live2D controller configured on prefab: {prefabPath}");
            }
            finally
            {
                PrefabUtility.UnloadPrefabContents(root);
            }
        }

        private static string FindPrefabPath(string folderPath, string modelName)
        {
            string preferredPath = $"{folderPath}/{modelName}.prefab";
            if (AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<GameObject>(preferredPath) != null) return preferredPath;

            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:Prefab", new[] { folderPath });
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                if (Path.GetDirectoryName(path)?.Replace("\\", "/") == folderPath) return path;
            }
            return null;
        }

        private Live2DInteractionProfile CreateOrUpdateProfile(string folderPath, string modelName, Live2DMotionLibrary library)
        {
            string profilePath = $"{folderPath}/{modelName}{_profileSuffix}.asset";
            var profile = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<Live2DInteractionProfile>(profilePath) ?? FindExistingAsset<Live2DInteractionProfile>(folderPath, _profileSuffix);
            if (profile == null)
            {
                profile = CreateInstance<Live2DInteractionProfile>();
                AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(profile, profilePath);
            }
            profile.motionLibrary = library;
            if (profile.layouts.Count == 0)
            {
                profile.defaultLayoutId = "Default";
                profile.layouts.Add(new Live2DInteractionLayout { layoutId = "Default", displayName = "Default" });
            }
            if (_createDefaultTouchArea) EnsureDefaultTouchArea(profile);
            EditorUtility.SetDirty(profile);
            return profile;
        }

        private void EnsureDefaultTouchArea(Live2DInteractionProfile profile)
        {
            var layout = profile.GetDefaultLayout();
            if (layout == null)
            {
                layout = new Live2DInteractionLayout { layoutId = "Default", displayName = "Default" };
                profile.defaultLayoutId = layout.layoutId;
                profile.layouts.Add(layout);
            }
            if (layout.areas == null) layout.areas = new List<Live2DTouchArea>();

            var area = layout.areas.Find(a => a != null && a.areaId == "default_touch");
            if (area == null)
            {
                area = new Live2DTouchArea { areaId = "default_touch", displayName = "Default Touch", priority = 0 };
                layout.areas.Add(area);
            }
            else if (!_overwriteDefaultTouchArea)
            {
                return;
            }

            area.enabled = true;
            area.shapeType = Live2DTouchShapeType.Rect;
            area.normalizedRect = new Rect(0f, 0f, 1f, 1f);
            area.bindings = new List<Live2DInteractionBinding>
            {
                new Live2DInteractionBinding
                {
                    trigger = Live2DTriggerType.Tap,
                    cooldown = 0.3f,
                    actions = new List<Live2DInteractionAction>
                    {
                        new Live2DInteractionAction
                        {
                            actionType = Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotionGroup,
                            groupId = "all_motions",
                            layerId = Live2DLayerId.Overlay,
                            interruptPolicy = Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade
                        }
                    }
                }
            };
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
        private void DrawSelectedActionEditor()
        {
            var action = SelectedAction;
            if (action == null) return;
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("选中 Action", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
            action.actionType = (Live2DInteractionActionType)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Action Type", action.actionType);
            action.layerId = (Live2DLayerId)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Layer", action.layerId);
            action.interruptPolicy = (Live2DInterruptPolicy)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Interrupt", action.interruptPolicy);

            switch (action.actionType)
            {
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotion:
                    action.motion.library = (Live2DMotionLibrary)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Library", action.motion.library != null ? action.motion.library : _library, typeof(Live2DMotionLibrary), false);
                    if (action.motion.library == null) action.motion.library = _library;
                    action.motion.motionId = DrawMotionIdPopup(action.motion.motionId);
                    action.playAfterMotionOnComplete = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("结束后播放指定 Motion", action.playAfterMotionOnComplete);
                    if (action.playAfterMotionOnComplete)
                    {
                        action.afterMotion.library = (Live2DMotionLibrary)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("After Library", action.afterMotion.library != null ? action.afterMotion.library : _library, typeof(Live2DMotionLibrary), false);
                        if (action.afterMotion.library == null) action.afterMotion.library = _library;
                        action.afterMotion.motionId = DrawMotionIdPopup(action.afterMotion.motionId);
                        action.afterMotionLayerId = (Live2DLayerId)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("After Layer", action.afterMotionLayerId);
                        action.afterMotionInterruptPolicy = (Live2DInterruptPolicy)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("After Interrupt", action.afterMotionInterruptPolicy);
                    }
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotionGroup:
                    action.groupId = DrawGroupIdPopup(action.groupId);
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayParameterAnimation:
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        action.parameterAnimation = (Live2DParameterAnimationAsset)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Parameter Animation", action.parameterAnimation, typeof(Live2DParameterAnimationAsset), false);
                        if (GUILayout.Button("新建", GUILayout.Width(56))) action.parameterAnimation = CreateParameterAnimationAsset(action);
                    }
                    action.parameterApplyMode = (Live2DParameterApplyMode)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Apply Mode", action.parameterApplyMode);
                    DrawParameterAnimationInline(action.parameterAnimation);
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.StopLayer:
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.SwitchLayout:
                    action.layoutId = DrawLayoutIdPopup(action.layoutId);
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.SendEvent:
                    action.eventName = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Event Name", action.eventName);
                    action.payload = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Payload", action.payload);
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayAudio:
                    action.audioKey = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Audio Key", action.audioKey);
                    action.fallbackClip = (AudioClip)EditorGUILayout.ObjectField("Fallback Clip", action.fallbackClip, typeof(AudioClip), false);
                    action.volume = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Volume", action.volume);
                    action.pitch = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Pitch", action.pitch);
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.SetParameterValue:
                    action.parameterId = DrawParameterIdPopup(action.parameterId);
                    action.parameterValue = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Value", action.parameterValue);
                    break;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.ToggleParameterValue:
                    action.parameterId = DrawParameterIdPopup(action.parameterId);
                    action.toggleOffValue = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Off Value", action.toggleOffValue);
                    action.toggleOnValue = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("On Value", action.toggleOnValue);
                    action.toggleThreshold = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Threshold", action.toggleThreshold);
                    break;
            }
            if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck()) MarkChanged();
        }

        private Live2DParameterAnimationAsset CreateParameterAnimationAsset(Live2DInteractionAction action)
        {
            string folder = GetProfileAssetFolder();
            string baseName = SelectedArea != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SelectedArea.areaId) ? SelectedArea.areaId : "parameter_animation";
            string path = AssetDatabase.GenerateUniqueAssetPath($"{folder}/{baseName}_ParameterAnimation.asset");
            var asset = CreateInstance<Live2DParameterAnimationAsset>();
            asset.animationId = System.IO.Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(path);
            asset.displayName = asset.animationId;
            asset.defaultLayerId = action.layerId;
            asset.simpleParameters.Add(new Live2DSimpleParameterSet
            {
                parameterId = action.parameterId,
                value = action.parameterValue,
                applyImmediately = action.parameterApplyMode == Live2DParameterApplyMode.Immediate,
                blendMode = Live2DParameterBlendMode.Override
            });
            AssetDatabase.CreateAsset(asset, path);
            AssetDatabase.SaveAssets();
            Selection.activeObject = asset;
            MarkChanged();
            return asset;
        }

        private void DrawParameterAnimationInline(Live2DParameterAnimationAsset asset)
        {
            if (asset == null) return;
            EditorGUILayout.Space(4);
            EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Parameter Animation 快速编辑", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
            EditorGUI.BeginChangeCheck();
            asset.animationId = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Animation Id", asset.animationId);
            asset.displayName = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Display Name", asset.displayName);
            asset.mode = (Live2DParameterAnimationMode)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Mode", asset.mode);
            asset.duration = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Duration", asset.duration);
            asset.loopMode = (Live2DLoopMode)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Loop", asset.loopMode);
            asset.fadeIn = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Fade In", asset.fadeIn);
            asset.fadeOut = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Fade Out", asset.fadeOut);
            asset.defaultLayerId = (Live2DLayerId)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Default Layer", asset.defaultLayerId);

            if (asset.mode == Live2DParameterAnimationMode.SimpleSet || asset.mode == Live2DParameterAnimationMode.Mixed)
            {
                if (asset.simpleParameters == null) asset.simpleParameters = new List<Live2DSimpleParameterSet>();
                DrawSimpleParameterSetList(asset.simpleParameters);
            }

            if (EditorGUI.EndChangeCheck())
            {
                EditorUtility.SetDirty(asset);
                MarkChanged();
            }
        }

        private void DrawSimpleParameterSetList(List<Live2DSimpleParameterSet> parameters)
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                EditorGUILayout.LabelField("Simple Parameters", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                if (GUILayout.Button("Add", GUILayout.Width(52))) parameters.Add(new Live2DSimpleParameterSet());
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < parameters.Count; i++)
            {
                var parameter = parameters[i];
                if (parameter == null)
                {
                    parameter = new Live2DSimpleParameterSet();
                    parameters[i] = parameter;
                }

                using (new EditorGUILayout.VerticalScope(EditorStyles.helpBox))
                {
                    using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
                    {
                        EditorGUILayout.LabelField($"Parameter {i}", EditorStyles.boldLabel);
                        if (GUILayout.Button("X", GUILayout.Width(24)))
                        {
                            parameters.RemoveAt(i);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    parameter.parameterId = DrawParameterIdPopup(parameter.parameterId, value => parameter.parameterId = value);
                    parameter.value = EditorGUILayout.FloatField("Value", parameter.value);
                    parameter.applyImmediately = EditorGUILayout.Toggle("Apply Immediately", parameter.applyImmediately);
                    parameter.blendMode = (Live2DParameterBlendMode)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup("Blend", parameter.blendMode);
                }
            }
        }

        private string DrawParameterIdPopup(string current, Action<string> onSelected = null)
        {
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                EditorGUILayout.TextField("Parameter Id", FormatParameterLabel(current));
                if (GUILayout.Button("选择", GUILayout.Width(56)))
                {
                    ParameterSelectWindow.Open(GetCubismParameterIds(), GetParameterDisplayNames(), current, value =>
                    {
                        if (onSelected != null) onSelected(value);
                        else
                        {
                            var action = SelectedAction;
                            if (action != null) action.parameterId = value;
                        }
                        MarkChanged();
                        Repaint();
                    });
                }
                if (GUILayout.Button("清空", GUILayout.Width(48)))
                {
                    current = string.Empty;
                    onSelected?.Invoke(current);
                }
            }
            return current;
        }

        private string FormatParameterLabel(string id)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(id)) return string.Empty;
            var names = GetParameterDisplayNames();
            return names.TryGetValue(id, out string displayName) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayName) ? $"{id}  ({displayName})" : id;
        }

        private Dictionary<string, string> GetParameterDisplayNames()
        {
            string path = FindCdi3Path();
            if (_parameterDisplayNames != null && string.Equals(_parameterDisplayNameSourcePath, path, StringComparison.Ordinal)) return _parameterDisplayNames;
            _parameterDisplayNameSourcePath = path;
            _parameterDisplayNames = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return _parameterDisplayNames;
            var asset = AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<TextAsset>(path);
            if (asset == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(asset.text)) return _parameterDisplayNames;
            foreach (Match match in Regex.Matches(asset.text, "\\\"Id\\\"\\s*:\\s*\\\"(?<id>[^\\\"]+)\\\"[\\s\\S]*?\\\"Name\\\"\\s*:\\s*\\\"(?<name>[^\\\"]*)\\\""))
            {
                string id = match.Groups["id"].Value;
                string name = match.Groups["name"].Value;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && !_parameterDisplayNames.ContainsKey(id)) _parameterDisplayNames.Add(id, name);
            }
            return _parameterDisplayNames;
        }

        private string FindCdi3Path()
        {
            string folder = null;
            if (_library != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_library.motionFolderPath)) folder = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(_library.motionFolderPath)?.Replace('\\', '/');
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(folder) && _profile != null)
            {
                string profilePath = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_profile);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(profilePath)) folder = System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(profilePath)?.Replace('\\', '/');
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(folder)) return string.Empty;
            string[] guids = AssetDatabase.FindAssets("t:TextAsset", new[] { folder });
            foreach (string guid in guids)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath(guid);
                if (path.EndsWith(".cdi3.json", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return path;
            }
            return string.Empty;
        }

        private List<string> GetCubismParameterIds()
        {
            var ids = new List<string>();
            var model = _controller != null ? _controller.cubismModel : null;
            if (model == null || model.Parameters == null) return ids;
            foreach (var parameter in model.Parameters)
            {
                string id = GetCubismIdString(parameter);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && !ids.Contains(id)) ids.Add(id);
            }
            return ids;
        }

        private static string GetCubismIdString(Component comp)
        {
            if (comp == null) return string.Empty;
            Type t = comp.GetType();
            var prop = t.GetProperty("Id", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (prop != null) return ConvertCubismIdObject(prop.GetValue(comp, null));
            var field = t.GetField("Id", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (field != null) return ConvertCubismIdObject(field.GetValue(comp));
            return comp.name;
        }

        private static string ConvertCubismIdObject(object idObj)
        {
            if (idObj == null) return string.Empty;
            if (idObj is string s) return s;
            Type t = idObj.GetType();
            var prop = t.GetProperty("Value", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance) ?? t.GetProperty("Name", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (prop != null)
            {
                object value = prop.GetValue(idObj, null);
                if (value != null) return value.ToString();
            }
            return idObj.ToString();
        }

        private string GetProfileAssetFolder()
        {
            if (_profile != null)
            {
                string path = AssetDatabase.GetAssetPath(_profile);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return System.IO.Path.GetDirectoryName(path).Replace('\\', '/');
            }
            return "Assets";
        }

        private void DrawMotionBlock()
        {
            _showMotionControls = EditorGUILayout.Foldout(_showMotionControls, "Motion 预览与关联", true);
            if (!_showMotionControls) return;
            if (_library == null)
            {
                EditorGUILayout.HelpBox("当前未关联 MotionLibrary。", MessageType.Info);
                return;
            }

            _motionSearch = EditorGUILayout.TextField("Search", _motionSearch);
            using (new EditorGUILayout.HorizontalScope())
            {
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_controller == null || !EditorApplication.isPlaying))
                {
                    if (GUILayout.Button("停止 Base 层")) _controller.Mixer.Stop(Live2DLayerId.Base, _controller.defaultFadeOut);
                    if (GUILayout.Button("播放 idle_base")) _controller.PlayGroup("idle_base", Live2DLayerId.Base, Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade, "Editor");
                }
            }

            if (_library.clips == null) return;
            int columns = 3;
            int col = 0;
            EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
            foreach (var clip in _library.clips)
            {
                if (clip == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(clip.motionId)) continue;
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_motionSearch) && clip.motionId.IndexOf(_motionSearch, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) < 0) continue;
                using (new EditorGUI.DisabledScope(_controller == null || !EditorApplication.isPlaying))
                {
                    if (GUILayout.Button(clip.motionId, GUILayout.Height(24)))
                        _controller.PlayMotion(clip.motionId, clip.defaultLayer, clip.interruptPolicy, "EditorPreview");
                }
                col++;
                if (col >= columns)
                {
                    col = 0;
                    EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
                    EditorGUILayout.BeginHorizontal();
                }
            }
            EditorGUILayout.EndHorizontal();
        }
````
