````csharp
        private void Start()
        {
            RefreshCurrentModel();
        }

        private void Update()
        {
            if (_pointer != null && _pointer.active && enableLongPress && !_pointer.longPressTriggered && !_pointer.dragStarted)
            {
                float duration = Time.unscaledTime - _pointer.downTime;
                float move = Vector2.Distance(_pointer.downScreenPos, _pointer.lastScreenPos);
                if (duration >= longPressDuration && move <= tapMaxMovePixels)
                {
                    _pointer.longPressTriggered = true;
                    TryTrigger(_pointer.lastScreenPos, GetTargetEventCamera(), Live2DTriggerType.LongPress);
                }
            }
        }

        public void OnPointerEnter(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            UpdateHover(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, true);
        }

        public void OnPointerExit(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (_hoverArea != null) TriggerArea(_hoverArea, Live2DTriggerType.HoverExit);
            _hoverArea = null;
        }

        public void OnPointerMove(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            UpdateHover(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, true);
        }

        public void OnPointerDown(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            _pointer = new PointerSession
            {
                active = true,
                pointerId = eventData.pointerId,
                downScreenPos = eventData.position,
                lastScreenPos = eventData.position,
                downTime = Time.unscaledTime
            };
            UpdateHover(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, false);
        }

        public void OnBeginDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (!IsActivePointer(eventData)) return;
            _pointer.lastScreenPos = eventData.position;
            if (Vector2.Distance(_pointer.downScreenPos, eventData.position) >= dragStartThresholdPixels)
            {
                _pointer.dragStarted = true;
                TryTrigger(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, Live2DTriggerType.DragStart);
            }
        }

        public void OnDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (!IsActivePointer(eventData)) return;
            _pointer.lastScreenPos = eventData.position;
            UpdateHover(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, true);

            if (!_pointer.dragStarted && Vector2.Distance(_pointer.downScreenPos, eventData.position) >= dragStartThresholdPixels)
            {
                _pointer.dragStarted = true;
                TryTrigger(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, Live2DTriggerType.DragStart);
            }

            if (!_pointer.dragStarted) return;
            if (dragOnlyInsideRawImage && !IsInsideRawImage(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera)) return;
            if (Time.unscaledTime - _pointer.lastDragTriggerTime < dragRepeatInterval) return;

            if (TryTrigger(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, Live2DTriggerType.DragRepeat))
                _pointer.lastDragTriggerTime = Time.unscaledTime;
        }

        public void OnEndDrag(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (!IsActivePointer(eventData)) return;
            TryTrigger(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, Live2DTriggerType.DragEnd);
        }

        public void OnPointerUp(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (!IsActivePointer(eventData)) return;
            _pointer.lastScreenPos = eventData.position;
            bool tap = ShouldTreatAsTap(eventData);
            if (tap) TryTrigger(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, Live2DTriggerType.Tap);
            if (enableSwipe && Vector2.Distance(_pointer.downScreenPos, eventData.position) >= swipeMinDistance)
                TryTrigger(eventData.position, eventData.pressEventCamera, Live2DTriggerType.Swipe);
            _pointer.active = false;
        }

        public void RefreshCurrentModel()
        {
            controller = FindFirstObjectByType<Live2DMotionController>();
            if (controller != null) profile = controller.interactionProfile;
            ApplyProfileTransforms();
        }

        public void RefreshCurrentModel(Live2DMotionController currentController)
        {
            controller = currentController;
            profile = controller != null ? controller.interactionProfile : null;
            ApplyProfileTransforms();
        }

        public bool TryScreenPointToNormalized(Vector2 screenPoint, Camera eventCamera, out Vector2 normalized)
        {
            normalized = default;
            if (targetRawImage == null) return false;
            RectTransform rt = targetRawImage.rectTransform;
            if (!RectTransformUtility.ScreenPointToLocalPointInRectangle(rt, screenPoint, eventCamera, out var localPoint)) return false;
            Rect rect = rt.rect;
            if (!rect.Contains(localPoint)) return false;
            normalized = new Vector2(Mathf.InverseLerp(rect.xMin, rect.xMax, localPoint.x), Mathf.InverseLerp(rect.yMin, rect.yMax, localPoint.y));
            return true;
        }

        public bool IsInsideRawImage(Vector2 screenPoint, Camera eventCamera) => TryScreenPointToNormalized(screenPoint, eventCamera, out _);

        public Camera GetTargetEventCamera()
        {
            if (targetRawImage == null || targetRawImage.canvas == null) return null;
            return targetRawImage.canvas.renderMode == RenderMode.ScreenSpaceOverlay ? null : targetRawImage.canvas.worldCamera;
        }

        public Rect GetRawImageScreenRect()
        {
            if (targetRawImage == null) return default;
            var corners = new Vector3[4];
            targetRawImage.rectTransform.GetWorldCorners(corners);
            var cam = GetTargetEventCamera();
            Vector3 bl = RectTransformUtility.WorldToScreenPoint(cam, corners[0]);
            Vector3 tr = RectTransformUtility.WorldToScreenPoint(cam, corners[2]);
            float xMin = Mathf.Min(bl.x, tr.x);
            float yMin = Mathf.Min(bl.y, tr.y);
            float xMax = Mathf.Max(bl.x, tr.x);
            float yMax = Mathf.Max(bl.y, tr.y);
            return new Rect(xMin, Screen.height - yMax, xMax - xMin, yMax - yMin);
        }

        public Rect NormalizedToScreenGuiRect(Rect normalizedRect)
        {
            Rect imageRect = GetRawImageScreenRect();
            return new Rect(
                imageRect.x + normalizedRect.xMin * imageRect.width,
                imageRect.y + (1f - normalizedRect.yMax) * imageRect.height,
                normalizedRect.width * imageRect.width,
                normalizedRect.height * imageRect.height);
        }

        public Rect ScreenRectToNormalized(Rect screenRect, Camera eventCamera)
        {
            if (!TryScreenPointToNormalized(new Vector2(screenRect.xMin, screenRect.yMin), eventCamera, out var a)) return default;
            if (!TryScreenPointToNormalized(new Vector2(screenRect.xMax, screenRect.yMax), eventCamera, out var b)) return default;
            float xMin = Mathf.Clamp01(Mathf.Min(a.x, b.x));
            float xMax = Mathf.Clamp01(Mathf.Max(a.x, b.x));
            float yMin = Mathf.Clamp01(Mathf.Min(a.y, b.y));
            float yMax = Mathf.Clamp01(Mathf.Max(a.y, b.y));
            return Rect.MinMaxRect(xMin, yMin, xMax, yMax);
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        public Live2DInteractionLayout GetOrCreateEditorRecordingLayout()
        {
            if (profile == null) return null;
            var layout = profile.GetLayout(editorRecordingLayoutId);
            if (layout != null) return layout;
            layout = new Live2DInteractionLayout { layoutId = editorRecordingLayoutId, displayName = editorRecordingLayoutId };
            profile.layouts.Add(layout);
            return layout;
        }

        public Live2DTouchArea CreateRecordedArea(Rect normalizedRect)
        {
            var layout = GetOrCreateEditorRecordingLayout();
            if (layout == null) return null;
            int index = layout.areas != null ? layout.areas.Count + 1 : 1;
            if (layout.areas == null) layout.areas = new List<Live2DTouchArea>();
            var area = new Live2DTouchArea
            {
                areaId = $"{editorRecordingAreaPrefix}_{index}",
                displayName = $"{editorRecordingAreaPrefix} {index}",
                shapeType = editorRecordingShapeType,
                normalizedRect = normalizedRect
            };
            if (area.shapeType == Live2DTouchShapeType.Polygon)
            {
                area.normalizedPoints.Add(new Vector2(normalizedRect.xMin, normalizedRect.yMin));
                area.normalizedPoints.Add(new Vector2(normalizedRect.xMax, normalizedRect.yMin));
                area.normalizedPoints.Add(new Vector2(normalizedRect.xMax, normalizedRect.yMax));
                area.normalizedPoints.Add(new Vector2(normalizedRect.xMin, normalizedRect.yMax));
            }
            layout.areas.Add(area);
            return area;
        }
#endif

        private void UpdateHover(Vector2 screenPoint, Camera eventCamera, bool triggerEvents)
        {
            if (!enableHover || !TryScreenPointToNormalized(screenPoint, eventCamera, out var normalized))
            {
                if (triggerEvents && _hoverArea != null) TriggerArea(_hoverArea, Live2DTriggerType.HoverExit);
                _hoverArea = null;
                return;
            }

            var newHover = profile != null ? profile.Hit(normalized, CurrentBaseMotionId) : null;
            if (newHover == _hoverArea) return;
            if (triggerEvents && _hoverArea != null) TriggerArea(_hoverArea, Live2DTriggerType.HoverExit);
            _hoverArea = newHover;
            if (triggerEvents && _hoverArea != null) TriggerArea(_hoverArea, Live2DTriggerType.HoverEnter);
        }

        private bool TryTrigger(Vector2 screenPoint, Camera eventCamera, Live2DTriggerType trigger)
        {
            if (!TryScreenPointToNormalized(screenPoint, eventCamera, out var normalized)) return false;
            var area = profile != null ? profile.Hit(normalized, CurrentBaseMotionId) : null;
            if (area == null) return false;
            if (_pointer != null && trigger == Live2DTriggerType.DragRepeat) _pointer.lastDragArea = area;
            return TriggerArea(area, trigger);
        }

        private bool TriggerArea(Live2DTouchArea area, Live2DTriggerType trigger)
        {
            if (area == null || controller == null || area.bindings == null) return false;
            if (!acceptTapWhenOverlayPlaying && trigger == Live2DTriggerType.Tap && controller.IsOverlayPlaying) return false;
            bool any = false;
            foreach (var binding in area.bindings)
            {
                if (binding == null || !binding.enabled || binding.trigger != trigger) continue;
                if (Time.unscaledTime < binding.cooldownUntil) continue;
                if (!EvaluateConditions(binding, area, trigger)) continue;
                foreach (var action in binding.actions) any |= controller.ExecuteAction(action, trigger.ToString());
                binding.cooldownUntil = Time.unscaledTime + Mathf.Max(0f, binding.cooldown);
            }
            if (debugLog && any) Debug.Log($"[Live2DInput] {trigger} area={area.displayName}", this);
            return any;
        }

        private bool EvaluateConditions(Live2DInteractionBinding binding, Live2DTouchArea area, Live2DTriggerType trigger)
        {
            if (binding.conditions == null || binding.conditions.Count == 0) return true;
            var context = new Live2DInteractionContext(controller, trigger, area != null ? area.areaId : string.Empty);
            foreach (var condition in binding.conditions)
            {
                if (condition != null && !condition.Evaluate(context)) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }

        private bool IsActivePointer(PointerEventData eventData) => _pointer != null && _pointer.active && _pointer.pointerId == eventData.pointerId;

        private bool ShouldTreatAsTap(PointerEventData eventData)
        {
            if (_pointer == null || !_pointer.active || _pointer.dragStarted || _pointer.longPressTriggered) return false;
            if (Time.unscaledTime - _pointer.downTime > tapMaxDuration) return false;
            return Vector2.Distance(_pointer.downScreenPos, eventData.position) <= tapMaxMovePixels;
        }

        private void ApplyProfileTransforms()
        {
            if (profile == null) return;
            if (applyRawImageTransformFromProfileOnStart && targetRawImage != null && profile.rawImageTransform.enabled)
            {
                var rt = targetRawImage.rectTransform;
                rt.anchoredPosition = profile.rawImageTransform.anchoredPosition;
                rt.localScale = profile.rawImageTransform.localScale;
            }

            if (applyModelTransformFromProfileOnStart && controller != null && controller.cubismModel != null && profile.modelTransform.enabled)
            {
                var t = controller.cubismModel.transform;
                t.localPosition = profile.modelTransform.localPosition;
                t.localEulerAngles = profile.modelTransform.localEulerAngles;
                t.localScale = profile.modelTransform.localScale;
            }
        }

        private void OnGUI()
        {
#if UNITY_EDITOR            
            if (showEditorAreaOverlay && profile != null)
            {
                EnsureWhiteTex();
                var layout = CurrentLayout;
                if (layout != null)
                {
                    foreach (var area in layout.areas)
                    {
                        if (area == null || !area.enabled) continue;
                        if (area.shapeType == Live2DTouchShapeType.Rect)
                        {
                            Rect r = NormalizedToScreenGuiRect(area.normalizedRect);
                            bool selected = area == _editorSelectedArea;
                            DrawRect(r, selected ? new Color(0f, 1f, 1f, 0.16f) : new Color(0f, 1f, 0f, 0.1f));
                            DrawBorder(r, selected ? Color.cyan : (area == _hoverArea ? Color.cyan : Color.green), selected || area == _hoverArea ? 3f : 2f);
                            GUI.Label(new Rect(r.x + 4, r.y + 2, r.width - 8, 20), $"{area.displayName} ({area.priority})");
                            if (enableEditorAreaEditing && selected) DrawEditorHandles(r);
                        }
                        else if (area.normalizedPoints != null && area.normalizedPoints.Count >= 3)
                        {
                            DrawPolygon(area, area == _hoverArea ? Color.cyan : Color.green);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            HandleEditorAreaRecordingGUI();
#endif
        }

#if UNITY_EDITOR
        private void HandleEditorAreaRecordingGUI()
        {
            if (!enableEditorAreaEditing || profile == null || targetRawImage == null) return;
            Event e = Event.current;
            Rect imageRect = GetRawImageScreenRect();
            if (e.type == EventType.MouseDown && e.button == 0 && imageRect.Contains(e.mousePosition))
            {
                _editorSelectedArea = HitEditorArea(e.mousePosition);
                if (_editorSelectedArea != null && _editorSelectedArea.shapeType == Live2DTouchShapeType.Rect)
                {
                    Rect areaRect = NormalizedToScreenGuiRect(_editorSelectedArea.normalizedRect);
                    _editorEditHandle = ResolveEditorHandle(areaRect, e.mousePosition);
                    _editorEditStartRect = _editorSelectedArea.normalizedRect;
                    _editorEditStartGui = e.mousePosition;
                    e.Use();
                    return;
                }

                _editorRecordingDrag = true;
                _editorRecordingStartGui = e.mousePosition;
                _editorRecordingCurrentGui = e.mousePosition;
                e.Use();
            }
            else if (_editorEditHandle != EditorEditHandle.None && e.type == EventType.MouseDrag)
            {
                ApplyEditorAreaEdit(e.mousePosition - _editorEditStartGui);
                UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(profile);
                e.Use();
            }
            else if (_editorEditHandle != EditorEditHandle.None && e.type == EventType.MouseUp && e.button == 0)
            {
                ApplyEditorAreaEdit(e.mousePosition - _editorEditStartGui);
                _editorEditHandle = EditorEditHandle.None;
                UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(profile);
                e.Use();
            }
            else if (_editorRecordingDrag && e.type == EventType.MouseDrag)
            {
                _editorRecordingCurrentGui = e.mousePosition;
                e.Use();
            }
            else if (_editorRecordingDrag && e.type == EventType.MouseUp && e.button == 0)
            {
                _editorRecordingCurrentGui = e.mousePosition;
                Rect guiRect = MakeGuiRect(_editorRecordingStartGui, _editorRecordingCurrentGui);
                Rect screenRect = new Rect(guiRect.x, Screen.height - guiRect.yMax, guiRect.width, guiRect.height);
                Rect normalized = ScreenRectToNormalized(screenRect, GetTargetEventCamera());
                if (normalized.width > 0.001f && normalized.height > 0.001f)
                {
                    _editorSelectedArea = CreateRecordedArea(normalized);
                    UnityEditor.EditorUtility.SetDirty(profile);
                }
                _editorRecordingDrag = false;
                e.Use();
            }

            if (_editorRecordingDrag)
            {
                Rect preview = MakeGuiRect(_editorRecordingStartGui, _editorRecordingCurrentGui);
                DrawRect(preview, new Color(1f, 1f, 0f, 0.15f));
                DrawBorder(preview, Color.yellow, 2f);
            }
        }

        private Live2DTouchArea HitEditorArea(Vector2 guiPoint)
        {
            var layout = CurrentLayout;
            if (layout == null || layout.areas == null) return null;
            Vector2 screenPoint = new Vector2(guiPoint.x, Screen.height - guiPoint.y);
            if (!TryScreenPointToNormalized(screenPoint, GetTargetEventCamera(), out var normalized)) return null;
            Live2DTouchArea best = null;
            int bestPriority = int.MinValue;
            foreach (var area in layout.areas)
            {
                if (area == null || !area.enabled || !area.Contains(normalized)) continue;
                if (area.priority >= bestPriority)
                {
                    best = area;
                    bestPriority = area.priority;
                }
            }
            return best;
        }

        private void ApplyEditorAreaEdit(Vector2 guiDelta)
        {
            if (_editorSelectedArea == null) return;
            Rect imageRect = GetRawImageScreenRect();
            float dx = guiDelta.x / Mathf.Max(1f, imageRect.width);
            float dy = -guiDelta.y / Mathf.Max(1f, imageRect.height);
            Rect r = _editorEditStartRect;

            switch (_editorEditHandle)
            {
                case EditorEditHandle.Move:
                    r.x += dx;
                    r.y += dy;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.Left:
                    r.xMin += dx;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.Right:
                    r.xMax += dx;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.Top:
                    r.yMax += dy;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.Bottom:
                    r.yMin += dy;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.TopLeft:
                    r.xMin += dx;
                    r.yMax += dy;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.TopRight:
                    r.xMax += dx;
                    r.yMax += dy;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.BottomLeft:
                    r.xMin += dx;
                    r.yMin += dy;
                    break;
                case EditorEditHandle.BottomRight:
                    r.xMax += dx;
                    r.yMin += dy;
                    break;
            }

            _editorSelectedArea.normalizedRect = ClampEditorRect(r);
        }

        private static Rect ClampEditorRect(Rect r)
        {
            if (r.width < 0f)
            {
                r.x += r.width;
                r.width = -r.width;
            }
            if (r.height < 0f)
            {
                r.y += r.height;
                r.height = -r.height;
            }
            r.width = Mathf.Clamp(r.width, 0.01f, 1f);
            r.height = Mathf.Clamp(r.height, 0.01f, 1f);
            r.x = Mathf.Clamp(r.x, 0f, 1f - r.width);
            r.y = Mathf.Clamp(r.y, 0f, 1f - r.height);
            return r;
        }

        private static EditorEditHandle ResolveEditorHandle(Rect r, Vector2 p)
        {
            if (GetCornerTopLeft(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.TopLeft;
            if (GetCornerTopRight(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.TopRight;
            if (GetCornerBottomLeft(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.BottomLeft;
            if (GetCornerBottomRight(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.BottomRight;
            if (GetEdgeLeft(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.Left;
            if (GetEdgeRight(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.Right;
            if (GetEdgeTop(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.Top;
            if (GetEdgeBottom(r).Contains(p)) return EditorEditHandle.Bottom;
            return r.Contains(p) ? EditorEditHandle.Move : EditorEditHandle.None;
        }

        private static void DrawEditorHandles(Rect r)
        {
            DrawHandle(GetCornerTopLeft(r));
            DrawHandle(GetCornerTopRight(r));
            DrawHandle(GetCornerBottomLeft(r));
            DrawHandle(GetCornerBottomRight(r));
            DrawHandle(GetEdgeLeft(r));
            DrawHandle(GetEdgeRight(r));
            DrawHandle(GetEdgeTop(r));
            DrawHandle(GetEdgeBottom(r));
        }

        private static void DrawHandle(Rect r)
        {
            DrawRect(r, Color.white);
            DrawBorder(r, Color.black, 1f);
        }

        private static Rect GetCornerTopLeft(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMin - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMin - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, EditorHandleSize, EditorHandleSize);
        private static Rect GetCornerTopRight(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMax - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMin - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, EditorHandleSize, EditorHandleSize);
        private static Rect GetCornerBottomLeft(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMin - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMax - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, EditorHandleSize, EditorHandleSize);
        private static Rect GetCornerBottomRight(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMax - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMax - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, EditorHandleSize, EditorHandleSize);
        private static Rect GetEdgeLeft(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMin - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMin + EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, EditorHandleSize, Mathf.Max(0f, r.height - EditorHandleSize));
        private static Rect GetEdgeRight(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMax - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMin + EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, EditorHandleSize, Mathf.Max(0f, r.height - EditorHandleSize));
        private static Rect GetEdgeTop(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMin + EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMin - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, Mathf.Max(0f, r.width - EditorHandleSize), EditorHandleSize);
        private static Rect GetEdgeBottom(Rect r) => new Rect(r.xMin + EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, r.yMax - EditorHandleSize * 0.5f, Mathf.Max(0f, r.width - EditorHandleSize), EditorHandleSize);

        private static Rect MakeGuiRect(Vector2 a, Vector2 b)
        {
            return Rect.MinMaxRect(Mathf.Min(a.x, b.x), Mathf.Min(a.y, b.y), Mathf.Max(a.x, b.x), Mathf.Max(a.y, b.y));
        }
#endif

        private static void EnsureWhiteTex()
        {
            if (_whiteTex != null) return;
            _whiteTex = new Texture2D(1, 1, TextureFormat.RGBA32, false);
            _whiteTex.SetPixel(0, 0, Color.white);
            _whiteTex.Apply();
        }

        public static void DrawRect(Rect rect, Color color)
        {
            EnsureWhiteTex();
            Color old = GUI.color;
            GUI.color = color;
            GUI.DrawTexture(rect, _whiteTex);
            GUI.color = old;
        }

        public static void DrawBorder(Rect rect, Color color, float thickness)
        {
            DrawRect(new Rect(rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, thickness), color);
            DrawRect(new Rect(rect.x, rect.yMax - thickness, rect.width, thickness), color);
            DrawRect(new Rect(rect.x, rect.y, thickness, rect.height), color);
            DrawRect(new Rect(rect.xMax - thickness, rect.y, thickness, rect.height), color);
        }

        private void DrawPolygon(Live2DTouchArea area, Color color)
        {
            Rect imageRect = GetRawImageScreenRect();
            for (int i = 0; i < area.normalizedPoints.Count; i++)
            {
                Vector2 a = NormalizedPointToGui(area.normalizedPoints[i], imageRect);
                Vector2 b = NormalizedPointToGui(area.normalizedPoints[(i + 1) % area.normalizedPoints.Count], imageRect);
                DrawLine(a, b, color, 2f);
            }
        }

        private static Vector2 NormalizedPointToGui(Vector2 p, Rect imageRect)
        {
            return new Vector2(imageRect.x + p.x * imageRect.width, imageRect.y + (1f - p.y) * imageRect.height);
        }

        private static void DrawLine(Vector2 a, Vector2 b, Color color, float thickness)
        {
            EnsureWhiteTex();
            Matrix4x4 oldMatrix = GUI.matrix;
            Color oldColor = GUI.color;
            float angle = Mathf.Atan2(b.y - a.y, b.x - a.x) * Mathf.Rad2Deg;
            float length = Vector2.Distance(a, b);
            GUI.color = color;
            GUIUtility.RotateAroundPivot(angle, a);
            GUI.DrawTexture(new Rect(a.x, a.y - thickness * 0.5f, length, thickness), _whiteTex);
            GUI.matrix = oldMatrix;
            GUI.color = oldColor;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using Live2D.Cubism.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    public sealed class Live2DCubismBindingCache
    {
        private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _parameterIndexMap = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private readonly Dictionary<string, int> _partIndexMap = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private readonly Dictionary<string, float> _persistentParameterValues = new Dictionary<string, float>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private readonly Dictionary<string, Live2DParameterBlendMode> _persistentParameterBlendModes = new Dictionary<string, Live2DParameterBlendMode>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private CubismParameter[] _parameters = Array.Empty<CubismParameter>();
        private CubismPart[] _parts = Array.Empty<CubismPart>();
        private float[] _defaultParameterValues = Array.Empty<float>();
        private float[] _defaultPartOpacities = Array.Empty<float>();

        public CubismModel Model { get; private set; }

        public void Build(CubismModel model)
        {
            Model = model;
            _parameterIndexMap.Clear();
            _partIndexMap.Clear();
            if (model == null)
            {
                _parameters = Array.Empty<CubismParameter>();
                _parts = Array.Empty<CubismPart>();
                _defaultParameterValues = Array.Empty<float>();
                _defaultPartOpacities = Array.Empty<float>();
                _persistentParameterValues.Clear();
                _persistentParameterBlendModes.Clear();
                return;
            }

            _parameters = model.Parameters ?? Array.Empty<CubismParameter>();
            _parts = model.Parts ?? Array.Empty<CubismPart>();
            _defaultParameterValues = new float[_parameters.Length];
            _defaultPartOpacities = new float[_parts.Length];

            for (int i = 0; i < _parameters.Length; i++)
            {
                _defaultParameterValues[i] = _parameters[i].Value;
                string id = GetCubismIdString(_parameters[i]);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && !_parameterIndexMap.ContainsKey(id)) _parameterIndexMap.Add(id, i);
            }

            for (int i = 0; i < _parts.Length; i++)
            {
                _defaultPartOpacities[i] = _parts[i].Opacity;
                string id = GetCubismIdString(_parts[i]);
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) && !_partIndexMap.ContainsKey(id)) _partIndexMap.Add(id, i);
            }
        }

        public void ResetToDefaults()
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < _parameters.Length; i++) _parameters[i].Value = _defaultParameterValues[i];
            for (int i = 0; i < _parts.Length; i++) _parts[i].Opacity = _defaultPartOpacities[i];
        }

        public void Apply(Live2DEvaluatedParameter evaluated)
        {
            if (evaluated.TargetType == Live2DMotionTargetType.Parameter)
                ApplyParameter(evaluated.Id, evaluated.Value, evaluated.Weight, evaluated.BlendMode);
            else if (evaluated.TargetType == Live2DMotionTargetType.PartOpacity)
                ApplyPartOpacity(evaluated.Id, evaluated.Value, evaluated.Weight);
        }

        public bool TryGetParameterValue(string parameterId, out float value)
        {
            value = 0f;
            if (!_parameterIndexMap.TryGetValue(parameterId, out int index)) return false;
            value = _parameters[index].Value;
            return true;
        }

        public bool ApplyParameter(string parameterId, float value, float weight, Live2DParameterBlendMode blendMode)
        {
            if (!_parameterIndexMap.TryGetValue(parameterId, out int index)) return false;
            float current = _parameters[index].Value;
            float target;
            switch (blendMode)
            {
                case Live2DParameterBlendMode.Additive:
                    target = current + value;
                    break;
                case Live2DParameterBlendMode.Multiply:
                    target = current * value;
                    break;
                default:
                    target = value;
                    break;
            }
            _parameters[index].Value = Mathf.Lerp(current, target, Mathf.Clamp01(weight));
            return true;
        }

        public void ApplyPartOpacity(string partId, float value, float weight)
        {
            if (!_partIndexMap.TryGetValue(partId, out int index)) return;
            _parts[index].Opacity = Mathf.Lerp(_parts[index].Opacity, value, Mathf.Clamp01(weight));
        }

        public bool SetPersistentParameter(string parameterId, float value, Live2DParameterBlendMode blendMode)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameterId)) return false;
            _persistentParameterValues[parameterId] = value;
            _persistentParameterBlendModes[parameterId] = blendMode;
            return ApplyParameter(parameterId, value, 1f, blendMode);
        }

        public void ClearPersistentParameter(string parameterId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(parameterId)) return;
            _persistentParameterValues.Remove(parameterId);
            _persistentParameterBlendModes.Remove(parameterId);
        }

        public void ClearPersistentParameters()
        {
            _persistentParameterValues.Clear();
            _persistentParameterBlendModes.Clear();
        }

        public void ApplyPersistentParameters()
        {
            foreach (var pair in _persistentParameterValues)
            {
                _persistentParameterBlendModes.TryGetValue(pair.Key, out var blendMode);
                ApplyParameter(pair.Key, pair.Value, 1f, blendMode);
            }
        }

        private static string GetCubismIdString(Component comp)
        {
            if (comp == null) return string.Empty;
            Type t = comp.GetType();
            var prop = t.GetProperty("Id", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (prop != null) return ConvertCubismIdObject(prop.GetValue(comp, null));
            var field = t.GetField("Id", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (field != null) return ConvertCubismIdObject(field.GetValue(comp));
            return comp.name;
        }

        private static string ConvertCubismIdObject(object idObj)
        {
            if (idObj == null) return string.Empty;
            if (idObj is string s) return s;
            Type t = idObj.GetType();
            var prop = t.GetProperty("Value", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance) ?? t.GetProperty("Name", BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Instance);
            if (prop != null)
            {
                object v = prop.GetValue(idObj, null);
                if (v != null) return v.ToString();
            }
            return idObj.ToString();
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using Live2D.Cubism.Core;
using Live2D.Cubism.Framework;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    [Serializable]
    public class Live2DMotionRequest
    {
        public Live2DLayerId layerId = Live2DLayerId.Base;
        public Live2DInterruptPolicy interruptPolicy = Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade;
        public Live2DMotionReference motion;
        public string groupId;
        public Live2DParameterAnimationAsset parameterAnimation;
        public Live2DParameterApplyMode parameterApplyMode = Live2DParameterApplyMode.AsTrack;
        public string source;
    }

    public class Live2DMotionController : MonoBehaviour, ICubismUpdatable
    {
        private const int MotionExecutionOrder = 125;

        [Header("References")]
        public CubismModel cubismModel;
        public Live2DMotionLibrary motionLibrary;
        public Live2DInteractionProfile interactionProfile;
        public MonoBehaviour audioEventHandler;
        public MonoBehaviour externalStateProvider;

        [Header("Startup")]
        public bool rebuildLibraryOnAwake = true;
        public bool playIdleOnStart = true;
        public string startupIdleGroupId = "idle_base";
        public bool playEffectOnStart = false;
        public string startupEffectGroupId = "effect";

        [Header("Apply")]
        public bool resetToDefaultValuesBeforeApply = true;
        public float defaultFadeIn = 0.25f;
        public float defaultFadeOut = 0.25f;

        [Header("Default Policies")]
        public Live2DInterruptPolicy baseInterruptPolicy = Live2DInterruptPolicy.QueueUntilFinish;
        public Live2DInterruptPolicy overlayInterruptPolicy = Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade;
        public Live2DInterruptPolicy effectInterruptPolicy = Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade;

        [Header("Debug")]
        public bool debugLog;

        private readonly Live2DMotionMixer _mixer = new Live2DMotionMixer();
        private readonly System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, Live2DMotionRequest> _afterMotionRequests = new System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, Live2DMotionRequest>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        private Live2DMotionRequest _pendingBaseRequest;
        private ILive2DAudioEventHandler _audioHandler;
        private ILive2DExternalStateProvider _externalStateProvider;
        private CubismUpdateController _cubismUpdateController;
        private bool _isInitialized;

        public ILive2DExternalStateProvider ExternalStateProvider => _externalStateProvider;
        public Live2DMotionMixer Mixer => _mixer;
        public int ExecutionOrder => MotionExecutionOrder;
        public bool NeedsUpdateOnEditing => false;
        public bool HasUpdateController { get; set; }
        public string CurrentBaseClipId => _mixer.GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId.Base);
        public string CurrentOverlayClipId => _mixer.GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId.Overlay);
        public string CurrentOverlayExpressionClipId => _mixer.GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId.OverlayExpression);
        public string CurrentOverlayBodyClipId => _mixer.GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId.OverlayBody);
        public string CurrentOverlayEffectClipId => _mixer.GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId.OverlayEffect);
        public string CurrentEffectClipId => _mixer.GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId.Effect);
        public bool IsOverlayPlaying => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentOverlayClipId) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentOverlayExpressionClipId) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentOverlayBodyClipId) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CurrentOverlayEffectClipId);

        private void Awake()
        {
            if (cubismModel == null) cubismModel = GetComponent<CubismModel>() ?? GetComponentInChildren<CubismModel>(true);
            if (cubismModel == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError("Live2DMotionController requires CubismModel.", this);
                enabled = false;
                return;
            }

            if (interactionProfile != null && motionLibrary == null) motionLibrary = interactionProfile.motionLibrary;
            if (motionLibrary != null && rebuildLibraryOnAwake) motionLibrary.BuildRuntimeCache();

            _audioHandler = audioEventHandler as ILive2DAudioEventHandler;
            _externalStateProvider = externalStateProvider as ILive2DExternalStateProvider;
            _mixer.ResetToDefaultBeforeApply = resetToDefaultValuesBeforeApply;
            _mixer.DefaultFadeIn = defaultFadeIn;
            _mixer.DefaultFadeOut = defaultFadeOut;
            _mixer.Build(cubismModel);
            _mixer.MotionCompleted += OnMotionCompleted;
            _mixer.PlayableEventTriggered += OnPlayableEventTriggered;

            _cubismUpdateController = cubismModel.GetComponent<CubismUpdateController>();
            HasUpdateController = _cubismUpdateController != null;
            _isInitialized = true;
        }

        private void Start()
        {
            // Register after every component has completed Awake/OnEnable. This keeps
            // custom motion evaluation inside Cubism's deterministic r5 update chain.
            if (_cubismUpdateController != null)
                _cubismUpdateController.Refresh();

            if (playEffectOnStart) PlayGroup(startupEffectGroupId, Live2DLayerId.Effect, effectInterruptPolicy, "StartupEffect");
            if (playIdleOnStart) PlayGroup(startupIdleGroupId, Live2DLayerId.Base, baseInterruptPolicy, "StartupIdle");
        }

        private void OnDestroy()
        {
            _isInitialized = false;
            _mixer.MotionCompleted -= OnMotionCompleted;
            _mixer.PlayableEventTriggered -= OnPlayableEventTriggered;
        }

        private void LateUpdate()
        {
            if (!HasUpdateController)
                OnLateUpdate();
        }

        public void OnLateUpdate()
        {
            if (!_isInitialized || !isActiveAndEnabled) return;
            _mixer.ResetToDefaultBeforeApply = resetToDefaultValuesBeforeApply;
            _mixer.DefaultFadeIn = defaultFadeIn;
            _mixer.DefaultFadeOut = defaultFadeOut;
            _mixer.Tick(Time.deltaTime);
        }

        public void ResetRuntimeState(bool playStartupMotions = false)
        {
            _pendingBaseRequest = null;
            _afterMotionRequests.Clear();
            _mixer.ResetRuntimeState();
            if (!playStartupMotions || !enabled) return;
            if (playEffectOnStart)
                PlayGroup(startupEffectGroupId, Live2DLayerId.Effect, effectInterruptPolicy, "StartupEffect");
            if (playIdleOnStart)
                PlayGroup(startupIdleGroupId, Live2DLayerId.Base, baseInterruptPolicy, "StartupIdle");
        }

        public bool PlayMotion(Live2DMotionReference motion, Live2DLayerId layerId, Live2DInterruptPolicy interruptPolicy, string source = null)
        {
            if (!motion.IsValid) return false;
            if (motion.library != motionLibrary && motion.library != null) motion.library.BuildRuntimeCache();
            var library = motion.library != null ? motion.library : motionLibrary;
            var runtime = library != null ? library.GetRuntimeData(motion.motionId) : null;
            if (runtime == null) return false;
            return PlayClip(runtime, motion.motionId, layerId, interruptPolicy, source);
        }

        public bool PlayMotion(string motionId, Live2DLayerId layerId, Live2DInterruptPolicy interruptPolicy, string source = null)
        {
            if (motionLibrary == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(motionId)) return false;
            var runtime = motionLibrary.GetRuntimeData(motionId);
            if (runtime == null) return false;
            return PlayClip(runtime, motionId, layerId, interruptPolicy, source);
        }

        public bool PlayGroup(string groupId, Live2DLayerId layerId, Live2DInterruptPolicy interruptPolicy, string source = null)
        {
            if (motionLibrary == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(groupId)) return false;
            string motionId = motionLibrary.PickMotionFromGroup(groupId);
            return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(motionId) && PlayMotion(motionId, layerId, interruptPolicy, source);
        }

        public bool PlayParameterAnimation(Live2DParameterAnimationAsset asset, Live2DLayerId layerId, Live2DInterruptPolicy interruptPolicy, Live2DParameterApplyMode applyMode, string source = null)
        {
            if (asset == null) return false;
            var clip = new Live2DParameterAnimationClip(asset);
            if (applyMode == Live2DParameterApplyMode.Immediate)
            {
                clip.ApplyImmediate(_mixer.BindingCache);
                return true;
            }
            return PlayClip(clip, asset.animationId, layerId, interruptPolicy, source);
        }

        public bool ExecuteAction(Live2DInteractionAction action, string source = null)
        {
            if (action == null || !enabled) return false;
            switch (action.actionType)
            {
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotion:
                    return PlayMotionAction(action, source);
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayMotionGroup:
                    return PlayGroup(action.groupId, action.layerId, action.interruptPolicy, source);
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayParameterAnimation:
                    return PlayParameterAnimation(action.parameterAnimation, action.layerId, action.interruptPolicy, action.parameterApplyMode, source);
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.StopLayer:
                    _mixer.Stop(action.layerId, defaultFadeOut);
                    return true;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.PlayAudio:
                    DispatchAudio(action.audioKey, action.fallbackClip, action.volume, action.pitch);
                    return true;
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.SetParameterValue:
                {
                    _mixer.BindingCache.TryGetParameterValue(action.parameterId, out float beforeValue);
                    bool applied = _mixer.BindingCache.SetPersistentParameter(action.parameterId, action.parameterValue, Live2DParameterBlendMode.Override);
                    _mixer.BindingCache.TryGetParameterValue(action.parameterId, out float afterValue);
                    if (debugLog)
                        Debug.Log($"[Live2D] SetParameterValue id={action.parameterId}, value={action.parameterValue}, applied={applied}, before={beforeValue}, after={afterValue}, source={source}", this);
                    return applied;
                }
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.ToggleParameterValue:
                {
                    bool found = _mixer.BindingCache.TryGetParameterValue(action.parameterId, out float currentValue);
                    if (!found)
                    {
                        if (debugLog) Debug.Log($"[Live2D] ToggleParameterValue id={action.parameterId}, found=false, source={source}", this);
                        return false;
                    }

                    float nextValue = currentValue >= action.toggleThreshold ? action.toggleOffValue : action.toggleOnValue;
                    bool applied = _mixer.BindingCache.SetPersistentParameter(action.parameterId, nextValue, Live2DParameterBlendMode.Override);
                    _mixer.BindingCache.TryGetParameterValue(action.parameterId, out float afterValue);
                    if (debugLog)
                        Debug.Log($"[Live2D] ToggleParameterValue id={action.parameterId}, current={currentValue}, next={nextValue}, threshold={action.toggleThreshold}, applied={applied}, after={afterValue}, source={source}", this);
                    return applied;
                }
                case Live2DInteractionActionType.SendEvent:
                    Debug.Log($"[Live2D] Event: {action.eventName}, payload={action.payload}", this);
                    return true;
                default:
                    return false;
            }
        }

        private bool PlayMotionAction(Live2DInteractionAction action, string source)
        {
            if (!PlayMotion(action.motion, action.layerId, action.interruptPolicy, source)) return false;
            if (action.playAfterMotionOnComplete && action.afterMotion.IsValid)
            {
                _afterMotionRequests[MakeAfterMotionKey(action.layerId, action.motion.motionId)] = new Live2DMotionRequest
                {
                    layerId = action.afterMotionLayerId,
                    interruptPolicy = action.afterMotionInterruptPolicy,
                    motion = action.afterMotion,
                    source = source
                };
            }
            return true;
        }

        private bool PlayClip(ILive2DPlayableClip clip, string clipId, Live2DLayerId layerId, Live2DInterruptPolicy interruptPolicy, string source)
        {
            var layer = _mixer.GetLayer(layerId);
            if (layer.Current != null)
            {
                if (interruptPolicy == Live2DInterruptPolicy.IgnoreIfPlaying) return false;
                if (layerId == Live2DLayerId.Base && interruptPolicy == Live2DInterruptPolicy.QueueUntilFinish && !layer.Current.IsNaturallyFinished() && !layer.Current.Clip.Loop)
                {
                    _pendingBaseRequest = new Live2DMotionRequest { layerId = layerId, interruptPolicy = Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade, source = source };
                    if (clip is Live2DMotionRuntimeData data)
                        _pendingBaseRequest.motion = new Live2DMotionReference { library = motionLibrary, motionId = data.MotionId };
                    return true;
                }
            }

            _mixer.Play(layerId, clip);
            if (debugLog) Debug.Log($"[Live2D] Play {clipId} on {layerId}, source={source}", this);
            return true;
        }

        private void OnMotionCompleted(Live2DMotionEvent e)
        {
            if (_afterMotionRequests.TryGetValue(MakeAfterMotionKey(e.LayerId, e.ClipId), out var afterRequest))
            {
                _afterMotionRequests.Remove(MakeAfterMotionKey(e.LayerId, e.ClipId));
                PlayMotion(afterRequest.motion, afterRequest.layerId, afterRequest.interruptPolicy, afterRequest.source);
                return;
            }

            if (e.LayerId != Live2DLayerId.Base) return;
            if (_pendingBaseRequest != null)
            {
                var req = _pendingBaseRequest;
                _pendingBaseRequest = null;
                PlayMotion(req.motion, Live2DLayerId.Base, Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade, req.source);
                return;
            }
            PlayGroup(startupIdleGroupId, Live2DLayerId.Base, Live2DInterruptPolicy.ImmediateCrossFade, "IdleFallback");
        }

        private static string MakeAfterMotionKey(Live2DLayerId layerId, string clipId) => $"{layerId}:{clipId}";

        private void OnPlayableEventTriggered(Live2DPlayableEvent e)
        {
            if (e.EventType == Live2DPlayableEventType.PlayAudio)
                DispatchAudio(e.AudioKey, e.ObjectReference as AudioClip, 1f, 1f);
        }

        private void DispatchAudio(string audioKey, AudioClip fallbackClip, float volume, float pitch)
        {
            if (_audioHandler != null)
                _audioHandler.PlayAudio(new Live2DAudioEventData(audioKey, fallbackClip, volume, pitch));
            else if (debugLog)
                Debug.Log($"[Live2D] PlayAudio requested: key={audioKey}, clip={(fallbackClip ? fallbackClip.name : "null")}", this);
        }
    }
}
````

## File: Third/Live2d/Runtime/Motion/Live2DMotionLayer.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    public sealed class Live2DMotionLayer
    {
        public Live2DLayerId LayerId { get; }
        public Live2DMotionTrack Current { get; private set; }
        public Live2DMotionTrack Previous { get; private set; }
        public string CurrentClipId => Current != null ? Current.ClipId : string.Empty;

        public Live2DMotionLayer(Live2DLayerId layerId)
        {
            LayerId = layerId;
        }

        public void Play(ILive2DPlayableClip clip)
        {
            if (Current != null)
            {
                Previous = Current;
                Previous.BeginStop();
            }
            Current = new Live2DMotionTrack(clip);
        }

        public void Stop(float fadeOut)
        {
            Current?.BeginStop(fadeOut);
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            Current = null;
            Previous = null;
        }

        public void Update(float dt, List<Live2DPlayableEvent> eventBuffer)
        {
            Previous?.Update(dt, LayerId, eventBuffer);
            if (Previous != null && Previous.IsFullyStopped()) Previous = null;
            Current?.Update(dt, LayerId, eventBuffer);
            if (Current != null && Current.IsFullyStopped()) Current = null;
        }

        public bool IsCurrentNaturallyFinished()
        {
            return Current != null && Current.IsNaturallyFinished();
        }

        public void Evaluate(float defaultFadeIn, float defaultFadeOut, List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> results)
        {
            Previous?.Evaluate(defaultFadeIn, defaultFadeOut, results);
            Current?.Evaluate(defaultFadeIn, defaultFadeOut, results);
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using Live2D.Cubism.Core;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    public sealed class Live2DMotionMixer
    {
        private readonly Live2DCubismBindingCache _bindingCache = new Live2DCubismBindingCache();
        private readonly Dictionary<Live2DLayerId, Live2DMotionLayer> _layers = new Dictionary<Live2DLayerId, Live2DMotionLayer>();
        private readonly List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> _evaluated = new List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter>(256);
        private readonly List<Live2DPlayableEvent> _events = new List<Live2DPlayableEvent>(32);
        private readonly Live2DLayerId[] _applyOrder = { Live2DLayerId.Effect, Live2DLayerId.Base, Live2DLayerId.Overlay, Live2DLayerId.OverlayExpression, Live2DLayerId.OverlayBody, Live2DLayerId.OverlayEffect };

        public event Action<Live2DMotionEvent> MotionStarted;
        public event Action<Live2DMotionEvent> MotionCompleted;
        public event Action<Live2DPlayableEvent> PlayableEventTriggered;

        public Live2DCubismBindingCache BindingCache => _bindingCache;
        public bool ResetToDefaultBeforeApply { get; set; } = true;
        public float DefaultFadeIn { get; set; } = 0.25f;
        public float DefaultFadeOut { get; set; } = 0.25f;

        public void Build(CubismModel model)
        {
            _bindingCache.Build(model);
            EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId.Effect);
            EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId.Base);
            EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId.Overlay);
            EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId.OverlayExpression);
            EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId.OverlayBody);
            EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId.OverlayEffect);
        }

        public Live2DMotionLayer GetLayer(Live2DLayerId layerId) => EnsureLayer(layerId);

        public string GetCurrentClipId(Live2DLayerId layerId) => EnsureLayer(layerId).CurrentClipId;

        public void Play(Live2DLayerId layerId, ILive2DPlayableClip clip)
        {
            if (clip == null) return;
            EnsureLayer(layerId).Play(clip);
            MotionStarted?.Invoke(new Live2DMotionEvent(layerId, clip.ClipId));
        }

        public void Stop(Live2DLayerId layerId, float fadeOut)
        {
            EnsureLayer(layerId).Stop(fadeOut);
        }

        public void ResetRuntimeState()
        {
            foreach (var layer in _layers.Values) layer.Clear();
            _evaluated.Clear();
            _events.Clear();
            _bindingCache.ClearPersistentParameters();
            _bindingCache.ResetToDefaults();
        }

        public void Tick(float dt)
        {
            _events.Clear();
            foreach (var layer in _layers.Values) layer.Update(dt, _events);
            foreach (var e in _events) PlayableEventTriggered?.Invoke(e);

            foreach (var layer in _layers.Values)
            {
                if (layer.IsCurrentNaturallyFinished())
                {
                    string clipId = layer.CurrentClipId;
                    layer.Clear();
                    MotionCompleted?.Invoke(new Live2DMotionEvent(layer.LayerId, clipId));
                }
            }

            Apply();
        }

        private void Apply()
        {
            if (ResetToDefaultBeforeApply) _bindingCache.ResetToDefaults();
            foreach (var layerId in _applyOrder)
            {
                if (!_layers.TryGetValue(layerId, out var layer)) continue;
                _evaluated.Clear();
                layer.Evaluate(DefaultFadeIn, DefaultFadeOut, _evaluated);
                foreach (var e in _evaluated) _bindingCache.Apply(e);
            }
            _bindingCache.ApplyPersistentParameters();
        }

        private Live2DMotionLayer EnsureLayer(Live2DLayerId layerId)
        {
            if (_layers.TryGetValue(layerId, out var layer)) return layer;
            layer = new Live2DMotionLayer(layerId);
            _layers.Add(layerId, layer);
            return layer;
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    [Serializable]
    public class Motion3JsonRoot
    {
        public int Version;
        public Motion3Meta Meta;
        public Motion3CurveJson[] Curves;
        public Motion3UserDataJson[] UserData;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public class Motion3Meta
    {
        public float Duration;
        public float Fps;
        public bool Loop;
        public bool AreBeziersRestricted;
        public int CurveCount;
        public int TotalSegmentCount;
        public int TotalPointCount;
        public int UserDataCount;
        public int TotalUserDataSize;
        public float FadeInTime = -1f;
        public float FadeOutTime = -1f;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public class Motion3CurveJson
    {
        public string Target;
        public string Id;
        public float FadeInTime = -1f;
        public float FadeOutTime = -1f;
        public float[] Segments;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public class Motion3UserDataJson
    {
        public float Time;
        public string Value;
    }

    public enum Live2DMotionTargetType
    {
        Parameter,
        PartOpacity,
        Model,
        Unknown
    }

    public enum Live2DMotionSegmentType
    {
        Linear = 0,
        Bezier = 1,
        Stepped = 2,
        InverseStepped = 3
    }

    public interface ILive2DPlayableClip
    {
        string ClipId { get; }
        float Duration { get; }
        bool Loop { get; }
        float FadeInTime { get; }
        float FadeOutTime { get; }
        IReadOnlyList<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent> CustomEvents { get; }
        void Evaluate(float time, List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> results);
    }

    public readonly struct Live2DEvaluatedParameter
    {
        public readonly string Id;
        public readonly Live2DMotionTargetType TargetType;
        public readonly float Value;
        public readonly float Weight;
        public readonly Live2DParameterBlendMode BlendMode;

        public Live2DEvaluatedParameter(string id, Live2DMotionTargetType targetType, float value, float weight, Live2DParameterBlendMode blendMode)
        {
            Id = id;
            TargetType = targetType;
            Value = value;
            Weight = weight;
            BlendMode = blendMode;
        }
    }

    public interface ILive2DMotionSegment
    {
        float StartTime { get; }
        float EndTime { get; }
        float StartValue { get; }
        float EndValue { get; }
        float Evaluate(float time);
    }

    [Serializable]
    public class Live2DMotionCurveRuntime
    {
        public Live2DMotionTargetType TargetType;
        public string Id;
        public float FadeInTime = -1f;
        public float FadeOutTime = -1f;
        public readonly List<ILive2DMotionSegment> Segments = new List<ILive2DMotionSegment>();

        public float Evaluate(float time)
        {
            if (Segments.Count == 0) return 0f;
            if (time <= Segments[0].StartTime) return Segments[0].StartValue;
            for (int i = 0; i < Segments.Count; i++)
            {
                var segment = Segments[i];
                if (time <= segment.EndTime) return segment.Evaluate(time);
            }
            return Segments[Segments.Count - 1].EndValue;
        }

        public float GetFadeIn(float defaultFadeIn) => FadeInTime >= 0f ? FadeInTime : defaultFadeIn;
        public float GetFadeOut(float defaultFadeOut) => FadeOutTime >= 0f ? FadeOutTime : defaultFadeOut;
    }

    [Serializable]
    public class Live2DMotionRuntimeData : ILive2DPlayableClip
    {
        public string MotionId;
        public float MotionDuration;
        public bool JsonLoop;
        public bool ResolvedLoop;
        public float MotionFadeInTime = 0.25f;
        public float MotionFadeOutTime = 0.25f;
        public readonly List<Live2DMotionCurveRuntime> Curves = new List<Live2DMotionCurveRuntime>();
        public List<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent> CustomEvents { get; set; } = new List<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent>();

        public string ClipId => MotionId;
        public float Duration => MotionDuration;
        public bool Loop => ResolvedLoop;
        public float FadeInTime => MotionFadeInTime;
        public float FadeOutTime => MotionFadeOutTime;
        IReadOnlyList<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent> ILive2DPlayableClip.CustomEvents => CustomEvents;

        public void Evaluate(float time, List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> results)
        {
            foreach (var curve in Curves)
                results.Add(new Live2DEvaluatedParameter(curve.Id, curve.TargetType, curve.Evaluate(time), 1f, Live2DParameterBlendMode.Override));
        }

        public static Live2DMotionRuntimeData FromTextAsset(TextAsset textAsset, string motionId = null)
        {
            if (textAsset == null) return null;
            Motion3JsonRoot root;
            try
            {
                root = JsonUtility.FromJson<Motion3JsonRoot>(textAsset.text);
            }
            catch (Exception e)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"Parse motion3 json failed: {textAsset.name}, {e.Message}");
                return null;
            }

            if (root == null || root.Meta == null || root.Curves == null)
            {
                Debug.LogError($"Parse motion3 json failed: {textAsset.name}");
                return null;
            }

            var data = new Live2DMotionRuntimeData
            {
                MotionId = string.IsNullOrEmpty(motionId) ? textAsset.name : motionId,
                MotionDuration = Mathf.Max(0f, root.Meta.Duration),
                JsonLoop = root.Meta.Loop,
                ResolvedLoop = root.Meta.Loop,
                MotionFadeInTime = root.Meta.FadeInTime >= 0f ? root.Meta.FadeInTime : 0.25f,
                MotionFadeOutTime = root.Meta.FadeOutTime >= 0f ? root.Meta.FadeOutTime : 0.25f
            };

            foreach (var curveJson in root.Curves)
            {
                if (curveJson == null || curveJson.Segments == null || curveJson.Segments.Length < 2) continue;
                var curve = new Live2DMotionCurveRuntime
                {
                    TargetType = ParseTarget(curveJson.Target),
                    Id = curveJson.Id,
                    FadeInTime = curveJson.FadeInTime,
                    FadeOutTime = curveJson.FadeOutTime
                };
                BuildSegments(curveJson.Segments, curve);
                if (curve.Segments.Count > 0) data.Curves.Add(curve);
            }

            if (root.UserData != null)
            {
                foreach (var userData in root.UserData)
                {
                    if (userData == null) continue;
                    data.CustomEvents.Add(new Live2DCustomTimelineEvent
                    {
                        time = userData.Time,
                        eventType = Live2DPlayableEventType.MotionUserData,
                        stringValue = userData.Value
                    });
                }
            }

            data.CustomEvents.Sort((a, b) => a.time.CompareTo(b.time));
            return data;
        }

        private static Live2DMotionTargetType ParseTarget(string target)
        {
            switch (target)
            {
                case "Parameter": return Live2DMotionTargetType.Parameter;
                case "PartOpacity": return Live2DMotionTargetType.PartOpacity;
                case "Model": return Live2DMotionTargetType.Model;
                default: return Live2DMotionTargetType.Unknown;
            }
        }

        private static void BuildSegments(float[] raw, Live2DMotionCurveRuntime curve)
        {
            int index = 0;
            if (!TryRead(raw, ref index, out float currentTime) || !TryRead(raw, ref index, out float currentValue)) return;

            while (index < raw.Length)
            {
                if (!TryRead(raw, ref index, out float typeFloat)) return;
                var type = (Live2DMotionSegmentType)Mathf.RoundToInt(typeFloat);
                switch (type)
                {
                    case Live2DMotionSegmentType.Linear:
                        if (!TryReadPoint(raw, ref index, out float lt, out float lv)) return;
                        curve.Segments.Add(new LinearSegment(currentTime, currentValue, lt, lv));
                        currentTime = lt; currentValue = lv;
                        break;
                    case Live2DMotionSegmentType.Bezier:
                        if (!TryRead(raw, ref index, out float c1t) || !TryRead(raw, ref index, out float c1v) ||
                            !TryRead(raw, ref index, out float c2t) || !TryRead(raw, ref index, out float c2v) ||
                            !TryRead(raw, ref index, out float bt) || !TryRead(raw, ref index, out float bv)) return;
                        curve.Segments.Add(new BezierSegment(currentTime, currentValue, c1t, c1v, c2t, c2v, bt, bv));
                        currentTime = bt; currentValue = bv;
                        break;
                    case Live2DMotionSegmentType.Stepped:
                        if (!TryReadPoint(raw, ref index, out float st, out float sv)) return;
                        curve.Segments.Add(new SteppedSegment(currentTime, currentValue, st, sv));
                        currentTime = st; currentValue = sv;
                        break;
                    case Live2DMotionSegmentType.InverseStepped:
                        if (!TryReadPoint(raw, ref index, out float it, out float iv)) return;
                        curve.Segments.Add(new InverseSteppedSegment(currentTime, currentValue, it, iv));
                        currentTime = it; currentValue = iv;
                        break;
                    default:
                        Debug.LogWarning($"Unknown motion segment type: {type}, curve={curve.Id}");
                        return;
                }
            }
        }

        private static bool TryReadPoint(float[] raw, ref int index, out float time, out float value)
        {
            time = 0f; value = 0f;
            return TryRead(raw, ref index, out time) && TryRead(raw, ref index, out value);
        }

        private static bool TryRead(float[] raw, ref int index, out float value)
        {
            value = 0f;
            if (raw == null || index < 0 || index >= raw.Length) return false;
            value = raw[index++];
            return true;
        }
    }

    public readonly struct LinearSegment : ILive2DMotionSegment
    {
        private readonly float _t0, _v0, _t1, _v1;
        public LinearSegment(float t0, float v0, float t1, float v1) { _t0 = t0; _v0 = v0; _t1 = t1; _v1 = v1; }
        public float StartTime => _t0; public float EndTime => _t1; public float StartValue => _v0; public float EndValue => _v1;
        public float Evaluate(float time) => Mathf.Approximately(_t0, _t1) ? _v1 : Mathf.Lerp(_v0, _v1, Mathf.InverseLerp(_t0, _t1, time));
    }

    public readonly struct BezierSegment : ILive2DMotionSegment
    {
        private readonly float _t0, _v0, _c1t, _c1v, _c2t, _c2v, _t1, _v1;
        public BezierSegment(float t0, float v0, float c1t, float c1v, float c2t, float c2v, float t1, float v1)
        { _t0 = t0; _v0 = v0; _c1t = c1t; _c1v = c1v; _c2t = c2t; _c2v = c2v; _t1 = t1; _v1 = v1; }
        public float StartTime => _t0; public float EndTime => _t1; public float StartValue => _v0; public float EndValue => _v1;
        public float Evaluate(float time)
        {
            if (Mathf.Approximately(_t0, _t1)) return _v1;
            float t = Mathf.InverseLerp(_t0, _t1, time);
            for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
            {
                float x = Cubic(_t0, _c1t, _c2t, _t1, t);
                float dx = CubicDerivative(_t0, _c1t, _c2t, _t1, t);
                if (Mathf.Abs(dx) < 0.00001f) break;
                t = Mathf.Clamp01(t - (x - time) / dx);
            }
            return Cubic(_v0, _c1v, _c2v, _v1, t);
        }
        private static float Cubic(float p0, float p1, float p2, float p3, float t)
        {
            float omt = 1f - t;
            return omt * omt * omt * p0 + 3f * omt * omt * t * p1 + 3f * omt * t * t * p2 + t * t * t * p3;
        }
        private static float CubicDerivative(float p0, float p1, float p2, float p3, float t)
        {
            float omt = 1f - t;
            return 3f * omt * omt * (p1 - p0) + 6f * omt * t * (p2 - p1) + 3f * t * t * (p3 - p2);
        }
    }

    public readonly struct SteppedSegment : ILive2DMotionSegment
    {
        private readonly float _t0, _v0, _t1, _v1;
        public SteppedSegment(float t0, float v0, float t1, float v1) { _t0 = t0; _v0 = v0; _t1 = t1; _v1 = v1; }
        public float StartTime => _t0; public float EndTime => _t1; public float StartValue => _v0; public float EndValue => _v1;
        public float Evaluate(float time) => _v0;
    }

    public readonly struct InverseSteppedSegment : ILive2DMotionSegment
    {
        private readonly float _t0, _v0, _t1, _v1;
        public InverseSteppedSegment(float t0, float v0, float t1, float v1) { _t0 = t0; _v0 = v0; _t1 = t1; _v1 = v1; }
        public float StartTime => _t0; public float EndTime => _t1; public float StartValue => _v0; public float EndValue => _v1;
        public float Evaluate(float time) => _v1;
    }
}
````

## File: Third/Live2d/Runtime/Motion/Live2DMotionTrack.cs
````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    public sealed class Live2DMotionTrack
    {
        private readonly List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> _evaluated = new List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter>(128);
        private int _eventCursor;
        private float _elapsed;
        private float _fadeInElapsed;
        private float _stopElapsed;
        private float _stopFadeOutDuration;
        private bool _stopping;

        public ILive2DPlayableClip Clip { get; }
        public bool IsStopping => _stopping;
        public string ClipId => Clip != null ? Clip.ClipId : string.Empty;

        public Live2DMotionTrack(ILive2DPlayableClip clip)
        {
            Clip = clip;
            _stopFadeOutDuration = clip != null ? clip.FadeOutTime : 0.25f;
        }

        public void Update(float dt, Live2DLayerId layerId, List<Live2DPlayableEvent> eventBuffer)
        {
            if (Clip == null) return;
            float previousTime = GetPlaybackTime();
            _elapsed += dt;
            _fadeInElapsed += dt;
            if (_stopping) _stopElapsed += dt;
            float currentTime = GetPlaybackTime();
            DispatchEvents(previousTime, currentTime, layerId, eventBuffer);
        }

        public void BeginStop(float fadeOut = -1f)
        {
            _stopping = true;
            _stopElapsed = 0f;
            _stopFadeOutDuration = fadeOut >= 0f ? fadeOut : (Clip != null ? Clip.FadeOutTime : 0.25f);
        }

        public bool IsFullyStopped()
        {
            if (!_stopping) return false;
            return _stopFadeOutDuration <= 0f || _stopElapsed >= _stopFadeOutDuration;
        }

        public bool IsNaturallyFinished()
        {
            if (Clip == null) return true;
            if (Clip.Loop) return false;
            return _elapsed >= Clip.Duration;
        }

        public float GetPlaybackTime()
        {
            if (Clip == null || Clip.Duration <= 0f) return 0f;
            return Clip.Loop ? Mathf.Repeat(_elapsed, Clip.Duration) : Mathf.Min(_elapsed, Clip.Duration);
        }

        public void Evaluate(float defaultFadeIn, float defaultFadeOut, List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> results)
        {
            if (Clip == null) return;
            _evaluated.Clear();
            Clip.Evaluate(GetPlaybackTime(), _evaluated);
            float weight = GetWeight(defaultFadeIn, defaultFadeOut);
            if (weight <= 0.0001f) return;
            foreach (var e in _evaluated)
                results.Add(new Live2DEvaluatedParameter(e.Id, e.TargetType, e.Value, weight * e.Weight, e.BlendMode));
        }

        private float GetWeight(float defaultFadeIn, float defaultFadeOut)
        {
            if (Clip == null) return 0f;
            float weight = 1f;
            float fadeIn = Clip.FadeInTime > 0f ? Clip.FadeInTime : defaultFadeIn;
            if (fadeIn > 0f) weight *= Mathf.Clamp01(_fadeInElapsed / fadeIn);

            if (_stopping)
            {
                float fadeOut = _stopFadeOutDuration > 0f ? _stopFadeOutDuration : defaultFadeOut;
                weight *= fadeOut > 0f ? Mathf.Clamp01(1f - _stopElapsed / fadeOut) : 0f;
            }
            else if (!Clip.Loop)
            {
                float remain = Mathf.Max(0f, Clip.Duration - _elapsed);
                float fadeOut = Clip.FadeOutTime > 0f ? Clip.FadeOutTime : defaultFadeOut;
                if (fadeOut > 0f && remain < fadeOut) weight *= Mathf.Clamp01(remain / fadeOut);
            }

            return Mathf.Clamp01(weight);
        }

        private void DispatchEvents(float previousTime, float currentTime, Live2DLayerId layerId, List<Live2DPlayableEvent> eventBuffer)
        {
            var events = Clip.CustomEvents;
            if (events == null || events.Count == 0) return;

            if (Clip.Loop && currentTime < previousTime) _eventCursor = 0;

            while (_eventCursor < events.Count)
            {
                var e = events[_eventCursor];
                if (e == null || e.time > currentTime) break;
                if (e.time >= previousTime || Mathf.Approximately(previousTime, currentTime))
                    eventBuffer.Add(new Live2DPlayableEvent(layerId, ClipId, e));
                _eventCursor++;
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using UnityEngine;

namespace FRFrame.Live2D
{
    public sealed class Live2DParameterAnimationClip : ILive2DPlayableClip
    {
        private readonly Live2DParameterAnimationAsset _asset;
        private readonly List<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent> _emptyEvents = new List<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent>();

        public Live2DParameterAnimationClip(Live2DParameterAnimationAsset asset)
        {
            _asset = asset;
        }

        public string ClipId => _asset != null ? _asset.animationId : string.Empty;
        public float Duration => _asset != null ? Mathf.Max(0f, _asset.duration) : 0f;
        public bool Loop => _asset != null && _asset.ResolvedLoop;
        public float FadeInTime => _asset != null ? Mathf.Max(0f, _asset.fadeIn) : 0f;
        public float FadeOutTime => _asset != null ? Mathf.Max(0f, _asset.fadeOut) : 0f;
        public IReadOnlyList<Live2DCustomTimelineEvent> CustomEvents => _asset != null && _asset.events != null ? _asset.events : _emptyEvents;
        public Live2DParameterAnimationAsset Asset => _asset;

        public void Evaluate(float time, List<Live2DEvaluatedParameter> results)
        {
            if (_asset == null) return;

            if (_asset.mode == Live2DParameterAnimationMode.SimpleSet || _asset.mode == Live2DParameterAnimationMode.Mixed)
            {
                foreach (var set in _asset.simpleParameters)
                {
                    if (set == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(set.parameterId) || set.applyImmediately) continue;
                    results.Add(new Live2DEvaluatedParameter(set.parameterId, Live2DMotionTargetType.Parameter, set.value, 1f, set.blendMode));
                }
            }

            if (_asset.mode == Live2DParameterAnimationMode.CurveAnimation || _asset.mode == Live2DParameterAnimationMode.Mixed)
            {
                foreach (var curve in _asset.curves)
                {
                    if (curve == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(curve.parameterId) || curve.curve == null) continue;
                    results.Add(new Live2DEvaluatedParameter(curve.parameterId, Live2DMotionTargetType.Parameter, curve.curve.Evaluate(time), 1f, curve.blendMode));
                }
            }
        }

        public void ApplyImmediate(Live2DCubismBindingCache bindingCache)
        {
            if (_asset == null || bindingCache == null) return;
            foreach (var set in _asset.simpleParameters)
            {
                if (set == null || !set.applyImmediately || string.IsNullOrEmpty(set.parameterId)) continue;
                bindingCache.SetPersistentParameter(set.parameterId, set.value, set.blendMode);
            }
        }
    }
}
````
